verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Praise be to Allah the Lord of the entire universe.
verses.translation: Praise be to Allah the Lord of the entire universe.

verses.text: The Most Merciful the Most Compassionate;
verses.translation: The Most Merciful the Most Compassionate;

verses.text: The Master of the Day of Recompense.
verses.translation: The Master of the Day of Recompense.

verses.text: You alone do we worship and You alone do we turn to for help
verses.translation: You alone do we worship and You alone do we turn to for help

verses.text: Direct us on to the Straight Way
verses.translation: Direct us on to the Straight Way

verses.text: The way of those whom You have favored
verses.translation: The way of those whom You have favored

verses.text: who did not incur Your wrath who are not astray.
verses.translation: who did not incur Your wrath who are not astray.

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: Praise be to Allah the Lord of the entire universe.
ayahs.translation: Praise be to Allah the Lord of the entire universe.

ayahs.text: The Most Merciful the Most Compassionate;
ayahs.translation: The Most Merciful the Most Compassionate;

ayahs.text: The Master of the Day of Recompense.
ayahs.translation: The Master of the Day of Recompense.

ayahs.text: You alone do we worship and You alone do we turn to for help
ayahs.translation: You alone do we worship and You alone do we turn to for help

ayahs.text: Direct us on to the Straight Way
ayahs.translation: Direct us on to the Straight Way

ayahs.text: The way of those whom You have favored
ayahs.translation: The way of those whom You have favored

ayahs.text: who did not incur Your wrath who are not astray.
ayahs.translation: who did not incur Your wrath who are not astray.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Alif Lam Mim.
verses.translation: Alif Lam Mim.

verses.text: This is the Book of Allah there is no doubt in it; it is a guidance for the pious
verses.translation: This is the Book of Allah there is no doubt in it; it is a guidance for the pious

verses.text: for those who believe in the existence of that which is beyond the reach of perception who establish Prayer and spend out of what We have provided them
verses.translation: for those who believe in the existence of that which is beyond the reach of perception who establish Prayer and spend out of what We have provided them

verses.text: who believe in what has been revealed to you and what was revealed before you and have firm faith in the Hereafter.
verses.translation: who believe in what has been revealed to you and what was revealed before you and have firm faith in the Hereafter.

verses.text: Such are on true guidance from their Lord; such are the truly successful.
verses.translation: Such are on true guidance from their Lord; such are the truly successful.

verses.text: As for those who have rejected (these truths) it is all the same whether or not you warn them for they will not believe.
verses.translation: As for those who have rejected (these truths) it is all the same whether or not you warn them for they will not believe.

verses.text: Allah has sealed their hearts and their hearing and a covering has fallen over their eyes. They deserve severe chastisement.
verses.translation: Allah has sealed their hearts and their hearing and a covering has fallen over their eyes. They deserve severe chastisement.

verses.text: There are some who say:  We believe in Allah and in the Last Day while in fact they do not believe.
verses.translation: There are some who say:  We believe in Allah and in the Last Day while in fact they do not believe.

verses.text: They are trying to deceive Allah and those who believe but they do not realize that in truth they are only deceiving themselves.
verses.translation: They are trying to deceive Allah and those who believe but they do not realize that in truth they are only deceiving themselves.

verses.text: There is a disease in their hearts and Allah has intensified this disease. A painful chastisement awaits them for their lying.
verses.translation: There is a disease in their hearts and Allah has intensified this disease. A painful chastisement awaits them for their lying.

verses.text: Whenever they are told:  Do not spread mischief on earth they say:  Why! We indeed are the ones who set things right.
verses.translation: Whenever they are told:  Do not spread mischief on earth they say:  Why! We indeed are the ones who set things right.

verses.text: They are the mischief makers but they do not realize it.
verses.translation: They are the mischief makers but they do not realize it.

verses.text: Whenever they are told:  Believe as others believe they answer:  Shall we believe as the fools have believed? Indeed it is they who are the fools but they are not aware of it.
verses.translation: Whenever they are told:  Believe as others believe they answer:  Shall we believe as the fools have believed? Indeed it is they who are the fools but they are not aware of it.

verses.text: When they meet the believers they say:  We believe but when they meet their evil companions (in privacy) they say:  Surely we are with you; we were merely jesting.
verses.translation: When they meet the believers they say:  We believe but when they meet their evil companions (in privacy) they say:  Surely we are with you; we were merely jesting.

verses.text: Allah jests with them leaving them to wander blindly on in their rebellion.
verses.translation: Allah jests with them leaving them to wander blindly on in their rebellion.

verses.text: These are the ones who have purchased error in exchange for guidance. This bargain has brought them no profit and certainly they are not on the Right Way.
verses.translation: These are the ones who have purchased error in exchange for guidance. This bargain has brought them no profit and certainly they are not on the Right Way.

verses.text: They are like him who kindled a fire and when it lit up all around him Allah took away the light (of their perception) and left them in utter darkness where they can see nothing.
verses.translation: They are like him who kindled a fire and when it lit up all around him Allah took away the light (of their perception) and left them in utter darkness where they can see nothing.

verses.text: They are deaf they are dumb they are blind; they will never return (to the Right Way).
verses.translation: They are deaf they are dumb they are blind; they will never return (to the Right Way).

verses.text: Or they are like those who encounter a violent rainstorm from the sky accompanied by pitch-dark clouds thunder-claps and flashes of lightning: on hearing thunder-claps they thrust their fingers into their ears in fear of death. Allah encompasses these deniers of the Truth.
verses.translation: Or they are like those who encounter a violent rainstorm from the sky accompanied by pitch-dark clouds thunder-claps and flashes of lightning: on hearing thunder-claps they thrust their fingers into their ears in fear of death. Allah encompasses these deniers of the Truth.

verses.text: It is as if the lightning would snatch their sight; whenever it gleams a while for them they walk a little and when darkness covers them they halt. If Allah so willed He could indeed take away their hearing and their sight. Surely Allah is All-Powerful.
verses.translation: It is as if the lightning would snatch their sight; whenever it gleams a while for them they walk a little and when darkness covers them they halt. If Allah so willed He could indeed take away their hearing and their sight. Surely Allah is All-Powerful.

verses.text: O mankind serve your Lord Who has created you as well as those before you; do so that you are saved.
verses.translation: O mankind serve your Lord Who has created you as well as those before you; do so that you are saved.

verses.text: It is He Who has made the earth a resting-place for you and the sky a canopy and sent down water from above wherewith He brought forth fruits for your sustenance. Do not then set up rivals to Allah when you know (the Truth).
verses.translation: It is He Who has made the earth a resting-place for you and the sky a canopy and sent down water from above wherewith He brought forth fruits for your sustenance. Do not then set up rivals to Allah when you know (the Truth).

verses.text: If you are in any doubt whether it is We Who have revealed this Book to Our servant then produce just a surah like it and call all your supporters and seek in it the support of all others save Allah. Accomplish this if you are truthful.
verses.translation: If you are in any doubt whether it is We Who have revealed this Book to Our servant then produce just a surah like it and call all your supporters and seek in it the support of all others save Allah. Accomplish this if you are truthful.

verses.text: But if you fail to do this   and you will most certainly fail   then have fear of the Fire whose fuel is men and stones and which has been prepared for those who deny the Truth.
verses.translation: But if you fail to do this   and you will most certainly fail   then have fear of the Fire whose fuel is men and stones and which has been prepared for those who deny the Truth.

verses.text: (O Prophet) announce glad tidings to those who believe in this Book and do righteous deeds (in accordance with its teachings) that for them are gardens beneath which rivers flow. Their fruits will have such resemblance to those of the earth that whenever they will be provided with those fruits they will say:  It was this which was granted to us on earth before. For them there shall be pure spouses and there they shall abide forever.
verses.translation: (O Prophet) announce glad tidings to those who believe in this Book and do righteous deeds (in accordance with its teachings) that for them are gardens beneath which rivers flow. Their fruits will have such resemblance to those of the earth that whenever they will be provided with those fruits they will say:  It was this which was granted to us on earth before. For them there shall be pure spouses and there they shall abide forever.

verses.text: Behold! Allah is not ashamed to propound the parable of a gnat or even of something more lowly. On hearing these parables the believers know that it is the truth from their Lord while those bent on denying the Truth say:  What does Allah mean by these parables?  Thus He causes many to go astray just as He directs many to the Right Way. And He thereby causes to go astray only the transgressors
verses.translation: Behold! Allah is not ashamed to propound the parable of a gnat or even of something more lowly. On hearing these parables the believers know that it is the truth from their Lord while those bent on denying the Truth say:  What does Allah mean by these parables?  Thus He causes many to go astray just as He directs many to the Right Way. And He thereby causes to go astray only the transgressors

verses.text: who break the covenant of Allah after its firm binding and cut asunder what Allah has commanded to be joined and spread mischief on earth. They are the utter losers.
verses.translation: who break the covenant of Allah after its firm binding and cut asunder what Allah has commanded to be joined and spread mischief on earth. They are the utter losers.

verses.text: How can you be ungrateful to Allah Who bestowed life upon you when you were lifeless then He will cause you to die and will again bring you back to life so that you will be returned to Him.
verses.translation: How can you be ungrateful to Allah Who bestowed life upon you when you were lifeless then He will cause you to die and will again bring you back to life so that you will be returned to Him.

verses.text: It is He Who created for you all that is on earth and then turned above and fashioned it into seven heavens. He knows all things.
verses.translation: It is He Who created for you all that is on earth and then turned above and fashioned it into seven heavens. He knows all things.

verses.text: Just think when your Lord said to the angels: Lo! I am about to place a vicegerent on earth they said:  Will You place on it one who will spread mischief and shed blood while we celebrate Your glory and extol Your holiness? He said:  Surely I know what you do not know.
verses.translation: Just think when your Lord said to the angels: Lo! I am about to place a vicegerent on earth they said:  Will You place on it one who will spread mischief and shed blood while we celebrate Your glory and extol Your holiness? He said:  Surely I know what you do not know.

verses.text: Then Allah taught Adam the names of all things and presented them to the angels and said:  If you are right (that the appointment of a vicegerent will cause mischief) then tell Me the names of these things.
verses.translation: Then Allah taught Adam the names of all things and presented them to the angels and said:  If you are right (that the appointment of a vicegerent will cause mischief) then tell Me the names of these things.

verses.text: They said.  Glory to You! We have no knowledge except what You taught us.You only You are All-Knowing All-Wise.
verses.translation: They said.  Glory to You! We have no knowledge except what You taught us.You only You are All-Knowing All-Wise.

verses.text: Then Allah said to Adam:  Tell them the names of these things. And when he had told them the names of all things Allah said:  Did I not say to you that I know everything about the heavens and the earth which are beyond your range of knowledge and I know all that you disclose and also all that you hide?
verses.translation: Then Allah said to Adam:  Tell them the names of these things. And when he had told them the names of all things Allah said:  Did I not say to you that I know everything about the heavens and the earth which are beyond your range of knowledge and I know all that you disclose and also all that you hide?

verses.text: And when We ordered the angels:  Prostrate yourselves before Adam all of them fell prostrate except Iblis. He refused and gloried in his arrogance and became one of the defiers.
verses.translation: And when We ordered the angels:  Prostrate yourselves before Adam all of them fell prostrate except Iblis. He refused and gloried in his arrogance and became one of the defiers.

verses.text: And We said:  O Adam live in the Garden you and your wife and eat abundantly of whatever you wish but do not approach this tree or else you will be counted among the wrong-doers.
verses.translation: And We said:  O Adam live in the Garden you and your wife and eat abundantly of whatever you wish but do not approach this tree or else you will be counted among the wrong-doers.

verses.text: But Satan caused both of them to deflect from obeying Our command by tempting them to the tree and brought them out of the state they were in and We said:  Get down all of you; henceforth each of you is an enemy of the other and on earth you shall have your abode and your livelihood for an appointed time.
verses.translation: But Satan caused both of them to deflect from obeying Our command by tempting them to the tree and brought them out of the state they were in and We said:  Get down all of you; henceforth each of you is an enemy of the other and on earth you shall have your abode and your livelihood for an appointed time.

verses.text: Thereupon Adam learned from his Lord some words and repentedand his Lord accepted his repentance for He is Much-Relenting Most Compassionate.
verses.translation: Thereupon Adam learned from his Lord some words and repentedand his Lord accepted his repentance for He is Much-Relenting Most Compassionate.

verses.text: We said:  Get you down from here all of you and guidance shall come to you from Me: then whoever will follow My guidance need have no fear nor shall they grieve.
verses.translation: We said:  Get you down from here all of you and guidance shall come to you from Me: then whoever will follow My guidance need have no fear nor shall they grieve.

verses.text: But those who refuse to accept this (guidance) and reject Our Signs as false are destined for the Fire where they shall abide for ever.
verses.translation: But those who refuse to accept this (guidance) and reject Our Signs as false are destined for the Fire where they shall abide for ever.

verses.text: Children of Israel! Recall My favour which I had bestowed on you and fulfil your covenant with Me and I shall fulfil My covenant with you and fear Me alone.
verses.translation: Children of Israel! Recall My favour which I had bestowed on you and fulfil your covenant with Me and I shall fulfil My covenant with you and fear Me alone.

verses.text: And believe in the Book which I have revealed and which confirms the Scripture you already have and be not foremost among its deniers. Do not sell My signs for a trifling gain and beware of My wrath.
verses.translation: And believe in the Book which I have revealed and which confirms the Scripture you already have and be not foremost among its deniers. Do not sell My signs for a trifling gain and beware of My wrath.

verses.text: Do not confound Truth by overlaying it with falsehood nor knowingly conceal the Truth.
verses.translation: Do not confound Truth by overlaying it with falsehood nor knowingly conceal the Truth.

verses.text: Establish Prayer and dispense Zakah (the Purifying Alms) and bow in worship with those who bow.
verses.translation: Establish Prayer and dispense Zakah (the Purifying Alms) and bow in worship with those who bow.

verses.text: Do you enjoin righteousness on people and forget your own selves even though you recite the Scripture? Have you no sense?
verses.translation: Do you enjoin righteousness on people and forget your own selves even though you recite the Scripture? Have you no sense?

verses.text: And resort to patience and Prayer for help.  Truly Prayer is burdensome for all except the devout
verses.translation: And resort to patience and Prayer for help.  Truly Prayer is burdensome for all except the devout

verses.text: who realize that ultimately they will have to meet their Lord and that to Him they are destined to return.
verses.translation: who realize that ultimately they will have to meet their Lord and that to Him they are destined to return.

verses.text: Children of Israel! Recall My favour which I bestowed upon you exalting you above all nations.
verses.translation: Children of Israel! Recall My favour which I bestowed upon you exalting you above all nations.

verses.text: Fear the Day when no one shall avail another when no intercession will be accepted when no one will be ransomed and no criminal will receive any help.
verses.translation: Fear the Day when no one shall avail another when no intercession will be accepted when no one will be ransomed and no criminal will receive any help.

verses.text: And recall when We rescued you from the slavery of Pharaoh s people who had afflicted you with dreadful suffering slaying your males and sparing your females. That was a tremendous trial for you from your Lord.
verses.translation: And recall when We rescued you from the slavery of Pharaoh s people who had afflicted you with dreadful suffering slaying your males and sparing your females. That was a tremendous trial for you from your Lord.

verses.text: And recall when We split the sea providing passage for you and thus saved you and caused Pharaoh s people to drown before your very eyes.
verses.translation: And recall when We split the sea providing passage for you and thus saved you and caused Pharaoh s people to drown before your very eyes.

verses.text: And recall when We summoned Moses for a term of forty nights and then you set up the calf as your god in his absence. You indeed committed a grave wrong.
verses.translation: And recall when We summoned Moses for a term of forty nights and then you set up the calf as your god in his absence. You indeed committed a grave wrong.

verses.text: Yet We pardoned you that you might be grateful.
verses.translation: Yet We pardoned you that you might be grateful.

verses.text: And recall (that while you were committing this wrong) We gave Moses the Scripture and the Criterion that you are guided to the Right Way.
verses.translation: And recall (that while you were committing this wrong) We gave Moses the Scripture and the Criterion that you are guided to the Right Way.

verses.text: And recall when (on returning with this favour) Moses said to his people:  My people! You have wronged yourselves by taking the calf for an object of worship so turn in repentance to your Creator and kill yourselves. This will be best for you in your Creator s sight.  Thereupon He accepted your repentance. Indeed He is Much-Relenting Most Compassionate.
verses.translation: And recall when (on returning with this favour) Moses said to his people:  My people! You have wronged yourselves by taking the calf for an object of worship so turn in repentance to your Creator and kill yourselves. This will be best for you in your Creator s sight.  Thereupon He accepted your repentance. Indeed He is Much-Relenting Most Compassionate.

verses.text: And recall when you said:  O Moses we will not believe in you until we clearly see Allah (speaking to you).  Thereupon a tremendous thunderbolt struck you before your very eyes.
verses.translation: And recall when you said:  O Moses we will not believe in you until we clearly see Allah (speaking to you).  Thereupon a tremendous thunderbolt struck you before your very eyes.

verses.text: Then We revived you after your extinction that you might be grateful.
verses.translation: Then We revived you after your extinction that you might be grateful.

verses.text: And We caused a cloud to comfort you with shade and We sent down upon you manna and the quails (saying):  Eat of the good wherewithal that We have provided you as sustenance.  And by their sinning (your forefathers) did not wrong Us: it is they themselves whom they wronged.
verses.translation: And We caused a cloud to comfort you with shade and We sent down upon you manna and the quails (saying):  Eat of the good wherewithal that We have provided you as sustenance.  And by their sinning (your forefathers) did not wrong Us: it is they themselves whom they wronged.

verses.text: And recall when We said:  Go into this town and eat abundantly of its food; but enter the gate prostrate saying Repentance .We will forgive you your sins and shall bestow more favour on the doers of good.
verses.translation: And recall when We said:  Go into this town and eat abundantly of its food; but enter the gate prostrate saying Repentance .We will forgive you your sins and shall bestow more favour on the doers of good.

verses.text: Then the wrong-doers substituted another saying for that which had been given them; and so We sent down a scourge upon the wrong-doers from the heavens for their transgression.
verses.translation: Then the wrong-doers substituted another saying for that which had been given them; and so We sent down a scourge upon the wrong-doers from the heavens for their transgression.

verses.text: And recall when Moses prayed for water for his people and We replied:  Strike the rock with your staff.  And there gushed out from it twelve springs and each tribe knew its drinking-place. (Then you were directed):  Eat and drink of the sustenance provided by Allah and do not go about acting wickedly on earth spreading mischief.
verses.translation: And recall when Moses prayed for water for his people and We replied:  Strike the rock with your staff.  And there gushed out from it twelve springs and each tribe knew its drinking-place. (Then you were directed):  Eat and drink of the sustenance provided by Allah and do not go about acting wickedly on earth spreading mischief.

verses.text: And recall when you said:  O Moses surely we cannot put up with one sort of food so pray to your Lord to bring out for us what the earth produces   its herbs and its cucumbers and its corn and its lentils and its garlic and its onions.  Then Moses said:  Will you take a meaner thing in exchange for what is better? Go down to some city and there you shall get what you ask for.  And ignominy and wretchedness were pitched upon them and they were laden with the burden of Allah s wrath. This was because they denied the Signs of Allah and slew the Prophets unrightfully. All this because they disobeyed and persistently exceeded the limits (of the Law).
verses.translation: And recall when you said:  O Moses surely we cannot put up with one sort of food so pray to your Lord to bring out for us what the earth produces   its herbs and its cucumbers and its corn and its lentils and its garlic and its onions.  Then Moses said:  Will you take a meaner thing in exchange for what is better? Go down to some city and there you shall get what you ask for.  And ignominy and wretchedness were pitched upon them and they were laden with the burden of Allah s wrath. This was because they denied the Signs of Allah and slew the Prophets unrightfully. All this because they disobeyed and persistently exceeded the limits (of the Law).

verses.text: Whether they are the ones who believe (in the Arabian Prophet) or whether they are Jews Christians or Sabians   all who believe in Allah and the Last Day and do righteous deeds   their reward is surely secure with their Lord; they need have no fear nor shall they grieve.
verses.translation: Whether they are the ones who believe (in the Arabian Prophet) or whether they are Jews Christians or Sabians   all who believe in Allah and the Last Day and do righteous deeds   their reward is surely secure with their Lord; they need have no fear nor shall they grieve.

verses.text: And recall when We made a covenant with you and caused the Mount Sinai to tower above you (saying):  Hold fast to the Book that We have given you and remember the directives and commandments in it that you be pious.
verses.translation: And recall when We made a covenant with you and caused the Mount Sinai to tower above you (saying):  Hold fast to the Book that We have given you and remember the directives and commandments in it that you be pious.

verses.text: Then you turned away from your covenant and had it not been for Allah s grace and mercy upon you you would have long been utter losers.
verses.translation: Then you turned away from your covenant and had it not been for Allah s grace and mercy upon you you would have long been utter losers.

verses.text: And you know the case of those of you who broke the Sabbath how We said to them:  Become apes despised and hated.
verses.translation: And you know the case of those of you who broke the Sabbath how We said to them:  Become apes despised and hated.

verses.text: And thus We made their end a warning for the people of their own time and for the succeeding generations and an admonition to the God-fearing.
verses.translation: And thus We made their end a warning for the people of their own time and for the succeeding generations and an admonition to the God-fearing.

verses.text: And then recall when Moses said to his people:  Behold Allah commands you to slaughter a cow.  They said:  Are you jesting with us?  Moses answered:  I seek refuge in Allah that I should behave in the manner of the ignorant.
verses.translation: And then recall when Moses said to his people:  Behold Allah commands you to slaughter a cow.  They said:  Are you jesting with us?  Moses answered:  I seek refuge in Allah that I should behave in the manner of the ignorant.

verses.text: They said:  Pray to your Lord that He make clear to us what she is like.  Moses answered:  He says she is a cow neither old nor immature but of an age in between the two. Do then what you have been commanded.
verses.translation: They said:  Pray to your Lord that He make clear to us what she is like.  Moses answered:  He says she is a cow neither old nor immature but of an age in between the two. Do then what you have been commanded.

verses.text: They said:  Pray to your Lord that He make clear to us of what colour she is.  Moses answered:  He says she is a yellow cow with a bright colour which is pleasing to those who see!
verses.translation: They said:  Pray to your Lord that He make clear to us of what colour she is.  Moses answered:  He says she is a yellow cow with a bright colour which is pleasing to those who see!

verses.text: They said:  Pray to your Lord that He make clear to us what cow she is. Cows seem much alike to us and if Allah wills we shall be guided.
verses.translation: They said:  Pray to your Lord that He make clear to us what cow she is. Cows seem much alike to us and if Allah wills we shall be guided.

verses.text: Moses answered:  Lo! He says she is a cow unyoked to plough the earth or to water the tillage one that has been kept secure with no blemish on her!  Thereupon they cried out:  Now you have come forth with the information that will direct us aright.  And they slaughtered her although they scarcely seemed to do so.
verses.translation: Moses answered:  Lo! He says she is a cow unyoked to plough the earth or to water the tillage one that has been kept secure with no blemish on her!  Thereupon they cried out:  Now you have come forth with the information that will direct us aright.  And they slaughtered her although they scarcely seemed to do so.

verses.text: And recall when you killed a man and then began to remonstrate and cast the blame (of killing) upon one another even though Allah was determined to bring to light what you were hiding.
verses.translation: And recall when you killed a man and then began to remonstrate and cast the blame (of killing) upon one another even though Allah was determined to bring to light what you were hiding.

verses.text: Then We ordered:  Smite the corpse with a part of it.  Thus does Allah bring the dead to life and thus does He show His Signs that you might understand.
verses.translation: Then We ordered:  Smite the corpse with a part of it.  Thus does Allah bring the dead to life and thus does He show His Signs that you might understand.

verses.text: Then (even after observing this) your hearts hardened and became like stones or even harder. For surely there are some stones from which streams burst forth and some that split asunder and water issues out and some that crash down for fear of Allah. Allah is not heedless of the things you do.
verses.translation: Then (even after observing this) your hearts hardened and became like stones or even harder. For surely there are some stones from which streams burst forth and some that split asunder and water issues out and some that crash down for fear of Allah. Allah is not heedless of the things you do.

verses.text: Do you hope that these people will believe in the Message you are preaching even though a party of them has been wont to listen to the Word of Allah and after they had fully grasped it knowingly distorted it?
verses.translation: Do you hope that these people will believe in the Message you are preaching even though a party of them has been wont to listen to the Word of Allah and after they had fully grasped it knowingly distorted it?

verses.text: And when they meet those who believe (in Muhammad) they say:  We too believe in him.  But in their intimate meetings they say to one another:  How foolish! Why should you intimate to them what Allah has revealed to you for they will use it as argument against you before your Lord?
verses.translation: And when they meet those who believe (in Muhammad) they say:  We too believe in him.  But in their intimate meetings they say to one another:  How foolish! Why should you intimate to them what Allah has revealed to you for they will use it as argument against you before your Lord?

verses.text: Are they unaware that Allah knows all that they hide and all that they disclose?
verses.translation: Are they unaware that Allah knows all that they hide and all that they disclose?

verses.text: Among them are also the unlettered folk who do not know about the Scriptures but cherish baseless wishes and merely follow their conjectures.
verses.translation: Among them are also the unlettered folk who do not know about the Scriptures but cherish baseless wishes and merely follow their conjectures.

verses.text: Woe then to those who write out the Scriptures with their own hands and then in order to make a trifling gain claim:  This is from Allah. Woe to them for what their hands have written and woe to them for what they thus earn.
verses.translation: Woe then to those who write out the Scriptures with their own hands and then in order to make a trifling gain claim:  This is from Allah. Woe to them for what their hands have written and woe to them for what they thus earn.

verses.text: They say:  The Fire will certainly not touch us except for a limited number of days. Say (to them):  Have you received a promise from Allah   for Allah never breaks His promise   or do you attribute to Allah something about which you have no knowledge?
verses.translation: They say:  The Fire will certainly not touch us except for a limited number of days. Say (to them):  Have you received a promise from Allah   for Allah never breaks His promise   or do you attribute to Allah something about which you have no knowledge?

verses.text: Those who earn evil and are encompassed by their sinfulness are the people of the Fire and there will they abide;
verses.translation: Those who earn evil and are encompassed by their sinfulness are the people of the Fire and there will they abide;

verses.text: those who believe and do righteous deeds are the people of the Garden and there will they abide.
verses.translation: those who believe and do righteous deeds are the people of the Garden and there will they abide.

verses.text: And recall when We made a covenant with the Children of Israel:  You shall serve none but Allah and do good to parents kinsmen orphans and the needy; you shall speak kindly to people and establish Prayer and give Zakah (Purifying Alms). And yet except for a few of you you turned back on this covenant and you are still backsliders.
verses.translation: And recall when We made a covenant with the Children of Israel:  You shall serve none but Allah and do good to parents kinsmen orphans and the needy; you shall speak kindly to people and establish Prayer and give Zakah (Purifying Alms). And yet except for a few of you you turned back on this covenant and you are still backsliders.

verses.text: And recall when We made a covenant with you that you shall not shed one another s blood and shall not turn out one another from your homelands; you confirmed it and you yourselves are witnesses to it.
verses.translation: And recall when We made a covenant with you that you shall not shed one another s blood and shall not turn out one another from your homelands; you confirmed it and you yourselves are witnesses to it.

verses.text: And here you are killing one another turning out a party of your own from their homelands aiding one another against them in sin and enmity and if they come to you as captives you ransom them although the very act of expelling them was unlawful to you. Do you believe in a part of the Scripture and reject the rest? What else then could be the retribution of those among you who do this than that they should live in degradation in the present life and that on the Day of Resurrection they should be sent to the severest chastisement? Allah is not heedless of what you do.
verses.translation: And here you are killing one another turning out a party of your own from their homelands aiding one another against them in sin and enmity and if they come to you as captives you ransom them although the very act of expelling them was unlawful to you. Do you believe in a part of the Scripture and reject the rest? What else then could be the retribution of those among you who do this than that they should live in degradation in the present life and that on the Day of Resurrection they should be sent to the severest chastisement? Allah is not heedless of what you do.

verses.text: These are the ones who have bought the present life in exchange for the World to Come. Their chastisement shall not be lightened nor shall they be helped.
verses.translation: These are the ones who have bought the present life in exchange for the World to Come. Their chastisement shall not be lightened nor shall they be helped.

verses.text: Surely We gave Moses the Scripture and caused a train of Messengers to follow him and then sent Jesus the son of Mary with Clear Proofs and supported him with the spirit of holiness.But is it not true that every time a Messenger brought to you something that was not to your liking you acted arrogantly: you called some Messengers liars and killed others?
verses.translation: Surely We gave Moses the Scripture and caused a train of Messengers to follow him and then sent Jesus the son of Mary with Clear Proofs and supported him with the spirit of holiness.But is it not true that every time a Messenger brought to you something that was not to your liking you acted arrogantly: you called some Messengers liars and killed others?

verses.text: They say:  Our hearts are well-protected. No! The fact is that Allah has cursed them because of their denying the Truth. So scarcely do they believe.
verses.translation: They say:  Our hearts are well-protected. No! The fact is that Allah has cursed them because of their denying the Truth. So scarcely do they believe.

verses.text: And now that there has come to them a Book from Allah how are they treating it? Even though it confirms the Truth already in their possession and even though they had prayed for victory against the unbelievers and yet when that Book came to them   and they recognized it   they refused to acknowledge its Truth. Allah s curse be upon the unbelievers.
verses.translation: And now that there has come to them a Book from Allah how are they treating it? Even though it confirms the Truth already in their possession and even though they had prayed for victory against the unbelievers and yet when that Book came to them   and they recognized it   they refused to acknowledge its Truth. Allah s curse be upon the unbelievers.

verses.text: Evil indeed is what they console themselves with. They deny the guidance revealed by Allah grudging that He chose to bestow His gracious bounty (of revelation and prophethood) on some of His servants whom He willed. Thus they have brought on themselves wrath after wrath and a humiliating chastisement is in store for such unbelievers.
verses.translation: Evil indeed is what they console themselves with. They deny the guidance revealed by Allah grudging that He chose to bestow His gracious bounty (of revelation and prophethood) on some of His servants whom He willed. Thus they have brought on themselves wrath after wrath and a humiliating chastisement is in store for such unbelievers.

verses.text: When they are told:  Believe in what Allah has revealed they say:  We believe only in what was revealed to us (Israel).  They deny everything else even though it be the Truth which confirms what they possess. Say (to them):  If indeed you are believers why is it that in the past you killed the Prophets of Allah (who were from Israel)?
verses.translation: When they are told:  Believe in what Allah has revealed they say:  We believe only in what was revealed to us (Israel).  They deny everything else even though it be the Truth which confirms what they possess. Say (to them):  If indeed you are believers why is it that in the past you killed the Prophets of Allah (who were from Israel)?

verses.text: Moses came to you with clear proofs and yet you were so wont to wrong-doing that as soon as he was gone you took to worshipping the calf.
verses.translation: Moses came to you with clear proofs and yet you were so wont to wrong-doing that as soon as he was gone you took to worshipping the calf.

verses.text: Recall the covenant We made with you and caused the Mount to tower above you stressing:  Hold to what We have given you with full strength and give heed to it.  But their forefathers said:  We hear but we disobey    for their hearts were overflowing with love for the calf because of their unbelief. Say:  If you are people of faith then evil are the things that your faith enjoins upon you.
verses.translation: Recall the covenant We made with you and caused the Mount to tower above you stressing:  Hold to what We have given you with full strength and give heed to it.  But their forefathers said:  We hear but we disobey    for their hearts were overflowing with love for the calf because of their unbelief. Say:  If you are people of faith then evil are the things that your faith enjoins upon you.

verses.text: Say to them:  If indeed the Last Abode with Allah is yours in exclusion of other people then long for death if you are truthful.
verses.translation: Say to them:  If indeed the Last Abode with Allah is yours in exclusion of other people then long for death if you are truthful.

verses.text: But they shall never long for it because of the (evil) deeds they have committed; Allah is well aware of the wrong-doers.
verses.translation: But they shall never long for it because of the (evil) deeds they have committed; Allah is well aware of the wrong-doers.

verses.text: You will certainly find them most eager to cling on to life indeed even more eager than those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity. Each one of them wishes to live a thousand years although the bestowal of long life cannot remove him from chastisement. Allah sees whatever they do.
verses.translation: You will certainly find them most eager to cling on to life indeed even more eager than those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity. Each one of them wishes to live a thousand years although the bestowal of long life cannot remove him from chastisement. Allah sees whatever they do.

verses.text: Say:  Whoever is an enemy to Gabriel (should know that) he revealed this (Qur an) to your heart by Allah s leave: it confirms the Scriptures revealed before it and is a guidance and good tiding to the people of faith.
verses.translation: Say:  Whoever is an enemy to Gabriel (should know that) he revealed this (Qur an) to your heart by Allah s leave: it confirms the Scriptures revealed before it and is a guidance and good tiding to the people of faith.

verses.text: (And if this is the cause of their hostility to Gabriel let them know) whoever is an enemy to Allah His Angels and His Messengers and to Gabriel and Michael will surely find Allah an enemy to such unbelievers.
verses.translation: (And if this is the cause of their hostility to Gabriel let them know) whoever is an enemy to Allah His Angels and His Messengers and to Gabriel and Michael will surely find Allah an enemy to such unbelievers.

verses.text: We surely sent down to you clear verses that elucidate the Truth (verses) which only the transgressors reject as false.
verses.translation: We surely sent down to you clear verses that elucidate the Truth (verses) which only the transgressors reject as false.

verses.text: Is it not that every time they made a covenant with Allah a party of them set it aside? The truth is that most of them do not truly believe.
verses.translation: Is it not that every time they made a covenant with Allah a party of them set it aside? The truth is that most of them do not truly believe.

verses.text: And whenever a Messenger from Allah came to them confirming what they already possessed a party of those who had been given the Scripture flung the Book of Allah behind their backs as if they knew nothing
verses.translation: And whenever a Messenger from Allah came to them confirming what they already possessed a party of those who had been given the Scripture flung the Book of Allah behind their backs as if they knew nothing

verses.text: and then followed what the evil ones falsely attributed to the Kingdom of Solomon even though Solomon had never disbelieved; it is the evil ones who disbelieved teaching people magic. And they followed what had been revealed to the two angels in Babylon   Harut and Marut   although these two (angels) never taught it to anyone without first declaring:  We are merely a means of testing people; so do not engage in unbelief. And yet they learned from them what might cause division between a man and his wife. They could not cause harm to anyone except by the leave of Allah and still they learned what harmed rather than profited them knowing well that he who bought it will have no share in the World to Come. Evil indeed is what they sold themselves for. Had they but known!
verses.translation: and then followed what the evil ones falsely attributed to the Kingdom of Solomon even though Solomon had never disbelieved; it is the evil ones who disbelieved teaching people magic. And they followed what had been revealed to the two angels in Babylon   Harut and Marut   although these two (angels) never taught it to anyone without first declaring:  We are merely a means of testing people; so do not engage in unbelief. And yet they learned from them what might cause division between a man and his wife. They could not cause harm to anyone except by the leave of Allah and still they learned what harmed rather than profited them knowing well that he who bought it will have no share in the World to Come. Evil indeed is what they sold themselves for. Had they but known!

verses.text: Had they believed and been God-fearing Allah s reward would have been better! Had they but known!
verses.translation: Had they believed and been God-fearing Allah s reward would have been better! Had they but known!

verses.text: O you who believe! Do not say (to the Prophet): Ra''ina (Lend ear to us) but say Unzurna (Favour us with your attention) and pay heed (to him). A painful chastisement awaits the unbelievers.
verses.translation: O you who believe! Do not say (to the Prophet): Ra''ina (Lend ear to us) but say Unzurna (Favour us with your attention) and pay heed (to him). A painful chastisement awaits the unbelievers.

verses.text: The unbelievers be they the People of the Book or those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity do not wish that any good should be sent down upon you from your Lord. But Allah chooses for His mercy whomsoever He wills. Allah is Lord of Abounding Bounty.
verses.translation: The unbelievers be they the People of the Book or those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity do not wish that any good should be sent down upon you from your Lord. But Allah chooses for His mercy whomsoever He wills. Allah is Lord of Abounding Bounty.

verses.text: For whatever verse We might abrogate or consign to oblivion We bring a better one or the like of it. Are you not aware that Allah is All-Powerful?
verses.translation: For whatever verse We might abrogate or consign to oblivion We bring a better one or the like of it. Are you not aware that Allah is All-Powerful?

verses.text: Are you not aware that the dominion of the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah and that none apart from Allah is your protector or helper?
verses.translation: Are you not aware that the dominion of the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah and that none apart from Allah is your protector or helper?

verses.text: Or would you ask your Messenger in the manner Moses was asked before? And whoever exchanges faith for unbelief has surely strayed from the Right Way.
verses.translation: Or would you ask your Messenger in the manner Moses was asked before? And whoever exchanges faith for unbelief has surely strayed from the Right Way.

verses.text: Out of sheer envy many People of the Book would be glad to turn you back into unbelievers after you have become believers even though the Truth has become clear to them. Nevertheless forgive and be indulgent towards them until Allah brings forth His decision. Surely Allah is All-Powerful.
verses.translation: Out of sheer envy many People of the Book would be glad to turn you back into unbelievers after you have become believers even though the Truth has become clear to them. Nevertheless forgive and be indulgent towards them until Allah brings forth His decision. Surely Allah is All-Powerful.

verses.text: Establish Prayer and dispense Zakah. Whatever good deeds you send forth for your own good you will find them with Allah. Surely Allah sees all that you do.
verses.translation: Establish Prayer and dispense Zakah. Whatever good deeds you send forth for your own good you will find them with Allah. Surely Allah sees all that you do.

verses.text: They say:  None shall enter the Garden unless he be a Jew or (according to the Christians) a Christian.  These are their vain desires. Say:  Bring your proof if you are speaking the truth.
verses.translation: They say:  None shall enter the Garden unless he be a Jew or (according to the Christians) a Christian.  These are their vain desires. Say:  Bring your proof if you are speaking the truth.

verses.text: (None has any special claim upon reward from Allah.) Whoever submits himself completely to the obedience of Allah and does good will find his reward with his Lord. No fear shall come upon them nor shall they grieve.
verses.translation: (None has any special claim upon reward from Allah.) Whoever submits himself completely to the obedience of Allah and does good will find his reward with his Lord. No fear shall come upon them nor shall they grieve.

verses.text: The Jews say:  The Christians have no basis for their beliefs and the Christians say:  The Jews have no basis for their beliefs.  They say so even though they read the Scripture. The claim of those who have no knowledge (of the Scripture) is similar. Allah will judge between them concerning their differences on the Day of Resurrection.
verses.translation: The Jews say:  The Christians have no basis for their beliefs and the Christians say:  The Jews have no basis for their beliefs.  They say so even though they read the Scripture. The claim of those who have no knowledge (of the Scripture) is similar. Allah will judge between them concerning their differences on the Day of Resurrection.

verses.text: Who is more iniquitous than he who bars Allah s places of worship that His name be mentioned there and seeks their destruction? It does not behove such people to enter them and should they enter they should enter in fear. There is degradation for them in this world and a mighty chastisement in the Next.
verses.translation: Who is more iniquitous than he who bars Allah s places of worship that His name be mentioned there and seeks their destruction? It does not behove such people to enter them and should they enter they should enter in fear. There is degradation for them in this world and a mighty chastisement in the Next.

verses.text: The East and the West belong to Allah. To whichever direction you turn you will be turning to Allah. Allah is All-Embracing All-Knowing.
verses.translation: The East and the West belong to Allah. To whichever direction you turn you will be turning to Allah. Allah is All-Embracing All-Knowing.

verses.text: They say:  Allah has taken to Himself a son.  Glory to Him! Nay whatever is in the heavens and the earth belongs to Him; to Him are all in obeisance.
verses.translation: They say:  Allah has taken to Himself a son.  Glory to Him! Nay whatever is in the heavens and the earth belongs to Him; to Him are all in obeisance.

verses.text: He is the Originator of the heavens and the earth; whenever He decrees a matter He (merely) says:  Be and it is.
verses.translation: He is the Originator of the heavens and the earth; whenever He decrees a matter He (merely) says:  Be and it is.

verses.text: The ignorant say:  Why does Allah not speak to us? Why does no Sign come to us?  The same was said by people before them. Their hearts are all alike. We have made the Signs clear for people of firm faith.
verses.translation: The ignorant say:  Why does Allah not speak to us? Why does no Sign come to us?  The same was said by people before them. Their hearts are all alike. We have made the Signs clear for people of firm faith.

verses.text: (What greater Sign can there be than that) We sent you with the Truth as a bearer of good tidings and a warner! And you will not be answerable about the people of the Blazing Flame!
verses.translation: (What greater Sign can there be than that) We sent you with the Truth as a bearer of good tidings and a warner! And you will not be answerable about the people of the Blazing Flame!

verses.text: Never will the Jews be pleased with you (O Prophet) nor the Christians until you follow their way. Say:  Surely Allah s guidance is the true guidance.  Should you follow their desires disregarding the knowledge which has come to you you shall have no protector or helper against Allah.
verses.translation: Never will the Jews be pleased with you (O Prophet) nor the Christians until you follow their way. Say:  Surely Allah s guidance is the true guidance.  Should you follow their desires disregarding the knowledge which has come to you you shall have no protector or helper against Allah.

verses.text: Those to whom We have given the Scripture and who recite it as it ought to be recited they truly believe in it; and those who disbelieve in it they are the real losers.
verses.translation: Those to whom We have given the Scripture and who recite it as it ought to be recited they truly believe in it; and those who disbelieve in it they are the real losers.

verses.text: Children of Israel! Recall My favour which I bestowed upon you and I exalted you above the nations of the world
verses.translation: Children of Israel! Recall My favour which I bestowed upon you and I exalted you above the nations of the world

verses.text: and beware of the Day when no one shall avail another when ransom shall be accepted from no one when no one s intercession will profit anyone when there shall be no help from any quarter.
verses.translation: and beware of the Day when no one shall avail another when ransom shall be accepted from no one when no one s intercession will profit anyone when there shall be no help from any quarter.

verses.text: Recall when Abraham s Lord tested him in certain matters and when he successfully stood the test He said:  Indeed I am going to appoint you a leader of all people.  When Abraham asked:  And is this covenant also for my descendants?  the Lord responded:  My covenant does not embrace the wrong-doers.
verses.translation: Recall when Abraham s Lord tested him in certain matters and when he successfully stood the test He said:  Indeed I am going to appoint you a leader of all people.  When Abraham asked:  And is this covenant also for my descendants?  the Lord responded:  My covenant does not embrace the wrong-doers.

verses.text: And We made this House (Ka''bah) a resort for mankind and a place of security commanding people:  Take the station of Abraham as a permanent place for Prayer and enjoined Abraham and Ishmael:  Purify My House for those who walk around it and those who abide in devotion and those who bow and who prostrate themselves (in Prayer).
verses.translation: And We made this House (Ka''bah) a resort for mankind and a place of security commanding people:  Take the station of Abraham as a permanent place for Prayer and enjoined Abraham and Ishmael:  Purify My House for those who walk around it and those who abide in devotion and those who bow and who prostrate themselves (in Prayer).

verses.text: And when Abraham prayed:  O my Lord! Make this a place of security and provide those of its people that believe in Allah and the Last Day with fruits for sustenance Allah answered And I shall still provide him who disbelieves with the wherewithal for this short life and then I shall drive him to the chastisement of the Fire; that is an evil end.
verses.translation: And when Abraham prayed:  O my Lord! Make this a place of security and provide those of its people that believe in Allah and the Last Day with fruits for sustenance Allah answered And I shall still provide him who disbelieves with the wherewithal for this short life and then I shall drive him to the chastisement of the Fire; that is an evil end.

verses.text: Recall when Abraham and Ishmael raised the foundations of the House praying:  Our Lord! Accept this from us; You are All-Hearing All-Knowing.
verses.translation: Recall when Abraham and Ishmael raised the foundations of the House praying:  Our Lord! Accept this from us; You are All-Hearing All-Knowing.

verses.text: Our Lord! Make us submissive to You and make out of our descendants a community that submits itself to You and show us the ways of Your worship and turn to us in mercy. You are Much-Relenting Most Compassionate.
verses.translation: Our Lord! Make us submissive to You and make out of our descendants a community that submits itself to You and show us the ways of Your worship and turn to us in mercy. You are Much-Relenting Most Compassionate.

verses.text: Our Lord! Raise up in the midst of our offspring a Messenger from among them who shall recite to them Your verses and instruct them in the Book and in Wisdom and purify their lives. Verily You are the Most Mighty the Most Wise.
verses.translation: Our Lord! Raise up in the midst of our offspring a Messenger from among them who shall recite to them Your verses and instruct them in the Book and in Wisdom and purify their lives. Verily You are the Most Mighty the Most Wise.

verses.text: And who but a fool would be averse to the way of Abraham? For it is We Who chose Abraham for Our mission in this world and surely in the World to Come he shall be reckoned among the righteous.
verses.translation: And who but a fool would be averse to the way of Abraham? For it is We Who chose Abraham for Our mission in this world and surely in the World to Come he shall be reckoned among the righteous.

verses.text: Such was Abraham that when his Lord said to him:  Submit he said:  I have submitted to the Lord of the Universe.
verses.translation: Such was Abraham that when his Lord said to him:  Submit he said:  I have submitted to the Lord of the Universe.

verses.text: And Abraham enjoined the same upon his children and so did Jacob: My children! Behold Allah has chosen this religion for you. Remain till death in submission (to Allah).
verses.translation: And Abraham enjoined the same upon his children and so did Jacob: My children! Behold Allah has chosen this religion for you. Remain till death in submission (to Allah).

verses.text: Why were you witnesses when death came to Jacob? He asked his children:  Whom will you serve after me?  They said:  We shall serve your God the God of your forefathers Abraham Ishmael and Isaac the One God and unto Him do we submit.
verses.translation: Why were you witnesses when death came to Jacob? He asked his children:  Whom will you serve after me?  They said:  We shall serve your God the God of your forefathers Abraham Ishmael and Isaac the One God and unto Him do we submit.

verses.text: Now they were a people who passed away. Theirs is what they have earned and yours is what you have earned. You shall not be asked concerning what they did.
verses.translation: Now they were a people who passed away. Theirs is what they have earned and yours is what you have earned. You shall not be asked concerning what they did.

verses.text: They say:  Be Jews or  Be Christians.   Then you will be rightly guided.  Say to them:  No follow exclusively the way of Abraham who was not one of those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity.
verses.translation: They say:  Be Jews or  Be Christians.   Then you will be rightly guided.  Say to them:  No follow exclusively the way of Abraham who was not one of those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity.

verses.text: Say:  We believe in Allah and in what has been revealed to us and to Abraham Ishmael Isaac Jacob and the descendants (of Jacob) and in what was given to Moses and Jesus and in what the other Prophets received from their Lord. We make no distinction between any of them and we are those who submit to Allah.
verses.translation: Say:  We believe in Allah and in what has been revealed to us and to Abraham Ishmael Isaac Jacob and the descendants (of Jacob) and in what was given to Moses and Jesus and in what the other Prophets received from their Lord. We make no distinction between any of them and we are those who submit to Allah.

verses.text: And then if they come to believe as you believe they are on right guidance; and if they turn away then quite obviously they have merely fallen into opposition to the Truth. Allah will suffice you for protection against them. He is All-Hearing All-Knowing.
verses.translation: And then if they come to believe as you believe they are on right guidance; and if they turn away then quite obviously they have merely fallen into opposition to the Truth. Allah will suffice you for protection against them. He is All-Hearing All-Knowing.

verses.text: Say:  Take on Allah s colour. And whose colour is better than Allah s? It is Him that we serve.
verses.translation: Say:  Take on Allah s colour. And whose colour is better than Allah s? It is Him that we serve.

verses.text: Say (O Prophet):  Will you then dispute with us concerning Allah when He is our Lord and your Lord? Our deeds are for us and your deeds are for you. And it is Him that we serve exclusively.
verses.translation: Say (O Prophet):  Will you then dispute with us concerning Allah when He is our Lord and your Lord? Our deeds are for us and your deeds are for you. And it is Him that we serve exclusively.

verses.text: Or do you claim that Abraham and Ishmael Isaac and Jacob and the descendants (of Jacob) were  Jews  or  Christians?  Say:  Who has greater knowledge you or Allah? Who does greater wrong than he who conceals a testimony he has received from Allah? Allah is not heedless of the things you do.
verses.translation: Or do you claim that Abraham and Ishmael Isaac and Jacob and the descendants (of Jacob) were  Jews  or  Christians?  Say:  Who has greater knowledge you or Allah? Who does greater wrong than he who conceals a testimony he has received from Allah? Allah is not heedless of the things you do.

verses.text: Now they were a people who passed away. Theirs is what they earned and yours is what you earn; you shall not be questioned concerning what they did.
verses.translation: Now they were a people who passed away. Theirs is what they earned and yours is what you earn; you shall not be questioned concerning what they did.

verses.text: The block-headed will say:  What has turned them away from the direction they formerly observed in Prayer? Say:  To Allah belong the East and the West; He guides whomsoever He wills onto a Straight Way.
verses.translation: The block-headed will say:  What has turned them away from the direction they formerly observed in Prayer? Say:  To Allah belong the East and the West; He guides whomsoever He wills onto a Straight Way.

verses.text: And it is thus that We appointed you to be the community of the middle way so that you might be witnesses to all mankind and the Messenger might be a witness to you. We appointed the direction which you formerly observed so that We might distinguish those who follow the Messenger from those who turn on their heels. For it was indeed burdensome except for those whom Allah guided. And Allah will never leave your faith to waste. Allah is full of gentleness and mercy to mankind.
verses.translation: And it is thus that We appointed you to be the community of the middle way so that you might be witnesses to all mankind and the Messenger might be a witness to you. We appointed the direction which you formerly observed so that We might distinguish those who follow the Messenger from those who turn on their heels. For it was indeed burdensome except for those whom Allah guided. And Allah will never leave your faith to waste. Allah is full of gentleness and mercy to mankind.

verses.text: We see you oft turning your face towards the sky; now We are turning you to the direction that will satisfy you. Turn your face towards the Holy Mosque and wherever you are turn your faces towards it in Prayer. Those who have been granted the Scripture certainly know that this (injunction to change the direction of Prayer) is right and is from their Lord. Allah is not heedless of what they do.
verses.translation: We see you oft turning your face towards the sky; now We are turning you to the direction that will satisfy you. Turn your face towards the Holy Mosque and wherever you are turn your faces towards it in Prayer. Those who have been granted the Scripture certainly know that this (injunction to change the direction of Prayer) is right and is from their Lord. Allah is not heedless of what they do.

verses.text: And yet no matter what proofs you bring before the People of the Book they will not follow your direction of Prayer; nor will you follow their direction of Prayer. None is prepared to follow the other s direction of Prayer. Were you to follow their desires in disregard of the knowledge which has come to you you will surely be reckoned among the wrong-doers.
verses.translation: And yet no matter what proofs you bring before the People of the Book they will not follow your direction of Prayer; nor will you follow their direction of Prayer. None is prepared to follow the other s direction of Prayer. Were you to follow their desires in disregard of the knowledge which has come to you you will surely be reckoned among the wrong-doers.

verses.text: Those to whom We have given the Scripture recognize the place (towards which one must turn in Prayer) as fully as they recognize their own sons this even though a group of them knowingly conceals the Truth.
verses.translation: Those to whom We have given the Scripture recognize the place (towards which one must turn in Prayer) as fully as they recognize their own sons this even though a group of them knowingly conceals the Truth.

verses.text: This is a definite Truth from your Lord; be not then among the doubters.
verses.translation: This is a definite Truth from your Lord; be not then among the doubters.

verses.text: Everyone has a direction towards which he turns; so excel one another in good works. Allah will bring you all together wherever you might be for nothing is beyond His power.
verses.translation: Everyone has a direction towards which he turns; so excel one another in good works. Allah will bring you all together wherever you might be for nothing is beyond His power.

verses.text: From wheresoever you might come forth turn your face towards the Holy Mosque; for that indeed is the Truth from your Lord and Allah is not heedless of what you do.
verses.translation: From wheresoever you might come forth turn your face towards the Holy Mosque; for that indeed is the Truth from your Lord and Allah is not heedless of what you do.

verses.text: From wheresoever you come forth turn your faces towards the Holy Mosque and wheresoever you may be turn your faces towards it in Prayer so that none may have an argument against you unless they be those immersed in wrong-doing. Do not fear them but fear only Me so that I may complete My favour upon you; perhaps you will be guided to the Right Way.
verses.translation: From wheresoever you come forth turn your faces towards the Holy Mosque and wheresoever you may be turn your faces towards it in Prayer so that none may have an argument against you unless they be those immersed in wrong-doing. Do not fear them but fear only Me so that I may complete My favour upon you; perhaps you will be guided to the Right Way.

verses.text: Just as when We sent among you a Messenger of yourselves who recites to you Our Signs purifies your lives instructs you in the Book and in Wisdom and instructs you what you did not know.
verses.translation: Just as when We sent among you a Messenger of yourselves who recites to you Our Signs purifies your lives instructs you in the Book and in Wisdom and instructs you what you did not know.

verses.text: So remember Me and I shall remember you; give thanks to Me and do not be ungrateful to Me for My favours.
verses.translation: So remember Me and I shall remember you; give thanks to Me and do not be ungrateful to Me for My favours.

verses.text: Believers! Seek help in patience and in Prayer; Allah is with those that are patient.
verses.translation: Believers! Seek help in patience and in Prayer; Allah is with those that are patient.

verses.text: And do not say of those who are killed in the way of Allah that they are dead; they are alive even though you have no knowledge of their life.
verses.translation: And do not say of those who are killed in the way of Allah that they are dead; they are alive even though you have no knowledge of their life.

verses.text: We shall certainly test you by afflicting you with fear hunger loss of properties and lives and fruits. Give glad tidings then to those who remain patient;
verses.translation: We shall certainly test you by afflicting you with fear hunger loss of properties and lives and fruits. Give glad tidings then to those who remain patient;

verses.text: those who when any affliction smites them they say:  Verily we belong to Allah and it is to Him that we are destined to return.
verses.translation: those who when any affliction smites them they say:  Verily we belong to Allah and it is to Him that we are destined to return.

verses.text: Upon them will be the blessings and mercy of their Lord and it is they who are rightly guided.
verses.translation: Upon them will be the blessings and mercy of their Lord and it is they who are rightly guided.

verses.text: Surely al-Safa and al-Marwah are the symbols of Allah. Hence whoever performs Hajj (Full Pilgrimage) to the House (of Allah) or makes ''Umrah (Minor Pilgrimage) will find that it is no sin for him to ambulate between the two. And whoever does a good work voluntarily should know that Allah is Appreciative All-Knowing.
verses.translation: Surely al-Safa and al-Marwah are the symbols of Allah. Hence whoever performs Hajj (Full Pilgrimage) to the House (of Allah) or makes ''Umrah (Minor Pilgrimage) will find that it is no sin for him to ambulate between the two. And whoever does a good work voluntarily should know that Allah is Appreciative All-Knowing.

verses.text: Those who conceal anything of the clear teachings and true guidance which We have sent down even though We have made them clear in Our Book Allah curses such people and so do all the cursers
verses.translation: Those who conceal anything of the clear teachings and true guidance which We have sent down even though We have made them clear in Our Book Allah curses such people and so do all the cursers

verses.text: except those who repent and make amends and openly declare (what they had concealed). Such shall I pardon for I am Much- Relenting Most Compassionate.
verses.translation: except those who repent and make amends and openly declare (what they had concealed). Such shall I pardon for I am Much- Relenting Most Compassionate.

verses.text: As for those who disbelieved and died disbelieving surely the curse of Allah and of the angels and of all men is on them.
verses.translation: As for those who disbelieved and died disbelieving surely the curse of Allah and of the angels and of all men is on them.

verses.text: Thus shall they abide and their chastisement shall not be lightened nor shall they be given respite.
verses.translation: Thus shall they abide and their chastisement shall not be lightened nor shall they be given respite.

verses.text: Your God is One God there is no god but He; the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate.
verses.translation: Your God is One God there is no god but He; the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate.

verses.text: (To guide) those who use their reason (to this Truth) there are many Signs in the structure of the heavens and the earth in the constant alternation of night and day in the vessels which speed across the sea carrying goods that are of profit to people in the water which Allah sends down from the sky and thereby quickens the earth after it was dead and disperse over it all manner of animals and in the changing courses of the winds and the clouds pressed into service between heaven and earth.
verses.translation: (To guide) those who use their reason (to this Truth) there are many Signs in the structure of the heavens and the earth in the constant alternation of night and day in the vessels which speed across the sea carrying goods that are of profit to people in the water which Allah sends down from the sky and thereby quickens the earth after it was dead and disperse over it all manner of animals and in the changing courses of the winds and the clouds pressed into service between heaven and earth.

verses.text: Yet there are some who take others as equals to Allah and love them as Allah alone should be loved; but those who (truly) believe they love Allah more than all else. If only the wrong-doers were to perceive now   as they will perceive when they will see the chastisement   that all power belongs to Allah alone and that Allah is severe in chastisement!
verses.translation: Yet there are some who take others as equals to Allah and love them as Allah alone should be loved; but those who (truly) believe they love Allah more than all else. If only the wrong-doers were to perceive now   as they will perceive when they will see the chastisement   that all power belongs to Allah alone and that Allah is severe in chastisement!

verses.text: At that moment those who have been followed will disown their followers and they will see the chastisement and their resources will be cut asunder.
verses.translation: At that moment those who have been followed will disown their followers and they will see the chastisement and their resources will be cut asunder.

verses.text: And the followers will then say:  Oh if only we might return again we would disown them as they have disowned us? Thus Allah will show them their works in a manner causing them bitter regrets. Never will they come out of the Fire.
verses.translation: And the followers will then say:  Oh if only we might return again we would disown them as they have disowned us? Thus Allah will show them their works in a manner causing them bitter regrets. Never will they come out of the Fire.

verses.text: O people! Eat of the lawful and pure things in the earth and follow not in the footsteps of Satan. For surely he is your open enemy;
verses.translation: O people! Eat of the lawful and pure things in the earth and follow not in the footsteps of Satan. For surely he is your open enemy;

verses.text: he only commands you to do evil and commit acts of indecency and to ascribe to Allah the things concerning which you have no knowledge (that He really is their source).
verses.translation: he only commands you to do evil and commit acts of indecency and to ascribe to Allah the things concerning which you have no knowledge (that He really is their source).

verses.text: And when they are told:  Follow what Allah has revealed they say:  No we shall follow what we found our forefathers adhering to. What! Even if their forefathers were devoid of understanding and right guidance?
verses.translation: And when they are told:  Follow what Allah has revealed they say:  No we shall follow what we found our forefathers adhering to. What! Even if their forefathers were devoid of understanding and right guidance?

verses.text: Those who have refused to follow the Way of Allah resemble cattle; when the shepherd calls them they hear nothing except shouting and crying; they are deaf dumb and blind and so they understand nothing.
verses.translation: Those who have refused to follow the Way of Allah resemble cattle; when the shepherd calls them they hear nothing except shouting and crying; they are deaf dumb and blind and so they understand nothing.

verses.text: Believers! Eat of the pure things wherewith We have provided you for sustenance and give thanks to Allah if it is Him that you serve.
verses.translation: Believers! Eat of the pure things wherewith We have provided you for sustenance and give thanks to Allah if it is Him that you serve.

verses.text: He has made unlawful to you only carrion and blood and the flesh of swine and that over which there has been pronounced the name of anyone other than Allah s. But he who is constrained (to eat of them)   and he neither covets them nor exceeds the indispensable limit incurs no sin: Allah is All-Forgiving All-Compassionate.
verses.translation: He has made unlawful to you only carrion and blood and the flesh of swine and that over which there has been pronounced the name of anyone other than Allah s. But he who is constrained (to eat of them)   and he neither covets them nor exceeds the indispensable limit incurs no sin: Allah is All-Forgiving All-Compassionate.

verses.text: Those who conceal anything of the Book revealed by Allah and sell it away for a trifling gain are merely filling their bellies with Fire. Allah will neither address them on the Day of Resurrection nor shall He pronounce them  pure . A painful chastisement lies in store for them.
verses.translation: Those who conceal anything of the Book revealed by Allah and sell it away for a trifling gain are merely filling their bellies with Fire. Allah will neither address them on the Day of Resurrection nor shall He pronounce them  pure . A painful chastisement lies in store for them.

verses.text: They are the ones who bought error in exchange for true guidance and chastisement in exchange for forgiveness. How patient they are in enduring the Fire!
verses.translation: They are the ones who bought error in exchange for true guidance and chastisement in exchange for forgiveness. How patient they are in enduring the Fire!

verses.text: This is so because Allah revealed the Book with the Truth but those who disagreed concerning the Book veered far away from the Truth.
verses.translation: This is so because Allah revealed the Book with the Truth but those who disagreed concerning the Book veered far away from the Truth.

verses.text: Righteousness does not consist in turning your faces towards the east or towards the west;true righteousness consists in believing in Allah and the Last Day the angels the Book and the Prophets and in giving away one s property in love of Him to one s kinsmen the orphans the poor and the wayfarer and to those who ask for help and in freeing the necks of slaves and in establishing Prayer and dispensing the Zakah. True righteousness is attained by those who are faithful to their promise once they have made it and by those who remain steadfast in adversity and affliction and at the time of battle (between Truth and falsehood). Such are the truthful ones; such are the God-fearing.
