ayahs.text: The believers may not take the unbelievers for their allies in preference to the believers. Whoever does this has nothing to do with Allah unless he does so in order to protect himself from their wrong-doing. Allah warns you to beware of Him for to Allah is the ultimate return.
ayahs.translation: The believers may not take the unbelievers for their allies in preference to the believers. Whoever does this has nothing to do with Allah unless he does so in order to protect himself from their wrong-doing. Allah warns you to beware of Him for to Allah is the ultimate return.

ayahs.text: Say: ''Whether you conceal what is in your hearts or disclose it Allah knows it. Allah knows all that is in the heavens and in the earth and He has power over everything.''
ayahs.translation: Say: ''Whether you conceal what is in your hearts or disclose it Allah knows it. Allah knows all that is in the heavens and in the earth and He has power over everything.''

ayahs.text: The Day is approaching when every soul shall find itself confronted with whatever good it has done and whatever evil it has wrought. It will then wish that there be a wide space between it and the Day! Allah warns you to beware of Him; He is most tender towards His servants.
ayahs.translation: The Day is approaching when every soul shall find itself confronted with whatever good it has done and whatever evil it has wrought. It will then wish that there be a wide space between it and the Day! Allah warns you to beware of Him; He is most tender towards His servants.

ayahs.text: (O Messenger!) Tell people: ''If you indeed love Allah follow me and Allah will love you and will forgive you your sins. Allah is All-Forgiving All-Compassionate.''
ayahs.translation: (O Messenger!) Tell people: ''If you indeed love Allah follow me and Allah will love you and will forgive you your sins. Allah is All-Forgiving All-Compassionate.''

ayahs.text: Say: ''Obey Allah and obey the Messenger.'' If they turn away from this then know that Allah does not love those who refuse to obey Him and His Messenger.
ayahs.translation: Say: ''Obey Allah and obey the Messenger.'' If they turn away from this then know that Allah does not love those who refuse to obey Him and His Messenger.

ayahs.text: Truly Allah chose Adam and Noah and the descendants of Abraham and of ''Imran above all mankind.
ayahs.translation: Truly Allah chose Adam and Noah and the descendants of Abraham and of ''Imran above all mankind.

ayahs.text: (for His messengership) - a people alike and the seed of one another. Allah is All-Hearing All-Knowing.
ayahs.translation: (for His messengership) - a people alike and the seed of one another. Allah is All-Hearing All-Knowing.

ayahs.text: . (He also heard) when ''Imran s woman said: ''O Lord! Behold unto You do I vow that the child in my womb is to be devoted to Your exclusive service. Accept it then from me. Surely You alone are All-Hearing All-Knowing.''
ayahs.translation: . (He also heard) when ''Imran s woman said: ''O Lord! Behold unto You do I vow that the child in my womb is to be devoted to Your exclusive service. Accept it then from me. Surely You alone are All-Hearing All-Knowing.''

ayahs.text: But when she gave birth to a female child she said: ''O Lord! I have given birth to a female'' - and Allah knew full well what she had given birth to - ''and a male is not the same as a female. I have named her Mary and commit her and her offspring to You for protection from Satan the accursed.''
ayahs.translation: But when she gave birth to a female child she said: ''O Lord! I have given birth to a female'' - and Allah knew full well what she had given birth to - ''and a male is not the same as a female. I have named her Mary and commit her and her offspring to You for protection from Satan the accursed.''

ayahs.text: Thereupon her Lord graciously accepted Mary and vouchsafed to her a goodly growth and placed her in the care of Zechariah. Whenever Zechariah visited her in the sanctuary he found her provided with food. He asked her: ''Mary how did this come to you?'' She said: ''It is from Allah. Allah provides sustenance to whom He wills beyond all reckoning.''
ayahs.translation: Thereupon her Lord graciously accepted Mary and vouchsafed to her a goodly growth and placed her in the care of Zechariah. Whenever Zechariah visited her in the sanctuary he found her provided with food. He asked her: ''Mary how did this come to you?'' She said: ''It is from Allah. Allah provides sustenance to whom He wills beyond all reckoning.''

ayahs.text: Then Zechariah prayed to his Lord: ''O Lord! Grant me from Yourself out of Your grace the gift of a goodly offspring for indeed You alone heed all Prayers.''
ayahs.translation: Then Zechariah prayed to his Lord: ''O Lord! Grant me from Yourself out of Your grace the gift of a goodly offspring for indeed You alone heed all Prayers.''

ayahs.text: As he stood praying in the sanctuary the angels called out to him: ''Allah gives you good tidings of John (Yahya) who shall confirm a command of Allah shall be outstanding among people utterly chaste and a Prophet from among the righteous.''
ayahs.translation: As he stood praying in the sanctuary the angels called out to him: ''Allah gives you good tidings of John (Yahya) who shall confirm a command of Allah shall be outstanding among people utterly chaste and a Prophet from among the righteous.''

ayahs.text: Zechariah exclaimed: ''My Lord! How shall I have a son when old age has overtaken me and my wife is barren?'' He said: Thus shall it be; Allah does what He wills.''
ayahs.translation: Zechariah exclaimed: ''My Lord! How shall I have a son when old age has overtaken me and my wife is barren?'' He said: Thus shall it be; Allah does what He wills.''

ayahs.text: Zechariah said: ''O my Lord! Appoint a sign for me.'' The angel said: ''The sign for you shall be that you shall not speak to people for three days except by gesture. Remember your Lord and extol His glory by night and by day.''
ayahs.translation: Zechariah said: ''O my Lord! Appoint a sign for me.'' The angel said: ''The sign for you shall be that you shall not speak to people for three days except by gesture. Remember your Lord and extol His glory by night and by day.''

ayahs.text: Then came the time when the angels said: ''O Mary! Behold Allah has chosen you and has made you pure and exalted you above all the women in the world.
ayahs.translation: Then came the time when the angels said: ''O Mary! Behold Allah has chosen you and has made you pure and exalted you above all the women in the world.

ayahs.text: O Mary! Remain devout to your Lord and prostrate yourself in worship and bow down with those who bow down (before Him).''
ayahs.translation: O Mary! Remain devout to your Lord and prostrate yourself in worship and bow down with those who bow down (before Him).''

ayahs.text: (O Muhammad!) We reveal to you this account from a realm which lies beyond the reach of your perception for you were not with them when they drew lots with their pens about who should be Mary''s guardian and you were not with them when they disputed about it.
ayahs.translation: (O Muhammad!) We reveal to you this account from a realm which lies beyond the reach of your perception for you were not with them when they drew lots with their pens about who should be Mary''s guardian and you were not with them when they disputed about it.

ayahs.text: And when the angels said: ''O Mary! Allah gives you the glad tidings of a command from Him: his name shall be Messiah Jesus the son of Mary. He shall be highly honoured in this world and in the Next and shall be one of those near stationed to Allah.
ayahs.translation: And when the angels said: ''O Mary! Allah gives you the glad tidings of a command from Him: his name shall be Messiah Jesus the son of Mary. He shall be highly honoured in this world and in the Next and shall be one of those near stationed to Allah.

ayahs.text: And he shall speak to people in the cradle and also later when he grows to maturity and shall indeed be among the righteous.''
ayahs.translation: And he shall speak to people in the cradle and also later when he grows to maturity and shall indeed be among the righteous.''

ayahs.text: She said: ''O my Lord! How shall I have a son when no man has ever touched me?'' The angel answered: Thus shall it be. Allah creates whatever He wills. When He decides something He merely says: ""Be"" and it is.
ayahs.translation: She said: ''O my Lord! How shall I have a son when no man has ever touched me?'' The angel answered: Thus shall it be. Allah creates whatever He wills. When He decides something He merely says: ""Be"" and it is.

ayahs.text: And He will teach him the Book the Wisdom the Torah the Gospel
ayahs.translation: And He will teach him the Book the Wisdom the Torah the Gospel

ayahs.text: and he will be a Messenger to the Children of Israel.'' (And when he came to them he said): ''I have come to you with a sign from your Lord. I will make for you from clay the likeness of a bird and then I will breathe into it and by the leave of Allah it will become a bird. I will also heal the blind and the leper and by the leave of Allah I will bring the dead to life. I will also inform you of what things you eat and what you treasure up in your houses. Surely this is a sign for you if you are true believers.
ayahs.translation: and he will be a Messenger to the Children of Israel.'' (And when he came to them he said): ''I have come to you with a sign from your Lord. I will make for you from clay the likeness of a bird and then I will breathe into it and by the leave of Allah it will become a bird. I will also heal the blind and the leper and by the leave of Allah I will bring the dead to life. I will also inform you of what things you eat and what you treasure up in your houses. Surely this is a sign for you if you are true believers.

ayahs.text: And I have come to confirm the truth of whatever there still remains of the Torah and to make lawful to you some of the things which had been forbidden to you. I have come to you with a Sign from your Lord; so have fear of Allah and obey me.
ayahs.translation: And I have come to confirm the truth of whatever there still remains of the Torah and to make lawful to you some of the things which had been forbidden to you. I have come to you with a Sign from your Lord; so have fear of Allah and obey me.

ayahs.text: Surely Allah is my Lord and your Lord; so serve Him alone. This is the straight way.''
ayahs.translation: Surely Allah is my Lord and your Lord; so serve Him alone. This is the straight way.''

ayahs.text: And when Jesus perceived their leaning towards unbelief he asked: ''Who will be my helpers in the way of Allah?'' The disciples said: ''We are the helpers of Allah. We believe in Allah and be our witness that we have submitted ourselves exclusively to Allah.
ayahs.translation: And when Jesus perceived their leaning towards unbelief he asked: ''Who will be my helpers in the way of Allah?'' The disciples said: ''We are the helpers of Allah. We believe in Allah and be our witness that we have submitted ourselves exclusively to Allah.

ayahs.text: Our Lord! We believe in the com-mandment You have revealed and we obey the Messenger; make us then one of those who bear witness (to the Truth).''
ayahs.translation: Our Lord! We believe in the com-mandment You have revealed and we obey the Messenger; make us then one of those who bear witness (to the Truth).''

ayahs.text: Then they schemed (against the Messiah) and Allah countered their schemes by schemes of His own. Allah is the best of schemers.
ayahs.translation: Then they schemed (against the Messiah) and Allah countered their schemes by schemes of His own. Allah is the best of schemers.

ayahs.text: (And it was part of His scheme) when Allah said: ''O Jesus! I will recall you and raise you up to Me and will purify you (of the company) of those who disbelieve and will set your followers above the unbelievers till the Day of Resurrection. Then to Me shall all of you return and I shall judge between you regarding whatever you differed among yourselves.
ayahs.translation: (And it was part of His scheme) when Allah said: ''O Jesus! I will recall you and raise you up to Me and will purify you (of the company) of those who disbelieve and will set your followers above the unbelievers till the Day of Resurrection. Then to Me shall all of you return and I shall judge between you regarding whatever you differed among yourselves.

ayahs.text: As for those who disbelieved I shall inflict a terrible chastisement on them in this world and in the Next; and they shall find none to help them.
ayahs.translation: As for those who disbelieved I shall inflict a terrible chastisement on them in this world and in the Next; and they shall find none to help them.

ayahs.text: But those who believe and do righteous deeds He will reward them in full. Allah does not love the unjust.''
ayahs.translation: But those who believe and do righteous deeds He will reward them in full. Allah does not love the unjust.''

ayahs.text: What We recite to you consists of signs and wise admonition.
ayahs.translation: What We recite to you consists of signs and wise admonition.

ayahs.text: Surely in the sight of Allah the similitude of the creation of Jesus is as the creation of Adam whom He created out of dust and then said: ''Be'' and he was.
ayahs.translation: Surely in the sight of Allah the similitude of the creation of Jesus is as the creation of Adam whom He created out of dust and then said: ''Be'' and he was.

ayahs.text: This is the truth from your Lord; be not then among those who doubt.
ayahs.translation: This is the truth from your Lord; be not then among those who doubt.

ayahs.text: Tell whoever disputes with you on this matter after true knowledge has come to you: ''Come! Let us summon our sons and your sons and our women and your women and ourselves and yourselves and then let us pray together and invoke the curse of Allah on those who lie.''
ayahs.translation: Tell whoever disputes with you on this matter after true knowledge has come to you: ''Come! Let us summon our sons and your sons and our women and your women and ourselves and yourselves and then let us pray together and invoke the curse of Allah on those who lie.''

ayahs.text: This is the true story. There is no God but Allah and assuredly Allah is All-Mighty All-Wise.
ayahs.translation: This is the true story. There is no God but Allah and assuredly Allah is All-Mighty All-Wise.

ayahs.text: And if they turn their backs truly Allah knows those who cause mischief.
ayahs.translation: And if they turn their backs truly Allah knows those who cause mischief.

ayahs.text: Say: ''People of the Book! Come to a word common between us and you: that we shall serve none but Allah and shall associate none with Him in His divinity and that some of us will not take others as lords other than Allah.'' And if they turn away (from accepting this call) tell them: ''Bear witness that we are the ones who have submitted ourselves exclusively to Allah.''
ayahs.translation: Say: ''People of the Book! Come to a word common between us and you: that we shall serve none but Allah and shall associate none with Him in His divinity and that some of us will not take others as lords other than Allah.'' And if they turn away (from accepting this call) tell them: ''Bear witness that we are the ones who have submitted ourselves exclusively to Allah.''

ayahs.text: People of the Book! Why do you dispute with us about Abraham even though the Torah and the Gospel were not revealed until after his time? Do you not understand?
ayahs.translation: People of the Book! Why do you dispute with us about Abraham even though the Torah and the Gospel were not revealed until after his time? Do you not understand?

ayahs.text: Behold you are those who have severely disputed concerning matters of which you have knowledge; why are you now disputing concerning matters that you know nothing about? Allah knows it whereas you do not know.
ayahs.translation: Behold you are those who have severely disputed concerning matters of which you have knowledge; why are you now disputing concerning matters that you know nothing about? Allah knows it whereas you do not know.

ayahs.text: Abraham was neither a Jew nor a Christian; he was a Muslim wholly devoted to God. And he certainly was not amongst those who associate others with Allah in His divinity.
ayahs.translation: Abraham was neither a Jew nor a Christian; he was a Muslim wholly devoted to God. And he certainly was not amongst those who associate others with Allah in His divinity.

ayahs.text: Surely the people who have the best claim to affiliation with Abraham are those who followed him (in the past) and presently this Prophet and those who believe in him. Allah is the guardian of those who truly believe.
ayahs.translation: Surely the people who have the best claim to affiliation with Abraham are those who followed him (in the past) and presently this Prophet and those who believe in him. Allah is the guardian of those who truly believe.

ayahs.text: A party of the People of the Book would fain lead you astray whereas in truth they lead none astray except themselves but that they do not realize it.
ayahs.translation: A party of the People of the Book would fain lead you astray whereas in truth they lead none astray except themselves but that they do not realize it.

ayahs.text: People of the Book! Why do you reject the signs of Allah even though you yourselves witness them?
ayahs.translation: People of the Book! Why do you reject the signs of Allah even though you yourselves witness them?

ayahs.text: People of the Book! Why do you confound Truth with falsehood and why do you conceal the Truth knowingly?
ayahs.translation: People of the Book! Why do you confound Truth with falsehood and why do you conceal the Truth knowingly?

ayahs.text: A party of the People of the Book said: ''Believe in the morning what has been revealed to those who believe and then deny it in the evening that they may retract (from their faith).''
ayahs.translation: A party of the People of the Book said: ''Believe in the morning what has been revealed to those who believe and then deny it in the evening that they may retract (from their faith).''

ayahs.text: They also say among themselves: ''Do not follow anyone except him who follows your faith.'' Say: ''Surely true guidance is Allah''s. It is His favour that anyone should be given the like of what you have been given in the past and that others should have been given firm evidence to proffer against you before your Lord.'' Say: ''Surely bounty is in the Hand of Allah; He gives it to whom He wills. Allah is All-Embracing All-Knowing.
ayahs.translation: They also say among themselves: ''Do not follow anyone except him who follows your faith.'' Say: ''Surely true guidance is Allah''s. It is His favour that anyone should be given the like of what you have been given in the past and that others should have been given firm evidence to proffer against you before your Lord.'' Say: ''Surely bounty is in the Hand of Allah; He gives it to whom He wills. Allah is All-Embracing All-Knowing.

ayahs.text: He singles out for His mercy whomever He wills Allah is possessed of abounding bounty.''
ayahs.translation: He singles out for His mercy whomever He wills Allah is possessed of abounding bounty.''

ayahs.text: There are some among the People of the Book who will restore you even if you were to entrust a treasure of gold and among them are also others who were you to entrust with one gold piece will not restore it unless you stand over them. That is because they say: ''We will not be taken to task for whatever we may do to non-Jews (ummis). Thus they falsely fix a lie upon Allah and do so wittingly.
ayahs.translation: There are some among the People of the Book who will restore you even if you were to entrust a treasure of gold and among them are also others who were you to entrust with one gold piece will not restore it unless you stand over them. That is because they say: ''We will not be taken to task for whatever we may do to non-Jews (ummis). Thus they falsely fix a lie upon Allah and do so wittingly.

ayahs.text: But Allah loves only those who fulfil their covenant and fear Allah. Truly Allah loves the God-fearing.
ayahs.translation: But Allah loves only those who fulfil their covenant and fear Allah. Truly Allah loves the God-fearing.

ayahs.text: There shall be no share in the Life to Come for those who sell away the covenant of Allah and their oaths for a trivial gain. On the Day of Resurrection Allah will neither address them nor look at them nor will He purify them. A grievous chastisement awaits them.
ayahs.translation: There shall be no share in the Life to Come for those who sell away the covenant of Allah and their oaths for a trivial gain. On the Day of Resurrection Allah will neither address them nor look at them nor will He purify them. A grievous chastisement awaits them.

ayahs.text: There is a party among them who twist their tongues while reciting the Book to make you think that it is part of the Book when in fact it is not. They say: ''It is from Allah'' when in fact it is not from Allah. They falsely fix a lie upon Allah and do so wittingly.
ayahs.translation: There is a party among them who twist their tongues while reciting the Book to make you think that it is part of the Book when in fact it is not. They say: ''It is from Allah'' when in fact it is not from Allah. They falsely fix a lie upon Allah and do so wittingly.

ayahs.text: It does not befit a man that Allah should grant him His Book and sound judgement and prophethood and thereafter he should say to people: ''Become servants to me apart from Allah.'' He would rather say: ''Become dedicated men of Allah in accord with the dictates of the Book you have been teaching and studying.''
ayahs.translation: It does not befit a man that Allah should grant him His Book and sound judgement and prophethood and thereafter he should say to people: ''Become servants to me apart from Allah.'' He would rather say: ''Become dedicated men of Allah in accord with the dictates of the Book you have been teaching and studying.''

ayahs.text: He will never enjoin you to take the angels or Prophets for your lords. Will he enjoin upon you unbelief when you have submitted yourselves to Allah?
ayahs.translation: He will never enjoin you to take the angels or Prophets for your lords. Will he enjoin upon you unbelief when you have submitted yourselves to Allah?

ayahs.text: Recall when Allah took a covenant from the Prophets: ''This is the Book and the Wisdom which I have granted you. But should a Prophet come to you confirming what you already possess you shall believe in him and shall help him. So saying Allah asked: ''Do you agree and accept to take up the burden of the covenant?'' They answered: ''We agree '' He said: ''Then bear witness; and I will be with you among the witnesses.
ayahs.translation: Recall when Allah took a covenant from the Prophets: ''This is the Book and the Wisdom which I have granted you. But should a Prophet come to you confirming what you already possess you shall believe in him and shall help him. So saying Allah asked: ''Do you agree and accept to take up the burden of the covenant?'' They answered: ''We agree '' He said: ''Then bear witness; and I will be with you among the witnesses.

ayahs.text:
B708
Then whosoever shall turn away from this covenant they are the transgressors.
ayahs.translation:
B708
Then whosoever shall turn away from this covenant they are the transgressors.

ayahs.text: Do they now seek a religion other than that prescribed by Allah and this despite all that is in the heavens and the earth is in submission to Him - willing or unwillingly - and to Him all shall return?
ayahs.translation: Do they now seek a religion other than that prescribed by Allah and this despite all that is in the heavens and the earth is in submission to Him - willing or unwillingly - and to Him all shall return?

ayahs.text: Say: ''We believe in Allah and what was revealed to us and what was revealed to Abraham and Ishmael and to Issac and Jacob and his descendents and the teachings which Allah gave to Moses and Jesus and to other Prophets. We make no distinction between any of them and to Him do we submit.
ayahs.translation: Say: ''We believe in Allah and what was revealed to us and what was revealed to Abraham and Ishmael and to Issac and Jacob and his descendents and the teachings which Allah gave to Moses and Jesus and to other Prophets. We make no distinction between any of them and to Him do we submit.

ayahs.text: And whoever seeks a way other than this way of submission Islam- will find that it will not be accepted from him and he will be among the losers in the Life to come.
ayahs.translation: And whoever seeks a way other than this way of submission Islam- will find that it will not be accepted from him and he will be among the losers in the Life to come.

ayahs.text: How can Allah guide a people who once believed and after they received clear signs and affirmed that the Messenger was a true one lapsed into disbelief. Allah does not guide the wrong-doers.
ayahs.translation: How can Allah guide a people who once believed and after they received clear signs and affirmed that the Messenger was a true one lapsed into disbelief. Allah does not guide the wrong-doers.

ayahs.text: The recompense for their wrong-doing is that the curse of Allah and of the angels and of all men shall be upon them.
ayahs.translation: The recompense for their wrong-doing is that the curse of Allah and of the angels and of all men shall be upon them.

ayahs.text: Thus shall they abide. Neither shall their chastisement be lightened nor shall they be granted any respite.
ayahs.translation: Thus shall they abide. Neither shall their chastisement be lightened nor shall they be granted any respite.

ayahs.text: But for those who repent and mend their ways Allah is indeed Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.
ayahs.translation: But for those who repent and mend their ways Allah is indeed Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.

ayahs.text: Those who disbelieved after having believed and then hardened in their disbelief their (pretence to) repentance shall not be accepted. Such have utterly gone astray.
ayahs.translation: Those who disbelieved after having believed and then hardened in their disbelief their (pretence to) repentance shall not be accepted. Such have utterly gone astray.

ayahs.text: Truly those who embracedunbelief and died as unbelievers not even the whole earth full of gold will be accepted from them as ransom. For such there is painful chastisement; and none shall come to their help.
ayahs.translation: Truly those who embracedunbelief and died as unbelievers not even the whole earth full of gold will be accepted from them as ransom. For such there is painful chastisement; and none shall come to their help.

ayahs.text: You shall not attain righteousness until you spend (for the sake of Allah) out of what you love.  Allah knows whatever you spend.
ayahs.translation: You shall not attain righteousness until you spend (for the sake of Allah) out of what you love.  Allah knows whatever you spend.

ayahs.text: All food (that is lawful in the Law revealed to Muhammad) was lawful to the Children of Israel except what Israel made unlawful to himself before the revelation of the Torah. Tell them: ''Bring the Torah and recite any passage of it if you are truthful.''
ayahs.translation: All food (that is lawful in the Law revealed to Muhammad) was lawful to the Children of Israel except what Israel made unlawful to himself before the revelation of the Torah. Tell them: ''Bring the Torah and recite any passage of it if you are truthful.''

ayahs.text: Those who forge lies against Allah despite this are the wrong-doers.
ayahs.translation: Those who forge lies against Allah despite this are the wrong-doers.

ayahs.text: Say: ''Whatever Allah has said is true. Follow then the way of Abraham in total devotion to Allah. He was notamong those who associate others with Allah in His divinity.
ayahs.translation: Say: ''Whatever Allah has said is true. Follow then the way of Abraham in total devotion to Allah. He was notamong those who associate others with Allah in His divinity.

ayahs.text: Behold the first House (of Prayer) established for mankind is the one at Bakkah: it is full of blessing and is a centre of guidance for the whole world.
ayahs.translation: Behold the first House (of Prayer) established for mankind is the one at Bakkah: it is full of blessing and is a centre of guidance for the whole world.

ayahs.text: In it there are clear signs and the station of Abraham; whoever enters it becomes secure. Pilgrimage to the House is a duty owed to Allah by all who can make their way to it. As for those who refuse to follow His command surely Allah stands in need of no one in the whole universe.
ayahs.translation: In it there are clear signs and the station of Abraham; whoever enters it becomes secure. Pilgrimage to the House is a duty owed to Allah by all who can make their way to it. As for those who refuse to follow His command surely Allah stands in need of no one in the whole universe.

ayahs.text: Say: ''People of the Book! Why do you reject the signs of Allah when Allah is witness to all that you do?''
ayahs.translation: Say: ''People of the Book! Why do you reject the signs of Allah when Allah is witness to all that you do?''

ayahs.text: Say: ''People of the Book! Why do you hinder believers from the way of Allah seeking that they follow a crooked way even though you yourselves are witness to its being the right way?'' Allah is not heedless of what you do.
ayahs.translation: Say: ''People of the Book! Why do you hinder believers from the way of Allah seeking that they follow a crooked way even though you yourselves are witness to its being the right way?'' Allah is not heedless of what you do.

ayahs.text: Believers! Were you to obey a party of those who were given the Book they might cause you to renounce the Truth after you have attained to faith.
ayahs.translation: Believers! Were you to obey a party of those who were given the Book they might cause you to renounce the Truth after you have attained to faith.

ayahs.text: How can you disbelieve when you are the ones to whom the signs of Allah are recited and when His Messenger is in your midst? Whoever holds fast to Allah will certainly be guided to the Straight way.
ayahs.translation: How can you disbelieve when you are the ones to whom the signs of Allah are recited and when His Messenger is in your midst? Whoever holds fast to Allah will certainly be guided to the Straight way.

ayahs.text: Believers! Fear Allah as He should be feared and see that you do not die save in submission to Allah.
ayahs.translation: Believers! Fear Allah as He should be feared and see that you do not die save in submission to Allah.

ayahs.text: Hold fast together to the cable of Allah and be not divided. Remember the blessing that Allah bestowed upon you: you were once enemies then He brought your hearts together so that through His blessing you became brothers. You stood on the brink of a pit of fire and He delivered you from it. Thus Allah makes His signs clear to you that you may be guided to the right way.
ayahs.translation: Hold fast together to the cable of Allah and be not divided. Remember the blessing that Allah bestowed upon you: you were once enemies then He brought your hearts together so that through His blessing you became brothers. You stood on the brink of a pit of fire and He delivered you from it. Thus Allah makes His signs clear to you that you may be guided to the right way.

ayahs.text: And from amongst you there must be a party who will call people to all that is good and will enjoin the doing of all that is right and will forbid the doing of all that is wrong. It is they who will attain true success.
ayahs.translation: And from amongst you there must be a party who will call people to all that is good and will enjoin the doing of all that is right and will forbid the doing of all that is wrong. It is they who will attain true success.

ayahs.text: Do not be like those who fell into factions and became opposed to one another after clear signs had come to them. A mighty chastisement awaits them.
ayahs.translation: Do not be like those who fell into factions and became opposed to one another after clear signs had come to them. A mighty chastisement awaits them.

ayahs.text: on the Day when some faces will turn bright and other faces will turn dark. Those whose faces have turned dark will be told: ''Did you fall into unbelief after you had been blessed with belief? Taste then chastisement for your unbelief.
ayahs.translation: on the Day when some faces will turn bright and other faces will turn dark. Those whose faces have turned dark will be told: ''Did you fall into unbelief after you had been blessed with belief? Taste then chastisement for your unbelief.

ayahs.text: And those whose faces have turned bright they will be in the mercy of Allah and therein they shall abide.
ayahs.translation: And those whose faces have turned bright they will be in the mercy of Allah and therein they shall abide.

ayahs.text: These are the messages of Allah which We recite to you in all truth and Allah desires no wrong to the people of the world.
ayahs.translation: These are the messages of Allah which We recite to you in all truth and Allah desires no wrong to the people of the world.

ayahs.text: To Allah belongs all that is in the heavens and the earth and to Allah are all matters referred for decision.
ayahs.translation: To Allah belongs all that is in the heavens and the earth and to Allah are all matters referred for decision.

ayahs.text: You are now the best nation brought forth for mankind. You enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong and believe in Allah. Had the People of the Book believed it were better for them. Some of them are believers but most of them are transgressors.
ayahs.translation: You are now the best nation brought forth for mankind. You enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong and believe in Allah. Had the People of the Book believed it were better for them. Some of them are believers but most of them are transgressors.

ayahs.text: They will not be able to harm you except for a little hurt and if they fight against you they will turn their backs (in flight) and then they will not be succoured.
ayahs.translation: They will not be able to harm you except for a little hurt and if they fight against you they will turn their backs (in flight) and then they will not be succoured.

ayahs.text: Wherever they were they were covered with ignominy except when they were protected by either a covenant with Allah or a covenant with men.They are laden with the burden of Allah''s wrath and humiliation has been pitched upon them; all this because they rejected the signs of Allah and slew the Prophets without right and because they wantonly disobeyed and used to transgress.
ayahs.translation: Wherever they were they were covered with ignominy except when they were protected by either a covenant with Allah or a covenant with men.They are laden with the burden of Allah''s wrath and humiliation has been pitched upon them; all this because they rejected the signs of Allah and slew the Prophets without right and because they wantonly disobeyed and used to transgress.

ayahs.text: Yet all are not alike: among the People of the Book there are upright people who recite the messages of Allah in the watches of the night and prostrate themselves in worship.
ayahs.translation: Yet all are not alike: among the People of the Book there are upright people who recite the messages of Allah in the watches of the night and prostrate themselves in worship.

ayahs.text: They believe in Allah and in the Last Day and enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong and hasten to excel each other in doing good. These are among the righteous.
ayahs.translation: They believe in Allah and in the Last Day and enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong and hasten to excel each other in doing good. These are among the righteous.

ayahs.text: Whatever good they do shall not go unappreciated- Allah fully knows those who are pious.
ayahs.translation: Whatever good they do shall not go unappreciated- Allah fully knows those who are pious.

ayahs.text: As for those who denied the Truth neither their possessions nor their children will avail them against Allah. They are the people of the Fire and therein they shall abide.
ayahs.translation: As for those who denied the Truth neither their possessions nor their children will avail them against Allah. They are the people of the Fire and therein they shall abide.

ayahs.text: The example of what they spend in the life of this world is like that of a wind accompanied with frost which smote the harvest of a people who wronged themselves and laid it to waste. It is not Allah who wronged them; rather it is they who wronged themselves.
ayahs.translation: The example of what they spend in the life of this world is like that of a wind accompanied with frost which smote the harvest of a people who wronged themselves and laid it to waste. It is not Allah who wronged them; rather it is they who wronged themselves.

ayahs.text: Believers! Do not take for intimate friends those who are not of your kind. They spare nothing to ruin you; indeed they long for you to suffer. Their hatred is clearly manifest in what they say and what their breasts conceal is even greater. Now We have made Our messages clear to you; if only you can understand (the danger of their intimacy).
ayahs.translation: Believers! Do not take for intimate friends those who are not of your kind. They spare nothing to ruin you; indeed they long for you to suffer. Their hatred is clearly manifest in what they say and what their breasts conceal is even greater. Now We have made Our messages clear to you; if only you can understand (the danger of their intimacy).

ayahs.text: Lo! It is you who love them but they do not love you even though you believe in the scriptures. When they meet you they say: ''We believe'' but when they are by themselves they bite their fingers in rage at you. Say: ''Perish in your rage.'' Allah knows even what lies hidden in their breasts.
ayahs.translation: Lo! It is you who love them but they do not love you even though you believe in the scriptures. When they meet you they say: ''We believe'' but when they are by themselves they bite their fingers in rage at you. Say: ''Perish in your rage.'' Allah knows even what lies hidden in their breasts.

ayahs.text: If anything good happens to you they are grieved; if any misfortune befalls you they rejoice.Yet if you remain steadfast and mindful of Allah their designs will not cause you any harm. Allah surely encompasses all that they do.
ayahs.translation: If anything good happens to you they are grieved; if any misfortune befalls you they rejoice.Yet if you remain steadfast and mindful of Allah their designs will not cause you any harm. Allah surely encompasses all that they do.

ayahs.text: (O Messenger remind the Muslims of the occasion) when you went forth from your home at early dawn (to the battlefield of Uhud) and placed the believers in battle arrays. Allah is All-Hearing All-Knowing.
ayahs.translation: (O Messenger remind the Muslims of the occasion) when you went forth from your home at early dawn (to the battlefield of Uhud) and placed the believers in battle arrays. Allah is All-Hearing All-Knowing.

ayahs.text: And recall when two groups from among you were inclined to flag although Allah was their protector; it is in Allah that the believers should put their trust.
ayahs.translation: And recall when two groups from among you were inclined to flag although Allah was their protector; it is in Allah that the believers should put their trust.

ayahs.text: For sure Allah helped you at Badr when you were utterly weak. Beware then of Allah; perhaps you will be thankful.
ayahs.translation: For sure Allah helped you at Badr when you were utterly weak. Beware then of Allah; perhaps you will be thankful.

ayahs.text: And recall when you said to the believers: ''Will it not suffice you that your Lord will aid you by sending down three thousand angels?
ayahs.translation: And recall when you said to the believers: ''Will it not suffice you that your Lord will aid you by sending down three thousand angels?

ayahs.text: If you are steadfast and mindful of God even though the enemy should suddenly fall upon you your Lord will help you with five thousand marked angels.
ayahs.translation: If you are steadfast and mindful of God even though the enemy should suddenly fall upon you your Lord will help you with five thousand marked angels.

ayahs.text: Allah has reminded you of this only as a glad tiding to you and to let your hearts be at rest. Help can only come from Allah the All-Mighty the All-Wise.
ayahs.translation: Allah has reminded you of this only as a glad tiding to you and to let your hearts be at rest. Help can only come from Allah the All-Mighty the All-Wise.

ayahs.text: (Allah provided this aid to you) in order that He may cut asunder a part of those who disbelieved or frustrate them so that they retreat in utter disappointment.
ayahs.translation: (Allah provided this aid to you) in order that He may cut asunder a part of those who disbelieved or frustrate them so that they retreat in utter disappointment.

ayahs.text: (O Messenger!) you have no part of the authority to decide whether He will accept their repentance or chastise them for they surely are wrongdoers.
ayahs.translation: (O Messenger!) you have no part of the authority to decide whether He will accept their repentance or chastise them for they surely are wrongdoers.

ayahs.text: Whatever is in the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah. He forgives whom He wills and chastises whom He wills: Allah is indeed All-Forgiving Most-Compassionate.
ayahs.translation: Whatever is in the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah. He forgives whom He wills and chastises whom He wills: Allah is indeed All-Forgiving Most-Compassionate.

ayahs.text: Believers! Do not devour interest doubled and redoubled and be mindful of Allah so that you may attain true success.
ayahs.translation: Believers! Do not devour interest doubled and redoubled and be mindful of Allah so that you may attain true success.

ayahs.text: and do have fear of the Fire which awaits those who deny the Truth.
ayahs.translation: and do have fear of the Fire which awaits those who deny the Truth.

ayahs.text: and obey Allah and the Messenger that mercy be shown to you.
ayahs.translation: and obey Allah and the Messenger that mercy be shown to you.

ayahs.text: And hasten to the forgiveness of your Lord and to a Paradise as vast as the heavens and the earth prepared for the God-fearing.
ayahs.translation: And hasten to the forgiveness of your Lord and to a Paradise as vast as the heavens and the earth prepared for the God-fearing.

ayahs.text: who spend in the way of Allah both in affluence and hardship who restrain their anger and forgive others. Allah loves such good-doers.""
ayahs.translation: who spend in the way of Allah both in affluence and hardship who restrain their anger and forgive others. Allah loves such good-doers.""

ayahs.text: These are the ones who when they commit any indecency or wrong themselves instantly remember Allah and implore forgiveness for their sins - for who will forgive sins save Allah? - and do not wilfully persist in the wrong they had committed.
ayahs.translation: These are the ones who when they commit any indecency or wrong themselves instantly remember Allah and implore forgiveness for their sins - for who will forgive sins save Allah? - and do not wilfully persist in the wrong they had committed.

ayahs.text: They shall be recompensed by forgiveness from their Lord and by Gardens beneath which rivers flow; there they shall abide. How good is the reward of those who earnestly labour!
ayahs.translation: They shall be recompensed by forgiveness from their Lord and by Gardens beneath which rivers flow; there they shall abide. How good is the reward of those who earnestly labour!

ayahs.text: Many eras have passed before you. Go about then in the land and behold the end of those who rejected (the directives and commands of Allah) calling them lies.
ayahs.translation: Many eras have passed before you. Go about then in the land and behold the end of those who rejected (the directives and commands of Allah) calling them lies.

ayahs.text: This is a plain exposition for mankind and a guidance and admonition for the God-fearing.
ayahs.translation: This is a plain exposition for mankind and a guidance and admonition for the God-fearing.

ayahs.text: Do not then lose heart or grieve: for you shall surely gain the upper hand if you are believers.
ayahs.translation: Do not then lose heart or grieve: for you shall surely gain the upper hand if you are believers.

ayahs.text: If you have suffered a wound the people opposed to you have suffered a similar wound. These are the vicissitudesof time which We deal out in turn among people so that Allah might mark out those who truly believe and select from among you those who really bear witness (to the Truth): for Allah does not love the wrong-doers
ayahs.translation: If you have suffered a wound the people opposed to you have suffered a similar wound. These are the vicissitudesof time which We deal out in turn among people so that Allah might mark out those who truly believe and select from among you those who really bear witness (to the Truth): for Allah does not love the wrong-doers

ayahs.text: and He makes men go through trials in order that He might purge the believers and blot out those who deny the Truth.
ayahs.translation: and He makes men go through trials in order that He might purge the believers and blot out those who deny the Truth.

ayahs.text: Did you think that you would enter Paradise even though Allah has not yet seen who among you strove hard in His way and remained steadfast?
ayahs.translation: Did you think that you would enter Paradise even though Allah has not yet seen who among you strove hard in His way and remained steadfast?

ayahs.text: You previously longed for death (in the way of Allah): now you have faced it observing it with your own eyes.
ayahs.translation: You previously longed for death (in the way of Allah): now you have faced it observing it with your own eyes.

ayahs.text: Muhammad is no more than a Messenger and Messengers have passed away before him.Then if he were to die or be slain will you turn about on your heels? Whoever turns about on his heels can in no way harm Allah. As for the grateful ones Allah will soon reward them.
ayahs.translation: Muhammad is no more than a Messenger and Messengers have passed away before him.Then if he were to die or be slain will you turn about on your heels? Whoever turns about on his heels can in no way harm Allah. As for the grateful ones Allah will soon reward them.

ayahs.text: It is not given to any soul to die except with the leave of Allah and at an appointed time.  He who desires his reward in this world We shall grant him the reward of this world; and he who desires the reward of the Other World We shall grant him the reward of the Other World. And soon shall We reward those that are grateful.
ayahs.translation: It is not given to any soul to die except with the leave of Allah and at an appointed time.  He who desires his reward in this world We shall grant him the reward of this world; and he who desires the reward of the Other World We shall grant him the reward of the Other World. And soon shall We reward those that are grateful.

ayahs.text: Many were the Prophets on whose side fought a large number of people devoted to God: they neither lost heart for all they had to suffer in the way of Allah nor did they weaken nor did they abase themselves. Allah loves such steadfast ones.
ayahs.translation: Many were the Prophets on whose side fought a large number of people devoted to God: they neither lost heart for all they had to suffer in the way of Allah nor did they weaken nor did they abase themselves. Allah loves such steadfast ones.

ayahs.text: And all they said was this: ''Our Lord! Forgive us our sins and our excesses in our affairs and set our feet firm and succour us against those who deny the Truth.''
ayahs.translation: And all they said was this: ''Our Lord! Forgive us our sins and our excesses in our affairs and set our feet firm and succour us against those who deny the Truth.''

ayahs.text: Thereupon Allah granted them the reward of this world as well as a better reward of the World to Come. Allah loves those who do good.
ayahs.translation: Thereupon Allah granted them the reward of this world as well as a better reward of the World to Come. Allah loves those who do good.

ayahs.text: Believers! If you follow those who deny the Truth they will drive you back on your heels and you will turn about losers.
ayahs.translation: Believers! If you follow those who deny the Truth they will drive you back on your heels and you will turn about losers.

ayahs.text: But Allah is your Protector and He is the best of helpers.
ayahs.translation: But Allah is your Protector and He is the best of helpers.

ayahs.text: We will cast terror into the hearts of those who have denied the Truth since they have associated others with Allah in His divinity for which He has sent down no sanction. The Fire is their abode; how bad the resting place of the wrong-doers will be!
ayahs.translation: We will cast terror into the hearts of those who have denied the Truth since they have associated others with Allah in His divinity for which He has sent down no sanction. The Fire is their abode; how bad the resting place of the wrong-doers will be!

ayahs.text: Allah surely fulfilled His promise (of succour) when you were slaying them by His leave until the moment when you flagged and quarrelled among yourselves about the matter and disobeyed (the Prophet) after He showed you what you intensely desire; for some of you sought this world and some of you sought the Next. Thereupon in order to put you to a test He turned you away from your foes. Still He pardoned you after that for Allah is Bounteous to those who believe.
ayahs.translation: Allah surely fulfilled His promise (of succour) when you were slaying them by His leave until the moment when you flagged and quarrelled among yourselves about the matter and disobeyed (the Prophet) after He showed you what you intensely desire; for some of you sought this world and some of you sought the Next. Thereupon in order to put you to a test He turned you away from your foes. Still He pardoned you after that for Allah is Bounteous to those who believe.

ayahs.text: Recall when you were fleeing without casting even a side glance at anyone and the Messenger was calling out to you from the rear. Then Allah requited you by inflicting grief after grief upon you so as to instruct you neither to grieve for the losses you might suffer or for the afflictions that might befall you. Allah knows all that you do.
ayahs.translation: Recall when you were fleeing without casting even a side glance at anyone and the Messenger was calling out to you from the rear. Then Allah requited you by inflicting grief after grief upon you so as to instruct you neither to grieve for the losses you might suffer or for the afflictions that might befall you. Allah knows all that you do.

ayahs.text: Then after inflicting this grief He sent down an inner peace upon you a sleep which overtook some of you. Those who were concerned merely about themselves entertaining false notions about Allah - the notions of the Age of Ignorance - asked: ''Have we any say in the matter?'' Tell them: ''Truly all power of decision rests solely with Allah.'' Indeed they conceal in their hearts what they would not reveal to you saying: ''If we had any power of decision we would not have been slain here.'' Say: ''Even if you had been in your houses those for whom slaying had been appointed would have gone forth to the places where they were to be slain.'' All this happened so that Allah might test the thoughts you entertained in your hearts and purge your hearts of all impurities. Allah knows well what is in the breasts of men.
ayahs.translation: Then after inflicting this grief He sent down an inner peace upon you a sleep which overtook some of you. Those who were concerned merely about themselves entertaining false notions about Allah - the notions of the Age of Ignorance - asked: ''Have we any say in the matter?'' Tell them: ''Truly all power of decision rests solely with Allah.'' Indeed they conceal in their hearts what they would not reveal to you saying: ''If we had any power of decision we would not have been slain here.'' Say: ''Even if you had been in your houses those for whom slaying had been appointed would have gone forth to the places where they were to be slain.'' All this happened so that Allah might test the thoughts you entertained in your hearts and purge your hearts of all impurities. Allah knows well what is in the breasts of men.

ayahs.text: Surely those of them who turned their backs on the day when the two armies met did so because Satan made them slip because of some of their lapses. But Allah has pardoned them; He is All-Forgiving All-Forbearing.
ayahs.translation: Surely those of them who turned their backs on the day when the two armies met did so because Satan made them slip because of some of their lapses. But Allah has pardoned them; He is All-Forgiving All-Forbearing.

ayahs.text: Believers do not be like those who disbelieved and said to their brethren (who meet some suffering) in the course of journey or fighting: ''Had they remained with us they would not have died nor been slain.'' Allah makes such thoughts the cause of deep regrets in their hearts. For in truth it is Allah alone who grants life and deals death. Allah sees all that you do.
ayahs.translation: Believers do not be like those who disbelieved and said to their brethren (who meet some suffering) in the course of journey or fighting: ''Had they remained with us they would not have died nor been slain.'' Allah makes such thoughts the cause of deep regrets in their hearts. For in truth it is Allah alone who grants life and deals death. Allah sees all that you do.

ayahs.text: If you were to be slain or to die in the way of Allah then surely Allah''s forgiveness and mercy are better than all the goods that people amass.
ayahs.translation: If you were to be slain or to die in the way of Allah then surely Allah''s forgiveness and mercy are better than all the goods that people amass.

ayahs.text: Were you to die or be slain it is to Allah that all of you will be mustered.
ayahs.translation: Were you to die or be slain it is to Allah that all of you will be mustered.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) It was thanks to Allah''s mercy that you were gentle to them. Had you been rough hard-hearted they would surely have scattered away from you. So pardon them and pray for their forgiveness and take counsel from them in matters of importance. And when you are resolved on a course of action put your trust in Allah; surely Allah loves those who put their trust (in Him).
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) It was thanks to Allah''s mercy that you were gentle to them. Had you been rough hard-hearted they would surely have scattered away from you. So pardon them and pray for their forgiveness and take counsel from them in matters of importance. And when you are resolved on a course of action put your trust in Allah; surely Allah loves those who put their trust (in Him).

ayahs.text: If Allah helps you none shall prevail over you; and if He forsakes you then who can help you? It is in Allah that the believers should put all their trust.
ayahs.translation: If Allah helps you none shall prevail over you; and if He forsakes you then who can help you? It is in Allah that the believers should put all their trust.

ayahs.text: It is not for a Prophet to defraud; and whoever defrauds shall bring with him the fruits of his fraud on the Day of Resurrection when every human being shall be paid in full what he has earned and shall not be wronged.
ayahs.translation: It is not for a Prophet to defraud; and whoever defrauds shall bring with him the fruits of his fraud on the Day of Resurrection when every human being shall be paid in full what he has earned and shall not be wronged.

ayahs.text: Is he who follows the good pleasure of Allah like him who is laden with Allah''s wrath and whose abode is Hell? How evil that is for a resting-place!
ayahs.translation: Is he who follows the good pleasure of Allah like him who is laden with Allah''s wrath and whose abode is Hell? How evil that is for a resting-place!

ayahs.text: They vary greatly in rank in the sight of Allah and Allah sees what they do.
ayahs.translation: They vary greatly in rank in the sight of Allah and Allah sees what they do.

ayahs.text: Surely Allah conferred a great favour on the believers when He raised from among them a Messenger to recite to them His signs and to purify them and to teach them the Book and Wisdom. For before that they were in manifest error.
ayahs.translation: Surely Allah conferred a great favour on the believers when He raised from among them a Messenger to recite to them His signs and to purify them and to teach them the Book and Wisdom. For before that they were in manifest error.

ayahs.text: And how come when a calamity befell you even though the enemy has suffered at your hands (in the Battle of Badr) twice what you have suffered you began to ask:   How has this come about?  Say: This calamity has been brought about by yourselves. Surely Allah has Power over every thing.
ayahs.translation: And how come when a calamity befell you even though the enemy has suffered at your hands (in the Battle of Badr) twice what you have suffered you began to ask:   How has this come about?  Say: This calamity has been brought about by yourselves. Surely Allah has Power over every thing.

ayahs.text: What befell you on the day when the two hosts met was by the leave of Allah and in order that He might mark out those who believe
ayahs.translation: What befell you on the day when the two hosts met was by the leave of Allah and in order that He might mark out those who believe

ayahs.text: from those who are hypocrites. And when these hypocrites were asked: ''Come and fight in the wayof Allah'' or (at least) ''defend yourselves'' they answered: ''If we but knew that there would be fighting we would certainly have followed. They were thennearer to infidelity than to faith. They utter from their mouths what is not in their hearts. Allah knows well what they conceal.
ayahs.translation: from those who are hypocrites. And when these hypocrites were asked: ''Come and fight in the wayof Allah'' or (at least) ''defend yourselves'' they answered: ''If we but knew that there would be fighting we would certainly have followed. They were thennearer to infidelity than to faith. They utter from their mouths what is not in their hearts. Allah knows well what they conceal.

ayahs.text: These are the ones who stayed away saying about their brothers: ''Had they followed us they would not have been slain.'' Say: ''If you speak the truth then avert death when it comes to you.''
ayahs.translation: These are the ones who stayed away saying about their brothers: ''Had they followed us they would not have been slain.'' Say: ''If you speak the truth then avert death when it comes to you.''

ayahs.text: Think not of those slain in the way of Allah as dead. Indeed they are living and with their Lord they have their sustenance
ayahs.translation: Think not of those slain in the way of Allah as dead. Indeed they are living and with their Lord they have their sustenance

ayahs.text: rejoicing in what Allah has bestowed upon them out of His bounty jubilant that neither fear nor grief shall come upon the believers who have been left behind in the world and have not yet joined them.
ayahs.translation: rejoicing in what Allah has bestowed upon them out of His bounty jubilant that neither fear nor grief shall come upon the believers who have been left behind in the world and have not yet joined them.

ayahs.text: They rejoice at the favours and bounties of Allah and at the awareness that Allah will not cause the reward of the believers to be lost.
ayahs.translation: They rejoice at the favours and bounties of Allah and at the awareness that Allah will not cause the reward of the believers to be lost.

ayahs.text: There were those who responded to the call of Allah and the Messenger after injury had smitten them. There is mighty reward for all those who do good and fear Allah.
ayahs.translation: There were those who responded to the call of Allah and the Messenger after injury had smitten them. There is mighty reward for all those who do good and fear Allah.

ayahs.text: When people said to them: ''Behold a host has gathered around you and you should fear them'' it only increased their faith and they answered: ''Allah is Sufficient for us; and what an excellent Guardian He is!''
ayahs.translation: When people said to them: ''Behold a host has gathered around you and you should fear them'' it only increased their faith and they answered: ''Allah is Sufficient for us; and what an excellent Guardian He is!''

ayahs.text: So they returned with a mighty favour and a great bounty from Allah having suffered no harm. They followed the good pleasure of Allah and Allah is the Lord of great bounty.
ayahs.translation: So they returned with a mighty favour and a great bounty from Allah having suffered no harm. They followed the good pleasure of Allah and Allah is the Lord of great bounty.

ayahs.text: It was Satan who urged you to have fear of his allies. But do not fear them; fear Me if you truly believe.
ayahs.translation: It was Satan who urged you to have fear of his allies. But do not fear them; fear Me if you truly believe.

ayahs.text: Let not those who run towards unbelief grieve you; they shall not hurt Allah in the least. Allah will not provide for them any share in the Next Life. A mighty chastisement awaits them.
ayahs.translation: Let not those who run towards unbelief grieve you; they shall not hurt Allah in the least. Allah will not provide for them any share in the Next Life. A mighty chastisement awaits them.

ayahs.text: Indeed those who have purchased unbelief in exchange for faith shall not hurt Allah in the least. Theirs shall be a painful chastisement.
ayahs.translation: Indeed those who have purchased unbelief in exchange for faith shall not hurt Allah in the least. Theirs shall be a painful chastisement.

ayahs.text: Let not the unbelievers imagine that the respite We grant them is good for them. We grant them respite so that they may grow in wickedness. A humiliating chastisement awaits them.
ayahs.translation: Let not the unbelievers imagine that the respite We grant them is good for them. We grant them respite so that they may grow in wickedness. A humiliating chastisement awaits them.

ayahs.text: Allah will not let the believers stay in the state they are: He will set the wicked apart from the good. Allah is not going to disclose to you what is hidden in the realm beyond the reach of perception but He chooses from among His Messengers whom He wills (to intimate such knowledge). So believe in Allah and in His Messengers; and if you believe and become God-fearing yours will be a great reward.
ayahs.translation: Allah will not let the believers stay in the state they are: He will set the wicked apart from the good. Allah is not going to disclose to you what is hidden in the realm beyond the reach of perception but He chooses from among His Messengers whom He wills (to intimate such knowledge). So believe in Allah and in His Messengers; and if you believe and become God-fearing yours will be a great reward.

ayahs.text: Those who are niggardly about what Allah has granted them out of His bounty think that niggardliness is good for them;rather it is bad for them. What they were niggardly about will turn into a halter round their necks on the Day of Resurrection. To Allah belongs the inheritance of the heavens and the earth. Allah is well aware of what you do.
ayahs.translation: Those who are niggardly about what Allah has granted them out of His bounty think that niggardliness is good for them;rather it is bad for them. What they were niggardly about will turn into a halter round their necks on the Day of Resurrection. To Allah belongs the inheritance of the heavens and the earth. Allah is well aware of what you do.

ayahs.text: Allah has heard the saying of those who said: ''Allah is poor and we are rich. We shall record what they have said and the fact of their slaying the Prophets unjustly and we shall say to them: Taste now the torment of the Fire.
ayahs.translation: Allah has heard the saying of those who said: ''Allah is poor and we are rich. We shall record what they have said and the fact of their slaying the Prophets unjustly and we shall say to them: Taste now the torment of the Fire.

ayahs.text: That is in recompense for your own deeds.'' Allah does no wrong to His servants.
ayahs.translation: That is in recompense for your own deeds.'' Allah does no wrong to His servants.

ayahs.text: To those who say: ''Allah has directed us that we accept none as Messenger until he makes an offering that the fire will consume'' say: ''Other Messengers came to you before me with clear signs and with the sign you have mentioned. So why did you slay them if what you say is true?
ayahs.translation: To those who say: ''Allah has directed us that we accept none as Messenger until he makes an offering that the fire will consume'' say: ''Other Messengers came to you before me with clear signs and with the sign you have mentioned. So why did you slay them if what you say is true?

ayahs.text: Now if they give the lie to you then other Messengers who came with Clear Signs and scriptures and the illuminating Book were also given the lie to before you.
ayahs.translation: Now if they give the lie to you then other Messengers who came with Clear Signs and scriptures and the illuminating Book were also given the lie to before you.

ayahs.text: Everyone is bound to taste death and you shall receive your full reward on the Day of Resurrection. Then whoever is spared the Fire and is admitted to Paradise has indeed been successful. The life of this world is merely an illusory enjoyment.
ayahs.translation: Everyone is bound to taste death and you shall receive your full reward on the Day of Resurrection. Then whoever is spared the Fire and is admitted to Paradise has indeed been successful. The life of this world is merely an illusory enjoyment.

ayahs.text: (Believers!) You will certainly be put to test in regardto your properties and lives and you will certainly hear many hurtful things from those who were granted the Book before you and those who have associated others with Allah in His divinity. If you remain patient and God-fearing this indeed is a matter of great resolution.
ayahs.translation: (Believers!) You will certainly be put to test in regardto your properties and lives and you will certainly hear many hurtful things from those who were granted the Book before you and those who have associated others with Allah in His divinity. If you remain patient and God-fearing this indeed is a matter of great resolution.

ayahs.text: Recall when Allah took a covenant from those who were given the Book: ''You shall explain it to people and not hide it. Then they cast the Book behind their backs and sold it away for a trivial gain. Evil indeed is their bargain.
ayahs.translation: Recall when Allah took a covenant from those who were given the Book: ''You shall explain it to people and not hide it. Then they cast the Book behind their backs and sold it away for a trivial gain. Evil indeed is their bargain.

ayahs.text: Do not think that those who exult in their misdeeds and love to be praised for what indeed they have not done do not (even) think that they are secure from chastisement. A painful chastisement awaits them.
ayahs.translation: Do not think that those who exult in their misdeeds and love to be praised for what indeed they have not done do not (even) think that they are secure from chastisement. A painful chastisement awaits them.

ayahs.text: To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; and Allah is All-Powerful.
ayahs.translation: To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; and Allah is All-Powerful.

ayahs.text: Surely in the creation of the heavens and the earth and in the alternation of night and day there are signs for people of understanding.
ayahs.translation: Surely in the creation of the heavens and the earth and in the alternation of night and day there are signs for people of understanding.

ayahs.text: those who remember Allah while standing sitting or (reclining) on their backs and reflect in the creation of the heavens and the earth (saying): ''Our Lord! You have not created this in vain. Glory to You! Save us then from the chastisement of the Fire.
ayahs.translation: those who remember Allah while standing sitting or (reclining) on their backs and reflect in the creation of the heavens and the earth (saying): ''Our Lord! You have not created this in vain. Glory to You! Save us then from the chastisement of the Fire.

ayahs.text: Our Lord! Whomsoever You cause to enter the Fire him You indeed bring to disgrace and there will be none to succour the wrong-doers.
ayahs.translation: Our Lord! Whomsoever You cause to enter the Fire him You indeed bring to disgrace and there will be none to succour the wrong-doers.

ayahs.text: Our Lord! we Indeed heard a crier calling to the faith saying: ""Believe in your Lord""; so we did believe. Our Lord! forgive us our sins and wipe out our evil deeds and make us die with the truly pious.''
ayahs.translation: Our Lord! we Indeed heard a crier calling to the faith saying: ""Believe in your Lord""; so we did believe. Our Lord! forgive us our sins and wipe out our evil deeds and make us die with the truly pious.''

ayahs.text: Our Lord fulfil what You promised to us through Your Messengers and disgrace us not on the Day of Resurrection; indeed You never go back on Your promise.
ayahs.translation: Our Lord fulfil what You promised to us through Your Messengers and disgrace us not on the Day of Resurrection; indeed You never go back on Your promise.

ayahs.text: Their Lord answered the Prayer thus: ""I will not suffer the work of any of you whether male or female to go to waste; each of you is from the other. Those who emigrated and were driven out from their homesteads and were persecuted in My cause and who fought and were slain indeed I shall wipe out their evil deeds from them and shall certainly admit them to the gardens beneath which rivers flow."" This is their reward with their Lord; and with Allah lies the best reward.
ayahs.translation: Their Lord answered the Prayer thus: ""I will not suffer the work of any of you whether male or female to go to waste; each of you is from the other. Those who emigrated and were driven out from their homesteads and were persecuted in My cause and who fought and were slain indeed I shall wipe out their evil deeds from them and shall certainly admit them to the gardens beneath which rivers flow."" This is their reward with their Lord; and with Allah lies the best reward.

ayahs.text: (O Messenger!) Do not let the strutting about of the unbelievers in the land deceive you.
ayahs.translation: (O Messenger!) Do not let the strutting about of the unbelievers in the land deceive you.

ayahs.text: This is but a trifling and fleeting enjoyment then their destination is Hell -what an evil resting place!
ayahs.translation: This is but a trifling and fleeting enjoyment then their destination is Hell -what an evil resting place!

ayahs.text: But those who fear their Lord: theirs shall be the gardens beneath which rivers flow and therein they will live forever: a hospitality from Allah. And Allah''s reward is best for the truly pious.
ayahs.translation: But those who fear their Lord: theirs shall be the gardens beneath which rivers flow and therein they will live forever: a hospitality from Allah. And Allah''s reward is best for the truly pious.

ayahs.text: Among the People of the Book some believe in Allah and what has been revealed to you and what has been revealed to them. They humble themselves before Allah and do not sell Allah''s revelations for a trivial gain. For such their reward lies with their Lord. Allah is swift in reckoning.
ayahs.translation: Among the People of the Book some believe in Allah and what has been revealed to you and what has been revealed to them. They humble themselves before Allah and do not sell Allah''s revelations for a trivial gain. For such their reward lies with their Lord. Allah is swift in reckoning.

ayahs.text: Believers be steadfast and vie in steadfastness stand firm in your faith and hold Allah in fear that you may attain true success.
ayahs.translation: Believers be steadfast and vie in steadfastness stand firm in your faith and hold Allah in fear that you may attain true success.

verses.text: In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate

verses.text: O people! Fear your Lord Who created you from a single being and out of it created its mate  and out of the two spread many men and women. Fear Allah in Whose name you plead for rights, and heed the ties of kinship. Surely, Allah is ever watchful over you.
verses.translation: O people! Fear your Lord Who created you from a single being and out of it created its mate  and out of the two spread many men and women. Fear Allah in Whose name you plead for rights, and heed the ties of kinship. Surely, Allah is ever watchful over you.

verses.text: Give orphans their property,and do not exchange the bad for the good,and do not eat up their property by mixing it with your own. This surely is a mighty sin.
verses.translation: Give orphans their property,and do not exchange the bad for the good,and do not eat up their property by mixing it with your own. This surely is a mighty sin.

verses.text: If you fear that you might not treat the orphans justly, then marry the women that seem good to you: two, or three, or four.If you fear that you will not be able to treat them justly, then marry (only) one,or marry from among those whom your right hands possess.This will make it more likely that you will avoid injustice.
verses.translation: If you fear that you might not treat the orphans justly, then marry the women that seem good to you: two, or three, or four.If you fear that you will not be able to treat them justly, then marry (only) one,or marry from among those whom your right hands possess.This will make it more likely that you will avoid injustice.

verses.text: Give women their bridal-due in good cheer (considering it a duty)  but if they willingly remit any part of it, consume it with good pleasure.
verses.translation: Give women their bridal-due in good cheer (considering it a duty)  but if they willingly remit any part of it, consume it with good pleasure.

verses.text: Do not entrust your properties - which Allah hasmade a means of support for you - to the weak of understanding, but maintain and clothe them out of it, and say to them a kind word of admonition.
verses.translation: Do not entrust your properties - which Allah hasmade a means of support for you - to the weak of understanding, but maintain and clothe them out of it, and say to them a kind word of admonition.

verses.text: Test the orphans until they reach the age of marriage,and then if you find them mature of mind hand over to them their property,and do not eat it up by either spending extravagantly or in haste, fearing that they would grow up (and claim it). If the guardian of the orphan is rich let him abstain entirely (from his ward''s property)  and if he is poor, let him partake of it in a fair measure.When you hand over their property to them let there be witnesses on their behalf. Allah is sufficient to take account (of your deeds).
verses.translation: Test the orphans until they reach the age of marriage,and then if you find them mature of mind hand over to them their property,and do not eat it up by either spending extravagantly or in haste, fearing that they would grow up (and claim it). If the guardian of the orphan is rich let him abstain entirely (from his ward''s property)  and if he is poor, let him partake of it in a fair measure.When you hand over their property to them let there be witnesses on their behalf. Allah is sufficient to take account (of your deeds).

verses.text: Just as there is a share for men in what their parents and kinsfolk leave behind, so there is a share for women in what their parents and kinsfolk leave behind - be it little or much- a share ordained (by Allah).
verses.translation: Just as there is a share for men in what their parents and kinsfolk leave behind, so there is a share for women in what their parents and kinsfolk leave behind - be it little or much- a share ordained (by Allah).

verses.text: And If other near of kin, orphans and needy are present at the time of division of inheritance give them something of it and speak to them kindly.
verses.translation: And If other near of kin, orphans and needy are present at the time of division of inheritance give them something of it and speak to them kindly.

verses.text: And those who would have been fearful on account of their helpless offspring they may have behind them, let them fear Allah and say what is right.
verses.translation: And those who would have been fearful on account of their helpless offspring they may have behind them, let them fear Allah and say what is right.

verses.text: Behold, those who wrongfully devour the properties of orphans only fill their bellies with fire. Soon they will burn in the Blazing Flame.
verses.translation: Behold, those who wrongfully devour the properties of orphans only fill their bellies with fire. Soon they will burn in the Blazing Flame.

verses.text:
Thus does Allah command you concerning your children: the share of the male is like that of two females. If (the heirs of the deceased are) more than two daughters, they shall have two-thirds of the inheritance  and if there is only one daughter, then she shall have half the inheritance. If the deceased has any offspring, each of his parents shall have a sixth of the inheritance  and if the deceased has no child and his parents alone inherit him, then one-third shall go to his mother  and if the deceased has brothers and sisters, then one-sixth shall go to his mother. All these shares are to be given after payment of the bequest he might have made or any debts outstanding against him.
You do not know which of them, your parents or your children, are more beneficial to you. But these portions have been determined by Allah, for He indeed knows everything, is cognizant of all beneficent considerations.
verses.translation:
Thus does Allah command you concerning your children: the share of the male is like that of two females.
