verses.translation: He continued: ''You shall live there and there shall you die and from it you shall be raised to life.''

verses.text: O Children of Adam! Indeed We have sent down to you a garment which covers your shame and provides protection and adornment. But the finest of all is the garment of piety. That is one of the signs of Allah so that they may take heed.
verses.translation: O Children of Adam! Indeed We have sent down to you a garment which covers your shame and provides protection and adornment. But the finest of all is the garment of piety. That is one of the signs of Allah so that they may take heed.

verses.text: Children of Adam! Let not Satan deceive you in the manner he deceived your parents out of Paradise pulling off from them their clothing to reveal to them their shame. He and his host surely see you from whence you do not see them. We have made satans the guardians of those who do not believe.
verses.translation: Children of Adam! Let not Satan deceive you in the manner he deceived your parents out of Paradise pulling off from them their clothing to reveal to them their shame. He and his host surely see you from whence you do not see them. We have made satans the guardians of those who do not believe.

verses.text: And when such people commit an indecent act they say: ''We found our fathers doing that and Allah has enjoined it on us. Say: ''Surely Allah never enjoins any indecency. Do you say things regarding Allah that you do not know?''
verses.translation: And when such people commit an indecent act they say: ''We found our fathers doing that and Allah has enjoined it on us. Say: ''Surely Allah never enjoins any indecency. Do you say things regarding Allah that you do not know?''

verses.text: Say to them (O Muhammad): ''My Lord enjoins justice; and that you set your faces aright at the time of every Prayer; and that you call upon Him exclusively dedicating your faith to Him. You shall return to Him as you were created.''
verses.translation: Say to them (O Muhammad): ''My Lord enjoins justice; and that you set your faces aright at the time of every Prayer; and that you call upon Him exclusively dedicating your faith to Him. You shall return to Him as you were created.''

verses.text: A party He has guided to the Right Way and for another party straying is justly its due for they have taken satans rather than Allah as their guardians for they think that they are rightly-guided.
verses.translation: A party He has guided to the Right Way and for another party straying is justly its due for they have taken satans rather than Allah as their guardians for they think that they are rightly-guided.

verses.text: Children of Adam! Take your adornment at every time of Prayer;and eat and drink without going to excesses. For Allah does not like those who go to excess.
verses.translation: Children of Adam! Take your adornment at every time of Prayer;and eat and drink without going to excesses. For Allah does not like those who go to excess.

verses.text: Say (O Muhammad): ''Who has forbidden the adornment which Allah has brought forth for His creatures or the good things from among the means of sustenance?'' Say: ''These are for the enjoyment of the believers in this world and shall be exclusively theirs on the Day of Resurrection.'' Thus do We clearly expound Our revelations for those who have knowledge.
verses.translation: Say (O Muhammad): ''Who has forbidden the adornment which Allah has brought forth for His creatures or the good things from among the means of sustenance?'' Say: ''These are for the enjoyment of the believers in this world and shall be exclusively theirs on the Day of Resurrection.'' Thus do We clearly expound Our revelations for those who have knowledge.

verses.text: Tell them (O Muhammad): ''My Lord has only forbidden indecent acts whether overt or hidden; all manner of sin; wrongful transgression; and [He has forbidden] that you associate with Allah in His divinity that for which He has sent down no sanction; and that you ascribe to Allah things of which you have no sure knowledge that they are from Him.''
verses.translation: Tell them (O Muhammad): ''My Lord has only forbidden indecent acts whether overt or hidden; all manner of sin; wrongful transgression; and [He has forbidden] that you associate with Allah in His divinity that for which He has sent down no sanction; and that you ascribe to Allah things of which you have no sure knowledge that they are from Him.''

verses.text: For every community there is an appointed term; and when its term arrives they cannot delay it by a moment nor can they hasten it.
verses.translation: For every community there is an appointed term; and when its term arrives they cannot delay it by a moment nor can they hasten it.

verses.text: Children of Adam! If Messengers come to you from amongst yourselves rehearsing to you My signs then those who shun disobedience and mend their ways shall have nothing to fear nor shall they grieve.
verses.translation: Children of Adam! If Messengers come to you from amongst yourselves rehearsing to you My signs then those who shun disobedience and mend their ways shall have nothing to fear nor shall they grieve.

verses.text: And those who reject Our revelations as false and arrogantly turn away from them they shall be the inmates of Hell; and there they shall abide.
verses.translation: And those who reject Our revelations as false and arrogantly turn away from them they shall be the inmates of Hell; and there they shall abide.

verses.text: Who is more unjust then he who invents a falsehood ascribing it to Allah or who rejects His revelation as false? Their full portion of God''s Decree shall reach them until Our deputed angels come to them to take charge of their souls and say: ''Where are the deities now those whom you invoked besides Allah?'' They will say: ''They are all gone away from us.'' And they shall bear witness against themselves that they were unbelievers.
verses.translation: Who is more unjust then he who invents a falsehood ascribing it to Allah or who rejects His revelation as false? Their full portion of God''s Decree shall reach them until Our deputed angels come to them to take charge of their souls and say: ''Where are the deities now those whom you invoked besides Allah?'' They will say: ''They are all gone away from us.'' And they shall bear witness against themselves that they were unbelievers.

verses.text: Allah will say:  Enter the fire of Hell and join the groups of jinn and humans that have gone before you.  As a group enters Hell it will curse the one that went before it and when all are gathered there the last of them shall say of the first:  Our Lord! These are the ones who led us astray. Let their torment be doubled in Hell-Fire.  He will answer:  Each will have a doubled torment; although you do not know.
verses.translation: Allah will say:  Enter the fire of Hell and join the groups of jinn and humans that have gone before you.  As a group enters Hell it will curse the one that went before it and when all are gathered there the last of them shall say of the first:  Our Lord! These are the ones who led us astray. Let their torment be doubled in Hell-Fire.  He will answer:  Each will have a doubled torment; although you do not know.

verses.text: Then the preceding ones will say to the succeeding ones: ''You were in no way superior to us; taste then this torment for your deeds.''
verses.translation: Then the preceding ones will say to the succeeding ones: ''You were in no way superior to us; taste then this torment for your deeds.''

verses.text: Surely the gates of Heaven shall not be opened for those who reject Our signs as false and turn away '' from them in arrogance; nor shall they enter Paradise until a camel passes through the eye of a needle. Thus do We reward the guilty ones.
verses.translation: Surely the gates of Heaven shall not be opened for those who reject Our signs as false and turn away '' from them in arrogance; nor shall they enter Paradise until a camel passes through the eye of a needle. Thus do We reward the guilty ones.

verses.text: Hell shall be their bed and also above them their covering. Thus do We reward the wrong-doers.
verses.translation: Hell shall be their bed and also above them their covering. Thus do We reward the wrong-doers.

verses.text: As for those who believe and do good We do not impose upon any of them a burden beyond his capacity. They are the people of Paradise. And there they shall abide.
verses.translation: As for those who believe and do good We do not impose upon any of them a burden beyond his capacity. They are the people of Paradise. And there they shall abide.

verses.text: We shall strip away all rancour from their hearts and rivers shall flow beneath them and they shall say: ''All praise be to Allah Who has guided us on to this. Had it not been for Allah Who granted us right guidance we would not be on the Right Path. Surely the Messengers of our Lord came down with Truth.'' Then a voice will cry out to them: ''This is the Paradise which you are made to inherit as a reward for your deeds.''
verses.translation: We shall strip away all rancour from their hearts and rivers shall flow beneath them and they shall say: ''All praise be to Allah Who has guided us on to this. Had it not been for Allah Who granted us right guidance we would not be on the Right Path. Surely the Messengers of our Lord came down with Truth.'' Then a voice will cry out to them: ''This is the Paradise which you are made to inherit as a reward for your deeds.''

verses.text: And the people of Paradise shall cry to the people of Hell: ''Surely we have found our Lord''s promise to us to be true; have you also found true what your Lord has promised you?'' ''Yes'' they shall answer; and a herald shall cry out among them: ''Allah''s curse be upon the wrong-doers'';
verses.translation: And the people of Paradise shall cry to the people of Hell: ''Surely we have found our Lord''s promise to us to be true; have you also found true what your Lord has promised you?'' ''Yes'' they shall answer; and a herald shall cry out among them: ''Allah''s curse be upon the wrong-doers'';

verses.text: upon those who hinder people from the path of Allah and seek to make it crooked; and disbelieve in the Hereafter.''
verses.translation: upon those who hinder people from the path of Allah and seek to make it crooked; and disbelieve in the Hereafter.''

verses.text: And between the two there will be a barrier and on the Heights will be some other people who will recognize each person by his mark and will cry out to the people of Paradise:  Peace be to you .These will be the ones who had not yet joined them in Paradise though they long to do so.
verses.translation: And between the two there will be a barrier and on the Heights will be some other people who will recognize each person by his mark and will cry out to the people of Paradise:  Peace be to you .These will be the ones who had not yet joined them in Paradise though they long to do so.

verses.text: And when the eyes of the people of the Heights will be turned towards the people of Hell they will say:  Our Lord! Do not cast us with the wrong-doing people.''
verses.translation: And when the eyes of the people of the Heights will be turned towards the people of Hell they will say:  Our Lord! Do not cast us with the wrong-doing people.''

verses.text: And the people of the Heights will cry out to the prominent people (of Hell) whom they would recognize by their marks:  Neither your host nor the riches of which you were proud availed you.
verses.translation: And the people of the Heights will cry out to the prominent people (of Hell) whom they would recognize by their marks:  Neither your host nor the riches of which you were proud availed you.

verses.text: Are these (People of Paradise) not the ones about whom you swore that Allah shall grant them no part of His mercy?  To such it will be said:  Enter Paradise. You have no cause to fear nor shall you grieve.''
verses.translation: Are these (People of Paradise) not the ones about whom you swore that Allah shall grant them no part of His mercy?  To such it will be said:  Enter Paradise. You have no cause to fear nor shall you grieve.''

verses.text: And the people of the Fire will cry out to the people of Paradise: ''Pour out some water on us or throw at us something of what Allah has bestowed upon you.'' They will reply: ''Allah has forbidden both of theseto the deniers of the Truth
verses.translation: And the people of the Fire will cry out to the people of Paradise: ''Pour out some water on us or throw at us something of what Allah has bestowed upon you.'' They will reply: ''Allah has forbidden both of theseto the deniers of the Truth

verses.text: who had made their religion a sport and play and who were beguiled by the life of the world. So on that Day We shall forget them in the manner they forget their meeting of this Day with Us and persisted in denying Our revelations.''
verses.translation: who had made their religion a sport and play and who were beguiled by the life of the world. So on that Day We shall forget them in the manner they forget their meeting of this Day with Us and persisted in denying Our revelations.''

verses.text: Surely We have brought them a Book which We expounded with knowledge; a guidance and a mercy to those who believe.
verses.translation: Surely We have brought them a Book which We expounded with knowledge; a guidance and a mercy to those who believe.

verses.text: Are they waiting for the fulfilment of its warning? On the Day that warning is fulfilled those that have neglected it before will say: ''The Messengers of Our Lord did indeed bring forth the truth. Are there any intercessors who will now plead on our behalf? Or can we be restored to life that we might perform differently from that which we did?'' They surely ended in utter loss and the lies they had fabricated failed them.
verses.translation: Are they waiting for the fulfilment of its warning? On the Day that warning is fulfilled those that have neglected it before will say: ''The Messengers of Our Lord did indeed bring forth the truth. Are there any intercessors who will now plead on our behalf? Or can we be restored to life that we might perform differently from that which we did?'' They surely ended in utter loss and the lies they had fabricated failed them.

verses.text: Surely your Lord is none other than Allah Who created the heavens and the earth in six days and then ascended His Throne; Who causes the night to cover the day and then the day swiftly pursues the night; Who created the sun and the moon and the stars making them all subservient to His command. Lo! His is the creation and His is the command. Blessed is Allah the Lord of the whole universe.
verses.translation: Surely your Lord is none other than Allah Who created the heavens and the earth in six days and then ascended His Throne; Who causes the night to cover the day and then the day swiftly pursues the night; Who created the sun and the moon and the stars making them all subservient to His command. Lo! His is the creation and His is the command. Blessed is Allah the Lord of the whole universe.

verses.text: Call upon your Lord with humility and in secret. Surely He does not love the transgressors.
verses.translation: Call upon your Lord with humility and in secret. Surely He does not love the transgressors.

verses.text: Anddo not make mischief in the earth after it has been set in order and call upon Him with fear and longing. Surely Allah''s mercy is close to those who do good.
verses.translation: Anddo not make mischief in the earth after it has been set in order and call upon Him with fear and longing. Surely Allah''s mercy is close to those who do good.

verses.text: And it is He Who sends forth winds as glad tidings in advance of His Mercy and when they have carried a heavy-laden cloud We drive it to a dead land then We send down rain from it and therewithbring forthfruits of every kind. In this manner do We raise the dead that you may take heed.
verses.translation: And it is He Who sends forth winds as glad tidings in advance of His Mercy and when they have carried a heavy-laden cloud We drive it to a dead land then We send down rain from it and therewithbring forthfruits of every kind. In this manner do We raise the dead that you may take heed.

verses.text: As for the good land vegetation comes forth in abundance by the command of its Lord whereas from the bad land only poor vegetation comes forth. Thus do We expound Our signs in diverse ways for a people who are grateful.
verses.translation: As for the good land vegetation comes forth in abundance by the command of its Lord whereas from the bad land only poor vegetation comes forth. Thus do We expound Our signs in diverse ways for a people who are grateful.

verses.text: Indeed We sent forth Noah to his people and he said: ''0 my people! Serve Allah you have no other god than Him Indeed I fear for you the chastisement of an awesome Day.''
verses.translation: Indeed We sent forth Noah to his people and he said: ''0 my people! Serve Allah you have no other god than Him Indeed I fear for you the chastisement of an awesome Day.''

verses.text: The leading people of his nation replied:  We see that you are in palpable error.
verses.translation: The leading people of his nation replied:  We see that you are in palpable error.

verses.text: He said: ''O my people! There is no error in me but I am a Messenger from the Lord of the universe.
verses.translation: He said: ''O my people! There is no error in me but I am a Messenger from the Lord of the universe.

verses.text: I convey to you the messages of my Lord give you sincere advice and I know from Allah that which you do not know.
verses.translation: I convey to you the messages of my Lord give you sincere advice and I know from Allah that which you do not know.

verses.text: Do you wonder that admonition should come to you from your Lord through a man from amongst yourselves that he may warn you that you may avoid evil and that mercy may be shown to you?''
verses.translation: Do you wonder that admonition should come to you from your Lord through a man from amongst yourselves that he may warn you that you may avoid evil and that mercy may be shown to you?''

verses.text: But they charged him with falsehood. Thereupon We delivered Noah and those who were with him in the Ark and caused those who rejected Our signs as false to be drowned. Surely they were a blind folk.
verses.translation: But they charged him with falsehood. Thereupon We delivered Noah and those who were with him in the Ark and caused those who rejected Our signs as false to be drowned. Surely they were a blind folk.

verses.text: And to ''Ad We sent forth their brother Hud. He said: ''O my people! Serve Allah you have no other god than He. Will you then not avoid evil?''
verses.translation: And to ''Ad We sent forth their brother Hud. He said: ''O my people! Serve Allah you have no other god than He. Will you then not avoid evil?''

verses.text: The unbelievers among the leading men of his people said: ''Indeed we see you in folly and consider you to be a liar.''
verses.translation: The unbelievers among the leading men of his people said: ''Indeed we see you in folly and consider you to be a liar.''

verses.text: He said: ''O my people! There is no folly in me; rather I am a Messenger from the Lord of the universe.
verses.translation: He said: ''O my people! There is no folly in me; rather I am a Messenger from the Lord of the universe.

verses.text: I convey to you the messages of my Lord and I give you sincere advice.
verses.translation: I convey to you the messages of my Lord and I give you sincere advice.

verses.text: Do you wonder that an exhortation should come to you from your Lord through a man from amongst yourselves that he may warn you? And do call to mind when He made you successors after the people of Noah and amply increased you in stature. Remember then the wondrous bounties of Allah that you may prosper.''
verses.translation: Do you wonder that an exhortation should come to you from your Lord through a man from amongst yourselves that he may warn you? And do call to mind when He made you successors after the people of Noah and amply increased you in stature. Remember then the wondrous bounties of Allah that you may prosper.''

verses.text: They said: ''Have you come to us that we should worship none other than Allah and forsake all whom our forefathers were wont to worship? Then bring upon us the scourge with which you have threatened us if you are truthful?''
verses.translation: They said: ''Have you come to us that we should worship none other than Allah and forsake all whom our forefathers were wont to worship? Then bring upon us the scourge with which you have threatened us if you are truthful?''

verses.text: Hud warned them: ''Surely punishment and wrath from your Lord have befallen upon you. Do you dispute with me about mere names that you and your forefathers have concocted and for which Allah has sent down no sanction? Wait then and I too am with you among those who wait.''
verses.translation: Hud warned them: ''Surely punishment and wrath from your Lord have befallen upon you. Do you dispute with me about mere names that you and your forefathers have concocted and for which Allah has sent down no sanction? Wait then and I too am with you among those who wait.''

verses.text: Then We delivered Hud and his companions by Our mercy and We utterly cut off the last remnant of those who gave the lie to Our signs and would not believe.
verses.translation: Then We delivered Hud and his companions by Our mercy and We utterly cut off the last remnant of those who gave the lie to Our signs and would not believe.

verses.text: And to Thamud We sent forth their brother Salih. He said to them: ''O my people! Serve Allah you have no other god than He. Truly there has come to you a clear proof from your Lord. This she-camel from Allah is a Divine portent for you. So leave her alone to pasture on Allah''s earth and touch her with no evil lest a painful chastisement should seize you.
verses.translation: And to Thamud We sent forth their brother Salih. He said to them: ''O my people! Serve Allah you have no other god than He. Truly there has come to you a clear proof from your Lord. This she-camel from Allah is a Divine portent for you. So leave her alone to pasture on Allah''s earth and touch her with no evil lest a painful chastisement should seize you.

verses.text: And call to mind when after ''Ad He made you their successors and gave you power in the earth so that you took for yourselves palaces in its plains and hewed out dwellings in the mountains. Remember then the wondrous bounties of Allah and do not go about creating mischief in the land.
verses.translation: And call to mind when after ''Ad He made you their successors and gave you power in the earth so that you took for yourselves palaces in its plains and hewed out dwellings in the mountains. Remember then the wondrous bounties of Allah and do not go about creating mischief in the land.

verses.text: The haughty elders of his nation said to those believers who had been oppressed: ''Do you know that Salih is one sent forth with a message from his Lord?'' They replied: ''Surely we believe in the message with which he has been sent.''
verses.translation: The haughty elders of his nation said to those believers who had been oppressed: ''Do you know that Salih is one sent forth with a message from his Lord?'' They replied: ''Surely we believe in the message with which he has been sent.''

verses.text: The haughty ones remarked. ''Most certainly we disbelieve in that which you believe.''
verses.translation: The haughty ones remarked. ''Most certainly we disbelieve in that which you believe.''

verses.text: Then they hamstrung the she-camel disdainfully disobeyed the commandment of their Lord and said: ''O Salih! Bring upon us the scourge with which you threatened us if you are truly a Messenger [of Allah].''
verses.translation: Then they hamstrung the she-camel disdainfully disobeyed the commandment of their Lord and said: ''O Salih! Bring upon us the scourge with which you threatened us if you are truly a Messenger [of Allah].''

verses.text: Thereupon a shocking catastrophe seized them so that they lay prostrate in their dwellings.
verses.translation: Thereupon a shocking catastrophe seized them so that they lay prostrate in their dwellings.

verses.text: And Salih left them saying: ''O my people! I conveyed to you the message of my Lord and gave you good advice; but you have no liking for your well-wishers.''
verses.translation: And Salih left them saying: ''O my people! I conveyed to you the message of my Lord and gave you good advice; but you have no liking for your well-wishers.''

verses.text: And remember when We sent Lot (as a Messenger) to his people and he said to them: ''Do you realize that you practise an indecency of which no other people in the world were guilty of before you?
verses.translation: And remember when We sent Lot (as a Messenger) to his people and he said to them: ''Do you realize that you practise an indecency of which no other people in the world were guilty of before you?

verses.text: You approach men lustfully in place of women. You are a people who exceed all bounds.''
verses.translation: You approach men lustfully in place of women. You are a people who exceed all bounds.''

verses.text: Their only answer was: ''Banish them from your town. They are a people who pretend to be pure.''
verses.translation: Their only answer was: ''Banish them from your town. They are a people who pretend to be pure.''

verses.text: Then We delivered Lot and his household save his wife who stayed behind
verses.translation: Then We delivered Lot and his household save his wife who stayed behind

verses.text: and We let loose a shower(of stones) upon them.Observe then the end of the evil-doers.
verses.translation: and We let loose a shower(of stones) upon them.Observe then the end of the evil-doers.

verses.text: And to Midian We sent forth their brother Shu''ayb. He exhorted them:  O my people! Serve Allah you have no god other than He. Indeed a clear proof has come to you from your Lord. So give just weight and measure and diminish not to people their things and make no mischief on the earth after it has been set in good order. That is to your own good if you do truly believe.
verses.translation: And to Midian We sent forth their brother Shu''ayb. He exhorted them:  O my people! Serve Allah you have no god other than He. Indeed a clear proof has come to you from your Lord. So give just weight and measure and diminish not to people their things and make no mischief on the earth after it has been set in good order. That is to your own good if you do truly believe.

verses.text: And do not lie in ambush by every path (of life) seeking to overawe or to hinder those who believe from the path of Allah nor seek to make the path crooked. Remember how you were once few and then He multiplied you and keep in mind what was the end of the mischief-makers.
verses.translation: And do not lie in ambush by every path (of life) seeking to overawe or to hinder those who believe from the path of Allah nor seek to make the path crooked. Remember how you were once few and then He multiplied you and keep in mind what was the end of the mischief-makers.

verses.text: And if there are some among you who believe in the message that I bear while some do not believe have patience till Allah should judge between us. He is the best of those who judge.''
verses.translation: And if there are some among you who believe in the message that I bear while some do not believe have patience till Allah should judge between us. He is the best of those who judge.''

verses.text: The haughty elders of his nation said: ''O Shu''ayb! We shall certainly banish you and your companions-in-faith from our town or else you shall return to our faith.'' Shu''ayb said: ''What even though we abhor (your faith)?
verses.translation: The haughty elders of his nation said: ''O Shu''ayb! We shall certainly banish you and your companions-in-faith from our town or else you shall return to our faith.'' Shu''ayb said: ''What even though we abhor (your faith)?

verses.text: If we return to your faith after Allah has delivered us from it we would be fabricating a lie against Allah; nor can we return to it again unless it be by the will of Allah our Lord. Our Lord has knowledge of all things and in Allah do we put our trust. Our Lord! Judge rightly between us and our people for You are the best of those who judge.''
verses.translation: If we return to your faith after Allah has delivered us from it we would be fabricating a lie against Allah; nor can we return to it again unless it be by the will of Allah our Lord. Our Lord has knowledge of all things and in Allah do we put our trust. Our Lord! Judge rightly between us and our people for You are the best of those who judge.''

verses.text: The disbelieving elders of his nation said: ''Should you follow Shu''ayb you will be utter losers.''
verses.translation: The disbelieving elders of his nation said: ''Should you follow Shu''ayb you will be utter losers.''

verses.text: Thereupon a shocking catastrophe seized them and they remained prostrate in their dwellings.
verses.translation: Thereupon a shocking catastrophe seized them and they remained prostrate in their dwellings.

verses.text: Those who had charged Shu''ayb with lying became as though they had never lived there; it is they who became utter losers.
verses.translation: Those who had charged Shu''ayb with lying became as though they had never lived there; it is they who became utter losers.

verses.text: Shu''ayb then departed from his people and said: ''O my people! Surely I conveyed to you the message of my Lord and gave you sincere advice. How then can I mourn for a people who refuse to accept the truth?''
verses.translation: Shu''ayb then departed from his people and said: ''O my people! Surely I conveyed to you the message of my Lord and gave you sincere advice. How then can I mourn for a people who refuse to accept the truth?''

verses.text: Never have We sent any Prophet to a place without trying its people with adversity and hardship that they may humble themselves.
verses.translation: Never have We sent any Prophet to a place without trying its people with adversity and hardship that they may humble themselves.

verses.text: Then We changed adversity into ease until they thrived and said: ''Our forefathers had also seen both adversity and prosperity.'' So We suddenly seized them without their even perceiving it.
verses.translation: Then We changed adversity into ease until they thrived and said: ''Our forefathers had also seen both adversity and prosperity.'' So We suddenly seized them without their even perceiving it.

verses.text: Had the people of those towns believed and been God-fearing We would certainly have opened up to them blessings from the heavens and the earth; but they gave the lie (to their Prophets) and so We seized them for their deeds.
verses.translation: Had the people of those towns believed and been God-fearing We would certainly have opened up to them blessings from the heavens and the earth; but they gave the lie (to their Prophets) and so We seized them for their deeds.

verses.text: Do the people of those towns feel secure that Our punishment will not come upon them at night while they are asleep?
verses.translation: Do the people of those towns feel secure that Our punishment will not come upon them at night while they are asleep?

verses.text: Or do the people of those towns feel secure that Our punishment will not come upon them by day while they are at play?
verses.translation: Or do the people of those towns feel secure that Our punishment will not come upon them by day while they are at play?

verses.text: Do they feel secure against Allah s design? None can feel secure against Allah s design except the utter losers.
verses.translation: Do they feel secure against Allah s design? None can feel secure against Allah s design except the utter losers.

verses.text: Has it not then become plain to those who have inherited the earth in the wake of the former generations that if We had so willed We could have afflicted them for their sins (they however are heedless to basic facts and so) We seal their hearts so that they hear nothing.
verses.translation: Has it not then become plain to those who have inherited the earth in the wake of the former generations that if We had so willed We could have afflicted them for their sins (they however are heedless to basic facts and so) We seal their hearts so that they hear nothing.

verses.text: To those (earlier) communities - some of whose stories We relate to you - there had indeed come Messengers with clear proofs but they would not believe what they had once rejected as false. Thus it is that Allah seals the hearts of those who deny the truth.
verses.translation: To those (earlier) communities - some of whose stories We relate to you - there had indeed come Messengers with clear proofs but they would not believe what they had once rejected as false. Thus it is that Allah seals the hearts of those who deny the truth.

verses.text: We did not find most of them true to their covenants; indeed We found most of them to be transgressors.
verses.translation: We did not find most of them true to their covenants; indeed We found most of them to be transgressors.

verses.text: After them We sent forth Moses to Pharaoh and his nobleswith Our Signs but they treated Our Signs iniquitously. Observe then what happened to the mischief-makers!
verses.translation: After them We sent forth Moses to Pharaoh and his nobleswith Our Signs but they treated Our Signs iniquitously. Observe then what happened to the mischief-makers!

verses.text: And Moses said: ''O Pharaoh! I am a Messenger from the Lord of the universe.
verses.translation: And Moses said: ''O Pharaoh! I am a Messenger from the Lord of the universe.

verses.text: It behoves me to say nothing about Allah except what is true. I have come to you with a Clear Sign of having been sent from your Lord. So let the Children of Israel go with me.''
verses.translation: It behoves me to say nothing about Allah except what is true. I have come to you with a Clear Sign of having been sent from your Lord. So let the Children of Israel go with me.''

verses.text: Pharaoh said: ''if you have brought a sign then bring it forth if you are truthful.''
verses.translation: Pharaoh said: ''if you have brought a sign then bring it forth if you are truthful.''

verses.text: Thereupon Moses threw his rod and suddenly it was a veritable serpent.
verses.translation: Thereupon Moses threw his rod and suddenly it was a veritable serpent.

verses.text: Then he drew out his hand and it appeared luminous to all beholders.
verses.translation: Then he drew out his hand and it appeared luminous to all beholders.

verses.text: The elders of Pharaoh''s nation said: ''Surely this person is a skillful magician
verses.translation: The elders of Pharaoh''s nation said: ''Surely this person is a skillful magician

verses.text: who seeks to drive you out from your land. What would you have us do?''
verses.translation: who seeks to drive you out from your land. What would you have us do?''

verses.text: Then they advised Pharaoh: ''Put off Moses and his brother for a while and send forth heralds to your cities
verses.translation: Then they advised Pharaoh: ''Put off Moses and his brother for a while and send forth heralds to your cities

verses.text: to summon every skillful magician to your presence.''
verses.translation: to summon every skillful magician to your presence.''

verses.text: And the magicians came to Pharaoh and said: ''Shall we indeed have a reward if we win?''
verses.translation: And the magicians came to Pharaoh and said: ''Shall we indeed have a reward if we win?''

verses.text: Pharaoh replied: ''Certainly and you shall be among those who are near to me.''
verses.translation: Pharaoh replied: ''Certainly and you shall be among those who are near to me.''

verses.text: Then they said: ''O Moses will you (first) throw your rod or shall we throw?''
verses.translation: Then they said: ''O Moses will you (first) throw your rod or shall we throw?''

verses.text: Moses said: ''You throw.'' So when they threw [their rods] they enchanted the eyes of the people and struck them with awe and produced a mighty sorcery.
verses.translation: Moses said: ''You throw.'' So when they threw [their rods] they enchanted the eyes of the people and struck them with awe and produced a mighty sorcery.

verses.text: Then We directed Moses: ''Now you throw your rod.'' And lo! it swallowed up all their false devices.
verses.translation: Then We directed Moses: ''Now you throw your rod.'' And lo! it swallowed up all their false devices.

verses.text: Thus was the Truth established and their doings were shown to be false.
verses.translation: Thus was the Truth established and their doings were shown to be false.

verses.text: Pharaoh and his comrades were defeated and put to shame
verses.translation: Pharaoh and his comrades were defeated and put to shame

verses.text: and the magicians flung themselves prostrate
verses.translation: and the magicians flung themselves prostrate

verses.text: saying: ''We believe in the Lord of the whole universe
verses.translation: saying: ''We believe in the Lord of the whole universe

verses.text: the Lord of Moses and Aaron.''
verses.translation: the Lord of Moses and Aaron.''

verses.text: Pharaoh said: ''What! Do you believe before you have my permission? Surely this is a plot you have contrived to drive out the rulers from the capital. So you shall see
verses.translation: Pharaoh said: ''What! Do you believe before you have my permission? Surely this is a plot you have contrived to drive out the rulers from the capital. So you shall see

verses.text: I shall cut off your hands and feet on the opposite sides and then crucify you all.''
verses.translation: I shall cut off your hands and feet on the opposite sides and then crucify you all.''

verses.text: They replied: ''We shall surely return to our Lord.
verses.translation: They replied: ''We shall surely return to our Lord.

verses.text: Will you punish us just because we believed in the signs of our Lord when they came to us? Our Lord! Shower us with perseverance and cause us to die as those who have submitted (to You).''
verses.translation: Will you punish us just because we believed in the signs of our Lord when they came to us? Our Lord! Shower us with perseverance and cause us to die as those who have submitted (to You).''

verses.text: The elders of Pharaoh''s nation said: ''Will you leave alone Moses and his people to spread mischief in the land and forsake you and your gods?'' Pharaoh replied: ''We will kill their male children and spare their female ones. For indeed we hold irresistible sway over them.''
verses.translation: The elders of Pharaoh''s nation said: ''Will you leave alone Moses and his people to spread mischief in the land and forsake you and your gods?'' Pharaoh replied: ''We will kill their male children and spare their female ones. For indeed we hold irresistible sway over them.''

verses.text: Moses said to his people: ''Seek help from Allah and be steadfast. The earth is Allah''s He bestows it on those of His servants He chooses. The end of things belongs to the God-fearing.''
verses.translation: Moses said to his people: ''Seek help from Allah and be steadfast. The earth is Allah''s He bestows it on those of His servants He chooses. The end of things belongs to the God-fearing.''

verses.text: The people of Moses replied: ''We were oppressed before your coming to us and after it.'' Moses said: ''Your Lord will soon destroy your enemy and make you rulers in the land. Then He will see how you act.''
verses.translation: The people of Moses replied: ''We were oppressed before your coming to us and after it.'' Moses said: ''Your Lord will soon destroy your enemy and make you rulers in the land. Then He will see how you act.''

verses.text: We afflicted the people of Pharaoh with hard times and with poor harvest that they may heed.
verses.translation: We afflicted the people of Pharaoh with hard times and with poor harvest that they may heed.

verses.text: But whenever prosperity came their way they said: ''This is our due.'' And whatever hardship befell them they attributed it to the misfortune of Moses and those who followed him. Surely their misfortune had been decreed by Allah - but most of them do not know that.
verses.translation: But whenever prosperity came their way they said: ''This is our due.'' And whatever hardship befell them they attributed it to the misfortune of Moses and those who followed him. Surely their misfortune had been decreed by Allah - but most of them do not know that.

verses.text: And they said to Moses: ''Whatever sign you might produce before us in order to enchant us we are not going to believe you.''
verses.translation: And they said to Moses: ''Whatever sign you might produce before us in order to enchant us we are not going to believe you.''

verses.text: Then We afflicted them with a great flood and locusts and lice and frogs and blood. All these were distinct Signs and yet they remained haughty. They were a wicked people.
verses.translation: Then We afflicted them with a great flood and locusts and lice and frogs and blood. All these were distinct Signs and yet they remained haughty. They were a wicked people.

verses.text: Each time a scourge struck them they said: ''O Moses! Pray for us to your Lord on the strength of the prophethood He has bestowed upon you. Surely if you remove this scourge from us we will truly believe in you and will let the Children of Israel go with you.''
verses.translation: Each time a scourge struck them they said: ''O Moses! Pray for us to your Lord on the strength of the prophethood He has bestowed upon you. Surely if you remove this scourge from us we will truly believe in you and will let the Children of Israel go with you.''

verses.text: But when We removed the scourge from them until a term - a term which they were bound to reach - they at once broke their promise.
verses.translation: But when We removed the scourge from them until a term - a term which they were bound to reach - they at once broke their promise.

verses.text: So We inflicted Our retribution on them and caused them to drown in the sea because they gave the lie to Our Signs and were heedless of them.
verses.translation: So We inflicted Our retribution on them and caused them to drown in the sea because they gave the lie to Our Signs and were heedless of them.

verses.text: And We made those who had been persecuted inherit the eastern and western lands which We had blessed. Thus your Lord''s gracious promise was fulfilled to the Children of Israel for they had endured with patience; and We destroyed all that Pharaoh and his people had wrought and all that they had built.
verses.translation: And We made those who had been persecuted inherit the eastern and western lands which We had blessed. Thus your Lord''s gracious promise was fulfilled to the Children of Israel for they had endured with patience; and We destroyed all that Pharaoh and his people had wrought and all that they had built.

verses.text: And We led the Children of Israel across the sea; and then they came upon a people who were devoted to the worship of their idols. They said: ''O Moses make for us a god even as they have gods.'' Moses said: ''You are indeed an ignorant people.''
verses.translation: And We led the Children of Israel across the sea; and then they came upon a people who were devoted to the worship of their idols. They said: ''O Moses make for us a god even as they have gods.'' Moses said: ''You are indeed an ignorant people.''

verses.text: The way these people follow is bound to lead to destruction; and all their works are vain.
verses.translation: The way these people follow is bound to lead to destruction; and all their works are vain.

verses.text: Moses said: ''Should I seek any god for you other than Allah although it is He who has exalted you above all?''
verses.translation: Moses said: ''Should I seek any god for you other than Allah although it is He who has exalted you above all?''

verses.text: And call to mind when We delivered you from Pharaoh''s people who perpetrated on you a terrible torment putting your males to death and sparing your females. Surely in it there was an awesome trial for you from your Lord.
verses.translation: And call to mind when We delivered you from Pharaoh''s people who perpetrated on you a terrible torment putting your males to death and sparing your females. Surely in it there was an awesome trial for you from your Lord.

verses.text: And We appointed for Moses thirty nights to which We added ten whereby the term of forty nights set by his Lord was fulfilled. And Moses said to Aaron his brother: ''Take my place among my people act righteously and do not follow the path of those who create mischief.''
verses.translation: And We appointed for Moses thirty nights to which We added ten whereby the term of forty nights set by his Lord was fulfilled. And Moses said to Aaron his brother: ''Take my place among my people act righteously and do not follow the path of those who create mischief.''

verses.text: And when Moses came at Our appointment and his Lord spoke to him he said: ''O my Lord! Reveal Yourself to me that I may look upon You!'' He replied: ''Never can you see Me. However behold this mount; if it remains firm in its place only then you will be able to see Me.'' And as soon as his Lord unveiled His glory to the mount He crushed it into fine dust and Moses fell down in a swoon. And when he recovered he said: ''Glory be to You! To You I turn in repentance and I am the foremost among those who believe.''
verses.translation: And when Moses came at Our appointment and his Lord spoke to him he said: ''O my Lord! Reveal Yourself to me that I may look upon You!'' He replied: ''Never can you see Me. However behold this mount; if it remains firm in its place only then you will be able to see Me.'' And as soon as his Lord unveiled His glory to the mount He crushed it into fine dust and Moses fell down in a swoon. And when he recovered he said: ''Glory be to You! To You I turn in repentance and I am the foremost among those who believe.''

verses.text: He said: ''O Moses! I have indeed preferred you to others by virtue of the Message I have entrusted to you and by virtue of My speaking to you. Hold fast therefore to whatever I have granted you and give thanks.''
verses.translation: He said: ''O Moses! I have indeed preferred you to others by virtue of the Message I have entrusted to you and by virtue of My speaking to you. Hold fast therefore to whatever I have granted you and give thanks.''

verses.text: And We ordained for Moses in the Tablets all manner of admonition and instruction concerning all things and said to him: Hold to these with all your strength and bid your people to follow them in accord with their best understanding. I shall soon show you the habitation of the wicked.
verses.translation: And We ordained for Moses in the Tablets all manner of admonition and instruction concerning all things and said to him: Hold to these with all your strength and bid your people to follow them in accord with their best understanding. I shall soon show you the habitation of the wicked.

verses.text: I shall turn away from My signs those who without any right behaved haughtily in the earth. Even if they may witness each and every Sing they shall not believe therein. And even if they see the Right Path they shall still not follow it; but if they see the path of error they shall choose it for their path. This is because they rejected Our Signs and were heedless to them.
verses.translation: I shall turn away from My signs those who without any right behaved haughtily in the earth. Even if they may witness each and every Sing they shall not believe therein. And even if they see the Right Path they shall still not follow it; but if they see the path of error they shall choose it for their path. This is because they rejected Our Signs and were heedless to them.

verses.text: Vain are the deeds of those who reject Our Signs as false and to the meeting of the Hereafter as false. Shall they be recompensed except according to their deeds?''
verses.translation: Vain are the deeds of those who reject Our Signs as false and to the meeting of the Hereafter as false. Shall they be recompensed except according to their deeds?''

verses.text: And in the absence of Moses his people made the image of a calf from their ornaments which lowed. Did they not observe that it could neither speak nor give them any guidance? And still they made it an object of worship. They were indeed wrong-doing.
verses.translation: And in the absence of Moses his people made the image of a calf from their ornaments which lowed. Did they not observe that it could neither speak nor give them any guidance? And still they made it an object of worship. They were indeed wrong-doing.

verses.text: And when they were afflicted with remorse and realized that they had fallen into error they said: ''If our Lord does not have mercy on us and does not pardon us we shall be among the losers.''
verses.translation: And when they were afflicted with remorse and realized that they had fallen into error they said: ''If our Lord does not have mercy on us and does not pardon us we shall be among the losers.''

verses.text: And when Moses returned to his people full of wrath and sorrow he said: ''Vile is the course you have followed in my absence. Could you not patiently wait for the decree of your Lord?'' And he threw down the Tablets [of the Law] and took hold of his brother''s head dragging him to himself. Aaron said: ''My mother''s son the people overpowered me and almost killed me. So let not my enemies gloat over me and do not number me among the wrong-doing folk.''
verses.translation: And when Moses returned to his people full of wrath and sorrow he said: ''Vile is the course you have followed in my absence. Could you not patiently wait for the decree of your Lord?'' And he threw down the Tablets [of the Law] and took hold of his brother''s head dragging him to himself. Aaron said: ''My mother''s son the people overpowered me and almost killed me. So let not my enemies gloat over me and do not number me among the wrong-doing folk.''

verses.text: Thereupon Moses said: ''O Lord! Bestow forgiveness upon me and my brother and admit us to Your Mercy for You are most Merciful of the Merciful.''
verses.translation: Thereupon Moses said: ''O Lord! Bestow forgiveness upon me and my brother and admit us to Your Mercy for You are most Merciful of the Merciful.''

verses.text: In reply they were told: ''Verily those who worshipped the calf will certainly incur indignation from their Lord and will be abased in the life of this world. Thus do We recompense those who fabricate lies.
verses.translation: In reply they were told: ''Verily those who worshipped the calf will certainly incur indignation from their Lord and will be abased in the life of this world. Thus do We recompense those who fabricate lies.

verses.text: As for those who do evil and later repent and have faith such shall find their Lord All-Forgiving All-Compassionate after (they repent and believe)
verses.translation: As for those who do evil and later repent and have faith such shall find their Lord All-Forgiving All-Compassionate after (they repent and believe)

verses.text: And when the anger of Moses was stilled he took up the Tablets again the text of which comprised guidance and mercy to those who fear their Lord.
verses.translation: And when the anger of Moses was stilled he took up the Tablets again the text of which comprised guidance and mercy to those who fear their Lord.

verses.text: And out of his people Moses singled out seventy men for Our appointment. Then when a violent shaking seized them he addressed his Lord: ''Had You willed O my Lord You could have destroyed them and me long ago. Will You destroy us for the misdeeds of the fools amongst us? That was nothing but a trial from You whereby You mislead whom You will and guide whom You will. You alone are our guardian. Forgive us then and have mercy upon us. You are the best of those who forgive.
verses.translation: And out of his people Moses singled out seventy men for Our appointment. Then when a violent shaking seized them he addressed his Lord: ''Had You willed O my Lord You could have destroyed them and me long ago. Will You destroy us for the misdeeds of the fools amongst us? That was nothing but a trial from You whereby You mislead whom You will and guide whom You will. You alone are our guardian. Forgive us then and have mercy upon us. You are the best of those who forgive.

verses.text: And ordain for us what is good in this world and in the World to Come for to You have we turned.''He replied: ''I afflict whomsoever I wish with My chastisement. As for My mercy it encompasses everything. I will show mercy to those who abstain from evil pay Zakah and have faith in Our Signs.''
verses.translation: And ordain for us what is good in this world and in the World to Come for to You have we turned.''He replied: ''I afflict whomsoever I wish with My chastisement. As for My mercy it encompasses everything. I will show mercy to those who abstain from evil pay Zakah and have faith in Our Signs.''

verses.text: (Today this mercy is for) those who follow the ummi Prophet whom they find mentioned in the Torah and the Gospel that they have. He enjoins upon them what is good and forbids them what is evil. He makes the clean things lawful to them and prohibits all corrupt things and removes from them their burdens and the shackles that were upon them. So those who believe in him and assist him and succour him and follow the Light which has been sent down with him it is they who shall prosper.
verses.translation: (Today this mercy is for) those who follow the ummi Prophet whom they find mentioned in the Torah and the Gospel that they have. He enjoins upon them what is good and forbids them what is evil. He makes the clean things lawful to them and prohibits all corrupt things and removes from them their burdens and the shackles that were upon them. So those who believe in him and assist him and succour him and follow the Light which has been sent down with him it is they who shall prosper.

verses.text: (Say O Muhammad): ''O people! I am Allah''s Messenger to you all - of Him to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. There is no god but He. He grants life and deals death. Have faith then in Allah and in His Messenger the ummi Prophet who believes in Allah and His words; and follow him so that you may be guided aright.''
verses.translation: (Say O Muhammad): ''O people! I am Allah''s Messenger to you all - of Him to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. There is no god but He. He grants life and deals death. Have faith then in Allah and in His Messenger the ummi Prophet who believes in Allah and His words; and follow him so that you may be guided aright.''

verses.text: Among the people of Moses there was a party who guided others in the way of the truth and established justice in its light.
verses.translation: Among the people of Moses there was a party who guided others in the way of the truth and established justice in its light.

verses.text: And We divided them into twelve tribes forming them into communities. When his people asked Moses for water We directed him: ''Smite the rock with your rod.'' Then twelve springs gushed forth from the rock and every people knew their drinking-places. And We caused thick clouds to provide them shade and sent down upon them manna and quails saying: ''Eat of the clean things that We have provided you.'' They wronged not Us but it was themselves that they wronged.
verses.translation: And We divided them into twelve tribes forming them into communities. When his people asked Moses for water We directed him: ''Smite the rock with your rod.'' Then twelve springs gushed forth from the rock and every people knew their drinking-places. And We caused thick clouds to provide them shade and sent down upon them manna and quails saying: ''Eat of the clean things that We have provided you.'' They wronged not Us but it was themselves that they wronged.

verses.text: And recall when it was said to them: ''Dwell in this town and eat plentifully of whatever you please and say: ""Repentance"" and enter the gate prostrate. We shall forgive you your sins and shall bestow further favours on those who do good.''
verses.translation: And recall when it was said to them: ''Dwell in this town and eat plentifully of whatever you please and say: ""Repentance"" and enter the gate prostrate. We shall forgive you your sins and shall bestow further favours on those who do good.''

verses.text: Then the wrong-doers among them substituted another word in place of the one told to them. So We sent upon them a scourge from the sky as a punishment for their Wrong-doing.
verses.translation: Then the wrong-doers among them substituted another word in place of the one told to them. So We sent upon them a scourge from the sky as a punishment for their Wrong-doing.

verses.text: And ask the people of Moses concerning the town situated along the sea: how its people profaned the Sabbath when fish came to them breaking the water''s surface on Sabbath days and it would not come to them on other than Sabbath-days. Thus did We try them because of their disobedience.
verses.translation: And ask the people of Moses concerning the town situated along the sea: how its people profaned the Sabbath when fish came to them breaking the water''s surface on Sabbath days and it would not come to them on other than Sabbath-days. Thus did We try them because of their disobedience.

verses.text: And recall when a party of them said: ''Why do you admonish a people whom Allah is about to destroy or punish severely?'' They said: ''We admonish them in order to be able to offer an excuse before Your Lord and in the hope that they will guard against disobedience.''
verses.translation: And recall when a party of them said: ''Why do you admonish a people whom Allah is about to destroy or punish severely?'' They said: ''We admonish them in order to be able to offer an excuse before Your Lord and in the hope that they will guard against disobedience.''

verses.text: Then when they forgot what they had been exhorted We delivered those who forbade evil and afflicted the wrong-doers with a grievous chastisement because of their evildoing.
verses.translation: Then when they forgot what they had been exhorted We delivered those who forbade evil and afflicted the wrong-doers with a grievous chastisement because of their evildoing.

verses.text: And when they persisted in pursuing that which had been forbidden We said: ''Become despised apes.''
verses.translation: And when they persisted in pursuing that which had been forbidden We said: ''Become despised apes.''

verses.text: And recall when Your Lord proclaimed that He would continually set in authority over them till the Day of Judgement those who would ruthlessly oppress them. Surely your Lord is swift in chastising; and yet He is All-Forgiving All-Merciful.
verses.translation: And recall when Your Lord proclaimed that He would continually set in authority over them till the Day of Judgement those who would ruthlessly oppress them. Surely your Lord is swift in chastising; and yet He is All-Forgiving All-Merciful.

verses.text: And We dispersed them through the earth in communities - some were righteous others were not -and We tested them with prosperity and adversity that they may revert (to righteousness).
verses.translation: And We dispersed them through the earth in communities - some were righteous others were not -and We tested them with prosperity and adversity that they may revert (to righteousness).

verses.text: Then others succeeded them who inherited the scriptures and yet kept themselves occupied in acquiring the goods of this world and kept saying: ''We shall be forgiven.'' And when there comes to them an opportunity for acquiring more of those goods they seize it. Was not the covenant of the Book taken from them that they would not ascribe to Allah anything but the truth? And they have read what is in the Book and know that the abode of the Hereafter is better for the God-fearing. Do you not understand?
verses.translation: Then others succeeded them who inherited the scriptures and yet kept themselves occupied in acquiring the goods of this world and kept saying: ''We shall be forgiven.'' And when there comes to them an opportunity for acquiring more of those goods they seize it. Was not the covenant of the Book taken from them that they would not ascribe to Allah anything but the truth? And they have read what is in the Book and know that the abode of the Hereafter is better for the God-fearing. Do you not understand?

verses.text: Those who hold fast to the Book and establish Prayer - We shall not allow the reward of such righteous people to go to waste.
verses.translation: Those who hold fast to the Book and establish Prayer - We shall not allow the reward of such righteous people to go to waste.

verses.text: And recall when We shook the mountain over them as though it were a canopy and they thought that it was going to fall over them; and We said: ''Hold firmly to that which We have given you and remember what is in it that you may guard against evil.''
verses.translation: And recall when We shook the mountain over them as though it were a canopy and they thought that it was going to fall over them; and We said: ''Hold firmly to that which We have given you and remember what is in it that you may guard against evil.''

verses.text: And recall (O Prophet) when your Lord brought forth descendants from the loins of the sons of Adam and made them witnesses against their ownselves asking them: ''Am I not your Lord?'' They said: ''Yes we do testify.'' We did so lest you should claim on the Day of Resurrection: ''We were unaware of this.''
verses.translation: And recall (O Prophet) when your Lord brought forth descendants from the loins of the sons of Adam and made them witnesses against their ownselves asking them: ''Am I not your Lord?'' They said: ''Yes we do testify.'' We did so lest you should claim on the Day of Resurrection: ''We were unaware of this.''

verses.text: Or say: ''(It was Our forefathers) before us who associated others with Allah in His divinity; we were merely their offspring who followed them. Would You destroy us for the deeds of the unrighteous?''
verses.translation: Or say: ''(It was Our forefathers) before us who associated others with Allah in His divinity; we were merely their offspring who followed them. Would You destroy us for the deeds of the unrighteous?''

verses.text: Thus do We expound the Signs that they may turn back (to the right path).
verses.translation: Thus do We expound the Signs that they may turn back (to the right path).

verses.text: And recite to them [O Muhammad] the story of the man to whom We gave Our signs and who turned away from them; then ultimately Satan caught up with him and he was led astray.
verses.translation: And recite to them [O Muhammad] the story of the man to whom We gave Our signs and who turned away from them; then ultimately Satan caught up with him and he was led astray.

verses.text: Now had We so willed We could indeed have exalted him through those signs but he clung to earthly life and followed his carnal desires. Thus his parable is that of the dog who lolls out his tongue whether you attack him or leave him alone. Such is the parable of those who reject Our signs as false. Narrate to them these parables that they may reflect.
verses.translation: Now had We so willed We could indeed have exalted him through those signs but he clung to earthly life and followed his carnal desires. Thus his parable is that of the dog who lolls out his tongue whether you attack him or leave him alone. Such is the parable of those who reject Our signs as false. Narrate to them these parables that they may reflect.

verses.text: Evil is the example of the people who reject Our signs as false and perpetrate wrong against their own selves.
verses.translation: Evil is the example of the people who reject Our signs as false and perpetrate wrong against their own selves.

verses.text: He whom Allah guides he alone is rightly guided; and he whom Allah lets go astray - it is they who are the loser.''
verses.translation: He whom Allah guides he alone is rightly guided; and he whom Allah lets go astray - it is they who are the loser.''

verses.text: And certainly We have created for Hell many of the jinn and mankind; they have hearts with which they fail to understand; and they have eyes with which they fail to see; and they have ears with which they fail to hear. They are like cattle - indeed even more astray. Such are utterly heedless.
verses.translation: And certainly We have created for Hell many of the jinn and mankind; they have hearts with which they fail to understand; and they have eyes with which they fail to see; and they have ears with which they fail to hear. They are like cattle - indeed even more astray. Such are utterly heedless.

verses.text: Allah has the most excellent names. So call on Him by His names and shun those who distort them. They shall soon be requited for their deeds.
verses.translation: Allah has the most excellent names. So call on Him by His names and shun those who distort them. They shall soon be requited for their deeds.

verses.text: And of those whom We have created there is a party who guide people through the Truth and act justly according to it.
verses.translation: And of those whom We have created there is a party who guide people through the Truth and act justly according to it.

verses.text: As for those who reject Our signs as false We shall lead them step by step to their ruin without their even perceiving it.
verses.translation: As for those who reject Our signs as false We shall lead them step by step to their ruin without their even perceiving it.

verses.text: And (for this purpose) I shall grant them respite. My design is incontrovertible.
verses.translation: And (for this purpose) I shall grant them respite. My design is incontrovertible.

verses.text: Have they not pondered that their companion (i.e. the Prophet Muhammad) is not afflicted with insanity? He is only a plain warner.
verses.translation: Have they not pondered that their companion (i.e. the Prophet Muhammad) is not afflicted with insanity? He is only a plain warner.

verses.text: Have they not observed the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and all that Allah has created and that their term of life might have drawn near? After this warning from the Prophet what will it be that will make them believe?
verses.translation: Have they not observed the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and all that Allah has created and that their term of life might have drawn near? After this warning from the Prophet what will it be that will make them believe?

verses.text: For those whom Allah lets go astray there is no guide; and He will leave them to stumble blindly in their transgression.
verses.translation: For those whom Allah lets go astray there is no guide; and He will leave them to stumble blindly in their transgression.

verses.text: They ask you concerning the Hour when will its coming be? Say: ''The knowledge of it is with my Lord alone: none but He will disclose it at its time. That will weigh heavily on the heavens and the earth; and it shall come upon you all too suddenly.'' They ask you as if you are eagerly inquisitive about it. Say to them: ''The knowledge of it lies with none except Allah. But most people are unaware of this reality.''
verses.translation: They ask you concerning the Hour when will its coming be? Say: ''The knowledge of it is with my Lord alone: none but He will disclose it at its time. That will weigh heavily on the heavens and the earth; and it shall come upon you all too suddenly.'' They ask you as if you are eagerly inquisitive about it. Say to them: ''The knowledge of it lies with none except Allah. But most people are unaware of this reality.''

verses.text: Tell them [O Muhammad]: ''I have no power to benefit or harm myself except as Allah may please. And had I knowledge of the unseen I should have amassed all kinds of good and no evil would have ever touched me. I am merely a warner and the herald of glad tidings to those who have faith.''
verses.translation: Tell them [O Muhammad]: ''I have no power to benefit or harm myself except as Allah may please. And had I knowledge of the unseen I should have amassed all kinds of good and no evil would have ever touched me. I am merely a warner and the herald of glad tidings to those who have faith.''

verses.text: It is He - Allah -Who created you from a single being and out of it He made its mate that he may find comfort in her. And when he covers her she bears a light burden and goes about with it. Then when she grows heavy they pray to their Lord: ''If You bestow upon us a healthy child we will surely give thanks.''
verses.translation: It is He - Allah -Who created you from a single being and out of it He made its mate that he may find comfort in her. And when he covers her she bears a light burden and goes about with it. Then when she grows heavy they pray to their Lord: ''If You bestow upon us a healthy child we will surely give thanks.''

verses.text: But when He bestows upon them a healthy child they attribute to Him partners in what Allah had bestowed upon them. Exalted is Allah above that which they associate with Him.
verses.translation: But when He bestows upon them a healthy child they attribute to Him partners in what Allah had bestowed upon them. Exalted is Allah above that which they associate with Him.

verses.text: Do they associate (with Allah in His divinity) those who can create nothing; rather they themselves are created?
verses.translation: Do they associate (with Allah in His divinity) those who can create nothing; rather they themselves are created?

verses.text: They have no power to help others nor can they help themselves.
verses.translation: They have no power to help others nor can they help themselves.

verses.text: And if you call them to True Guidance they will not follow you. It is all the same for you whether you call them to True Guidance or keep silent.
verses.translation: And if you call them to True Guidance they will not follow you. It is all the same for you whether you call them to True Guidance or keep silent.

verses.text: Those whom you invoke other than Allah are creatures like you. So invoke them and see if they answer your call if what you claim is true.
verses.translation: Those whom you invoke other than Allah are creatures like you. So invoke them and see if they answer your call if what you claim is true.

verses.text: Have they feet on which they can walk? Have they hands with which they can grasp? Have they eyes with which they can see? Have they ears with which they can hear? Say (O Muhammad): ''Invoke all those to whom you ascribe a share in Allah''s divinity then scheme against me and grant me no respite.
verses.translation: Have they feet on which they can walk? Have they hands with which they can grasp? Have they eyes with which they can see? Have they ears with which they can hear? Say (O Muhammad): ''Invoke all those to whom you ascribe a share in Allah''s divinity then scheme against me and grant me no respite.

verses.text: My guardian is Allah Who has revealed the Book and it is He Who protects the righteous.
verses.translation: My guardian is Allah Who has revealed the Book and it is He Who protects the righteous.

verses.text: Those whom you invoke other than Allah they can neither help themselves nor you.
verses.translation: Those whom you invoke other than Allah they can neither help themselves nor you.

verses.text: If you were to call them to True Guidance they will not hear; and you observe them looking at you whereas they have no power to see.''
verses.translation: If you were to call them to True Guidance they will not hear; and you observe them looking at you whereas they have no power to see.''

verses.text: (O Prophet!) Show forgiveness enjoin what is good and avoid the ignorant.
verses.translation: (O Prophet!) Show forgiveness enjoin what is good and avoid the ignorant.

verses.text: And if it happens that a prompting from Satan should stir you up seek refuge with Allah. He is All-Hearing All-Knowing.
verses.translation: And if it happens that a prompting from Satan should stir you up seek refuge with Allah. He is All-Hearing All-Knowing.

verses.text: If the God-fearing are instigated by any suggestion of Satan they instantly become alert where-after they clearly perceive the right way.
verses.translation: If the God-fearing are instigated by any suggestion of Satan they instantly become alert where-after they clearly perceive the right way.

verses.text: As for their brethren (the Satans) they draw them deeper into error and do not relax in their efforts.
verses.translation: As for their brethren (the Satans) they draw them deeper into error and do not relax in their efforts.

verses.text: (O Prophet!) when you do not produce before them any miracle they say: ''Why do you not choose for yourself a miracle?'' Say to them: ''I follow only what is revealed to me by my Lord. This is nothing but a means of insight into the truth and guidance and mercy from your Lord to the people who believe.''
verses.translation: (O Prophet!) when you do not produce before them any miracle they say: ''Why do you not choose for yourself a miracle?'' Say to them: ''I follow only what is revealed to me by my Lord. This is nothing but a means of insight into the truth and guidance and mercy from your Lord to the people who believe.''

verses.text: So when the Qur''an is recited listen carefully to it and keep silent so that you may be shown mercy.
verses.translation: So when the Qur''an is recited listen carefully to it and keep silent so that you may be shown mercy.

verses.text: And remember (O Prophet) your Lord in your heart with humility and fear and without raising your voice; remember Him in the morning and evening and do not become of those who are negligent.
verses.translation: And remember (O Prophet) your Lord in your heart with humility and fear and without raising your voice; remember Him in the morning and evening and do not become of those who are negligent.

verses.text: (The angels) who are near to Your Lord never turn away from His service out of arrogance; they rather glorify Him and prostrate themselves before Him.
verses.translation: (The angels) who are near to Your Lord never turn away from His service out of arrogance; they rather glorify Him and prostrate themselves before Him.

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: Alif-Lam-Mim-Sad.
ayahs.translation: Alif-Lam-Mim-Sad.

ayahs.text: This is a Book revealed to you. Let there be no qualm in your heart about it. (It has been revealed to you) that you may thereby warn [the unbelievers] and that it may serve as a reminder to the believers.
ayahs.translation: This is a Book revealed to you. Let there be no qualm in your heart about it. (It has been revealed to you) that you may thereby warn [the unbelievers] and that it may serve as a reminder to the believers.

ayahs.text: (O People) follow what has been revealed to you from your Lord and follow no masters other than Him. Little are you admonished.
ayahs.translation: (O People) follow what has been revealed to you from your Lord and follow no masters other than Him. Little are you admonished.

ayahs.text: How many a township have We destroyed! Our scourge fell upon them at night or when they were taking midday rest.
ayahs.translation: How many a township have We destroyed! Our scourge fell upon them at night or when they were taking midday rest.

ayahs.text: And when Our scourge fell upon them their only cry was: ''We are indeed transgressors.''
ayahs.translation: And when Our scourge fell upon them their only cry was: ''We are indeed transgressors.''

ayahs.text: So We shall call to account those to whom Messengers were sent and We shall call to account the Messengers (to see how dutifully they conveyed the Message and how people responded to it).
ayahs.translation: So We shall call to account those to whom Messengers were sent and We shall call to account the Messengers (to see how dutifully they conveyed the Message and how people responded to it).

ayahs.text: Then We shall narrate to them with knowledge the whole account. For surely We were not away from them.
ayahs.translation: Then We shall narrate to them with knowledge the whole account. For surely We were not away from them.

ayahs.text: The weighing on that Day will be the true weighing: those whose scales are heavy will prosper.
ayahs.translation: The weighing on that Day will be the true weighing: those whose scales are heavy will prosper.

ayahs.text: and those whose scales are light will be the losers for they are the ones who have been iniquitous to Our signs.
ayahs.translation: and those whose scales are light will be the losers for they are the ones who have been iniquitous to Our signs.

ayahs.text: We assuredly established you in the earth and arranged for your livelihood in it. Little do you give thanks.
ayahs.translation: We assuredly established you in the earth and arranged for your livelihood in it. Little do you give thanks.

ayahs.text: We initiated your creation then We gave you each a shape and then We said to th e angels:  Prostrate yourselves before Adam. They all prostrated them selves except Iblis: he was not one of those who fell prostrate.
ayahs.translation: We initiated your creation then We gave you each a shape and then We said to th e angels:  Prostrate yourselves before Adam. They all prostrated them selves except Iblis: he was not one of those who fell prostrate.

ayahs.text: Allah said:  What prevented you from prostrating yourself when I commanded you to do so?  He said:  I am better than he. You created me from fire and him You created from clay.
ayahs.translation: Allah said:  What prevented you from prostrating yourself when I commanded you to do so?  He said:  I am better than he. You created me from fire and him You created from clay.

ayahs.text: Allah said: ''Then get you down from here. It does not behove you to be arrogant here. So be gone. You will be among the humiliated.''
ayahs.translation: Allah said: ''Then get you down from here. It does not behove you to be arrogant here. So be gone. You will be among the humiliated.''

ayahs.text: Satan replied: ''Give me respite till the Day they shall be raised.''
ayahs.translation: Satan replied: ''Give me respite till the Day they shall be raised.''

ayahs.text: Allah said: ''You are granted respite.''
ayahs.translation: Allah said: ''You are granted respite.''
