verses.translation: Such indeed are true believers. They have high ranks with their Lord and forgiveness for their sins and an honourable sustenance.

verses.text: (Now with regard to the spoils the same situation exists as when) your Lord brought you forth from your home in a righteous cause while a party among the believers was much averse to it.
verses.translation: (Now with regard to the spoils the same situation exists as when) your Lord brought you forth from your home in a righteous cause while a party among the believers was much averse to it.

verses.text: They disputed with you about the truth after that had become evident as if they were being driven to death with their eyes wide open.
verses.translation: They disputed with you about the truth after that had become evident as if they were being driven to death with their eyes wide open.

verses.text: And recall when Allah promised you that one of the two hosts would fall to you and you wished that the one without arms should fall into your hands. But Allah sought to confirm the Truth by His words and to annihilate the last remnant of the unbelievers.
verses.translation: And recall when Allah promised you that one of the two hosts would fall to you and you wished that the one without arms should fall into your hands. But Allah sought to confirm the Truth by His words and to annihilate the last remnant of the unbelievers.

verses.text: so that He might prove the truth to be true and the false to be false however much the evil-doers might dislike it.
verses.translation: so that He might prove the truth to be true and the false to be false however much the evil-doers might dislike it.

verses.text: And recall when you implored your Lord for help and He responded to you: ''I will indeed reinforce you with a thousand angels coming host after host.''
verses.translation: And recall when you implored your Lord for help and He responded to you: ''I will indeed reinforce you with a thousand angels coming host after host.''

verses.text: Allah meant this as glad tidings and in order that your hearts may be set at rest. For every help comes from Allah alone. Surely Allah is All-Mighty All-Wise.
verses.translation: Allah meant this as glad tidings and in order that your hearts may be set at rest. For every help comes from Allah alone. Surely Allah is All-Mighty All-Wise.

verses.text: And recall when Allah brought on you drowsiness giving you a feeling of peace and security (coming) from Him and He sent down rain upon you from the sky that He might thereby cleanse you and take awaythe pollution of Satan from you and strengthen your hearts and steady your feet.
verses.translation: And recall when Allah brought on you drowsiness giving you a feeling of peace and security (coming) from Him and He sent down rain upon you from the sky that He might thereby cleanse you and take awaythe pollution of Satan from you and strengthen your hearts and steady your feet.

verses.text: And recall when your Lord inspired the angels: ''I am certainly with you. So make firm the feet of those who believe. I will cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieve. So strike at their necks and strike at every pore and tip.
verses.translation: And recall when your Lord inspired the angels: ''I am certainly with you. So make firm the feet of those who believe. I will cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieve. So strike at their necks and strike at every pore and tip.

verses.text: This is because they defied Allah and His Messenger. Whoever defies Allah and His Messenger must know that Allah is severe in punishment.
verses.translation: This is because they defied Allah and His Messenger. Whoever defies Allah and His Messenger must know that Allah is severe in punishment.

verses.text: That is your punishment (from Allah). So taste this punishment and know that chastisement of the Fire awaits the unbelievers.
verses.translation: That is your punishment (from Allah). So taste this punishment and know that chastisement of the Fire awaits the unbelievers.

verses.text: Believers whenever you encounter a hostile force of unbelievers do not turn your backs to them in flight.
verses.translation: Believers whenever you encounter a hostile force of unbelievers do not turn your backs to them in flight.

verses.text: For he who turns his back on them on such an occasion - except that it be for tactical reasons or turning to join another company - he shall incur the wrath of Allah and Hell shall be his abode. It is an evil destination.
verses.translation: For he who turns his back on them on such an occasion - except that it be for tactical reasons or turning to join another company - he shall incur the wrath of Allah and Hell shall be his abode. It is an evil destination.

verses.text: So the fact is that it was not you but it was Allah Who killed them; and it was not you when you threw (sand at them) but it was Allah Who threw it (and the believers were employed for the task) that He might cause the believers to successfully pass through this test. Allah is All-Hearing All-Knowing.
verses.translation: So the fact is that it was not you but it was Allah Who killed them; and it was not you when you threw (sand at them) but it was Allah Who threw it (and the believers were employed for the task) that He might cause the believers to successfully pass through this test. Allah is All-Hearing All-Knowing.

verses.text: This is His manner of dealing with you. As for the unbelievers Allah will surely undermine their designs.
verses.translation: This is His manner of dealing with you. As for the unbelievers Allah will surely undermine their designs.

verses.text: (Tell the unbelievers:) ''If you have sought a judgement then surely a judgement has come to you. And if you desist from disobedience it is all the better for you. But if you revert to your mischief We will again chastise you; and your host howsoever numerous will never be of any avail to you. Know well Allah is with the believers.''
verses.translation: (Tell the unbelievers:) ''If you have sought a judgement then surely a judgement has come to you. And if you desist from disobedience it is all the better for you. But if you revert to your mischief We will again chastise you; and your host howsoever numerous will never be of any avail to you. Know well Allah is with the believers.''

verses.text: Believers! Obey Allah and His Messenger and do not turn away from him after you hear his command.
verses.translation: Believers! Obey Allah and His Messenger and do not turn away from him after you hear his command.

verses.text: And do not be like those who say: ''We hear'' though they do not hearken.
verses.translation: And do not be like those who say: ''We hear'' though they do not hearken.

verses.text: Indeed the worst kind of all beasts in the sight of Allah are the people who are deaf and dumb and who do not understand.
verses.translation: Indeed the worst kind of all beasts in the sight of Allah are the people who are deaf and dumb and who do not understand.

verses.text: And had Allah known any good in them He would surely have made them hear; but (considering what they are) even if He made them hear they would have surely turned away in aversion.
verses.translation: And had Allah known any good in them He would surely have made them hear; but (considering what they are) even if He made them hear they would have surely turned away in aversion.

verses.text: Believers! Respond to Allah and respond to the Messenger when he calls you to that which gives you life. Know well that Allah stands between a person and his heart and it is to Him that all of you shall be mustered.
verses.translation: Believers! Respond to Allah and respond to the Messenger when he calls you to that which gives you life. Know well that Allah stands between a person and his heart and it is to Him that all of you shall be mustered.

verses.text: And guard against the mischief that will bring punishment not only to the wrong-doers among you. Know well that Allah is severe in punishment
verses.translation: And guard against the mischief that will bring punishment not only to the wrong-doers among you. Know well that Allah is severe in punishment

verses.text: And recall when you were few in number and deemed weak in the land when you were fearful lest people do away with you. And then He provided you refuge strengthened you with His help and provided you sustenance with good things that you may be grateful.
verses.translation: And recall when you were few in number and deemed weak in the land when you were fearful lest people do away with you. And then He provided you refuge strengthened you with His help and provided you sustenance with good things that you may be grateful.

verses.text: Believers! Do not be unfaithful to Allah and the Messenger nor be knowingly unfaithful to your trusts.
verses.translation: Believers! Do not be unfaithful to Allah and the Messenger nor be knowingly unfaithful to your trusts.

verses.text: Know well that your belongings and your children are but a trial and that there lies a mighty reward with Allah.
verses.translation: Know well that your belongings and your children are but a trial and that there lies a mighty reward with Allah.

verses.text: Believers! If you fear Allah He will grant you a criterion and will cleanse you of your sins and forgive you. Allah is the Lord of abounding bounty.
verses.translation: Believers! If you fear Allah He will grant you a criterion and will cleanse you of your sins and forgive you. Allah is the Lord of abounding bounty.

verses.text: And recall how those who disbelieved schemed against you to take you captive or kill you or drive you away. They schemed and Allah also schemed. Allah is the best of those who scheme.
verses.translation: And recall how those who disbelieved schemed against you to take you captive or kill you or drive you away. They schemed and Allah also schemed. Allah is the best of those who scheme.

verses.text: And when Our verses are recited to them they say: ''We have heard. We could if we willed compose the like of it. They are nothing but fables of the ancient times.''
verses.translation: And when Our verses are recited to them they say: ''We have heard. We could if we willed compose the like of it. They are nothing but fables of the ancient times.''

verses.text: And also recall when they said: ''O Allah! If this indeed be the truth from You then rain down stones upon us from heaven or bring upon us a painful chastisement.''
verses.translation: And also recall when they said: ''O Allah! If this indeed be the truth from You then rain down stones upon us from heaven or bring upon us a painful chastisement.''

verses.text: But Allah was not to chastise them while you are in their midst; nor was Allah going to chastise them while they sought His forgiveness.
verses.translation: But Allah was not to chastise them while you are in their midst; nor was Allah going to chastise them while they sought His forgiveness.

verses.text: But why should Allah not chastise them now when they are hindering people from the Holy Mosque even though they are not even its true guardians? For its true guardians are none but the God-fearing though most of them do not know that.
verses.translation: But why should Allah not chastise them now when they are hindering people from the Holy Mosque even though they are not even its true guardians? For its true guardians are none but the God-fearing though most of them do not know that.

verses.text: Their Prayer at the House is nothing but whistling and handclapping. Taste then the chastisement for your denying the truth.
verses.translation: Their Prayer at the House is nothing but whistling and handclapping. Taste then the chastisement for your denying the truth.

verses.text: Surely those who deny the truth spend their wealth to hinder people from the way of Allah. They will continue to so spend until their efforts become a source of intense regret for them and then they will be vanquished and then these deniers of the Truth will be driven to Hell
verses.translation: Surely those who deny the truth spend their wealth to hinder people from the way of Allah. They will continue to so spend until their efforts become a source of intense regret for them and then they will be vanquished and then these deniers of the Truth will be driven to Hell

verses.text: so that Allah may separate the bad from the good and join together all those who are bad into a pile one upon another and cast them into Hell. They it is they who are the losers.
verses.translation: so that Allah may separate the bad from the good and join together all those who are bad into a pile one upon another and cast them into Hell. They it is they who are the losers.

verses.text: (O Prophet!) Tell the unbelievers that if they desist from evil their past deeds shall be forgiven and if they revert to their past ways then it is well known what happened with the people of the past.
verses.translation: (O Prophet!) Tell the unbelievers that if they desist from evil their past deeds shall be forgiven and if they revert to their past ways then it is well known what happened with the people of the past.

verses.text: And fight against them until the mischief ends and the way prescribed by Allah - the whole of it  prevails. Then if they give up mischief surely Allah sees what they do.
verses.translation: And fight against them until the mischief ends and the way prescribed by Allah - the whole of it  prevails. Then if they give up mischief surely Allah sees what they do.

verses.text: But if they turn away then know well that Allah is your Protector - an excellent Protector and an excellent Helper.
verses.translation: But if they turn away then know well that Allah is your Protector - an excellent Protector and an excellent Helper.

verses.text: Know that one fifth of the spoils that you obtain belongs to Allah and to the Messenger and to the near of kin to the orphans and the needy and the wayfarer. This you must observe if you truly believe in Allah and in what We sent down on Our servant on the day when the true was distinguished from the false the day on which the two armies met in battle. Allah has power over all things.
verses.translation: Know that one fifth of the spoils that you obtain belongs to Allah and to the Messenger and to the near of kin to the orphans and the needy and the wayfarer. This you must observe if you truly believe in Allah and in what We sent down on Our servant on the day when the true was distinguished from the false the day on which the two armies met in battle. Allah has power over all things.

verses.text: And recall when you were encamped at the nearer end of the valley (of Badr) and they were at the farther end and the caravan was below you (along the seaside). Had you made a mutual appointment to meet in an encounter you would have declined. But the encounter was brought about so that Allah might accomplish what He had decreed and that he who was to perish should perish through a clear proof and who was to survive might survive through a clear proof. Surely Allah is All-Hearing All-Knowing.
verses.translation: And recall when you were encamped at the nearer end of the valley (of Badr) and they were at the farther end and the caravan was below you (along the seaside). Had you made a mutual appointment to meet in an encounter you would have declined. But the encounter was brought about so that Allah might accomplish what He had decreed and that he who was to perish should perish through a clear proof and who was to survive might survive through a clear proof. Surely Allah is All-Hearing All-Knowing.

verses.text: And recall when Allah showed them to you in your dream to be few in number. And had He showed them to you to be numerous you would have flagged and disagreed with one another about fighting them. But Allah saved you. Surely Allah knows what is hidden in the breasts.
verses.translation: And recall when Allah showed them to you in your dream to be few in number. And had He showed them to you to be numerous you would have flagged and disagreed with one another about fighting them. But Allah saved you. Surely Allah knows what is hidden in the breasts.

verses.text: And recall when He made them appear to be few in your eyes when you met them in the battle just as He lessened you in their eyes so that Allah might accomplish what had been decreed. To Allah are all matters referred for decision.
verses.translation: And recall when He made them appear to be few in your eyes when you met them in the battle just as He lessened you in their eyes so that Allah might accomplish what had been decreed. To Allah are all matters referred for decision.

verses.text: Believers! When you encounter a host in battle stand firm and remember Allah much that you may triumph.
verses.translation: Believers! When you encounter a host in battle stand firm and remember Allah much that you may triumph.

verses.text: And obey Allah and His Messenger and do not quarrel with one another lest you should lose courage and your power depart. Be steadfast surely Allah is with those who remain steadfast.
verses.translation: And obey Allah and His Messenger and do not quarrel with one another lest you should lose courage and your power depart. Be steadfast surely Allah is with those who remain steadfast.

verses.text: And be not like those who came forth from their homes exulting with a desire to be seen bypeople as full of strength and hindering others form the Way of Allah. Allah encompasses all that they do.
verses.translation: And be not like those who came forth from their homes exulting with a desire to be seen bypeople as full of strength and hindering others form the Way of Allah. Allah encompasses all that they do.

verses.text: And recall when Satan made their works seem fair to them and said: ''None shall overcome you today and I am your supporter.'' But when the two armies faced each other he turned on his heels and said: ''Surely I am quit of you for I behold that which you do not. Indeed I fear Allah and Allah is stern in punishment.''
verses.translation: And recall when Satan made their works seem fair to them and said: ''None shall overcome you today and I am your supporter.'' But when the two armies faced each other he turned on his heels and said: ''Surely I am quit of you for I behold that which you do not. Indeed I fear Allah and Allah is stern in punishment.''

verses.text: And recall when the hypocrites and those whose hearts were diseased said: ''Their faith has deluded these (believers). But he who puts his trust in Allah shall find Allah All-Mighty. All-Wise.''
verses.translation: And recall when the hypocrites and those whose hearts were diseased said: ''Their faith has deluded these (believers). But he who puts his trust in Allah shall find Allah All-Mighty. All-Wise.''

verses.text: And if you could only see when the angels took away the souls of the unbelievers striking them on their faces and backs saying: ''Taste the torment of burning.
verses.translation: And if you could only see when the angels took away the souls of the unbelievers striking them on their faces and backs saying: ''Taste the torment of burning.

verses.text: This is your punishment for what your hands have wrought. Allah is not unjust in the least to His creatures.''
verses.translation: This is your punishment for what your hands have wrought. Allah is not unjust in the least to His creatures.''

verses.text: Their case is like that of the people of Pharaoh and those before them. They denied the signs of Allah and so Allah seized them for their sins. Surely Allah is All-Powerful Most Stern in retribution.
verses.translation: Their case is like that of the people of Pharaoh and those before them. They denied the signs of Allah and so Allah seized them for their sins. Surely Allah is All-Powerful Most Stern in retribution.

verses.text: This happened because Allah is not one to change the favour which He has bestowed upon a people until they have changed their attitude. Surely Allah is All-Hearing All-Knowing.
verses.translation: This happened because Allah is not one to change the favour which He has bestowed upon a people until they have changed their attitude. Surely Allah is All-Hearing All-Knowing.

verses.text: Their case is like that of the people of Pharaoh and those before them: they rejected the signs of their Lord as false and so We destroyed them for their sins and caused the people of Pharaoh to drown. For all of them were wrong-doers.
verses.translation: Their case is like that of the people of Pharaoh and those before them: they rejected the signs of their Lord as false and so We destroyed them for their sins and caused the people of Pharaoh to drown. For all of them were wrong-doers.

verses.text: Surely the worst moving creatures in the sight of Allah are those who definitively denied the truth and are therefore in no way prepared to accept it;
verses.translation: Surely the worst moving creatures in the sight of Allah are those who definitively denied the truth and are therefore in no way prepared to accept it;

verses.text: (especially) those with whom you entered into a covenant and then they broke their covenant time after time and who do not fear Allah.
verses.translation: (especially) those with whom you entered into a covenant and then they broke their covenant time after time and who do not fear Allah.

verses.text: So if you meet them in war make of them a fearsome example for those who follow them that they may he admonished.
verses.translation: So if you meet them in war make of them a fearsome example for those who follow them that they may he admonished.

verses.text: And if you fear treachery from any people (with whom you have a covenant) then publicly throw their covenant at them. Allah does not love the treacherous.
verses.translation: And if you fear treachery from any people (with whom you have a covenant) then publicly throw their covenant at them. Allah does not love the treacherous.

verses.text: Let not the deniers of the truth be deluded that they will gain any advantage. Surely they can never overcome Us!
verses.translation: Let not the deniers of the truth be deluded that they will gain any advantage. Surely they can never overcome Us!

verses.text: Make ready for an encounter against them all the forces and well-readied horses you can muster so that you may overawe the enemies of Allah and your own enemies and others besides them of whom you are unaware but of whom Allah is aware. Whatever you may spend in the cause of Allah shall be fully repaid to you and you shall not be wronged.
verses.translation: Make ready for an encounter against them all the forces and well-readied horses you can muster so that you may overawe the enemies of Allah and your own enemies and others besides them of whom you are unaware but of whom Allah is aware. Whatever you may spend in the cause of Allah shall be fully repaid to you and you shall not be wronged.

verses.text: If they incline to peace incline you as well to it and trust in Allah. Surely He is All-Hearing All-Knowing.
verses.translation: If they incline to peace incline you as well to it and trust in Allah. Surely He is All-Hearing All-Knowing.

verses.text: And should they seek to deceive you Allah is sufficient for you. He it is Who strengthened you with His succour and the believers
verses.translation: And should they seek to deceive you Allah is sufficient for you. He it is Who strengthened you with His succour and the believers

verses.text: and joined their hearts. Had you given away all the riches of the earth you could not have joined their hearts but it is Allah Who joined their hearts. Indeed He is All-Mighty All-Wise.
verses.translation: and joined their hearts. Had you given away all the riches of the earth you could not have joined their hearts but it is Allah Who joined their hearts. Indeed He is All-Mighty All-Wise.

verses.text: O Prophet! Allah is sufficient for you and the believers who follow you.
verses.translation: O Prophet! Allah is sufficient for you and the believers who follow you.

verses.text: O Prophet! Rouse the believers to fighting. If there be twenty of you who persevere they shall vanquish two hundred; and if there be of you a hundred they shall vanquish a thousand of those who disbelieve for they are a people who lack understanding.
verses.translation: O Prophet! Rouse the believers to fighting. If there be twenty of you who persevere they shall vanquish two hundred; and if there be of you a hundred they shall vanquish a thousand of those who disbelieve for they are a people who lack understanding.

verses.text: Allah has now lightened your burden for He found weakness in you. So if there be a hundred of you who persevere they shall vanquish two hundred; and if there be a thousand of you they shall by the leave of Allah vanquish two thousand. Allah is with those who persevere.
verses.translation: Allah has now lightened your burden for He found weakness in you. So if there be a hundred of you who persevere they shall vanquish two hundred; and if there be a thousand of you they shall by the leave of Allah vanquish two thousand. Allah is with those who persevere.

verses.text: It behoves not a Prophet to take captives until he has sufficiently suppressed the enemies in the land. You merely seek the gains of the world whereas Allah desires (for you the good) of the Hereafter. Allah is All-Mighty All-Wise.
verses.translation: It behoves not a Prophet to take captives until he has sufficiently suppressed the enemies in the land. You merely seek the gains of the world whereas Allah desires (for you the good) of the Hereafter. Allah is All-Mighty All-Wise.

verses.text: Had there not been a previous decree from Allah a stern punishment would have afflicted you for what you have taken.
verses.translation: Had there not been a previous decree from Allah a stern punishment would have afflicted you for what you have taken.

verses.text: So eat that which you have obtained - for it is lawful and clean- and fear Allah. Surely Allah is Ever-Forgiving Most Merciful.
verses.translation: So eat that which you have obtained - for it is lawful and clean- and fear Allah. Surely Allah is Ever-Forgiving Most Merciful.

verses.text: O Prophet! Say to the captives in your hands: ''If Allah finds any goodness in your hearts He will give you that which is better than what has been taken away from you and He will forgive you. Allah is Ever-Forgiving Most Merciful.''
verses.translation: O Prophet! Say to the captives in your hands: ''If Allah finds any goodness in your hearts He will give you that which is better than what has been taken away from you and He will forgive you. Allah is Ever-Forgiving Most Merciful.''

verses.text: But if they seek to betray you know that they had already betrayed Allah. Therefore He made you prevail over them. Allah is All-Knowing All-Wise.
verses.translation: But if they seek to betray you know that they had already betrayed Allah. Therefore He made you prevail over them. Allah is All-Knowing All-Wise.

verses.text: Surely those who believed and migrated and strove hard in the way of Allah with their possessions and their lives and those that sheltered and helped them - they alone are the true allies of one another. And those who believed but did not migrate (to Dar-al-Islam) you are under no obligation of alliance unless they migrate. And should they seek help from you in the matter of religion it is incumbent on you to provide help unless it be against a people with whom you have a pact. Allah is cognizant of all that you do.
verses.translation: Surely those who believed and migrated and strove hard in the way of Allah with their possessions and their lives and those that sheltered and helped them - they alone are the true allies of one another. And those who believed but did not migrate (to Dar-al-Islam) you are under no obligation of alliance unless they migrate. And should they seek help from you in the matter of religion it is incumbent on you to provide help unless it be against a people with whom you have a pact. Allah is cognizant of all that you do.

verses.text: And those who disbelieve they are allies of one another; and unless you act likewise there will be oppression in the world and great corruption.
verses.translation: And those who disbelieve they are allies of one another; and unless you act likewise there will be oppression in the world and great corruption.

verses.text: Those who believe and have migrated and strove in the way of Allah and those who gave them refuge and help - it is they who are the true believers. Theirs shall be forgiveness and honourable sustenance.
verses.translation: Those who believe and have migrated and strove in the way of Allah and those who gave them refuge and help - it is they who are the true believers. Theirs shall be forgiveness and honourable sustenance.

verses.text: And those who believed afterwards and migrated and strove along with you: they belong to you. But those related by blood are nearer to one another according to the Book of Allah. Allah has knowledge of everything.
verses.translation: And those who believed afterwards and migrated and strove along with you: they belong to you. But those related by blood are nearer to one another according to the Book of Allah. Allah has knowledge of everything.

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: They ask you concerning the spoils of war. Tell them: ''The spoils of war belong to Allah and the Messenger. So fear Allah and set things right among you and obey Allah and His Messenger if you are true believers.''
ayahs.translation: They ask you concerning the spoils of war. Tell them: ''The spoils of war belong to Allah and the Messenger. So fear Allah and set things right among you and obey Allah and His Messenger if you are true believers.''

ayahs.text: The true believers are those who when Allah''s name is mentioned their hearts quake and when His verses are recited to them their faith grows and who put their trust in their Lord;
ayahs.translation: The true believers are those who when Allah''s name is mentioned their hearts quake and when His verses are recited to them their faith grows and who put their trust in their Lord;

ayahs.text: who establish Prayer and spend out of what We have provided them.
ayahs.translation: who establish Prayer and spend out of what We have provided them.

ayahs.text: Such indeed are true believers. They have high ranks with their Lord and forgiveness for their sins and an honourable sustenance.
ayahs.translation: Such indeed are true believers. They have high ranks with their Lord and forgiveness for their sins and an honourable sustenance.

ayahs.text: (Now with regard to the spoils the same situation exists as when) your Lord brought you forth from your home in a righteous cause while a party among the believers was much averse to it.
ayahs.translation: (Now with regard to the spoils the same situation exists as when) your Lord brought you forth from your home in a righteous cause while a party among the believers was much averse to it.

ayahs.text: They disputed with you about the truth after that had become evident as if they were being driven to death with their eyes wide open.
ayahs.translation: They disputed with you about the truth after that had become evident as if they were being driven to death with their eyes wide open.

ayahs.text: And recall when Allah promised you that one of the two hosts would fall to you and you wished that the one without arms should fall into your hands. But Allah sought to confirm the Truth by His words and to annihilate the last remnant of the unbelievers.
ayahs.translation: And recall when Allah promised you that one of the two hosts would fall to you and you wished that the one without arms should fall into your hands. But Allah sought to confirm the Truth by His words and to annihilate the last remnant of the unbelievers.

ayahs.text: so that He might prove the truth to be true and the false to be false however much the evil-doers might dislike it.
ayahs.translation: so that He might prove the truth to be true and the false to be false however much the evil-doers might dislike it.

ayahs.text: And recall when you implored your Lord for help and He responded to you: ''I will indeed reinforce you with a thousand angels coming host after host.''
ayahs.translation: And recall when you implored your Lord for help and He responded to you: ''I will indeed reinforce you with a thousand angels coming host after host.''

ayahs.text: Allah meant this as glad tidings and in order that your hearts may be set at rest. For every help comes from Allah alone. Surely Allah is All-Mighty All-Wise.
ayahs.translation: Allah meant this as glad tidings and in order that your hearts may be set at rest. For every help comes from Allah alone. Surely Allah is All-Mighty All-Wise.

ayahs.text: And recall when Allah brought on you drowsiness giving you a feeling of peace and security (coming) from Him and He sent down rain upon you from the sky that He might thereby cleanse you and take awaythe pollution of Satan from you and strengthen your hearts and steady your feet.
ayahs.translation: And recall when Allah brought on you drowsiness giving you a feeling of peace and security (coming) from Him and He sent down rain upon you from the sky that He might thereby cleanse you and take awaythe pollution of Satan from you and strengthen your hearts and steady your feet.

ayahs.text: And recall when your Lord inspired the angels: ''I am certainly with you. So make firm the feet of those who believe. I will cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieve. So strike at their necks and strike at every pore and tip.
ayahs.translation: And recall when your Lord inspired the angels: ''I am certainly with you. So make firm the feet of those who believe. I will cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieve. So strike at their necks and strike at every pore and tip.

ayahs.text: This is because they defied Allah and His Messenger. Whoever defies Allah and His Messenger must know that Allah is severe in punishment.
ayahs.translation: This is because they defied Allah and His Messenger. Whoever defies Allah and His Messenger must know that Allah is severe in punishment.

ayahs.text: That is your punishment (from Allah). So taste this punishment and know that chastisement of the Fire awaits the unbelievers.
ayahs.translation: That is your punishment (from Allah). So taste this punishment and know that chastisement of the Fire awaits the unbelievers.

ayahs.text: Believers whenever you encounter a hostile force of unbelievers do not turn your backs to them in flight.
ayahs.translation: Believers whenever you encounter a hostile force of unbelievers do not turn your backs to them in flight.

ayahs.text: For he who turns his back on them on such an occasion - except that it be for tactical reasons or turning to join another company - he shall incur the wrath of Allah and Hell shall be his abode. It is an evil destination.
ayahs.translation: For he who turns his back on them on such an occasion - except that it be for tactical reasons or turning to join another company - he shall incur the wrath of Allah and Hell shall be his abode. It is an evil destination.

ayahs.text: So the fact is that it was not you but it was Allah Who killed them; and it was not you when you threw (sand at them) but it was Allah Who threw it (and the believers were employed for the task) that He might cause the believers to successfully pass through this test. Allah is All-Hearing All-Knowing.
ayahs.translation: So the fact is that it was not you but it was Allah Who killed them; and it was not you when you threw (sand at them) but it was Allah Who threw it (and the believers were employed for the task) that He might cause the believers to successfully pass through this test. Allah is All-Hearing All-Knowing.

ayahs.text: This is His manner of dealing with you. As for the unbelievers Allah will surely undermine their designs.
ayahs.translation: This is His manner of dealing with you. As for the unbelievers Allah will surely undermine their designs.

ayahs.text: (Tell the unbelievers:) ''If you have sought a judgement then surely a judgement has come to you. And if you desist from disobedience it is all the better for you. But if you revert to your mischief We will again chastise you; and your host howsoever numerous will never be of any avail to you. Know well Allah is with the believers.''
ayahs.translation: (Tell the unbelievers:) ''If you have sought a judgement then surely a judgement has come to you. And if you desist from disobedience it is all the better for you. But if you revert to your mischief We will again chastise you; and your host howsoever numerous will never be of any avail to you. Know well Allah is with the believers.''

ayahs.text: Believers! Obey Allah and His Messenger and do not turn away from him after you hear his command.
ayahs.translation: Believers! Obey Allah and His Messenger and do not turn away from him after you hear his command.

ayahs.text: And do not be like those who say: ''We hear'' though they do not hearken.
ayahs.translation: And do not be like those who say: ''We hear'' though they do not hearken.

ayahs.text: Indeed the worst kind of all beasts in the sight of Allah are the people who are deaf and dumb and who do not understand.
ayahs.translation: Indeed the worst kind of all beasts in the sight of Allah are the people who are deaf and dumb and who do not understand.

ayahs.text: And had Allah known any good in them He would surely have made them hear; but (considering what they are) even if He made them hear they would have surely turned away in aversion.
ayahs.translation: And had Allah known any good in them He would surely have made them hear; but (considering what they are) even if He made them hear they would have surely turned away in aversion.

ayahs.text: Believers! Respond to Allah and respond to the Messenger when he calls you to that which gives you life. Know well that Allah stands between a person and his heart and it is to Him that all of you shall be mustered.
ayahs.translation: Believers! Respond to Allah and respond to the Messenger when he calls you to that which gives you life. Know well that Allah stands between a person and his heart and it is to Him that all of you shall be mustered.

ayahs.text: And guard against the mischief that will bring punishment not only to the wrong-doers among you. Know well that Allah is severe in punishment
ayahs.translation: And guard against the mischief that will bring punishment not only to the wrong-doers among you. Know well that Allah is severe in punishment

ayahs.text: And recall when you were few in number and deemed weak in the land when you were fearful lest people do away with you. And then He provided you refuge strengthened you with His help and provided you sustenance with good things that you may be grateful.
ayahs.translation: And recall when you were few in number and deemed weak in the land when you were fearful lest people do away with you. And then He provided you refuge strengthened you with His help and provided you sustenance with good things that you may be grateful.

ayahs.text: Believers! Do not be unfaithful to Allah and the Messenger nor be knowingly unfaithful to your trusts.
ayahs.translation: Believers! Do not be unfaithful to Allah and the Messenger nor be knowingly unfaithful to your trusts.

ayahs.text: Know well that your belongings and your children are but a trial and that there lies a mighty reward with Allah.
ayahs.translation: Know well that your belongings and your children are but a trial and that there lies a mighty reward with Allah.

ayahs.text: Believers! If you fear Allah He will grant you a criterion and will cleanse you of your sins and forgive you. Allah is the Lord of abounding bounty.
ayahs.translation: Believers! If you fear Allah He will grant you a criterion and will cleanse you of your sins and forgive you. Allah is the Lord of abounding bounty.

ayahs.text: And recall how those who disbelieved schemed against you to take you captive or kill you or drive you away. They schemed and Allah also schemed. Allah is the best of those who scheme.
ayahs.translation: And recall how those who disbelieved schemed against you to take you captive or kill you or drive you away. They schemed and Allah also schemed. Allah is the best of those who scheme.

ayahs.text: And when Our verses are recited to them they say: ''We have heard. We could if we willed compose the like of it. They are nothing but fables of the ancient times.''
ayahs.translation: And when Our verses are recited to them they say: ''We have heard. We could if we willed compose the like of it. They are nothing but fables of the ancient times.''

ayahs.text: And also recall when they said: ''O Allah! If this indeed be the truth from You then rain down stones upon us from heaven or bring upon us a painful chastisement.''
ayahs.translation: And also recall when they said: ''O Allah! If this indeed be the truth from You then rain down stones upon us from heaven or bring upon us a painful chastisement.''

ayahs.text: But Allah was not to chastise them while you are in their midst; nor was Allah going to chastise them while they sought His forgiveness.
ayahs.translation: But Allah was not to chastise them while you are in their midst; nor was Allah going to chastise them while they sought His forgiveness.

ayahs.text: But why should Allah not chastise them now when they are hindering people from the Holy Mosque even though they are not even its true guardians? For its true guardians are none but the God-fearing though most of them do not know that.
ayahs.translation: But why should Allah not chastise them now when they are hindering people from the Holy Mosque even though they are not even its true guardians? For its true guardians are none but the God-fearing though most of them do not know that.

ayahs.text: Their Prayer at the House is nothing but whistling and handclapping. Taste then the chastisement for your denying the truth.
ayahs.translation: Their Prayer at the House is nothing but whistling and handclapping. Taste then the chastisement for your denying the truth.

ayahs.text: Surely those who deny the truth spend their wealth to hinder people from the way of Allah. They will continue to so spend until their efforts become a source of intense regret for them and then they will be vanquished and then these deniers of the Truth will be driven to Hell
ayahs.translation: Surely those who deny the truth spend their wealth to hinder people from the way of Allah. They will continue to so spend until their efforts become a source of intense regret for them and then they will be vanquished and then these deniers of the Truth will be driven to Hell

ayahs.text: so that Allah may separate the bad from the good and join together all those who are bad into a pile one upon another and cast them into Hell. They it is they who are the losers.
ayahs.translation: so that Allah may separate the bad from the good and join together all those who are bad into a pile one upon another and cast them into Hell. They it is they who are the losers.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet!) Tell the unbelievers that if they desist from evil their past deeds shall be forgiven and if they revert to their past ways then it is well known what happened with the people of the past.
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet!) Tell the unbelievers that if they desist from evil their past deeds shall be forgiven and if they revert to their past ways then it is well known what happened with the people of the past.

ayahs.text: And fight against them until the mischief ends and the way prescribed by Allah - the whole of it  prevails. Then if they give up mischief surely Allah sees what they do.
ayahs.translation: And fight against them until the mischief ends and the way prescribed by Allah - the whole of it  prevails. Then if they give up mischief surely Allah sees what they do.

ayahs.text: But if they turn away then know well that Allah is your Protector - an excellent Protector and an excellent Helper.
ayahs.translation: But if they turn away then know well that Allah is your Protector - an excellent Protector and an excellent Helper.

ayahs.text: Know that one fifth of the spoils that you obtain belongs to Allah and to the Messenger and to the near of kin to the orphans and the needy and the wayfarer. This you must observe if you truly believe in Allah and in what We sent down on Our servant on the day when the true was distinguished from the false the day on which the two armies met in battle. Allah has power over all things.
ayahs.translation: Know that one fifth of the spoils that you obtain belongs to Allah and to the Messenger and to the near of kin to the orphans and the needy and the wayfarer. This you must observe if you truly believe in Allah and in what We sent down on Our servant on the day when the true was distinguished from the false the day on which the two armies met in battle. Allah has power over all things.

ayahs.text: And recall when you were encamped at the nearer end of the valley (of Badr) and they were at the farther end and the caravan was below you (along the seaside). Had you made a mutual appointment to meet in an encounter you would have declined. But the encounter was brought about so that Allah might accomplish what He had decreed and that he who was to perish should perish through a clear proof and who was to survive might survive through a clear proof. Surely Allah is All-Hearing All-Knowing.
ayahs.translation: And recall when you were encamped at the nearer end of the valley (of Badr) and they were at the farther end and the caravan was below you (along the seaside). Had you made a mutual appointment to meet in an encounter you would have declined. But the encounter was brought about so that Allah might accomplish what He had decreed and that he who was to perish should perish through a clear proof and who was to survive might survive through a clear proof. Surely Allah is All-Hearing All-Knowing.

ayahs.text: And recall when Allah showed them to you in your dream to be few in number. And had He showed them to you to be numerous you would have flagged and disagreed with one another about fighting them. But Allah saved you. Surely Allah knows what is hidden in the breasts.
ayahs.translation: And recall when Allah showed them to you in your dream to be few in number. And had He showed them to you to be numerous you would have flagged and disagreed with one another about fighting them. But Allah saved you. Surely Allah knows what is hidden in the breasts.

ayahs.text: And recall when He made them appear to be few in your eyes when you met them in the battle just as He lessened you in their eyes so that Allah might accomplish what had been decreed. To Allah are all matters referred for decision.
ayahs.translation: And recall when He made them appear to be few in your eyes when you met them in the battle just as He lessened you in their eyes so that Allah might accomplish what had been decreed. To Allah are all matters referred for decision.

ayahs.text: Believers! When you encounter a host in battle stand firm and remember Allah much that you may triumph.
ayahs.translation: Believers! When you encounter a host in battle stand firm and remember Allah much that you may triumph.

ayahs.text: And obey Allah and His Messenger and do not quarrel with one another lest you should lose courage and your power depart. Be steadfast surely Allah is with those who remain steadfast.
ayahs.translation: And obey Allah and His Messenger and do not quarrel with one another lest you should lose courage and your power depart. Be steadfast surely Allah is with those who remain steadfast.

ayahs.text: And be not like those who came forth from their homes exulting with a desire to be seen bypeople as full of strength and hindering others form the Way of Allah. Allah encompasses all that they do.
ayahs.translation: And be not like those who came forth from their homes exulting with a desire to be seen bypeople as full of strength and hindering others form the Way of Allah. Allah encompasses all that they do.

ayahs.text: And recall when Satan made their works seem fair to them and said: ''None shall overcome you today and I am your supporter.'' But when the two armies faced each other he turned on his heels and said: ''Surely I am quit of you for I behold that which you do not. Indeed I fear Allah and Allah is stern in punishment.''
ayahs.translation: And recall when Satan made their works seem fair to them and said: ''None shall overcome you today and I am your supporter.'' But when the two armies faced each other he turned on his heels and said: ''Surely I am quit of you for I behold that which you do not. Indeed I fear Allah and Allah is stern in punishment.''

ayahs.text: And recall when the hypocrites and those whose hearts were diseased said: ''Their faith has deluded these (believers). But he who puts his trust in Allah shall find Allah All-Mighty. All-Wise.''
ayahs.translation: And recall when the hypocrites and those whose hearts were diseased said: ''Their faith has deluded these (believers). But he who puts his trust in Allah shall find Allah All-Mighty. All-Wise.''

ayahs.text: And if you could only see when the angels took away the souls of the unbelievers striking them on their faces and backs saying: ''Taste the torment of burning.
ayahs.translation: And if you could only see when the angels took away the souls of the unbelievers striking them on their faces and backs saying: ''Taste the torment of burning.

ayahs.text: This is your punishment for what your hands have wrought. Allah is not unjust in the least to His creatures.''
ayahs.translation: This is your punishment for what your hands have wrought. Allah is not unjust in the least to His creatures.''

ayahs.text: Their case is like that of the people of Pharaoh and those before them. They denied the signs of Allah and so Allah seized them for their sins. Surely Allah is All-Powerful Most Stern in retribution.
ayahs.translation: Their case is like that of the people of Pharaoh and those before them. They denied the signs of Allah and so Allah seized them for their sins. Surely Allah is All-Powerful Most Stern in retribution.

ayahs.text: This happened because Allah is not one to change the favour which He has bestowed upon a people until they have changed their attitude. Surely Allah is All-Hearing All-Knowing.
ayahs.translation: This happened because Allah is not one to change the favour which He has bestowed upon a people until they have changed their attitude. Surely Allah is All-Hearing All-Knowing.

ayahs.text: Their case is like that of the people of Pharaoh and those before them: they rejected the signs of their Lord as false and so We destroyed them for their sins and caused the people of Pharaoh to drown. For all of them were wrong-doers.
ayahs.translation: Their case is like that of the people of Pharaoh and those before them: they rejected the signs of their Lord as false and so We destroyed them for their sins and caused the people of Pharaoh to drown. For all of them were wrong-doers.

ayahs.text: Surely the worst moving creatures in the sight of Allah are those who definitively denied the truth and are therefore in no way prepared to accept it;
ayahs.translation: Surely the worst moving creatures in the sight of Allah are those who definitively denied the truth and are therefore in no way prepared to accept it;

ayahs.text: (especially) those with whom you entered into a covenant and then they broke their covenant time after time and who do not fear Allah.
ayahs.translation: (especially) those with whom you entered into a covenant and then they broke their covenant time after time and who do not fear Allah.

ayahs.text: So if you meet them in war make of them a fearsome example for those who follow them that they may he admonished.
ayahs.translation: So if you meet them in war make of them a fearsome example for those who follow them that they may he admonished.

ayahs.text: And if you fear treachery from any people (with whom you have a covenant) then publicly throw their covenant at them. Allah does not love the treacherous.
ayahs.translation: And if you fear treachery from any people (with whom you have a covenant) then publicly throw their covenant at them. Allah does not love the treacherous.

ayahs.text: Let not the deniers of the truth be deluded that they will gain any advantage. Surely they can never overcome Us!
ayahs.translation: Let not the deniers of the truth be deluded that they will gain any advantage. Surely they can never overcome Us!

ayahs.text: Make ready for an encounter against them all the forces and well-readied horses you can muster so that you may overawe the enemies of Allah and your own enemies and others besides them of whom you are unaware but of whom Allah is aware. Whatever you may spend in the cause of Allah shall be fully repaid to you and you shall not be wronged.
ayahs.translation: Make ready for an encounter against them all the forces and well-readied horses you can muster so that you may overawe the enemies of Allah and your own enemies and others besides them of whom you are unaware but of whom Allah is aware. Whatever you may spend in the cause of Allah shall be fully repaid to you and you shall not be wronged.

ayahs.text: If they incline to peace incline you as well to it and trust in Allah. Surely He is All-Hearing All-Knowing.
ayahs.translation: If they incline to peace incline you as well to it and trust in Allah. Surely He is All-Hearing All-Knowing.

ayahs.text: And should they seek to deceive you Allah is sufficient for you. He it is Who strengthened you with His succour and the believers
ayahs.translation: And should they seek to deceive you Allah is sufficient for you. He it is Who strengthened you with His succour and the believers

ayahs.text: and joined their hearts. Had you given away all the riches of the earth you could not have joined their hearts but it is Allah Who joined their hearts. Indeed He is All-Mighty All-Wise.
ayahs.translation: and joined their hearts. Had you given away all the riches of the earth you could not have joined their hearts but it is Allah Who joined their hearts. Indeed He is All-Mighty All-Wise.

ayahs.text: O Prophet! Allah is sufficient for you and the believers who follow you.
ayahs.translation: O Prophet! Allah is sufficient for you and the believers who follow you.

ayahs.text: O Prophet! Rouse the believers to fighting. If there be twenty of you who persevere they shall vanquish two hundred; and if there be of you a hundred they shall vanquish a thousand of those who disbelieve for they are a people who lack understanding.
ayahs.translation: O Prophet! Rouse the believers to fighting. If there be twenty of you who persevere they shall vanquish two hundred; and if there be of you a hundred they shall vanquish a thousand of those who disbelieve for they are a people who lack understanding.

ayahs.text: Allah has now lightened your burden for He found weakness in you. So if there be a hundred of you who persevere they shall vanquish two hundred; and if there be a thousand of you they shall by the leave of Allah vanquish two thousand. Allah is with those who persevere.
ayahs.translation: Allah has now lightened your burden for He found weakness in you. So if there be a hundred of you who persevere they shall vanquish two hundred; and if there be a thousand of you they shall by the leave of Allah vanquish two thousand. Allah is with those who persevere.

ayahs.text: It behoves not a Prophet to take captives until he has sufficiently suppressed the enemies in the land. You merely seek the gains of the world whereas Allah desires (for you the good) of the Hereafter. Allah is All-Mighty All-Wise.
ayahs.translation: It behoves not a Prophet to take captives until he has sufficiently suppressed the enemies in the land. You merely seek the gains of the world whereas Allah desires (for you the good) of the Hereafter. Allah is All-Mighty All-Wise.

ayahs.text: Had there not been a previous decree from Allah a stern punishment would have afflicted you for what you have taken.
ayahs.translation: Had there not been a previous decree from Allah a stern punishment would have afflicted you for what you have taken.

ayahs.text: So eat that which you have obtained - for it is lawful and clean- and fear Allah. Surely Allah is Ever-Forgiving Most Merciful.
ayahs.translation: So eat that which you have obtained - for it is lawful and clean- and fear Allah. Surely Allah is Ever-Forgiving Most Merciful.

ayahs.text: O Prophet! Say to the captives in your hands: ''If Allah finds any goodness in your hearts He will give you that which is better than what has been taken away from you and He will forgive you. Allah is Ever-Forgiving Most Merciful.''
ayahs.translation: O Prophet! Say to the captives in your hands: ''If Allah finds any goodness in your hearts He will give you that which is better than what has been taken away from you and He will forgive you. Allah is Ever-Forgiving Most Merciful.''

ayahs.text: But if they seek to betray you know that they had already betrayed Allah. Therefore He made you prevail over them. Allah is All-Knowing All-Wise.
ayahs.translation: But if they seek to betray you know that they had already betrayed Allah. Therefore He made you prevail over them. Allah is All-Knowing All-Wise.

ayahs.text: Surely those who believed and migrated and strove hard in the way of Allah with their possessions and their lives and those that sheltered and helped them - they alone are the true allies of one another. And those who believed but did not migrate (to Dar-al-Islam) you are under no obligation of alliance unless they migrate. And should they seek help from you in the matter of religion it is incumbent on you to provide help unless it be against a people with whom you have a pact. Allah is cognizant of all that you do.
ayahs.translation: Surely those who believed and migrated and strove hard in the way of Allah with their possessions and their lives and those that sheltered and helped them - they alone are the true allies of one another. And those who believed but did not migrate (to Dar-al-Islam) you are under no obligation of alliance unless they migrate. And should they seek help from you in the matter of religion it is incumbent on you to provide help unless it be against a people with whom you have a pact. Allah is cognizant of all that you do.

ayahs.text: And those who disbelieve they are allies of one another; and unless you act likewise there will be oppression in the world and great corruption.
ayahs.translation: And those who disbelieve they are allies of one another; and unless you act likewise there will be oppression in the world and great corruption.

ayahs.text: Those who believe and have migrated and strove in the way of Allah and those who gave them refuge and help - it is they who are the true believers. Theirs shall be forgiveness and honourable sustenance.
ayahs.translation: Those who believe and have migrated and strove in the way of Allah and those who gave them refuge and help - it is they who are the true believers. Theirs shall be forgiveness and honourable sustenance.

ayahs.text: And those who believed afterwards and migrated and strove along with you: they belong to you. But those related by blood are nearer to one another according to the Book of Allah. Allah has knowledge of everything.
ayahs.translation: And those who believed afterwards and migrated and strove along with you: they belong to you. But those related by blood are nearer to one another according to the Book of Allah. Allah has knowledge of everything.

verses.text: This is a declaration of disavowal by Allah and His Messenger to those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity and with whom you have made treaties:
verses.translation: This is a declaration of disavowal by Allah and His Messenger to those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity and with whom you have made treaties:

verses.text: You may go about freely in the land for four months but know well that you will not be able to frustrate Allah and that Allah will bring disgrace upon those who deny the Truth.""
verses.translation: You may go about freely in the land for four months but know well that you will not be able to frustrate Allah and that Allah will bring disgrace upon those who deny the Truth.""

verses.text: This is a public proclamation by Allah and His Messenger to all people on the day of the Great Pilgrimage: ""Allah is free from all obligation to those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity; and so is His Messenger. If you repent it shall be for your own good; but if you turn away then know well that you will not be able to frustrate Allah. So give glad tidings of a painful chastisement to those who disbelieve.
verses.translation: This is a public proclamation by Allah and His Messenger to all people on the day of the Great Pilgrimage: ""Allah is free from all obligation to those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity; and so is His Messenger. If you repent it shall be for your own good; but if you turn away then know well that you will not be able to frustrate Allah. So give glad tidings of a painful chastisement to those who disbelieve.

verses.text: In exception to those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity are those with whom you have made treaties and who have not violated their treaties nor have backed up anyone against you. Fulfil your treaties with them till the end of their term. Surely Allah loves the pious.
verses.translation: In exception to those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity are those with whom you have made treaties and who have not violated their treaties nor have backed up anyone against you. Fulfil your treaties with them till the end of their term. Surely Allah loves the pious.

verses.text: But when the sacred months expire slay those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity wherever you find them; seize them and besiege them and lie in wait for them. But if they repent and establish the Prayer and pay Zakah leave them alone. Surely Allah is All-Forgiving Ever-Merciful.
verses.translation: But when the sacred months expire slay those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity wherever you find them; seize them and besiege them and lie in wait for them. But if they repent and establish the Prayer and pay Zakah leave them alone. Surely Allah is All-Forgiving Ever-Merciful.

verses.text: And if any of those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity seeks asylum grant him asylum that he may hear the Word of Allah and then escort him to safety for they are a people who do not know.
verses.translation: And if any of those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity seeks asylum grant him asylum that he may hear the Word of Allah and then escort him to safety for they are a people who do not know.

verses.text: How can there be a covenant with those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity be binding upon Allah and His Messenger excepting those with whom you made a covenant near the Sacred Mosque? Behave in a straight manner with them so long as they behave with you in a straight manner for Allah loves the Godfearing.
verses.translation: How can there be a covenant with those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity be binding upon Allah and His Messenger excepting those with whom you made a covenant near the Sacred Mosque? Behave in a straight manner with them so long as they behave with you in a straight manner for Allah loves the Godfearing.

verses.text: How can there be any covenant with the other polytheists for were they to prevail against you they will respect neither kinship nor agreement. They seek to please you with their tongues while their hearts are averse to you and most of them are wicked.
verses.translation: How can there be any covenant with the other polytheists for were they to prevail against you they will respect neither kinship nor agreement. They seek to please you with their tongues while their hearts are averse to you and most of them are wicked.

verses.text: They have sold the revelations of Allah for a paltry price and have firmly hindered people from His Path. Evil indeed is what they have done.
verses.translation: They have sold the revelations of Allah for a paltry price and have firmly hindered people from His Path. Evil indeed is what they have done.

verses.text: They neither have any respect for kinship nor for agreement in respect of the believers. Such are indeed transgressors.
verses.translation: They neither have any respect for kinship nor for agreement in respect of the believers. Such are indeed transgressors.

verses.text: But if they repent and establish Prayer and give Zakah they are your brothers in faith. Thus do We expound Our revelations to those who know.
verses.translation: But if they repent and establish Prayer and give Zakah they are your brothers in faith. Thus do We expound Our revelations to those who know.

verses.text: But if they break their pledges after making them and attack your faith make war on the leaders of unbelief that they may desist for they have no regard for their pledged words.
verses.translation: But if they break their pledges after making them and attack your faith make war on the leaders of unbelief that they may desist for they have no regard for their pledged words.

verses.text: Will you not fight against those who broke their pledges and did all they could to drive the Messenger away and initiated hostilities against you? Do you fear them? Surely Allah has greater right that you should fear Him if you are true believers.
verses.translation: Will you not fight against those who broke their pledges and did all they could to drive the Messenger away and initiated hostilities against you? Do you fear them? Surely Allah has greater right that you should fear Him if you are true believers.

verses.text: Make war on them. Allah will chastise them through you and will humiliate them. He will grant you victory over them and will soothe the bosoms of those who believe
verses.translation: Make war on them. Allah will chastise them through you and will humiliate them. He will grant you victory over them and will soothe the bosoms of those who believe

verses.text: and will remove rage from their hearts and will enable whomsoever He wills to repent. Allah is All-Knowing All-Wise.
verses.translation: and will remove rage from their hearts and will enable whomsoever He wills to repent. Allah is All-Knowing All-Wise.

verses.text: Do you imagine that you will be spared without being subjected to any test? Know well that Allah has not yet determined who strove hard (in His cause) and has not taken any others instead of His Messenger and the believers as his trusted allies? Allah is well aware of all that you do.
verses.translation: Do you imagine that you will be spared without being subjected to any test? Know well that Allah has not yet determined who strove hard (in His cause) and has not taken any others instead of His Messenger and the believers as his trusted allies? Allah is well aware of all that you do.

verses.text: It does not become those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity to visit and tend Allah''s mosques while they bear witness of unbelief against themselves. All their works have gone to waste. They shall abide in the Fire.
verses.translation: It does not become those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity to visit and tend Allah''s mosques while they bear witness of unbelief against themselves. All their works have gone to waste. They shall abide in the Fire.

verses.text: It only becomes those who believe in Allah and the Last Day and establish Prayer and pay Zakah and fear none but Allah to visit and tend the mosques of Allah. These are likely to be guided aright.
verses.translation: It only becomes those who believe in Allah and the Last Day and establish Prayer and pay Zakah and fear none but Allah to visit and tend the mosques of Allah. These are likely to be guided aright.

verses.text: Do you consider providing water to the Pilgrims and tending the Sacred Mosque equal in worth to believing in Allah and the Last Day and striving in the cause of Allah? The two are not equal with Allah. Allah does not direct the wrong-doing folk to the Right Way.
verses.translation: Do you consider providing water to the Pilgrims and tending the Sacred Mosque equal in worth to believing in Allah and the Last Day and striving in the cause of Allah? The two are not equal with Allah. Allah does not direct the wrong-doing folk to the Right Way.

verses.text: The higher rank with Allah is for those who believed and migrated and strove in His cause with their belongings and their persons. It is they who are triumphant.
verses.translation: The higher rank with Allah is for those who believed and migrated and strove in His cause with their belongings and their persons. It is they who are triumphant.

verses.text: Their Lord gives them glad tidings of mercy from Him and of His good pleasure. For them await Gardens of eternal bliss.
verses.translation: Their Lord gives them glad tidings of mercy from Him and of His good pleasure. For them await Gardens of eternal bliss.

verses.text: Therein they shall abide forever. Surely with Allah a mighty reward awaits them.
verses.translation: Therein they shall abide forever. Surely with Allah a mighty reward awaits them.

verses.text: Believers do not take your fathers and your brothers for your allies if they choose unbelief in preference to belief. Whosoever of you takes them as allies those are wrong-doers.
verses.translation: Believers do not take your fathers and your brothers for your allies if they choose unbelief in preference to belief. Whosoever of you takes them as allies those are wrong-doers.

verses.text: Tell them (O Prophet): ""If your fathers and your sons and your brothers and your wives and your tribe and the riches you have acquired and the commerce of which you fear a slackening and the dwellings that you love if they are dearer to you than Allah and His Messenger and striving in His cause then wait until Allah brings about His decree. Allah does not guide the evil-doing folk.""
verses.translation: Tell them (O Prophet): ""If your fathers and your sons and your brothers and your wives and your tribe and the riches you have acquired and the commerce of which you fear a slackening and the dwellings that you love if they are dearer to you than Allah and His Messenger and striving in His cause then wait until Allah brings about His decree. Allah does not guide the evil-doing folk.""

verses.text: Surely Allah has succoured you before on many a battlefield and (you have yourselves witnessed His succour to you) on the day of Hunayn when your numbers made you proud but they did you no good and the earth for all its vastness constrained you and you turned your backs in retreat.
verses.translation: Surely Allah has succoured you before on many a battlefield and (you have yourselves witnessed His succour to you) on the day of Hunayn when your numbers made you proud but they did you no good and the earth for all its vastness constrained you and you turned your backs in retreat.

verses.text: Then Allah caused His tranquillity to descend upon His Messenger and upon the believers and He sent down hosts whom you did not see and chastised those who disbelieved. Such is the recompense of those who deny the Truth.
verses.translation: Then Allah caused His tranquillity to descend upon His Messenger and upon the believers and He sent down hosts whom you did not see and chastised those who disbelieved. Such is the recompense of those who deny the Truth.

verses.text: Then (after so chastising the unbelievers) Allah enables whomsoever He wills to repent. Allah is All-Forgiving All-Merciful.
verses.translation: Then (after so chastising the unbelievers) Allah enables whomsoever He wills to repent. Allah is All-Forgiving All-Merciful.

verses.text: Believers those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity are unclean. So after the expiry of this year let them not even go near the Sacred Mosque. And should you fear poverty Allah will enrich you out of His bounty if He wills. Surely Allah is All-Knowing All-Wise.
verses.translation: Believers those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity are unclean. So after the expiry of this year let them not even go near the Sacred Mosque. And should you fear poverty Allah will enrich you out of His bounty if He wills. Surely Allah is All-Knowing All-Wise.

verses.text: Those who do not believe in Allah and the Last Day - even though they were given the scriptures and who do not hold as unlawful that which Allah and His Messenger have declared to be unlawful and who do not follow the true religion - fight against them until they pay tribute out of their hand and are utterly subdued.
verses.translation: Those who do not believe in Allah and the Last Day - even though they were given the scriptures and who do not hold as unlawful that which Allah and His Messenger have declared to be unlawful and who do not follow the true religion - fight against them until they pay tribute out of their hand and are utterly subdued.

verses.text: The Jews say: ""Ezra (''Uzayr) is Allah''s son  and the Christians say: ""The Messiah is the son of Allah."" These are merely verbal assertions in imitation of the sayings of those unbelievers who preceded them. May Allah ruin them. How do they turn away from the Truth?
verses.translation: The Jews say: ""Ezra (''Uzayr) is Allah''s son  and the Christians say: ""The Messiah is the son of Allah."" These are merely verbal assertions in imitation of the sayings of those unbelievers who preceded them. May Allah ruin them. How do they turn away from the Truth?

verses.text: They take their rabbis and their monks for their lords apart from Allah and also the Messiah son of Mary whereas they were commanded to worship none but the One True God. There is no god but He. Exalted be He above those whom they associate with Him in His Divinity.
verses.translation: They take their rabbis and their monks for their lords apart from Allah and also the Messiah son of Mary whereas they were commanded to worship none but the One True God. There is no god but He. Exalted be He above those whom they associate with Him in His Divinity.

verses.text: They seek to extinguish the light of Allah by blowing through their mouths; but Allah refuses everything except that He will perfect His light howsoever the unbelievers might abhor it.
verses.translation: They seek to extinguish the light of Allah by blowing through their mouths; but Allah refuses everything except that He will perfect His light howsoever the unbelievers might abhor it.

verses.text: He it is Who has sent His Messenger with the guidance and the True Religion that He may make it prevail over all religions howsoever those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity might detest it.
verses.translation: He it is Who has sent His Messenger with the guidance and the True Religion that He may make it prevail over all religions howsoever those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity might detest it.

verses.text: Believers! Many of the rabbis and monks wrongfully devour mankind''s possessions and hinder people from the Way of Allah. And there are those who amass gold and silver and do not spend it in the Way of Allah. Announce to them the tidings of a painful chastisement
verses.translation: Believers! Many of the rabbis and monks wrongfully devour mankind''s possessions and hinder people from the Way of Allah. And there are those who amass gold and silver and do not spend it in the Way of Allah. Announce to them the tidings of a painful chastisement

verses.text: on a Day when they shall be heated up in the Fire of Hell and their foreheads and their sides and their backs shall be branded with it (and they shall be told): ""This is the treasure which you hoarded for yourselves. Taste then the punishment for what you have hoarded.""
verses.translation: on a Day when they shall be heated up in the Fire of Hell and their foreheads and their sides and their backs shall be branded with it (and they shall be told): ""This is the treasure which you hoarded for yourselves. Taste then the punishment for what you have hoarded.""

verses.text: Surely the reckoning of months in the sight of Allah is twelve months laid down in Allah''s decree on the day when He created the heavens and the earth; and out of these months four are sacred. That is the true ordainment. Do not therefore wrong yourselves with respect to these months. And fight all together against those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity in the manner that they fight against you all together and know well that Allah is with the God-fearing.
verses.translation: Surely the reckoning of months in the sight of Allah is twelve months laid down in Allah''s decree on the day when He created the heavens and the earth; and out of these months four are sacred. That is the true ordainment. Do not therefore wrong yourselves with respect to these months. And fight all together against those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity in the manner that they fight against you all together and know well that Allah is with the God-fearing.

verses.text: The intercalation (of sacred months) is an act of gross infidelity which causes the unbelievers to be led further astray. They declare a month to be lawful in one year and forbidden in another year in order that they may conform to the number of months that Allah has declared as sacred and at the same time make lawful what Allah has forbidden. Their foul acts seem fair to them. Allah does not direct those who deny the Truth to the Right Way.
verses.translation: The intercalation (of sacred months) is an act of gross infidelity which causes the unbelievers to be led further astray. They declare a month to be lawful in one year and forbidden in another year in order that they may conform to the number of months that Allah has declared as sacred and at the same time make lawful what Allah has forbidden. Their foul acts seem fair to them. Allah does not direct those who deny the Truth to the Right Way.

verses.text: Believers! What is amiss with you that when it is said to you: ""March forth in the cause of Allah  you cling heavily to the earth? Do you prefer the worldly life to the Hereafter? Know well that all the enjoyment of this world in comparison with the Hereafter is trivial.
verses.translation: Believers! What is amiss with you that when it is said to you: ""March forth in the cause of Allah  you cling heavily to the earth? Do you prefer the worldly life to the Hereafter? Know well that all the enjoyment of this world in comparison with the Hereafter is trivial.

verses.text: If you do not march forth Allah will chastise you grievously and will replace you by another people while you will in no way be able to harm Him. Allah has power over everything.
verses.translation: If you do not march forth Allah will chastise you grievously and will replace you by another people while you will in no way be able to harm Him. Allah has power over everything.
