They are spiteful against Muslims for no other reason than that Allah and His Messenger have enriched them through His bounty! So if they repent it will be to their own good. But if they turn away Allah will sternly punish them in this world and in the Hereafter. None in the world will be able to protect or help them.
ayahs.translation: They swear by Allah that they said nothing blasphemous whereas they indeed blasphemed and fell into unbelief after believing and also had evil designs which they could not carry into effect. They are spiteful against Muslims for no other reason than that Allah and His Messenger have enriched them through His bounty! So if they repent it will be to their own good. But if they turn away Allah will sternly punish them in this world and in the Hereafter. None in the world will be able to protect or help them.

ayahs.text: Some of them made a covenant with Allah: ""If Allah gives us out of His bounty we will give alms and act righteously.""
ayahs.translation: Some of them made a covenant with Allah: ""If Allah gives us out of His bounty we will give alms and act righteously.""

ayahs.text: Then when He gave them out of His bounty they grew niggardly and turned their backs (upon their covenant).
ayahs.translation: Then when He gave them out of His bounty they grew niggardly and turned their backs (upon their covenant).

ayahs.text: So He caused hypocrisy to take root in their hearts and to remain therein until the Day they meet Him because they broke their promise with Allah and because they lied.
ayahs.translation: So He caused hypocrisy to take root in their hearts and to remain therein until the Day they meet Him because they broke their promise with Allah and because they lied.

ayahs.text: Are they not aware that Allah knows what they conceal and what they secretly discuss and that Allah has full knowledge even of all that is beyond the reach of perception.
ayahs.translation: Are they not aware that Allah knows what they conceal and what they secretly discuss and that Allah has full knowledge even of all that is beyond the reach of perception.

ayahs.text: He also knows (the rich that are niggardly) who taunt the believers that voluntarily give alms they scoff at those who have nothing to give except what they earn through their hard toil. Allah scoffs at them in return. A grievous chastisement awaits them.
ayahs.translation: He also knows (the rich that are niggardly) who taunt the believers that voluntarily give alms they scoff at those who have nothing to give except what they earn through their hard toil. Allah scoffs at them in return. A grievous chastisement awaits them.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) it is all the same whether or not you ask for their forgiveness. Even if you were to ask forgiveness for them seventy times Allah shall not forgive them. That is because they disbelieved in Allah and His Messenger; and Allah does not bestow His Guidance on such evil-doing folk.
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) it is all the same whether or not you ask for their forgiveness. Even if you were to ask forgiveness for them seventy times Allah shall not forgive them. That is because they disbelieved in Allah and His Messenger; and Allah does not bestow His Guidance on such evil-doing folk.

ayahs.text: Those who were allowed to stay behind rejoiced at remaining behind and not accompanying the Messenger of Allah. They were averse to striving in the Way of Allah with their belongings and their lives and told others: ""Do not go forth in this fierce heat."" Tell them: ""The Hell is far fiercer in heat."" Would that they understand!
ayahs.translation: Those who were allowed to stay behind rejoiced at remaining behind and not accompanying the Messenger of Allah. They were averse to striving in the Way of Allah with their belongings and their lives and told others: ""Do not go forth in this fierce heat."" Tell them: ""The Hell is far fiercer in heat."" Would that they understand!

ayahs.text: Let them then laugh little and weep much at the contemplation of the punishment for the evil they have committed.
ayahs.translation: Let them then laugh little and weep much at the contemplation of the punishment for the evil they have committed.

ayahs.text: Then if Allah brings you face to face with a party of them and they ask your leave to go forth (to fight in the Way of Allah) tell them: ""You shall not go forth with me and shall never fight against any enemy along with me. You were well-pleased to remain at home the first time so now continue to remain with those who have stayed behind.""
ayahs.translation: Then if Allah brings you face to face with a party of them and they ask your leave to go forth (to fight in the Way of Allah) tell them: ""You shall not go forth with me and shall never fight against any enemy along with me. You were well-pleased to remain at home the first time so now continue to remain with those who have stayed behind.""

ayahs.text: Do not ever pray over any of them who dies nor stand over his grave. They disbelieved in Allah and His Messenger and died in iniquity.
ayahs.translation: Do not ever pray over any of them who dies nor stand over his grave. They disbelieved in Allah and His Messenger and died in iniquity.

ayahs.text: Let not their riches or their children excite your admiration. Through these Allah seeks to chastise them in this world and that their lives will depart them while they are unbelievers.
ayahs.translation: Let not their riches or their children excite your admiration. Through these Allah seeks to chastise them in this world and that their lives will depart them while they are unbelievers.

ayahs.text: And whenever any surah is revealed enjoining: ""Believe in Allah and strive (in His Way) along with His Messenger  the affluent among them ask you to excuse them saying: ""Leave us with those who will sit back at home.""
ayahs.translation: And whenever any surah is revealed enjoining: ""Believe in Allah and strive (in His Way) along with His Messenger  the affluent among them ask you to excuse them saying: ""Leave us with those who will sit back at home.""

ayahs.text: They were content to stay behind with the womenfolk. Their hearts were sealed leaving them bereft of understanding.
ayahs.translation: They were content to stay behind with the womenfolk. Their hearts were sealed leaving them bereft of understanding.

ayahs.text: But the Messenger and those who shared his faith strove with their belongings and their lives. It is they who shall have all kinds of good. It is they who shall prosper.
ayahs.translation: But the Messenger and those who shared his faith strove with their belongings and their lives. It is they who shall have all kinds of good. It is they who shall prosper.

ayahs.text: Allah has prepared for them Gardens beneath which rivers flow. There shall they abide. That is the supreme triumph.
ayahs.translation: Allah has prepared for them Gardens beneath which rivers flow. There shall they abide. That is the supreme triumph.

ayahs.text: Many of the bedouin Arabs came with excuses seeking leave to stay behind. Thus those who were false to Allah and His Messenger in their covenant remained behind. A painful chastisement shall befall those of them that disbelieved.
ayahs.translation: Many of the bedouin Arabs came with excuses seeking leave to stay behind. Thus those who were false to Allah and His Messenger in their covenant remained behind. A painful chastisement shall befall those of them that disbelieved.

ayahs.text: There is no blame on the weak nor on the sick nor on those who have nothing to enable them to join (the struggle in the Way of Allah) if they stay behind provided that they are sincere to Allah and to His Messenger. There is no cause for reproach against those who do good. Allah is All-Forgiving Ever Merciful.
ayahs.translation: There is no blame on the weak nor on the sick nor on those who have nothing to enable them to join (the struggle in the Way of Allah) if they stay behind provided that they are sincere to Allah and to His Messenger. There is no cause for reproach against those who do good. Allah is All-Forgiving Ever Merciful.

ayahs.text: Nor can there be any cause for reproach against those who when they came to you asking for mounts to go to the battlefront and when you said that you had no mounts for them they went back their eyes overflowing with tears grieving that they had no resources to enable them to take part in fighting.
ayahs.translation: Nor can there be any cause for reproach against those who when they came to you asking for mounts to go to the battlefront and when you said that you had no mounts for them they went back their eyes overflowing with tears grieving that they had no resources to enable them to take part in fighting.

ayahs.text: But there are grounds for reproach against those who seek leave to stay behind even though they are affluent. They are the ones who were content to be with the womenfolk who stay behind. Allah has set a seal on their hearts leaving them bereft of understanding.
ayahs.translation: But there are grounds for reproach against those who seek leave to stay behind even though they are affluent. They are the ones who were content to be with the womenfolk who stay behind. Allah has set a seal on their hearts leaving them bereft of understanding.

ayahs.text: They will put up excuses before you when you return to them. Tell them: ""Make no excuses. We will not believe you. Allah has already informed us of the truth about you. Allah will observe your conduct and so will His Messenger; then you will be brought back to Him Who knows alike what lies beyond perception and what lies in the range of perception and will let you know what you have done.""
ayahs.translation: They will put up excuses before you when you return to them. Tell them: ""Make no excuses. We will not believe you. Allah has already informed us of the truth about you. Allah will observe your conduct and so will His Messenger; then you will be brought back to Him Who knows alike what lies beyond perception and what lies in the range of perception and will let you know what you have done.""

ayahs.text: When you return to them they will surely swear to you in the name of Allah that you may leave them alone. So do leave them alone; they are unclean. Hell shall be their home a recompense for what they did.
ayahs.translation: When you return to them they will surely swear to you in the name of Allah that you may leave them alone. So do leave them alone; they are unclean. Hell shall be their home a recompense for what they did.

ayahs.text: They will swear to you in order to please you. But even if you become pleased with them Allah will not be pleased with such an evil-doing folk.
ayahs.translation: They will swear to you in order to please you. But even if you become pleased with them Allah will not be pleased with such an evil-doing folk.

ayahs.text: The bedouin Arabs surpass all in unbelief and hypocrisy and are most likely to be unaware of the limits prescribed by Allah in what He has revealed to His Messenger. Allah is All-Knowing All-Wise.
ayahs.translation: The bedouin Arabs surpass all in unbelief and hypocrisy and are most likely to be unaware of the limits prescribed by Allah in what He has revealed to His Messenger. Allah is All-Knowing All-Wise.

ayahs.text: And among the bedouin Arabs there are such as regard whatever they spend (in the Way of Allah) as a fineand wait for some misfortune to befall you. May ill fortune befall them! Allah is All-Hearing All-Knowing.
ayahs.translation: And among the bedouin Arabs there are such as regard whatever they spend (in the Way of Allah) as a fineand wait for some misfortune to befall you. May ill fortune befall them! Allah is All-Hearing All-Knowing.

ayahs.text: And among the bedouin Arabs are those who believe in Allah and the Last Day and regard their spending (in the Way of Allah) as a means of drawing near to Allah and of deserving the prayers of the Messenger. Indeed this shall be a means of drawing near to Allah. Allah will surely admit them to His mercy. Allah is All-Forgiving Ever Merciful.
ayahs.translation: And among the bedouin Arabs are those who believe in Allah and the Last Day and regard their spending (in the Way of Allah) as a means of drawing near to Allah and of deserving the prayers of the Messenger. Indeed this shall be a means of drawing near to Allah. Allah will surely admit them to His mercy. Allah is All-Forgiving Ever Merciful.

ayahs.text: And of those who led the way - the first of the Emigrants (Muhajirun) and the Helpers (Ansar) and those who followed them in the best possible manner - Allah is well-pleased with them and they are well-pleased with Allah. He has prepared for them Gardens beneath which rivers flow; therein they will abide forever. That is the supreme triumph.
ayahs.translation: And of those who led the way - the first of the Emigrants (Muhajirun) and the Helpers (Ansar) and those who followed them in the best possible manner - Allah is well-pleased with them and they are well-pleased with Allah. He has prepared for them Gardens beneath which rivers flow; therein they will abide forever. That is the supreme triumph.

ayahs.text: As for the bedouin Arabs around you some are hypocrites; and so are some of the people of Madinah who have become inured to hypocrisy. You do not know them but We know them. We will inflict double chastisement on them and then they shall be returned to an awesome suffering.
ayahs.translation: As for the bedouin Arabs around you some are hypocrites; and so are some of the people of Madinah who have become inured to hypocrisy. You do not know them but We know them. We will inflict double chastisement on them and then they shall be returned to an awesome suffering.

ayahs.text: There are others who have confessed their faults. They intermixed their good deeds with evil. It is likely that Allah will turn to them in mercy for Allah is All- Forgiving Ever Merciful.
ayahs.translation: There are others who have confessed their faults. They intermixed their good deeds with evil. It is likely that Allah will turn to them in mercy for Allah is All- Forgiving Ever Merciful.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet)! ""Take alms out of their riches and thereby cleanse them and bring about their growth (in righteousness) and pray for them. Indeed your prayer is a source of tranquility for them."" Allah is All-Hearing All-Knowing.
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet)! ""Take alms out of their riches and thereby cleanse them and bring about their growth (in righteousness) and pray for them. Indeed your prayer is a source of tranquility for them."" Allah is All-Hearing All-Knowing.

ayahs.text: Are they not aware that it is Allah Who accepts the repentance of His servants and accepts their alms and that it is Allah Who is Oft-Relenting Ever Merciful?
ayahs.translation: Are they not aware that it is Allah Who accepts the repentance of His servants and accepts their alms and that it is Allah Who is Oft-Relenting Ever Merciful?

ayahs.text: And tell them (O Prophet): ""Keep working: Allah will behold your works and so will His Messenger and the believers; and you shall be brought back to Him Who knows that which is beyond the reach of perception and that which is within the reach of perception. He will then declare to you all that you have been doing.""
ayahs.translation: And tell them (O Prophet): ""Keep working: Allah will behold your works and so will His Messenger and the believers; and you shall be brought back to Him Who knows that which is beyond the reach of perception and that which is within the reach of perception. He will then declare to you all that you have been doing.""

ayahs.text: There are others in whose regard Allah''s decree is awaited: whether He will chastise them or relent towards them. Allah is All-Knowing All-Wise.
ayahs.translation: There are others in whose regard Allah''s decree is awaited: whether He will chastise them or relent towards them. Allah is All-Knowing All-Wise.

ayahs.text: Then there are others who have set up a mosque to hurt the True Faith to promote unbelief and cause division among believers and as an ambush for one who had earlier made war on Allah and His Messenger. They will surely swear: ""We intended nothing but good  whereas Allah bears witness that they are liars.
ayahs.translation: Then there are others who have set up a mosque to hurt the True Faith to promote unbelief and cause division among believers and as an ambush for one who had earlier made war on Allah and His Messenger. They will surely swear: ""We intended nothing but good  whereas Allah bears witness that they are liars.

ayahs.text: Never stand therein. Surely a mosque founded from the first day on piety is more worthy that you should stand in it for Prayer. In it are people who love to purify themselves and Allah loves those that purify themselves.
ayahs.translation: Never stand therein. Surely a mosque founded from the first day on piety is more worthy that you should stand in it for Prayer. In it are people who love to purify themselves and Allah loves those that purify themselves.

ayahs.text: Is he then who has erected his structure on the fear of Allah and His good pleasure better or he who erects his structure on the brink of a crumbling bank so that it crumbles down with him into the Hell-Fire? Allah does not bestow His Guidance on the wrong-doing folk.
ayahs.translation: Is he then who has erected his structure on the fear of Allah and His good pleasure better or he who erects his structure on the brink of a crumbling bank so that it crumbles down with him into the Hell-Fire? Allah does not bestow His Guidance on the wrong-doing folk.

ayahs.text: And the structure which they have erected will ever inspire their hearts with doubts unless it be that their very hearts are cut into pieces. Allah is All-Knowing All-Wise.
ayahs.translation: And the structure which they have erected will ever inspire their hearts with doubts unless it be that their very hearts are cut into pieces. Allah is All-Knowing All-Wise.

ayahs.text: Surely Allah has purchased of the believers their lives and their belongings and in return has promised that they shall have Paradise. They fight in the Way of Allah and slay and are slain. Such is the promise He has made incumbent upon Himself in the Torah and the Gospel and the Qur''an. Who is more faithful to his promise than Allah? Rejoice then in the bargain you have made with Him. That indeed is the mighty triumph.
ayahs.translation: Surely Allah has purchased of the believers their lives and their belongings and in return has promised that they shall have Paradise. They fight in the Way of Allah and slay and are slain. Such is the promise He has made incumbent upon Himself in the Torah and the Gospel and the Qur''an. Who is more faithful to his promise than Allah? Rejoice then in the bargain you have made with Him. That indeed is the mighty triumph.

ayahs.text: Those who constantly turn to Allah in repentance who constantly worship Him who celebrate His praise who go about the world to serve His cause who bow down to Him who prostrate themselves before Him who enjoin what is good and forbid what is evil and who keep the limits set by Allah. Announce glad tidings to such believers.
ayahs.translation: Those who constantly turn to Allah in repentance who constantly worship Him who celebrate His praise who go about the world to serve His cause who bow down to Him who prostrate themselves before Him who enjoin what is good and forbid what is evil and who keep the limits set by Allah. Announce glad tidings to such believers.

ayahs.text: After it has become clear that they are condemned to the Flaming Fire it is not for the Prophet and those who believe to ask for the forgiveness of those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity even if they be near of kin.
ayahs.translation: After it has become clear that they are condemned to the Flaming Fire it is not for the Prophet and those who believe to ask for the forgiveness of those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity even if they be near of kin.

ayahs.text: And Abraham''s prayer for the forgiveness of his father was only because of a promise which he had made to him. Then when it became clear to him that he was an enemy of Allah he dissociated himself from him. Surely Abraham was most tender-hearted God-fearing forbearing.
ayahs.translation: And Abraham''s prayer for the forgiveness of his father was only because of a promise which he had made to him. Then when it became clear to him that he was an enemy of Allah he dissociated himself from him. Surely Abraham was most tender-hearted God-fearing forbearing.

ayahs.text: It is not Allah''s way to cause people to stray in error after He has guided them until He has made clear to them what they should guard against. Surely Allah knows everything.
ayahs.translation: It is not Allah''s way to cause people to stray in error after He has guided them until He has made clear to them what they should guard against. Surely Allah knows everything.

ayahs.text: Indeed Allah''s is the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He it is Who confers life and causes death. You have no protector or helper apart from Allah.
ayahs.translation: Indeed Allah''s is the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He it is Who confers life and causes death. You have no protector or helper apart from Allah.

ayahs.text: Surely Allah has relented towards the Prophet and towards the Muhajirun (Emigrants) and the Ansar (Helpers) who stood by him in the hour of hardship although the hearts of a party of them had well-nigh swerved. (But when they gave up swerving from the Right Course and followed the Prophet) Allah relented towards them. Surely to them He is the Most Tender the Most Merciful.
ayahs.translation: Surely Allah has relented towards the Prophet and towards the Muhajirun (Emigrants) and the Ansar (Helpers) who stood by him in the hour of hardship although the hearts of a party of them had well-nigh swerved. (But when they gave up swerving from the Right Course and followed the Prophet) Allah relented towards them. Surely to them He is the Most Tender the Most Merciful.

ayahs.text: And He also relented towards the three whose cases had been deferred. When the earth for all its spaciousness became constrained to them and their own beings became a burden to them and they realized that there was no refuge for them from Allah except in Him; He relented towards them that they may turn back to Him. Surely it is Allah Who is Much Forgiving Ever Merciful.
ayahs.translation: And He also relented towards the three whose cases had been deferred. When the earth for all its spaciousness became constrained to them and their own beings became a burden to them and they realized that there was no refuge for them from Allah except in Him; He relented towards them that they may turn back to Him. Surely it is Allah Who is Much Forgiving Ever Merciful.

ayahs.text: Believers! Have fear of Allah and stand with those that are truthful.
ayahs.translation: Believers! Have fear of Allah and stand with those that are truthful.

ayahs.text: It did not behove the people of Madinah and the bedouin Arabs around them that they should refrain from accompanying the Messenger of Allah and stay behind and prefer their own security to his. For whenever they suffer from thirst or weariness or hunger in the Way of Allah and whenever they tread a place which enrages the unbelievers (whenever anything of this comes to pass) a good deed is recorded in their favour. Allah does not cause the work of the doers of good to go to waste.
ayahs.translation: It did not behove the people of Madinah and the bedouin Arabs around them that they should refrain from accompanying the Messenger of Allah and stay behind and prefer their own security to his. For whenever they suffer from thirst or weariness or hunger in the Way of Allah and whenever they tread a place which enrages the unbelievers (whenever anything of this comes to pass) a good deed is recorded in their favour. Allah does not cause the work of the doers of good to go to waste.

ayahs.text: Likewise each amount they spend be it small or large and each journey they undertake shall be recorded in their favour so that Allah may bestow upon them reward for their good deeds.
ayahs.translation: Likewise each amount they spend be it small or large and each journey they undertake shall be recorded in their favour so that Allah may bestow upon them reward for their good deeds.

ayahs.text: It was not necessary for the believers to go forth all together (to receive religious instruction) but why did not a party of them go forth that they may grow in religious understanding and that they may warn their people when they return to them so that they may avoid (erroneous attitudes)?
ayahs.translation: It was not necessary for the believers to go forth all together (to receive religious instruction) but why did not a party of them go forth that they may grow in religious understanding and that they may warn their people when they return to them so that they may avoid (erroneous attitudes)?

ayahs.text: Believers! Fight against the unbelievers who live around you; and let them find in you sternness. Know that Allah is with the God-fearing.
ayahs.translation: Believers! Fight against the unbelievers who live around you; and let them find in you sternness. Know that Allah is with the God-fearing.

ayahs.text: And whenever a new surah is revealed some of the hypocrites ask the believers (in jest): ""Whose faith has increased because of this?"" As for those who believe it will certainly increase their faith and they are joyful over that.
ayahs.translation: And whenever a new surah is revealed some of the hypocrites ask the believers (in jest): ""Whose faith has increased because of this?"" As for those who believe it will certainly increase their faith and they are joyful over that.

ayahs.text: But those whose hearts are affected with the disease (of hypocrisy) every new surah added a fresh abomination to their abomination. They remained unbelievers till their death.
ayahs.translation: But those whose hearts are affected with the disease (of hypocrisy) every new surah added a fresh abomination to their abomination. They remained unbelievers till their death.

ayahs.text: Do they not see that they are tried every year once or twice? Yet they neither repent nor take heed.
ayahs.translation: Do they not see that they are tried every year once or twice? Yet they neither repent nor take heed.

ayahs.text: And whenever a surah is revealed they glance at each other as though saying: ""Is anyone watching?"" Then they slip away. Allah has turned away their hearts for they are a people who are bereft of understanding.
ayahs.translation: And whenever a surah is revealed they glance at each other as though saying: ""Is anyone watching?"" Then they slip away. Allah has turned away their hearts for they are a people who are bereft of understanding.

ayahs.text: There has come to you a Messenger of Allah from among yourselves who is distressed by the losses you sustain who is ardently desirous of your welfare and is tender and merciful to those that believe.
ayahs.translation: There has come to you a Messenger of Allah from among yourselves who is distressed by the losses you sustain who is ardently desirous of your welfare and is tender and merciful to those that believe.

ayahs.text: Yet if they should turn away then tell them: ""Allah is sufficient for me; there is no god but He. In Him I have put my trust. He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.""
ayahs.translation: Yet if they should turn away then tell them: ""Allah is sufficient for me; there is no god but He. In Him I have put my trust. He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.""

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Alif. Lam. Ra. These are the verses of the Book overflowing with wisdom.
verses.translation: Alif. Lam. Ra. These are the verses of the Book overflowing with wisdom.

verses.text: Does it seem strange to people that We should have revealed to a man from among themselves directing him to warn the people (who areengrossed in heedlessness) and to give good news to the believers that they shall enjoy true honour and an exalted status with their Lord? (This seemed so strange that) the deniers of the Truth said: ''This man is indeed a plain sorcerer?''
verses.translation: Does it seem strange to people that We should have revealed to a man from among themselves directing him to warn the people (who areengrossed in heedlessness) and to give good news to the believers that they shall enjoy true honour and an exalted status with their Lord? (This seemed so strange that) the deniers of the Truth said: ''This man is indeed a plain sorcerer?''

verses.text: Surely your Lord is Allah Who created the heavens and the earth in six days then established Himself on the Throne (of His Dominion) governing all affairs of the universe. None may intercede with Him except after obtaining His leave. Such is Allah your Lord; do therefore serve Him.Will you not take heed?
verses.translation: Surely your Lord is Allah Who created the heavens and the earth in six days then established Himself on the Throne (of His Dominion) governing all affairs of the universe. None may intercede with Him except after obtaining His leave. Such is Allah your Lord; do therefore serve Him.Will you not take heed?

verses.text: To Him is your return. This is Allah''s promise that will certainly come true. Surely it is He Who brings about the creation of all and He will repeat it so that He may justly reward those who believe and do righteous deeds and those who disbelieve may have a draught of boiling water and suffer a painful chastisement for their denying the Truth.
verses.translation: To Him is your return. This is Allah''s promise that will certainly come true. Surely it is He Who brings about the creation of all and He will repeat it so that He may justly reward those who believe and do righteous deeds and those who disbelieve may have a draught of boiling water and suffer a painful chastisement for their denying the Truth.

verses.text: He it is Who gave the sun radiance and the moon light and determined the stages (for the waxing and waning of the moon) that you may learn the calculation of years and the reckoning of time. Allah has created all this with a rightful purpose (rather than out of play). He expounds His signs for the people who know.
verses.translation: He it is Who gave the sun radiance and the moon light and determined the stages (for the waxing and waning of the moon) that you may learn the calculation of years and the reckoning of time. Allah has created all this with a rightful purpose (rather than out of play). He expounds His signs for the people who know.

verses.text: Surely in the alternation of the night and the day and in all that Allah has created in the heavens and the earth there are signs for the people who seek to avoid (error of outlook and conduct).
verses.translation: Surely in the alternation of the night and the day and in all that Allah has created in the heavens and the earth there are signs for the people who seek to avoid (error of outlook and conduct).

verses.text: Surely those who do not expect to meet Us who are gratified with the life of the world and are well-pleased with it and are heedless of Our signs
verses.translation: Surely those who do not expect to meet Us who are gratified with the life of the world and are well-pleased with it and are heedless of Our signs

verses.text: their abode shall be the Fire in return for their misdeeds
verses.translation: their abode shall be the Fire in return for their misdeeds

verses.text: Surely those who believe (in the Truths revealed in the Book) and do righteous deeds their Lord will guide them aright because of their faith. Rivers shall flow beneath them in the Gardens of Bliss.
verses.translation: Surely those who believe (in the Truths revealed in the Book) and do righteous deeds their Lord will guide them aright because of their faith. Rivers shall flow beneath them in the Gardens of Bliss.

verses.text: Their cry in it will be: ''Glory be to You Our Lord!'' and their greeting: ''Peace!''; and their cry will always end with: ''All praise be to Allah the Lord of the universe.
verses.translation: Their cry in it will be: ''Glory be to You Our Lord!'' and their greeting: ''Peace!''; and their cry will always end with: ''All praise be to Allah the Lord of the universe.

verses.text: Were Allah to hasten to bring upon people (the consequence of) evil in the way people hasten in seeking the wealth of this world their term would have long since expired. (But that is not Our way) So We leave alone those who do not expect to meet Us that they may blindly stumble in their transgression.
verses.translation: Were Allah to hasten to bring upon people (the consequence of) evil in the way people hasten in seeking the wealth of this world their term would have long since expired. (But that is not Our way) So We leave alone those who do not expect to meet Us that they may blindly stumble in their transgression.

verses.text: And (such is man that) when an affliction befalls him he cries out to Us reclining and sitting and standing. But no sooner than We have removed his affliction he passes on as though he had never cried out to Us to remove his affliction. Thus it is that the misdeeds of the transgressors are made fair-seeming to them.
verses.translation: And (such is man that) when an affliction befalls him he cries out to Us reclining and sitting and standing. But no sooner than We have removed his affliction he passes on as though he had never cried out to Us to remove his affliction. Thus it is that the misdeeds of the transgressors are made fair-seeming to them.

verses.text: Surely We destroyed the nations before you  (which had risen to heights of glory in their times) when they indulged in wrong-doing and refused to believe even when their Messengers brought Clear Signs to them. Thus do We recompense the people who are guilty.
verses.translation: Surely We destroyed the nations before you  (which had risen to heights of glory in their times) when they indulged in wrong-doing and refused to believe even when their Messengers brought Clear Signs to them. Thus do We recompense the people who are guilty.

verses.text: Now We have appointed you as their successors in the earth to see how you act.
verses.translation: Now We have appointed you as their successors in the earth to see how you act.

verses.text: And whenever Our clear revelations are recited to them those who do not expect to meet Us say: ''Bring us a Qur''an other than this one or at least make changes in it''. Tell them (O Muhammad): ''It is not for me to change it of my accord. I only follow what is revealed to me. Were I to disobey my Lord I fear the chastisement of an Awesome Day''.
verses.translation: And whenever Our clear revelations are recited to them those who do not expect to meet Us say: ''Bring us a Qur''an other than this one or at least make changes in it''. Tell them (O Muhammad): ''It is not for me to change it of my accord. I only follow what is revealed to me. Were I to disobey my Lord I fear the chastisement of an Awesome Day''.

verses.text: Tell them: ''Had Allah so willed I would not have recited the Qur''an to you nor would Allah have informed you of it. I have spent a lifetime among you before this. Do you then not use your reason?
verses.translation: Tell them: ''Had Allah so willed I would not have recited the Qur''an to you nor would Allah have informed you of it. I have spent a lifetime among you before this. Do you then not use your reason?

verses.text: Who then is a greater wrong-doer than he who forges a lie against Allah or rejects His signs as false? Surely the guilty shall not prosper.
verses.translation: Who then is a greater wrong-doer than he who forges a lie against Allah or rejects His signs as false? Surely the guilty shall not prosper.

verses.text: They worship beside Allah those who can neither harm nor profit them saying; ''These are our intercessors with Allah.'' Tell them (O Muhammad): ''Do you inform Allah of something regarding whose existence in the heavens or on the earth He has no knowledge? Holy is He and exalted far above what they associate with Him in His divinity.''
verses.translation: They worship beside Allah those who can neither harm nor profit them saying; ''These are our intercessors with Allah.'' Tell them (O Muhammad): ''Do you inform Allah of something regarding whose existence in the heavens or on the earth He has no knowledge? Holy is He and exalted far above what they associate with Him in His divinity.''

verses.text: Once all human beings were but a single community; then they disagreed (and formulated different beliefs and rites).Had it not been that your Lord had already so ordained a decisive judgement would have been made regarding their disagreements.
verses.translation: Once all human beings were but a single community; then they disagreed (and formulated different beliefs and rites).Had it not been that your Lord had already so ordained a decisive judgement would have been made regarding their disagreements.

verses.text: They say: ''Why was a sign not sent down upon the prophet from His Lord? Tell (such people): ''The realm of the Unseen belongs to Allah. Wait then; I shall wait along with you.
verses.translation: They say: ''Why was a sign not sent down upon the prophet from His Lord? Tell (such people): ''The realm of the Unseen belongs to Allah. Wait then; I shall wait along with you.

verses.text: No sooner than We bestow mercy on a people after hardship has hit them than they begin to scheme against Our signs. Tell them: ''Allah is swifter in scheming. Our angels are recording all your intriguing.
verses.translation: No sooner than We bestow mercy on a people after hardship has hit them than they begin to scheme against Our signs. Tell them: ''Allah is swifter in scheming. Our angels are recording all your intriguing.

verses.text: He it is Who enables you to journey through the land and the sea. And so it happens that when you have boarded the ships and they set sail with a favourable wind and the passengers rejoice at the pleasant voyage then suddenly a fierce gale appears and wave upon wave surges upon them from every side and people believe that they are surrounded from all directions and all of them cry out to Allah in full sincerity of faith: ''If You deliver us from this we shall surely be thankful.
verses.translation: He it is Who enables you to journey through the land and the sea. And so it happens that when you have boarded the ships and they set sail with a favourable wind and the passengers rejoice at the pleasant voyage then suddenly a fierce gale appears and wave upon wave surges upon them from every side and people believe that they are surrounded from all directions and all of them cry out to Allah in full sincerity of faith: ''If You deliver us from this we shall surely be thankful.

verses.text: But no sooner than He delivers them than they go about committing excesses on the earth acting unjustly. O mankind! The excesses you commit will be of harm only to yourselves (Enjoy if you will) the fleeting pleasure of this world; in the end you shall all return to Us and then We shall tell you what you have been doing.
verses.translation: But no sooner than He delivers them than they go about committing excesses on the earth acting unjustly. O mankind! The excesses you commit will be of harm only to yourselves (Enjoy if you will) the fleeting pleasure of this world; in the end you shall all return to Us and then We shall tell you what you have been doing.

verses.text: The example of the life of this world (which has enamoured you into becoming heedless to Our Signs) is that of water that We sent down from the sky which caused the vegetation of the earth sustaining human beings and cattle to grow luxuriantly. But when the earth took on its golden raiment and became well adorned and the owners believed that they had full control over their lands Our Command came upon them by night or by day and We converted it into a stubble as though it had not blossomed yesterday. Thus do We expound the Signs for a people who reflect.
verses.translation: The example of the life of this world (which has enamoured you into becoming heedless to Our Signs) is that of water that We sent down from the sky which caused the vegetation of the earth sustaining human beings and cattle to grow luxuriantly. But when the earth took on its golden raiment and became well adorned and the owners believed that they had full control over their lands Our Command came upon them by night or by day and We converted it into a stubble as though it had not blossomed yesterday. Thus do We expound the Signs for a people who reflect.

verses.text: (You are being lured by this ephemeral world) although Allah calls you to the abode of peace and guides whomsoever He wills to a straightway.
verses.translation: (You are being lured by this ephemeral world) although Allah calls you to the abode of peace and guides whomsoever He wills to a straightway.

verses.text: For those who do good there is good reward and more besides; neither gloom nor humiliation shall cover their faces. They are the people of the Garden and in it they shall abide.
verses.translation: For those who do good there is good reward and more besides; neither gloom nor humiliation shall cover their faces. They are the people of the Garden and in it they shall abide.

verses.text: Those who do evil deeds the recompense of an evil deed is its like and humiliation shall spread over them and there will be none to protect them from Allah. Darkness will cover their faces as though they were veiled with the dark blackness of night.These are the people of the Fire and in it they shall abide.
verses.translation: Those who do evil deeds the recompense of an evil deed is its like and humiliation shall spread over them and there will be none to protect them from Allah. Darkness will cover their faces as though they were veiled with the dark blackness of night.These are the people of the Fire and in it they shall abide.

verses.text: And the Day when We shall muster them all together We shall say to those who associated others with Allah in His divinity: ''Keep to your places - you and those whom you associated with Allah.'' Then We shall remove the veil of foreignness separating them. Those whom they had associated with Allah will say. ''It was not us that you worshipped.
verses.translation: And the Day when We shall muster them all together We shall say to those who associated others with Allah in His divinity: ''Keep to your places - you and those whom you associated with Allah.'' Then We shall remove the veil of foreignness separating them. Those whom they had associated with Allah will say. ''It was not us that you worshipped.

verses.text: Allah''s witness suffices between you and us that (even if you worshipped us) we were totally unaware of your worshipping us.
verses.translation: Allah''s witness suffices between you and us that (even if you worshipped us) we were totally unaware of your worshipping us.

verses.text: Thereupon everyone shall taste the recompense of his past deeds. All shall be sent back to Allah their true Lord and then all the falsehoods they had fabricated will have forsaken them.
verses.translation: Thereupon everyone shall taste the recompense of his past deeds. All shall be sent back to Allah their true Lord and then all the falsehoods they had fabricated will have forsaken them.

verses.text: Ask them: ''Who provides you with sustenance out of the heavens and the earth? Who holds mastery over your hearing and sight? Who brings forth the living from the dead and the dead from the living? Who governs all affairs of the universe?'' They will surely say: ''Allah.'' Tell them: ''Will you then not shun (going against reality)?""
verses.translation: Ask them: ''Who provides you with sustenance out of the heavens and the earth? Who holds mastery over your hearing and sight? Who brings forth the living from the dead and the dead from the living? Who governs all affairs of the universe?'' They will surely say: ''Allah.'' Tell them: ''Will you then not shun (going against reality)?""

verses.text: Such then is Allah your true Lord. And what is there after truth but error? How then are you being turned away?
verses.translation: Such then is Allah your true Lord. And what is there after truth but error? How then are you being turned away?

verses.text: Thus the word of your Lord is fulfilled concerning the transgressors that they shall not believe.
verses.translation: Thus the word of your Lord is fulfilled concerning the transgressors that they shall not believe.

verses.text: Ask them: ''Is there any among those whom you associate with Allah in His divinity who brings about the creation of all beings in the first instance and will then repeat it?'' Tell them: ''It is Allah Who brings about the creation of all beings and will then repeat it. How are you then being misled?
verses.translation: Ask them: ''Is there any among those whom you associate with Allah in His divinity who brings about the creation of all beings in the first instance and will then repeat it?'' Tell them: ''It is Allah Who brings about the creation of all beings and will then repeat it. How are you then being misled?

verses.text: Ask them: ''Are there among those whom you associate with Allah in His divinity any who can guide to the truth? Say: ''It is Allah alone Who guides to the Truth.'' Then who is more worthy to be followed - He Who guides to the Truth or he who cannot find the right way unless others guide him to it? What is wrong with you? How ill do you judge!
verses.translation: Ask them: ''Are there among those whom you associate with Allah in His divinity any who can guide to the truth? Say: ''It is Allah alone Who guides to the Truth.'' Then who is more worthy to be followed - He Who guides to the Truth or he who cannot find the right way unless others guide him to it? What is wrong with you? How ill do you judge!

verses.text: Most of them only follow conjectures; and surely conjecture can be no substitute for the Truth. Allah is well aware of whatever they do.
verses.translation: Most of them only follow conjectures; and surely conjecture can be no substitute for the Truth. Allah is well aware of whatever they do.

verses.text: And this Qur''an is such that it could not be composed by any unless it be revealed from Allah. It is a confirmation of the revelation made before it and a detailed exposition of the Book. Beyond doubt it is from the Lord of the entire Universe.
verses.translation: And this Qur''an is such that it could not be composed by any unless it be revealed from Allah. It is a confirmation of the revelation made before it and a detailed exposition of the Book. Beyond doubt it is from the Lord of the entire Universe.

verses.text: Do they say that the Messenger has himself composed the Qur''an? Say: ''In that case bring forth just one surah like it and call on all whom you can except Allah to help you if you are truthful.
verses.translation: Do they say that the Messenger has himself composed the Qur''an? Say: ''In that case bring forth just one surah like it and call on all whom you can except Allah to help you if you are truthful.

verses.text: In fact they arbitrarily rejected as false whatever they failed to comprehend and whose final sequel was not apparent to them. Likewise had their predecessors rejected the truth declaring it falsehood. Do observe then what was the end of the wrong-doers.
verses.translation: In fact they arbitrarily rejected as false whatever they failed to comprehend and whose final sequel was not apparent to them. Likewise had their predecessors rejected the truth declaring it falsehood. Do observe then what was the end of the wrong-doers.

verses.text: Of those some will believe and others will not. Your Lord fully knows the mischief-makers.
verses.translation: Of those some will believe and others will not. Your Lord fully knows the mischief-makers.

verses.text: And if they reject you as false tell them: ''My deeds are for myself and your deeds for yourselves. You will not be held responsible for my deeds nor I for your deeds.
verses.translation: And if they reject you as false tell them: ''My deeds are for myself and your deeds for yourselves. You will not be held responsible for my deeds nor I for your deeds.

verses.text: Of them some seem to give heed to you; will you then make the deaf hear even though they understand nothing?
verses.translation: Of them some seem to give heed to you; will you then make the deaf hear even though they understand nothing?

verses.text: And of them some look towards you; will you then guide the blind even though they can see nothing?
verses.translation: And of them some look towards you; will you then guide the blind even though they can see nothing?

verses.text: Surely Allah does not wrong people; they rather wrong themselves.
verses.translation: Surely Allah does not wrong people; they rather wrong themselves.

verses.text: (But today they are oblivious of everything except enjoyment of worldly life.) And on the Day when He will muster all people together they will feel as though they had been in the world no more than an hour of the day to get acquainted with one another. (It will then become evident that) those who called the lie to meeting with Allah were utter losers and were not rightly directed.
verses.translation: (But today they are oblivious of everything except enjoyment of worldly life.) And on the Day when He will muster all people together they will feel as though they had been in the world no more than an hour of the day to get acquainted with one another. (It will then become evident that) those who called the lie to meeting with Allah were utter losers and were not rightly directed.

verses.text: Whether We let you see (during your lifetime) some of the chastisement with which We threaten them or We call you to Us (before the chastisement strikes them) in any case they are bound to return to Us. Allah is witness to all that they do.
verses.translation: Whether We let you see (during your lifetime) some of the chastisement with which We threaten them or We call you to Us (before the chastisement strikes them) in any case they are bound to return to Us. Allah is witness to all that they do.

verses.text: A Messenger is sent to every people and when their Messenger comes the fate of that people is decided with full justice; they are subjected to no wrong.
verses.translation: A Messenger is sent to every people and when their Messenger comes the fate of that people is decided with full justice; they are subjected to no wrong.

verses.text: They say:''If what you promise is true when will this threat be fulfilled?''
verses.translation: They say:''If what you promise is true when will this threat be fulfilled?''

verses.text: Tell them: ''I have no power to harm or benefit even myself except what Allah may will. There is an appointed term for every people; and when the end of their term comes neither can they defer it for an hour nor can they bring it an hour before.
verses.translation: Tell them: ''I have no power to harm or benefit even myself except what Allah may will. There is an appointed term for every people; and when the end of their term comes neither can they defer it for an hour nor can they bring it an hour before.

verses.text: Tell them: ''Did you consider (what you would do) were His chastisement to fall upon you suddenly by night or by day? So why are the culprits seeking to hasten its coming?
verses.translation: Tell them: ''Did you consider (what you would do) were His chastisement to fall upon you suddenly by night or by day? So why are the culprits seeking to hasten its coming?

verses.text: Is it only when this chastisement has actually overtaken you that you will believe in it? (And when the chastisement will surprise you) you will try to get away from it although it is you who had sought to hasten its coming.''
verses.translation: Is it only when this chastisement has actually overtaken you that you will believe in it? (And when the chastisement will surprise you) you will try to get away from it although it is you who had sought to hasten its coming.''

verses.text: The wrong-doers will then be told: ''Suffer now the abiding chastisement. How else can you be rewarded except according to your deeds?''
verses.translation: The wrong-doers will then be told: ''Suffer now the abiding chastisement. How else can you be rewarded except according to your deeds?''

verses.text: They ask you if what you say is true? Tell them: ''Yes by my Lord this is altogether true and you have no power to prevent the chastisement from befalling.''
verses.translation: They ask you if what you say is true? Tell them: ''Yes by my Lord this is altogether true and you have no power to prevent the chastisement from befalling.''

verses.text: If a wrong-doer had all that is in the earth he would surely offer it to ransom himself. When the wrong-doers perceive the chastisement they will feel intense remorse in their hearts. But a judgement shall be made with full justice about them. They shall not be wronged.
verses.translation: If a wrong-doer had all that is in the earth he would surely offer it to ransom himself. When the wrong-doers perceive the chastisement they will feel intense remorse in their hearts. But a judgement shall be made with full justice about them. They shall not be wronged.

verses.text: Indeed all that is in the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah. And most certainly Allah''s promise will be fulfilled though most people are not aware of it.
verses.translation: Indeed all that is in the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah. And most certainly Allah''s promise will be fulfilled though most people are not aware of it.

verses.text: He it is Who gives life and causes death and to Him shall you all be returned.
verses.translation: He it is Who gives life and causes death and to Him shall you all be returned.

verses.text: Mankind! Now there has come to you an exhortation from your Lord a healing for the ailments of the hearts and a guidance and mercy for those who believe.
verses.translation: Mankind! Now there has come to you an exhortation from your Lord a healing for the ailments of the hearts and a guidance and mercy for those who believe.

verses.text: Tell them (O Prophet!): ''Let them rejoice in Allah''s grace and mercy through which this (Book) has come to you. It is better than all the riches that they accumulate.
verses.translation: Tell them (O Prophet!): ''Let them rejoice in Allah''s grace and mercy through which this (Book) has come to you. It is better than all the riches that they accumulate.

verses.text: Did you consider that the sustenance which Allah had sent down for you of your own accord you have declared some of it as unlawful and some as lawful? Ask them: ''Did Allah bestow upon you any authority for this or do you forge lies against Allah?
verses.translation: Did you consider that the sustenance which Allah had sent down for you of your own accord you have declared some of it as unlawful and some as lawful? Ask them: ''Did Allah bestow upon you any authority for this or do you forge lies against Allah?

verses.text: Think how those who invent lies against Him will be treated on the Day of Judgement? Allah is bountiful to people yet most of them do not give thanks.
verses.translation: Think how those who invent lies against Him will be treated on the Day of Judgement? Allah is bountiful to people yet most of them do not give thanks.

verses.text: (O Prophet) whatever you may be engaged in - whether you recite any portion of the Qur''an or whatever else all of you are doing - We are witnesses to whatever you may be occupied with. Not even an atom''s weight on the earth or in the heavens escapes your Lord nor is there anything smaller or bigger than that except that it is on record in a Clear Book.
verses.translation: (O Prophet) whatever you may be engaged in - whether you recite any portion of the Qur''an or whatever else all of you are doing - We are witnesses to whatever you may be occupied with. Not even an atom''s weight on the earth or in the heavens escapes your Lord nor is there anything smaller or bigger than that except that it is on record in a Clear Book.

verses.text: Surely the friends of Allah have nothing to fear nor shall they grieve
verses.translation: Surely the friends of Allah have nothing to fear nor shall they grieve

verses.text: the ones who believe and are God-fearing.
verses.translation: the ones who believe and are God-fearing.

verses.text: For them are glad tidings in this world and in the Hereafter. The words of Allah shall not change. That is the supreme triumph.
verses.translation: For them are glad tidings in this world and in the Hereafter. The words of Allah shall not change. That is the supreme triumph.

verses.text: (O Prophet!) Let not the utterances of the opponents distress you. Indeed all honour is Allah''s. He is All-Hearing All-Knowing.
verses.translation: (O Prophet!) Let not the utterances of the opponents distress you. Indeed all honour is Allah''s. He is All-Hearing All-Knowing.

verses.text: Verily whoever dwells in the heavens or the earth belongs to Allah. Those who invoke others instead of Allah associating them with Him in His divinity only follow conjectures and are merely guessing.
verses.translation: Verily whoever dwells in the heavens or the earth belongs to Allah. Those who invoke others instead of Allah associating them with Him in His divinity only follow conjectures and are merely guessing.

verses.text: It is Allah alone Who has made the night that you may rest in it and has made the day light-giving. Surely in it there are signs for those who give heed (to the call of the Messenger).
verses.translation: It is Allah alone Who has made the night that you may rest in it and has made the day light-giving. Surely in it there are signs for those who give heed (to the call of the Messenger).

verses.text: They say: ''Allah has taken a son. Glory be to Him. He is self-sufficient! His is all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. Have you any authority to support (that Allah has taken a son)? Do you ascribe to Allah something of which you have no knowledge?
verses.translation: They say: ''Allah has taken a son. Glory be to Him. He is self-sufficient! His is all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. Have you any authority to support (that Allah has taken a son)? Do you ascribe to Allah something of which you have no knowledge?

verses.text: Tell them (O Muhammad): ''Indeed those who invent lies against Allah will never prosper.
verses.translation: Tell them (O Muhammad): ''Indeed those who invent lies against Allah will never prosper.

verses.text: They may enjoy the life of this world but in the end they must return to Us and then We shall cause them to taste severe chastisement for their disbelieving.''
verses.translation: They may enjoy the life of this world but in the end they must return to Us and then We shall cause them to taste severe chastisement for their disbelieving.''

verses.text: Narrate to them the story of Noah when he said to his people: ''My people! If my living in your midst and my effort to shake you out of heedlessness by reciting to you the revelations of Allah offend you then remember that I have put all my trust in Allah. So draw up your plan in concert with those whom you associate with Allah in His divinity leaving no part of it obscure and then put it into effect against me and give me no respite.
verses.translation: Narrate to them the story of Noah when he said to his people: ''My people! If my living in your midst and my effort to shake you out of heedlessness by reciting to you the revelations of Allah offend you then remember that I have put all my trust in Allah. So draw up your plan in concert with those whom you associate with Allah in His divinity leaving no part of it obscure and then put it into effect against me and give me no respite.

verses.text: When you turned your back on my admonition (what harm did you cause me?) I had asked you for no reward for my reward lies only with Allah and I am commanded to be of those who totally submit (to Him).
verses.translation: When you turned your back on my admonition (what harm did you cause me?) I had asked you for no reward for my reward lies only with Allah and I am commanded to be of those who totally submit (to Him).

verses.text: But they rejected Noah calling him a liar. So We saved him and those who were with him in the Ark and made them successors (to the authority in the land) and drowned all those who had rejected Our signs as false. Consider then the fate of those who had been warned (and still did not believe).
verses.translation: But they rejected Noah calling him a liar. So We saved him and those who were with him in the Ark and made them successors (to the authority in the land) and drowned all those who had rejected Our signs as false. Consider then the fate of those who had been warned (and still did not believe).

verses.text: Then We sent forth after him other Messengers each one to his people. They brought to them clear signs but they were not such as to believe in what they had rejected earlier as false. Thus do We seal the hearts of those who transgress.
verses.translation: Then We sent forth after him other Messengers each one to his people. They brought to them clear signs but they were not such as to believe in what they had rejected earlier as false. Thus do We seal the hearts of those who transgress.

verses.text: Then after them We sent forth Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh and his chiefs with Our signs but they waxed proud. They were a wicked people.
verses.translation: Then after them We sent forth Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh and his chiefs with Our signs but they waxed proud. They were a wicked people.

verses.text: And when truth came to them from Us they said: ''Indeed this is plain sorcery.
verses.translation: And when truth came to them from Us they said: ''Indeed this is plain sorcery.

verses.text: Moses said: ''Do you say this about the truth after it has come to you? Is this sorcery? You call this sorcery although sorcerers never come to a happy end.
verses.translation: Moses said: ''Do you say this about the truth after it has come to you? Is this sorcery? You call this sorcery although sorcerers never come to a happy end.

verses.text: They replied: ''Have you come to turn us away from the way of our forefathers that the two of you might become supreme in the land? We shall never accept what the two of you say.''
verses.translation: They replied: ''Have you come to turn us away from the way of our forefathers that the two of you might become supreme in the land? We shall never accept what the two of you say.''

verses.text: And Pharaoh said (to his) men: ''Bring every skilled sorcerer to me.''
verses.translation: And Pharaoh said (to his) men: ''Bring every skilled sorcerer to me.''

verses.text: And when the sorcerers came Moses said to them: ''Cast whatever you wish to cast.''
verses.translation: And when the sorcerers came Moses said to them: ''Cast whatever you wish to cast.''

verses.text: Then when they had cast (their staffs and ropes) Moses said: ''What you have produced is sheer sorcery. Allah will certainly reduce it to naught. Surely Allah does not set right the work of the mischief-makers.
verses.translation: Then when they had cast (their staffs and ropes) Moses said: ''What you have produced is sheer sorcery. Allah will certainly reduce it to naught. Surely Allah does not set right the work of the mischief-makers.

verses.text: Allah vindicates the truth by His commands howsoever much the guilty might detest that.''
verses.translation: Allah vindicates the truth by His commands howsoever much the guilty might detest that.''

verses.text: None but a few youths of Moses'' people accepted him fearing that Pharaoh and their own chiefs would persecute them. Indeed Pharaoh was mighty in the land he was among those who exceed all limits.
verses.translation: None but a few youths of Moses'' people accepted him fearing that Pharaoh and their own chiefs would persecute them. Indeed Pharaoh was mighty in the land he was among those who exceed all limits.

verses.text: Moses said: ''My people! If you believe in Allah and are truly Muslims then place your reliance on Him alone.''
verses.translation: Moses said: ''My people! If you believe in Allah and are truly Muslims then place your reliance on Him alone.''

verses.text: They replied: ''We place our reliance on Allah. Our Lord! Do not make us a trial for the oppressors
verses.translation: They replied: ''We place our reliance on Allah. Our Lord! Do not make us a trial for the oppressors

verses.text: and deliver us through Your mercy from the unbelievers.''
verses.translation: and deliver us through Your mercy from the unbelievers.''

verses.text: And We directed Moses and his brother: ''Prepare a few houses for your people in Egypt and make your houses a direction for them to pray and establish Prayer and give glad tidings to the people of faith.''
verses.translation: And We directed Moses and his brother: ''Prepare a few houses for your people in Egypt and make your houses a direction for them to pray and establish Prayer and give glad tidings to the people of faith.''

verses.text: Moses prayed: ''Our Lord! You bestowed upon Pharaoh and his nobles splendour and riches in the world. Our Lord! Have You done this that they may lead people astray from Your path? Our Lord! Obliterate their riches and harden their hearts that they may not believe until they observe the painful chastisement.
verses.translation: Moses prayed: ''Our Lord! You bestowed upon Pharaoh and his nobles splendour and riches in the world. Our Lord! Have You done this that they may lead people astray from Your path? Our Lord! Obliterate their riches and harden their hearts that they may not believe until they observe the painful chastisement.

verses.text: Allah responded: ''The prayer of the two of you is accepted. So keep steadfast and do not follow the path of the ignorant.
verses.translation: Allah responded: ''The prayer of the two of you is accepted. So keep steadfast and do not follow the path of the ignorant.

verses.text: And We led the Children of Israel across the sea. Then Pharaoh and his hosts pursued them in iniquity and transgression until Pharaoh cried out while he was drowning: ''I believe that there is no god but Allah in Whom the Children of Israel believe and I am also one of those who submit to Allah.
verses.translation: And We led the Children of Israel across the sea. Then Pharaoh and his hosts pursued them in iniquity and transgression until Pharaoh cried out while he was drowning: ''I believe that there is no god but Allah in Whom the Children of Israel believe and I am also one of those who submit to Allah.

verses.text: (Thereupon came the response): ''Now you believe although you disobeyed earlier and were among the mischief-makers.
verses.translation: (Thereupon came the response): ''Now you believe although you disobeyed earlier and were among the mischief-makers.

verses.text: We shall now save your corpse that you may serve as a sign of warning for all posterity although many men are heedless of Our signs.
verses.translation: We shall now save your corpse that you may serve as a sign of warning for all posterity although many men are heedless of Our signs.

verses.text: We settled the Children of Israel in a blessed land and provided them with all manner of good things. They only disagreed among themselves after knowledge (of the Truth had) come to them. Surely your Lord will judge among them on the Day of Resurrection concerning their disagreements.
verses.translation: We settled the Children of Israel in a blessed land and provided them with all manner of good things. They only disagreed among themselves after knowledge (of the Truth had) come to them. Surely your Lord will judge among them on the Day of Resurrection concerning their disagreements.

verses.text: Now if you are in doubt concerning what We have revealed to you then ask those who have been reading the Book before you. It is the truth that has come to you from your Lord so never become one of those who doubt
verses.translation: Now if you are in doubt concerning what We have revealed to you then ask those who have been reading the Book before you. It is the truth that has come to you from your Lord so never become one of those who doubt

verses.text: nor reject the Signs of Allah as false for then you shall be among the utter losers.
verses.translation: nor reject the Signs of Allah as false for then you shall be among the utter losers.

verses.text: Surely those against whom the word of your Lord has been fulfilled will not believe
verses.translation: Surely those against whom the word of your Lord has been fulfilled will not believe

verses.text: even if they witness every single Sign that might come to them until they are face to face with the painful chastisement
verses.translation: even if they witness every single Sign that might come to them until they are face to face with the painful chastisement

verses.text: Did it ever happen that the people of a town believed on seeing God''s chastisement and its believing profited them? (There is no such instance) except of the people of Yunus. When they believed We granted them reprieve from a humiliating chastisement in this world and We let them enjoy themselves for a while.
verses.translation: Did it ever happen that the people of a town believed on seeing God''s chastisement and its believing profited them? (There is no such instance) except of the people of Yunus. When they believed We granted them reprieve from a humiliating chastisement in this world and We let them enjoy themselves for a while.

verses.text: Had your Lord so willed all those who are on earth would have believed. Will you then force people into believing?
verses.translation: Had your Lord so willed all those who are on earth would have believed. Will you then force people into believing?

verses.text: No one can believe except by Allah''s leave and Allah lays abomination on those who do not use their understanding.
verses.translation: No one can believe except by Allah''s leave and Allah lays abomination on those who do not use their understanding.

verses.text: Tell them: ''Observe carefully all that is in the heavens and the earth.'' But no signs and warnings can avail those who are bent on not believing.
verses.translation: Tell them: ''Observe carefully all that is in the heavens and the earth.'' But no signs and warnings can avail those who are bent on not believing.

verses.text: What are they waiting for except to witness the repetition of the days of calamity that their predecessors witnessed? Tell them: ''Wait; I too am waiting with you.
verses.translation: What are they waiting for except to witness the repetition of the days of calamity that their predecessors witnessed? Tell them: ''Wait; I too am waiting with you.

verses.text: Then (when Allah''s wrath falls upon the wicked) We save our Messengers and also those who believe. It is incumbent on Us to deliver the believers.
verses.translation: Then (when Allah''s wrath falls upon the wicked) We save our Messengers and also those who believe. It is incumbent on Us to deliver the believers.

verses.text: (O Prophet!) tell them: ''O people! If you are still in doubt concerning my religion know that I do not serve those whom you serve beside Allah. I only serve Allah Who will cause (all of) you to die. I have been commanded to be one of those who believe
verses.translation: (O Prophet!) tell them: ''O people! If you are still in doubt concerning my religion know that I do not serve those whom you serve beside Allah. I only serve Allah Who will cause (all of) you to die. I have been commanded to be one of those who believe

verses.text: and to adhere exclusively and sincerely to the true faith and not to be one of those who associate others with Allah in His divinity.
verses.translation: and to adhere exclusively and sincerely to the true faith and not to be one of those who associate others with Allah in His divinity.

verses.text: Do not call upon any apart from Allah upon those who have no power to benefit or hurt you. For if you call upon others than Allah you will be reckoned among the wrong-doers.
verses.translation: Do not call upon any apart from Allah upon those who have no power to benefit or hurt you. For if you call upon others than Allah you will be reckoned among the wrong-doers.

verses.text: If Allah afflicts you with any hardship none other than He can remove it; and if He wills any good for you none can avert His bounty. He bestows good upon whomsoever of His servants He wills. He is All-Forgiving All-Merciful.''
verses.translation: If Allah afflicts you with any hardship none other than He can remove it; and if He wills any good for you none can avert His bounty. He bestows good upon whomsoever of His servants He wills. He is All-Forgiving All-Merciful.''

verses.text: Tell them (O Muhammad): ''O People! Truth has come to you from your Lord. Whosoever then follows the True Guidance does so for his own good; and whosoever strays his straying will be to his own hurt. I am no custodian over you.
verses.translation: Tell them (O Muhammad): ''O People! Truth has come to you from your Lord. Whosoever then follows the True Guidance does so for his own good; and whosoever strays his straying will be to his own hurt. I am no custodian over you.

verses.text: And follow (O Prophet!) whatever is revealed to you and remain patient until Allah brings forth His judgment. He is the best of those who judge.''
verses.translation: And follow (O Prophet!) whatever is revealed to you and remain patient until Allah brings forth His judgment. He is the best of those who judge.''

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: Alif. Lam. Ra. These are the verses of the Book overflowing with wisdom.
ayahs.translation: Alif. Lam. Ra. These are the verses of the Book overflowing with wisdom.

ayahs.text: Does it seem strange to people that We should have revealed to a man from among themselves directing him to warn the people (who areengrossed in heedlessness) and to give good news to the believers that they shall enjoy true honour and an exalted status with their Lord? (This seemed so strange that) the deniers of the Truth said: ''This man is indeed a plain sorcerer?''
ayahs.translation: Does it seem strange to people that We should have revealed to a man from among themselves directing him to warn the people (who areengrossed in heedlessness) and to give good news to the believers that they shall enjoy true honour and an exalted status with their Lord? (This seemed so strange that) the deniers of the Truth said: ''This man is indeed a plain sorcerer?''

ayahs.text: Surely your Lord is Allah Who created the heavens and the earth in six days then established Himself on the Throne (of His Dominion) governing all affairs of the universe. None may intercede with Him except after obtaining His leave. Such is Allah your Lord; do therefore serve Him.Will you not take heed?
ayahs.translation: Surely your Lord is Allah Who created the heavens and the earth in six days then established Himself on the Throne (of His Dominion) governing all affairs of the universe. None may intercede with Him except after obtaining His leave. Such is Allah your Lord; do therefore serve Him.Will you not take heed?

ayahs.text: To Him is your return. This is Allah''s promise that will certainly come true. Surely it is He Who brings about the creation of all and He will repeat it so that He may justly reward those who believe and do righteous deeds and those who disbelieve may have a draught of boiling water and suffer a painful chastisement for their denying the Truth.
ayahs.translation: To Him is your return. This is Allah''s promise that will certainly come true. Surely it is He Who brings about the creation of all and He will repeat it so that He may justly reward those who believe and do righteous deeds and those who disbelieve may have a draught of boiling water and suffer a painful chastisement for their denying the Truth.

ayahs.text: He it is Who gave the sun radiance and the moon light and determined the stages (for the waxing and waning of the moon) that you may learn the calculation of years and the reckoning of time. Allah has created all this with a rightful purpose (rather than out of play). He expounds His signs for the people who know.
ayahs.translation: He it is Who gave the sun radiance and the moon light and determined the stages (for the waxing and waning of the moon) that you may learn the calculation of years and the reckoning of time. Allah has created all this with a rightful purpose (rather than out of play). He expounds His signs for the people who know.

ayahs.text: Surely in the alternation of the night and the day and in all that Allah has created in the heavens and the earth there are signs for the people who seek to avoid (error of outlook and conduct).
ayahs.translation: Surely in the alternation of the night and the day and in all that Allah has created in the heavens and the earth there are signs for the people who seek to avoid (error of outlook and conduct).

ayahs.text: Surely those who do not expect to meet Us who are gratified with the life of the world and are well-pleased with it and are heedless of Our signs
ayahs.translation: Surely those who do not expect to meet Us who are gratified with the life of the world and are well-pleased with it and are heedless of Our signs

ayahs.text: their abode shall be the Fire in return for their misdeeds
ayahs.translation: their abode shall be the Fire in return for their misdeeds

ayahs.text: Surely those who believe (in the Truths revealed in the Book) and do righteous deeds their Lord will guide them aright because of their faith. Rivers shall flow beneath them in the Gardens of Bliss.
ayahs.translation: Surely those who believe (in the Truths revealed in the Book) and do righteous deeds their Lord will guide them aright because of their faith. Rivers shall flow beneath them in the Gardens of Bliss.

ayahs.text: Their cry in it will be: ''Glory be to You Our Lord!'' and their greeting: ''Peace!''; and their cry will always end with: ''All praise be to Allah the Lord of the universe.
ayahs.translation: Their cry in it will be: ''Glory be to You Our Lord!'' and their greeting: ''Peace!''; and their cry will always end with: ''All praise be to Allah the Lord of the universe.

ayahs.text: Were Allah to hasten to bring upon people (the consequence of) evil in the way people hasten in seeking the wealth of this world their term would have long since expired. (But that is not Our way) So We leave alone those who do not expect to meet Us that they may blindly stumble in their transgression.
