ayahs.translation: Were Allah to hasten to bring upon people (the consequence of) evil in the way people hasten in seeking the wealth of this world their term would have long since expired. (But that is not Our way) So We leave alone those who do not expect to meet Us that they may blindly stumble in their transgression.

ayahs.text: And (such is man that) when an affliction befalls him he cries out to Us reclining and sitting and standing. But no sooner than We have removed his affliction he passes on as though he had never cried out to Us to remove his affliction. Thus it is that the misdeeds of the transgressors are made fair-seeming to them.
ayahs.translation: And (such is man that) when an affliction befalls him he cries out to Us reclining and sitting and standing. But no sooner than We have removed his affliction he passes on as though he had never cried out to Us to remove his affliction. Thus it is that the misdeeds of the transgressors are made fair-seeming to them.

ayahs.text: Surely We destroyed the nations before you  (which had risen to heights of glory in their times) when they indulged in wrong-doing and refused to believe even when their Messengers brought Clear Signs to them. Thus do We recompense the people who are guilty.
ayahs.translation: Surely We destroyed the nations before you  (which had risen to heights of glory in their times) when they indulged in wrong-doing and refused to believe even when their Messengers brought Clear Signs to them. Thus do We recompense the people who are guilty.

ayahs.text: Now We have appointed you as their successors in the earth to see how you act.
ayahs.translation: Now We have appointed you as their successors in the earth to see how you act.

ayahs.text: And whenever Our clear revelations are recited to them those who do not expect to meet Us say: ''Bring us a Qur''an other than this one or at least make changes in it''. Tell them (O Muhammad): ''It is not for me to change it of my accord. I only follow what is revealed to me. Were I to disobey my Lord I fear the chastisement of an Awesome Day''.
ayahs.translation: And whenever Our clear revelations are recited to them those who do not expect to meet Us say: ''Bring us a Qur''an other than this one or at least make changes in it''. Tell them (O Muhammad): ''It is not for me to change it of my accord. I only follow what is revealed to me. Were I to disobey my Lord I fear the chastisement of an Awesome Day''.

ayahs.text: Tell them: ''Had Allah so willed I would not have recited the Qur''an to you nor would Allah have informed you of it. I have spent a lifetime among you before this. Do you then not use your reason?
ayahs.translation: Tell them: ''Had Allah so willed I would not have recited the Qur''an to you nor would Allah have informed you of it. I have spent a lifetime among you before this. Do you then not use your reason?

ayahs.text: Who then is a greater wrong-doer than he who forges a lie against Allah or rejects His signs as false? Surely the guilty shall not prosper.
ayahs.translation: Who then is a greater wrong-doer than he who forges a lie against Allah or rejects His signs as false? Surely the guilty shall not prosper.

ayahs.text: They worship beside Allah those who can neither harm nor profit them saying; ''These are our intercessors with Allah.'' Tell them (O Muhammad): ''Do you inform Allah of something regarding whose existence in the heavens or on the earth He has no knowledge? Holy is He and exalted far above what they associate with Him in His divinity.''
ayahs.translation: They worship beside Allah those who can neither harm nor profit them saying; ''These are our intercessors with Allah.'' Tell them (O Muhammad): ''Do you inform Allah of something regarding whose existence in the heavens or on the earth He has no knowledge? Holy is He and exalted far above what they associate with Him in His divinity.''

ayahs.text: Once all human beings were but a single community; then they disagreed (and formulated different beliefs and rites).Had it not been that your Lord had already so ordained a decisive judgement would have been made regarding their disagreements.
ayahs.translation: Once all human beings were but a single community; then they disagreed (and formulated different beliefs and rites).Had it not been that your Lord had already so ordained a decisive judgement would have been made regarding their disagreements.

ayahs.text: They say: ''Why was a sign not sent down upon the prophet from His Lord? Tell (such people): ''The realm of the Unseen belongs to Allah. Wait then; I shall wait along with you.
ayahs.translation: They say: ''Why was a sign not sent down upon the prophet from His Lord? Tell (such people): ''The realm of the Unseen belongs to Allah. Wait then; I shall wait along with you.

ayahs.text: No sooner than We bestow mercy on a people after hardship has hit them than they begin to scheme against Our signs. Tell them: ''Allah is swifter in scheming. Our angels are recording all your intriguing.
ayahs.translation: No sooner than We bestow mercy on a people after hardship has hit them than they begin to scheme against Our signs. Tell them: ''Allah is swifter in scheming. Our angels are recording all your intriguing.

ayahs.text: He it is Who enables you to journey through the land and the sea. And so it happens that when you have boarded the ships and they set sail with a favourable wind and the passengers rejoice at the pleasant voyage then suddenly a fierce gale appears and wave upon wave surges upon them from every side and people believe that they are surrounded from all directions and all of them cry out to Allah in full sincerity of faith: ''If You deliver us from this we shall surely be thankful.
ayahs.translation: He it is Who enables you to journey through the land and the sea. And so it happens that when you have boarded the ships and they set sail with a favourable wind and the passengers rejoice at the pleasant voyage then suddenly a fierce gale appears and wave upon wave surges upon them from every side and people believe that they are surrounded from all directions and all of them cry out to Allah in full sincerity of faith: ''If You deliver us from this we shall surely be thankful.

ayahs.text: But no sooner than He delivers them than they go about committing excesses on the earth acting unjustly. O mankind! The excesses you commit will be of harm only to yourselves (Enjoy if you will) the fleeting pleasure of this world; in the end you shall all return to Us and then We shall tell you what you have been doing.
ayahs.translation: But no sooner than He delivers them than they go about committing excesses on the earth acting unjustly. O mankind! The excesses you commit will be of harm only to yourselves (Enjoy if you will) the fleeting pleasure of this world; in the end you shall all return to Us and then We shall tell you what you have been doing.

ayahs.text: The example of the life of this world (which has enamoured you into becoming heedless to Our Signs) is that of water that We sent down from the sky which caused the vegetation of the earth sustaining human beings and cattle to grow luxuriantly. But when the earth took on its golden raiment and became well adorned and the owners believed that they had full control over their lands Our Command came upon them by night or by day and We converted it into a stubble as though it had not blossomed yesterday. Thus do We expound the Signs for a people who reflect.
ayahs.translation: The example of the life of this world (which has enamoured you into becoming heedless to Our Signs) is that of water that We sent down from the sky which caused the vegetation of the earth sustaining human beings and cattle to grow luxuriantly. But when the earth took on its golden raiment and became well adorned and the owners believed that they had full control over their lands Our Command came upon them by night or by day and We converted it into a stubble as though it had not blossomed yesterday. Thus do We expound the Signs for a people who reflect.

ayahs.text: (You are being lured by this ephemeral world) although Allah calls you to the abode of peace and guides whomsoever He wills to a straightway.
ayahs.translation: (You are being lured by this ephemeral world) although Allah calls you to the abode of peace and guides whomsoever He wills to a straightway.

ayahs.text: For those who do good there is good reward and more besides; neither gloom nor humiliation shall cover their faces. They are the people of the Garden and in it they shall abide.
ayahs.translation: For those who do good there is good reward and more besides; neither gloom nor humiliation shall cover their faces. They are the people of the Garden and in it they shall abide.

ayahs.text: Those who do evil deeds the recompense of an evil deed is its like and humiliation shall spread over them and there will be none to protect them from Allah. Darkness will cover their faces as though they were veiled with the dark blackness of night.These are the people of the Fire and in it they shall abide.
ayahs.translation: Those who do evil deeds the recompense of an evil deed is its like and humiliation shall spread over them and there will be none to protect them from Allah. Darkness will cover their faces as though they were veiled with the dark blackness of night.These are the people of the Fire and in it they shall abide.

ayahs.text: And the Day when We shall muster them all together We shall say to those who associated others with Allah in His divinity: ''Keep to your places - you and those whom you associated with Allah.'' Then We shall remove the veil of foreignness separating them. Those whom they had associated with Allah will say. ''It was not us that you worshipped.
ayahs.translation: And the Day when We shall muster them all together We shall say to those who associated others with Allah in His divinity: ''Keep to your places - you and those whom you associated with Allah.'' Then We shall remove the veil of foreignness separating them. Those whom they had associated with Allah will say. ''It was not us that you worshipped.

ayahs.text: Allah''s witness suffices between you and us that (even if you worshipped us) we were totally unaware of your worshipping us.
ayahs.translation: Allah''s witness suffices between you and us that (even if you worshipped us) we were totally unaware of your worshipping us.

ayahs.text: Thereupon everyone shall taste the recompense of his past deeds. All shall be sent back to Allah their true Lord and then all the falsehoods they had fabricated will have forsaken them.
ayahs.translation: Thereupon everyone shall taste the recompense of his past deeds. All shall be sent back to Allah their true Lord and then all the falsehoods they had fabricated will have forsaken them.

ayahs.text: Ask them: ''Who provides you with sustenance out of the heavens and the earth? Who holds mastery over your hearing and sight? Who brings forth the living from the dead and the dead from the living? Who governs all affairs of the universe?'' They will surely say: ''Allah.'' Tell them: ''Will you then not shun (going against reality)?""
ayahs.translation: Ask them: ''Who provides you with sustenance out of the heavens and the earth? Who holds mastery over your hearing and sight? Who brings forth the living from the dead and the dead from the living? Who governs all affairs of the universe?'' They will surely say: ''Allah.'' Tell them: ''Will you then not shun (going against reality)?""

ayahs.text: Such then is Allah your true Lord. And what is there after truth but error? How then are you being turned away?
ayahs.translation: Such then is Allah your true Lord. And what is there after truth but error? How then are you being turned away?

ayahs.text: Thus the word of your Lord is fulfilled concerning the transgressors that they shall not believe.
ayahs.translation: Thus the word of your Lord is fulfilled concerning the transgressors that they shall not believe.

ayahs.text: Ask them: ''Is there any among those whom you associate with Allah in His divinity who brings about the creation of all beings in the first instance and will then repeat it?'' Tell them: ''It is Allah Who brings about the creation of all beings and will then repeat it. How are you then being misled?
ayahs.translation: Ask them: ''Is there any among those whom you associate with Allah in His divinity who brings about the creation of all beings in the first instance and will then repeat it?'' Tell them: ''It is Allah Who brings about the creation of all beings and will then repeat it. How are you then being misled?

ayahs.text: Ask them: ''Are there among those whom you associate with Allah in His divinity any who can guide to the truth? Say: ''It is Allah alone Who guides to the Truth.'' Then who is more worthy to be followed - He Who guides to the Truth or he who cannot find the right way unless others guide him to it? What is wrong with you? How ill do you judge!
ayahs.translation: Ask them: ''Are there among those whom you associate with Allah in His divinity any who can guide to the truth? Say: ''It is Allah alone Who guides to the Truth.'' Then who is more worthy to be followed - He Who guides to the Truth or he who cannot find the right way unless others guide him to it? What is wrong with you? How ill do you judge!

ayahs.text: Most of them only follow conjectures; and surely conjecture can be no substitute for the Truth. Allah is well aware of whatever they do.
ayahs.translation: Most of them only follow conjectures; and surely conjecture can be no substitute for the Truth. Allah is well aware of whatever they do.

ayahs.text: And this Qur''an is such that it could not be composed by any unless it be revealed from Allah. It is a confirmation of the revelation made before it and a detailed exposition of the Book. Beyond doubt it is from the Lord of the entire Universe.
ayahs.translation: And this Qur''an is such that it could not be composed by any unless it be revealed from Allah. It is a confirmation of the revelation made before it and a detailed exposition of the Book. Beyond doubt it is from the Lord of the entire Universe.

ayahs.text: Do they say that the Messenger has himself composed the Qur''an? Say: ''In that case bring forth just one surah like it and call on all whom you can except Allah to help you if you are truthful.
ayahs.translation: Do they say that the Messenger has himself composed the Qur''an? Say: ''In that case bring forth just one surah like it and call on all whom you can except Allah to help you if you are truthful.

ayahs.text: In fact they arbitrarily rejected as false whatever they failed to comprehend and whose final sequel was not apparent to them. Likewise had their predecessors rejected the truth declaring it falsehood. Do observe then what was the end of the wrong-doers.
ayahs.translation: In fact they arbitrarily rejected as false whatever they failed to comprehend and whose final sequel was not apparent to them. Likewise had their predecessors rejected the truth declaring it falsehood. Do observe then what was the end of the wrong-doers.

ayahs.text: Of those some will believe and others will not. Your Lord fully knows the mischief-makers.
ayahs.translation: Of those some will believe and others will not. Your Lord fully knows the mischief-makers.

ayahs.text: And if they reject you as false tell them: ''My deeds are for myself and your deeds for yourselves. You will not be held responsible for my deeds nor I for your deeds.
ayahs.translation: And if they reject you as false tell them: ''My deeds are for myself and your deeds for yourselves. You will not be held responsible for my deeds nor I for your deeds.

ayahs.text: Of them some seem to give heed to you; will you then make the deaf hear even though they understand nothing?
ayahs.translation: Of them some seem to give heed to you; will you then make the deaf hear even though they understand nothing?

ayahs.text: And of them some look towards you; will you then guide the blind even though they can see nothing?
ayahs.translation: And of them some look towards you; will you then guide the blind even though they can see nothing?

ayahs.text: Surely Allah does not wrong people; they rather wrong themselves.
ayahs.translation: Surely Allah does not wrong people; they rather wrong themselves.

ayahs.text: (But today they are oblivious of everything except enjoyment of worldly life.) And on the Day when He will muster all people together they will feel as though they had been in the world no more than an hour of the day to get acquainted with one another. (It will then become evident that) those who called the lie to meeting with Allah were utter losers and were not rightly directed.
ayahs.translation: (But today they are oblivious of everything except enjoyment of worldly life.) And on the Day when He will muster all people together they will feel as though they had been in the world no more than an hour of the day to get acquainted with one another. (It will then become evident that) those who called the lie to meeting with Allah were utter losers and were not rightly directed.

ayahs.text: Whether We let you see (during your lifetime) some of the chastisement with which We threaten them or We call you to Us (before the chastisement strikes them) in any case they are bound to return to Us. Allah is witness to all that they do.
ayahs.translation: Whether We let you see (during your lifetime) some of the chastisement with which We threaten them or We call you to Us (before the chastisement strikes them) in any case they are bound to return to Us. Allah is witness to all that they do.

ayahs.text: A Messenger is sent to every people and when their Messenger comes the fate of that people is decided with full justice; they are subjected to no wrong.
ayahs.translation: A Messenger is sent to every people and when their Messenger comes the fate of that people is decided with full justice; they are subjected to no wrong.

ayahs.text: They say:''If what you promise is true when will this threat be fulfilled?''
ayahs.translation: They say:''If what you promise is true when will this threat be fulfilled?''

ayahs.text: Tell them: ''I have no power to harm or benefit even myself except what Allah may will. There is an appointed term for every people; and when the end of their term comes neither can they defer it for an hour nor can they bring it an hour before.
ayahs.translation: Tell them: ''I have no power to harm or benefit even myself except what Allah may will. There is an appointed term for every people; and when the end of their term comes neither can they defer it for an hour nor can they bring it an hour before.

ayahs.text: Tell them: ''Did you consider (what you would do) were His chastisement to fall upon you suddenly by night or by day? So why are the culprits seeking to hasten its coming?
ayahs.translation: Tell them: ''Did you consider (what you would do) were His chastisement to fall upon you suddenly by night or by day? So why are the culprits seeking to hasten its coming?

ayahs.text: Is it only when this chastisement has actually overtaken you that you will believe in it? (And when the chastisement will surprise you) you will try to get away from it although it is you who had sought to hasten its coming.''
ayahs.translation: Is it only when this chastisement has actually overtaken you that you will believe in it? (And when the chastisement will surprise you) you will try to get away from it although it is you who had sought to hasten its coming.''

ayahs.text: The wrong-doers will then be told: ''Suffer now the abiding chastisement. How else can you be rewarded except according to your deeds?''
ayahs.translation: The wrong-doers will then be told: ''Suffer now the abiding chastisement. How else can you be rewarded except according to your deeds?''

ayahs.text: They ask you if what you say is true? Tell them: ''Yes by my Lord this is altogether true and you have no power to prevent the chastisement from befalling.''
ayahs.translation: They ask you if what you say is true? Tell them: ''Yes by my Lord this is altogether true and you have no power to prevent the chastisement from befalling.''

ayahs.text: If a wrong-doer had all that is in the earth he would surely offer it to ransom himself. When the wrong-doers perceive the chastisement they will feel intense remorse in their hearts. But a judgement shall be made with full justice about them. They shall not be wronged.
ayahs.translation: If a wrong-doer had all that is in the earth he would surely offer it to ransom himself. When the wrong-doers perceive the chastisement they will feel intense remorse in their hearts. But a judgement shall be made with full justice about them. They shall not be wronged.

ayahs.text: Indeed all that is in the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah. And most certainly Allah''s promise will be fulfilled though most people are not aware of it.
ayahs.translation: Indeed all that is in the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah. And most certainly Allah''s promise will be fulfilled though most people are not aware of it.

ayahs.text: He it is Who gives life and causes death and to Him shall you all be returned.
ayahs.translation: He it is Who gives life and causes death and to Him shall you all be returned.

ayahs.text: Mankind! Now there has come to you an exhortation from your Lord a healing for the ailments of the hearts and a guidance and mercy for those who believe.
ayahs.translation: Mankind! Now there has come to you an exhortation from your Lord a healing for the ailments of the hearts and a guidance and mercy for those who believe.

ayahs.text: Tell them (O Prophet!): ''Let them rejoice in Allah''s grace and mercy through which this (Book) has come to you. It is better than all the riches that they accumulate.
ayahs.translation: Tell them (O Prophet!): ''Let them rejoice in Allah''s grace and mercy through which this (Book) has come to you. It is better than all the riches that they accumulate.

ayahs.text: Did you consider that the sustenance which Allah had sent down for you of your own accord you have declared some of it as unlawful and some as lawful? Ask them: ''Did Allah bestow upon you any authority for this or do you forge lies against Allah?
ayahs.translation: Did you consider that the sustenance which Allah had sent down for you of your own accord you have declared some of it as unlawful and some as lawful? Ask them: ''Did Allah bestow upon you any authority for this or do you forge lies against Allah?

ayahs.text: Think how those who invent lies against Him will be treated on the Day of Judgement? Allah is bountiful to people yet most of them do not give thanks.
ayahs.translation: Think how those who invent lies against Him will be treated on the Day of Judgement? Allah is bountiful to people yet most of them do not give thanks.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) whatever you may be engaged in - whether you recite any portion of the Qur''an or whatever else all of you are doing - We are witnesses to whatever you may be occupied with. Not even an atom''s weight on the earth or in the heavens escapes your Lord nor is there anything smaller or bigger than that except that it is on record in a Clear Book.
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) whatever you may be engaged in - whether you recite any portion of the Qur''an or whatever else all of you are doing - We are witnesses to whatever you may be occupied with. Not even an atom''s weight on the earth or in the heavens escapes your Lord nor is there anything smaller or bigger than that except that it is on record in a Clear Book.

ayahs.text: Surely the friends of Allah have nothing to fear nor shall they grieve
ayahs.translation: Surely the friends of Allah have nothing to fear nor shall they grieve

ayahs.text: the ones who believe and are God-fearing.
ayahs.translation: the ones who believe and are God-fearing.

ayahs.text: For them are glad tidings in this world and in the Hereafter. The words of Allah shall not change. That is the supreme triumph.
ayahs.translation: For them are glad tidings in this world and in the Hereafter. The words of Allah shall not change. That is the supreme triumph.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet!) Let not the utterances of the opponents distress you. Indeed all honour is Allah''s. He is All-Hearing All-Knowing.
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet!) Let not the utterances of the opponents distress you. Indeed all honour is Allah''s. He is All-Hearing All-Knowing.

ayahs.text: Verily whoever dwells in the heavens or the earth belongs to Allah. Those who invoke others instead of Allah associating them with Him in His divinity only follow conjectures and are merely guessing.
ayahs.translation: Verily whoever dwells in the heavens or the earth belongs to Allah. Those who invoke others instead of Allah associating them with Him in His divinity only follow conjectures and are merely guessing.

ayahs.text: It is Allah alone Who has made the night that you may rest in it and has made the day light-giving. Surely in it there are signs for those who give heed (to the call of the Messenger).
ayahs.translation: It is Allah alone Who has made the night that you may rest in it and has made the day light-giving. Surely in it there are signs for those who give heed (to the call of the Messenger).

ayahs.text: They say: ''Allah has taken a son. Glory be to Him. He is self-sufficient! His is all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. Have you any authority to support (that Allah has taken a son)? Do you ascribe to Allah something of which you have no knowledge?
ayahs.translation: They say: ''Allah has taken a son. Glory be to Him. He is self-sufficient! His is all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. Have you any authority to support (that Allah has taken a son)? Do you ascribe to Allah something of which you have no knowledge?

ayahs.text: Tell them (O Muhammad): ''Indeed those who invent lies against Allah will never prosper.
ayahs.translation: Tell them (O Muhammad): ''Indeed those who invent lies against Allah will never prosper.

ayahs.text: They may enjoy the life of this world but in the end they must return to Us and then We shall cause them to taste severe chastisement for their disbelieving.''
ayahs.translation: They may enjoy the life of this world but in the end they must return to Us and then We shall cause them to taste severe chastisement for their disbelieving.''

ayahs.text: Narrate to them the story of Noah when he said to his people: ''My people! If my living in your midst and my effort to shake you out of heedlessness by reciting to you the revelations of Allah offend you then remember that I have put all my trust in Allah. So draw up your plan in concert with those whom you associate with Allah in His divinity leaving no part of it obscure and then put it into effect against me and give me no respite.
ayahs.translation: Narrate to them the story of Noah when he said to his people: ''My people! If my living in your midst and my effort to shake you out of heedlessness by reciting to you the revelations of Allah offend you then remember that I have put all my trust in Allah. So draw up your plan in concert with those whom you associate with Allah in His divinity leaving no part of it obscure and then put it into effect against me and give me no respite.

ayahs.text: When you turned your back on my admonition (what harm did you cause me?) I had asked you for no reward for my reward lies only with Allah and I am commanded to be of those who totally submit (to Him).
ayahs.translation: When you turned your back on my admonition (what harm did you cause me?) I had asked you for no reward for my reward lies only with Allah and I am commanded to be of those who totally submit (to Him).

ayahs.text: But they rejected Noah calling him a liar. So We saved him and those who were with him in the Ark and made them successors (to the authority in the land) and drowned all those who had rejected Our signs as false. Consider then the fate of those who had been warned (and still did not believe).
ayahs.translation: But they rejected Noah calling him a liar. So We saved him and those who were with him in the Ark and made them successors (to the authority in the land) and drowned all those who had rejected Our signs as false. Consider then the fate of those who had been warned (and still did not believe).

ayahs.text: Then We sent forth after him other Messengers each one to his people. They brought to them clear signs but they were not such as to believe in what they had rejected earlier as false. Thus do We seal the hearts of those who transgress.
ayahs.translation: Then We sent forth after him other Messengers each one to his people. They brought to them clear signs but they were not such as to believe in what they had rejected earlier as false. Thus do We seal the hearts of those who transgress.

ayahs.text: Then after them We sent forth Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh and his chiefs with Our signs but they waxed proud. They were a wicked people.
ayahs.translation: Then after them We sent forth Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh and his chiefs with Our signs but they waxed proud. They were a wicked people.

ayahs.text: And when truth came to them from Us they said: ''Indeed this is plain sorcery.
ayahs.translation: And when truth came to them from Us they said: ''Indeed this is plain sorcery.

ayahs.text: Moses said: ''Do you say this about the truth after it has come to you? Is this sorcery? You call this sorcery although sorcerers never come to a happy end.
ayahs.translation: Moses said: ''Do you say this about the truth after it has come to you? Is this sorcery? You call this sorcery although sorcerers never come to a happy end.

ayahs.text: They replied: ''Have you come to turn us away from the way of our forefathers that the two of you might become supreme in the land? We shall never accept what the two of you say.''
ayahs.translation: They replied: ''Have you come to turn us away from the way of our forefathers that the two of you might become supreme in the land? We shall never accept what the two of you say.''

ayahs.text: And Pharaoh said (to his) men: ''Bring every skilled sorcerer to me.''
ayahs.translation: And Pharaoh said (to his) men: ''Bring every skilled sorcerer to me.''

ayahs.text: And when the sorcerers came Moses said to them: ''Cast whatever you wish to cast.''
ayahs.translation: And when the sorcerers came Moses said to them: ''Cast whatever you wish to cast.''

ayahs.text: Then when they had cast (their staffs and ropes) Moses said: ''What you have produced is sheer sorcery. Allah will certainly reduce it to naught. Surely Allah does not set right the work of the mischief-makers.
ayahs.translation: Then when they had cast (their staffs and ropes) Moses said: ''What you have produced is sheer sorcery. Allah will certainly reduce it to naught. Surely Allah does not set right the work of the mischief-makers.

ayahs.text: Allah vindicates the truth by His commands howsoever much the guilty might detest that.''
ayahs.translation: Allah vindicates the truth by His commands howsoever much the guilty might detest that.''

ayahs.text: None but a few youths of Moses'' people accepted him fearing that Pharaoh and their own chiefs would persecute them. Indeed Pharaoh was mighty in the land he was among those who exceed all limits.
ayahs.translation: None but a few youths of Moses'' people accepted him fearing that Pharaoh and their own chiefs would persecute them. Indeed Pharaoh was mighty in the land he was among those who exceed all limits.

ayahs.text: Moses said: ''My people! If you believe in Allah and are truly Muslims then place your reliance on Him alone.''
ayahs.translation: Moses said: ''My people! If you believe in Allah and are truly Muslims then place your reliance on Him alone.''

ayahs.text: They replied: ''We place our reliance on Allah. Our Lord! Do not make us a trial for the oppressors
ayahs.translation: They replied: ''We place our reliance on Allah. Our Lord! Do not make us a trial for the oppressors

ayahs.text: and deliver us through Your mercy from the unbelievers.''
ayahs.translation: and deliver us through Your mercy from the unbelievers.''

ayahs.text: And We directed Moses and his brother: ''Prepare a few houses for your people in Egypt and make your houses a direction for them to pray and establish Prayer and give glad tidings to the people of faith.''
ayahs.translation: And We directed Moses and his brother: ''Prepare a few houses for your people in Egypt and make your houses a direction for them to pray and establish Prayer and give glad tidings to the people of faith.''

ayahs.text: Moses prayed: ''Our Lord! You bestowed upon Pharaoh and his nobles splendour and riches in the world. Our Lord! Have You done this that they may lead people astray from Your path? Our Lord! Obliterate their riches and harden their hearts that they may not believe until they observe the painful chastisement.
ayahs.translation: Moses prayed: ''Our Lord! You bestowed upon Pharaoh and his nobles splendour and riches in the world. Our Lord! Have You done this that they may lead people astray from Your path? Our Lord! Obliterate their riches and harden their hearts that they may not believe until they observe the painful chastisement.

ayahs.text: Allah responded: ''The prayer of the two of you is accepted. So keep steadfast and do not follow the path of the ignorant.
ayahs.translation: Allah responded: ''The prayer of the two of you is accepted. So keep steadfast and do not follow the path of the ignorant.

ayahs.text: And We led the Children of Israel across the sea. Then Pharaoh and his hosts pursued them in iniquity and transgression until Pharaoh cried out while he was drowning: ''I believe that there is no god but Allah in Whom the Children of Israel believe and I am also one of those who submit to Allah.
ayahs.translation: And We led the Children of Israel across the sea. Then Pharaoh and his hosts pursued them in iniquity and transgression until Pharaoh cried out while he was drowning: ''I believe that there is no god but Allah in Whom the Children of Israel believe and I am also one of those who submit to Allah.

ayahs.text: (Thereupon came the response): ''Now you believe although you disobeyed earlier and were among the mischief-makers.
ayahs.translation: (Thereupon came the response): ''Now you believe although you disobeyed earlier and were among the mischief-makers.

ayahs.text: We shall now save your corpse that you may serve as a sign of warning for all posterity although many men are heedless of Our signs.
ayahs.translation: We shall now save your corpse that you may serve as a sign of warning for all posterity although many men are heedless of Our signs.

ayahs.text: We settled the Children of Israel in a blessed land and provided them with all manner of good things. They only disagreed among themselves after knowledge (of the Truth had) come to them. Surely your Lord will judge among them on the Day of Resurrection concerning their disagreements.
ayahs.translation: We settled the Children of Israel in a blessed land and provided them with all manner of good things. They only disagreed among themselves after knowledge (of the Truth had) come to them. Surely your Lord will judge among them on the Day of Resurrection concerning their disagreements.

ayahs.text: Now if you are in doubt concerning what We have revealed to you then ask those who have been reading the Book before you. It is the truth that has come to you from your Lord so never become one of those who doubt
ayahs.translation: Now if you are in doubt concerning what We have revealed to you then ask those who have been reading the Book before you. It is the truth that has come to you from your Lord so never become one of those who doubt

ayahs.text: nor reject the Signs of Allah as false for then you shall be among the utter losers.
ayahs.translation: nor reject the Signs of Allah as false for then you shall be among the utter losers.

ayahs.text: Surely those against whom the word of your Lord has been fulfilled will not believe
ayahs.translation: Surely those against whom the word of your Lord has been fulfilled will not believe

ayahs.text: even if they witness every single Sign that might come to them until they are face to face with the painful chastisement
ayahs.translation: even if they witness every single Sign that might come to them until they are face to face with the painful chastisement

ayahs.text: Did it ever happen that the people of a town believed on seeing God''s chastisement and its believing profited them? (There is no such instance) except of the people of Yunus. When they believed We granted them reprieve from a humiliating chastisement in this world and We let them enjoy themselves for a while.
ayahs.translation: Did it ever happen that the people of a town believed on seeing God''s chastisement and its believing profited them? (There is no such instance) except of the people of Yunus. When they believed We granted them reprieve from a humiliating chastisement in this world and We let them enjoy themselves for a while.

ayahs.text: Had your Lord so willed all those who are on earth would have believed. Will you then force people into believing?
ayahs.translation: Had your Lord so willed all those who are on earth would have believed. Will you then force people into believing?

ayahs.text: No one can believe except by Allah''s leave and Allah lays abomination on those who do not use their understanding.
ayahs.translation: No one can believe except by Allah''s leave and Allah lays abomination on those who do not use their understanding.

ayahs.text: Tell them: ''Observe carefully all that is in the heavens and the earth.'' But no signs and warnings can avail those who are bent on not believing.
ayahs.translation: Tell them: ''Observe carefully all that is in the heavens and the earth.'' But no signs and warnings can avail those who are bent on not believing.

ayahs.text: What are they waiting for except to witness the repetition of the days of calamity that their predecessors witnessed? Tell them: ''Wait; I too am waiting with you.
ayahs.translation: What are they waiting for except to witness the repetition of the days of calamity that their predecessors witnessed? Tell them: ''Wait; I too am waiting with you.

ayahs.text: Then (when Allah''s wrath falls upon the wicked) We save our Messengers and also those who believe. It is incumbent on Us to deliver the believers.
ayahs.translation: Then (when Allah''s wrath falls upon the wicked) We save our Messengers and also those who believe. It is incumbent on Us to deliver the believers.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet!) tell them: ''O people! If you are still in doubt concerning my religion know that I do not serve those whom you serve beside Allah. I only serve Allah Who will cause (all of) you to die. I have been commanded to be one of those who believe
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet!) tell them: ''O people! If you are still in doubt concerning my religion know that I do not serve those whom you serve beside Allah. I only serve Allah Who will cause (all of) you to die. I have been commanded to be one of those who believe

ayahs.text: and to adhere exclusively and sincerely to the true faith and not to be one of those who associate others with Allah in His divinity.
ayahs.translation: and to adhere exclusively and sincerely to the true faith and not to be one of those who associate others with Allah in His divinity.

ayahs.text: Do not call upon any apart from Allah upon those who have no power to benefit or hurt you. For if you call upon others than Allah you will be reckoned among the wrong-doers.
ayahs.translation: Do not call upon any apart from Allah upon those who have no power to benefit or hurt you. For if you call upon others than Allah you will be reckoned among the wrong-doers.

ayahs.text: If Allah afflicts you with any hardship none other than He can remove it; and if He wills any good for you none can avert His bounty. He bestows good upon whomsoever of His servants He wills. He is All-Forgiving All-Merciful.''
ayahs.translation: If Allah afflicts you with any hardship none other than He can remove it; and if He wills any good for you none can avert His bounty. He bestows good upon whomsoever of His servants He wills. He is All-Forgiving All-Merciful.''

ayahs.text: Tell them (O Muhammad): ''O People! Truth has come to you from your Lord. Whosoever then follows the True Guidance does so for his own good; and whosoever strays his straying will be to his own hurt. I am no custodian over you.
ayahs.translation: Tell them (O Muhammad): ''O People! Truth has come to you from your Lord. Whosoever then follows the True Guidance does so for his own good; and whosoever strays his straying will be to his own hurt. I am no custodian over you.

ayahs.text: And follow (O Prophet!) whatever is revealed to you and remain patient until Allah brings forth His judgment. He is the best of those who judge.''
ayahs.translation: And follow (O Prophet!) whatever is revealed to you and remain patient until Allah brings forth His judgment. He is the best of those who judge.''

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Alif. Lam. Ra. This is a Divine Command whose contents have been made firm and set forth in detail; (a Command) from One Who is All-Wise All-Aware
verses.translation: Alif. Lam. Ra. This is a Divine Command whose contents have been made firm and set forth in detail; (a Command) from One Who is All-Wise All-Aware

verses.text: that you may worship none but Allah. Verily I have come to you as a warner and a bearer of good news from Him
verses.translation: that you may worship none but Allah. Verily I have come to you as a warner and a bearer of good news from Him

verses.text: that you may seek forgiveness of your Lord and turn to Him in repentance whereupon He will grant you a fair enjoyment of life until an appointed term and will bestow favour on everyone who merits favour. But should you turn away (from the truth) I fear for you the chastisement of an Awesome Day.
verses.translation: that you may seek forgiveness of your Lord and turn to Him in repentance whereupon He will grant you a fair enjoyment of life until an appointed term and will bestow favour on everyone who merits favour. But should you turn away (from the truth) I fear for you the chastisement of an Awesome Day.

verses.text: Unto Allah is your return and He has power to do everything.
verses.translation: Unto Allah is your return and He has power to do everything.

verses.text: Lo! They fold up their breasts that they may conceal themselves from Him. Surely when they cover themselves up with their garments Allah still knows well what they cover and what they reveal. Indeed He even knows the secrets hidden in the breasts of people.
verses.translation: Lo! They fold up their breasts that they may conceal themselves from Him. Surely when they cover themselves up with their garments Allah still knows well what they cover and what they reveal. Indeed He even knows the secrets hidden in the breasts of people.

verses.text: There is not a single moving creature on earth except that Allah is responsible for providing its sustenance. He knows where it dwells and where it will permanently rest. All this is recorded in a clear Book.
verses.translation: There is not a single moving creature on earth except that Allah is responsible for providing its sustenance. He knows where it dwells and where it will permanently rest. All this is recorded in a clear Book.

verses.text: And He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six days - and (before that) His Throne was upon the water that He may test you who of you is better in conduct. If you were to say (O Muhammad): ''All of you will surely be raised after death'' then those who disbelieve will certainly say: ''This is nothing but plain sorcery.
verses.translation: And He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six days - and (before that) His Throne was upon the water that He may test you who of you is better in conduct. If you were to say (O Muhammad): ''All of you will surely be raised after death'' then those who disbelieve will certainly say: ''This is nothing but plain sorcery.

verses.text: And were We to put off the chastisement from them for a determined period they will cry out: ''What withholds Him from chastising?'' Surely when the day of the chastisement comes nothing will avert it and the chastisement which they had ridiculed shall encompass them.
verses.translation: And were We to put off the chastisement from them for a determined period they will cry out: ''What withholds Him from chastising?'' Surely when the day of the chastisement comes nothing will avert it and the chastisement which they had ridiculed shall encompass them.

verses.text: If We ever favour man with Our Mercy and thereafter take it away from him he becomes utterly desperate totally ungrateful.
verses.translation: If We ever favour man with Our Mercy and thereafter take it away from him he becomes utterly desperate totally ungrateful.

verses.text: And if We let him taste favour after harm has touched him he says: ''All my ills are gone'' and he suddenly becomes exultant and boastful
verses.translation: And if We let him taste favour after harm has touched him he says: ''All my ills are gone'' and he suddenly becomes exultant and boastful

verses.text: except those who are patient and act righteously. Such shall have Allah''s forgiveness and a great reward.
verses.translation: except those who are patient and act righteously. Such shall have Allah''s forgiveness and a great reward.

verses.text: (O Messenger!) Let it not happen that you omit (to expound) a portion of what was revealed to you. And do not be distressed that they will say: ''Why was a treasure not bestowed upon him?'' or ''Why did no angel accompany him?'' For you are merely a warner whereas Allah has control over everything.
verses.translation: (O Messenger!) Let it not happen that you omit (to expound) a portion of what was revealed to you. And do not be distressed that they will say: ''Why was a treasure not bestowed upon him?'' or ''Why did no angel accompany him?'' For you are merely a warner whereas Allah has control over everything.

verses.text: Do they say: ''He has invented this Book himself?'' Say: ''If that is so bring ten surahs the like of it of your composition and call upon all (the deities) that you can to your help other than Allah. Do so if you are truthful.''
verses.translation: Do they say: ''He has invented this Book himself?'' Say: ''If that is so bring ten surahs the like of it of your composition and call upon all (the deities) that you can to your help other than Allah. Do so if you are truthful.''

verses.text: Then if (your deities) do not respond to your call for help feel assured that this Book was revealed with the knowledge of Allah and that there is no god but He. Will you then surrender (to this truth)?
verses.translation: Then if (your deities) do not respond to your call for help feel assured that this Book was revealed with the knowledge of Allah and that there is no god but He. Will you then surrender (to this truth)?

verses.text: Those who merely seek the present world and its adornment. We fully recompense them for their work in this world and they are made to suffer no diminution in it concerning what is their due.
verses.translation: Those who merely seek the present world and its adornment. We fully recompense them for their work in this world and they are made to suffer no diminution in it concerning what is their due.

verses.text: They are the ones who shall have nothing in the Hereafter except Fire. (There they shall come to know) that their deeds in the world have come to naught; and that whatever they have done is absolutely useless.
verses.translation: They are the ones who shall have nothing in the Hereafter except Fire. (There they shall come to know) that their deeds in the world have come to naught; and that whatever they have done is absolutely useless.

verses.text: Can it happen that he who enjoyed a clear evidence from his Lord  which is subsequently followed by a witness from Him (in his support) and prior to that was the Book of Moses revealed as a guide and a mercy - (would even such a person deny the truth in the manner of those who adore the life of this world)? Rather such persons are bound to believe in it. The Fire shall be promised resort of the groups of people that disbelieve. So be in no doubt about it for this indeed is the Truth from your Lord although most people do not believe.
verses.translation: Can it happen that he who enjoyed a clear evidence from his Lord  which is subsequently followed by a witness from Him (in his support) and prior to that was the Book of Moses revealed as a guide and a mercy - (would even such a person deny the truth in the manner of those who adore the life of this world)? Rather such persons are bound to believe in it. The Fire shall be promised resort of the groups of people that disbelieve. So be in no doubt about it for this indeed is the Truth from your Lord although most people do not believe.

verses.text: And who is a greater wrong-doer than he who invents a lie against Allah? Such persons will be set forth before their Lord and witnesses will testify: ''These are the ones who lied against their Lord.'' Lo! Allah''s curse be upon the wrong-doers;
verses.translation: And who is a greater wrong-doer than he who invents a lie against Allah? Such persons will be set forth before their Lord and witnesses will testify: ''These are the ones who lied against their Lord.'' Lo! Allah''s curse be upon the wrong-doers;

verses.text: upon those who bar people from the way of Allah and seek in it crookedness and disbelieve in the Hereafter.
verses.translation: upon those who bar people from the way of Allah and seek in it crookedness and disbelieve in the Hereafter.

verses.text: They had no power to frustrate Allah''s plan on earth nor did they have any protectors against Allah. Their chastisement will be doubled. They were unable to hear nor could they see.
verses.translation: They had no power to frustrate Allah''s plan on earth nor did they have any protectors against Allah. Their chastisement will be doubled. They were unable to hear nor could they see.

verses.text: They caused utter loss to themselves and all that they had invented failed them.
verses.translation: They caused utter loss to themselves and all that they had invented failed them.

verses.text: Doubtlessly they shall be the greatest losers in the Hereafter.
verses.translation: Doubtlessly they shall be the greatest losers in the Hereafter.

verses.text: As for those who believed and acted righteously and dedicated themselves totally to their Lord -they are the people of Paradise and there they shall abide forever.
verses.translation: As for those who believed and acted righteously and dedicated themselves totally to their Lord -they are the people of Paradise and there they shall abide forever.

verses.text: The example of the two parties is that one is blind and deaf and the other capable of seeing and hearing. Can the two be equal? Will you then not heed?''
verses.translation: The example of the two parties is that one is blind and deaf and the other capable of seeing and hearing. Can the two be equal? Will you then not heed?''

verses.text: (Such were the circumstances) when We sent forth Noah to his people. (He said): ''I have been sent to you to warn you plainly
verses.translation: (Such were the circumstances) when We sent forth Noah to his people. (He said): ''I have been sent to you to warn you plainly

verses.text: that you may worship none but Allah or else I fear for you the chastisement of a Grievous Day.
verses.translation: that you may worship none but Allah or else I fear for you the chastisement of a Grievous Day.

verses.text: The elders among Noah''s own people who had refused to follow him responded: ''We see you as merely a human being like ourselves. Nor do we find among those who follow you except the lowliest of our folk those who follow you without any proper reason. We see nothing in you to suggest that you are any better than us. Rather we believe you to be liars.''
verses.translation: The elders among Noah''s own people who had refused to follow him responded: ''We see you as merely a human being like ourselves. Nor do we find among those who follow you except the lowliest of our folk those who follow you without any proper reason. We see nothing in you to suggest that you are any better than us. Rather we believe you to be liars.''

verses.text: Noah said: ''My people! If I base myself on a clear evidence from my Lord and I have also been blessed by His mercy to which you have been blind how can we force it upon you despite your aversion to it?
verses.translation: Noah said: ''My people! If I base myself on a clear evidence from my Lord and I have also been blessed by His mercy to which you have been blind how can we force it upon you despite your aversion to it?

verses.text: My people! I seek no recompense from you. My recompense is only with Allah. Nor will I drive away those who believe. They are destined to meet their Lord. But I find you to be an ignorant people.
verses.translation: My people! I seek no recompense from you. My recompense is only with Allah. Nor will I drive away those who believe. They are destined to meet their Lord. But I find you to be an ignorant people.

verses.text: My people! Were I to drive the people of faith away who will protect me from (the chastisement of) Allah? Do you not understand even this much?
verses.translation: My people! Were I to drive the people of faith away who will protect me from (the chastisement of) Allah? Do you not understand even this much?

verses.text: I do not say to you that I possess Allah''s treasures nor that I have access to the realm beyond the ken of perception nor do I claim to be an angel nor do I say regarding those whom you look upon with disdain that Allah will not bestow any good upon them. Allah knows best what is in their hearts. Were I to say so I would be one of the wrong-doers.''
verses.translation: I do not say to you that I possess Allah''s treasures nor that I have access to the realm beyond the ken of perception nor do I claim to be an angel nor do I say regarding those whom you look upon with disdain that Allah will not bestow any good upon them. Allah knows best what is in their hearts. Were I to say so I would be one of the wrong-doers.''

verses.text: They said: ''O Noah! Surely you have disputed with us and have prolonged your dispute. Now bring upon us the chastisement that you threaten us with; do so if you are truthful.''
verses.translation: They said: ''O Noah! Surely you have disputed with us and have prolonged your dispute. Now bring upon us the chastisement that you threaten us with; do so if you are truthful.''

verses.text: Noah said: ''Only Allah will bring it upon you if He so wills and you will be utterly unable to frustrate that.
verses.translation: Noah said: ''Only Allah will bring it upon you if He so wills and you will be utterly unable to frustrate that.

verses.text: If I want to give you good advice it will not profit you if Allah Himself has decided to let you go astray. He is your Lord and to Him will you be returned.''
verses.translation: If I want to give you good advice it will not profit you if Allah Himself has decided to let you go astray. He is your Lord and to Him will you be returned.''

verses.text: (O Muhammad!) Do they say that he himself has forged this message? Tell them: ''If I have forged this the guilt of it will fall upon me but I am not responsible for the crimes you are committing.
verses.translation: (O Muhammad!) Do they say that he himself has forged this message? Tell them: ''If I have forged this the guilt of it will fall upon me but I am not responsible for the crimes you are committing.

verses.text: It was revealed to Noah that no more of your people other than those who already believe will ever come to believe. So do not grieve over their deeds
verses.translation: It was revealed to Noah that no more of your people other than those who already believe will ever come to believe. So do not grieve over their deeds

verses.text: and build the Ark under Our eyes and Our direction. And do not supplicate Me concerning those who have engaged in wrong-doing. They are doomed to be drowned.
verses.translation: and build the Ark under Our eyes and Our direction. And do not supplicate Me concerning those who have engaged in wrong-doing. They are doomed to be drowned.

verses.text: As Noah was building the Ark whenever the elders of his nation passed by him they would scoff at him. He said: ''If you scoff at us we too scoff at you in like manner.
verses.translation: As Noah was building the Ark whenever the elders of his nation passed by him they would scoff at him. He said: ''If you scoff at us we too scoff at you in like manner.

verses.text: You will come to know who will be struck by a humiliating chastisement and who will be subjected to an unceasing torment.
verses.translation: You will come to know who will be struck by a humiliating chastisement and who will be subjected to an unceasing torment.

verses.text: Thus it was until Our command came to pass and the oven boiled over. We said: ''Take into the Ark a pair of every species; and take your own family except those who have already been declared (as unworthy); and also take everyone who believes. But those who along with him had believed were indeed just a few.
verses.translation: Thus it was until Our command came to pass and the oven boiled over. We said: ''Take into the Ark a pair of every species; and take your own family except those who have already been declared (as unworthy); and also take everyone who believes. But those who along with him had believed were indeed just a few.

verses.text: Noah said: '' Embark in it. In the name of Allah is it sailing and its anchorage. My Lord is Ever Forgiving Most Merciful.
verses.translation: Noah said: '' Embark in it. In the name of Allah is it sailing and its anchorage. My Lord is Ever Forgiving Most Merciful.

verses.text: The Ark sailed along with them amid mountain-like waves. Noah spotting his son at a distance called out to him: ''My son embark with us. and do not be with the unbelievers.''
verses.translation: The Ark sailed along with them amid mountain-like waves. Noah spotting his son at a distance called out to him: ''My son embark with us. and do not be with the unbelievers.''

verses.text: The son replied: ''I will go to a mountain for refuge and it will save me from the water.'' Noah said: ''None can save anyone today from the command of Allah except those on whom He may have mercy.'' Thereupon a wave swept in between the two and he was drowned.
verses.translation: The son replied: ''I will go to a mountain for refuge and it will save me from the water.'' Noah said: ''None can save anyone today from the command of Allah except those on whom He may have mercy.'' Thereupon a wave swept in between the two and he was drowned.

verses.text: And the Command was given: ''Earth! Swallow up your water''; and: ''Heavens! Abate!'' So the water subsided the command was fulfilled and the Ark settled on Mount Judi and it was said: ''Away with the wrong-doing folk!''
verses.translation: And the Command was given: ''Earth! Swallow up your water''; and: ''Heavens! Abate!'' So the water subsided the command was fulfilled and the Ark settled on Mount Judi and it was said: ''Away with the wrong-doing folk!''

verses.text: And Noah called out to his Lord saying: ''My Lord! My son is of my family. Surely Your promise is true and You are the best of those who judge.''
verses.translation: And Noah called out to his Lord saying: ''My Lord! My son is of my family. Surely Your promise is true and You are the best of those who judge.''

verses.text: In response Noah was told: ''Most certainly he is not of your family; verily he is of unrighteous conduct. So do not ask of Me for that concerning which you have no knowledge. I admonish you never to act like the ignorant ones.
verses.translation: In response Noah was told: ''Most certainly he is not of your family; verily he is of unrighteous conduct. So do not ask of Me for that concerning which you have no knowledge. I admonish you never to act like the ignorant ones.

verses.text: Noah said: ''My Lord! I take refuge with You that I should ask you for that concerning which I have no knowledge. And if You do not forgive me and do not show mercy to me I shall be among the losers.
verses.translation: Noah said: ''My Lord! I take refuge with You that I should ask you for that concerning which I have no knowledge. And if You do not forgive me and do not show mercy to me I shall be among the losers.

verses.text: It was said: ''Noah! Disembark with Our peace and with blessings upon you and upon those who are with you. There are also people whom We shall allow to enjoy themselves for a while and then a painful chastisement from Us shall afflict them.''
verses.translation: It was said: ''Noah! Disembark with Our peace and with blessings upon you and upon those who are with you. There are also people whom We shall allow to enjoy themselves for a while and then a painful chastisement from Us shall afflict them.''

verses.text: We reveal to you these accounts of matters that are beyond the reach of perception. Neither you nor your people knew about them before this. Be patient then. Surely the good end is for the God-fearing.
verses.translation: We reveal to you these accounts of matters that are beyond the reach of perception. Neither you nor your people knew about them before this. Be patient then. Surely the good end is for the God-fearing.

verses.text: And to ''Ad We sent their brother Hud. He said: ''My people! Serve Allah: you have no god but He. (In attributing partners to Allah) you have merely been fabricating lies.
verses.translation: And to ''Ad We sent their brother Hud. He said: ''My people! Serve Allah: you have no god but He. (In attributing partners to Allah) you have merely been fabricating lies.

verses.text: My people! I seek no reward from you for my work. My reward lies only with Him Who created me. Do you not understand anything?
verses.translation: My people! I seek no reward from you for my work. My reward lies only with Him Who created me. Do you not understand anything?

verses.text: My people! Ask your Lord for forgiveness and turn to Him in repentance. He will shower abundant rains upon you from the heaven and will add strength to your strength. Do not turn away as those given to guilt.''
verses.translation: My people! Ask your Lord for forgiveness and turn to Him in repentance. He will shower abundant rains upon you from the heaven and will add strength to your strength. Do not turn away as those given to guilt.''

verses.text: They said: ''O Hud! You have not brought to us any clear evidence and we are not going to forsake our gods merely because you say so. We are not going to believe you.
verses.translation: They said: ''O Hud! You have not brought to us any clear evidence and we are not going to forsake our gods merely because you say so. We are not going to believe you.

verses.text: All we can say is that some god of ours has afflicted you with evil. Hud said: ''Indeed I take Allah as my witness and you too to be my witnesses that I have nothing to do with your associating with Allah
verses.translation: All we can say is that some god of ours has afflicted you with evil. Hud said: ''Indeed I take Allah as my witness and you too to be my witnesses that I have nothing to do with your associating with Allah

verses.text: others than Him in His divinity. So conspire against me all of you and give me no respite.
verses.translation: others than Him in His divinity. So conspire against me all of you and give me no respite.

verses.text: I have put my trust in Allah Who is my Lord and your Lord. There is no moving creature but that He holds it by its forelock. Surely My Lord is on the straight path.
verses.translation: I have put my trust in Allah Who is my Lord and your Lord. There is no moving creature but that He holds it by its forelock. Surely My Lord is on the straight path.

verses.text: If you then turn away (from the truth) know that I have delivered the message with which I was sent to you. Now my Lord will set up another people in place of you and you shall in no way be able to harm Him. Surely my Lord keeps a watch over everything.''
verses.translation: If you then turn away (from the truth) know that I have delivered the message with which I was sent to you. Now my Lord will set up another people in place of you and you shall in no way be able to harm Him. Surely my Lord keeps a watch over everything.''

verses.text: And when Our command came to pass We delivered Hud together with those who shared his faith out of Our mercy. We delivered them from a woeful chastisement.
verses.translation: And when Our command came to pass We delivered Hud together with those who shared his faith out of Our mercy. We delivered them from a woeful chastisement.

verses.text: Such were ''Ad. They repudiated the signs of their Lord disobeyed His Messengers and followed the bidding of every tyrannical enemy of the truth.
verses.translation: Such were ''Ad. They repudiated the signs of their Lord disobeyed His Messengers and followed the bidding of every tyrannical enemy of the truth.

verses.text: They were pursued by a curse in this world and so will they be on the Day of Judgement. Lo ''Ad disbelieved in the Lord. Lo ruined are ''Ad the people of Hud.
verses.translation: They were pursued by a curse in this world and so will they be on the Day of Judgement. Lo ''Ad disbelieved in the Lord. Lo ruined are ''Ad the people of Hud.

verses.text: And to Thamud We sent their brother Salih. He said: ''My people! Serve Allah; you have no god butHe. He brought you into being out of the earth and has made you dwell in it. So ask Him to forgive you and do turn towards Him in repentance. Indeed My Lord is near responsive to prayers.''
verses.translation: And to Thamud We sent their brother Salih. He said: ''My people! Serve Allah; you have no god butHe. He brought you into being out of the earth and has made you dwell in it. So ask Him to forgive you and do turn towards Him in repentance. Indeed My Lord is near responsive to prayers.''

verses.text: They said: ''O Salih! Until now you were one of those among us on whom we placed great hopes. Now would you forbid us to worship what our forefathers were wont to worship?Indeed we are in disquieting doubt about what you are calling us to.
verses.translation: They said: ''O Salih! Until now you were one of those among us on whom we placed great hopes. Now would you forbid us to worship what our forefathers were wont to worship?Indeed we are in disquieting doubt about what you are calling us to.

verses.text: Salih said: ''My people! What do you think? If I had a clear evidence from my Lord and then He also bestowed His mercy upon me who will rescue me from the punishment of Allah if I still disobey Him? You can only make me lose even more.
verses.translation: Salih said: ''My people! What do you think? If I had a clear evidence from my Lord and then He also bestowed His mercy upon me who will rescue me from the punishment of Allah if I still disobey Him? You can only make me lose even more.

verses.text: My people! This she-camel of Allah is a Sign for you. So let her pasture on Allah''s earth and do not hurt her or else some chastisement - which is near at hand -shall overtake you.''
verses.translation: My people! This she-camel of Allah is a Sign for you. So let her pasture on Allah''s earth and do not hurt her or else some chastisement - which is near at hand -shall overtake you.''

verses.text: But they slaughtered her. Thereupon Salih warned them: ''Enjoy yourselves in your homes for a maximum of three days. This is a promise which shall not be belied.''
verses.translation: But they slaughtered her. Thereupon Salih warned them: ''Enjoy yourselves in your homes for a maximum of three days. This is a promise which shall not be belied.''

verses.text: Then when Our command came to pass We saved Salih and those who shared his faith by Our mercy from the disgrace of that day. Truly Your Lord is All-Strong All-Mighty.
verses.translation: Then when Our command came to pass We saved Salih and those who shared his faith by Our mercy from the disgrace of that day. Truly Your Lord is All-Strong All-Mighty.

verses.text: And the Blast overtook those who were wont to do wrong and then they lay lifeless in their homes
verses.translation: And the Blast overtook those who were wont to do wrong and then they lay lifeless in their homes

verses.text: as though they had never lived there before. Oh verily the Thamud denied their Lord! Oh the Thamud were destroyed.
verses.translation: as though they had never lived there before. Oh verily the Thamud denied their Lord! Oh the Thamud were destroyed.

verses.text: Indeed Our messengers came to Abraham bearing glad tidings. They greeted him with ''peace'' and Abraham answered back to them ''peace'' and hurriedly brought to them a roasted calf.
verses.translation: Indeed Our messengers came to Abraham bearing glad tidings. They greeted him with ''peace'' and Abraham answered back to them ''peace'' and hurriedly brought to them a roasted calf.

verses.text: When he perceived that their hands were not stretching toit he mistrusted them and felt afraid of them. They said: ''Do not be afraid. We have been sent to the people of Lot.
verses.translation: When he perceived that their hands were not stretching toit he mistrusted them and felt afraid of them. They said: ''Do not be afraid. We have been sent to the people of Lot.

verses.text: And Abraham''s wife was standing by and on hearing this she laughed. And We gave her the good news of (the birth of) Isaac and after Isaac of Jacob.
verses.translation: And Abraham''s wife was standing by and on hearing this she laughed. And We gave her the good news of (the birth of) Isaac and after Isaac of Jacob.

verses.text: She said: ''Woe is me! Shall I bear a child now that I am an old woman and my husband is much too age-stricken? This is indeed strange!''
verses.translation: She said: ''Woe is me! Shall I bear a child now that I am an old woman and my husband is much too age-stricken? This is indeed strange!''

verses.text: They said: ''Do you wonder at Allah''s decree? Allah''s mercy and His blessings be upon you O people of the house. Surely He is Praiseworthy Glorious.''
verses.translation: They said: ''Do you wonder at Allah''s decree? Allah''s mercy and His blessings be upon you O people of the house. Surely He is Praiseworthy Glorious.''

verses.text: Thus when fear had left Abraham and the good news had been conveyed to him he began to dispute with Us concerning the people of Lot.
verses.translation: Thus when fear had left Abraham and the good news had been conveyed to him he began to dispute with Us concerning the people of Lot.

verses.text: Surely Abraham was forbearing tenderhearted and oft-turning to Allah.
verses.translation: Surely Abraham was forbearing tenderhearted and oft-turning to Allah.

verses.text: Thereupon (Our angels) said to him: ''O Abraham! Desist from this for indeed your Lord''s command has come; and a chastisement which cannot be averted is about to befall them.''
verses.translation: Thereupon (Our angels) said to him: ''O Abraham! Desist from this for indeed your Lord''s command has come; and a chastisement which cannot be averted is about to befall them.''

verses.text: And when Our messengers came to Lot he was perturbed by their coming and felt troubled on their account and said: ''This is a distressing day.
verses.translation: And when Our messengers came to Lot he was perturbed by their coming and felt troubled on their account and said: ''This is a distressing day.

verses.text: And his people came to him rushing. Before this they were wont to commit evil deeds. Lot said: ''My people! Here are my daughters; they are purer for you. Have fear of Allah and do not disgrace me concerning my guests. Is there not even one right-minded person in your midst?''
verses.translation: And his people came to him rushing. Before this they were wont to commit evil deeds. Lot said: ''My people! Here are my daughters; they are purer for you. Have fear of Allah and do not disgrace me concerning my guests. Is there not even one right-minded person in your midst?''

verses.text: They said: ''Surely you already know that we have nothing to do with your daughters. You also know well what we want.''
verses.translation: They said: ''Surely you already know that we have nothing to do with your daughters. You also know well what we want.''

verses.text: He said: ''Would that I had the strength to set you straight or could seek refuge in some powerful support.''
verses.translation: He said: ''Would that I had the strength to set you straight or could seek refuge in some powerful support.''

verses.text: Thereupon the angels said: ''O Lot! We indeed are messengers of your Lord. And your people will in no way be able to hurt you. So depart with your family in a part of the night and let none of you turn around excepting your wife (who shall not go); for what will befall them shall also befall her. In the morning their promised hour will come. Is not the morning near?''
verses.translation: Thereupon the angels said: ''O Lot! We indeed are messengers of your Lord. And your people will in no way be able to hurt you. So depart with your family in a part of the night and let none of you turn around excepting your wife (who shall not go); for what will befall them shall also befall her. In the morning their promised hour will come. Is not the morning near?''

verses.text: And when Our command came to pass We turned the town upside down and rained on it stones of baked clay one on another
verses.translation: And when Our command came to pass We turned the town upside down and rained on it stones of baked clay one on another

verses.text: marked from your Lord. Such punishment is not far from the wrong-doers.
verses.translation: marked from your Lord. Such punishment is not far from the wrong-doers.

verses.text: And to (the people of) Midian We sent their brother Shu''ayb. He said: ''My people! Serve Allah; you have no god but He. And do not diminish the measure and weight. Indeed I see that you are prospering now but I fear for you the chastisement of an encompassing day in the future.
verses.translation: And to (the people of) Midian We sent their brother Shu''ayb. He said: ''My people! Serve Allah; you have no god but He. And do not diminish the measure and weight. Indeed I see that you are prospering now but I fear for you the chastisement of an encompassing day in the future.

verses.text: My people! Give full measure and weight with justice do not diminish the goods of others and do not go about creating corruption in the land.
verses.translation: My people! Give full measure and weight with justice do not diminish the goods of others and do not go about creating corruption in the land.

verses.text: The gains that Allah lets you retain are better for you if you indeed believe. In any case I have not been appointed a keeper over you.''
verses.translation: The gains that Allah lets you retain are better for you if you indeed believe. In any case I have not been appointed a keeper over you.''

verses.text: They replied: ''O Shu''ayb! Does your Prayer enjoin upon you that we should forsake the deities whom our forefathers worshipped or that we should give up using our wealth as we please? Do you fancy that you and only you are forbearing and rightly-directed?''
verses.translation: They replied: ''O Shu''ayb! Does your Prayer enjoin upon you that we should forsake the deities whom our forefathers worshipped or that we should give up using our wealth as we please? Do you fancy that you and only you are forbearing and rightly-directed?''

verses.text: Shu''ayb said: ''My people! What do you think? If I stand on clear evidence from my Lord and He has also provided me a handsome provision from Himself -(should I still be ungrateful to Him and share your error and iniquity?) Nor do I desire to act contrary to what I admonish you. I desire nothing but to set things right as far as I can. My succour is only with Allah. In Him have I put my trust and to Him do I always turn.
verses.translation: Shu''ayb said: ''My people! What do you think? If I stand on clear evidence from my Lord and He has also provided me a handsome provision from Himself -(should I still be ungrateful to Him and share your error and iniquity?) Nor do I desire to act contrary to what I admonish you. I desire nothing but to set things right as far as I can. My succour is only with Allah. In Him have I put my trust and to Him do I always turn.

verses.text: My people! Let not your opposition to me lead you to guilt that would bring upon you the chastisement that struck earlier the people of Noah and the people of Hud and the people of Salih. And the land of the people of Lot is not far from you!
verses.translation: My people! Let not your opposition to me lead you to guilt that would bring upon you the chastisement that struck earlier the people of Noah and the people of Hud and the people of Salih. And the land of the people of Lot is not far from you!

verses.text: Seek the forgiveness of your Lord and turn to Him in repentance. Surely my Lord is Ever Merciful Most Loving.
verses.translation: Seek the forgiveness of your Lord and turn to Him in repentance. Surely my Lord is Ever Merciful Most Loving.

verses.text: They said: ''O Shu''ayb! We do not understand much of what you say. Indeed we see you weak in our midst. Were it not for your kinsmen we would surely have stoned you for you have no strength to overpower us.
verses.translation: They said: ''O Shu''ayb! We do not understand much of what you say. Indeed we see you weak in our midst. Were it not for your kinsmen we would surely have stoned you for you have no strength to overpower us.

verses.text: Shu''ayb said: ''My people are my kinsmen mightier with you than Allah that you (hold the kinsmen in awe while) you cast Allah behind your back? Surely my Lord encompasses all that you do.
verses.translation: Shu''ayb said: ''My people are my kinsmen mightier with you than Allah that you (hold the kinsmen in awe while) you cast Allah behind your back? Surely my Lord encompasses all that you do.

verses.text: My people! Go on working according to your way and I will keep working (according to mine). Soon you will come to know who will be afflicted by a humiliating chastisement and who will be proved a liar. And I too shall watch with you.''
verses.translation: My people! Go on working according to your way and I will keep working (according to mine). Soon you will come to know who will be afflicted by a humiliating chastisement and who will be proved a liar. And I too shall watch with you.''

verses.text: And when Our command came to pass We delivered Shu''ayb and those who shared his faith out of Our mercy and the Blast seized those who were engaged in wrong-doing so they lay lifeless in their homes
