verses.text: It is all the same for Him whether any of you says a thing secretly or says it loudly and whether one hides oneself in the darkness of night or struts about in broad daylight.
verses.translation: It is all the same for Him whether any of you says a thing secretly or says it loudly and whether one hides oneself in the darkness of night or struts about in broad daylight.

verses.text: There are guardians over everyone both before him and behind him who guard him by Allah''s command. Verily Allah does not change a people''s condition unless they change their inner selves. And when Allah decides to make a people suffer punishment no one can avert it. Nor can any be of help to such a people against Allah.
verses.translation: There are guardians over everyone both before him and behind him who guard him by Allah''s command. Verily Allah does not change a people''s condition unless they change their inner selves. And when Allah decides to make a people suffer punishment no one can avert it. Nor can any be of help to such a people against Allah.

verses.text: He it is Who causes you to see lightning that inspires you with both fear and hope and He it is Who whips up heavy clouds.
verses.translation: He it is Who causes you to see lightning that inspires you with both fear and hope and He it is Who whips up heavy clouds.

verses.text: The thunder celebrates His praise and holiness and the angels too celebrate His praise for awe of Him. He hurls thunderbolts striking with them whom He wills while they are engaged in disputation concerning Allah. He is Mighty in His contriving.
verses.translation: The thunder celebrates His praise and holiness and the angels too celebrate His praise for awe of Him. He hurls thunderbolts striking with them whom He wills while they are engaged in disputation concerning Allah. He is Mighty in His contriving.

verses.text: To Him alone should all prayer be addressed for those to whom they do address their prayers beside Him are altogether powerless to respond to them. The example of praying to any other than Allah is that of a man who stretches out his hands to water asking it to reach his mouth although water has no power to reach his mouth. The prayers of the unbelievers are a sheer waste.
verses.translation: To Him alone should all prayer be addressed for those to whom they do address their prayers beside Him are altogether powerless to respond to them. The example of praying to any other than Allah is that of a man who stretches out his hands to water asking it to reach his mouth although water has no power to reach his mouth. The prayers of the unbelievers are a sheer waste.

verses.text: All that is in the heavens and the earth prostrates itself whether willingly or by force before Allah; and so do their shadows in the morning and in the evening.
verses.translation: All that is in the heavens and the earth prostrates itself whether willingly or by force before Allah; and so do their shadows in the morning and in the evening.

verses.text: Ask them: ""Who is the Lord of the heavens and the earth?"" Say: ""Allah."" Tell them: ""Have you taken beside Him as your patrons those who do not have the power to benefit or to hurt even themselves?"" Say: ""Can the blind and the seeing be deemed equals? Or can light and darkness be deemed equals?"" If that is not so then have those whom they associate with Allah in His Divinity ever created anything like what Allah did so that the question of creation has become dubious to them? Say: ""Allah is the creator of everything. He is the One the Irresistible.""
verses.translation: Ask them: ""Who is the Lord of the heavens and the earth?"" Say: ""Allah."" Tell them: ""Have you taken beside Him as your patrons those who do not have the power to benefit or to hurt even themselves?"" Say: ""Can the blind and the seeing be deemed equals? Or can light and darkness be deemed equals?"" If that is not so then have those whom they associate with Allah in His Divinity ever created anything like what Allah did so that the question of creation has become dubious to them? Say: ""Allah is the creator of everything. He is the One the Irresistible.""

verses.text: Allah sends down water from the heavens and the river-beds flow each according to its measure and the torrent carries along a swelling scum. In like manner from that metal which they smelt in the fire to make ornaments and utensils there arises scum like it. Thus does Allah depict truth and falsehood. As for the scum it passes away as dross; but that which benefits mankind abides on the earth. Thus does Allah explain (the truth) through examples.
verses.translation: Allah sends down water from the heavens and the river-beds flow each according to its measure and the torrent carries along a swelling scum. In like manner from that metal which they smelt in the fire to make ornaments and utensils there arises scum like it. Thus does Allah depict truth and falsehood. As for the scum it passes away as dross; but that which benefits mankind abides on the earth. Thus does Allah explain (the truth) through examples.

verses.text: There is good reward for those who respond to the call of their Lord. And those who do not respond to their Lord (a time will come when) they shall offer all they have - even if they have all the riches of the world and the like of it besides to redeem themselves (from the chastisement of Allah). They will be subjected to a severe reckoning and Hell shall be their refuge. What a wretched resting place it is!
verses.translation: There is good reward for those who respond to the call of their Lord. And those who do not respond to their Lord (a time will come when) they shall offer all they have - even if they have all the riches of the world and the like of it besides to redeem themselves (from the chastisement of Allah). They will be subjected to a severe reckoning and Hell shall be their refuge. What a wretched resting place it is!

verses.text: He who knows that the Book which has been sent to you from your Lord is the Truth is he like him who is blind to that truth? It is only people of understanding who take heed:
verses.translation: He who knows that the Book which has been sent to you from your Lord is the Truth is he like him who is blind to that truth? It is only people of understanding who take heed:

verses.text: those who fulfil their covenant with Allah and do not break their compact after firmly confirming it;
verses.translation: those who fulfil their covenant with Allah and do not break their compact after firmly confirming it;

verses.text: who join together the ties which Allah has bidden to be joined; who fear their Lord and dread lest they are subjected to severe reckoning;
verses.translation: who join together the ties which Allah has bidden to be joined; who fear their Lord and dread lest they are subjected to severe reckoning;

verses.text: who are steadfast in seeking the good pleasure of their Lord; who establish Prayer and spend both secretly and openly out of the wealth We have provided them and who ward off evil with good. Theirs shall be the ultimate abode
verses.translation: who are steadfast in seeking the good pleasure of their Lord; who establish Prayer and spend both secretly and openly out of the wealth We have provided them and who ward off evil with good. Theirs shall be the ultimate abode

verses.text: - the Ever-lasting Gardens which they shall enter and so shall the righteous from among their fathers and their spouses and their offspring. And angels shall enter unto them from every gate and say:
verses.translation: - the Ever-lasting Gardens which they shall enter and so shall the righteous from among their fathers and their spouses and their offspring. And angels shall enter unto them from every gate and say:

verses.text: Peace be upon you. You merit this reward for your steadfastness."" How excellent is the ultimate abode!
verses.translation: Peace be upon you. You merit this reward for your steadfastness."" How excellent is the ultimate abode!

verses.text: As for those who break the covenant of Allah after firmly confirming it who cut asunder the ties that Allah has commanded to be joined and who create corruption in the land: Allah''s curse shall be upon them and theirs shall be a wretched abode (in the Hereafter).
verses.translation: As for those who break the covenant of Allah after firmly confirming it who cut asunder the ties that Allah has commanded to be joined and who create corruption in the land: Allah''s curse shall be upon them and theirs shall be a wretched abode (in the Hereafter).

verses.text: Allah grants the provision to whomsoever He wills abundantly and grants others in strict measure. They exult in the life of the world although compared with the Hereafter the life of the world is no more than temporary enjoyment.
verses.translation: Allah grants the provision to whomsoever He wills abundantly and grants others in strict measure. They exult in the life of the world although compared with the Hereafter the life of the world is no more than temporary enjoyment.

verses.text: Those who have rejected (the message of Muhammad) say: ""Why has no sign been sent down upon him from his Lord?"" Tell them: ""Allah lets go astray those whom He wills and guides to Himself those who turn to Him.""
verses.translation: Those who have rejected (the message of Muhammad) say: ""Why has no sign been sent down upon him from his Lord?"" Tell them: ""Allah lets go astray those whom He wills and guides to Himself those who turn to Him.""

verses.text: Such are the ones who believe (in the message of the Prophet) and whose hearts find rest in the remembrance of Allah. Surely in Allah''s remembrance do hearts find rest.
verses.translation: Such are the ones who believe (in the message of the Prophet) and whose hearts find rest in the remembrance of Allah. Surely in Allah''s remembrance do hearts find rest.

verses.text: So those who believe (in the message of the Truth) and do good are destined for happiness and a blissful end.
verses.translation: So those who believe (in the message of the Truth) and do good are destined for happiness and a blissful end.

verses.text: Thus have We sent you as a Messenger to a community before which many other communities have passed away that you may recite to them whatever We have revealed to you. And yet they deny the Lord of Mercy. Say to them: ""He is my Lord there is no god but Him. In Him I have placed all my trust and to Him I shall return.""
verses.translation: Thus have We sent you as a Messenger to a community before which many other communities have passed away that you may recite to them whatever We have revealed to you. And yet they deny the Lord of Mercy. Say to them: ""He is my Lord there is no god but Him. In Him I have placed all my trust and to Him I shall return.""

verses.text: And what would have happened were a Qur''an to be revealed wherewith mountains could be set in motion or the earth cleft or the dead made to speak? (To show such signs is not at all difficult for) everything rests entirely with Allah. So do not the people of faith (still look forward to such a sign in response to the demand of the unbelievers and) despair as a result of knowing that had Allah so willed He could have guided all to the Truth. Misfortune continues to afflict the unbelievers on account of their misdeeds or to befall on locations close to their habitation. This will continue until Allah''s promise (of chastisement) is fulfilled. Indeed Allah does not go back upon His promise.
verses.translation: And what would have happened were a Qur''an to be revealed wherewith mountains could be set in motion or the earth cleft or the dead made to speak? This will continue until Allah''s promise (of chastisement) is fulfilled. Indeed Allah does not go back upon His promise.

verses.text: Surely the Messengers before you were ridiculed but I always initially granted respite to those who disbelieved and then I seized them (with chastisement). Then how awesome was My chastisement!
verses.translation: Surely the Messengers before you were ridiculed but I always initially granted respite to those who disbelieved and then I seized them (with chastisement). Then how awesome was My chastisement!

verses.text: Is it then in regard to Him Who watches over the deeds of every person that they are acting blasphemously by setting up His associates? Tell them: ""Name those associates (if Allah Himself has made them His associates)! Or are you informing Allah of something the existence of which He does not even know?"" Or do people arbitrarily utter empty words? Indeed their foul contriving has been made to seem fair to the unbelievers and they have been barred from finding the Right Way. Whomsoever Allah lets go astray will have none to guide him.
verses.translation: Is it then in regard to Him Who watches over the deeds of every person that they are acting blasphemously by setting up His associates? Tell them: ""Name those associates (if Allah Himself has made them His associates)! Or are you informing Allah of something the existence of which He does not even know?"" Or do people arbitrarily utter empty words? Indeed their foul contriving has been made to seem fair to the unbelievers and they have been barred from finding the Right Way. Whomsoever Allah lets go astray will have none to guide him.

verses.text: They shall suffer chastisement in the life of the world and surely the chastisement of the Hereafter is even more grievous. None has the power to shield them from (the chastisement of) Allah.
verses.translation: They shall suffer chastisement in the life of the world and surely the chastisement of the Hereafter is even more grievous. None has the power to shield them from (the chastisement of) Allah.

verses.text: And such will be the Paradise promised to the God-fearing: rivers will flow beneath it its fruits will be eternal and so will be its blissful shade. That is the ultimate destiny of the God-fearing while Fire is the destiny of the unbelievers.
verses.translation: And such will be the Paradise promised to the God-fearing: rivers will flow beneath it its fruits will be eternal and so will be its blissful shade. That is the ultimate destiny of the God-fearing while Fire is the destiny of the unbelievers.

verses.text: Those upon whom We bestowed the Scriptures earlier rejoice at the Book revealed to you while there are also some among different groups that reject part of it. Tell them: ""I have only been commanded to serve Allah and not to associate anyone with Him. To Him do I call and to Him is my return.""
verses.translation: Those upon whom We bestowed the Scriptures earlier rejoice at the Book revealed to you while there are also some among different groups that reject part of it. Tell them: ""I have only been commanded to serve Allah and not to associate anyone with Him. To Him do I call and to Him is my return.""

verses.text: And it is with the same directive that We revealed to you this Arabic Writ. Were you indeed to follow the vain desires of people after the true knowledge has come to you none will be your supporter against Allah and none will have the power to shield you from His punishment.
verses.translation: And it is with the same directive that We revealed to you this Arabic Writ. Were you indeed to follow the vain desires of people after the true knowledge has come to you none will be your supporter against Allah and none will have the power to shield you from His punishment.

verses.text: We indeed sent many Messengers before you and We gave them wives and children; and no Messenger had the power to produce a miraculous sign except by the command of Allah. Every age has its own (revealed) Book.
verses.translation: We indeed sent many Messengers before you and We gave them wives and children; and no Messenger had the power to produce a miraculous sign except by the command of Allah. Every age has its own (revealed) Book.

verses.text: Allah effaces whatever He wills and retains whatever He wills. With Him is the Mother of the Book.
verses.translation: Allah effaces whatever He wills and retains whatever He wills. With Him is the Mother of the Book.

verses.text: (O Prophet) whether We make you see a part of the punishment that We have threatened them with come to pass during your life-time or We take you away before that happens your duty is no more than to convey the Message and it is for Us to make a reckoning.
verses.translation: (O Prophet) whether We make you see a part of the punishment that We have threatened them with come to pass during your life-time or We take you away before that happens your duty is no more than to convey the Message and it is for Us to make a reckoning.

verses.text: Do they not see that We are advancing in the land diminishing it by its borders on all sides? Allah judges and no one has the power to reverse His judgement. He is swift in reckoning.
verses.translation: Do they not see that We are advancing in the land diminishing it by its borders on all sides? Allah judges and no one has the power to reverse His judgement. He is swift in reckoning.

verses.text: Those who lived before them also devised many a plot but the master plot rests with Allah. He knows what everyone does. The deniers of the truth will soon come to know whose end is good.
verses.translation: Those who lived before them also devised many a plot but the master plot rests with Allah. He knows what everyone does. The deniers of the truth will soon come to know whose end is good.

verses.text: The unbelievers claim that you have not been sent by Allah. Tell them: ""Allah is sufficient as a witness between me and you; and so also do those who know the Scriptures.""
verses.translation: The unbelievers claim that you have not been sent by Allah. Tell them: ""Allah is sufficient as a witness between me and you; and so also do those who know the Scriptures.""

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: Alif. Lam. Mim. Ra''. These are the verses of the Divine Book. Whatever has been revealed to you from your Lord is the truth and yet most (of your) people do not believe.
ayahs.translation: Alif. Lam. Mim. Ra''. These are the verses of the Divine Book. Whatever has been revealed to you from your Lord is the truth and yet most (of your) people do not believe.

ayahs.text: It is Allah Who has raised the heavens without any supports that you could see and then He established Himself on the Throne (of Dominion). And He it is Who has made the sun and the moon subservient (to a law) each running its course till an appointed term. He governs the entire order of the universe and clearly explains the signs that you may be firmly convinced about meeting your Lord.
ayahs.translation: It is Allah Who has raised the heavens without any supports that you could see and then He established Himself on the Throne (of Dominion). And He it is Who has made the sun and the moon subservient (to a law) each running its course till an appointed term. He governs the entire order of the universe and clearly explains the signs that you may be firmly convinced about meeting your Lord.

ayahs.text: He it is Who has stretched out the earth and has placed in it firm mountains and has caused the rivers to flow. He has made every fruit in pairs two and two and He it is Who causes the night to cover the day. Surely there are signs in these for those who reflect.
ayahs.translation: He it is Who has stretched out the earth and has placed in it firm mountains and has caused the rivers to flow. He has made every fruit in pairs two and two and He it is Who causes the night to cover the day. Surely there are signs in these for those who reflect.

ayahs.text: And on the earth there are many tracts of land neighbouring each other. There are on it vineyards and sown fields and date palms: some growing in clusters from one root some standing alone. They are irrigated by the same water and yet We make some excel others in taste. Surely there are signs in these for a people who use their reason.
ayahs.translation: And on the earth there are many tracts of land neighbouring each other. There are on it vineyards and sown fields and date palms: some growing in clusters from one root some standing alone. They are irrigated by the same water and yet We make some excel others in taste. Surely there are signs in these for a people who use their reason.

ayahs.text: And were you to wonder then wondrous indeed is the saying of those who say: ""What! After we have been reduced to dust shall we be created afresh?"" They are the ones who disbelieved in their Lord; they are the ones who shall have shackles around their necks. They shall be the inmates of the Fire wherein they will abide for ever.
ayahs.translation: And were you to wonder then wondrous indeed is the saying of those who say: ""What! After we have been reduced to dust shall we be created afresh?"" They are the ones who disbelieved in their Lord; they are the ones who shall have shackles around their necks. They shall be the inmates of the Fire wherein they will abide for ever.

ayahs.text: They challenge you to hasten the coming of evil upon them before the coming of any good although people who followed a like course before had met with exemplary punishment (from Allah). Verily your Lord is forgiving to mankind despite all their wrong-doing. Verily your Lord is also severe in retribution.
ayahs.translation: They challenge you to hasten the coming of evil upon them before the coming of any good although people who followed a like course before had met with exemplary punishment (from Allah). Verily your Lord is forgiving to mankind despite all their wrong-doing. Verily your Lord is also severe in retribution.

ayahs.text: Those who refused to believe in you say: ""Why has no (miraculous) sign been sent down upon him from his Lord?"" You are only a warner and every people has its guide.
ayahs.translation: Those who refused to believe in you say: ""Why has no (miraculous) sign been sent down upon him from his Lord?"" You are only a warner and every people has its guide.

ayahs.text: Allah knows what every female bears; and what the wombs fall short of (in gestation) and what they may add. With Him everything is in a fixed measure.
ayahs.translation: Allah knows what every female bears; and what the wombs fall short of (in gestation) and what they may add. With Him everything is in a fixed measure.

ayahs.text: He knows both what is hidden and what is manifest. He is the Supreme One the Most High.
ayahs.translation: He knows both what is hidden and what is manifest. He is the Supreme One the Most High.

ayahs.text: It is all the same for Him whether any of you says a thing secretly or says it loudly and whether one hides oneself in the darkness of night or struts about in broad daylight.
ayahs.translation: It is all the same for Him whether any of you says a thing secretly or says it loudly and whether one hides oneself in the darkness of night or struts about in broad daylight.

ayahs.text: There are guardians over everyone both before him and behind him who guard him by Allah''s command. Verily Allah does not change a people''s condition unless they change their inner selves. And when Allah decides to make a people suffer punishment no one can avert it. Nor can any be of help to such a people against Allah.

Verily Allah does not change a people''s condition unless they change their inner selves. And when Allah decides to make a people suffer punishment no one can avert it. Nor can any be of help to such a people against Allah.

Misfortune continues to afflict the unbelievers on account of their misdeeds or to befall on locations close to their habitation. This will continue until Allah''s promise (of chastisement) is fulfilled. Indeed Allah does not go back upon His promise.

ayahs.text: Surely the Messengers before you were ridiculed but I always initially granted respite to those who disbelieved and then I seized them (with chastisement). Then how awesome was My chastisement!
ayahs.translation: Surely the Messengers before you were ridiculed but I always initially granted respite to those who disbelieved and then I seized them (with chastisement). Then how awesome was My chastisement!

ayahs.text: Is it then in regard to Him Who watches over the deeds of every person that they are acting blasphemously by setting up His associates? Tell them: ""Name those associates (if Allah Himself has made them His associates)! Or are you informing Allah of something the existence of which He does not even know?"" Or do people arbitrarily utter empty words? Indeed their foul contriving has been made to seem fair to the unbelievers and they have been barred from finding the Right Way. Whomsoever Allah lets go astray will have none to guide him.
ayahs.translation: Is it then in regard to Him Who watches over the deeds of every person that they are acting blasphemously by setting up His associates? Tell them: ""Name those associates (if Allah Himself has made them His associates)! Or are you informing Allah of something the existence of which He does not even know?"" Or do people arbitrarily utter empty words? Indeed their foul contriving has been made to seem fair to the unbelievers and they have been barred from finding the Right Way. Whomsoever Allah lets go astray will have none to guide him.

ayahs.text: They shall suffer chastisement in the life of the world and surely the chastisement of the Hereafter is even more grievous. None has the power to shield them from (the chastisement of) Allah.
ayahs.translation: They shall suffer chastisement in the life of the world and surely the chastisement of the Hereafter is even more grievous. None has the power to shield them from (the chastisement of) Allah.

ayahs.text: And such will be the Paradise promised to the God-fearing: rivers will flow beneath it its fruits will be eternal and so will be its blissful shade. That is the ultimate destiny of the God-fearing while Fire is the destiny of the unbelievers.
ayahs.translation: And such will be the Paradise promised to the God-fearing: rivers will flow beneath it its fruits will be eternal and so will be its blissful shade. That is the ultimate destiny of the God-fearing while Fire is the destiny of the unbelievers.

ayahs.text: Those upon whom We bestowed the Scriptures earlier rejoice at the Book revealed to you while there are also some among different groups that reject part of it. Tell them: ""I have only been commanded to serve Allah and not to associate anyone with Him. To Him do I call and to Him is my return.""
ayahs.translation: Those upon whom We bestowed the Scriptures earlier rejoice at the Book revealed to you while there are also some among different groups that reject part of it. Tell them: ""I have only been commanded to serve Allah and not to associate anyone with Him. To Him do I call and to Him is my return.""

ayahs.text: And it is with the same directive that We revealed to you this Arabic Writ. Were you indeed to follow the vain desires of people after the true knowledge has come to you none will be your supporter against Allah and none will have the power to shield you from His punishment.
ayahs.translation: And it is with the same directive that We revealed to you this Arabic Writ. Were you indeed to follow the vain desires of people after the true knowledge has come to you none will be your supporter against Allah and none will have the power to shield you from His punishment.

ayahs.text: We indeed sent many Messengers before you and We gave them wives and children; and no Messenger had the power to produce a miraculous sign except by the command of Allah. Every age has its own (revealed) Book.
ayahs.translation: We indeed sent many Messengers before you and We gave them wives and children; and no Messenger had the power to produce a miraculous sign except by the command of Allah. Every age has its own (revealed) Book.

ayahs.text: Allah effaces whatever He wills and retains whatever He wills. With Him is the Mother of the Book.
ayahs.translation: Allah effaces whatever He wills and retains whatever He wills. With Him is the Mother of the Book.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) whether We make you see a part of the punishment that We have threatened them with come to pass during your life-time or We take you away before that happens your duty is no more than to convey the Message and it is for Us to make a reckoning.
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) whether We make you see a part of the punishment that We have threatened them with come to pass during your life-time or We take you away before that happens your duty is no more than to convey the Message and it is for Us to make a reckoning.

ayahs.text: Do they not see that We are advancing in the land diminishing it by its borders on all sides? Allah judges and no one has the power to reverse His judgement. He is swift in reckoning.
ayahs.translation: Do they not see that We are advancing in the land diminishing it by its borders on all sides? Allah judges and no one has the power to reverse His judgement. He is swift in reckoning.

ayahs.text: Those who lived before them also devised many a plot but the master plot rests with Allah. He knows what everyone does. The deniers of the truth will soon come to know whose end is good.
ayahs.translation: Those who lived before them also devised many a plot but the master plot rests with Allah. He knows what everyone does. The deniers of the truth will soon come to know whose end is good.

ayahs.text: The unbelievers claim that you have not been sent by Allah. Tell them: ""Allah is sufficient as a witness between me and you; and so also do those who know the Scriptures.""
ayahs.translation: The unbelievers claim that you have not been sent by Allah. Tell them: ""Allah is sufficient as a witness between me and you; and so also do those who know the Scriptures.""

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Alif. Lam. Ra''. This is a Book which We have revealed to you that you may bring forth mankind from every kind of darkness into light and direct them with the leave of their Lord to the Way of the Mighty the Innately Praiseworthy
verses.translation: Alif. Lam. Ra''. This is a Book which We have revealed to you that you may bring forth mankind from every kind of darkness into light and direct them with the leave of their Lord to the Way of the Mighty the Innately Praiseworthy

verses.text: (to the Way of) Allah to Whom belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. Woe be to those who reject the Truth for a severe chastisement
verses.translation: (to the Way of) Allah to Whom belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. Woe be to those who reject the Truth for a severe chastisement

verses.text: to those who have chosen the life of the world in preference to the Hereafter who hinder people from the Way of Allah and seek to make it crooked. They have gone far astray.
verses.translation: to those who have chosen the life of the world in preference to the Hereafter who hinder people from the Way of Allah and seek to make it crooked. They have gone far astray.

verses.text: Never have We sent a Messenger but he has addressed his people in their language that he may fully expound his Message to them. (And after the Message is expounded) Allah lets go astray whomsoever He wills and guides to the Right Way whomsoever He wills. He is the All-Mighty the All-Wise.
verses.translation: Never have We sent a Messenger but he has addressed his people in their language that he may fully expound his Message to them. (And after the Message is expounded) Allah lets go astray whomsoever He wills and guides to the Right Way whomsoever He wills. He is the All-Mighty the All-Wise.

verses.text: We indeed sent Moses with Our Signs saying: ""Lead your people out of all kinds of darkness into light and admonish them by narrating to them anecdotes from the Days of Allah."" Verily in it there are great Signs for everyone who is patient and gives thanks (to Allah).
verses.translation: We indeed sent Moses with Our Signs saying: ""Lead your people out of all kinds of darkness into light and admonish them by narrating to them anecdotes from the Days of Allah."" Verily in it there are great Signs for everyone who is patient and gives thanks (to Allah).

verses.text: And call to mind when Moses said to his people: ""Remember Allah''s favour upon you when He delivered you from Pharaoh''s people who afflicted you with a grievous chastisement slaughtering your sons while letting your women live. In it there was a terrible trial from your Lord.""
verses.translation: And call to mind when Moses said to his people: ""Remember Allah''s favour upon you when He delivered you from Pharaoh''s people who afflicted you with a grievous chastisement slaughtering your sons while letting your women live. In it there was a terrible trial from your Lord.""

verses.text: Also call to mind when your Lord proclaimed: ""If you give thanks I will certainly grant you more; but if you are ungrateful for My favours My chastisement is terrible.
verses.translation: Also call to mind when your Lord proclaimed: ""If you give thanks I will certainly grant you more; but if you are ungrateful for My favours My chastisement is terrible.

verses.text: Moses said: ""Were you to disbelieve - you and all those who live on earth - Allah is still Self-Sufficient Innately Praiseworthy.""
verses.translation: Moses said: ""Were you to disbelieve - you and all those who live on earth - Allah is still Self-Sufficient Innately Praiseworthy.""

verses.text: Have the accounts of your predecessors not reached you: the people of Noah the Ad the Thamud and those who came after them - they whose number is not known to any except Allah? Their Messengers came to them with Clear Signs but they thrust their hands in their mouths and said: ""We do surely reject the Message you have brought and we are in disquieting doubt about what you are summoning us to.""
verses.translation: Have the accounts of your predecessors not reached you: the people of Noah the Ad the Thamud and those who came after them - they whose number is not known to any except Allah? Their Messengers came to them with Clear Signs but they thrust their hands in their mouths and said: ""We do surely reject the Message you have brought and we are in disquieting doubt about what you are summoning us to.""

verses.text: Their Messengers said: ""Can there be any doubt about Allah the Creator of the heavens and the earth? He invites you that He may forgive you your sins and grant you respite till an appointed term."" They replied: ""You are only a human being like ourselves. You seek to prevent us from serving those whom our forefathers have been serving all along. If that is so produce a clear authority for it.""
verses.translation: Their Messengers said: ""Can there be any doubt about Allah the Creator of the heavens and the earth? He invites you that He may forgive you your sins and grant you respite till an appointed term."" They replied: ""You are only a human being like ourselves. You seek to prevent us from serving those whom our forefathers have been serving all along. If that is so produce a clear authority for it.""

verses.text: Their Messengers told them: ""Indeed we are only human beings like yourselves but Allah bestows His favour on those of His servants whom He wills. It does not lie in our power to produce any authority except by the leave of Allah. It is in Allah that the believers should put their trust.
verses.translation: Their Messengers told them: ""Indeed we are only human beings like yourselves but Allah bestows His favour on those of His servants whom He wills. It does not lie in our power to produce any authority except by the leave of Allah. It is in Allah that the believers should put their trust.

verses.text: And why should we not put our trust in Allah when it is indeed He Who has guided us to the ways of our life? We shall surely continue to remain steadfast in face of your persecution. All those who have to put trust should put their trust only in Allah.""
verses.translation: And why should we not put our trust in Allah when it is indeed He Who has guided us to the ways of our life? We shall surely continue to remain steadfast in face of your persecution. All those who have to put trust should put their trust only in Allah.""

verses.text: Then the unbelievers told their Messengers: ""You will have to return to the fold of our faith or else we shall banish you from our land."" Thereupon their Lord revealed to them: ""We will most certainly destroy these wrong-doers
verses.translation: Then the unbelievers told their Messengers: ""You will have to return to the fold of our faith or else we shall banish you from our land."" Thereupon their Lord revealed to them: ""We will most certainly destroy these wrong-doers

verses.text: and will then cause you to settle in the land as their successors. That is the reward for him who fears to stand for reckoning and holds My threat in awe.""
verses.translation: and will then cause you to settle in the land as their successors. That is the reward for him who fears to stand for reckoning and holds My threat in awe.""

verses.text: They sought Our judgement. And (thanks to that judgement) every obstinate tyrant opposed to the Truth was brought to naught.
verses.translation: They sought Our judgement. And (thanks to that judgement) every obstinate tyrant opposed to the Truth was brought to naught.

verses.text: Hell is before him and he shall be made to drink of the oozing pus
verses.translation: Hell is before him and he shall be made to drink of the oozing pus

verses.text: which he will gulp but will scarcely swallow and death will come upon him from every quarter and yet he will not be able to die. A terrible chastisement lies ahead in pursuit of him.
verses.translation: which he will gulp but will scarcely swallow and death will come upon him from every quarter and yet he will not be able to die. A terrible chastisement lies ahead in pursuit of him.

verses.text: This is the example of those who disbelieve in their Lord: their works are like ashes upon which the wind blows fiercely on a tempestuous day. They shall find no reward for their deeds. That indeed is the farthest point in straying.
verses.translation: This is the example of those who disbelieve in their Lord: their works are like ashes upon which the wind blows fiercely on a tempestuous day. They shall find no reward for their deeds. That indeed is the farthest point in straying.

verses.text: Do you not see that Allah created the heavens and the earth in Truth? Were He to will He could take you away and bring a new creation.
verses.translation: Do you not see that Allah created the heavens and the earth in Truth? Were He to will He could take you away and bring a new creation.

verses.text: That is not at all difficult for Allah.
verses.translation: That is not at all difficult for Allah.

verses.text: Then all of them will appear exposed before Allah and the weak ones will say to the haughty ones: ""We merely followed you. Will you then protect us from Allah''s chastisement?"" They will say: ""Had Allah shown us the Way to our salvation we would surely have also guided you. Now it is all the same whether we cry or suffer patiently we have no escape.""
verses.translation: Then all of them will appear exposed before Allah and the weak ones will say to the haughty ones: ""We merely followed you. Will you then protect us from Allah''s chastisement?"" They will say: ""Had Allah shown us the Way to our salvation we would surely have also guided you. Now it is all the same whether we cry or suffer patiently we have no escape.""

verses.text: After the matter has been finally decided Satan will say: ""Surely whatever Allah promised you was true; as for me I went back on the promise I made to you. I had no power over you except that I called you to my way and you responded to me. So do not blame me but blame yourselves. Here neither I can come to your rescue nor can you come to mine. I disavow your former act of associating me in the past with Allah. A grievous chastisement inevitably lies ahead for such wrong-doers.""
verses.translation: After the matter has been finally decided Satan will say: ""Surely whatever Allah promised you was true; as for me I went back on the promise I made to you. I had no power over you except that I called you to my way and you responded to me. So do not blame me but blame yourselves. Here neither I can come to your rescue nor can you come to mine. I disavow your former act of associating me in the past with Allah. A grievous chastisement inevitably lies ahead for such wrong-doers.""

verses.text: As for those who had believed and did good in the world they shall be admitted to the Gardens beneath which rivers flow. There with the leave of Allah they shall abide forever and will be greeted with: ""Peace"".
verses.translation: As for those who had believed and did good in the world they shall be admitted to the Gardens beneath which rivers flow. There with the leave of Allah they shall abide forever and will be greeted with: ""Peace"".

verses.text: Do you not see how Allah has given the example of a good word? It is like a good tree whose root is firmly fixed and whose branches reach the sky
verses.translation: Do you not see how Allah has given the example of a good word? It is like a good tree whose root is firmly fixed and whose branches reach the sky

verses.text: ever yielding its fruit in every season with the leave of its Lord. Allah gives examples for mankind that they may take heed.
verses.translation: ever yielding its fruit in every season with the leave of its Lord. Allah gives examples for mankind that they may take heed.

verses.text: And the example of an evil word is that of an evil tree uprooted from the surface of the earth wholly unable to endure.
verses.translation: And the example of an evil word is that of an evil tree uprooted from the surface of the earth wholly unable to endure.

verses.text: Thus through a firm word Allah grants firmness to the believers both in this world and in the Hereafter. As for the wrong-doers Allah lets them go astray. Allah does whatever He wills.
verses.translation: Thus through a firm word Allah grants firmness to the believers both in this world and in the Hereafter. As for the wrong-doers Allah lets them go astray. Allah does whatever He wills.

verses.text: Did you not see those who have exchanged Allah''s favour with ingratitude to Him causing their people to be cast in the abode of utter perdition
verses.translation: Did you not see those who have exchanged Allah''s favour with ingratitude to Him causing their people to be cast in the abode of utter perdition

verses.text: Hell wherein they shall roast? How wretched a place to settle in!
verses.translation: Hell wherein they shall roast? How wretched a place to settle in!

verses.text: They have set up rivals to Allah that they may lead people astray from His way. Tell them: ""Enjoy for a while. You are doomed to end up in the Fire!""
verses.translation: They have set up rivals to Allah that they may lead people astray from His way. Tell them: ""Enjoy for a while. You are doomed to end up in the Fire!""

verses.text: (O Prophet) tell those of My servants who believe that they should establish Prayer and spend out of what We have provided them with both secretly and openly before there arrives the Day when there will be no bargaining nor any mutual befriending.
verses.translation: (O Prophet) tell those of My servants who believe that they should establish Prayer and spend out of what We have provided them with both secretly and openly before there arrives the Day when there will be no bargaining nor any mutual befriending.

verses.text: It is Allah Who created the heavens and the earth Who sent down water from the heaven and thereby brought forth a variety of fruits as your sustenance Who subjected for you the ships that they may sail in the sea by His command Who subjected for you the rivers
verses.translation: It is Allah Who created the heavens and the earth Who sent down water from the heaven and thereby brought forth a variety of fruits as your sustenance Who subjected for you the ships that they may sail in the sea by His command Who subjected for you the rivers

verses.text: Who subjected for you the sun and the moon and both of them are constant on their courses Who subjected for you the night and the day
verses.translation: Who subjected for you the sun and the moon and both of them are constant on their courses Who subjected for you the night and the day

verses.text: and Who gave you all that you asked Him for. Were you to count the favours of Allah you shall never be able to encompass them. Verily man is highly unjust exceedingly ungrateful.
verses.translation: and Who gave you all that you asked Him for. Were you to count the favours of Allah you shall never be able to encompass them. Verily man is highly unjust exceedingly ungrateful.

verses.text: And call to mind when Abraham prayed: ""My Lord! Make this city secure and keep me and my sons away from worshipping the idols.
verses.translation: And call to mind when Abraham prayed: ""My Lord! Make this city secure and keep me and my sons away from worshipping the idols.

verses.text: My Lord! They have caused many people to go astray. Now if anyone follows my way he is from me; and if anyone follows a way opposed to mine then surely You are Ever-Forgiving Most Merciful.""
verses.translation: My Lord! They have caused many people to go astray. Now if anyone follows my way he is from me; and if anyone follows a way opposed to mine then surely You are Ever-Forgiving Most Merciful.""

verses.text: Our Lord! I have made some of my offspring settle in a barren valley near Your Sacred House! Our Lord! I did so that they may establish Prayer. So make the hearts of people affectionately inclined to them and provide them with fruits for their sustenance that they may give thanks.
verses.translation: Our Lord! I have made some of my offspring settle in a barren valley near Your Sacred House! Our Lord! I did so that they may establish Prayer. So make the hearts of people affectionately inclined to them and provide them with fruits for their sustenance that they may give thanks.

verses.text: Our Lord! Surely You know all that we conceal and all that we reveal and nothing in the earth or in the heaven is hidden from Allah.
verses.translation: Our Lord! Surely You know all that we conceal and all that we reveal and nothing in the earth or in the heaven is hidden from Allah.

verses.text: All praise be to Allah Who despite my old age has given me Ishmael and Isaac. Surely my Lord hears all prayers.
verses.translation: All praise be to Allah Who despite my old age has given me Ishmael and Isaac. Surely my Lord hears all prayers.

verses.text: My Lord! Enable me and my offspring to establish Prayer and do accept our Lord this prayer of mine.
verses.translation: My Lord! Enable me and my offspring to establish Prayer and do accept our Lord this prayer of mine.

verses.text: Our Lord! Forgive me and my parents and the believers on the Day when the reckoning will take place.""
verses.translation: Our Lord! Forgive me and my parents and the believers on the Day when the reckoning will take place.""

verses.text: Do not think Allah is heedless of the evil deeds in which the evil-doers are engaged. He is merely granting them respite until a Day when their eyes shall continue to stare in horror
verses.translation: Do not think Allah is heedless of the evil deeds in which the evil-doers are engaged. He is merely granting them respite until a Day when their eyes shall continue to stare in horror

verses.text: when they shall keep pressing ahead in haste their heads lifted up their gaze directed forward unable to look away from what they behold their hearts utterly void.
verses.translation: when they shall keep pressing ahead in haste their heads lifted up their gaze directed forward unable to look away from what they behold their hearts utterly void.

verses.text: (O Muhammad) warn mankind of the Day when a severe chastisement shall overtake them and the wrong-doers will say: ""Our Lord grant us respite for a short while; we shall respond to Your call and will follow Your Messengers."" (But they will be clearly told): ""Are you not the same who swore earlier that they shall never suffer decline?""
verses.translation: (O Muhammad) warn mankind of the Day when a severe chastisement shall overtake them and the wrong-doers will say: ""Our Lord grant us respite for a short while; we shall respond to Your call and will follow Your Messengers."" (But they will be clearly told): ""Are you not the same who swore earlier that they shall never suffer decline?""

verses.text: You said so even though you had lived in the dwellings of those who had wronged themselves (by sinning) and you were aware how We dealt with them and We had even explained to you all this by giving examples.
verses.translation: You said so even though you had lived in the dwellings of those who had wronged themselves (by sinning) and you were aware how We dealt with them and We had even explained to you all this by giving examples.

verses.text: Indeed the unbelievers contrived their plan but it is in Allah''s power to nullify their plan even though their plans were such that would move even mountains.
verses.translation: Indeed the unbelievers contrived their plan but it is in Allah''s power to nullify their plan even though their plans were such that would move even mountains.

verses.text: So do not think (O Prophet) that Allah will go back upon His promise to His Messengers. Surely Allah is Mighty Lord of retribution.
verses.translation: So do not think (O Prophet) that Allah will go back upon His promise to His Messengers. Surely Allah is Mighty Lord of retribution.

verses.text: (Do warn them of the) Day when the heavens and the earth shall be altogether changed; when all will appear fully exposed before Allah the One the Irresistible!
verses.translation: (Do warn them of the) Day when the heavens and the earth shall be altogether changed; when all will appear fully exposed before Allah the One the Irresistible!

verses.text: On that Day you shall see the guilty ones secured in chains;
verses.translation: On that Day you shall see the guilty ones secured in chains;

verses.text: their garments shall be black as if made out of pitch and flames of the Fire shall cover their faces
verses.translation: their garments shall be black as if made out of pitch and flames of the Fire shall cover their faces

verses.text: so that Allah may requite each person for his deeds. Allah is swift in reckoning.
verses.translation: so that Allah may requite each person for his deeds. Allah is swift in reckoning.

verses.text: This is a proclamation for all mankind that they may be warned by it and that they may know that their God is none but the One True God and that men of understanding may take heed.
verses.translation: This is a proclamation for all mankind that they may be warned by it and that they may know that their God is none but the One True God and that men of understanding may take heed.

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: Alif. Lam. Ra''. This is a Book which We have revealed to you that you may bring forth mankind from every kind of darkness into light and direct them with the leave of their Lord to the Way of the Mighty the Innately Praiseworthy

ayahs.translation: Their Messengers told them: ""Indeed we are only human beings like yourselves but Allah bestows His favour on those of His servants whom He wills. It does not lie in our power to produce any authority except by the leave of Allah. It is in Allah that the believers should put their trust.

ayahs.text: And why should we not put our trust in Allah when it is indeed He Who has guided us to the ways of our life? We shall surely continue to remain steadfast in face of your persecution. All those who have to put trust should put their trust only in Allah.""
ayahs.translation: And why should we not put our trust in Allah when it is indeed He Who has guided us to the ways of our life? We shall surely continue to remain steadfast in face of your persecution. All those who have to put trust should put their trust only in Allah.""

ayahs.text: Then the unbelievers told their Messengers: ""You will have to return to the fold of our faith or else we shall banish you from our land."" Thereupon their Lord revealed to them: ""We will most certainly destroy these wrong-doers
ayahs.translation: Then the unbelievers told their Messengers: ""You will have to return to the fold of our faith or else we shall banish you from our land."" Thereupon their Lord revealed to them: ""We will most certainly destroy these wrong-doers

ayahs.text: and will then cause you to settle in the land as their successors. That is the reward for him who fears to stand for reckoning and holds My threat in awe.""
ayahs.translation: and will then cause you to settle in the land as their successors. That is the reward for him who fears to stand for reckoning and holds My threat in awe.""

ayahs.text: They sought Our judgement. And (thanks to that judgement) every obstinate tyrant opposed to the Truth was brought to naught.
ayahs.translation: They sought Our judgement. And (thanks to that judgement) every obstinate tyrant opposed to the Truth was brought to naught.

ayahs.text: Hell is before him and he shall be made to drink of the oozing pus
ayahs.translation: Hell is before him and he shall be made to drink of the oozing pus

ayahs.text: which he will gulp but will scarcely swallow and death will come upon him from every quarter and yet he will not be able to die. A terrible chastisement lies ahead in pursuit of him.
ayahs.translation: which he will gulp but will scarcely swallow and death will come upon him from every quarter and yet he will not be able to die. A terrible chastisement lies ahead in pursuit of him.

ayahs.text: This is the example of those who disbelieve in their Lord: their works are like ashes upon which the wind blows fiercely on a tempestuous day. They shall find no reward for their deeds. That indeed is the farthest point in straying.
ayahs.translation: This is the example of those who disbelieve in their Lord: their works are like ashes upon which the wind blows fiercely on a tempestuous day. They shall find no reward for their deeds. That indeed is the farthest point in straying.

ayahs.text: Do you not see that Allah created the heavens and the earth in Truth? Were He to will He could take you away and bring a new creation.
ayahs.translation: Do you not see that Allah created the heavens and the earth in Truth? Were He to will He could take you away and bring a new creation.

ayahs.text: That is not at all difficult for Allah.
ayahs.translation: That is not at all difficult for Allah.

ayahs.text: Then all of them will appear exposed before Allah and the weak ones will say to the haughty ones: ""We merely followed you. Will you then protect us from Allah''s chastisement?"" They will say: ""Had Allah shown us the Way to our salvation we would surely have also guided you. Now it is all the same whether we cry or suffer patiently we have no escape.""
ayahs.translation: Then all of them will appear exposed before Allah and the weak ones will say to the haughty ones: ""We merely followed you. Will you then protect us from Allah''s chastisement?"" They will say: ""Had Allah shown us the Way to our salvation we would surely have also guided you. Now it is all the same whether we cry or suffer patiently we have no escape.""

ayahs.text: After the matter has been finally decided Satan will say: ""Surely whatever Allah promised you was true; as for me I went back on the promise I made to you. I had no power over you except that I called you to my way and you responded to me. So do not blame me but blame yourselves. Here neither I can come to your rescue nor can you come to mine. I disavow your former act of associating me in the past with Allah. A grievous chastisement inevitably lies ahead for such wrong-doers.""
ayahs.translation: After the matter has been finally decided Satan will say: ""Surely whatever Allah promised you was true; as for me I went back on the promise I made to you. I had no power over you except that I called you to my way and you responded to me. So do not blame me but blame yourselves. Here neither I can come to your rescue nor can you come to mine. I disavow your former act of associating me in the past with Allah. A grievous chastisement inevitably lies ahead for such wrong-doers.""

ayahs.text: As for those who had believed and did good in the world they shall be admitted to the Gardens beneath which rivers flow. There with the leave of Allah they shall abide forever and will be greeted with: ""Peace"".
ayahs.translation: As for those who had believed and did good in the world they shall be admitted to the Gardens beneath which rivers flow. There with the leave of Allah they shall abide forever and will be greeted with: ""Peace"".

ayahs.text: Do you not see how Allah has given the example of a good word? It is like a good tree whose root is firmly fixed and whose branches reach the sky
ayahs.translation: Do you not see how Allah has given the example of a good word? It is like a good tree whose root is firmly fixed and whose branches reach the sky

ayahs.text: ever yielding its fruit in every season with the leave of its Lord. Allah gives examples for mankind that they may take heed.
ayahs.translation: ever yielding its fruit in every season with the leave of its Lord. Allah gives examples for mankind that they may take heed.

ayahs.text: And the example of an evil word is that of an evil tree uprooted from the surface of the earth wholly unable to endure.
ayahs.translation: And the example of an evil word is that of an evil tree uprooted from the surface of the earth wholly unable to endure.

ayahs.text: Thus through a firm word Allah grants firmness to the believers both in this world and in the Hereafter. As for the wrong-doers Allah lets them go astray. Allah does whatever He wills.
ayahs.translation: Thus through a firm word Allah grants firmness to the believers both in this world and in the Hereafter. As for the wrong-doers Allah lets them go astray. Allah does whatever He wills.

ayahs.text: Did you not see those who have exchanged Allah''s favour with ingratitude to Him causing their people to be cast in the abode of utter perdition
ayahs.translation: Did you not see those who have exchanged Allah''s favour with ingratitude to Him causing their people to be cast in the abode of utter perdition

ayahs.text: Hell wherein they shall roast? How wretched a place to settle in!
ayahs.translation: Hell wherein they shall roast? How wretched a place to settle in!

ayahs.text: They have set up rivals to Allah that they may lead people astray from His way. Tell them: ""Enjoy for a while. You are doomed to end up in the Fire!""
ayahs.translation: They have set up rivals to Allah that they may lead people astray from His way. Tell them: ""Enjoy for a while. You are doomed to end up in the Fire!""

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) tell those of My servants who believe that they should establish Prayer and spend out of what We have provided them with both secretly and openly before there arrives the Day when there will be no bargaining nor any mutual befriending.
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) tell those of My servants who believe that they should establish Prayer and spend out of what We have provided them with both secretly and openly before there arrives the Day when there will be no bargaining nor any mutual befriending.

ayahs.text: It is Allah Who created the heavens and the earth Who sent down water from the heaven and thereby brought forth a variety of fruits as your sustenance Who subjected for you the ships that they may sail in the sea by His command Who subjected for you the rivers
ayahs.translation: It is Allah Who created the heavens and the earth Who sent down water from the heaven and thereby brought forth a variety of fruits as your sustenance Who subjected for you the ships that they may sail in the sea by His command Who subjected for you the rivers

ayahs.text: Who subjected for you the sun and the moon and both of them are constant on their courses Who subjected for you the night and the day
ayahs.translation: Who subjected for you the sun and the moon and both of them are constant on their courses Who subjected for you the night and the day

ayahs.text: and Who gave you all that you asked Him for. Were you to count the favours of Allah you shall never be able to encompass them. Verily man is highly unjust exceedingly ungrateful.
ayahs.translation: and Who gave you all that you asked Him for. Were you to count the favours of Allah you shall never be able to encompass them. Verily man is highly unjust exceedingly ungrateful.

ayahs.text: And call to mind when Abraham prayed: ""My Lord! Make this city secure and keep me and my sons away from worshipping the idols.
ayahs.translation: And call to mind when Abraham prayed: ""My Lord! Make this city secure and keep me and my sons away from worshipping the idols.

ayahs.text: My Lord! They have caused many people to go astray. Now if anyone follows my way he is from me; and if anyone follows a way opposed to mine then surely You are Ever-Forgiving Most Merciful.""
ayahs.translation: My Lord! They have caused many people to go astray. Now if anyone follows my way he is from me; and if anyone follows a way opposed to mine then surely You are Ever-Forgiving Most Merciful.""

ayahs.text: Our Lord! I have made some of my offspring settle in a barren valley near Your Sacred House! Our Lord! I did so that they may establish Prayer. So make the hearts of people affectionately inclined to them and provide them with fruits for their sustenance that they may give thanks.
ayahs.translation: Our Lord! I have made some of my offspring settle in a barren valley near Your Sacred House! Our Lord! I did so that they may establish Prayer. So make the hearts of people affectionately inclined to them and provide them with fruits for their sustenance that they may give thanks.

ayahs.text: Our Lord! Surely You know all that we conceal and all that we reveal and nothing in the earth or in the heaven is hidden from Allah.
ayahs.translation: Our Lord! Surely You know all that we conceal and all that we reveal and nothing in the earth or in the heaven is hidden from Allah.

ayahs.text: All praise be to Allah Who despite my old age has given me Ishmael and Isaac. Surely my Lord hears all prayers.
ayahs.translation: All praise be to Allah Who despite my old age has given me Ishmael and Isaac. Surely my Lord hears all prayers.

ayahs.text: My Lord! Enable me and my offspring to establish Prayer and do accept our Lord this prayer of mine.
ayahs.translation: My Lord! Enable me and my offspring to establish Prayer and do accept our Lord this prayer of mine.

ayahs.text: Our Lord! Forgive me and my parents and the believers on the Day when the reckoning will take place.""
ayahs.translation: Our Lord! Forgive me and my parents and the believers on the Day when the reckoning will take place.""

ayahs.text: Do not think Allah is heedless of the evil deeds in which the evil-doers are engaged. He is merely granting them respite until a Day when their eyes shall continue to stare in horror
ayahs.translation: Do not think Allah is heedless of the evil deeds in which the evil-doers are engaged. He is merely granting them respite until a Day when their eyes shall continue to stare in horror

ayahs.text: when they shall keep pressing ahead in haste their heads lifted up their gaze directed forward unable to look away from what they behold their hearts utterly void.
ayahs.translation: when they shall keep pressing ahead in haste their heads lifted up their gaze directed forward unable to look away from what they behold their hearts utterly void.

ayahs.text: (O Muhammad) warn mankind of the Day when a severe chastisement shall overtake them and the wrong-doers will say: ""Our Lord grant us respite for a short while; we shall respond to Your call and will follow Your Messengers."" (But they will be clearly told): ""Are you not the same who swore earlier that they shall never suffer decline?""
ayahs.translation: (O Muhammad) warn mankind of the Day when a severe chastisement shall overtake them and the wrong-doers will say: ""Our Lord grant us respite for a short while; we shall respond to Your call and will follow Your Messengers."" (But they will be clearly told): ""Are you not the same who swore earlier that they shall never suffer decline?""

ayahs.text: You said so even though you had lived in the dwellings of those who had wronged themselves (by sinning) and you were aware how We dealt with them and We had even explained to you all this by giving examples.
ayahs.translation: You said so even though you had lived in the dwellings of those who had wronged themselves (by sinning) and you were aware how We dealt with them and We had even explained to you all this by giving examples.

ayahs.text: Indeed the unbelievers contrived their plan but it is in Allah''s power to nullify their plan even though their plans were such that would move even mountains.
ayahs.translation: Indeed the unbelievers contrived their plan but it is in Allah''s power to nullify their plan even though their plans were such that would move even mountains.

ayahs.text: So do not think (O Prophet) that Allah will go back upon His promise to His Messengers. Surely Allah is Mighty Lord of retribution.
ayahs.translation: So do not think (O Prophet) that Allah will go back upon His promise to His Messengers. Surely Allah is Mighty Lord of retribution.

ayahs.text: (Do warn them of the) Day when the heavens and the earth shall be altogether changed; when all will appear fully exposed before Allah the One the Irresistible!
ayahs.translation: (Do warn them of the) Day when the heavens and the earth shall be altogether changed; when all will appear fully exposed before Allah the One the Irresistible!

ayahs.text: On that Day you shall see the guilty ones secured in chains;
ayahs.translation: On that Day you shall see the guilty ones secured in chains;

ayahs.text: their garments shall be black as if made out of pitch and flames of the Fire shall cover their faces
ayahs.translation: their garments shall be black as if made out of pitch and flames of the Fire shall cover their faces

ayahs.text: so that Allah may requite each person for his deeds. Allah is swift in reckoning.
ayahs.translation: so that Allah may requite each person for his deeds. Allah is swift in reckoning.

ayahs.text: This is a proclamation for all mankind that they may be warned by it and that they may know that their God is none but the One True God and that men of understanding may take heed.
ayahs.translation: This is a proclamation for all mankind that they may be warned by it and that they may know that their God is none but the One True God and that men of understanding may take heed.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Alif. Lam. Ra''. These are the verses of the Book and a Clear Qur''an.
verses.translation: Alif. Lam. Ra''. These are the verses of the Book and a Clear Qur''an.

verses.text: Soon will the time come when the unbelievers will wish they were Muslims.
verses.translation: Soon will the time come when the unbelievers will wish they were Muslims.

verses.text: Leave them to eat and enjoy life and let false hopes amuse them. They will soon come to know.
verses.translation: Leave them to eat and enjoy life and let false hopes amuse them. They will soon come to know.

verses.text: Whenever We destroyed a town a definite term had previously been decreed for it.
verses.translation: Whenever We destroyed a town a definite term had previously been decreed for it.

verses.text: No people can outstrip the term for its destruction nor can it delay it.
verses.translation: No people can outstrip the term for its destruction nor can it delay it.

verses.text: They say: ""O you to whom the Admonition has been revealed you are surely crazed.
verses.translation: They say: ""O you to whom the Admonition has been revealed you are surely crazed.

verses.text: Why do you not bring down angels upon us if you are indeed truthful?""
verses.translation: Why do you not bring down angels upon us if you are indeed truthful?""

verses.text: We do not send down the angels (in frivolity); and when We do send them down We do so with Truth; then people are granted no respite.
verses.translation: We do not send down the angels (in frivolity); and when We do send them down We do so with Truth; then people are granted no respite.

verses.text: As for the Admonition indeed it is We Who have revealed it and it is indeed We Who are its guardians.
verses.translation: As for the Admonition indeed it is We Who have revealed it and it is indeed We Who are its guardians.

verses.text: (O Muhammad) certainly We did send Messengers before you among the nations which have gone by.
verses.translation: (O Muhammad) certainly We did send Messengers before you among the nations which have gone by.

verses.text: And whenever a Messenger came to them they never failed to mock him.
verses.translation: And whenever a Messenger came to them they never failed to mock him.

verses.text: Even so We make a way for it (that is the Admonition) in the hearts of the culprits (like a hot rod);
verses.translation: Even so We make a way for it (that is the Admonition) in the hearts of the culprits (like a hot rod);

verses.text: they do not believe in it. This has been the wont of people of this kind from ancient times.
verses.translation: they do not believe in it. This has been the wont of people of this kind from ancient times.

verses.text: If We were even to open for them a way to the heavens and they could continually climb up to it in broad daylight
verses.translation: If We were even to open for them a way to the heavens and they could continually climb up to it in broad daylight

verses.text: they would still have said: ""Surely our eyes have been dazzled; rather we have been enchanted.""
verses.translation: they would still have said: ""Surely our eyes have been dazzled; rather we have been enchanted.""

verses.text: We have indeed set constellations in the heavens and have beautified them for the beholders
verses.translation: We have indeed set constellations in the heavens and have beautified them for the beholders

verses.text: and have protected them against every accursed satan
verses.translation: and have protected them against every accursed satan

verses.text: save him who may eavesdrop and then a bright flame pursues him.
verses.translation: save him who may eavesdrop and then a bright flame pursues him.

verses.text: As for the earth We have stretched it out and have cast on it firm mountains and have caused to grow in it everything well-measured.
verses.translation: As for the earth We have stretched it out and have cast on it firm mountains and have caused to grow in it everything well-measured.

verses.text: And We have provided sustenance for you on it and also for those of whom you are not the providers.
verses.translation: And We have provided sustenance for you on it and also for those of whom you are not the providers.

verses.text: There is nothing except that its treasuries are with Us and We do not send it down except in a known measure.
verses.translation: There is nothing except that its treasuries are with Us and We do not send it down except in a known measure.

verses.text: We send fertilizing winds and then cause rain to descend from the sky providing you abundant water to drink even though you could not have stored it up for yourselves.
verses.translation: We send fertilizing winds and then cause rain to descend from the sky providing you abundant water to drink even though you could not have stored it up for yourselves.

verses.text: It is indeed We Who grant life and cause death and it is We who shall be the sole Inheritors of all.
verses.translation: It is indeed We Who grant life and cause death and it is We who shall be the sole Inheritors of all.

verses.text: Surely We know those of you who have passed before and those who will come later.
verses.translation: Surely We know those of you who have passed before and those who will come later.

verses.text: Indeed your Lord will gather them all together. Surely He is All-Wise All-Knowing.
verses.translation: Indeed your Lord will gather them all together. Surely He is All-Wise All-Knowing.

verses.text: Surely We brought man into being out of dry ringing clay which was wrought from black mud
verses.translation: Surely We brought man into being out of dry ringing clay which was wrought from black mud

verses.text: while We had brought the jinn into being before out of blazing fire.
verses.translation: while We had brought the jinn into being before out of blazing fire.

verses.text: Recall when your Lord said to the angels: ""I will indeed bring into being a human being out of dry ringing clay wrought from black mud.
verses.translation: Recall when your Lord said to the angels: ""I will indeed bring into being a human being out of dry ringing clay wrought from black mud.

verses.text: When I have completed shaping him and have breathed into him of My Spirit then fall you down before him in prostration.""
verses.translation: When I have completed shaping him and have breathed into him of My Spirit then fall you down before him in prostration.""

verses.text: So the angels - all of them - fell down in prostration
verses.translation: So the angels - all of them - fell down in prostration

verses.text: except Iblis; he refused to join those who prostrated.
verses.translation: except Iblis; he refused to join those who prostrated.

verses.text: The Lord inquired: ""Iblis! What is the matter with you that you did not join those who prostrated?""
verses.translation: The Lord inquired: ""Iblis! What is the matter with you that you did not join those who prostrated?""

verses.text: He said: ""It does not behove of me to prostrate myself before a human being whom You have created out of dry ringing clay wrought from black mud.""
verses.translation: He said: ""It does not behove of me to prostrate myself before a human being whom You have created out of dry ringing clay wrought from black mud.""

verses.text: The Lord said: ""Then get out of here; you are rejected
verses.translation: The Lord said: ""Then get out of here; you are rejected

verses.text: and there shall be a curse upon you till the Day of Recompense.""
verses.translation: and there shall be a curse upon you till the Day of Recompense.""

verses.text: Iblis said: ""My Lord! Grant me respite till the Day when they will be resurrected.""
verses.translation: Iblis said: ""My Lord! Grant me respite till the Day when they will be resurrected.""

verses.text: Allah said: ""For sure you are granted respite
verses.translation: Allah said: ""For sure you are granted respite

verses.text: until the day of a known time.""
verses.translation: until the day of a known time.""

verses.text: Iblis said: ""My Lord! In the manner You led me to error I will make things on earth seem attractive to them and lead all of them to error
verses.translation: Iblis said: ""My Lord! In the manner You led me to error I will make things on earth seem attractive to them and lead all of them to error

verses.text: except those of Your servants whom You have singled out for Yourself.""
verses.translation: except those of Your servants whom You have singled out for Yourself.""

verses.text: Allah said: ""Here is the path that leads straight to Me.
verses.translation: Allah said: ""Here is the path that leads straight to Me.

verses.text: Over My true servants you will be able to exercise no power your power will be confined to the erring ones those who choose to follow you.
verses.translation: Over My true servants you will be able to exercise no power your power will be confined to the erring ones those who choose to follow you.

verses.text: Surely Hell is the promised place for all of them.""
verses.translation: Surely Hell is the promised place for all of them.""

verses.text: There are seven gates in it and to each gate a portion of them has been allotted.
verses.translation: There are seven gates in it and to each gate a portion of them has been allotted.

verses.text: As for the God-fearing they shall be amid gardens and springs.
verses.translation: As for the God-fearing they shall be amid gardens and springs.

verses.text: They will be told: ""Enter it in peace and security.""
verses.translation: They will be told: ""Enter it in peace and security.""

verses.text: And We shall purge their breasts of all traces of rancour; and they shall be seated on couches facing one another as brothers.
verses.translation: And We shall purge their breasts of all traces of rancour; and they shall be seated on couches facing one another as brothers.

verses.text: They shall face no fatigue in it nor shall they ever be driven out of it.
verses.translation: They shall face no fatigue in it nor shall they ever be driven out of it.

verses.text: (O Prophet) declare to My servants that I am indeed Ever Forgiving Most Merciful.
verses.translation: (O Prophet) declare to My servants that I am indeed Ever Forgiving Most Merciful.

verses.text: At the same time My chastisement is highly painful.
verses.translation: At the same time My chastisement is highly painful.

verses.text: And tell them about Abraham''s guests.
verses.translation: And tell them about Abraham''s guests.

verses.text: When they came to Abraham they said: ""Peace be upon you!"" He replied: ""Indeed we feel afraid of you.""
verses.translation: When they came to Abraham they said: ""Peace be upon you!"" He replied: ""Indeed we feel afraid of you.""

verses.text: They said: ""Do not feel afraid for we give you the good news of a wise boy.""
verses.translation: They said: ""Do not feel afraid for we give you the good news of a wise boy.""

verses.text: Abraham said: ""What do you give me this tiding though old age has smitten me? Just consider what tiding do you give me!""
verses.translation: Abraham said: ""What do you give me this tiding though old age has smitten me? Just consider what tiding do you give me!""

verses.text: They said: ""The good tiding we give you is of truth. Do not therefore be of those who despair.""
verses.translation: They said: ""The good tiding we give you is of truth. Do not therefore be of those who despair.""

verses.text: Abraham said: ""Who despairs of the Mercy of his Lord except the misguided?""
verses.translation: Abraham said: ""Who despairs of the Mercy of his Lord except the misguided?""

verses.text: He added: ""What is your errand O sent ones?""
verses.translation: He added: ""What is your errand O sent ones?""
