verses.text: They said: ""Verily we have been sent to a guilty people
verses.translation: They said: ""Verily we have been sent to a guilty people

verses.text: excepting the household of Lot. We shall deliver all of them
verses.translation: excepting the household of Lot. We shall deliver all of them

verses.text: except his wife (about whom Allah says that) We have decreed that she shall be among those who stay behind.""
verses.translation: except his wife (about whom Allah says that) We have decreed that she shall be among those who stay behind.""

verses.text: So when the envoys came to the household of Lot
verses.translation: So when the envoys came to the household of Lot

verses.text: he said: ""Surely you are an unknown folk.""
verses.translation: he said: ""Surely you are an unknown folk.""

verses.text: They said: ""Nay we have brought to you that concerning which they have been in doubt.
verses.translation: They said: ""Nay we have brought to you that concerning which they have been in doubt.

verses.text: We truly tell you that we have brought to you the Truth.
verses.translation: We truly tell you that we have brought to you the Truth.

verses.text: So set out with your family in a watch of the night and keep yourself behind them and no one of you may turn around and keep going ahead as you have been commanded.""
verses.translation: So set out with your family in a watch of the night and keep yourself behind them and no one of you may turn around and keep going ahead as you have been commanded.""

verses.text: And We communicated to him the decree that by the morning those people will be totally destroyed.
verses.translation: And We communicated to him the decree that by the morning those people will be totally destroyed.

verses.text: In the meantime the people of the city came to Lot rejoicing.
verses.translation: In the meantime the people of the city came to Lot rejoicing.

verses.text: He said: ""These are my guests so do not disgrace me.
verses.translation: He said: ""These are my guests so do not disgrace me.

verses.text: Have fear of Allah and do not humiliate me.""
verses.translation: Have fear of Allah and do not humiliate me.""

verses.text: They replied: ""Did we not forbid you again and again to extend hospitality to all and sundry?""
verses.translation: They replied: ""Did we not forbid you again and again to extend hospitality to all and sundry?""

verses.text: Lot exclaimed in exasperation: ""If you are bent on doing something then here are my daughters.""
verses.translation: Lot exclaimed in exasperation: ""If you are bent on doing something then here are my daughters.""

verses.text: By your life (O Prophet) they went about blindly stumbling in their intoxication.
verses.translation: By your life (O Prophet) they went about blindly stumbling in their intoxication.

verses.text: Then the mighty Blast caught them at sunrise
verses.translation: Then the mighty Blast caught them at sunrise

verses.text: and turned the land upside down and rained down stones of baked clay.
verses.translation: and turned the land upside down and rained down stones of baked clay.

verses.text: There are great Signs in this for those endowed with intelligence.
verses.translation: There are great Signs in this for those endowed with intelligence.

verses.text: The place (where this occurred) lies along a known route.
verses.translation: The place (where this occurred) lies along a known route.

verses.text: Verily there is a Sign in this for the believers.
verses.translation: Verily there is a Sign in this for the believers.

verses.text: And the people of Aykah were also wrong-doers.
verses.translation: And the people of Aykah were also wrong-doers.

verses.text: So We chastised them. The desolate locations of both communities lie on a well-known highway.
verses.translation: So We chastised them. The desolate locations of both communities lie on a well-known highway.

verses.text: Surely the people of al-Hijr also rejected the Messengers calling them liars.
verses.translation: Surely the people of al-Hijr also rejected the Messengers calling them liars.

verses.text: We also gave them Our Signs yet they turned away from them.
verses.translation: We also gave them Our Signs yet they turned away from them.

verses.text: They used to hew out houses from the mountains and lived in security.
verses.translation: They used to hew out houses from the mountains and lived in security.

verses.text: Then the Blast caught them in the morning
verses.translation: Then the Blast caught them in the morning

verses.text: and whatever they had been earning proved of no avail.
verses.translation: and whatever they had been earning proved of no avail.

verses.text: We have not created the heavens and the earth and all that is in between them except with Truth. Surely the Hour will come. So (O Muhammad) do graciously overlook them (despite their misdeeds).
verses.translation: We have not created the heavens and the earth and all that is in between them except with Truth. Surely the Hour will come. So (O Muhammad) do graciously overlook them (despite their misdeeds).

verses.text: Your Lord is indeed the Creator of all the All-Knowing.
verses.translation: Your Lord is indeed the Creator of all the All-Knowing.

verses.text: We have indeed bestowed on you the seven oft-repeated verses and the Great Qur''an.
verses.translation: We have indeed bestowed on you the seven oft-repeated verses and the Great Qur''an.

verses.text: Do not even cast your eyes towards the worldly goods We have granted to different kinds of people nor grieve over the state they are in but turn your loving attention to the believers instead
verses.translation: Do not even cast your eyes towards the worldly goods We have granted to different kinds of people nor grieve over the state they are in but turn your loving attention to the believers instead

verses.text: and clearly tell the unbelievers: ""I am most certainly a plain warner
verses.translation: and clearly tell the unbelievers: ""I am most certainly a plain warner

verses.text: even as We had sent warning to those who had divided their religion into fragments;
verses.translation: even as We had sent warning to those who had divided their religion into fragments;

verses.text: those who had split up their Qur''an into pieces.
verses.translation: those who had split up their Qur''an into pieces.

verses.text: By your Lord We will question them all
verses.translation: By your Lord We will question them all

verses.text: concerning what they have been doing.
verses.translation: concerning what they have been doing.

verses.text: (O Prophet) proclaim what you are commanded and pay no heed to those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity.
verses.translation: (O Prophet) proclaim what you are commanded and pay no heed to those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity.

verses.text: Surely We suffice to deal with those who scoff at you
verses.translation: Surely We suffice to deal with those who scoff at you

verses.text: those who set up another deity alongside Allah. They shall soon come to know.
verses.translation: those who set up another deity alongside Allah. They shall soon come to know.

verses.text: We certainly know that their statements sorely grieve you.
verses.translation: We certainly know that their statements sorely grieve you.

verses.text: When (you feel so) glorify your Lord with His praise and prostrate yourself before Him
verses.translation: When (you feel so) glorify your Lord with His praise and prostrate yourself before Him

verses.text: and worship your Lord until the last moment (of your life) that will most certainly come.
verses.translation: and worship your Lord until the last moment (of your life) that will most certainly come.

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: Alif. Lam. Ra''. These are the verses of the Book and a Clear Qur''an.
ayahs.translation: Alif. Lam. Ra''. These are the verses of the Book and a Clear Qur''an.

ayahs.text: Soon will the time come when the unbelievers will wish they were Muslims.
ayahs.translation: Soon will the time come when the unbelievers will wish they were Muslims.

ayahs.text: Leave them to eat and enjoy life and let false hopes amuse them. They will soon come to know.
ayahs.translation: Leave them to eat and enjoy life and let false hopes amuse them. They will soon come to know.

ayahs.text: Whenever We destroyed a town a definite term had previously been decreed for it.
ayahs.translation: Whenever We destroyed a town a definite term had previously been decreed for it.

ayahs.text: No people can outstrip the term for its destruction nor can it delay it.
ayahs.translation: No people can outstrip the term for its destruction nor can it delay it.

ayahs.text: They say: ""O you to whom the Admonition has been revealed you are surely crazed.
ayahs.translation: They say: ""O you to whom the Admonition has been revealed you are surely crazed.

ayahs.text: Why do you not bring down angels upon us if you are indeed truthful?""
ayahs.translation: Why do you not bring down angels upon us if you are indeed truthful?""

ayahs.text: We do not send down the angels (in frivolity); and when We do send them down We do so with Truth; then people are granted no respite.
ayahs.translation: We do not send down the angels (in frivolity); and when We do send them down We do so with Truth; then people are granted no respite.

ayahs.text: As for the Admonition indeed it is We Who have revealed it and it is indeed We Who are its guardians.
ayahs.translation: As for the Admonition indeed it is We Who have revealed it and it is indeed We Who are its guardians.

ayahs.text: (O Muhammad) certainly We did send Messengers before you among the nations which have gone by.
ayahs.translation: (O Muhammad) certainly We did send Messengers before you among the nations which have gone by.

ayahs.text: And whenever a Messenger came to them they never failed to mock him.
ayahs.translation: And whenever a Messenger came to them they never failed to mock him.

ayahs.text: Even so We make a way for it (that is the Admonition) in the hearts of the culprits (like a hot rod);
ayahs.translation: Even so We make a way for it (that is the Admonition) in the hearts of the culprits (like a hot rod);

ayahs.text: they do not believe in it. This has been the wont of people of this kind from ancient times.
ayahs.translation: they do not believe in it. This has been the wont of people of this kind from ancient times.

ayahs.text: If We were even to open for them a way to the heavens and they could continually climb up to it in broad daylight
ayahs.translation: If We were even to open for them a way to the heavens and they could continually climb up to it in broad daylight

ayahs.text: they would still have said: ""Surely our eyes have been dazzled; rather we have been enchanted.""
ayahs.translation: they would still have said: ""Surely our eyes have been dazzled; rather we have been enchanted.""

ayahs.text: We have indeed set constellations in the heavens and have beautified them for the beholders
ayahs.translation: We have indeed set constellations in the heavens and have beautified them for the beholders

ayahs.text: and have protected them against every accursed satan
ayahs.translation: and have protected them against every accursed satan

ayahs.text: save him who may eavesdrop and then a bright flame pursues him.
ayahs.translation: save him who may eavesdrop and then a bright flame pursues him.

ayahs.text: As for the earth We have stretched it out and have cast on it firm mountains and have caused to grow in it everything well-measured.
ayahs.translation: As for the earth We have stretched it out and have cast on it firm mountains and have caused to grow in it everything well-measured.

ayahs.text: And We have provided sustenance for you on it and also for those of whom you are not the providers.
ayahs.translation: And We have provided sustenance for you on it and also for those of whom you are not the providers.

ayahs.text: There is nothing except that its treasuries are with Us and We do not send it down except in a known measure.
ayahs.translation: There is nothing except that its treasuries are with Us and We do not send it down except in a known measure.

ayahs.text: We send fertilizing winds and then cause rain to descend from the sky providing you abundant water to drink even though you could not have stored it up for yourselves.
ayahs.translation: We send fertilizing winds and then cause rain to descend from the sky providing you abundant water to drink even though you could not have stored it up for yourselves.

ayahs.text: It is indeed We Who grant life and cause death and it is We who shall be the sole Inheritors of all.
ayahs.translation: It is indeed We Who grant life and cause death and it is We who shall be the sole Inheritors of all.

ayahs.text: Surely We know those of you who have passed before and those who will come later.
ayahs.translation: Surely We know those of you who have passed before and those who will come later.

ayahs.text: Indeed your Lord will gather them all together. Surely He is All-Wise All-Knowing.
ayahs.translation: Indeed your Lord will gather them all together. Surely He is All-Wise All-Knowing.

ayahs.text: Surely We brought man into being out of dry ringing clay which was wrought from black mud
ayahs.translation: Surely We brought man into being out of dry ringing clay which was wrought from black mud

ayahs.text: while We had brought the jinn into being before out of blazing fire.
ayahs.translation: while We had brought the jinn into being before out of blazing fire.

ayahs.text: Recall when your Lord said to the angels: ""I will indeed bring into being a human being out of dry ringing clay wrought from black mud.
ayahs.translation: Recall when your Lord said to the angels: ""I will indeed bring into being a human being out of dry ringing clay wrought from black mud.

ayahs.text: When I have completed shaping him and have breathed into him of My Spirit then fall you down before him in prostration.""
ayahs.translation: When I have completed shaping him and have breathed into him of My Spirit then fall you down before him in prostration.""

ayahs.text: So the angels - all of them - fell down in prostration
ayahs.translation: So the angels - all of them - fell down in prostration

ayahs.text: except Iblis; he refused to join those who prostrated.
ayahs.translation: except Iblis; he refused to join those who prostrated.

ayahs.text: The Lord inquired: ""Iblis! What is the matter with you that you did not join those who prostrated?""
ayahs.translation: The Lord inquired: ""Iblis! What is the matter with you that you did not join those who prostrated?""

ayahs.text: He said: ""It does not behove of me to prostrate myself before a human being whom You have created out of dry ringing clay wrought from black mud.""
ayahs.translation: He said: ""It does not behove of me to prostrate myself before a human being whom You have created out of dry ringing clay wrought from black mud.""

ayahs.text: The Lord said: ""Then get out of here; you are rejected
ayahs.translation: The Lord said: ""Then get out of here; you are rejected

ayahs.text: and there shall be a curse upon you till the Day of Recompense.""
ayahs.translation: and there shall be a curse upon you till the Day of Recompense.""

ayahs.text: Iblis said: ""My Lord! Grant me respite till the Day when they will be resurrected.""
ayahs.translation: Iblis said: ""My Lord! Grant me respite till the Day when they will be resurrected.""

ayahs.text: Allah said: ""For sure you are granted respite
ayahs.translation: Allah said: ""For sure you are granted respite

ayahs.text: until the day of a known time.""
ayahs.translation: until the day of a known time.""

ayahs.text: Iblis said: ""My Lord! In the manner You led me to error I will make things on earth seem attractive to them and lead all of them to error
ayahs.translation: Iblis said: ""My Lord! In the manner You led me to error I will make things on earth seem attractive to them and lead all of them to error

ayahs.text: except those of Your servants whom You have singled out for Yourself.""
ayahs.translation: except those of Your servants whom You have singled out for Yourself.""

ayahs.text: Allah said: ""Here is the path that leads straight to Me.
ayahs.translation: Allah said: ""Here is the path that leads straight to Me.

ayahs.text: Over My true servants you will be able to exercise no power your power will be confined to the erring ones those who choose to follow you.
ayahs.translation: Over My true servants you will be able to exercise no power your power will be confined to the erring ones those who choose to follow you.

ayahs.text: Surely Hell is the promised place for all of them.""
ayahs.translation: Surely Hell is the promised place for all of them.""

ayahs.text: There are seven gates in it and to each gate a portion of them has been allotted.
ayahs.translation: There are seven gates in it and to each gate a portion of them has been allotted.

ayahs.text: As for the God-fearing they shall be amid gardens and springs.
ayahs.translation: As for the God-fearing they shall be amid gardens and springs.

ayahs.text: They will be told: ""Enter it in peace and security.""
ayahs.translation: They will be told: ""Enter it in peace and security.""

ayahs.text: And We shall purge their breasts of all traces of rancour; and they shall be seated on couches facing one another as brothers.
ayahs.translation: And We shall purge their breasts of all traces of rancour; and they shall be seated on couches facing one another as brothers.

ayahs.text: They shall face no fatigue in it nor shall they ever be driven out of it.
ayahs.translation: They shall face no fatigue in it nor shall they ever be driven out of it.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) declare to My servants that I am indeed Ever Forgiving Most Merciful.
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) declare to My servants that I am indeed Ever Forgiving Most Merciful.

ayahs.text: At the same time My chastisement is highly painful.
ayahs.translation: At the same time My chastisement is highly painful.

ayahs.text: And tell them about Abraham''s guests.
ayahs.translation: And tell them about Abraham''s guests.

ayahs.text: When they came to Abraham they said: ""Peace be upon you!"" He replied: ""Indeed we feel afraid of you.""
ayahs.translation: When they came to Abraham they said: ""Peace be upon you!"" He replied: ""Indeed we feel afraid of you.""

ayahs.text: They said: ""Do not feel afraid for we give you the good news of a wise boy.""
ayahs.translation: They said: ""Do not feel afraid for we give you the good news of a wise boy.""

ayahs.text: Abraham said: ""What do you give me this tiding though old age has smitten me? Just consider what tiding do you give me!""
ayahs.translation: Abraham said: ""What do you give me this tiding though old age has smitten me? Just consider what tiding do you give me!""

ayahs.text: They said: ""The good tiding we give you is of truth. Do not therefore be of those who despair.""
ayahs.translation: They said: ""The good tiding we give you is of truth. Do not therefore be of those who despair.""

ayahs.text: Abraham said: ""Who despairs of the Mercy of his Lord except the misguided?""
ayahs.translation: Abraham said: ""Who despairs of the Mercy of his Lord except the misguided?""

ayahs.text: He added: ""What is your errand O sent ones?""
ayahs.translation: He added: ""What is your errand O sent ones?""

ayahs.text: They said: ""Verily we have been sent to a guilty people
ayahs.translation: They said: ""Verily we have been sent to a guilty people

ayahs.text: excepting the household of Lot. We shall deliver all of them
ayahs.translation: excepting the household of Lot. We shall deliver all of them

ayahs.text: except his wife (about whom Allah says that) We have decreed that she shall be among those who stay behind.""
ayahs.translation: except his wife (about whom Allah says that) We have decreed that she shall be among those who stay behind.""

ayahs.text: So when the envoys came to the household of Lot
ayahs.translation: So when the envoys came to the household of Lot

ayahs.text: he said: ""Surely you are an unknown folk.""
ayahs.translation: he said: ""Surely you are an unknown folk.""

ayahs.text: They said: ""Nay we have brought to you that concerning which they have been in doubt.
ayahs.translation: They said: ""Nay we have brought to you that concerning which they have been in doubt.

ayahs.text: We truly tell you that we have brought to you the Truth.
ayahs.translation: We truly tell you that we have brought to you the Truth.

ayahs.text: So set out with your family in a watch of the night and keep yourself behind them and no one of you may turn around and keep going ahead as you have been commanded.""
ayahs.translation: So set out with your family in a watch of the night and keep yourself behind them and no one of you may turn around and keep going ahead as you have been commanded.""

ayahs.text: And We communicated to him the decree that by the morning those people will be totally destroyed.
ayahs.translation: And We communicated to him the decree that by the morning those people will be totally destroyed.

ayahs.text: In the meantime the people of the city came to Lot rejoicing.
ayahs.translation: In the meantime the people of the city came to Lot rejoicing.

ayahs.text: He said: ""These are my guests so do not disgrace me.
ayahs.translation: He said: ""These are my guests so do not disgrace me.

ayahs.text: Have fear of Allah and do not humiliate me.""
ayahs.translation: Have fear of Allah and do not humiliate me.""

ayahs.text: They replied: ""Did we not forbid you again and again to extend hospitality to all and sundry?""
ayahs.translation: They replied: ""Did we not forbid you again and again to extend hospitality to all and sundry?""

ayahs.text: Lot exclaimed in exasperation: ""If you are bent on doing something then here are my daughters.""
ayahs.translation: Lot exclaimed in exasperation: ""If you are bent on doing something then here are my daughters.""

ayahs.text: By your life (O Prophet) they went about blindly stumbling in their intoxication.
ayahs.translation: By your life (O Prophet) they went about blindly stumbling in their intoxication.

ayahs.text: Then the mighty Blast caught them at sunrise
ayahs.translation: Then the mighty Blast caught them at sunrise

ayahs.text: and turned the land upside down and rained down stones of baked clay.
ayahs.translation: and turned the land upside down and rained down stones of baked clay.

ayahs.text: There are great Signs in this for those endowed with intelligence.
ayahs.translation: There are great Signs in this for those endowed with intelligence.

ayahs.text: The place (where this occurred) lies along a known route.
ayahs.translation: The place (where this occurred) lies along a known route.

ayahs.text: Verily there is a Sign in this for the believers.
ayahs.translation: Verily there is a Sign in this for the believers.

ayahs.text: And the people of Aykah were also wrong-doers.
ayahs.translation: And the people of Aykah were also wrong-doers.

ayahs.text: So We chastised them. The desolate locations of both communities lie on a well-known highway.
ayahs.translation: So We chastised them. The desolate locations of both communities lie on a well-known highway.

ayahs.text: Surely the people of al-Hijr also rejected the Messengers calling them liars.
ayahs.translation: Surely the people of al-Hijr also rejected the Messengers calling them liars.

ayahs.text: We also gave them Our Signs yet they turned away from them.
ayahs.translation: We also gave them Our Signs yet they turned away from them.

ayahs.text: They used to hew out houses from the mountains and lived in security.
ayahs.translation: They used to hew out houses from the mountains and lived in security.

ayahs.text: Then the Blast caught them in the morning
ayahs.translation: Then the Blast caught them in the morning

ayahs.text: and whatever they had been earning proved of no avail.
ayahs.translation: and whatever they had been earning proved of no avail.

ayahs.text: We have not created the heavens and the earth and all that is in between them except with Truth. Surely the Hour will come. So (O Muhammad) do graciously overlook them (despite their misdeeds).
ayahs.translation: We have not created the heavens and the earth and all that is in between them except with Truth. Surely the Hour will come. So (O Muhammad) do graciously overlook them (despite their misdeeds).

ayahs.text: Your Lord is indeed the Creator of all the All-Knowing.
ayahs.translation: Your Lord is indeed the Creator of all the All-Knowing.

ayahs.text: We have indeed bestowed on you the seven oft-repeated verses and the Great Qur''an.
ayahs.translation: We have indeed bestowed on you the seven oft-repeated verses and the Great Qur''an.

ayahs.text: Do not even cast your eyes towards the worldly goods We have granted to different kinds of people nor grieve over the state they are in but turn your loving attention to the believers instead
ayahs.translation: Do not even cast your eyes towards the worldly goods We have granted to different kinds of people nor grieve over the state they are in but turn your loving attention to the believers instead

ayahs.text: and clearly tell the unbelievers: ""I am most certainly a plain warner
ayahs.translation: and clearly tell the unbelievers: ""I am most certainly a plain warner

ayahs.text: even as We had sent warning to those who had divided their religion into fragments;
ayahs.translation: even as We had sent warning to those who had divided their religion into fragments;

ayahs.text: those who had split up their Qur''an into pieces.
ayahs.translation: those who had split up their Qur''an into pieces.

ayahs.text: By your Lord We will question them all
ayahs.translation: By your Lord We will question them all

ayahs.text: concerning what they have been doing.
ayahs.translation: concerning what they have been doing.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) proclaim what you are commanded and pay no heed to those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity.
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) proclaim what you are commanded and pay no heed to those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity.

ayahs.text: Surely We suffice to deal with those who scoff at you
ayahs.translation: Surely We suffice to deal with those who scoff at you

ayahs.text: those who set up another deity alongside Allah. They shall soon come to know.
ayahs.translation: those who set up another deity alongside Allah. They shall soon come to know.

ayahs.text: We certainly know that their statements sorely grieve you.
ayahs.translation: We certainly know that their statements sorely grieve you.

ayahs.text: When (you feel so) glorify your Lord with His praise and prostrate yourself before Him
ayahs.translation: When (you feel so) glorify your Lord with His praise and prostrate yourself before Him

ayahs.text: and worship your Lord until the last moment (of your life) that will most certainly come.
ayahs.translation: and worship your Lord until the last moment (of your life) that will most certainly come.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Allah''s judgement has (all but) come; do not then call for its speedy advent. Holy is He and far above their associating others with Him in His Divinity.
verses.translation: Allah''s judgement has (all but) come; do not then call for its speedy advent. Holy is He and far above their associating others with Him in His Divinity.

verses.text: He sends down this spirit(of prophecy) by His command through His angels on any of His servants whom He wills (directing them): ""Warn people that there is no deity but Me; so hold Me alone in fear.""
verses.translation: He sends down this spirit(of prophecy) by His command through His angels on any of His servants whom He wills (directing them): ""Warn people that there is no deity but Me; so hold Me alone in fear.""

verses.text: He created the heavens and the earth with Truth. Exalted is He above whatever they associate with Allah in His Divinity.
verses.translation: He created the heavens and the earth with Truth. Exalted is He above whatever they associate with Allah in His Divinity.

verses.text: He created man out of a mere drop of fluid and lo! he turned into an open wrangler.
verses.translation: He created man out of a mere drop of fluid and lo! he turned into an open wrangler.

verses.text: He created the cattle. They are a source of clothing and food and also a variety of other benefits for you.
verses.translation: He created the cattle. They are a source of clothing and food and also a variety of other benefits for you.

verses.text: And you find beauty in them as you drive them to pasture in the morning and as you drive them back home in the evening;
verses.translation: And you find beauty in them as you drive them to pasture in the morning and as you drive them back home in the evening;

verses.text: and they carry your loads to many a place which you would be unable to reach without much hardship. Surely your Lord is Intensely Loving Most Merciful.
verses.translation: and they carry your loads to many a place which you would be unable to reach without much hardship. Surely your Lord is Intensely Loving Most Merciful.

verses.text: And He created horses and mules and asses for you to ride and also for your adornment. And He creates many things (for you) that you do not even know about.
verses.translation: And He created horses and mules and asses for you to ride and also for your adornment. And He creates many things (for you) that you do not even know about.

verses.text: It rests with Allah alone to show you the Right Way even when there are many crooked ways. Had He so willed He would have (perforce) guided you all aright.
verses.translation: It rests with Allah alone to show you the Right Way even when there are many crooked ways. Had He so willed He would have (perforce) guided you all aright.

verses.text: He it is Who sends down water for you from the sky out of which you drink and out of which grow the plants on which you pasture your cattle
verses.translation: He it is Who sends down water for you from the sky out of which you drink and out of which grow the plants on which you pasture your cattle

verses.text: and by virtue of which He causes crops and olives and date-palms and grapes and all kinds of fruit to grow for you. Surely in this there is a great Sign for those who reflect.
verses.translation: and by virtue of which He causes crops and olives and date-palms and grapes and all kinds of fruit to grow for you. Surely in this there is a great Sign for those who reflect.

verses.text: He has subjected for you the night and the day and the sun and the moon and the stars have also been made subservient by His command. Surely there are Signs in this for those who use their reason.
verses.translation: He has subjected for you the night and the day and the sun and the moon and the stars have also been made subservient by His command. Surely there are Signs in this for those who use their reason.

verses.text: And there are also Signs for those who take heed in the numerous things of various colours that He has created for you on earth.
verses.translation: And there are also Signs for those who take heed in the numerous things of various colours that He has created for you on earth.

verses.text: And He it is Who has subjected the sea that you may eat fresh fish from it and bring forth ornaments from it that you can wear. And you see ships ploughing their course through it so that you may go forth seeking His Bounty and be grateful to Him.
verses.translation: And He it is Who has subjected the sea that you may eat fresh fish from it and bring forth ornaments from it that you can wear. And you see ships ploughing their course through it so that you may go forth seeking His Bounty and be grateful to Him.

verses.text: And He has placed firm mountains on the earth lest it should move away from you and has made rivers and tracks that you may find your way
verses.translation: And He has placed firm mountains on the earth lest it should move away from you and has made rivers and tracks that you may find your way

verses.text: and He has set other landmarks in the earth. And by the stars too do people find their way.
verses.translation: and He has set other landmarks in the earth. And by the stars too do people find their way.

verses.text: Is then the One Who creates like the one who does not create? Will you not then take heed?
verses.translation: Is then the One Who creates like the one who does not create? Will you not then take heed?

verses.text: For were you to count the favours of Allah you will not be able to count them. Surely Allah is Ever Forgiving Most Merciful.
verses.translation: For were you to count the favours of Allah you will not be able to count them. Surely Allah is Ever Forgiving Most Merciful.

verses.text: Allah knows all that you conceal and all that you disclose.
verses.translation: Allah knows all that you conceal and all that you disclose.

verses.text: Those whom they call upon beside Allah have created nothing; rather they themselves were created;
verses.translation: Those whom they call upon beside Allah have created nothing; rather they themselves were created;

verses.text: they are dead not living. They do not even know when they will be resurrected.
verses.translation: they are dead not living. They do not even know when they will be resurrected.

verses.text: Your God is the One God. But the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter are steeped in rejection of the Truth and they are given to arrogance.
verses.translation: Your God is the One God. But the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter are steeped in rejection of the Truth and they are given to arrogance.

verses.text: Surely Allah knows all that they conceal and all that they disclose. He certainly does not love those who are steeped in arrogance.
verses.translation: Surely Allah knows all that they conceal and all that they disclose. He certainly does not love those who are steeped in arrogance.

verses.text: When they are asked: ""What is it that your Lord has revealed?"" They answer: ""They are merely tales of olden times!""
verses.translation: When they are asked: ""What is it that your Lord has revealed?"" They answer: ""They are merely tales of olden times!""

verses.text: (They say so) that they may bear the full weight of their burdens on the Day of Resurrection and also of the burdens of those whom they misled on account of their ignorance. What a heavy burden are they undertaking to bear!
verses.translation: (They say so) that they may bear the full weight of their burdens on the Day of Resurrection and also of the burdens of those whom they misled on account of their ignorance. What a heavy burden are they undertaking to bear!

verses.text: Surely many people before them had plotted in a similar manner to (vanquish the Truth) but Allah uprooted the whole structure of their plot from its foundations so that the roof fell in upon them and the chastisement (of Allah) visited them from unknown directions.
verses.translation: Surely many people before them had plotted in a similar manner to (vanquish the Truth) but Allah uprooted the whole structure of their plot from its foundations so that the roof fell in upon them and the chastisement (of Allah) visited them from unknown directions.

verses.text: And again on the Day of Resurrection He will bring them to disgrace and say: ""Tell Me now where are those to whom you ascribed a share in My Divinity and for whose sake you disputed (with the upholders of the Truth)?"" Those who were endowed with knowledge (in the world) will say: ""Surely today humiliation and misery shall be the lot of the unbelievers"";
verses.translation: And again on the Day of Resurrection He will bring them to disgrace and say: ""Tell Me now where are those to whom you ascribed a share in My Divinity and for whose sake you disputed (with the upholders of the Truth)?"" Those who were endowed with knowledge (in the world) will say: ""Surely today humiliation and misery shall be the lot of the unbelievers"";

verses.text: the same unbelievers who when the angels seize them and cause them to die while they are engaged in wrong-doing they will proffer their submission saying: ""We were engaged in no evil."" (The angels will answer them): ""Surely Allah knows well all that you did.
verses.translation: the same unbelievers who when the angels seize them and cause them to die while they are engaged in wrong-doing they will proffer their submission saying: ""We were engaged in no evil."" (The angels will answer them): ""Surely Allah knows well all that you did.

verses.text: Go now and enter the gate of Hell and abide in it for ever."" Evil indeed is the abode of the arrogant.
verses.translation: Go now and enter the gate of Hell and abide in it for ever."" Evil indeed is the abode of the arrogant.

verses.text: And when the God-fearing are asked: ""What has your Lord revealed?"" they answer: ""Something excellent!"" Good fortune in this world awaits those who do good; and certainly the abode of the Hereafter is even better for them. How excellent is the abode of the God-fearing:
verses.translation: And when the God-fearing are asked: ""What has your Lord revealed?"" they answer: ""Something excellent!"" Good fortune in this world awaits those who do good; and certainly the abode of the Hereafter is even better for them. How excellent is the abode of the God-fearing:

verses.text: everlasting gardens that they shall enter; the gardens beneath which rivers shall flow and where they shall have whatever they desire! Thus does Allah reward the God-fearing
verses.translation: everlasting gardens that they shall enter; the gardens beneath which rivers shall flow and where they shall have whatever they desire! Thus does Allah reward the God-fearing

verses.text: those whose souls the angels seize while they are in a state of purity saying: ""Peace be upon you. Enter Paradise as a reward for your deeds.""
verses.translation: those whose souls the angels seize while they are in a state of purity saying: ""Peace be upon you. Enter Paradise as a reward for your deeds.""

verses.text: (O Muhammad) are they waiting for anything else than that the angels should appear before them or that your Lord''s judgement should come? Many before them acted with similar temerity. And then what happened with them was not Allah''s wrong-doing; they rather wronged themselves.
verses.translation: (O Muhammad) are they waiting for anything else than that the angels should appear before them or that your Lord''s judgement should come? Many before them acted with similar temerity. And then what happened with them was not Allah''s wrong-doing; they rather wronged themselves.

verses.text: The evil consequences of their misdeeds overtook them and what they mocked at overwhelmed them.
verses.translation: The evil consequences of their misdeeds overtook them and what they mocked at overwhelmed them.

verses.text: Those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity say: ""Were Allah to will so neither we nor our forefathers would have worshipped any other than Him nor would we have prohibited anything without His command."" Their predecessors proffered similar excuses. Do the Messengers have any other duty but to plainly convey the Message?
verses.translation: Those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity say: ""Were Allah to will so neither we nor our forefathers would have worshipped any other than Him nor would we have prohibited anything without His command."" Their predecessors proffered similar excuses. Do the Messengers have any other duty but to plainly convey the Message?

verses.text: We raised a Messenger in every community (to tell them): ""Serve Allah and shun the Evil One."" Thereafter Allah guided some of them while others were overtaken by error. Go about the earth then and observe what was the end of those who rejected the Messengers calling them liars.
verses.translation: We raised a Messenger in every community (to tell them): ""Serve Allah and shun the Evil One."" Thereafter Allah guided some of them while others were overtaken by error. Go about the earth then and observe what was the end of those who rejected the Messengers calling them liars.

verses.text: (O Muhammad) howsoever eager you may be to show them the Right Way Allah does not bestow His guidance on those whom He lets go astray; and in fact none will be able to help them.
verses.translation: (O Muhammad) howsoever eager you may be to show them the Right Way Allah does not bestow His guidance on those whom He lets go astray; and in fact none will be able to help them.

verses.text: They swear most solemnly in the name of Allah and say: ""Allah shall not raise to life any who dies."" (Yes He will do so); that is a promise by which He is bound even though most people do not know that.
verses.translation: They swear most solemnly in the name of Allah and say: ""Allah shall not raise to life any who dies."" (Yes He will do so); that is a promise by which He is bound even though most people do not know that.

verses.text: (That is bound to happen in order that) He may make clear to them the reality regarding the matters on which they differ and that the unbelievers may realize that they were liars.
verses.translation: (That is bound to happen in order that) He may make clear to them the reality regarding the matters on which they differ and that the unbelievers may realize that they were liars.

verses.text: (As for the possibility of resurrection bear in mind that) whenever We do will something We have to do no more than say: ""Be"" and it is.
verses.translation: (As for the possibility of resurrection bear in mind that) whenever We do will something We have to do no more than say: ""Be"" and it is.

verses.text: As for those who have forsaken their homes for the sake of Allah after enduring persecution We shall certainly grant them a good abode in this world; and surely the reward of the Hereafter is much greater. If they could but know (what an excellent end awaits) those who remain steadfast and put their trust in their Lord.
verses.translation: As for those who have forsaken their homes for the sake of Allah after enduring persecution We shall certainly grant them a good abode in this world; and surely the reward of the Hereafter is much greater. If they could but know (what an excellent end awaits) those who remain steadfast and put their trust in their Lord.

verses.text: As for those who have forsaken their homes for the sake of Allah after enduring persecution We shall certainly grant them a good abode in this world; and surely the reward of the Hereafter is much greater. If they could but know (what an excellent end awaits) those who remain steadfast and put their trust in their Lord.
verses.translation: As for those who have forsaken their homes for the sake of Allah after enduring persecution We shall certainly grant them a good abode in this world; and surely the reward of the Hereafter is much greater. If they could but know (what an excellent end awaits) those who remain steadfast and put their trust in their Lord.

verses.text: (O Muhammad) whenever We raised any Messengers before you they were no other than human beings; (except that) to them We sent revelation. So ask those who possess knowledge if you do not know.
verses.translation: (O Muhammad) whenever We raised any Messengers before you they were no other than human beings; (except that) to them We sent revelation. So ask those who possess knowledge if you do not know.

verses.text: We raised the Messengers earlier with Clear Signs and Divine Books and We have now sent down this Reminder upon you that you may elucidate to people the teaching that has been sent down for them and that the people may themselves reflect.
verses.translation: We raised the Messengers earlier with Clear Signs and Divine Books and We have now sent down this Reminder upon you that you may elucidate to people the teaching that has been sent down for them and that the people may themselves reflect.

verses.text: Do those who have been devising evil plans (against the mission of the Messenger) feel secure that Allah will not cause the earth to swallow them up or that chastisement will not come upon them from a direction that they will not even be able to imagine;
verses.translation: Do those who have been devising evil plans (against the mission of the Messenger) feel secure that Allah will not cause the earth to swallow them up or that chastisement will not come upon them from a direction that they will not even be able to imagine;

verses.text: or that He will not suddenly seize them while they are going about to and fro and they will be unable to frustrate His design
verses.translation: or that He will not suddenly seize them while they are going about to and fro and they will be unable to frustrate His design

verses.text: or that He will not seize them when they are apprehensive of the impending calamity? Surely your Lord is Most Compassionate Most Merciful.
verses.translation: or that He will not seize them when they are apprehensive of the impending calamity? Surely your Lord is Most Compassionate Most Merciful.

verses.text: Do the people not see how the objects Allah has created cast their shadows right and left prostrating themselves in utter submission to Allah?
verses.translation: Do the people not see how the objects Allah has created cast their shadows right and left prostrating themselves in utter submission to Allah?

verses.text: All living creatures and all angels in the heavens and on the earth are in prostration before Allah; and never do they behave in arrogant defiance.
verses.translation: All living creatures and all angels in the heavens and on the earth are in prostration before Allah; and never do they behave in arrogant defiance.

verses.text: They hold their Lord Who is above them in fear and do as they are bidden.
verses.translation: They hold their Lord Who is above them in fear and do as they are bidden.

verses.text: Allah has commanded: ""Do not take two gods; for He is but One God. So fear Me alone.""
verses.translation: Allah has commanded: ""Do not take two gods; for He is but One God. So fear Me alone.""

verses.text: His is whatever is in the heavens and the earth and obedience to Him inevitably pervades the whole universe. Will you then hold in awe any other than Allah?
verses.translation: His is whatever is in the heavens and the earth and obedience to Him inevitably pervades the whole universe. Will you then hold in awe any other than Allah?

verses.text: Every bounty that you enjoy is from Allah; and whenever any misfortune strikes you it is to Him that you cry for the removal of your distress.
verses.translation: Every bounty that you enjoy is from Allah; and whenever any misfortune strikes you it is to Him that you cry for the removal of your distress.

verses.text: But as soon as He removes the distress from you some of you associate others with their Lord in giving thanks
verses.translation: But as soon as He removes the distress from you some of you associate others with their Lord in giving thanks

verses.text: that they may show ingratitude for the bounties We bestowed upon them. So enjoy yourselves for a while soon you will come to know (the truth).
verses.translation: that they may show ingratitude for the bounties We bestowed upon them. So enjoy yourselves for a while soon you will come to know (the truth).

verses.text: They set apart for those whose reality they do not even know a portion of the sustenance We have provided them. By Allah you will surely be called to account for the lies that you have invented!
verses.translation: They set apart for those whose reality they do not even know a portion of the sustenance We have provided them. By Allah you will surely be called to account for the lies that you have invented!

verses.text: They assign daughters to Allah - glory be to Him - whereas they assign to themselves what they truly desire!
verses.translation: They assign daughters to Allah - glory be to Him - whereas they assign to themselves what they truly desire!

verses.text: When any of them is told about the birth of a female his face turns dark and he is filled with suppressed anger
verses.translation: When any of them is told about the birth of a female his face turns dark and he is filled with suppressed anger

verses.text: and he hides himself from people because of the bad news thinking: should he keep the child despite disgrace or should he bury it in dust? How evil is their estimate of Allah!
verses.translation: and he hides himself from people because of the bad news thinking: should he keep the child despite disgrace or should he bury it in dust? How evil is their estimate of Allah!

verses.text: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter deserve to be characterized with evil attributes whereas Allah''s are the most excellent attributes. He is the Most Mighty the Most Wise.
verses.translation: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter deserve to be characterized with evil attributes whereas Allah''s are the most excellent attributes. He is the Most Mighty the Most Wise.

verses.text: Were Allah to take people to task for their wrong-doing He would not have spared even a single living creature on the face of the earth. But He grants them respite until an appointed term. And when that term arrives they have no power to delay it by a single moment nor to hasten it.
verses.translation: Were Allah to take people to task for their wrong-doing He would not have spared even a single living creature on the face of the earth. But He grants them respite until an appointed term. And when that term arrives they have no power to delay it by a single moment nor to hasten it.

verses.text: They assign to Allah what they dislike for themselves and their tongues utter a sheer lie in stating that a happy state awaits them. Without doubt the Fire awaits them and it is to it that they shall be hastened.
verses.translation: They assign to Allah what they dislike for themselves and their tongues utter a sheer lie in stating that a happy state awaits them. Without doubt the Fire awaits them and it is to it that they shall be hastened.

verses.text: By Allah (O Muhammad) We sent Messengers to other communities before you but Satan made their evil deeds attractive to them (so they paid no heed to the call of the Messengers). The same Satan is their patron today and they are heading towards a painful chastisement.
verses.translation: By Allah (O Muhammad) We sent Messengers to other communities before you but Satan made their evil deeds attractive to them (so they paid no heed to the call of the Messengers). The same Satan is their patron today and they are heading towards a painful chastisement.

verses.text: We have sent down the Book that you may explain to them the truth concerning what they are disputing and that the Book may serve as a guidance and mercy for those who believe in it.
verses.translation: We have sent down the Book that you may explain to them the truth concerning what they are disputing and that the Book may serve as a guidance and mercy for those who believe in it.

verses.text: Allah sends down water from the heaven and thereby He instantly revives the earth after it lay dead. Verily there is a sign in it for those who have ears.
verses.translation: Allah sends down water from the heaven and thereby He instantly revives the earth after it lay dead. Verily there is a sign in it for those who have ears.

verses.text: Surely there is a lesson for you in the cattle: We provide you to drink out of that which is in their bellies between the faeces and the blood - pure milk - which is a palatable drink for those who take it.
verses.translation: Surely there is a lesson for you in the cattle: We provide you to drink out of that which is in their bellies between the faeces and the blood - pure milk - which is a palatable drink for those who take it.

verses.text: And out of the fruits of date-palms and grapes you derive intoxicants as well as wholesome sustenance. Surely there is a sign for those who use reason.
verses.translation: And out of the fruits of date-palms and grapes you derive intoxicants as well as wholesome sustenance. Surely there is a sign for those who use reason.

verses.text: Your Lord inspired the bee saying: ""Set up hives in the mountains and in the trees and in the trellises that people put up
verses.translation: Your Lord inspired the bee saying: ""Set up hives in the mountains and in the trees and in the trellises that people put up

verses.text: then suck the juice of every kind of fruit and keep treading the ways of your Lord which have been made easy."" There comes forth from their bellies a drink varied in colours wherein there is healing for men. Verily there is a sign in this for those who reflect.
verses.translation: then suck the juice of every kind of fruit and keep treading the ways of your Lord which have been made easy."" There comes forth from their bellies a drink varied in colours wherein there is healing for men. Verily there is a sign in this for those who reflect.

verses.text: Allah has created you and then He causes you to die. Some of you have your lives prolonged to an abject old age when one loses all knowledge after having acquired it. Allah is All-Knowing All-Powerful.
verses.translation: Allah has created you and then He causes you to die. Some of you have your lives prolonged to an abject old age when one loses all knowledge after having acquired it. Allah is All-Knowing All-Powerful.

verses.text: Allah has favoured some of you with more worldly provisions than others. Then those who are more favoured do not give away their provisions to their slaves lest they become equal sharers in it. Do they then deny the favour of Allah?
verses.translation: Allah has favoured some of you with more worldly provisions than others. Then those who are more favoured do not give away their provisions to their slaves lest they become equal sharers in it. Do they then deny the favour of Allah?

verses.text: And Allah has given you spouses from your kind and has granted you through your spouses sons and grandsons and has provided you wholesome things as sustenance. (After knowing all this) do they still believe in falsehood and deny Allah''s bounty
verses.translation: And Allah has given you spouses from your kind and has granted you through your spouses sons and grandsons and has provided you wholesome things as sustenance. (After knowing all this) do they still believe in falsehood and deny Allah''s bounty

verses.text: and worship instead of Allah those helpless beings who have no control over providing them any sustenance from the heavens and the earth; do you worship those who have no power to do anything of this sort?
verses.translation: and worship instead of Allah those helpless beings who have no control over providing them any sustenance from the heavens and the earth; do you worship those who have no power to do anything of this sort?

verses.text: So do not strike any similitudes to Allah. Allah knows whereas you do not know.
verses.translation: So do not strike any similitudes to Allah. Allah knows whereas you do not know.

verses.text: Allah sets forth a parable: There is one who is a slave and is owned by another and has no power over anything; and there is one whom We have granted good provision Ourselves of which he spends both secretly and openly. Can they be equal? All praise be to Allah. But most of them do not even know (this simple fact).
verses.translation: Allah sets forth a parable: There is one who is a slave and is owned by another and has no power over anything; and there is one whom We have granted good provision Ourselves of which he spends both secretly and openly. Can they be equal? All praise be to Allah. But most of them do not even know (this simple fact).

verses.text: Allah sets forth another parable: There are two men one of whom is dumb and has no power over anything; he is a burden to his master and wheresoever his master directs him he fails to bring forth any good. Can such a person be the equal of one who enjoins justice and himself follows the Right Way?
verses.translation: Allah sets forth another parable: There are two men one of whom is dumb and has no power over anything; he is a burden to his master and wheresoever his master directs him he fails to bring forth any good. Can such a person be the equal of one who enjoins justice and himself follows the Right Way?

verses.text: Allah has full knowledge of the truths beyond the reach of perception both in the heavens and the earth; and the coming of the Hour will take no more than the twinkling of an eye; it may take even less. Indeed Allah has power over everything.
verses.translation: Allah has full knowledge of the truths beyond the reach of perception both in the heavens and the earth; and the coming of the Hour will take no more than the twinkling of an eye; it may take even less. Indeed Allah has power over everything.

verses.text: Allah has brought you forth from your mothers'' wombs when you knew nothing and then gave you hearing and sight and thinking hearts so that you may give thanks.
verses.translation: Allah has brought you forth from your mothers'' wombs when you knew nothing and then gave you hearing and sight and thinking hearts so that you may give thanks.

verses.text: Have they never noticed the birds how they are held under control in the middle of the sky where none holds them (from falling) except Allah? Surely there are signs in this for those who believe.
verses.translation: Have they never noticed the birds how they are held under control in the middle of the sky where none holds them (from falling) except Allah? Surely there are signs in this for those who believe.

verses.text: Allah has made your houses a repose and has provided you with the skins of the cattle for your habitation which are light to handle both when you travel and when you camp; and out of their wool and their fur and their hair He has given you furnishings and goods for use over a period of time.
verses.translation: Allah has made your houses a repose and has provided you with the skins of the cattle for your habitation which are light to handle both when you travel and when you camp; and out of their wool and their fur and their hair He has given you furnishings and goods for use over a period of time.

verses.text: And Allah has provided shade for you out of some of the things He has created; and He has provided you with shelters in the mountains and has given you coats that protect you from heat as well as coats that protect you in battle. Thus does He complete His favour upon you that you may submit to Him.
verses.translation: And Allah has provided shade for you out of some of the things He has created; and He has provided you with shelters in the mountains and has given you coats that protect you from heat as well as coats that protect you in battle. Thus does He complete His favour upon you that you may submit to Him.

verses.text: But if they turn away your only duty is to clearly deliver the message of the truth.
verses.translation: But if they turn away your only duty is to clearly deliver the message of the truth.

verses.text: They are aware of the favours of Allah and yet refuse to acknowledge them. Most of them are determined not to accept the Truth.
verses.translation: They are aware of the favours of Allah and yet refuse to acknowledge them. Most of them are determined not to accept the Truth.

verses.text: (They are heedless of) the Day when We shall raise a witness from each community and then the unbelievers will neither be allowed to plead nor will they be asked to repent and seek pardon.
verses.translation: (They are heedless of) the Day when We shall raise a witness from each community and then the unbelievers will neither be allowed to plead nor will they be asked to repent and seek pardon.

verses.text: Once the wrong-doers have beheld the chastisement neither will it be lightened for them nor will they be granted any respite.
verses.translation: Once the wrong-doers have beheld the chastisement neither will it be lightened for them nor will they be granted any respite.

verses.text: And when those who associated others with Allah in His Divinity will see those to whom they ascribed this share they will say: ""Our Lord! These are the beings to whom we ascribed a share in Your Divinity and whom we called upon instead of You  whereupon those beings will fling at them the words: ""You are liars.""
verses.translation: And when those who associated others with Allah in His Divinity will see those to whom they ascribed this share they will say: ""Our Lord! These are the beings to whom we ascribed a share in Your Divinity and whom we called upon instead of You  whereupon those beings will fling at them the words: ""You are liars.""

verses.text: On that Day they will offer their submission and all that they had fabricated will have vanished.
verses.translation: On that Day they will offer their submission and all that they had fabricated will have vanished.

verses.text: As for those who disbelieved and barred others from the way of Allah We shall add further chastisement to their chastisement for all the mischief they did.
verses.translation: As for those who disbelieved and barred others from the way of Allah We shall add further chastisement to their chastisement for all the mischief they did.

verses.text: (O Muhammad) warn them of the coming of a Day when We shall bring forth a witness against them from each community and We shall bring you forth as a witness against them all; (and it is for that purpose that) We sent down the Book to you which makes everything clear and serves as a guidance and mercy and glad tidings to those who have submitted to Allah.
verses.translation: (O Muhammad) warn them of the coming of a Day when We shall bring forth a witness against them from each community and We shall bring you forth as a witness against them all; (and it is for that purpose that) We sent down the Book to you which makes everything clear and serves as a guidance and mercy and glad tidings to those who have submitted to Allah.

verses.text: Surely Allah enjoins justice kindness and the doing of good to kith and kin and forbids all that is shameful evil and oppressive. He exhorts you so that you may be mindful.
verses.translation: Surely Allah enjoins justice kindness and the doing of good to kith and kin and forbids all that is shameful evil and oppressive. He exhorts you so that you may be mindful.

verses.text: And fulfil the covenant which you have made with Allah and do not break your oaths after having firmly made them and after having made Allah your witness. Surely Allah knows all that you do.
verses.translation: And fulfil the covenant which you have made with Allah and do not break your oaths after having firmly made them and after having made Allah your witness. Surely Allah knows all that you do.

verses.text: And do not become like the woman who after having painstakingly spun her yarn caused it to disintegrate into pieces. You resort to oaths as instruments of mutual deceit so that one people might take greater advantage than another although Allah puts you to the test through this. Surely on the Day of Resurrection He will make clear the Truth concerning the matters over which you differed.
verses.translation: And do not become like the woman who after having painstakingly spun her yarn caused it to disintegrate into pieces. You resort to oaths as instruments of mutual deceit so that one people might take greater advantage than another although Allah puts you to the test through this. Surely on the Day of Resurrection He will make clear the Truth concerning the matters over which you differed.

verses.text: Had Allah so willed He would have made you all one single community. However He lets go astray whomsoever He wills and shows the Right Way to whomsoever He wills. Surely you shall be called to account regarding what you did.
verses.translation: Had Allah so willed He would have made you all one single community. However He lets go astray whomsoever He wills and shows the Right Way to whomsoever He wills. Surely you shall be called to account regarding what you did.

verses.text: Do not make your oaths a means of deceiving one another or else your foot may slip after having been firm and you may suffer evil consequences because of hindering people from the way of Allah. A mighty chastisement awaits you.
verses.translation: Do not make your oaths a means of deceiving one another or else your foot may slip after having been firm and you may suffer evil consequences because of hindering people from the way of Allah. A mighty chastisement awaits you.

verses.text: Do not barter away the covenant of Allah for a paltry gain. Verily that which is with Allah is far better for you if you only knew.
verses.translation: Do not barter away the covenant of Allah for a paltry gain. Verily that which is with Allah is far better for you if you only knew.

verses.text: Whatever you have is bound to pass away and whatever is with Allah will last. And We shall surely grant those who have been patient their reward according to the best of what they did.
verses.translation: Whatever you have is bound to pass away and whatever is with Allah will last. And We shall surely grant those who have been patient their reward according to the best of what they did.

verses.text: Whosoever acts righteously - whether a man or a woman - and embraces belief We will surely grant him a good life; and will surely grant such persons their reward according to the best of their deeds.
verses.translation: Whosoever acts righteously - whether a man or a woman - and embraces belief We will surely grant him a good life; and will surely grant such persons their reward according to the best of their deeds.

verses.text: Whenever you read the Qur''an seek refuge with Allah from Satan the accursed.
verses.translation: Whenever you read the Qur''an seek refuge with Allah from Satan the accursed.

verses.text: Surely he has no power over those who have faith and who place their trust in their Lord.
verses.translation: Surely he has no power over those who have faith and who place their trust in their Lord.

verses.text: He has power only over those who take him as their patron and who under his influence associate others with Allah in His Divinity.
verses.translation: He has power only over those who take him as their patron and who under his influence associate others with Allah in His Divinity.

verses.text: Whenever We replace one verse by another verse - and Allah knows what He should reveal - they are wont to say: ""You are nothing but a fabricator (who has invented the Qur''an)."" The fact is that most of them are ignorant of the Truth.
verses.translation: Whenever We replace one verse by another verse - and Allah knows what He should reveal - they are wont to say: ""You are nothing but a fabricator (who has invented the Qur''an)."" The fact is that most of them are ignorant of the Truth.

verses.text: Tell them: ""It is the spirit of holiness that has brought it down by stages from your Lord so that it might bring firmness to those who believe and guidance to the Right Way and give glad tidings of felicity and success to those who submit to Allah.""
verses.translation: Tell them: ""It is the spirit of holiness that has brought it down by stages from your Lord so that it might bring firmness to those who believe and guidance to the Right Way and give glad tidings of felicity and success to those who submit to Allah.""

verses.text: Surely We know well that they say about you: ""It is only a human being who teaches him  (notwithstanding) that he whom they maliciously hint at is of foreign tongue while this (Qur''an) is plain Arabic speech.
verses.translation: Surely We know well that they say about you: ""It is only a human being who teaches him  (notwithstanding) that he whom they maliciously hint at is of foreign tongue while this (Qur''an) is plain Arabic speech.

verses.text: Surely Allah will not enable those who do not believe in the signs of Allah to be directed to the Right Way and a painful chastisement awaits them.
verses.translation: Surely Allah will not enable those who do not believe in the signs of Allah to be directed to the Right Way and a painful chastisement awaits them.

verses.text: (It is not the Prophet who invents lies) it is rather those who do not believe in the signs of Allah who invent lies. They are liars.
verses.translation: (It is not the Prophet who invents lies) it is rather those who do not believe in the signs of Allah who invent lies. They are liars.

verses.text: Except for those who were forced to engage in infidelity to Allah after believing the while their hearts remained firmly convinced of their belief the ones whose hearts willingly embraced disbelief shall incur Allah''s wrath and a mighty chastisement lies in store for them.
verses.translation: Except for those who were forced to engage in infidelity to Allah after believing the while their hearts remained firmly convinced of their belief the ones whose hearts willingly embraced disbelief shall incur Allah''s wrath and a mighty chastisement lies in store for them.

verses.text: That is because they love the life of this world more than the Hereafter; and Allah does not guide those who are ungrateful to Allah for His favours.
verses.translation: That is because they love the life of this world more than the Hereafter; and Allah does not guide those who are ungrateful to Allah for His favours.

verses.text: They are the ones upon whose hearts and hearing and eyes Allah has set a seal. They are utterly steeped in heedlessness.
verses.translation: They are the ones upon whose hearts and hearing and eyes Allah has set a seal. They are utterly steeped in heedlessness.

verses.text: No doubt they shall be losers in the Hereafter.
verses.translation: No doubt they shall be losers in the Hereafter.

verses.text: And surely your Lord will be Most Forgiving and Most Merciful towards those who left their homes after they were persecuted and who thereafter struggled hard and remained constant.
verses.translation: And surely your Lord will be Most Forgiving and Most Merciful towards those who left their homes after they were persecuted and who thereafter struggled hard and remained constant.

verses.text: Allah''s judgement will come about them all on the Day when everyone shall come pleading in his defence and everyone shall be fully requited for his deeds and none shall be wronged in the least.
verses.translation: Allah''s judgement will come about them all on the Day when everyone shall come pleading in his defence and everyone shall be fully requited for his deeds and none shall be wronged in the least.

verses.text: Allah sets forth the parable of (the people of) a town who were secure and content and whose sustenance came in abundance from every quarter. But then the people of the town showed ingratitude towards Allah for His bounties so Allah afflicted them with hunger and fear in punishment for their evil deeds.
verses.translation: Allah sets forth the parable of (the people of) a town who were secure and content and whose sustenance came in abundance from every quarter. But then the people of the town showed ingratitude towards Allah for His bounties so Allah afflicted them with hunger and fear in punishment for their evil deeds.

verses.text: Most certainly a Messenger came to them from among them; but they rejected him calling him a liar. Therefore chastisement seized them while they engaged in wrong-doing.
verses.translation: Most certainly a Messenger came to them from among them; but they rejected him calling him a liar. Therefore chastisement seized them while they engaged in wrong-doing.

verses.text: So eat out of the lawful and good sustenance that Allah has bestowed upon you and thank Allah for His bounty if it is Him that you serve.
verses.translation: So eat out of the lawful and good sustenance that Allah has bestowed upon you and thank Allah for His bounty if it is Him that you serve.

verses.text: Allah has forbidden you only carrion and blood and the flesh of swine; also any animal over which the name of any other than Allah has been pronounced. But whoever eats of them under compelling necessity - neither desiring it nor exceeding the limit of absolute necessity - surely for such action Allah is Much Forgiving Most Merciful.
verses.translation: Allah has forbidden you only carrion and blood and the flesh of swine; also any animal over which the name of any other than Allah has been pronounced. But whoever eats of them under compelling necessity - neither desiring it nor exceeding the limit of absolute necessity - surely for such action Allah is Much Forgiving Most Merciful.

verses.text: And do not utter falsehoods by letting your tongues declare: ""This is lawful"" and ""That is unlawful  thus fabricating lies against Allah. Surely those who fabricate lies against Allah will never prosper.
verses.translation: And do not utter falsehoods by letting your tongues declare: ""This is lawful"" and ""That is unlawful  thus fabricating lies against Allah. Surely those who fabricate lies against Allah will never prosper.

verses.text: Brief is their enjoyment of the world and thereafter they shall suffer a painful chastisement.
verses.translation: Brief is their enjoyment of the world and thereafter they shall suffer a painful chastisement.

verses.text: We have already recounted to you what We prohibited to the Jews. In so doing We did not wrong them; it is they who wronged themselves.
verses.translation: We have already recounted to you what We prohibited to the Jews. In so doing We did not wrong them; it is they who wronged themselves.

verses.text: But to those who commit evil out of ignorance and then repent and amend their ways thereafter your Lord will be Much Forgiving Most Merciful.
verses.translation: But to those who commit evil out of ignorance and then repent and amend their ways thereafter your Lord will be Much Forgiving Most Merciful.

verses.text: Indeed Abraham was a whole community by himself obedient to Allah exclusively devoted to Him. And he was never one of those who associated others with Allah in His Divinity.
verses.translation: Indeed Abraham was a whole community by himself obedient to Allah exclusively devoted to Him. And he was never one of those who associated others with Allah in His Divinity.

verses.text: He rendered thanks to Allah for His bounties so that Allah chose him (for His favours) and directed him to the Right Way.
verses.translation: He rendered thanks to Allah for His bounties so that Allah chose him (for His favours) and directed him to the Right Way.

verses.text: We bestowed good upon him in this world and in the Hereafter he shall certainly be among the righteous.
verses.translation: We bestowed good upon him in this world and in the Hereafter he shall certainly be among the righteous.

verses.text: Then We revealed to you: ""Follow the way of Abraham with exclusive devotion to Allah. He was not one of those who associated others with Allah in His Divinity.""
verses.translation: Then We revealed to you: ""Follow the way of Abraham with exclusive devotion to Allah. He was not one of those who associated others with Allah in His Divinity.""

verses.text: As for the Sabbath it was made incumbent only on those who differed about its laws. Certainly your Lord will judge on the Day of Resurrection between them regarding the matters they disputed.
verses.translation: As for the Sabbath it was made incumbent only on those who differed about its laws. Certainly your Lord will judge on the Day of Resurrection between them regarding the matters they disputed.

verses.text: (O Prophet) call to the way of your Lord with wisdom and goodly exhortation and reason with them in the best manner possible. Surely your Lord knows best who has strayed away from His path and He also knows well those who are guided to the Right Way.
verses.translation: (O Prophet) call to the way of your Lord with wisdom and goodly exhortation and reason with them in the best manner possible. Surely your Lord knows best who has strayed away from His path and He also knows well those who are guided to the Right Way.

verses.text: If you take retribution then do so in proportion to the wrong done to you. But if you can bear such conduct with patience indeed that is best for the steadfast.
verses.translation: If you take retribution then do so in proportion to the wrong done to you. But if you can bear such conduct with patience indeed that is best for the steadfast.

verses.text: And bear with patience (O Muhammad) - and your patience is only because of the help of Allah - and do not grieve over them nor feel distressed by their evil plans.
verses.translation: And bear with patience (O Muhammad) - and your patience is only because of the help of Allah - and do not grieve over them nor feel distressed by their evil plans.

verses.text: For surely Allah is with those who hold Him in fear and do good.
verses.translation: For surely Allah is with those who hold Him in fear and do good.

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: Allah''s judgement has (all but) come; do not then call for its speedy advent. Holy is He and far above their associating others with Him in His Divinity.
ayahs.translation: Allah''s judgement has (all but) come; do not then call for its speedy advent. Holy is He and far above their associating others with Him in His Divinity.

ayahs.text: He sends down this spirit(of prophecy) by His command through His angels on any of His servants whom He wills (directing them): ""Warn people that there is no deity but Me; so hold Me alone in fear.""
ayahs.translation: He sends down this spirit(of prophecy) by His command through His angels on any of His servants whom He wills (directing them): ""Warn people that there is no deity but Me; so hold Me alone in fear.""

ayahs.text: He created the heavens and the earth with Truth. Exalted is He above whatever they associate with Allah in His Divinity.
ayahs.translation: He created the heavens and the earth with Truth. Exalted is He above whatever they associate with Allah in His Divinity.

ayahs.text: He created man out of a mere drop of fluid and lo! he turned into an open wrangler.
ayahs.translation: He created man out of a mere drop of fluid and lo! he turned into an open wrangler.

ayahs.text: He created the cattle. They are a source of clothing and food and also a variety of other benefits for you.
ayahs.translation: He created the cattle. They are a source of clothing and food and also a variety of other benefits for you.

ayahs.text: And you find beauty in them as you drive them to pasture in the morning and as you drive them back home in the evening;
