ayahs.translation: And you find beauty in them as you drive them to pasture in the morning and as you drive them back home in the evening;

ayahs.text: and they carry your loads to many a place which you would be unable to reach without much hardship. Surely your Lord is Intensely Loving Most Merciful.
ayahs.translation: and they carry your loads to many a place which you would be unable to reach without much hardship. Surely your Lord is Intensely Loving Most Merciful.

ayahs.text: And He created horses and mules and asses for you to ride and also for your adornment. And He creates many things (for you) that you do not even know about.
ayahs.translation: And He created horses and mules and asses for you to ride and also for your adornment. And He creates many things (for you) that you do not even know about.

ayahs.text: It rests with Allah alone to show you the Right Way even when there are many crooked ways. Had He so willed He would have (perforce) guided you all aright.
ayahs.translation: It rests with Allah alone to show you the Right Way even when there are many crooked ways. Had He so willed He would have (perforce) guided you all aright.

ayahs.text: He it is Who sends down water for you from the sky out of which you drink and out of which grow the plants on which you pasture your cattle
ayahs.translation: He it is Who sends down water for you from the sky out of which you drink and out of which grow the plants on which you pasture your cattle

ayahs.text: and by virtue of which He causes crops and olives and date-palms and grapes and all kinds of fruit to grow for you. Surely in this there is a great Sign for those who reflect.
ayahs.translation: and by virtue of which He causes crops and olives and date-palms and grapes and all kinds of fruit to grow for you. Surely in this there is a great Sign for those who reflect.

ayahs.text: He has subjected for you the night and the day and the sun and the moon and the stars have also been made subservient by His command. Surely there are Signs in this for those who use their reason.
ayahs.translation: He has subjected for you the night and the day and the sun and the moon and the stars have also been made subservient by His command. Surely there are Signs in this for those who use their reason.

ayahs.text: And there are also Signs for those who take heed in the numerous things of various colours that He has created for you on earth.
ayahs.translation: And there are also Signs for those who take heed in the numerous things of various colours that He has created for you on earth.

ayahs.text: And He it is Who has subjected the sea that you may eat fresh fish from it and bring forth ornaments from it that you can wear. And you see ships ploughing their course through it so that you may go forth seeking His Bounty and be grateful to Him.
ayahs.translation: And He it is Who has subjected the sea that you may eat fresh fish from it and bring forth ornaments from it that you can wear. And you see ships ploughing their course through it so that you may go forth seeking His Bounty and be grateful to Him.

ayahs.text: And He has placed firm mountains on the earth lest it should move away from you and has made rivers and tracks that you may find your way
ayahs.translation: And He has placed firm mountains on the earth lest it should move away from you and has made rivers and tracks that you may find your way

ayahs.text: and He has set other landmarks in the earth. And by the stars too do people find their way.
ayahs.translation: and He has set other landmarks in the earth. And by the stars too do people find their way.

ayahs.text: Is then the One Who creates like the one who does not create? Will you not then take heed?
ayahs.translation: Is then the One Who creates like the one who does not create? Will you not then take heed?

ayahs.text: For were you to count the favours of Allah you will not be able to count them. Surely Allah is Ever Forgiving Most Merciful.
ayahs.translation: For were you to count the favours of Allah you will not be able to count them. Surely Allah is Ever Forgiving Most Merciful.

ayahs.text: Allah knows all that you conceal and all that you disclose.
ayahs.translation: Allah knows all that you conceal and all that you disclose.

ayahs.text: Those whom they call upon beside Allah have created nothing; rather they themselves were created;
ayahs.translation: Those whom they call upon beside Allah have created nothing; rather they themselves were created;

ayahs.text: they are dead not living. They do not even know when they will be resurrected.
ayahs.translation: they are dead not living. They do not even know when they will be resurrected.

ayahs.text: Your God is the One God. But the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter are steeped in rejection of the Truth and they are given to arrogance.
ayahs.translation: Your God is the One God. But the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter are steeped in rejection of the Truth and they are given to arrogance.

ayahs.text: Surely Allah knows all that they conceal and all that they disclose. He certainly does not love those who are steeped in arrogance.
ayahs.translation: Surely Allah knows all that they conceal and all that they disclose. He certainly does not love those who are steeped in arrogance.

ayahs.text: When they are asked: ""What is it that your Lord has revealed?"" They answer: ""They are merely tales of olden times!""
ayahs.translation: When they are asked: ""What is it that your Lord has revealed?"" They answer: ""They are merely tales of olden times!""

ayahs.text: (They say so) that they may bear the full weight of their burdens on the Day of Resurrection and also of the burdens of those whom they misled on account of their ignorance. What a heavy burden are they undertaking to bear!
ayahs.translation: (They say so) that they may bear the full weight of their burdens on the Day of Resurrection and also of the burdens of those whom they misled on account of their ignorance. What a heavy burden are they undertaking to bear!

ayahs.text: Surely many people before them had plotted in a similar manner to (vanquish the Truth) but Allah uprooted the whole structure of their plot from its foundations so that the roof fell in upon them and the chastisement (of Allah) visited them from unknown directions.
ayahs.translation: Surely many people before them had plotted in a similar manner to (vanquish the Truth) but Allah uprooted the whole structure of their plot from its foundations so that the roof fell in upon them and the chastisement (of Allah) visited them from unknown directions.

ayahs.text: And again on the Day of Resurrection He will bring them to disgrace and say: ""Tell Me now where are those to whom you ascribed a share in My Divinity and for whose sake you disputed (with the upholders of the Truth)?"" Those who were endowed with knowledge (in the world) will say: ""Surely today humiliation and misery shall be the lot of the unbelievers"";
ayahs.translation: And again on the Day of Resurrection He will bring them to disgrace and say: ""Tell Me now where are those to whom you ascribed a share in My Divinity and for whose sake you disputed (with the upholders of the Truth)?"" Those who were endowed with knowledge (in the world) will say: ""Surely today humiliation and misery shall be the lot of the unbelievers"";

ayahs.text: the same unbelievers who when the angels seize them and cause them to die while they are engaged in wrong-doing they will proffer their submission saying: ""We were engaged in no evil."" (The angels will answer them): ""Surely Allah knows well all that you did.
ayahs.translation: the same unbelievers who when the angels seize them and cause them to die while they are engaged in wrong-doing they will proffer their submission saying: ""We were engaged in no evil."" (The angels will answer them): ""Surely Allah knows well all that you did.

ayahs.text: Go now and enter the gate of Hell and abide in it for ever."" Evil indeed is the abode of the arrogant.
ayahs.translation: Go now and enter the gate of Hell and abide in it for ever."" Evil indeed is the abode of the arrogant.

ayahs.text: And when the God-fearing are asked: ""What has your Lord revealed?"" they answer: ""Something excellent!"" Good fortune in this world awaits those who do good; and certainly the abode of the Hereafter is even better for them. How excellent is the abode of the God-fearing:
ayahs.translation: And when the God-fearing are asked: ""What has your Lord revealed?"" they answer: ""Something excellent!"" Good fortune in this world awaits those who do good; and certainly the abode of the Hereafter is even better for them. How excellent is the abode of the God-fearing:

ayahs.text: everlasting gardens that they shall enter; the gardens beneath which rivers shall flow and where they shall have whatever they desire! Thus does Allah reward the God-fearing
ayahs.translation: everlasting gardens that they shall enter; the gardens beneath which rivers shall flow and where they shall have whatever they desire! Thus does Allah reward the God-fearing

ayahs.text: those whose souls the angels seize while they are in a state of purity saying: ""Peace be upon you. Enter Paradise as a reward for your deeds.""
ayahs.translation: those whose souls the angels seize while they are in a state of purity saying: ""Peace be upon you. Enter Paradise as a reward for your deeds.""

ayahs.text: (O Muhammad) are they waiting for anything else than that the angels should appear before them or that your Lord''s judgement should come? Many before them acted with similar temerity. And then what happened with them was not Allah''s wrong-doing; they rather wronged themselves.
ayahs.translation: (O Muhammad) are they waiting for anything else than that the angels should appear before them or that your Lord''s judgement should come? Many before them acted with similar temerity. And then what happened with them was not Allah''s wrong-doing; they rather wronged themselves.

ayahs.text: The evil consequences of their misdeeds overtook them and what they mocked at overwhelmed them.
ayahs.translation: The evil consequences of their misdeeds overtook them and what they mocked at overwhelmed them.

ayahs.text: Those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity say: ""Were Allah to will so neither we nor our forefathers would have worshipped any other than Him nor would we have prohibited anything without His command."" Their predecessors proffered similar excuses. Do the Messengers have any other duty but to plainly convey the Message?
ayahs.translation: Those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity say: ""Were Allah to will so neither we nor our forefathers would have worshipped any other than Him nor would we have prohibited anything without His command."" Their predecessors proffered similar excuses. Do the Messengers have any other duty but to plainly convey the Message?

ayahs.text: We raised a Messenger in every community (to tell them): ""Serve Allah and shun the Evil One."" Thereafter Allah guided some of them while others were overtaken by error. Go about the earth then and observe what was the end of those who rejected the Messengers calling them liars.
ayahs.translation: We raised a Messenger in every community (to tell them): ""Serve Allah and shun the Evil One."" Thereafter Allah guided some of them while others were overtaken by error. Go about the earth then and observe what was the end of those who rejected the Messengers calling them liars.

ayahs.text: (O Muhammad) howsoever eager you may be to show them the Right Way Allah does not bestow His guidance on those whom He lets go astray; and in fact none will be able to help them.
ayahs.translation: (O Muhammad) howsoever eager you may be to show them the Right Way Allah does not bestow His guidance on those whom He lets go astray; and in fact none will be able to help them.

ayahs.text: They swear most solemnly in the name of Allah and say: ""Allah shall not raise to life any who dies."" (Yes He will do so); that is a promise by which He is bound even though most people do not know that.
ayahs.translation: They swear most solemnly in the name of Allah and say: ""Allah shall not raise to life any who dies."" (Yes He will do so); that is a promise by which He is bound even though most people do not know that.

ayahs.text: (That is bound to happen in order that) He may make clear to them the reality regarding the matters on which they differ and that the unbelievers may realize that they were liars.
ayahs.translation: (That is bound to happen in order that) He may make clear to them the reality regarding the matters on which they differ and that the unbelievers may realize that they were liars.

ayahs.text: (As for the possibility of resurrection bear in mind that) whenever We do will something We have to do no more than say: ""Be"" and it is.
ayahs.translation: (As for the possibility of resurrection bear in mind that) whenever We do will something We have to do no more than say: ""Be"" and it is.

ayahs.text: As for those who have forsaken their homes for the sake of Allah after enduring persecution We shall certainly grant them a good abode in this world; and surely the reward of the Hereafter is much greater. If they could but know (what an excellent end awaits) those who remain steadfast and put their trust in their Lord.
ayahs.translation: As for those who have forsaken their homes for the sake of Allah after enduring persecution We shall certainly grant them a good abode in this world; and surely the reward of the Hereafter is much greater. If they could but know (what an excellent end awaits) those who remain steadfast and put their trust in their Lord.

ayahs.text: As for those who have forsaken their homes for the sake of Allah after enduring persecution We shall certainly grant them a good abode in this world; and surely the reward of the Hereafter is much greater. If they could but know (what an excellent end awaits) those who remain steadfast and put their trust in their Lord.
ayahs.translation: As for those who have forsaken their homes for the sake of Allah after enduring persecution We shall certainly grant them a good abode in this world; and surely the reward of the Hereafter is much greater. If they could but know (what an excellent end awaits) those who remain steadfast and put their trust in their Lord.

ayahs.text: (O Muhammad) whenever We raised any Messengers before you they were no other than human beings; (except that) to them We sent revelation. So ask those who possess knowledge if you do not know.
ayahs.translation: (O Muhammad) whenever We raised any Messengers before you they were no other than human beings; (except that) to them We sent revelation. So ask those who possess knowledge if you do not know.

ayahs.text: We raised the Messengers earlier with Clear Signs and Divine Books and We have now sent down this Reminder upon you that you may elucidate to people the teaching that has been sent down for them and that the people may themselves reflect.
ayahs.translation: We raised the Messengers earlier with Clear Signs and Divine Books and We have now sent down this Reminder upon you that you may elucidate to people the teaching that has been sent down for them and that the people may themselves reflect.

ayahs.text: Do those who have been devising evil plans (against the mission of the Messenger) feel secure that Allah will not cause the earth to swallow them up or that chastisement will not come upon them from a direction that they will not even be able to imagine;
ayahs.translation: Do those who have been devising evil plans (against the mission of the Messenger) feel secure that Allah will not cause the earth to swallow them up or that chastisement will not come upon them from a direction that they will not even be able to imagine;

ayahs.text: or that He will not suddenly seize them while they are going about to and fro and they will be unable to frustrate His design
ayahs.translation: or that He will not suddenly seize them while they are going about to and fro and they will be unable to frustrate His design

ayahs.text: or that He will not seize them when they are apprehensive of the impending calamity? Surely your Lord is Most Compassionate Most Merciful.
ayahs.translation: or that He will not seize them when they are apprehensive of the impending calamity? Surely your Lord is Most Compassionate Most Merciful.

ayahs.text: Do the people not see how the objects Allah has created cast their shadows right and left prostrating themselves in utter submission to Allah?
ayahs.translation: Do the people not see how the objects Allah has created cast their shadows right and left prostrating themselves in utter submission to Allah?

ayahs.text: All living creatures and all angels in the heavens and on the earth are in prostration before Allah; and never do they behave in arrogant defiance.
ayahs.translation: All living creatures and all angels in the heavens and on the earth are in prostration before Allah; and never do they behave in arrogant defiance.

ayahs.text: They hold their Lord Who is above them in fear and do as they are bidden.
ayahs.translation: They hold their Lord Who is above them in fear and do as they are bidden.

ayahs.text: Allah has commanded: ""Do not take two gods; for He is but One God. So fear Me alone.""
ayahs.translation: Allah has commanded: ""Do not take two gods; for He is but One God. So fear Me alone.""

ayahs.text: His is whatever is in the heavens and the earth and obedience to Him inevitably pervades the whole universe. Will you then hold in awe any other than Allah?
ayahs.translation: His is whatever is in the heavens and the earth and obedience to Him inevitably pervades the whole universe. Will you then hold in awe any other than Allah?

ayahs.text: Every bounty that you enjoy is from Allah; and whenever any misfortune strikes you it is to Him that you cry for the removal of your distress.
ayahs.translation: Every bounty that you enjoy is from Allah; and whenever any misfortune strikes you it is to Him that you cry for the removal of your distress.

ayahs.text: But as soon as He removes the distress from you some of you associate others with their Lord in giving thanks
ayahs.translation: But as soon as He removes the distress from you some of you associate others with their Lord in giving thanks

ayahs.text: that they may show ingratitude for the bounties We bestowed upon them. So enjoy yourselves for a while soon you will come to know (the truth).
ayahs.translation: that they may show ingratitude for the bounties We bestowed upon them. So enjoy yourselves for a while soon you will come to know (the truth).

ayahs.text: They set apart for those whose reality they do not even know a portion of the sustenance We have provided them. By Allah you will surely be called to account for the lies that you have invented!
ayahs.translation: They set apart for those whose reality they do not even know a portion of the sustenance We have provided them. By Allah you will surely be called to account for the lies that you have invented!

ayahs.text: They assign daughters to Allah - glory be to Him - whereas they assign to themselves what they truly desire!
ayahs.translation: They assign daughters to Allah - glory be to Him - whereas they assign to themselves what they truly desire!

ayahs.text: When any of them is told about the birth of a female his face turns dark and he is filled with suppressed anger
ayahs.translation: When any of them is told about the birth of a female his face turns dark and he is filled with suppressed anger

ayahs.text: and he hides himself from people because of the bad news thinking: should he keep the child despite disgrace or should he bury it in dust? How evil is their estimate of Allah!
ayahs.translation: and he hides himself from people because of the bad news thinking: should he keep the child despite disgrace or should he bury it in dust? How evil is their estimate of Allah!

ayahs.text: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter deserve to be characterized with evil attributes whereas Allah''s are the most excellent attributes. He is the Most Mighty the Most Wise.
ayahs.translation: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter deserve to be characterized with evil attributes whereas Allah''s are the most excellent attributes. He is the Most Mighty the Most Wise.

ayahs.text: Were Allah to take people to task for their wrong-doing He would not have spared even a single living creature on the face of the earth. But He grants them respite until an appointed term. And when that term arrives they have no power to delay it by a single moment nor to hasten it.
ayahs.translation: Were Allah to take people to task for their wrong-doing He would not have spared even a single living creature on the face of the earth. But He grants them respite until an appointed term. And when that term arrives they have no power to delay it by a single moment nor to hasten it.

ayahs.text: They assign to Allah what they dislike for themselves and their tongues utter a sheer lie in stating that a happy state awaits them. Without doubt the Fire awaits them and it is to it that they shall be hastened.
ayahs.translation: They assign to Allah what they dislike for themselves and their tongues utter a sheer lie in stating that a happy state awaits them. Without doubt the Fire awaits them and it is to it that they shall be hastened.

ayahs.text: By Allah (O Muhammad) We sent Messengers to other communities before you but Satan made their evil deeds attractive to them (so they paid no heed to the call of the Messengers). The same Satan is their patron today and they are heading towards a painful chastisement.
ayahs.translation: By Allah (O Muhammad) We sent Messengers to other communities before you but Satan made their evil deeds attractive to them (so they paid no heed to the call of the Messengers). The same Satan is their patron today and they are heading towards a painful chastisement.

ayahs.text: We have sent down the Book that you may explain to them the truth concerning what they are disputing and that the Book may serve as a guidance and mercy for those who believe in it.
ayahs.translation: We have sent down the Book that you may explain to them the truth concerning what they are disputing and that the Book may serve as a guidance and mercy for those who believe in it.

ayahs.text: Allah sends down water from the heaven and thereby He instantly revives the earth after it lay dead. Verily there is a sign in it for those who have ears.
ayahs.translation: Allah sends down water from the heaven and thereby He instantly revives the earth after it lay dead. Verily there is a sign in it for those who have ears.

ayahs.text: Surely there is a lesson for you in the cattle: We provide you to drink out of that which is in their bellies between the faeces and the blood - pure milk - which is a palatable drink for those who take it.
ayahs.translation: Surely there is a lesson for you in the cattle: We provide you to drink out of that which is in their bellies between the faeces and the blood - pure milk - which is a palatable drink for those who take it.

ayahs.text: And out of the fruits of date-palms and grapes you derive intoxicants as well as wholesome sustenance. Surely there is a sign for those who use reason.
ayahs.translation: And out of the fruits of date-palms and grapes you derive intoxicants as well as wholesome sustenance. Surely there is a sign for those who use reason.

ayahs.text: Your Lord inspired the bee saying: ""Set up hives in the mountains and in the trees and in the trellises that people put up
ayahs.translation: Your Lord inspired the bee saying: ""Set up hives in the mountains and in the trees and in the trellises that people put up

ayahs.text: then suck the juice of every kind of fruit and keep treading the ways of your Lord which have been made easy."" There comes forth from their bellies a drink varied in colours wherein there is healing for men. Verily there is a sign in this for those who reflect.
ayahs.translation: then suck the juice of every kind of fruit and keep treading the ways of your Lord which have been made easy."" There comes forth from their bellies a drink varied in colours wherein there is healing for men. Verily there is a sign in this for those who reflect.

ayahs.text: Allah has created you and then He causes you to die. Some of you have your lives prolonged to an abject old age when one loses all knowledge after having acquired it. Allah is All-Knowing All-Powerful.
ayahs.translation: Allah has created you and then He causes you to die. Some of you have your lives prolonged to an abject old age when one loses all knowledge after having acquired it. Allah is All-Knowing All-Powerful.

ayahs.text: Allah has favoured some of you with more worldly provisions than others. Then those who are more favoured do not give away their provisions to their slaves lest they become equal sharers in it. Do they then deny the favour of Allah?
ayahs.translation: Allah has favoured some of you with more worldly provisions than others. Then those who are more favoured do not give away their provisions to their slaves lest they become equal sharers in it. Do they then deny the favour of Allah?

ayahs.text: And Allah has given you spouses from your kind and has granted you through your spouses sons and grandsons and has provided you wholesome things as sustenance. (After knowing all this) do they still believe in falsehood and deny Allah''s bounty
ayahs.translation: And Allah has given you spouses from your kind and has granted you through your spouses sons and grandsons and has provided you wholesome things as sustenance. (After knowing all this) do they still believe in falsehood and deny Allah''s bounty

ayahs.text: and worship instead of Allah those helpless beings who have no control over providing them any sustenance from the heavens and the earth; do you worship those who have no power to do anything of this sort?
ayahs.translation: and worship instead of Allah those helpless beings who have no control over providing them any sustenance from the heavens and the earth; do you worship those who have no power to do anything of this sort?

ayahs.text: So do not strike any similitudes to Allah. Allah knows whereas you do not know.
ayahs.translation: So do not strike any similitudes to Allah. Allah knows whereas you do not know.

ayahs.text: Allah sets forth a parable: There is one who is a slave and is owned by another and has no power over anything; and there is one whom We have granted good provision Ourselves of which he spends both secretly and openly. Can they be equal? All praise be to Allah. But most of them do not even know (this simple fact).
ayahs.translation: Allah sets forth a parable: There is one who is a slave and is owned by another and has no power over anything; and there is one whom We have granted good provision Ourselves of which he spends both secretly and openly. Can they be equal? All praise be to Allah. But most of them do not even know (this simple fact).

ayahs.text: Allah sets forth another parable: There are two men one of whom is dumb and has no power over anything; he is a burden to his master and wheresoever his master directs him he fails to bring forth any good. Can such a person be the equal of one who enjoins justice and himself follows the Right Way?
ayahs.translation: Allah sets forth another parable: There are two men one of whom is dumb and has no power over anything; he is a burden to his master and wheresoever his master directs him he fails to bring forth any good. Can such a person be the equal of one who enjoins justice and himself follows the Right Way?

ayahs.text: Allah has full knowledge of the truths beyond the reach of perception both in the heavens and the earth; and the coming of the Hour will take no more than the twinkling of an eye; it may take even less. Indeed Allah has power over everything.
ayahs.translation: Allah has full knowledge of the truths beyond the reach of perception both in the heavens and the earth; and the coming of the Hour will take no more than the twinkling of an eye; it may take even less. Indeed Allah has power over everything.

ayahs.text: Allah has brought you forth from your mothers'' wombs when you knew nothing and then gave you hearing and sight and thinking hearts so that you may give thanks.
ayahs.translation: Allah has brought you forth from your mothers'' wombs when you knew nothing and then gave you hearing and sight and thinking hearts so that you may give thanks.

ayahs.text: Have they never noticed the birds how they are held under control in the middle of the sky where none holds them (from falling) except Allah? Surely there are signs in this for those who believe.
ayahs.translation: Have they never noticed the birds how they are held under control in the middle of the sky where none holds them (from falling) except Allah? Surely there are signs in this for those who believe.

ayahs.text: Allah has made your houses a repose and has provided you with the skins of the cattle for your habitation which are light to handle both when you travel and when you camp; and out of their wool and their fur and their hair He has given you furnishings and goods for use over a period of time.
ayahs.translation: Allah has made your houses a repose and has provided you with the skins of the cattle for your habitation which are light to handle both when you travel and when you camp; and out of their wool and their fur and their hair He has given you furnishings and goods for use over a period of time.

ayahs.text: And Allah has provided shade for you out of some of the things He has created; and He has provided you with shelters in the mountains and has given you coats that protect you from heat as well as coats that protect you in battle. Thus does He complete His favour upon you that you may submit to Him.
ayahs.translation: And Allah has provided shade for you out of some of the things He has created; and He has provided you with shelters in the mountains and has given you coats that protect you from heat as well as coats that protect you in battle. Thus does He complete His favour upon you that you may submit to Him.

ayahs.text: But if they turn away your only duty is to clearly deliver the message of the truth.
ayahs.translation: But if they turn away your only duty is to clearly deliver the message of the truth.

ayahs.text: They are aware of the favours of Allah and yet refuse to acknowledge them. Most of them are determined not to accept the Truth.
ayahs.translation: They are aware of the favours of Allah and yet refuse to acknowledge them. Most of them are determined not to accept the Truth.

ayahs.text: (They are heedless of) the Day when We shall raise a witness from each community and then the unbelievers will neither be allowed to plead nor will they be asked to repent and seek pardon.
ayahs.translation: (They are heedless of) the Day when We shall raise a witness from each community and then the unbelievers will neither be allowed to plead nor will they be asked to repent and seek pardon.

ayahs.text: Once the wrong-doers have beheld the chastisement neither will it be lightened for them nor will they be granted any respite.
ayahs.translation: Once the wrong-doers have beheld the chastisement neither will it be lightened for them nor will they be granted any respite.

ayahs.text: And when those who associated others with Allah in His Divinity will see those to whom they ascribed this share they will say: ""Our Lord! These are the beings to whom we ascribed a share in Your Divinity and whom we called upon instead of You  whereupon those beings will fling at them the words: ""You are liars.""
ayahs.translation: And when those who associated others with Allah in His Divinity will see those to whom they ascribed this share they will say: ""Our Lord! These are the beings to whom we ascribed a share in Your Divinity and whom we called upon instead of You  whereupon those beings will fling at them the words: ""You are liars.""

ayahs.text: On that Day they will offer their submission and all that they had fabricated will have vanished.
ayahs.translation: On that Day they will offer their submission and all that they had fabricated will have vanished.

ayahs.text: As for those who disbelieved and barred others from the way of Allah We shall add further chastisement to their chastisement for all the mischief they did.
ayahs.translation: As for those who disbelieved and barred others from the way of Allah We shall add further chastisement to their chastisement for all the mischief they did.

ayahs.text: (O Muhammad) warn them of the coming of a Day when We shall bring forth a witness against them from each community and We shall bring you forth as a witness against them all; (and it is for that purpose that) We sent down the Book to you which makes everything clear and serves as a guidance and mercy and glad tidings to those who have submitted to Allah.
ayahs.translation: (O Muhammad) warn them of the coming of a Day when We shall bring forth a witness against them from each community and We shall bring you forth as a witness against them all; (and it is for that purpose that) We sent down the Book to you which makes everything clear and serves as a guidance and mercy and glad tidings to those who have submitted to Allah.

ayahs.text: Surely Allah enjoins justice kindness and the doing of good to kith and kin and forbids all that is shameful evil and oppressive. He exhorts you so that you may be mindful.
ayahs.translation: Surely Allah enjoins justice kindness and the doing of good to kith and kin and forbids all that is shameful evil and oppressive. He exhorts you so that you may be mindful.

ayahs.text: And fulfil the covenant which you have made with Allah and do not break your oaths after having firmly made them and after having made Allah your witness. Surely Allah knows all that you do.
ayahs.translation: And fulfil the covenant which you have made with Allah and do not break your oaths after having firmly made them and after having made Allah your witness. Surely Allah knows all that you do.

ayahs.text: And do not become like the woman who after having painstakingly spun her yarn caused it to disintegrate into pieces. You resort to oaths as instruments of mutual deceit so that one people might take greater advantage than another although Allah puts you to the test through this. Surely on the Day of Resurrection He will make clear the Truth concerning the matters over which you differed.
ayahs.translation: And do not become like the woman who after having painstakingly spun her yarn caused it to disintegrate into pieces. You resort to oaths as instruments of mutual deceit so that one people might take greater advantage than another although Allah puts you to the test through this. Surely on the Day of Resurrection He will make clear the Truth concerning the matters over which you differed.

ayahs.text: Had Allah so willed He would have made you all one single community. However He lets go astray whomsoever He wills and shows the Right Way to whomsoever He wills. Surely you shall be called to account regarding what you did.
ayahs.translation: Had Allah so willed He would have made you all one single community. However He lets go astray whomsoever He wills and shows the Right Way to whomsoever He wills. Surely you shall be called to account regarding what you did.

ayahs.text: Do not make your oaths a means of deceiving one another or else your foot may slip after having been firm and you may suffer evil consequences because of hindering people from the way of Allah. A mighty chastisement awaits you.
ayahs.translation: Do not make your oaths a means of deceiving one another or else your foot may slip after having been firm and you may suffer evil consequences because of hindering people from the way of Allah. A mighty chastisement awaits you.

ayahs.text: Do not barter away the covenant of Allah for a paltry gain. Verily that which is with Allah is far better for you if you only knew.
ayahs.translation: Do not barter away the covenant of Allah for a paltry gain. Verily that which is with Allah is far better for you if you only knew.

ayahs.text: Whatever you have is bound to pass away and whatever is with Allah will last. And We shall surely grant those who have been patient their reward according to the best of what they did.
ayahs.translation: Whatever you have is bound to pass away and whatever is with Allah will last. And We shall surely grant those who have been patient their reward according to the best of what they did.

ayahs.text: Whosoever acts righteously - whether a man or a woman - and embraces belief We will surely grant him a good life; and will surely grant such persons their reward according to the best of their deeds.
ayahs.translation: Whosoever acts righteously - whether a man or a woman - and embraces belief We will surely grant him a good life; and will surely grant such persons their reward according to the best of their deeds.

ayahs.text: Whenever you read the Qur''an seek refuge with Allah from Satan the accursed.
ayahs.translation: Whenever you read the Qur''an seek refuge with Allah from Satan the accursed.

ayahs.text: Surely he has no power over those who have faith and who place their trust in their Lord.
ayahs.translation: Surely he has no power over those who have faith and who place their trust in their Lord.

ayahs.text: He has power only over those who take him as their patron and who under his influence associate others with Allah in His Divinity.
ayahs.translation: He has power only over those who take him as their patron and who under his influence associate others with Allah in His Divinity.

ayahs.text: Whenever We replace one verse by another verse - and Allah knows what He should reveal - they are wont to say: ""You are nothing but a fabricator (who has invented the Qur''an)."" The fact is that most of them are ignorant of the Truth.
ayahs.translation: Whenever We replace one verse by another verse - and Allah knows what He should reveal - they are wont to say: ""You are nothing but a fabricator (who has invented the Qur''an)."" The fact is that most of them are ignorant of the Truth.

ayahs.text: Tell them: ""It is the spirit of holiness that has brought it down by stages from your Lord so that it might bring firmness to those who believe and guidance to the Right Way and give glad tidings of felicity and success to those who submit to Allah.""
ayahs.translation: Tell them: ""It is the spirit of holiness that has brought it down by stages from your Lord so that it might bring firmness to those who believe and guidance to the Right Way and give glad tidings of felicity and success to those who submit to Allah.""

ayahs.text: Surely We know well that they say about you: ""It is only a human being who teaches him  (notwithstanding) that he whom they maliciously hint at is of foreign tongue while this (Qur''an) is plain Arabic speech.
ayahs.translation: Surely We know well that they say about you: ""It is only a human being who teaches him  (notwithstanding) that he whom they maliciously hint at is of foreign tongue while this (Qur''an) is plain Arabic speech.

ayahs.text: Surely Allah will not enable those who do not believe in the signs of Allah to be directed to the Right Way and a painful chastisement awaits them.
ayahs.translation: Surely Allah will not enable those who do not believe in the signs of Allah to be directed to the Right Way and a painful chastisement awaits them.

ayahs.text: (It is not the Prophet who invents lies) it is rather those who do not believe in the signs of Allah who invent lies. They are liars.
ayahs.translation: (It is not the Prophet who invents lies) it is rather those who do not believe in the signs of Allah who invent lies. They are liars.

ayahs.text: Except for those who were forced to engage in infidelity to Allah after believing the while their hearts remained firmly convinced of their belief the ones whose hearts willingly embraced disbelief shall incur Allah''s wrath and a mighty chastisement lies in store for them.
ayahs.translation: Except for those who were forced to engage in infidelity to Allah after believing the while their hearts remained firmly convinced of their belief the ones whose hearts willingly embraced disbelief shall incur Allah''s wrath and a mighty chastisement lies in store for them.

ayahs.text: That is because they love the life of this world more than the Hereafter; and Allah does not guide those who are ungrateful to Allah for His favours.
ayahs.translation: That is because they love the life of this world more than the Hereafter; and Allah does not guide those who are ungrateful to Allah for His favours.

ayahs.text: They are the ones upon whose hearts and hearing and eyes Allah has set a seal. They are utterly steeped in heedlessness.
ayahs.translation: They are the ones upon whose hearts and hearing and eyes Allah has set a seal. They are utterly steeped in heedlessness.

ayahs.text: No doubt they shall be losers in the Hereafter.
ayahs.translation: No doubt they shall be losers in the Hereafter.

ayahs.text: And surely your Lord will be Most Forgiving and Most Merciful towards those who left their homes after they were persecuted and who thereafter struggled hard and remained constant.
ayahs.translation: And surely your Lord will be Most Forgiving and Most Merciful towards those who left their homes after they were persecuted and who thereafter struggled hard and remained constant.

ayahs.text: Allah''s judgement will come about them all on the Day when everyone shall come pleading in his defence and everyone shall be fully requited for his deeds and none shall be wronged in the least.
ayahs.translation: Allah''s judgement will come about them all on the Day when everyone shall come pleading in his defence and everyone shall be fully requited for his deeds and none shall be wronged in the least.

ayahs.text: Allah sets forth the parable of (the people of) a town who were secure and content and whose sustenance came in abundance from every quarter. But then the people of the town showed ingratitude towards Allah for His bounties so Allah afflicted them with hunger and fear in punishment for their evil deeds.
ayahs.translation: Allah sets forth the parable of (the people of) a town who were secure and content and whose sustenance came in abundance from every quarter. But then the people of the town showed ingratitude towards Allah for His bounties so Allah afflicted them with hunger and fear in punishment for their evil deeds.

ayahs.text: Most certainly a Messenger came to them from among them; but they rejected him calling him a liar. Therefore chastisement seized them while they engaged in wrong-doing.
ayahs.translation: Most certainly a Messenger came to them from among them; but they rejected him calling him a liar. Therefore chastisement seized them while they engaged in wrong-doing.

ayahs.text: So eat out of the lawful and good sustenance that Allah has bestowed upon you and thank Allah for His bounty if it is Him that you serve.
ayahs.translation: So eat out of the lawful and good sustenance that Allah has bestowed upon you and thank Allah for His bounty if it is Him that you serve.

ayahs.text: Allah has forbidden you only carrion and blood and the flesh of swine; also any animal over which the name of any other than Allah has been pronounced. But whoever eats of them under compelling necessity - neither desiring it nor exceeding the limit of absolute necessity - surely for such action Allah is Much Forgiving Most Merciful.
ayahs.translation: Allah has forbidden you only carrion and blood and the flesh of swine; also any animal over which the name of any other than Allah has been pronounced. But whoever eats of them under compelling necessity - neither desiring it nor exceeding the limit of absolute necessity - surely for such action Allah is Much Forgiving Most Merciful.

ayahs.text: And do not utter falsehoods by letting your tongues declare: ""This is lawful"" and ""That is unlawful  thus fabricating lies against Allah. Surely those who fabricate lies against Allah will never prosper.
ayahs.translation: And do not utter falsehoods by letting your tongues declare: ""This is lawful"" and ""That is unlawful  thus fabricating lies against Allah. Surely those who fabricate lies against Allah will never prosper.

ayahs.text: Brief is their enjoyment of the world and thereafter they shall suffer a painful chastisement.
ayahs.translation: Brief is their enjoyment of the world and thereafter they shall suffer a painful chastisement.

ayahs.text: We have already recounted to you what We prohibited to the Jews. In so doing We did not wrong them; it is they who wronged themselves.
ayahs.translation: We have already recounted to you what We prohibited to the Jews. In so doing We did not wrong them; it is they who wronged themselves.

ayahs.text: But to those who commit evil out of ignorance and then repent and amend their ways thereafter your Lord will be Much Forgiving Most Merciful.
ayahs.translation: But to those who commit evil out of ignorance and then repent and amend their ways thereafter your Lord will be Much Forgiving Most Merciful.

ayahs.text: Indeed Abraham was a whole community by himself obedient to Allah exclusively devoted to Him. And he was never one of those who associated others with Allah in His Divinity.
ayahs.translation: Indeed Abraham was a whole community by himself obedient to Allah exclusively devoted to Him. And he was never one of those who associated others with Allah in His Divinity.

ayahs.text: He rendered thanks to Allah for His bounties so that Allah chose him (for His favours) and directed him to the Right Way.
ayahs.translation: He rendered thanks to Allah for His bounties so that Allah chose him (for His favours) and directed him to the Right Way.

ayahs.text: We bestowed good upon him in this world and in the Hereafter he shall certainly be among the righteous.
ayahs.translation: We bestowed good upon him in this world and in the Hereafter he shall certainly be among the righteous.

ayahs.text: Then We revealed to you: ""Follow the way of Abraham with exclusive devotion to Allah. He was not one of those who associated others with Allah in His Divinity.""
ayahs.translation: Then We revealed to you: ""Follow the way of Abraham with exclusive devotion to Allah. He was not one of those who associated others with Allah in His Divinity.""

ayahs.text: As for the Sabbath it was made incumbent only on those who differed about its laws. Certainly your Lord will judge on the Day of Resurrection between them regarding the matters they disputed.
ayahs.translation: As for the Sabbath it was made incumbent only on those who differed about its laws. Certainly your Lord will judge on the Day of Resurrection between them regarding the matters they disputed.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) call to the way of your Lord with wisdom and goodly exhortation and reason with them in the best manner possible. Surely your Lord knows best who has strayed away from His path and He also knows well those who are guided to the Right Way.
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) call to the way of your Lord with wisdom and goodly exhortation and reason with them in the best manner possible. Surely your Lord knows best who has strayed away from His path and He also knows well those who are guided to the Right Way.

ayahs.text: If you take retribution then do so in proportion to the wrong done to you. But if you can bear such conduct with patience indeed that is best for the steadfast.
ayahs.translation: If you take retribution then do so in proportion to the wrong done to you. But if you can bear such conduct with patience indeed that is best for the steadfast.

ayahs.text: And bear with patience (O Muhammad) - and your patience is only because of the help of Allah - and do not grieve over them nor feel distressed by their evil plans.
ayahs.translation: And bear with patience (O Muhammad) - and your patience is only because of the help of Allah - and do not grieve over them nor feel distressed by their evil plans.

ayahs.text: For surely Allah is with those who hold Him in fear and do good.
ayahs.translation: For surely Allah is with those who hold Him in fear and do good.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Holy is He Who carried His servant by night from the Holy Mosque (in Makkah) to the farther Mosque (in Jerusalem) whose surroundings We have blessed that We might show him some of Our Signs. Indeed He alone is All-Hearing All-Seeing.
verses.translation: Holy is He Who carried His servant by night from the Holy Mosque (in Makkah) to the farther Mosque (in Jerusalem) whose surroundings We have blessed that We might show him some of Our Signs. Indeed He alone is All-Hearing All-Seeing.

verses.text: We gave Moses the Book and made it a source of guidance for the Children of Israel commanding: ""Take no other Guardian beside Me.""
verses.translation: We gave Moses the Book and made it a source of guidance for the Children of Israel commanding: ""Take no other Guardian beside Me.""

verses.text: You are the descendants of those whom We carried (in the Ark) with Noah. He was truly a thankful servant.
verses.translation: You are the descendants of those whom We carried (in the Ark) with Noah. He was truly a thankful servant.

verses.text: Then We clearly declared to the Children of Israel in the Book: ""Twice you will make mischief in the land and will commit transgression.""
verses.translation: Then We clearly declared to the Children of Israel in the Book: ""Twice you will make mischief in the land and will commit transgression.""

verses.text: So when the occasion for the first of the transgressions arrived We raised against you some of Our creatures who were full of might and they ran over the whole of your land. This was a promise that was bound to be fulfilled.
verses.translation: So when the occasion for the first of the transgressions arrived We raised against you some of Our creatures who were full of might and they ran over the whole of your land. This was a promise that was bound to be fulfilled.

verses.text: Then We granted you an upper hand against them and strengthened you with wealth and children and multiplied your numbers.
verses.translation: Then We granted you an upper hand against them and strengthened you with wealth and children and multiplied your numbers.

verses.text: Whenever you did good it was to your own advantage; and whenever you committed evil it was to your own disadvantage. So when the time of the fulfilment of the second promise arrived (We raised other enemies that would) disfigure your faces and enter the Temple (of Jerusalem) as they had entered the first time and destroy whatever they could lay their hands on.
verses.translation: Whenever you did good it was to your own advantage; and whenever you committed evil it was to your own disadvantage. So when the time of the fulfilment of the second promise arrived (We raised other enemies that would) disfigure your faces and enter the Temple (of Jerusalem) as they had entered the first time and destroy whatever they could lay their hands on.

verses.text: Your Lord may well show Mercy to you but if you revert to your evil behaviour We shall revert to chastising you. We have made Hell a prison for those who are thankless of Allah''s bounties.
verses.translation: Your Lord may well show Mercy to you but if you revert to your evil behaviour We shall revert to chastising you. We have made Hell a prison for those who are thankless of Allah''s bounties.

verses.text: Verily this Qur''an guides to the Way that is the Straight most. To those who believe in it and do righteous works it gives the good news that a great reward awaits them
verses.translation: Verily this Qur''an guides to the Way that is the Straight most. To those who believe in it and do righteous works it gives the good news that a great reward awaits them

verses.text: and warns those who do not believe in the Hereafter that We have prepared for them a grievous chastisement.
verses.translation: and warns those who do not believe in the Hereafter that We have prepared for them a grievous chastisement.

verses.text: Man prays for evil in the manner he ought to pray for good. Man is ever hasty.
verses.translation: Man prays for evil in the manner he ought to pray for good. Man is ever hasty.

verses.text: We have made night and day as two signs. We made the sign of the night devoid of light and made the sign of the day radiant that you may seek the bounty of your Lord and know the computation of years and numbers. Thus We have expounded everything in detail to keep everything distinct from the other.
verses.translation: We have made night and day as two signs. We made the sign of the night devoid of light and made the sign of the day radiant that you may seek the bounty of your Lord and know the computation of years and numbers. Thus We have expounded everything in detail to keep everything distinct from the other.

verses.text: We have fastened every man''s omen to his neck. On the Day of Resurrection We shall produce for him his scroll in the shape of a wide open book (saying):
verses.translation: We have fastened every man''s omen to his neck. On the Day of Resurrection We shall produce for him his scroll in the shape of a wide open book (saying):

verses.text: Read your scroll; this Day you suffice to take account of yourself.""
verses.translation: Read your scroll; this Day you suffice to take account of yourself.""

verses.text: He who follows the Right Way shall do so to his own advantage; and he who strays shall incur his own loss. No one shall bear another''s burden. And never do We punish any people until We send a Messenger (to make the Truth distinct from falsehood).
verses.translation: He who follows the Right Way shall do so to his own advantage; and he who strays shall incur his own loss. No one shall bear another''s burden. And never do We punish any people until We send a Messenger (to make the Truth distinct from falsehood).

verses.text: When We decide to destroy a town We command the affluent among them whereupon they commit sins in it then the decree (of chastisement) becomes due against them and thereafter We destroy that town utterly.
verses.translation: When We decide to destroy a town We command the affluent among them whereupon they commit sins in it then the decree (of chastisement) becomes due against them and thereafter We destroy that town utterly.

verses.text: Many a generation has been destroyed by Our command since Noah''s time. Your Lord is well aware and fully observant of the sins of His servants.
verses.translation: Many a generation has been destroyed by Our command since Noah''s time. Your Lord is well aware and fully observant of the sins of His servants.

verses.text: If anyone desires immediate benefits We hasten to grant whatever benefits We will in the present life to whomsoever We please but thereafter We decree for him Hell wherein he shall burn condemned and rejected.
verses.translation: If anyone desires immediate benefits We hasten to grant whatever benefits We will in the present life to whomsoever We please but thereafter We decree for him Hell wherein he shall burn condemned and rejected.

verses.text: But he who desires the Hereafter and strives for it in the manner he should and is a true believer his striving will come to fruition.
verses.translation: But he who desires the Hereafter and strives for it in the manner he should and is a true believer his striving will come to fruition.

verses.text: To all of these as well as those We shall provide the wherewithal of this life in the present world by dint of your Lord''s Bounty; and from none shall the Bounty of your Lord be withheld.
verses.translation: To all of these as well as those We shall provide the wherewithal of this life in the present world by dint of your Lord''s Bounty; and from none shall the Bounty of your Lord be withheld.

verses.text: See how We have exalted some above others in this world and in the Life to Come they will have higher ranks and greater degrees of excellence over others.
verses.translation: See how We have exalted some above others in this world and in the Life to Come they will have higher ranks and greater degrees of excellence over others.

verses.text: Do not set up any other god with Allah lest you are rendered humiliated and helpless.
verses.translation: Do not set up any other god with Allah lest you are rendered humiliated and helpless.

verses.text: Your Lord has decreed: (i) Do not worship any but Him; (ii) Be good to your parents; and should both or any one of them attain old age with you do not say to them even ""fie"" neither chide them but speak to them with respect
verses.translation: Your Lord has decreed: (i) Do not worship any but Him; (ii) Be good to your parents; and should both or any one of them attain old age with you do not say to them even ""fie"" neither chide them but speak to them with respect

verses.text: and be humble and tender to them and say: ""Lord show mercy to them as they nurtured me when I was small.""
verses.translation: and be humble and tender to them and say: ""Lord show mercy to them as they nurtured me when I was small.""

verses.text: Your Lord is best aware of what is in your hearts. If you are righteous He will indeed forgive those who relent and revert (to serving Allah).
verses.translation: Your Lord is best aware of what is in your hearts. If you are righteous He will indeed forgive those who relent and revert (to serving Allah).

verses.text: (iii) Give to the near of kin his due and also to the needy and the wayfarer. (iv) Do not squander your wealth wastefully
verses.translation: (iii) Give to the near of kin his due and also to the needy and the wayfarer. (iv) Do not squander your wealth wastefully

verses.text: for those who squander wastefully are Satan''s brothers and Satan is ever ungrateful to his Lord.
verses.translation: for those who squander wastefully are Satan''s brothers and Satan is ever ungrateful to his Lord.

verses.text: (v) And when you must turn away from them - (that is from the destitute the near of kin the needy and the wayfarer) - in pursuit of God''s Mercy which you expect to receive then speak to them kindly.
verses.translation: (v) And when you must turn away from them - (that is from the destitute the near of kin the needy and the wayfarer) - in pursuit of God''s Mercy which you expect to receive then speak to them kindly.

verses.text: (vi) Do not keep your hand fastened to your neck nor outspread it altogether outspread for you will be left sitting rebuked destitute.
verses.translation: (vi) Do not keep your hand fastened to your neck nor outspread it altogether outspread for you will be left sitting rebuked destitute.

verses.text: Certainly Your Lord makes plentiful the provision of whomsoever He wills and straitens it for whomsoever He wills. He is well-aware and is fully observant of all that relates to His servants.
verses.translation: Certainly Your Lord makes plentiful the provision of whomsoever He wills and straitens it for whomsoever He wills. He is well-aware and is fully observant of all that relates to His servants.

verses.text: (vii) Do not kill your children for fear of want. We will provide for them and for you. Surely killing them is a great sin.
verses.translation: (vii) Do not kill your children for fear of want. We will provide for them and for you. Surely killing them is a great sin.

verses.text: (viii) Do not even approach fornication for it is an outrageous act and an evil way.
verses.translation: (viii) Do not even approach fornication for it is an outrageous act and an evil way.

verses.text: (ix) Do not kill any person whom Allah has forbidden to kill except with right. We have granted the heir of him who has been wrongfully killed the authority to (claim retribution);so let him not exceed in slaying. He shall be helped.
verses.translation: (ix) Do not kill any person whom Allah has forbidden to kill except with right. We have granted the heir of him who has been wrongfully killed the authority to (claim retribution);so let him not exceed in slaying. He shall be helped.

verses.text: (x) And do not even go near the property of the orphan - except that it be in the best manner - till he attains his maturity. (xi) And fulfil the covenant for you will be called to account regarding the covenant.
verses.translation: (x) And do not even go near the property of the orphan - except that it be in the best manner - till he attains his maturity. (xi) And fulfil the covenant for you will be called to account regarding the covenant.

verses.text: (xii) Give full measure when you measure and weigh with even scales. That is fair and better in consequence.
verses.translation: (xii) Give full measure when you measure and weigh with even scales. That is fair and better in consequence.

verses.text: (xiii) Do not follow that of which you have no knowledge. Surely the hearing the sight the heart - each of these shall be called to account.
verses.translation: (xiii) Do not follow that of which you have no knowledge. Surely the hearing the sight the heart - each of these shall be called to account.

verses.text: (xiv) Do not strut about in the land arrogantly. Surely you cannot cleave the earth nor reach the heights of the mountains in stature.
verses.translation: (xiv) Do not strut about in the land arrogantly. Surely you cannot cleave the earth nor reach the heights of the mountains in stature.

verses.text: The wickedness of each of that is hateful to your Lord.
verses.translation: The wickedness of each of that is hateful to your Lord.

verses.text: That is part of the wisdom your Lord has revealed to you. So do not set up any deity beside Allah lest you are cast into Hell rebuked and deprived of every good.
verses.translation: That is part of the wisdom your Lord has revealed to you. So do not set up any deity beside Allah lest you are cast into Hell rebuked and deprived of every good.

verses.text: What has your Lord favoured you with sons and has taken for Himself daughters from among the angels? You are indeed uttering a monstrous lie.
verses.translation: What has your Lord favoured you with sons and has taken for Himself daughters from among the angels? You are indeed uttering a monstrous lie.

verses.text: We have expounded (the Truth) in diverse ways in this Qur''an that they might take it to heart but all this only aggravates their aversion.
verses.translation: We have expounded (the Truth) in diverse ways in this Qur''an that they might take it to heart but all this only aggravates their aversion.

verses.text: Say (O Muhammad): ""Had there been other gods with Him as they claim they would surely have attempted to find a way to the Lord of the Throne.
verses.translation: Say (O Muhammad): ""Had there been other gods with Him as they claim they would surely have attempted to find a way to the Lord of the Throne.

verses.text: Holy is He and far above all that they say.
verses.translation: Holy is He and far above all that they say.

verses.text: The seven heavens the earth and all that is within them give glory to Him. There is nothing but gives glory to Him with His praise though you do not understand their hymns of praise. He is Most Forbearing Exceedingly Forgiving.""
verses.translation: The seven heavens the earth and all that is within them give glory to Him. There is nothing but gives glory to Him with His praise though you do not understand their hymns of praise. He is Most Forbearing Exceedingly Forgiving.""

verses.text: When you recite the Qur''an We place a hidden barrier between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter;
verses.translation: When you recite the Qur''an We place a hidden barrier between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter;

verses.text: and We place a covering on their hearts so that they do not comprehend it and We cause a heaviness in their ears; and when you mention your Lord the Only True Lord in the Qur''an they turn their backs in aversion.
verses.translation: and We place a covering on their hearts so that they do not comprehend it and We cause a heaviness in their ears; and when you mention your Lord the Only True Lord in the Qur''an they turn their backs in aversion.

verses.text: We are well aware of what they wish to hear when they listen to you and what they say when they confer in whispers when the wrong-doers say: ""You are only following one who is bewitched.""
verses.translation: We are well aware of what they wish to hear when they listen to you and what they say when they confer in whispers when the wrong-doers say: ""You are only following one who is bewitched.""

verses.text: Just see how strange are the things they invent about you. They have altogether strayed and are unable to find the right way.
verses.translation: Just see how strange are the things they invent about you. They have altogether strayed and are unable to find the right way.

verses.text: They say: ""When we are turned to bones and particles (of dust) shall we truly be raised up as a new creation?""
verses.translation: They say: ""When we are turned to bones and particles (of dust) shall we truly be raised up as a new creation?""

verses.text: Tell them: ""(You will be raised afresh even if) you turn to stone or iron
verses.translation: Tell them: ""(You will be raised afresh even if) you turn to stone or iron

verses.text: or any other form of creation you deem hardest of all (to recreate from)."" They will certainly ask: ""Who will bring us back (to life)?"" Say: ""He Who created you in the first instance."" They will shake their heads at you and inquire: ""When will that be?""Say: ""Perhaps that time might have drawn near;
verses.translation: or any other form of creation you deem hardest of all (to recreate from)."" They will certainly ask: ""Who will bring us back (to life)?"" Say: ""He Who created you in the first instance."" They will shake their heads at you and inquire: ""When will that be?""Say: ""Perhaps that time might have drawn near;

verses.text: on the Day when He will call you and you will rise praising Him in response to His call and you will believe that you had lain in this state only for a while.""
verses.translation: on the Day when He will call you and you will rise praising Him in response to His call and you will believe that you had lain in this state only for a while.""

verses.text: Tell My servants (O Muhammad) to say always that which is best. Verily it is Satan who sows discord among people. Satan indeed is an open enemy to mankind.
verses.translation: Tell My servants (O Muhammad) to say always that which is best. Verily it is Satan who sows discord among people. Satan indeed is an open enemy to mankind.

verses.text: Your Lord knows you best. He will have mercy on you if He wills and chastise you if He wills. We have not sent you (O Muhammad) as an overseer over them.
verses.translation: Your Lord knows you best. He will have mercy on you if He wills and chastise you if He wills. We have not sent you (O Muhammad) as an overseer over them.

verses.text: Your Lord knows all who dwell in the heavens and the earth. We have exalted some Prophets over others and We gave the Psalms to David.
verses.translation: Your Lord knows all who dwell in the heavens and the earth. We have exalted some Prophets over others and We gave the Psalms to David.

verses.text: Tell them: ""Call upon those whom you fancy to be (your helpers) instead of Him! They have no power to remove any affliction from you nor can they shift it (to any other).""
verses.translation: Tell them: ""Call upon those whom you fancy to be (your helpers) instead of Him! They have no power to remove any affliction from you nor can they shift it (to any other).""

verses.text: Those whom they call upon are themselves seeking the means of access to their Lord each trying to be nearer to Him. They crave for His Mercy and dread His chastisement. Surely your Lord''s punishment is to be feared.
verses.translation: Those whom they call upon are themselves seeking the means of access to their Lord each trying to be nearer to Him. They crave for His Mercy and dread His chastisement. Surely your Lord''s punishment is to be feared.

verses.text: There is not a town but We shall destroy it or upon which We shall inflict severe chastisement before the Day of Resurrection. This is written down in the Eternal Book (of Allah).
verses.translation: There is not a town but We shall destroy it or upon which We shall inflict severe chastisement before the Day of Resurrection. This is written down in the Eternal Book (of Allah).

verses.text: Nothing hindered Us from sending Our Signs except that the people of olden times rejected them as lies. We publicly sent the she-camel to the Thamud to open their eyes but they wronged her. We never send Our Signs except to cause people to fear.
verses.translation: Nothing hindered Us from sending Our Signs except that the people of olden times rejected them as lies. We publicly sent the she-camel to the Thamud to open their eyes but they wronged her. We never send Our Signs except to cause people to fear.

verses.text: And recall when We said to you (O Muhammad) that your Lord encompasses these people; and that We have made that vision that We have shown you and the tree accursed in the Qur''an but as a trial for people. We go about warning them but each warning leads them to greater transgression.
verses.translation: And recall when We said to you (O Muhammad) that your Lord encompasses these people; and that We have made that vision that We have shown you and the tree accursed in the Qur''an but as a trial for people. We go about warning them but each warning leads them to greater transgression.

verses.text: And recall when We asked the angels to prostrate themselves before Adam; all prostrated themselves except Iblis who said: ""Shall I prostrate myself before him whom You created of clay?""
verses.translation: And recall when We asked the angels to prostrate themselves before Adam; all prostrated themselves except Iblis who said: ""Shall I prostrate myself before him whom You created of clay?""

verses.text: He then continued: ""Look! This is he whom You have exalted above me! If you will grant me respite till the Day of Resurrection I shall uproot the whole of his progeny except only a few.""
verses.translation: He then continued: ""Look! This is he whom You have exalted above me! If you will grant me respite till the Day of Resurrection I shall uproot the whole of his progeny except only a few.""

verses.text: Thereupon He retorted: ""Be gone! Hell shall be the recompense - and a most ample one - of whosoever of them who follows you.
verses.translation: Thereupon He retorted: ""Be gone! Hell shall be the recompense - and a most ample one - of whosoever of them who follows you.

verses.text: Tempt with your call all whom you wish. Muster against them all your forces - your cavalry and your foot soldiers; share with them riches and offspring and seduce them with rosy promises - and Satan''s promise is nothing but a deception
verses.translation: Tempt with your call all whom you wish. Muster against them all your forces - your cavalry and your foot soldiers; share with them riches and offspring and seduce them with rosy promises - and Satan''s promise is nothing but a deception

verses.text: but know well that you will have no power against My servants. Your Lord suffices for them to place their trust in.""
verses.translation: but know well that you will have no power against My servants. Your Lord suffices for them to place their trust in.""

verses.text: Your Lord is He Who steers your vessels across the seas that you may seek of His Bounty. He is ever Merciful towards you.
verses.translation: Your Lord is He Who steers your vessels across the seas that you may seek of His Bounty. He is ever Merciful towards you.

verses.text: When a calamity befalls you on the sea all those whom you invoke forsake you except Him. But when He delivers you safely to the shore you turn away from Him for man is indeed most thankless.
verses.translation: When a calamity befalls you on the sea all those whom you invoke forsake you except Him. But when He delivers you safely to the shore you turn away from Him for man is indeed most thankless.

verses.text: Do you then feel secure against His causing you to be swallowed up by a tract of the earth or letting loose a deadly whirlwind charged with stones towards you and there you will find none to protect you?
verses.translation: Do you then feel secure against His causing you to be swallowed up by a tract of the earth or letting loose a deadly whirlwind charged with stones towards you and there you will find none to protect you?

verses.text: Or do you feel secure that He will not cause you to revert to the sea and let a tempest loose upon you and then drown you for your ingratitude whereupon you will find none even to inquire of Us what happened to you?
verses.translation: Or do you feel secure that He will not cause you to revert to the sea and let a tempest loose upon you and then drown you for your ingratitude whereupon you will find none even to inquire of Us what happened to you?

verses.text: Indeed We honoured the progeny of Adam and bore them across land and sea and provided them with good things for their sustenance and exalted them above many of Our creatures.
verses.translation: Indeed We honoured the progeny of Adam and bore them across land and sea and provided them with good things for their sustenance and exalted them above many of Our creatures.

verses.text: Then think of the Day We shall summon every community with its leader. Those who are given their Record in their right hand shall read the Record of their deeds and shall not be wronged a whit.
verses.translation: Then think of the Day We shall summon every community with its leader. Those who are given their Record in their right hand shall read the Record of their deeds and shall not be wronged a whit.

verses.text: Whoever lived in this world as blind shall live as blind in the Life to Come; rather he will be even farther astray than if he were (just) blind.
verses.translation: Whoever lived in this world as blind shall live as blind in the Life to Come; rather he will be even farther astray than if he were (just) blind.

verses.text: (O Muhammad) they had all but tempted you away from what We have revealed to you that you may invent something else in Our Name. Had you done so they would have taken you as their trusted friend.
verses.translation: (O Muhammad) they had all but tempted you away from what We have revealed to you that you may invent something else in Our Name. Had you done so they would have taken you as their trusted friend.

verses.text: Indeed had We not strengthened you you might have inclined to them a little
verses.translation: Indeed had We not strengthened you you might have inclined to them a little

verses.text: whereupon We would have made you taste double (the chastisement) in the world and double (the chastisement) after death and then you would have found none to help you against Us.
verses.translation: whereupon We would have made you taste double (the chastisement) in the world and double (the chastisement) after death and then you would have found none to help you against Us.

verses.text: They were bent upon uprooting you from this land and driving you away from it. But were they to succeed they would not be able to remain after you more than a little while.
verses.translation: They were bent upon uprooting you from this land and driving you away from it. But were they to succeed they would not be able to remain after you more than a little while.

verses.text: This has been Our Way with the Messengers whom We sent before you. You will find no change in Our Way.
verses.translation: This has been Our Way with the Messengers whom We sent before you. You will find no change in Our Way.

verses.text: Establish Prayer from the declining of the sun to the darkness of the night; and hold fast to the recitation of the Qur''an at dawn for the recitation of the Qur''an at dawn is witnessed.
verses.translation: Establish Prayer from the declining of the sun to the darkness of the night; and hold fast to the recitation of the Qur''an at dawn for the recitation of the Qur''an at dawn is witnessed.

verses.text: And rise from sleep during the night as well- this is an additional Prayer for you. Possibly your Lord will raise you to an honoured position.
verses.translation: And rise from sleep during the night as well- this is an additional Prayer for you. Possibly your Lord will raise you to an honoured position.

verses.text: And pray: ""My Lord! Cause me to enter wherever it be with Truth and cause me to exit wherever it be with Truth and support me with authority from Yourself.""
verses.translation: And pray: ""My Lord! Cause me to enter wherever it be with Truth and cause me to exit wherever it be with Truth and support me with authority from Yourself.""

verses.text: And proclaim: ""The Truth has come and falsehood has vanished. Surely falsehood is ever bound to vanish.""
verses.translation: And proclaim: ""The Truth has come and falsehood has vanished. Surely falsehood is ever bound to vanish.""

verses.text: What We are sending down in the course of revealing the Qur''an is a healing and a grace for those who have faith; but it adds only to the ruin of the wrong-doers.
verses.translation: What We are sending down in the course of revealing the Qur''an is a healing and a grace for those who have faith; but it adds only to the ruin of the wrong-doers.

verses.text: Whenever We bestow favours upon man he arrogantly turns away and draws aside; and whenever evil visits him he is in utter despair.
verses.translation: Whenever We bestow favours upon man he arrogantly turns away and draws aside; and whenever evil visits him he is in utter despair.

verses.text: Say (O Prophet): ""Each one acts according to his own manner. Your Lord knows well who is best-guided to the Right Path.""
verses.translation: Say (O Prophet): ""Each one acts according to his own manner. Your Lord knows well who is best-guided to the Right Path.""

verses.text: They ask you about ""the spirit"". Say: ""The spirit descends by the command of my Lord but you have been given only a little knowledge.""
verses.translation: They ask you about ""the spirit"". Say: ""The spirit descends by the command of my Lord but you have been given only a little knowledge.""

verses.text: Had We willed We could take away what We have revealed to you then you would find none to help you in recovering it from Us.
verses.translation: Had We willed We could take away what We have revealed to you then you would find none to help you in recovering it from Us.

verses.text: (Whatever you have received) is nothing but grace from your Lord. Indeed His favour to you is great.
verses.translation: (Whatever you have received) is nothing but grace from your Lord. Indeed His favour to you is great.

verses.text: Say: ""Surely if mankind and jinn were to get together to produce the like of this Qur''an they will never be able to produce the like of it howsoever they might help one another.""
