verses.text: He said: ""This brings me and you to a parting of ways. Now I shall explain to you the true meaning of things about which you could not remain patient.
verses.translation: He said: ""This brings me and you to a parting of ways. Now I shall explain to you the true meaning of things about which you could not remain patient.

verses.text: As for the boat it belonged to some poor people who worked on the river and I desired to damage it for beyond them lay the dominion of a king who was wont to seize every boat by force.
verses.translation: As for the boat it belonged to some poor people who worked on the river and I desired to damage it for beyond them lay the dominion of a king who was wont to seize every boat by force.

verses.text: As for the lad his parents were people of faith and we feared lest he should plague them with transgression and disbelief
verses.translation: As for the lad his parents were people of faith and we feared lest he should plague them with transgression and disbelief

verses.text: and we desired that their Lord should grant them another in his place a son more upright and more tender hearted.
verses.translation: and we desired that their Lord should grant them another in his place a son more upright and more tender hearted.

verses.text: As for the wall it belonged to two orphan boys in the city and under it there was a treasure that belonged to them. Their father was a righteous man and your Lord intended that they should come of age and then bring forth their treasure as a mercy from your Lord; I did not do this of my own bidding. This is the true meaning of things with which you could not keep your patience.""
verses.translation: As for the wall it belonged to two orphan boys in the city and under it there was a treasure that belonged to them. Their father was a righteous man and your Lord intended that they should come of age and then bring forth their treasure as a mercy from your Lord; I did not do this of my own bidding. This is the true meaning of things with which you could not keep your patience.""

verses.text: (O Muhammad) they ask you about Dhu al-Qarnayn. Say: ""I will give you an account of him.""
verses.translation: (O Muhammad) they ask you about Dhu al-Qarnayn. Say: ""I will give you an account of him.""

verses.text: We granted him power in the land and endowed him with all kinds of resources.
verses.translation: We granted him power in the land and endowed him with all kinds of resources.

verses.text: He set out (westwards) on an expedition
verses.translation: He set out (westwards) on an expedition

verses.text: until when he reached the very limits where the sun sets he saw it setting in dark turbid waters; and nearby he met a people. We said: ""O Dhu al-Qarnayn you have the power to punish or to treat them with kindness.""
verses.translation: until when he reached the very limits where the sun sets he saw it setting in dark turbid waters; and nearby he met a people. We said: ""O Dhu al-Qarnayn you have the power to punish or to treat them with kindness.""

verses.text: He said: ""We will chastise him who does wrong whereafter he will be returned to his Lord and He will chastise him grievously.
verses.translation: He said: ""We will chastise him who does wrong whereafter he will be returned to his Lord and He will chastise him grievously.

verses.text: But as for him who believes and acts righteously his will be a goodly reward and we shall enjoin upon him only mild commands.""
verses.translation: But as for him who believes and acts righteously his will be a goodly reward and we shall enjoin upon him only mild commands.""

verses.text: Then he set out on another expedition
verses.translation: Then he set out on another expedition

verses.text: until he reached the limit where the sun rises and he found it rising on a people whom We had provided no shelter from it.
verses.translation: until he reached the limit where the sun rises and he found it rising on a people whom We had provided no shelter from it.

verses.text: Thus was the state of those people and We encompassed in knowledge all concerning Dhu al- Qarnayn.
verses.translation: Thus was the state of those people and We encompassed in knowledge all concerning Dhu al- Qarnayn.

verses.text: Then he set out on another expedition
verses.translation: Then he set out on another expedition

verses.text: until when he reached a place between the two mountains he found beside the mountains a people who scarcely understood anything.
verses.translation: until when he reached a place between the two mountains he found beside the mountains a people who scarcely understood anything.

verses.text: They said: ""O Dhu al-Qarnayn Gog and Magog are spreading corruption in this land. So shall we pay you taxes on the understanding that you will set up a barrier between us and them?""
verses.translation: They said: ""O Dhu al-Qarnayn Gog and Magog are spreading corruption in this land. So shall we pay you taxes on the understanding that you will set up a barrier between us and them?""

verses.text: He answered: ""Whatever my Lord has granted me is good enough. But help me with your labour and I will erect a rampart between you and them.
verses.translation: He answered: ""Whatever my Lord has granted me is good enough. But help me with your labour and I will erect a rampart between you and them.

verses.text: Bring me ingots of iron."" Then after he had filled up the space between the two mountain-sides he said: ""(Light a fire) and ply bellows."" When he had made it (red like) fire he said: ""Bring me molten copper which I may pour on it.""
verses.translation: Bring me ingots of iron."" Then after he had filled up the space between the two mountain-sides he said: ""(Light a fire) and ply bellows."" When he had made it (red like) fire he said: ""Bring me molten copper which I may pour on it.""

verses.text: Such was the rampart that Gog and Magog could not scale nor could they pierce it.
verses.translation: Such was the rampart that Gog and Magog could not scale nor could they pierce it.

verses.text: Dhu al-Qarnayn said: ""This is a mercy from my Lord: but when the time of my Lord''s promise shall come He will level the rampart with the ground. My Lord''s promise always comes true.""
verses.translation: Dhu al-Qarnayn said: ""This is a mercy from my Lord: but when the time of my Lord''s promise shall come He will level the rampart with the ground. My Lord''s promise always comes true.""

verses.text: And on that Day We shall let some of them surge like waves against others and the Trumpet shall be blown. Then We shall gather them all together.
verses.translation: And on that Day We shall let some of them surge like waves against others and the Trumpet shall be blown. Then We shall gather them all together.

verses.text: That will be the Day We shall place Hell before the unbelievers
verses.translation: That will be the Day We shall place Hell before the unbelievers

verses.text: whose eyes had become blind against My admonition and who were utterly disinclined to hear it.
verses.translation: whose eyes had become blind against My admonition and who were utterly disinclined to hear it.

verses.text: Do the unbelievers then believe that they can take any of My creatures as their guardians beside Me? Verily We have prepared Hell to welcome the unbelievers.
verses.translation: Do the unbelievers then believe that they can take any of My creatures as their guardians beside Me? Verily We have prepared Hell to welcome the unbelievers.

verses.text: Say (O Muhammad): ""Shall We tell you who will be the greatest losers in respect of their works?
verses.translation: Say (O Muhammad): ""Shall We tell you who will be the greatest losers in respect of their works?

verses.text: It will be those whose effort went astray in the life of the world and who believe nevertheless that they are doing good.
verses.translation: It will be those whose effort went astray in the life of the world and who believe nevertheless that they are doing good.

verses.text: Those are the ones who refused to believe in the revelations of their Lord and that they are bound to meet Him. Hence all their deeds have come to naught and We shall assign no weight to them on the Day of Resurrection.
verses.translation: Those are the ones who refused to believe in the revelations of their Lord and that they are bound to meet Him. Hence all their deeds have come to naught and We shall assign no weight to them on the Day of Resurrection.

verses.text: Hell is their recompense for disbelieving and their taking My revelations and My Messengers as objects of jest.
verses.translation: Hell is their recompense for disbelieving and their taking My revelations and My Messengers as objects of jest.

verses.text: As for those who believe and do good works the Gardens of Paradise shall be there to welcome them;
verses.translation: As for those who believe and do good works the Gardens of Paradise shall be there to welcome them;

verses.text: there they will abide for ever with no desire to be removed from there.""
verses.translation: there they will abide for ever with no desire to be removed from there.""

verses.text: Say: ""If the sea were to become ink to record the Words of my Lord indeed the sea would be all used up before the Words of my Lord are exhausted and it would be the same even if We were to bring an equal amount of ink.""
verses.translation: Say: ""If the sea were to become ink to record the Words of my Lord indeed the sea would be all used up before the Words of my Lord are exhausted and it would be the same even if We were to bring an equal amount of ink.""

verses.text: Say (O Muhammad): ""I am no more than a human being like you; one to whom revelation is made: ''Your Lord is the One and Only God.'' Hence whoever looks forward to meet his Lord let him do righteous works and let him associate none with the worship of his Lord.""
verses.translation: Say (O Muhammad): ""I am no more than a human being like you; one to whom revelation is made: ''Your Lord is the One and Only God.'' Hence whoever looks forward to meet his Lord let him do righteous works and let him associate none with the worship of his Lord.""

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: Praise be to Allah Who has revealed to His servant the Book devoid of all crookedness;
ayahs.translation: Praise be to Allah Who has revealed to His servant the Book devoid of all crookedness;

ayahs.text: an unerringly Straight Book meant to warn of a stern punishment from Allah and to proclaim to those who believe and work righteous deeds the tiding that theirs shall be a good reward
ayahs.translation: an unerringly Straight Book meant to warn of a stern punishment from Allah and to proclaim to those who believe and work righteous deeds the tiding that theirs shall be a good reward

ayahs.text: wherein they shall abide for ever;
ayahs.translation: wherein they shall abide for ever;

ayahs.text: and also to warn those who say: ""Allah has taken to Himself a son
ayahs.translation: and also to warn those who say: ""Allah has taken to Himself a son

ayahs.text: a thing about which they have no knowledge neither they nor their ancestors. Dreadful is the word that comes out of their mouths. What they utter is merely a lie.
ayahs.translation: a thing about which they have no knowledge neither they nor their ancestors. Dreadful is the word that comes out of their mouths. What they utter is merely a lie.

ayahs.text: (O Muhammad) if they do not believe in this Message you will perhaps torment yourself to death with grief sorrowing over them.
ayahs.translation: (O Muhammad) if they do not believe in this Message you will perhaps torment yourself to death with grief sorrowing over them.

ayahs.text: Surely We have made all that is on the earth an embellishment for it in order to test people as to who of them is better in conduct.
ayahs.translation: Surely We have made all that is on the earth an embellishment for it in order to test people as to who of them is better in conduct.

ayahs.text: In the ultimate We shall reduce all that is on the earth to a barren plain.
ayahs.translation: In the ultimate We shall reduce all that is on the earth to a barren plain.

ayahs.text: Do you think that the people of the Cave and the Inscription were one of Our wondrous signs?
ayahs.translation: Do you think that the people of the Cave and the Inscription were one of Our wondrous signs?

ayahs.text: When those youths sought refuge in the Cave and said: ""Our Lord! Grant us mercy from Yourself and provide for us rectitude in our affairs.""
ayahs.translation: When those youths sought refuge in the Cave and said: ""Our Lord! Grant us mercy from Yourself and provide for us rectitude in our affairs.""

ayahs.text: We lulled them to sleep in that cave for a number of years
ayahs.translation: We lulled them to sleep in that cave for a number of years

ayahs.text: and then roused them so that We might see which of the two parties could best tell the length of their stay.
ayahs.translation: and then roused them so that We might see which of the two parties could best tell the length of their stay.

ayahs.text: We narrate to you their true story. They were a party of young men who had faith in their Lord and We increased them in guidance
ayahs.translation: We narrate to you their true story. They were a party of young men who had faith in their Lord and We increased them in guidance

ayahs.text: and strengthened their hearts when they stood up and proclaimed: ""Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth. We shall call upon no other god beside Him; (for if we did so) we shall be uttering a blasphemy.""
ayahs.translation: and strengthened their hearts when they stood up and proclaimed: ""Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth. We shall call upon no other god beside Him; (for if we did so) we shall be uttering a blasphemy.""

ayahs.text: (Then they conferred among themselves and said): ""These men our own people have taken others as gods beside Him: why do they not bring any clear evidence that they indeed are gods? Who can be more unjust than he who foists a lie on Allah?
ayahs.translation: (Then they conferred among themselves and said): ""These men our own people have taken others as gods beside Him: why do they not bring any clear evidence that they indeed are gods? Who can be more unjust than he who foists a lie on Allah?

ayahs.text: And now that you have dissociated yourselves from them and from whatever they worship beside Allah go and seek refuge in the Cave. Your Lord will extend His mercy to you and will provide for you the means for the disposal of your affairs.""
ayahs.translation: And now that you have dissociated yourselves from them and from whatever they worship beside Allah go and seek refuge in the Cave. Your Lord will extend His mercy to you and will provide for you the means for the disposal of your affairs.""

ayahs.text: Had you seen them in the Cave it would have appeared to you that when the sun rose it moved away from their Cave to the right; and when it set it turned away from them to the left while they remained in a spacious hollow in the Cave. This is one of the Signs of Allah. Whomsoever Allah guides he alone is led aright; and whomsoever Allah lets go astray you will find for him no guardian to direct him.
ayahs.translation: Had you seen them in the Cave it would have appeared to you that when the sun rose it moved away from their Cave to the right; and when it set it turned away from them to the left while they remained in a spacious hollow in the Cave. This is one of the Signs of Allah. Whomsoever Allah guides he alone is led aright; and whomsoever Allah lets go astray you will find for him no guardian to direct him.

ayahs.text: On seeing them you would fancy them to be awake though they were asleep; and We caused them to turn their sides to their right and to their left and their dog sat stretching out its forelegs on the threshold of the Cave. Had you looked upon them you would have certainly fled away from them their sight filling you with terror.
ayahs.translation: On seeing them you would fancy them to be awake though they were asleep; and We caused them to turn their sides to their right and to their left and their dog sat stretching out its forelegs on the threshold of the Cave. Had you looked upon them you would have certainly fled away from them their sight filling you with terror.

ayahs.text: Likewise We roused them in a miraculous way that they might question one another. One of them asked: ""How long did you remain (in this state)?"" The others said: ""We remained so for a day or part of a day."" Then they said: ""Your Lord knows better how long we remained in this state. Now send one of you to the city with this coin of yours and let him see who has the best food and let him buy some provisions from there. Let him be cautious and not inform anyone of our whereabouts.
ayahs.translation: Likewise We roused them in a miraculous way that they might question one another. One of them asked: ""How long did you remain (in this state)?"" The others said: ""We remained so for a day or part of a day."" Then they said: ""Your Lord knows better how long we remained in this state. Now send one of you to the city with this coin of yours and let him see who has the best food and let him buy some provisions from there. Let him be cautious and not inform anyone of our whereabouts.

ayahs.text: For if they should come upon us they will stone us to death or force us to revert to their faith whereafter we shall never prosper.""
ayahs.translation: For if they should come upon us they will stone us to death or force us to revert to their faith whereafter we shall never prosper.""

ayahs.text: Thus did We make their case known to the people of the city so that they might know that Allah''s promise is true and that there is absolutely no doubt that the Hour will come to pass. But instead of giving thought to this they disputed with one another concerning the People of the Cave some saying: ""Build a wall over them. Their Lord alone knows best about them."" But those who prevailed over their affairs said: ""We shall build a place of worship over them.""
ayahs.translation: Thus did We make their case known to the people of the city so that they might know that Allah''s promise is true and that there is absolutely no doubt that the Hour will come to pass. But instead of giving thought to this they disputed with one another concerning the People of the Cave some saying: ""Build a wall over them. Their Lord alone knows best about them."" But those who prevailed over their affairs said: ""We shall build a place of worship over them.""

ayahs.text: Some will say concerning them: ""They were three and their dog the fourth""; and some will say: ""They were five and their dog the sixth"" - all this being merely guesswork; and still others will say: ""They were seven and their dog the eighth."" Say: ""My Lord knows their number best. Only a few know their correct number. So do not dispute concerning their number but stick to what is evident and do not question anyone about them.""
ayahs.translation: Some will say concerning them: ""They were three and their dog the fourth""; and some will say: ""They were five and their dog the sixth"" - all this being merely guesswork; and still others will say: ""They were seven and their dog the eighth."" Say: ""My Lord knows their number best. Only a few know their correct number. So do not dispute concerning their number but stick to what is evident and do not question anyone about them.""

ayahs.text: And never say about anything: ""I shall certainly do this tomorrow""
ayahs.translation: And never say about anything: ""I shall certainly do this tomorrow""

ayahs.text: unless Allah should will it. And should you forget (and make such a statement) remember your Lord and say: ""I expect my Lord to guide me to what is nearer to rectitude than this.""
ayahs.translation: unless Allah should will it. And should you forget (and make such a statement) remember your Lord and say: ""I expect my Lord to guide me to what is nearer to rectitude than this.""

ayahs.text: They remained in the Cave for three hundred years; and others added nine more years.
ayahs.translation: They remained in the Cave for three hundred years; and others added nine more years.

ayahs.text: Say: ""Allah knows best how long they remained in it for only He knows all that is hidden in the heavens and the earth. How well He sees; how well He hears! The creatures have no other guardian than Him; He allows none to share His authority.""
ayahs.translation: Say: ""Allah knows best how long they remained in it for only He knows all that is hidden in the heavens and the earth. How well He sees; how well He hears! The creatures have no other guardian than Him; He allows none to share His authority.""

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) recite to them from the Book of your Lord what has been revealed to you for none may change His words; (and were you to make any change in His words) you will find no refuge from Him.
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) recite to them from the Book of your Lord what has been revealed to you for none may change His words; (and were you to make any change in His words) you will find no refuge from Him.

ayahs.text: Keep yourself content with those who call upon their Lord morning and evening seeking His pleasure and do not let your eyes pass beyond them. Do you seek the pomp and glitter of the world? Do not follow him whose heart We have caused to be heedless of Our remembrance and who follows his desires and whose attitude is of excess.
ayahs.translation: Keep yourself content with those who call upon their Lord morning and evening seeking His pleasure and do not let your eyes pass beyond them. Do you seek the pomp and glitter of the world? Do not follow him whose heart We have caused to be heedless of Our remembrance and who follows his desires and whose attitude is of excess.

ayahs.text: And proclaim: ""This is the Truth from your Lord. Now let him who will believe; and let him who will disbelieve. We have prepared a Fire for the wrong-doers whose billowing folds encompass them. If they ask for water they will be served with a drink like dregs of oil that will scald their faces. How dreadful a drink and how evil an abode!
ayahs.translation: And proclaim: ""This is the Truth from your Lord. Now let him who will believe; and let him who will disbelieve. We have prepared a Fire for the wrong-doers whose billowing folds encompass them. If they ask for water they will be served with a drink like dregs of oil that will scald their faces. How dreadful a drink and how evil an abode!

ayahs.text: As for those who believe and do good We shall not cause their reward to be lost.
ayahs.translation: As for those who believe and do good We shall not cause their reward to be lost.

ayahs.text: They shall dwell in the Gardens of Eternity beneath which streams flow. There they will be adorned with bracelets of gold will be arrayed in green garments of silk and rich brocade and will recline on raised couches. How excellent is their reward and how nice their resting-place!""
ayahs.translation: They shall dwell in the Gardens of Eternity beneath which streams flow. There they will be adorned with bracelets of gold will be arrayed in green garments of silk and rich brocade and will recline on raised couches. How excellent is their reward and how nice their resting-place!""

ayahs.text: (O Muhammad) propound a parable to them. There were two men of whom We bestowed upon one of them two vineyards surrounding both of them with date-palms and putting a tillage in between.
ayahs.translation: (O Muhammad) propound a parable to them. There were two men of whom We bestowed upon one of them two vineyards surrounding both of them with date-palms and putting a tillage in between.

ayahs.text: Both the vineyards yielded abundant produce without failure and We caused a stream to flow in their midst
ayahs.translation: Both the vineyards yielded abundant produce without failure and We caused a stream to flow in their midst

ayahs.text: so the owner had fruit in abundance and he said to his neighbour while conversing with him: ""I have greater wealth than you and I am stronger than you in numbers.""
ayahs.translation: so the owner had fruit in abundance and he said to his neighbour while conversing with him: ""I have greater wealth than you and I am stronger than you in numbers.""

ayahs.text: Then he entered his vine-yard and said wronging himself: ""Surely I do not believe that all this will ever perish.
ayahs.translation: Then he entered his vine-yard and said wronging himself: ""Surely I do not believe that all this will ever perish.

ayahs.text: Nor do I believe that the Hour of Resurrection will ever come to pass. And even if I am returned to my Lord I shall find a better place than this.""
ayahs.translation: Nor do I believe that the Hour of Resurrection will ever come to pass. And even if I am returned to my Lord I shall find a better place than this.""

ayahs.text: While conversing with him his neighbour exclaimed: ""Do you deny Him Who created you out of dust then out of a drop of sperm and then fashioned you into a complete man?
ayahs.translation: While conversing with him his neighbour exclaimed: ""Do you deny Him Who created you out of dust then out of a drop of sperm and then fashioned you into a complete man?

ayahs.text: As for myself Allah alone is my Lord and I associate none with my Lord in His Divinity.
ayahs.translation: As for myself Allah alone is my Lord and I associate none with my Lord in His Divinity.

ayahs.text: When you entered your vineyard why did you not say: ''Whatever Allah wills shall come to pass for there is no power save with Allah!'' If you find me less than yourself in wealth and children
ayahs.translation: When you entered your vineyard why did you not say: ''Whatever Allah wills shall come to pass for there is no power save with Allah!'' If you find me less than yourself in wealth and children

ayahs.text: it may well be that my Lord will give me something better than your vineyard and send a calamity upon your vineyard from the heavens and it will be reduced to a barren waste
ayahs.translation: it may well be that my Lord will give me something better than your vineyard and send a calamity upon your vineyard from the heavens and it will be reduced to a barren waste

ayahs.text: or the water of your vineyard will be drained deep into the ground so that you will not be able to seek it out.""
ayahs.translation: or the water of your vineyard will be drained deep into the ground so that you will not be able to seek it out.""

ayahs.text: Eventually all his produce was destroyed and he began to wring his hands in sorrow at the loss of what he had spent on it and on seeing it fallen down upon its trellises saying: ""Would I had not associated anyone with my Lord in His Divinity.""
ayahs.translation: Eventually all his produce was destroyed and he began to wring his hands in sorrow at the loss of what he had spent on it and on seeing it fallen down upon its trellises saying: ""Would I had not associated anyone with my Lord in His Divinity.""

ayahs.text: And there was no host beside Allah to help him nor could he be of any help to himself.
ayahs.translation: And there was no host beside Allah to help him nor could he be of any help to himself.

ayahs.text: (Then he knew) that all power of protection rests with Allah the True One. He is the best to reward the best to determine the end of things.
ayahs.translation: (Then he knew) that all power of protection rests with Allah the True One. He is the best to reward the best to determine the end of things.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) propound to them the parable of the present life: it is like the vegetation of the earth which flourished luxuriantly when it mingled with the water that We sent down from the sky but after that the same vegetation turned into stubble which the winds blew about. Allah alone has the power over all things.
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) propound to them the parable of the present life: it is like the vegetation of the earth which flourished luxuriantly when it mingled with the water that We sent down from the sky but after that the same vegetation turned into stubble which the winds blew about. Allah alone has the power over all things.

ayahs.text: Wealth and children are an adornment of the life of the world. But the deeds of lasting righteousness are the best in the sight of your Lord in reward and far better a source of hope.
ayahs.translation: Wealth and children are an adornment of the life of the world. But the deeds of lasting righteousness are the best in the sight of your Lord in reward and far better a source of hope.

ayahs.text: Bear in mind the Day when We shall set the mountains in motion and you will find the earth void and bare. On that Day We shall muster all men together leaving none of them behind.
ayahs.translation: Bear in mind the Day when We shall set the mountains in motion and you will find the earth void and bare. On that Day We shall muster all men together leaving none of them behind.

ayahs.text: They shall be brought before your Lord all lined up and shall be told: ""Now indeed you have come before Us in the manner We created you in the first instance although you thought that We shall not appoint a tryst (with Us).""
ayahs.translation: They shall be brought before your Lord all lined up and shall be told: ""Now indeed you have come before Us in the manner We created you in the first instance although you thought that We shall not appoint a tryst (with Us).""

ayahs.text: And then the Record of their deeds shall be placed before them and you will see the guilty full of fear for what it contains and will say: ""Woe to us! What a Record this is! It leaves nothing big or small but encompasses it."" They will find their deeds confronting them. Your Lord wrongs no one.
ayahs.translation: And then the Record of their deeds shall be placed before them and you will see the guilty full of fear for what it contains and will say: ""Woe to us! What a Record this is! It leaves nothing big or small but encompasses it."" They will find their deeds confronting them. Your Lord wrongs no one.

ayahs.text: And recall when We said to the angels: ""Prostrate yourselves before Adam""; all of them fell prostrate except Iblis. He was of the jinn and so disobeyed the command of his Lord. Will you then take him and his progeny as your guardians rather than Me although they are your open enemies? What an evil substitute are these wrong-doers taking!
ayahs.translation: And recall when We said to the angels: ""Prostrate yourselves before Adam""; all of them fell prostrate except Iblis. He was of the jinn and so disobeyed the command of his Lord. Will you then take him and his progeny as your guardians rather than Me although they are your open enemies? What an evil substitute are these wrong-doers taking!

ayahs.text: I did not call them to witness the creation of the heavens and the earth nor in their own creation. I do not seek the aid of those who lead people astray.
ayahs.translation: I did not call them to witness the creation of the heavens and the earth nor in their own creation. I do not seek the aid of those who lead people astray.

ayahs.text: What will such people do on the Day when the Lord will say: ""Now call upon all those whom you believed to be My partners?""Thereupon they will call upon them but they will not respond to their call; and We shall make them a common pit of doom
ayahs.translation: What will such people do on the Day when the Lord will say: ""Now call upon all those whom you believed to be My partners?""Thereupon they will call upon them but they will not respond to their call; and We shall make them a common pit of doom

ayahs.text: and the guilty shall behold the Fire and know that they are bound to fall into it and will find no escape from it.
ayahs.translation: and the guilty shall behold the Fire and know that they are bound to fall into it and will find no escape from it.

ayahs.text: And surely We have explained matters to people in the Qur''an in diverse ways using all manner of parables. But man is exceedingly contentious.
ayahs.translation: And surely We have explained matters to people in the Qur''an in diverse ways using all manner of parables. But man is exceedingly contentious.

ayahs.text: What is it that prevented mankind from believing when the guidance came to them and from asking forgiveness of their Lord except that they would like to be treated as the nations of yore or that they would like to see the scourge come upon them face to face?
ayahs.translation: What is it that prevented mankind from believing when the guidance came to them and from asking forgiveness of their Lord except that they would like to be treated as the nations of yore or that they would like to see the scourge come upon them face to face?

ayahs.text: We raise Messengers only to give good news and to warn. But the unbelievers resort to falsehood in order to rebut the truth with it and scoff at My revelations and My warnings.
ayahs.translation: We raise Messengers only to give good news and to warn. But the unbelievers resort to falsehood in order to rebut the truth with it and scoff at My revelations and My warnings.

ayahs.text: Who is more wicked than the man who when he is reminded by the revelations of his Lord turns away from them and forgets (the consequence of) the deeds wrought by his own hands? We have laid veils over their hearts lest they understand the message of the Qur''an and We have caused heaviness in their ears. Call them as you may to the Right Path they will not be ever guided aright.
ayahs.translation: Who is more wicked than the man who when he is reminded by the revelations of his Lord turns away from them and forgets (the consequence of) the deeds wrought by his own hands? We have laid veils over their hearts lest they understand the message of the Qur''an and We have caused heaviness in their ears. Call them as you may to the Right Path they will not be ever guided aright.

ayahs.text: Your Lord is All-Forgiving full of mercy. Had He wished to take them to task for their doings He would have hastened in sending His scourge upon them. But He has set for them a time-limit which they cannot evade.
ayahs.translation: Your Lord is All-Forgiving full of mercy. Had He wished to take them to task for their doings He would have hastened in sending His scourge upon them. But He has set for them a time-limit which they cannot evade.

ayahs.text: All the townships afflicted with scourge are before your eyes. When they committed wrong We destroyed them. For the destruction of each We had set a definite term.
ayahs.translation: All the townships afflicted with scourge are before your eyes. When they committed wrong We destroyed them. For the destruction of each We had set a definite term.

ayahs.text: (And recount to them the story of Moses) when Moses said to his servant: ""I will journey on until I reach the point where the two rivers meet though I may march on for ages.""
ayahs.translation: (And recount to them the story of Moses) when Moses said to his servant: ""I will journey on until I reach the point where the two rivers meet though I may march on for ages.""

ayahs.text: But when they reached the point where the two rivers meet they forgot their fish and it took its way into the sea as if through a tunnel.
ayahs.translation: But when they reached the point where the two rivers meet they forgot their fish and it took its way into the sea as if through a tunnel.

ayahs.text: When they had journeyed further on Moses said to his servant: ""Bring us our repast. We are surely fatigued by today''s journey.""
ayahs.translation: When they had journeyed further on Moses said to his servant: ""Bring us our repast. We are surely fatigued by today''s journey.""

ayahs.text: The servant said: ""Did you see what happened? When we betook ourselves to the rock to take rest I forgot the fish - and it is only Satan who caused me to forget to mention it to you - so that it made its way into the sea in a strange manner.""
ayahs.translation: The servant said: ""Did you see what happened? When we betook ourselves to the rock to take rest I forgot the fish - and it is only Satan who caused me to forget to mention it to you - so that it made its way into the sea in a strange manner.""

ayahs.text: Moses said: ""That is what we were looking for."" So the two turned back retracing their footsteps
ayahs.translation: Moses said: ""That is what we were looking for."" So the two turned back retracing their footsteps

ayahs.text: and there they found one of Our servants upon whom We had bestowed Our mercy and to whom We had imparted a special knowledge from Ourselves.
ayahs.translation: and there they found one of Our servants upon whom We had bestowed Our mercy and to whom We had imparted a special knowledge from Ourselves.

ayahs.text: Moses said to him: ""May l follow you that you may teach me something of the wisdom which you have been taught?""
ayahs.translation: Moses said to him: ""May l follow you that you may teach me something of the wisdom which you have been taught?""

ayahs.text: He answered: ""You will surely not be able to bear with me.
ayahs.translation: He answered: ""You will surely not be able to bear with me.

ayahs.text: For how can you patiently bear with something you cannot encompass in your knowledge?""
ayahs.translation: For how can you patiently bear with something you cannot encompass in your knowledge?""

ayahs.text: Moses replied: ""You shall find me if Allah wills patient; and I shall not disobey you in anything.""
ayahs.translation: Moses replied: ""You shall find me if Allah wills patient; and I shall not disobey you in anything.""

ayahs.text: He said: ""Well if you follow me do not ask me concerning anything until I myself mention it to you.""
ayahs.translation: He said: ""Well if you follow me do not ask me concerning anything until I myself mention it to you.""

ayahs.text: Then the two went forth until when they embarked on the boat he made a hole in it whereupon Moses exclaimed: ""Have you made a hole in it so as to drown the people in the boat? You have certainly done an awful thing.""
ayahs.translation: Then the two went forth until when they embarked on the boat he made a hole in it whereupon Moses exclaimed: ""Have you made a hole in it so as to drown the people in the boat? You have certainly done an awful thing.""

ayahs.text: He replied: ""Did I not tell you that you will not be able to patiently bear with me?""
ayahs.translation: He replied: ""Did I not tell you that you will not be able to patiently bear with me?""

ayahs.text: Moses said: ""Do not take me to task at my forgetfulness and do not be hard on me.""
ayahs.translation: Moses said: ""Do not take me to task at my forgetfulness and do not be hard on me.""

ayahs.text: Then the two went forth until they met a lad whom he slew whereupon Moses exclaimed: ""What! Have you slain an innocent person without his having slain anyone? Surely you have done a horrible thing.""
ayahs.translation: Then the two went forth until they met a lad whom he slew whereupon Moses exclaimed: ""What! Have you slain an innocent person without his having slain anyone? Surely you have done a horrible thing.""

ayahs.text: He said: ""Did I not tell you that you will not be able to patiently bear with me?""
ayahs.translation: He said: ""Did I not tell you that you will not be able to patiently bear with me?""

ayahs.text: Moses said: ""Keep me no more in your company if I question you concerning anything after this. You will then be fully justified.""
ayahs.translation: Moses said: ""Keep me no more in your company if I question you concerning anything after this. You will then be fully justified.""

ayahs.text: Then the two went forth until when they came to a town they asked its people for food but they refused to play host to them. They found in that town a wall that was on the verge of tumbling down and he buttressed it whereupon Moses said: ""If you had wished you could have received payment for it.""
ayahs.translation: Then the two went forth until when they came to a town they asked its people for food but they refused to play host to them. They found in that town a wall that was on the verge of tumbling down and he buttressed it whereupon Moses said: ""If you had wished you could have received payment for it.""

ayahs.text: He said: ""This brings me and you to a parting of ways. Now I shall explain to you the true meaning of things about which you could not remain patient.
ayahs.translation: He said: ""This brings me and you to a parting of ways. Now I shall explain to you the true meaning of things about which you could not remain patient.

ayahs.text: As for the boat it belonged to some poor people who worked on the river and I desired to damage it for beyond them lay the dominion of a king who was wont to seize every boat by force.
ayahs.translation: As for the boat it belonged to some poor people who worked on the river and I desired to damage it for beyond them lay the dominion of a king who was wont to seize every boat by force.

ayahs.text: As for the lad his parents were people of faith and we feared lest he should plague them with transgression and disbelief
ayahs.translation: As for the lad his parents were people of faith and we feared lest he should plague them with transgression and disbelief

ayahs.text: and we desired that their Lord should grant them another in his place a son more upright and more tender hearted.
ayahs.translation: and we desired that their Lord should grant them another in his place a son more upright and more tender hearted.

ayahs.text: As for the wall it belonged to two orphan boys in the city and under it there was a treasure that belonged to them. Their father was a righteous man and your Lord intended that they should come of age and then bring forth their treasure as a mercy from your Lord; I did not do this of my own bidding. This is the true meaning of things with which you could not keep your patience.""
ayahs.translation: As for the wall it belonged to two orphan boys in the city and under it there was a treasure that belonged to them. Their father was a righteous man and your Lord intended that they should come of age and then bring forth their treasure as a mercy from your Lord; I did not do this of my own bidding. This is the true meaning of things with which you could not keep your patience.""

ayahs.text: (O Muhammad) they ask you about Dhu al-Qarnayn. Say: ""I will give you an account of him.""
ayahs.translation: (O Muhammad) they ask you about Dhu al-Qarnayn. Say: ""I will give you an account of him.""

ayahs.text: We granted him power in the land and endowed him with all kinds of resources.
ayahs.translation: We granted him power in the land and endowed him with all kinds of resources.

ayahs.text: He set out (westwards) on an expedition
ayahs.translation: He set out (westwards) on an expedition

ayahs.text: until when he reached the very limits where the sun sets he saw it setting in dark turbid waters; and nearby he met a people. We said: ""O Dhu al-Qarnayn you have the power to punish or to treat them with kindness.""
ayahs.translation: until when he reached the very limits where the sun sets he saw it setting in dark turbid waters; and nearby he met a people. We said: ""O Dhu al-Qarnayn you have the power to punish or to treat them with kindness.""

ayahs.text: He said: ""We will chastise him who does wrong whereafter he will be returned to his Lord and He will chastise him grievously.
ayahs.translation: He said: ""We will chastise him who does wrong whereafter he will be returned to his Lord and He will chastise him grievously.

ayahs.text: But as for him who believes and acts righteously his will be a goodly reward and we shall enjoin upon him only mild commands.""
ayahs.translation: But as for him who believes and acts righteously his will be a goodly reward and we shall enjoin upon him only mild commands.""

ayahs.text: Then he set out on another expedition
ayahs.translation: Then he set out on another expedition

ayahs.text: until he reached the limit where the sun rises and he found it rising on a people whom We had provided no shelter from it.
ayahs.translation: until he reached the limit where the sun rises and he found it rising on a people whom We had provided no shelter from it.

ayahs.text: Thus was the state of those people and We encompassed in knowledge all concerning Dhu al- Qarnayn.
ayahs.translation: Thus was the state of those people and We encompassed in knowledge all concerning Dhu al- Qarnayn.

ayahs.text: Then he set out on another expedition
ayahs.translation: Then he set out on another expedition

ayahs.text: until when he reached a place between the two mountains he found beside the mountains a people who scarcely understood anything.
ayahs.translation: until when he reached a place between the two mountains he found beside the mountains a people who scarcely understood anything.

ayahs.text: They said: ""O Dhu al-Qarnayn Gog and Magog are spreading corruption in this land. So shall we pay you taxes on the understanding that you will set up a barrier between us and them?""
ayahs.translation: They said: ""O Dhu al-Qarnayn Gog and Magog are spreading corruption in this land. So shall we pay you taxes on the understanding that you will set up a barrier between us and them?""

ayahs.text: He answered: ""Whatever my Lord has granted me is good enough. But help me with your labour and I will erect a rampart between you and them.
ayahs.translation: He answered: ""Whatever my Lord has granted me is good enough. But help me with your labour and I will erect a rampart between you and them.

ayahs.text: Bring me ingots of iron."" Then after he had filled up the space between the two mountain-sides he said: ""(Light a fire) and ply bellows."" When he had made it (red like) fire he said: ""Bring me molten copper which I may pour on it.""
ayahs.translation: Bring me ingots of iron."" Then after he had filled up the space between the two mountain-sides he said: ""(Light a fire) and ply bellows."" When he had made it (red like) fire he said: ""Bring me molten copper which I may pour on it.""

ayahs.text: Such was the rampart that Gog and Magog could not scale nor could they pierce it.
ayahs.translation: Such was the rampart that Gog and Magog could not scale nor could they pierce it.

ayahs.text: Dhu al-Qarnayn said: ""This is a mercy from my Lord: but when the time of my Lord''s promise shall come He will level the rampart with the ground. My Lord''s promise always comes true.""
ayahs.translation: Dhu al-Qarnayn said: ""This is a mercy from my Lord: but when the time of my Lord''s promise shall come He will level the rampart with the ground. My Lord''s promise always comes true.""

ayahs.text: And on that Day We shall let some of them surge like waves against others and the Trumpet shall be blown. Then We shall gather them all together.
ayahs.translation: And on that Day We shall let some of them surge like waves against others and the Trumpet shall be blown. Then We shall gather them all together.

ayahs.text: That will be the Day We shall place Hell before the unbelievers
ayahs.translation: That will be the Day We shall place Hell before the unbelievers

ayahs.text: whose eyes had become blind against My admonition and who were utterly disinclined to hear it.
ayahs.translation: whose eyes had become blind against My admonition and who were utterly disinclined to hear it.

ayahs.text: Do the unbelievers then believe that they can take any of My creatures as their guardians beside Me? Verily We have prepared Hell to welcome the unbelievers.
ayahs.translation: Do the unbelievers then believe that they can take any of My creatures as their guardians beside Me? Verily We have prepared Hell to welcome the unbelievers.

ayahs.text: Say (O Muhammad): ""Shall We tell you who will be the greatest losers in respect of their works?
ayahs.translation: Say (O Muhammad): ""Shall We tell you who will be the greatest losers in respect of their works?

ayahs.text: It will be those whose effort went astray in the life of the world and who believe nevertheless that they are doing good.
ayahs.translation: It will be those whose effort went astray in the life of the world and who believe nevertheless that they are doing good.

ayahs.text: Those are the ones who refused to believe in the revelations of their Lord and that they are bound to meet Him. Hence all their deeds have come to naught and We shall assign no weight to them on the Day of Resurrection.
ayahs.translation: Those are the ones who refused to believe in the revelations of their Lord and that they are bound to meet Him. Hence all their deeds have come to naught and We shall assign no weight to them on the Day of Resurrection.

ayahs.text: Hell is their recompense for disbelieving and their taking My revelations and My Messengers as objects of jest.
ayahs.translation: Hell is their recompense for disbelieving and their taking My revelations and My Messengers as objects of jest.

ayahs.text: As for those who believe and do good works the Gardens of Paradise shall be there to welcome them;
ayahs.translation: As for those who believe and do good works the Gardens of Paradise shall be there to welcome them;

ayahs.text: there they will abide for ever with no desire to be removed from there.""
ayahs.translation: there they will abide for ever with no desire to be removed from there.""

ayahs.text: Say: ""If the sea were to become ink to record the Words of my Lord indeed the sea would be all used up before the Words of my Lord are exhausted and it would be the same even if We were to bring an equal amount of ink.""
ayahs.translation: Say: ""If the sea were to become ink to record the Words of my Lord indeed the sea would be all used up before the Words of my Lord are exhausted and it would be the same even if We were to bring an equal amount of ink.""

ayahs.text: Say (O Muhammad): ""I am no more than a human being like you; one to whom revelation is made: ''Your Lord is the One and Only God.'' Hence whoever looks forward to meet his Lord let him do righteous works and let him associate none with the worship of his Lord.""
ayahs.translation: Say (O Muhammad): ""I am no more than a human being like you; one to whom revelation is made: ''Your Lord is the One and Only God.'' Hence whoever looks forward to meet his Lord let him do righteous works and let him associate none with the worship of his Lord.""

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Kaf. Ha''. Ya''.  Ayn. Sad.
verses.translation: Kaf. Ha''. Ya''.  Ayn. Sad.

verses.text: This is an account of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zechariah
verses.translation: This is an account of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zechariah

verses.text: when he cried to his Lord in secret.
verses.translation: when he cried to his Lord in secret.

verses.text: He said: ""Lord! My bones have grown feeble and my head is glistening with age; yet never have my prayers to You my Lord been unfruitful.
verses.translation: He said: ""Lord! My bones have grown feeble and my head is glistening with age; yet never have my prayers to You my Lord been unfruitful.

verses.text: I fear evil from my kinsmen after I am gone; and my wife is barren so grant me an heir out of Your special grace
verses.translation: I fear evil from my kinsmen after I am gone; and my wife is barren so grant me an heir out of Your special grace

verses.text: one that might be my heir and the heir of the house of Jacob; and make him Lord one that will be pleasing to You.
verses.translation: one that might be my heir and the heir of the house of Jacob; and make him Lord one that will be pleasing to You.

verses.text: (He was told): ""Zechariah We bring you the good news of the birth of a son whose name shall be Yahya (John) one whose namesake We never created before.""
verses.translation: (He was told): ""Zechariah We bring you the good news of the birth of a son whose name shall be Yahya (John) one whose namesake We never created before.""

verses.text: He said: ""My Lord! How can I have a boy when my wife is barren and I have reached an extremely old age?""
verses.translation: He said: ""My Lord! How can I have a boy when my wife is barren and I have reached an extremely old age?""

verses.text: He answered: ""So shall it be."" Your Lord says: ""It is easy for Me  and then added: ""For beyond doubt I created you earlier when you were nothing.""
verses.translation: He answered: ""So shall it be."" Your Lord says: ""It is easy for Me  and then added: ""For beyond doubt I created you earlier when you were nothing.""

verses.text: Zechariah said: ""Lord grant me a Sign."" Said He: ""Your Sign is that you shall not be able to speak to people for three nights though you will be otherwise sound.""
verses.translation: Zechariah said: ""Lord grant me a Sign."" Said He: ""Your Sign is that you shall not be able to speak to people for three nights though you will be otherwise sound.""

verses.text: Thereupon Zechariah came out from the sanctuary and directed his people by gestures to extol His glory by day and by night.
verses.translation: Thereupon Zechariah came out from the sanctuary and directed his people by gestures to extol His glory by day and by night.

verses.text: O John! Hold the Book with all your strength."" We had bestowed wisdom upon him while he was still a child;
verses.translation: O John! Hold the Book with all your strength."" We had bestowed wisdom upon him while he was still a child;

verses.text: and We also endowed him with tenderness and purity and he was exceedingly pious
verses.translation: and We also endowed him with tenderness and purity and he was exceedingly pious

verses.text: and cherishing to his parents. Never was he insolent or rebellious.
verses.translation: and cherishing to his parents. Never was he insolent or rebellious.

verses.text: Peace be upon him the day he was born and the day he will die and the day he will be raised up alive.
verses.translation: Peace be upon him the day he was born and the day he will die and the day he will be raised up alive.

verses.text: (O Muhammad) recite in the Book the account of Mary when she withdrew from her people to a place towards the east;
verses.translation: (O Muhammad) recite in the Book the account of Mary when she withdrew from her people to a place towards the east;

verses.text: and drew a curtain screening herself from people whereupon We sent to her Our spirit and he appeared to her as a well-shaped man.
verses.translation: and drew a curtain screening herself from people whereupon We sent to her Our spirit and he appeared to her as a well-shaped man.

verses.text: Mary exclaimed: ""I surely take refuge from you with the Most Compassionate Lord if you are at all God-fearing.""
verses.translation: Mary exclaimed: ""I surely take refuge from you with the Most Compassionate Lord if you are at all God-fearing.""

verses.text: He said: ""I am just a message-bearer of your Lord I have come to grant you a most pure boy.""
verses.translation: He said: ""I am just a message-bearer of your Lord I have come to grant you a most pure boy.""

verses.text: Mary said: ""How can a boy be born to me when no man has even touched me nor have I ever been unchaste?""
verses.translation: Mary said: ""How can a boy be born to me when no man has even touched me nor have I ever been unchaste?""

verses.text: The angel said: ""Thus shall it be. Your Lord says: ''It is easy for Me; and We shall do so in order to make him a Sign for mankind and a mercy from Us. This has been decreed.'' ""
verses.translation: The angel said: ""Thus shall it be. Your Lord says: ''It is easy for Me; and We shall do so in order to make him a Sign for mankind and a mercy from Us. This has been decreed.'' ""

verses.text: Then she conceived him and withdrew with him to a far-off place.
verses.translation: Then she conceived him and withdrew with him to a far-off place.

verses.text: Then the birth pangs drove her to the trunk of a palm-tree and she said: ""Oh would that I had died before this and had been all forgotten.""
verses.translation: Then the birth pangs drove her to the trunk of a palm-tree and she said: ""Oh would that I had died before this and had been all forgotten.""

verses.text: Thereupon the angel below her cried out: ""Grieve not for your Lord has caused a stream of water to flow beneath you.
verses.translation: Thereupon the angel below her cried out: ""Grieve not for your Lord has caused a stream of water to flow beneath you.

verses.text: Shake the trunk of the palm-tree towards yourself and fresh and ripe dates shall fall upon you.
verses.translation: Shake the trunk of the palm-tree towards yourself and fresh and ripe dates shall fall upon you.

verses.text: So eat and drink and cool your eyes; and if you see any person say to him: ''Verily I have vowed a fast to the Most Compassionate Lord and so I shall not speak to anyone today.'' ""
verses.translation: So eat and drink and cool your eyes; and if you see any person say to him: ''Verily I have vowed a fast to the Most Compassionate Lord and so I shall not speak to anyone today.'' ""

verses.text: Then she came to her people carrying her baby. They said: ""O Mary! You have committed a monstrous thing.
verses.translation: Then she came to her people carrying her baby. They said: ""O Mary! You have committed a monstrous thing.

verses.text: O sister of Aaron! Your father was not an evil man nor was your mother an unchaste woman.""
verses.translation: O sister of Aaron! Your father was not an evil man nor was your mother an unchaste woman.""

verses.text: Thereupon Mary pointed to the child. They exclaimed: ""How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a mere child?""
verses.translation: Thereupon Mary pointed to the child. They exclaimed: ""How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a mere child?""

verses.text: The child cried out: ""Verily I am Allah''s servant. He has granted me the Book and has made me a Prophet
verses.translation: The child cried out: ""Verily I am Allah''s servant. He has granted me the Book and has made me a Prophet

verses.text: and has blessed me wherever I might be and has enjoined upon me Prayer and Zakah (purifying alms) as long as I live;
verses.translation: and has blessed me wherever I might be and has enjoined upon me Prayer and Zakah (purifying alms) as long as I live;

verses.text: and has made me dutiful to my mother. He has not made me oppressive nor bereft of God''s blessings.
verses.translation: and has made me dutiful to my mother. He has not made me oppressive nor bereft of God''s blessings.

verses.text: Peace be upon me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I will be raised up alive.""
verses.translation: Peace be upon me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I will be raised up alive.""

verses.text: This is Jesus the son of Mary; and this is the truth about him concerning which they are in doubt.
verses.translation: This is Jesus the son of Mary; and this is the truth about him concerning which they are in doubt.

verses.text: It does not befit Allah to take for Himself a son. Glory be to Him! When He decrees a thing He only says: ""Be"" and it is.
verses.translation: It does not befit Allah to take for Himself a son. Glory be to Him! When He decrees a thing He only says: ""Be"" and it is.

verses.text: (Jesus had said): ""Indeed Allah is my Lord and your Lord so serve Him alone. This is the Straight Way.""
verses.translation: (Jesus had said): ""Indeed Allah is my Lord and your Lord so serve Him alone. This is the Straight Way.""

verses.text: But different parties began to dispute with one another. A dreadful woe awaits on that great Day for those that reject the Truth.
verses.translation: But different parties began to dispute with one another. A dreadful woe awaits on that great Day for those that reject the Truth.

verses.text: How well shall they hear and how well shall they see on the Day they come to Us! But today the evil-doers are in manifest error.
verses.translation: How well shall they hear and how well shall they see on the Day they come to Us! But today the evil-doers are in manifest error.

verses.text: (O Muhammad) warn those who are steeped in heedlessness and are obstinately rejecting the truth that the Day shall come when things will be finally decided and they shall be left with utter remorse.
verses.translation: (O Muhammad) warn those who are steeped in heedlessness and are obstinately rejecting the truth that the Day shall come when things will be finally decided and they shall be left with utter remorse.

verses.text: Ultimately We shall inherit the earth and whatever is on it; to Us shall they be returned.
verses.translation: Ultimately We shall inherit the earth and whatever is on it; to Us shall they be returned.

verses.text: (O Muhammad) recite in the Book the account of Abraham. Most surely he was a man of truth a Prophet.
verses.translation: (O Muhammad) recite in the Book the account of Abraham. Most surely he was a man of truth a Prophet.

verses.text: (And remind people) when he said to his father: ""Father! Why do you worship that which neither sees nor hears and which can be of no avail to you?
verses.translation: (And remind people) when he said to his father: ""Father! Why do you worship that which neither sees nor hears and which can be of no avail to you?

verses.text: Father a knowledge that has not reached you has come to me. So follow me that I may guide you to a Straight Way.
verses.translation: Father a knowledge that has not reached you has come to me. So follow me that I may guide you to a Straight Way.

verses.text: Father do not serve Satan for Satan has indeed been a persistent rebel against the Most Compassionate Lord.
verses.translation: Father do not serve Satan for Satan has indeed been a persistent rebel against the Most Compassionate Lord.

verses.text: Father I fear that a punishment from the Most Compassionate Lord might strike you and you may end up as one of Satan''s companions?""
verses.translation: Father I fear that a punishment from the Most Compassionate Lord might strike you and you may end up as one of Satan''s companions?""

verses.text: The father said: ""Abraham have you turned away from my gods? If you do not give this up I shall stone you to death. Now begone from me forever.""
verses.translation: The father said: ""Abraham have you turned away from my gods? If you do not give this up I shall stone you to death. Now begone from me forever.""

verses.text: Abraham answered: ""Peace be upon you. I shall seek pardon for you from my Lord. My Lord has always been kind to Me.
verses.translation: Abraham answered: ""Peace be upon you. I shall seek pardon for you from my Lord. My Lord has always been kind to Me.

verses.text: I shall withdraw from you and all that you call upon beside Allah. I shall only call upon my Lord. I trust the prayer to my Lord will not go unanswered.""
verses.translation: I shall withdraw from you and all that you call upon beside Allah. I shall only call upon my Lord. I trust the prayer to my Lord will not go unanswered.""

verses.text: Thereupon Abraham dissociated himself from his people and the deities they worshipped instead of Allah and We bestowed upon him Isaac and Jacob and made each of them a Prophet;
verses.translation: Thereupon Abraham dissociated himself from his people and the deities they worshipped instead of Allah and We bestowed upon him Isaac and Jacob and made each of them a Prophet;

verses.text: and We bestowed on them Our mercy and granted them a truly lofty renown.
verses.translation: and We bestowed on them Our mercy and granted them a truly lofty renown.

verses.text: And recite in the Book the account of Moses. He was a chosen one a Messenger a Prophet.
verses.translation: And recite in the Book the account of Moses. He was a chosen one a Messenger a Prophet.

verses.text: We called out to him from the right side of the Mount and We drew him near to Us by communing to him in secret
verses.translation: We called out to him from the right side of the Mount and We drew him near to Us by communing to him in secret

verses.text: and out of Our mercy We appointed his brother Aaron a Prophet (that he may assist him).
verses.translation: and out of Our mercy We appointed his brother Aaron a Prophet (that he may assist him).

verses.text: And recite in the Book the account of Ishmael. He was ever true to his promise and was a Messenger a Prophet.
verses.translation: And recite in the Book the account of Ishmael. He was ever true to his promise and was a Messenger a Prophet.

verses.text: He enjoined his household to observe Prayer and to give Zakah (purifying alms); and his Lord was well pleased with him.
verses.translation: He enjoined his household to observe Prayer and to give Zakah (purifying alms); and his Lord was well pleased with him.

verses.text: And recite in the Book the account of Idris. He was a man of truth a Prophet;
verses.translation: And recite in the Book the account of Idris. He was a man of truth a Prophet;

verses.text: and We exalted him to a lofty position.
verses.translation: and We exalted him to a lofty position.

verses.text: These are the Prophets upon whom Allah bestowed His favour from the seed of Adam and from the seed of those whom We carried (in the Ark) with Noah and from the seed of Abraham and Israel. They were those whom We guided and chose (for an exalted position). They were such that when the words of the Most Compassionate Lord were recited to them they fell down in prostration weeping.
verses.translation: These are the Prophets upon whom Allah bestowed His favour from the seed of Adam and from the seed of those whom We carried (in the Ark) with Noah and from the seed of Abraham and Israel. They were those whom We guided and chose (for an exalted position). They were such that when the words of the Most Compassionate Lord were recited to them they fell down in prostration weeping.

verses.text: They were succeeded by a people who neglected the Prayers and pursued their lusts. They shall presently meet with their doom
verses.translation: They were succeeded by a people who neglected the Prayers and pursued their lusts. They shall presently meet with their doom

verses.text: except those who repent and believe and act righteously. Such shall enter Paradise and shall not be wronged at all.
verses.translation: except those who repent and believe and act righteously. Such shall enter Paradise and shall not be wronged at all.

verses.text: Theirs shall be everlasting Gardens which the Most Compassionate Lord has promised His servants in a realm which is beyond the ken of perception. Surely His promise shall be fulfilled.
verses.translation: Theirs shall be everlasting Gardens which the Most Compassionate Lord has promised His servants in a realm which is beyond the ken of perception. Surely His promise shall be fulfilled.

verses.text: They shall not hear in it anything vain; they shall hear only what is good; and they shall have their provision in it morning and evening.
verses.translation: They shall not hear in it anything vain; they shall hear only what is good; and they shall have their provision in it morning and evening.

verses.text: Such is the Paradise which We shall cause those of Our servants who have been God-fearing to inherit.
verses.translation: Such is the Paradise which We shall cause those of Our servants who have been God-fearing to inherit.

verses.text: (The angels will say): ""(O Muhammad!) We descend not except by the command of your Lord. To Him belongs all that is before us and all that is behind us and all that is in-between. Your Lord is not forgetful in the least.
verses.translation: (The angels will say): ""(O Muhammad!) We descend not except by the command of your Lord. To Him belongs all that is before us and all that is behind us and all that is in-between. Your Lord is not forgetful in the least.

verses.text: He is the Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is in-between. Serve Him then and be constant in serving Him. Do you know anyone that might be His compeer?""
verses.translation: He is the Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is in-between. Serve Him then and be constant in serving Him. Do you know anyone that might be His compeer?""

verses.text: Man is prone to say: ""Shall I be raised to life after I die?""
verses.translation: Man is prone to say: ""Shall I be raised to life after I die?""

verses.text: Does man not remember that We created him before when he was nothing?
verses.translation: Does man not remember that We created him before when he was nothing?

verses.text: By your Lord We will surely muster them and the devils together. Then We will surely bring them all on their knees around Hell
verses.translation: By your Lord We will surely muster them and the devils together. Then We will surely bring them all on their knees around Hell

verses.text: and then We will draw aside from each party those who were most rebellious against the Most Compassionate Lord
verses.translation: and then We will draw aside from each party those who were most rebellious against the Most Compassionate Lord

verses.text: and then We shall know well all those most worthy to be cast in Hell.
verses.translation: and then We shall know well all those most worthy to be cast in Hell.

verses.text: There is not one of you but shall pass by Hell. This is a decree which your Lord will fulfil.
verses.translation: There is not one of you but shall pass by Hell. This is a decree which your Lord will fulfil.

verses.text: Then We shall deliver those that feared Allah and leave the wrong-doers there on their knees.
verses.translation: Then We shall deliver those that feared Allah and leave the wrong-doers there on their knees.

verses.text: When Our clear revelations are recited to those who deny the Truth they are wont to say to those who have faith: ""Which of the two groups has a better status and whose assemblies are grander?""
verses.translation: When Our clear revelations are recited to those who deny the Truth they are wont to say to those who have faith: ""Which of the two groups has a better status and whose assemblies are grander?""

verses.text: How numerous are the peoples We destroyed before them - those that were more resourceful and grander in outward appearance!
verses.translation: How numerous are the peoples We destroyed before them - those that were more resourceful and grander in outward appearance!

verses.text: Say: ""The Most Compassionate Lord grants respite to those who stray into error until they behold what they had been threatened with either God''s chastisement (in the world) or the Hour (of Resurrection)"" - then they fully know whose station is worse and who is weaker in hosts!
verses.translation: Say: ""The Most Compassionate Lord grants respite to those who stray into error until they behold what they had been threatened with either God''s chastisement (in the world) or the Hour (of Resurrection)"" - then they fully know whose station is worse and who is weaker in hosts!

verses.text: (On the contrary) Allah increases in guidance those who follow the Right Way. Lasting acts of righteousness are better in the sight of your Lord as reward and conducive to a better end.
verses.translation: (On the contrary) Allah increases in guidance those who follow the Right Way. Lasting acts of righteousness are better in the sight of your Lord as reward and conducive to a better end.

verses.text: Have you seen him who rejected Our signs and said: ""Surely I shall continue to be favoured with riches and children.""
verses.translation: Have you seen him who rejected Our signs and said: ""Surely I shall continue to be favoured with riches and children.""

verses.text: Has he obtained knowledge of the Unseen or has he taken a covenant with the Most Compassionate Lord?
verses.translation: Has he obtained knowledge of the Unseen or has he taken a covenant with the Most Compassionate Lord?

verses.text: By no means! We shall write down all what he says; and We shall greatly prolong his chastisement
verses.translation: By no means! We shall write down all what he says; and We shall greatly prolong his chastisement

verses.text: and We shall inherit all the resources and hosts of which he boasts and he will come to Us all alone.
verses.translation: and We shall inherit all the resources and hosts of which he boasts and he will come to Us all alone.

verses.text: They have taken other gods instead of Allah that they may be a source of strength for them.
verses.translation: They have taken other gods instead of Allah that they may be a source of strength for them.

verses.text: By no means! They shall soon deny their worship and shall become their adversaries instead.
verses.translation: By no means! They shall soon deny their worship and shall become their adversaries instead.

verses.text: Do you not see that We have sent devils upon the unbelievers who greatly incite them (to oppose the Truth)?
verses.translation: Do you not see that We have sent devils upon the unbelievers who greatly incite them (to oppose the Truth)?

verses.text: Therefore do not hasten (in seeking a scourge against them). We are counting their days.
verses.translation: Therefore do not hasten (in seeking a scourge against them). We are counting their days.

verses.text: The Day shall soon come when We shall bring together the God-fearing to the Most Compassionate Lord as honoured guests;
verses.translation: The Day shall soon come when We shall bring together the God-fearing to the Most Compassionate Lord as honoured guests;

verses.text: and We shall drive the guilty ones to Hell as a thirsty herd.
verses.translation: and We shall drive the guilty ones to Hell as a thirsty herd.

verses.text: On that Day none will have the power to intercede for them except those who received a sanction from the Most Compassionate Lord.
verses.translation: On that Day none will have the power to intercede for them except those who received a sanction from the Most Compassionate Lord.

verses.text: They claim: ""The Most Compassionate Lord has taken a son to Himself.""
verses.translation: They claim: ""The Most Compassionate Lord has taken a son to Himself.""

verses.text: Surely you have made a monstrous statement.
verses.translation: Surely you have made a monstrous statement.

verses.text: It is such a monstrosity that heavens might well-nigh burst forth at it the earth might be cleaved and the mountains fall
verses.translation: It is such a monstrosity that heavens might well-nigh burst forth at it the earth might be cleaved and the mountains fall

verses.text: at their ascribing a son to the Most Compassionate Lord.
verses.translation: at their ascribing a son to the Most Compassionate Lord.

verses.text: It does not befit the Most Compassionate Lord that He should take a son.
verses.translation: It does not befit the Most Compassionate Lord that He should take a son.

verses.text: There is no one in the heavens and the earth but he shall come to the Most Compassionate Lord as His servant.
verses.translation: There is no one in the heavens and the earth but he shall come to the Most Compassionate Lord as His servant.

verses.text: Verily He encompasses them and has counted them all.
verses.translation: Verily He encompasses them and has counted them all.

verses.text: On the Day of Resurrection each one of these will come to Him singly.
verses.translation: On the Day of Resurrection each one of these will come to Him singly.

verses.text: Indeed the Most Compassionate Lord will soon create enduring love for those who believe and do righteous works.
verses.translation: Indeed the Most Compassionate Lord will soon create enduring love for those who believe and do righteous works.

verses.text: Therefore We have revealed the Qur''an in your tongue and made it easy to understand that you may give glad tidings to the God-fearing and warn a contentious people.
verses.translation: Therefore We have revealed the Qur''an in your tongue and made it easy to understand that you may give glad tidings to the God-fearing and warn a contentious people.

verses.text: How numerous are the peoples that We destroyed before them! Do you now perceive any one of them or hear even their whisper?
verses.translation: How numerous are the peoples that We destroyed before them! Do you now perceive any one of them or hear even their whisper?

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: Kaf. Ha''. Ya''.  Ayn. Sad.
ayahs.translation: Kaf. Ha''. Ya''.  Ayn. Sad.

ayahs.text: This is an account of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zechariah
ayahs.translation: This is an account of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zechariah

ayahs.text: when he cried to his Lord in secret.
ayahs.translation: when he cried to his Lord in secret.

ayahs.text: He said: ""Lord! My bones have grown feeble and my head is glistening with age; yet never have my prayers to You my Lord been unfruitful.
ayahs.translation: He said: ""Lord! My bones have grown feeble and my head is glistening with age; yet never have my prayers to You my Lord been unfruitful.

ayahs.text: I fear evil from my kinsmen after I am gone; and my wife is barren so grant me an heir out of Your special grace
ayahs.translation: I fear evil from my kinsmen after I am gone; and my wife is barren so grant me an heir out of Your special grace

ayahs.text: one that might be my heir and the heir of the house of Jacob; and make him Lord one that will be pleasing to You.
ayahs.translation: one that might be my heir and the heir of the house of Jacob; and make him Lord one that will be pleasing to You.

ayahs.text: (He was told): ""Zechariah We bring you the good news of the birth of a son whose name shall be Yahya (John) one whose namesake We never created before.""
ayahs.translation: (He was told): ""Zechariah We bring you the good news of the birth of a son whose name shall be Yahya (John) one whose namesake We never created before.""

ayahs.text: He said: ""My Lord! How can I have a boy when my wife is barren and I have reached an extremely old age?""
ayahs.translation: He said: ""My Lord! How can I have a boy when my wife is barren and I have reached an extremely old age?""

ayahs.text: He answered: ""So shall it be."" Your Lord says: ""It is easy for Me  and then added: ""For beyond doubt I created you earlier when you were nothing.""
ayahs.translation: He answered: ""So shall it be."" Your Lord says: ""It is easy for Me  and then added: ""For beyond doubt I created you earlier when you were nothing.""

ayahs.text: Zechariah said: ""Lord grant me a Sign."" Said He: ""Your Sign is that you shall not be able to speak to people for three nights though you will be otherwise sound.""
