ayahs.text: They answered: ""We did not break our promise with you out of our own volition; but we were laden with the load of people''s ornaments and we simply threw them down (into the fire) and the Samiri also threw down something
ayahs.translation: They answered: ""We did not break our promise with you out of our own volition; but we were laden with the load of people''s ornaments and we simply threw them down (into the fire) and the Samiri also threw down something

ayahs.text: and brought out of there (from the molten gold) the effigy of a calf that lowed."" The people cried out: ""This is your deity and the deity of Moses whom Moses has forgotten.""
ayahs.translation: and brought out of there (from the molten gold) the effigy of a calf that lowed."" The people cried out: ""This is your deity and the deity of Moses whom Moses has forgotten.""

ayahs.text: Did they not see that it did not return a word to them and had no power either to hurt them or to cause them any benefit?
ayahs.translation: Did they not see that it did not return a word to them and had no power either to hurt them or to cause them any benefit?

ayahs.text: Certainly Aaron had said to them even before (the return of Moses): ""My people you were fallen into error because of the calf. Surely your Lord is Most Compassionate; so follow me and obey my command.""
ayahs.translation: Certainly Aaron had said to them even before (the return of Moses): ""My people you were fallen into error because of the calf. Surely your Lord is Most Compassionate; so follow me and obey my command.""

ayahs.text: But they answered: ""By no means shall we cease to worship it until Moses returns to us.""
ayahs.translation: But they answered: ""By no means shall we cease to worship it until Moses returns to us.""

ayahs.text: (After rebuking his people) Moses turned to Aaron and said: ""Aaron! What prevented you when you saw them going astray
ayahs.translation: (After rebuking his people) Moses turned to Aaron and said: ""Aaron! What prevented you when you saw them going astray

ayahs.text: from following my way? Have you disobeyed my command?""
ayahs.translation: from following my way? Have you disobeyed my command?""

ayahs.text: Aaron answered: ""Son of my mother! Do not seize me with my beard nor by (the hair of) my head. I feared that on returning you might say: ''You sowed discord among the Children of Israel and did not pay heed to my words.''""
ayahs.translation: Aaron answered: ""Son of my mother! Do not seize me with my beard nor by (the hair of) my head. I feared that on returning you might say: ''You sowed discord among the Children of Israel and did not pay heed to my words.''""

ayahs.text: Moses said: ""What then is your case O Samiri?""
ayahs.translation: Moses said: ""What then is your case O Samiri?""

ayahs.text: He answered: ""I saw what the people did not see. So I took a handful of dust from the trail of the Messenger and I flung it (into the fire). Thus did my mind prompt me.""
ayahs.translation: He answered: ""I saw what the people did not see. So I took a handful of dust from the trail of the Messenger and I flung it (into the fire). Thus did my mind prompt me.""

ayahs.text: Moses said: ""Be gone then. All your life you shall cry: ''Untouchable.'' There awaits a term for your reckoning that you cannot fail to keep. Now look at your god that you devotedly adored: We shall burn it and scatter its remains in the sea.
ayahs.translation: Moses said: ""Be gone then. All your life you shall cry: ''Untouchable.'' There awaits a term for your reckoning that you cannot fail to keep. Now look at your god that you devotedly adored: We shall burn it and scatter its remains in the sea.

ayahs.text: Your God is none else than Allah beside Whom there is no god. His knowledge embraces everything.""
ayahs.translation: Your God is none else than Allah beside Whom there is no god. His knowledge embraces everything.""

ayahs.text: (O Muhammad) thus do We recount to you the events of the past and We have bestowed upon you from Ourself an admonition.
ayahs.translation: (O Muhammad) thus do We recount to you the events of the past and We have bestowed upon you from Ourself an admonition.

ayahs.text: He who turns away from it will surely bear a heavy burden on the Day of Resurrection
ayahs.translation: He who turns away from it will surely bear a heavy burden on the Day of Resurrection

ayahs.text: and will abide under this burden for ever. Grievous shall be the burden on the Day of Resurrection
ayahs.translation: and will abide under this burden for ever. Grievous shall be the burden on the Day of Resurrection

ayahs.text: the Day when the Trumpet shall be sounded and We shall muster the sinners their eyes turned blue with terror.
ayahs.translation: the Day when the Trumpet shall be sounded and We shall muster the sinners their eyes turned blue with terror.

ayahs.text: They shall whisper among themselves: ""You stayed on the earth barely ten days.""
ayahs.translation: They shall whisper among themselves: ""You stayed on the earth barely ten days.""

ayahs.text: We know well what they will say to one another: We also know that even the most cautious in his estimate will say: ""You lived in the world no more than a day.""
ayahs.translation: We know well what they will say to one another: We also know that even the most cautious in his estimate will say: ""You lived in the world no more than a day.""

ayahs.text: They ask you concerning the mountains: ""Where will they go?"" Say: ""My Lord will scatter them like dust
ayahs.translation: They ask you concerning the mountains: ""Where will they go?"" Say: ""My Lord will scatter them like dust

ayahs.text: and leave the earth a levelled plain
ayahs.translation: and leave the earth a levelled plain

ayahs.text: in which you shall find no crookedness or curvature.
ayahs.translation: in which you shall find no crookedness or curvature.

ayahs.text: On that Day people shall follow straight on to the call of the summoner no one daring to show any haughtiness. Their voices shall be hushed before the Most Compassionate Lord so that you will hear nothing but a whispering murmur.
ayahs.translation: On that Day people shall follow straight on to the call of the summoner no one daring to show any haughtiness. Their voices shall be hushed before the Most Compassionate Lord so that you will hear nothing but a whispering murmur.

ayahs.text: On that Day intercession shall not avail save of him whom the Most Compassionate Lord permits and whose word of intercession is pleasing to Him.
ayahs.translation: On that Day intercession shall not avail save of him whom the Most Compassionate Lord permits and whose word of intercession is pleasing to Him.

ayahs.text: He knows all that is ahead of them and all that is behind them while the others do not know.
ayahs.translation: He knows all that is ahead of them and all that is behind them while the others do not know.

ayahs.text: All faces shall be humbled before the Ever-Living the Self-Subsisting Lord and he who bears the burden of iniquity will have failed;
ayahs.translation: All faces shall be humbled before the Ever-Living the Self-Subsisting Lord and he who bears the burden of iniquity will have failed;

ayahs.text: but whosoever does righteous works being a believer shall have no fear of suffering wrong or loss.""
ayahs.translation: but whosoever does righteous works being a believer shall have no fear of suffering wrong or loss.""

ayahs.text: (O Muhammad) thus have We revealed this as an Arabic Qur''an and have expounded in it warning in diverse ways so that they may avoid evil or become heedful.
ayahs.translation: (O Muhammad) thus have We revealed this as an Arabic Qur''an and have expounded in it warning in diverse ways so that they may avoid evil or become heedful.

ayahs.text: Exalted is Allah the True King! Hasten not with reciting the Qur''an before its revelation to you is finished and pray: ""Lord! Increase me in knowledge.""
ayahs.translation: Exalted is Allah the True King! Hasten not with reciting the Qur''an before its revelation to you is finished and pray: ""Lord! Increase me in knowledge.""

ayahs.text: Most certainly We had given Adam a command before but he forgot. We found him lacking in firmness of resolution.
ayahs.translation: Most certainly We had given Adam a command before but he forgot. We found him lacking in firmness of resolution.

ayahs.text: Recall when We said to the angels: ""Prostrate yourselves before Adam""; all prostrated themselves save Iblis. He refused.
ayahs.translation: Recall when We said to the angels: ""Prostrate yourselves before Adam""; all prostrated themselves save Iblis. He refused.

ayahs.text: Then We said: ""Adam! He is an enemy to you and to your wife. So let him not drive both of you out of Paradise and plunge you into affliction
ayahs.translation: Then We said: ""Adam! He is an enemy to you and to your wife. So let him not drive both of you out of Paradise and plunge you into affliction

ayahs.text: (for in Paradise) neither are you hungry nor naked
ayahs.translation: (for in Paradise) neither are you hungry nor naked

ayahs.text: nor face thirst or scorching heat.""
ayahs.translation: nor face thirst or scorching heat.""

ayahs.text: But Satan seduced him saying: ""Adam! Shall I direct you to a tree of eternal life and an abiding kingdom?""
ayahs.translation: But Satan seduced him saying: ""Adam! Shall I direct you to a tree of eternal life and an abiding kingdom?""

ayahs.text: Then the two of them ate the fruit of that tree and their shameful parts became revealed to each other and they began to cover themselves with the leaves from the Garden. Thus Adam disobeyed his Lord and strayed into error.
ayahs.translation: Then the two of them ate the fruit of that tree and their shameful parts became revealed to each other and they began to cover themselves with the leaves from the Garden. Thus Adam disobeyed his Lord and strayed into error.

ayahs.text: Thereafter his Lord exalted him accepted his repentance and bestowed guidance upon him
ayahs.translation: Thereafter his Lord exalted him accepted his repentance and bestowed guidance upon him

ayahs.text: and said: ""Get down both of you (that is man and Satan) and be out of it; each of you shall be an enemy to the other. Henceforth if there comes to you a guidance from Me then whosoever follows My guidance shall neither go astray nor suffer misery.
ayahs.translation: and said: ""Get down both of you (that is man and Satan) and be out of it; each of you shall be an enemy to the other. Henceforth if there comes to you a guidance from Me then whosoever follows My guidance shall neither go astray nor suffer misery.

ayahs.text: But whosoever turns away from this Admonition from Me shall have a straitened life; We shall raise him blind on the Day of Resurrection
ayahs.translation: But whosoever turns away from this Admonition from Me shall have a straitened life; We shall raise him blind on the Day of Resurrection

ayahs.text: whereupon he will say: ""Lord! Why have You raised me blind when I had sight in the world?""
ayahs.translation: whereupon he will say: ""Lord! Why have You raised me blind when I had sight in the world?""

ayahs.text: He will say: ""Even so it is. Our Signs came to you and you ignored them. So shall you be ignored this Day.""
ayahs.translation: He will say: ""Even so it is. Our Signs came to you and you ignored them. So shall you be ignored this Day.""

ayahs.text: Thus do We requite him who transgresses and does not believe in the signs of your Lord (during the life of the world); and surely the punishment of the Hereafter is even more terrible and more enduring.
ayahs.translation: Thus do We requite him who transgresses and does not believe in the signs of your Lord (during the life of the world); and surely the punishment of the Hereafter is even more terrible and more enduring.

ayahs.text: Did they not find any guidance in the fact that We destroyed many nations in whose ruined dwelling-places they now walk about? Surely there are many Signs in them for people endowed with wisdom.
ayahs.translation: Did they not find any guidance in the fact that We destroyed many nations in whose ruined dwelling-places they now walk about? Surely there are many Signs in them for people endowed with wisdom.

ayahs.text: Were it not for a word already gone from your Lord the decree (of their destruction) would have come to pass.
ayahs.translation: Were it not for a word already gone from your Lord the decree (of their destruction) would have come to pass.

ayahs.text: So bear patiently with what they say. Glorify your Lord praising Him before sunrise and before sunset and in the watches of the night and glorify Him and at the ends of the day that you may attain to happiness.
ayahs.translation: So bear patiently with what they say. Glorify your Lord praising Him before sunrise and before sunset and in the watches of the night and glorify Him and at the ends of the day that you may attain to happiness.

ayahs.text: Do not turn your eyes covetously towards the embellishments of worldly life that We have bestowed upon various kinds of people to test them. But the clean provision bestowed upon you by your Lord is better and more enduring.
ayahs.translation: Do not turn your eyes covetously towards the embellishments of worldly life that We have bestowed upon various kinds of people to test them. But the clean provision bestowed upon you by your Lord is better and more enduring.

ayahs.text: Enjoin Prayer on your household and do keep observing it. We do not ask you for any worldly provision; rather it is We Who provide you and ultimately the pious will end up the best.
ayahs.translation: Enjoin Prayer on your household and do keep observing it. We do not ask you for any worldly provision; rather it is We Who provide you and ultimately the pious will end up the best.

ayahs.text: They ask: ""Why does he not bring us a (miraculous) sign from his Lord?"" Has there not come to them a Book containing the teachings of the previous scriptures?
ayahs.translation: They ask: ""Why does he not bring us a (miraculous) sign from his Lord?"" Has there not come to them a Book containing the teachings of the previous scriptures?

ayahs.text: Had We destroyed them through some calamity before his coming they would have said: ""Our Lord! Why did You not send any Messenger to us that we might have followed Your signs before being humbled and disgraced?""
ayahs.translation: Had We destroyed them through some calamity before his coming they would have said: ""Our Lord! Why did You not send any Messenger to us that we might have followed Your signs before being humbled and disgraced?""

ayahs.text: Tell them (O Muhammad): ""Everyone is waiting for his end. Wait then and you will soon know who are the people of the Right Way and are rightly-guided.""
ayahs.translation: Tell them (O Muhammad): ""Everyone is waiting for his end. Wait then and you will soon know who are the people of the Right Way and are rightly-guided.""

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: The time of people''s reckoning has drawn near and yet they turn aside in heedlessness.
verses.translation: The time of people''s reckoning has drawn near and yet they turn aside in heedlessness.

verses.text: Whenever any fresh admonition comes to them from their Lord they barely heed it and remain immersed in play
verses.translation: Whenever any fresh admonition comes to them from their Lord they barely heed it and remain immersed in play

verses.text: their hearts being set on other concerns. The wrong-doers whisper to one another: ""This person is no more than a mortal like yourselves. Will you then be enchanted by sorcery while you see?""
verses.translation: their hearts being set on other concerns. The wrong-doers whisper to one another: ""This person is no more than a mortal like yourselves. Will you then be enchanted by sorcery while you see?""

verses.text: He said: ""My Lord knows well all that is spoken in the heavens and the earth. He is All-Hearing All- Knowing.""
verses.translation: He said: ""My Lord knows well all that is spoken in the heavens and the earth. He is All-Hearing All- Knowing.""

verses.text: They say: ""Nay these are confused dreams; nay he has forged it; nay he is a poet. So let him bring us a sign even as the Messengers of the past were sent with signs.""
verses.translation: They say: ""Nay these are confused dreams; nay he has forged it; nay he is a poet. So let him bring us a sign even as the Messengers of the past were sent with signs.""

verses.text: Not one township that We destroyed before them believed. Would they then believe?
verses.translation: Not one township that We destroyed before them believed. Would they then believe?

verses.text: (O Muhammad) even before you We never sent any other than human beings as Messengers and to them We sent revelation. Ask the People of the Book if you do not know.
verses.translation: (O Muhammad) even before you We never sent any other than human beings as Messengers and to them We sent revelation. Ask the People of the Book if you do not know.

verses.text: We did not endow the Messengers with bodies that would need no food; nor were they immortals.
verses.translation: We did not endow the Messengers with bodies that would need no food; nor were they immortals.

verses.text: Then We fulfilled the promise We had made to them: We rescued them and those whom We wished and We destroyed those who exceeded all bounds.
verses.translation: Then We fulfilled the promise We had made to them: We rescued them and those whom We wished and We destroyed those who exceeded all bounds.

verses.text: We have bestowed upon you a Book that mentions you. Do you not understand?
verses.translation: We have bestowed upon you a Book that mentions you. Do you not understand?

verses.text: How many a wrong-doing town did We shatter and then raise up another people.
verses.translation: How many a wrong-doing town did We shatter and then raise up another people.

verses.text: Then when they perceived Our chastisement they took to their heels and fled.
verses.translation: Then when they perceived Our chastisement they took to their heels and fled.

verses.text: (They were told): ""Flee not but return to your comforts and to your dwellings. You are likely to be questioned.""
verses.translation: (They were told): ""Flee not but return to your comforts and to your dwellings. You are likely to be questioned.""

verses.text: They said: ""Woe to us; surely we were wrong-doers.""
verses.translation: They said: ""Woe to us; surely we were wrong-doers.""

verses.text: They did not cease to cry this until We reduced them to stubble still and silent.
verses.translation: They did not cease to cry this until We reduced them to stubble still and silent.

verses.text: We did not create in sport the heavens and the earth and all that lies between the two.
verses.translation: We did not create in sport the heavens and the earth and all that lies between the two.

verses.text: Had it been Our will to find a pastime We would have found one near at hand; if at all We were inclined to do so.
verses.translation: Had it been Our will to find a pastime We would have found one near at hand; if at all We were inclined to do so.

verses.text: Nay We hurl the Truth at falsehood so that the Truth crushes falsehood and lo! it vanishes. Woe to you for what you utter!
verses.translation: Nay We hurl the Truth at falsehood so that the Truth crushes falsehood and lo! it vanishes. Woe to you for what you utter!

verses.text: To Him belongs whosoever dwells in the heavens and on earth. Those (angels) that are with Him neither disdain to serve Him out of pride nor do they weary of it.
verses.translation: To Him belongs whosoever dwells in the heavens and on earth. Those (angels) that are with Him neither disdain to serve Him out of pride nor do they weary of it.

verses.text: They glorify Him night and day without flagging.
verses.translation: They glorify Him night and day without flagging.

verses.text: Have they taken earthly gods who are such that they raise up the dead to life?
verses.translation: Have they taken earthly gods who are such that they raise up the dead to life?

verses.text: Had there been any gods in the heavens and the earth apart from Allah the order of both the heavens and the earth would have gone to ruins. Glory be to Allah the Lord of the Throne Who is far above their false descriptions of Him.
verses.translation: Had there been any gods in the heavens and the earth apart from Allah the order of both the heavens and the earth would have gone to ruins. Glory be to Allah the Lord of the Throne Who is far above their false descriptions of Him.

verses.text: None shall question Him about what He does but they shall be questioned.
verses.translation: None shall question Him about what He does but they shall be questioned.

verses.text: Have they taken gods other than Him? Say (O Muhammad): ""Bring forth your proof! Here is the Book with admonition for those of my time and there are also scriptures with admonition for people before me."" But most people do not know the Truth and have therefore turned away from it.
verses.translation: Have they taken gods other than Him? Say (O Muhammad): ""Bring forth your proof! Here is the Book with admonition for those of my time and there are also scriptures with admonition for people before me."" But most people do not know the Truth and have therefore turned away from it.

verses.text: Never did We send any Messenger before you to whom We did not reveal: ""There is no god but Me. So serve Me alone.""
verses.translation: Never did We send any Messenger before you to whom We did not reveal: ""There is no god but Me. So serve Me alone.""

verses.text: They say: ""The Most Compassionate Lord has taken to Himself a son."" Glory be to Him! Those whom they so designate are only His honoured servants.
verses.translation: They say: ""The Most Compassionate Lord has taken to Himself a son."" Glory be to Him! Those whom they so designate are only His honoured servants.

verses.text: They do not outstrip Him in speech and only act as He commands.
verses.translation: They do not outstrip Him in speech and only act as He commands.

verses.text: He knows whatever is before them and whatsoever is remote from them and they do not intercede except for him intercession on whose behalf pleases Him and they stand constantly in awe of Him.
verses.translation: He knows whatever is before them and whatsoever is remote from them and they do not intercede except for him intercession on whose behalf pleases Him and they stand constantly in awe of Him.

verses.text: And if anyone of them were to claim: ""Indeed I am a god apart from Him  We shall recompense him with Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrong-doers.
verses.translation: And if anyone of them were to claim: ""Indeed I am a god apart from Him  We shall recompense him with Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrong-doers.

verses.text: Did the unbelievers (who do not accept the teaching of the Prophet) not realize that the heavens and the earth were one solid mass then We tore them apart and We made every living being out of water? Will they then not believe (that We created all this)?
verses.translation: Did the unbelievers (who do not accept the teaching of the Prophet) not realize that the heavens and the earth were one solid mass then We tore them apart and We made every living being out of water? Will they then not believe (that We created all this)?

verses.text: And We placed firm mountains on earth lest it should sway with them and We made wide paths in them that they may find their way;
verses.translation: And We placed firm mountains on earth lest it should sway with them and We made wide paths in them that they may find their way;

verses.text: and We made the sky a secure canopy; and yet they turn away from these Signs.
verses.translation: and We made the sky a secure canopy; and yet they turn away from these Signs.

verses.text: It is He Who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon. Each of them is floating in its orbit.
verses.translation: It is He Who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon. Each of them is floating in its orbit.

verses.text: (O Muhammad) We did not grant everlasting life to any human being even before you. If you were to die will they live for ever?
verses.translation: (O Muhammad) We did not grant everlasting life to any human being even before you. If you were to die will they live for ever?

verses.text: Every living being shall taste death and We shall subject you to ill and good by way of trial and to Us shall all of you be eventually sent back.
verses.translation: Every living being shall taste death and We shall subject you to ill and good by way of trial and to Us shall all of you be eventually sent back.

verses.text: When the unbelievers see you they make you an object of fun saying: ""Is he the one who mentions your gods?"" They say so and yet they reject with disdain the very mention of the Most Compassionate Lord.
verses.translation: When the unbelievers see you they make you an object of fun saying: ""Is he the one who mentions your gods?"" They say so and yet they reject with disdain the very mention of the Most Compassionate Lord.

verses.text: Man is hasty by nature. I shall certainly show you My Signs. Do not ask Me to be hasty.
verses.translation: Man is hasty by nature. I shall certainly show you My Signs. Do not ask Me to be hasty.

verses.text: They say: ""(Tell us) when will the threat of punishment come to pass if you are truthful?""
verses.translation: They say: ""(Tell us) when will the threat of punishment come to pass if you are truthful?""

verses.text: If only the unbelievers knew of the Hour when they shall not be able to keep off the Fire from their faces nor from their backs; nor shall they be helped.
verses.translation: If only the unbelievers knew of the Hour when they shall not be able to keep off the Fire from their faces nor from their backs; nor shall they be helped.

verses.text: That will suddenly come upon them and stupefy them. They shall not be able to ward it off nor shall they be granted any respite.
verses.translation: That will suddenly come upon them and stupefy them. They shall not be able to ward it off nor shall they be granted any respite.

verses.text: Other Messengers before you were also mocked but those who scoffed at the Messengers were overtaken by the same scourge that they had scoffed at.
verses.translation: Other Messengers before you were also mocked but those who scoffed at the Messengers were overtaken by the same scourge that they had scoffed at.

verses.text: Tell them (O Muhammad): ""Who protects you during the night or the day from the Most Compassionate Lord?"" And yet they turn away from the Admonition of their Lord.
verses.translation: Tell them (O Muhammad): ""Who protects you during the night or the day from the Most Compassionate Lord?"" And yet they turn away from the Admonition of their Lord.

verses.text: Do they have any gods who would protect them against Us? They have no power even to help themselves; nor do they enjoy Our support.
verses.translation: Do they have any gods who would protect them against Us? They have no power even to help themselves; nor do they enjoy Our support.

verses.text: Nay We generously provided them and their fathers and they enjoyed Our provision for long. Do they not see that We are now advancing into their territory diminishing it from different sides? Is it they then who will triumph?""
verses.translation: Nay We generously provided them and their fathers and they enjoyed Our provision for long. Do they not see that We are now advancing into their territory diminishing it from different sides? Is it they then who will triumph?""

verses.text: Tell them: ""I only warn you by the Revelation."" But the deaf do not hear the cry when they are warned.
verses.translation: Tell them: ""I only warn you by the Revelation."" But the deaf do not hear the cry when they are warned.

verses.text: Were only the slightest whiff from your Lord''s punishment to touch them they would cry out: ""Woe to us; we were indeed wrong-doers.""
verses.translation: Were only the slightest whiff from your Lord''s punishment to touch them they would cry out: ""Woe to us; we were indeed wrong-doers.""

verses.text: We shall set up just scales on the Day of Resurrection so that none will be wronged in the least. (We shall bring forth the acts of everyone) even if it be the weight of a grain of mustard seed. We shall suffice as Reckoners.
verses.translation: We shall set up just scales on the Day of Resurrection so that none will be wronged in the least. (We shall bring forth the acts of everyone) even if it be the weight of a grain of mustard seed. We shall suffice as Reckoners.

verses.text: Surely We had granted to Moses and Aaron the Criterion (between right and wrong) and Light and Admonition for the good of the God-fearing
verses.translation: Surely We had granted to Moses and Aaron the Criterion (between right and wrong) and Light and Admonition for the good of the God-fearing

verses.text: for those who fear their Lord without seeing Him and dread the Hour (of Reckoning).
verses.translation: for those who fear their Lord without seeing Him and dread the Hour (of Reckoning).

verses.text: This is a Blessed Admonition that We have revealed. Are you then going to reject it?
verses.translation: This is a Blessed Admonition that We have revealed. Are you then going to reject it?

verses.text: Surely We had bestowed wisdom upon Abraham even earlier and We knew him well.
verses.translation: Surely We had bestowed wisdom upon Abraham even earlier and We knew him well.

verses.text: Recall when he said to his father and his people: ""What are these images to which you are devoutly clinging?""
verses.translation: Recall when he said to his father and his people: ""What are these images to which you are devoutly clinging?""

verses.text: They answered: ""We found our fathers worshipping them.""
verses.translation: They answered: ""We found our fathers worshipping them.""

verses.text: He said: ""Certainly you and your fathers have all been in manifest error.""
verses.translation: He said: ""Certainly you and your fathers have all been in manifest error.""

verses.text: They said: ""Are you expressing your true ideas before us or are you jesting?""
verses.translation: They said: ""Are you expressing your true ideas before us or are you jesting?""

verses.text: He said: ""Nay but your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth which He created and to that I bear witness before you.
verses.translation: He said: ""Nay but your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth which He created and to that I bear witness before you.

verses.text: By Allah I shall certainly carry out my plan against your gods after you are gone.""
verses.translation: By Allah I shall certainly carry out my plan against your gods after you are gone.""

verses.text: Then he broke them all into pieces sparing only the supreme one among them that they may possibly return to him.
verses.translation: Then he broke them all into pieces sparing only the supreme one among them that they may possibly return to him.

verses.text: (When they saw the idols in this state) they said: ""Who has done this to our gods? Surely he is one of the wrong-doers.""
verses.translation: (When they saw the idols in this state) they said: ""Who has done this to our gods? Surely he is one of the wrong-doers.""

verses.text: Some of them said: ""We heard a youth called Abraham speak (ill) of them.""
verses.translation: Some of them said: ""We heard a youth called Abraham speak (ill) of them.""

verses.text: The others said: ""Bring him then before the eyes of the people that they may see (what will be done to him).""
verses.translation: The others said: ""Bring him then before the eyes of the people that they may see (what will be done to him).""

verses.text: (On Abraham''s arrival) they said: ""Abraham are you he who has done this to our gods?""
verses.translation: (On Abraham''s arrival) they said: ""Abraham are you he who has done this to our gods?""

verses.text: He answered: ""Rather it was this supreme one who has done it. So ask them if they can speak.""
verses.translation: He answered: ""Rather it was this supreme one who has done it. So ask them if they can speak.""

verses.text: Thereupon they turned to their (inner) selves and said (to themselves): ""Surely it is you who are the wrong-doers.""
verses.translation: Thereupon they turned to their (inner) selves and said (to themselves): ""Surely it is you who are the wrong-doers.""

verses.text: Then their minds were turned upside down and they said: ""You know well that they do not speak.""
verses.translation: Then their minds were turned upside down and they said: ""You know well that they do not speak.""

verses.text: Abraham said: ""Do you then worship beside Allah a thing that can neither benefit you nor hurt you?
verses.translation: Abraham said: ""Do you then worship beside Allah a thing that can neither benefit you nor hurt you?

verses.text: Fie upon you and upon all that you worship beside Allah. Do you have no sense?""
verses.translation: Fie upon you and upon all that you worship beside Allah. Do you have no sense?""

verses.text: They said: ""Burn him and come to the support of your gods if you are going to do anything.""
verses.translation: They said: ""Burn him and come to the support of your gods if you are going to do anything.""

verses.text: We said: ""O fire become coolness and safety for Abraham.""
verses.translation: We said: ""O fire become coolness and safety for Abraham.""

verses.text: They had sought to do evil to him but We caused them to be the worst losers
verses.translation: They had sought to do evil to him but We caused them to be the worst losers

verses.text: and We saved him and Lot and brought him to the land upon which We had bestowed Our blessings for all the people of the world.
verses.translation: and We saved him and Lot and brought him to the land upon which We had bestowed Our blessings for all the people of the world.

verses.text: And We bestowed upon him Isaac and Jacob as an additional gift making each of them righteous.
verses.translation: And We bestowed upon him Isaac and Jacob as an additional gift making each of them righteous.

verses.text: And We made them into leaders to guide people in accordance with Our command and We inspired them to good works and to establish Prayers and to give Zakah. They worshipped Us alone.
verses.translation: And We made them into leaders to guide people in accordance with Our command and We inspired them to good works and to establish Prayers and to give Zakah. They worshipped Us alone.

verses.text: We bestowed upon Lot sound judgement and knowledge and We delivered him from the city that was immersed in foul deeds. They were indeed a wicked people exceedingly disobedient.
verses.translation: We bestowed upon Lot sound judgement and knowledge and We delivered him from the city that was immersed in foul deeds. They were indeed a wicked people exceedingly disobedient.

verses.text: And We admitted him into Our mercy. Verily he was of the righteous.
verses.translation: And We admitted him into Our mercy. Verily he was of the righteous.

verses.text: We bestowed the same favour upon Noah. Recall when he cried to Us before; We accepted his prayer and delivered him and his household from the great distress
verses.translation: We bestowed the same favour upon Noah. Recall when he cried to Us before; We accepted his prayer and delivered him and his household from the great distress

verses.text: and We helped him against a people who rejected Our signs as false. They were indeed an evil people and so We drowned them all.
verses.translation: and We helped him against a people who rejected Our signs as false. They were indeed an evil people and so We drowned them all.

verses.text: We bestowed the same favour upon David and Solomon. Recall when they gave judgement regarding a tillage into which the sheep of some people had strayed at night and We were witnesses to their judgement.
verses.translation: We bestowed the same favour upon David and Solomon. Recall when they gave judgement regarding a tillage into which the sheep of some people had strayed at night and We were witnesses to their judgement.

verses.text: We guided Solomon to the right verdict and We had granted each of them judgement and knowledge. We made the mountains and the birds celebrate the praise of Allah with David. It was We Who did all this.
verses.translation: We guided Solomon to the right verdict and We had granted each of them judgement and knowledge. We made the mountains and the birds celebrate the praise of Allah with David. It was We Who did all this.

verses.text: It was We Who taught him the art of making coats of mail for your benefit so that it may protect you from each other''s violence. Do you then give thanks?
verses.translation: It was We Who taught him the art of making coats of mail for your benefit so that it may protect you from each other''s violence. Do you then give thanks?

verses.text: And We subdued the strongly raging wind to Solomon which blew at his bidding towards the land We blessed. We know everything.
verses.translation: And We subdued the strongly raging wind to Solomon which blew at his bidding towards the land We blessed. We know everything.

verses.text: And We subdued many devils who dived (into the sea) for him and carried out other jobs besides that. We kept watch over all of them.
verses.translation: And We subdued many devils who dived (into the sea) for him and carried out other jobs besides that. We kept watch over all of them.

verses.text: We bestowed (the same wisdom judgement and knowledge) upon Job. Recall when he cried to his Lord: ""Behold disease has struck me and You are the Most Merciful of those that are merciful.""
verses.translation: We bestowed (the same wisdom judgement and knowledge) upon Job. Recall when he cried to his Lord: ""Behold disease has struck me and You are the Most Merciful of those that are merciful.""

verses.text: We accepted his prayer and removed the affliction from him and We not only restored to him his family but as many more with them as a mercy from Us and as a lesson to the worshippers.
verses.translation: We accepted his prayer and removed the affliction from him and We not only restored to him his family but as many more with them as a mercy from Us and as a lesson to the worshippers.

verses.text: And (We bestowed the same favour) upon Ishmael Idris and Dhu al-Kifl for they were all steadfast.
verses.translation: And (We bestowed the same favour) upon Ishmael Idris and Dhu al-Kifl for they were all steadfast.

verses.text: And We admitted them into Our mercy for they were of the righteous.
verses.translation: And We admitted them into Our mercy for they were of the righteous.

verses.text: And We bestowed Our favour upon Dhu al-Nun. Recall when he went forth enraged thinking We have no power to take him to task. Eventually he cried out in the darkness: ""There is no god but You. Glory be to You! I have done wrong.""
verses.translation: And We bestowed Our favour upon Dhu al-Nun. Recall when he went forth enraged thinking We have no power to take him to task. Eventually he cried out in the darkness: ""There is no god but You. Glory be to You! I have done wrong.""

verses.text: Thereupon We accepted his prayer and rescued him from grief. Thus do We rescue the believers.
verses.translation: Thereupon We accepted his prayer and rescued him from grief. Thus do We rescue the believers.

verses.text: And We bestowed favour upon Zechariah when he cried to his Lord: ""Lord! Leave me not solitary (without any issue). You are the Best Inheritor.""
verses.translation: And We bestowed favour upon Zechariah when he cried to his Lord: ""Lord! Leave me not solitary (without any issue). You are the Best Inheritor.""

verses.text: So We accepted his prayer and bestowed upon him John and We made his wife fit (to bear a child). Verily they hastened in doing good works and called upon Us with longing and fear and humbled themselves to Us.
verses.translation: So We accepted his prayer and bestowed upon him John and We made his wife fit (to bear a child). Verily they hastened in doing good works and called upon Us with longing and fear and humbled themselves to Us.

verses.text: And also recall the woman who guarded her chastity: We breathed into her of Our spirit and made her and her son a Sign to the whole world.
verses.translation: And also recall the woman who guarded her chastity: We breathed into her of Our spirit and made her and her son a Sign to the whole world.

verses.text: Verily this community of yours is a single community and I am your Lord; so worship Me.
verses.translation: Verily this community of yours is a single community and I am your Lord; so worship Me.

verses.text: But they tore asunder their faith into many parts. But to Us they are bound to return.
verses.translation: But they tore asunder their faith into many parts. But to Us they are bound to return.

verses.text: Then whosoever does righteous works while believing his striving will not go unappreciated. We record them all for him.
verses.translation: Then whosoever does righteous works while believing his striving will not go unappreciated. We record them all for him.

verses.text: It has been ordained against every town that We ever destroyed that they shall not return (to enjoy a new lease of life)
verses.translation: It has been ordained against every town that We ever destroyed that they shall not return (to enjoy a new lease of life)

verses.text: until Gog and Magog are let loose and begin swooping from every mound
verses.translation: until Gog and Magog are let loose and begin swooping from every mound

verses.text: and the time for the fulfillment of the true promise of Allah draws near whereupon the eyes of those who disbelieved will stare in fear and they will say: ""Woe to us we were indeed heedless of this; nay we were wrong-doers.""
verses.translation: and the time for the fulfillment of the true promise of Allah draws near whereupon the eyes of those who disbelieved will stare in fear and they will say: ""Woe to us we were indeed heedless of this; nay we were wrong-doers.""

verses.text: (They will be told): ""Verily you and the gods you worshipped beside Allah are the fuel of Hell. All of you are bound to arrive there.
verses.translation: (They will be told): ""Verily you and the gods you worshipped beside Allah are the fuel of Hell. All of you are bound to arrive there.

verses.text: Had these indeed been gods they would not have gone there. But (as it is) all of you shall ever abide in it.""
verses.translation: Had these indeed been gods they would not have gone there. But (as it is) all of you shall ever abide in it.""

verses.text: There they shall groan with anguish and the din and noise in Hell will not let them hear anything.
verses.translation: There they shall groan with anguish and the din and noise in Hell will not let them hear anything.

verses.text: But for those whom We had decided to favour with good reward they shall be kept far removed from Hell.
verses.translation: But for those whom We had decided to favour with good reward they shall be kept far removed from Hell.

verses.text: They shall not hear even a whisper of it and they shall live for ever in the delights which they had desired.
verses.translation: They shall not hear even a whisper of it and they shall live for ever in the delights which they had desired.

verses.text: The Hour of the Great Terror shall not grieve them and the angels shall receive them saying: ""This is your Day which you had been promised.""
verses.translation: The Hour of the Great Terror shall not grieve them and the angels shall receive them saying: ""This is your Day which you had been promised.""

verses.text: On that Day We shall roll up the heavens like a scroll for writing. Even as We originated the creation first so We shall repeat it. This is a promise binding on Us; and so We shall do.
verses.translation: On that Day We shall roll up the heavens like a scroll for writing. Even as We originated the creation first so We shall repeat it. This is a promise binding on Us; and so We shall do.

verses.text: Surely We wrote in the Psalms after the exhortation that the earth shall be inherited by My righteous servants.
verses.translation: Surely We wrote in the Psalms after the exhortation that the earth shall be inherited by My righteous servants.

verses.text: Herein surely is a message for those devoted to worship.
verses.translation: Herein surely is a message for those devoted to worship.

verses.text: We have sent you forth as nothing but mercy to people of the whole world.
verses.translation: We have sent you forth as nothing but mercy to people of the whole world.

verses.text: Say: ""It is revealed to me that your God is only One God. Will you then submit to Him?""
verses.translation: Say: ""It is revealed to me that your God is only One God. Will you then submit to Him?""

verses.text: If they turn away say to them: ""I have warned you all alike; and I cannot say whether what you have been promised is near or distant.
verses.translation: If they turn away say to them: ""I have warned you all alike; and I cannot say whether what you have been promised is near or distant.

verses.text: Indeed He knows what you say loudly and what you hide.
verses.translation: Indeed He knows what you say loudly and what you hide.

verses.text: I think that this [reprieve] is possibly a trial for you an opportunity to enjoy yourselves until an appointed time.""
verses.translation: I think that this [reprieve] is possibly a trial for you an opportunity to enjoy yourselves until an appointed time.""

verses.text: The Messenger said: ""My Lord! Judge with truth. Our Compassionate Lord alone is our support against your (blasphemous) utterances.""
verses.translation: The Messenger said: ""My Lord! Judge with truth. Our Compassionate Lord alone is our support against your (blasphemous) utterances.""

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: The time of people''s reckoning has drawn near and yet they turn aside in heedlessness.
ayahs.translation: The time of people''s reckoning has drawn near and yet they turn aside in heedlessness.

ayahs.text: Whenever any fresh admonition comes to them from their Lord they barely heed it and remain immersed in play
ayahs.translation: Whenever any fresh admonition comes to them from their Lord they barely heed it and remain immersed in play

ayahs.text: their hearts being set on other concerns. The wrong-doers whisper to one another: ""This person is no more than a mortal like yourselves. Will you then be enchanted by sorcery while you see?""
ayahs.translation: their hearts being set on other concerns. The wrong-doers whisper to one another: ""This person is no more than a mortal like yourselves. Will you then be enchanted by sorcery while you see?""

ayahs.text: He said: ""My Lord knows well all that is spoken in the heavens and the earth. He is All-Hearing All- Knowing.""
ayahs.translation: He said: ""My Lord knows well all that is spoken in the heavens and the earth. He is All-Hearing All- Knowing.""

ayahs.text: They say: ""Nay these are confused dreams; nay he has forged it; nay he is a poet. So let him bring us a sign even as the Messengers of the past were sent with signs.""
ayahs.translation: They say: ""Nay these are confused dreams; nay he has forged it; nay he is a poet. So let him bring us a sign even as the Messengers of the past were sent with signs.""

ayahs.text: Not one township that We destroyed before them believed. Would they then believe?
ayahs.translation: Not one township that We destroyed before them believed. Would they then believe?

ayahs.text: (O Muhammad) even before you We never sent any other than human beings as Messengers and to them We sent revelation. Ask the People of the Book if you do not know.
ayahs.translation: (O Muhammad) even before you We never sent any other than human beings as Messengers and to them We sent revelation. Ask the People of the Book if you do not know.

ayahs.text: We did not endow the Messengers with bodies that would need no food; nor were they immortals.
ayahs.translation: We did not endow the Messengers with bodies that would need no food; nor were they immortals.

ayahs.text: Then We fulfilled the promise We had made to them: We rescued them and those whom We wished and We destroyed those who exceeded all bounds.
ayahs.translation: Then We fulfilled the promise We had made to them: We rescued them and those whom We wished and We destroyed those who exceeded all bounds.

ayahs.text: We have bestowed upon you a Book that mentions you. Do you not understand?
ayahs.translation: We have bestowed upon you a Book that mentions you. Do you not understand?

ayahs.text: How many a wrong-doing town did We shatter and then raise up another people.
ayahs.translation: How many a wrong-doing town did We shatter and then raise up another people.

ayahs.text: Then when they perceived Our chastisement they took to their heels and fled.
ayahs.translation: Then when they perceived Our chastisement they took to their heels and fled.

ayahs.text: (They were told): ""Flee not but return to your comforts and to your dwellings. You are likely to be questioned.""
ayahs.translation: (They were told): ""Flee not but return to your comforts and to your dwellings. You are likely to be questioned.""

ayahs.text: They said: ""Woe to us; surely we were wrong-doers.""
ayahs.translation: They said: ""Woe to us; surely we were wrong-doers.""

ayahs.text: They did not cease to cry this until We reduced them to stubble still and silent.
ayahs.translation: They did not cease to cry this until We reduced them to stubble still and silent.

ayahs.text: We did not create in sport the heavens and the earth and all that lies between the two.
ayahs.translation: We did not create in sport the heavens and the earth and all that lies between the two.

ayahs.text: Had it been Our will to find a pastime We would have found one near at hand; if at all We were inclined to do so.
ayahs.translation: Had it been Our will to find a pastime We would have found one near at hand; if at all We were inclined to do so.

ayahs.text: Nay We hurl the Truth at falsehood so that the Truth crushes falsehood and lo! it vanishes. Woe to you for what you utter!
ayahs.translation: Nay We hurl the Truth at falsehood so that the Truth crushes falsehood and lo! it vanishes. Woe to you for what you utter!

ayahs.text: To Him belongs whosoever dwells in the heavens and on earth. Those (angels) that are with Him neither disdain to serve Him out of pride nor do they weary of it.
ayahs.translation: To Him belongs whosoever dwells in the heavens and on earth. Those (angels) that are with Him neither disdain to serve Him out of pride nor do they weary of it.

ayahs.text: They glorify Him night and day without flagging.
ayahs.translation: They glorify Him night and day without flagging.

ayahs.text: Have they taken earthly gods who are such that they raise up the dead to life?
ayahs.translation: Have they taken earthly gods who are such that they raise up the dead to life?

ayahs.text: Had there been any gods in the heavens and the earth apart from Allah the order of both the heavens and the earth would have gone to ruins. Glory be to Allah the Lord of the Throne Who is far above their false descriptions of Him.
ayahs.translation: Had there been any gods in the heavens and the earth apart from Allah the order of both the heavens and the earth would have gone to ruins. Glory be to Allah the Lord of the Throne Who is far above their false descriptions of Him.

ayahs.text: None shall question Him about what He does but they shall be questioned.
ayahs.translation: None shall question Him about what He does but they shall be questioned.

ayahs.text: Have they taken gods other than Him? Say (O Muhammad): ""Bring forth your proof! Here is the Book with admonition for those of my time and there are also scriptures with admonition for people before me."" But most people do not know the Truth and have therefore turned away from it.
ayahs.translation: Have they taken gods other than Him? Say (O Muhammad): ""Bring forth your proof! Here is the Book with admonition for those of my time and there are also scriptures with admonition for people before me."" But most people do not know the Truth and have therefore turned away from it.

ayahs.text: Never did We send any Messenger before you to whom We did not reveal: ""There is no god but Me. So serve Me alone.""
ayahs.translation: Never did We send any Messenger before you to whom We did not reveal: ""There is no god but Me. So serve Me alone.""

ayahs.text: They say: ""The Most Compassionate Lord has taken to Himself a son."" Glory be to Him! Those whom they so designate are only His honoured servants.
ayahs.translation: They say: ""The Most Compassionate Lord has taken to Himself a son."" Glory be to Him! Those whom they so designate are only His honoured servants.

ayahs.text: They do not outstrip Him in speech and only act as He commands.
ayahs.translation: They do not outstrip Him in speech and only act as He commands.

ayahs.text: He knows whatever is before them and whatsoever is remote from them and they do not intercede except for him intercession on whose behalf pleases Him and they stand constantly in awe of Him.
ayahs.translation: He knows whatever is before them and whatsoever is remote from them and they do not intercede except for him intercession on whose behalf pleases Him and they stand constantly in awe of Him.

ayahs.text: And if anyone of them were to claim: ""Indeed I am a god apart from Him  We shall recompense him with Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrong-doers.
ayahs.translation: And if anyone of them were to claim: ""Indeed I am a god apart from Him  We shall recompense him with Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrong-doers.

ayahs.text: Did the unbelievers (who do not accept the teaching of the Prophet) not realize that the heavens and the earth were one solid mass then We tore them apart and We made every living being out of water? Will they then not believe (that We created all this)?
ayahs.translation: Did the unbelievers (who do not accept the teaching of the Prophet) not realize that the heavens and the earth were one solid mass then We tore them apart and We made every living being out of water? Will they then not believe (that We created all this)?

ayahs.text: And We placed firm mountains on earth lest it should sway with them and We made wide paths in them that they may find their way;
ayahs.translation: And We placed firm mountains on earth lest it should sway with them and We made wide paths in them that they may find their way;

ayahs.text: and We made the sky a secure canopy; and yet they turn away from these Signs.
ayahs.translation: and We made the sky a secure canopy; and yet they turn away from these Signs.

ayahs.text: It is He Who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon. Each of them is floating in its orbit.
ayahs.translation: It is He Who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon. Each of them is floating in its orbit.

ayahs.text: (O Muhammad) We did not grant everlasting life to any human being even before you. If you were to die will they live for ever?
ayahs.translation: (O Muhammad) We did not grant everlasting life to any human being even before you. If you were to die will they live for ever?

ayahs.text: Every living being shall taste death and We shall subject you to ill and good by way of trial and to Us shall all of you be eventually sent back.
ayahs.translation: Every living being shall taste death and We shall subject you to ill and good by way of trial and to Us shall all of you be eventually sent back.

ayahs.text: When the unbelievers see you they make you an object of fun saying: ""Is he the one who mentions your gods?"" They say so and yet they reject with disdain the very mention of the Most Compassionate Lord.
ayahs.translation: When the unbelievers see you they make you an object of fun saying: ""Is he the one who mentions your gods?"" They say so and yet they reject with disdain the very mention of the Most Compassionate Lord.

ayahs.text: Man is hasty by nature. I shall certainly show you My Signs. Do not ask Me to be hasty.
ayahs.translation: Man is hasty by nature. I shall certainly show you My Signs. Do not ask Me to be hasty.

ayahs.text: They say: ""(Tell us) when will the threat of punishment come to pass if you are truthful?""
ayahs.translation: They say: ""(Tell us) when will the threat of punishment come to pass if you are truthful?""

ayahs.text: If only the unbelievers knew of the Hour when they shall not be able to keep off the Fire from their faces nor from their backs; nor shall they be helped.
ayahs.translation: If only the unbelievers knew of the Hour when they shall not be able to keep off the Fire from their faces nor from their backs; nor shall they be helped.

ayahs.text: That will suddenly come upon them and stupefy them. They shall not be able to ward it off nor shall they be granted any respite.
ayahs.translation: That will suddenly come upon them and stupefy them. They shall not be able to ward it off nor shall they be granted any respite.

ayahs.text: Other Messengers before you were also mocked but those who scoffed at the Messengers were overtaken by the same scourge that they had scoffed at.
ayahs.translation: Other Messengers before you were also mocked but those who scoffed at the Messengers were overtaken by the same scourge that they had scoffed at.

ayahs.text: Tell them (O Muhammad): ""Who protects you during the night or the day from the Most Compassionate Lord?"" And yet they turn away from the Admonition of their Lord.
ayahs.translation: Tell them (O Muhammad): ""Who protects you during the night or the day from the Most Compassionate Lord?"" And yet they turn away from the Admonition of their Lord.

ayahs.text: Do they have any gods who would protect them against Us? They have no power even to help themselves; nor do they enjoy Our support.
ayahs.translation: Do they have any gods who would protect them against Us? They have no power even to help themselves; nor do they enjoy Our support.

ayahs.text: Nay We generously provided them and their fathers and they enjoyed Our provision for long. Do they not see that We are now advancing into their territory diminishing it from different sides? Is it they then who will triumph?""
ayahs.translation: Nay We generously provided them and their fathers and they enjoyed Our provision for long. Do they not see that We are now advancing into their territory diminishing it from different sides? Is it they then who will triumph?""

ayahs.text: Tell them: ""I only warn you by the Revelation."" But the deaf do not hear the cry when they are warned.
ayahs.translation: Tell them: ""I only warn you by the Revelation."" But the deaf do not hear the cry when they are warned.

ayahs.text: Were only the slightest whiff from your Lord''s punishment to touch them they would cry out: ""Woe to us; we were indeed wrong-doers.""
ayahs.translation: Were only the slightest whiff from your Lord''s punishment to touch them they would cry out: ""Woe to us; we were indeed wrong-doers.""

ayahs.text: We shall set up just scales on the Day of Resurrection so that none will be wronged in the least. (We shall bring forth the acts of everyone) even if it be the weight of a grain of mustard seed. We shall suffice as Reckoners.
ayahs.translation: We shall set up just scales on the Day of Resurrection so that none will be wronged in the least. (We shall bring forth the acts of everyone) even if it be the weight of a grain of mustard seed. We shall suffice as Reckoners.

ayahs.text: Surely We had granted to Moses and Aaron the Criterion (between right and wrong) and Light and Admonition for the good of the God-fearing
ayahs.translation: Surely We had granted to Moses and Aaron the Criterion (between right and wrong) and Light and Admonition for the good of the God-fearing

ayahs.text: for those who fear their Lord without seeing Him and dread the Hour (of Reckoning).
ayahs.translation: for those who fear their Lord without seeing Him and dread the Hour (of Reckoning).

ayahs.text: This is a Blessed Admonition that We have revealed. Are you then going to reject it?
ayahs.translation: This is a Blessed Admonition that We have revealed. Are you then going to reject it?

ayahs.text: Surely We had bestowed wisdom upon Abraham even earlier and We knew him well.
ayahs.translation: Surely We had bestowed wisdom upon Abraham even earlier and We knew him well.

ayahs.text: Recall when he said to his father and his people: ""What are these images to which you are devoutly clinging?""
ayahs.translation: Recall when he said to his father and his people: ""What are these images to which you are devoutly clinging?""

ayahs.text: They answered: ""We found our fathers worshipping them.""
ayahs.translation: They answered: ""We found our fathers worshipping them.""

ayahs.text: He said: ""Certainly you and your fathers have all been in manifest error.""
ayahs.translation: He said: ""Certainly you and your fathers have all been in manifest error.""

ayahs.text: They said: ""Are you expressing your true ideas before us or are you jesting?""
ayahs.translation: They said: ""Are you expressing your true ideas before us or are you jesting?""

ayahs.text: He said: ""Nay but your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth which He created and to that I bear witness before you.
ayahs.translation: He said: ""Nay but your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth which He created and to that I bear witness before you.

ayahs.text: By Allah I shall certainly carry out my plan against your gods after you are gone.""
ayahs.translation: By Allah I shall certainly carry out my plan against your gods after you are gone.""

ayahs.text: Then he broke them all into pieces sparing only the supreme one among them that they may possibly return to him.
ayahs.translation: Then he broke them all into pieces sparing only the supreme one among them that they may possibly return to him.

ayahs.text: (When they saw the idols in this state) they said: ""Who has done this to our gods? Surely he is one of the wrong-doers.""
ayahs.translation: (When they saw the idols in this state) they said: ""Who has done this to our gods? Surely he is one of the wrong-doers.""

ayahs.text: Some of them said: ""We heard a youth called Abraham speak (ill) of them.""
ayahs.translation: Some of them said: ""We heard a youth called Abraham speak (ill) of them.""

ayahs.text: The others said: ""Bring him then before the eyes of the people that they may see (what will be done to him).""
ayahs.translation: The others said: ""Bring him then before the eyes of the people that they may see (what will be done to him).""

ayahs.text: (On Abraham''s arrival) they said: ""Abraham are you he who has done this to our gods?""
ayahs.translation: (On Abraham''s arrival) they said: ""Abraham are you he who has done this to our gods?""

ayahs.text: He answered: ""Rather it was this supreme one who has done it. So ask them if they can speak.""
ayahs.translation: He answered: ""Rather it was this supreme one who has done it. So ask them if they can speak.""

ayahs.text: Thereupon they turned to their (inner) selves and said (to themselves): ""Surely it is you who are the wrong-doers.""
ayahs.translation: Thereupon they turned to their (inner) selves and said (to themselves): ""Surely it is you who are the wrong-doers.""

ayahs.text: Then their minds were turned upside down and they said: ""You know well that they do not speak.""
ayahs.translation: Then their minds were turned upside down and they said: ""You know well that they do not speak.""

ayahs.text: Abraham said: ""Do you then worship beside Allah a thing that can neither benefit you nor hurt you?
ayahs.translation: Abraham said: ""Do you then worship beside Allah a thing that can neither benefit you nor hurt you?

ayahs.text: Fie upon you and upon all that you worship beside Allah. Do you have no sense?""
ayahs.translation: Fie upon you and upon all that you worship beside Allah. Do you have no sense?""

ayahs.text: They said: ""Burn him and come to the support of your gods if you are going to do anything.""
ayahs.translation: They said: ""Burn him and come to the support of your gods if you are going to do anything.""

ayahs.text: We said: ""O fire become coolness and safety for Abraham.""
ayahs.translation: We said: ""O fire become coolness and safety for Abraham.""

ayahs.text: They had sought to do evil to him but We caused them to be the worst losers
ayahs.translation: They had sought to do evil to him but We caused them to be the worst losers

ayahs.text: and We saved him and Lot and brought him to the land upon which We had bestowed Our blessings for all the people of the world.
ayahs.translation: and We saved him and Lot and brought him to the land upon which We had bestowed Our blessings for all the people of the world.

ayahs.text: And We bestowed upon him Isaac and Jacob as an additional gift making each of them righteous.
ayahs.translation: And We bestowed upon him Isaac and Jacob as an additional gift making each of them righteous.

ayahs.text: And We made them into leaders to guide people in accordance with Our command and We inspired them to good works and to establish Prayers and to give Zakah. They worshipped Us alone.
ayahs.translation: And We made them into leaders to guide people in accordance with Our command and We inspired them to good works and to establish Prayers and to give Zakah. They worshipped Us alone.

ayahs.text: We bestowed upon Lot sound judgement and knowledge and We delivered him from the city that was immersed in foul deeds. They were indeed a wicked people exceedingly disobedient.
ayahs.translation: We bestowed upon Lot sound judgement and knowledge and We delivered him from the city that was immersed in foul deeds. They were indeed a wicked people exceedingly disobedient.

ayahs.text: And We admitted him into Our mercy. Verily he was of the righteous.
ayahs.translation: And We admitted him into Our mercy. Verily he was of the righteous.

ayahs.text: We bestowed the same favour upon Noah. Recall when he cried to Us before; We accepted his prayer and delivered him and his household from the great distress
ayahs.translation: We bestowed the same favour upon Noah. Recall when he cried to Us before; We accepted his prayer and delivered him and his household from the great distress

ayahs.text: and We helped him against a people who rejected Our signs as false. They were indeed an evil people and so We drowned them all.
ayahs.translation: and We helped him against a people who rejected Our signs as false. They were indeed an evil people and so We drowned them all.

ayahs.text: We bestowed the same favour upon David and Solomon. Recall when they gave judgement regarding a tillage into which the sheep of some people had strayed at night and We were witnesses to their judgement.
ayahs.translation: We bestowed the same favour upon David and Solomon. Recall when they gave judgement regarding a tillage into which the sheep of some people had strayed at night and We were witnesses to their judgement.

ayahs.text: We guided Solomon to the right verdict and We had granted each of them judgement and knowledge. We made the mountains and the birds celebrate the praise of Allah with David. It was We Who did all this.
ayahs.translation: We guided Solomon to the right verdict and We had granted each of them judgement and knowledge. We made the mountains and the birds celebrate the praise of Allah with David. It was We Who did all this.

ayahs.text: It was We Who taught him the art of making coats of mail for your benefit so that it may protect you from each other''s violence. Do you then give thanks?
ayahs.translation: It was We Who taught him the art of making coats of mail for your benefit so that it may protect you from each other''s violence. Do you then give thanks?

ayahs.text: And We subdued the strongly raging wind to Solomon which blew at his bidding towards the land We blessed. We know everything.
ayahs.translation: And We subdued the strongly raging wind to Solomon which blew at his bidding towards the land We blessed. We know everything.

ayahs.text: And We subdued many devils who dived (into the sea) for him and carried out other jobs besides that. We kept watch over all of them.
ayahs.translation: And We subdued many devils who dived (into the sea) for him and carried out other jobs besides that. We kept watch over all of them.

ayahs.text: We bestowed (the same wisdom judgement and knowledge) upon Job. Recall when he cried to his Lord: ""Behold disease has struck me and You are the Most Merciful of those that are merciful.""
ayahs.translation: We bestowed (the same wisdom judgement and knowledge) upon Job. Recall when he cried to his Lord: ""Behold disease has struck me and You are the Most Merciful of those that are merciful.""

ayahs.text: We accepted his prayer and removed the affliction from him and We not only restored to him his family but as many more with them as a mercy from Us and as a lesson to the worshippers.
ayahs.translation: We accepted his prayer and removed the affliction from him and We not only restored to him his family but as many more with them as a mercy from Us and as a lesson to the worshippers.

ayahs.text: And (We bestowed the same favour) upon Ishmael Idris and Dhu al-Kifl for they were all steadfast.
ayahs.translation: And (We bestowed the same favour) upon Ishmael Idris and Dhu al-Kifl for they were all steadfast.

ayahs.text: And We admitted them into Our mercy for they were of the righteous.
ayahs.translation: And We admitted them into Our mercy for they were of the righteous.

ayahs.text: And We bestowed Our favour upon Dhu al-Nun. Recall when he went forth enraged thinking We have no power to take him to task. Eventually he cried out in the darkness: ""There is no god but You. Glory be to You! I have done wrong.""
ayahs.translation: And We bestowed Our favour upon Dhu al-Nun. Recall when he went forth enraged thinking We have no power to take him to task. Eventually he cried out in the darkness: ""There is no god but You. Glory be to You! I have done wrong.""

ayahs.text: Thereupon We accepted his prayer and rescued him from grief. Thus do We rescue the believers.
ayahs.translation: Thereupon We accepted his prayer and rescued him from grief. Thus do We rescue the believers.

ayahs.text: And We bestowed favour upon Zechariah when he cried to his Lord: ""Lord! Leave me not solitary (without any issue). You are the Best Inheritor.""
ayahs.translation: And We bestowed favour upon Zechariah when he cried to his Lord: ""Lord! Leave me not solitary (without any issue). You are the Best Inheritor.""

ayahs.text: So We accepted his prayer and bestowed upon him John and We made his wife fit (to bear a child). Verily they hastened in doing good works and called upon Us with longing and fear and humbled themselves to Us.
ayahs.translation: So We accepted his prayer and bestowed upon him John and We made his wife fit (to bear a child). Verily they hastened in doing good works and called upon Us with longing and fear and humbled themselves to Us.

ayahs.text: And also recall the woman who guarded her chastity: We breathed into her of Our spirit and made her and her son a Sign to the whole world.
ayahs.translation: And also recall the woman who guarded her chastity: We breathed into her of Our spirit and made her and her son a Sign to the whole world.

ayahs.text: Verily this community of yours is a single community and I am your Lord; so worship Me.
ayahs.translation: Verily this community of yours is a single community and I am your Lord; so worship Me.

ayahs.text: But they tore asunder their faith into many parts. But to Us they are bound to return.
ayahs.translation: But they tore asunder their faith into many parts. But to Us they are bound to return.

ayahs.text: Then whosoever does righteous works while believing his striving will not go unappreciated. We record them all for him.
ayahs.translation: Then whosoever does righteous works while believing his striving will not go unappreciated. We record them all for him.

ayahs.text: It has been ordained against every town that We ever destroyed that they shall not return (to enjoy a new lease of life)
ayahs.translation: It has been ordained against every town that We ever destroyed that they shall not return (to enjoy a new lease of life)

ayahs.text: until Gog and Magog are let loose and begin swooping from every mound
ayahs.translation: until Gog and Magog are let loose and begin swooping from every mound

ayahs.text: and the time for the fulfillment of the true promise of Allah draws near whereupon the eyes of those who disbelieved will stare in fear and they will say: ""Woe to us we were indeed heedless of this; nay we were wrong-doers.""
ayahs.translation: and the time for the fulfillment of the true promise of Allah draws near whereupon the eyes of those who disbelieved will stare in fear and they will say: ""Woe to us we were indeed heedless of this; nay we were wrong-doers.""

ayahs.text: (They will be told): ""Verily you and the gods you worshipped beside Allah are the fuel of Hell. All of you are bound to arrive there.
ayahs.translation: (They will be told): ""Verily you and the gods you worshipped beside Allah are the fuel of Hell. All of you are bound to arrive there.

ayahs.text: Had these indeed been gods they would not have gone there. But (as it is) all of you shall ever abide in it.""
ayahs.translation: Had these indeed been gods they would not have gone there. But (as it is) all of you shall ever abide in it.""

ayahs.text: There they shall groan with anguish and the din and noise in Hell will not let them hear anything.
ayahs.translation: There they shall groan with anguish and the din and noise in Hell will not let them hear anything.

ayahs.text: But for those whom We had decided to favour with good reward they shall be kept far removed from Hell.
ayahs.translation: But for those whom We had decided to favour with good reward they shall be kept far removed from Hell.

ayahs.text: They shall not hear even a whisper of it and they shall live for ever in the delights which they had desired.
ayahs.translation: They shall not hear even a whisper of it and they shall live for ever in the delights which they had desired.

ayahs.text: The Hour of the Great Terror shall not grieve them and the angels shall receive them saying: ""This is your Day which you had been promised.""
ayahs.translation: The Hour of the Great Terror shall not grieve them and the angels shall receive them saying: ""This is your Day which you had been promised.""

ayahs.text: On that Day We shall roll up the heavens like a scroll for writing. Even as We originated the creation first so We shall repeat it. This is a promise binding on Us; and so We shall do.
ayahs.translation: On that Day We shall roll up the heavens like a scroll for writing. Even as We originated the creation first so We shall repeat it. This is a promise binding on Us; and so We shall do.

ayahs.text: Surely We wrote in the Psalms after the exhortation that the earth shall be inherited by My righteous servants.
ayahs.translation: Surely We wrote in the Psalms after the exhortation that the earth shall be inherited by My righteous servants.

ayahs.text: Herein surely is a message for those devoted to worship.
ayahs.translation: Herein surely is a message for those devoted to worship.

ayahs.text: We have sent you forth as nothing but mercy to people of the whole world.
ayahs.translation: We have sent you forth as nothing but mercy to people of the whole world.

ayahs.text: Say: ""It is revealed to me that your God is only One God. Will you then submit to Him?""
ayahs.translation: Say: ""It is revealed to me that your God is only One God. Will you then submit to Him?""

ayahs.text: If they turn away say to them: ""I have warned you all alike; and I cannot say whether what you have been promised is near or distant.
ayahs.translation: If they turn away say to them: ""I have warned you all alike; and I cannot say whether what you have been promised is near or distant.

ayahs.text: Indeed He knows what you say loudly and what you hide.
ayahs.translation: Indeed He knows what you say loudly and what you hide.

ayahs.text: I think that this [reprieve] is possibly a trial for you an opportunity to enjoy yourselves until an appointed time.""
ayahs.translation: I think that this [reprieve] is possibly a trial for you an opportunity to enjoy yourselves until an appointed time.""

ayahs.text: The Messenger said: ""My Lord! Judge with truth. Our Compassionate Lord alone is our support against your (blasphemous) utterances.""
ayahs.translation: The Messenger said: ""My Lord! Judge with truth. Our Compassionate Lord alone is our support against your (blasphemous) utterances.""

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: O mankind fear the (wrath of) your Lord! Indeed the earthquake of the Hour (of Judgement) will be an awesome thing.
verses.translation: O mankind fear the (wrath of) your Lord! Indeed the earthquake of the Hour (of Judgement) will be an awesome thing.

verses.text: On the Day when you witness it the suckling woman shall utterly neglect the infant she suckles and every pregnant woman shall cast her burden and you will see people as though they are drunk when they are not drunk; but dreadful shall be Allah''s chastisement.
verses.translation: On the Day when you witness it the suckling woman shall utterly neglect the infant she suckles and every pregnant woman shall cast her burden and you will see people as though they are drunk when they are not drunk; but dreadful shall be Allah''s chastisement.

verses.text: Among people there are some who wrangle about Allah without knowledge and follow every rebellious devil
verses.translation: Among people there are some who wrangle about Allah without knowledge and follow every rebellious devil

verses.text: although it is decreed about him that he shall lead into error whosoever takes him for a friend and will direct him to the torment of the Fire.
verses.translation: although it is decreed about him that he shall lead into error whosoever takes him for a friend and will direct him to the torment of the Fire.

verses.text: O mankind! If you have any doubt concerning Resurrection then know that it is surely We Who created you from dust then from a drop of sperm then from a clot of blood then from a little lump of flesh some of it shapely and other shapeless. (We are rehearsing this) that We may make the reality clear to you. We cause (the drop of sperm) that We please to remain in the wombs till an appointed time.
