We bring you forth as infants (and nurture you) that you may come of age. Among you is he that dies (at a young age) and he who is kept back to the most abject age so that after once having known he reaches a stage when he knows nothing. You see the earth dry and barren and then no sooner than We send down water upon it it begins to quiver and swell and brings forth every kind of beauteous vegetation.
verses.translation: O mankind! If you have any doubt concerning Resurrection then know that it is surely We Who created you from dust then from a drop of sperm then from a clot of blood then from a little lump of flesh some of it shapely and other shapeless. (We are rehearsing this) that We may make the reality clear to you. We cause (the drop of sperm) that We please to remain in the wombs till an appointed time. We bring you forth as infants (and nurture you) that you may come of age. Among you is he that dies (at a young age) and he who is kept back to the most abject age so that after once having known he reaches a stage when he knows nothing. You see the earth dry and barren and then no sooner than We send down water upon it it begins to quiver and swell and brings forth every kind of beauteous vegetation.

verses.text: All this is because Allah He is the Truth and because He resurrects the dead and because He has power over everything
verses.translation: All this is because Allah He is the Truth and because He resurrects the dead and because He has power over everything

verses.text: (all of which shows that) the Hour shall surely come to pass - in this there is no doubt - and Allah shall surely resurrect those that are in graves.
verses.translation: (all of which shows that) the Hour shall surely come to pass - in this there is no doubt - and Allah shall surely resurrect those that are in graves.

verses.text: And among people are those that wrangle about Allah without knowledge without any true guidance and without any scripture to enlighten them.
verses.translation: And among people are those that wrangle about Allah without knowledge without any true guidance and without any scripture to enlighten them.

verses.text: They wrangle arrogantly intent on leading people astray from the Way of Allah. Such shall suffer disgrace in this world and We shall cause them to taste the chastisement of burning (in the Next).
verses.translation: They wrangle arrogantly intent on leading people astray from the Way of Allah. Such shall suffer disgrace in this world and We shall cause them to taste the chastisement of burning (in the Next).

verses.text: That is the outcome of what your own hands have wrought for Allah never wrongs His creatures.
verses.translation: That is the outcome of what your own hands have wrought for Allah never wrongs His creatures.

verses.text: And among people is he who worships Allah on the borderline; if any good befalls him he is satisfied; but if a trial afflicts him he utterly turns away. He will incur the loss of this world and the Hereafter. That indeed is a clear loss.
verses.translation: And among people is he who worships Allah on the borderline; if any good befalls him he is satisfied; but if a trial afflicts him he utterly turns away. He will incur the loss of this world and the Hereafter. That indeed is a clear loss.

verses.text: He invokes instead of Allah those who can neither harm nor benefit him. That indeed is straying far away.
verses.translation: He invokes instead of Allah those who can neither harm nor benefit him. That indeed is straying far away.

verses.text: He invokes those that are more likely to cause him harm than benefit. Such is surely an evil patron and an evil associate.
verses.translation: He invokes those that are more likely to cause him harm than benefit. Such is surely an evil patron and an evil associate.

verses.text: (In contrast) Allah will assuredly cause those who believe and act righteously to enter Gardens beneath which rivers flow. For most certainly Allah does whatever He pleases.
verses.translation: (In contrast) Allah will assuredly cause those who believe and act righteously to enter Gardens beneath which rivers flow. For most certainly Allah does whatever He pleases.

verses.text: Anyone who fancies that Allah will not support him in this world and in the Hereafter let him reach out to heaven through a rope and then make a hole in the sky and see whether his device can avert that which enrages him.
verses.translation: Anyone who fancies that Allah will not support him in this world and in the Hereafter let him reach out to heaven through a rope and then make a hole in the sky and see whether his device can avert that which enrages him.

verses.text: Even so We have revealed the Qur''an with Clear Signs. Verily Allah guides whomsoever He wills.
verses.translation: Even so We have revealed the Qur''an with Clear Signs. Verily Allah guides whomsoever He wills.

verses.text: On the Day of Resurrection Allah will most certainly judge among those who believe and those who became Jews and Sabaeans and Christians and Magians and those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity. Surely Allah watches over everything.
verses.translation: On the Day of Resurrection Allah will most certainly judge among those who believe and those who became Jews and Sabaeans and Christians and Magians and those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity. Surely Allah watches over everything.

verses.text: Have you not seen that all those who are in the heavens and all those who are in the earth prostrate themselves before Allah; and so do the sun and the moon and the stars and the mountains and the trees and the beasts and so do many human beings and even many of those who are condemned to chastisement? And he whom Allah humiliates none can give him honour. Allah does whatever He wills.
verses.translation: Have you not seen that all those who are in the heavens and all those who are in the earth prostrate themselves before Allah; and so do the sun and the moon and the stars and the mountains and the trees and the beasts and so do many human beings and even many of those who are condemned to chastisement? And he whom Allah humiliates none can give him honour. Allah does whatever He wills.

verses.text: These two groups (-the believers and unbelievers-) are in dispute about their Lord. As for those that disbelieve garments of fire have been cut out for them; boiling water shall be poured down over their heads
verses.translation: These two groups (-the believers and unbelievers-) are in dispute about their Lord. As for those that disbelieve garments of fire have been cut out for them; boiling water shall be poured down over their heads

verses.text: causing (not only) their skins but all that is in their bellies as well to melt away.
verses.translation: causing (not only) their skins but all that is in their bellies as well to melt away.

verses.text: There shall be maces of iron to lash them.
verses.translation: There shall be maces of iron to lash them.

verses.text: Whenever they try in their anguish to escape from Hell they will be driven back into it (and shall be told): ""Now taste the torment of burning.""
verses.translation: Whenever they try in their anguish to escape from Hell they will be driven back into it (and shall be told): ""Now taste the torment of burning.""

verses.text: (On the other hand) Allah will cause those who believed and acted righteously to enter the Gardens beneath which rivers flow. They shall be decked in them with bracelets of gold and pearls and their raiment shall be of silk.
verses.translation: (On the other hand) Allah will cause those who believed and acted righteously to enter the Gardens beneath which rivers flow. They shall be decked in them with bracelets of gold and pearls and their raiment shall be of silk.

verses.text: They were guided (to accept) the pure word; they were guided to the Way of the Praiseworthy (Lord).
verses.translation: They were guided (to accept) the pure word; they were guided to the Way of the Praiseworthy (Lord).

verses.text: Indeed those who disbelieve and who (now) hinder people from the Way of Allah and hinder them from the Holy Mosque which We have set up (as a place of worship) for all people equally for those who dwell therein and for those who come from outside (they surely deserve punishment). Whosoever deviates therein from the Right Way and acts with iniquity We shall cause him to taste a painful chastisement.
verses.translation: Indeed those who disbelieve and who (now) hinder people from the Way of Allah and hinder them from the Holy Mosque which We have set up (as a place of worship) for all people equally for those who dwell therein and for those who come from outside (they surely deserve punishment). Whosoever deviates therein from the Right Way and acts with iniquity We shall cause him to taste a painful chastisement.

verses.text: Call to mind when We assigned to Abraham the site of the House (Kabah) directing him: ""Do not associate aught with Me"" and ""Keep My House pure for those who walk around it and for those who stand and who bow down and who prostrate themselves (in worship)
verses.translation: Call to mind when We assigned to Abraham the site of the House (Kabah) directing him: ""Do not associate aught with Me"" and ""Keep My House pure for those who walk around it and for those who stand and who bow down and who prostrate themselves (in worship)

verses.text: and publicly proclaim Pilgrimage for all mankind so that they come to you on foot and mounted on lean camels from every distant point
verses.translation: and publicly proclaim Pilgrimage for all mankind so that they come to you on foot and mounted on lean camels from every distant point

verses.text: to witness the benefits in store for them and pronounce the name of Allah during the appointed days over the cattle that He has provided them. So eat of it and feed the distressed and the needy.
verses.translation: to witness the benefits in store for them and pronounce the name of Allah during the appointed days over the cattle that He has provided them. So eat of it and feed the distressed and the needy.

verses.text: Thereafter let them tidy up and fulfil their vows and circumambulate the Ancient House.""
verses.translation: Thereafter let them tidy up and fulfil their vows and circumambulate the Ancient House.""

verses.text: Such (was the purpose of building the Kabah). Whosoever then venerates Allah''s sanctities will find it to be good for him in the sight of his Lord. Cattle have been made lawful for you except those mentioned to you (as unlawful). So shun the abomination of idols and shun all words of falsehood.
verses.translation: Such (was the purpose of building the Kabah). Whosoever then venerates Allah''s sanctities will find it to be good for him in the sight of his Lord. Cattle have been made lawful for you except those mentioned to you (as unlawful). So shun the abomination of idols and shun all words of falsehood.

verses.text: Become exclusively devoted to Allah ascribing Divinity to none other than Him. Whoso ascribes Divinity to aught beside Allah it is as though he fell down from the sky whereafter either the birds will snatch him away or the wind will sweep him to a distant place (causing him to be shattered to pieces).
verses.translation: Become exclusively devoted to Allah ascribing Divinity to none other than Him. Whoso ascribes Divinity to aught beside Allah it is as though he fell down from the sky whereafter either the birds will snatch him away or the wind will sweep him to a distant place (causing him to be shattered to pieces).

verses.text: Such is the fact. And whoso venerates the sanctity of all that have been ordained as symbols of Allah surely does so because it is part of the true piety of the hearts.
verses.translation: Such is the fact. And whoso venerates the sanctity of all that have been ordained as symbols of Allah surely does so because it is part of the true piety of the hearts.

verses.text: You may derive benefit (from sacrificial animals) until an appointed time. Thereafter their place (of sacrifice) is near the Ancient House.
verses.translation: You may derive benefit (from sacrificial animals) until an appointed time. Thereafter their place (of sacrifice) is near the Ancient House.

verses.text: For every people We have laid down a ritual of sacrifice (- although the purpose of the ritual is the same -) that they pronounce the name of Allah over the cattle He has provided them. Your Lord is One God; so submit yourselves to Him alone. And give (O Prophet) glad tidings to those that humble themselves (before Allah)
verses.translation: For every people We have laid down a ritual of sacrifice (- although the purpose of the ritual is the same -) that they pronounce the name of Allah over the cattle He has provided them. Your Lord is One God; so submit yourselves to Him alone. And give (O Prophet) glad tidings to those that humble themselves (before Allah)

verses.text: whose hearts shiver whenever Allah is mentioned who patiently bear whatever affliction comes to them who establish Prayer and who spend (for good purposes) out of what We have provided them.
verses.translation: whose hearts shiver whenever Allah is mentioned who patiently bear whatever affliction comes to them who establish Prayer and who spend (for good purposes) out of what We have provided them.

verses.text: We have appointed sacrificial camels among the symbols of (devotion to) Allah. There is much good in them for you. So make them stand (at the time of sacrifice) and pronounce the name of Allah over them and when they fall down on their sides(after they are slaughtered) eat and also feed them who do not ask and those who ask. Thus have We subjected these animals that you may give thanks.
verses.translation: We have appointed sacrificial camels among the symbols of (devotion to) Allah. There is much good in them for you. So make them stand (at the time of sacrifice) and pronounce the name of Allah over them and when they fall down on their sides(after they are slaughtered) eat and also feed them who do not ask and those who ask. Thus have We subjected these animals that you may give thanks.

verses.text: Neither their flesh reaches Allah nor their blood; it is your piety that reaches Him. He has subjected these animals (to you) that you may magnify Allah for the guidance He has bestowed upon you. Give glad tidings (O Prophet) to those who do good.
verses.translation: Neither their flesh reaches Allah nor their blood; it is your piety that reaches Him. He has subjected these animals (to you) that you may magnify Allah for the guidance He has bestowed upon you. Give glad tidings (O Prophet) to those who do good.

verses.text: Surely Allah defends those who believe. Certainly Allah has no love for the perfidious the thankless.
verses.translation: Surely Allah defends those who believe. Certainly Allah has no love for the perfidious the thankless.

verses.text: Permission (to fight) has been granted to those for they have been wronged. Verily Allah has the power to help them:
verses.translation: Permission (to fight) has been granted to those for they have been wronged. Verily Allah has the power to help them:

verses.text: those who were unjustly expelled from their homes for no other reason than their saying: ""Allah is Our Lord."" If Allah were not to repel some through others monasteries and churches and synagogues and mosques wherein the name of Allah is much mentioned would certainly have been pulled down. Allah will most certainly help those who will help Him. Verily Allah is Immensely Strong Overwhelmingly Mighty.
verses.translation: those who were unjustly expelled from their homes for no other reason than their saying: ""Allah is Our Lord."" If Allah were not to repel some through others monasteries and churches and synagogues and mosques wherein the name of Allah is much mentioned would certainly have been pulled down. Allah will most certainly help those who will help Him. Verily Allah is Immensely Strong Overwhelmingly Mighty.

verses.text: (Allah will certainly help) those who were We to bestow authority on them in the land will establish Prayers render Zakah enjoin good and forbid evil. The end of all matters rests with Allah.
verses.translation: (Allah will certainly help) those who were We to bestow authority on them in the land will establish Prayers render Zakah enjoin good and forbid evil. The end of all matters rests with Allah.

verses.text: (O Prophet) if they give the lie to you then before them the people of Noah ''Ad and Thamud also gave the lie (to the Prophets)
verses.translation: (O Prophet) if they give the lie to you then before them the people of Noah ''Ad and Thamud also gave the lie (to the Prophets)

verses.text: and so too did the people of Abraham and the people of Lot;
verses.translation: and so too did the people of Abraham and the people of Lot;

verses.text: and so did the dwellers of Midian and Moses too was branded a liar. Initially I granted respite to the unbelievers for a while and then seized them. How dreadful was My punishment!
verses.translation: and so did the dwellers of Midian and Moses too was branded a liar. Initially I granted respite to the unbelievers for a while and then seized them. How dreadful was My punishment!

verses.text: How many towns have We destroyed because their people were steeped in iniquity: so they lie fallen down upon their turrets! How many wells lie deserted; and how many towering palaces lie in ruins!
verses.translation: How many towns have We destroyed because their people were steeped in iniquity: so they lie fallen down upon their turrets! How many wells lie deserted; and how many towering palaces lie in ruins!

verses.text: Have they not journeyed in the land that their hearts might understand and their ears might listen? For indeed it is not the eyes that are blinded; it is rather the hearts in the breasts that are rendered blind.
verses.translation: Have they not journeyed in the land that their hearts might understand and their ears might listen? For indeed it is not the eyes that are blinded; it is rather the hearts in the breasts that are rendered blind.

verses.text: They ask you to hasten the punishment. Allah shall most certainly not fail His promise; but a Day with your Lord is as a thousand years of your reckoning.
verses.translation: They ask you to hasten the punishment. Allah shall most certainly not fail His promise; but a Day with your Lord is as a thousand years of your reckoning.

verses.text: How many towns did I respite at first though they were steeped in iniquity and then I seized them! To Me are all destined to return.
verses.translation: How many towns did I respite at first though they were steeped in iniquity and then I seized them! To Me are all destined to return.

verses.text: Say (O Muhammad): ""O people! I have been sent to you only as a plain warner (before the Doom strikes you).""
verses.translation: Say (O Muhammad): ""O people! I have been sent to you only as a plain warner (before the Doom strikes you).""

verses.text: So those who believe and act righteously shall be granted forgiveness and an honourable sustenance
verses.translation: So those who believe and act righteously shall be granted forgiveness and an honourable sustenance

verses.text: whereas those who strive against Our Signs seeking to profane them they are the friends of the Fire!
verses.translation: whereas those who strive against Our Signs seeking to profane them they are the friends of the Fire!

verses.text: Never did We send a Messenger or a Prophet before you (O Muhammad) but that whenever he had a desire Satan interfered with that desire. Allah eradicates the interference of Satan and strengthens His Signs. Allah is All-Knowing All-Wise.
verses.translation: Never did We send a Messenger or a Prophet before you (O Muhammad) but that whenever he had a desire Satan interfered with that desire. Allah eradicates the interference of Satan and strengthens His Signs. Allah is All-Knowing All-Wise.

verses.text: (He does this) in order that He may make the evil caused by Satan a trial for those in whose hearts there is sickness (of hypocrisy) whose hearts are hard (and vitiated). Surely these wrong-doers have gone too far in their dissension.
verses.translation: (He does this) in order that He may make the evil caused by Satan a trial for those in whose hearts there is sickness (of hypocrisy) whose hearts are hard (and vitiated). Surely these wrong-doers have gone too far in their dissension.

verses.text: (He also does this) in order that those endowed with knowledge may know that it is the Truth from your Lord and that they may have faith in it and their hearts may humble themselves before Him. Verily Allah always directs those that believe to the Right Way.
verses.translation: (He also does this) in order that those endowed with knowledge may know that it is the Truth from your Lord and that they may have faith in it and their hearts may humble themselves before Him. Verily Allah always directs those that believe to the Right Way.

verses.text: The unbelievers will not cease to be in doubt about it until the Hour suddenly comes upon them or the chastisement of an ominous day overtakes them.
verses.translation: The unbelievers will not cease to be in doubt about it until the Hour suddenly comes upon them or the chastisement of an ominous day overtakes them.

verses.text: On that Day all sovereignty shall be Allah''s and He will judge among them. Then those who believed and acted righteously shall be in Gardens of Bliss.
verses.translation: On that Day all sovereignty shall be Allah''s and He will judge among them. Then those who believed and acted righteously shall be in Gardens of Bliss.

verses.text: A humiliating chastisement awaits those who disbelieved and denied Our Signs.
verses.translation: A humiliating chastisement awaits those who disbelieved and denied Our Signs.

verses.text: As for those who migrated in the way of Allah whereafter they were slain or died Allah will certainly grant them a goodly provision. Indeed Allah is the Best of all those who provide.
verses.translation: As for those who migrated in the way of Allah whereafter they were slain or died Allah will certainly grant them a goodly provision. Indeed Allah is the Best of all those who provide.

verses.text: He will surely admit them to a resort which will please them. Most certainly Allah is All-Knowing Most Forbearing.
verses.translation: He will surely admit them to a resort which will please them. Most certainly Allah is All-Knowing Most Forbearing.

verses.text: That indeed is so as for him who retaliates in proportion to the excess committed against him and is thereafter again subjected to transgression Allah will surely aid him. Verily Allah is All-Pardoning All-Forgiving.
verses.translation: That indeed is so as for him who retaliates in proportion to the excess committed against him and is thereafter again subjected to transgression Allah will surely aid him. Verily Allah is All-Pardoning All-Forgiving.

verses.text: So shall it be because it is Allah Who causes the night to emerge out of the day and causes the day to emerge out of the night and Allah is All-Hearing All-Seeing.
verses.translation: So shall it be because it is Allah Who causes the night to emerge out of the day and causes the day to emerge out of the night and Allah is All-Hearing All-Seeing.

verses.text: So shall it be because Allah He is the Truth and all whom they invoke instead of Him are false. Allah is Most High All-Great.
verses.translation: So shall it be because Allah He is the Truth and all whom they invoke instead of Him are false. Allah is Most High All-Great.

verses.text: Do you not see that Allah sends down water from the sky whereby the earth turns green? Verily Allah is Subtle All-Aware.
verses.translation: Do you not see that Allah sends down water from the sky whereby the earth turns green? Verily Allah is Subtle All-Aware.

verses.text: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. Surely Allah - He alone is Self- Sufficient Praiseworthy.
verses.translation: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. Surely Allah - He alone is Self- Sufficient Praiseworthy.

verses.text: Have you not seen how Allah has subjected to you all that is in the earth and the vessels that sail in the sea by His command and it is He Who holds back the sky that it may not fall on earth except by His leave? Surely Allah is Most Gentle Ever Compassionate to people.
verses.translation: Have you not seen how Allah has subjected to you all that is in the earth and the vessels that sail in the sea by His command and it is He Who holds back the sky that it may not fall on earth except by His leave? Surely Allah is Most Gentle Ever Compassionate to people.

verses.text: And it is He Who has endowed you with life and it is He who causes you to die and it is He Who will then resurrect you. Man is indeed extremely prone to denying the Truth.
verses.translation: And it is He Who has endowed you with life and it is He who causes you to die and it is He Who will then resurrect you. Man is indeed extremely prone to denying the Truth.

verses.text: For every people We have prescribed a way of worship which they follow. So (O Muhammad) let them not dispute with you concerning this and call them to Your Lord. You are certainly on the Straight Way.
verses.translation: For every people We have prescribed a way of worship which they follow. So (O Muhammad) let them not dispute with you concerning this and call them to Your Lord. You are certainly on the Straight Way.

verses.text: And if they dispute with you say: ""Allah knows well what you do.
verses.translation: And if they dispute with you say: ""Allah knows well what you do.

verses.text: Allah will judge among you on the Day of Resurrection concerning matters about which you disagreed.""
verses.translation: Allah will judge among you on the Day of Resurrection concerning matters about which you disagreed.""

verses.text: Are you not aware that Allah knows all that is in the heaven and the earth? Surely it is all preserved in a Book. Indeed that is easy with Allah.
verses.translation: Are you not aware that Allah knows all that is in the heaven and the earth? Surely it is all preserved in a Book. Indeed that is easy with Allah.

verses.text: Instead of Allah they worship those concerning whom He has revealed no sanction and concerning whom they have no true knowledge. None shall be able to help such evil-doers.
verses.translation: Instead of Allah they worship those concerning whom He has revealed no sanction and concerning whom they have no true knowledge. None shall be able to help such evil-doers.

verses.text: When Our Signs are plainly recited to them you will perceive utter repugnance on their faces and it all but seems as if they will soon pounce upon those who recite Our Signs to them. Say: ""Shall I tell you what is worse than that? The Fire with which Allah has threatened those who disbelieve. That is truly an evil end.""
verses.translation: When Our Signs are plainly recited to them you will perceive utter repugnance on their faces and it all but seems as if they will soon pounce upon those who recite Our Signs to them. Say: ""Shall I tell you what is worse than that? The Fire with which Allah has threatened those who disbelieve. That is truly an evil end.""

verses.text: O people a parable is set forth: pay heed to it. Those who call upon aught other than Allah shall never be able to create even a fly even if all of them were to come together to do that. And if the fly were to snatch away anything from them they would not be able to recover that from it. Powerless is the supplicant; and powerless is he to whom he supplicates.
verses.translation: O people a parable is set forth: pay heed to it. Those who call upon aught other than Allah shall never be able to create even a fly even if all of them were to come together to do that. And if the fly were to snatch away anything from them they would not be able to recover that from it. Powerless is the supplicant; and powerless is he to whom he supplicates.

verses.text: They have not formed a true estimate of Allah. Indeed Allah is All-Powerful All-Mighty.
verses.translation: They have not formed a true estimate of Allah. Indeed Allah is All-Powerful All-Mighty.

verses.text: Allah chooses Messengers from among angels and from among human beings (to convey His command). Allah is All-Hearing All-Seeing.
verses.translation: Allah chooses Messengers from among angels and from among human beings (to convey His command). Allah is All-Hearing All-Seeing.

verses.text: He knows all that is before them and that which is hidden from them. And it is to Allah that all affairs are returned.
verses.translation: He knows all that is before them and that which is hidden from them. And it is to Allah that all affairs are returned.

verses.text: Believers bow down and prostrate yourselves before Your Lord and serve Your Lord and do good that you may prosper.
verses.translation: Believers bow down and prostrate yourselves before Your Lord and serve Your Lord and do good that you may prosper.

verses.text: Strive in the cause of Allah in a manner worthy of that striving. He has chosen you (for His task) and He has not laid upon you any hardship in religion. Keep to the faith of your father Abraham. Allah named you Muslims earlier and even in this (Book) that the Messenger may be a witness over you and that you may be witnesses over all mankind. So establish Prayer and pay Zakah and hold fast to Allah. He is your Protector. What an excellent Protector; what an excellent Helper!
verses.translation: Strive in the cause of Allah in a manner worthy of that striving. He has chosen you (for His task) and He has not laid upon you any hardship in religion. Keep to the faith of your father Abraham. Allah named you Muslims earlier and even in this (Book) that the Messenger may be a witness over you and that you may be witnesses over all mankind. So establish Prayer and pay Zakah and hold fast to Allah. He is your Protector. What an excellent Protector; what an excellent Helper!

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: O mankind fear the (wrath of) your Lord! Indeed the earthquake of the Hour (of Judgement) will be an awesome thing.
ayahs.translation: O mankind fear the (wrath of) your Lord! Indeed the earthquake of the Hour (of Judgement) will be an awesome thing.

ayahs.text: On the Day when you witness it the suckling woman shall utterly neglect the infant she suckles and every pregnant woman shall cast her burden and you will see people as though they are drunk when they are not drunk; but dreadful shall be Allah''s chastisement.
ayahs.translation: On the Day when you witness it the suckling woman shall utterly neglect the infant she suckles and every pregnant woman shall cast her burden and you will see people as though they are drunk when they are not drunk; but dreadful shall be Allah''s chastisement.

ayahs.text: Among people there are some who wrangle about Allah without knowledge and follow every rebellious devil
ayahs.translation: Among people there are some who wrangle about Allah without knowledge and follow every rebellious devil

ayahs.text: although it is decreed about him that he shall lead into error whosoever takes him for a friend and will direct him to the torment of the Fire.
ayahs.translation: although it is decreed about him that he shall lead into error whosoever takes him for a friend and will direct him to the torment of the Fire.

ayahs.text: O mankind! If you have any doubt concerning Resurrection then know that it is surely We Who created you from dust then from a drop of sperm then from a clot of blood then from a little lump of flesh some of it shapely and other shapeless. (We are rehearsing this) that We may make the reality clear to you. We cause (the drop of sperm) that We please to remain in the wombs till an appointed time. We bring you forth as infants (and nurture you) that you may come of age. Among you is he that dies (at a young age) and he who is kept back to the most abject age so that after once having known he reaches a stage when he knows nothing. You see the earth dry and barren and then no sooner than We send down water upon it it begins to quiver and swell and brings forth every kind of beauteous vegetation.
ayahs.translation: O mankind! If you have any doubt concerning Resurrection then know that it is surely We Who created you from dust then from a drop of sperm then from a clot of blood then from a little lump of flesh some of it shapely and other shapeless. (We are rehearsing this) that We may make the reality clear to you. We cause (the drop of sperm) that We please to remain in the wombs till an appointed time. We bring you forth as infants (and nurture you) that you may come of age. Among you is he that dies (at a young age) and he who is kept back to the most abject age so that after once having known he reaches a stage when he knows nothing. You see the earth dry and barren and then no sooner than We send down water upon it it begins to quiver and swell and brings forth every kind of beauteous vegetation.

ayahs.text: All this is because Allah He is the Truth and because He resurrects the dead and because He has power over everything
ayahs.translation: All this is because Allah He is the Truth and because He resurrects the dead and because He has power over everything

ayahs.text: (all of which shows that) the Hour shall surely come to pass - in this there is no doubt - and Allah shall surely resurrect those that are in graves.
ayahs.translation: (all of which shows that) the Hour shall surely come to pass - in this there is no doubt - and Allah shall surely resurrect those that are in graves.

ayahs.text: And among people are those that wrangle about Allah without knowledge without any true guidance and without any scripture to enlighten them.
ayahs.translation: And among people are those that wrangle about Allah without knowledge without any true guidance and without any scripture to enlighten them.

ayahs.text: They wrangle arrogantly intent on leading people astray from the Way of Allah. Such shall suffer disgrace in this world and We shall cause them to taste the chastisement of burning (in the Next).
ayahs.translation: They wrangle arrogantly intent on leading people astray from the Way of Allah. Such shall suffer disgrace in this world and We shall cause them to taste the chastisement of burning (in the Next).

ayahs.text: That is the outcome of what your own hands have wrought for Allah never wrongs His creatures.
ayahs.translation: That is the outcome of what your own hands have wrought for Allah never wrongs His creatures.

ayahs.text: And among people is he who worships Allah on the borderline; if any good befalls him he is satisfied; but if a trial afflicts him he utterly turns away. He will incur the loss of this world and the Hereafter. That indeed is a clear loss.
ayahs.translation: And among people is he who worships Allah on the borderline; if any good befalls him he is satisfied; but if a trial afflicts him he utterly turns away. He will incur the loss of this world and the Hereafter. That indeed is a clear loss.

ayahs.text: He invokes instead of Allah those who can neither harm nor benefit him. That indeed is straying far away.
ayahs.translation: He invokes instead of Allah those who can neither harm nor benefit him. That indeed is straying far away.

ayahs.text: He invokes those that are more likely to cause him harm than benefit. Such is surely an evil patron and an evil associate.
ayahs.translation: He invokes those that are more likely to cause him harm than benefit. Such is surely an evil patron and an evil associate.

ayahs.text: (In contrast) Allah will assuredly cause those who believe and act righteously to enter Gardens beneath which rivers flow. For most certainly Allah does whatever He pleases.
ayahs.translation: (In contrast) Allah will assuredly cause those who believe and act righteously to enter Gardens beneath which rivers flow. For most certainly Allah does whatever He pleases.

ayahs.text: Anyone who fancies that Allah will not support him in this world and in the Hereafter let him reach out to heaven through a rope and then make a hole in the sky and see whether his device can avert that which enrages him.
ayahs.translation: Anyone who fancies that Allah will not support him in this world and in the Hereafter let him reach out to heaven through a rope and then make a hole in the sky and see whether his device can avert that which enrages him.

ayahs.text: Even so We have revealed the Qur''an with Clear Signs. Verily Allah guides whomsoever He wills.
ayahs.translation: Even so We have revealed the Qur''an with Clear Signs. Verily Allah guides whomsoever He wills.

ayahs.text: On the Day of Resurrection Allah will most certainly judge among those who believe and those who became Jews and Sabaeans and Christians and Magians and those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity. Surely Allah watches over everything.
ayahs.translation: On the Day of Resurrection Allah will most certainly judge among those who believe and those who became Jews and Sabaeans and Christians and Magians and those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity. Surely Allah watches over everything.

ayahs.text: Have you not seen that all those who are in the heavens and all those who are in the earth prostrate themselves before Allah; and so do the sun and the moon and the stars and the mountains and the trees and the beasts and so do many human beings and even many of those who are condemned to chastisement? And he whom Allah humiliates none can give him honour. Allah does whatever He wills.
ayahs.translation: Have you not seen that all those who are in the heavens and all those who are in the earth prostrate themselves before Allah; and so do the sun and the moon and the stars and the mountains and the trees and the beasts and so do many human beings and even many of those who are condemned to chastisement? And he whom Allah humiliates none can give him honour. Allah does whatever He wills.

ayahs.text: These two groups (-the believers and unbelievers-) are in dispute about their Lord. As for those that disbelieve garments of fire have been cut out for them; boiling water shall be poured down over their heads
ayahs.translation: These two groups (-the believers and unbelievers-) are in dispute about their Lord. As for those that disbelieve garments of fire have been cut out for them; boiling water shall be poured down over their heads

ayahs.text: causing (not only) their skins but all that is in their bellies as well to melt away.
ayahs.translation: causing (not only) their skins but all that is in their bellies as well to melt away.

ayahs.text: There shall be maces of iron to lash them.
ayahs.translation: There shall be maces of iron to lash them.

ayahs.text: Whenever they try in their anguish to escape from Hell they will be driven back into it (and shall be told): ""Now taste the torment of burning.""
ayahs.translation: Whenever they try in their anguish to escape from Hell they will be driven back into it (and shall be told): ""Now taste the torment of burning.""

ayahs.text: (On the other hand) Allah will cause those who believed and acted righteously to enter the Gardens beneath which rivers flow. They shall be decked in them with bracelets of gold and pearls and their raiment shall be of silk.
ayahs.translation: (On the other hand) Allah will cause those who believed and acted righteously to enter the Gardens beneath which rivers flow. They shall be decked in them with bracelets of gold and pearls and their raiment shall be of silk.

ayahs.text: They were guided (to accept) the pure word; they were guided to the Way of the Praiseworthy (Lord).
ayahs.translation: They were guided (to accept) the pure word; they were guided to the Way of the Praiseworthy (Lord).

ayahs.text: Indeed those who disbelieve and who (now) hinder people from the Way of Allah and hinder them from the Holy Mosque which We have set up (as a place of worship) for all people equally for those who dwell therein and for those who come from outside (they surely deserve punishment). Whosoever deviates therein from the Right Way and acts with iniquity We shall cause him to taste a painful chastisement.
ayahs.translation: Indeed those who disbelieve and who (now) hinder people from the Way of Allah and hinder them from the Holy Mosque which We have set up (as a place of worship) for all people equally for those who dwell therein and for those who come from outside (they surely deserve punishment). Whosoever deviates therein from the Right Way and acts with iniquity We shall cause him to taste a painful chastisement.

ayahs.text: Call to mind when We assigned to Abraham the site of the House (Kabah) directing him: ""Do not associate aught with Me"" and ""Keep My House pure for those who walk around it and for those who stand and who bow down and who prostrate themselves (in worship)
ayahs.translation: Call to mind when We assigned to Abraham the site of the House (Kabah) directing him: ""Do not associate aught with Me"" and ""Keep My House pure for those who walk around it and for those who stand and who bow down and who prostrate themselves (in worship)

ayahs.text: and publicly proclaim Pilgrimage for all mankind so that they come to you on foot and mounted on lean camels from every distant point
ayahs.translation: and publicly proclaim Pilgrimage for all mankind so that they come to you on foot and mounted on lean camels from every distant point

ayahs.text: to witness the benefits in store for them and pronounce the name of Allah during the appointed days over the cattle that He has provided them. So eat of it and feed the distressed and the needy.
ayahs.translation: to witness the benefits in store for them and pronounce the name of Allah during the appointed days over the cattle that He has provided them. So eat of it and feed the distressed and the needy.

ayahs.text: Thereafter let them tidy up and fulfil their vows and circumambulate the Ancient House.""
ayahs.translation: Thereafter let them tidy up and fulfil their vows and circumambulate the Ancient House.""

ayahs.text: Such (was the purpose of building the Kabah). Whosoever then venerates Allah''s sanctities will find it to be good for him in the sight of his Lord. Cattle have been made lawful for you except those mentioned to you (as unlawful). So shun the abomination of idols and shun all words of falsehood.
ayahs.translation: Such (was the purpose of building the Kabah). Whosoever then venerates Allah''s sanctities will find it to be good for him in the sight of his Lord. Cattle have been made lawful for you except those mentioned to you (as unlawful). So shun the abomination of idols and shun all words of falsehood.

ayahs.text: Become exclusively devoted to Allah ascribing Divinity to none other than Him. Whoso ascribes Divinity to aught beside Allah it is as though he fell down from the sky whereafter either the birds will snatch him away or the wind will sweep him to a distant place (causing him to be shattered to pieces).
ayahs.translation: Become exclusively devoted to Allah ascribing Divinity to none other than Him. Whoso ascribes Divinity to aught beside Allah it is as though he fell down from the sky whereafter either the birds will snatch him away or the wind will sweep him to a distant place (causing him to be shattered to pieces).

ayahs.text: Such is the fact. And whoso venerates the sanctity of all that have been ordained as symbols of Allah surely does so because it is part of the true piety of the hearts.
ayahs.translation: Such is the fact. And whoso venerates the sanctity of all that have been ordained as symbols of Allah surely does so because it is part of the true piety of the hearts.

ayahs.text: You may derive benefit (from sacrificial animals) until an appointed time. Thereafter their place (of sacrifice) is near the Ancient House.
ayahs.translation: You may derive benefit (from sacrificial animals) until an appointed time. Thereafter their place (of sacrifice) is near the Ancient House.

ayahs.text: For every people We have laid down a ritual of sacrifice (- although the purpose of the ritual is the same -) that they pronounce the name of Allah over the cattle He has provided them. Your Lord is One God; so submit yourselves to Him alone. And give (O Prophet) glad tidings to those that humble themselves (before Allah)
ayahs.translation: For every people We have laid down a ritual of sacrifice (- although the purpose of the ritual is the same -) that they pronounce the name of Allah over the cattle He has provided them. Your Lord is One God; so submit yourselves to Him alone. And give (O Prophet) glad tidings to those that humble themselves (before Allah)

ayahs.text: whose hearts shiver whenever Allah is mentioned who patiently bear whatever affliction comes to them who establish Prayer and who spend (for good purposes) out of what We have provided them.
ayahs.translation: whose hearts shiver whenever Allah is mentioned who patiently bear whatever affliction comes to them who establish Prayer and who spend (for good purposes) out of what We have provided them.

ayahs.text: We have appointed sacrificial camels among the symbols of (devotion to) Allah. There is much good in them for you. So make them stand (at the time of sacrifice) and pronounce the name of Allah over them and when they fall down on their sides(after they are slaughtered) eat and also feed them who do not ask and those who ask. Thus have We subjected these animals that you may give thanks.
ayahs.translation: We have appointed sacrificial camels among the symbols of (devotion to) Allah. There is much good in them for you. So make them stand (at the time of sacrifice) and pronounce the name of Allah over them and when they fall down on their sides(after they are slaughtered) eat and also feed them who do not ask and those who ask. Thus have We subjected these animals that you may give thanks.

ayahs.text: Neither their flesh reaches Allah nor their blood; it is your piety that reaches Him. He has subjected these animals (to you) that you may magnify Allah for the guidance He has bestowed upon you. Give glad tidings (O Prophet) to those who do good.
ayahs.translation: Neither their flesh reaches Allah nor their blood; it is your piety that reaches Him. He has subjected these animals (to you) that you may magnify Allah for the guidance He has bestowed upon you. Give glad tidings (O Prophet) to those who do good.

ayahs.text: Surely Allah defends those who believe. Certainly Allah has no love for the perfidious the thankless.
ayahs.translation: Surely Allah defends those who believe. Certainly Allah has no love for the perfidious the thankless.

ayahs.text: Permission (to fight) has been granted to those for they have been wronged. Verily Allah has the power to help them:
ayahs.translation: Permission (to fight) has been granted to those for they have been wronged. Verily Allah has the power to help them:

ayahs.text: those who were unjustly expelled from their homes for no other reason than their saying: ""Allah is Our Lord."" If Allah were not to repel some through others monasteries and churches and synagogues and mosques wherein the name of Allah is much mentioned would certainly have been pulled down. Allah will most certainly help those who will help Him. Verily Allah is Immensely Strong Overwhelmingly Mighty.
ayahs.translation: those who were unjustly expelled from their homes for no other reason than their saying: ""Allah is Our Lord."" If Allah were not to repel some through others monasteries and churches and synagogues and mosques wherein the name of Allah is much mentioned would certainly have been pulled down. Allah will most certainly help those who will help Him. Verily Allah is Immensely Strong Overwhelmingly Mighty.

ayahs.text: (Allah will certainly help) those who were We to bestow authority on them in the land will establish Prayers render Zakah enjoin good and forbid evil. The end of all matters rests with Allah.
ayahs.translation: (Allah will certainly help) those who were We to bestow authority on them in the land will establish Prayers render Zakah enjoin good and forbid evil. The end of all matters rests with Allah.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) if they give the lie to you then before them the people of Noah ''Ad and Thamud also gave the lie (to the Prophets)
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) if they give the lie to you then before them the people of Noah ''Ad and Thamud also gave the lie (to the Prophets)

ayahs.text: and so too did the people of Abraham and the people of Lot;
ayahs.translation: and so too did the people of Abraham and the people of Lot;

ayahs.text: and so did the dwellers of Midian and Moses too was branded a liar. Initially I granted respite to the unbelievers for a while and then seized them. How dreadful was My punishment!
ayahs.translation: and so did the dwellers of Midian and Moses too was branded a liar. Initially I granted respite to the unbelievers for a while and then seized them. How dreadful was My punishment!

ayahs.text: How many towns have We destroyed because their people were steeped in iniquity: so they lie fallen down upon their turrets! How many wells lie deserted; and how many towering palaces lie in ruins!
ayahs.translation: How many towns have We destroyed because their people were steeped in iniquity: so they lie fallen down upon their turrets! How many wells lie deserted; and how many towering palaces lie in ruins!

ayahs.text: Have they not journeyed in the land that their hearts might understand and their ears might listen? For indeed it is not the eyes that are blinded; it is rather the hearts in the breasts that are rendered blind.
ayahs.translation: Have they not journeyed in the land that their hearts might understand and their ears might listen? For indeed it is not the eyes that are blinded; it is rather the hearts in the breasts that are rendered blind.

ayahs.text: They ask you to hasten the punishment. Allah shall most certainly not fail His promise; but a Day with your Lord is as a thousand years of your reckoning.
ayahs.translation: They ask you to hasten the punishment. Allah shall most certainly not fail His promise; but a Day with your Lord is as a thousand years of your reckoning.

ayahs.text: How many towns did I respite at first though they were steeped in iniquity and then I seized them! To Me are all destined to return.
ayahs.translation: How many towns did I respite at first though they were steeped in iniquity and then I seized them! To Me are all destined to return.

ayahs.text: Say (O Muhammad): ""O people! I have been sent to you only as a plain warner (before the Doom strikes you).""
ayahs.translation: Say (O Muhammad): ""O people! I have been sent to you only as a plain warner (before the Doom strikes you).""

ayahs.text: So those who believe and act righteously shall be granted forgiveness and an honourable sustenance
ayahs.translation: So those who believe and act righteously shall be granted forgiveness and an honourable sustenance

ayahs.text: whereas those who strive against Our Signs seeking to profane them they are the friends of the Fire!
ayahs.translation: whereas those who strive against Our Signs seeking to profane them they are the friends of the Fire!

ayahs.text: Never did We send a Messenger or a Prophet before you (O Muhammad) but that whenever he had a desire Satan interfered with that desire. Allah eradicates the interference of Satan and strengthens His Signs. Allah is All-Knowing All-Wise.
ayahs.translation: Never did We send a Messenger or a Prophet before you (O Muhammad) but that whenever he had a desire Satan interfered with that desire. Allah eradicates the interference of Satan and strengthens His Signs. Allah is All-Knowing All-Wise.

ayahs.text: (He does this) in order that He may make the evil caused by Satan a trial for those in whose hearts there is sickness (of hypocrisy) whose hearts are hard (and vitiated). Surely these wrong-doers have gone too far in their dissension.
ayahs.translation: (He does this) in order that He may make the evil caused by Satan a trial for those in whose hearts there is sickness (of hypocrisy) whose hearts are hard (and vitiated). Surely these wrong-doers have gone too far in their dissension.

ayahs.text: (He also does this) in order that those endowed with knowledge may know that it is the Truth from your Lord and that they may have faith in it and their hearts may humble themselves before Him. Verily Allah always directs those that believe to the Right Way.
ayahs.translation: (He also does this) in order that those endowed with knowledge may know that it is the Truth from your Lord and that they may have faith in it and their hearts may humble themselves before Him. Verily Allah always directs those that believe to the Right Way.

ayahs.text: The unbelievers will not cease to be in doubt about it until the Hour suddenly comes upon them or the chastisement of an ominous day overtakes them.
ayahs.translation: The unbelievers will not cease to be in doubt about it until the Hour suddenly comes upon them or the chastisement of an ominous day overtakes them.

ayahs.text: On that Day all sovereignty shall be Allah''s and He will judge among them. Then those who believed and acted righteously shall be in Gardens of Bliss.
ayahs.translation: On that Day all sovereignty shall be Allah''s and He will judge among them. Then those who believed and acted righteously shall be in Gardens of Bliss.

ayahs.text: A humiliating chastisement awaits those who disbelieved and denied Our Signs.
ayahs.translation: A humiliating chastisement awaits those who disbelieved and denied Our Signs.

ayahs.text: As for those who migrated in the way of Allah whereafter they were slain or died Allah will certainly grant them a goodly provision. Indeed Allah is the Best of all those who provide.
ayahs.translation: As for those who migrated in the way of Allah whereafter they were slain or died Allah will certainly grant them a goodly provision. Indeed Allah is the Best of all those who provide.

ayahs.text: He will surely admit them to a resort which will please them. Most certainly Allah is All-Knowing Most Forbearing.
ayahs.translation: He will surely admit them to a resort which will please them. Most certainly Allah is All-Knowing Most Forbearing.

ayahs.text: That indeed is so as for him who retaliates in proportion to the excess committed against him and is thereafter again subjected to transgression Allah will surely aid him. Verily Allah is All-Pardoning All-Forgiving.
ayahs.translation: That indeed is so as for him who retaliates in proportion to the excess committed against him and is thereafter again subjected to transgression Allah will surely aid him. Verily Allah is All-Pardoning All-Forgiving.

ayahs.text: So shall it be because it is Allah Who causes the night to emerge out of the day and causes the day to emerge out of the night and Allah is All-Hearing All-Seeing.
ayahs.translation: So shall it be because it is Allah Who causes the night to emerge out of the day and causes the day to emerge out of the night and Allah is All-Hearing All-Seeing.

ayahs.text: So shall it be because Allah He is the Truth and all whom they invoke instead of Him are false. Allah is Most High All-Great.
ayahs.translation: So shall it be because Allah He is the Truth and all whom they invoke instead of Him are false. Allah is Most High All-Great.

ayahs.text: Do you not see that Allah sends down water from the sky whereby the earth turns green? Verily Allah is Subtle All-Aware.
ayahs.translation: Do you not see that Allah sends down water from the sky whereby the earth turns green? Verily Allah is Subtle All-Aware.

ayahs.text: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. Surely Allah - He alone is Self- Sufficient Praiseworthy.
ayahs.translation: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. Surely Allah - He alone is Self- Sufficient Praiseworthy.

ayahs.text: Have you not seen how Allah has subjected to you all that is in the earth and the vessels that sail in the sea by His command and it is He Who holds back the sky that it may not fall on earth except by His leave? Surely Allah is Most Gentle Ever Compassionate to people.
ayahs.translation: Have you not seen how Allah has subjected to you all that is in the earth and the vessels that sail in the sea by His command and it is He Who holds back the sky that it may not fall on earth except by His leave? Surely Allah is Most Gentle Ever Compassionate to people.

ayahs.text: And it is He Who has endowed you with life and it is He who causes you to die and it is He Who will then resurrect you. Man is indeed extremely prone to denying the Truth.
ayahs.translation: And it is He Who has endowed you with life and it is He who causes you to die and it is He Who will then resurrect you. Man is indeed extremely prone to denying the Truth.

ayahs.text: For every people We have prescribed a way of worship which they follow. So (O Muhammad) let them not dispute with you concerning this and call them to Your Lord. You are certainly on the Straight Way.
ayahs.translation: For every people We have prescribed a way of worship which they follow. So (O Muhammad) let them not dispute with you concerning this and call them to Your Lord. You are certainly on the Straight Way.

ayahs.text: And if they dispute with you say: ""Allah knows well what you do.
ayahs.translation: And if they dispute with you say: ""Allah knows well what you do.

ayahs.text: Allah will judge among you on the Day of Resurrection concerning matters about which you disagreed.""
ayahs.translation: Allah will judge among you on the Day of Resurrection concerning matters about which you disagreed.""

ayahs.text: Are you not aware that Allah knows all that is in the heaven and the earth? Surely it is all preserved in a Book. Indeed that is easy with Allah.
ayahs.translation: Are you not aware that Allah knows all that is in the heaven and the earth? Surely it is all preserved in a Book. Indeed that is easy with Allah.

ayahs.text: Instead of Allah they worship those concerning whom He has revealed no sanction and concerning whom they have no true knowledge. None shall be able to help such evil-doers.
ayahs.translation: Instead of Allah they worship those concerning whom He has revealed no sanction and concerning whom they have no true knowledge. None shall be able to help such evil-doers.

ayahs.text: When Our Signs are plainly recited to them you will perceive utter repugnance on their faces and it all but seems as if they will soon pounce upon those who recite Our Signs to them. Say: ""Shall I tell you what is worse than that? The Fire with which Allah has threatened those who disbelieve. That is truly an evil end.""
ayahs.translation: When Our Signs are plainly recited to them you will perceive utter repugnance on their faces and it all but seems as if they will soon pounce upon those who recite Our Signs to them. Say: ""Shall I tell you what is worse than that? The Fire with which Allah has threatened those who disbelieve. That is truly an evil end.""

ayahs.text: O people a parable is set forth: pay heed to it. Those who call upon aught other than Allah shall never be able to create even a fly even if all of them were to come together to do that. And if the fly were to snatch away anything from them they would not be able to recover that from it. Powerless is the supplicant; and powerless is he to whom he supplicates.
ayahs.translation: O people a parable is set forth: pay heed to it. Those who call upon aught other than Allah shall never be able to create even a fly even if all of them were to come together to do that. And if the fly were to snatch away anything from them they would not be able to recover that from it. Powerless is the supplicant; and powerless is he to whom he supplicates.

ayahs.text: They have not formed a true estimate of Allah. Indeed Allah is All-Powerful All-Mighty.
ayahs.translation: They have not formed a true estimate of Allah. Indeed Allah is All-Powerful All-Mighty.

ayahs.text: Allah chooses Messengers from among angels and from among human beings (to convey His command). Allah is All-Hearing All-Seeing.
ayahs.translation: Allah chooses Messengers from among angels and from among human beings (to convey His command). Allah is All-Hearing All-Seeing.

ayahs.text: He knows all that is before them and that which is hidden from them. And it is to Allah that all affairs are returned.
ayahs.translation: He knows all that is before them and that which is hidden from them. And it is to Allah that all affairs are returned.

ayahs.text: Believers bow down and prostrate yourselves before Your Lord and serve Your Lord and do good that you may prosper.
ayahs.translation: Believers bow down and prostrate yourselves before Your Lord and serve Your Lord and do good that you may prosper.

ayahs.text: Strive in the cause of Allah in a manner worthy of that striving. He has chosen you (for His task) and He has not laid upon you any hardship in religion. Keep to the faith of your father Abraham. Allah named you Muslims earlier and even in this (Book) that the Messenger may be a witness over you and that you may be witnesses over all mankind. So establish Prayer and pay Zakah and hold fast to Allah. He is your Protector. What an excellent Protector; what an excellent Helper!
ayahs.translation: Strive in the cause of Allah in a manner worthy of that striving. He has chosen you (for His task) and He has not laid upon you any hardship in religion. Keep to the faith of your father Abraham. Allah named you Muslims earlier and even in this (Book) that the Messenger may be a witness over you and that you may be witnesses over all mankind. So establish Prayer and pay Zakah and hold fast to Allah. He is your Protector. What an excellent Protector; what an excellent Helper!

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: The believers have indeed attained true success:
verses.translation: The believers have indeed attained true success:

verses.text: those who in their Prayers humble themselves;
verses.translation: those who in their Prayers humble themselves;

verses.text: who avoid whatever is vain and frivolous;
verses.translation: who avoid whatever is vain and frivolous;

verses.text: who observe Zakah;
verses.translation: who observe Zakah;

verses.text: who strictly guard their private parts
verses.translation: who strictly guard their private parts

verses.text: save from their wives or those whom their right hands possess; for with regard to them they are free from blame -""
verses.translation: save from their wives or those whom their right hands possess; for with regard to them they are free from blame -""

verses.text: As for those who seek beyond that they are transgressors -
verses.translation: As for those who seek beyond that they are transgressors -

verses.text: who are true to their trusts and their covenants
verses.translation: who are true to their trusts and their covenants

verses.text: and who guard their Prayers.
verses.translation: and who guard their Prayers.

verses.text: Such are the inheritors
verses.translation: Such are the inheritors

verses.text: that shall inherit Paradise; and in it they shall abide for ever.
verses.translation: that shall inherit Paradise; and in it they shall abide for ever.

verses.text: We created man out of the extract of clay
verses.translation: We created man out of the extract of clay

verses.text: then We made him into a drop of life-germ then We placed it in a safe depository
verses.translation: then We made him into a drop of life-germ then We placed it in a safe depository

verses.text: then We made this drop into a clot then We made the clot into a lump then We made the lump into bones then We clothed the bones with flesh and then We caused it to grow into another creation. Thus Most Blessed is Allah the Best of all those that create.
verses.translation: then We made this drop into a clot then We made the clot into a lump then We made the lump into bones then We clothed the bones with flesh and then We caused it to grow into another creation. Thus Most Blessed is Allah the Best of all those that create.

verses.text: Thereafter you are destined to die
verses.translation: Thereafter you are destined to die

verses.text: and then on the Day of Resurrection you shall certainly be raised up.
verses.translation: and then on the Day of Resurrection you shall certainly be raised up.

verses.text: We have indeed fashioned above you seven paths. Never were We unaware of the task of creation.
verses.translation: We have indeed fashioned above you seven paths. Never were We unaware of the task of creation.

verses.text: We sent down water from the sky in right measure and caused it to stay in the earth and We have the power to cause it to vanish (in the manner We please).
verses.translation: We sent down water from the sky in right measure and caused it to stay in the earth and We have the power to cause it to vanish (in the manner We please).

verses.text: Then through water We caused gardens of date-palms and vines to grow for you wherein you have an abundance of delicious fruits and from them you derive your livelihood.
verses.translation: Then through water We caused gardens of date-palms and vines to grow for you wherein you have an abundance of delicious fruits and from them you derive your livelihood.

verses.text: And We also produced the tree which springs forth from Mount Sinai containing oil and sauce for those that eat.
verses.translation: And We also produced the tree which springs forth from Mount Sinai containing oil and sauce for those that eat.

verses.text: And indeed there is also a lesson for you in cattle. We provide you with drink out of what they have in their bellies; and you have many other benefits in them: you eat of them
verses.translation: And indeed there is also a lesson for you in cattle. We provide you with drink out of what they have in their bellies; and you have many other benefits in them: you eat of them

verses.text: and are carried on them and also on ships.
verses.translation: and are carried on them and also on ships.

verses.text: We sent Noah to his people and he said: ""My people! Serve Allah; you have no deity other than He. Do you have no fear?""
verses.translation: We sent Noah to his people and he said: ""My people! Serve Allah; you have no deity other than He. Do you have no fear?""

verses.text: But the notables among his people had refused to believe and said: ""This is none other than a mortal like yourselves who desires to attain superiority over you. Had Allah wanted (to send any Messengers) He would have sent down angels. We have heard nothing like this in the time of our forebears of old (that humans were sent as Messengers).
verses.translation: But the notables among his people had refused to believe and said: ""This is none other than a mortal like yourselves who desires to attain superiority over you. Had Allah wanted (to send any Messengers) He would have sent down angels. We have heard nothing like this in the time of our forebears of old (that humans were sent as Messengers).

verses.text: He is a person who has been seized with a little madness; so wait for a while (perhaps he will improve).""
verses.translation: He is a person who has been seized with a little madness; so wait for a while (perhaps he will improve).""

verses.text: Noah said: ""My Lord! Come to my help at their accusation that I am lying.""
verses.translation: Noah said: ""My Lord! Come to my help at their accusation that I am lying.""

verses.text: Thereupon We revealed to him saying: ""Build the Ark under Our eyes and according to Our revelation. And when Our command comes to pass and the oven boils over take on board a pair each from every species and also take your household except those of them against whom sentence has already been passed and do not plead to Me on behalf of the wrong-doers. They are doomed to be drowned.
verses.translation: Thereupon We revealed to him saying: ""Build the Ark under Our eyes and according to Our revelation. And when Our command comes to pass and the oven boils over take on board a pair each from every species and also take your household except those of them against whom sentence has already been passed and do not plead to Me on behalf of the wrong-doers. They are doomed to be drowned.

verses.text: And then when you and those accompanying you are firmly seated in the Ark say: ""Thanks be to Allah Who has delivered us from the wrong-doing people.""
verses.translation: And then when you and those accompanying you are firmly seated in the Ark say: ""Thanks be to Allah Who has delivered us from the wrong-doing people.""

verses.text: And say: ""My Lord! Make my landing a blessed landing for You are the Best of those Who can cause people to land in safety.""
verses.translation: And say: ""My Lord! Make my landing a blessed landing for You are the Best of those Who can cause people to land in safety.""

verses.text: There are great Signs in this story; and surely We do put people to test.
verses.translation: There are great Signs in this story; and surely We do put people to test.

verses.text: Then after them We brought forth another generation;
verses.translation: Then after them We brought forth another generation;

verses.text: and We sent among them a Messenger from among themselves saying: ""Serve Allah; you have no god other than He. Do you have no fear?""
verses.translation: and We sent among them a Messenger from among themselves saying: ""Serve Allah; you have no god other than He. Do you have no fear?""

verses.text: The notables among his people who had refused to believe and who denied the meeting of the Hereafter and those whom We had endowed with ease and comfort in this life cried out: ""This is no other than a mortal like yourselves who eats what you eat and drinks what you drink.
verses.translation: The notables among his people who had refused to believe and who denied the meeting of the Hereafter and those whom We had endowed with ease and comfort in this life cried out: ""This is no other than a mortal like yourselves who eats what you eat and drinks what you drink.

verses.text: If you were to obey a human being like yourselves you will certainly be losers.
verses.translation: If you were to obey a human being like yourselves you will certainly be losers.

verses.text: Does he promise you that when you are dead and are reduced to dust and bones you will be brought forth to life?
verses.translation: Does he promise you that when you are dead and are reduced to dust and bones you will be brought forth to life?

verses.text: Far-fetched utterly far-fetched is what you are being promised.
verses.translation: Far-fetched utterly far-fetched is what you are being promised.

verses.text: There is no other life than the life of the world. We shall live here and here shall we die; and we are not going to be raised again.
verses.translation: There is no other life than the life of the world. We shall live here and here shall we die; and we are not going to be raised again.

verses.text: This man has forged a mere lie in the name of Allah and we shall never believe what he says.""
verses.translation: This man has forged a mere lie in the name of Allah and we shall never believe what he says.""

verses.text: The Messenger said: ""My Lord! Come to my help at their accusing me of lying.""
verses.translation: The Messenger said: ""My Lord! Come to my help at their accusing me of lying.""

verses.text: He answered: ""A short while and they shall be repenting.""
verses.translation: He answered: ""A short while and they shall be repenting.""

verses.text: Then a mighty blast quite justly overtook them and We reduced them to a rubble. So away with the wrong-doing folk!
verses.translation: Then a mighty blast quite justly overtook them and We reduced them to a rubble. So away with the wrong-doing folk!

verses.text: Then after them We brought forth other generations.
verses.translation: Then after them We brought forth other generations.

verses.text: No nation can outstrip its term nor can it put it back.
verses.translation: No nation can outstrip its term nor can it put it back.

verses.text: Then We sent Our Messengers in succession. Whenever a Messenger came to his people they rejected him calling him a liar. Thereupon We made each people to follow the other (to its doom) reducing them to mere tales (of the past). Scourged be the people who do not believe!
verses.translation: Then We sent Our Messengers in succession. Whenever a Messenger came to his people they rejected him calling him a liar. Thereupon We made each people to follow the other (to its doom) reducing them to mere tales (of the past). Scourged be the people who do not believe!

verses.text: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our Signs and a clear authority
verses.translation: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our Signs and a clear authority

verses.text: to Pharaoh and to his chiefs but they behaved superciliously and they were haughty.
verses.translation: to Pharaoh and to his chiefs but they behaved superciliously and they were haughty.

verses.text: They said: ""Shall we put faith in two mortals like ourselves when their people are slaves to us?""
verses.translation: They said: ""Shall we put faith in two mortals like ourselves when their people are slaves to us?""

verses.text: So they rejected them calling them liars and they too eventually became of those that were destroyed.
verses.translation: So they rejected them calling them liars and they too eventually became of those that were destroyed.

verses.text: And We gave Moses the Book that people might be guided by it.
verses.translation: And We gave Moses the Book that people might be guided by it.

verses.text: And We made Mary''s son and his mother a Sign and We gave them refuge on a lofty ground a peaceful site with springs flowing in it.
verses.translation: And We made Mary''s son and his mother a Sign and We gave them refuge on a lofty ground a peaceful site with springs flowing in it.

verses.text: Messengers! Partake of the things that are clean and act righteously. I know well all that you do.
verses.translation: Messengers! Partake of the things that are clean and act righteously. I know well all that you do.

verses.text: This community of yours is one community and I am your Lord; so hold Me alone in fear.
verses.translation: This community of yours is one community and I am your Lord; so hold Me alone in fear.

verses.text: But people later cut up their religion into bits each group rejoicing in what they have.
verses.translation: But people later cut up their religion into bits each group rejoicing in what they have.

verses.text: So leave them immersed in their heedlessness till an appointed time.
verses.translation: So leave them immersed in their heedlessness till an appointed time.

verses.text: Do they fancy that Our continuing to give them wealth and children (means) that
verses.translation: Do they fancy that Our continuing to give them wealth and children (means) that

verses.text: We are busy lavishing on them all kinds of good? Nay they do not perceive the reality of the matter.
verses.translation: We are busy lavishing on them all kinds of good? Nay they do not perceive the reality of the matter.

verses.text: Surely those who stand in awe for fear of their Lord
verses.translation: Surely those who stand in awe for fear of their Lord

verses.text: who have full faith in the Signs of their Lord;
verses.translation: who have full faith in the Signs of their Lord;

verses.text: who associate none with their Lord in His Divinity
verses.translation: who associate none with their Lord in His Divinity

verses.text: who give whatever they give in charity with their hearts trembling at the thought that they are destined to return to their Lord;
verses.translation: who give whatever they give in charity with their hearts trembling at the thought that they are destined to return to their Lord;

verses.text: it is these who hasten to do good works and vie in so doing with one another.
verses.translation: it is these who hasten to do good works and vie in so doing with one another.

verses.text: We do not lay a burden on anyone beyond his capacity. We have a Book with Us that speaks the truth (about everyone); and they shall in no wise be wronged.
verses.translation: We do not lay a burden on anyone beyond his capacity. We have a Book with Us that speaks the truth (about everyone); and they shall in no wise be wronged.

verses.text: Nay their hearts are lost in ignorance of all this; and their deeds too vary from the way (mentioned above). They will persist in these deeds
verses.translation: Nay their hearts are lost in ignorance of all this; and their deeds too vary from the way (mentioned above). They will persist in these deeds

verses.text: until We seize with Our chastisement those of them that are given to luxuriant ways. They will then begin to groan.
verses.translation: until We seize with Our chastisement those of them that are given to luxuriant ways. They will then begin to groan.

verses.text: Put a stop to your groaning now! Surely no help shall be provided to you from Us.
verses.translation: Put a stop to your groaning now! Surely no help shall be provided to you from Us.

verses.text: My Signs were rehearsed to you and you turned back on your heels and took to flight
verses.translation: My Signs were rehearsed to you and you turned back on your heels and took to flight

verses.text: behaving arrogantly and making fun and talking nonsense (about the Book in your nightly chats).""
verses.translation: behaving arrogantly and making fun and talking nonsense (about the Book in your nightly chats).""

verses.text: Did they never ponder over this Word (of God)? Or has he (to wit the Messenger) brought something the like of which did not come to their forefathers of yore?
verses.translation: Did they never ponder over this Word (of God)? Or has he (to wit the Messenger) brought something the like of which did not come to their forefathers of yore?

verses.text: Or is it that they were unaware of their Messenger and were therefore repelled by him for he was a stranger to them?
verses.translation: Or is it that they were unaware of their Messenger and were therefore repelled by him for he was a stranger to them?

verses.text: Or do they say that there is madness in him? Nay he has brought them the Truth and it is the Truth that most of them disdain.
verses.translation: Or do they say that there is madness in him? Nay he has brought them the Truth and it is the Truth that most of them disdain.

verses.text: Were the Truth to follow their desires the order of the heavens and the earth and those who dwell in them would have been ruined. Nay the fact is that We have brought to them their own remembrance; and yet it is from their own remembrance that they are turning away.
