ayahs.text: Were it not for Allah''s Bounty and His Mercy unto you and that Allah is Most Forgiving and Wise (the evil that had been spread among you would have led to terrible consequences).
ayahs.translation: Were it not for Allah''s Bounty and His Mercy unto you and that Allah is Most Forgiving and Wise (the evil that had been spread among you would have led to terrible consequences).

ayahs.text: Believers! Do not follow in Satan''s footsteps. Let him who follows in Satan''s footsteps (remember that) Satan bids people to indecency and evil. Were it not for Allah''s Bounty and His Mercy unto you not one of you would have ever attained purity. But Allah enables whomsoever He wills to attain purity. Allah is All- Hearing All-Knowing.
ayahs.translation: Believers! Do not follow in Satan''s footsteps. Let him who follows in Satan''s footsteps (remember that) Satan bids people to indecency and evil. Were it not for Allah''s Bounty and His Mercy unto you not one of you would have ever attained purity. But Allah enables whomsoever He wills to attain purity. Allah is All- Hearing All-Knowing.

ayahs.text: Let those among you who are bounteous and resourceful not swear to withhold giving to the kindred to the needy and to those who have forsaken their homes in the cause of Allah; rather let them forgive and forbear. Do you not wish that Allah should forgive you? Allah is Ever Forgiving Most Merciful.
ayahs.translation: Let those among you who are bounteous and resourceful not swear to withhold giving to the kindred to the needy and to those who have forsaken their homes in the cause of Allah; rather let them forgive and forbear. Do you not wish that Allah should forgive you? Allah is Ever Forgiving Most Merciful.

ayahs.text: Those that accuse chaste unwary believing women have been cursed in the world and the Hereafter and a mighty chastisement awaits them.
ayahs.translation: Those that accuse chaste unwary believing women have been cursed in the world and the Hereafter and a mighty chastisement awaits them.

ayahs.text: (Let them not be heedless of) the Day when their own tongues their hands and their feet shall all bear witness against them as to what they have been doing.
ayahs.translation: (Let them not be heedless of) the Day when their own tongues their hands and their feet shall all bear witness against them as to what they have been doing.

ayahs.text: On that Day Allah will justly requite them and they will come to know that Allah - and He alone - is the Truth the One Who makes the Truth manifest.
ayahs.translation: On that Day Allah will justly requite them and they will come to know that Allah - and He alone - is the Truth the One Who makes the Truth manifest.

ayahs.text: Corrupt women are for corrupt men and corrupt men for corrupt women. Good women are for good men and good men for good women. They are innocent of the calumnies people utter. There shall be forgiveness for them and a generous provision.
ayahs.translation: Corrupt women are for corrupt men and corrupt men for corrupt women. Good women are for good men and good men for good women. They are innocent of the calumnies people utter. There shall be forgiveness for them and a generous provision.

ayahs.text: Believers! Enter not houses other than your own houses until you have obtained the permission of the inmates of those houses and have greeted them with peace. This is better for you. It is expected that you will observe this.
ayahs.translation: Believers! Enter not houses other than your own houses until you have obtained the permission of the inmates of those houses and have greeted them with peace. This is better for you. It is expected that you will observe this.

ayahs.text: Then if you find no one in them do not enter until you have been given permission (to enter). And if you are told to go back then do go back. This is a purer way for you. Allah knows all what you do.
ayahs.translation: Then if you find no one in them do not enter until you have been given permission (to enter). And if you are told to go back then do go back. This is a purer way for you. Allah knows all what you do.

ayahs.text: However it is not blameworthy for you if you enter houses that are uninhabited but wherein there is something of use to you. Allah is well aware of what you disclose and what you conceal.
ayahs.translation: However it is not blameworthy for you if you enter houses that are uninhabited but wherein there is something of use to you. Allah is well aware of what you disclose and what you conceal.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) enjoin believing men to cast down their looks and guard their private parts. That is purer for them. Surely Allah is well aware of all what they do.
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) enjoin believing men to cast down their looks and guard their private parts. That is purer for them. Surely Allah is well aware of all what they do.

ayahs.text: And enjoin believing women to cast down their looks and guard their private parts and not reveal their adornment except that which is revealed of itself and to draw their veils over their bosoms and not to reveal their adornment save to their husbands or their fathers or the fathers of their husbands or of their own sons or the sons of their husbands or their brothers or the sons of their brothers or the sons of their sisters or the women with whom they associate or those that are in their bondage or the male attendants in their service free of sexual interest or boys that are yet unaware of illicit matters pertaining to women. Nor should they stamp their feet on the ground in such manner that their hidden ornament becomes revealed. Believers turn together all of you to Allah in repentance that you may attain true success.
ayahs.translation: And enjoin believing women to cast down their looks and guard their private parts and not reveal their adornment except that which is revealed of itself and to draw their veils over their bosoms and not to reveal their adornment save to their husbands or their fathers or the fathers of their husbands or of their own sons or the sons of their husbands or their brothers or the sons of their brothers or the sons of their sisters or the women with whom they associate or those that are in their bondage or the male attendants in their service free of sexual interest or boys that are yet unaware of illicit matters pertaining to women. Nor should they stamp their feet on the ground in such manner that their hidden ornament becomes revealed. Believers turn together all of you to Allah in repentance that you may attain true success.

ayahs.text: Marry those of you that are single (whether men or women) and those of your male and female slaves that are righteous. If they are poor Allah will enrich them out of His Bounty. Allah is Immensely Resourceful All-Knowing.
ayahs.translation: Marry those of you that are single (whether men or women) and those of your male and female slaves that are righteous. If they are poor Allah will enrich them out of His Bounty. Allah is Immensely Resourceful All-Knowing.

ayahs.text: Let those who cannot afford to marry keep themselves chaste until Allah enriches them out of His Bounty. And write out a deed of manumission for such of your slaves that desire their freedom in lieu of payment - if you see any good in them - and give them out of the wealth that Allah has given you. And do not compel your slave-girls to prostitution for the sake of the benefits of worldly life the while they desire to remain chaste. And if anyone compels them to prostitution Allah will be Most Pardoning Much Merciful (to them) after their subjection to such compulsion.
ayahs.translation: Let those who cannot afford to marry keep themselves chaste until Allah enriches them out of His Bounty. And write out a deed of manumission for such of your slaves that desire their freedom in lieu of payment - if you see any good in them - and give them out of the wealth that Allah has given you. And do not compel your slave-girls to prostitution for the sake of the benefits of worldly life the while they desire to remain chaste. And if anyone compels them to prostitution Allah will be Most Pardoning Much Merciful (to them) after their subjection to such compulsion.

ayahs.text: Verily We have sent down for you revelations which clearly expound true guidance and examples of those who passed away before you and an admonition for those who fear (Allah).
ayahs.translation: Verily We have sent down for you revelations which clearly expound true guidance and examples of those who passed away before you and an admonition for those who fear (Allah).

ayahs.text: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. His Light (in the Universe) may be likened to a niche wherein is a lamp and the lamp is in the crystal which shines in star-like brilliance. It is lit from (the oil) of a blessed olive tree that is neither eastern nor western. Its oil well nigh glows forth (of itself) though no fire touched it: Light upon Light. Allah guides to His Light whom He wills. Allah sets forth parables to make people understand. Allah knows everything.
ayahs.translation: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. His Light (in the Universe) may be likened to a niche wherein is a lamp and the lamp is in the crystal which shines in star-like brilliance. It is lit from (the oil) of a blessed olive tree that is neither eastern nor western. Its oil well nigh glows forth (of itself) though no fire touched it: Light upon Light. Allah guides to His Light whom He wills. Allah sets forth parables to make people understand. Allah knows everything.

ayahs.text: (Those who are directed to this Light are found) in houses which Allah has allowed to be raised and wherein His name is to be remembered: in them people glorify Him in the morning and in the evening
ayahs.translation: (Those who are directed to this Light are found) in houses which Allah has allowed to be raised and wherein His name is to be remembered: in them people glorify Him in the morning and in the evening

ayahs.text: people whom neither commerce nor striving after profit diverts them from remembering Allah from establishing Prayer and from paying Zakah; people who dread the Day on which all hearts will be overturned and eyes will be petrified;
ayahs.translation: people whom neither commerce nor striving after profit diverts them from remembering Allah from establishing Prayer and from paying Zakah; people who dread the Day on which all hearts will be overturned and eyes will be petrified;

ayahs.text: (people who do all this so) that Allah may reward them in accordance with the best that they did; indeed He will bestow upon them more out of His Bounty for Allah grants whomsoever He wills beyond all measure.
ayahs.translation: (people who do all this so) that Allah may reward them in accordance with the best that they did; indeed He will bestow upon them more out of His Bounty for Allah grants whomsoever He wills beyond all measure.

ayahs.text: But for those who deny the Truth their deeds are like a mirage in the desert which the thirsty supposes to be water until he comes to it only to find that it was nothing; he found instead that Allah was with Him and He paid his account in full. Allah is swift in settling the account.
ayahs.translation: But for those who deny the Truth their deeds are like a mirage in the desert which the thirsty supposes to be water until he comes to it only to find that it was nothing; he found instead that Allah was with Him and He paid his account in full. Allah is swift in settling the account.

ayahs.text: Or its similitude is that of depths of darkness upon an abysmal sea covered by a billow above which is a billow above which is cloud creating darkness piled one upon another; when he puts forth his hand he would scarcely see it. He to whom Allah assigns no light he will have no light.
ayahs.translation: Or its similitude is that of depths of darkness upon an abysmal sea covered by a billow above which is a billow above which is cloud creating darkness piled one upon another; when he puts forth his hand he would scarcely see it. He to whom Allah assigns no light he will have no light.

ayahs.text: Do you not see that all that is in the heavens and the earth even the birds that go about spreading their wings in flight extol His glory? Each knows the way of its prayer and of its extolling Allah''s glory. Allah is well aware of whatever they do.
ayahs.translation: Do you not see that all that is in the heavens and the earth even the birds that go about spreading their wings in flight extol His glory? Each knows the way of its prayer and of its extolling Allah''s glory. Allah is well aware of whatever they do.

ayahs.text: Allah''s is the dominion of the heavens and the earth and to Him are all destined to return.
ayahs.translation: Allah''s is the dominion of the heavens and the earth and to Him are all destined to return.

ayahs.text: Do you not see that it is Allah Who gently drives the clouds then He joins them together and then turns them into a thick mass and thereafter you see rain-drops fall down from its midst? And then He sends down hail from the heaven - thanks to the mountains - and causes it to smite whom He wills and averts it from whom He wills. The flash of His lightning almost takes away the sight.
ayahs.translation: Do you not see that it is Allah Who gently drives the clouds then He joins them together and then turns them into a thick mass and thereafter you see rain-drops fall down from its midst? And then He sends down hail from the heaven - thanks to the mountains - and causes it to smite whom He wills and averts it from whom He wills. The flash of His lightning almost takes away the sight.

ayahs.text: It is Allah Who alternates the night and the day. Surely there is a lesson in it for those that have sight.
ayahs.translation: It is Allah Who alternates the night and the day. Surely there is a lesson in it for those that have sight.

ayahs.text: Allah has created every animal from water. Of them some move on their bellies some move on two legs and some on four. Allah creates whatever He wills. Surely Allah has power over everything.
ayahs.translation: Allah has created every animal from water. Of them some move on their bellies some move on two legs and some on four. Allah creates whatever He wills. Surely Allah has power over everything.

ayahs.text: Verily We have sent down revelations that clearly explain the Truth. Allah guides whomsoever He wills to a Straight Way.
ayahs.translation: Verily We have sent down revelations that clearly explain the Truth. Allah guides whomsoever He wills to a Straight Way.

ayahs.text: They say: ""We believe in Allah and the Messenger and we obey  but thereafter a faction of them turns away (from obedience). These indeed are not believers.
ayahs.translation: They say: ""We believe in Allah and the Messenger and we obey  but thereafter a faction of them turns away (from obedience). These indeed are not believers.

ayahs.text: When they are called to Allah and His Messenger that he (that is the Messenger) may judge (the disputes) among them a faction of them turns away.
ayahs.translation: When they are called to Allah and His Messenger that he (that is the Messenger) may judge (the disputes) among them a faction of them turns away.

ayahs.text: However if the right is on their side they come to him (professing) their submissiveness.
ayahs.translation: However if the right is on their side they come to him (professing) their submissiveness.

ayahs.text: Do their hearts suffer from the disease (of hypocrisy)? Or have they fallen prey to doubts? Or do they fear that Allah and His Messenger will wrong them? Nay the truth is that they themselves are wrong-doers.
ayahs.translation: Do their hearts suffer from the disease (of hypocrisy)? Or have they fallen prey to doubts? Or do they fear that Allah and His Messenger will wrong them? Nay the truth is that they themselves are wrong-doers.

ayahs.text: When those that believe are called to Allah and His Messenger in order that he (that is the Messenger) may judge their disputes among them nothing becomes them but to say: ""We hear and we obey."" Such shall attain true success.
ayahs.translation: When those that believe are called to Allah and His Messenger in order that he (that is the Messenger) may judge their disputes among them nothing becomes them but to say: ""We hear and we obey."" Such shall attain true success.

ayahs.text: Those who obey Allah and His Messenger and fear Him and avoid disobeying Him: such indeed shall triumph.
ayahs.translation: Those who obey Allah and His Messenger and fear Him and avoid disobeying Him: such indeed shall triumph.

ayahs.text: (The hypocrites) solemnly swear by Allah: ""If you order us we shall surely go forth (and fight in the cause of Allah)."" Tell them: ""Do not swear. The state of your obedience is known. Allah is well aware of all that you do.""
ayahs.translation: (The hypocrites) solemnly swear by Allah: ""If you order us we shall surely go forth (and fight in the cause of Allah)."" Tell them: ""Do not swear. The state of your obedience is known. Allah is well aware of all that you do.""

ayahs.text: Say: ""Obey Allah and obey the Messenger. But if you turn away then (know well) that the Messenger is responsible for what he has been charged with and you are responsible for what you have been charged with. But if you obey him you will be guided to the Right Way. The Messenger has no other responsibility but to clearly convey (the command).""
ayahs.translation: Say: ""Obey Allah and obey the Messenger. But if you turn away then (know well) that the Messenger is responsible for what he has been charged with and you are responsible for what you have been charged with. But if you obey him you will be guided to the Right Way. The Messenger has no other responsibility but to clearly convey (the command).""

ayahs.text: Allah has promised those of you who believe and do righteous deeds that He will surely bestow power on them in the land even as He bestowed power on those that preceded them and that He will firmly establish their religion which He has been pleased to choose for them and He will replace with security the state of fear that they are in. Let them serve Me and associate none with Me in My Divinity. Whoso thereafter engages in unbelief such indeed are the ungodly.
ayahs.translation: Allah has promised those of you who believe and do righteous deeds that He will surely bestow power on them in the land even as He bestowed power on those that preceded them and that He will firmly establish their religion which He has been pleased to choose for them and He will replace with security the state of fear that they are in. Let them serve Me and associate none with Me in My Divinity. Whoso thereafter engages in unbelief such indeed are the ungodly.

ayahs.text: Establish Prayer and pay Zakah and obey the Messenger so that mercy may be shown to you.
ayahs.translation: Establish Prayer and pay Zakah and obey the Messenger so that mercy may be shown to you.

ayahs.text: Do not even imagine that those who disbelieve can render Allah powerless in the land. Their abode is the Fire; what an evil abode!
ayahs.translation: Do not even imagine that those who disbelieve can render Allah powerless in the land. Their abode is the Fire; what an evil abode!

ayahs.text: Believers! At three times let those whom your right hands possess and those of your children who have not yet reached puberty ask leave of you before entering your quarters: before the Morning Prayer and when you take off your clothes at noon and after the Night Prayer. These are the three times of privacy for you. If they come to you at other times then there is no sin for them nor for you for you have to visit one another frequently. Thus does Allah clearly explain His directives to you. Allah is All- Knowing All-Wise.
ayahs.translation: Believers! At three times let those whom your right hands possess and those of your children who have not yet reached puberty ask leave of you before entering your quarters: before the Morning Prayer and when you take off your clothes at noon and after the Night Prayer. These are the three times of privacy for you. If they come to you at other times then there is no sin for them nor for you for you have to visit one another frequently. Thus does Allah clearly explain His directives to you. Allah is All- Knowing All-Wise.

ayahs.text: And when your children attain puberty let them ask leave to come to you like their elders used to ask leave. Thus does Allah clearly explain to you His Signs. He is All-Knowing All-Wise.
ayahs.translation: And when your children attain puberty let them ask leave to come to you like their elders used to ask leave. Thus does Allah clearly explain to you His Signs. He is All-Knowing All-Wise.

ayahs.text: The women who are past their youth (and can no longer bear children) and do not look forward to marriage will incur no sin if they cast off their outer garments without displaying their adornment. But if they remain modest that is still better for them. Allah is All-Hearing All-Knowing.
ayahs.translation: The women who are past their youth (and can no longer bear children) and do not look forward to marriage will incur no sin if they cast off their outer garments without displaying their adornment. But if they remain modest that is still better for them. Allah is All-Hearing All-Knowing.

ayahs.text: There is no blame on the blind nor any blame on the lame nor any blame on the sick nor on yourselves that you eat in your own houses or your fathers'' houses or your mothers'' houses or your brothers'' houses or the houses of your sisters or the houses of your fathers'' brothers or the houses of your fathers'' sisters or in the houses of your mothers'' brothers or in the houses of your mothers'' sisters or in the houses whose keys you possess or the house of a friend. There is no blame if you eat together or separately. But when you enter such houses greet each other with a salutation appointed by Allah a salutation that is blessed and good. Thus does Allah expound His signs to you in order that you will act with understanding.
ayahs.translation: There is no blame on the blind nor any blame on the lame nor any blame on the sick nor on yourselves that you eat in your own houses or your fathers'' houses or your mothers'' houses or your brothers'' houses or the houses of your sisters or the houses of your fathers'' brothers or the houses of your fathers'' sisters or in the houses of your mothers'' brothers or in the houses of your mothers'' sisters or in the houses whose keys you possess or the house of a friend. There is no blame if you eat together or separately. But when you enter such houses greet each other with a salutation appointed by Allah a salutation that is blessed and good. Thus does Allah expound His signs to you in order that you will act with understanding.

ayahs.text: The true believers are only those who sincerely believe in Allah and in His Messenger and who whenever they are with him on some common errand they do not go away until they have asked leave of him. Verily those who ask leave of you it is they who truly believe in Allah and His Messenger. So if they ask your leave in connection with some of their affairs give leave to those whom you will and ask Allah for forgiveness on their behalf. Surely Allah is Much Forgiving Ever Merciful.
ayahs.translation: The true believers are only those who sincerely believe in Allah and in His Messenger and who whenever they are with him on some common errand they do not go away until they have asked leave of him. Verily those who ask leave of you it is they who truly believe in Allah and His Messenger. So if they ask your leave in connection with some of their affairs give leave to those whom you will and ask Allah for forgiveness on their behalf. Surely Allah is Much Forgiving Ever Merciful.

ayahs.text: (Muslims!) Do not make the calling of the Messenger among you as your calling one another. Allah knows well those of you who surreptitiously steal away taking shelter behind one another. Let those who go against the order (of the Messenger) beware lest a trial or severe punishment afflict them.
ayahs.translation: (Muslims!) Do not make the calling of the Messenger among you as your calling one another. Allah knows well those of you who surreptitiously steal away taking shelter behind one another. Let those who go against the order (of the Messenger) beware lest a trial or severe punishment afflict them.

ayahs.text: Lo! Whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah. He is well aware of your ways. And the Day when they will be returned to Him He will tell them all what they did. Allah knows everything.
ayahs.translation: Lo! Whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah. He is well aware of your ways. And the Day when they will be returned to Him He will tell them all what they did. Allah knows everything.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Most blessed is He Who sent down this Criterion on His servant to be a warner to all mankind;
verses.translation: Most blessed is He Who sent down this Criterion on His servant to be a warner to all mankind;

verses.text: He to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth; Who has taken to Himself no son nor has He taken any partner in His kingdom; Who created everything and then determined its destiny.
verses.translation: He to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth; Who has taken to Himself no son nor has He taken any partner in His kingdom; Who created everything and then determined its destiny.

verses.text: Yet people have taken instead of Him other deities; those that create nothing but are themselves created; who do not have the power to hurt or benefit even themselves; who have no power over death nor over life nor over the resurrection of the dead.
verses.translation: Yet people have taken instead of Him other deities; those that create nothing but are themselves created; who do not have the power to hurt or benefit even themselves; who have no power over death nor over life nor over the resurrection of the dead.

verses.text: Those who disbelieve in the Message of the Prophet say: ""This (Criterion) is nothing but a lie which he has forged with the help of others."" Such have indeed resorted to a grievous wrong and sheer falsehood.
verses.translation: Those who disbelieve in the Message of the Prophet say: ""This (Criterion) is nothing but a lie which he has forged with the help of others."" Such have indeed resorted to a grievous wrong and sheer falsehood.

verses.text: They say: ""These are merely fairy tales of the ancients which he has got inscribed and they are then recited to him morning and evening.""
verses.translation: They say: ""These are merely fairy tales of the ancients which he has got inscribed and they are then recited to him morning and evening.""

verses.text: Say to them (O Muhammad): ""It is He Who knows the secrets of the heavens and the earth Who has sent down this Book. Indeed He is Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.""
verses.translation: Say to them (O Muhammad): ""It is He Who knows the secrets of the heavens and the earth Who has sent down this Book. Indeed He is Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.""

verses.text: They say: ""What sort of a Messenger is this: he eats food and walks about in the markets? Why was an angel not sent down to him so that he may remain with the Messenger and warn those that do not believe in him?
verses.translation: They say: ""What sort of a Messenger is this: he eats food and walks about in the markets? Why was an angel not sent down to him so that he may remain with the Messenger and warn those that do not believe in him?

verses.text: Why was a treasure not bestowed upon him or a garden whereof he might obtain his sustenance?"" The evil-doers say: ""You are simply following a bewitched man.""
verses.translation: Why was a treasure not bestowed upon him or a garden whereof he might obtain his sustenance?"" The evil-doers say: ""You are simply following a bewitched man.""

verses.text: See what specious arguments they put forth before you: they are so strayed that they will not find their way to anything sound.
verses.translation: See what specious arguments they put forth before you: they are so strayed that they will not find their way to anything sound.

verses.text: Most blessed is He Who if He wills can grant you even better than what they propose: Gardens beneath which rivers flow and stately mansions.
verses.translation: Most blessed is He Who if He wills can grant you even better than what they propose: Gardens beneath which rivers flow and stately mansions.

verses.text: Nay the truth is that it is the Hour to which they give the lie. We have kept a Blazing Fire ready for him who denies the Hour.
verses.translation: Nay the truth is that it is the Hour to which they give the lie. We have kept a Blazing Fire ready for him who denies the Hour.

verses.text: When it sees them from a place afar they will hear its raging and roaring
verses.translation: When it sees them from a place afar they will hear its raging and roaring

verses.text: and when they are flung chained together into a narrow place in it they will fervently call there for annihilation.
verses.translation: and when they are flung chained together into a narrow place in it they will fervently call there for annihilation.

verses.text: (They will then be told): ""Do not call for a single annihilation but for many an annihilation.""
verses.translation: (They will then be told): ""Do not call for a single annihilation but for many an annihilation.""

verses.text: Ask them: ""Is this state better or the Garden of Eternity which the God-fearing have been promised?"" It shall be their recompense and the end-point of their journey;
verses.translation: Ask them: ""Is this state better or the Garden of Eternity which the God-fearing have been promised?"" It shall be their recompense and the end-point of their journey;

verses.text: the Garden wherein whatever they desire will be fulfilled. In it they shall abide for ever. This is a promise whose fulfilment Your Lord has made incumbent on Himself.
verses.translation: the Garden wherein whatever they desire will be fulfilled. In it they shall abide for ever. This is a promise whose fulfilment Your Lord has made incumbent on Himself.

verses.text: On the Day when He will muster together all the unbelievers as well as the deities that they worship beside Allah and He will ask them: ""Was it you who caused these servants of Mine to stray away or did they themselves stray away from the Right Path?""
verses.translation: On the Day when He will muster together all the unbelievers as well as the deities that they worship beside Allah and He will ask them: ""Was it you who caused these servants of Mine to stray away or did they themselves stray away from the Right Path?""

verses.text: They will say: ""Glory be to You! It did not behove us to take any other than You as our guardians but You lavished the pleasures of life upon them and their forefathers until they forgot the Admonition and became doomed to destruction.""
verses.translation: They will say: ""Glory be to You! It did not behove us to take any other than You as our guardians but You lavished the pleasures of life upon them and their forefathers until they forgot the Admonition and became doomed to destruction.""

verses.text: Thus will those deities give the lie to all what you now say and you will not be able to avert your doom nor obtain any succour. We shall cause whoever of you commits wrong to taste an enormous chastisement.
verses.translation: Thus will those deities give the lie to all what you now say and you will not be able to avert your doom nor obtain any succour. We shall cause whoever of you commits wrong to taste an enormous chastisement.

verses.text: (O Muhammad) We never sent any Messengers before you but they ate food and walked about in the markets. We made some of you a means to test each by the other to see whether you remain patient. Your Lord is All-Seeing.
verses.translation: (O Muhammad) We never sent any Messengers before you but they ate food and walked about in the markets. We made some of you a means to test each by the other to see whether you remain patient. Your Lord is All-Seeing.

verses.text: Those who do not look forward to meet Us say: ""Why should angels not be sent to us or why do we ourselves not observe our Lord?"" Surely they are too proud of themselves and have gone beyond all limits in their rebellion.
verses.translation: Those who do not look forward to meet Us say: ""Why should angels not be sent to us or why do we ourselves not observe our Lord?"" Surely they are too proud of themselves and have gone beyond all limits in their rebellion.

verses.text: On that Day - the Day when they will behold angels - there will be no good news for those immersed in evil and they will cry out: ""We seek refuge (in Allah).""
verses.translation: On that Day - the Day when they will behold angels - there will be no good news for those immersed in evil and they will cry out: ""We seek refuge (in Allah).""

verses.text: And We shall turn to their deeds and shall reduce them to scattered dust.
verses.translation: And We shall turn to their deeds and shall reduce them to scattered dust.

verses.text: On that Day it is the inmates of Paradise that will be graced with a better abode and a fairer resting place.
verses.translation: On that Day it is the inmates of Paradise that will be graced with a better abode and a fairer resting place.

verses.text: On that Day the sky shall be rent asunder by a cloud and a whole cavalcade of angels will be made to descend.
verses.translation: On that Day the sky shall be rent asunder by a cloud and a whole cavalcade of angels will be made to descend.

verses.text: On that Day the true kingdom will belong only to the Merciful Lord. That will be a hard day for those that deny the Truth;
verses.translation: On that Day the true kingdom will belong only to the Merciful Lord. That will be a hard day for those that deny the Truth;

verses.text: a Day when the wrong-doer will bite his hands saying: ""Would that I had stood by the Messenger!
verses.translation: a Day when the wrong-doer will bite his hands saying: ""Would that I had stood by the Messenger!

verses.text: Woe is me! Would that I had not taken such a one for a friend!
verses.translation: Woe is me! Would that I had not taken such a one for a friend!

verses.text: He led me astray from the Admonition that had come to me. Satan proved to be a great betrayer of man.""
verses.translation: He led me astray from the Admonition that had come to me. Satan proved to be a great betrayer of man.""

verses.text: And the Messenger will say: ""My Lord! My own people had made this Qur''an an object of laughter.""
verses.translation: And the Messenger will say: ""My Lord! My own people had made this Qur''an an object of laughter.""

verses.text: (O Muhammad) thus did We make for every Prophet enemies from among those immersed in evil. Your Lord suffices you as a Guide and a Helper.
verses.translation: (O Muhammad) thus did We make for every Prophet enemies from among those immersed in evil. Your Lord suffices you as a Guide and a Helper.

verses.text: Those who disbelieve say: ""Why was the Qur''an not revealed to him all at once?"" It was revealed thus that We may fully impress it on your mind; (and for the same end) We have revealed it gradually (according to a scheme) in fragments.
verses.translation: Those who disbelieve say: ""Why was the Qur''an not revealed to him all at once?"" It was revealed thus that We may fully impress it on your mind; (and for the same end) We have revealed it gradually (according to a scheme) in fragments.

verses.text: (This was also done so that) whenever they put any strange question to you We sent its right answer and explained the matter in the best manner.
verses.translation: (This was also done so that) whenever they put any strange question to you We sent its right answer and explained the matter in the best manner.

verses.text: Those who shall be mustered in the Hell upon their faces their stand is the worst and their way most erroneous.
verses.translation: Those who shall be mustered in the Hell upon their faces their stand is the worst and their way most erroneous.

verses.text: Verily We granted Moses the Book and appointed his brother Aaron with him as his helper
verses.translation: Verily We granted Moses the Book and appointed his brother Aaron with him as his helper

verses.text: and said to him: ""Go the two of you to the people who have given the lie to Our Signs."" Thereafter We utterly destroyed them.
verses.translation: and said to him: ""Go the two of you to the people who have given the lie to Our Signs."" Thereafter We utterly destroyed them.

verses.text: (The same happened with) the people of Noah: when they gave the lie to the Messengers We drowned them and made of them a Sign of warning for all mankind. We have kept ready a painful chastisement for the wrong-doers.
verses.translation: (The same happened with) the people of Noah: when they gave the lie to the Messengers We drowned them and made of them a Sign of warning for all mankind. We have kept ready a painful chastisement for the wrong-doers.

verses.text: And in like manner were the ''Ad and the Thamud destroyed and the people of al-Rass and many a nation in the centuries in between.
verses.translation: And in like manner were the ''Ad and the Thamud destroyed and the people of al-Rass and many a nation in the centuries in between.

verses.text: We warned each (of them) by examples (of the nations so destroyed in the past) and We totally annihilated each of them.
verses.translation: We warned each (of them) by examples (of the nations so destroyed in the past) and We totally annihilated each of them.

verses.text: They have surely passed by the town which was rained upon by an evil rain. Have they not seen it? Nay; but they do not believe in being raised up after death.
verses.translation: They have surely passed by the town which was rained upon by an evil rain. Have they not seen it? Nay; but they do not believe in being raised up after death.

verses.text: Whenever they see you they take you for nothing else but an object of jest saying: ""Is this whom Allah has sent as a Messenger?
verses.translation: Whenever they see you they take you for nothing else but an object of jest saying: ""Is this whom Allah has sent as a Messenger?

verses.text: Had we not firmly persevered in our devotion to them (he had almost) led us astray from our gods."" But soon when they see the chastisement they will come to know who had strayed too far from the Right Way.
verses.translation: Had we not firmly persevered in our devotion to them (he had almost) led us astray from our gods."" But soon when they see the chastisement they will come to know who had strayed too far from the Right Way.

verses.text: Have you ever considered the case of him who has taken his carnal desire for his god? Can you take responsibility for guiding him to the Right Way?
verses.translation: Have you ever considered the case of him who has taken his carnal desire for his god? Can you take responsibility for guiding him to the Right Way?

verses.text: Do you think that most of them hear or understand? For they are merely like cattle; nay even worse than them.
verses.translation: Do you think that most of them hear or understand? For they are merely like cattle; nay even worse than them.

verses.text: Have you not seen how your Lord spreads the shade? If He will He could have made it stationary; instead We have made the sun its pilot.
verses.translation: Have you not seen how your Lord spreads the shade? If He will He could have made it stationary; instead We have made the sun its pilot.

verses.text: So (as the sun rises) We gradually roll up that shade unto Us.
verses.translation: So (as the sun rises) We gradually roll up that shade unto Us.

verses.text: It is Allah Who has made night a garment for you and sleep the repose (of death) and has made day the time of rising to life.
verses.translation: It is Allah Who has made night a garment for you and sleep the repose (of death) and has made day the time of rising to life.

verses.text: And He it is Who sends forth the winds as glad tidings heralding His Mercy. Then We send down pure water from the sky
verses.translation: And He it is Who sends forth the winds as glad tidings heralding His Mercy. Then We send down pure water from the sky

verses.text: that We may revive through it a dead land and give it for drink to many cattle and human beings from among Our creation.
verses.translation: that We may revive through it a dead land and give it for drink to many cattle and human beings from among Our creation.

verses.text: We present this wondrous phenomenon to them over and over again that they may learn a lesson from it. But most people simply decline everything except disbelief and ingratitude.
verses.translation: We present this wondrous phenomenon to them over and over again that they may learn a lesson from it. But most people simply decline everything except disbelief and ingratitude.

verses.text: Had We so willed We would have raised up in every town a warner.
verses.translation: Had We so willed We would have raised up in every town a warner.

verses.text: So (O Prophet) do not follow the unbelievers but engage in a mighty striving against them with this Qur''an.
verses.translation: So (O Prophet) do not follow the unbelievers but engage in a mighty striving against them with this Qur''an.

verses.text: And He it is Who has joined the two seas: one sweet and palatable and the other saltish and bitter; and He has set a barrier and an insurmountable obstruction between the two that keeps them apart.
verses.translation: And He it is Who has joined the two seas: one sweet and palatable and the other saltish and bitter; and He has set a barrier and an insurmountable obstruction between the two that keeps them apart.

verses.text: And He it is Who has created man from water and then produced from him two sorts of kindred: by descent and by marriage. Your Lord is All-Powerful.
verses.translation: And He it is Who has created man from water and then produced from him two sorts of kindred: by descent and by marriage. Your Lord is All-Powerful.

verses.text: And yet people worship deities other than Allah that can neither benefit them nor hurt them. Besides the unbeliever is ever prone to come to the support of everyone who rebels against his Lord.
verses.translation: And yet people worship deities other than Allah that can neither benefit them nor hurt them. Besides the unbeliever is ever prone to come to the support of everyone who rebels against his Lord.

verses.text: We have not sent you (O Muhammad) except as a bearer of good tidings and a warner.
verses.translation: We have not sent you (O Muhammad) except as a bearer of good tidings and a warner.

verses.text: Say to them: ""I ask of you no reward for my work. My only reward is that whoever so wills may follow the way leading to His Lord.""
verses.translation: Say to them: ""I ask of you no reward for my work. My only reward is that whoever so wills may follow the way leading to His Lord.""

verses.text: (O Muhammad) put your trust in Him Who is Ever-Living Who will never die and glorify Him with His praise. He suffices as the Knower of the sins of His servants
verses.translation: (O Muhammad) put your trust in Him Who is Ever-Living Who will never die and glorify Him with His praise. He suffices as the Knower of the sins of His servants

verses.text: He Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is in between them in six days and then ascended the Throne; the Merciful One. Ask concerning Him the one who knows.
verses.translation: He Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is in between them in six days and then ascended the Throne; the Merciful One. Ask concerning Him the one who knows.

verses.text: When they are told: ""Prostrate yourselves before the Merciful One  they say: ""What is the Merciful One? Shall we prostrate ourselves before whomsoever you command us to prostrate?"" This even further increases their aversion.
verses.translation: When they are told: ""Prostrate yourselves before the Merciful One  they say: ""What is the Merciful One? Shall we prostrate ourselves before whomsoever you command us to prostrate?"" This even further increases their aversion.

verses.text: Most blessed is He Who set a constellation in the heavens and placed in it a great lamp and a shining moon.
verses.translation: Most blessed is He Who set a constellation in the heavens and placed in it a great lamp and a shining moon.

verses.text: He it is Who has appointed night and day to succeed one another (as a Sign) for him who desires to take heed or desires to be thankful.
verses.translation: He it is Who has appointed night and day to succeed one another (as a Sign) for him who desires to take heed or desires to be thankful.

verses.text: The true servants of the Merciful One are those who walk on the earth gently and when the foolish ones address them they simply say: ""Peace to you"";
verses.translation: The true servants of the Merciful One are those who walk on the earth gently and when the foolish ones address them they simply say: ""Peace to you"";

verses.text: who spend the night prostrating themselves before their Lord and standing;
verses.translation: who spend the night prostrating themselves before their Lord and standing;

verses.text: who entreat: ""Our Lord! Ward off from us the chastisement of Hell for its chastisement is one that clings.
verses.translation: who entreat: ""Our Lord! Ward off from us the chastisement of Hell for its chastisement is one that clings.

verses.text: Verily it is a wretched abode and resting-place.""
verses.translation: Verily it is a wretched abode and resting-place.""

verses.text: (The true servants of the Merciful One are) those who are neither extravagant nor niggardly in their spending but keep the golden mean between the two;
verses.translation: (The true servants of the Merciful One are) those who are neither extravagant nor niggardly in their spending but keep the golden mean between the two;

verses.text: who invoke no other deity along with Allah nor take any life - which Allah has forbidden - save justly; who do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse - and whoso does that shall meet its penalty;
verses.translation: who invoke no other deity along with Allah nor take any life - which Allah has forbidden - save justly; who do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse - and whoso does that shall meet its penalty;

verses.text: his torment shall be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection and he will abide in it in ignominy
verses.translation: his torment shall be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection and he will abide in it in ignominy

verses.text: unless he repents and believes and does righteous works. For such Allah will change their evil deeds into good deeds. Allah is Ever Forgiving Most Compassionate.
verses.translation: unless he repents and believes and does righteous works. For such Allah will change their evil deeds into good deeds. Allah is Ever Forgiving Most Compassionate.

verses.text: Whosoever repents and does good he returns to Allah in the manner that he should.
verses.translation: Whosoever repents and does good he returns to Allah in the manner that he should.

verses.text: (The true servants of the Merciful One) are those who do not bear witness to any falsehood and who when they pass by frivolity pass by it with dignity;
verses.translation: (The true servants of the Merciful One) are those who do not bear witness to any falsehood and who when they pass by frivolity pass by it with dignity;

verses.text: who when they are reminded of the revelations of their Lord do not fall at them deaf and blind;
verses.translation: who when they are reminded of the revelations of their Lord do not fall at them deaf and blind;

verses.text: who are prone to pray: ""Our Lord! Grant us that our spouses and our offspring be a joy to our eyes and do make us the leaders of the God-fearing.""
verses.translation: who are prone to pray: ""Our Lord! Grant us that our spouses and our offspring be a joy to our eyes and do make us the leaders of the God-fearing.""

verses.text: They are the ones who will be rewarded for their patience: lofty palaces will be granted to them and they will be received with greeting and salutation.
verses.translation: They are the ones who will be rewarded for their patience: lofty palaces will be granted to them and they will be received with greeting and salutation.

verses.text: Therein they shall abide for ever: how good an abode and how good a resting-place!
verses.translation: Therein they shall abide for ever: how good an abode and how good a resting-place!

verses.text: Say to them (O Muhammad): ""My Lord would not care for you were it not for your prayer. But now that you have given the lie to (the Message of Allah) an inextricable punishment shall soon come upon you.""
verses.translation: Say to them (O Muhammad): ""My Lord would not care for you were it not for your prayer. But now that you have given the lie to (the Message of Allah) an inextricable punishment shall soon come upon you.""

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: Most blessed is He Who sent down this Criterion on His servant to be a warner to all mankind;
ayahs.translation: Most blessed is He Who sent down this Criterion on His servant to be a warner to all mankind;

ayahs.text: He to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth; Who has taken to Himself no son nor has He taken any partner in His kingdom; Who created everything and then determined its destiny.
ayahs.translation: He to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth; Who has taken to Himself no son nor has He taken any partner in His kingdom; Who created everything and then determined its destiny.

ayahs.text: Yet people have taken instead of Him other deities; those that create nothing but are themselves created; who do not have the power to hurt or benefit even themselves; who have no power over death nor over life nor over the resurrection of the dead.
ayahs.translation: Yet people have taken instead of Him other deities; those that create nothing but are themselves created; who do not have the power to hurt or benefit even themselves; who have no power over death nor over life nor over the resurrection of the dead.

ayahs.text: Those who disbelieve in the Message of the Prophet say: ""This (Criterion) is nothing but a lie which he has forged with the help of others."" Such have indeed resorted to a grievous wrong and sheer falsehood.
ayahs.translation: Those who disbelieve in the Message of the Prophet say: ""This (Criterion) is nothing but a lie which he has forged with the help of others."" Such have indeed resorted to a grievous wrong and sheer falsehood.

ayahs.text: They say: ""These are merely fairy tales of the ancients which he has got inscribed and they are then recited to him morning and evening.""
ayahs.translation: They say: ""These are merely fairy tales of the ancients which he has got inscribed and they are then recited to him morning and evening.""

ayahs.text: Say to them (O Muhammad): ""It is He Who knows the secrets of the heavens and the earth Who has sent down this Book. Indeed He is Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.""
ayahs.translation: Say to them (O Muhammad): ""It is He Who knows the secrets of the heavens and the earth Who has sent down this Book. Indeed He is Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.""

ayahs.text: They say: ""What sort of a Messenger is this: he eats food and walks about in the markets? Why was an angel not sent down to him so that he may remain with the Messenger and warn those that do not believe in him?
ayahs.translation: They say: ""What sort of a Messenger is this: he eats food and walks about in the markets? Why was an angel not sent down to him so that he may remain with the Messenger and warn those that do not believe in him?

ayahs.text: Why was a treasure not bestowed upon him or a garden whereof he might obtain his sustenance?"" The evil-doers say: ""You are simply following a bewitched man.""
ayahs.translation: Why was a treasure not bestowed upon him or a garden whereof he might obtain his sustenance?"" The evil-doers say: ""You are simply following a bewitched man.""

ayahs.text: See what specious arguments they put forth before you: they are so strayed that they will not find their way to anything sound.
ayahs.translation: See what specious arguments they put forth before you: they are so strayed that they will not find their way to anything sound.

ayahs.text: Most blessed is He Who if He wills can grant you even better than what they propose: Gardens beneath which rivers flow and stately mansions.
ayahs.translation: Most blessed is He Who if He wills can grant you even better than what they propose: Gardens beneath which rivers flow and stately mansions.

ayahs.text: Nay the truth is that it is the Hour to which they give the lie. We have kept a Blazing Fire ready for him who denies the Hour.
ayahs.translation: Nay the truth is that it is the Hour to which they give the lie. We have kept a Blazing Fire ready for him who denies the Hour.

ayahs.text: When it sees them from a place afar they will hear its raging and roaring
ayahs.translation: When it sees them from a place afar they will hear its raging and roaring

ayahs.text: and when they are flung chained together into a narrow place in it they will fervently call there for annihilation.
ayahs.translation: and when they are flung chained together into a narrow place in it they will fervently call there for annihilation.

ayahs.text: (They will then be told): ""Do not call for a single annihilation but for many an annihilation.""
ayahs.translation: (They will then be told): ""Do not call for a single annihilation but for many an annihilation.""

ayahs.text: Ask them: ""Is this state better or the Garden of Eternity which the God-fearing have been promised?"" It shall be their recompense and the end-point of their journey;
ayahs.translation: Ask them: ""Is this state better or the Garden of Eternity which the God-fearing have been promised?"" It shall be their recompense and the end-point of their journey;

ayahs.text: the Garden wherein whatever they desire will be fulfilled. In it they shall abide for ever. This is a promise whose fulfilment Your Lord has made incumbent on Himself.
ayahs.translation: the Garden wherein whatever they desire will be fulfilled. In it they shall abide for ever. This is a promise whose fulfilment Your Lord has made incumbent on Himself.

ayahs.text: On the Day when He will muster together all the unbelievers as well as the deities that they worship beside Allah and He will ask them: ""Was it you who caused these servants of Mine to stray away or did they themselves stray away from the Right Path?""
ayahs.translation: On the Day when He will muster together all the unbelievers as well as the deities that they worship beside Allah and He will ask them: ""Was it you who caused these servants of Mine to stray away or did they themselves stray away from the Right Path?""

ayahs.text: They will say: ""Glory be to You! It did not behove us to take any other than You as our guardians but You lavished the pleasures of life upon them and their forefathers until they forgot the Admonition and became doomed to destruction.""
ayahs.translation: They will say: ""Glory be to You! It did not behove us to take any other than You as our guardians but You lavished the pleasures of life upon them and their forefathers until they forgot the Admonition and became doomed to destruction.""

ayahs.text: Thus will those deities give the lie to all what you now say and you will not be able to avert your doom nor obtain any succour. We shall cause whoever of you commits wrong to taste an enormous chastisement.
ayahs.translation: Thus will those deities give the lie to all what you now say and you will not be able to avert your doom nor obtain any succour. We shall cause whoever of you commits wrong to taste an enormous chastisement.

ayahs.text: (O Muhammad) We never sent any Messengers before you but they ate food and walked about in the markets. We made some of you a means to test each by the other to see whether you remain patient. Your Lord is All-Seeing.
ayahs.translation: (O Muhammad) We never sent any Messengers before you but they ate food and walked about in the markets. We made some of you a means to test each by the other to see whether you remain patient. Your Lord is All-Seeing.

ayahs.text: Those who do not look forward to meet Us say: ""Why should angels not be sent to us or why do we ourselves not observe our Lord?"" Surely they are too proud of themselves and have gone beyond all limits in their rebellion.
ayahs.translation: Those who do not look forward to meet Us say: ""Why should angels not be sent to us or why do we ourselves not observe our Lord?"" Surely they are too proud of themselves and have gone beyond all limits in their rebellion.

ayahs.text: On that Day - the Day when they will behold angels - there will be no good news for those immersed in evil and they will cry out: ""We seek refuge (in Allah).""
ayahs.translation: On that Day - the Day when they will behold angels - there will be no good news for those immersed in evil and they will cry out: ""We seek refuge (in Allah).""

ayahs.text: And We shall turn to their deeds and shall reduce them to scattered dust.
ayahs.translation: And We shall turn to their deeds and shall reduce them to scattered dust.

ayahs.text: On that Day it is the inmates of Paradise that will be graced with a better abode and a fairer resting place.
ayahs.translation: On that Day it is the inmates of Paradise that will be graced with a better abode and a fairer resting place.

ayahs.text: On that Day the sky shall be rent asunder by a cloud and a whole cavalcade of angels will be made to descend.
ayahs.translation: On that Day the sky shall be rent asunder by a cloud and a whole cavalcade of angels will be made to descend.

ayahs.text: On that Day the true kingdom will belong only to the Merciful Lord. That will be a hard day for those that deny the Truth;
ayahs.translation: On that Day the true kingdom will belong only to the Merciful Lord. That will be a hard day for those that deny the Truth;

ayahs.text: a Day when the wrong-doer will bite his hands saying: ""Would that I had stood by the Messenger!
ayahs.translation: a Day when the wrong-doer will bite his hands saying: ""Would that I had stood by the Messenger!

ayahs.text: Woe is me! Would that I had not taken such a one for a friend!
ayahs.translation: Woe is me! Would that I had not taken such a one for a friend!

ayahs.text: He led me astray from the Admonition that had come to me. Satan proved to be a great betrayer of man.""
ayahs.translation: He led me astray from the Admonition that had come to me. Satan proved to be a great betrayer of man.""

ayahs.text: And the Messenger will say: ""My Lord! My own people had made this Qur''an an object of laughter.""
ayahs.translation: And the Messenger will say: ""My Lord! My own people had made this Qur''an an object of laughter.""

ayahs.text: (O Muhammad) thus did We make for every Prophet enemies from among those immersed in evil. Your Lord suffices you as a Guide and a Helper.
ayahs.translation: (O Muhammad) thus did We make for every Prophet enemies from among those immersed in evil. Your Lord suffices you as a Guide and a Helper.

ayahs.text: Those who disbelieve say: ""Why was the Qur''an not revealed to him all at once?"" It was revealed thus that We may fully impress it on your mind; (and for the same end) We have revealed it gradually (according to a scheme) in fragments.
ayahs.translation: Those who disbelieve say: ""Why was the Qur''an not revealed to him all at once?"" It was revealed thus that We may fully impress it on your mind; (and for the same end) We have revealed it gradually (according to a scheme) in fragments.

ayahs.text: (This was also done so that) whenever they put any strange question to you We sent its right answer and explained the matter in the best manner.
ayahs.translation: (This was also done so that) whenever they put any strange question to you We sent its right answer and explained the matter in the best manner.

ayahs.text: Those who shall be mustered in the Hell upon their faces their stand is the worst and their way most erroneous.
ayahs.translation: Those who shall be mustered in the Hell upon their faces their stand is the worst and their way most erroneous.

ayahs.text: Verily We granted Moses the Book and appointed his brother Aaron with him as his helper
ayahs.translation: Verily We granted Moses the Book and appointed his brother Aaron with him as his helper

ayahs.text: and said to him: ""Go the two of you to the people who have given the lie to Our Signs."" Thereafter We utterly destroyed them.
ayahs.translation: and said to him: ""Go the two of you to the people who have given the lie to Our Signs."" Thereafter We utterly destroyed them.

ayahs.text: (The same happened with) the people of Noah: when they gave the lie to the Messengers We drowned them and made of them a Sign of warning for all mankind. We have kept ready a painful chastisement for the wrong-doers.
ayahs.translation: (The same happened with) the people of Noah: when they gave the lie to the Messengers We drowned them and made of them a Sign of warning for all mankind. We have kept ready a painful chastisement for the wrong-doers.

ayahs.text: And in like manner were the ''Ad and the Thamud destroyed and the people of al-Rass and many a nation in the centuries in between.
ayahs.translation: And in like manner were the ''Ad and the Thamud destroyed and the people of al-Rass and many a nation in the centuries in between.

ayahs.text: We warned each (of them) by examples (of the nations so destroyed in the past) and We totally annihilated each of them.
ayahs.translation: We warned each (of them) by examples (of the nations so destroyed in the past) and We totally annihilated each of them.

ayahs.text: They have surely passed by the town which was rained upon by an evil rain. Have they not seen it? Nay; but they do not believe in being raised up after death.
ayahs.translation: They have surely passed by the town which was rained upon by an evil rain. Have they not seen it? Nay; but they do not believe in being raised up after death.

ayahs.text: Whenever they see you they take you for nothing else but an object of jest saying: ""Is this whom Allah has sent as a Messenger?
ayahs.translation: Whenever they see you they take you for nothing else but an object of jest saying: ""Is this whom Allah has sent as a Messenger?

ayahs.text: Had we not firmly persevered in our devotion to them (he had almost) led us astray from our gods."" But soon when they see the chastisement they will come to know who had strayed too far from the Right Way.
ayahs.translation: Had we not firmly persevered in our devotion to them (he had almost) led us astray from our gods."" But soon when they see the chastisement they will come to know who had strayed too far from the Right Way.

ayahs.text: Have you ever considered the case of him who has taken his carnal desire for his god? Can you take responsibility for guiding him to the Right Way?
ayahs.translation: Have you ever considered the case of him who has taken his carnal desire for his god? Can you take responsibility for guiding him to the Right Way?

ayahs.text: Do you think that most of them hear or understand? For they are merely like cattle; nay even worse than them.
ayahs.translation: Do you think that most of them hear or understand? For they are merely like cattle; nay even worse than them.

ayahs.text: Have you not seen how your Lord spreads the shade? If He will He could have made it stationary; instead We have made the sun its pilot.
ayahs.translation: Have you not seen how your Lord spreads the shade? If He will He could have made it stationary; instead We have made the sun its pilot.

ayahs.text: So (as the sun rises) We gradually roll up that shade unto Us.
ayahs.translation: So (as the sun rises) We gradually roll up that shade unto Us.

ayahs.text: It is Allah Who has made night a garment for you and sleep the repose (of death) and has made day the time of rising to life.
ayahs.translation: It is Allah Who has made night a garment for you and sleep the repose (of death) and has made day the time of rising to life.

ayahs.text: And He it is Who sends forth the winds as glad tidings heralding His Mercy. Then We send down pure water from the sky
ayahs.translation: And He it is Who sends forth the winds as glad tidings heralding His Mercy. Then We send down pure water from the sky

ayahs.text: that We may revive through it a dead land and give it for drink to many cattle and human beings from among Our creation.
ayahs.translation: that We may revive through it a dead land and give it for drink to many cattle and human beings from among Our creation.

ayahs.text: We present this wondrous phenomenon to them over and over again that they may learn a lesson from it. But most people simply decline everything except disbelief and ingratitude.
ayahs.translation: We present this wondrous phenomenon to them over and over again that they may learn a lesson from it. But most people simply decline everything except disbelief and ingratitude.

ayahs.text: Had We so willed We would have raised up in every town a warner.
ayahs.translation: Had We so willed We would have raised up in every town a warner.

ayahs.text: So (O Prophet) do not follow the unbelievers but engage in a mighty striving against them with this Qur''an.
ayahs.translation: So (O Prophet) do not follow the unbelievers but engage in a mighty striving against them with this Qur''an.

ayahs.text: And He it is Who has joined the two seas: one sweet and palatable and the other saltish and bitter; and He has set a barrier and an insurmountable obstruction between the two that keeps them apart.
ayahs.translation: And He it is Who has joined the two seas: one sweet and palatable and the other saltish and bitter; and He has set a barrier and an insurmountable obstruction between the two that keeps them apart.

ayahs.text: And He it is Who has created man from water and then produced from him two sorts of kindred: by descent and by marriage. Your Lord is All-Powerful.
ayahs.translation: And He it is Who has created man from water and then produced from him two sorts of kindred: by descent and by marriage. Your Lord is All-Powerful.

ayahs.text: And yet people worship deities other than Allah that can neither benefit them nor hurt them. Besides the unbeliever is ever prone to come to the support of everyone who rebels against his Lord.
ayahs.translation: And yet people worship deities other than Allah that can neither benefit them nor hurt them. Besides the unbeliever is ever prone to come to the support of everyone who rebels against his Lord.

ayahs.text: We have not sent you (O Muhammad) except as a bearer of good tidings and a warner.
ayahs.translation: We have not sent you (O Muhammad) except as a bearer of good tidings and a warner.

ayahs.text: Say to them: ""I ask of you no reward for my work. My only reward is that whoever so wills may follow the way leading to His Lord.""
ayahs.translation: Say to them: ""I ask of you no reward for my work. My only reward is that whoever so wills may follow the way leading to His Lord.""

ayahs.text: (O Muhammad) put your trust in Him Who is Ever-Living Who will never die and glorify Him with His praise. He suffices as the Knower of the sins of His servants
ayahs.translation: (O Muhammad) put your trust in Him Who is Ever-Living Who will never die and glorify Him with His praise. He suffices as the Knower of the sins of His servants

ayahs.text: He Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is in between them in six days and then ascended the Throne; the Merciful One. Ask concerning Him the one who knows.
ayahs.translation: He Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is in between them in six days and then ascended the Throne; the Merciful One. Ask concerning Him the one who knows.

ayahs.text: When they are told: ""Prostrate yourselves before the Merciful One  they say: ""What is the Merciful One? Shall we prostrate ourselves before whomsoever you command us to prostrate?"" This even further increases their aversion.
ayahs.translation: When they are told: ""Prostrate yourselves before the Merciful One  they say: ""What is the Merciful One? Shall we prostrate ourselves before whomsoever you command us to prostrate?"" This even further increases their aversion.

ayahs.text: Most blessed is He Who set a constellation in the heavens and placed in it a great lamp and a shining moon.
ayahs.translation: Most blessed is He Who set a constellation in the heavens and placed in it a great lamp and a shining moon.

ayahs.text: He it is Who has appointed night and day to succeed one another (as a Sign) for him who desires to take heed or desires to be thankful.
ayahs.translation: He it is Who has appointed night and day to succeed one another (as a Sign) for him who desires to take heed or desires to be thankful.

ayahs.text: The true servants of the Merciful One are those who walk on the earth gently and when the foolish ones address them they simply say: ""Peace to you"";
ayahs.translation: The true servants of the Merciful One are those who walk on the earth gently and when the foolish ones address them they simply say: ""Peace to you"";

ayahs.text: who spend the night prostrating themselves before their Lord and standing;
ayahs.translation: who spend the night prostrating themselves before their Lord and standing;

ayahs.text: who entreat: ""Our Lord! Ward off from us the chastisement of Hell for its chastisement is one that clings.
ayahs.translation: who entreat: ""Our Lord! Ward off from us the chastisement of Hell for its chastisement is one that clings.

ayahs.text: Verily it is a wretched abode and resting-place.""
ayahs.translation: Verily it is a wretched abode and resting-place.""

ayahs.text: (The true servants of the Merciful One are) those who are neither extravagant nor niggardly in their spending but keep the golden mean between the two;
ayahs.translation: (The true servants of the Merciful One are) those who are neither extravagant nor niggardly in their spending but keep the golden mean between the two;

ayahs.text: who invoke no other deity along with Allah nor take any life - which Allah has forbidden - save justly; who do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse - and whoso does that shall meet its penalty;
ayahs.translation: who invoke no other deity along with Allah nor take any life - which Allah has forbidden - save justly; who do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse - and whoso does that shall meet its penalty;

ayahs.text: his torment shall be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection and he will abide in it in ignominy
ayahs.translation: his torment shall be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection and he will abide in it in ignominy

ayahs.text: unless he repents and believes and does righteous works. For such Allah will change their evil deeds into good deeds. Allah is Ever Forgiving Most Compassionate.
ayahs.translation: unless he repents and believes and does righteous works. For such Allah will change their evil deeds into good deeds. Allah is Ever Forgiving Most Compassionate.

ayahs.text: Whosoever repents and does good he returns to Allah in the manner that he should.
ayahs.translation: Whosoever repents and does good he returns to Allah in the manner that he should.

ayahs.text: (The true servants of the Merciful One) are those who do not bear witness to any falsehood and who when they pass by frivolity pass by it with dignity;
ayahs.translation: (The true servants of the Merciful One) are those who do not bear witness to any falsehood and who when they pass by frivolity pass by it with dignity;

ayahs.text: who when they are reminded of the revelations of their Lord do not fall at them deaf and blind;
ayahs.translation: who when they are reminded of the revelations of their Lord do not fall at them deaf and blind;

ayahs.text: who are prone to pray: ""Our Lord! Grant us that our spouses and our offspring be a joy to our eyes and do make us the leaders of the God-fearing.""
ayahs.translation: who are prone to pray: ""Our Lord! Grant us that our spouses and our offspring be a joy to our eyes and do make us the leaders of the God-fearing.""

ayahs.text: They are the ones who will be rewarded for their patience: lofty palaces will be granted to them and they will be received with greeting and salutation.
ayahs.translation: They are the ones who will be rewarded for their patience: lofty palaces will be granted to them and they will be received with greeting and salutation.

ayahs.text: Therein they shall abide for ever: how good an abode and how good a resting-place!
ayahs.translation: Therein they shall abide for ever: how good an abode and how good a resting-place!

ayahs.text: Say to them (O Muhammad): ""My Lord would not care for you were it not for your prayer. But now that you have given the lie to (the Message of Allah) an inextricable punishment shall soon come upon you.""
ayahs.translation: Say to them (O Muhammad): ""My Lord would not care for you were it not for your prayer. But now that you have given the lie to (the Message of Allah) an inextricable punishment shall soon come upon you.""

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Ta''. Sin. Mim.
verses.translation: Ta''. Sin. Mim.

verses.text: These are the verses of the Clear Book.
verses.translation: These are the verses of the Clear Book.

verses.text: (O Muhammad) you will perhaps grieve yourself to death because these people do not believe.
verses.translation: (O Muhammad) you will perhaps grieve yourself to death because these people do not believe.

verses.text: If We will We can send down a Sign to them from heaven so their necks will be humbled to it.
verses.translation: If We will We can send down a Sign to them from heaven so their necks will be humbled to it.

verses.text: Never does there come to them an admonition from the Merciful Lord but they turn away from it.
verses.translation: Never does there come to them an admonition from the Merciful Lord but they turn away from it.

verses.text: They will soon come to know the truth of that which they have been scoffing at.
verses.translation: They will soon come to know the truth of that which they have been scoffing at.

verses.text: Do they not look at the earth how We caused a variety of fine vegetation to grow from it (in abundance)?
verses.translation: Do they not look at the earth how We caused a variety of fine vegetation to grow from it (in abundance)?

verses.text: Surely there is a Sign in this but most of them would not believe.
verses.translation: Surely there is a Sign in this but most of them would not believe.

verses.text: Verily Your Lord is Infinitely Mighty Most Compassionate.
verses.translation: Verily Your Lord is Infinitely Mighty Most Compassionate.

verses.text: (Recount to them about the time) when Your Lord called Moses: ""Go to the wrong-doing people
verses.translation: (Recount to them about the time) when Your Lord called Moses: ""Go to the wrong-doing people

verses.text: the people of Pharaoh: do they have no fear?""
verses.translation: the people of Pharaoh: do they have no fear?""

verses.text: He said: ""My Lord! I fear that they will brand me a liar.
verses.translation: He said: ""My Lord! I fear that they will brand me a liar.

verses.text: My breast is constricted and my tongue is not fluent so endow Messengership on Aaron.
verses.translation: My breast is constricted and my tongue is not fluent so endow Messengership on Aaron.

verses.text: As for me they hold the charge of a crime against me. I fear they will put me to death.""
verses.translation: As for me they hold the charge of a crime against me. I fear they will put me to death.""

verses.text: He said: ""Certainly not! So go both of you with Our Signs. We shall be with you listening to everything.
verses.translation: He said: ""Certainly not! So go both of you with Our Signs. We shall be with you listening to everything.

verses.text: Go then to Pharaoh and say to him: ''The Lord of the Universe has sent us
verses.translation: Go then to Pharaoh and say to him: ''The Lord of the Universe has sent us

verses.text: that you let the Children of Israel go with us.''
verses.translation: that you let the Children of Israel go with us.''

verses.text: Pharaoh said: ""Did we not bring you up among us when you were a child?
verses.translation: Pharaoh said: ""Did we not bring you up among us when you were a child?

verses.text: You spent many years of your life among us and then you committed that deed of yours. You are very ungrateful indeed.""
verses.translation: You spent many years of your life among us and then you committed that deed of yours. You are very ungrateful indeed.""

verses.text: Moses replied: ""I committed that act erringly.
verses.translation: Moses replied: ""I committed that act erringly.

verses.text: Then I fled for fear of you. Then my Lord bestowed wisdom and authority on me and made me one of the Messengers.
verses.translation: Then I fled for fear of you. Then my Lord bestowed wisdom and authority on me and made me one of the Messengers.

verses.text: Now this is the favour that you tauntingly remind me of: that you enslaved the Children of Israel!""
verses.translation: Now this is the favour that you tauntingly remind me of: that you enslaved the Children of Israel!""

verses.text: Pharaoh said: ""And who is this Lord of the Universe?""
verses.translation: Pharaoh said: ""And who is this Lord of the Universe?""

verses.text: Moses answered: ""The Lord of the heavens and the earth and of all that is between them if you were only to believe.""
verses.translation: Moses answered: ""The Lord of the heavens and the earth and of all that is between them if you were only to believe.""

verses.text: Pharaoh said to those around him: ""Do you hear (what he says)?""
verses.translation: Pharaoh said to those around him: ""Do you hear (what he says)?""

verses.text: Moses said: ""(He is) Your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers of yore.""
verses.translation: Moses said: ""(He is) Your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers of yore.""

verses.text: Pharaoh said to the audience: ""This Messenger of yours who has been sent to you is simply mad.""
verses.translation: Pharaoh said to the audience: ""This Messenger of yours who has been sent to you is simply mad.""

verses.text: Moses continued: ""(He is) the Lord of the east and the west and all between them. If you only had any understanding!""
