verses.translation: Moses continued: ""(He is) the Lord of the east and the west and all between them. If you only had any understanding!""

verses.text: Pharaoh said: ""If you take any god other than me I will certainly make you one of those (who are rotting) in prison.""
verses.translation: Pharaoh said: ""If you take any god other than me I will certainly make you one of those (who are rotting) in prison.""

verses.text: Moses said: ""Even if I were to bring a Clear Sign to you?""
verses.translation: Moses said: ""Even if I were to bring a Clear Sign to you?""

verses.text: Pharaoh said: ""Then bring it if you are truthful at all.""
verses.translation: Pharaoh said: ""Then bring it if you are truthful at all.""

verses.text: (No sooner had he said this than) Moses threw down his rod and behold it was a veritable serpent
verses.translation: (No sooner had he said this than) Moses threw down his rod and behold it was a veritable serpent

verses.text: and he drew his hand (out of his armpit) and lo! it had become a shining object to the beholders.
verses.translation: and he drew his hand (out of his armpit) and lo! it had become a shining object to the beholders.

verses.text: Pharaoh said to the nobles around him: ""Surely this man is a skilled magician
verses.translation: Pharaoh said to the nobles around him: ""Surely this man is a skilled magician

verses.text: who wants to drive you out of your land by his magic. Tell us what do you advise us?""
verses.translation: who wants to drive you out of your land by his magic. Tell us what do you advise us?""

verses.text: They said: ""Detain him and his brother for a while and send forth heralds to the cities
verses.translation: They said: ""Detain him and his brother for a while and send forth heralds to the cities

verses.text: to mobilise all skilled magicians.""
verses.translation: to mobilise all skilled magicians.""

verses.text: So the magicians were brought together on a particular day at a set time
verses.translation: So the magicians were brought together on a particular day at a set time

verses.text: and the people were told: ""Will you join the assembly?
verses.translation: and the people were told: ""Will you join the assembly?

verses.text: We may perhaps follow the religion of the magicians if they triumph.""
verses.translation: We may perhaps follow the religion of the magicians if they triumph.""

verses.text: When the magicians came forth (for the encounter) they said to Pharaoh: ""Is there a reward for us if we triumph?""
verses.translation: When the magicians came forth (for the encounter) they said to Pharaoh: ""Is there a reward for us if we triumph?""

verses.text: He said: ""Yes you will then become those near-stationed to me.""
verses.translation: He said: ""Yes you will then become those near-stationed to me.""

verses.text: Moses said to them: ""Throw down whatever you wish to throw.""
verses.translation: Moses said to them: ""Throw down whatever you wish to throw.""

verses.text: Thereupon they threw down their ropes and their rods and said: ""By the glory of Pharaoh we shall prevail.""
verses.translation: Thereupon they threw down their ropes and their rods and said: ""By the glory of Pharaoh we shall prevail.""

verses.text: Thereafter Moses threw down his rod and behold it went about swallowing up all the false devices they had contrived.
verses.translation: Thereafter Moses threw down his rod and behold it went about swallowing up all the false devices they had contrived.

verses.text: Thereupon the magicians fell down in prostration
verses.translation: Thereupon the magicians fell down in prostration

verses.text: saying: ""We (now) believe in the Lord of the Universe
verses.translation: saying: ""We (now) believe in the Lord of the Universe

verses.text: the Lord of Moses and Aaron.""
verses.translation: the Lord of Moses and Aaron.""

verses.text: Pharaoh said: ""You accepted the word of Moses even before I granted you the leave to do so. Surely he is your chief who has taught you magic. Soon shall you come to know. I shall cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides and shall crucify all of you.""
verses.translation: Pharaoh said: ""You accepted the word of Moses even before I granted you the leave to do so. Surely he is your chief who has taught you magic. Soon shall you come to know. I shall cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides and shall crucify all of you.""

verses.text: They said: ""We do not care for we are bound to return to our Lord
verses.translation: They said: ""We do not care for we are bound to return to our Lord

verses.translation: and we surely expect that Our Lord will forgive us our sins for we are the first ones to believe.""

verses.text: We revealed to Moses: ""Set forth with My servants by night for you will be pursued.""
verses.translation: We revealed to Moses: ""Set forth with My servants by night for you will be pursued.""

verses.translation: Then Pharaoh sent heralds to the cities (to mobilise troops)

verses.text: saying: ""These (Israelites) are only a small band of people
verses.translation: saying: ""These (Israelites) are only a small band of people

verses.translation: who have certainly provoked our wrath.

verses.text: But we are a numerous host ever on guard.""
verses.translation: But we are a numerous host ever on guard.""

verses.translation: Thus did We drive them out of their gardens and springs

verses.text: and their treasures and excellent dwellings.
verses.translation: and their treasures and excellent dwellings.

verses.translation: This happened with them; (but on the other hand) We enabled the Children of Israel to inherit those bounties.

verses.translation: At sunrise they set off in pursuit of them

verses.translation: and when the groups came face to face the companions of Moses cried out: ""We are overtaken!""

verses.text: Moses said: ""Certainly not. My Lord is with me; He will direct me.""
verses.translation: Moses said: ""Certainly not. My Lord is with me; He will direct me.""

verses.translation: Then We revealed to Moses (commanding him): ""Strike the sea with your rod."" Thereupon the sea split up and then each became like the mass of a huge mount.

verses.text: We also brought the other party close to the same spot
verses.translation: We also brought the other party close to the same spot

verses.translation: and We delivered Moses and his companions all of them

verses.translation: then We drowned the others.

verses.text: Surely there is a Sign in this but most of them would not believe.
verses.translation: Surely there is a Sign in this but most of them would not believe.

verses.text: Verily your Lord is Immensely Mighty Ever Compassionate.
verses.translation: Verily your Lord is Immensely Mighty Ever Compassionate.

verses.translation: And recount to them the story of Abraham:

verses.translation: when he asked his father and his people: ""What do you worship?""

verses.translation: They answered: ""There are some idols that we worship and are devoted to them with constancy.""

verses.translation: He asked: ""Do they hear you when you call them

verses.translation: or do they cause you any benefit or harm?""

verses.translation: They answered: ""No; but we found our forefathers doing so.""

verses.translation: you and your forefathers of yore?

verses.translation: They are all enemies to me; all except the Lord of the Universe

verses.translation: Who created me and Who guides me;

verses.translation: Who gives me food and drink

verses.translation: and Who when I am ill heals me;

verses.translation: Who will cause me to die and then will again restore me to life;

verses.translation: Who I hope will forgive me my sins on the Day of Judgement.""

verses.translation: (And then Abraham prayed): ""My Lord endow me with knowledge and wisdom and join me with the righteous

verses.translation: and grant me an honourable reputation among posterity

verses.translation: and make me of those who will inherit the Garden of Bliss

verses.translation: and forgive my father for he is among those who strayed

verses.translation: and disgrace me not on the Day when people will be raised to life

verses.translation: but only he that brings to Allah a sound heart will (attain to success).""

verses.translation: (On that Day)the Garden will be brought near to the God-fearing

verses.translation: and the Fire will be uncovered for those who strayed

verses.translation: and they will be asked: ""Where are the gods that you worshipped

verses.translation: beside Allah? Can they be of any help to you or even be of any help to themselves?""

verses.translation: and so too the hosts of Iblis all of them.

verses.translation: By Allah we were surely in clear error

verses.translation: when we assigned to you a position equal to that of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.translation: It is none but those steeped in guilt who led us into this error

verses.translation: and now we have none to intercede on our behalf

verses.translation: If only we could return we would be among the believers.""

verses.translation: Verily Your Lord is Immensely Mighty Ever Compassionate.

verses.translation: So fear Allah and obey me.""

verses.translation: Noah said: ""What knowledge do I have about their deeds?

verses.translation: It is only for my Lord to take account of them. Would that you made use of your understanding!

verses.translation: So pass a clear judgement between me and them and rescue me and the believers with me.""

verses.text: to admonish them. We have never been unjust.
verses.translation: to admonish them. We have never been unjust.

verses.text: The satans did not bring down this (Clear Book)
verses.translation: The satans did not bring down this (Clear Book)

verses.text: nor does it behove them nor does it lie in their power.
verses.translation: nor does it behove them nor does it lie in their power.

verses.text: Indeed they are debarred from even hearing it.
verses.translation: Indeed they are debarred from even hearing it.

verses.text: So do not call any other god beside Allah lest you become of those who will be punished
verses.translation: So do not call any other god beside Allah lest you become of those who will be punished

verses.text: and warn your nearest kinsmen;
verses.translation: and warn your nearest kinsmen;

verses.text: and be meek to the believers who follow you.
verses.translation: and be meek to the believers who follow you.

verses.text: Then if they disobey you say to them: ""I am quit of what you do.""
verses.translation: Then if they disobey you say to them: ""I am quit of what you do.""

verses.text: And put your trust in Him Who is Immensely Mighty Most Compassionate
verses.translation: And put your trust in Him Who is Immensely Mighty Most Compassionate

verses.text: Who observes you when you rise (to pray)
verses.translation: Who observes you when you rise (to pray)

verses.text: and observes your movements among those who prostrate themselves.
verses.translation: and observes your movements among those who prostrate themselves.

verses.text: He is All-Hearing All-Knowing.
verses.translation: He is All-Hearing All-Knowing.

verses.text: O people shall I tell you on whom it is that satans descend?
verses.translation: O people shall I tell you on whom it is that satans descend?

verses.text: They descend on every forgerer steeped in sin
verses.translation: They descend on every forgerer steeped in sin

verses.text: on those who whisper hearsay in the ears of people; and most of them are liars.
verses.translation: on those who whisper hearsay in the ears of people; and most of them are liars.

verses.text: As for poets only the wayward follow them.
verses.translation: As for poets only the wayward follow them.

verses.text: Do you not see that they wander about in every valley
verses.translation: Do you not see that they wander about in every valley

verses.text: and say things which they do not act upon
verses.translation: and say things which they do not act upon

verses.text: except those who believed and acted righteously and remembered Allah much and when they themselves were subjected to wrong they exacted retribution no more than to the extent of the wrong? Soon will the wrong-doers know the end that they shall reach.
verses.translation: except those who believed and acted righteously and remembered Allah much and when they themselves were subjected to wrong they exacted retribution no more than to the extent of the wrong? Soon will the wrong-doers know the end that they shall reach.

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: Ta''. Sin. Mim.
ayahs.translation: Ta''. Sin. Mim.

ayahs.text: These are the verses of the Clear Book.
ayahs.translation: These are the verses of the Clear Book.

ayahs.text: (O Muhammad) you will perhaps grieve yourself to death because these people do not believe.
ayahs.translation: (O Muhammad) you will perhaps grieve yourself to death because these people do not believe.

ayahs.text: If We will We can send down a Sign to them from heaven so their necks will be humbled to it.
ayahs.translation: If We will We can send down a Sign to them from heaven so their necks will be humbled to it.

ayahs.text: Never does there come to them an admonition from the Merciful Lord but they turn away from it.
ayahs.translation: Never does there come to them an admonition from the Merciful Lord but they turn away from it.

ayahs.text: They will soon come to know the truth of that which they have been scoffing at.
ayahs.translation: They will soon come to know the truth of that which they have been scoffing at.

ayahs.text: Do they not look at the earth how We caused a variety of fine vegetation to grow from it (in abundance)?
ayahs.translation: Do they not look at the earth how We caused a variety of fine vegetation to grow from it (in abundance)?

ayahs.text: Surely there is a Sign in this but most of them would not believe.
ayahs.translation: Surely there is a Sign in this but most of them would not believe.

ayahs.text: Verily Your Lord is Infinitely Mighty Most Compassionate.
ayahs.translation: Verily Your Lord is Infinitely Mighty Most Compassionate.

ayahs.text: (Recount to them about the time) when Your Lord called Moses: ""Go to the wrong-doing people
ayahs.translation: (Recount to them about the time) when Your Lord called Moses: ""Go to the wrong-doing people

ayahs.text: the people of Pharaoh: do they have no fear?""
ayahs.translation: the people of Pharaoh: do they have no fear?""

ayahs.text: He said: ""My Lord! I fear that they will brand me a liar.
ayahs.translation: He said: ""My Lord! I fear that they will brand me a liar.

ayahs.text: My breast is constricted and my tongue is not fluent so endow Messengership on Aaron.
ayahs.translation: My breast is constricted and my tongue is not fluent so endow Messengership on Aaron.

ayahs.text: As for me they hold the charge of a crime against me. I fear they will put me to death.""
ayahs.translation: As for me they hold the charge of a crime against me. I fear they will put me to death.""

ayahs.text: He said: ""Certainly not! So go both of you with Our Signs. We shall be with you listening to everything.
ayahs.translation: He said: ""Certainly not! So go both of you with Our Signs. We shall be with you listening to everything.

ayahs.text: Go then to Pharaoh and say to him: ''The Lord of the Universe has sent us
ayahs.translation: Go then to Pharaoh and say to him: ''The Lord of the Universe has sent us

ayahs.text: that you let the Children of Israel go with us.''
ayahs.translation: that you let the Children of Israel go with us.''

ayahs.text: Pharaoh said: ""Did we not bring you up among us when you were a child?
ayahs.translation: Pharaoh said: ""Did we not bring you up among us when you were a child?

ayahs.text: You spent many years of your life among us and then you committed that deed of yours. You are very ungrateful indeed.""
ayahs.translation: You spent many years of your life among us and then you committed that deed of yours. You are very ungrateful indeed.""

ayahs.text: Moses replied: ""I committed that act erringly.
ayahs.translation: Moses replied: ""I committed that act erringly.

ayahs.text: Then I fled for fear of you. Then my Lord bestowed wisdom and authority on me and made me one of the Messengers.
ayahs.translation: Then I fled for fear of you. Then my Lord bestowed wisdom and authority on me and made me one of the Messengers.

ayahs.text: Now this is the favour that you tauntingly remind me of: that you enslaved the Children of Israel!""
ayahs.translation: Now this is the favour that you tauntingly remind me of: that you enslaved the Children of Israel!""

ayahs.text: Pharaoh said: ""And who is this Lord of the Universe?""
ayahs.translation: Pharaoh said: ""And who is this Lord of the Universe?""

ayahs.text: Moses answered: ""The Lord of the heavens and the earth and of all that is between them if you were only to believe.""
ayahs.translation: Moses answered: ""The Lord of the heavens and the earth and of all that is between them if you were only to believe.""

ayahs.text: Pharaoh said to those around him: ""Do you hear (what he says)?""
ayahs.translation: Pharaoh said to those around him: ""Do you hear (what he says)?""

ayahs.text: Moses said: ""(He is) Your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers of yore.""
ayahs.translation: Moses said: ""(He is) Your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers of yore.""

ayahs.text: Pharaoh said to the audience: ""This Messenger of yours who has been sent to you is simply mad.""
ayahs.translation: Pharaoh said to the audience: ""This Messenger of yours who has been sent to you is simply mad.""

ayahs.text: Moses continued: ""(He is) the Lord of the east and the west and all between them. If you only had any understanding!""
ayahs.translation: Moses continued: ""(He is) the Lord of the east and the west and all between them. If you only had any understanding!""

ayahs.text: Pharaoh said: ""If you take any god other than me I will certainly make you one of those (who are rotting) in prison.""
ayahs.translation: Pharaoh said: ""If you take any god other than me I will certainly make you one of those (who are rotting) in prison.""

ayahs.text: Moses said: ""Even if I were to bring a Clear Sign to you?""
ayahs.translation: Moses said: ""Even if I were to bring a Clear Sign to you?""

ayahs.text: Pharaoh said: ""Then bring it if you are truthful at all.""
ayahs.translation: Pharaoh said: ""Then bring it if you are truthful at all.""

ayahs.text: (No sooner had he said this than) Moses threw down his rod and behold it was a veritable serpent
ayahs.translation: (No sooner had he said this than) Moses threw down his rod and behold it was a veritable serpent

ayahs.text: and he drew his hand (out of his armpit) and lo! it had become a shining object to the beholders.
ayahs.translation: and he drew his hand (out of his armpit) and lo! it had become a shining object to the beholders.

ayahs.text: Pharaoh said to the nobles around him: ""Surely this man is a skilled magician
ayahs.translation: Pharaoh said to the nobles around him: ""Surely this man is a skilled magician

ayahs.text: who wants to drive you out of your land by his magic. Tell us what do you advise us?""
ayahs.translation: who wants to drive you out of your land by his magic. Tell us what do you advise us?""

ayahs.text: They said: ""Detain him and his brother for a while and send forth heralds to the cities
ayahs.translation: They said: ""Detain him and his brother for a while and send forth heralds to the cities

ayahs.text: to mobilise all skilled magicians.""
ayahs.translation: to mobilise all skilled magicians.""

ayahs.text: So the magicians were brought together on a particular day at a set time
ayahs.translation: So the magicians were brought together on a particular day at a set time

ayahs.text: and the people were told: ""Will you join the assembly?
ayahs.translation: and the people were told: ""Will you join the assembly?

ayahs.text: We may perhaps follow the religion of the magicians if they triumph.""
ayahs.translation: We may perhaps follow the religion of the magicians if they triumph.""

ayahs.text: When the magicians came forth (for the encounter) they said to Pharaoh: ""Is there a reward for us if we triumph?""
ayahs.translation: When the magicians came forth (for the encounter) they said to Pharaoh: ""Is there a reward for us if we triumph?""

ayahs.text: He said: ""Yes you will then become those near-stationed to me.""
ayahs.translation: He said: ""Yes you will then become those near-stationed to me.""

ayahs.text: Moses said to them: ""Throw down whatever you wish to throw.""
ayahs.translation: Moses said to them: ""Throw down whatever you wish to throw.""

ayahs.text: Thereupon they threw down their ropes and their rods and said: ""By the glory of Pharaoh we shall prevail.""
ayahs.translation: Thereupon they threw down their ropes and their rods and said: ""By the glory of Pharaoh we shall prevail.""

ayahs.text: Thereafter Moses threw down his rod and behold it went about swallowing up all the false devices they had contrived.
ayahs.translation: Thereafter Moses threw down his rod and behold it went about swallowing up all the false devices they had contrived.

ayahs.text: Thereupon the magicians fell down in prostration
ayahs.translation: Thereupon the magicians fell down in prostration

ayahs.text: saying: ""We (now) believe in the Lord of the Universe
ayahs.translation: saying: ""We (now) believe in the Lord of the Universe

ayahs.text: the Lord of Moses and Aaron.""
ayahs.translation: the Lord of Moses and Aaron.""

ayahs.text: Pharaoh said: ""You accepted the word of Moses even before I granted you the leave to do so. Surely he is your chief who has taught you magic. Soon shall you come to know. I shall cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides and shall crucify all of you.""
ayahs.translation: Pharaoh said: ""You accepted the word of Moses even before I granted you the leave to do so. Surely he is your chief who has taught you magic. Soon shall you come to know. I shall cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides and shall crucify all of you.""

ayahs.text: They said: ""We do not care for we are bound to return to our Lord
ayahs.translation: They said: ""We do not care for we are bound to return to our Lord

ayahs.text: and we surely expect that Our Lord will forgive us our sins for we are the first ones to believe.""
ayahs.translation: and we surely expect that Our Lord will forgive us our sins for we are the first ones to believe.""

ayahs.text: We revealed to Moses: ""Set forth with My servants by night for you will be pursued.""
ayahs.translation: We revealed to Moses: ""Set forth with My servants by night for you will be pursued.""

ayahs.text: Then Pharaoh sent heralds to the cities (to mobilise troops)
ayahs.translation: Then Pharaoh sent heralds to the cities (to mobilise troops)

ayahs.text: saying: ""These (Israelites) are only a small band of people
ayahs.translation: saying: ""These (Israelites) are only a small band of people

ayahs.text: who have certainly provoked our wrath.
ayahs.translation: who have certainly provoked our wrath.

ayahs.text: But we are a numerous host ever on guard.""
ayahs.translation: But we are a numerous host ever on guard.""

ayahs.text: Thus did We drive them out of their gardens and springs
ayahs.translation: Thus did We drive them out of their gardens and springs

ayahs.text: and their treasures and excellent dwellings.
ayahs.translation: and their treasures and excellent dwellings.

ayahs.text: This happened with them; (but on the other hand) We enabled the Children of Israel to inherit those bounties.
ayahs.translation: This happened with them; (but on the other hand) We enabled the Children of Israel to inherit those bounties.

ayahs.text: At sunrise they set off in pursuit of them
ayahs.translation: At sunrise they set off in pursuit of them

ayahs.text: and when the groups came face to face the companions of Moses cried out: ""We are overtaken!""
ayahs.translation: and when the groups came face to face the companions of Moses cried out: ""We are overtaken!""

ayahs.text: Moses said: ""Certainly not. My Lord is with me; He will direct me.""
ayahs.translation: Moses said: ""Certainly not. My Lord is with me; He will direct me.""

ayahs.text: Then We revealed to Moses (commanding him): ""Strike the sea with your rod."" Thereupon the sea split up and then each became like the mass of a huge mount.
ayahs.translation: Then We revealed to Moses (commanding him): ""Strike the sea with your rod."" Thereupon the sea split up and then each became like the mass of a huge mount.

ayahs.text: We also brought the other party close to the same spot
ayahs.translation: We also brought the other party close to the same spot

ayahs.text: and We delivered Moses and his companions all of them
ayahs.translation: and We delivered Moses and his companions all of them

ayahs.text: then We drowned the others.
ayahs.translation: then We drowned the others.

ayahs.text: Surely there is a Sign in this but most of them would not believe.
ayahs.translation: Surely there is a Sign in this but most of them would not believe.

ayahs.text: Verily your Lord is Immensely Mighty Ever Compassionate.
ayahs.translation: Verily your Lord is Immensely Mighty Ever Compassionate.

ayahs.text: And recount to them the story of Abraham:
ayahs.translation: And recount to them the story of Abraham:

ayahs.text: when he asked his father and his people: ""What do you worship?""
ayahs.translation: when he asked his father and his people: ""What do you worship?""

ayahs.text: They answered: ""There are some idols that we worship and are devoted to them with constancy.""
ayahs.translation: They answered: ""There are some idols that we worship and are devoted to them with constancy.""

ayahs.text: He asked: ""Do they hear you when you call them
ayahs.translation: He asked: ""Do they hear you when you call them

ayahs.text: or do they cause you any benefit or harm?""
ayahs.translation: or do they cause you any benefit or harm?""

ayahs.text: They answered: ""No; but we found our forefathers doing so.""
ayahs.translation: They answered: ""No; but we found our forefathers doing so.""

ayahs.text: Thereupon Abraham said: ""Have you seen (with your eyes) those whom you have been worshipping
ayahs.translation: Thereupon Abraham said: ""Have you seen (with your eyes) those whom you have been worshipping

ayahs.text: you and your forefathers of yore?
ayahs.translation: you and your forefathers of yore?

ayahs.text: They are all enemies to me; all except the Lord of the Universe
ayahs.translation: They are all enemies to me; all except the Lord of the Universe

ayahs.text: Who created me and Who guides me;
ayahs.translation: Who created me and Who guides me;

ayahs.text: Who gives me food and drink
ayahs.translation: Who gives me food and drink

ayahs.text: and Who when I am ill heals me;
ayahs.translation: and Who when I am ill heals me;

ayahs.text: Who will cause me to die and then will again restore me to life;
ayahs.translation: Who will cause me to die and then will again restore me to life;

ayahs.text: Who I hope will forgive me my sins on the Day of Judgement.""
ayahs.translation: Who I hope will forgive me my sins on the Day of Judgement.""

ayahs.text: (And then Abraham prayed): ""My Lord endow me with knowledge and wisdom and join me with the righteous
ayahs.translation: (And then Abraham prayed): ""My Lord endow me with knowledge and wisdom and join me with the righteous

ayahs.text: and grant me an honourable reputation among posterity
ayahs.translation: and grant me an honourable reputation among posterity

ayahs.text: and make me of those who will inherit the Garden of Bliss
ayahs.translation: and make me of those who will inherit the Garden of Bliss

ayahs.text: and forgive my father for he is among those who strayed
ayahs.translation: and forgive my father for he is among those who strayed

ayahs.text: and disgrace me not on the Day when people will be raised to life
ayahs.translation: and disgrace me not on the Day when people will be raised to life

ayahs.text: the Day when nothing will avail neither wealth nor offspring
ayahs.translation: the Day when nothing will avail neither wealth nor offspring

ayahs.text: but only he that brings to Allah a sound heart will (attain to success).""
ayahs.translation: but only he that brings to Allah a sound heart will (attain to success).""

ayahs.text: (On that Day)the Garden will be brought near to the God-fearing
ayahs.translation: (On that Day)the Garden will be brought near to the God-fearing

ayahs.text: and the Fire will be uncovered for those who strayed
ayahs.translation: and the Fire will be uncovered for those who strayed

ayahs.text: and they will be asked: ""Where are the gods that you worshipped
ayahs.translation: and they will be asked: ""Where are the gods that you worshipped

ayahs.text: beside Allah? Can they be of any help to you or even be of any help to themselves?""
ayahs.translation: beside Allah? Can they be of any help to you or even be of any help to themselves?""

ayahs.text: Then the idols and those who strayed will be hurled into the Fire headlong one upon another
ayahs.translation: Then the idols and those who strayed will be hurled into the Fire headlong one upon another

ayahs.text: and so too the hosts of Iblis all of them.
ayahs.translation: and so too the hosts of Iblis all of them.

ayahs.text: There they will quarrel with one another and the erring ones will say (to their deities):
ayahs.translation: There they will quarrel with one another and the erring ones will say (to their deities):

ayahs.text: By Allah we were surely in clear error
ayahs.translation: By Allah we were surely in clear error

ayahs.text: when we assigned to you a position equal to that of the Lord of the Universe.
ayahs.translation: when we assigned to you a position equal to that of the Lord of the Universe.

ayahs.text: It is none but those steeped in guilt who led us into this error
ayahs.translation: It is none but those steeped in guilt who led us into this error

ayahs.text: and now we have none to intercede on our behalf
ayahs.translation: and now we have none to intercede on our behalf

ayahs.text: nor do we have a truly sincere friend.
ayahs.translation: nor do we have a truly sincere friend.

ayahs.text: If only we could return we would be among the believers.""
ayahs.translation: If only we could return we would be among the believers.""

ayahs.text: Surely there is a Sign in this but most of them would not believe.
ayahs.translation: Surely there is a Sign in this but most of them would not believe.

ayahs.text: Verily Your Lord is Immensely Mighty Ever Compassionate.
ayahs.translation: Verily Your Lord is Immensely Mighty Ever Compassionate.

ayahs.text: The people of Noah gave the lie to the Messengers.
ayahs.translation: The people of Noah gave the lie to the Messengers.

ayahs.text: Recall when their brother Noah said to them: ""Do you have no fear?
ayahs.translation: Recall when their brother Noah said to them: ""Do you have no fear?

ayahs.text: I am a trustworthy Messenger to you;
ayahs.translation: I am a trustworthy Messenger to you;

ayahs.text: so fear Allah and obey me.
ayahs.translation: so fear Allah and obey me.

ayahs.text: I seek of you no reward for this: my reward is with none except the Lord of the Universe.
ayahs.translation: I seek of you no reward for this: my reward is with none except the Lord of the Universe.

ayahs.text: So fear Allah and obey me.""
ayahs.translation: So fear Allah and obey me.""

ayahs.text: They answered: ""Shall we accept you even though it is the meanest of people who follow you?""
ayahs.translation: They answered: ""Shall we accept you even though it is the meanest of people who follow you?""

ayahs.text: Noah said: ""What knowledge do I have about their deeds?
ayahs.translation: Noah said: ""What knowledge do I have about their deeds?

ayahs.text: It is only for my Lord to take account of them. Would that you made use of your understanding!
ayahs.translation: It is only for my Lord to take account of them. Would that you made use of your understanding!

ayahs.text: It is not for me to repel those who choose to believe.
ayahs.translation: It is not for me to repel those who choose to believe.

ayahs.text: I am none but a plain warner.""
ayahs.translation: I am none but a plain warner.""

ayahs.text: They said: ""O Noah! If you do not desist you will certainly become one of the accursed.""
ayahs.translation: They said: ""O Noah! If you do not desist you will certainly become one of the accursed.""

ayahs.text: He said: ""My Lord! My people have branded me a liar.
ayahs.translation: He said: ""My Lord! My people have branded me a liar.

ayahs.text: So pass a clear judgement between me and them and rescue me and the believers with me.""
ayahs.translation: So pass a clear judgement between me and them and rescue me and the believers with me.""

ayahs.text: Thereafter We rescued him and those who were with him in the laden Ark
ayahs.translation: Thereafter We rescued him and those who were with him in the laden Ark

ayahs.text: and drowned the rest.
ayahs.translation: and drowned the rest.

ayahs.text: Surely there is a Sign in this but most of them would not believe.
ayahs.translation: Surely there is a Sign in this but most of them would not believe.

ayahs.text: Verily Your Lord is Immensely Mighty Ever Compassionate.
ayahs.translation: Verily Your Lord is Immensely Mighty Ever Compassionate.

ayahs.text: The  Ad gave the lie to the Messengers.
ayahs.translation: The  Ad gave the lie to the Messengers.

ayahs.text: Recall when their brother Hud said to them: ""Have you no fear?
ayahs.translation: Recall when their brother Hud said to them: ""Have you no fear?

ayahs.text: I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.
ayahs.translation: I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

ayahs.text: So fear Allah and obey me.
ayahs.translation: So fear Allah and obey me.

ayahs.text: I seek of you no reward for this; my reward is with none but the Lord of the Universe.
ayahs.translation: I seek of you no reward for this; my reward is with none but the Lord of the Universe.

ayahs.text: What you build a monument on every hill merely for fun
ayahs.translation: What you build a monument on every hill merely for fun

ayahs.text: and erect huge palaces as though you will live for ever
ayahs.translation: and erect huge palaces as though you will live for ever

ayahs.text: and when you strike you strike like tyrants?
ayahs.translation: and when you strike you strike like tyrants?

ayahs.text: So fear Allah and obey me.
ayahs.translation: So fear Allah and obey me.

ayahs.text: Have fear of Him Who has provided you with all the (good) things you know;
ayahs.translation: Have fear of Him Who has provided you with all the (good) things you know;

ayahs.text: Who has provided you with flocks and children
ayahs.translation: Who has provided you with flocks and children

ayahs.text: and with gardens and springs.
ayahs.translation: and with gardens and springs.

ayahs.text: I fear for you the chastisement of an Awesome Day.""
ayahs.translation: I fear for you the chastisement of an Awesome Day.""

ayahs.text: They replied: ""It is all the same for us whether you admonish us or not.
ayahs.translation: They replied: ""It is all the same for us whether you admonish us or not.

ayahs.text: This has been happening all along.
ayahs.translation: This has been happening all along.

ayahs.text: We will not be subjected to any chastisement.""
ayahs.translation: We will not be subjected to any chastisement.""

ayahs.text: Eventually they gave the lie to him and We destroyed them. Surely there is a Sign in this but most of them would not believe.
ayahs.translation: Eventually they gave the lie to him and We destroyed them. Surely there is a Sign in this but most of them would not believe.

ayahs.text: Verily your Lord is Immensely Mighty Most Compassionate.
ayahs.translation: Verily your Lord is Immensely Mighty Most Compassionate.

ayahs.text: The Thamud gave the lie to the Messengers.
ayahs.translation: The Thamud gave the lie to the Messengers.

ayahs.text: Recall when their brother Salih said to them: ""Have you no fear?""
ayahs.translation: Recall when their brother Salih said to them: ""Have you no fear?""

ayahs.text: I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.
ayahs.translation: I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

ayahs.text: So fear Allah and obey me.
ayahs.translation: So fear Allah and obey me.

ayahs.text: I ask of you no reward. My reward is with none but the Lord of the Universe.
ayahs.translation: I ask of you no reward. My reward is with none but the Lord of the Universe.

ayahs.text: Do you believe that you will be left here to live securely in the present state
ayahs.translation: Do you believe that you will be left here to live securely in the present state

ayahs.text: amidst gardens and springs
ayahs.translation: amidst gardens and springs

ayahs.text: and cornfields and date-palms laden with juicy fruits?
ayahs.translation: and cornfields and date-palms laden with juicy fruits?

ayahs.text: You hew dwellings in mountains and exult in that.
ayahs.translation: You hew dwellings in mountains and exult in that.

ayahs.text: Fear Allah and obey me
ayahs.translation: Fear Allah and obey me

ayahs.text: and do not follow the biddings of those that go to excesses
ayahs.translation: and do not follow the biddings of those that go to excesses

ayahs.text: and spread mischief in the land rather than set things right.""
ayahs.translation: and spread mischief in the land rather than set things right.""

ayahs.text: They replied: ""You are nothing but one of those who are bewitched;
ayahs.translation: They replied: ""You are nothing but one of those who are bewitched;

ayahs.text: you are no different from a mortal like us. So produce a sign if you are truthful.""
ayahs.translation: you are no different from a mortal like us. So produce a sign if you are truthful.""

ayahs.text: Salih said: ""This is a she-camel. There is a day set for her to drink and there is a day set for you to drink.
ayahs.translation: Salih said: ""This is a she-camel. There is a day set for her to drink and there is a day set for you to drink.

ayahs.text: Do not molest her lest the chastisement of an Awesome Day should seize you.""
ayahs.translation: Do not molest her lest the chastisement of an Awesome Day should seize you.""

ayahs.text: But they hamstrung her and then regretted it.
ayahs.translation: But they hamstrung her and then regretted it.

ayahs.text: So the chastisement seized them. Surely there is a Sign in this but most of them would not believe.
ayahs.translation: So the chastisement seized them. Surely there is a Sign in this but most of them would not believe.

ayahs.text: Verily Your Lord is Immensely Mighty Most Compassionate.
ayahs.translation: Verily Your Lord is Immensely Mighty Most Compassionate.

ayahs.text: The people of Lot rejected the Messengers branding them liars.
ayahs.translation: The people of Lot rejected the Messengers branding them liars.

ayahs.text: Recall when their brother Lot said to them: ""Have you no fear?
ayahs.translation: Recall when their brother Lot said to them: ""Have you no fear?

ayahs.text: I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.
ayahs.translation: I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

ayahs.text: So fear Allah and obey me.
ayahs.translation: So fear Allah and obey me.

ayahs.text: I seek of you no reward. My reward is with none but the Lord of the Universe.
ayahs.translation: I seek of you no reward. My reward is with none but the Lord of the Universe.

ayahs.text: What of all creation will you go to (fornicate with) the males
ayahs.translation: What of all creation will you go to (fornicate with) the males

ayahs.text: leaving aside those whom Allah has created for you as your mates. Nay you are a people that has transgressed all limits.""
ayahs.translation: leaving aside those whom Allah has created for you as your mates. Nay you are a people that has transgressed all limits.""

ayahs.text: They said: ""O Lot! If you do not desist you will be one of those expelled (from our towns).""
ayahs.translation: They said: ""O Lot! If you do not desist you will be one of those expelled (from our towns).""

ayahs.text: He said: ""I am one of those who abhor your practice.
ayahs.translation: He said: ""I am one of those who abhor your practice.

ayahs.text: My Lord deliver me and my family from their wicked deeds.""
ayahs.translation: My Lord deliver me and my family from their wicked deeds.""

ayahs.text: Then We delivered him and all his family
ayahs.translation: Then We delivered him and all his family

ayahs.text: except an old woman who was among those that stayed behind.
ayahs.translation: except an old woman who was among those that stayed behind.

ayahs.text: Thereafter We utterly destroyed the rest
ayahs.translation: Thereafter We utterly destroyed the rest

ayahs.text: and We sent upon them a rain an evil rain that fell on those who had been warned.
ayahs.translation: and We sent upon them a rain an evil rain that fell on those who had been warned.

ayahs.text: Surely there is a Sign in this but most of them would not believe.
ayahs.translation: Surely there is a Sign in this but most of them would not believe.

ayahs.text: Verily Your Lord is Immensely Mighty Most Compassionate.
ayahs.translation: Verily Your Lord is Immensely Mighty Most Compassionate.

ayahs.text: The people of Aykah also gave the lie to the Messengers.
ayahs.translation: The people of Aykah also gave the lie to the Messengers.

ayahs.text: Recall when Shu ayb said to them: ""Have you no fear?
ayahs.translation: Recall when Shu ayb said to them: ""Have you no fear?

ayahs.text: I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.
ayahs.translation: I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

ayahs.text: So fear Allah and obey me.
ayahs.translation: So fear Allah and obey me.

ayahs.text: I ask of you no reward for this. My reward is with none but the Lord of the Universe.
ayahs.translation: I ask of you no reward for this. My reward is with none but the Lord of the Universe.

ayahs.text: Fill up the measure and do not diminish the goods of people
ayahs.translation: Fill up the measure and do not diminish the goods of people

ayahs.text: weigh with an even balance
ayahs.translation: weigh with an even balance

ayahs.text: and do not deliver short and do not go about creating mischief in the land
ayahs.translation: and do not deliver short and do not go about creating mischief in the land

ayahs.text: and have fear of Him Who created you and the earlier generations.""
ayahs.translation: and have fear of Him Who created you and the earlier generations.""

ayahs.text: They said: ""You are no more than one of those who have been bewitched
ayahs.translation: They said: ""You are no more than one of those who have been bewitched

ayahs.text: you are only a mortal like us. Indeed we believe that you are an utter liar.
ayahs.translation: you are only a mortal like us. Indeed we believe that you are an utter liar.

ayahs.text: So cause a piece of the sky to fall upon us if you are truthful.""
ayahs.translation: So cause a piece of the sky to fall upon us if you are truthful.""

ayahs.text: Shu ayb said: ""My Lord knows well all what you do.""
ayahs.translation: Shu ayb said: ""My Lord knows well all what you do.""

ayahs.text: Then they branded him a liar whereupon the chastisement of the Day of Canopy overtook them. It was the chastisement of a very awesome day.
ayahs.translation: Then they branded him a liar whereupon the chastisement of the Day of Canopy overtook them. It was the chastisement of a very awesome day.

ayahs.text: Surely there is a Sign in this but most of them would not believe.
ayahs.translation: Surely there is a Sign in this but most of them would not believe.

ayahs.text: Verily Your Lord is Immensely Mighty Most Compassionate.
ayahs.translation: Verily Your Lord is Immensely Mighty Most Compassionate.

ayahs.text: Indeed this is a revelation from the Lord of the Universe;
ayahs.translation: Indeed this is a revelation from the Lord of the Universe;

ayahs.text: which the truthful spirit has carried down
ayahs.translation: which the truthful spirit has carried down

ayahs.text: to your heart that you might become one of those who warn (others on behalf of Allah)
ayahs.translation: to your heart that you might become one of those who warn (others on behalf of Allah)

ayahs.text: (a revelation) in clear Arabic language
ayahs.translation: (a revelation) in clear Arabic language

ayahs.text: (a revelation embodied) in the scriptures of the ancients.
ayahs.translation: (a revelation embodied) in the scriptures of the ancients.

ayahs.text: Is it not a Sign to them - (to wit the Makkans) - that the learned men of the Children of Israel know that?
ayahs.translation: Is it not a Sign to them - (to wit the Makkans) - that the learned men of the Children of Israel know that?

ayahs.text: (But such is their adamance) that had We revealed it to one of the non-Arabs and even if he had recited (this clear Arabic discourse) to them
ayahs.translation: (But such is their adamance) that had We revealed it to one of the non-Arabs and even if he had recited (this clear Arabic discourse) to them

ayahs.text: they would still not have believed in it.
ayahs.translation: they would still not have believed in it.

ayahs.text: Thus have We caused this (Admonition) to penetrate the hearts of the culprits (like a hot rod).
ayahs.translation: Thus have We caused this (Admonition) to penetrate the hearts of the culprits (like a hot rod).

ayahs.text: They will not believe in it until they clearly see the grievous chastisement.
ayahs.translation: They will not believe in it until they clearly see the grievous chastisement.

ayahs.text: But when it comes upon them suddenly taking them unawares
ayahs.translation: But when it comes upon them suddenly taking them unawares

ayahs.text: they say: ""Can we be granted some respite?""
ayahs.translation: they say: ""Can we be granted some respite?""

ayahs.text: Do they really want Our chastisement to be expedited?
ayahs.translation: Do they really want Our chastisement to be expedited?

ayahs.text: Did you consider that if We were to let them enjoy life for many years
ayahs.translation: Did you consider that if We were to let them enjoy life for many years

ayahs.text: and then the chastisement of which they were being warned were to come upon them
ayahs.translation: and then the chastisement of which they were being warned were to come upon them

ayahs.text: of what avail will be the provisions of life which they have been granted to enjoy?
ayahs.translation: of what avail will be the provisions of life which they have been granted to enjoy?

ayahs.text: We never destroyed any habitation but that it had warners
ayahs.translation: We never destroyed any habitation but that it had warners

ayahs.text: to admonish them. We have never been unjust.
ayahs.translation: to admonish them. We have never been unjust.

ayahs.text: The satans did not bring down this (Clear Book)
ayahs.translation: The satans did not bring down this (Clear Book)

ayahs.text: nor does it behove them nor does it lie in their power.
ayahs.translation: nor does it behove them nor does it lie in their power.

ayahs.text: Indeed they are debarred from even hearing it.
ayahs.translation: Indeed they are debarred from even hearing it.

ayahs.text: So do not call any other god beside Allah lest you become of those who will be punished
ayahs.translation: So do not call any other god beside Allah lest you become of those who will be punished

ayahs.text: and warn your nearest kinsmen;
ayahs.translation: and warn your nearest kinsmen;

ayahs.text: and be meek to the believers who follow you.
ayahs.translation: and be meek to the believers who follow you.

ayahs.text: Then if they disobey you say to them: ""I am quit of what you do.""
ayahs.translation: Then if they disobey you say to them: ""I am quit of what you do.""

ayahs.text: And put your trust in Him Who is Immensely Mighty Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: And put your trust in Him Who is Immensely Mighty Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: Who observes you when you rise (to pray)
ayahs.translation: Who observes you when you rise (to pray)

ayahs.text: and observes your movements among those who prostrate themselves.
ayahs.translation: and observes your movements among those who prostrate themselves.

ayahs.text: He is All-Hearing All-Knowing.
ayahs.translation: He is All-Hearing All-Knowing.

ayahs.text: O people shall I tell you on whom it is that satans descend?
ayahs.translation: O people shall I tell you on whom it is that satans descend?

ayahs.text: They descend on every forgerer steeped in sin
ayahs.translation: They descend on every forgerer steeped in sin

ayahs.text: on those who whisper hearsay in the ears of people; and most of them are liars.
ayahs.translation: on those who whisper hearsay in the ears of people; and most of them are liars.

ayahs.text: As for poets only the wayward follow them.
ayahs.translation: As for poets only the wayward follow them.

ayahs.text: Do you not see that they wander about in every valley
ayahs.translation: Do you not see that they wander about in every valley

ayahs.text: and say things which they do not act upon
ayahs.translation: and say things which they do not act upon

ayahs.text: except those who believed and acted righteously and remembered Allah much and when they themselves were subjected to wrong they exacted retribution no more than to the extent of the wrong? Soon will the wrong-doers know the end that they shall reach.
ayahs.translation: except those who believed and acted righteously and remembered Allah much and when they themselves were subjected to wrong they exacted retribution no more than to the extent of the wrong? Soon will the wrong-doers know the end that they shall reach.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Ta''. Sin. These are the verses of the Qur''an and a Clear Book;
verses.translation: Ta''. Sin. These are the verses of the Qur''an and a Clear Book;

verses.text: a guidance and good tidings for the believers
verses.translation: a guidance and good tidings for the believers

verses.text: who establish Prayer and give Zakah and have firm faith in the Hereafter.
verses.translation: who establish Prayer and give Zakah and have firm faith in the Hereafter.

verses.text: As for those who do not believe in the Hereafter We have made their deeds seem attractive to them so they stumble around in perplexity.
verses.translation: As for those who do not believe in the Hereafter We have made their deeds seem attractive to them so they stumble around in perplexity.

verses.text: It is they for whom a grievous chastisement lies in store; it is they who shall be the greatest losers in the Hereafter.
verses.translation: It is they for whom a grievous chastisement lies in store; it is they who shall be the greatest losers in the Hereafter.

verses.text: As for you (O Muhammad) you are receiving the Qur''an from the Most Wise the All-Knowing.
verses.translation: As for you (O Muhammad) you are receiving the Qur''an from the Most Wise the All-Knowing.

verses.text: (Recount to them) when Moses said to his family: ""I perceive something like fire: soon will I bring to you some information from there or I will bring you a burning brand that you may warm yourselves.""
verses.translation: (Recount to them) when Moses said to his family: ""I perceive something like fire: soon will I bring to you some information from there or I will bring you a burning brand that you may warm yourselves.""

verses.text: But when Moses came to the fire a call was sounded: ""Blessed is He Who is in the fire and whatever is around it. Glory be to Allah the Sustainer of all in the Universe.
verses.translation: But when Moses came to the fire a call was sounded: ""Blessed is He Who is in the fire and whatever is around it. Glory be to Allah the Sustainer of all in the Universe.

verses.text: O Moses verily this is Me Allah the All-Mighty the All-Wise!
verses.translation: O Moses verily this is Me Allah the All-Mighty the All-Wise!

verses.text: Now cast your rod!"" But when he saw the rod writhing as though it were a serpent he turned his back in retreat and did not even look behind. ""O Moses have no fear. Messengers have no fear in My presence
verses.translation: Now cast your rod!"" But when he saw the rod writhing as though it were a serpent he turned his back in retreat and did not even look behind. ""O Moses have no fear. Messengers have no fear in My presence

verses.text: except he who has committed some wrong. But if he substitutes good in place of evil I am Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.
verses.translation: except he who has committed some wrong. But if he substitutes good in place of evil I am Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.

verses.text: Now put your hand into your bosom and it will come forth shining without any blemish. (These are two of the) nine Signs to be carried to Pharaoh and his people. They are surely a wicked people.""
verses.translation: Now put your hand into your bosom and it will come forth shining without any blemish. (These are two of the) nine Signs to be carried to Pharaoh and his people. They are surely a wicked people.""

verses.text: But when Our Clear Signs came to them they said: ""This is plain magic.""
verses.translation: But when Our Clear Signs came to them they said: ""This is plain magic.""

verses.text: They denied those Signs out of iniquity and arrogance although their hearts were convinced of their truth. So see how evil was the end of those mischief-makers!
verses.translation: They denied those Signs out of iniquity and arrogance although their hearts were convinced of their truth. So see how evil was the end of those mischief-makers!

verses.text: (On the other hand) We granted knowledge to David and Solomon and they said: ""All praise be to Allah Who has exalted us above many of His believing servants!""
verses.translation: (On the other hand) We granted knowledge to David and Solomon and they said: ""All praise be to Allah Who has exalted us above many of His believing servants!""

verses.text: And Solomon succeeded David and said: ""O people we have been taught the speech of birds and we have been endowed with all kinds of things. Surely this is a conspicuous favour (from Allah).""
verses.translation: And Solomon succeeded David and said: ""O people we have been taught the speech of birds and we have been endowed with all kinds of things. Surely this is a conspicuous favour (from Allah).""

verses.text: Hosts of jinn and humans and birds were marshalled for Solomon and were kept under full control.
verses.translation: Hosts of jinn and humans and birds were marshalled for Solomon and were kept under full control.

verses.text: (Solomon was once on the move with them) until when they reached a valley of ants one of the ants said: ""O ants get into your holes lest Solomon and his hosts crush you (under their feet) without even knowing.""
verses.translation: (Solomon was once on the move with them) until when they reached a valley of ants one of the ants said: ""O ants get into your holes lest Solomon and his hosts crush you (under their feet) without even knowing.""

verses.text: Smiling at the ant''s utterance Solomon burst into laughter and said: ""My Lord! Hold me under (Your) control that I may render thanks for the favour which You have bestowed on me and on my parents and that I may act righteously in a manner that would please You. Include me out of Your Mercy among Your righteous servants.""
verses.translation: Smiling at the ant''s utterance Solomon burst into laughter and said: ""My Lord! Hold me under (Your) control that I may render thanks for the favour which You have bestowed on me and on my parents and that I may act righteously in a manner that would please You. Include me out of Your Mercy among Your righteous servants.""

verses.text: (On another occasion) Solomon inspected the birds and said: ""Why is it that I do not see the hoopoe? Is he among the absentees?
verses.translation: (On another occasion) Solomon inspected the birds and said: ""Why is it that I do not see the hoopoe? Is he among the absentees?

verses.text: I will inflict a severe punishment on him or maybe even slaughter him unless he comes forth with a convincing reason (for his absence).""
verses.translation: I will inflict a severe punishment on him or maybe even slaughter him unless he comes forth with a convincing reason (for his absence).""

verses.text: Not before long the hoopoe came up and said: ""I have obtained a knowledge which you could not. I have brought for you sure news about Sheba.
verses.translation: Not before long the hoopoe came up and said: ""I have obtained a knowledge which you could not. I have brought for you sure news about Sheba.

verses.text: I found there a woman ruling over them one who has been endowed with all things and has a mighty throne.
verses.translation: I found there a woman ruling over them one who has been endowed with all things and has a mighty throne.

verses.text: I found that she and her people prostrate themselves before the sun rather than Allah."" Satan has made their deeds appear attractive to them and has thus debarred them from the Right Path so they do not find true guidance
verses.translation: I found that she and her people prostrate themselves before the sun rather than Allah."" Satan has made their deeds appear attractive to them and has thus debarred them from the Right Path so they do not find true guidance

verses.text: that they would prostrate themselves before Allah Who brings to light all that is hidden in the heavens and the earth and knows all that you conceal and all that you reveal.
verses.translation: that they would prostrate themselves before Allah Who brings to light all that is hidden in the heavens and the earth and knows all that you conceal and all that you reveal.

verses.text: Allah - none is worthy of worship save He; He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.
verses.translation: Allah - none is worthy of worship save He; He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.

verses.text: Solomon said: ""Soon shall we see whether you have spoken the truth or are one of those that lie.
verses.translation: Solomon said: ""Soon shall we see whether you have spoken the truth or are one of those that lie.

verses.text: Take this letter of mine deliver it to them and then draw back from them and observe what they do.""
verses.translation: Take this letter of mine deliver it to them and then draw back from them and observe what they do.""

verses.text: The Queen said:"" Know my nobles that a gracious letter has been delivered to me.
verses.translation: The Queen said:"" Know my nobles that a gracious letter has been delivered to me.

verses.text: It is from Solomon and it is: ""In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate.""
verses.translation: It is from Solomon and it is: ""In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate.""

verses.text: (It says): ""Do not act towards me with defiance but come to me in submission.""
verses.translation: (It says): ""Do not act towards me with defiance but come to me in submission.""

verses.text: (After reading the letter) the Queen said: ""Nobles let me have your counsel in this matter for I make no firm decision without you.""
verses.translation: (After reading the letter) the Queen said: ""Nobles let me have your counsel in this matter for I make no firm decision without you.""

verses.text: They said: ""We are strong and are given to vehement fighting. But the decision is yours. Therefore consider what you would like to command.""
verses.translation: They said: ""We are strong and are given to vehement fighting. But the decision is yours. Therefore consider what you would like to command.""

verses.text: The Queen said: ""When the kings enter a country they cause corruption in it and abase those of its people who are held in honour. This is what they are wont to do.
verses.translation: The Queen said: ""When the kings enter a country they cause corruption in it and abase those of its people who are held in honour. This is what they are wont to do.

verses.text: I will send them a gift and then see with what answer my envoys return.""
verses.translation: I will send them a gift and then see with what answer my envoys return.""

verses.text: Now when (the envoy of the Queen) came to Solomon he said: ""Do you want to aid me with wealth? Whatever Allah has granted me is much more than what He has given you. (Keep for yourselves) your gift in which you are exulting.
verses.translation: Now when (the envoy of the Queen) came to Solomon he said: ""Do you want to aid me with wealth? Whatever Allah has granted me is much more than what He has given you. (Keep for yourselves) your gift in which you are exulting.

verses.text: Envoy go back to those who sent you and we shall certainly come upon them with hosts whom they will be unable to resist. We shall drive them out from there and they will suffer humiliation and disgrace.""
verses.translation: Envoy go back to those who sent you and we shall certainly come upon them with hosts whom they will be unable to resist. We shall drive them out from there and they will suffer humiliation and disgrace.""

verses.text: Solomon said: ""My nobles which of you can bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?""
verses.translation: Solomon said: ""My nobles which of you can bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?""

verses.text: A stalwart of the jinn said: ""I will bring it to you before you rise from your council. Surely I have the power to do so and I am trustworthy.""
verses.translation: A stalwart of the jinn said: ""I will bring it to you before you rise from your council. Surely I have the power to do so and I am trustworthy.""

verses.text: And he who had some knowledge of the Book said: ""I will bring it before the twinkling of your eye."" When Solomon saw the throne placed firmly beside him he cried out: ""This is by the grace of my Lord so that He may test me whether I give thanks for (His Bounty) or act with ingratitude. Whoever is grateful is so to his own good; and whoever is ungrateful let him know that my Lord is Immensely Resourceful Most Bountiful.""
verses.translation: And he who had some knowledge of the Book said: ""I will bring it before the twinkling of your eye."" When Solomon saw the throne placed firmly beside him he cried out: ""This is by the grace of my Lord so that He may test me whether I give thanks for (His Bounty) or act with ingratitude. Whoever is grateful is so to his own good; and whoever is ungrateful let him know that my Lord is Immensely Resourceful Most Bountiful.""

verses.text: Solomon said:"" Set the throne before her casually and let us see whether she gets to the Truth or is one of those who are not guided to what is right.""
verses.translation: Solomon said:"" Set the throne before her casually and let us see whether she gets to the Truth or is one of those who are not guided to what is right.""

verses.text: When the Queen arrived she was asked: ""Is your throne like this one?"" She said: ""It seems as if it is the same. We had already come to know this and we had submitted ourselves.""
verses.translation: When the Queen arrived she was asked: ""Is your throne like this one?"" She said: ""It seems as if it is the same. We had already come to know this and we had submitted ourselves.""

verses.text: What prevented her (from accepting the True Faith) was her worshipping deities other than Allah for she belonged to an unbelieving people.
verses.translation: What prevented her (from accepting the True Faith) was her worshipping deities other than Allah for she belonged to an unbelieving people.

verses.text: She was told: ""Enter the palace."" But when she saw it she thought it was a pool of water and she bared both her calves (to enter into it). Solomon said: ""This is a slippery floor of crystal."" Thereupon she cried out: ""My Lord I have been inflicting much wrong on myself. Now I submit myself with Solomon to Allah the Lord of the whole Universe.""
verses.translation: She was told: ""Enter the palace."" But when she saw it she thought it was a pool of water and she bared both her calves (to enter into it). Solomon said: ""This is a slippery floor of crystal."" Thereupon she cried out: ""My Lord I have been inflicting much wrong on myself. Now I submit myself with Solomon to Allah the Lord of the whole Universe.""

verses.text: And We sent to Thamud their brother Salih (with the Message): ""Serve Allah  but all of a sudden they became split into two quarrelling factions.
verses.translation: And We sent to Thamud their brother Salih (with the Message): ""Serve Allah  but all of a sudden they became split into two quarrelling factions.

verses.text: Salih said: ""My people why do you wish to hasten that evil rather than good should come upon you? Why should you not seek pardon from Allah so that mercy be shown to you?""
verses.translation: Salih said: ""My people why do you wish to hasten that evil rather than good should come upon you? Why should you not seek pardon from Allah so that mercy be shown to you?""

verses.text: They said: ""We augur ill of you and those who are with you."" Salih replied: ""Your augury is with Allah. The truth is that you are a people who are being tried.""
verses.translation: They said: ""We augur ill of you and those who are with you."" Salih replied: ""Your augury is with Allah. The truth is that you are a people who are being tried.""

verses.text: Now there were nine ring-leaders in the city who created corruption in the land and never worked to set things right.
verses.translation: Now there were nine ring-leaders in the city who created corruption in the land and never worked to set things right.

verses.text: They said: ""Swear to one another in the name of Allah that we shall make a sudden night swoop on Salih and his family and will then tell their heirs that we did not witness the destruction of his family. We are indeed truthful.""
verses.translation: They said: ""Swear to one another in the name of Allah that we shall make a sudden night swoop on Salih and his family and will then tell their heirs that we did not witness the destruction of his family. We are indeed truthful.""

verses.text: Thus they planned and We too planned the while they did not know.
verses.translation: Thus they planned and We too planned the while they did not know.

verses.text: So see what was the outcome of the plan they made: We utterly destroyed them and their people all of them.
verses.translation: So see what was the outcome of the plan they made: We utterly destroyed them and their people all of them.

verses.text: Now behold their houses that lie in utter ruins because of their wrong-doing. Verily there is a Sign in this for the people who know.
verses.translation: Now behold their houses that lie in utter ruins because of their wrong-doing. Verily there is a Sign in this for the people who know.

verses.text: And We delivered those who believed and were wont to avoid disobeying (Allah).
verses.translation: And We delivered those who believed and were wont to avoid disobeying (Allah).

verses.text: We also sent Lot and recall when he told his people: ""Do you commit shameless acts with your eyes open?
verses.translation: We also sent Lot and recall when he told his people: ""Do you commit shameless acts with your eyes open?

verses.text: Do you lustfully approach men instead of women? Nay you engage in acts of sheer ignorance.""
verses.translation: Do you lustfully approach men instead of women? Nay you engage in acts of sheer ignorance.""

verses.text: But this had only one answer from his people. They said: ""Expel Lot''s folk from your city. They pretend to be absolutely clean.""
verses.translation: But this had only one answer from his people. They said: ""Expel Lot''s folk from your city. They pretend to be absolutely clean.""

verses.text: Eventually We saved (Lot) and his family except his wife. We had decreed that she should be among those who would remain behind.
verses.translation: Eventually We saved (Lot) and his family except his wife. We had decreed that she should be among those who would remain behind.

verses.text: And We rained down upon them a rain. It was an evil rain for those who had already been warned.
verses.translation: And We rained down upon them a rain. It was an evil rain for those who had already been warned.

verses.text: Say (O Muhammad): ""All praise be to Allah and peace be on those of His servants whom He has chosen."" (Ask them): ""Who is better: Allah or the false gods that they associate with Him as His partners?
verses.translation: Say (O Muhammad): ""All praise be to Allah and peace be on those of His servants whom He has chosen."" (Ask them): ""Who is better: Allah or the false gods that they associate with Him as His partners?

verses.text: Who is it that has created the heavens and the earth and sent down for you water from the sky and then We caused to grow therewith orchards full of beauty whose trees you could never grow. Is there any god associated with Allah (in these tasks)?"" Nay they are a people who are veering away from the Right Path.
verses.translation: Who is it that has created the heavens and the earth and sent down for you water from the sky and then We caused to grow therewith orchards full of beauty whose trees you could never grow. Is there any god associated with Allah (in these tasks)?"" Nay they are a people who are veering away from the Right Path.

verses.text: Who is it Who has made the earth a place of resort and has caused rivers to flow in its midst and has placed upon it firm mountains and has placed a barrier between two masses of water? Is there any god associated with Allah (in these tasks)? Nay; but most of them do not know.
verses.translation: Who is it Who has made the earth a place of resort and has caused rivers to flow in its midst and has placed upon it firm mountains and has placed a barrier between two masses of water? Is there any god associated with Allah (in these tasks)? Nay; but most of them do not know.

verses.text: Who is it Who heeds the prayers of the distressed when he calls out to Him and Who removes his affliction? And who is it Who makes you vicegerents of the earth? Is there any god associated with Allah (in this task)? How little do you reflect!
verses.translation: Who is it Who heeds the prayers of the distressed when he calls out to Him and Who removes his affliction? And who is it Who makes you vicegerents of the earth? Is there any god associated with Allah (in this task)? How little do you reflect!

verses.text: Who is it Who guides you through the darkness on land and sea? And Who sends winds as heralds of good tidings ahead of His Mercy? Is there any god associated with Allah (in this task)? Exalted be Allah above whatever they associate with Him in His Divinity!
verses.translation: Who is it Who guides you through the darkness on land and sea? And Who sends winds as heralds of good tidings ahead of His Mercy? Is there any god associated with Allah (in this task)? Exalted be Allah above whatever they associate with Him in His Divinity!

verses.text: Who is it Who creates in the first instance and then repeats it? Who is it Who provides you with sustenance from the heavens and the earth? Is there any god associated with Allah (in these tasks)? Say: ""Bring forth your evidence if you are truthful.""
verses.translation: Who is it Who creates in the first instance and then repeats it? Who is it Who provides you with sustenance from the heavens and the earth? Is there any god associated with Allah (in these tasks)? Say: ""Bring forth your evidence if you are truthful.""

verses.text: Say: ""None in the heavens or on the earth has knowledge of the Unseen save Allah. They do not know when they will be raised to life.""
verses.translation: Say: ""None in the heavens or on the earth has knowledge of the Unseen save Allah. They do not know when they will be raised to life.""

verses.text: Nay but they have lost their knowledge of the Hereafter. They are steeped in doubt and uncertainty about it: rather they are blind to it.
verses.translation: Nay but they have lost their knowledge of the Hereafter. They are steeped in doubt and uncertainty about it: rather they are blind to it.

verses.text: The unbelievers say: ""When we become dust we and our forefathers shall we really be brought out (from our graves)?
verses.translation: The unbelievers say: ""When we become dust we and our forefathers shall we really be brought out (from our graves)?

verses.text: We were told about this and so were our forefathers before us. But these are no more than fairy tales that have been recounted from ancient times.""
verses.translation: We were told about this and so were our forefathers before us. But these are no more than fairy tales that have been recounted from ancient times.""

verses.text: Say: ""Go about through the earth and see what has been the end of the evil-doers.""
verses.translation: Say: ""Go about through the earth and see what has been the end of the evil-doers.""

verses.text: (O Prophet) do not grieve over them nor be distressed at their designs.
verses.translation: (O Prophet) do not grieve over them nor be distressed at their designs.

verses.text: They also say: ""Tell us when this threat will come to pass if you are truthful.""
verses.translation: They also say: ""Tell us when this threat will come to pass if you are truthful.""

verses.text: Say: ""The chastisement whose hastening you have been asking for maybe a part of it has drawn quite near to you.""
verses.translation: Say: ""The chastisement whose hastening you have been asking for maybe a part of it has drawn quite near to you.""

verses.text: Indeed Your Lord is exceedingly bountiful to mankind. Yet most of them do not give thanks.
verses.translation: Indeed Your Lord is exceedingly bountiful to mankind. Yet most of them do not give thanks.

verses.text: Verily your Lord knows all that their hearts conceal as well as all that they reveal.
verses.translation: Verily your Lord knows all that their hearts conceal as well as all that they reveal.

verses.text: There is nothing that is hidden - be it in the heaven or the earth - but is recorded in a Clear Book.
verses.translation: There is nothing that is hidden - be it in the heaven or the earth - but is recorded in a Clear Book.

verses.text: Surely this Qur''an explains to the Children of Israel most of the matters concerning which they have disagreements
verses.translation: Surely this Qur''an explains to the Children of Israel most of the matters concerning which they have disagreements

verses.text: and it is a guidance and mercy for the believers.
verses.translation: and it is a guidance and mercy for the believers.

verses.text: Indeed your Lord will decide between them by His judgement. He is All-Mighty All-Knowing.
verses.translation: Indeed your Lord will decide between them by His judgement. He is All-Mighty All-Knowing.

verses.text: So put your trust in Allah for you are on the manifest truth.
verses.translation: So put your trust in Allah for you are on the manifest truth.

verses.text: Surely you cannot make the dead hear you nor can you make the deaf hear your call if they turn back in flight
verses.translation: Surely you cannot make the dead hear you nor can you make the deaf hear your call if they turn back in flight

verses.text: nor can you direct the blind to the Right Way preventing them from falling into error. You can make only those who believe in Our verses to hear the call and then submit.
verses.translation: nor can you direct the blind to the Right Way preventing them from falling into error. You can make only those who believe in Our verses to hear the call and then submit.

verses.text: And when the time for the fulfilment of Our Word against them will come We shall bring forth for them a beast from the earth who will speak to them because people did not believe in Our Signs.
verses.translation: And when the time for the fulfilment of Our Word against them will come We shall bring forth for them a beast from the earth who will speak to them because people did not believe in Our Signs.

verses.text: Just imagine the Day when We shall muster from every nation a large group of those who gave the lie to Our Signs and they shall be duly arranged in ranks
verses.translation: Just imagine the Day when We shall muster from every nation a large group of those who gave the lie to Our Signs and they shall be duly arranged in ranks

verses.text: until when all of them have arrived Allah will say: ""Did you give the lie to My Signs even without encompassing them with your knowledge? If that is not so what did you do?""
verses.translation: until when all of them have arrived Allah will say: ""Did you give the lie to My Signs even without encompassing them with your knowledge? If that is not so what did you do?""

verses.text: And the Word will come to pass against them because of their wrong-doing: they will then be able to utter nothing.
verses.translation: And the Word will come to pass against them because of their wrong-doing: they will then be able to utter nothing.

verses.text: Did they not perceive that We had made the night so that they may repose in it and made the day clear and shining. Surely there are Signs in this for those who believe.
verses.translation: Did they not perceive that We had made the night so that they may repose in it and made the day clear and shining. Surely there are Signs in this for those who believe.

verses.text: The Day when the Trumpet will be blown all those who are in the heavens and on the earth shall be terror stricken - all except those whom Allah wills - and everyone shall come to Him utterly abject.
verses.translation: The Day when the Trumpet will be blown all those who are in the heavens and on the earth shall be terror stricken - all except those whom Allah wills - and everyone shall come to Him utterly abject.

verses.text: You now see the mountains and consider them firmly fixed but then they shall pass away even as clouds pass away. That will be the handiwork of Allah Who has created everything with perfect wisdom. He is well aware of what you do.
verses.translation: You now see the mountains and consider them firmly fixed but then they shall pass away even as clouds pass away. That will be the handiwork of Allah Who has created everything with perfect wisdom. He is well aware of what you do.

verses.text: Whosoever comes with good will receive a reward better than his deed and they will be made secure from the terror of that Day.
verses.translation: Whosoever comes with good will receive a reward better than his deed and they will be made secure from the terror of that Day.

verses.text: And whosoever comes with evil they will be flung upon their faces into the Fire. Will you be recompensed for aught other than what you do?
