verses.translation: And whosoever comes with evil they will be flung upon their faces into the Fire. Will you be recompensed for aught other than what you do?

verses.text: (Tell them O Muhammad): ""I have been commanded only to serve the Lord of this city that He has made inviolable to serve Him to Whom all things belong. I have been commanded to be of those that submit to Allah
verses.translation: (Tell them O Muhammad): ""I have been commanded only to serve the Lord of this city that He has made inviolable to serve Him to Whom all things belong. I have been commanded to be of those that submit to Allah

verses.text: and to recite the Qur''an."" So whosoever is guided his guidance will be to his own good. As for those who stray tell them: ""I am none but a warner.""
verses.translation: and to recite the Qur''an."" So whosoever is guided his guidance will be to his own good. As for those who stray tell them: ""I am none but a warner.""

verses.text: And say: ""All praise be to Allah Who will soon show you His Signs that you will recognize."" Your Lord is not unaware of what you do.
verses.translation: And say: ""All praise be to Allah Who will soon show you His Signs that you will recognize."" Your Lord is not unaware of what you do.

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: Ta''. Sin. These are the verses of the Qur''an and a Clear Book;
ayahs.translation: Ta''. Sin. These are the verses of the Qur''an and a Clear Book;

ayahs.text: a guidance and good tidings for the believers
ayahs.translation: a guidance and good tidings for the believers

ayahs.text: who establish Prayer and give Zakah and have firm faith in the Hereafter.
ayahs.translation: who establish Prayer and give Zakah and have firm faith in the Hereafter.

ayahs.text: As for those who do not believe in the Hereafter We have made their deeds seem attractive to them so they stumble around in perplexity.
ayahs.translation: As for those who do not believe in the Hereafter We have made their deeds seem attractive to them so they stumble around in perplexity.

ayahs.text: It is they for whom a grievous chastisement lies in store; it is they who shall be the greatest losers in the Hereafter.
ayahs.translation: It is they for whom a grievous chastisement lies in store; it is they who shall be the greatest losers in the Hereafter.

ayahs.text: As for you (O Muhammad) you are receiving the Qur''an from the Most Wise the All-Knowing.
ayahs.translation: As for you (O Muhammad) you are receiving the Qur''an from the Most Wise the All-Knowing.

ayahs.text: (Recount to them) when Moses said to his family: ""I perceive something like fire: soon will I bring to you some information from there or I will bring you a burning brand that you may warm yourselves.""
ayahs.translation: (Recount to them) when Moses said to his family: ""I perceive something like fire: soon will I bring to you some information from there or I will bring you a burning brand that you may warm yourselves.""

ayahs.text: But when Moses came to the fire a call was sounded: ""Blessed is He Who is in the fire and whatever is around it. Glory be to Allah the Sustainer of all in the Universe.
ayahs.translation: But when Moses came to the fire a call was sounded: ""Blessed is He Who is in the fire and whatever is around it. Glory be to Allah the Sustainer of all in the Universe.

ayahs.text: O Moses verily this is Me Allah the All-Mighty the All-Wise!
ayahs.translation: O Moses verily this is Me Allah the All-Mighty the All-Wise!

ayahs.text: Now cast your rod!"" But when he saw the rod writhing as though it were a serpent he turned his back in retreat and did not even look behind. ""O Moses have no fear. Messengers have no fear in My presence
ayahs.translation: Now cast your rod!"" But when he saw the rod writhing as though it were a serpent he turned his back in retreat and did not even look behind. ""O Moses have no fear. Messengers have no fear in My presence

ayahs.text: except he who has committed some wrong. But if he substitutes good in place of evil I am Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.
ayahs.translation: except he who has committed some wrong. But if he substitutes good in place of evil I am Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.

ayahs.text: Now put your hand into your bosom and it will come forth shining without any blemish. (These are two of the) nine Signs to be carried to Pharaoh and his people. They are surely a wicked people.""
ayahs.translation: Now put your hand into your bosom and it will come forth shining without any blemish. (These are two of the) nine Signs to be carried to Pharaoh and his people. They are surely a wicked people.""

ayahs.text: But when Our Clear Signs came to them they said: ""This is plain magic.""
ayahs.translation: But when Our Clear Signs came to them they said: ""This is plain magic.""

ayahs.text: They denied those Signs out of iniquity and arrogance although their hearts were convinced of their truth. So see how evil was the end of those mischief-makers!
ayahs.translation: They denied those Signs out of iniquity and arrogance although their hearts were convinced of their truth. So see how evil was the end of those mischief-makers!

ayahs.text: (On the other hand) We granted knowledge to David and Solomon and they said: ""All praise be to Allah Who has exalted us above many of His believing servants!""
ayahs.translation: (On the other hand) We granted knowledge to David and Solomon and they said: ""All praise be to Allah Who has exalted us above many of His believing servants!""

ayahs.text: And Solomon succeeded David and said: ""O people we have been taught the speech of birds and we have been endowed with all kinds of things. Surely this is a conspicuous favour (from Allah).""
ayahs.translation: And Solomon succeeded David and said: ""O people we have been taught the speech of birds and we have been endowed with all kinds of things. Surely this is a conspicuous favour (from Allah).""

ayahs.text: Hosts of jinn and humans and birds were marshalled for Solomon and were kept under full control.
ayahs.translation: Hosts of jinn and humans and birds were marshalled for Solomon and were kept under full control.

ayahs.text: (Solomon was once on the move with them) until when they reached a valley of ants one of the ants said: ""O ants get into your holes lest Solomon and his hosts crush you (under their feet) without even knowing.""
ayahs.translation: (Solomon was once on the move with them) until when they reached a valley of ants one of the ants said: ""O ants get into your holes lest Solomon and his hosts crush you (under their feet) without even knowing.""

ayahs.text: Smiling at the ant''s utterance Solomon burst into laughter and said: ""My Lord! Hold me under (Your) control that I may render thanks for the favour which You have bestowed on me and on my parents and that I may act righteously in a manner that would please You. Include me out of Your Mercy among Your righteous servants.""
ayahs.translation: Smiling at the ant''s utterance Solomon burst into laughter and said: ""My Lord! Hold me under (Your) control that I may render thanks for the favour which You have bestowed on me and on my parents and that I may act righteously in a manner that would please You. Include me out of Your Mercy among Your righteous servants.""

ayahs.text: (On another occasion) Solomon inspected the birds and said: ""Why is it that I do not see the hoopoe? Is he among the absentees?
ayahs.translation: (On another occasion) Solomon inspected the birds and said: ""Why is it that I do not see the hoopoe? Is he among the absentees?

ayahs.text: I will inflict a severe punishment on him or maybe even slaughter him unless he comes forth with a convincing reason (for his absence).""
ayahs.translation: I will inflict a severe punishment on him or maybe even slaughter him unless he comes forth with a convincing reason (for his absence).""

ayahs.text: Not before long the hoopoe came up and said: ""I have obtained a knowledge which you could not. I have brought for you sure news about Sheba.
ayahs.translation: Not before long the hoopoe came up and said: ""I have obtained a knowledge which you could not. I have brought for you sure news about Sheba.

ayahs.text: I found there a woman ruling over them one who has been endowed with all things and has a mighty throne.
ayahs.translation: I found there a woman ruling over them one who has been endowed with all things and has a mighty throne.

ayahs.text: I found that she and her people prostrate themselves before the sun rather than Allah."" Satan has made their deeds appear attractive to them and has thus debarred them from the Right Path so they do not find true guidance
ayahs.translation: I found that she and her people prostrate themselves before the sun rather than Allah."" Satan has made their deeds appear attractive to them and has thus debarred them from the Right Path so they do not find true guidance

ayahs.text: that they would prostrate themselves before Allah Who brings to light all that is hidden in the heavens and the earth and knows all that you conceal and all that you reveal.
ayahs.translation: that they would prostrate themselves before Allah Who brings to light all that is hidden in the heavens and the earth and knows all that you conceal and all that you reveal.

ayahs.text: Allah - none is worthy of worship save He; He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.
ayahs.translation: Allah - none is worthy of worship save He; He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.

ayahs.text: Solomon said: ""Soon shall we see whether you have spoken the truth or are one of those that lie.
ayahs.translation: Solomon said: ""Soon shall we see whether you have spoken the truth or are one of those that lie.

ayahs.text: Take this letter of mine deliver it to them and then draw back from them and observe what they do.""
ayahs.translation: Take this letter of mine deliver it to them and then draw back from them and observe what they do.""

ayahs.text: The Queen said:"" Know my nobles that a gracious letter has been delivered to me.
ayahs.translation: The Queen said:"" Know my nobles that a gracious letter has been delivered to me.

ayahs.text: It is from Solomon and it is: ""In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate.""
ayahs.translation: It is from Solomon and it is: ""In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate.""

ayahs.text: (It says): ""Do not act towards me with defiance but come to me in submission.""
ayahs.translation: (It says): ""Do not act towards me with defiance but come to me in submission.""

ayahs.text: (After reading the letter) the Queen said: ""Nobles let me have your counsel in this matter for I make no firm decision without you.""
ayahs.translation: (After reading the letter) the Queen said: ""Nobles let me have your counsel in this matter for I make no firm decision without you.""

ayahs.text: They said: ""We are strong and are given to vehement fighting. But the decision is yours. Therefore consider what you would like to command.""
ayahs.translation: They said: ""We are strong and are given to vehement fighting. But the decision is yours. Therefore consider what you would like to command.""

ayahs.text: The Queen said: ""When the kings enter a country they cause corruption in it and abase those of its people who are held in honour. This is what they are wont to do.
ayahs.translation: The Queen said: ""When the kings enter a country they cause corruption in it and abase those of its people who are held in honour. This is what they are wont to do.

ayahs.text: I will send them a gift and then see with what answer my envoys return.""
ayahs.translation: I will send them a gift and then see with what answer my envoys return.""

ayahs.text: Now when (the envoy of the Queen) came to Solomon he said: ""Do you want to aid me with wealth? Whatever Allah has granted me is much more than what He has given you. (Keep for yourselves) your gift in which you are exulting.
ayahs.translation: Now when (the envoy of the Queen) came to Solomon he said: ""Do you want to aid me with wealth? Whatever Allah has granted me is much more than what He has given you. (Keep for yourselves) your gift in which you are exulting.

ayahs.text: Envoy go back to those who sent you and we shall certainly come upon them with hosts whom they will be unable to resist. We shall drive them out from there and they will suffer humiliation and disgrace.""
ayahs.translation: Envoy go back to those who sent you and we shall certainly come upon them with hosts whom they will be unable to resist. We shall drive them out from there and they will suffer humiliation and disgrace.""

ayahs.text: Solomon said: ""My nobles which of you can bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?""
ayahs.translation: Solomon said: ""My nobles which of you can bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?""

ayahs.text: A stalwart of the jinn said: ""I will bring it to you before you rise from your council. Surely I have the power to do so and I am trustworthy.""
ayahs.translation: A stalwart of the jinn said: ""I will bring it to you before you rise from your council. Surely I have the power to do so and I am trustworthy.""

ayahs.text: And he who had some knowledge of the Book said: ""I will bring it before the twinkling of your eye."" When Solomon saw the throne placed firmly beside him he cried out: ""This is by the grace of my Lord so that He may test me whether I give thanks for (His Bounty) or act with ingratitude. Whoever is grateful is so to his own good; and whoever is ungrateful let him know that my Lord is Immensely Resourceful Most Bountiful.""
ayahs.translation: And he who had some knowledge of the Book said: ""I will bring it before the twinkling of your eye."" When Solomon saw the throne placed firmly beside him he cried out: ""This is by the grace of my Lord so that He may test me whether I give thanks for (His Bounty) or act with ingratitude. Whoever is grateful is so to his own good; and whoever is ungrateful let him know that my Lord is Immensely Resourceful Most Bountiful.""

ayahs.text: Solomon said:"" Set the throne before her casually and let us see whether she gets to the Truth or is one of those who are not guided to what is right.""
ayahs.translation: Solomon said:"" Set the throne before her casually and let us see whether she gets to the Truth or is one of those who are not guided to what is right.""

ayahs.text: When the Queen arrived she was asked: ""Is your throne like this one?"" She said: ""It seems as if it is the same. We had already come to know this and we had submitted ourselves.""
ayahs.translation: When the Queen arrived she was asked: ""Is your throne like this one?"" She said: ""It seems as if it is the same. We had already come to know this and we had submitted ourselves.""

ayahs.text: What prevented her (from accepting the True Faith) was her worshipping deities other than Allah for she belonged to an unbelieving people.
ayahs.translation: What prevented her (from accepting the True Faith) was her worshipping deities other than Allah for she belonged to an unbelieving people.

ayahs.text: She was told: ""Enter the palace."" But when she saw it she thought it was a pool of water and she bared both her calves (to enter into it). Solomon said: ""This is a slippery floor of crystal."" Thereupon she cried out: ""My Lord I have been inflicting much wrong on myself. Now I submit myself with Solomon to Allah the Lord of the whole Universe.""
ayahs.translation: She was told: ""Enter the palace."" But when she saw it she thought it was a pool of water and she bared both her calves (to enter into it). Solomon said: ""This is a slippery floor of crystal."" Thereupon she cried out: ""My Lord I have been inflicting much wrong on myself. Now I submit myself with Solomon to Allah the Lord of the whole Universe.""

ayahs.text: And We sent to Thamud their brother Salih (with the Message): ""Serve Allah  but all of a sudden they became split into two quarrelling factions.
ayahs.translation: And We sent to Thamud their brother Salih (with the Message): ""Serve Allah  but all of a sudden they became split into two quarrelling factions.

ayahs.text: Salih said: ""My people why do you wish to hasten that evil rather than good should come upon you? Why should you not seek pardon from Allah so that mercy be shown to you?""
ayahs.translation: Salih said: ""My people why do you wish to hasten that evil rather than good should come upon you? Why should you not seek pardon from Allah so that mercy be shown to you?""

ayahs.text: They said: ""We augur ill of you and those who are with you."" Salih replied: ""Your augury is with Allah. The truth is that you are a people who are being tried.""
ayahs.translation: They said: ""We augur ill of you and those who are with you."" Salih replied: ""Your augury is with Allah. The truth is that you are a people who are being tried.""

ayahs.text: Now there were nine ring-leaders in the city who created corruption in the land and never worked to set things right.
ayahs.translation: Now there were nine ring-leaders in the city who created corruption in the land and never worked to set things right.

ayahs.text: They said: ""Swear to one another in the name of Allah that we shall make a sudden night swoop on Salih and his family and will then tell their heirs that we did not witness the destruction of his family. We are indeed truthful.""
ayahs.translation: They said: ""Swear to one another in the name of Allah that we shall make a sudden night swoop on Salih and his family and will then tell their heirs that we did not witness the destruction of his family. We are indeed truthful.""

ayahs.text: Thus they planned and We too planned the while they did not know.
ayahs.translation: Thus they planned and We too planned the while they did not know.

ayahs.text: So see what was the outcome of the plan they made: We utterly destroyed them and their people all of them.
ayahs.translation: So see what was the outcome of the plan they made: We utterly destroyed them and their people all of them.

ayahs.text: Now behold their houses that lie in utter ruins because of their wrong-doing. Verily there is a Sign in this for the people who know.
ayahs.translation: Now behold their houses that lie in utter ruins because of their wrong-doing. Verily there is a Sign in this for the people who know.

ayahs.text: And We delivered those who believed and were wont to avoid disobeying (Allah).
ayahs.translation: And We delivered those who believed and were wont to avoid disobeying (Allah).

ayahs.text: We also sent Lot and recall when he told his people: ""Do you commit shameless acts with your eyes open?
ayahs.translation: We also sent Lot and recall when he told his people: ""Do you commit shameless acts with your eyes open?

ayahs.text: Do you lustfully approach men instead of women? Nay you engage in acts of sheer ignorance.""
ayahs.translation: Do you lustfully approach men instead of women? Nay you engage in acts of sheer ignorance.""

ayahs.text: But this had only one answer from his people. They said: ""Expel Lot''s folk from your city. They pretend to be absolutely clean.""
ayahs.translation: But this had only one answer from his people. They said: ""Expel Lot''s folk from your city. They pretend to be absolutely clean.""

ayahs.text: Eventually We saved (Lot) and his family except his wife. We had decreed that she should be among those who would remain behind.
ayahs.translation: Eventually We saved (Lot) and his family except his wife. We had decreed that she should be among those who would remain behind.

ayahs.text: And We rained down upon them a rain. It was an evil rain for those who had already been warned.
ayahs.translation: And We rained down upon them a rain. It was an evil rain for those who had already been warned.

ayahs.text: Say (O Muhammad): ""All praise be to Allah and peace be on those of His servants whom He has chosen."" (Ask them): ""Who is better: Allah or the false gods that they associate with Him as His partners?
ayahs.translation: Say (O Muhammad): ""All praise be to Allah and peace be on those of His servants whom He has chosen."" (Ask them): ""Who is better: Allah or the false gods that they associate with Him as His partners?

ayahs.text: Who is it that has created the heavens and the earth and sent down for you water from the sky and then We caused to grow therewith orchards full of beauty whose trees you could never grow. Is there any god associated with Allah (in these tasks)?"" Nay they are a people who are veering away from the Right Path.
ayahs.translation: Who is it that has created the heavens and the earth and sent down for you water from the sky and then We caused to grow therewith orchards full of beauty whose trees you could never grow. Is there any god associated with Allah (in these tasks)?"" Nay they are a people who are veering away from the Right Path.

ayahs.text: Who is it Who has made the earth a place of resort and has caused rivers to flow in its midst and has placed upon it firm mountains and has placed a barrier between two masses of water? Is there any god associated with Allah (in these tasks)? Nay; but most of them do not know.
ayahs.translation: Who is it Who has made the earth a place of resort and has caused rivers to flow in its midst and has placed upon it firm mountains and has placed a barrier between two masses of water? Is there any god associated with Allah (in these tasks)? Nay; but most of them do not know.

ayahs.text: Who is it Who heeds the prayers of the distressed when he calls out to Him and Who removes his affliction? And who is it Who makes you vicegerents of the earth? Is there any god associated with Allah (in this task)? How little do you reflect!
ayahs.translation: Who is it Who heeds the prayers of the distressed when he calls out to Him and Who removes his affliction? And who is it Who makes you vicegerents of the earth? Is there any god associated with Allah (in this task)? How little do you reflect!

ayahs.text: Who is it Who guides you through the darkness on land and sea? And Who sends winds as heralds of good tidings ahead of His Mercy? Is there any god associated with Allah (in this task)? Exalted be Allah above whatever they associate with Him in His Divinity!
ayahs.translation: Who is it Who guides you through the darkness on land and sea? And Who sends winds as heralds of good tidings ahead of His Mercy? Is there any god associated with Allah (in this task)? Exalted be Allah above whatever they associate with Him in His Divinity!

ayahs.text: Who is it Who creates in the first instance and then repeats it? Who is it Who provides you with sustenance from the heavens and the earth? Is there any god associated with Allah (in these tasks)? Say: ""Bring forth your evidence if you are truthful.""
ayahs.translation: Who is it Who creates in the first instance and then repeats it? Who is it Who provides you with sustenance from the heavens and the earth? Is there any god associated with Allah (in these tasks)? Say: ""Bring forth your evidence if you are truthful.""

ayahs.text: Say: ""None in the heavens or on the earth has knowledge of the Unseen save Allah. They do not know when they will be raised to life.""
ayahs.translation: Say: ""None in the heavens or on the earth has knowledge of the Unseen save Allah. They do not know when they will be raised to life.""

ayahs.text: Nay but they have lost their knowledge of the Hereafter. They are steeped in doubt and uncertainty about it: rather they are blind to it.
ayahs.translation: Nay but they have lost their knowledge of the Hereafter. They are steeped in doubt and uncertainty about it: rather they are blind to it.

ayahs.text: The unbelievers say: ""When we become dust we and our forefathers shall we really be brought out (from our graves)?
ayahs.translation: The unbelievers say: ""When we become dust we and our forefathers shall we really be brought out (from our graves)?

ayahs.text: We were told about this and so were our forefathers before us. But these are no more than fairy tales that have been recounted from ancient times.""
ayahs.translation: We were told about this and so were our forefathers before us. But these are no more than fairy tales that have been recounted from ancient times.""

ayahs.text: Say: ""Go about through the earth and see what has been the end of the evil-doers.""
ayahs.translation: Say: ""Go about through the earth and see what has been the end of the evil-doers.""

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) do not grieve over them nor be distressed at their designs.
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) do not grieve over them nor be distressed at their designs.

ayahs.text: They also say: ""Tell us when this threat will come to pass if you are truthful.""
ayahs.translation: They also say: ""Tell us when this threat will come to pass if you are truthful.""

ayahs.text: Say: ""The chastisement whose hastening you have been asking for maybe a part of it has drawn quite near to you.""
ayahs.translation: Say: ""The chastisement whose hastening you have been asking for maybe a part of it has drawn quite near to you.""

ayahs.text: Indeed Your Lord is exceedingly bountiful to mankind. Yet most of them do not give thanks.
ayahs.translation: Indeed Your Lord is exceedingly bountiful to mankind. Yet most of them do not give thanks.

ayahs.text: Verily your Lord knows all that their hearts conceal as well as all that they reveal.
ayahs.translation: Verily your Lord knows all that their hearts conceal as well as all that they reveal.

ayahs.text: There is nothing that is hidden - be it in the heaven or the earth - but is recorded in a Clear Book.
ayahs.translation: There is nothing that is hidden - be it in the heaven or the earth - but is recorded in a Clear Book.

ayahs.text: Surely this Qur''an explains to the Children of Israel most of the matters concerning which they have disagreements
ayahs.translation: Surely this Qur''an explains to the Children of Israel most of the matters concerning which they have disagreements

ayahs.text: and it is a guidance and mercy for the believers.
ayahs.translation: and it is a guidance and mercy for the believers.

ayahs.text: Indeed your Lord will decide between them by His judgement. He is All-Mighty All-Knowing.
ayahs.translation: Indeed your Lord will decide between them by His judgement. He is All-Mighty All-Knowing.

ayahs.text: So put your trust in Allah for you are on the manifest truth.
ayahs.translation: So put your trust in Allah for you are on the manifest truth.

ayahs.text: Surely you cannot make the dead hear you nor can you make the deaf hear your call if they turn back in flight
ayahs.translation: Surely you cannot make the dead hear you nor can you make the deaf hear your call if they turn back in flight

ayahs.text: nor can you direct the blind to the Right Way preventing them from falling into error. You can make only those who believe in Our verses to hear the call and then submit.
ayahs.translation: nor can you direct the blind to the Right Way preventing them from falling into error. You can make only those who believe in Our verses to hear the call and then submit.

ayahs.text: And when the time for the fulfilment of Our Word against them will come We shall bring forth for them a beast from the earth who will speak to them because people did not believe in Our Signs.
ayahs.translation: And when the time for the fulfilment of Our Word against them will come We shall bring forth for them a beast from the earth who will speak to them because people did not believe in Our Signs.

ayahs.text: Just imagine the Day when We shall muster from every nation a large group of those who gave the lie to Our Signs and they shall be duly arranged in ranks
ayahs.translation: Just imagine the Day when We shall muster from every nation a large group of those who gave the lie to Our Signs and they shall be duly arranged in ranks

ayahs.text: until when all of them have arrived Allah will say: ""Did you give the lie to My Signs even without encompassing them with your knowledge? If that is not so what did you do?""
ayahs.translation: until when all of them have arrived Allah will say: ""Did you give the lie to My Signs even without encompassing them with your knowledge? If that is not so what did you do?""

ayahs.text: And the Word will come to pass against them because of their wrong-doing: they will then be able to utter nothing.
ayahs.translation: And the Word will come to pass against them because of their wrong-doing: they will then be able to utter nothing.

ayahs.text: Did they not perceive that We had made the night so that they may repose in it and made the day clear and shining. Surely there are Signs in this for those who believe.
ayahs.translation: Did they not perceive that We had made the night so that they may repose in it and made the day clear and shining. Surely there are Signs in this for those who believe.

ayahs.text: The Day when the Trumpet will be blown all those who are in the heavens and on the earth shall be terror stricken - all except those whom Allah wills - and everyone shall come to Him utterly abject.
ayahs.translation: The Day when the Trumpet will be blown all those who are in the heavens and on the earth shall be terror stricken - all except those whom Allah wills - and everyone shall come to Him utterly abject.

ayahs.text: You now see the mountains and consider them firmly fixed but then they shall pass away even as clouds pass away. That will be the handiwork of Allah Who has created everything with perfect wisdom. He is well aware of what you do.
ayahs.translation: You now see the mountains and consider them firmly fixed but then they shall pass away even as clouds pass away. That will be the handiwork of Allah Who has created everything with perfect wisdom. He is well aware of what you do.

ayahs.text: Whosoever comes with good will receive a reward better than his deed and they will be made secure from the terror of that Day.
ayahs.translation: Whosoever comes with good will receive a reward better than his deed and they will be made secure from the terror of that Day.

ayahs.text: And whosoever comes with evil they will be flung upon their faces into the Fire. Will you be recompensed for aught other than what you do?
ayahs.translation: And whosoever comes with evil they will be flung upon their faces into the Fire. Will you be recompensed for aught other than what you do?

ayahs.text: (Tell them O Muhammad): ""I have been commanded only to serve the Lord of this city that He has made inviolable to serve Him to Whom all things belong. I have been commanded to be of those that submit to Allah
ayahs.translation: (Tell them O Muhammad): ""I have been commanded only to serve the Lord of this city that He has made inviolable to serve Him to Whom all things belong. I have been commanded to be of those that submit to Allah

ayahs.text: and to recite the Qur''an."" So whosoever is guided his guidance will be to his own good. As for those who stray tell them: ""I am none but a warner.""
ayahs.translation: and to recite the Qur''an."" So whosoever is guided his guidance will be to his own good. As for those who stray tell them: ""I am none but a warner.""

ayahs.text: And say: ""All praise be to Allah Who will soon show you His Signs that you will recognize."" Your Lord is not unaware of what you do.
ayahs.translation: And say: ""All praise be to Allah Who will soon show you His Signs that you will recognize."" Your Lord is not unaware of what you do.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Ta''. Sin. Mim
verses.translation: Ta''. Sin. Mim

verses.text: These are the verses of the Clear Book.
verses.translation: These are the verses of the Clear Book.

verses.text: We recount to you with truth some parts of the story of Moses and Pharaoh for the benefit of those who believe.
verses.translation: We recount to you with truth some parts of the story of Moses and Pharaoh for the benefit of those who believe.

verses.text: Indeed Pharaoh transgressed in the land and divided its people into sections. One group of them he humiliated and slew their sons and spared their daughters. Truly he was among the mischief-makers.
verses.translation: Indeed Pharaoh transgressed in the land and divided its people into sections. One group of them he humiliated and slew their sons and spared their daughters. Truly he was among the mischief-makers.

verses.text: We wanted to bestow favour on those who were oppressed in the land. We wanted to make them leaders and heirs
verses.translation: We wanted to bestow favour on those who were oppressed in the land. We wanted to make them leaders and heirs

verses.text: and to grant them power in the land and make Pharaoh and Haman and their hosts see what they had feared.
verses.translation: and to grant them power in the land and make Pharaoh and Haman and their hosts see what they had feared.

verses.text: We suggested to the mother of Moses: ""Suckle your child but when you fear for his life cast him into the river and be not fearful nor grieve for We shall restore him to you and make him one of the Messengers.""
verses.translation: We suggested to the mother of Moses: ""Suckle your child but when you fear for his life cast him into the river and be not fearful nor grieve for We shall restore him to you and make him one of the Messengers.""

verses.text: Then Pharaoh''s household picked him up (from the river) that he may be their adversary and be a cause of sorrow to them. Surely Pharaoh and Haman and their hosts erred (in their scheming).
verses.translation: Then Pharaoh''s household picked him up (from the river) that he may be their adversary and be a cause of sorrow to them. Surely Pharaoh and Haman and their hosts erred (in their scheming).

verses.text: The wife of Pharaoh said: ""Here is a delight of the eye to me and to you. Do not kill him. Maybe he will prove useful for us or we may adopt him as a son."" They were unaware of the end of it all.
verses.translation: The wife of Pharaoh said: ""Here is a delight of the eye to me and to you. Do not kill him. Maybe he will prove useful for us or we may adopt him as a son."" They were unaware of the end of it all.

verses.text: On the other hand the heart of Moses'' mother was sorely distressed. Had We not strengthened her heart that she might have full faith (in Our promise) she would have disclosed the secret.
verses.translation: On the other hand the heart of Moses'' mother was sorely distressed. Had We not strengthened her heart that she might have full faith (in Our promise) she would have disclosed the secret.

verses.text: She told the sister of Moses: ""Follow him."" So she kept watch over him unperceived (by the enemies).
verses.translation: She told the sister of Moses: ""Follow him."" So she kept watch over him unperceived (by the enemies).

verses.text: And We had already forbidden the breasts of the nurses for the child. (So seeing the girl) said: ""Shall I direct you to the people of a household that will rear him with utter sincerity?""
verses.translation: And We had already forbidden the breasts of the nurses for the child. (So seeing the girl) said: ""Shall I direct you to the people of a household that will rear him with utter sincerity?""

verses.text: Thus did We restore Moses to his mother that her eyes might be comforted and she might not grieve and realise that the promise of Allah was true. But most people are unaware of this.
verses.translation: Thus did We restore Moses to his mother that her eyes might be comforted and she might not grieve and realise that the promise of Allah was true. But most people are unaware of this.

verses.text: When Moses reached the age of full youth and grew to maturity We bestowed upon him wisdom and knowledge. Thus do We reward those who do good.
verses.translation: When Moses reached the age of full youth and grew to maturity We bestowed upon him wisdom and knowledge. Thus do We reward those who do good.

verses.text: Once he entered the city at a time when its people were heedless and he encountered two men fighting one of whom belonged to his own people and the other to his foes. Now the man belonging to Moses'' own people cried out to him for help against the man from the foes and Moses struck him with his fist and finished him. Moses said: ""This is an act of Satan. Surely he is an enemy who openly misleads.""
verses.translation: Once he entered the city at a time when its people were heedless and he encountered two men fighting one of whom belonged to his own people and the other to his foes. Now the man belonging to Moses'' own people cried out to him for help against the man from the foes and Moses struck him with his fist and finished him. Moses said: ""This is an act of Satan. Surely he is an enemy who openly misleads.""

verses.text: Then he prayed: ""My Lord! I have indeed inflicted wrong on myself so do forgive me  wherefore Allah forgave him for He is Ever Forgiving Most Merciful.
verses.translation: Then he prayed: ""My Lord! I have indeed inflicted wrong on myself so do forgive me  wherefore Allah forgave him for He is Ever Forgiving Most Merciful.

verses.text: Thereupon Moses vowed: ""My Lord because of the favour that You have done me I shall never support the guilty.""
verses.translation: Thereupon Moses vowed: ""My Lord because of the favour that You have done me I shall never support the guilty.""

verses.text: The next morning he proceeded to the city in fear and looking around as one apprehensive of danger when all of a sudden the man who had sought his help the day before again called out to him for his help. Moses said to him: ""Clearly you are a very misguided fellow.""
verses.translation: The next morning he proceeded to the city in fear and looking around as one apprehensive of danger when all of a sudden the man who had sought his help the day before again called out to him for his help. Moses said to him: ""Clearly you are a very misguided fellow.""

verses.text: And when Moses decided to lay his violent hands on the man belonging to the enemy he cried out: ""Moses do you intend to kill me as you killed a person yesterday?"" You simply want to live in the land as a tyrant and do not wish to set things right.""
verses.translation: And when Moses decided to lay his violent hands on the man belonging to the enemy he cried out: ""Moses do you intend to kill me as you killed a person yesterday?"" You simply want to live in the land as a tyrant and do not wish to set things right.""

verses.text: Then a man came running from the farther end of the city and said: ""O Moses the nobles are deliberating about you that they may put you to death. So do be gone. I am one of your well-wishers.""
verses.translation: Then a man came running from the farther end of the city and said: ""O Moses the nobles are deliberating about you that they may put you to death. So do be gone. I am one of your well-wishers.""

verses.text: Soon after hearing this Moses departed in a state of fear looking around as one in apprehension and prayed: ""My Lord deliver me from these unjust people.""
verses.translation: Soon after hearing this Moses departed in a state of fear looking around as one in apprehension and prayed: ""My Lord deliver me from these unjust people.""

verses.text: When (after his departure from Egypt) Moses headed towards Midian he said: ""I hope my Lord will show me the right Path.""
verses.translation: When (after his departure from Egypt) Moses headed towards Midian he said: ""I hope my Lord will show me the right Path.""

verses.text: When he arrived at the spring of Midian he found there a crowd of people watering their flocks and he found apart from them two women holding their flocks back. He asked the women: ""What is it that troubles you?"" They said: ""We cannot water our flocks until the shepherds take their flocks away and our father is a very old man.""
verses.translation: When he arrived at the spring of Midian he found there a crowd of people watering their flocks and he found apart from them two women holding their flocks back. He asked the women: ""What is it that troubles you?"" They said: ""We cannot water our flocks until the shepherds take their flocks away and our father is a very old man.""

verses.text: On hearing this Moses watered their flocks for them and then returned in a shaded place and said: ""My Lord I am truly in great need of any good that You might send down to me.""
verses.translation: On hearing this Moses watered their flocks for them and then returned in a shaded place and said: ""My Lord I am truly in great need of any good that You might send down to me.""

verses.text: Soon thereafter one of the two women came to him walking bashfully and said: ""My father invites you that he may reward you for your having watered our flocks for us."" When Moses came to him and narrated to him the whole of his story he said: ""Have no fear. You are now safe from the iniquitous people.""
verses.translation: Soon thereafter one of the two women came to him walking bashfully and said: ""My father invites you that he may reward you for your having watered our flocks for us."" When Moses came to him and narrated to him the whole of his story he said: ""Have no fear. You are now safe from the iniquitous people.""

verses.text: One of the two women said: ""Father employ this man in your service. The best whom you might employ is he who is strong and trustworthy.""
verses.translation: One of the two women said: ""Father employ this man in your service. The best whom you might employ is he who is strong and trustworthy.""

verses.text: Her father said to Moses: ""I want to marry one of these two daughters of mine to you if you serve me for eight years. But if you complete ten years that will be of your own accord (but not an obligation). I do not intend to treat you harshly. If Allah wills you will find me an upright man.""
verses.translation: Her father said to Moses: ""I want to marry one of these two daughters of mine to you if you serve me for eight years. But if you complete ten years that will be of your own accord (but not an obligation). I do not intend to treat you harshly. If Allah wills you will find me an upright man.""

verses.text: Moses replied: ""So that is agreed between me and you. Whichever of the two terms I fulfil I trust that I shall not be wronged. Allah is a witness over the covenant we are committing ourselves to.""
verses.translation: Moses replied: ""So that is agreed between me and you. Whichever of the two terms I fulfil I trust that I shall not be wronged. Allah is a witness over the covenant we are committing ourselves to.""

verses.text: When Moses had fulfilled the term and was journeying with his family he perceived a fire in the direction of the Mount (Sinai). He said to his family: ""Wait here; I have observed a fire. Maybe I will bring to you some news or a brand of fire from there that you may warm yourselves.""
verses.translation: When Moses had fulfilled the term and was journeying with his family he perceived a fire in the direction of the Mount (Sinai). He said to his family: ""Wait here; I have observed a fire. Maybe I will bring to you some news or a brand of fire from there that you may warm yourselves.""

verses.text: But when he came to the fire a cry was heard from the right bank of the valley from a tree in the hallowed ground: ""O Moses verily I am Allah the Lord of all creatures of the Universe.""
verses.translation: But when he came to the fire a cry was heard from the right bank of the valley from a tree in the hallowed ground: ""O Moses verily I am Allah the Lord of all creatures of the Universe.""

verses.text: He received the command: ""Throw away your rod!"" But when he saw the rod writhing as though it were a serpent he turned back in retreat and did not even look behind. (He was told): ""O Moses go ahead and have no fear. You are perfectly secure.
verses.translation: He received the command: ""Throw away your rod!"" But when he saw the rod writhing as though it were a serpent he turned back in retreat and did not even look behind. (He was told): ""O Moses go ahead and have no fear. You are perfectly secure.

verses.text: Put your hand into your bosom and it will come out shining without any blemish;and draw your hand close to your body to still your fear. Those are the two clear Signs from your Lord for Pharaoh and his chiefs for truly they are a disobedient people.""
verses.translation: Put your hand into your bosom and it will come out shining without any blemish;and draw your hand close to your body to still your fear. Those are the two clear Signs from your Lord for Pharaoh and his chiefs for truly they are a disobedient people.""

verses.text: Moses said: ""My Lord I have killed one person from among them and I fear that they will kill me.
verses.translation: Moses said: ""My Lord I have killed one person from among them and I fear that they will kill me.

verses.text: My brother Aaron is more eloquent in speech than I: so send him with me as a helper to confirm my truthfulness for I fear that they will reject me as a liar.""
verses.translation: My brother Aaron is more eloquent in speech than I: so send him with me as a helper to confirm my truthfulness for I fear that they will reject me as a liar.""

verses.text: He said: ""We will certainly strengthen you through your brother and will invest both of you with such power that they shall not be able to hurt you. With the help of Our Signs the two of you and your followers will prevail.""
verses.translation: He said: ""We will certainly strengthen you through your brother and will invest both of you with such power that they shall not be able to hurt you. With the help of Our Signs the two of you and your followers will prevail.""

verses.text: But when Moses came to them with Our Clear Signs they said: ""This is nothing but a magic that has been contrived. We never heard anything like it from our ancestors of yore.""
verses.translation: But when Moses came to them with Our Clear Signs they said: ""This is nothing but a magic that has been contrived. We never heard anything like it from our ancestors of yore.""

verses.text: Moses replied: ""My Lord knows best who comes with guidance from Him and also whose end will be the best in the Hereafter. As for the wrongdoers they shall not prosper.""
verses.translation: Moses replied: ""My Lord knows best who comes with guidance from Him and also whose end will be the best in the Hereafter. As for the wrongdoers they shall not prosper.""

verses.text: Pharaoh said: ""O nobles I do not know that you have any god beside myself. Haman bake bricks out of clay and build a lofty palace for me so that I may mount up and be able to observe the god of Moses even though I believe that Moses is a liar.""
verses.translation: Pharaoh said: ""O nobles I do not know that you have any god beside myself. Haman bake bricks out of clay and build a lofty palace for me so that I may mount up and be able to observe the god of Moses even though I believe that Moses is a liar.""

verses.text: And he and his hosts waxed arrogant in the land without any right believing that they will never have to return to Us!
verses.translation: And he and his hosts waxed arrogant in the land without any right believing that they will never have to return to Us!

verses.text: Eventually We seized him and his hosts and We flung them into the sea. So do see the end of the wrong-doers!
verses.translation: Eventually We seized him and his hosts and We flung them into the sea. So do see the end of the wrong-doers!

verses.text: And We made them leaders who invite people to the Fire. On the Day of Judgement they shall not find help from any quarter.
verses.translation: And We made them leaders who invite people to the Fire. On the Day of Judgement they shall not find help from any quarter.

verses.text: We have made a curse to pursue them in this world and on the Day of Judgement they shall be among the despised.
verses.translation: We have made a curse to pursue them in this world and on the Day of Judgement they shall be among the despised.

verses.text: After We had destroyed the earlier generations We bestowed the Book on Moses - a source of enlightenment for people and a guidance and mercy - that they may take heed.
verses.translation: After We had destroyed the earlier generations We bestowed the Book on Moses - a source of enlightenment for people and a guidance and mercy - that they may take heed.

verses.text: (O Muhammad) you were then not on the western side when We bestowed this commandment (of Law) and you were not among its witnesses.
verses.translation: (O Muhammad) you were then not on the western side when We bestowed this commandment (of Law) and you were not among its witnesses.

verses.text: Thereafter We raised up many a generation and a long time passed. You were then not even present among the people of Midian to rehearse Our verses to them. But it is We Who are sending news about that.
verses.translation: Thereafter We raised up many a generation and a long time passed. You were then not even present among the people of Midian to rehearse Our verses to them. But it is We Who are sending news about that.

verses.text: Nor were you on the side of the Mount (Sinai) when We called out to Moses (in the first instance). But it is out of Mercy from your Lord (that you are being informed of all this) so that you may warn a people to whom no warner came before you. Maybe they will take heed.
verses.translation: Nor were you on the side of the Mount (Sinai) when We called out to Moses (in the first instance). But it is out of Mercy from your Lord (that you are being informed of all this) so that you may warn a people to whom no warner came before you. Maybe they will take heed.

verses.text: (We did so) lest a calamity might seize them because of the misdeeds they committed whereafter they would say: ""Our Lord why did you not send a Messenger to us that we follow Your revelation and become among those who believe?""
verses.translation: (We did so) lest a calamity might seize them because of the misdeeds they committed whereafter they would say: ""Our Lord why did you not send a Messenger to us that we follow Your revelation and become among those who believe?""

verses.text: But when the Truth reached them from Us they said: ""Why was he not given that which was given to Moses?"" But did they not reject before what had been given to Moses? They said: ""Both are magic each supporting the other!"" And they said: ""We deny each of these.""
verses.translation: But when the Truth reached them from Us they said: ""Why was he not given that which was given to Moses?"" But did they not reject before what had been given to Moses? They said: ""Both are magic each supporting the other!"" And they said: ""We deny each of these.""

verses.text: Tell them (O Prophet): ""Then do bring a Book from Allah which is a better guide than either of them and I will follow it! Do so if you are truthful!""
verses.translation: Tell them (O Prophet): ""Then do bring a Book from Allah which is a better guide than either of them and I will follow it! Do so if you are truthful!""

verses.text: But if they do not hearken to this know well that they only follow their lusts and who is in greater error than he who follows his lusts without any guidance from Allah? Allah does not guide those given to wrong-doing.
verses.translation: But if they do not hearken to this know well that they only follow their lusts and who is in greater error than he who follows his lusts without any guidance from Allah? Allah does not guide those given to wrong-doing.

verses.text: We have constantly conveyed them the word (of admonition) that they may take heed.
verses.translation: We have constantly conveyed them the word (of admonition) that they may take heed.

verses.text: Those on whom We bestowed the Book before do believe in this (to wit the Qur''an).
verses.translation: Those on whom We bestowed the Book before do believe in this (to wit the Qur''an).

verses.text: When it is recited to them they say: ""We believe in it for it is the Truth from our Lord. Indeed we were already Muslims.""
verses.translation: When it is recited to them they say: ""We believe in it for it is the Truth from our Lord. Indeed we were already Muslims.""

verses.text: These will be granted their reward twice over because they remained steadfast; they repel evil with good and spend (in alms) out of the sustenance We provided them
verses.translation: These will be granted their reward twice over because they remained steadfast; they repel evil with good and spend (in alms) out of the sustenance We provided them

verses.text: and when they hear any vain talk they turn away from it saying: ""We have our deeds and you have your deeds. Peace be to you. We do not desire to act like the ignorant.""
verses.translation: and when they hear any vain talk they turn away from it saying: ""We have our deeds and you have your deeds. Peace be to you. We do not desire to act like the ignorant.""

verses.text: (O Prophet) you cannot grant guidance to whom you please. It is Allah Who guides those whom He will. He knows best who are amenable to guidance.
verses.translation: (O Prophet) you cannot grant guidance to whom you please. It is Allah Who guides those whom He will. He knows best who are amenable to guidance.

verses.text: They say: ""If we were to follow this guidance with you we should be snatched away from our land."" Have We not established for them a secure sanctuary to which fruits of all kinds are brought as a provision from Us? But most of them do not know.
verses.translation: They say: ""If we were to follow this guidance with you we should be snatched away from our land."" Have We not established for them a secure sanctuary to which fruits of all kinds are brought as a provision from Us? But most of them do not know.

verses.text: And how many a town did We destroy whose inhabitants exulted on account of their affluence. These are their dwellings in which very few dwelt after them. Eventually it is We Who inherited them.
verses.translation: And how many a town did We destroy whose inhabitants exulted on account of their affluence. These are their dwellings in which very few dwelt after them. Eventually it is We Who inherited them.

verses.text: Your Lord would not destroy a town until He had sent to its centre a Messenger who would recite to them Our verses. Nor would We destroy any town unless its inhabitants were iniquitous.
verses.translation: Your Lord would not destroy a town until He had sent to its centre a Messenger who would recite to them Our verses. Nor would We destroy any town unless its inhabitants were iniquitous.

verses.text: Whatever you have been given is a provision for the life of this world and its glitter. But that which is with Allah is better and more enduring. Do you not use your intellect?
verses.translation: Whatever you have been given is a provision for the life of this world and its glitter. But that which is with Allah is better and more enduring. Do you not use your intellect?

verses.text: Now he to whom We have promised a good which he is going to obtain - can he be like him whom We have given the good things of this life but who will be brought up for punishment on the Day of Judgement?
verses.translation: Now he to whom We have promised a good which he is going to obtain - can he be like him whom We have given the good things of this life but who will be brought up for punishment on the Day of Judgement?

verses.text: (Let them not forget) that the Day when Allah will call unto them and say: ""Where are those whom you imagined to be My associates?""
verses.translation: (Let them not forget) that the Day when Allah will call unto them and say: ""Where are those whom you imagined to be My associates?""

verses.text: Those against whom the Word will be realised will say: ""Our Lord these are the ones whom we led astray just as we ourselves strayed. We absolve ourselves before You of all blame. It was not us that they worshipped.""
verses.translation: Those against whom the Word will be realised will say: ""Our Lord these are the ones whom we led astray just as we ourselves strayed. We absolve ourselves before You of all blame. It was not us that they worshipped.""

verses.text: They will then be told: ""Call upon those for help whom you declared to be Our associates."" They will then call upon them but they will not answer them. They will have observed the chastisement in front of them. Would that they were guided!
verses.translation: They will then be told: ""Call upon those for help whom you declared to be Our associates."" They will then call upon them but they will not answer them. They will have observed the chastisement in front of them. Would that they were guided!

verses.text: (Let them not disregard) that the Day when Allah will call out to them saying: ""What was the answer you gave to the Messengers?""
verses.translation: (Let them not disregard) that the Day when Allah will call out to them saying: ""What was the answer you gave to the Messengers?""

verses.text: Then they will not be able to think of any reply nor will they be able to ask one another.
verses.translation: Then they will not be able to think of any reply nor will they be able to ask one another.

verses.text: But those who repented and believed and acted righteously they will perhaps be among those who will prosper there.
verses.translation: But those who repented and believed and acted righteously they will perhaps be among those who will prosper there.

verses.text: Your Lord creates what He will and chooses (for His tasks) whomsoever He will. It is not for them to make the choice. Glory be to Allah. He is exalted far above their associating others in His Divinity.
verses.translation: Your Lord creates what He will and chooses (for His tasks) whomsoever He will. It is not for them to make the choice. Glory be to Allah. He is exalted far above their associating others in His Divinity.

verses.text: Your Lord knows all that their hearts conceal and all that they reveal.
verses.translation: Your Lord knows all that their hearts conceal and all that they reveal.

verses.text: He is Allah; there is no god but He. His is the praise in this world and in the Hereafter. His is the command and to Him will all of you be returned.
verses.translation: He is Allah; there is no god but He. His is the praise in this world and in the Hereafter. His is the command and to Him will all of you be returned.

verses.text: (O Prophet) tell them: ""Did you consider: if Allah were to make the night perpetual over you till the Day of Judgement is there a god other than Allah who can bring forth light for you? Do you not hear?""
verses.translation: (O Prophet) tell them: ""Did you consider: if Allah were to make the night perpetual over you till the Day of Judgement is there a god other than Allah who can bring forth light for you? Do you not hear?""

verses.text: Say: ""Did you consider: if Allah were to make the day become perpetual over you till the Day of Judgement is there a god other than Allah who can bring in night for you that you may repose in it? Will you not see?""
verses.translation: Say: ""Did you consider: if Allah were to make the day become perpetual over you till the Day of Judgement is there a god other than Allah who can bring in night for you that you may repose in it? Will you not see?""

verses.text: It is out of His Mercy that He has made for you night and day that you may repose (during the night) and seek His Bounty (during the day) that you might be grateful.
verses.translation: It is out of His Mercy that He has made for you night and day that you may repose (during the night) and seek His Bounty (during the day) that you might be grateful.

verses.text: (Let them bear in mind) that on that Day when He will call out to them saying: ""Where are My associates those whom you imagined to be so?""
verses.translation: (Let them bear in mind) that on that Day when He will call out to them saying: ""Where are My associates those whom you imagined to be so?""

verses.text: And from each people We shall draw a witness and shall say to them: ""Do produce your evidence now."" Then they shall know that the Truth is with Allah alone and the lies which they had invented will forsake them.
verses.translation: And from each people We shall draw a witness and shall say to them: ""Do produce your evidence now."" Then they shall know that the Truth is with Allah alone and the lies which they had invented will forsake them.

verses.text: To be sure Qarun (Korah) was one of Moses'' people; then he transgressed against them. We had bestowed on him such treasure that their very keys would have been raised with difficulty by a whole group of strong people. Once when his people said to him: ""Do not exult for Allah does not love those who exult (in their riches).
verses.translation: To be sure Qarun (Korah) was one of Moses'' people; then he transgressed against them. We had bestowed on him such treasure that their very keys would have been raised with difficulty by a whole group of strong people. Once when his people said to him: ""Do not exult for Allah does not love those who exult (in their riches).

verses.text: Seek by means of the wealth that Allah has granted you the Abode of the Hereafter but forget not your share in this world and do good as Allah has been good to you and do not strive to create mischief in the land for Allah loves not those who create mischief.""
verses.translation: Seek by means of the wealth that Allah has granted you the Abode of the Hereafter but forget not your share in this world and do good as Allah has been good to you and do not strive to create mischief in the land for Allah loves not those who create mischief.""

verses.text: He replied: ""All this has been given to me on account of a certain knowledge that I have."" Did he not know that Allah had destroyed before him those who were stronger in might than he and were more numerous in multitude? The wicked are not asked about their acts of sin.
verses.translation: He replied: ""All this has been given to me on account of a certain knowledge that I have."" Did he not know that Allah had destroyed before him those who were stronger in might than he and were more numerous in multitude? The wicked are not asked about their acts of sin.

verses.text: Once Korah went forth among his people in full glitter. Those seeking the life of this world said: ""Would that we had the like of what Korah has! He truly has a great fortune.""
verses.translation: Once Korah went forth among his people in full glitter. Those seeking the life of this world said: ""Would that we had the like of what Korah has! He truly has a great fortune.""

verses.text: But those endowed with true knowledge said: ""Woe to you. The reward of Allah is best for those who believe and act righteously. But none except those who are patient shall attain to this.""
verses.translation: But those endowed with true knowledge said: ""Woe to you. The reward of Allah is best for those who believe and act righteously. But none except those who are patient shall attain to this.""

verses.text: At last We caused the earth to swallow him and his house. Thereafter there was no group of people that could come to his aid against Allah; nor was he able to come to his own aid.
verses.translation: At last We caused the earth to swallow him and his house. Thereafter there was no group of people that could come to his aid against Allah; nor was he able to come to his own aid.

verses.text: And those who had envied his position the day before began to say on the morrow: ""Alas we had forgotten that it is Allah Who increases the provision of those of His servants whom He will and grants in sparing measure to those whom He will. But for Allah''s favour upon us He could have made us to be swallowed too. Alas we had forgotten that the unbelievers do not prosper.""
verses.translation: And those who had envied his position the day before began to say on the morrow: ""Alas we had forgotten that it is Allah Who increases the provision of those of His servants whom He will and grants in sparing measure to those whom He will. But for Allah''s favour upon us He could have made us to be swallowed too. Alas we had forgotten that the unbelievers do not prosper.""

verses.text: As for the Abode of the Hereafter We shall assign it exclusively for those who do not seek glory on earth nor want to cause mischief. The God-fearing shall have the best end.
verses.translation: As for the Abode of the Hereafter We shall assign it exclusively for those who do not seek glory on earth nor want to cause mischief. The God-fearing shall have the best end.

verses.text: He who shall bring a good deed shall be rewarded with what is better. But those who bring evil deeds shall not be requited more than their deeds.
verses.translation: He who shall bring a good deed shall be rewarded with what is better. But those who bring evil deeds shall not be requited more than their deeds.

verses.text: (O Prophet) surely He Who has ordained the Qur''an on you will bring you to the best end. Say to them: ""My Lord knows best who has brought true guidance and who is in clear error.""
verses.translation: (O Prophet) surely He Who has ordained the Qur''an on you will bring you to the best end. Say to them: ""My Lord knows best who has brought true guidance and who is in clear error.""

verses.text: (O Prophet) you never looked forward for the Book to be revealed to you. It is out of sheer Mercy of your Lord that it was (revealed to you). So do not lend any support to the unbelievers.
verses.translation: (O Prophet) you never looked forward for the Book to be revealed to you. It is out of sheer Mercy of your Lord that it was (revealed to you). So do not lend any support to the unbelievers.

verses.text: And let it never happen that the unbelievers might turn you away from the revelations of Allah after they have been revealed to you. Call people to your Lord and never become one of the unbelievers
verses.translation: And let it never happen that the unbelievers might turn you away from the revelations of Allah after they have been revealed to you. Call people to your Lord and never become one of the unbelievers

verses.text: and do not invoke any god beside Allah. There is no god but He. All will perish but He. To Him belongs the command. And to Him shall all of you return.
verses.translation: and do not invoke any god beside Allah. There is no god but He. All will perish but He. To Him belongs the command. And to Him shall all of you return.

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: Ta''. Sin. Mim
ayahs.translation: Ta''. Sin. Mim

ayahs.text: These are the verses of the Clear Book.
ayahs.translation: These are the verses of the Clear Book.

ayahs.text: We recount to you with truth some parts of the story of Moses and Pharaoh for the benefit of those who believe.
ayahs.translation: We recount to you with truth some parts of the story of Moses and Pharaoh for the benefit of those who believe.

ayahs.text: Indeed Pharaoh transgressed in the land and divided its people into sections. One group of them he humiliated and slew their sons and spared their daughters. Truly he was among the mischief-makers.
ayahs.translation: Indeed Pharaoh transgressed in the land and divided its people into sections. One group of them he humiliated and slew their sons and spared their daughters. Truly he was among the mischief-makers.

ayahs.text: We wanted to bestow favour on those who were oppressed in the land. We wanted to make them leaders and heirs
ayahs.translation: We wanted to bestow favour on those who were oppressed in the land. We wanted to make them leaders and heirs

ayahs.text: and to grant them power in the land and make Pharaoh and Haman and their hosts see what they had feared.
ayahs.translation: and to grant them power in the land and make Pharaoh and Haman and their hosts see what they had feared.

ayahs.text: We suggested to the mother of Moses: ""Suckle your child but when you fear for his life cast him into the river and be not fearful nor grieve for We shall restore him to you and make him one of the Messengers.""
ayahs.translation: We suggested to the mother of Moses: ""Suckle your child but when you fear for his life cast him into the river and be not fearful nor grieve for We shall restore him to you and make him one of the Messengers.""

ayahs.text: Then Pharaoh''s household picked him up (from the river) that he may be their adversary and be a cause of sorrow to them. Surely Pharaoh and Haman and their hosts erred (in their scheming).
ayahs.translation: Then Pharaoh''s household picked him up (from the river) that he may be their adversary and be a cause of sorrow to them. Surely Pharaoh and Haman and their hosts erred (in their scheming).

ayahs.text: The wife of Pharaoh said: ""Here is a delight of the eye to me and to you. Do not kill him. Maybe he will prove useful for us or we may adopt him as a son."" They were unaware of the end of it all.
ayahs.translation: The wife of Pharaoh said: ""Here is a delight of the eye to me and to you. Do not kill him. Maybe he will prove useful for us or we may adopt him as a son."" They were unaware of the end of it all.

ayahs.text: On the other hand the heart of Moses'' mother was sorely distressed. Had We not strengthened her heart that she might have full faith (in Our promise) she would have disclosed the secret.
ayahs.translation: On the other hand the heart of Moses'' mother was sorely distressed. Had We not strengthened her heart that she might have full faith (in Our promise) she would have disclosed the secret.

ayahs.text: She told the sister of Moses: ""Follow him."" So she kept watch over him unperceived (by the enemies).
ayahs.translation: She told the sister of Moses: ""Follow him."" So she kept watch over him unperceived (by the enemies).

ayahs.text: And We had already forbidden the breasts of the nurses for the child. (So seeing the girl) said: ""Shall I direct you to the people of a household that will rear him with utter sincerity?""
ayahs.translation: And We had already forbidden the breasts of the nurses for the child. (So seeing the girl) said: ""Shall I direct you to the people of a household that will rear him with utter sincerity?""

ayahs.text: Thus did We restore Moses to his mother that her eyes might be comforted and she might not grieve and realise that the promise of Allah was true. But most people are unaware of this.
ayahs.translation: Thus did We restore Moses to his mother that her eyes might be comforted and she might not grieve and realise that the promise of Allah was true. But most people are unaware of this.

ayahs.text: When Moses reached the age of full youth and grew to maturity We bestowed upon him wisdom and knowledge. Thus do We reward those who do good.
ayahs.translation: When Moses reached the age of full youth and grew to maturity We bestowed upon him wisdom and knowledge. Thus do We reward those who do good.

ayahs.text: Once he entered the city at a time when its people were heedless and he encountered two men fighting one of whom belonged to his own people and the other to his foes. Now the man belonging to Moses'' own people cried out to him for help against the man from the foes and Moses struck him with his fist and finished him. Moses said: ""This is an act of Satan. Surely he is an enemy who openly misleads.""
ayahs.translation: Once he entered the city at a time when its people were heedless and he encountered two men fighting one of whom belonged to his own people and the other to his foes. Now the man belonging to Moses'' own people cried out to him for help against the man from the foes and Moses struck him with his fist and finished him. Moses said: ""This is an act of Satan. Surely he is an enemy who openly misleads.""

ayahs.text: Then he prayed: ""My Lord! I have indeed inflicted wrong on myself so do forgive me  wherefore Allah forgave him for He is Ever Forgiving Most Merciful.
ayahs.translation: Then he prayed: ""My Lord! I have indeed inflicted wrong on myself so do forgive me  wherefore Allah forgave him for He is Ever Forgiving Most Merciful.

ayahs.text: Thereupon Moses vowed: ""My Lord because of the favour that You have done me I shall never support the guilty.""
ayahs.translation: Thereupon Moses vowed: ""My Lord because of the favour that You have done me I shall never support the guilty.""

ayahs.text: The next morning he proceeded to the city in fear and looking around as one apprehensive of danger when all of a sudden the man who had sought his help the day before again called out to him for his help. Moses said to him: ""Clearly you are a very misguided fellow.""
ayahs.translation: The next morning he proceeded to the city in fear and looking around as one apprehensive of danger when all of a sudden the man who had sought his help the day before again called out to him for his help. Moses said to him: ""Clearly you are a very misguided fellow.""

ayahs.text: And when Moses decided to lay his violent hands on the man belonging to the enemy he cried out: ""Moses do you intend to kill me as you killed a person yesterday?"" You simply want to live in the land as a tyrant and do not wish to set things right.""
ayahs.translation: And when Moses decided to lay his violent hands on the man belonging to the enemy he cried out: ""Moses do you intend to kill me as you killed a person yesterday?"" You simply want to live in the land as a tyrant and do not wish to set things right.""

ayahs.text: Then a man came running from the farther end of the city and said: ""O Moses the nobles are deliberating about you that they may put you to death. So do be gone. I am one of your well-wishers.""
ayahs.translation: Then a man came running from the farther end of the city and said: ""O Moses the nobles are deliberating about you that they may put you to death. So do be gone. I am one of your well-wishers.""

ayahs.text: Soon after hearing this Moses departed in a state of fear looking around as one in apprehension and prayed: ""My Lord deliver me from these unjust people.""
ayahs.translation: Soon after hearing this Moses departed in a state of fear looking around as one in apprehension and prayed: ""My Lord deliver me from these unjust people.""

ayahs.text: When (after his departure from Egypt) Moses headed towards Midian he said: ""I hope my Lord will show me the right Path.""
ayahs.translation: When (after his departure from Egypt) Moses headed towards Midian he said: ""I hope my Lord will show me the right Path.""

ayahs.text: When he arrived at the spring of Midian he found there a crowd of people watering their flocks and he found apart from them two women holding their flocks back. He asked the women: ""What is it that troubles you?"" They said: ""We cannot water our flocks until the shepherds take their flocks away and our father is a very old man.""
ayahs.translation: When he arrived at the spring of Midian he found there a crowd of people watering their flocks and he found apart from them two women holding their flocks back. He asked the women: ""What is it that troubles you?"" They said: ""We cannot water our flocks until the shepherds take their flocks away and our father is a very old man.""

ayahs.text: On hearing this Moses watered their flocks for them and then returned in a shaded place and said: ""My Lord I am truly in great need of any good that You might send down to me.""
ayahs.translation: On hearing this Moses watered their flocks for them and then returned in a shaded place and said: ""My Lord I am truly in great need of any good that You might send down to me.""

ayahs.text: Soon thereafter one of the two women came to him walking bashfully and said: ""My father invites you that he may reward you for your having watered our flocks for us."" When Moses came to him and narrated to him the whole of his story he said: ""Have no fear. You are now safe from the iniquitous people.""
ayahs.translation: Soon thereafter one of the two women came to him walking bashfully and said: ""My father invites you that he may reward you for your having watered our flocks for us."" When Moses came to him and narrated to him the whole of his story he said: ""Have no fear. You are now safe from the iniquitous people.""

ayahs.text: One of the two women said: ""Father employ this man in your service. The best whom you might employ is he who is strong and trustworthy.""
ayahs.translation: One of the two women said: ""Father employ this man in your service. The best whom you might employ is he who is strong and trustworthy.""

ayahs.text: Her father said to Moses: ""I want to marry one of these two daughters of mine to you if you serve me for eight years. But if you complete ten years that will be of your own accord (but not an obligation). I do not intend to treat you harshly. If Allah wills you will find me an upright man.""
ayahs.translation: Her father said to Moses: ""I want to marry one of these two daughters of mine to you if you serve me for eight years. But if you complete ten years that will be of your own accord (but not an obligation). I do not intend to treat you harshly. If Allah wills you will find me an upright man.""

ayahs.text: Moses replied: ""So that is agreed between me and you. Whichever of the two terms I fulfil I trust that I shall not be wronged. Allah is a witness over the covenant we are committing ourselves to.""
ayahs.translation: Moses replied: ""So that is agreed between me and you. Whichever of the two terms I fulfil I trust that I shall not be wronged. Allah is a witness over the covenant we are committing ourselves to.""

ayahs.text: When Moses had fulfilled the term and was journeying with his family he perceived a fire in the direction of the Mount (Sinai). He said to his family: ""Wait here; I have observed a fire. Maybe I will bring to you some news or a brand of fire from there that you may warm yourselves.""
ayahs.translation: When Moses had fulfilled the term and was journeying with his family he perceived a fire in the direction of the Mount (Sinai). He said to his family: ""Wait here; I have observed a fire. Maybe I will bring to you some news or a brand of fire from there that you may warm yourselves.""

ayahs.text: But when he came to the fire a cry was heard from the right bank of the valley from a tree in the hallowed ground: ""O Moses verily I am Allah the Lord of all creatures of the Universe.""
ayahs.translation: But when he came to the fire a cry was heard from the right bank of the valley from a tree in the hallowed ground: ""O Moses verily I am Allah the Lord of all creatures of the Universe.""

ayahs.text: He received the command: ""Throw away your rod!"" But when he saw the rod writhing as though it were a serpent he turned back in retreat and did not even look behind. (He was told): ""O Moses go ahead and have no fear. You are perfectly secure.
