ayahs.translation: He received the command: ""Throw away your rod!"" But when he saw the rod writhing as though it were a serpent he turned back in retreat and did not even look behind. (He was told): ""O Moses go ahead and have no fear. You are perfectly secure.

ayahs.text: Put your hand into your bosom and it will come out shining without any blemish;and draw your hand close to your body to still your fear. Those are the two clear Signs from your Lord for Pharaoh and his chiefs for truly they are a disobedient people.""
ayahs.translation: Put your hand into your bosom and it will come out shining without any blemish;and draw your hand close to your body to still your fear. Those are the two clear Signs from your Lord for Pharaoh and his chiefs for truly they are a disobedient people.""

ayahs.text: Moses said: ""My Lord I have killed one person from among them and I fear that they will kill me.
ayahs.translation: Moses said: ""My Lord I have killed one person from among them and I fear that they will kill me.

ayahs.text: My brother Aaron is more eloquent in speech than I: so send him with me as a helper to confirm my truthfulness for I fear that they will reject me as a liar.""
ayahs.translation: My brother Aaron is more eloquent in speech than I: so send him with me as a helper to confirm my truthfulness for I fear that they will reject me as a liar.""

ayahs.text: He said: ""We will certainly strengthen you through your brother and will invest both of you with such power that they shall not be able to hurt you. With the help of Our Signs the two of you and your followers will prevail.""
ayahs.translation: He said: ""We will certainly strengthen you through your brother and will invest both of you with such power that they shall not be able to hurt you. With the help of Our Signs the two of you and your followers will prevail.""

ayahs.text: But when Moses came to them with Our Clear Signs they said: ""This is nothing but a magic that has been contrived. We never heard anything like it from our ancestors of yore.""
ayahs.translation: But when Moses came to them with Our Clear Signs they said: ""This is nothing but a magic that has been contrived. We never heard anything like it from our ancestors of yore.""

ayahs.text: Moses replied: ""My Lord knows best who comes with guidance from Him and also whose end will be the best in the Hereafter. As for the wrongdoers they shall not prosper.""
ayahs.translation: Moses replied: ""My Lord knows best who comes with guidance from Him and also whose end will be the best in the Hereafter. As for the wrongdoers they shall not prosper.""

ayahs.text: Pharaoh said: ""O nobles I do not know that you have any god beside myself. Haman bake bricks out of clay and build a lofty palace for me so that I may mount up and be able to observe the god of Moses even though I believe that Moses is a liar.""
ayahs.translation: Pharaoh said: ""O nobles I do not know that you have any god beside myself. Haman bake bricks out of clay and build a lofty palace for me so that I may mount up and be able to observe the god of Moses even though I believe that Moses is a liar.""

ayahs.text: And he and his hosts waxed arrogant in the land without any right believing that they will never have to return to Us!
ayahs.translation: And he and his hosts waxed arrogant in the land without any right believing that they will never have to return to Us!

ayahs.text: Eventually We seized him and his hosts and We flung them into the sea. So do see the end of the wrong-doers!
ayahs.translation: Eventually We seized him and his hosts and We flung them into the sea. So do see the end of the wrong-doers!

ayahs.text: And We made them leaders who invite people to the Fire. On the Day of Judgement they shall not find help from any quarter.
ayahs.translation: And We made them leaders who invite people to the Fire. On the Day of Judgement they shall not find help from any quarter.

ayahs.text: We have made a curse to pursue them in this world and on the Day of Judgement they shall be among the despised.
ayahs.translation: We have made a curse to pursue them in this world and on the Day of Judgement they shall be among the despised.

ayahs.text: After We had destroyed the earlier generations We bestowed the Book on Moses - a source of enlightenment for people and a guidance and mercy - that they may take heed.
ayahs.translation: After We had destroyed the earlier generations We bestowed the Book on Moses - a source of enlightenment for people and a guidance and mercy - that they may take heed.

ayahs.text: (O Muhammad) you were then not on the western side when We bestowed this commandment (of Law) and you were not among its witnesses.
ayahs.translation: (O Muhammad) you were then not on the western side when We bestowed this commandment (of Law) and you were not among its witnesses.

ayahs.text: Thereafter We raised up many a generation and a long time passed. You were then not even present among the people of Midian to rehearse Our verses to them. But it is We Who are sending news about that.
ayahs.translation: Thereafter We raised up many a generation and a long time passed. You were then not even present among the people of Midian to rehearse Our verses to them. But it is We Who are sending news about that.

ayahs.text: Nor were you on the side of the Mount (Sinai) when We called out to Moses (in the first instance). But it is out of Mercy from your Lord (that you are being informed of all this) so that you may warn a people to whom no warner came before you. Maybe they will take heed.
ayahs.translation: Nor were you on the side of the Mount (Sinai) when We called out to Moses (in the first instance). But it is out of Mercy from your Lord (that you are being informed of all this) so that you may warn a people to whom no warner came before you. Maybe they will take heed.

ayahs.text: (We did so) lest a calamity might seize them because of the misdeeds they committed whereafter they would say: ""Our Lord why did you not send a Messenger to us that we follow Your revelation and become among those who believe?""
ayahs.translation: (We did so) lest a calamity might seize them because of the misdeeds they committed whereafter they would say: ""Our Lord why did you not send a Messenger to us that we follow Your revelation and become among those who believe?""

ayahs.text: But when the Truth reached them from Us they said: ""Why was he not given that which was given to Moses?"" But did they not reject before what had been given to Moses? They said: ""Both are magic each supporting the other!"" And they said: ""We deny each of these.""
ayahs.translation: But when the Truth reached them from Us they said: ""Why was he not given that which was given to Moses?"" But did they not reject before what had been given to Moses? They said: ""Both are magic each supporting the other!"" And they said: ""We deny each of these.""

ayahs.text: Tell them (O Prophet): ""Then do bring a Book from Allah which is a better guide than either of them and I will follow it! Do so if you are truthful!""
ayahs.translation: Tell them (O Prophet): ""Then do bring a Book from Allah which is a better guide than either of them and I will follow it! Do so if you are truthful!""

ayahs.text: But if they do not hearken to this know well that they only follow their lusts and who is in greater error than he who follows his lusts without any guidance from Allah? Allah does not guide those given to wrong-doing.
ayahs.translation: But if they do not hearken to this know well that they only follow their lusts and who is in greater error than he who follows his lusts without any guidance from Allah? Allah does not guide those given to wrong-doing.

ayahs.text: We have constantly conveyed them the word (of admonition) that they may take heed.
ayahs.translation: We have constantly conveyed them the word (of admonition) that they may take heed.

ayahs.text: Those on whom We bestowed the Book before do believe in this (to wit the Qur''an).
ayahs.translation: Those on whom We bestowed the Book before do believe in this (to wit the Qur''an).

ayahs.text: When it is recited to them they say: ""We believe in it for it is the Truth from our Lord. Indeed we were already Muslims.""
ayahs.translation: When it is recited to them they say: ""We believe in it for it is the Truth from our Lord. Indeed we were already Muslims.""

ayahs.text: These will be granted their reward twice over because they remained steadfast; they repel evil with good and spend (in alms) out of the sustenance We provided them
ayahs.translation: These will be granted their reward twice over because they remained steadfast; they repel evil with good and spend (in alms) out of the sustenance We provided them

ayahs.text: and when they hear any vain talk they turn away from it saying: ""We have our deeds and you have your deeds. Peace be to you. We do not desire to act like the ignorant.""
ayahs.translation: and when they hear any vain talk they turn away from it saying: ""We have our deeds and you have your deeds. Peace be to you. We do not desire to act like the ignorant.""

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) you cannot grant guidance to whom you please. It is Allah Who guides those whom He will. He knows best who are amenable to guidance.
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) you cannot grant guidance to whom you please. It is Allah Who guides those whom He will. He knows best who are amenable to guidance.

ayahs.text: They say: ""If we were to follow this guidance with you we should be snatched away from our land."" Have We not established for them a secure sanctuary to which fruits of all kinds are brought as a provision from Us? But most of them do not know.
ayahs.translation: They say: ""If we were to follow this guidance with you we should be snatched away from our land."" Have We not established for them a secure sanctuary to which fruits of all kinds are brought as a provision from Us? But most of them do not know.

ayahs.text: And how many a town did We destroy whose inhabitants exulted on account of their affluence. These are their dwellings in which very few dwelt after them. Eventually it is We Who inherited them.
ayahs.translation: And how many a town did We destroy whose inhabitants exulted on account of their affluence. These are their dwellings in which very few dwelt after them. Eventually it is We Who inherited them.

ayahs.text: Your Lord would not destroy a town until He had sent to its centre a Messenger who would recite to them Our verses. Nor would We destroy any town unless its inhabitants were iniquitous.
ayahs.translation: Your Lord would not destroy a town until He had sent to its centre a Messenger who would recite to them Our verses. Nor would We destroy any town unless its inhabitants were iniquitous.

ayahs.text: Whatever you have been given is a provision for the life of this world and its glitter. But that which is with Allah is better and more enduring. Do you not use your intellect?
ayahs.translation: Whatever you have been given is a provision for the life of this world and its glitter. But that which is with Allah is better and more enduring. Do you not use your intellect?

ayahs.text: Now he to whom We have promised a good which he is going to obtain - can he be like him whom We have given the good things of this life but who will be brought up for punishment on the Day of Judgement?
ayahs.translation: Now he to whom We have promised a good which he is going to obtain - can he be like him whom We have given the good things of this life but who will be brought up for punishment on the Day of Judgement?

ayahs.text: (Let them not forget) that the Day when Allah will call unto them and say: ""Where are those whom you imagined to be My associates?""
ayahs.translation: (Let them not forget) that the Day when Allah will call unto them and say: ""Where are those whom you imagined to be My associates?""

ayahs.text: Those against whom the Word will be realised will say: ""Our Lord these are the ones whom we led astray just as we ourselves strayed. We absolve ourselves before You of all blame. It was not us that they worshipped.""
ayahs.translation: Those against whom the Word will be realised will say: ""Our Lord these are the ones whom we led astray just as we ourselves strayed. We absolve ourselves before You of all blame. It was not us that they worshipped.""

ayahs.text: They will then be told: ""Call upon those for help whom you declared to be Our associates."" They will then call upon them but they will not answer them. They will have observed the chastisement in front of them. Would that they were guided!
ayahs.translation: They will then be told: ""Call upon those for help whom you declared to be Our associates."" They will then call upon them but they will not answer them. They will have observed the chastisement in front of them. Would that they were guided!

ayahs.text: (Let them not disregard) that the Day when Allah will call out to them saying: ""What was the answer you gave to the Messengers?""
ayahs.translation: (Let them not disregard) that the Day when Allah will call out to them saying: ""What was the answer you gave to the Messengers?""

ayahs.text: Then they will not be able to think of any reply nor will they be able to ask one another.
ayahs.translation: Then they will not be able to think of any reply nor will they be able to ask one another.

ayahs.text: But those who repented and believed and acted righteously they will perhaps be among those who will prosper there.
ayahs.translation: But those who repented and believed and acted righteously they will perhaps be among those who will prosper there.

ayahs.text: Your Lord creates what He will and chooses (for His tasks) whomsoever He will. It is not for them to make the choice. Glory be to Allah. He is exalted far above their associating others in His Divinity.
ayahs.translation: Your Lord creates what He will and chooses (for His tasks) whomsoever He will. It is not for them to make the choice. Glory be to Allah. He is exalted far above their associating others in His Divinity.

ayahs.text: Your Lord knows all that their hearts conceal and all that they reveal.
ayahs.translation: Your Lord knows all that their hearts conceal and all that they reveal.

ayahs.text: He is Allah; there is no god but He. His is the praise in this world and in the Hereafter. His is the command and to Him will all of you be returned.
ayahs.translation: He is Allah; there is no god but He. His is the praise in this world and in the Hereafter. His is the command and to Him will all of you be returned.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) tell them: ""Did you consider: if Allah were to make the night perpetual over you till the Day of Judgement is there a god other than Allah who can bring forth light for you? Do you not hear?""
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) tell them: ""Did you consider: if Allah were to make the night perpetual over you till the Day of Judgement is there a god other than Allah who can bring forth light for you? Do you not hear?""

ayahs.text: Say: ""Did you consider: if Allah were to make the day become perpetual over you till the Day of Judgement is there a god other than Allah who can bring in night for you that you may repose in it? Will you not see?""
ayahs.translation: Say: ""Did you consider: if Allah were to make the day become perpetual over you till the Day of Judgement is there a god other than Allah who can bring in night for you that you may repose in it? Will you not see?""

ayahs.text: It is out of His Mercy that He has made for you night and day that you may repose (during the night) and seek His Bounty (during the day) that you might be grateful.
ayahs.translation: It is out of His Mercy that He has made for you night and day that you may repose (during the night) and seek His Bounty (during the day) that you might be grateful.

ayahs.text: (Let them bear in mind) that on that Day when He will call out to them saying: ""Where are My associates those whom you imagined to be so?""
ayahs.translation: (Let them bear in mind) that on that Day when He will call out to them saying: ""Where are My associates those whom you imagined to be so?""

ayahs.text: And from each people We shall draw a witness and shall say to them: ""Do produce your evidence now."" Then they shall know that the Truth is with Allah alone and the lies which they had invented will forsake them.
ayahs.translation: And from each people We shall draw a witness and shall say to them: ""Do produce your evidence now."" Then they shall know that the Truth is with Allah alone and the lies which they had invented will forsake them.

ayahs.text: To be sure Qarun (Korah) was one of Moses'' people; then he transgressed against them. We had bestowed on him such treasure that their very keys would have been raised with difficulty by a whole group of strong people. Once when his people said to him: ""Do not exult for Allah does not love those who exult (in their riches).
ayahs.translation: To be sure Qarun (Korah) was one of Moses'' people; then he transgressed against them. We had bestowed on him such treasure that their very keys would have been raised with difficulty by a whole group of strong people. Once when his people said to him: ""Do not exult for Allah does not love those who exult (in their riches).

ayahs.text: Seek by means of the wealth that Allah has granted you the Abode of the Hereafter but forget not your share in this world and do good as Allah has been good to you and do not strive to create mischief in the land for Allah loves not those who create mischief.""
ayahs.translation: Seek by means of the wealth that Allah has granted you the Abode of the Hereafter but forget not your share in this world and do good as Allah has been good to you and do not strive to create mischief in the land for Allah loves not those who create mischief.""

ayahs.text: He replied: ""All this has been given to me on account of a certain knowledge that I have."" Did he not know that Allah had destroyed before him those who were stronger in might than he and were more numerous in multitude? The wicked are not asked about their acts of sin.
ayahs.translation: He replied: ""All this has been given to me on account of a certain knowledge that I have."" Did he not know that Allah had destroyed before him those who were stronger in might than he and were more numerous in multitude? The wicked are not asked about their acts of sin.

ayahs.text: Once Korah went forth among his people in full glitter. Those seeking the life of this world said: ""Would that we had the like of what Korah has! He truly has a great fortune.""
ayahs.translation: Once Korah went forth among his people in full glitter. Those seeking the life of this world said: ""Would that we had the like of what Korah has! He truly has a great fortune.""

ayahs.text: But those endowed with true knowledge said: ""Woe to you. The reward of Allah is best for those who believe and act righteously. But none except those who are patient shall attain to this.""
ayahs.translation: But those endowed with true knowledge said: ""Woe to you. The reward of Allah is best for those who believe and act righteously. But none except those who are patient shall attain to this.""

ayahs.text: At last We caused the earth to swallow him and his house. Thereafter there was no group of people that could come to his aid against Allah; nor was he able to come to his own aid.
ayahs.translation: At last We caused the earth to swallow him and his house. Thereafter there was no group of people that could come to his aid against Allah; nor was he able to come to his own aid.

ayahs.text: And those who had envied his position the day before began to say on the morrow: ""Alas we had forgotten that it is Allah Who increases the provision of those of His servants whom He will and grants in sparing measure to those whom He will. But for Allah''s favour upon us He could have made us to be swallowed too. Alas we had forgotten that the unbelievers do not prosper.""
ayahs.translation: And those who had envied his position the day before began to say on the morrow: ""Alas we had forgotten that it is Allah Who increases the provision of those of His servants whom He will and grants in sparing measure to those whom He will. But for Allah''s favour upon us He could have made us to be swallowed too. Alas we had forgotten that the unbelievers do not prosper.""

ayahs.text: As for the Abode of the Hereafter We shall assign it exclusively for those who do not seek glory on earth nor want to cause mischief. The God-fearing shall have the best end.
ayahs.translation: As for the Abode of the Hereafter We shall assign it exclusively for those who do not seek glory on earth nor want to cause mischief. The God-fearing shall have the best end.

ayahs.text: He who shall bring a good deed shall be rewarded with what is better. But those who bring evil deeds shall not be requited more than their deeds.
ayahs.translation: He who shall bring a good deed shall be rewarded with what is better. But those who bring evil deeds shall not be requited more than their deeds.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) surely He Who has ordained the Qur''an on you will bring you to the best end. Say to them: ""My Lord knows best who has brought true guidance and who is in clear error.""
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) surely He Who has ordained the Qur''an on you will bring you to the best end. Say to them: ""My Lord knows best who has brought true guidance and who is in clear error.""

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) you never looked forward for the Book to be revealed to you. It is out of sheer Mercy of your Lord that it was (revealed to you). So do not lend any support to the unbelievers.
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) you never looked forward for the Book to be revealed to you. It is out of sheer Mercy of your Lord that it was (revealed to you). So do not lend any support to the unbelievers.

ayahs.text: And let it never happen that the unbelievers might turn you away from the revelations of Allah after they have been revealed to you. Call people to your Lord and never become one of the unbelievers
ayahs.translation: And let it never happen that the unbelievers might turn you away from the revelations of Allah after they have been revealed to you. Call people to your Lord and never become one of the unbelievers

ayahs.text: and do not invoke any god beside Allah. There is no god but He. All will perish but He. To Him belongs the command. And to Him shall all of you return.
ayahs.translation: and do not invoke any god beside Allah. There is no god but He. All will perish but He. To Him belongs the command. And to Him shall all of you return.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Alif. Lam. Mim.
verses.translation: Alif. Lam. Mim.

verses.text: Do people think that they will be let go merely by saying:  We believe and that they will not be tested
verses.translation: Do people think that they will be let go merely by saying:  We believe and that they will not be tested

verses.text: for We indeed tested those who went before them? Allah will most certainly ascertain those who spoke the truth and those who lied.
verses.translation: for We indeed tested those who went before them? Allah will most certainly ascertain those who spoke the truth and those who lied.

verses.text: Do the evil-doers suppose that they will get the better of Us? How evil is their judgement!
verses.translation: Do the evil-doers suppose that they will get the better of Us? How evil is their judgement!

verses.text: Let him who looks forward to meeting Allah know that Allah''s appointed term will surely come to pass. He is All-Hearing All-Knowing.
verses.translation: Let him who looks forward to meeting Allah know that Allah''s appointed term will surely come to pass. He is All-Hearing All-Knowing.

verses.text: Whosoever strives(in the cause of Allah) does so to his own good. Surely Allah stands in no need of anyone in the whole Universe.
verses.translation: Whosoever strives(in the cause of Allah) does so to his own good. Surely Allah stands in no need of anyone in the whole Universe.

verses.text: Those who believe and do good deeds We shall cleanse them of their evil deeds and reward them according to the best of their deeds.
verses.translation: Those who believe and do good deeds We shall cleanse them of their evil deeds and reward them according to the best of their deeds.

verses.text: We have enjoined upon man kindness to his parents but if they exert pressure on you to associate with Me in My Divinity any that you do not know (to be My associate) do not obey them. To Me is your return and I shall let you know all that you have done.
verses.translation: We have enjoined upon man kindness to his parents but if they exert pressure on you to associate with Me in My Divinity any that you do not know (to be My associate) do not obey them. To Me is your return and I shall let you know all that you have done.

verses.text: As for those who believed and acted righteously We shall certainly admit them among the righteous.
verses.translation: As for those who believed and acted righteously We shall certainly admit them among the righteous.

verses.text: Among people there are some who say: We believe in Allah.  But when such a person is made to endure suffering in Allah''s cause he reckons the persecution he suffers at the hands of people as though it is a chastisement from Allah. But if victory comes from your Lord the same person will say  We were with you. Does Allah not know whatever is in the hearts of the people of the world?
verses.translation: Among people there are some who say: We believe in Allah.  But when such a person is made to endure suffering in Allah''s cause he reckons the persecution he suffers at the hands of people as though it is a chastisement from Allah. But if victory comes from your Lord the same person will say  We were with you. Does Allah not know whatever is in the hearts of the people of the world?

verses.text: Allah will surely ascertain who are the believers and who are the hypocrites.
verses.translation: Allah will surely ascertain who are the believers and who are the hypocrites.

verses.text: The unbelievers say to the believers:  Follow our way and we will carry the burden of your sins. (They say so even though) they are not going to carry any part of their sins. Surely they are lying.
verses.translation: The unbelievers say to the believers:  Follow our way and we will carry the burden of your sins. (They say so even though) they are not going to carry any part of their sins. Surely they are lying.

verses.text: They will certainly carry their own burdens and other burdens besides their own. They will assuredly be called to account on the Day of Resurrection concerning the fabrications which they contrived.
verses.translation: They will certainly carry their own burdens and other burdens besides their own. They will assuredly be called to account on the Day of Resurrection concerning the fabrications which they contrived.

verses.text: We did indeed send Noah to his people and he lived among them a thousand years save fifty. Eventually the Flood overtook them while they were engaged in wrongdoing.
verses.translation: We did indeed send Noah to his people and he lived among them a thousand years save fifty. Eventually the Flood overtook them while they were engaged in wrongdoing.

verses.text: Then We rescued Noah together with the people in the Ark and made it (that is the Ark) a lesson for all people.
verses.translation: Then We rescued Noah together with the people in the Ark and made it (that is the Ark) a lesson for all people.

verses.text: We sent Abraham and he said to his people:  Serve Allah and fear Him.This is better for you if you only knew.
verses.translation: We sent Abraham and he said to his people:  Serve Allah and fear Him.This is better for you if you only knew.

verses.text: Those that you worship instead of Allah are merely idols and you are simply inventing lies (about them). Indeed those whom you worship beside Allah have no power to provide you with any sustenance. So seek your sustenance from Allah and serve only Him and give thanks to Him alone. It is to Him that you will be sent back.
verses.translation: Those that you worship instead of Allah are merely idols and you are simply inventing lies (about them). Indeed those whom you worship beside Allah have no power to provide you with any sustenance. So seek your sustenance from Allah and serve only Him and give thanks to Him alone. It is to Him that you will be sent back.

verses.text: And if you give the lie (to the Messenger) then many nations before you also gave the lie (to their Messengers). The Messenger is charged with no other duty than to deliver the Message in clear terms.
verses.translation: And if you give the lie (to the Messenger) then many nations before you also gave the lie (to their Messengers). The Messenger is charged with no other duty than to deliver the Message in clear terms.

verses.text: Have they never observed how Allah creates for the first time and then repeats it? Indeed (to repeat the creation of a thing) is even easier for Allah (than creating it for the first time).
verses.translation: Have they never observed how Allah creates for the first time and then repeats it? Indeed (to repeat the creation of a thing) is even easier for Allah (than creating it for the first time).

verses.text: Say:  Go about the earth and see how He created for the first time and then Allah will recreate life.  Surely Allah has power over everything.
verses.translation: Say:  Go about the earth and see how He created for the first time and then Allah will recreate life.  Surely Allah has power over everything.

verses.text: He chastises whom He will and forgives whom He will. To Him all of you will be sent back.
verses.translation: He chastises whom He will and forgives whom He will. To Him all of you will be sent back.

verses.text: You cannot overpower Allah neither on the earth nor in the heaven. None can protect you from Allah nor come to your aid against Him.
verses.translation: You cannot overpower Allah neither on the earth nor in the heaven. None can protect you from Allah nor come to your aid against Him.

verses.text: Those who disbelieved in Allah''s signs and in meeting Him it is they who have despaired of My Mercy; it is they for whom a painful chastisement lies ahead.
verses.translation: Those who disbelieved in Allah''s signs and in meeting Him it is they who have despaired of My Mercy; it is they for whom a painful chastisement lies ahead.

verses.text: The people (of Abraham) had no other answer than to say:  Kill him or burn him. But Allah delivered him from the fire. There are many Signs in this for those who believe.
verses.translation: The people (of Abraham) had no other answer than to say:  Kill him or burn him. But Allah delivered him from the fire. There are many Signs in this for those who believe.

verses.text: He said: You have taken up idols instead of Allah as a bond of love among yourselves in the present life but on the Day of Resurrection you will disown and curse one another. Your refuge shall be the Fire and none will come to your aid.
verses.translation: He said: You have taken up idols instead of Allah as a bond of love among yourselves in the present life but on the Day of Resurrection you will disown and curse one another. Your refuge shall be the Fire and none will come to your aid.

verses.text: Then did Lot believe him and Abraham said:  I am emigrating unto my Lord. He is All-Powerful All-Wise
verses.translation: Then did Lot believe him and Abraham said:  I am emigrating unto my Lord. He is All-Powerful All-Wise

verses.text: and We bestowed upon him (offspring like) Isaac and Jacob and bestowed prophethood and the Book on his descendants and granted him his reward in this world; he will certainly be among the righteous in the Hereafter.
verses.translation: and We bestowed upon him (offspring like) Isaac and Jacob and bestowed prophethood and the Book on his descendants and granted him his reward in this world; he will certainly be among the righteous in the Hereafter.

verses.text: We sent Lot and he said to his people:  You commit the abomination that none in the world ever committed before you.
verses.translation: We sent Lot and he said to his people:  You commit the abomination that none in the world ever committed before you.

verses.text: What! Do you go to men (to satisfy your lust) engage in highway robbery and commit evil deeds in your gatherings? Then they had no answer to offer other than to say:  Bring Allah''s chastisement upon us if you are truthful.
verses.translation: What! Do you go to men (to satisfy your lust) engage in highway robbery and commit evil deeds in your gatherings? Then they had no answer to offer other than to say:  Bring Allah''s chastisement upon us if you are truthful.

verses.text: Lot said:  My Lord aid me against these mischievous people.
verses.translation: Lot said:  My Lord aid me against these mischievous people.

verses.text: When Our emissaries brought the good news to Abraham and said (to him):  We are surely going to destroy the inhabitants of this city; its inhabitants are immersed in wrong-doing.
verses.translation: When Our emissaries brought the good news to Abraham and said (to him):  We are surely going to destroy the inhabitants of this city; its inhabitants are immersed in wrong-doing.

verses.text: Abraham said:  But Lot is there. They replied:  We are well aware of those who are there. We shall save him and all his household except his wife.  His wife is among those who will stay behind.
verses.translation: Abraham said:  But Lot is there. They replied:  We are well aware of those who are there. We shall save him and all his household except his wife.  His wife is among those who will stay behind.

verses.text: When Our emissaries came to Lot he was distressed and embarrassed on their account. They said:  Do not fear nor be distressed. We shall save you and all your household except your wife who is among those that will stay behind.
verses.translation: When Our emissaries came to Lot he was distressed and embarrassed on their account. They said:  Do not fear nor be distressed. We shall save you and all your household except your wife who is among those that will stay behind.

verses.text: We shall bring down upon the people of this city a scourge from the heaven because of their evil-doing.
verses.translation: We shall bring down upon the people of this city a scourge from the heaven because of their evil-doing.

verses.text: And We have left a vestige of it in that city as a Clear Sign for a people who use their reason.
verses.translation: And We have left a vestige of it in that city as a Clear Sign for a people who use their reason.

verses.text: And We sent to Midian their brother Shuayb. He said:  My people serve Allah and look forward to the Last Day and do not go about the earth committing mischief.
verses.translation: And We sent to Midian their brother Shuayb. He said:  My people serve Allah and look forward to the Last Day and do not go about the earth committing mischief.

verses.text: But they denounced him as a liar. So a mighty earthquake overtook them and by the morning they lay overturned in their houses.
verses.translation: But they denounced him as a liar. So a mighty earthquake overtook them and by the morning they lay overturned in their houses.

verses.text: And We destroyed Ad and Thamud whose dwellings you have observed. Satan had embellished their deeds for them and had turned them away from the Right Path although they were a people of clear perception.
verses.translation: And We destroyed Ad and Thamud whose dwellings you have observed. Satan had embellished their deeds for them and had turned them away from the Right Path although they were a people of clear perception.

verses.text: And We destroyed Qarun (Korah) and Pharaoh and Haman. Moses came to them with Clear Signs but they waxed arrogant in the land although they could not have outstripped (Us).
verses.translation: And We destroyed Qarun (Korah) and Pharaoh and Haman. Moses came to them with Clear Signs but they waxed arrogant in the land although they could not have outstripped (Us).

verses.text: So We seized each for their sin. We let loose upon some a violent tornado with showers of stones; some were overtaken by a mighty Cry; some were caused to be swallowed up by the earth and some We drowned. Allah would not wrong them but it is they who wronged themselves.
verses.translation: So We seized each for their sin. We let loose upon some a violent tornado with showers of stones; some were overtaken by a mighty Cry; some were caused to be swallowed up by the earth and some We drowned. Allah would not wrong them but it is they who wronged themselves.

verses.text: The case of those who took others than Allah as their protectors is that of a spider who builds a house; but the frailest of all houses is the spider''s house; if they only knew.
verses.translation: The case of those who took others than Allah as their protectors is that of a spider who builds a house; but the frailest of all houses is the spider''s house; if they only knew.

verses.text: Surely Allah knows fully what they call upon apart from Him. He is the Most Powerful the Most Wise.
verses.translation: Surely Allah knows fully what they call upon apart from Him. He is the Most Powerful the Most Wise.

verses.text: These are the parables that We set forth to make people understand. But only those endowed with knowledge will comprehend them.
verses.translation: These are the parables that We set forth to make people understand. But only those endowed with knowledge will comprehend them.

verses.text: Allah has created the heavens and the earth in Truth. Certainly there is a Sign in this for those who believe.
verses.translation: Allah has created the heavens and the earth in Truth. Certainly there is a Sign in this for those who believe.

verses.text: (O Prophet) recite the Book that has been revealed to you and establish Prayer. Surely Prayer forbids indecency and evil. And Allah''s remembrance is of even greater merit. Allah knows all that you do.
verses.translation: (O Prophet) recite the Book that has been revealed to you and establish Prayer. Surely Prayer forbids indecency and evil. And Allah''s remembrance is of even greater merit. Allah knows all that you do.

verses.text: Argue not with the People of the Book except in the fairest manner unless it be those of them that are utterly unjust. Say to them:  We believe in what was revealed to us and what was revealed to you. One is our God and your God; and we are those who submit ourselves to Him.
verses.translation: Argue not with the People of the Book except in the fairest manner unless it be those of them that are utterly unjust. Say to them:  We believe in what was revealed to us and what was revealed to you. One is our God and your God; and we are those who submit ourselves to Him.

verses.text: (O Prophet) thus have We bestowed the Book on you. So those on whom We had bestowed the Book before believe in it and of these (Arabs) too a good many believe in it. It is none but the utter unbelievers who deny Our Signs.
verses.translation: (O Prophet) thus have We bestowed the Book on you. So those on whom We had bestowed the Book before believe in it and of these (Arabs) too a good many believe in it. It is none but the utter unbelievers who deny Our Signs.

verses.text: (O Prophet) you did not recite any Book before nor did you write it down with your hand; for then the votaries of falsehood would have had a cause for doubt.
verses.translation: (O Prophet) you did not recite any Book before nor did you write it down with your hand; for then the votaries of falsehood would have had a cause for doubt.

verses.text: But it is a set of Clear Signs in the hearts of those who have been endowed with knowledge.None except the utterly unjust will deny Our Signs.
verses.translation: But it is a set of Clear Signs in the hearts of those who have been endowed with knowledge.None except the utterly unjust will deny Our Signs.

verses.text: They say:  Why were Signs from his Lord not sent down upon him?  Say:  The Signs are only with Allah. As for me I am no more than a plain warner.
verses.translation: They say:  Why were Signs from his Lord not sent down upon him?  Say:  The Signs are only with Allah. As for me I am no more than a plain warner.

verses.text: Does it not suffice for them (as a Sign) that We revealed to you the Book that is recited to them? Surely there is mercy and good counsel in it for those who believe.
verses.translation: Does it not suffice for them (as a Sign) that We revealed to you the Book that is recited to them? Surely there is mercy and good counsel in it for those who believe.

verses.text: Say (O Prophet):  Allah suffices as a witness between me and you. He knows whatever is in the heavens and the earth. As for those who believe in falsehood and are engaged in infidelity with Allah it is they who will be the losers.
verses.translation: Say (O Prophet):  Allah suffices as a witness between me and you. He knows whatever is in the heavens and the earth. As for those who believe in falsehood and are engaged in infidelity with Allah it is they who will be the losers.

verses.text: They ask you to hasten in bringing chastisement upon them. Had there not been an appointed term for it the chastisement would have already visited them; in fact it will come down upon them all of a sudden (at its appointed time) while they will not be aware of it.
verses.translation: They ask you to hasten in bringing chastisement upon them. Had there not been an appointed term for it the chastisement would have already visited them; in fact it will come down upon them all of a sudden (at its appointed time) while they will not be aware of it.

verses.text: They ask you to hasten the chastisement upon them although Hell encompasses the unbelievers.
verses.translation: They ask you to hasten the chastisement upon them although Hell encompasses the unbelievers.

verses.text: (They will become aware of it) the Day when the chastisement will overwhelm them from above and from under their feet and He will say to them:  Taste now the consequence of the deeds that you used to commit.
verses.translation: (They will become aware of it) the Day when the chastisement will overwhelm them from above and from under their feet and He will say to them:  Taste now the consequence of the deeds that you used to commit.

verses.text: O My servants who believe verily My earth is vast; so serve Me alone.
verses.translation: O My servants who believe verily My earth is vast; so serve Me alone.

verses.text: Every being shall taste death then it is to Us that you shall be sent back.
verses.translation: Every being shall taste death then it is to Us that you shall be sent back.

verses.text: We shall house those who believed and acted righteously in the lofty mansions of Paradise beneath which rivers flow. There they shall remain for ever. How excellent a reward it is for those who acted (in obedience to Allah)
verses.translation: We shall house those who believed and acted righteously in the lofty mansions of Paradise beneath which rivers flow. There they shall remain for ever. How excellent a reward it is for those who acted (in obedience to Allah)

verses.text: who remained steadfast and put their trust in their Lord!
verses.translation: who remained steadfast and put their trust in their Lord!

verses.text: How many an animal there is that does not carry about its sustenance. Allah provides sustenance to them and to you. He is All-Hearing All-Knowing.
verses.translation: How many an animal there is that does not carry about its sustenance. Allah provides sustenance to them and to you. He is All-Hearing All-Knowing.

verses.text: If you were to ask them: Who created the heavens and the earth and Who has kept the sun and the moon in subjection?  they will certainly say:  Allah.  How come then they are being deluded from the Truth?
verses.translation: If you were to ask them: Who created the heavens and the earth and Who has kept the sun and the moon in subjection?  they will certainly say:  Allah.  How come then they are being deluded from the Truth?

verses.text: Allah enlarges the sustenance of any of His servants whom He will and straitens the sustenance of whom He will. Surely Allah has knowledge of everything.
verses.translation: Allah enlarges the sustenance of any of His servants whom He will and straitens the sustenance of whom He will. Surely Allah has knowledge of everything.

verses.text: If you were to ask them:  Who sent down water from the sky and therewith revived the earth after its death?  they will certainly say:  Allah.  Say:  To Allah alone be praise and thanks. But most people do not understand.
verses.translation: If you were to ask them:  Who sent down water from the sky and therewith revived the earth after its death?  they will certainly say:  Allah.  Say:  To Allah alone be praise and thanks. But most people do not understand.

verses.text: The present life is nothing but sport and amusement. The true life is in the Abode of the Hereafter; if only they knew.
verses.translation: The present life is nothing but sport and amusement. The true life is in the Abode of the Hereafter; if only they knew.

verses.text: When they embark in the ships they call upon Allah consecrating their faith to Him. But when He rescues them and brings them to land they suddenly begin to associate others with Allah in His Divinity
verses.translation: When they embark in the ships they call upon Allah consecrating their faith to Him. But when He rescues them and brings them to land they suddenly begin to associate others with Allah in His Divinity

verses.text: that they may be ungrateful for the rescue that We granted them and that they may revel in the pleasures (of the present life). Soon they shall come to know.
verses.translation: that they may be ungrateful for the rescue that We granted them and that they may revel in the pleasures (of the present life). Soon they shall come to know.

verses.text: Do they not see that We have given them a sanctuary of safety whereas people around them are being snatched away? So do they believe in falsehood and ungratefully deny Allah''s bounties?
verses.translation: Do they not see that We have given them a sanctuary of safety whereas people around them are being snatched away? So do they believe in falsehood and ungratefully deny Allah''s bounties?

verses.text: Who can be more unjust than he who foists a lie on Allah or gives the lie to the Truth after it has come to him? Is Hell not the resort of the unbelievers?
verses.translation: Who can be more unjust than he who foists a lie on Allah or gives the lie to the Truth after it has come to him? Is Hell not the resort of the unbelievers?

verses.text: As for those who strive in Our cause We shall surely guide them to Our Ways. Indeed Allah is with those who do good.
verses.translation: As for those who strive in Our cause We shall surely guide them to Our Ways. Indeed Allah is with those who do good.

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: Alif. Lam. Mim.
ayahs.translation: Alif. Lam. Mim.

ayahs.text: Do people think that they will be let go merely by saying:  We believe and that they will not be tested
ayahs.translation: Do people think that they will be let go merely by saying:  We believe and that they will not be tested

ayahs.text: for We indeed tested those who went before them? Allah will most certainly ascertain those who spoke the truth and those who lied.
ayahs.translation: for We indeed tested those who went before them? Allah will most certainly ascertain those who spoke the truth and those who lied.

ayahs.text: Do the evil-doers suppose that they will get the better of Us? How evil is their judgement!
ayahs.translation: Do the evil-doers suppose that they will get the better of Us? How evil is their judgement!

ayahs.text: Let him who looks forward to meeting Allah know that Allah''s appointed term will surely come to pass. He is All-Hearing All-Knowing.
ayahs.translation: Let him who looks forward to meeting Allah know that Allah''s appointed term will surely come to pass. He is All-Hearing All-Knowing.

ayahs.text: Whosoever strives(in the cause of Allah) does so to his own good. Surely Allah stands in no need of anyone in the whole Universe.
ayahs.translation: Whosoever strives(in the cause of Allah) does so to his own good. Surely Allah stands in no need of anyone in the whole Universe.

ayahs.text: Those who believe and do good deeds We shall cleanse them of their evil deeds and reward them according to the best of their deeds.
ayahs.translation: Those who believe and do good deeds We shall cleanse them of their evil deeds and reward them according to the best of their deeds.

ayahs.text: We have enjoined upon man kindness to his parents but if they exert pressure on you to associate with Me in My Divinity any that you do not know (to be My associate) do not obey them. To Me is your return and I shall let you know all that you have done.
ayahs.translation: We have enjoined upon man kindness to his parents but if they exert pressure on you to associate with Me in My Divinity any that you do not know (to be My associate) do not obey them. To Me is your return and I shall let you know all that you have done.

ayahs.text: As for those who believed and acted righteously We shall certainly admit them among the righteous.
ayahs.translation: As for those who believed and acted righteously We shall certainly admit them among the righteous.

ayahs.text: Among people there are some who say: We believe in Allah.  But when such a person is made to endure suffering in Allah''s cause he reckons the persecution he suffers at the hands of people as though it is a chastisement from Allah. But if victory comes from your Lord the same person will say  We were with you. Does Allah not know whatever is in the hearts of the people of the world?
ayahs.translation: Among people there are some who say: We believe in Allah.  But when such a person is made to endure suffering in Allah''s cause he reckons the persecution he suffers at the hands of people as though it is a chastisement from Allah. But if victory comes from your Lord the same person will say  We were with you. Does Allah not know whatever is in the hearts of the people of the world?

ayahs.text: Allah will surely ascertain who are the believers and who are the hypocrites.
ayahs.translation: Allah will surely ascertain who are the believers and who are the hypocrites.

ayahs.text: The unbelievers say to the believers:  Follow our way and we will carry the burden of your sins. (They say so even though) they are not going to carry any part of their sins. Surely they are lying.
ayahs.translation: The unbelievers say to the believers:  Follow our way and we will carry the burden of your sins. (They say so even though) they are not going to carry any part of their sins. Surely they are lying.

ayahs.text: They will certainly carry their own burdens and other burdens besides their own. They will assuredly be called to account on the Day of Resurrection concerning the fabrications which they contrived.
ayahs.translation: They will certainly carry their own burdens and other burdens besides their own. They will assuredly be called to account on the Day of Resurrection concerning the fabrications which they contrived.

ayahs.text: We did indeed send Noah to his people and he lived among them a thousand years save fifty. Eventually the Flood overtook them while they were engaged in wrongdoing.
ayahs.translation: We did indeed send Noah to his people and he lived among them a thousand years save fifty. Eventually the Flood overtook them while they were engaged in wrongdoing.

ayahs.text: Then We rescued Noah together with the people in the Ark and made it (that is the Ark) a lesson for all people.
ayahs.translation: Then We rescued Noah together with the people in the Ark and made it (that is the Ark) a lesson for all people.

ayahs.text: We sent Abraham and he said to his people:  Serve Allah and fear Him.This is better for you if you only knew.
ayahs.translation: We sent Abraham and he said to his people:  Serve Allah and fear Him.This is better for you if you only knew.

ayahs.text: Those that you worship instead of Allah are merely idols and you are simply inventing lies (about them). Indeed those whom you worship beside Allah have no power to provide you with any sustenance. So seek your sustenance from Allah and serve only Him and give thanks to Him alone. It is to Him that you will be sent back.
ayahs.translation: Those that you worship instead of Allah are merely idols and you are simply inventing lies (about them). Indeed those whom you worship beside Allah have no power to provide you with any sustenance. So seek your sustenance from Allah and serve only Him and give thanks to Him alone. It is to Him that you will be sent back.

ayahs.text: And if you give the lie (to the Messenger) then many nations before you also gave the lie (to their Messengers). The Messenger is charged with no other duty than to deliver the Message in clear terms.
ayahs.translation: And if you give the lie (to the Messenger) then many nations before you also gave the lie (to their Messengers). The Messenger is charged with no other duty than to deliver the Message in clear terms.

ayahs.text: Have they never observed how Allah creates for the first time and then repeats it? Indeed (to repeat the creation of a thing) is even easier for Allah (than creating it for the first time).
ayahs.translation: Have they never observed how Allah creates for the first time and then repeats it? Indeed (to repeat the creation of a thing) is even easier for Allah (than creating it for the first time).

ayahs.text: Say:  Go about the earth and see how He created for the first time and then Allah will recreate life.  Surely Allah has power over everything.
ayahs.translation: Say:  Go about the earth and see how He created for the first time and then Allah will recreate life.  Surely Allah has power over everything.

ayahs.text: He chastises whom He will and forgives whom He will. To Him all of you will be sent back.
ayahs.translation: He chastises whom He will and forgives whom He will. To Him all of you will be sent back.

ayahs.text: You cannot overpower Allah neither on the earth nor in the heaven. None can protect you from Allah nor come to your aid against Him.
ayahs.translation: You cannot overpower Allah neither on the earth nor in the heaven. None can protect you from Allah nor come to your aid against Him.

ayahs.text: Those who disbelieved in Allah''s signs and in meeting Him it is they who have despaired of My Mercy; it is they for whom a painful chastisement lies ahead.
ayahs.translation: Those who disbelieved in Allah''s signs and in meeting Him it is they who have despaired of My Mercy; it is they for whom a painful chastisement lies ahead.

ayahs.text: The people (of Abraham) had no other answer than to say:  Kill him or burn him. But Allah delivered him from the fire. There are many Signs in this for those who believe.
ayahs.translation: The people (of Abraham) had no other answer than to say:  Kill him or burn him. But Allah delivered him from the fire. There are many Signs in this for those who believe.

ayahs.text: He said: You have taken up idols instead of Allah as a bond of love among yourselves in the present life but on the Day of Resurrection you will disown and curse one another. Your refuge shall be the Fire and none will come to your aid.
ayahs.translation: He said: You have taken up idols instead of Allah as a bond of love among yourselves in the present life but on the Day of Resurrection you will disown and curse one another. Your refuge shall be the Fire and none will come to your aid.

ayahs.text: Then did Lot believe him and Abraham said:  I am emigrating unto my Lord. He is All-Powerful All-Wise
ayahs.translation: Then did Lot believe him and Abraham said:  I am emigrating unto my Lord. He is All-Powerful All-Wise

ayahs.text: and We bestowed upon him (offspring like) Isaac and Jacob and bestowed prophethood and the Book on his descendants and granted him his reward in this world; he will certainly be among the righteous in the Hereafter.
ayahs.translation: and We bestowed upon him (offspring like) Isaac and Jacob and bestowed prophethood and the Book on his descendants and granted him his reward in this world; he will certainly be among the righteous in the Hereafter.

ayahs.text: We sent Lot and he said to his people:  You commit the abomination that none in the world ever committed before you.
ayahs.translation: We sent Lot and he said to his people:  You commit the abomination that none in the world ever committed before you.

ayahs.text: What! Do you go to men (to satisfy your lust) engage in highway robbery and commit evil deeds in your gatherings? Then they had no answer to offer other than to say:  Bring Allah''s chastisement upon us if you are truthful.
ayahs.translation: What! Do you go to men (to satisfy your lust) engage in highway robbery and commit evil deeds in your gatherings? Then they had no answer to offer other than to say:  Bring Allah''s chastisement upon us if you are truthful.

ayahs.text: Lot said:  My Lord aid me against these mischievous people.
ayahs.translation: Lot said:  My Lord aid me against these mischievous people.

ayahs.text: When Our emissaries brought the good news to Abraham and said (to him):  We are surely going to destroy the inhabitants of this city; its inhabitants are immersed in wrong-doing.
ayahs.translation: When Our emissaries brought the good news to Abraham and said (to him):  We are surely going to destroy the inhabitants of this city; its inhabitants are immersed in wrong-doing.

ayahs.text: Abraham said:  But Lot is there. They replied:  We are well aware of those who are there. We shall save him and all his household except his wife.  His wife is among those who will stay behind.
ayahs.translation: Abraham said:  But Lot is there. They replied:  We are well aware of those who are there. We shall save him and all his household except his wife.  His wife is among those who will stay behind.

ayahs.text: When Our emissaries came to Lot he was distressed and embarrassed on their account. They said:  Do not fear nor be distressed. We shall save you and all your household except your wife who is among those that will stay behind.
ayahs.translation: When Our emissaries came to Lot he was distressed and embarrassed on their account. They said:  Do not fear nor be distressed. We shall save you and all your household except your wife who is among those that will stay behind.

ayahs.text: We shall bring down upon the people of this city a scourge from the heaven because of their evil-doing.
ayahs.translation: We shall bring down upon the people of this city a scourge from the heaven because of their evil-doing.

ayahs.text: And We have left a vestige of it in that city as a Clear Sign for a people who use their reason.
ayahs.translation: And We have left a vestige of it in that city as a Clear Sign for a people who use their reason.

ayahs.text: And We sent to Midian their brother Shuayb. He said:  My people serve Allah and look forward to the Last Day and do not go about the earth committing mischief.
ayahs.translation: And We sent to Midian their brother Shuayb. He said:  My people serve Allah and look forward to the Last Day and do not go about the earth committing mischief.

ayahs.text: But they denounced him as a liar. So a mighty earthquake overtook them and by the morning they lay overturned in their houses.
ayahs.translation: But they denounced him as a liar. So a mighty earthquake overtook them and by the morning they lay overturned in their houses.

ayahs.text: And We destroyed Ad and Thamud whose dwellings you have observed. Satan had embellished their deeds for them and had turned them away from the Right Path although they were a people of clear perception.
ayahs.translation: And We destroyed Ad and Thamud whose dwellings you have observed. Satan had embellished their deeds for them and had turned them away from the Right Path although they were a people of clear perception.

ayahs.text: And We destroyed Qarun (Korah) and Pharaoh and Haman. Moses came to them with Clear Signs but they waxed arrogant in the land although they could not have outstripped (Us).
ayahs.translation: And We destroyed Qarun (Korah) and Pharaoh and Haman. Moses came to them with Clear Signs but they waxed arrogant in the land although they could not have outstripped (Us).

ayahs.text: So We seized each for their sin. We let loose upon some a violent tornado with showers of stones; some were overtaken by a mighty Cry; some were caused to be swallowed up by the earth and some We drowned. Allah would not wrong them but it is they who wronged themselves.
ayahs.translation: So We seized each for their sin. We let loose upon some a violent tornado with showers of stones; some were overtaken by a mighty Cry; some were caused to be swallowed up by the earth and some We drowned. Allah would not wrong them but it is they who wronged themselves.

ayahs.text: The case of those who took others than Allah as their protectors is that of a spider who builds a house; but the frailest of all houses is the spider''s house; if they only knew.
ayahs.translation: The case of those who took others than Allah as their protectors is that of a spider who builds a house; but the frailest of all houses is the spider''s house; if they only knew.

ayahs.text: Surely Allah knows fully what they call upon apart from Him. He is the Most Powerful the Most Wise.
ayahs.translation: Surely Allah knows fully what they call upon apart from Him. He is the Most Powerful the Most Wise.

ayahs.text: These are the parables that We set forth to make people understand. But only those endowed with knowledge will comprehend them.
ayahs.translation: These are the parables that We set forth to make people understand. But only those endowed with knowledge will comprehend them.

ayahs.text: Allah has created the heavens and the earth in Truth. Certainly there is a Sign in this for those who believe.
ayahs.translation: Allah has created the heavens and the earth in Truth. Certainly there is a Sign in this for those who believe.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) recite the Book that has been revealed to you and establish Prayer. Surely Prayer forbids indecency and evil. And Allah''s remembrance is of even greater merit. Allah knows all that you do.
