ayahs.translation: When they embark in the ships they call upon Allah consecrating their faith to Him. But when He rescues them and brings them to land they suddenly begin to associate others with Allah in His Divinity

ayahs.text: that they may be ungrateful for the rescue that We granted them and that they may revel in the pleasures (of the present life). Soon they shall come to know.
ayahs.translation: that they may be ungrateful for the rescue that We granted them and that they may revel in the pleasures (of the present life). Soon they shall come to know.

ayahs.text: Do they not see that We have given them a sanctuary of safety whereas people around them are being snatched away? So do they believe in falsehood and ungratefully deny Allah''s bounties?
ayahs.translation: Do they not see that We have given them a sanctuary of safety whereas people around them are being snatched away? So do they believe in falsehood and ungratefully deny Allah''s bounties?

ayahs.text: Who can be more unjust than he who foists a lie on Allah or gives the lie to the Truth after it has come to him? Is Hell not the resort of the unbelievers?
ayahs.translation: Who can be more unjust than he who foists a lie on Allah or gives the lie to the Truth after it has come to him? Is Hell not the resort of the unbelievers?

ayahs.text: As for those who strive in Our cause We shall surely guide them to Our Ways. Indeed Allah is with those who do good.
ayahs.translation: As for those who strive in Our cause We shall surely guide them to Our Ways. Indeed Allah is with those who do good.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Alif. Lam. Mim.
verses.translation: Alif. Lam. Mim.

verses.text: The Romans have been defeated
verses.translation: The Romans have been defeated

verses.text: in the neighbouring land; but after their defeat they shall gain victory in a few years.
verses.translation: in the neighbouring land; but after their defeat they shall gain victory in a few years.

verses.text: All power belongs to Allah both before and after. On that day will the believers rejoice
verses.translation: All power belongs to Allah both before and after. On that day will the believers rejoice

verses.text: at the victory granted by Allah. He grants victory to whomsoever He pleases. He is the Most Mighty the Most Compassionate.
verses.translation: at the victory granted by Allah. He grants victory to whomsoever He pleases. He is the Most Mighty the Most Compassionate.

verses.text: This is Allah''s promise and He does not go back on His promise. But most people do not know.
verses.translation: This is Allah''s promise and He does not go back on His promise. But most people do not know.

verses.text: People simply know the outward aspect of the worldly life but are utterly heedless of the Hereafter.
verses.translation: People simply know the outward aspect of the worldly life but are utterly heedless of the Hereafter.

verses.text: Do they not reflect on themselves? Allah created the heavens and the earth and whatever lies between them in Truth and for an appointed term. Yet many people deny that they will meet their Lord.
verses.translation: Do they not reflect on themselves? Allah created the heavens and the earth and whatever lies between them in Truth and for an appointed term. Yet many people deny that they will meet their Lord.

verses.text: Have they not travelled through the earth that they may observe what was the end of their predecessors who were far mightier and tilled the land and built upon it more than these have ever built?And Allah''s Messengers came to them with Clear Signs. It was not Allah Who wronged them but it is they who wronged themselves.
verses.translation: Have they not travelled through the earth that they may observe what was the end of their predecessors who were far mightier and tilled the land and built upon it more than these have ever built?And Allah''s Messengers came to them with Clear Signs. It was not Allah Who wronged them but it is they who wronged themselves.

verses.text: Evil was the end of those evil-doers for they gave the lie to Allah''s Signs and scoffed at them.
verses.translation: Evil was the end of those evil-doers for they gave the lie to Allah''s Signs and scoffed at them.

verses.text: Allah creates in the first instance and will later repeat it. Thereafter it is to Him that you shall be sent back.
verses.translation: Allah creates in the first instance and will later repeat it. Thereafter it is to Him that you shall be sent back.

verses.text: On that Day when the Hour will come to pass the criminals shall be dumbfounded.
verses.translation: On that Day when the Hour will come to pass the criminals shall be dumbfounded.

verses.text: None whom they had associated with Allah in His Divinity will intercede on their behalf; rather they will disown those whom they had set up as Allah''s associates in His Divinity.
verses.translation: None whom they had associated with Allah in His Divinity will intercede on their behalf; rather they will disown those whom they had set up as Allah''s associates in His Divinity.

verses.text: On that Day when the Hour will come to pass people will be split into groups.
verses.translation: On that Day when the Hour will come to pass people will be split into groups.

verses.text: Then those who believed and acted righteously will be placed in a Garden and will be happy and jubilant.
verses.translation: Then those who believed and acted righteously will be placed in a Garden and will be happy and jubilant.

verses.text: As for those who disbelieved and gave the lie to Our Signs and to the encounter of the Hereafter they will be arraigned for chastisement.
verses.translation: As for those who disbelieved and gave the lie to Our Signs and to the encounter of the Hereafter they will be arraigned for chastisement.

verses.text: So glorify Allah in the evening and the morning.
verses.translation: So glorify Allah in the evening and the morning.

verses.text: His is all praise in the heavens and in the earth; (and glorify Him) in the afternoon and when the sun begins to decline.
verses.translation: His is all praise in the heavens and in the earth; (and glorify Him) in the afternoon and when the sun begins to decline.

verses.text: He brings forth the living from the dead and brings forth the dead from the living and revives the earth after it is dead. Likewise will you be raised to life (after you die).
verses.translation: He brings forth the living from the dead and brings forth the dead from the living and revives the earth after it is dead. Likewise will you be raised to life (after you die).

verses.text: And of His Signs is that He created you from dust and behold you became human beings and are multiplying around (the earth).
verses.translation: And of His Signs is that He created you from dust and behold you became human beings and are multiplying around (the earth).

verses.text: And of His Signs is that He has created mates for you from your own kind that you may find peace in them and He has set between you love and mercy. Surely there are Signs in this for those who reflect.
verses.translation: And of His Signs is that He has created mates for you from your own kind that you may find peace in them and He has set between you love and mercy. Surely there are Signs in this for those who reflect.

verses.text: And of His Signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your tongues and colours. Indeed there are Signs in this for the wise.
verses.translation: And of His Signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your tongues and colours. Indeed there are Signs in this for the wise.

verses.text: And of His Signs is your sleeping at night and your seeking His Bounty during the day. Indeed there are Signs in this for those who hearken.
verses.translation: And of His Signs is your sleeping at night and your seeking His Bounty during the day. Indeed there are Signs in this for those who hearken.

verses.text: And of His Signs is that He shows you lightning arousing both fear and hope and sends down water from the sky and revives the earth after it is dead. Indeed there are Signs in this for those who use their reason.
verses.translation: And of His Signs is that He shows you lightning arousing both fear and hope and sends down water from the sky and revives the earth after it is dead. Indeed there are Signs in this for those who use their reason.

verses.text: And of His Signs is that the sky and the earth stand firm by His command. Then no sooner than He summons you out of the earth you will come forth.
verses.translation: And of His Signs is that the sky and the earth stand firm by His command. Then no sooner than He summons you out of the earth you will come forth.

verses.text: To Him belong all who are in the heavens and all who are on the earth. All are in obedience to Him.
verses.translation: To Him belong all who are in the heavens and all who are on the earth. All are in obedience to Him.

verses.text: It is He Who creates in the first instance and it is He Who will repeat the creation and that is easier for Him. His is the loftiest attribute in the heavens and the earth. He is the Most Mighty the Most Wise.
verses.translation: It is He Who creates in the first instance and it is He Who will repeat the creation and that is easier for Him. His is the loftiest attribute in the heavens and the earth. He is the Most Mighty the Most Wise.

verses.text: He sets forth for you a parable from your own lives. Do you have among your slaves some who share with you the sustenance that We have bestowed on you so that you become equals in it all being alike and then you would hold them in fear as you fear each other? Thus do We make plain the Signs for those who use reason.
verses.translation: He sets forth for you a parable from your own lives. Do you have among your slaves some who share with you the sustenance that We have bestowed on you so that you become equals in it all being alike and then you would hold them in fear as you fear each other? Thus do We make plain the Signs for those who use reason.

verses.text: But the wrong-doers follow their desires without any knowledge. Who then can show the way to him whom Allah lets go astray? Such shall have no helpers.
verses.translation: But the wrong-doers follow their desires without any knowledge. Who then can show the way to him whom Allah lets go astray? Such shall have no helpers.

verses.text: (O Prophet and his followers) turn your face single-mindedly to the true Faith and adhere to the true nature on which Allah has created human beings. The mould fashioned by Allah cannot be altered. That is the True Straight Faith although most people do not know.
verses.translation: (O Prophet and his followers) turn your face single-mindedly to the true Faith and adhere to the true nature on which Allah has created human beings. The mould fashioned by Allah cannot be altered. That is the True Straight Faith although most people do not know.

verses.text: (Adhere to the True Faith and) turn to Him and hold Him in awe and establish Prayer and do not be of those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity
verses.translation: (Adhere to the True Faith and) turn to Him and hold Him in awe and establish Prayer and do not be of those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity

verses.text: those who have split up their religion and have become divided into sects each party exulting in what they have.
verses.translation: those who have split up their religion and have become divided into sects each party exulting in what they have.

verses.text: (Such are human beings) that when any misfortune befalls them they cry to their Lord penitently turning to Him. But no sooner that He lets them have a taste of His Mercy than some of them begin associating others with their Lord in His Divinity
verses.translation: (Such are human beings) that when any misfortune befalls them they cry to their Lord penitently turning to Him. But no sooner that He lets them have a taste of His Mercy than some of them begin associating others with their Lord in His Divinity

verses.text: so that they may show ingratitude to Us for the favours We had bestowed upon them. So enjoy yourselves a while; but then you shall soon come to know.
verses.translation: so that they may show ingratitude to Us for the favours We had bestowed upon them. So enjoy yourselves a while; but then you shall soon come to know.

verses.text: Have We sent down any sanction which provides support to their associating others with Allah in His Divinity?
verses.translation: Have We sent down any sanction which provides support to their associating others with Allah in His Divinity?

verses.text: When We make people have a taste of Our Mercy they exult in it; and when any misfortune befalls them in consequence of their deeds then lo and behold they despair.
verses.translation: When We make people have a taste of Our Mercy they exult in it; and when any misfortune befalls them in consequence of their deeds then lo and behold they despair.

verses.text: Do they not see that Allah enlarges and straitens the sustenance of those whom He pleases? There are Signs in this for those who believe.
verses.translation: Do they not see that Allah enlarges and straitens the sustenance of those whom He pleases? There are Signs in this for those who believe.

verses.text: So give his due to the near of kin and to the needy and to the wayfarer. That is better for those who desire to please Allah. It is they who will prosper.
verses.translation: So give his due to the near of kin and to the needy and to the wayfarer. That is better for those who desire to please Allah. It is they who will prosper.

verses.text: Whatever you pay as interest so that it may increase the wealth of people does not increase in the sight of Allah. As for the Zakah that you give seeking with it Allah''s good pleasure that is multiplied manifold.
verses.translation: Whatever you pay as interest so that it may increase the wealth of people does not increase in the sight of Allah. As for the Zakah that you give seeking with it Allah''s good pleasure that is multiplied manifold.

verses.text: It is Allah Who created you then bestowed upon you your sustenance and He will cause you to die and then will bring you back to life. Can any of those whom you associate with Allah in His Divinity do any such thing? Glory be to Him and exalted be He above whatever they associate with Allah in His Divinity!
verses.translation: It is Allah Who created you then bestowed upon you your sustenance and He will cause you to die and then will bring you back to life. Can any of those whom you associate with Allah in His Divinity do any such thing? Glory be to Him and exalted be He above whatever they associate with Allah in His Divinity!

verses.text: Evil has become rife on the land and at sea because of men''s deeds; this in order that He may cause them to have a taste of some of their deeds; perhaps they will turn back (from evil).
verses.translation: Evil has become rife on the land and at sea because of men''s deeds; this in order that He may cause them to have a taste of some of their deeds; perhaps they will turn back (from evil).

verses.text: (O Prophet) say:  Traverse in the earth and see what was the end of those who went before you: most of them associated others with Allah in His Divinity.
verses.translation: (O Prophet) say:  Traverse in the earth and see what was the end of those who went before you: most of them associated others with Allah in His Divinity.

verses.text: So turn your face exclusively towards the True Faith before there comes the Day whose coming from Allah cannot be averted the Day when people will split into groups.
verses.translation: So turn your face exclusively towards the True Faith before there comes the Day whose coming from Allah cannot be averted the Day when people will split into groups.

verses.text: He who disbelieves will suffer the consequence of it and he who acts righteously they will pave the way for their own good
verses.translation: He who disbelieves will suffer the consequence of it and he who acts righteously they will pave the way for their own good

verses.text: so that Allah may out of His Bounty reward those who believe and act righteously. Verily He does not love the unbelievers.
verses.translation: so that Allah may out of His Bounty reward those who believe and act righteously. Verily He does not love the unbelievers.

verses.text: And of His Signs is that He sends winds to herald good tidings and that He may give you a taste of His Mercy and that ships may sail at His bidding and you may seek His Bounty and give thanks to Him.
verses.translation: And of His Signs is that He sends winds to herald good tidings and that He may give you a taste of His Mercy and that ships may sail at His bidding and you may seek His Bounty and give thanks to Him.

verses.text: We sent Messengers before you to their respective nations and they brought Clear Signs to them. Then We took vengeance upon those who acted wickedly. It was incumbent on Us to come to the aid of the believers.
verses.translation: We sent Messengers before you to their respective nations and they brought Clear Signs to them. Then We took vengeance upon those who acted wickedly. It was incumbent on Us to come to the aid of the believers.

verses.text: Allah sends the winds that stir up clouds and then He spreads them in the sky as He pleases and splits them into different fragments whereafter you see drops of rain pouring down from them. He then causes the rain to fall on whomsoever of His servants He pleases and lo they rejoice at it
verses.translation: Allah sends the winds that stir up clouds and then He spreads them in the sky as He pleases and splits them into different fragments whereafter you see drops of rain pouring down from them. He then causes the rain to fall on whomsoever of His servants He pleases and lo they rejoice at it

verses.text: although before that they were given to despair.
verses.translation: although before that they were given to despair.

verses.text: See then the tokens of Allah''s Mercy: how He revives the earth after it is dead. Verily He is the One Who will revive the dead. He has power over everything.
verses.translation: See then the tokens of Allah''s Mercy: how He revives the earth after it is dead. Verily He is the One Who will revive the dead. He has power over everything.

verses.text: But if We were to send a wind and then their tilth has become yellow they would never cease to disbelieve.
verses.translation: But if We were to send a wind and then their tilth has become yellow they would never cease to disbelieve.

verses.text: (O Prophet) you cannot make the dead hear nor can you make the deaf hear your call when they turn back in retreat
verses.translation: (O Prophet) you cannot make the dead hear nor can you make the deaf hear your call when they turn back in retreat

verses.text: nor can you guide the blind out of their error. You can make none hear (your call) except those who believe in Our Signs and have surrendered themselves (to Him).
verses.translation: nor can you guide the blind out of their error. You can make none hear (your call) except those who believe in Our Signs and have surrendered themselves (to Him).

verses.text: It is Allah Who created you in a state of weakness; then after weakness He gave you strength then after strength He made you weak and old. He creates what He pleases. He is All-Knowing All-Powerful.
verses.translation: It is Allah Who created you in a state of weakness; then after weakness He gave you strength then after strength He made you weak and old. He creates what He pleases. He is All-Knowing All-Powerful.

verses.text: On that Day when the Hour will come to pass the wicked shall swear that they had stayed (in the world) no more than an hour. Thus they used to be deceived in the life of the world.
verses.translation: On that Day when the Hour will come to pass the wicked shall swear that they had stayed (in the world) no more than an hour. Thus they used to be deceived in the life of the world.

verses.text: But those who had been endowed with knowledge and faith shall say:  According to Allah''s Record you have stayed till the Day of Resurrection. Now this is the Day of Resurrection. But you did not know.
verses.translation: But those who had been endowed with knowledge and faith shall say:  According to Allah''s Record you have stayed till the Day of Resurrection. Now this is the Day of Resurrection. But you did not know.

verses.text: So that will be the Day when the excuses of the wrong-doers will not avail them nor will they be asked to make amends.
verses.translation: So that will be the Day when the excuses of the wrong-doers will not avail them nor will they be asked to make amends.

verses.text: In the Qur''an We have explained things to people in myriad ways. But no matter what Sign you bring to them those who are resolved upon denying the Truth will say:  You are given to falsehood.
verses.translation: In the Qur''an We have explained things to people in myriad ways. But no matter what Sign you bring to them those who are resolved upon denying the Truth will say:  You are given to falsehood.

verses.text: Thus does Allah seal the hearts of those who have no knowledge.
verses.translation: Thus does Allah seal the hearts of those who have no knowledge.

verses.text: Therefore (O Prophet) have patience. Surely Allah''s promise is true. Let those who lack certainty not cause you to be unsteady.
verses.translation: Therefore (O Prophet) have patience. Surely Allah''s promise is true. Let those who lack certainty not cause you to be unsteady.

ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: Alif. Lam. Mim.

It was not Allah Who wronged them but it is they who wronged themselves.

ayahs.text: Then those who believed and acted righteously will be placed in a Garden and will be happy and jubilant.
ayahs.translation: Then those who believed and acted righteously will be placed in a Garden and will be happy and jubilant.

ayahs.text: As for those who disbelieved and gave the lie to Our Signs and to the encounter of the Hereafter they will be arraigned for chastisement.

ayahs.translation: So glorify Allah in the evening and the morning.

ayahs.translation: (Such are human beings) that when any misfortune befalls them they cry to their Lord penitently turning to Him. But no sooner that He lets them have a taste of His Mercy than some of them begin associating others with their Lord in His Divinity

ayahs.text: so that they may show ingratitude to Us for the favours We had bestowed upon them. So enjoy yourselves a while; but then you shall soon come to know.
ayahs.translation: so that they may show ingratitude to Us for the favours We had bestowed upon them. So enjoy yourselves a while; but then you shall soon come to know.

ayahs.text: Have We sent down any sanction which provides support to their associating others with Allah in His Divinity?
ayahs.translation: Have We sent down any sanction which provides support to their associating others with Allah in His Divinity?

ayahs.text: When We make people have a taste of Our Mercy they exult in it; and when any misfortune befalls them in consequence of their deeds then lo and behold they despair.
ayahs.translation: When We make people have a taste of Our Mercy they exult in it; and when any misfortune befalls them in consequence of their deeds then lo and behold they despair.

ayahs.text: Do they not see that Allah enlarges and straitens the sustenance of those whom He pleases? There are Signs in this for those who believe.
ayahs.translation: Do they not see that Allah enlarges and straitens the sustenance of those whom He pleases? There are Signs in this for those who believe.

ayahs.text: So give his due to the near of kin and to the needy and to the wayfarer. That is better for those who desire to please Allah. It is they who will prosper.
ayahs.translation: So give his due to the near of kin and to the needy and to the wayfarer. That is better for those who desire to please Allah. It is they who will prosper.

ayahs.text: Whatever you pay as interest so that it may increase the wealth of people does not increase in the sight of Allah. As for the Zakah that you give seeking with it Allah''s good pleasure that is multiplied manifold.
ayahs.translation: Whatever you pay as interest so that it may increase the wealth of people does not increase in the sight of Allah. As for the Zakah that you give seeking with it Allah''s good pleasure that is multiplied manifold.

ayahs.text: It is Allah Who created you then bestowed upon you your sustenance and He will cause you to die and then will bring you back to life. Can any of those whom you associate with Allah in His Divinity do any such thing? Glory be to Him and exalted be He above whatever they associate with Allah in His Divinity!
ayahs.translation: It is Allah Who created you then bestowed upon you your sustenance and He will cause you to die and then will bring you back to life. Can any of those whom you associate with Allah in His Divinity do any such thing? Glory be to Him and exalted be He above whatever they associate with Allah in His Divinity!

ayahs.text: Evil has become rife on the land and at sea because of men''s deeds; this in order that He may cause them to have a taste of some of their deeds; perhaps they will turn back (from evil).
ayahs.translation: Evil has become rife on the land and at sea because of men''s deeds; this in order that He may cause them to have a taste of some of their deeds; perhaps they will turn back (from evil).

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) say:  Traverse in the earth and see what was the end of those who went before you: most of them associated others with Allah in His Divinity.
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) say:  Traverse in the earth and see what was the end of those who went before you: most of them associated others with Allah in His Divinity.

ayahs.text: So turn your face exclusively towards the True Faith before there comes the Day whose coming from Allah cannot be averted the Day when people will split into groups.
ayahs.translation: So turn your face exclusively towards the True Faith before there comes the Day whose coming from Allah cannot be averted the Day when people will split into groups.

ayahs.text: He who disbelieves will suffer the consequence of it and he who acts righteously they will pave the way for their own good
ayahs.translation: He who disbelieves will suffer the consequence of it and he who acts righteously they will pave the way for their own good

ayahs.text: so that Allah may out of His Bounty reward those who believe and act righteously. Verily He does not love the unbelievers.
ayahs.translation: so that Allah may out of His Bounty reward those who believe and act righteously. Verily He does not love the unbelievers.

ayahs.text: And of His Signs is that He sends winds to herald good tidings and that He may give you a taste of His Mercy and that ships may sail at His bidding and you may seek His Bounty and give thanks to Him.
ayahs.translation: And of His Signs is that He sends winds to herald good tidings and that He may give you a taste of His Mercy and that ships may sail at His bidding and you may seek His Bounty and give thanks to Him.

ayahs.text: We sent Messengers before you to their respective nations and they brought Clear Signs to them. Then We took vengeance upon those who acted wickedly. It was incumbent on Us to come to the aid of the believers.
ayahs.translation: We sent Messengers before you to their respective nations and they brought Clear Signs to them. Then We took vengeance upon those who acted wickedly. It was incumbent on Us to come to the aid of the believers.

ayahs.text: Allah sends the winds that stir up clouds and then He spreads them in the sky as He pleases and splits them into different fragments whereafter you see drops of rain pouring down from them. He then causes the rain to fall on whomsoever of His servants He pleases and lo they rejoice at it
ayahs.translation: Allah sends the winds that stir up clouds and then He spreads them in the sky as He pleases and splits them into different fragments whereafter you see drops of rain pouring down from them. He then causes the rain to fall on whomsoever of His servants He pleases and lo they rejoice at it

ayahs.text: although before that they were given to despair.
ayahs.translation: although before that they were given to despair.

ayahs.text: See then the tokens of Allah''s Mercy: how He revives the earth after it is dead. Verily He is the One Who will revive the dead. He has power over everything.
ayahs.translation: See then the tokens of Allah''s Mercy: how He revives the earth after it is dead. Verily He is the One Who will revive the dead. He has power over everything.

ayahs.text: But if We were to send a wind and then their tilth has become yellow they would never cease to disbelieve.
ayahs.translation: But if We were to send a wind and then their tilth has become yellow they would never cease to disbelieve.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) you cannot make the dead hear nor can you make the deaf hear your call when they turn back in retreat
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) you cannot make the dead hear nor can you make the deaf hear your call when they turn back in retreat

ayahs.text: nor can you guide the blind out of their error. You can make none hear (your call) except those who believe in Our Signs and have surrendered themselves (to Him).
ayahs.translation: nor can you guide the blind out of their error. You can make none hear (your call) except those who believe in Our Signs and have surrendered themselves (to Him).

ayahs.text: It is Allah Who created you in a state of weakness; then after weakness He gave you strength then after strength He made you weak and old. He creates what He pleases. He is All-Knowing All-Powerful.
ayahs.translation: It is Allah Who created you in a state of weakness; then after weakness He gave you strength then after strength He made you weak and old. He creates what He pleases. He is All-Knowing All-Powerful.

ayahs.text: On that Day when the Hour will come to pass the wicked shall swear that they had stayed (in the world) no more than an hour. Thus they used to be deceived in the life of the world.
ayahs.translation: On that Day when the Hour will come to pass the wicked shall swear that they had stayed (in the world) no more than an hour. Thus they used to be deceived in the life of the world.

ayahs.text: But those who had been endowed with knowledge and faith shall say:  According to Allah''s Record you have stayed till the Day of Resurrection. Now this is the Day of Resurrection. But you did not know.
ayahs.translation: But those who had been endowed with knowledge and faith shall say:  According to Allah''s Record you have stayed till the Day of Resurrection. Now this is the Day of Resurrection. But you did not know.

ayahs.text: So that will be the Day when the excuses of the wrong-doers will not avail them nor will they be asked to make amends.
ayahs.translation: So that will be the Day when the excuses of the wrong-doers will not avail them nor will they be asked to make amends.

ayahs.text: In the Qur''an We have explained things to people in myriad ways. But no matter what Sign you bring to them those who are resolved upon denying the Truth will say:  You are given to falsehood.
ayahs.translation: In the Qur''an We have explained things to people in myriad ways. But no matter what Sign you bring to them those who are resolved upon denying the Truth will say:  You are given to falsehood.

ayahs.text: Thus does Allah seal the hearts of those who have no knowledge.
ayahs.translation: Thus does Allah seal the hearts of those who have no knowledge.

ayahs.text: Therefore (O Prophet) have patience. Surely Allah''s promise is true. Let those who lack certainty not cause you to be unsteady.
ayahs.translation: Therefore (O Prophet) have patience. Surely Allah''s promise is true. Let those who lack certainty not cause you to be unsteady.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Alif. Lam. Mim.
verses.translation: Alif. Lam. Mim.

verses.text: These are the verses of the Wise Book
verses.translation: These are the verses of the Wise Book

verses.text: a guidance and mercy for the doers of good
verses.translation: a guidance and mercy for the doers of good

verses.text: who establish Prayer and pay Zakah and have firm faith in the Hereafter.
verses.translation: who establish Prayer and pay Zakah and have firm faith in the Hereafter.

verses.text: It is they who are on true guidance from their Lord and it is they who shall prosper.
verses.translation: It is they who are on true guidance from their Lord and it is they who shall prosper.

verses.text: There are some human beings who purchase an enchanting diversion in order to lead people away from the way of Allah without having any knowledge who hold the call to the Way of Allah to ridicule.A humiliating chastisement awaits them.
verses.translation: There are some human beings who purchase an enchanting diversion in order to lead people away from the way of Allah without having any knowledge who hold the call to the Way of Allah to ridicule.A humiliating chastisement awaits them.

verses.text: When Our verses are recited to such a person he arrogantly turns away as though he had not heard them or as though there was a deafness in his ears. So announce to him the tidings of a grievous chastisement.
verses.translation: When Our verses are recited to such a person he arrogantly turns away as though he had not heard them or as though there was a deafness in his ears. So announce to him the tidings of a grievous chastisement.

verses.text: Surely those who believe and do good deeds shall have Gardens of Bliss.
verses.translation: Surely those who believe and do good deeds shall have Gardens of Bliss.

verses.text: They shall abide in them forever. This is Allah''s promise that shall come true. He is the Most Powerful the Most Wise.
verses.translation: They shall abide in them forever. This is Allah''s promise that shall come true. He is the Most Powerful the Most Wise.

verses.text: He created the heavens without any pillars visible to you and He placed mountains in the earth as pegs lest it should turn topsy turvy with you and He dispersed all kinds of animals over the earth and sent down water from the sky causing all kinds of excellent plants to grow on it.
verses.translation: He created the heavens without any pillars visible to you and He placed mountains in the earth as pegs lest it should turn topsy turvy with you and He dispersed all kinds of animals over the earth and sent down water from the sky causing all kinds of excellent plants to grow on it.

verses.text: Such is Allah''s creation. Show me then what any others apart from Allah have created. Nay the fact is that the wrong-doers are in manifest error.
verses.translation: Such is Allah''s creation. Show me then what any others apart from Allah have created. Nay the fact is that the wrong-doers are in manifest error.

verses.text: We bestowed wisdom upon Luqman (enjoining):  Give thanks to Allah. Whoso gives thanks to Allah does so to his own good. And whoso disbelieves (let him know that) Allah is All-Sufficient Immensely Praiseworthy.
verses.translation: We bestowed wisdom upon Luqman (enjoining):  Give thanks to Allah. Whoso gives thanks to Allah does so to his own good. And whoso disbelieves (let him know that) Allah is All-Sufficient Immensely Praiseworthy.

verses.text: And call to mind when Luqman said to his son while exhorting him:  My son do not associate others with Allah in His Divinity. Surely associating others with Allah in His Divinity is a mighty wrong.
verses.translation: And call to mind when Luqman said to his son while exhorting him:  My son do not associate others with Allah in His Divinity. Surely associating others with Allah in His Divinity is a mighty wrong.

verses.text: We enjoined upon man to be dutiful to his parents. His mother bore him in weakness upon weakness and his weaning lasted two years. (We therefore enjoined upon him):  Give thanks to Me and to your parents. To Me is your ultimate return.
verses.translation: We enjoined upon man to be dutiful to his parents. His mother bore him in weakness upon weakness and his weaning lasted two years. (We therefore enjoined upon him):  Give thanks to Me and to your parents. To Me is your ultimate return.

verses.text: But if they press you to associate others with Me in My Divinity (to associate) those regarding whom you have no knowledge (that they are My associates) do not obey them. And yet treat them well in this world and follow the way of him who turns to Me in devotion. Eventually it is to Me that all of you shall return and I shall then tell you all that you did.
verses.translation: But if they press you to associate others with Me in My Divinity (to associate) those regarding whom you have no knowledge (that they are My associates) do not obey them. And yet treat them well in this world and follow the way of him who turns to Me in devotion. Eventually it is to Me that all of you shall return and I shall then tell you all that you did.

verses.text: (Luqman said): Son Allah will bring forth everything even if it be as small as the grain of a mustard seed even though it be hidden inside a rock or (anywhere) in the heavens or earth. Allah is Most Subtle All-Aware.
verses.translation: (Luqman said): Son Allah will bring forth everything even if it be as small as the grain of a mustard seed even though it be hidden inside a rock or (anywhere) in the heavens or earth. Allah is Most Subtle All-Aware.

verses.text: Son establish Prayer enjoin all that is good and forbid all that is evil and endure with patience whatever affliction befalls you. Surely these have been emphatically enjoined.
verses.translation: Son establish Prayer enjoin all that is good and forbid all that is evil and endure with patience whatever affliction befalls you. Surely these have been emphatically enjoined.

verses.text: Do not (contemptuously) turn your face away from people nor tread haughtily upon earth. Allah does not love the arrogant and the vainglorious.
verses.translation: Do not (contemptuously) turn your face away from people nor tread haughtily upon earth. Allah does not love the arrogant and the vainglorious.

verses.text: Be moderate in your stride and lower your voice. Verily the most disgusting of all voices is the braying of the donkey.
verses.translation: Be moderate in your stride and lower your voice. Verily the most disgusting of all voices is the braying of the donkey.

verses.text: Have you not seen that Allah has subjected to your service all that is in the heavens and on the earth and has abundantly bestowed upon you all His bounties both visible and invisible? Yet some persons dispute regarding Allah without having any knowledge or guidance or any illuminating Book.
verses.translation: Have you not seen that Allah has subjected to your service all that is in the heavens and on the earth and has abundantly bestowed upon you all His bounties both visible and invisible? Yet some persons dispute regarding Allah without having any knowledge or guidance or any illuminating Book.

verses.text: When they are told:  Follow what Allah has revealed they say:  We will rather follow that which we have found our forefathers following.  (Will they follow that) even though Satan might invite them to the chastisement of the Blazing Fire?
verses.translation: When they are told:  Follow what Allah has revealed they say:  We will rather follow that which we have found our forefathers following.  (Will they follow that) even though Satan might invite them to the chastisement of the Blazing Fire?

verses.text: Whoever surrenders himself to Allah and lives righteously grasps the most firm handle. The ultimate decision of all matters rests with Allah.
verses.translation: Whoever surrenders himself to Allah and lives righteously grasps the most firm handle. The ultimate decision of all matters rests with Allah.

verses.text: So let the unbelief of the unbeliever not grieve you. To Us is their return and then We shall inform them of all that they did. Surely Allah knows well even the secrets that are hidden in the breasts (of people).
verses.translation: So let the unbelief of the unbeliever not grieve you. To Us is their return and then We shall inform them of all that they did. Surely Allah knows well even the secrets that are hidden in the breasts (of people).

verses.text: We allow them to enjoy themselves a while in the world and then We shall drive them in utter helplessness to a harsh chastisement.
verses.translation: We allow them to enjoy themselves a while in the world and then We shall drive them in utter helplessness to a harsh chastisement.

verses.text: If you were to ask them:  Who created the heavens and the earth?  they will certainly reply:  Allah.  Say:  All praise and thanks be to Allah. Yet most of them do not know.
verses.translation: If you were to ask them:  Who created the heavens and the earth?  they will certainly reply:  Allah.  Say:  All praise and thanks be to Allah. Yet most of them do not know.

verses.text: All that is in the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah. Verily He is All-Sufficient Immensely Praiseworthy.
verses.translation: All that is in the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah. Verily He is All-Sufficient Immensely Praiseworthy.

verses.text: If all the trees on earth become pens and the sea replenished by seven more seas were to supply them with ink the Words of Allah would not be exhausted.Verily Allah is Most Mighty Most Wise.
verses.translation: If all the trees on earth become pens and the sea replenished by seven more seas were to supply them with ink the Words of Allah would not be exhausted.Verily Allah is Most Mighty Most Wise.

verses.text: To create all of you or to resurrect all of you is to Him like (creating or resurrecting) a single person. Verily Allah is All-Hearing All-Seeing.
verses.translation: To create all of you or to resurrect all of you is to Him like (creating or resurrecting) a single person. Verily Allah is All-Hearing All-Seeing.

verses.text: Do you not see that Allah makes the night phase into the day and makes the day phase into the night and has subjected the sun and the moon to His will so that each of them is pursuing its course till an appointed time? (Do you not know that) Allah is well aware of all that you do?
verses.translation: Do you not see that Allah makes the night phase into the day and makes the day phase into the night and has subjected the sun and the moon to His will so that each of them is pursuing its course till an appointed time? (Do you not know that) Allah is well aware of all that you do?

verses.text: All this is because Allah He alone is the Truth and all that which they call upon beside Him is false. Surely Allah He alone is All-High Incomparably Great.
verses.translation: All this is because Allah He alone is the Truth and all that which they call upon beside Him is false. Surely Allah He alone is All-High Incomparably Great.

verses.text: Do you not see that ships sail in the sea by Allah''s Grace that He may show you some of His Signs? Surely there are Signs in this for everyone who is steadfast thankful.
verses.translation: Do you not see that ships sail in the sea by Allah''s Grace that He may show you some of His Signs? Surely there are Signs in this for everyone who is steadfast thankful.

verses.text: When waves engulf them (in the sea) like canopies they call upon Allah consecrating their faith solely to Him. But when He delivers them safely to the land some of them become lukewarm. None denies Our Signs except the perfidious the ungrateful.
verses.translation: When waves engulf them (in the sea) like canopies they call upon Allah consecrating their faith solely to Him. But when He delivers them safely to the land some of them become lukewarm. None denies Our Signs except the perfidious the ungrateful.

verses.text: O people fear (the wrath) of your Lord and dread the Day when no father will stand for his child nor any child stand for his father. Surely Allah''s promise is true. So let the life of this world not beguile you nor let the Deluder delude you about Allah.
verses.translation: O people fear (the wrath) of your Lord and dread the Day when no father will stand for his child nor any child stand for his father. Surely Allah''s promise is true. So let the life of this world not beguile you nor let the Deluder delude you about Allah.

verses.text: Surely Allah alone has the knowledge of the Hour. It is He Who sends down the rain and knows what is in the wombs although no person knows what he will earn tomorrow nor does he know in which land he will die. Indeed Allah is All-Knowing All-Aware.
verses.translation: Surely Allah alone has the knowledge of the Hour. It is He Who sends down the rain and knows what is in the wombs although no person knows what he will earn tomorrow nor does he know in which land he will die. Indeed Allah is All-Knowing All-Aware.

ayahs.text: All that is in the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah. Verily He is All-Sufficient Immensely Praiseworthy.
ayahs.translation: All that is in the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah. Verily He is All-Sufficient Immensely Praiseworthy.

ayahs.text: If all the trees on earth become pens and the sea replenished by seven more seas were to supply them with ink the Words of Allah would not be exhausted.Verily Allah is Most Mighty Most Wise.
ayahs.translation: If all the trees on earth become pens and the sea replenished by seven more seas were to supply them with ink the Words of Allah would not be exhausted.Verily Allah is Most Mighty Most Wise.

ayahs.text: To create all of you or to resurrect all of you is to Him like (creating or resurrecting) a single person. Verily Allah is All-Hearing All-Seeing.
ayahs.translation: To create all of you or to resurrect all of you is to Him like (creating or resurrecting) a single person. Verily Allah is All-Hearing All-Seeing.

ayahs.text: Do you not see that Allah makes the night phase into the day and makes the day phase into the night and has subjected the sun and the moon to His will so that each of them is pursuing its course till an appointed time? (Do you not know that) Allah is well aware of all that you do?
ayahs.translation: Do you not see that Allah makes the night phase into the day and makes the day phase into the night and has subjected the sun and the moon to His will so that each of them is pursuing its course till an appointed time? (Do you not know that) Allah is well aware of all that you do?

ayahs.text: All this is because Allah He alone is the Truth and all that which they call upon beside Him is false. Surely Allah He alone is All-High Incomparably Great.
ayahs.translation: All this is because Allah He alone is the Truth and all that which they call upon beside Him is false. Surely Allah He alone is All-High Incomparably Great.

ayahs.text: Do you not see that ships sail in the sea by Allah''s Grace that He may show you some of His Signs? Surely there are Signs in this for everyone who is steadfast thankful.
ayahs.translation: Do you not see that ships sail in the sea by Allah''s Grace that He may show you some of His Signs? Surely there are Signs in this for everyone who is steadfast thankful.

ayahs.text: When waves engulf them (in the sea) like canopies they call upon Allah consecrating their faith solely to Him. But when He delivers them safely to the land some of them become lukewarm. None denies Our Signs except the perfidious the ungrateful.
ayahs.translation: When waves engulf them (in the sea) like canopies they call upon Allah consecrating their faith solely to Him. But when He delivers them safely to the land some of them become lukewarm. None denies Our Signs except the perfidious the ungrateful.

ayahs.text: O people fear (the wrath) of your Lord and dread the Day when no father will stand for his child nor any child stand for his father. Surely Allah''s promise is true. So let the life of this world not beguile you nor let the Deluder delude you about Allah.
ayahs.translation: O people fear (the wrath) of your Lord and dread the Day when no father will stand for his child nor any child stand for his father. Surely Allah''s promise is true. So let the life of this world not beguile you nor let the Deluder delude you about Allah.

ayahs.text: Surely Allah alone has the knowledge of the Hour. It is He Who sends down the rain and knows what is in the wombs although no person knows what he will earn tomorrow nor does he know in which land he will die. Indeed Allah is All-Knowing All-Aware.
ayahs.translation: Surely Allah alone has the knowledge of the Hour. It is He Who sends down the rain and knows what is in the wombs although no person knows what he will earn tomorrow nor does he know in which land he will die. Indeed Allah is All-Knowing All-Aware.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Alif. Lam. Mim.
verses.translation: Alif. Lam. Mim.

verses.text: This Book beyond all doubt was revealed by the Lord of the Universe.
verses.translation: This Book beyond all doubt was revealed by the Lord of the Universe.

verses.text: Or do they say:  He has fabricated it? Nay it is the Truth from your Lord so that you may warn a people to whom no warner came before you; perhaps they will be guided to the Right Way.
verses.translation: Or do they say:  He has fabricated it? Nay it is the Truth from your Lord so that you may warn a people to whom no warner came before you; perhaps they will be guided to the Right Way.

verses.text: It is Allah Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is between the two in six days and then He established Himself on the Throne. You have no guardian or intercessor other than He. Will you then not take heed?
verses.translation: It is Allah Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is between the two in six days and then He established Himself on the Throne. You have no guardian or intercessor other than He. Will you then not take heed?

verses.text: He governs from the heaven to the earth and then the record (of this governance) goes up to Him in a day whose measure is a thousand years in your reckoning.
verses.translation: He governs from the heaven to the earth and then the record (of this governance) goes up to Him in a day whose measure is a thousand years in your reckoning.

verses.text: He knows all that is beyond as well as all that is within a creature''s sense-perception. He is the Most Mighty the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: He knows all that is beyond as well as all that is within a creature''s sense-perception. He is the Most Mighty the Most Compassionate

verses.text: He Who excelled in the creation of all that He created. He originated the creation of man from clay
verses.translation: He Who excelled in the creation of all that He created. He originated the creation of man from clay

verses.text: then made his progeny from the extract of a mean fluid
verses.translation: then made his progeny from the extract of a mean fluid

verses.text: then He duly proportioned him and breathed into him of His spirit and bestowed upon you ears and eyes and hearts. And yet little thanks do you give.
verses.translation: then He duly proportioned him and breathed into him of His spirit and bestowed upon you ears and eyes and hearts. And yet little thanks do you give.

verses.text: They say: Shall we be created afresh after we have become lost in the earth?  Nay the fact is that they deny that they will meet their Lord.
verses.translation: They say: Shall we be created afresh after we have become lost in the earth?  Nay the fact is that they deny that they will meet their Lord.

verses.text: Tell them:  The angel of death who has been charged with your souls shall gather you and then you shall be brought back to your Lord.
verses.translation: Tell them:  The angel of death who has been charged with your souls shall gather you and then you shall be brought back to your Lord.

verses.text: Would that you could see the guilty standing before their Lord with their heads downcast (saying to Him):  Our Lord we have now seen and heard so send us back (to the world) that we might act righteously. For now we have come to have firm faith.
verses.translation: Would that you could see the guilty standing before their Lord with their heads downcast (saying to Him):  Our Lord we have now seen and heard so send us back (to the world) that we might act righteously. For now we have come to have firm faith.

verses.text: (They will be told):  If We had so willed We could have bestowed guidance on every person. But the Word from Me that I will fill Hell with men and jinn all together has been fulfilled.
verses.translation: (They will be told):  If We had so willed We could have bestowed guidance on every person. But the Word from Me that I will fill Hell with men and jinn all together has been fulfilled.

verses.text: So taste the chastisement on account of your forgetting the encounter of this Day. We too have forgotten you. Taste the eternal chastisement as a requital for your misdeeds.
verses.translation: So taste the chastisement on account of your forgetting the encounter of this Day. We too have forgotten you. Taste the eternal chastisement as a requital for your misdeeds.

verses.text: None believes in Our Signs except those who when they are given good counsel through Our verses fall down prostrate and celebrate the praise of their Lord and do not wax proud.
verses.translation: None believes in Our Signs except those who when they are given good counsel through Our verses fall down prostrate and celebrate the praise of their Lord and do not wax proud.

verses.text: Their sides forsake their beds and they call upon their Lord in fear and hope and expend (in charity) out of the sustenance We have granted them.
verses.translation: Their sides forsake their beds and they call upon their Lord in fear and hope and expend (in charity) out of the sustenance We have granted them.

verses.text: No one knows what delights of the eyes are kept hidden for them as a reward for their deeds.
verses.translation: No one knows what delights of the eyes are kept hidden for them as a reward for their deeds.

verses.text: Would a true believer be like him who was an evil-doer? Surely they are not equal.
verses.translation: Would a true believer be like him who was an evil-doer? Surely they are not equal.

verses.text: As for those who believe and act righteously theirs shall be Gardens to dwell in a hospitality to reward them for their deeds.
verses.translation: As for those who believe and act righteously theirs shall be Gardens to dwell in a hospitality to reward them for their deeds.

verses.text: As for the evil-doers their refuge shall be the Fire. Every time they want to escape from it they shall be driven back and shall be told:  Taste the chastisement of the Fire which you used to reject as a lie.
verses.translation: As for the evil-doers their refuge shall be the Fire. Every time they want to escape from it they shall be driven back and shall be told:  Taste the chastisement of the Fire which you used to reject as a lie.

verses.text: We shall certainly have them taste some chastisement in this world in addition to the greater chastisement (of the Hereafter); perhaps they will retract (from their transgression).
verses.translation: We shall certainly have them taste some chastisement in this world in addition to the greater chastisement (of the Hereafter); perhaps they will retract (from their transgression).

verses.text: And who is more unjust than he who is given good counsel through the Signs of his Lord and yet he turns away from them? Surely We will exact full retribution from such criminals.
verses.translation: And who is more unjust than he who is given good counsel through the Signs of his Lord and yet he turns away from them? Surely We will exact full retribution from such criminals.

verses.text: Verily We bestowed the Book upon Moses. So entertain no doubt if (the Prophet Muhammad) received the same. We had made that Book a guidance for the Children of Israel
verses.translation: Verily We bestowed the Book upon Moses. So entertain no doubt if (the Prophet Muhammad) received the same. We had made that Book a guidance for the Children of Israel

verses.text: and when they remained steadfast and firmly believed in Our Signs We created among them leaders who guided people by Our command.
verses.translation: and when they remained steadfast and firmly believed in Our Signs We created among them leaders who guided people by Our command.

verses.text: Surely your Lord will judge among them on the Day of Resurrection concerning the matters about which the Children of Israel used to differ.
verses.translation: Surely your Lord will judge among them on the Day of Resurrection concerning the matters about which the Children of Israel used to differ.

verses.text: Did (these historical events) not make them realise that We destroyed many nations before them amidst whose dwellings they now move about? Surely there are many Signs in this. Are they unable to hear?
verses.translation: Did (these historical events) not make them realise that We destroyed many nations before them amidst whose dwellings they now move about? Surely there are many Signs in this. Are they unable to hear?

verses.text: Have they not seen that We drive water to the parched land thereby bringing forth crops which they and their cattle eat? Are they unable to see?
verses.translation: Have they not seen that We drive water to the parched land thereby bringing forth crops which they and their cattle eat? Are they unable to see?

verses.text: They say:  If you are truthful (tell us) when will the Judgement come?
verses.translation: They say:  If you are truthful (tell us) when will the Judgement come?

verses.text: Tell them:  If the unbelievers were to believe on the Day of Judgement that will not avail them. For then they will be granted no respite.
verses.translation: Tell them:  If the unbelievers were to believe on the Day of Judgement that will not avail them. For then they will be granted no respite.

verses.text: So (leave them to themselves and) turn away from them and wait; they too are waiting.
verses.translation: So (leave them to themselves and) turn away from them and wait; they too are waiting.

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: O Prophet fear Allah and do not obey the unbelievers and the hypocrites. Verily Allah is All-Knowing Most Wise.
verses.translation: O Prophet fear Allah and do not obey the unbelievers and the hypocrites. Verily Allah is All-Knowing Most Wise.

verses.text: Follow that which is revealed to you from your Lord. Verily Allah is fully aware of all that you do.
verses.translation: Follow that which is revealed to you from your Lord. Verily Allah is fully aware of all that you do.

verses.text: Put your trust in Allah: Allah is sufficient as Guardian.
verses.translation: Put your trust in Allah: Allah is sufficient as Guardian.

verses.text: Allah has never put two hearts within one person''s body; nor has He made your wives whom you compare to your mothers'' backs (to divorce them) your true mothers; nor has He made those whom you adopt as sons your own sons. These are only words that you utter with your mouths. But Allah proclaims the Truth and directs you to the Right Path.
verses.translation: Allah has never put two hearts within one person''s body; nor has He made your wives whom you compare to your mothers'' backs (to divorce them) your true mothers; nor has He made those whom you adopt as sons your own sons. These are only words that you utter with your mouths. But Allah proclaims the Truth and directs you to the Right Path.

verses.text: Call your adopted sons after their true fathers; that is more equitable in the sight of Allah. But if you do not know their true fathers then regard them as your brethren in faith and as allies. You will not be taken to task for your mistaken utterances but you will be taken to task for what you say deliberately. Allah is Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.
verses.translation: Call your adopted sons after their true fathers; that is more equitable in the sight of Allah. But if you do not know their true fathers then regard them as your brethren in faith and as allies. You will not be taken to task for your mistaken utterances but you will be taken to task for what you say deliberately. Allah is Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.

verses.text: Surely the Prophet has a greater claim over the believers than they have over each other and his wives are their mothers. According to the Book of Allah blood relatives have greater claim over each other than the rest of the believers and the Emigrants (in the cause of Allah) except that you may do some good to your allies (if you so wish). This is inscribed in the Book of Allah.
verses.translation: Surely the Prophet has a greater claim over the believers than they have over each other and his wives are their mothers. According to the Book of Allah blood relatives have greater claim over each other than the rest of the believers and the Emigrants (in the cause of Allah) except that you may do some good to your allies (if you so wish). This is inscribed in the Book of Allah.

verses.text: And call to mind (O Prophet) when We took the covenant from all Prophets; and also from you and Noah and Abraham Moses and Jesus the son of Mary. We took from them a solemn covenant
verses.translation: And call to mind (O Prophet) when We took the covenant from all Prophets; and also from you and Noah and Abraham Moses and Jesus the son of Mary. We took from them a solemn covenant

verses.text: so that (their Lord) may question the truthful about their truthfulness. As for the unbelievers He has kept a painful chastisement in store for them.
verses.translation: so that (their Lord) may question the truthful about their truthfulness. As for the unbelievers He has kept a painful chastisement in store for them.

verses.text: Believers call to mind Allah''s favour to you when enemy hosts invaded you. Then We sent against them a wind and hosts that you did not see although Allah was observing all that you were then doing.
verses.translation: Believers call to mind Allah''s favour to you when enemy hosts invaded you. Then We sent against them a wind and hosts that you did not see although Allah was observing all that you were then doing.

verses.text: When they came upon you from above you and from below you when your eyes were stupefied with horror and your hearts leapt to your throats and you began to entertain diverse thoughts about Allah.
verses.translation: When they came upon you from above you and from below you when your eyes were stupefied with horror and your hearts leapt to your throats and you began to entertain diverse thoughts about Allah.

verses.text: The believers were then put to a severe test and were most violently convulsed.
verses.translation: The believers were then put to a severe test and were most violently convulsed.

verses.text: And call to mind when the hypocrites and all those with diseased hearts said:  All that Allah and His Messenger had promised us was nothing but deceit.
verses.translation: And call to mind when the hypocrites and all those with diseased hearts said:  All that Allah and His Messenger had promised us was nothing but deceit.

verses.text: And when a section of them said:  (O people of Yathrib) now there is no place for you to stay so turn back. (And call to mind) when a section of them was seeking permission from the Prophet to leave saying:  Our houses are exposed (to attack) although they were not exposed (to attack); they only wished to flee (from the battle-front).
verses.translation: And when a section of them said:  (O people of Yathrib) now there is no place for you to stay so turn back. (And call to mind) when a section of them was seeking permission from the Prophet to leave saying:  Our houses are exposed (to attack) although they were not exposed (to attack); they only wished to flee (from the battle-front).

verses.text: If the enemy were to enter the town from various directions and they were summoned to act treacherously they would have succumbed to it and would have shown little reluctance in doing so.
verses.translation: If the enemy were to enter the town from various directions and they were summoned to act treacherously they would have succumbed to it and would have shown little reluctance in doing so.

verses.text: They had earlier covenanted with Allah that they would not turn their backs in flight. And a covenant made with Allah must needs be answered for.
verses.translation: They had earlier covenanted with Allah that they would not turn their backs in flight. And a covenant made with Allah must needs be answered for.

verses.text: (O Prophet) tell them:  If you run away from death or slaying this flight will not avail you. You will have little time after that to enjoy (the pleasures of life).
verses.translation: (O Prophet) tell them:  If you run away from death or slaying this flight will not avail you. You will have little time after that to enjoy (the pleasures of life).

verses.text: Say (to them):  Who can protect you from Allah if He desires an evil for you? And who can prevent Him if He desires to show mercy to you?  They shall find none other than Allah to be their protector or helper.
verses.translation: Say (to them):  Who can protect you from Allah if He desires an evil for you? And who can prevent Him if He desires to show mercy to you?  They shall find none other than Allah to be their protector or helper.

verses.text: Allah knows well those of you who create obstructions (in war efforts) and say to their brethren:  Come and join us. They hardly take any part in battle.
verses.translation: Allah knows well those of you who create obstructions (in war efforts) and say to their brethren:  Come and join us. They hardly take any part in battle.

verses.text: They are utterly niggardly (in coming to your aid). Whenever there is danger you will see them looking at you their eyes rolling as though they were on the verge of fainting at the approach of death. But when the danger passes away their greed for wealth prompts them to greet you with their sharp scissor-like tongues. These are the ones who never truly believed and so Allah has caused their deeds to be reduced to naught. That is easy enough for Allah.
verses.translation: They are utterly niggardly (in coming to your aid). Whenever there is danger you will see them looking at you their eyes rolling as though they were on the verge of fainting at the approach of death. But when the danger passes away their greed for wealth prompts them to greet you with their sharp scissor-like tongues. These are the ones who never truly believed and so Allah has caused their deeds to be reduced to naught. That is easy enough for Allah.

verses.text: They think that the invading confederates have not yet gone. But if the confederates were to mount another assault they would wish to be in the desert among the bedouins and keep themselves informed about you from there. But even if they remained in your midst hardly would they fight.
verses.translation: They think that the invading confederates have not yet gone. But if the confederates were to mount another assault they would wish to be in the desert among the bedouins and keep themselves informed about you from there. But even if they remained in your midst hardly would they fight.

verses.text: Surely there was a good example for you in the Messenger of Allah for all those who look forward to Allah and the Last Day and remember Allah much.
verses.translation: Surely there was a good example for you in the Messenger of Allah for all those who look forward to Allah and the Last Day and remember Allah much.

verses.text: As for the true believers when they saw the invading confederates they cried out:  This is what Allah and His Messenger had promised us and what Allah and His Messenger said was absolutely true. This only increased their faith and submission.
verses.translation: As for the true believers when they saw the invading confederates they cried out:  This is what Allah and His Messenger had promised us and what Allah and His Messenger said was absolutely true. This only increased their faith and submission.

verses.text: Among the believers there are those who have remained true to the covenant they made with Allah. Among those some of them have fulfilled their vow and others await the appointed time. They have not changed in the least.
verses.translation: Among the believers there are those who have remained true to the covenant they made with Allah. Among those some of them have fulfilled their vow and others await the appointed time. They have not changed in the least.

verses.text: (All this is) in order that Allah may reward the truthful for their truthfulness and either punish the hypocrites or if He so wills accept their repentance. Verily Allah is Most Pardoning Most Compassionate.
verses.translation: (All this is) in order that Allah may reward the truthful for their truthfulness and either punish the hypocrites or if He so wills accept their repentance. Verily Allah is Most Pardoning Most Compassionate.

verses.text: Allah sent back the unbelievers empty-handed their hearts seething with rage. Allah sufficed the believers in their fight. Allah is Most Powerful Most Mighty.
verses.translation: Allah sent back the unbelievers empty-handed their hearts seething with rage. Allah sufficed the believers in their fight. Allah is Most Powerful Most Mighty.

verses.text: Allah brought down from their fortresses those People of the Book who had supported the invading confederates and cast such terror into their hearts that some of them you kill and some of them you take captive.
verses.translation: Allah brought down from their fortresses those People of the Book who had supported the invading confederates and cast such terror into their hearts that some of them you kill and some of them you take captive.

verses.text: Allah made you inherit their land their dwellings and their goods and a piece of land on which you had not yet trodden. Verily Allah has power over all things.
verses.translation: Allah made you inherit their land their dwellings and their goods and a piece of land on which you had not yet trodden. Verily Allah has power over all things.

verses.text: O Prophet tell your wives:  If you seek the world and its embellishments then come and I will make some provision for you and release you in an honourable way.
verses.translation: O Prophet tell your wives:  If you seek the world and its embellishments then come and I will make some provision for you and release you in an honourable way.

verses.text: But if you seek Allah and His Messenger and the Abode of the Hereafter then surely Allah has prepared a great reward for those of you who do good.
verses.translation: But if you seek Allah and His Messenger and the Abode of the Hereafter then surely Allah has prepared a great reward for those of you who do good.

verses.text: Wives of the Prophet if any of you commit flagrant indecency her chastisement shall be doubled. That is easy for Allah.
verses.translation: Wives of the Prophet if any of you commit flagrant indecency her chastisement shall be doubled. That is easy for Allah.

verses.text: But whoever of you is obedient to Allah and His Messenger and does good deeds Allah will double her reward. We have prepared for her a generous provision.
verses.translation: But whoever of you is obedient to Allah and His Messenger and does good deeds Allah will double her reward. We have prepared for her a generous provision.

verses.text: Wives of the Prophet you are not like other women. If you fear Allah do not be too complaisant in your speech lest those with diseased hearts should covet you; but speak in a straight forward manner.
verses.translation: Wives of the Prophet you are not like other women. If you fear Allah do not be too complaisant in your speech lest those with diseased hearts should covet you; but speak in a straight forward manner.

verses.text: And stay in your homes and do not go about displaying your allurements as in the former Time of Ignorance. Establish Prayer give Zakah and obey Allah and His Messenger. Allah only wishes to remove uncleanness from you O members of the (Prophet''s) household and to purify you completely.
verses.translation: And stay in your homes and do not go about displaying your allurements as in the former Time of Ignorance. Establish Prayer give Zakah and obey Allah and His Messenger. Allah only wishes to remove uncleanness from you O members of the (Prophet''s) household and to purify you completely.

verses.text: Remember the Signs of Allah and the words of wisdom which are rehearsed in your homes. Verily Allah is All-Subtle All-Aware.
verses.translation: Remember the Signs of Allah and the words of wisdom which are rehearsed in your homes. Verily Allah is All-Subtle All-Aware.

verses.text: Surely the men who submit (to Allah) and the women who submit (to Allah) the men who have faith and the women who have faith the men who are obedient and the women who are obedient the men who are truthful and the women who are truthful; the men who are steadfast and the women who are steadfast the men who humble themselves (to Allah) and the women who humble themselves (to Allah) the men who give alms and the women who give alms the men who fast and the women who fast the men who guard their chastity and the women who guard their chastity the men who remember Allah much and the women who remember Allah much: for them has Allah prepared forgiveness and a mighty reward.
verses.translation: Surely the men who submit (to Allah) and the women who submit (to Allah) the men who have faith and the women who have faith the men who are obedient and the women who are obedient the men who are truthful and the women who are truthful; the men who are steadfast and the women who are steadfast the men who humble themselves (to Allah) and the women who humble themselves (to Allah) the men who give alms and the women who give alms the men who fast and the women who fast the men who guard their chastity and the women who guard their chastity the men who remember Allah much and the women who remember Allah much: for them has Allah prepared forgiveness and a mighty reward.

verses.text: It does not behove a believer male or female that when Allah and His Messenger have decided an affair they should exercise their choice. And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger has strayed to manifest error.
verses.translation: It does not behove a believer male or female that when Allah and His Messenger have decided an affair they should exercise their choice. And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger has strayed to manifest error.

verses.text: (O Prophet) call to mind when you said to him whom Allah had favoured and you had favoured:  Cleave to your wife and fear Allah and you concealed within yourself for fear of people what Allah was to reveal although Allah has greater right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had accomplished what he would of her We gave her in marriage to you so that there should not be any constraint for the believers regarding the wives of their adopted sons after they had accomplished whatever they would of them. And Allah''s command was bound to be accomplished.
verses.translation: (O Prophet) call to mind when you said to him whom Allah had favoured and you had favoured:  Cleave to your wife and fear Allah and you concealed within yourself for fear of people what Allah was to reveal although Allah has greater right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had accomplished what he would of her We gave her in marriage to you so that there should not be any constraint for the believers regarding the wives of their adopted sons after they had accomplished whatever they would of them. And Allah''s command was bound to be accomplished.

verses.text: There could be no hindrance to the Prophet regarding what Allah ordained for him. Such has been Allah''s Way (with the Prophets) who went before. Allah''s command is a decree firmly determined.
verses.translation: There could be no hindrance to the Prophet regarding what Allah ordained for him. Such has been Allah''s Way (with the Prophets) who went before. Allah''s command is a decree firmly determined.

verses.text: (This is Allah''s Way) regarding those who deliver the Messages of Allah and who fear Him and fear no one else than Allah. Allah is Sufficient as a Reckoner.
verses.translation: (This is Allah''s Way) regarding those who deliver the Messages of Allah and who fear Him and fear no one else than Allah. Allah is Sufficient as a Reckoner.

verses.text: Muhammad is not the father of any of your men but he is the Messenger of Allah and the seal of the Prophets. Allah has full knowledge of everything.
verses.translation: Muhammad is not the father of any of your men but he is the Messenger of Allah and the seal of the Prophets. Allah has full knowledge of everything.

verses.text: Believers remember Allah much
verses.translation: Believers remember Allah much

verses.text: and glorify Him morning and evening.
verses.translation: and glorify Him morning and evening.

verses.text: It is He Who lavishes His blessings on you and His angels invoke blessings on you that He may lead you out of darkness into light. He is Most Compassionate to the believers.
verses.translation: It is He Who lavishes His blessings on you and His angels invoke blessings on you that He may lead you out of darkness into light. He is Most Compassionate to the believers.

verses.text: On the Day they meet Him they will be greeted with:  Peace. He has prepared for them a generous reward.
verses.translation: On the Day they meet Him they will be greeted with:  Peace. He has prepared for them a generous reward.

verses.text: O Prophet We have sent you forth as a witness a bearer of good tidings and a warner
verses.translation: O Prophet We have sent you forth as a witness a bearer of good tidings and a warner

verses.text: as one who calls people to Allah by His leave and as a bright shining lamp.
verses.translation: as one who calls people to Allah by His leave and as a bright shining lamp.

verses.text: Announce to the believers the good tidings that Allah has kept bounteous blessings in store for them.
verses.translation: Announce to the believers the good tidings that Allah has kept bounteous blessings in store for them.
