verses.text: Do not yield to the unbelievers and the hypocrites and disregard the hurt that comes from them and put your trust in Allah. Allah suffices as the Guardian to entrust one''s affairs to.
verses.translation: Do not yield to the unbelievers and the hypocrites and disregard the hurt that comes from them and put your trust in Allah. Allah suffices as the Guardian to entrust one''s affairs to.

verses.text: Believers when you marry believing women and then divorce them before you have touched them you may not require them to observe a waiting period that you might reckon against them. So make provision for them and release them in an honourable manner.
verses.translation: Believers when you marry believing women and then divorce them before you have touched them you may not require them to observe a waiting period that you might reckon against them. So make provision for them and release them in an honourable manner.

verses.text: O Prophet We have made lawful for you your wives whose bridal dues you have paid and the slave-girls you possess from among the prisoners of war granted to you by Allah and the daughters of your paternal uncles and paternal aunts and the daughters of your maternal uncles and maternal aunts who have migrated with you and a believing woman who gives herself to the Prophet and whom he wants to take in marriage. (O Prophet) this privilege is yours alone to the exclusion of other believers. We know well what restrictions We have imposed upon them as regards their wives and those whom their right hands possess (and have exempted you from those restrictions) that there may be no constraint upon you. Allah is Most Forgiving Most Merciful.
verses.translation: O Prophet We have made lawful for you your wives whose bridal dues you have paid and the slave-girls you possess from among the prisoners of war granted to you by Allah and the daughters of your paternal uncles and paternal aunts and the daughters of your maternal uncles and maternal aunts who have migrated with you and a believing woman who gives herself to the Prophet and whom he wants to take in marriage. (O Prophet) this privilege is yours alone to the exclusion of other believers. We know well what restrictions We have imposed upon them as regards their wives and those whom their right hands possess (and have exempted you from those restrictions) that there may be no constraint upon you. Allah is Most Forgiving Most Merciful.

verses.text: Of them you may put off any of them you wish and you may take any of them whom you wish and you may call back any of those whom you had (temporarily) set aside: there will be no blame on you (on this account). It is likelier that they will thus be comforted and will not grieve and every one of them will be well-pleased with what you give them. Allah knows what is in your hearts. Allah is All-Knowing All-Forbearing.
verses.translation: Of them you may put off any of them you wish and you may take any of them whom you wish and you may call back any of those whom you had (temporarily) set aside: there will be no blame on you (on this account). It is likelier that they will thus be comforted and will not grieve and every one of them will be well-pleased with what you give them. Allah knows what is in your hearts. Allah is All-Knowing All-Forbearing.

verses.text: Thereafter women will not be lawful for you and it will not be lawful for you to take other wives in place of them even though their beauty might please you unless they be those whom your right hand owns. Allah is watchful over everything.
verses.translation: Thereafter women will not be lawful for you and it will not be lawful for you to take other wives in place of them even though their beauty might please you unless they be those whom your right hand owns. Allah is watchful over everything.

verses.text: Believers enter not the houses of the Prophet without his permission nor wait for a meal to be prepared; instead enter when you are invited to eat and when you have had the meal disperse. Do not linger in idle talk. That is hurtful to the Prophet but he does not express it out of shyness; but Allah is not ashamed of speaking out the Truth. And if you were to ask the wives of the Prophet for something ask from behind a curtain. That is more apt for the cleanness of your hearts and theirs. It is not lawful for you to cause hurt to Allah''s Messenger nor to ever marry his wives after him. Surely that would be an enormous sin in Allah''s sight.
verses.translation: Believers enter not the houses of the Prophet without his permission nor wait for a meal to be prepared; instead enter when you are invited to eat and when you have had the meal disperse. Do not linger in idle talk. That is hurtful to the Prophet but he does not express it out of shyness; but Allah is not ashamed of speaking out the Truth. And if you were to ask the wives of the Prophet for something ask from behind a curtain. That is more apt for the cleanness of your hearts and theirs. It is not lawful for you to cause hurt to Allah''s Messenger nor to ever marry his wives after him. Surely that would be an enormous sin in Allah''s sight.

verses.text: (It does not matter) whether you disclose something or conceal it for Allah certainly knows everything.
verses.translation: (It does not matter) whether you disclose something or conceal it for Allah certainly knows everything.

verses.text: It will not be blameworthy for the wives of the Prophet if their fathers their sons their brothers their brothers'' sons their sisters'' sons and the women with whom they have social relations and the persons whom their right hands possess enter their houses. (O women) shun disobeying Allah. Allah is watchful over everything.
verses.translation: It will not be blameworthy for the wives of the Prophet if their fathers their sons their brothers their brothers'' sons their sisters'' sons and the women with whom they have social relations and the persons whom their right hands possess enter their houses. (O women) shun disobeying Allah. Allah is watchful over everything.

verses.text: Allah and His angels bless the Prophet. Believers invoke blessings and peace on him.
verses.translation: Allah and His angels bless the Prophet. Believers invoke blessings and peace on him.

verses.text: Verily those who cause annoyance to Allah and His Messenger - Allah has cursed them in this world and in the Hereafter and has prepared for them a humiliating chastisement.
verses.translation: Verily those who cause annoyance to Allah and His Messenger - Allah has cursed them in this world and in the Hereafter and has prepared for them a humiliating chastisement.

verses.text: Those who cause hurt to believing men and to believing women have invited upon themselves a calumny and a manifest sin.
verses.translation: Those who cause hurt to believing men and to believing women have invited upon themselves a calumny and a manifest sin.

verses.text: O Prophet enjoin your wives and your daughters and the believing women to draw a part of their outer coverings around them. It is likelier that they will be recognised and not molested. Allah is Most Forgiving Most Merciful.
verses.translation: O Prophet enjoin your wives and your daughters and the believing women to draw a part of their outer coverings around them. It is likelier that they will be recognised and not molested. Allah is Most Forgiving Most Merciful.

verses.text: If the hypocrites and those in whose hearts there is a sickness and the scandal mongers in Madinah do not desist from their vile acts We shall urge you to take action against them and then they will hardly be able to stay in the city with you.
verses.translation: If the hypocrites and those in whose hearts there is a sickness and the scandal mongers in Madinah do not desist from their vile acts We shall urge you to take action against them and then they will hardly be able to stay in the city with you.

verses.text: They shall be cursed from all around and they shall be ruthlessly killed wherever they are seized.
verses.translation: They shall be cursed from all around and they shall be ruthlessly killed wherever they are seized.

verses.text: This has been Allah''s Way with those who have gone before and you shall find no change in Allah''s Way.
verses.translation: This has been Allah''s Way with those who have gone before and you shall find no change in Allah''s Way.

verses.text: People ask you concerning the Hour (of Resurrection). Say:  Allah alone has knowledge of it. What do you know? Perhaps the Hour is nigh.
verses.translation: People ask you concerning the Hour (of Resurrection). Say:  Allah alone has knowledge of it. What do you know? Perhaps the Hour is nigh.

verses.text: Allah has cursed the unbelievers and has prepared for them a Blazing Fire;
verses.translation: Allah has cursed the unbelievers and has prepared for them a Blazing Fire;

verses.text: therein they shall abide for ever. They shall find none to protect or help them.
verses.translation: therein they shall abide for ever. They shall find none to protect or help them.

verses.text: On that Day when their faces shall be turned around in the Fire they will say:  Would that we had obeyed Allah and obeyed the Messenger.
verses.translation: On that Day when their faces shall be turned around in the Fire they will say:  Would that we had obeyed Allah and obeyed the Messenger.

verses.text: They will say:  Our Lord we obeyed our chiefs and our great ones and they turned us away from the Right Way.
verses.translation: They will say:  Our Lord we obeyed our chiefs and our great ones and they turned us away from the Right Way.

verses.text: Our Lord mete out to them a double chastisement and lay upon them a mighty curse.
verses.translation: Our Lord mete out to them a double chastisement and lay upon them a mighty curse.

verses.text: Believers do not be like those who distressed Moses and then Allah declared him quit of the ill they spoke about him; and he had a high standing with Allah.
verses.translation: Believers do not be like those who distressed Moses and then Allah declared him quit of the ill they spoke about him; and he had a high standing with Allah.

verses.text: Believers fear Allah and speak the truth:
verses.translation: Believers fear Allah and speak the truth:

verses.text: Allah will set your deeds right for you and will forgive you your sins. Whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger has achieved a great triumph.
verses.translation: Allah will set your deeds right for you and will forgive you your sins. Whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger has achieved a great triumph.

verses.text: We offered the trust to the heavens and the earth and the mountains but they refused to carry it and were afraid of doing so; but man carried it. Surely he is wrong-doing ignorant.
verses.translation: We offered the trust to the heavens and the earth and the mountains but they refused to carry it and were afraid of doing so; but man carried it. Surely he is wrong-doing ignorant.

verses.text: (The consequence of man''s carrying the trust is) that Allah may chastise hypocritical men and hypocritical women and accept the repentance of believing men and believing women. He is Most Forgiving Most Merciful.
verses.translation: (The consequence of man''s carrying the trust is) that Allah may chastise hypocritical men and hypocritical women and accept the repentance of believing men and believing women. He is Most Forgiving Most Merciful.

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: O Prophet fear Allah and do not obey the unbelievers and the hypocrites. Verily Allah is All-Knowing Most Wise.
ayahs.translation: O Prophet fear Allah and do not obey the unbelievers and the hypocrites. Verily Allah is All-Knowing Most Wise.

ayahs.text: Follow that which is revealed to you from your Lord. Verily Allah is fully aware of all that you do.
ayahs.translation: Follow that which is revealed to you from your Lord. Verily Allah is fully aware of all that you do.

ayahs.text: Put your trust in Allah: Allah is sufficient as Guardian.
ayahs.translation: Put your trust in Allah: Allah is sufficient as Guardian.

ayahs.text: Allah has never put two hearts within one person''s body; nor has He made your wives whom you compare to your mothers'' backs (to divorce them) your true mothers; nor has He made those whom you adopt as sons your own sons. These are only words that you utter with your mouths. But Allah proclaims the Truth and directs you to the Right Path.
ayahs.translation: Allah has never put two hearts within one person''s body; nor has He made your wives whom you compare to your mothers'' backs (to divorce them) your true mothers; nor has He made those whom you adopt as sons your own sons. These are only words that you utter with your mouths. But Allah proclaims the Truth and directs you to the Right Path.

ayahs.text: Call your adopted sons after their true fathers; that is more equitable in the sight of Allah. But if you do not know their true fathers then regard them as your brethren in faith and as allies. You will not be taken to task for your mistaken utterances but you will be taken to task for what you say deliberately. Allah is Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.
ayahs.translation: Call your adopted sons after their true fathers; that is more equitable in the sight of Allah. But if you do not know their true fathers then regard them as your brethren in faith and as allies. You will not be taken to task for your mistaken utterances but you will be taken to task for what you say deliberately. Allah is Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.

ayahs.text: Surely the Prophet has a greater claim over the believers than they have over each other and his wives are their mothers. According to the Book of Allah blood relatives have greater claim over each other than the rest of the believers and the Emigrants (in the cause of Allah) except that you may do some good to your allies (if you so wish). This is inscribed in the Book of Allah.
ayahs.translation: Surely the Prophet has a greater claim over the believers than they have over each other and his wives are their mothers. According to the Book of Allah blood relatives have greater claim over each other than the rest of the believers and the Emigrants (in the cause of Allah) except that you may do some good to your allies (if you so wish). This is inscribed in the Book of Allah.

ayahs.text: And call to mind (O Prophet) when We took the covenant from all Prophets; and also from you and Noah and Abraham Moses and Jesus the son of Mary. We took from them a solemn covenant
ayahs.translation: And call to mind (O Prophet) when We took the covenant from all Prophets; and also from you and Noah and Abraham Moses and Jesus the son of Mary. We took from them a solemn covenant

ayahs.text: so that (their Lord) may question the truthful about their truthfulness. As for the unbelievers He has kept a painful chastisement in store for them.
ayahs.translation: so that (their Lord) may question the truthful about their truthfulness. As for the unbelievers He has kept a painful chastisement in store for them.

ayahs.text: Believers call to mind Allah''s favour to you when enemy hosts invaded you. Then We sent against them a wind and hosts that you did not see although Allah was observing all that you were then doing.
ayahs.translation: Believers call to mind Allah''s favour to you when enemy hosts invaded you. Then We sent against them a wind and hosts that you did not see although Allah was observing all that you were then doing.

ayahs.text: When they came upon you from above you and from below you when your eyes were stupefied with horror and your hearts leapt to your throats and you began to entertain diverse thoughts about Allah.
ayahs.translation: When they came upon you from above you and from below you when your eyes were stupefied with horror and your hearts leapt to your throats and you began to entertain diverse thoughts about Allah.

ayahs.text: The believers were then put to a severe test and were most violently convulsed.
ayahs.translation: The believers were then put to a severe test and were most violently convulsed.

ayahs.text: And call to mind when the hypocrites and all those with diseased hearts said:  All that Allah and His Messenger had promised us was nothing but deceit.
ayahs.translation: And call to mind when the hypocrites and all those with diseased hearts said:  All that Allah and His Messenger had promised us was nothing but deceit.

ayahs.text: And when a section of them said:  (O people of Yathrib) now there is no place for you to stay so turn back. (And call to mind) when a section of them was seeking permission from the Prophet to leave saying:  Our houses are exposed (to attack) although they were not exposed (to attack); they only wished to flee (from the battle-front).
ayahs.translation: And when a section of them said:  (O people of Yathrib) now there is no place for you to stay so turn back. (And call to mind) when a section of them was seeking permission from the Prophet to leave saying:  Our houses are exposed (to attack) although they were not exposed (to attack); they only wished to flee (from the battle-front).

ayahs.text: If the enemy were to enter the town from various directions and they were summoned to act treacherously they would have succumbed to it and would have shown little reluctance in doing so.
ayahs.translation: If the enemy were to enter the town from various directions and they were summoned to act treacherously they would have succumbed to it and would have shown little reluctance in doing so.

ayahs.text: They had earlier covenanted with Allah that they would not turn their backs in flight. And a covenant made with Allah must needs be answered for.
ayahs.translation: They had earlier covenanted with Allah that they would not turn their backs in flight. And a covenant made with Allah must needs be answered for.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) tell them:  If you run away from death or slaying this flight will not avail you. You will have little time after that to enjoy (the pleasures of life).
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) tell them:  If you run away from death or slaying this flight will not avail you. You will have little time after that to enjoy (the pleasures of life).

ayahs.text: Say (to them):  Who can protect you from Allah if He desires an evil for you? And who can prevent Him if He desires to show mercy to you?  They shall find none other than Allah to be their protector or helper.
ayahs.translation: Say (to them):  Who can protect you from Allah if He desires an evil for you? And who can prevent Him if He desires to show mercy to you?  They shall find none other than Allah to be their protector or helper.

ayahs.text: Allah knows well those of you who create obstructions (in war efforts) and say to their brethren:  Come and join us. They hardly take any part in battle.
ayahs.translation: Allah knows well those of you who create obstructions (in war efforts) and say to their brethren:  Come and join us. They hardly take any part in battle.

ayahs.text: They are utterly niggardly (in coming to your aid). Whenever there is danger you will see them looking at you their eyes rolling as though they were on the verge of fainting at the approach of death. But when the danger passes away their greed for wealth prompts them to greet you with their sharp scissor-like tongues. These are the ones who never truly believed and so Allah has caused their deeds to be reduced to naught. That is easy enough for Allah.
ayahs.translation: They are utterly niggardly (in coming to your aid). Whenever there is danger you will see them looking at you their eyes rolling as though they were on the verge of fainting at the approach of death. But when the danger passes away their greed for wealth prompts them to greet you with their sharp scissor-like tongues. These are the ones who never truly believed and so Allah has caused their deeds to be reduced to naught. That is easy enough for Allah.

ayahs.text: They think that the invading confederates have not yet gone. But if the confederates were to mount another assault they would wish to be in the desert among the bedouins and keep themselves informed about you from there. But even if they remained in your midst hardly would they fight.
ayahs.translation: They think that the invading confederates have not yet gone. But if the confederates were to mount another assault they would wish to be in the desert among the bedouins and keep themselves informed about you from there. But even if they remained in your midst hardly would they fight.

ayahs.text: Surely there was a good example for you in the Messenger of Allah for all those who look forward to Allah and the Last Day and remember Allah much.
ayahs.translation: Surely there was a good example for you in the Messenger of Allah for all those who look forward to Allah and the Last Day and remember Allah much.

ayahs.text: As for the true believers when they saw the invading confederates they cried out:  This is what Allah and His Messenger had promised us and what Allah and His Messenger said was absolutely true. This only increased their faith and submission.
ayahs.translation: As for the true believers when they saw the invading confederates they cried out:  This is what Allah and His Messenger had promised us and what Allah and His Messenger said was absolutely true. This only increased their faith and submission.

ayahs.text: Among the believers there are those who have remained true to the covenant they made with Allah. Among those some of them have fulfilled their vow and others await the appointed time. They have not changed in the least.
ayahs.translation: Among the believers there are those who have remained true to the covenant they made with Allah. Among those some of them have fulfilled their vow and others await the appointed time. They have not changed in the least.

ayahs.text: (All this is) in order that Allah may reward the truthful for their truthfulness and either punish the hypocrites or if He so wills accept their repentance. Verily Allah is Most Pardoning Most Compassionate.
ayahs.translation: (All this is) in order that Allah may reward the truthful for their truthfulness and either punish the hypocrites or if He so wills accept their repentance. Verily Allah is Most Pardoning Most Compassionate.

ayahs.text: Allah sent back the unbelievers empty-handed their hearts seething with rage. Allah sufficed the believers in their fight. Allah is Most Powerful Most Mighty.
ayahs.translation: Allah sent back the unbelievers empty-handed their hearts seething with rage. Allah sufficed the believers in their fight. Allah is Most Powerful Most Mighty.

ayahs.text: Allah brought down from their fortresses those People of the Book who had supported the invading confederates and cast such terror into their hearts that some of them you kill and some of them you take captive.
ayahs.translation: Allah brought down from their fortresses those People of the Book who had supported the invading confederates and cast such terror into their hearts that some of them you kill and some of them you take captive.

ayahs.text: Allah made you inherit their land their dwellings and their goods and a piece of land on which you had not yet trodden. Verily Allah has power over all things.
ayahs.translation: Allah made you inherit their land their dwellings and their goods and a piece of land on which you had not yet trodden. Verily Allah has power over all things.

ayahs.text: O Prophet tell your wives:  If you seek the world and its embellishments then come and I will make some provision for you and release you in an honourable way.
ayahs.translation: O Prophet tell your wives:  If you seek the world and its embellishments then come and I will make some provision for you and release you in an honourable way.

ayahs.text: But if you seek Allah and His Messenger and the Abode of the Hereafter then surely Allah has prepared a great reward for those of you who do good.
ayahs.translation: But if you seek Allah and His Messenger and the Abode of the Hereafter then surely Allah has prepared a great reward for those of you who do good.

ayahs.text: Wives of the Prophet if any of you commit flagrant indecency her chastisement shall be doubled. That is easy for Allah.
ayahs.translation: Wives of the Prophet if any of you commit flagrant indecency her chastisement shall be doubled. That is easy for Allah.

ayahs.text: But whoever of you is obedient to Allah and His Messenger and does good deeds Allah will double her reward. We have prepared for her a generous provision.
ayahs.translation: But whoever of you is obedient to Allah and His Messenger and does good deeds Allah will double her reward. We have prepared for her a generous provision.

ayahs.text: Wives of the Prophet you are not like other women. If you fear Allah do not be too complaisant in your speech lest those with diseased hearts should covet you; but speak in a straight forward manner.
ayahs.translation: Wives of the Prophet you are not like other women. If you fear Allah do not be too complaisant in your speech lest those with diseased hearts should covet you; but speak in a straight forward manner.

ayahs.text: And stay in your homes and do not go about displaying your allurements as in the former Time of Ignorance. Establish Prayer give Zakah and obey Allah and His Messenger. Allah only wishes to remove uncleanness from you O members of the (Prophet''s) household and to purify you completely.
ayahs.translation: And stay in your homes and do not go about displaying your allurements as in the former Time of Ignorance. Establish Prayer give Zakah and obey Allah and His Messenger. Allah only wishes to remove uncleanness from you O members of the (Prophet''s) household and to purify you completely.

ayahs.text: Remember the Signs of Allah and the words of wisdom which are rehearsed in your homes. Verily Allah is All-Subtle All-Aware.
ayahs.translation: Remember the Signs of Allah and the words of wisdom which are rehearsed in your homes. Verily Allah is All-Subtle All-Aware.

ayahs.text: Surely the men who submit (to Allah) and the women who submit (to Allah) the men who have faith and the women who have faith the men who are obedient and the women who are obedient the men who are truthful and the women who are truthful; the men who are steadfast and the women who are steadfast the men who humble themselves (to Allah) and the women who humble themselves (to Allah) the men who give alms and the women who give alms the men who fast and the women who fast the men who guard their chastity and the women who guard their chastity the men who remember Allah much and the women who remember Allah much: for them has Allah prepared forgiveness and a mighty reward.
ayahs.translation: Surely the men who submit (to Allah) and the women who submit (to Allah) the men who have faith and the women who have faith the men who are obedient and the women who are obedient the men who are truthful and the women who are truthful; the men who are steadfast and the women who are steadfast the men who humble themselves (to Allah) and the women who humble themselves (to Allah) the men who give alms and the women who give alms the men who fast and the women who fast the men who guard their chastity and the women who guard their chastity the men who remember Allah much and the women who remember Allah much: for them has Allah prepared forgiveness and a mighty reward.

ayahs.text: It does not behove a believer male or female that when Allah and His Messenger have decided an affair they should exercise their choice. And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger has strayed to manifest error.
ayahs.translation: It does not behove a believer male or female that when Allah and His Messenger have decided an affair they should exercise their choice. And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger has strayed to manifest error.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) call to mind when you said to him whom Allah had favoured and you had favoured:  Cleave to your wife and fear Allah and you concealed within yourself for fear of people what Allah was to reveal although Allah has greater right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had accomplished what he would of her We gave her in marriage to you so that there should not be any constraint for the believers regarding the wives of their adopted sons after they had accomplished whatever they would of them. And Allah''s command was bound to be accomplished.
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) call to mind when you said to him whom Allah had favoured and you had favoured:  Cleave to your wife and fear Allah and you concealed within yourself for fear of people what Allah was to reveal although Allah has greater right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had accomplished what he would of her We gave her in marriage to you so that there should not be any constraint for the believers regarding the wives of their adopted sons after they had accomplished whatever they would of them. And Allah''s command was bound to be accomplished.

ayahs.text: There could be no hindrance to the Prophet regarding what Allah ordained for him. Such has been Allah''s Way (with the Prophets) who went before. Allah''s command is a decree firmly determined.
ayahs.translation: There could be no hindrance to the Prophet regarding what Allah ordained for him. Such has been Allah''s Way (with the Prophets) who went before. Allah''s command is a decree firmly determined.

ayahs.text: (This is Allah''s Way) regarding those who deliver the Messages of Allah and who fear Him and fear no one else than Allah. Allah is Sufficient as a Reckoner.
ayahs.translation: (This is Allah''s Way) regarding those who deliver the Messages of Allah and who fear Him and fear no one else than Allah. Allah is Sufficient as a Reckoner.

ayahs.text: Muhammad is not the father of any of your men but he is the Messenger of Allah and the seal of the Prophets. Allah has full knowledge of everything.
ayahs.translation: Muhammad is not the father of any of your men but he is the Messenger of Allah and the seal of the Prophets. Allah has full knowledge of everything.

ayahs.text: Believers remember Allah much
ayahs.translation: Believers remember Allah much

ayahs.text: and glorify Him morning and evening.
ayahs.translation: and glorify Him morning and evening.

ayahs.text: It is He Who lavishes His blessings on you and His angels invoke blessings on you that He may lead you out of darkness into light. He is Most Compassionate to the believers.
ayahs.translation: It is He Who lavishes His blessings on you and His angels invoke blessings on you that He may lead you out of darkness into light. He is Most Compassionate to the believers.

ayahs.text: On the Day they meet Him they will be greeted with:  Peace. He has prepared for them a generous reward.
ayahs.translation: On the Day they meet Him they will be greeted with:  Peace. He has prepared for them a generous reward.

ayahs.text: O Prophet We have sent you forth as a witness a bearer of good tidings and a warner
ayahs.translation: O Prophet We have sent you forth as a witness a bearer of good tidings and a warner

ayahs.text: as one who calls people to Allah by His leave and as a bright shining lamp.
ayahs.translation: as one who calls people to Allah by His leave and as a bright shining lamp.

ayahs.text: Announce to the believers the good tidings that Allah has kept bounteous blessings in store for them.
ayahs.translation: Announce to the believers the good tidings that Allah has kept bounteous blessings in store for them.

ayahs.text: Do not yield to the unbelievers and the hypocrites and disregard the hurt that comes from them and put your trust in Allah. Allah suffices as the Guardian to entrust one''s affairs to.
ayahs.translation: Do not yield to the unbelievers and the hypocrites and disregard the hurt that comes from them and put your trust in Allah. Allah suffices as the Guardian to entrust one''s affairs to.

ayahs.text: Believers when you marry believing women and then divorce them before you have touched them you may not require them to observe a waiting period that you might reckon against them. So make provision for them and release them in an honourable manner.
ayahs.translation: Believers when you marry believing women and then divorce them before you have touched them you may not require them to observe a waiting period that you might reckon against them. So make provision for them and release them in an honourable manner.

ayahs.text: O Prophet We have made lawful for you your wives whose bridal dues you have paid and the slave-girls you possess from among the prisoners of war granted to you by Allah and the daughters of your paternal uncles and paternal aunts and the daughters of your maternal uncles and maternal aunts who have migrated with you and a believing woman who gives herself to the Prophet and whom he wants to take in marriage. (O Prophet) this privilege is yours alone to the exclusion of other believers. We know well what restrictions We have imposed upon them as regards their wives and those whom their right hands possess (and have exempted you from those restrictions) that there may be no constraint upon you. Allah is Most Forgiving Most Merciful.
ayahs.translation: O Prophet We have made lawful for you your wives whose bridal dues you have paid and the slave-girls you possess from among the prisoners of war granted to you by Allah and the daughters of your paternal uncles and paternal aunts and the daughters of your maternal uncles and maternal aunts who have migrated with you and a believing woman who gives herself to the Prophet and whom he wants to take in marriage. (O Prophet) this privilege is yours alone to the exclusion of other believers. We know well what restrictions We have imposed upon them as regards their wives and those whom their right hands possess (and have exempted you from those restrictions) that there may be no constraint upon you. Allah is Most Forgiving Most Merciful.

ayahs.text: Of them you may put off any of them you wish and you may take any of them whom you wish and you may call back any of those whom you had (temporarily) set aside: there will be no blame on you (on this account). It is likelier that they will thus be comforted and will not grieve and every one of them will be well-pleased with what you give them. Allah knows what is in your hearts. Allah is All-Knowing All-Forbearing.
ayahs.translation: Of them you may put off any of them you wish and you may take any of them whom you wish and you may call back any of those whom you had (temporarily) set aside: there will be no blame on you (on this account). It is likelier that they will thus be comforted and will not grieve and every one of them will be well-pleased with what you give them. Allah knows what is in your hearts. Allah is All-Knowing All-Forbearing.

ayahs.text: Thereafter women will not be lawful for you and it will not be lawful for you to take other wives in place of them even though their beauty might please you unless they be those whom your right hand owns. Allah is watchful over everything.
ayahs.translation: Thereafter women will not be lawful for you and it will not be lawful for you to take other wives in place of them even though their beauty might please you unless they be those whom your right hand owns. Allah is watchful over everything.

ayahs.text: Believers enter not the houses of the Prophet without his permission nor wait for a meal to be prepared; instead enter when you are invited to eat and when you have had the meal disperse. Do not linger in idle talk. That is hurtful to the Prophet but he does not express it out of shyness; but Allah is not ashamed of speaking out the Truth. And if you were to ask the wives of the Prophet for something ask from behind a curtain. That is more apt for the cleanness of your hearts and theirs. It is not lawful for you to cause hurt to Allah''s Messenger nor to ever marry his wives after him. Surely that would be an enormous sin in Allah''s sight.
ayahs.translation: Believers enter not the houses of the Prophet without his permission nor wait for a meal to be prepared; instead enter when you are invited to eat and when you have had the meal disperse. Do not linger in idle talk. That is hurtful to the Prophet but he does not express it out of shyness; but Allah is not ashamed of speaking out the Truth. And if you were to ask the wives of the Prophet for something ask from behind a curtain. That is more apt for the cleanness of your hearts and theirs. It is not lawful for you to cause hurt to Allah''s Messenger nor to ever marry his wives after him. Surely that would be an enormous sin in Allah''s sight.

ayahs.text: (It does not matter) whether you disclose something or conceal it for Allah certainly knows everything.
ayahs.translation: (It does not matter) whether you disclose something or conceal it for Allah certainly knows everything.

ayahs.text: It will not be blameworthy for the wives of the Prophet if their fathers their sons their brothers their brothers'' sons their sisters'' sons and the women with whom they have social relations and the persons whom their right hands possess enter their houses. (O women) shun disobeying Allah. Allah is watchful over everything.
ayahs.translation: It will not be blameworthy for the wives of the Prophet if their fathers their sons their brothers their brothers'' sons their sisters'' sons and the women with whom they have social relations and the persons whom their right hands possess enter their houses. (O women) shun disobeying Allah. Allah is watchful over everything.

ayahs.text: Allah and His angels bless the Prophet. Believers invoke blessings and peace on him.
ayahs.translation: Allah and His angels bless the Prophet. Believers invoke blessings and peace on him.

ayahs.text: Verily those who cause annoyance to Allah and His Messenger - Allah has cursed them in this world and in the Hereafter and has prepared for them a humiliating chastisement.
ayahs.translation: Verily those who cause annoyance to Allah and His Messenger - Allah has cursed them in this world and in the Hereafter and has prepared for them a humiliating chastisement.

ayahs.text: Those who cause hurt to believing men and to believing women have invited upon themselves a calumny and a manifest sin.
ayahs.translation: Those who cause hurt to believing men and to believing women have invited upon themselves a calumny and a manifest sin.

ayahs.text: O Prophet enjoin your wives and your daughters and the believing women to draw a part of their outer coverings around them. It is likelier that they will be recognised and not molested. Allah is Most Forgiving Most Merciful.
ayahs.translation: O Prophet enjoin your wives and your daughters and the believing women to draw a part of their outer coverings around them. It is likelier that they will be recognised and not molested. Allah is Most Forgiving Most Merciful.

ayahs.text: If the hypocrites and those in whose hearts there is a sickness and the scandal mongers in Madinah do not desist from their vile acts We shall urge you to take action against them and then they will hardly be able to stay in the city with you.
ayahs.translation: If the hypocrites and those in whose hearts there is a sickness and the scandal mongers in Madinah do not desist from their vile acts We shall urge you to take action against them and then they will hardly be able to stay in the city with you.

ayahs.text: They shall be cursed from all around and they shall be ruthlessly killed wherever they are seized.
ayahs.translation: They shall be cursed from all around and they shall be ruthlessly killed wherever they are seized.

ayahs.text: This has been Allah''s Way with those who have gone before and you shall find no change in Allah''s Way.
ayahs.translation: This has been Allah''s Way with those who have gone before and you shall find no change in Allah''s Way.

ayahs.text: People ask you concerning the Hour (of Resurrection). Say:  Allah alone has knowledge of it. What do you know? Perhaps the Hour is nigh.
ayahs.translation: People ask you concerning the Hour (of Resurrection). Say:  Allah alone has knowledge of it. What do you know? Perhaps the Hour is nigh.

ayahs.text: Allah has cursed the unbelievers and has prepared for them a Blazing Fire;
ayahs.translation: Allah has cursed the unbelievers and has prepared for them a Blazing Fire;

ayahs.text: therein they shall abide for ever. They shall find none to protect or help them.
ayahs.translation: therein they shall abide for ever. They shall find none to protect or help them.

ayahs.text: On that Day when their faces shall be turned around in the Fire they will say:  Would that we had obeyed Allah and obeyed the Messenger.
ayahs.translation: On that Day when their faces shall be turned around in the Fire they will say:  Would that we had obeyed Allah and obeyed the Messenger.

ayahs.text: They will say:  Our Lord we obeyed our chiefs and our great ones and they turned us away from the Right Way.
ayahs.translation: They will say:  Our Lord we obeyed our chiefs and our great ones and they turned us away from the Right Way.

ayahs.text: Our Lord mete out to them a double chastisement and lay upon them a mighty curse.
ayahs.translation: Our Lord mete out to them a double chastisement and lay upon them a mighty curse.

ayahs.text: Believers do not be like those who distressed Moses and then Allah declared him quit of the ill they spoke about him; and he had a high standing with Allah.
ayahs.translation: Believers do not be like those who distressed Moses and then Allah declared him quit of the ill they spoke about him; and he had a high standing with Allah.

ayahs.text: Believers fear Allah and speak the truth:
ayahs.translation: Believers fear Allah and speak the truth:

ayahs.text: Allah will set your deeds right for you and will forgive you your sins. Whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger has achieved a great triumph.
ayahs.translation: Allah will set your deeds right for you and will forgive you your sins. Whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger has achieved a great triumph.

ayahs.text: We offered the trust to the heavens and the earth and the mountains but they refused to carry it and were afraid of doing so; but man carried it. Surely he is wrong-doing ignorant.
ayahs.translation: We offered the trust to the heavens and the earth and the mountains but they refused to carry it and were afraid of doing so; but man carried it. Surely he is wrong-doing ignorant.

ayahs.text: (The consequence of man''s carrying the trust is) that Allah may chastise hypocritical men and hypocritical women and accept the repentance of believing men and believing women. He is Most Forgiving Most Merciful.
ayahs.translation: (The consequence of man''s carrying the trust is) that Allah may chastise hypocritical men and hypocritical women and accept the repentance of believing men and believing women. He is Most Forgiving Most Merciful.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: All praise be to Allah to Whom belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth and all praise be to Him in the World to Come. He is Most Wise All-Aware.
verses.translation: All praise be to Allah to Whom belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth and all praise be to Him in the World to Come. He is Most Wise All-Aware.

verses.text: He knows what penetrates into the earth and what goes forth from it what descends from the heaven and what ascends to it. He is the Most Merciful the Most Forgiving.
verses.translation: He knows what penetrates into the earth and what goes forth from it what descends from the heaven and what ascends to it. He is the Most Merciful the Most Forgiving.

verses.text: The unbelievers say:  How come the Hour is not coming upon us! Say to them:  Yes indeed by my Lord by Him Who fully knows the realm beyond the ken of perception that the Hour shall inevitably come upon you.Nothing escapes Him not even the smallest particle in the heavens or the earth; nor is anything smaller or bigger than that but is in a Manifest Book.
verses.translation: The unbelievers say:  How come the Hour is not coming upon us! Say to them:  Yes indeed by my Lord by Him Who fully knows the realm beyond the ken of perception that the Hour shall inevitably come upon you.Nothing escapes Him not even the smallest particle in the heavens or the earth; nor is anything smaller or bigger than that but is in a Manifest Book.

verses.text: (The Hour shall come) that He may reward those who believe and do righteous deeds. Theirs shall be forgiveness and a generous provision.
verses.translation: (The Hour shall come) that He may reward those who believe and do righteous deeds. Theirs shall be forgiveness and a generous provision.

verses.text: As for those who worked against Our Signs in order to frustrate them they shall suffer a painful chastisement.
verses.translation: As for those who worked against Our Signs in order to frustrate them they shall suffer a painful chastisement.

verses.text: (O Prophet) those who have knowledge see clearly that what has been revealed to you from your Lord is the Truth and directs to the Way of the Most Mighty the Immensely Praiseworthy Lord.
verses.translation: (O Prophet) those who have knowledge see clearly that what has been revealed to you from your Lord is the Truth and directs to the Way of the Most Mighty the Immensely Praiseworthy Lord.

verses.text: The unbelievers say:  Shall we direct you to the man who tells you that when you have been utterly broken to pieces you will be raised to life again?
verses.translation: The unbelievers say:  Shall we direct you to the man who tells you that when you have been utterly broken to pieces you will be raised to life again?

verses.text: Has he forged a lie against Allah or is he afflicted with madness? Nay but those who do not believe in the Hereafter are doomed to be chastised and are far gone in error.
verses.translation: Has he forged a lie against Allah or is he afflicted with madness? Nay but those who do not believe in the Hereafter are doomed to be chastised and are far gone in error.

verses.text: Do they not see how the heavens and the earth encompass them from the front and the rear? We could if We so wished cause the earth to swallow them or let fragments of the sky fall upon them. Verily there is a Sign in this for every servant (of Allah) who penitently turns to Him.
verses.translation: Do they not see how the heavens and the earth encompass them from the front and the rear? We could if We so wished cause the earth to swallow them or let fragments of the sky fall upon them. Verily there is a Sign in this for every servant (of Allah) who penitently turns to Him.

verses.text: We bestowed Our favour upon David. (We commanded):  O mountains sing Allah''s praises with him ; (and so did We command) the birds. We softened the iron for him (saying):
verses.translation: We bestowed Our favour upon David. (We commanded):  O mountains sing Allah''s praises with him ; (and so did We command) the birds. We softened the iron for him (saying):

verses.text: Fashion coats of mail and measure their links with care and act righteously. I am watching over whatever you do.
verses.translation: Fashion coats of mail and measure their links with care and act righteously. I am watching over whatever you do.

verses.text: And We subdued the wind to Solomon: its morning course was a month''s journey and its evening course was a month''s journey. We gave him a spring flowing with molten brass and We subdued for him jinn who by his Lord''s permission worked before him. Such of them as swerved from Our commandment We let them taste the chastisement of the Blazing Fire.
verses.translation: And We subdued the wind to Solomon: its morning course was a month''s journey and its evening course was a month''s journey. We gave him a spring flowing with molten brass and We subdued for him jinn who by his Lord''s permission worked before him. Such of them as swerved from Our commandment We let them taste the chastisement of the Blazing Fire.

verses.text: They made for him whatever he would desire: stately buildings images basins like water-troughs and huge built-in-cauldrons: Work O house of David in thankfulness (to your Lord). Few of My servants are truly thankful.
verses.translation: They made for him whatever he would desire: stately buildings images basins like water-troughs and huge built-in-cauldrons: Work O house of David in thankfulness (to your Lord). Few of My servants are truly thankful.

verses.text: When We executed Our decree of death on Solomon nothing indicated to the jinn that he was dead except a worm eating away his staff. So when Solomon fell down the jinn realised that had they known what lies in the realm beyond perception they would not have continued to be in this humiliating chastisement.
verses.translation: When We executed Our decree of death on Solomon nothing indicated to the jinn that he was dead except a worm eating away his staff. So when Solomon fell down the jinn realised that had they known what lies in the realm beyond perception they would not have continued to be in this humiliating chastisement.

verses.text: For Sheba there was also a Sign in their dwelling-place: the two gardens to the right and to the left.  Eat of your Lord''s provision and render thanks to Him. Most pleasant is your land and Most Forgiving is your Lord.
verses.translation: For Sheba there was also a Sign in their dwelling-place: the two gardens to the right and to the left.  Eat of your Lord''s provision and render thanks to Him. Most pleasant is your land and Most Forgiving is your Lord.

verses.text: But they turned away and so We let loose upon them a devastating flood that swept away the dams and replaced their gardens by two others bearing bitter fruits tamarisks and a few lote trees.
verses.translation: But they turned away and so We let loose upon them a devastating flood that swept away the dams and replaced their gardens by two others bearing bitter fruits tamarisks and a few lote trees.

verses.text: Thus did We retribute them for their ingratitude. And none do We retribute in this manner except the utterly ungrateful.
verses.translation: Thus did We retribute them for their ingratitude. And none do We retribute in this manner except the utterly ungrateful.

verses.text: We placed other prominent towns between them the towns that We had blessed and had set well-measured stages between them.Move back and forth between them night and day in perfect security.
verses.translation: We placed other prominent towns between them the towns that We had blessed and had set well-measured stages between them.Move back and forth between them night and day in perfect security.

verses.text: But they said:  Lord make the stages of our journeys longer. They wronged their own selves so We reduced them to bygone tales and utterly tore them to pieces. Verily there are Signs in this for everyone who is steadfast and thankful.
verses.translation: But they said:  Lord make the stages of our journeys longer. They wronged their own selves so We reduced them to bygone tales and utterly tore them to pieces. Verily there are Signs in this for everyone who is steadfast and thankful.

verses.text: Iblis found his estimate of them to be true and they followed him except a party of the believers.
verses.translation: Iblis found his estimate of them to be true and they followed him except a party of the believers.

verses.text: Iblis had no authority over them and whatever happened was in order that We might know him who believes in the Hereafter as distinct from him who is in doubt about it. Your Lord is watchful over everything.
verses.translation: Iblis had no authority over them and whatever happened was in order that We might know him who believes in the Hereafter as distinct from him who is in doubt about it. Your Lord is watchful over everything.

verses.text: (O Prophet) say to those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity:  Call upon those whom you fancied to be deities beside Allah. They own not even the smallest particle neither in the heavens nor on the earth; nor do they have any share in the ownership of either of them. Nor is any of them even a helper of Allah.
verses.translation: (O Prophet) say to those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity:  Call upon those whom you fancied to be deities beside Allah. They own not even the smallest particle neither in the heavens nor on the earth; nor do they have any share in the ownership of either of them. Nor is any of them even a helper of Allah.

verses.text: No intercession can avail with Allah except for him whom Allah permits (to intercede). When their hearts are relieved of fright they will ask the intercessors:  What did your Lord say?  They will reply:  (He said) what is right and He is the High the Great.
verses.translation: No intercession can avail with Allah except for him whom Allah permits (to intercede). When their hearts are relieved of fright they will ask the intercessors:  What did your Lord say?  They will reply:  (He said) what is right and He is the High the Great.

verses.text: Ask them (O Prophet):  Who provides you sustenance from the heavens and the earth?  Say:  Allah. Now inevitably only one of us is rightly guided either we or you; and the other is in manifest error.
verses.translation: Ask them (O Prophet):  Who provides you sustenance from the heavens and the earth?  Say:  Allah. Now inevitably only one of us is rightly guided either we or you; and the other is in manifest error.

verses.text: Tell them:  You will not be called to account about the guilt we committed nor will we be called to account for what you did.
verses.translation: Tell them:  You will not be called to account about the guilt we committed nor will we be called to account for what you did.

verses.text: Say:  Our Lord will bring us together and then He will rightly judge between us. He is the Great Judge the All-Knowing.
verses.translation: Say:  Our Lord will bring us together and then He will rightly judge between us. He is the Great Judge the All-Knowing.

verses.text: Say:  Show me those whom you have attached to Him as His associates (in Divinity). Nay Allah alone is Most Mighty Most Wise.
verses.translation: Say:  Show me those whom you have attached to Him as His associates (in Divinity). Nay Allah alone is Most Mighty Most Wise.

verses.text: (O Prophet) We have not sent you forth but as a herald of good news and a warner for all mankind. But most people do not know.
verses.translation: (O Prophet) We have not sent you forth but as a herald of good news and a warner for all mankind. But most people do not know.

verses.text: They ask you:  When will this promise (of Resurrection) be fulfilled if what you say is true?
verses.translation: They ask you:  When will this promise (of Resurrection) be fulfilled if what you say is true?

verses.text: Say:  Your day is appointed you can neither hold back its coming by an hour nor hasten it by an hour.
verses.translation: Say:  Your day is appointed you can neither hold back its coming by an hour nor hasten it by an hour.

verses.text: The unbelievers say:  We shall never believe in this Qur''an nor in any Scripture before it. If you could only see the wrong-doers arrayed before their Lord each bandying charges against the other. Those who were suppressed will say to those who waxed arrogant:  Had it not been for you we would have been believers.
verses.translation: The unbelievers say:  We shall never believe in this Qur''an nor in any Scripture before it. If you could only see the wrong-doers arrayed before their Lord each bandying charges against the other. Those who were suppressed will say to those who waxed arrogant:  Had it not been for you we would have been believers.

verses.text: The arrogant ones will retort to those who were suppressed:  What! Did we bar you from the guidance after it came to you? Not at all; rather you yourselves were evil-doers.
verses.translation: The arrogant ones will retort to those who were suppressed:  What! Did we bar you from the guidance after it came to you? Not at all; rather you yourselves were evil-doers.

verses.text: Those who were suppressed will say to those who waxed arrogant:  By no means; it was your scheming night and day when you would enjoin us to disbelieve in Allah and set up others as equals to Him. When they are confronted with the chastisement they will be remorseful in their hearts. We shall put fetters around the necks of the unbelievers. Can people be requited except for their deeds?
verses.translation: Those who were suppressed will say to those who waxed arrogant:  By no means; it was your scheming night and day when you would enjoin us to disbelieve in Allah and set up others as equals to Him. When they are confronted with the chastisement they will be remorseful in their hearts. We shall put fetters around the necks of the unbelievers. Can people be requited except for their deeds?

verses.text: We never sent a warner to any town but its wealthy ones said:  We disbelieve in the Message you have brought.
verses.translation: We never sent a warner to any town but its wealthy ones said:  We disbelieve in the Message you have brought.

verses.text: They always said:  We have more wealth and children than you have and we shall not be chastised.
verses.translation: They always said:  We have more wealth and children than you have and we shall not be chastised.

verses.text: (O Prophet) say to them:  My Lord grants provision abundantly to whomsoever He pleases and straitens it for whomsoever He pleases. But most people do not know this.
verses.translation: (O Prophet) say to them:  My Lord grants provision abundantly to whomsoever He pleases and straitens it for whomsoever He pleases. But most people do not know this.

verses.text: It is not your riches nor your children that make you near-stationed to Us except for him who has faith and acts righteously; it is they who will receive double the recompense for their deeds. They shall live in lofty mansions in perfect peace.
verses.translation: It is not your riches nor your children that make you near-stationed to Us except for him who has faith and acts righteously; it is they who will receive double the recompense for their deeds. They shall live in lofty mansions in perfect peace.

verses.text: As for those who work against Our Signs so as to frustrate them they shall be arraigned into the chastisement.
verses.translation: As for those who work against Our Signs so as to frustrate them they shall be arraigned into the chastisement.

verses.text: Say (O Prophet):  Verily my Lord grants provision abundantly to whomsoever He pleases and straitens it for whomsoever He pleases. Whatever you spend He will replace it. He is the Best of all Providers.
verses.translation: Say (O Prophet):  Verily my Lord grants provision abundantly to whomsoever He pleases and straitens it for whomsoever He pleases. Whatever you spend He will replace it. He is the Best of all Providers.

verses.text: And on the Day when He will muster them all and will ask the angels:  Are they the ones who worshipped you?
verses.translation: And on the Day when He will muster them all and will ask the angels:  Are they the ones who worshipped you?

verses.text: They will reply:  Glory to You! You are our Protector not they. Nay they rather used to worship the jinn. Most of them believe in them.
verses.translation: They will reply:  Glory to You! You are our Protector not they. Nay they rather used to worship the jinn. Most of them believe in them.

verses.text: Today none of you has the power to benefit or harm another; and We shall say to the evil-doers:  Taste now the chastisement of the Fire which you used to deny calling it a lie.
verses.translation: Today none of you has the power to benefit or harm another; and We shall say to the evil-doers:  Taste now the chastisement of the Fire which you used to deny calling it a lie.

verses.text: When Our Clear Signs are rehearsed to them they say:  This is a person who wants to turn you away from the deities whom your ancestors worshipped.  They say:  This is nothing but an invented falsehood.  And when the Truth came to the unbelievers they declared:  This is nothing but plain sorcery
verses.translation: When Our Clear Signs are rehearsed to them they say:  This is a person who wants to turn you away from the deities whom your ancestors worshipped.  They say:  This is nothing but an invented falsehood.  And when the Truth came to the unbelievers they declared:  This is nothing but plain sorcery

verses.text: whereas We gave them no Books that they could study nor sent to them any warner before you.
verses.translation: whereas We gave them no Books that they could study nor sent to them any warner before you.

verses.text: Those who went before them also denounced (Allah''s Messengers) as liars. They have not attained even a tenth of what We had given them. But when they rejected My Messengers calling them liars how terrible was My chastisement!
verses.translation: Those who went before them also denounced (Allah''s Messengers) as liars. They have not attained even a tenth of what We had given them. But when they rejected My Messengers calling them liars how terrible was My chastisement!

verses.text: Say to them (O Prophet):  I give you but one counsel: stand up (for heaven''s sake) singly and in pairs and then think: what is it in your companion(to wit Muhammad) that could be deemed as madness? He is nothing but a warner warning you before the coming of a grevious chastisement.
verses.translation: Say to them (O Prophet):  I give you but one counsel: stand up (for heaven''s sake) singly and in pairs and then think: what is it in your companion(to wit Muhammad) that could be deemed as madness? He is nothing but a warner warning you before the coming of a grevious chastisement.

verses.text: Say to them:  Whatever recompense I might ask of you it shall be yours. My recompense is with Allah and He is witness over everything.
verses.translation: Say to them:  Whatever recompense I might ask of you it shall be yours. My recompense is with Allah and He is witness over everything.

verses.text: Say to them:  My Lord hurls down the Truth (upon me). He knows fully all that lies beyond the range of perception.
verses.translation: Say to them:  My Lord hurls down the Truth (upon me). He knows fully all that lies beyond the range of perception.

verses.text: Say:  The Truth has come and falsehood can neither originate nor recreate anything.
verses.translation: Say:  The Truth has come and falsehood can neither originate nor recreate anything.

verses.text: Say:  If I go astray then the hurt of straying will come only upon me. But if I am rightly-guided that is only because of the revelation that my Lord makes to me. He is All-Hearing Ever Nigh.
verses.translation: Say:  If I go astray then the hurt of straying will come only upon me. But if I am rightly-guided that is only because of the revelation that my Lord makes to me. He is All-Hearing Ever Nigh.

verses.text: If you could only see when the unbelievers will go about in a state of terror. They will have no escape and will be seized from a place near at hand.
verses.translation: If you could only see when the unbelievers will go about in a state of terror. They will have no escape and will be seized from a place near at hand.

verses.text: They will then say:  We believe in it ; but whence can they attain it from so far-off a place?
verses.translation: They will then say:  We believe in it ; but whence can they attain it from so far-off a place?

verses.text: They disbelieved in it before and indulged in conjectures from far away.
verses.translation: They disbelieved in it before and indulged in conjectures from far away.

verses.text: A barrier will be placed between them and what they desire as was done with the likes of them before. Surely they were in a disquieting doubt.
verses.translation: A barrier will be placed between them and what they desire as was done with the likes of them before. Surely they were in a disquieting doubt.

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: All praise be to Allah to Whom belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth and all praise be to Him in the World to Come. He is Most Wise All-Aware.
ayahs.translation: All praise be to Allah to Whom belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth and all praise be to Him in the World to Come. He is Most Wise All-Aware.

ayahs.text: He knows what penetrates into the earth and what goes forth from it what descends from the heaven and what ascends to it. He is the Most Merciful the Most Forgiving.
ayahs.translation: He knows what penetrates into the earth and what goes forth from it what descends from the heaven and what ascends to it. He is the Most Merciful the Most Forgiving.

ayahs.text: The unbelievers say:  How come the Hour is not coming upon us! Say to them:  Yes indeed by my Lord by Him Who fully knows the realm beyond the ken of perception that the Hour shall inevitably come upon you.Nothing escapes Him not even the smallest particle in the heavens or the earth; nor is anything smaller or bigger than that but is in a Manifest Book.
ayahs.translation: The unbelievers say:  How come the Hour is not coming upon us! Say to them:  Yes indeed by my Lord by Him Who fully knows the realm beyond the ken of perception that the Hour shall inevitably come upon you.Nothing escapes Him not even the smallest particle in the heavens or the earth; nor is anything smaller or bigger than that but is in a Manifest Book.

ayahs.text: (The Hour shall come) that He may reward those who believe and do righteous deeds. Theirs shall be forgiveness and a generous provision.
ayahs.translation: (The Hour shall come) that He may reward those who believe and do righteous deeds. Theirs shall be forgiveness and a generous provision.

ayahs.text: As for those who worked against Our Signs in order to frustrate them they shall suffer a painful chastisement.
ayahs.translation: As for those who worked against Our Signs in order to frustrate them they shall suffer a painful chastisement.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) those who have knowledge see clearly that what has been revealed to you from your Lord is the Truth and directs to the Way of the Most Mighty the Immensely Praiseworthy Lord.
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) those who have knowledge see clearly that what has been revealed to you from your Lord is the Truth and directs to the Way of the Most Mighty the Immensely Praiseworthy Lord.

ayahs.text: The unbelievers say:  Shall we direct you to the man who tells you that when you have been utterly broken to pieces you will be raised to life again?
ayahs.translation: The unbelievers say:  Shall we direct you to the man who tells you that when you have been utterly broken to pieces you will be raised to life again?

ayahs.text: Has he forged a lie against Allah or is he afflicted with madness? Nay but those who do not believe in the Hereafter are doomed to be chastised and are far gone in error.
ayahs.translation: Has he forged a lie against Allah or is he afflicted with madness? Nay but those who do not believe in the Hereafter are doomed to be chastised and are far gone in error.

ayahs.text: Do they not see how the heavens and the earth encompass them from the front and the rear? We could if We so wished cause the earth to swallow them or let fragments of the sky fall upon them. Verily there is a Sign in this for every servant (of Allah) who penitently turns to Him.
ayahs.translation: Do they not see how the heavens and the earth encompass them from the front and the rear? We could if We so wished cause the earth to swallow them or let fragments of the sky fall upon them. Verily there is a Sign in this for every servant (of Allah) who penitently turns to Him.

ayahs.text: We bestowed Our favour upon David. (We commanded):  O mountains sing Allah''s praises with him ; (and so did We command) the birds. We softened the iron for him (saying):
ayahs.translation: We bestowed Our favour upon David. (We commanded):  O mountains sing Allah''s praises with him ; (and so did We command) the birds. We softened the iron for him (saying):

ayahs.text: Fashion coats of mail and measure their links with care and act righteously. I am watching over whatever you do.
ayahs.translation: Fashion coats of mail and measure their links with care and act righteously. I am watching over whatever you do.

ayahs.text: And We subdued the wind to Solomon: its morning course was a month''s journey and its evening course was a month''s journey. We gave him a spring flowing with molten brass and We subdued for him jinn who by his Lord''s permission worked before him. Such of them as swerved from Our commandment We let them taste the chastisement of the Blazing Fire.
ayahs.translation: And We subdued the wind to Solomon: its morning course was a month''s journey and its evening course was a month''s journey. We gave him a spring flowing with molten brass and We subdued for him jinn who by his Lord''s permission worked before him. Such of them as swerved from Our commandment We let them taste the chastisement of the Blazing Fire.

ayahs.text: They made for him whatever he would desire: stately buildings images basins like water-troughs and huge built-in-cauldrons: Work O house of David in thankfulness (to your Lord). Few of My servants are truly thankful.
ayahs.translation: They made for him whatever he would desire: stately buildings images basins like water-troughs and huge built-in-cauldrons: Work O house of David in thankfulness (to your Lord). Few of My servants are truly thankful.

ayahs.text: When We executed Our decree of death on Solomon nothing indicated to the jinn that he was dead except a worm eating away his staff. So when Solomon fell down the jinn realised that had they known what lies in the realm beyond perception they would not have continued to be in this humiliating chastisement.
ayahs.translation: When We executed Our decree of death on Solomon nothing indicated to the jinn that he was dead except a worm eating away his staff. So when Solomon fell down the jinn realised that had they known what lies in the realm beyond perception they would not have continued to be in this humiliating chastisement.

ayahs.text: For Sheba there was also a Sign in their dwelling-place: the two gardens to the right and to the left.  Eat of your Lord''s provision and render thanks to Him. Most pleasant is your land and Most Forgiving is your Lord.
ayahs.translation: For Sheba there was also a Sign in their dwelling-place: the two gardens to the right and to the left.  Eat of your Lord''s provision and render thanks to Him. Most pleasant is your land and Most Forgiving is your Lord.

ayahs.text: But they turned away and so We let loose upon them a devastating flood that swept away the dams and replaced their gardens by two others bearing bitter fruits tamarisks and a few lote trees.
ayahs.translation: But they turned away and so We let loose upon them a devastating flood that swept away the dams and replaced their gardens by two others bearing bitter fruits tamarisks and a few lote trees.

ayahs.text: Thus did We retribute them for their ingratitude. And none do We retribute in this manner except the utterly ungrateful.
ayahs.translation: Thus did We retribute them for their ingratitude. And none do We retribute in this manner except the utterly ungrateful.

ayahs.text: We placed other prominent towns between them the towns that We had blessed and had set well-measured stages between them.Move back and forth between them night and day in perfect security.
ayahs.translation: We placed other prominent towns between them the towns that We had blessed and had set well-measured stages between them.Move back and forth between them night and day in perfect security.

ayahs.text: But they said:  Lord make the stages of our journeys longer. They wronged their own selves so We reduced them to bygone tales and utterly tore them to pieces. Verily there are Signs in this for everyone who is steadfast and thankful.
ayahs.translation: But they said:  Lord make the stages of our journeys longer. They wronged their own selves so We reduced them to bygone tales and utterly tore them to pieces. Verily there are Signs in this for everyone who is steadfast and thankful.

ayahs.text: Iblis found his estimate of them to be true and they followed him except a party of the believers.
ayahs.translation: Iblis found his estimate of them to be true and they followed him except a party of the believers.

ayahs.text: Iblis had no authority over them and whatever happened was in order that We might know him who believes in the Hereafter as distinct from him who is in doubt about it. Your Lord is watchful over everything.
ayahs.translation: Iblis had no authority over them and whatever happened was in order that We might know him who believes in the Hereafter as distinct from him who is in doubt about it. Your Lord is watchful over everything.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) say to those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity:  Call upon those whom you fancied to be deities beside Allah. They own not even the smallest particle neither in the heavens nor on the earth; nor do they have any share in the ownership of either of them. Nor is any of them even a helper of Allah.
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) say to those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity:  Call upon those whom you fancied to be deities beside Allah. They own not even the smallest particle neither in the heavens nor on the earth; nor do they have any share in the ownership of either of them. Nor is any of them even a helper of Allah.

ayahs.text: No intercession can avail with Allah except for him whom Allah permits (to intercede). When their hearts are relieved of fright they will ask the intercessors:  What did your Lord say?  They will reply:  (He said) what is right and He is the High the Great.
ayahs.translation: No intercession can avail with Allah except for him whom Allah permits (to intercede). When their hearts are relieved of fright they will ask the intercessors:  What did your Lord say?  They will reply:  (He said) what is right and He is the High the Great.

ayahs.text: Ask them (O Prophet):  Who provides you sustenance from the heavens and the earth?  Say:  Allah. Now inevitably only one of us is rightly guided either we or you; and the other is in manifest error.
ayahs.translation: Ask them (O Prophet):  Who provides you sustenance from the heavens and the earth?  Say:  Allah. Now inevitably only one of us is rightly guided either we or you; and the other is in manifest error.

ayahs.text: Tell them:  You will not be called to account about the guilt we committed nor will we be called to account for what you did.
ayahs.translation: Tell them:  You will not be called to account about the guilt we committed nor will we be called to account for what you did.

ayahs.text: Say:  Our Lord will bring us together and then He will rightly judge between us. He is the Great Judge the All-Knowing.
ayahs.translation: Say:  Our Lord will bring us together and then He will rightly judge between us. He is the Great Judge the All-Knowing.

ayahs.text: Say:  Show me those whom you have attached to Him as His associates (in Divinity). Nay Allah alone is Most Mighty Most Wise.
ayahs.translation: Say:  Show me those whom you have attached to Him as His associates (in Divinity). Nay Allah alone is Most Mighty Most Wise.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) We have not sent you forth but as a herald of good news and a warner for all mankind. But most people do not know.
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) We have not sent you forth but as a herald of good news and a warner for all mankind. But most people do not know.

ayahs.text: They ask you:  When will this promise (of Resurrection) be fulfilled if what you say is true?
ayahs.translation: They ask you:  When will this promise (of Resurrection) be fulfilled if what you say is true?

ayahs.text: Say:  Your day is appointed you can neither hold back its coming by an hour nor hasten it by an hour.
ayahs.translation: Say:  Your day is appointed you can neither hold back its coming by an hour nor hasten it by an hour.

ayahs.text: The unbelievers say:  We shall never believe in this Qur''an nor in any Scripture before it. If you could only see the wrong-doers arrayed before their Lord each bandying charges against the other. Those who were suppressed will say to those who waxed arrogant:  Had it not been for you we would have been believers.
ayahs.translation: The unbelievers say:  We shall never believe in this Qur''an nor in any Scripture before it. If you could only see the wrong-doers arrayed before their Lord each bandying charges against the other. Those who were suppressed will say to those who waxed arrogant:  Had it not been for you we would have been believers.
