verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: All praise be to Allah the Fashioner of the heavens and earth Who appointed angels as His message-bearers having two three four wings. He adds to His creation whatever He pleases. Verily Allah has power over everything.
verses.translation: All praise be to Allah the Fashioner of the heavens and earth Who appointed angels as His message-bearers having two three four wings. He adds to His creation whatever He pleases. Verily Allah has power over everything.

verses.text: Whatever Mercy Allah accords to people none can withhold; and whatever He withholds no other will be able to release after Him. He is Most Mighty Most Wise.
verses.translation: Whatever Mercy Allah accords to people none can withhold; and whatever He withholds no other will be able to release after Him. He is Most Mighty Most Wise.

verses.text: O people remember Allah''s favour upon you. Is there any creator apart from Allah who provides you your sustenance out of the heavens and earth? There is no god but He. Whither are you then being misdirected?
verses.translation: O people remember Allah''s favour upon you. Is there any creator apart from Allah who provides you your sustenance out of the heavens and earth? There is no god but He. Whither are you then being misdirected?

verses.text: (O Prophet) (there is nothing novel in it) if they cry lies to you;Messengers before you were also cried lies to. To Allah shall all matters be sent back.
verses.translation: (O Prophet) (there is nothing novel in it) if they cry lies to you;Messengers before you were also cried lies to. To Allah shall all matters be sent back.

verses.text: O people assuredly Allah''s promise is true. So let the life of the world not delude you and let not the Deluder delude you concerning Allah.
verses.translation: O people assuredly Allah''s promise is true. So let the life of the world not delude you and let not the Deluder delude you concerning Allah.

verses.text: Surely Satan is an enemy to you. Therefore do take him as an enemy. He calls his followers to his way so that they may be among the inmates of the Fire.
verses.translation: Surely Satan is an enemy to you. Therefore do take him as an enemy. He calls his followers to his way so that they may be among the inmates of the Fire.

verses.text: A severe chastisement lies in store for those that disbelieve but there is pardon and a great reward for those that believe and work righteous deeds.
verses.translation: A severe chastisement lies in store for those that disbelieve but there is pardon and a great reward for those that believe and work righteous deeds.

verses.text: (How awful is the straying of the person) for whom his evil deed has been embellished so that it looks fair to him? The fact is that Allah causes whomsoever He will to fall into error and shows the Right Way to whomsoever He will. So (O Prophet) let not your life go to waste sorrowing over them. Allah is well aware of all that they do.
verses.translation: (How awful is the straying of the person) for whom his evil deed has been embellished so that it looks fair to him? The fact is that Allah causes whomsoever He will to fall into error and shows the Right Way to whomsoever He will. So (O Prophet) let not your life go to waste sorrowing over them. Allah is well aware of all that they do.

verses.text: It is Allah Who sends forth winds which then set the clouds in motion which We drive to some dead land giving a fresh life to earth after it had become dead. Such will be the resurrection of the dead.
verses.translation: It is Allah Who sends forth winds which then set the clouds in motion which We drive to some dead land giving a fresh life to earth after it had become dead. Such will be the resurrection of the dead.

verses.text: He who seeks glory let him know that all glory belongs to Allah alone. To Him do good words go up and righteous action uplifts them. But those who contrive evil deeds a severe punishment lies in store for them and their contriving will come to naught.
verses.translation: He who seeks glory let him know that all glory belongs to Allah alone. To Him do good words go up and righteous action uplifts them. But those who contrive evil deeds a severe punishment lies in store for them and their contriving will come to naught.

verses.text: Allah created you from dust then from a drop of sperm then He made you into pairs. No female conceives nor delivers (a child) except with His knowledge. None is given a long life nor is any diminished in his life but it is written in a Book. Surely that is quite easy for Allah.
verses.translation: Allah created you from dust then from a drop of sperm then He made you into pairs. No female conceives nor delivers (a child) except with His knowledge. None is given a long life nor is any diminished in his life but it is written in a Book. Surely that is quite easy for Allah.

verses.text: The two masses of water are not alike. The one is sweet sates thirst and is pleasant to drink from while the other is salt bitter on the tongue. Yet from both you eat fresh meat and extract from it ornaments that you wear; and you see ships cruising through it that you may seek of His Bounty and be thankful to Him.

Yet from both you eat fresh meat and extract from it ornaments that you wear; and you see ships cruising through it that you may seek of His Bounty and be thankful to Him.

verses.text: He causes the night to phase into the day and the day into the night and He has subjected the sun and the moon each running its course to an appointed term. That is Allah your Lord; to Him belongs the Kingdom; but those whom you call upon apart from Allah possess not so much as the skin of a date-stone.

That is Allah your Lord; to Him belongs the Kingdom; but those whom you call upon apart from Allah possess not so much as the skin of a date-stone.

verses.text: If you call upon them they cannot hear your prayer. And if they hear it they cannot answer it. On the Day of Resurrection they will disown you for associating others with Allah in His Divinity. No one can inform you of the truth save the All-Aware.

verses.text: O people it is you who stand in need of Allah; as for Allah He is Self-Sufficient Immensely Praiseworthy.
verses.translation: O people it is you who stand in need of Allah; as for Allah He is Self-Sufficient Immensely Praiseworthy.

verses.text: If He wishes He can remove you and put in your place a new creation.
verses.translation: If He wishes He can remove you and put in your place a new creation.

verses.text: That surely is not difficult for Allah.
verses.translation: That surely is not difficult for Allah.

verses.text: No one can bear another''s burden. If a heavily laden one should call another to carry his load none of it shall be carried by the other even though he be a near of kin. (O Prophet) you can warn only those who fear their Lord without seeing Him and establish Prayer. Whoever purifies himself does so to his own good. To Allah is the final return.

verses.text: The blind and the seeing are not alike
verses.translation: The blind and the seeing are not alike

verses.text: nor darkness and light;
verses.translation: nor darkness and light;

verses.text: nor cool shade and torrid heat;
verses.translation: nor cool shade and torrid heat;

verses.text: nor are the living and the dead alike. Allah makes to hear whomsoever He wishes but you (O Prophet) cannot cause to hear those who are in their graves.
verses.translation: nor are the living and the dead alike. Allah makes to hear whomsoever He wishes but you (O Prophet) cannot cause to hear those who are in their graves.

verses.text: You are no more than a warner.
verses.translation: You are no more than a warner.

verses.text: We have sent you with the Truth to proclaim good news and to warn. Never has there been a nation but a warner came to it.
verses.translation: We have sent you with the Truth to proclaim good news and to warn. Never has there been a nation but a warner came to it.

verses.text: If they give the lie to you now those that went before them also gave the lie to their Messengers when they came to them with Clear Proofs with Scriptures and with the Illuminating Book.
verses.translation: If they give the lie to you now those that went before them also gave the lie to their Messengers when they came to them with Clear Proofs with Scriptures and with the Illuminating Book.

verses.text: Then I seized those who denied the Truth and how terrible was My punishment!
verses.translation: Then I seized those who denied the Truth and how terrible was My punishment!

verses.text: Do you not see that Allah sent down water from the sky with which We brought forth fruits of diverse hues? In the mountains there are white and red of diverse hues and pitchy black;
verses.translation: Do you not see that Allah sent down water from the sky with which We brought forth fruits of diverse hues? In the mountains there are white and red of diverse hues and pitchy black;

verses.text: and human beings too and beasts and cattle-diverse are their hues.From among His servants it is only those who know that fear Allah.Verily Allah is Most Mighty Most Forgiving.

verses.translation: Surely those who recite the Book of Allah and establish Prayer and spend privately and publicly out of what We have provided them look forward to a trade that shall suffer no loss;

verses.text: (a trade in which they have invested their all) so that Allah may pay them their wages in full and may add to them out of His Bounty. He is Most Forgiving Most Appreciative.
verses.translation: (a trade in which they have invested their all) so that Allah may pay them their wages in full and may add to them out of His Bounty. He is Most Forgiving Most Appreciative.

verses.text: (O Prophet) the Book We have revealed to you is the Truth confirming the Books that came before it. Verily Allah is well aware of His servants and sees everything.

verses.text: Then We bequeathed the Book to those of Our servants that We chose.Now some of them wrong themselves and some follow the medium course; and some by Allah''s leave vie with each other in acts of goodness. That is the great bounty.

verses.text: They shall enter the everlasting Gardens shall be adorned with bracelets of gold and with pearls and their apparel therein shall be silk.
verses.translation: They shall enter the everlasting Gardens shall be adorned with bracelets of gold and with pearls and their apparel therein shall be silk.

verses.text: They will say:  All praise be to Allah Who has taken away all sorrow from us. Surely our Lord is Most Forgiving Most Appreciative;
verses.translation: They will say:  All praise be to Allah Who has taken away all sorrow from us. Surely our Lord is Most Forgiving Most Appreciative;

verses.text: (the Lord) Who out of His Bounty has made us dwell in an abode wherein no toil nor fatigue affects us.
verses.translation: (the Lord) Who out of His Bounty has made us dwell in an abode wherein no toil nor fatigue affects us.

verses.text: As for those who disbelieved the Fire of Hell awaits them. There they shall not be finished off and die; nor will the torment (of Hell) be lightened for them. Thus do We requite every thankless being.

verses.text: They will cry out in Hell and say:  Our Lord let us out so that we may act righteously different from what we did before.  (They will be told):  Did we not grant you an age long enough for anyone to take heed if he had wanted to take heed?Besides there came a warner to you. So have a taste of the torment now. None may come to the help of the wrong-doers.

Nay what these wrong-doers promise each other is nothing but delusion.

verses.text: They began to wax even more proud on earth and contrived evil designs although the contriving of evil designs only overtakes their authors. Are they waiting then for anything except what happened to the nations before them? You shall not find any change in the Way of Allah; and you shall not find anything that can ever alter the Way of Allah.
verses.translation: They began to wax even more proud on earth and contrived evil designs although the contriving of evil designs only overtakes their authors. Are they waiting then for anything except what happened to the nations before them? You shall not find any change in the Way of Allah; and you shall not find anything that can ever alter the Way of Allah.

verses.text: Have they not journeyed in the earth to behold the end of those who went before them though they were stronger than them in might? Nothing in the heavens nor on earth can frustrate Him in the least. He is All-Knowing All-Powerful.
verses.translation: Have they not journeyed in the earth to behold the end of those who went before them though they were stronger than them in might? Nothing in the heavens nor on earth can frustrate Him in the least. He is All-Knowing All-Powerful.

verses.text: If Allah were to take people to task for their deeds He would not leave any living creature on earth but He grants them respite to an appointed time. When their appointed time comes to an end surely Allah fully observes His servants.
verses.translation: If Allah were to take people to task for their deeds He would not leave any living creature on earth but He grants them respite to an appointed time. When their appointed time comes to an end surely Allah fully observes His servants.

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: All praise be to Allah the Fashioner of the heavens and earth Who appointed angels as His message-bearers having two three four wings. He adds to His creation whatever He pleases. Verily Allah has power over everything.
ayahs.translation: All praise be to Allah the Fashioner of the heavens and earth Who appointed angels as His message-bearers having two three four wings. He adds to His creation whatever He pleases. Verily Allah has power over everything.

ayahs.text: Whatever Mercy Allah accords to people none can withhold; and whatever He withholds no other will be able to release after Him. He is Most Mighty Most Wise.
ayahs.translation: Whatever Mercy Allah accords to people none can withhold; and whatever He withholds no other will be able to release after Him. He is Most Mighty Most Wise.

ayahs.text: O people remember Allah''s favour upon you. Is there any creator apart from Allah who provides you your sustenance out of the heavens and earth? There is no god but He. Whither are you then being misdirected?

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) (there is nothing novel in it) if they cry lies to you;Messengers before you were also cried lies to. To Allah shall all matters be sent back.

ayahs.text: They began to wax even more proud on earth and contrived evil designs although the contriving of evil designs only overtakes their authors. Are they waiting then for anything except what happened to the nations before them? You shall not find any change in the Way of Allah; and you shall not find anything that can ever alter the Way of Allah.
ayahs.translation: They began to wax even more proud on earth and contrived evil designs although the contriving of evil designs only overtakes their authors. Are they waiting then for anything except what happened to the nations before them? You shall not find any change in the Way of Allah; and you shall not find anything that can ever alter the Way of Allah.

ayahs.text: Have they not journeyed in the earth to behold the end of those who went before them though they were stronger than them in might? Nothing in the heavens nor on earth can frustrate Him in the least. He is All-Knowing All-Powerful.
ayahs.translation: Have they not journeyed in the earth to behold the end of those who went before them though they were stronger than them in might? Nothing in the heavens nor on earth can frustrate Him in the least. He is All-Knowing All-Powerful.

ayahs.text: If Allah were to take people to task for their deeds He would not leave any living creature on earth but He grants them respite to an appointed time. When their appointed time comes to an end surely Allah fully observes His servants.
ayahs.translation: If Allah were to take people to task for their deeds He would not leave any living creature on earth but He grants them respite to an appointed time. When their appointed time comes to an end surely Allah fully observes His servants.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Ya''. Sin.
verses.translation: Ya''. Sin.

verses.text: By the Wise Qur''an
verses.translation: By the Wise Qur''an

verses.text: you are truly among the Messengers
verses.translation: you are truly among the Messengers

verses.text: on a Straight Way
verses.translation: on a Straight Way

verses.text: (and this Qur''an) is a revelation from the Most Mighty the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: (and this Qur''an) is a revelation from the Most Mighty the Most Compassionate

verses.text: so that you may warn a people whose ancestors were not warned before wherefore they are heedless.
verses.translation: so that you may warn a people whose ancestors were not warned before wherefore they are heedless.

verses.text: Surely most of them merit the decree of chastisement; so they do not believe.
verses.translation: Surely most of them merit the decree of chastisement; so they do not believe.

verses.text: We have put fetters around their necks which reach up to their chins so that they are standing with their heads upright
verses.translation: We have put fetters around their necks which reach up to their chins so that they are standing with their heads upright

verses.text: and We have put a barrier before them and a barrier behind them and have covered them up so they are unable to see.
verses.translation: and We have put a barrier before them and a barrier behind them and have covered them up so they are unable to see.

verses.text: It is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them for they shall not believe.
verses.translation: It is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them for they shall not believe.

verses.text: You can warn only him who follows the Admonition and fears the Merciful Lord without seeing Him. Give such a one good tidings of forgiveness and a generous reward.
verses.translation: You can warn only him who follows the Admonition and fears the Merciful Lord without seeing Him. Give such a one good tidings of forgiveness and a generous reward.

verses.text: We shall surely raise the dead to life and We record what they did and the traces of their deeds that they have left behind. We have encompassed that in a Clear Book.
verses.translation: We shall surely raise the dead to life and We record what they did and the traces of their deeds that they have left behind. We have encompassed that in a Clear Book.

verses.text: Recite to them as a case in point the story of the people of the town when the Messengers came to them.
verses.translation: Recite to them as a case in point the story of the people of the town when the Messengers came to them.

verses.text: We sent to them two Messengers and they rejected both of them as liars. Then We strengthened them with a third (Messenger). They said:  We have been sent to you as Messengers.
verses.translation: We sent to them two Messengers and they rejected both of them as liars. Then We strengthened them with a third (Messenger). They said:  We have been sent to you as Messengers.

verses.text: The people of the town said:  You are only human beings like ourselves and the Merciful Lord has revealed nothing. You are simply lying.
verses.translation: The people of the town said:  You are only human beings like ourselves and the Merciful Lord has revealed nothing. You are simply lying.

verses.text: The Messengers said:  Our Lord knows that we have indeed been sent to you
verses.translation: The Messengers said:  Our Lord knows that we have indeed been sent to you

verses.text: and our duty is no more than to clearly convey the Message.
verses.translation: and our duty is no more than to clearly convey the Message.

verses.text: The people of the town said:  We believe you are an evil omen for us. If you do not desist we will stone you or you will receive a grievous chastisement from us.
verses.translation: The people of the town said:  We believe you are an evil omen for us. If you do not desist we will stone you or you will receive a grievous chastisement from us.

verses.text: The Messengers replied:  Your evil omen is with you. (Are you saying this) because you were asked to take heed? The truth is that you are a people who have exceeded all bounds.
verses.translation: The Messengers replied:  Your evil omen is with you. (Are you saying this) because you were asked to take heed? The truth is that you are a people who have exceeded all bounds.

verses.text: In the meantime a man came running from the far end of the town saying:  My people follow the Messengers;
verses.translation: In the meantime a man came running from the far end of the town saying:  My people follow the Messengers;

verses.text: follow those who do not ask any recompense from you and are rightly-guided.
verses.translation: follow those who do not ask any recompense from you and are rightly-guided.

verses.text: Why should I not serve the One Who created me and to Whom all of you shall be sent back?
verses.translation: Why should I not serve the One Who created me and to Whom all of you shall be sent back?

verses.text: What! Shall I take any deities apart from Him whose intercession will not avail me the least were the Merciful One to bring any adversity upon me nor will they be able to rescue me?
verses.translation: What! Shall I take any deities apart from Him whose intercession will not avail me the least were the Merciful One to bring any adversity upon me nor will they be able to rescue me?

verses.text: Surely in that case I should indeed be in evident error.
verses.translation: Surely in that case I should indeed be in evident error.

verses.text: I believe in your Lord; so listen to me.
verses.translation: I believe in your Lord; so listen to me.

verses.text: (Eventually they killed him and he was told):  Enter Paradise. The man exclaimed:  Would that my people knew
verses.translation: (Eventually they killed him and he was told):  Enter Paradise. The man exclaimed:  Would that my people knew

verses.text: for what reason Allah has forgiven me and placed me among the honoured ones.
verses.translation: for what reason Allah has forgiven me and placed me among the honoured ones.

verses.text: After him We did not send down any hosts from the heaven; We stood in no need to send down any host.
verses.translation: After him We did not send down any hosts from the heaven; We stood in no need to send down any host.

verses.text: There was but a single Blast and suddenly they became silent and still.
verses.translation: There was but a single Blast and suddenly they became silent and still.

verses.text: Alas for My servants! Never does a Messenger come to them but they mock him.
verses.translation: Alas for My servants! Never does a Messenger come to them but they mock him.

verses.text: Have they not seen how many nations before them did We destroy? Thereafter they never came back to them.
verses.translation: Have they not seen how many nations before them did We destroy? Thereafter they never came back to them.

verses.text: All of them shall (one day) be gathered before Us.
verses.translation: All of them shall (one day) be gathered before Us.

verses.text: Let the dead earth be a Sign for them. We gave it life and produced from it grain whereof they eat.
verses.translation: Let the dead earth be a Sign for them. We gave it life and produced from it grain whereof they eat.

verses.text: We made in it gardens of date-palms and vines and We caused springs to gush forth
verses.translation: We made in it gardens of date-palms and vines and We caused springs to gush forth

verses.text: that they might eat of its fruits. It was not their hands that made them.Will they not then give thanks?
verses.translation: that they might eat of its fruits. It was not their hands that made them.Will they not then give thanks?

verses.text: Holy is He Who created all things in pairs whether it be of what the earth produces and of themselves and of what they do not know.
verses.translation: Holy is He Who created all things in pairs whether it be of what the earth produces and of themselves and of what they do not know.

verses.text: And the night is another Sign for them. We strip the day from it and they become plunged in darkness.
verses.translation: And the night is another Sign for them. We strip the day from it and they become plunged in darkness.

verses.text: The sun is running its course to its appointed place. That is the ordaining of the All-Mighty the All-Knowing.
verses.translation: The sun is running its course to its appointed place. That is the ordaining of the All-Mighty the All-Knowing.

verses.text: We have appointed stages for the moon till it returns in the shape of a dry old branch of palm-tree.
verses.translation: We have appointed stages for the moon till it returns in the shape of a dry old branch of palm-tree.

verses.text: Neither does it lie in the sun''s power to overtake the moon nor can the night outstrip the day. All glide along each in its own orbit.
verses.translation: Neither does it lie in the sun''s power to overtake the moon nor can the night outstrip the day. All glide along each in its own orbit.

verses.text: Another Sign for them is that We carried all their offspring in the laden vessel
verses.translation: Another Sign for them is that We carried all their offspring in the laden vessel

verses.text: and then created for them other vessels like those on which they ride.
verses.translation: and then created for them other vessels like those on which they ride.

verses.text: Should We so wish We can drown them and there will be none to heed their cries of distress nor will they be rescued.
verses.translation: Should We so wish We can drown them and there will be none to heed their cries of distress nor will they be rescued.

verses.text: It is only Our Mercy (that rescues them) and enables enjoyment of life for a while.
verses.translation: It is only Our Mercy (that rescues them) and enables enjoyment of life for a while.

verses.text: When it is said to such people:  Guard yourselves against what is ahead of you and what has preceded you that mercy be shown to you  (they pay scant heed to it).
verses.translation: When it is said to such people:  Guard yourselves against what is ahead of you and what has preceded you that mercy be shown to you  (they pay scant heed to it).

verses.text: Never does any Sign of their Lord come to them but they turn away from it.
verses.translation: Never does any Sign of their Lord come to them but they turn away from it.

verses.text: And when it is said to them:  Spend (in the Way of Allah) out of the sustenance that Allah has provided you the unbelievers say to the believers:  Shall we feed him whom Allah would have fed had He so wished?  Say:  You are in evident error.
verses.translation: And when it is said to them:  Spend (in the Way of Allah) out of the sustenance that Allah has provided you the unbelievers say to the believers:  Shall we feed him whom Allah would have fed had He so wished?  Say:  You are in evident error.

verses.text: They say:  When will this threat (of Resurrection) come to pass? Tell us if indeed you are truthful.
verses.translation: They say:  When will this threat (of Resurrection) come to pass? Tell us if indeed you are truthful.

verses.text: The Truth is that they are waiting for nothing but a mighty Blast to seize them the while they are disputing (in their worldly affairs)
verses.translation: The Truth is that they are waiting for nothing but a mighty Blast to seize them the while they are disputing (in their worldly affairs)

verses.text: and they will not even be able to make a testament nor to return to their households.
verses.translation: and they will not even be able to make a testament nor to return to their households.

verses.text: Then the Trumpet shall be blown and lo! they will come out of their graves and be on the move towards their Lord
verses.translation: Then the Trumpet shall be blown and lo! they will come out of their graves and be on the move towards their Lord

verses.text: (nervously) exclaiming.  Alas for us! Who roused us out of our sleeping-place?  This is what the Merciful One had promised and what (His) Messengers had said was true.
verses.translation: (nervously) exclaiming.  Alas for us! Who roused us out of our sleeping-place?  This is what the Merciful One had promised and what (His) Messengers had said was true.

verses.text: Then there will simply be one single Blast and all will have gathered before Us.
verses.translation: Then there will simply be one single Blast and all will have gathered before Us.

verses.text: Today no one shall suffer the least injustice and you shall not be recompensed except according to your deeds.
verses.translation: Today no one shall suffer the least injustice and you shall not be recompensed except according to your deeds.

verses.text: Indeed the people of Paradise will be busy enjoying themselves:
verses.translation: Indeed the people of Paradise will be busy enjoying themselves:

verses.text: they and their spouses shall be reclining on their couches in shady groves;
verses.translation: they and their spouses shall be reclining on their couches in shady groves;

verses.text: therein there will be all kinds of fruits to eat and they shall have all that they desire.
verses.translation: therein there will be all kinds of fruits to eat and they shall have all that they desire.

verses.text: Peace  shall be the word conveyed to them from their Merciful Lord.
verses.translation: Peace  shall be the word conveyed to them from their Merciful Lord.

verses.text: Criminals separate yourselves from others today!
verses.translation: Criminals separate yourselves from others today!

verses.text: Children of Adam did I not command you not to serve Satan - he is to you an open enemy
verses.translation: Children of Adam did I not command you not to serve Satan - he is to you an open enemy

verses.text: and serve Me alone: this is the Straight Way?
verses.translation: and serve Me alone: this is the Straight Way?

verses.text: Still he misguided a whole throng of you. Did you have no sense?
verses.translation: Still he misguided a whole throng of you. Did you have no sense?

verses.text: Now this is the Hell of which you were warned.
verses.translation: Now this is the Hell of which you were warned.

verses.text: Burn in it on account of your disbelieving.
verses.translation: Burn in it on account of your disbelieving.

verses.text: Today We shall put a seal on their mouths and their hands will speak to Us and their feet shall bear witness to what they had been doing.
verses.translation: Today We shall put a seal on their mouths and their hands will speak to Us and their feet shall bear witness to what they had been doing.

verses.text: If We so willed We would have put out their eyes then they would rush to see the Way but how would they be able to see?
verses.translation: If We so willed We would have put out their eyes then they would rush to see the Way but how would they be able to see?

verses.text: If We so willed We would have transformed them where they were so that they would not go forward or backward.
verses.translation: If We so willed We would have transformed them where they were so that they would not go forward or backward.

verses.text: Whomsoever We grant a long life We reverse him in his constitution. Do they still not understand?
verses.translation: Whomsoever We grant a long life We reverse him in his constitution. Do they still not understand?

verses.text: We did not teach him (to wit the Messenger) poetry and it does not behove him. This is none but an Admonition and a Clear Book
verses.translation: We did not teach him (to wit the Messenger) poetry and it does not behove him. This is none but an Admonition and a Clear Book

verses.text: that he may warn him who is alive and establish an argument against those that deny the Truth.
verses.translation: that he may warn him who is alive and establish an argument against those that deny the Truth.

verses.text: Do they not see Our handiwork: We created for them cattle which they own?
verses.translation: Do they not see Our handiwork: We created for them cattle which they own?

verses.text: We have subjected the cattle to them so that some of them they ride and eat the flesh of others.
verses.translation: We have subjected the cattle to them so that some of them they ride and eat the flesh of others.

verses.text: They derive a variety of benefits and drinks from them. Will they then not give thanks?
verses.translation: They derive a variety of benefits and drinks from them. Will they then not give thanks?

verses.text: They set up deities apart from Allah hoping that they will receive help from them.
verses.translation: They set up deities apart from Allah hoping that they will receive help from them.

verses.text: Those deities can render them no help. Yet these devotees act as though they were an army in waiting for them.
verses.translation: Those deities can render them no help. Yet these devotees act as though they were an army in waiting for them.

verses.text: Let not their words grieve you. Surely We know all things about them what they conceal and what they reveal.
verses.translation: Let not their words grieve you. Surely We know all things about them what they conceal and what they reveal.

verses.text: Does man not see that We created him of a sperm drop and lo! he is flagrantly contentious?
verses.translation: Does man not see that We created him of a sperm drop and lo! he is flagrantly contentious?

verses.text: He strikes for Us a similitude and forgot his own creation. He says:  Who will quicken the bones when they have decayed?
verses.translation: He strikes for Us a similitude and forgot his own creation. He says:  Who will quicken the bones when they have decayed?

verses.text: Say:  He Who first brought them into being will quicken them; He knows well about every kind of creation;
verses.translation: Say:  He Who first brought them into being will quicken them; He knows well about every kind of creation;

verses.text: He Who created from a green tree a fire for you a fire to light your stoves with.
verses.translation: He Who created from a green tree a fire for you a fire to light your stoves with.

verses.text: Has He Who created the heavens and the earth no power to create the likes of them? Yes indeed He is the Superb Creator.
verses.translation: Has He Who created the heavens and the earth no power to create the likes of them? Yes indeed He is the Superb Creator.

verses.text: Whenever He wills a thing He just commands it  Be  and it is.
verses.translation: Whenever He wills a thing He just commands it  Be  and it is.

verses.text: Holy is He Who has full control over everything and to Him you shall all be recalled.
verses.translation: Holy is He Who has full control over everything and to Him you shall all be recalled.

ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.translation: It is only Our Mercy (that rescues them) and enables enjoyment of life for a while.

ayahs.text: When it is said to such people:  Guard yourselves against what is ahead of you and what has preceded you that mercy be shown to you  (they pay scant heed to it).
ayahs.translation: When it is said to such people:  Guard yourselves against what is ahead of you and what has preceded you that mercy be shown to you  (they pay scant heed to it).

ayahs.text: Never does any Sign of their Lord come to them but they turn away from it.
ayahs.translation: Never does any Sign of their Lord come to them but they turn away from it.

ayahs.text: And when it is said to them:  Spend (in the Way of Allah) out of the sustenance that Allah has provided you the unbelievers say to the believers:  Shall we feed him whom Allah would have fed had He so wished?  Say:  You are in evident error.
ayahs.translation: And when it is said to them:  Spend (in the Way of Allah) out of the sustenance that Allah has provided you the unbelievers say to the believers:  Shall we feed him whom Allah would have fed had He so wished?  Say:  You are in evident error.

ayahs.text: They say:  When will this threat (of Resurrection) come to pass? Tell us if indeed you are truthful.
ayahs.translation: They say:  When will this threat (of Resurrection) come to pass? Tell us if indeed you are truthful.

ayahs.text: The Truth is that they are waiting for nothing but a mighty Blast to seize them the while they are disputing (in their worldly affairs)
ayahs.translation: The Truth is that they are waiting for nothing but a mighty Blast to seize them the while they are disputing (in their worldly affairs)

ayahs.text: and they will not even be able to make a testament nor to return to their households.
ayahs.translation: and they will not even be able to make a testament nor to return to their households.

ayahs.text: Then the Trumpet shall be blown and lo! they will come out of their graves and be on the move towards their Lord
ayahs.translation: Then the Trumpet shall be blown and lo! they will come out of their graves and be on the move towards their Lord

ayahs.text: (nervously) exclaiming.  Alas for us! Who roused us out of our sleeping-place?  This is what the Merciful One had promised and what (His) Messengers had said was true.
ayahs.translation: (nervously) exclaiming.  Alas for us! Who roused us out of our sleeping-place?  This is what the Merciful One had promised and what (His) Messengers had said was true.

ayahs.text: Then there will simply be one single Blast and all will have gathered before Us.
ayahs.translation: Then there will simply be one single Blast and all will have gathered before Us.

ayahs.text: Today no one shall suffer the least injustice and you shall not be recompensed except according to your deeds.
ayahs.translation: Today no one shall suffer the least injustice and you shall not be recompensed except according to your deeds.

ayahs.text: Indeed the people of Paradise will be busy enjoying themselves:
ayahs.translation: Indeed the people of Paradise will be busy enjoying themselves:

ayahs.text: they and their spouses shall be reclining on their couches in shady groves;
ayahs.translation: they and their spouses shall be reclining on their couches in shady groves;

ayahs.text: therein there will be all kinds of fruits to eat and they shall have all that they desire.
ayahs.translation: therein there will be all kinds of fruits to eat and they shall have all that they desire.

ayahs.text: Peace  shall be the word conveyed to them from their Merciful Lord.
ayahs.translation: Peace  shall be the word conveyed to them from their Merciful Lord.

ayahs.text: Criminals separate yourselves from others today!
ayahs.translation: Criminals separate yourselves from others today!

ayahs.text: Children of Adam did I not command you not to serve Satan - he is to you an open enemy
ayahs.translation: Children of Adam did I not command you not to serve Satan - he is to you an open enemy

ayahs.text: and serve Me alone: this is the Straight Way?
ayahs.translation: and serve Me alone: this is the Straight Way?

ayahs.text: Still he misguided a whole throng of you. Did you have no sense?
ayahs.translation: Still he misguided a whole throng of you. Did you have no sense?

ayahs.text: Now this is the Hell of which you were warned.
ayahs.translation: Now this is the Hell of which you were warned.

ayahs.text: Burn in it on account of your disbelieving.
ayahs.translation: Burn in it on account of your disbelieving.

ayahs.text: Today We shall put a seal on their mouths and their hands will speak to Us and their feet shall bear witness to what they had been doing.
ayahs.translation: Today We shall put a seal on their mouths and their hands will speak to Us and their feet shall bear witness to what they had been doing.

ayahs.text: If We so willed We would have put out their eyes then they would rush to see the Way but how would they be able to see?
ayahs.translation: If We so willed We would have put out their eyes then they would rush to see the Way but how would they be able to see?

ayahs.text: If We so willed We would have transformed them where they were so that they would not go forward or backward.
ayahs.translation: If We so willed We would have transformed them where they were so that they would not go forward or backward.

ayahs.text: Whomsoever We grant a long life We reverse him in his constitution. Do they still not understand?
ayahs.translation: Whomsoever We grant a long life We reverse him in his constitution. Do they still not understand?

ayahs.text: We did not teach him (to wit the Messenger) poetry and it does not behove him. This is none but an Admonition and a Clear Book
ayahs.translation: We did not teach him (to wit the Messenger) poetry and it does not behove him. This is none but an Admonition and a Clear Book

ayahs.text: that he may warn him who is alive and establish an argument against those that deny the Truth.
ayahs.translation: that he may warn him who is alive and establish an argument against those that deny the Truth.

ayahs.text: Do they not see Our handiwork: We created for them cattle which they own?
ayahs.translation: Do they not see Our handiwork: We created for them cattle which they own?

ayahs.text: We have subjected the cattle to them so that some of them they ride and eat the flesh of others.
ayahs.translation: We have subjected the cattle to them so that some of them they ride and eat the flesh of others.

ayahs.text: They derive a variety of benefits and drinks from them. Will they then not give thanks?
ayahs.translation: They derive a variety of benefits and drinks from them. Will they then not give thanks?

ayahs.text: They set up deities apart from Allah hoping that they will receive help from them.
ayahs.translation: They set up deities apart from Allah hoping that they will receive help from them.

ayahs.text: Those deities can render them no help. Yet these devotees act as though they were an army in waiting for them.
ayahs.translation: Those deities can render them no help. Yet these devotees act as though they were an army in waiting for them.

ayahs.text: Let not their words grieve you. Surely We know all things about them what they conceal and what they reveal.
ayahs.translation: Let not their words grieve you. Surely We know all things about them what they conceal and what they reveal.

ayahs.text: Does man not see that We created him of a sperm drop and lo! he is flagrantly contentious?
ayahs.translation: Does man not see that We created him of a sperm drop and lo! he is flagrantly contentious?

ayahs.text: He strikes for Us a similitude and forgot his own creation. He says:  Who will quicken the bones when they have decayed?
ayahs.translation: He strikes for Us a similitude and forgot his own creation. He says:  Who will quicken the bones when they have decayed?

ayahs.text: Say:  He Who first brought them into being will quicken them; He knows well about every kind of creation;
ayahs.translation: Say:  He Who first brought them into being will quicken them; He knows well about every kind of creation;

ayahs.text: He Who created from a green tree a fire for you a fire to light your stoves with.
ayahs.translation: He Who created from a green tree a fire for you a fire to light your stoves with.

ayahs.text: Has He Who created the heavens and the earth no power to create the likes of them? Yes indeed He is the Superb Creator.
ayahs.translation: Has He Who created the heavens and the earth no power to create the likes of them? Yes indeed He is the Superb Creator.

ayahs.text: Whenever He wills a thing He just commands it  Be  and it is.
ayahs.translation: Whenever He wills a thing He just commands it  Be  and it is.

ayahs.text: Holy is He Who has full control over everything and to Him you shall all be recalled.
ayahs.translation: Holy is He Who has full control over everything and to Him you shall all be recalled.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: By those who range themselves in rows;
verses.translation: By those who range themselves in rows;

verses.text: by those who reprove severely
verses.translation: by those who reprove severely

verses.text: and those who recite the Exhortation;
verses.translation: and those who recite the Exhortation;

verses.text: surely your God is One
verses.translation: surely your God is One

verses.text: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and of whatever lies between the two the Lord of the Easts.
verses.translation: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and of whatever lies between the two the Lord of the Easts.

verses.text: We have adorned the lower heaven with the adornment of the stars
verses.translation: We have adorned the lower heaven with the adornment of the stars

verses.text: and have protected it from every rebellious satan.
verses.translation: and have protected it from every rebellious satan.

verses.text: These satans cannot listen to what transpires in the High Council for they are pelted away from every side
verses.translation: These satans cannot listen to what transpires in the High Council for they are pelted away from every side

verses.text: and are repelled. Theirs is an unceasing chastisement.
verses.translation: and are repelled. Theirs is an unceasing chastisement.

verses.text: And if any is able to snatch a fragment he is pursued by a piercing flame.
verses.translation: And if any is able to snatch a fragment he is pursued by a piercing flame.

verses.text: So ask them (that is human beings):  Were they harder to create than the objects We created? We created them from sticky clay.
verses.translation: So ask them (that is human beings):  Were they harder to create than the objects We created? We created them from sticky clay.

verses.text: You marvel (at the wondrous creations of Allah) and they scoff at it
verses.translation: You marvel (at the wondrous creations of Allah) and they scoff at it

verses.text: and when they are admonished they pay no heed;
verses.translation: and when they are admonished they pay no heed;

verses.text: and if they see any Sign they laugh it away
verses.translation: and if they see any Sign they laugh it away

verses.text: and say:  This is nothing but plain sorcery.
verses.translation: and say:  This is nothing but plain sorcery.

verses.text: Is it ever possible that after we die and are reduced to dust and (a skeleton of) bones we will be raised to life?
verses.translation: Is it ever possible that after we die and are reduced to dust and (a skeleton of) bones we will be raised to life?

verses.text: And so also shall our forefathers of yore be raised to life?
verses.translation: And so also shall our forefathers of yore be raised to life?

verses.text: Tell them:  Yes; and you are utterly helpless (against Allah).
verses.translation: Tell them:  Yes; and you are utterly helpless (against Allah).

verses.text: There will be a single stern rebuff and lo they will be observing with their own eyes (all that they had been warned against).
verses.translation: There will be a single stern rebuff and lo they will be observing with their own eyes (all that they had been warned against).

verses.text: They will then say:  Woe for us. This is the Day of Judgement.
verses.translation: They will then say:  Woe for us. This is the Day of Judgement.

verses.text: Yes this is the Day of Final Decision that you used to deny as a lie.
verses.translation: Yes this is the Day of Final Decision that you used to deny as a lie.

verses.text: (Then will the command be given):  Muster all the wrong-doers and their spouses and the deities whom they used to serve
verses.translation: (Then will the command be given):  Muster all the wrong-doers and their spouses and the deities whom they used to serve

verses.text: apart from Allah and direct them to the path of Hell
verses.translation: apart from Allah and direct them to the path of Hell

verses.text: and detain them there; they will be called to account.
verses.translation: and detain them there; they will be called to account.

verses.text: How is it that you are not helping one another?
verses.translation: How is it that you are not helping one another?

verses.text: Indeed today they are surrendering themselves completely.
verses.translation: Indeed today they are surrendering themselves completely.

verses.text: They will then turn towards each other (and start wrangling).
verses.translation: They will then turn towards each other (and start wrangling).

verses.text: (The followers will say to their leaders):  You used to come to us from the right hand.
verses.translation: (The followers will say to their leaders):  You used to come to us from the right hand.

verses.text: They will say:  Nay you yourselves were not the ones who would believe.
verses.translation: They will say:  Nay you yourselves were not the ones who would believe.

verses.text: We had no power over you. You were a rebellious people
verses.translation: We had no power over you. You were a rebellious people

verses.text: and so we became deserving of the Word of our Lord that we shall be made to suffer chastisement.
verses.translation: and so we became deserving of the Word of our Lord that we shall be made to suffer chastisement.

verses.text: So we led you astray; we ourselves were strayed.
verses.translation: So we led you astray; we ourselves were strayed.

verses.text: On that Day they will all share the chastisement.
verses.translation: On that Day they will all share the chastisement.

verses.text: Thus do We treat the culprits.
verses.translation: Thus do We treat the culprits.

verses.text: Whenever it was said to them:  There is no true deity apart from Allah they waxed proud
verses.translation: Whenever it was said to them:  There is no true deity apart from Allah they waxed proud

verses.text: and said:  Shall we forsake our deities for the sake of a distracted poet?
verses.translation: and said:  Shall we forsake our deities for the sake of a distracted poet?

verses.text: (They say so although) he brought the Truth and confirmed the veracity of the Messengers.
verses.translation: (They say so although) he brought the Truth and confirmed the veracity of the Messengers.

verses.text: (They will be told):  You shall taste the grievous chastisement.
verses.translation: (They will be told):  You shall taste the grievous chastisement.

verses.text: You will only be recompensed according to your deeds.
verses.translation: You will only be recompensed according to your deeds.

verses.text: But Allah''s chosen servants (shall be spared this woeful end).
verses.translation: But Allah''s chosen servants (shall be spared this woeful end).

verses.text: For them awaits a known provision
verses.translation: For them awaits a known provision

verses.text: a variety of delicious fruits; and they shall be honoured
verses.translation: a variety of delicious fruits; and they shall be honoured

verses.text: in the Gardens of Bliss.
verses.translation: in the Gardens of Bliss.

verses.text: They will be seated upon couches set face to face;
verses.translation: They will be seated upon couches set face to face;

verses.text: a cup filled with wine from its springs will be passed around to them;
verses.translation: a cup filled with wine from its springs will be passed around to them;

verses.text: white sparkling (wine) a delight to the drinkers.
verses.translation: white sparkling (wine) a delight to the drinkers.

verses.text: There will neither be any harm in it for their body nor will it intoxicate their mind.
verses.translation: There will neither be any harm in it for their body nor will it intoxicate their mind.

verses.text: Theirs shall be wide-eyed maidens with bashful restrained glances
verses.translation: Theirs shall be wide-eyed maidens with bashful restrained glances

verses.text: so delicate as the hidden peel under an egg''s shell.
verses.translation: so delicate as the hidden peel under an egg''s shell.

verses.text: Then some of them will turn to others and will ask each other.
verses.translation: Then some of them will turn to others and will ask each other.

verses.text: One of them will say:  I had a companion in the world
verses.translation: One of them will say:  I had a companion in the world

verses.text: who used to say: ''Are you also one of those who confirm the Truth (of life after death)?
verses.translation: who used to say: ''Are you also one of those who confirm the Truth (of life after death)?

verses.text: After we are dead and have become all dust and bones shall we still be requited?''
verses.translation: After we are dead and have become all dust and bones shall we still be requited?''

verses.text: He will say: ''Do you wish to know where he is now?''
verses.translation: He will say: ''Do you wish to know where he is now?''

verses.text: Then he will look downwards and will see him in the depths of Hell.
verses.translation: Then he will look downwards and will see him in the depths of Hell.

verses.text: He will say to him: ''By Allah you almost ruined me.
verses.translation: He will say to him: ''By Allah you almost ruined me.

verses.text: But for Allah''s favour I should be one of those who have been mustered here.
verses.translation: But for Allah''s favour I should be one of those who have been mustered here.

verses.text: So are we not going to die
verses.translation: So are we not going to die

verses.text: except for our first death? And shall we suffer no chastisement?''
verses.translation: except for our first death? And shall we suffer no chastisement?''

verses.text: Surely this is the supreme triumph.
verses.translation: Surely this is the supreme triumph.

verses.text: For the like of it should the workers work.
verses.translation: For the like of it should the workers work.

verses.text: Is this a better hospitality or the tree of al-Zaqqum?
verses.translation: Is this a better hospitality or the tree of al-Zaqqum?

verses.text: We have made this tree a trial for the wrong-doers.
verses.translation: We have made this tree a trial for the wrong-doers.

verses.text: It is a tree that grows in the nethermost part of Hell.
verses.translation: It is a tree that grows in the nethermost part of Hell.

verses.text: Its spathes are like the heads of satans.
verses.translation: Its spathes are like the heads of satans.

verses.text: (The people of Hell) will surely eat of it filling their bellies with it.
verses.translation: (The people of Hell) will surely eat of it filling their bellies with it.

verses.text: Then on top of it they will have a brew of boiling water.
verses.translation: Then on top of it they will have a brew of boiling water.

verses.text: Then their return will be to the same blazing Hell.
verses.translation: Then their return will be to the same blazing Hell.

verses.text: These are the ones who found their fathers steeped in error
verses.translation: These are the ones who found their fathers steeped in error

verses.text: and they are running in their footsteps.
verses.translation: and they are running in their footsteps.

verses.text: Before them a multitude of people of olden times had erred
verses.translation: Before them a multitude of people of olden times had erred

verses.text: and We had sent among them Messengers to warn them.
verses.translation: and We had sent among them Messengers to warn them.

verses.text: Observe then what was the end of those that had been warned
verses.translation: Observe then what was the end of those that had been warned

verses.text: except for the chosen servants of Allah?
verses.translation: except for the chosen servants of Allah?

verses.text: Noah had called upon Us (earlier). See how excellent We were in answering him!
verses.translation: Noah had called upon Us (earlier). See how excellent We were in answering him!

verses.text: We delivered him and his household from the great calamity;
verses.translation: We delivered him and his household from the great calamity;

verses.text: and made his offspring the only ones to survive
verses.translation: and made his offspring the only ones to survive

verses.text: and We established for him a good name among posterity.
verses.translation: and We established for him a good name among posterity.

verses.text: Peace be upon Noah among all the nations.
verses.translation: Peace be upon Noah among all the nations.

verses.text: Thus do We reward all those who do good.
verses.translation: Thus do We reward all those who do good.

verses.text: Surely he was one of Our truly believing servants.
verses.translation: Surely he was one of Our truly believing servants.

verses.text: Thereafter We caused the others to be drowned.
verses.translation: Thereafter We caused the others to be drowned.

verses.text: Abraham was on the self-same way (as Noah).
verses.translation: Abraham was on the self-same way (as Noah).

verses.text: When he came to his Lord with a pure heart
verses.translation: When he came to his Lord with a pure heart

verses.text: and said to his father and his people: Whom do you worship?
verses.translation: and said to his father and his people: Whom do you worship?

verses.text: Is it false deities that you want to serve rather than Allah?
verses.translation: Is it false deities that you want to serve rather than Allah?

verses.text: What do you think of the Lord of the whole Universe?
verses.translation: What do you think of the Lord of the whole Universe?

verses.text: Then he looked carefully at the stars
verses.translation: Then he looked carefully at the stars

verses.text: and said:  I am sick.
verses.translation: and said:  I am sick.

verses.text: So turning their backs they went away from him.
verses.translation: So turning their backs they went away from him.

verses.text: Then he went quietly to the (temple of the deities) and said:  What is the matter with you why do you not eat?
verses.translation: Then he went quietly to the (temple of the deities) and said:  What is the matter with you why do you not eat?

verses.text: What is the matter with you why do you not speak?
verses.translation: What is the matter with you why do you not speak?

verses.text: Then he turned upon them striking them with his right hand
verses.translation: Then he turned upon them striking them with his right hand

verses.text: whereupon people came to him running.
verses.translation: whereupon people came to him running.

verses.text: Abraham said to them:  Do you worship what you yourselves have carved with your own hands
verses.translation: Abraham said to them:  Do you worship what you yourselves have carved with your own hands

verses.text: while it is Allah Who has created you and all that you make?
verses.translation: while it is Allah Who has created you and all that you make?

verses.text: They spoke among themselves:  Build him a pyre and then throw him into the furnace.
verses.translation: They spoke among themselves:  Build him a pyre and then throw him into the furnace.

verses.text: They had contrived an evil plan against him but We abased them all.
verses.translation: They had contrived an evil plan against him but We abased them all.

verses.text: Abraham said: I am going to my Lord; He will guide me.
verses.translation: Abraham said: I am going to my Lord; He will guide me.

verses.text: Lord grant me a righteous son.
verses.translation: Lord grant me a righteous son.

verses.text: (In response to this prayer) We gave him the good news of a prudent boy;
verses.translation: (In response to this prayer) We gave him the good news of a prudent boy;

verses.text: and when he was old enough to go about and work with him (one day) Abraham said to him:  My son I see in my dream that I am slaughtering you. So consider (and tell me) what you think. He said:  Do as you are bidden. You will find me if Allah so wills among the steadfast.
verses.translation: and when he was old enough to go about and work with him (one day) Abraham said to him:  My son I see in my dream that I am slaughtering you. So consider (and tell me) what you think. He said:  Do as you are bidden. You will find me if Allah so wills among the steadfast.

verses.text: When both surrendered (to Allah''s command) and Abraham flung the son down on his forehead
verses.translation: When both surrendered (to Allah''s command) and Abraham flung the son down on his forehead

verses.text: We cried out: O Abraham
verses.translation: We cried out: O Abraham

verses.text: you have indeed fulfilled your dream. Thus do We reward the good-doers.
verses.translation: you have indeed fulfilled your dream. Thus do We reward the good-doers.

verses.text: This was indeed a plain trial.
verses.translation: This was indeed a plain trial.

verses.text: And We ransomed him with a mighty sacrifice
verses.translation: And We ransomed him with a mighty sacrifice

verses.text: and We preserved for him a good name among posterity.
verses.translation: and We preserved for him a good name among posterity.

verses.text: Peace be upon Abraham.
verses.translation: Peace be upon Abraham.

verses.text: Thus do We reward the good-doers.
verses.translation: Thus do We reward the good-doers.

verses.text: Surely he was one of Our believing servants.
verses.translation: Surely he was one of Our believing servants.

verses.text: And We gave him the good news of Isaac a Prophet and among the righteous ones.
verses.translation: And We gave him the good news of Isaac a Prophet and among the righteous ones.

verses.text: And We blessed him and Isaac. Among the offspring of the two some did good and some plainly wronged themselves.
verses.translation: And We blessed him and Isaac. Among the offspring of the two some did good and some plainly wronged themselves.

verses.text: Verily We bestowed Our favours on Moses and Aaron
verses.translation: Verily We bestowed Our favours on Moses and Aaron

verses.text: and We delivered both of them and their people from the great calamity.
verses.translation: and We delivered both of them and their people from the great calamity.

verses.text: We succoured them and they gained the upper hand (against their enemies).
verses.translation: We succoured them and they gained the upper hand (against their enemies).

verses.text: We granted them a Clear Book
verses.translation: We granted them a Clear Book

verses.text: and showed them the Straight Way
verses.translation: and showed them the Straight Way

verses.text: and preserved for them a good name among posterity.
verses.translation: and preserved for them a good name among posterity.

verses.text: Peace be upon Moses and Aaron.
verses.translation: Peace be upon Moses and Aaron.

verses.text: Thus do We reward the good-doers.
verses.translation: Thus do We reward the good-doers.

verses.text: Surely both of them were among Our believing servants.
verses.translation: Surely both of them were among Our believing servants.

verses.text: Surely Elias too was among the Messengers.
verses.translation: Surely Elias too was among the Messengers.

verses.text: (Call to mind) when he said to his people:  Will you not fear Allah?
verses.translation: (Call to mind) when he said to his people:  Will you not fear Allah?

verses.text: Do you call upon Baal and forsake the Best of the Creators?
verses.translation: Do you call upon Baal and forsake the Best of the Creators?

verses.text: Allah is your Lord and the Lord of your ancestors of yore.
verses.translation: Allah is your Lord and the Lord of your ancestors of yore.

verses.text: But they denounced him as a liar so they will surely be arraigned (for punishment)
verses.translation: But they denounced him as a liar so they will surely be arraigned (for punishment)

verses.text: except Allah''s chosen servants.
verses.translation: except Allah''s chosen servants.

verses.text: We preserved a good name for him among posterity.
verses.translation: We preserved a good name for him among posterity.

verses.text: Peace be upon Elias.
verses.translation: Peace be upon Elias.

verses.text: Thus do We reward the good-doers.
verses.translation: Thus do We reward the good-doers.

verses.text: He was one of Our believing servants.
verses.translation: He was one of Our believing servants.

verses.text: And Lot too was one of the Messengers.
verses.translation: And Lot too was one of the Messengers.

verses.text: (Call to mind) when We delivered him and all his kinsfolk
verses.translation: (Call to mind) when We delivered him and all his kinsfolk

verses.text: except for an old woman who was among those that stayed behind.
verses.translation: except for an old woman who was among those that stayed behind.

verses.text: Then We utterly destroyed the rest of them.
verses.translation: Then We utterly destroyed the rest of them.

verses.text: You pass by their desolate habitations in the morning
verses.translation: You pass by their desolate habitations in the morning

verses.text: and at night. Do you still not understand?
verses.translation: and at night. Do you still not understand?

verses.text: And Jonah too was one of the Messengers.
verses.translation: And Jonah too was one of the Messengers.

verses.text: Call to mind when he fled to the laden ship
verses.translation: Call to mind when he fled to the laden ship

verses.text: cast lots and was among the losers.
verses.translation: cast lots and was among the losers.

verses.text: Then a fish swallowed him and he was blameworthy.
verses.translation: Then a fish swallowed him and he was blameworthy.

verses.text: Had he not been one of those who glorify Allah
verses.translation: Had he not been one of those who glorify Allah

verses.text: he would certainly have remained in its belly till the Day of Resurrection.
verses.translation: he would certainly have remained in its belly till the Day of Resurrection.

verses.text: But We threw him on a wide bare tract of land while he was ill;
verses.translation: But We threw him on a wide bare tract of land while he was ill;

verses.text: and caused a gourd tree to grow over him
verses.translation: and caused a gourd tree to grow over him

verses.text: and We sent him forth to a nation of a hundred thousand or more
verses.translation: and We sent him forth to a nation of a hundred thousand or more

verses.text: and they believed. So We let them enjoy life for a while.
verses.translation: and they believed. So We let them enjoy life for a while.

verses.text: So ask their opinion: (Are you convinced) that your Lord should have daughters and you should have sons?
verses.translation: So ask their opinion: (Are you convinced) that your Lord should have daughters and you should have sons?

verses.text: Did We create the angels as females the while they witnessed?
verses.translation: Did We create the angels as females the while they witnessed?

verses.text: Behold it is one of their fabrications that they say:
verses.translation: Behold it is one of their fabrications that they say:

verses.text: Allah has begotten.  They are liars!
verses.translation: Allah has begotten.  They are liars!

verses.text: Did He choose daughters rather than sons?
verses.translation: Did He choose daughters rather than sons?

verses.text: What is the matter with you that you make such strange judgements?
verses.translation: What is the matter with you that you make such strange judgements?

verses.text: Will you then not take heed?
verses.translation: Will you then not take heed?

verses.text: Do you have any clear authority for such claims?
verses.translation: Do you have any clear authority for such claims?

verses.text: Bring your Book if you are truthful.
verses.translation: Bring your Book if you are truthful.

verses.text: They have established a kinship between Allah and the angels;and the angels know well that these people will be arraigned (as culprits).
verses.translation: They have established a kinship between Allah and the angels;and the angels know well that these people will be arraigned (as culprits).

verses.text: (They say):  Exalted be Allah above what they attribute to Him
verses.translation: (They say):  Exalted be Allah above what they attribute to Him

verses.text: all of them except the chosen servants of Allah.
verses.translation: all of them except the chosen servants of Allah.

verses.text: So you and your deities
verses.translation: So you and your deities

verses.text: shall not be able to tempt anyone away from Allah
verses.translation: shall not be able to tempt anyone away from Allah

verses.text: except him who shall roast in the Blazing Fire.
verses.translation: except him who shall roast in the Blazing Fire.

verses.text: As for us there is none but has an appointed station.
verses.translation: As for us there is none but has an appointed station.

verses.text: Verily we range ourselves in rows (as humble servants)
verses.translation: Verily we range ourselves in rows (as humble servants)

verses.text: and we are of those who glorify Allah.
verses.translation: and we are of those who glorify Allah.

verses.text: They used to say before:
verses.translation: They used to say before:

verses.text: If only we had the Reminder which had been granted to the people of yore
verses.translation: If only we had the Reminder which had been granted to the people of yore

verses.text: we would surely have been Allah''s chosen servants.
verses.translation: we would surely have been Allah''s chosen servants.

verses.text: But when it came to them they rejected it. They shall soon come to know (the end of such an attitude).
verses.translation: But when it came to them they rejected it. They shall soon come to know (the end of such an attitude).

verses.text: We have already given Our promise to Our Messengers
verses.translation: We have already given Our promise to Our Messengers

verses.text: that they shall certainly be succoured
verses.translation: that they shall certainly be succoured

verses.text: and that Our hosts shall triumph.
verses.translation: and that Our hosts shall triumph.

verses.text: So (O Prophet) leave them alone for a while
verses.translation: So (O Prophet) leave them alone for a while

verses.text: and see and soon they too shall see.
verses.translation: and see and soon they too shall see.

verses.text: Do they seek to hasten Our chastisement?
verses.translation: Do they seek to hasten Our chastisement?

verses.text: When that chastisement will descend upon their courtyard evil shall that Day be for those who had been warned.
verses.translation: When that chastisement will descend upon their courtyard evil shall that Day be for those who had been warned.

verses.text: Leave them alone for a while
verses.translation: Leave them alone for a while

verses.text: and see; and they too shall soon see.
verses.translation: and see; and they too shall soon see.

verses.text: Exalted be your Lord the Lord of Glory above what they attribute to Him
verses.translation: Exalted be your Lord the Lord of Glory above what they attribute to Him

verses.text: and peace be upon the Messengers
verses.translation: and peace be upon the Messengers

verses.text: and all praise be to Allah the Lord of the Universe.
verses.translation: and all praise be to Allah the Lord of the Universe.

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: By those who range themselves in rows;
ayahs.translation: By those who range themselves in rows;

ayahs.text: by those who reprove severely
ayahs.translation: by those who reprove severely

ayahs.text: and those who recite the Exhortation;
ayahs.translation: and those who recite the Exhortation;

ayahs.text: surely your God is One
ayahs.translation: surely your God is One

ayahs.text: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and of whatever lies between the two the Lord of the Easts.
ayahs.translation: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and of whatever lies between the two the Lord of the Easts.

ayahs.text: We have adorned the lower heaven with the adornment of the stars
ayahs.translation: We have adorned the lower heaven with the adornment of the stars

ayahs.text: and have protected it from every rebellious satan.
ayahs.translation: and have protected it from every rebellious satan.

ayahs.text: These satans cannot listen to what transpires in the High Council for they are pelted away from every side
ayahs.translation: These satans cannot listen to what transpires in the High Council for they are pelted away from every side

ayahs.text: and are repelled. Theirs is an unceasing chastisement.
ayahs.translation: and are repelled. Theirs is an unceasing chastisement.

ayahs.text: And if any is able to snatch a fragment he is pursued by a piercing flame.
ayahs.translation: And if any is able to snatch a fragment he is pursued by a piercing flame.

ayahs.text: So ask them (that is human beings):  Were they harder to create than the objects We created? We created them from sticky clay.
ayahs.translation: So ask them (that is human beings):  Were they harder to create than the objects We created? We created them from sticky clay.

ayahs.text: You marvel (at the wondrous creations of Allah) and they scoff at it
ayahs.translation: You marvel (at the wondrous creations of Allah) and they scoff at it

ayahs.text: and when they are admonished they pay no heed;
ayahs.translation: and when they are admonished they pay no heed;

ayahs.text: and if they see any Sign they laugh it away
ayahs.translation: and if they see any Sign they laugh it away

ayahs.text: and say:  This is nothing but plain sorcery.
ayahs.translation: and say:  This is nothing but plain sorcery.

ayahs.text: Is it ever possible that after we die and are reduced to dust and (a skeleton of) bones we will be raised to life?
ayahs.translation: Is it ever possible that after we die and are reduced to dust and (a skeleton of) bones we will be raised to life?

ayahs.text: And so also shall our forefathers of yore be raised to life?
ayahs.translation: And so also shall our forefathers of yore be raised to life?

ayahs.text: Tell them:  Yes; and you are utterly helpless (against Allah).
ayahs.translation: Tell them:  Yes; and you are utterly helpless (against Allah).

ayahs.text: There will be a single stern rebuff and lo they will be observing with their own eyes (all that they had been warned against).
ayahs.translation: There will be a single stern rebuff and lo they will be observing with their own eyes (all that they had been warned against).

ayahs.text: They will then say:  Woe for us. This is the Day of Judgement.
ayahs.translation: They will then say:  Woe for us. This is the Day of Judgement.

ayahs.text: Yes this is the Day of Final Decision that you used to deny as a lie.
ayahs.translation: Yes this is the Day of Final Decision that you used to deny as a lie.

ayahs.text: (Then will the command be given):  Muster all the wrong-doers and their spouses and the deities whom they used to serve
ayahs.translation: (Then will the command be given):  Muster all the wrong-doers and their spouses and the deities whom they used to serve

ayahs.text: apart from Allah and direct them to the path of Hell
ayahs.translation: apart from Allah and direct them to the path of Hell

ayahs.text: and detain them there; they will be called to account.
ayahs.translation: and detain them there; they will be called to account.

ayahs.text: How is it that you are not helping one another?
ayahs.translation: How is it that you are not helping one another?

ayahs.text: Indeed today they are surrendering themselves completely.
ayahs.translation: Indeed today they are surrendering themselves completely.

ayahs.text: They will then turn towards each other (and start wrangling).
ayahs.translation: They will then turn towards each other (and start wrangling).

ayahs.text: (The followers will say to their leaders):  You used to come to us from the right hand.
ayahs.translation: (The followers will say to their leaders):  You used to come to us from the right hand.

ayahs.text: They will say:  Nay you yourselves were not the ones who would believe.
ayahs.translation: They will say:  Nay you yourselves were not the ones who would believe.

ayahs.text: We had no power over you. You were a rebellious people
ayahs.translation: We had no power over you. You were a rebellious people

ayahs.text: and so we became deserving of the Word of our Lord that we shall be made to suffer chastisement.
ayahs.translation: and so we became deserving of the Word of our Lord that we shall be made to suffer chastisement.

ayahs.text: So we led you astray; we ourselves were strayed.
ayahs.translation: So we led you astray; we ourselves were strayed.

ayahs.text: On that Day they will all share the chastisement.
ayahs.translation: On that Day they will all share the chastisement.

ayahs.text: Thus do We treat the culprits.
ayahs.translation: Thus do We treat the culprits.

ayahs.text: Whenever it was said to them:  There is no true deity apart from Allah they waxed proud
ayahs.translation: Whenever it was said to them:  There is no true deity apart from Allah they waxed proud

ayahs.text: and said:  Shall we forsake our deities for the sake of a distracted poet?
ayahs.translation: and said:  Shall we forsake our deities for the sake of a distracted poet?

ayahs.text: (They say so although) he brought the Truth and confirmed the veracity of the Messengers.
ayahs.translation: (They say so although) he brought the Truth and confirmed the veracity of the Messengers.

ayahs.text: (They will be told):  You shall taste the grievous chastisement.
ayahs.translation: (They will be told):  You shall taste the grievous chastisement.

ayahs.text: You will only be recompensed according to your deeds.
ayahs.translation: You will only be recompensed according to your deeds.

ayahs.text: But Allah''s chosen servants (shall be spared this woeful end).
ayahs.translation: But Allah''s chosen servants (shall be spared this woeful end).

ayahs.text: For them awaits a known provision
ayahs.translation: For them awaits a known provision

ayahs.text: a variety of delicious fruits; and they shall be honoured
ayahs.translation: a variety of delicious fruits; and they shall be honoured

ayahs.text: in the Gardens of Bliss.
ayahs.translation: in the Gardens of Bliss.

ayahs.text: They will be seated upon couches set face to face;
ayahs.translation: They will be seated upon couches set face to face;

ayahs.text: a cup filled with wine from its springs will be passed around to them;
ayahs.translation: a cup filled with wine from its springs will be passed around to them;

ayahs.text: white sparkling (wine) a delight to the drinkers.
ayahs.translation: white sparkling (wine) a delight to the drinkers.
