ayahs.text: There will neither be any harm in it for their body nor will it intoxicate their mind.
ayahs.translation: There will neither be any harm in it for their body nor will it intoxicate their mind.

ayahs.text: Theirs shall be wide-eyed maidens with bashful restrained glances
ayahs.translation: Theirs shall be wide-eyed maidens with bashful restrained glances

ayahs.text: so delicate as the hidden peel under an egg''s shell.
ayahs.translation: so delicate as the hidden peel under an egg''s shell.

ayahs.text: Then some of them will turn to others and will ask each other.
ayahs.translation: Then some of them will turn to others and will ask each other.

ayahs.text: One of them will say:  I had a companion in the world
ayahs.translation: One of them will say:  I had a companion in the world

ayahs.text: who used to say: ''Are you also one of those who confirm the Truth (of life after death)?
ayahs.translation: who used to say: ''Are you also one of those who confirm the Truth (of life after death)?

ayahs.text: After we are dead and have become all dust and bones shall we still be requited?''
ayahs.translation: After we are dead and have become all dust and bones shall we still be requited?''

ayahs.text: He will say: ''Do you wish to know where he is now?''
ayahs.translation: He will say: ''Do you wish to know where he is now?''

ayahs.text: Then he will look downwards and will see him in the depths of Hell.
ayahs.translation: Then he will look downwards and will see him in the depths of Hell.

ayahs.text: He will say to him: ''By Allah you almost ruined me.
ayahs.translation: He will say to him: ''By Allah you almost ruined me.

ayahs.text: But for Allah''s favour I should be one of those who have been mustered here.
ayahs.translation: But for Allah''s favour I should be one of those who have been mustered here.

ayahs.text: So are we not going to die
ayahs.translation: So are we not going to die

ayahs.text: except for our first death? And shall we suffer no chastisement?''
ayahs.translation: except for our first death? And shall we suffer no chastisement?''

ayahs.text: Surely this is the supreme triumph.
ayahs.translation: Surely this is the supreme triumph.

ayahs.text: For the like of it should the workers work.
ayahs.translation: For the like of it should the workers work.

ayahs.text: Is this a better hospitality or the tree of al-Zaqqum?
ayahs.translation: Is this a better hospitality or the tree of al-Zaqqum?

ayahs.text: We have made this tree a trial for the wrong-doers.
ayahs.translation: We have made this tree a trial for the wrong-doers.

ayahs.text: It is a tree that grows in the nethermost part of Hell.
ayahs.translation: It is a tree that grows in the nethermost part of Hell.

ayahs.text: Its spathes are like the heads of satans.
ayahs.translation: Its spathes are like the heads of satans.

ayahs.text: (The people of Hell) will surely eat of it filling their bellies with it.
ayahs.translation: (The people of Hell) will surely eat of it filling their bellies with it.

ayahs.text: Then on top of it they will have a brew of boiling water.
ayahs.translation: Then on top of it they will have a brew of boiling water.

ayahs.text: Then their return will be to the same blazing Hell.
ayahs.translation: Then their return will be to the same blazing Hell.

ayahs.text: These are the ones who found their fathers steeped in error
ayahs.translation: These are the ones who found their fathers steeped in error

ayahs.text: and they are running in their footsteps.
ayahs.translation: and they are running in their footsteps.

ayahs.text: Before them a multitude of people of olden times had erred
ayahs.translation: Before them a multitude of people of olden times had erred

ayahs.text: and We had sent among them Messengers to warn them.
ayahs.translation: and We had sent among them Messengers to warn them.

ayahs.text: Observe then what was the end of those that had been warned
ayahs.translation: Observe then what was the end of those that had been warned

ayahs.text: except for the chosen servants of Allah?
ayahs.translation: except for the chosen servants of Allah?

ayahs.text: Noah had called upon Us (earlier). See how excellent We were in answering him!
ayahs.translation: Noah had called upon Us (earlier). See how excellent We were in answering him!

ayahs.text: We delivered him and his household from the great calamity;
ayahs.translation: We delivered him and his household from the great calamity;

ayahs.text: and made his offspring the only ones to survive
ayahs.translation: and made his offspring the only ones to survive

ayahs.text: and We established for him a good name among posterity.
ayahs.translation: and We established for him a good name among posterity.

ayahs.text: Peace be upon Noah among all the nations.
ayahs.translation: Peace be upon Noah among all the nations.

ayahs.text: Thus do We reward all those who do good.
ayahs.translation: Thus do We reward all those who do good.

ayahs.text: Surely he was one of Our truly believing servants.
ayahs.translation: Surely he was one of Our truly believing servants.

ayahs.text: Thereafter We caused the others to be drowned.
ayahs.translation: Thereafter We caused the others to be drowned.

ayahs.text: Abraham was on the self-same way (as Noah).
ayahs.translation: Abraham was on the self-same way (as Noah).

ayahs.text: When he came to his Lord with a pure heart
ayahs.translation: When he came to his Lord with a pure heart

ayahs.text: and said to his father and his people: Whom do you worship?
ayahs.translation: and said to his father and his people: Whom do you worship?

ayahs.text: Is it false deities that you want to serve rather than Allah?
ayahs.translation: Is it false deities that you want to serve rather than Allah?

ayahs.text: What do you think of the Lord of the whole Universe?
ayahs.translation: What do you think of the Lord of the whole Universe?

ayahs.text: Then he looked carefully at the stars
ayahs.translation: Then he looked carefully at the stars

ayahs.text: and said:  I am sick.
ayahs.translation: and said:  I am sick.

ayahs.text: So turning their backs they went away from him.
ayahs.translation: So turning their backs they went away from him.

ayahs.text: Then he went quietly to the (temple of the deities) and said:  What is the matter with you why do you not eat?
ayahs.translation: Then he went quietly to the (temple of the deities) and said:  What is the matter with you why do you not eat?

ayahs.text: What is the matter with you why do you not speak?
ayahs.translation: What is the matter with you why do you not speak?

ayahs.text: Then he turned upon them striking them with his right hand
ayahs.translation: Then he turned upon them striking them with his right hand

ayahs.text: whereupon people came to him running.
ayahs.translation: whereupon people came to him running.

ayahs.text: Abraham said to them:  Do you worship what you yourselves have carved with your own hands
ayahs.translation: Abraham said to them:  Do you worship what you yourselves have carved with your own hands

ayahs.text: while it is Allah Who has created you and all that you make?
ayahs.translation: while it is Allah Who has created you and all that you make?

ayahs.text: They spoke among themselves:  Build him a pyre and then throw him into the furnace.
ayahs.translation: They spoke among themselves:  Build him a pyre and then throw him into the furnace.

ayahs.text: They had contrived an evil plan against him but We abased them all.
ayahs.translation: They had contrived an evil plan against him but We abased them all.

ayahs.text: Abraham said: I am going to my Lord; He will guide me.
ayahs.translation: Abraham said: I am going to my Lord; He will guide me.

ayahs.text: Lord grant me a righteous son.
ayahs.translation: Lord grant me a righteous son.

ayahs.text: (In response to this prayer) We gave him the good news of a prudent boy;
ayahs.translation: (In response to this prayer) We gave him the good news of a prudent boy;

ayahs.text: and when he was old enough to go about and work with him (one day) Abraham said to him:  My son I see in my dream that I am slaughtering you. So consider (and tell me) what you think. He said:  Do as you are bidden. You will find me if Allah so wills among the steadfast.
ayahs.translation: and when he was old enough to go about and work with him (one day) Abraham said to him:  My son I see in my dream that I am slaughtering you. So consider (and tell me) what you think. He said:  Do as you are bidden. You will find me if Allah so wills among the steadfast.

ayahs.text: When both surrendered (to Allah''s command) and Abraham flung the son down on his forehead
ayahs.translation: When both surrendered (to Allah''s command) and Abraham flung the son down on his forehead

ayahs.text: We cried out: O Abraham
ayahs.translation: We cried out: O Abraham

ayahs.text: you have indeed fulfilled your dream. Thus do We reward the good-doers.
ayahs.translation: you have indeed fulfilled your dream. Thus do We reward the good-doers.

ayahs.text: This was indeed a plain trial.
ayahs.translation: This was indeed a plain trial.

ayahs.text: And We ransomed him with a mighty sacrifice
ayahs.translation: And We ransomed him with a mighty sacrifice

ayahs.text: and We preserved for him a good name among posterity.
ayahs.translation: and We preserved for him a good name among posterity.

ayahs.text: Peace be upon Abraham.
ayahs.translation: Peace be upon Abraham.

ayahs.text: Thus do We reward the good-doers.
ayahs.translation: Thus do We reward the good-doers.

ayahs.text: Surely he was one of Our believing servants.
ayahs.translation: Surely he was one of Our believing servants.

ayahs.text: And We gave him the good news of Isaac a Prophet and among the righteous ones.
ayahs.translation: And We gave him the good news of Isaac a Prophet and among the righteous ones.

ayahs.text: And We blessed him and Isaac. Among the offspring of the two some did good and some plainly wronged themselves.
ayahs.translation: And We blessed him and Isaac. Among the offspring of the two some did good and some plainly wronged themselves.

ayahs.text: Verily We bestowed Our favours on Moses and Aaron
ayahs.translation: Verily We bestowed Our favours on Moses and Aaron

ayahs.text: and We delivered both of them and their people from the great calamity.
ayahs.translation: and We delivered both of them and their people from the great calamity.

ayahs.text: We succoured them and they gained the upper hand (against their enemies).
ayahs.translation: We succoured them and they gained the upper hand (against their enemies).

ayahs.text: We granted them a Clear Book
ayahs.translation: We granted them a Clear Book

ayahs.text: and showed them the Straight Way
ayahs.translation: and showed them the Straight Way

ayahs.text: and preserved for them a good name among posterity.
ayahs.translation: and preserved for them a good name among posterity.

ayahs.text: Peace be upon Moses and Aaron.
ayahs.translation: Peace be upon Moses and Aaron.

ayahs.text: Thus do We reward the good-doers.
ayahs.translation: Thus do We reward the good-doers.

ayahs.text: Surely both of them were among Our believing servants.
ayahs.translation: Surely both of them were among Our believing servants.

ayahs.text: Surely Elias too was among the Messengers.
ayahs.translation: Surely Elias too was among the Messengers.

ayahs.text: (Call to mind) when he said to his people:  Will you not fear Allah?
ayahs.translation: (Call to mind) when he said to his people:  Will you not fear Allah?

ayahs.text: Do you call upon Baal and forsake the Best of the Creators?
ayahs.translation: Do you call upon Baal and forsake the Best of the Creators?

ayahs.text: Allah is your Lord and the Lord of your ancestors of yore.
ayahs.translation: Allah is your Lord and the Lord of your ancestors of yore.

ayahs.text: But they denounced him as a liar so they will surely be arraigned (for punishment)
ayahs.translation: But they denounced him as a liar so they will surely be arraigned (for punishment)

ayahs.text: except Allah''s chosen servants.
ayahs.translation: except Allah''s chosen servants.

ayahs.text: We preserved a good name for him among posterity.
ayahs.translation: We preserved a good name for him among posterity.

ayahs.text: Peace be upon Elias.
ayahs.translation: Peace be upon Elias.

ayahs.text: Thus do We reward the good-doers.
ayahs.translation: Thus do We reward the good-doers.

ayahs.text: He was one of Our believing servants.
ayahs.translation: He was one of Our believing servants.

ayahs.text: And Lot too was one of the Messengers.
ayahs.translation: And Lot too was one of the Messengers.

ayahs.text: (Call to mind) when We delivered him and all his kinsfolk
ayahs.translation: (Call to mind) when We delivered him and all his kinsfolk

ayahs.text: except for an old woman who was among those that stayed behind.
ayahs.translation: except for an old woman who was among those that stayed behind.

ayahs.text: Then We utterly destroyed the rest of them.
ayahs.translation: Then We utterly destroyed the rest of them.

ayahs.text: You pass by their desolate habitations in the morning
ayahs.translation: You pass by their desolate habitations in the morning

ayahs.text: and at night. Do you still not understand?
ayahs.translation: and at night. Do you still not understand?

ayahs.text: And Jonah too was one of the Messengers.
ayahs.translation: And Jonah too was one of the Messengers.

ayahs.text: Call to mind when he fled to the laden ship
ayahs.translation: Call to mind when he fled to the laden ship

ayahs.text: cast lots and was among the losers.
ayahs.translation: cast lots and was among the losers.

ayahs.text: Then a fish swallowed him and he was blameworthy.
ayahs.translation: Then a fish swallowed him and he was blameworthy.

ayahs.text: Had he not been one of those who glorify Allah
ayahs.translation: Had he not been one of those who glorify Allah

ayahs.text: he would certainly have remained in its belly till the Day of Resurrection.
ayahs.translation: he would certainly have remained in its belly till the Day of Resurrection.

ayahs.text: But We threw him on a wide bare tract of land while he was ill;
ayahs.translation: But We threw him on a wide bare tract of land while he was ill;

ayahs.text: and caused a gourd tree to grow over him
ayahs.translation: and caused a gourd tree to grow over him

ayahs.text: and We sent him forth to a nation of a hundred thousand or more
ayahs.translation: and We sent him forth to a nation of a hundred thousand or more

ayahs.text: and they believed. So We let them enjoy life for a while.
ayahs.translation: and they believed. So We let them enjoy life for a while.

ayahs.text: So ask their opinion: (Are you convinced) that your Lord should have daughters and you should have sons?
ayahs.translation: So ask their opinion: (Are you convinced) that your Lord should have daughters and you should have sons?

ayahs.text: Did We create the angels as females the while they witnessed?
ayahs.translation: Did We create the angels as females the while they witnessed?

ayahs.text: Behold it is one of their fabrications that they say:
ayahs.translation: Behold it is one of their fabrications that they say:

ayahs.text: Allah has begotten.  They are liars!
ayahs.translation: Allah has begotten.  They are liars!

ayahs.text: Did He choose daughters rather than sons?
ayahs.translation: Did He choose daughters rather than sons?

ayahs.text: What is the matter with you that you make such strange judgements?
ayahs.translation: What is the matter with you that you make such strange judgements?

ayahs.text: Will you then not take heed?
ayahs.translation: Will you then not take heed?

ayahs.text: Do you have any clear authority for such claims?
ayahs.translation: Do you have any clear authority for such claims?

ayahs.text: Bring your Book if you are truthful.
ayahs.translation: Bring your Book if you are truthful.

ayahs.text: They have established a kinship between Allah and the angels;and the angels know well that these people will be arraigned (as culprits).
ayahs.translation: They have established a kinship between Allah and the angels;and the angels know well that these people will be arraigned (as culprits).

ayahs.text: (They say):  Exalted be Allah above what they attribute to Him
ayahs.translation: (They say):  Exalted be Allah above what they attribute to Him

ayahs.text: all of them except the chosen servants of Allah.
ayahs.translation: all of them except the chosen servants of Allah.

ayahs.text: So you and your deities
ayahs.translation: So you and your deities

ayahs.text: shall not be able to tempt anyone away from Allah
ayahs.translation: shall not be able to tempt anyone away from Allah

ayahs.text: except him who shall roast in the Blazing Fire.
ayahs.translation: except him who shall roast in the Blazing Fire.

ayahs.text: As for us there is none but has an appointed station.
ayahs.translation: As for us there is none but has an appointed station.

ayahs.text: Verily we range ourselves in rows (as humble servants)
ayahs.translation: Verily we range ourselves in rows (as humble servants)

ayahs.text: and we are of those who glorify Allah.
ayahs.translation: and we are of those who glorify Allah.

ayahs.text: They used to say before:
ayahs.translation: They used to say before:

ayahs.text: If only we had the Reminder which had been granted to the people of yore
ayahs.translation: If only we had the Reminder which had been granted to the people of yore

ayahs.text: we would surely have been Allah''s chosen servants.
ayahs.translation: we would surely have been Allah''s chosen servants.

ayahs.text: But when it came to them they rejected it. They shall soon come to know (the end of such an attitude).
ayahs.translation: But when it came to them they rejected it. They shall soon come to know (the end of such an attitude).

ayahs.text: We have already given Our promise to Our Messengers
ayahs.translation: We have already given Our promise to Our Messengers

ayahs.text: that they shall certainly be succoured
ayahs.translation: that they shall certainly be succoured

ayahs.text: and that Our hosts shall triumph.
ayahs.translation: and that Our hosts shall triumph.

ayahs.text: So (O Prophet) leave them alone for a while
ayahs.translation: So (O Prophet) leave them alone for a while

ayahs.text: and see and soon they too shall see.
ayahs.translation: and see and soon they too shall see.

ayahs.text: Do they seek to hasten Our chastisement?
ayahs.translation: Do they seek to hasten Our chastisement?

ayahs.text: When that chastisement will descend upon their courtyard evil shall that Day be for those who had been warned.
ayahs.translation: When that chastisement will descend upon their courtyard evil shall that Day be for those who had been warned.

ayahs.text: Leave them alone for a while
ayahs.translation: Leave them alone for a while

ayahs.text: and see; and they too shall soon see.
ayahs.translation: and see; and they too shall soon see.

ayahs.text: Exalted be your Lord the Lord of Glory above what they attribute to Him
ayahs.translation: Exalted be your Lord the Lord of Glory above what they attribute to Him

ayahs.text: and peace be upon the Messengers
ayahs.translation: and peace be upon the Messengers

ayahs.text: and all praise be to Allah the Lord of the Universe.
ayahs.translation: and all praise be to Allah the Lord of the Universe.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Sad and by the Qur''an full of exhortation!
verses.translation: Sad and by the Qur''an full of exhortation!

verses.text: Nay but the unbelievers are steeped in arrogance and stubborn defiance.
verses.translation: Nay but the unbelievers are steeped in arrogance and stubborn defiance.

verses.text: How many a nation did We destroy before them! (When they approached their doom) they cried out (for deliverance) but the time for deliverance was already past.
verses.translation: How many a nation did We destroy before them! (When they approached their doom) they cried out (for deliverance) but the time for deliverance was already past.

verses.text: They wondered that a warner had come to them from among themselves and the deniers of the Truth said:  This is a sorcerer and a big liar.
verses.translation: They wondered that a warner had come to them from among themselves and the deniers of the Truth said:  This is a sorcerer and a big liar.

verses.text: Has he made the gods one single God? This is truly astounding.
verses.translation: Has he made the gods one single God? This is truly astounding.

verses.text: And the elders among them went forth saying:  Go ahead and be steadfast in adhering to your deities. What is being said is with a design.
verses.translation: And the elders among them went forth saying:  Go ahead and be steadfast in adhering to your deities. What is being said is with a design.

verses.text: We have not heard this in the religious community close to our time.This is nothing but a fabrication.
verses.translation: We have not heard this in the religious community close to our time.This is nothing but a fabrication.

verses.text: Has this Exhortation been sent down among us only to him to the exclusion of all others?  Nay they are in doubt regarding My Exhortation and are saying all this because they have not yet had any taste of My chastisement.
verses.translation: Has this Exhortation been sent down among us only to him to the exclusion of all others?  Nay they are in doubt regarding My Exhortation and are saying all this because they have not yet had any taste of My chastisement.

verses.text: Do they possess the treasures of your Lord the Most Mighty the Great Bestower?
verses.translation: Do they possess the treasures of your Lord the Most Mighty the Great Bestower?

verses.text: Or do they possess the dominion of the heavens and the earth and of all that is in between them? If so let them ascend the heights of the realm of causation and see!
verses.translation: Or do they possess the dominion of the heavens and the earth and of all that is in between them? If so let them ascend the heights of the realm of causation and see!

verses.text: This is only a small army out of the several armies that will suffer defeat here.
verses.translation: This is only a small army out of the several armies that will suffer defeat here.

verses.text: Before them the people of Noah Ad and Pharaoh of the tent-pegs gave the lie (to the Messengers)
verses.translation: Before them the people of Noah Ad and Pharaoh of the tent-pegs gave the lie (to the Messengers)

verses.text: and so did Thamud and the people of Lot and the people of Aykah. These were all leagued together.
verses.translation: and so did Thamud and the people of Lot and the people of Aykah. These were all leagued together.

verses.text: Each of them gave the lie to Messengers and My decree of chastisement came upon them.
verses.translation: Each of them gave the lie to Messengers and My decree of chastisement came upon them.

verses.text: They are waiting for nothing except a single Cry after which there will be no second Cry.
verses.translation: They are waiting for nothing except a single Cry after which there will be no second Cry.

verses.text: They say:  Our Lord hasten to us our share (of chastisement) before the Day of Reckoning.
verses.translation: They say:  Our Lord hasten to us our share (of chastisement) before the Day of Reckoning.

verses.text: (O Prophet) bear with patience what they say and call to mind Our servant David who was endowed with great strength and who constantly turned (to Allah).
verses.translation: (O Prophet) bear with patience what they say and call to mind Our servant David who was endowed with great strength and who constantly turned (to Allah).

verses.text: With him We had subjected the mountains that they join him in celebrating Allah''s glory evening and morning
verses.translation: With him We had subjected the mountains that they join him in celebrating Allah''s glory evening and morning

verses.text: and the birds too in their flocks and turn again and again to celebrating Allah''s glory.
verses.translation: and the birds too in their flocks and turn again and again to celebrating Allah''s glory.

verses.text: And We strengthened his kingdom and endowed him with wisdom and decisive judgement.
verses.translation: And We strengthened his kingdom and endowed him with wisdom and decisive judgement.

verses.text: Has the story of the litigants reached you - of those who entered his private chambers by climbing over the wall?
verses.translation: Has the story of the litigants reached you - of those who entered his private chambers by climbing over the wall?

verses.text: As they came upon David - and he was frightened of them - they said:  Be not afraid. We are just two litigants: one of us has committed excess against the other. So judge rightly between us and be not unjust; and guide us to the Right Way.
verses.translation: As they came upon David - and he was frightened of them - they said:  Be not afraid. We are just two litigants: one of us has committed excess against the other. So judge rightly between us and be not unjust; and guide us to the Right Way.

verses.text: Behold this is my brother; he has ninety-nine ewes and I have only one ewe.  And yet he said:  Give her into my charge and he got the better of me in argument.
verses.translation: Behold this is my brother; he has ninety-nine ewes and I have only one ewe.  And yet he said:  Give her into my charge and he got the better of me in argument.

verses.text: David said:  He has certainly wronged you in seeking to add your ewe to his ewes; and indeed many who live together commit excesses one to the other except those that believe and act righteously; and they are but few.  (While so saying) David realized that it is We Who have put him to test; therefore he sought the forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing and penitently turning (to Him).
verses.translation: David said:  He has certainly wronged you in seeking to add your ewe to his ewes; and indeed many who live together commit excesses one to the other except those that believe and act righteously; and they are but few.  (While so saying) David realized that it is We Who have put him to test; therefore he sought the forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing and penitently turning (to Him).

verses.text: Thereupon We forgave him his shortcoming and indeed (an exalted position of) nearness awaits him and an excellent resort.
verses.translation: Thereupon We forgave him his shortcoming and indeed (an exalted position of) nearness awaits him and an excellent resort.

verses.text: (We said to him):  O David We have appointed you vicegerent on earth. Therefore rule among people with justice and do not follow (your) desire lest it should lead you astray from Allah''s Path. Allah''s severe chastisement awaits those who stray away from Allah''s Path for they had forgotten the Day of Reckoning.
verses.translation: (We said to him):  O David We have appointed you vicegerent on earth. Therefore rule among people with justice and do not follow (your) desire lest it should lead you astray from Allah''s Path. Allah''s severe chastisement awaits those who stray away from Allah''s Path for they had forgotten the Day of Reckoning.

verses.text: We did not create this heaven and earth and all that lies between them in vain. That is the fancy of those who denied the Truth. So woe from the Fire to all who deny the Truth.
verses.translation: We did not create this heaven and earth and all that lies between them in vain. That is the fancy of those who denied the Truth. So woe from the Fire to all who deny the Truth.

verses.text: Shall We then treat alike those that believe and act righteously and those that create mischief on earth? Or treat alike the God-fearing and the wicked?
verses.translation: Shall We then treat alike those that believe and act righteously and those that create mischief on earth? Or treat alike the God-fearing and the wicked?

verses.text: This is the Blessed Book that We have revealed to you (O Muhammad) that people with understanding may reflect over its verses and those with understanding derive a lesson.
verses.translation: This is the Blessed Book that We have revealed to you (O Muhammad) that people with understanding may reflect over its verses and those with understanding derive a lesson.

verses.text: We bestowed upon David (an illustrious son) Solomon. How excellent a servant (of Ours he was)! Indeed he constantly turned to Us in devotion.
verses.translation: We bestowed upon David (an illustrious son) Solomon. How excellent a servant (of Ours he was)! Indeed he constantly turned to Us in devotion.

verses.text: And when one evening well-trained and running horses of noble breed were brought to him
verses.translation: And when one evening well-trained and running horses of noble breed were brought to him

verses.text: he said:  Lo! I have come to love this wealth on account of the remembrance of my Lord.  And when the horses disappeared
verses.translation: he said:  Lo! I have come to love this wealth on account of the remembrance of my Lord.  And when the horses disappeared

verses.text: (he ordered):  Bring these horses back to me and then he began to gently stroke their shanks and necks.
verses.translation: (he ordered):  Bring these horses back to me and then he began to gently stroke their shanks and necks.

verses.text: Surely We put Solomon to the test and cast upon his throne a mere body. Thereupon he penitently turned (to Us).
verses.translation: Surely We put Solomon to the test and cast upon his throne a mere body. Thereupon he penitently turned (to Us).

verses.text: He said:  My Lord forgive me and bestow upon me a kingdom such as none other after me will deserve. Surely You are the Bounteous Giver.
verses.translation: He said:  My Lord forgive me and bestow upon me a kingdom such as none other after me will deserve. Surely You are the Bounteous Giver.

verses.text: We subjected the wind to him so that it blew gently at his bidding wherever he directed it
verses.translation: We subjected the wind to him so that it blew gently at his bidding wherever he directed it

verses.text: and We also subjected the devils to him - all kinds of builders and divers;
verses.translation: and We also subjected the devils to him - all kinds of builders and divers;

verses.text: and others that were bound with chains.
verses.translation: and others that were bound with chains.

verses.text: This is Our bestowal. So give or withhold as you wish without account.
verses.translation: This is Our bestowal. So give or withhold as you wish without account.

verses.text: Indeed an exalted position of nearness awaits him and an excellent resort.
verses.translation: Indeed an exalted position of nearness awaits him and an excellent resort.

verses.text: And remember Our servant Job: when he cried to his Lord:  Behold Satan has afflicted me with much hardship and suffering.
verses.translation: And remember Our servant Job: when he cried to his Lord:  Behold Satan has afflicted me with much hardship and suffering.

verses.text: (We commanded him):  Stamp your foot on earth and here is cool water to wash with and to drink.
verses.translation: (We commanded him):  Stamp your foot on earth and here is cool water to wash with and to drink.

verses.text: And We granted to him his family and also the like of them as a mercy from Us and as a reminder to people of understanding
verses.translation: And We granted to him his family and also the like of them as a mercy from Us and as a reminder to people of understanding

verses.text: (and We said to him):  Take in your hand a bundle of rushes and strike with it and do not break your oath. Indeed We found him steadfast. How excellent a servant (of Ours) he was. Indeed he constantly turned (to his Lord).
verses.translation: (and We said to him):  Take in your hand a bundle of rushes and strike with it and do not break your oath. Indeed We found him steadfast. How excellent a servant (of Ours) he was. Indeed he constantly turned (to his Lord).

verses.text: And remember Our servants - Abraham Isaac and Jacob - they were endowed with great strength and vision.
verses.translation: And remember Our servants - Abraham Isaac and Jacob - they were endowed with great strength and vision.

verses.text: Verily We exalted them in consideration of a sterling quality: their remembrance of the Abode of the Hereafter.
verses.translation: Verily We exalted them in consideration of a sterling quality: their remembrance of the Abode of the Hereafter.

verses.text: In Our sight they are among the chosen and excellent ones.
verses.translation: In Our sight they are among the chosen and excellent ones.

verses.text: And remember Ishmael Elisha and Dhu al-Kifl.All were of the best.
verses.translation: And remember Ishmael Elisha and Dhu al-Kifl.All were of the best.

verses.text: This was a remembrance. An excellent retreat awaits the God-fearing
verses.translation: This was a remembrance. An excellent retreat awaits the God-fearing

verses.text: - everlasting Gardens with gates wide open for them
verses.translation: - everlasting Gardens with gates wide open for them

verses.text: wherein they shall recline wherein they shall ask for abundant fruit and drinks
verses.translation: wherein they shall recline wherein they shall ask for abundant fruit and drinks

verses.text: and wherein there shall be with them well-matched bashful mates.
verses.translation: and wherein there shall be with them well-matched bashful mates.

verses.text: All this is what you are promised for the Day of Judgement.
verses.translation: All this is what you are promised for the Day of Judgement.

verses.text: This is Our provision for you never to end.
verses.translation: This is Our provision for you never to end.

verses.text: All this (is for the God-fearing). But for the transgressors an evil resort awaits them -
verses.translation: All this (is for the God-fearing). But for the transgressors an evil resort awaits them -

verses.text: Hell where they will be roasted. An evil place to dwell!
verses.translation: Hell where they will be roasted. An evil place to dwell!

verses.text: All this (is for them); so let them taste boiling water and pus
verses.translation: All this (is for them); so let them taste boiling water and pus

verses.text: and other sufferings of the kind.
verses.translation: and other sufferings of the kind.

verses.text: (Observing their followers advancing to Hell they will say among themselves:  This is a troop rushing in to you. There is no welcome for them. They are destined to roast in the Fire.
verses.translation: (Observing their followers advancing to Hell they will say among themselves:  This is a troop rushing in to you. There is no welcome for them. They are destined to roast in the Fire.

verses.text: They will reply:  Rather no welcome to you. (You will roast in Hell.) It is you who led us to this end. What an evil resort!
verses.translation: They will reply:  Rather no welcome to you. (You will roast in Hell.) It is you who led us to this end. What an evil resort!

verses.text: They will say:  Our Lord give twofold punishment in the Fire to him who has led us to this.
verses.translation: They will say:  Our Lord give twofold punishment in the Fire to him who has led us to this.

verses.text: They will say to one another:  But why do not we see those whom we considered him among the wicked?
verses.translation: They will say to one another:  But why do not we see those whom we considered him among the wicked?

verses.text: Is it that we mistakenly made fun of them; or have they disappeared from our sight?
verses.translation: Is it that we mistakenly made fun of them; or have they disappeared from our sight?

verses.text: Verily all this is true. This is how the inmates of the Fire will dispute among themselves.
verses.translation: Verily all this is true. This is how the inmates of the Fire will dispute among themselves.

verses.text: Tell them (O Prophet): I am nothing but a warner. There is no deity but Allah the One the Supreme
verses.translation: Tell them (O Prophet): I am nothing but a warner. There is no deity but Allah the One the Supreme

verses.text: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is in between them the Most Mighty the Most Forgiving.
verses.translation: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is in between them the Most Mighty the Most Forgiving.

verses.text: Say:  This is a tiding of tremendous import
verses.translation: Say:  This is a tiding of tremendous import

verses.text: from which you are turning away.
verses.translation: from which you are turning away.

verses.text: (Tell them):  I had no knowledge of the High Council when they were disputing.
verses.translation: (Tell them):  I had no knowledge of the High Council when they were disputing.

verses.text: I am told (about matters) by means of revelation only because I am a clear warner.
verses.translation: I am told (about matters) by means of revelation only because I am a clear warner.

verses.text: When your Lord said to the angels: Verily I am creating a human being from clay.
verses.translation: When your Lord said to the angels: Verily I am creating a human being from clay.

verses.text: After I have created him and breathed into him of My spirit fall you down prostrating yourselves to him.
verses.translation: After I have created him and breathed into him of My spirit fall you down prostrating yourselves to him.

verses.text: Then the angels all of them prostrated themselves before Adam
verses.translation: Then the angels all of them prostrated themselves before Adam

verses.text: except Iblis. He waxed proud and became one of the unbelievers.
verses.translation: except Iblis. He waxed proud and became one of the unbelievers.

verses.text: The Lord said:  O Iblis what prevented you from prostrating yourself before him whom I created of My Two Hands. Are you waxing proud or fancy yourself to be too exalted?
verses.translation: The Lord said:  O Iblis what prevented you from prostrating yourself before him whom I created of My Two Hands. Are you waxing proud or fancy yourself to be too exalted?

verses.text: He replied:  I am nobler than he. You created me from fire and created him from clay.
verses.translation: He replied:  I am nobler than he. You created me from fire and created him from clay.

verses.text: He said:  Get out of here; surely you are accursed
verses.translation: He said:  Get out of here; surely you are accursed

verses.text: and My curse shall remain upon you till the Day of Resurrection.
verses.translation: and My curse shall remain upon you till the Day of Resurrection.

verses.text: Satan said:  My Lord then grant me respite till the Day that they are raised up.
verses.translation: Satan said:  My Lord then grant me respite till the Day that they are raised up.

verses.text: He said:  You are of those who have been granted respite
verses.translation: He said:  You are of those who have been granted respite

verses.text: till the Day whose Hour I know.
verses.translation: till the Day whose Hour I know.

verses.text: (Iblis) said:  By Your glory I shall mislead them all
verses.translation: (Iblis) said:  By Your glory I shall mislead them all

verses.text: except those of Your servants the chosen ones from amongst them.
verses.translation: except those of Your servants the chosen ones from amongst them.

verses.text: He (i.e. Allah) said:  This is the Truth - and I only speak the Truth -
verses.translation: He (i.e. Allah) said:  This is the Truth - and I only speak the Truth -

verses.text: I will certainly fill the Gehenna with you and with all those among them who follow you.
verses.translation: I will certainly fill the Gehenna with you and with all those among them who follow you.

verses.text: (O Prophet) tell them:  I do not ask you for any recompense for the performance of this task; nor am I given to affectation.
verses.translation: (O Prophet) tell them:  I do not ask you for any recompense for the performance of this task; nor am I given to affectation.

verses.text: This is nothing but an Admonition for all people the world over.
verses.translation: This is nothing but an Admonition for all people the world over.

verses.text: You will know the truth of the matter after a while.
verses.translation: You will know the truth of the matter after a while.

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: Sad and by the Qur''an full of exhortation!
ayahs.translation: Sad and by the Qur''an full of exhortation!

ayahs.text: Nay but the unbelievers are steeped in arrogance and stubborn defiance.
ayahs.translation: Nay but the unbelievers are steeped in arrogance and stubborn defiance.

ayahs.text: How many a nation did We destroy before them! (When they approached their doom) they cried out (for deliverance) but the time for deliverance was already past.
ayahs.translation: How many a nation did We destroy before them! (When they approached their doom) they cried out (for deliverance) but the time for deliverance was already past.

ayahs.text: They wondered that a warner had come to them from among themselves and the deniers of the Truth said:  This is a sorcerer and a big liar.
ayahs.translation: They wondered that a warner had come to them from among themselves and the deniers of the Truth said:  This is a sorcerer and a big liar.

ayahs.text: Has he made the gods one single God? This is truly astounding.
ayahs.translation: Has he made the gods one single God? This is truly astounding.

ayahs.text: And the elders among them went forth saying:  Go ahead and be steadfast in adhering to your deities. What is being said is with a design.
ayahs.translation: And the elders among them went forth saying:  Go ahead and be steadfast in adhering to your deities. What is being said is with a design.

ayahs.text: We have not heard this in the religious community close to our time.This is nothing but a fabrication.
ayahs.translation: We have not heard this in the religious community close to our time.This is nothing but a fabrication.

ayahs.text: Has this Exhortation been sent down among us only to him to the exclusion of all others?  Nay they are in doubt regarding My Exhortation and are saying all this because they have not yet had any taste of My chastisement.
ayahs.translation: Has this Exhortation been sent down among us only to him to the exclusion of all others?  Nay they are in doubt regarding My Exhortation and are saying all this because they have not yet had any taste of My chastisement.

ayahs.text: Do they possess the treasures of your Lord the Most Mighty the Great Bestower?
ayahs.translation: Do they possess the treasures of your Lord the Most Mighty the Great Bestower?

ayahs.text: Or do they possess the dominion of the heavens and the earth and of all that is in between them? If so let them ascend the heights of the realm of causation and see!
ayahs.translation: Or do they possess the dominion of the heavens and the earth and of all that is in between them? If so let them ascend the heights of the realm of causation and see!

ayahs.text: This is only a small army out of the several armies that will suffer defeat here.
ayahs.translation: This is only a small army out of the several armies that will suffer defeat here.

ayahs.text: Before them the people of Noah Ad and Pharaoh of the tent-pegs gave the lie (to the Messengers)
ayahs.translation: Before them the people of Noah Ad and Pharaoh of the tent-pegs gave the lie (to the Messengers)

ayahs.text: and so did Thamud and the people of Lot and the people of Aykah. These were all leagued together.
ayahs.translation: and so did Thamud and the people of Lot and the people of Aykah. These were all leagued together.

ayahs.text: Each of them gave the lie to Messengers and My decree of chastisement came upon them.
ayahs.translation: Each of them gave the lie to Messengers and My decree of chastisement came upon them.

ayahs.text: They are waiting for nothing except a single Cry after which there will be no second Cry.
ayahs.translation: They are waiting for nothing except a single Cry after which there will be no second Cry.

ayahs.text: They say:  Our Lord hasten to us our share (of chastisement) before the Day of Reckoning.
ayahs.translation: They say:  Our Lord hasten to us our share (of chastisement) before the Day of Reckoning.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) bear with patience what they say and call to mind Our servant David who was endowed with great strength and who constantly turned (to Allah).
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) bear with patience what they say and call to mind Our servant David who was endowed with great strength and who constantly turned (to Allah).

ayahs.text: With him We had subjected the mountains that they join him in celebrating Allah''s glory evening and morning
ayahs.translation: With him We had subjected the mountains that they join him in celebrating Allah''s glory evening and morning

ayahs.text: and the birds too in their flocks and turn again and again to celebrating Allah''s glory.
ayahs.translation: and the birds too in their flocks and turn again and again to celebrating Allah''s glory.

ayahs.text: And We strengthened his kingdom and endowed him with wisdom and decisive judgement.
ayahs.translation: And We strengthened his kingdom and endowed him with wisdom and decisive judgement.

ayahs.text: Has the story of the litigants reached you - of those who entered his private chambers by climbing over the wall?
ayahs.translation: Has the story of the litigants reached you - of those who entered his private chambers by climbing over the wall?

ayahs.text: As they came upon David - and he was frightened of them - they said:  Be not afraid. We are just two litigants: one of us has committed excess against the other. So judge rightly between us and be not unjust; and guide us to the Right Way.
ayahs.translation: As they came upon David - and he was frightened of them - they said:  Be not afraid. We are just two litigants: one of us has committed excess against the other. So judge rightly between us and be not unjust; and guide us to the Right Way.

ayahs.text: Behold this is my brother; he has ninety-nine ewes and I have only one ewe.  And yet he said:  Give her into my charge and he got the better of me in argument.
ayahs.translation: Behold this is my brother; he has ninety-nine ewes and I have only one ewe.  And yet he said:  Give her into my charge and he got the better of me in argument.

ayahs.text: David said:  He has certainly wronged you in seeking to add your ewe to his ewes; and indeed many who live together commit excesses one to the other except those that believe and act righteously; and they are but few.  (While so saying) David realized that it is We Who have put him to test; therefore he sought the forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing and penitently turning (to Him).
ayahs.translation: David said:  He has certainly wronged you in seeking to add your ewe to his ewes; and indeed many who live together commit excesses one to the other except those that believe and act righteously; and they are but few.  (While so saying) David realized that it is We Who have put him to test; therefore he sought the forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing and penitently turning (to Him).

ayahs.text: Thereupon We forgave him his shortcoming and indeed (an exalted position of) nearness awaits him and an excellent resort.
ayahs.translation: Thereupon We forgave him his shortcoming and indeed (an exalted position of) nearness awaits him and an excellent resort.

ayahs.text: (We said to him):  O David We have appointed you vicegerent on earth. Therefore rule among people with justice and do not follow (your) desire lest it should lead you astray from Allah''s Path. Allah''s severe chastisement awaits those who stray away from Allah''s Path for they had forgotten the Day of Reckoning.
ayahs.translation: (We said to him):  O David We have appointed you vicegerent on earth. Therefore rule among people with justice and do not follow (your) desire lest it should lead you astray from Allah''s Path. Allah''s severe chastisement awaits those who stray away from Allah''s Path for they had forgotten the Day of Reckoning.

ayahs.text: We did not create this heaven and earth and all that lies between them in vain. That is the fancy of those who denied the Truth. So woe from the Fire to all who deny the Truth.
ayahs.translation: We did not create this heaven and earth and all that lies between them in vain. That is the fancy of those who denied the Truth. So woe from the Fire to all who deny the Truth.

ayahs.text: Shall We then treat alike those that believe and act righteously and those that create mischief on earth? Or treat alike the God-fearing and the wicked?
ayahs.translation: Shall We then treat alike those that believe and act righteously and those that create mischief on earth? Or treat alike the God-fearing and the wicked?

ayahs.text: This is the Blessed Book that We have revealed to you (O Muhammad) that people with understanding may reflect over its verses and those with understanding derive a lesson.
ayahs.translation: This is the Blessed Book that We have revealed to you (O Muhammad) that people with understanding may reflect over its verses and those with understanding derive a lesson.

ayahs.text: We bestowed upon David (an illustrious son) Solomon. How excellent a servant (of Ours he was)! Indeed he constantly turned to Us in devotion.
ayahs.translation: We bestowed upon David (an illustrious son) Solomon. How excellent a servant (of Ours he was)! Indeed he constantly turned to Us in devotion.

ayahs.text: And when one evening well-trained and running horses of noble breed were brought to him
ayahs.translation: And when one evening well-trained and running horses of noble breed were brought to him

ayahs.text: he said:  Lo! I have come to love this wealth on account of the remembrance of my Lord.  And when the horses disappeared
ayahs.translation: he said:  Lo! I have come to love this wealth on account of the remembrance of my Lord.  And when the horses disappeared

ayahs.text: (he ordered):  Bring these horses back to me and then he began to gently stroke their shanks and necks.
ayahs.translation: (he ordered):  Bring these horses back to me and then he began to gently stroke their shanks and necks.

ayahs.text: Surely We put Solomon to the test and cast upon his throne a mere body. Thereupon he penitently turned (to Us).
ayahs.translation: Surely We put Solomon to the test and cast upon his throne a mere body. Thereupon he penitently turned (to Us).

ayahs.text: He said:  My Lord forgive me and bestow upon me a kingdom such as none other after me will deserve. Surely You are the Bounteous Giver.
ayahs.translation: He said:  My Lord forgive me and bestow upon me a kingdom such as none other after me will deserve. Surely You are the Bounteous Giver.

ayahs.text: We subjected the wind to him so that it blew gently at his bidding wherever he directed it
ayahs.translation: We subjected the wind to him so that it blew gently at his bidding wherever he directed it

ayahs.text: and We also subjected the devils to him - all kinds of builders and divers;
ayahs.translation: and We also subjected the devils to him - all kinds of builders and divers;

ayahs.text: and others that were bound with chains.
ayahs.translation: and others that were bound with chains.

ayahs.text: This is Our bestowal. So give or withhold as you wish without account.
ayahs.translation: This is Our bestowal. So give or withhold as you wish without account.

ayahs.text: Indeed an exalted position of nearness awaits him and an excellent resort.
ayahs.translation: Indeed an exalted position of nearness awaits him and an excellent resort.

ayahs.text: And remember Our servant Job: when he cried to his Lord:  Behold Satan has afflicted me with much hardship and suffering.
ayahs.translation: And remember Our servant Job: when he cried to his Lord:  Behold Satan has afflicted me with much hardship and suffering.

ayahs.text: (We commanded him):  Stamp your foot on earth and here is cool water to wash with and to drink.
ayahs.translation: (We commanded him):  Stamp your foot on earth and here is cool water to wash with and to drink.

ayahs.text: And We granted to him his family and also the like of them as a mercy from Us and as a reminder to people of understanding
ayahs.translation: And We granted to him his family and also the like of them as a mercy from Us and as a reminder to people of understanding

ayahs.text: (and We said to him):  Take in your hand a bundle of rushes and strike with it and do not break your oath. Indeed We found him steadfast. How excellent a servant (of Ours) he was. Indeed he constantly turned (to his Lord).
ayahs.translation: (and We said to him):  Take in your hand a bundle of rushes and strike with it and do not break your oath. Indeed We found him steadfast. How excellent a servant (of Ours) he was. Indeed he constantly turned (to his Lord).

ayahs.text: And remember Our servants - Abraham Isaac and Jacob - they were endowed with great strength and vision.
ayahs.translation: And remember Our servants - Abraham Isaac and Jacob - they were endowed with great strength and vision.

ayahs.text: Verily We exalted them in consideration of a sterling quality: their remembrance of the Abode of the Hereafter.
ayahs.translation: Verily We exalted them in consideration of a sterling quality: their remembrance of the Abode of the Hereafter.

ayahs.text: In Our sight they are among the chosen and excellent ones.
ayahs.translation: In Our sight they are among the chosen and excellent ones.

ayahs.text: And remember Ishmael Elisha and Dhu al-Kifl.All were of the best.
ayahs.translation: And remember Ishmael Elisha and Dhu al-Kifl.All were of the best.

ayahs.text: This was a remembrance. An excellent retreat awaits the God-fearing
ayahs.translation: This was a remembrance. An excellent retreat awaits the God-fearing

ayahs.text: - everlasting Gardens with gates wide open for them
ayahs.translation: - everlasting Gardens with gates wide open for them

ayahs.text: wherein they shall recline wherein they shall ask for abundant fruit and drinks
ayahs.translation: wherein they shall recline wherein they shall ask for abundant fruit and drinks

ayahs.text: and wherein there shall be with them well-matched bashful mates.
ayahs.translation: and wherein there shall be with them well-matched bashful mates.

ayahs.text: All this is what you are promised for the Day of Judgement.
ayahs.translation: All this is what you are promised for the Day of Judgement.

ayahs.text: This is Our provision for you never to end.
ayahs.translation: This is Our provision for you never to end.

ayahs.text: All this (is for the God-fearing). But for the transgressors an evil resort awaits them -
ayahs.translation: All this (is for the God-fearing). But for the transgressors an evil resort awaits them -

ayahs.text: Hell where they will be roasted. An evil place to dwell!
ayahs.translation: Hell where they will be roasted. An evil place to dwell!

ayahs.text: All this (is for them); so let them taste boiling water and pus
ayahs.translation: All this (is for them); so let them taste boiling water and pus

ayahs.text: and other sufferings of the kind.
ayahs.translation: and other sufferings of the kind.

ayahs.text: (Observing their followers advancing to Hell they will say among themselves:  This is a troop rushing in to you. There is no welcome for them. They are destined to roast in the Fire.
ayahs.translation: (Observing their followers advancing to Hell they will say among themselves:  This is a troop rushing in to you. There is no welcome for them. They are destined to roast in the Fire.

ayahs.text: They will reply:  Rather no welcome to you. (You will roast in Hell.) It is you who led us to this end. What an evil resort!
ayahs.translation: They will reply:  Rather no welcome to you. (You will roast in Hell.) It is you who led us to this end. What an evil resort!

ayahs.text: They will say:  Our Lord give twofold punishment in the Fire to him who has led us to this.
ayahs.translation: They will say:  Our Lord give twofold punishment in the Fire to him who has led us to this.

ayahs.text: They will say to one another:  But why do not we see those whom we considered him among the wicked?
ayahs.translation: They will say to one another:  But why do not we see those whom we considered him among the wicked?

ayahs.text: Is it that we mistakenly made fun of them; or have they disappeared from our sight?
ayahs.translation: Is it that we mistakenly made fun of them; or have they disappeared from our sight?

ayahs.text: Verily all this is true. This is how the inmates of the Fire will dispute among themselves.
ayahs.translation: Verily all this is true. This is how the inmates of the Fire will dispute among themselves.

ayahs.text: Tell them (O Prophet): I am nothing but a warner. There is no deity but Allah the One the Supreme
ayahs.translation: Tell them (O Prophet): I am nothing but a warner. There is no deity but Allah the One the Supreme

ayahs.text: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is in between them the Most Mighty the Most Forgiving.
ayahs.translation: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is in between them the Most Mighty the Most Forgiving.

ayahs.text: Say:  This is a tiding of tremendous import
ayahs.translation: Say:  This is a tiding of tremendous import

ayahs.text: from which you are turning away.
ayahs.translation: from which you are turning away.

ayahs.text: (Tell them):  I had no knowledge of the High Council when they were disputing.
ayahs.translation: (Tell them):  I had no knowledge of the High Council when they were disputing.

ayahs.text: I am told (about matters) by means of revelation only because I am a clear warner.
ayahs.translation: I am told (about matters) by means of revelation only because I am a clear warner.

ayahs.text: When your Lord said to the angels: Verily I am creating a human being from clay.
ayahs.translation: When your Lord said to the angels: Verily I am creating a human being from clay.

ayahs.text: After I have created him and breathed into him of My spirit fall you down prostrating yourselves to him.
ayahs.translation: After I have created him and breathed into him of My spirit fall you down prostrating yourselves to him.

ayahs.text: Then the angels all of them prostrated themselves before Adam
ayahs.translation: Then the angels all of them prostrated themselves before Adam

ayahs.text: except Iblis. He waxed proud and became one of the unbelievers.
ayahs.translation: except Iblis. He waxed proud and became one of the unbelievers.

ayahs.text: The Lord said:  O Iblis what prevented you from prostrating yourself before him whom I created of My Two Hands. Are you waxing proud or fancy yourself to be too exalted?
ayahs.translation: The Lord said:  O Iblis what prevented you from prostrating yourself before him whom I created of My Two Hands. Are you waxing proud or fancy yourself to be too exalted?

ayahs.text: He replied:  I am nobler than he. You created me from fire and created him from clay.
ayahs.translation: He replied:  I am nobler than he. You created me from fire and created him from clay.

ayahs.text: He said:  Get out of here; surely you are accursed
ayahs.translation: He said:  Get out of here; surely you are accursed

ayahs.text: and My curse shall remain upon you till the Day of Resurrection.
ayahs.translation: and My curse shall remain upon you till the Day of Resurrection.

ayahs.text: Satan said:  My Lord then grant me respite till the Day that they are raised up.
ayahs.translation: Satan said:  My Lord then grant me respite till the Day that they are raised up.

ayahs.text: He said:  You are of those who have been granted respite
ayahs.translation: He said:  You are of those who have been granted respite

ayahs.text: till the Day whose Hour I know.
ayahs.translation: till the Day whose Hour I know.

ayahs.text: (Iblis) said:  By Your glory I shall mislead them all
ayahs.translation: (Iblis) said:  By Your glory I shall mislead them all

ayahs.text: except those of Your servants the chosen ones from amongst them.
ayahs.translation: except those of Your servants the chosen ones from amongst them.

ayahs.text: He (i.e. Allah) said:  This is the Truth - and I only speak the Truth -
ayahs.translation: He (i.e. Allah) said:  This is the Truth - and I only speak the Truth -

ayahs.text: I will certainly fill the Gehenna with you and with all those among them who follow you.
ayahs.translation: I will certainly fill the Gehenna with you and with all those among them who follow you.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) tell them:  I do not ask you for any recompense for the performance of this task; nor am I given to affectation.
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) tell them:  I do not ask you for any recompense for the performance of this task; nor am I given to affectation.

ayahs.text: This is nothing but an Admonition for all people the world over.
ayahs.translation: This is nothing but an Admonition for all people the world over.

ayahs.text: You will know the truth of the matter after a while.
ayahs.translation: You will know the truth of the matter after a while.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: The revelation of this Book is from Allah the Most Mighty the Most Wise.
verses.translation: The revelation of this Book is from Allah the Most Mighty the Most Wise.

verses.text: (O Prophet) it is We Who have revealed this Book to you with Truth. So serve only Allah consecrating your devotion to Him.
verses.translation: (O Prophet) it is We Who have revealed this Book to you with Truth. So serve only Allah consecrating your devotion to Him.

verses.text: Lo religion is exclusively devoted to Allah. Your religion is entirely consecrated to Him. As for those who have taken others than Allah for their guardians (they say):  We worship them only that they may bring us nearer to Allah. Allah will judge between them concerning what they differ about. Verily Allah does not guide anyone who is given to sheer lying is an utter unbeliever.
verses.translation: Lo religion is exclusively devoted to Allah. Your religion is entirely consecrated to Him. As for those who have taken others than Allah for their guardians (they say):  We worship them only that they may bring us nearer to Allah. Allah will judge between them concerning what they differ about. Verily Allah does not guide anyone who is given to sheer lying is an utter unbeliever.

verses.text: If Allah had wanted to take to Himself a son He could have chosen anyone He wanted out of those whom He creates.Glory be to Him (that He should have a son). He is Allah: the One the Overpowering.
verses.translation: If Allah had wanted to take to Himself a son He could have chosen anyone He wanted out of those whom He creates.Glory be to Him (that He should have a son). He is Allah: the One the Overpowering.

verses.text: He created the heavens and the earth with Truth and He folds up the day over the night and folds up the night over the day. He has subjected the sun and the moon each is running its course until an appointed time. Lo He is the Most Mighty the Most Forgiving.
verses.translation: He created the heavens and the earth with Truth and He folds up the day over the night and folds up the night over the day. He has subjected the sun and the moon each is running its course until an appointed time. Lo He is the Most Mighty the Most Forgiving.

verses.text: He it is Who created you from a single being and He it is Who made from it its mate. He it is Who created for you eight heads of cattle in pairs. He creates you in your mothers'' wombs giving you one form after another in threefold depths of darkness. That then is Allah your Lord. His is the kingdom. There is no god but He. So whence are you being turned astray?
verses.translation: He it is Who created you from a single being and He it is Who made from it its mate. He it is Who created for you eight heads of cattle in pairs. He creates you in your mothers'' wombs giving you one form after another in threefold depths of darkness. That then is Allah your Lord. His is the kingdom. There is no god but He. So whence are you being turned astray?

verses.text: If you disbelieve know well that Allah has no need of you. Yet He does not like unbelief in His servants. But if you are thankful your thankfulness will please Him. No one shall bear another''s burden. You are destined to return to your Lord and He will tell you what you used to do. He is well aware even of what lies hidden in your breasts.
verses.translation: If you disbelieve know well that Allah has no need of you. Yet He does not like unbelief in His servants. But if you are thankful your thankfulness will please Him. No one shall bear another''s burden. You are destined to return to your Lord and He will tell you what you used to do. He is well aware even of what lies hidden in your breasts.

verses.text: When any affliction befalls man he cries out to his Lord penitently turning to Him. But when his Lord bestows His favour upon him he forgets the affliction regarding which he had cried out and sets up compeers to Allah that they may lead others astray from His Path. Say (O Prophet):  Enjoy your unbelief for a while. Surely you will be among the inmates of the Fire.
verses.translation: When any affliction befalls man he cries out to his Lord penitently turning to Him. But when his Lord bestows His favour upon him he forgets the affliction regarding which he had cried out and sets up compeers to Allah that they may lead others astray from His Path. Say (O Prophet):  Enjoy your unbelief for a while. Surely you will be among the inmates of the Fire.

verses.text: Is such a person (preferable or he) who is obedient and prostrates himself in the watches of the night stands (in Prayer) is fearful of the Hereafter and looks forward to the mercy of His Lord? Ask them:  Are those who know equal to those who do not know? Only those endowed with understanding take heed.
verses.translation: Is such a person (preferable or he) who is obedient and prostrates himself in the watches of the night stands (in Prayer) is fearful of the Hereafter and looks forward to the mercy of His Lord? Ask them:  Are those who know equal to those who do not know? Only those endowed with understanding take heed.

verses.text: Tell them (O Prophet):  O you servants of Mine who believe have fear of your Lord. A good end awaits those who did good in this world. Allah''s earth is spacious. Verily those who persevere shall be granted their reward beyond all reckoning.
verses.translation: Tell them (O Prophet):  O you servants of Mine who believe have fear of your Lord. A good end awaits those who did good in this world. Allah''s earth is spacious. Verily those who persevere shall be granted their reward beyond all reckoning.

verses.text: Tell them (O Prophet):  I am bidden to serve Allah consecrating my devotion to Him
verses.translation: Tell them (O Prophet):  I am bidden to serve Allah consecrating my devotion to Him

verses.text: and I am bidden to be the first of those who surrender to Him.
verses.translation: and I am bidden to be the first of those who surrender to Him.

verses.text: Say:  If I disobey my Lord I fear the chastisement of an Awesome Day.
verses.translation: Say:  If I disobey my Lord I fear the chastisement of an Awesome Day.

verses.text: Say:  Allah alone shall I serve consecrating my devotion to Him.
verses.translation: Say:  Allah alone shall I serve consecrating my devotion to Him.

verses.text: So serve apart from Him whomsoever you please.  Say:  Behold the real losers shall be those who will have lost their own selves and their kith and kin on the Day of Resurrection. Behold that is the obvious loss.
verses.translation: So serve apart from Him whomsoever you please.  Say:  Behold the real losers shall be those who will have lost their own selves and their kith and kin on the Day of Resurrection. Behold that is the obvious loss.

verses.text: There shall be sheets of fire above them and beneath them. This is the end against which Allah warns His servants. So dread My wrath O you servants of Mine!
verses.translation: There shall be sheets of fire above them and beneath them. This is the end against which Allah warns His servants. So dread My wrath O you servants of Mine!

verses.text: (On the other hand) good tidings await those who eschew serving false gods and penitently return to Allah. (O Prophet) give good tidings to My servants
verses.translation: (On the other hand) good tidings await those who eschew serving false gods and penitently return to Allah. (O Prophet) give good tidings to My servants

verses.text: to those who pay heed to what is said and follow the best of it. They are the ones whom Allah has guided to the Right Way; they are the ones endowed with understanding.
verses.translation: to those who pay heed to what is said and follow the best of it. They are the ones whom Allah has guided to the Right Way; they are the ones endowed with understanding.

verses.text: (O Prophet) can you save him (from chastisement) against whom the sentence of chastisement has become due; him who has (as it were) already fallen into the Fire?
verses.translation: (O Prophet) can you save him (from chastisement) against whom the sentence of chastisement has become due; him who has (as it were) already fallen into the Fire?

verses.text: But those who fear their Lord shall have lofty mansions built over one another beneath which rivers flow. This is Allah''s promise and never does Allah fail to fulfil His promise.
verses.translation: But those who fear their Lord shall have lofty mansions built over one another beneath which rivers flow. This is Allah''s promise and never does Allah fail to fulfil His promise.

verses.text: Do you not see that Allah sent down water from the sky then made it flow on earth as springs and streams and rivers and then with it He brings forth vegetation of various hues; then this vegetation ripens and dries up turning yellow whereafter He reduces it to broken straw? Surely there is a lesson in this for those endowed with understanding.
verses.translation: Do you not see that Allah sent down water from the sky then made it flow on earth as springs and streams and rivers and then with it He brings forth vegetation of various hues; then this vegetation ripens and dries up turning yellow whereafter He reduces it to broken straw? Surely there is a lesson in this for those endowed with understanding.

verses.text: Can he whose breast Allah has opened up for Islam and who is thus (moving along a Path) illumined by a light from Allah (be likened to him who derives no lesson from what he observes)? Woe then to those whose hearts were further hardened after Allah''s admonition. Such are indeed in obvious error.
verses.translation: Can he whose breast Allah has opened up for Islam and who is thus (moving along a Path) illumined by a light from Allah (be likened to him who derives no lesson from what he observes)? Woe then to those whose hearts were further hardened after Allah''s admonition. Such are indeed in obvious error.

verses.text: Allah has revealed the best teaching a self-consistent Book which repeats its contents in manifold forms whereat shiver the skins of those that hold their Lord in awe and then their skins and their hearts soften for Allah''s remembrance. That is Allah''s Guidance wherewith He guides whosoever He pleases. And he whom Allah does not guide to the Right Path has none to guide him.
verses.translation: Allah has revealed the best teaching a self-consistent Book which repeats its contents in manifold forms whereat shiver the skins of those that hold their Lord in awe and then their skins and their hearts soften for Allah''s remembrance. That is Allah''s Guidance wherewith He guides whosoever He pleases. And he whom Allah does not guide to the Right Path has none to guide him.

verses.text: How woeful is the plight of him who has nothing except his face to shield him from severe chastisement on the Day of Resurrection? Such evil-doers shall be told:  Taste now the consequence of your deeds.
verses.translation: How woeful is the plight of him who has nothing except his face to shield him from severe chastisement on the Day of Resurrection? Such evil-doers shall be told:  Taste now the consequence of your deeds.

verses.text: Their predecessors gave the lie to the Truth and then chastisement came upon them from whence they could not imagine.
verses.translation: Their predecessors gave the lie to the Truth and then chastisement came upon them from whence they could not imagine.

verses.text: So Allah made them taste degradation in the life of this world and certainly the chastisement of the Hereafter will be much more grievous. Would that they knew!
verses.translation: So Allah made them taste degradation in the life of this world and certainly the chastisement of the Hereafter will be much more grievous. Would that they knew!

verses.text: We have indeed propounded for mankind all kinds of parables in this Qur''an that they may take heed.
verses.translation: We have indeed propounded for mankind all kinds of parables in this Qur''an that they may take heed.

verses.text: It is an Arabic Qur''an free of all crookedness that they may guard against their evil end.
verses.translation: It is an Arabic Qur''an free of all crookedness that they may guard against their evil end.

verses.text: Allah propounds a parable: there is a man whose ownership is shared by several quarrelsome masters each pulling him to himself; and there is another who is exclusively owned by one man. Can the two be alike? All praise and thanks be to Allah. But most of them are unaware.
verses.translation: Allah propounds a parable: there is a man whose ownership is shared by several quarrelsome masters each pulling him to himself; and there is another who is exclusively owned by one man. Can the two be alike? All praise and thanks be to Allah. But most of them are unaware.

verses.text: (O Prophet) you are destined to die and they too are destined to die.
verses.translation: (O Prophet) you are destined to die and they too are destined to die.

verses.text: Then eventually all of you will contend before your Lord on the Day of Resurrection.
verses.translation: Then eventually all of you will contend before your Lord on the Day of Resurrection.

verses.text: Who then can be more unjust than he who lied against Allah and denied the Truth when it came to him calling it a lie? Is there no room for such unbelievers in Hell?
verses.translation: Who then can be more unjust than he who lied against Allah and denied the Truth when it came to him calling it a lie? Is there no room for such unbelievers in Hell?

verses.text: But he who brought the Truth and those who confirmed it as true such are the ones who shall be guarded against the chastisement.
verses.translation: But he who brought the Truth and those who confirmed it as true such are the ones who shall be guarded against the chastisement.

verses.text: They shall have from their Lord all that they wish for. That is the reward of those that do good
verses.translation: They shall have from their Lord all that they wish for. That is the reward of those that do good

verses.text: so that Allah may remit their worst deeds and reward them according to the best of their deeds.
verses.translation: so that Allah may remit their worst deeds and reward them according to the best of their deeds.

verses.text: (O Prophet) does Allah not suffice for His servant? They frighten you with others apart from Him although he whom Allah lets go astray none can guide him to the Right Way.
verses.translation: (O Prophet) does Allah not suffice for His servant? They frighten you with others apart from Him although he whom Allah lets go astray none can guide him to the Right Way.

verses.text: And he whom Allah guides to the Right Way none can lead him astray. Is not Allah the Most Mighty the Lord of Retribution?
verses.translation: And he whom Allah guides to the Right Way none can lead him astray. Is not Allah the Most Mighty the Lord of Retribution?

verses.text: If you ask them:  Who created the heavens and the earth?  they will surely answer:  Allah.  Tell them:  What do you think then of the deities whom you call upon instead of Allah? If Allah should will that an affliction befall me will those deities remove the harm inflicted by Him? Or if Allah should will that I receive (His) Mercy will they be able to withhold His Mercy from me?  Say:  Allah is sufficient for me; those who have to put their trust let them put their trust in Him.
verses.translation: If you ask them:  Who created the heavens and the earth?  they will surely answer:  Allah.  Tell them:  What do you think then of the deities whom you call upon instead of Allah? If Allah should will that an affliction befall me will those deities remove the harm inflicted by Him? Or if Allah should will that I receive (His) Mercy will they be able to withhold His Mercy from me?  Say:  Allah is sufficient for me; those who have to put their trust let them put their trust in Him.

verses.text: Tell them:  My people continue to work in your position as you will I too will continue with my work. Soon you shall know
verses.translation: Tell them:  My people continue to work in your position as you will I too will continue with my work. Soon you shall know

verses.text: whom the degrading chastisement will visit and upon whom the everlasting chastisement will alight.
verses.translation: whom the degrading chastisement will visit and upon whom the everlasting chastisement will alight.

verses.text: (O Prophet) We revealed to you the Book with the Truth for all mankind. So he who follows the Right Way does so to his own benefit and he who goes astray shall hurt only himself by straying. You are not accountable on their behalf.
verses.translation: (O Prophet) We revealed to you the Book with the Truth for all mankind. So he who follows the Right Way does so to his own benefit and he who goes astray shall hurt only himself by straying. You are not accountable on their behalf.

verses.text: It is Allah Who takes away the souls of people at the hour of their death and takes away at the time of sleep the souls of those that have not died. Then He retains the souls of those against whom He had decreed death and returns the souls of others till an appointed time. Surely there are Signs in this for a people who reflect.
verses.translation: It is Allah Who takes away the souls of people at the hour of their death and takes away at the time of sleep the souls of those that have not died. Then He retains the souls of those against whom He had decreed death and returns the souls of others till an appointed time. Surely there are Signs in this for a people who reflect.
