verses.text: Or have they taken others instead of Allah as intercessors? Say:  Will they intercede though they may have no power and though they may not even understand?
verses.translation: Or have they taken others instead of Allah as intercessors? Say:  Will they intercede though they may have no power and though they may not even understand?

verses.text: Say:  All intercession lies with Allah. His is the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And to Him will all of you be sent back.
verses.translation: Say:  All intercession lies with Allah. His is the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And to Him will all of you be sent back.

verses.text: When Allah alone is mentioned the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter contract with bitterness but when deities apart from Allah are mentioned they are filled with joy.
verses.translation: When Allah alone is mentioned the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter contract with bitterness but when deities apart from Allah are mentioned they are filled with joy.

verses.text: Say:  O Allah the Originator of the heavens and the earth the Knower of the unseen and the seen You it is Who will judge among Your servants concerning what they differed.
verses.translation: Say:  O Allah the Originator of the heavens and the earth the Knower of the unseen and the seen You it is Who will judge among Your servants concerning what they differed.

verses.text: If the wrong-doers possessed the treasures of the earth in their entirety and as much besides they would gladly offer it on the Day of Resurrection to redeem themselves from the harrowing chastisement. This because there will appear to them from Allah something (exceedingly dismal which) they had never even imagined.
verses.translation: If the wrong-doers possessed the treasures of the earth in their entirety and as much besides they would gladly offer it on the Day of Resurrection to redeem themselves from the harrowing chastisement. This because there will appear to them from Allah something (exceedingly dismal which) they had never even imagined.

verses.text: The evil consequences of their deeds will become fully apparent to them and what they had scoffed at will encompass them.
verses.translation: The evil consequences of their deeds will become fully apparent to them and what they had scoffed at will encompass them.

verses.text: When an affliction befalls man he cries out to Us; but when We grant him a favour from Us he says:  I have been granted this on account of my knowledge. Nay; this (favour) is a test; but most of them do not know.
verses.translation: When an affliction befalls man he cries out to Us; but when We grant him a favour from Us he says:  I have been granted this on account of my knowledge. Nay; this (favour) is a test; but most of them do not know.

verses.text: Their predecessors also said the same but their earnings proved of no avail to them
verses.translation: Their predecessors also said the same but their earnings proved of no avail to them

verses.text: and the evil consequences of their deeds overtook them. The wrong-doers among these will also be overtaken by the evil consequences of their deeds. They will be utterly unable to frustrate (Us).
verses.translation: and the evil consequences of their deeds overtook them. The wrong-doers among these will also be overtaken by the evil consequences of their deeds. They will be utterly unable to frustrate (Us).

verses.text: Do they not know that Allah enlarges and straitens the provision of whomsoever He pleases? Therein are Signs for those that believe.
verses.translation: Do they not know that Allah enlarges and straitens the provision of whomsoever He pleases? Therein are Signs for those that believe.

verses.text: Tell them (O Prophet):  My servants who have committed excesses against themselves do not despair of Allah''s Mercy. Surely Allah forgives all sins. He is Most Forgiving Most Merciful.
verses.translation: Tell them (O Prophet):  My servants who have committed excesses against themselves do not despair of Allah''s Mercy. Surely Allah forgives all sins. He is Most Forgiving Most Merciful.

verses.text: Turn to your Lord and surrender yourselves to Him before the chastisement over-takes you; for then you will receive no help.
verses.translation: Turn to your Lord and surrender yourselves to Him before the chastisement over-takes you; for then you will receive no help.

verses.text: Follow the best of what has been revealed to you from your Lord before the chastisement suddenly comes upon you without you even being aware of it.
verses.translation: Follow the best of what has been revealed to you from your Lord before the chastisement suddenly comes upon you without you even being aware of it.

verses.text: Lest a person should say:  Alas for me for neglecting my duty towards Allah and for being among those that scoffed ;
verses.translation: Lest a person should say:  Alas for me for neglecting my duty towards Allah and for being among those that scoffed ;

verses.text: and lest a person should say:  If only Allah had guided me I should have been one of the God-fearing ;
verses.translation: and lest a person should say:  If only Allah had guided me I should have been one of the God-fearing ;

verses.text: or lest he should say when he sees the chastisement:  O that I might return again and be among those who do good.
verses.translation: or lest he should say when he sees the chastisement:  O that I might return again and be among those who do good.

verses.text: Yes indeed! But My Signs came to you and you rejected them as lies and waxed arrogant and were among those who disbelieved.
verses.translation: Yes indeed! But My Signs came to you and you rejected them as lies and waxed arrogant and were among those who disbelieved.

verses.text: On the Day of Resurrection you shall see that the faces of those who had lied against Allah have turned dark. Is Hell not vast enough to provide a room to the vainglorious?
verses.translation: On the Day of Resurrection you shall see that the faces of those who had lied against Allah have turned dark. Is Hell not vast enough to provide a room to the vainglorious?

verses.text: But as for the God-fearing Allah will deliver them on account of their achievements: no harm shall visit them nor shall they grieve.
verses.translation: But as for the God-fearing Allah will deliver them on account of their achievements: no harm shall visit them nor shall they grieve.

verses.text: Allah is the Creator of everything; He is the Guardian over everything.
verses.translation: Allah is the Creator of everything; He is the Guardian over everything.

verses.text: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. It is those who disbelieve in Allah''s Signs who will be the losers.
verses.translation: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. It is those who disbelieve in Allah''s Signs who will be the losers.

verses.text: (O Prophet) say:  Ignorant people! Do you bid me to serve any other beside Allah?
verses.translation: (O Prophet) say:  Ignorant people! Do you bid me to serve any other beside Allah?

verses.text: (Tell them clearly that) it was revealed to you and to all Prophets before you:  If you associate any others with Allah in His Divinity your works will surely come to naught and you will certainly be among the losers.
verses.translation: (Tell them clearly that) it was revealed to you and to all Prophets before you:  If you associate any others with Allah in His Divinity your works will surely come to naught and you will certainly be among the losers.

verses.text: Therefore serve Allah alone and be among those who give thanks.
verses.translation: Therefore serve Allah alone and be among those who give thanks.

verses.text: They did not recognise the true worth of Allah. (Such is Allah''s power that) on the Day of Resurrection the whole earth will be in His grasp and the heavens shall be folded up in His Right Hand. Glory be to Him! Exalted be He from all that they associate with Him.
verses.translation: They did not recognise the true worth of Allah. (Such is Allah''s power that) on the Day of Resurrection the whole earth will be in His grasp and the heavens shall be folded up in His Right Hand. Glory be to Him! Exalted be He from all that they associate with Him.

verses.text: And the Trumpet shall be blown and all who are in the heavens and the earth shall fall down dead save those whom Allah wills. Then the Trumpet shall be blown again and lo! all of them will be standing and looking on.
verses.translation: And the Trumpet shall be blown and all who are in the heavens and the earth shall fall down dead save those whom Allah wills. Then the Trumpet shall be blown again and lo! all of them will be standing and looking on.

verses.text: The earth shall shine with the light of its Lord and the Scroll (of deeds) shall be set in place and the Prophets and all witnesses shall be brought and judgement shall be justly passed among them and they shall not be wronged;
verses.translation: The earth shall shine with the light of its Lord and the Scroll (of deeds) shall be set in place and the Prophets and all witnesses shall be brought and judgement shall be justly passed among them and they shall not be wronged;

verses.text: and everyone shall be paid in full for all that he did. Allah is best aware of all that they do.
verses.translation: and everyone shall be paid in full for all that he did. Allah is best aware of all that they do.

verses.text: (After the judgement has been passed) the unbelievers shall be driven in companies to Hell so that when they arrive there its gates shall be thrown open and its keepers shall say to them:  Did Messengers from among yourselves not come to you rehearsing to you the Signs of your Lord and warning you against your meeting of this Day?  They will say:  Yes indeed; but the sentence of chastisement was bound to be executed against the unbelievers.
verses.translation: (After the judgement has been passed) the unbelievers shall be driven in companies to Hell so that when they arrive there its gates shall be thrown open and its keepers shall say to them:  Did Messengers from among yourselves not come to you rehearsing to you the Signs of your Lord and warning you against your meeting of this Day?  They will say:  Yes indeed; but the sentence of chastisement was bound to be executed against the unbelievers.

verses.text: It will be said:  Enter the gates of Hell. Herein shall you abide.  How evil is the abode of the vainglorious!
verses.translation: It will be said:  Enter the gates of Hell. Herein shall you abide.  How evil is the abode of the vainglorious!

verses.text: And those who eschewed disobeying their Lord shall be driven in companies to Paradise so that when they arrive there its gates will have already been thrown open and its keepers shall say to them:  Peace be upon you; you have done well. So enter. Herein you shall abide.
verses.translation: And those who eschewed disobeying their Lord shall be driven in companies to Paradise so that when they arrive there its gates will have already been thrown open and its keepers shall say to them:  Peace be upon you; you have done well. So enter. Herein you shall abide.

verses.text: They will say:  All thanks and praise be to Allah Who has made His promise to us come true and Who gave us the earth to inherit. We may now dwell in Paradise wherever we please. How excellent is the reward of those who laboured!
verses.translation: They will say:  All thanks and praise be to Allah Who has made His promise to us come true and Who gave us the earth to inherit. We may now dwell in Paradise wherever we please. How excellent is the reward of those who laboured!

verses.text: You shall see the angels surrounding the Throne glorifying their Lord with His praise and judgement will have been made among them with fairness and it will be proclaimed:  All praise and thanks be to Allah the Lord of the whole Universe.
verses.translation: You shall see the angels surrounding the Throne glorifying their Lord with His praise and judgement will have been made among them with fairness and it will be proclaimed:  All praise and thanks be to Allah the Lord of the whole Universe.

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: The revelation of this Book is from Allah the Most Mighty the Most Wise.
ayahs.translation: The revelation of this Book is from Allah the Most Mighty the Most Wise.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) it is We Who have revealed this Book to you with Truth. So serve only Allah consecrating your devotion to Him.
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) it is We Who have revealed this Book to you with Truth. So serve only Allah consecrating your devotion to Him.

ayahs.text: Lo religion is exclusively devoted to Allah. Your religion is entirely consecrated to Him. As for those who have taken others than Allah for their guardians (they say):  We worship them only that they may bring us nearer to Allah. Allah will judge between them concerning what they differ about. Verily Allah does not guide anyone who is given to sheer lying is an utter unbeliever.
ayahs.translation: Lo religion is exclusively devoted to Allah. Your religion is entirely consecrated to Him. As for those who have taken others than Allah for their guardians (they say):  We worship them only that they may bring us nearer to Allah. Allah will judge between them concerning what they differ about. Verily Allah does not guide anyone who is given to sheer lying is an utter unbeliever.

ayahs.text: If Allah had wanted to take to Himself a son He could have chosen anyone He wanted out of those whom He creates.Glory be to Him (that He should have a son). He is Allah: the One the Overpowering.
ayahs.translation: If Allah had wanted to take to Himself a son He could have chosen anyone He wanted out of those whom He creates.Glory be to Him (that He should have a son). He is Allah: the One the Overpowering.

ayahs.text: He created the heavens and the earth with Truth and He folds up the day over the night and folds up the night over the day. He has subjected the sun and the moon each is running its course until an appointed time. Lo He is the Most Mighty the Most Forgiving.
ayahs.translation: He created the heavens and the earth with Truth and He folds up the day over the night and folds up the night over the day. He has subjected the sun and the moon each is running its course until an appointed time. Lo He is the Most Mighty the Most Forgiving.

ayahs.text: He it is Who created you from a single being and He it is Who made from it its mate. He it is Who created for you eight heads of cattle in pairs. He creates you in your mothers'' wombs giving you one form after another in threefold depths of darkness. That then is Allah your Lord. His is the kingdom. There is no god but He. So whence are you being turned astray?
ayahs.translation: He it is Who created you from a single being and He it is Who made from it its mate. He it is Who created for you eight heads of cattle in pairs. He creates you in your mothers'' wombs giving you one form after another in threefold depths of darkness. That then is Allah your Lord. His is the kingdom. There is no god but He. So whence are you being turned astray?

ayahs.text: If you disbelieve know well that Allah has no need of you. Yet He does not like unbelief in His servants. But if you are thankful your thankfulness will please Him. No one shall bear another''s burden. You are destined to return to your Lord and He will tell you what you used to do. He is well aware even of what lies hidden in your breasts.
ayahs.translation: If you disbelieve know well that Allah has no need of you. Yet He does not like unbelief in His servants. But if you are thankful your thankfulness will please Him. No one shall bear another''s burden. You are destined to return to your Lord and He will tell you what you used to do. He is well aware even of what lies hidden in your breasts.

ayahs.text: When any affliction befalls man he cries out to his Lord penitently turning to Him. But when his Lord bestows His favour upon him he forgets the affliction regarding which he had cried out and sets up compeers to Allah that they may lead others astray from His Path. Say (O Prophet):  Enjoy your unbelief for a while. Surely you will be among the inmates of the Fire.
ayahs.translation: When any affliction befalls man he cries out to his Lord penitently turning to Him. But when his Lord bestows His favour upon him he forgets the affliction regarding which he had cried out and sets up compeers to Allah that they may lead others astray from His Path. Say (O Prophet):  Enjoy your unbelief for a while. Surely you will be among the inmates of the Fire.

ayahs.text: Is such a person (preferable or he) who is obedient and prostrates himself in the watches of the night stands (in Prayer) is fearful of the Hereafter and looks forward to the mercy of His Lord? Ask them:  Are those who know equal to those who do not know? Only those endowed with understanding take heed.
ayahs.translation: Is such a person (preferable or he) who is obedient and prostrates himself in the watches of the night stands (in Prayer) is fearful of the Hereafter and looks forward to the mercy of His Lord? Ask them:  Are those who know equal to those who do not know? Only those endowed with understanding take heed.

ayahs.text: Tell them (O Prophet):  O you servants of Mine who believe have fear of your Lord. A good end awaits those who did good in this world. Allah''s earth is spacious. Verily those who persevere shall be granted their reward beyond all reckoning.
ayahs.translation: Tell them (O Prophet):  O you servants of Mine who believe have fear of your Lord. A good end awaits those who did good in this world. Allah''s earth is spacious. Verily those who persevere shall be granted their reward beyond all reckoning.

ayahs.text: Tell them (O Prophet):  I am bidden to serve Allah consecrating my devotion to Him
ayahs.translation: Tell them (O Prophet):  I am bidden to serve Allah consecrating my devotion to Him

ayahs.text: and I am bidden to be the first of those who surrender to Him.
ayahs.translation: and I am bidden to be the first of those who surrender to Him.

ayahs.text: Say:  If I disobey my Lord I fear the chastisement of an Awesome Day.
ayahs.translation: Say:  If I disobey my Lord I fear the chastisement of an Awesome Day.

ayahs.text: Say:  Allah alone shall I serve consecrating my devotion to Him.
ayahs.translation: Say:  Allah alone shall I serve consecrating my devotion to Him.

ayahs.text: So serve apart from Him whomsoever you please.  Say:  Behold the real losers shall be those who will have lost their own selves and their kith and kin on the Day of Resurrection. Behold that is the obvious loss.
ayahs.translation: So serve apart from Him whomsoever you please.  Say:  Behold the real losers shall be those who will have lost their own selves and their kith and kin on the Day of Resurrection. Behold that is the obvious loss.

ayahs.text: There shall be sheets of fire above them and beneath them. This is the end against which Allah warns His servants. So dread My wrath O you servants of Mine!
ayahs.translation: There shall be sheets of fire above them and beneath them. This is the end against which Allah warns His servants. So dread My wrath O you servants of Mine!

ayahs.text: (On the other hand) good tidings await those who eschew serving false gods and penitently return to Allah. (O Prophet) give good tidings to My servants
ayahs.translation: (On the other hand) good tidings await those who eschew serving false gods and penitently return to Allah. (O Prophet) give good tidings to My servants

ayahs.text: to those who pay heed to what is said and follow the best of it. They are the ones whom Allah has guided to the Right Way; they are the ones endowed with understanding.
ayahs.translation: to those who pay heed to what is said and follow the best of it. They are the ones whom Allah has guided to the Right Way; they are the ones endowed with understanding.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) can you save him (from chastisement) against whom the sentence of chastisement has become due; him who has (as it were) already fallen into the Fire?
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) can you save him (from chastisement) against whom the sentence of chastisement has become due; him who has (as it were) already fallen into the Fire?

ayahs.text: But those who fear their Lord shall have lofty mansions built over one another beneath which rivers flow. This is Allah''s promise and never does Allah fail to fulfil His promise.
ayahs.translation: But those who fear their Lord shall have lofty mansions built over one another beneath which rivers flow. This is Allah''s promise and never does Allah fail to fulfil His promise.

ayahs.text: Do you not see that Allah sent down water from the sky then made it flow on earth as springs and streams and rivers and then with it He brings forth vegetation of various hues; then this vegetation ripens and dries up turning yellow whereafter He reduces it to broken straw? Surely there is a lesson in this for those endowed with understanding.
ayahs.translation: Do you not see that Allah sent down water from the sky then made it flow on earth as springs and streams and rivers and then with it He brings forth vegetation of various hues; then this vegetation ripens and dries up turning yellow whereafter He reduces it to broken straw? Surely there is a lesson in this for those endowed with understanding.

ayahs.text: Can he whose breast Allah has opened up for Islam and who is thus (moving along a Path) illumined by a light from Allah (be likened to him who derives no lesson from what he observes)? Woe then to those whose hearts were further hardened after Allah''s admonition. Such are indeed in obvious error.
ayahs.translation: Can he whose breast Allah has opened up for Islam and who is thus (moving along a Path) illumined by a light from Allah (be likened to him who derives no lesson from what he observes)? Woe then to those whose hearts were further hardened after Allah''s admonition. Such are indeed in obvious error.

ayahs.text: Allah has revealed the best teaching a self-consistent Book which repeats its contents in manifold forms whereat shiver the skins of those that hold their Lord in awe and then their skins and their hearts soften for Allah''s remembrance. That is Allah''s Guidance wherewith He guides whosoever He pleases. And he whom Allah does not guide to the Right Path has none to guide him.
ayahs.translation: Allah has revealed the best teaching a self-consistent Book which repeats its contents in manifold forms whereat shiver the skins of those that hold their Lord in awe and then their skins and their hearts soften for Allah''s remembrance. That is Allah''s Guidance wherewith He guides whosoever He pleases. And he whom Allah does not guide to the Right Path has none to guide him.

ayahs.text: How woeful is the plight of him who has nothing except his face to shield him from severe chastisement on the Day of Resurrection? Such evil-doers shall be told:  Taste now the consequence of your deeds.
ayahs.translation: How woeful is the plight of him who has nothing except his face to shield him from severe chastisement on the Day of Resurrection? Such evil-doers shall be told:  Taste now the consequence of your deeds.

ayahs.text: Their predecessors gave the lie to the Truth and then chastisement came upon them from whence they could not imagine.
ayahs.translation: Their predecessors gave the lie to the Truth and then chastisement came upon them from whence they could not imagine.

ayahs.text: So Allah made them taste degradation in the life of this world and certainly the chastisement of the Hereafter will be much more grievous. Would that they knew!
ayahs.translation: So Allah made them taste degradation in the life of this world and certainly the chastisement of the Hereafter will be much more grievous. Would that they knew!

ayahs.text: We have indeed propounded for mankind all kinds of parables in this Qur''an that they may take heed.
ayahs.translation: We have indeed propounded for mankind all kinds of parables in this Qur''an that they may take heed.

ayahs.text: It is an Arabic Qur''an free of all crookedness that they may guard against their evil end.
ayahs.translation: It is an Arabic Qur''an free of all crookedness that they may guard against their evil end.

ayahs.text: Allah propounds a parable: there is a man whose ownership is shared by several quarrelsome masters each pulling him to himself; and there is another who is exclusively owned by one man. Can the two be alike? All praise and thanks be to Allah. But most of them are unaware.
ayahs.translation: Allah propounds a parable: there is a man whose ownership is shared by several quarrelsome masters each pulling him to himself; and there is another who is exclusively owned by one man. Can the two be alike? All praise and thanks be to Allah. But most of them are unaware.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) you are destined to die and they too are destined to die.
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) you are destined to die and they too are destined to die.

ayahs.text: Then eventually all of you will contend before your Lord on the Day of Resurrection.
ayahs.translation: Then eventually all of you will contend before your Lord on the Day of Resurrection.

ayahs.text: Who then can be more unjust than he who lied against Allah and denied the Truth when it came to him calling it a lie? Is there no room for such unbelievers in Hell?
ayahs.translation: Who then can be more unjust than he who lied against Allah and denied the Truth when it came to him calling it a lie? Is there no room for such unbelievers in Hell?

ayahs.text: But he who brought the Truth and those who confirmed it as true such are the ones who shall be guarded against the chastisement.
ayahs.translation: But he who brought the Truth and those who confirmed it as true such are the ones who shall be guarded against the chastisement.

ayahs.text: They shall have from their Lord all that they wish for. That is the reward of those that do good
ayahs.translation: They shall have from their Lord all that they wish for. That is the reward of those that do good

ayahs.text: so that Allah may remit their worst deeds and reward them according to the best of their deeds.
ayahs.translation: so that Allah may remit their worst deeds and reward them according to the best of their deeds.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) does Allah not suffice for His servant? They frighten you with others apart from Him although he whom Allah lets go astray none can guide him to the Right Way.
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) does Allah not suffice for His servant? They frighten you with others apart from Him although he whom Allah lets go astray none can guide him to the Right Way.

ayahs.text: And he whom Allah guides to the Right Way none can lead him astray. Is not Allah the Most Mighty the Lord of Retribution?
ayahs.translation: And he whom Allah guides to the Right Way none can lead him astray. Is not Allah the Most Mighty the Lord of Retribution?

ayahs.text: If you ask them:  Who created the heavens and the earth?  they will surely answer:  Allah.  Tell them:  What do you think then of the deities whom you call upon instead of Allah? If Allah should will that an affliction befall me will those deities remove the harm inflicted by Him? Or if Allah should will that I receive (His) Mercy will they be able to withhold His Mercy from me?  Say:  Allah is sufficient for me; those who have to put their trust let them put their trust in Him.
ayahs.translation: If you ask them:  Who created the heavens and the earth?  they will surely answer:  Allah.  Tell them:  What do you think then of the deities whom you call upon instead of Allah? If Allah should will that an affliction befall me will those deities remove the harm inflicted by Him? Or if Allah should will that I receive (His) Mercy will they be able to withhold His Mercy from me?  Say:  Allah is sufficient for me; those who have to put their trust let them put their trust in Him.

ayahs.text: Tell them:  My people continue to work in your position as you will I too will continue with my work. Soon you shall know
ayahs.translation: Tell them:  My people continue to work in your position as you will I too will continue with my work. Soon you shall know

ayahs.text: whom the degrading chastisement will visit and upon whom the everlasting chastisement will alight.
ayahs.translation: whom the degrading chastisement will visit and upon whom the everlasting chastisement will alight.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) We revealed to you the Book with the Truth for all mankind. So he who follows the Right Way does so to his own benefit and he who goes astray shall hurt only himself by straying. You are not accountable on their behalf.
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) We revealed to you the Book with the Truth for all mankind. So he who follows the Right Way does so to his own benefit and he who goes astray shall hurt only himself by straying. You are not accountable on their behalf.

ayahs.text: It is Allah Who takes away the souls of people at the hour of their death and takes away at the time of sleep the souls of those that have not died. Then He retains the souls of those against whom He had decreed death and returns the souls of others till an appointed time. Surely there are Signs in this for a people who reflect.
ayahs.translation: It is Allah Who takes away the souls of people at the hour of their death and takes away at the time of sleep the souls of those that have not died. Then He retains the souls of those against whom He had decreed death and returns the souls of others till an appointed time. Surely there are Signs in this for a people who reflect.

ayahs.text: Or have they taken others instead of Allah as intercessors? Say:  Will they intercede though they may have no power and though they may not even understand?
ayahs.translation: Or have they taken others instead of Allah as intercessors? Say:  Will they intercede though they may have no power and though they may not even understand?

ayahs.text: Say:  All intercession lies with Allah. His is the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And to Him will all of you be sent back.
ayahs.translation: Say:  All intercession lies with Allah. His is the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And to Him will all of you be sent back.

ayahs.text: When Allah alone is mentioned the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter contract with bitterness but when deities apart from Allah are mentioned they are filled with joy.
ayahs.translation: When Allah alone is mentioned the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter contract with bitterness but when deities apart from Allah are mentioned they are filled with joy.

ayahs.text: Say:  O Allah the Originator of the heavens and the earth the Knower of the unseen and the seen You it is Who will judge among Your servants concerning what they differed.
ayahs.translation: Say:  O Allah the Originator of the heavens and the earth the Knower of the unseen and the seen You it is Who will judge among Your servants concerning what they differed.

ayahs.text: If the wrong-doers possessed the treasures of the earth in their entirety and as much besides they would gladly offer it on the Day of Resurrection to redeem themselves from the harrowing chastisement. This because there will appear to them from Allah something (exceedingly dismal which) they had never even imagined.
ayahs.translation: If the wrong-doers possessed the treasures of the earth in their entirety and as much besides they would gladly offer it on the Day of Resurrection to redeem themselves from the harrowing chastisement. This because there will appear to them from Allah something (exceedingly dismal which) they had never even imagined.

ayahs.text: The evil consequences of their deeds will become fully apparent to them and what they had scoffed at will encompass them.
ayahs.translation: The evil consequences of their deeds will become fully apparent to them and what they had scoffed at will encompass them.

ayahs.text: When an affliction befalls man he cries out to Us; but when We grant him a favour from Us he says:  I have been granted this on account of my knowledge. Nay; this (favour) is a test; but most of them do not know.
ayahs.translation: When an affliction befalls man he cries out to Us; but when We grant him a favour from Us he says:  I have been granted this on account of my knowledge. Nay; this (favour) is a test; but most of them do not know.

ayahs.text: Their predecessors also said the same but their earnings proved of no avail to them
ayahs.translation: Their predecessors also said the same but their earnings proved of no avail to them

ayahs.text: and the evil consequences of their deeds overtook them. The wrong-doers among these will also be overtaken by the evil consequences of their deeds. They will be utterly unable to frustrate (Us).
ayahs.translation: and the evil consequences of their deeds overtook them. The wrong-doers among these will also be overtaken by the evil consequences of their deeds. They will be utterly unable to frustrate (Us).

ayahs.text: Do they not know that Allah enlarges and straitens the provision of whomsoever He pleases? Therein are Signs for those that believe.
ayahs.translation: Do they not know that Allah enlarges and straitens the provision of whomsoever He pleases? Therein are Signs for those that believe.

ayahs.text: Tell them (O Prophet):  My servants who have committed excesses against themselves do not despair of Allah''s Mercy. Surely Allah forgives all sins. He is Most Forgiving Most Merciful.
ayahs.translation: Tell them (O Prophet):  My servants who have committed excesses against themselves do not despair of Allah''s Mercy. Surely Allah forgives all sins. He is Most Forgiving Most Merciful.

ayahs.text: Turn to your Lord and surrender yourselves to Him before the chastisement over-takes you; for then you will receive no help.
ayahs.translation: Turn to your Lord and surrender yourselves to Him before the chastisement over-takes you; for then you will receive no help.

ayahs.text: Follow the best of what has been revealed to you from your Lord before the chastisement suddenly comes upon you without you even being aware of it.
ayahs.translation: Follow the best of what has been revealed to you from your Lord before the chastisement suddenly comes upon you without you even being aware of it.

ayahs.text: Lest a person should say:  Alas for me for neglecting my duty towards Allah and for being among those that scoffed ;
ayahs.translation: Lest a person should say:  Alas for me for neglecting my duty towards Allah and for being among those that scoffed ;

ayahs.text: and lest a person should say:  If only Allah had guided me I should have been one of the God-fearing ;
ayahs.translation: and lest a person should say:  If only Allah had guided me I should have been one of the God-fearing ;

ayahs.text: or lest he should say when he sees the chastisement:  O that I might return again and be among those who do good.
ayahs.translation: or lest he should say when he sees the chastisement:  O that I might return again and be among those who do good.

ayahs.text: Yes indeed! But My Signs came to you and you rejected them as lies and waxed arrogant and were among those who disbelieved.
ayahs.translation: Yes indeed! But My Signs came to you and you rejected them as lies and waxed arrogant and were among those who disbelieved.

ayahs.text: On the Day of Resurrection you shall see that the faces of those who had lied against Allah have turned dark. Is Hell not vast enough to provide a room to the vainglorious?
ayahs.translation: On the Day of Resurrection you shall see that the faces of those who had lied against Allah have turned dark. Is Hell not vast enough to provide a room to the vainglorious?

ayahs.text: But as for the God-fearing Allah will deliver them on account of their achievements: no harm shall visit them nor shall they grieve.
ayahs.translation: But as for the God-fearing Allah will deliver them on account of their achievements: no harm shall visit them nor shall they grieve.

ayahs.text: Allah is the Creator of everything; He is the Guardian over everything.
ayahs.translation: Allah is the Creator of everything; He is the Guardian over everything.

ayahs.text: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. It is those who disbelieve in Allah''s Signs who will be the losers.
ayahs.translation: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. It is those who disbelieve in Allah''s Signs who will be the losers.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) say:  Ignorant people! Do you bid me to serve any other beside Allah?
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) say:  Ignorant people! Do you bid me to serve any other beside Allah?

ayahs.text: (Tell them clearly that) it was revealed to you and to all Prophets before you:  If you associate any others with Allah in His Divinity your works will surely come to naught and you will certainly be among the losers.
ayahs.translation: (Tell them clearly that) it was revealed to you and to all Prophets before you:  If you associate any others with Allah in His Divinity your works will surely come to naught and you will certainly be among the losers.

ayahs.text: Therefore serve Allah alone and be among those who give thanks.
ayahs.translation: Therefore serve Allah alone and be among those who give thanks.

ayahs.text: They did not recognise the true worth of Allah. (Such is Allah''s power that) on the Day of Resurrection the whole earth will be in His grasp and the heavens shall be folded up in His Right Hand. Glory be to Him! Exalted be He from all that they associate with Him.
ayahs.translation: They did not recognise the true worth of Allah. (Such is Allah''s power that) on the Day of Resurrection the whole earth will be in His grasp and the heavens shall be folded up in His Right Hand. Glory be to Him! Exalted be He from all that they associate with Him.

ayahs.text: And the Trumpet shall be blown and all who are in the heavens and the earth shall fall down dead save those whom Allah wills. Then the Trumpet shall be blown again and lo! all of them will be standing and looking on.
ayahs.translation: And the Trumpet shall be blown and all who are in the heavens and the earth shall fall down dead save those whom Allah wills. Then the Trumpet shall be blown again and lo! all of them will be standing and looking on.

ayahs.text: The earth shall shine with the light of its Lord and the Scroll (of deeds) shall be set in place and the Prophets and all witnesses shall be brought and judgement shall be justly passed among them and they shall not be wronged;
ayahs.translation: The earth shall shine with the light of its Lord and the Scroll (of deeds) shall be set in place and the Prophets and all witnesses shall be brought and judgement shall be justly passed among them and they shall not be wronged;

ayahs.text: and everyone shall be paid in full for all that he did. Allah is best aware of all that they do.
ayahs.translation: and everyone shall be paid in full for all that he did. Allah is best aware of all that they do.

ayahs.text: (After the judgement has been passed) the unbelievers shall be driven in companies to Hell so that when they arrive there its gates shall be thrown open and its keepers shall say to them:  Did Messengers from among yourselves not come to you rehearsing to you the Signs of your Lord and warning you against your meeting of this Day?  They will say:  Yes indeed; but the sentence of chastisement was bound to be executed against the unbelievers.
ayahs.translation: (After the judgement has been passed) the unbelievers shall be driven in companies to Hell so that when they arrive there its gates shall be thrown open and its keepers shall say to them:  Did Messengers from among yourselves not come to you rehearsing to you the Signs of your Lord and warning you against your meeting of this Day?  They will say:  Yes indeed; but the sentence of chastisement was bound to be executed against the unbelievers.

ayahs.text: It will be said:  Enter the gates of Hell. Herein shall you abide.  How evil is the abode of the vainglorious!
ayahs.translation: It will be said:  Enter the gates of Hell. Herein shall you abide.  How evil is the abode of the vainglorious!

ayahs.text: And those who eschewed disobeying their Lord shall be driven in companies to Paradise so that when they arrive there its gates will have already been thrown open and its keepers shall say to them:  Peace be upon you; you have done well. So enter. Herein you shall abide.
ayahs.translation: And those who eschewed disobeying their Lord shall be driven in companies to Paradise so that when they arrive there its gates will have already been thrown open and its keepers shall say to them:  Peace be upon you; you have done well. So enter. Herein you shall abide.

ayahs.text: They will say:  All thanks and praise be to Allah Who has made His promise to us come true and Who gave us the earth to inherit. We may now dwell in Paradise wherever we please. How excellent is the reward of those who laboured!
ayahs.translation: They will say:  All thanks and praise be to Allah Who has made His promise to us come true and Who gave us the earth to inherit. We may now dwell in Paradise wherever we please. How excellent is the reward of those who laboured!

ayahs.text: You shall see the angels surrounding the Throne glorifying their Lord with His praise and judgement will have been made among them with fairness and it will be proclaimed:  All praise and thanks be to Allah the Lord of the whole Universe.
ayahs.translation: You shall see the angels surrounding the Throne glorifying their Lord with His praise and judgement will have been made among them with fairness and it will be proclaimed:  All praise and thanks be to Allah the Lord of the whole Universe.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Ha''. Mim.
verses.translation: Ha''. Mim.

verses.text: This Book is a revelation from Allah the All-Mighty the All-Knowing;
verses.translation: This Book is a revelation from Allah the All-Mighty the All-Knowing;

verses.text: the Forgiver of sins the Accepter of repentance the Stern in retribution the Bountiful. There is no god but He. To Him are all destined to return.
verses.translation: the Forgiver of sins the Accepter of repentance the Stern in retribution the Bountiful. There is no god but He. To Him are all destined to return.

verses.text: None but the unbelievers dispute regarding the Signs of Allah. So let not their strutting about in the land delude you.
verses.translation: None but the unbelievers dispute regarding the Signs of Allah. So let not their strutting about in the land delude you.

verses.text: Before them the people of Noah also gave the lie (to Messengers) and so did many parties after them. Each nation sallied forth against its Messenger to seize him and they disputed with false arguments seeking therewith to repudiate the Truth. Then I seized them; and behold how woeful was My retribution!
verses.translation: Before them the people of Noah also gave the lie (to Messengers) and so did many parties after them. Each nation sallied forth against its Messenger to seize him and they disputed with false arguments seeking therewith to repudiate the Truth. Then I seized them; and behold how woeful was My retribution!

verses.text: Thus has the decree of your Lord become due against the unbelievers. They are destined for the Fire.
verses.translation: Thus has the decree of your Lord become due against the unbelievers. They are destined for the Fire.

verses.text: The angels that bear the Throne and those that are around to extol your Lord''s glory with His praise they believe in Him and ask forgiveness for the believers saying:  Our Lord! You encompass everything with Your Mercy and Knowledge. So forgive those that repent and follow Your Path and guard them against the chastisement of Hell.
verses.translation: The angels that bear the Throne and those that are around to extol your Lord''s glory with His praise they believe in Him and ask forgiveness for the believers saying:  Our Lord! You encompass everything with Your Mercy and Knowledge. So forgive those that repent and follow Your Path and guard them against the chastisement of Hell.

verses.text: Our Lord admit them to the everlasting Gardens You have promised them and those of their fathers and spouses and progeny that were righteous. Surely You alone are Most Mighty Most Wise;
verses.translation: Our Lord admit them to the everlasting Gardens You have promised them and those of their fathers and spouses and progeny that were righteous. Surely You alone are Most Mighty Most Wise;

verses.text: and guard them against all ills. He whom You guard against ills on that Day to him You have surely been Most Merciful. That is the great triumph.
verses.translation: and guard them against all ills. He whom You guard against ills on that Day to him You have surely been Most Merciful. That is the great triumph.

verses.text: It will be announced to the unbelievers (on the Day of Resurrection):  Surely Allah''s abhorrence of you when you were called to believe but you disbelieved was greater than is your abhorrence of yourselves today.
verses.translation: It will be announced to the unbelievers (on the Day of Resurrection):  Surely Allah''s abhorrence of you when you were called to believe but you disbelieved was greater than is your abhorrence of yourselves today.

verses.text: They will say:  Our Lord twice have You caused us to die and twice have You given us life. We have now confessed our sins. Is there then any way out?
verses.translation: They will say:  Our Lord twice have You caused us to die and twice have You given us life. We have now confessed our sins. Is there then any way out?

verses.text: (They will be told):  (The cause of your present state is that) when Allah alone was invoked you disbelieved; and when others instead of Him were invoked you believed. Today all judgement lies with Allah the Most High the All-Great.
verses.translation: (They will be told):  (The cause of your present state is that) when Allah alone was invoked you disbelieved; and when others instead of Him were invoked you believed. Today all judgement lies with Allah the Most High the All-Great.

verses.text: He it is Who shows you His Signs and sends down provision for you from the sky. Yet none takes heed except he who constantly turns to Allah.
verses.translation: He it is Who shows you His Signs and sends down provision for you from the sky. Yet none takes heed except he who constantly turns to Allah.

verses.text: So call upon Allah consecrating all your devotion to Him howsoever much the unbelievers may dislike it.
verses.translation: So call upon Allah consecrating all your devotion to Him howsoever much the unbelievers may dislike it.

verses.text: Exalted in Rank Lord of the Throne: He causes the spirit to descend on whomsoever of His servants He pleases so as to warn them of the Day of Encounter;
verses.translation: Exalted in Rank Lord of the Throne: He causes the spirit to descend on whomsoever of His servants He pleases so as to warn them of the Day of Encounter;

verses.text: the Day when they will emerge and nothing of them shall be hidden from Allah. (On that Day they will be asked):  Whose is the kingdom today? (The whole world will cry out):  It is Allah''s the One the Overpowering.
verses.translation: the Day when they will emerge and nothing of them shall be hidden from Allah. (On that Day they will be asked):  Whose is the kingdom today? (The whole world will cry out):  It is Allah''s the One the Overpowering.

verses.text: (It will then be said):  Today shall everyone be fully recompensed for his deeds. None shall be wronged today. Surely Allah is Swift in Reckoning.
verses.translation: (It will then be said):  Today shall everyone be fully recompensed for his deeds. None shall be wronged today. Surely Allah is Swift in Reckoning.

verses.text: (O Prophet) then warn them of the Day that has drawn near the Day when hearts full of suppressed grief will leap up to the throats and the wrong-doers shall neither have any sincere friend nor intercessor whose word will be heeded.
verses.translation: (O Prophet) then warn them of the Day that has drawn near the Day when hearts full of suppressed grief will leap up to the throats and the wrong-doers shall neither have any sincere friend nor intercessor whose word will be heeded.

verses.text: He knows even the most stealthy glance of the eyes and all the secrets that hearts conceal.
verses.translation: He knows even the most stealthy glance of the eyes and all the secrets that hearts conceal.

verses.text: Allah will judge with justice whereas those whom they call upon beside Him cannot judge at all. Surely Allah - and He alone - is All- Hearing All-Seeing.
verses.translation: Allah will judge with justice whereas those whom they call upon beside Him cannot judge at all. Surely Allah - and He alone - is All- Hearing All-Seeing.

verses.text: Have they not journeyed in the land that they might observe the end of those who came before them? They were even greater in strength than they and left behind more splendid traces in the land. Then Allah seized them because of their sins and they had none who could protect them from Allah.
verses.translation: Have they not journeyed in the land that they might observe the end of those who came before them? They were even greater in strength than they and left behind more splendid traces in the land. Then Allah seized them because of their sins and they had none who could protect them from Allah.

verses.text: They came to this end because their Messengers would come to them with Clear Signs and yet they would refuse to believe. So Allah seized them. He is indeed Strong Terrible in Retribution.
verses.translation: They came to this end because their Messengers would come to them with Clear Signs and yet they would refuse to believe. So Allah seized them. He is indeed Strong Terrible in Retribution.

verses.text: Verily We sent Moses with Our Signs and a clear authority
verses.translation: Verily We sent Moses with Our Signs and a clear authority

verses.text: to Pharaoh and Haman and Korah. They said:  (He is) a sorcerer an utter liar.
verses.translation: to Pharaoh and Haman and Korah. They said:  (He is) a sorcerer an utter liar.

verses.text: When Moses brought them the Truth from Us they said:  Kill the sons of all the believers who have joined him but spare the women. The guile of the unbelievers always ends in vain.
verses.translation: When Moses brought them the Truth from Us they said:  Kill the sons of all the believers who have joined him but spare the women. The guile of the unbelievers always ends in vain.

verses.text: One day Pharaoh said:  Let me go and kill Moses; then let him invoke his Lord. I fear that he will change your religion or cause disruption in the land.
verses.translation: One day Pharaoh said:  Let me go and kill Moses; then let him invoke his Lord. I fear that he will change your religion or cause disruption in the land.

verses.text: Moses said:  I have taken refuge with my Lord and your Lord from everyone who waxes arrogant and does not believe in the Day of Reckoning.
verses.translation: Moses said:  I have taken refuge with my Lord and your Lord from everyone who waxes arrogant and does not believe in the Day of Reckoning.

verses.text: Then a man endowed with faith from Pharaoh''s folk who had kept his faith hidden said:  Do you kill a person simply because he says: ''My Lord is Allah'' even though he brought to you clear Signs from your Lord? If he is a liar his lying will recoil upon him; but if he is truthful you will be smitten with some of the awesome consequences of which he warns you. Allah does not guide to the Right Way any who exceeds the limits and is an utter liar.
verses.translation: Then a man endowed with faith from Pharaoh''s folk who had kept his faith hidden said:  Do you kill a person simply because he says: ''My Lord is Allah'' even though he brought to you clear Signs from your Lord? If he is a liar his lying will recoil upon him; but if he is truthful you will be smitten with some of the awesome consequences of which he warns you. Allah does not guide to the Right Way any who exceeds the limits and is an utter liar.

verses.text: My people today the kingdom is yours and you are supreme in the land. But if Allah''s chastisement were to come upon you who will come to our help? Pharaoh said:  I only counsel what I consider right; I only direct you to the Path of Rectitude.
verses.translation: My people today the kingdom is yours and you are supreme in the land. But if Allah''s chastisement were to come upon you who will come to our help? Pharaoh said:  I only counsel what I consider right; I only direct you to the Path of Rectitude.

verses.text: He who had faith said:  My people I fear that you will confront a day like that which overtook many parties before you
verses.translation: He who had faith said:  My people I fear that you will confront a day like that which overtook many parties before you

verses.text: like the day that overtook the people of Noah and Ad and Thamud and those who came after them. Allah does not wish to subject His servants to any injustice.
verses.translation: like the day that overtook the people of Noah and Ad and Thamud and those who came after them. Allah does not wish to subject His servants to any injustice.

verses.text: My people I fear that you will encounter a day when there will be much wailing and you will cry out to one another for help
verses.translation: My people I fear that you will encounter a day when there will be much wailing and you will cry out to one another for help

verses.text: the day when you will turn around to retreat there will be none to protect you from Allah. He whom Allah lets go astray none will be able to show him the Right Way.
verses.translation: the day when you will turn around to retreat there will be none to protect you from Allah. He whom Allah lets go astray none will be able to show him the Right Way.

verses.text: Verily Joseph came to you with Clear Signs before yet you continued to doubt his Message. Thereafter when he died you said: ''Allah shall send no Messenger after him.'' Thus Allah leads astray those who transgress the limits and are given to much doubting;
verses.translation: Verily Joseph came to you with Clear Signs before yet you continued to doubt his Message. Thereafter when he died you said: ''Allah shall send no Messenger after him.'' Thus Allah leads astray those who transgress the limits and are given to much doubting;

verses.text: those who contend regarding Allah''s Signs without any evidence that might have come to them. That is exceedingly loathsome to Allah and to those that believe. Thus does Allah seal the heart of everyone who is proud and high-handed.
verses.translation: those who contend regarding Allah''s Signs without any evidence that might have come to them. That is exceedingly loathsome to Allah and to those that believe. Thus does Allah seal the heart of everyone who is proud and high-handed.

verses.text: Pharaoh said:  Haman build for me a lofty tower that I may scale the highways -
verses.translation: Pharaoh said:  Haman build for me a lofty tower that I may scale the highways -

verses.text: the highways to the heavens - and have a look at the God of Moses although I am certain that Moses is a liar. Thus Pharaoh''s evil deed was made to seem fair to him and he was barred from the Right Path. Pharaoh''s guile only led him to his own perdition.
verses.translation: the highways to the heavens - and have a look at the God of Moses although I am certain that Moses is a liar. Thus Pharaoh''s evil deed was made to seem fair to him and he was barred from the Right Path. Pharaoh''s guile only led him to his own perdition.

verses.text: The person endowed with faith said:  My people follow me; I shall direct you to the Path of Rectitude.
verses.translation: The person endowed with faith said:  My people follow me; I shall direct you to the Path of Rectitude.

verses.text: My people the life of this world is ephemeral whereas the Hereafter that is the permanent abode.
verses.translation: My people the life of this world is ephemeral whereas the Hereafter that is the permanent abode.

verses.text: Whosoever does an evil deed will be requited only with the like of it; and whosoever acts righteously and has attained to faith - be he a male or a female - they shall enter Paradise and be provided sustenance beyond all reckoning.
verses.translation: Whosoever does an evil deed will be requited only with the like of it; and whosoever acts righteously and has attained to faith - be he a male or a female - they shall enter Paradise and be provided sustenance beyond all reckoning.

verses.text: My people how is it that I call you to salvation while you call me to the Fire;
verses.translation: My people how is it that I call you to salvation while you call me to the Fire;

verses.text: you call me to deny Allah and to associate with Him as His partners those regarding whom I have no knowledge (that they are Allah''s partners in His Divinity) whereas I call you to the Most Mighty the Most Forgiving?
verses.translation: you call me to deny Allah and to associate with Him as His partners those regarding whom I have no knowledge (that they are Allah''s partners in His Divinity) whereas I call you to the Most Mighty the Most Forgiving?

verses.text: There is no doubt that those whom you call me to have no claim to be called upon in this world and in the Hereafter. Certainly to Allah shall be our return and those who exceed the limits are destined to the Fire.
verses.translation: There is no doubt that those whom you call me to have no claim to be called upon in this world and in the Hereafter. Certainly to Allah shall be our return and those who exceed the limits are destined to the Fire.

verses.text: Soon you shall remember what I say to you. I entrust my affairs to Allah. Surely Allah is watchful over His servants.
verses.translation: Soon you shall remember what I say to you. I entrust my affairs to Allah. Surely Allah is watchful over His servants.

verses.text: Eventually Allah saved the person endowed with faith from all the evils of their guile and a woeful chastisement encompassed the Pharaonites.
verses.translation: Eventually Allah saved the person endowed with faith from all the evils of their guile and a woeful chastisement encompassed the Pharaonites.

verses.text: They are exposed to the Fire every morning and evening; and when the Last Hour will come to pass a command shall be given:  Admit the Pharaonites to an even more severe chastisement.
verses.translation: They are exposed to the Fire every morning and evening; and when the Last Hour will come to pass a command shall be given:  Admit the Pharaonites to an even more severe chastisement.

verses.text: Just imagine when they will remonstrate with one another in Hell. The weak ones will say to those who waxed proud:  We were your followers. Will you then lighten for us a part of our suffering of the Fire?
verses.translation: Just imagine when they will remonstrate with one another in Hell. The weak ones will say to those who waxed proud:  We were your followers. Will you then lighten for us a part of our suffering of the Fire?

verses.text: Those who had waxed proud will reply:  All of us are in it. Allah has already passed His judgement among His servants.
verses.translation: Those who had waxed proud will reply:  All of us are in it. Allah has already passed His judgement among His servants.

verses.text: Those suffering in the Fire will say to the keepers of Hell:  Call upon your Lord to lighten the chastisement for us just for a day.
verses.translation: Those suffering in the Fire will say to the keepers of Hell:  Call upon your Lord to lighten the chastisement for us just for a day.

verses.text: The keepers of Hell will ask:  Did your Messengers not come to you with Clear Signs?  They will say:  Yes (they did).  The keepers of Hell will say:  Then you yourselves should call (upon the Lord). And the call of the unbelievers will end in vain.
verses.translation: The keepers of Hell will ask:  Did your Messengers not come to you with Clear Signs?  They will say:  Yes (they did).  The keepers of Hell will say:  Then you yourselves should call (upon the Lord). And the call of the unbelievers will end in vain.

verses.text: Surely We shall help Our Messengers and the believers in the life of this world and on the Day when witnesses will rise to testify
verses.translation: Surely We shall help Our Messengers and the believers in the life of this world and on the Day when witnesses will rise to testify

verses.text: the Day when the excuses offered by the wrong-doers shall not avail them. They shall be victims of the curse and a woeful abode.
verses.translation: the Day when the excuses offered by the wrong-doers shall not avail them. They shall be victims of the curse and a woeful abode.

verses.text: We surely guided Moses and made the Children of Israel the heirs of the Book
verses.translation: We surely guided Moses and made the Children of Israel the heirs of the Book

verses.text: which was a guidance and good counsel to people endowed with understanding and wisdom.
verses.translation: which was a guidance and good counsel to people endowed with understanding and wisdom.

verses.text: Be steadfast then (O Prophet) Allah''s promise is true.Seek forgiveness for your shortcomings and celebrate the praise of your Lord evening and morning.
verses.translation: Be steadfast then (O Prophet) Allah''s promise is true.Seek forgiveness for your shortcomings and celebrate the praise of your Lord evening and morning.

verses.text: Verily those who dispute regarding the Signs of Allah without any evidence that might have come to them nothing but vain pride fills their hearts. Yet they shall never be able to satisfy the pride with which they are puffed up. So seek refuge with Allah. Verily He is All-Hearing All-Seeing.
verses.translation: Verily those who dispute regarding the Signs of Allah without any evidence that might have come to them nothing but vain pride fills their hearts. Yet they shall never be able to satisfy the pride with which they are puffed up. So seek refuge with Allah. Verily He is All-Hearing All-Seeing.

verses.text: Surely the creation of the heavens and the earth is a greater act than the creation of human beings. But most people do not know.
verses.translation: Surely the creation of the heavens and the earth is a greater act than the creation of human beings. But most people do not know.

verses.text: Never can the blind and the seeing be equal; nor those that believe and act righteously and those that do evil. Little do you understand.
verses.translation: Never can the blind and the seeing be equal; nor those that believe and act righteously and those that do evil. Little do you understand.

verses.text: The Hour will indeed come; there is no doubt about that. Yet most people do not believe.
verses.translation: The Hour will indeed come; there is no doubt about that. Yet most people do not believe.

verses.text: Your Lord said:  Pray to Me and I will accept your prayers. Surely those who wax too proud to worship Me shall enter Hell utterly abased.
verses.translation: Your Lord said:  Pray to Me and I will accept your prayers. Surely those who wax too proud to worship Me shall enter Hell utterly abased.

verses.text: Allah it is Who made the night so that you may seek repose in it and made the day radiant. Surely Allah is Most Bounteous to people; but most people do not give thanks.
verses.translation: Allah it is Who made the night so that you may seek repose in it and made the day radiant. Surely Allah is Most Bounteous to people; but most people do not give thanks.

verses.text: Allah (Who bestowed all these favours upon you) is your Lord the Creator of everything. There is no god but He. Whence are you then being led astray?
verses.translation: Allah (Who bestowed all these favours upon you) is your Lord the Creator of everything. There is no god but He. Whence are you then being led astray?

verses.text: Thus it is only those who had denied Allah''s Signs that were led astray.
verses.translation: Thus it is only those who had denied Allah''s Signs that were led astray.

verses.text: Allah it is Who made the earth a dwelling place for you and made the sky a canopy Who shaped you - and shaped you exceedingly well - and gave you good things as sustenance. That is Allah your Lord; blessed be Allah the Lord of the Universe.
verses.translation: Allah it is Who made the earth a dwelling place for you and made the sky a canopy Who shaped you - and shaped you exceedingly well - and gave you good things as sustenance. That is Allah your Lord; blessed be Allah the Lord of the Universe.

verses.text: He is the Ever-Living: there is no god but He. So call upon Him consecrating to Him all your devotion. All praise and thanks be to Allah the Lord of the whole Universe.
verses.translation: He is the Ever-Living: there is no god but He. So call upon Him consecrating to Him all your devotion. All praise and thanks be to Allah the Lord of the whole Universe.

verses.text: Say (O Prophet):  I have been forbidden to worship those beside Allah whom you call upon. (How can I worship any beside Allah) when clear Signs have come to me from my Lord and I have been commanded to surrender to Allah the Lord of the Universe?
verses.translation: Say (O Prophet):  I have been forbidden to worship those beside Allah whom you call upon. (How can I worship any beside Allah) when clear Signs have come to me from my Lord and I have been commanded to surrender to Allah the Lord of the Universe?

verses.text: He it is Who created you from dust then from a sperm-drop then from a clot; then He brings you out as an infant then causes you to grow into full maturity and then causes you to grow further so that you may reach old age while some of you He recalls earlier. All this is in order that you may reach an appointed term and that you may understand (the Truth).
verses.translation: He it is Who created you from dust then from a sperm-drop then from a clot; then He brings you out as an infant then causes you to grow into full maturity and then causes you to grow further so that you may reach old age while some of you He recalls earlier. All this is in order that you may reach an appointed term and that you may understand (the Truth).

verses.text: He it is Who gives life and causes death. Whenever He decrees a thing He only commands to it  Be and it is.
verses.translation: He it is Who gives life and causes death. Whenever He decrees a thing He only commands to it  Be and it is.

verses.text: Did you not see those who dispute concerning Allah''s Signs? Whence are they then being turned astray?
verses.translation: Did you not see those who dispute concerning Allah''s Signs? Whence are they then being turned astray?

verses.text: Those who gave the lie to this Book and all the Books which We had sent with Our Messengers shall soon come to know the Truth
verses.translation: Those who gave the lie to this Book and all the Books which We had sent with Our Messengers shall soon come to know the Truth

verses.text: when fetters and chains shall be on their necks and they shall be dragged into
verses.translation: when fetters and chains shall be on their necks and they shall be dragged into

verses.text: boiling water and cast into the Fire.
verses.translation: boiling water and cast into the Fire.

verses.text: It will then be said to them:  Where are those whom you
verses.translation: It will then be said to them:  Where are those whom you

verses.text: associated with Allah in His Divinity? They will say:  We have lost them; rather we never used to call upon anyone before. Thus will Allah cause them to stumble in error.
verses.translation: associated with Allah in His Divinity? They will say:  We have lost them; rather we never used to call upon anyone before. Thus will Allah cause them to stumble in error.

verses.text: (They will be told):  This is because while you were on earth you took delight in untruth and exulted in it.
verses.translation: (They will be told):  This is because while you were on earth you took delight in untruth and exulted in it.

verses.text: Enter Hell now to abide in it. How woeful is the abode of those who wax proud!
verses.translation: Enter Hell now to abide in it. How woeful is the abode of those who wax proud!

verses.text: So be patient (O Prophet). Surely Allah''s promise is true. Whether We show them a part of the woeful consequences against which We warn them (while you are still in their midst) or We recall you (from this world) before that eventually it is to Us that they shall be brought back.
verses.translation: So be patient (O Prophet). Surely Allah''s promise is true. Whether We show them a part of the woeful consequences against which We warn them (while you are still in their midst) or We recall you (from this world) before that eventually it is to Us that they shall be brought back.

verses.text: Indeed We sent many Messengers before you: of them there are some whose account We have narrated to you and there are others whose account We have not narrated to you. It did not lie in any Messenger''s power to bring any Sign except with Allah''s leave. So when Allah''s decree came the matter was decided with justice and those steeped in error courted utter loss then and there.
verses.translation: Indeed We sent many Messengers before you: of them there are some whose account We have narrated to you and there are others whose account We have not narrated to you. It did not lie in any Messenger''s power to bring any Sign except with Allah''s leave. So when Allah''s decree came the matter was decided with justice and those steeped in error courted utter loss then and there.

verses.text: Allah it is Who has made cattle for you so that you ride some of them and from some of them you derive food.
verses.translation: Allah it is Who has made cattle for you so that you ride some of them and from some of them you derive food.

verses.text: In them there are also other benefits for you and through them you fulfil your heartfelt need (to reach places) and you are borne along upon them as upon the ships.
verses.translation: In them there are also other benefits for you and through them you fulfil your heartfelt need (to reach places) and you are borne along upon them as upon the ships.

verses.text: Allah shows His Signs to you; then which of Allah''s Signs will you deny?
verses.translation: Allah shows His Signs to you; then which of Allah''s Signs will you deny?

verses.text: Did they not journey in the land that they may behold the end of those who had gone before them? They were more numerous and greater in strength and left behind more splendid traces in the land. Yet their attainments did not avail them.
verses.translation: Did they not journey in the land that they may behold the end of those who had gone before them? They were more numerous and greater in strength and left behind more splendid traces in the land. Yet their attainments did not avail them.

verses.text: When their Messengers came to them with Clear Signs they arrogantly exulted in whatever knowledge they had. They were then encompassed by what they had mocked.
verses.translation: When their Messengers came to them with Clear Signs they arrogantly exulted in whatever knowledge they had. They were then encompassed by what they had mocked.

verses.text: When they saw Our chastisement they said:  We have come to believe in Allah the Only One and we reject all what we had associated (with Allah in His Divinity).
verses.translation: When they saw Our chastisement they said:  We have come to believe in Allah the Only One and we reject all what we had associated (with Allah in His Divinity).

verses.text: But their believing after they had seen Our chastisement did not avail them. That has been Allah''s Way concerning His servants. And the unbelievers courted utter loss then and there.
verses.translation: But their believing after they had seen Our chastisement did not avail them. That has been Allah''s Way concerning His servants. And the unbelievers courted utter loss then and there.

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: Ha''. Mim.
ayahs.translation: Ha''. Mim.

ayahs.text: This Book is a revelation from Allah the All-Mighty the All-Knowing;
ayahs.translation: This Book is a revelation from Allah the All-Mighty the All-Knowing;

ayahs.text: the Forgiver of sins the Accepter of repentance the Stern in retribution the Bountiful. There is no god but He. To Him are all destined to return.
ayahs.translation: the Forgiver of sins the Accepter of repentance the Stern in retribution the Bountiful. There is no god but He. To Him are all destined to return.

ayahs.text: None but the unbelievers dispute regarding the Signs of Allah. So let not their strutting about in the land delude you.
ayahs.translation: None but the unbelievers dispute regarding the Signs of Allah. So let not their strutting about in the land delude you.

ayahs.text: Before them the people of Noah also gave the lie (to Messengers) and so did many parties after them. Each nation sallied forth against its Messenger to seize him and they disputed with false arguments seeking therewith to repudiate the Truth. Then I seized them; and behold how woeful was My retribution!
ayahs.translation: Before them the people of Noah also gave the lie (to Messengers) and so did many parties after them. Each nation sallied forth against its Messenger to seize him and they disputed with false arguments seeking therewith to repudiate the Truth. Then I seized them; and behold how woeful was My retribution!

ayahs.text: Thus has the decree of your Lord become due against the unbelievers. They are destined for the Fire.
ayahs.translation: Thus has the decree of your Lord become due against the unbelievers. They are destined for the Fire.

ayahs.text: The angels that bear the Throne and those that are around to extol your Lord''s glory with His praise they believe in Him and ask forgiveness for the believers saying:  Our Lord! You encompass everything with Your Mercy and Knowledge. So forgive those that repent and follow Your Path and guard them against the chastisement of Hell.
ayahs.translation: The angels that bear the Throne and those that are around to extol your Lord''s glory with His praise they believe in Him and ask forgiveness for the believers saying:  Our Lord! You encompass everything with Your Mercy and Knowledge. So forgive those that repent and follow Your Path and guard them against the chastisement of Hell.

ayahs.text: Our Lord admit them to the everlasting Gardens You have promised them and those of their fathers and spouses and progeny that were righteous. Surely You alone are Most Mighty Most Wise;
ayahs.translation: Our Lord admit them to the everlasting Gardens You have promised them and those of their fathers and spouses and progeny that were righteous. Surely You alone are Most Mighty Most Wise;

ayahs.text: and guard them against all ills. He whom You guard against ills on that Day to him You have surely been Most Merciful. That is the great triumph.
ayahs.translation: and guard them against all ills. He whom You guard against ills on that Day to him You have surely been Most Merciful. That is the great triumph.

ayahs.text: It will be announced to the unbelievers (on the Day of Resurrection):  Surely Allah''s abhorrence of you when you were called to believe but you disbelieved was greater than is your abhorrence of yourselves today.
ayahs.translation: It will be announced to the unbelievers (on the Day of Resurrection):  Surely Allah''s abhorrence of you when you were called to believe but you disbelieved was greater than is your abhorrence of yourselves today.

ayahs.text: They will say:  Our Lord twice have You caused us to die and twice have You given us life. We have now confessed our sins. Is there then any way out?
ayahs.translation: They will say:  Our Lord twice have You caused us to die and twice have You given us life. We have now confessed our sins. Is there then any way out?

ayahs.text: (They will be told):  (The cause of your present state is that) when Allah alone was invoked you disbelieved; and when others instead of Him were invoked you believed. Today all judgement lies with Allah the Most High the All-Great.
ayahs.translation: (They will be told):  (The cause of your present state is that) when Allah alone was invoked you disbelieved; and when others instead of Him were invoked you believed. Today all judgement lies with Allah the Most High the All-Great.

ayahs.text: He it is Who shows you His Signs and sends down provision for you from the sky. Yet none takes heed except he who constantly turns to Allah.
ayahs.translation: He it is Who shows you His Signs and sends down provision for you from the sky. Yet none takes heed except he who constantly turns to Allah.

ayahs.text: So call upon Allah consecrating all your devotion to Him howsoever much the unbelievers may dislike it.
ayahs.translation: So call upon Allah consecrating all your devotion to Him howsoever much the unbelievers may dislike it.

ayahs.text: Exalted in Rank Lord of the Throne: He causes the spirit to descend on whomsoever of His servants He pleases so as to warn them of the Day of Encounter;
ayahs.translation: Exalted in Rank Lord of the Throne: He causes the spirit to descend on whomsoever of His servants He pleases so as to warn them of the Day of Encounter;

ayahs.text: the Day when they will emerge and nothing of them shall be hidden from Allah. (On that Day they will be asked):  Whose is the kingdom today? (The whole world will cry out):  It is Allah''s the One the Overpowering.
ayahs.translation: the Day when they will emerge and nothing of them shall be hidden from Allah. (On that Day they will be asked):  Whose is the kingdom today? (The whole world will cry out):  It is Allah''s the One the Overpowering.

ayahs.text: (It will then be said):  Today shall everyone be fully recompensed for his deeds. None shall be wronged today. Surely Allah is Swift in Reckoning.
ayahs.translation: (It will then be said):  Today shall everyone be fully recompensed for his deeds. None shall be wronged today. Surely Allah is Swift in Reckoning.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) then warn them of the Day that has drawn near the Day when hearts full of suppressed grief will leap up to the throats and the wrong-doers shall neither have any sincere friend nor intercessor whose word will be heeded.
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) then warn them of the Day that has drawn near the Day when hearts full of suppressed grief will leap up to the throats and the wrong-doers shall neither have any sincere friend nor intercessor whose word will be heeded.
