ayahs.text: He knows even the most stealthy glance of the eyes and all the secrets that hearts conceal.
ayahs.translation: He knows even the most stealthy glance of the eyes and all the secrets that hearts conceal.

ayahs.text: Allah will judge with justice whereas those whom they call upon beside Him cannot judge at all. Surely Allah - and He alone - is All- Hearing All-Seeing.
ayahs.translation: Allah will judge with justice whereas those whom they call upon beside Him cannot judge at all. Surely Allah - and He alone - is All- Hearing All-Seeing.

ayahs.text: Have they not journeyed in the land that they might observe the end of those who came before them? They were even greater in strength than they and left behind more splendid traces in the land. Then Allah seized them because of their sins and they had none who could protect them from Allah.
ayahs.translation: Have they not journeyed in the land that they might observe the end of those who came before them? They were even greater in strength than they and left behind more splendid traces in the land. Then Allah seized them because of their sins and they had none who could protect them from Allah.

ayahs.text: They came to this end because their Messengers would come to them with Clear Signs and yet they would refuse to believe. So Allah seized them. He is indeed Strong Terrible in Retribution.
ayahs.translation: They came to this end because their Messengers would come to them with Clear Signs and yet they would refuse to believe. So Allah seized them. He is indeed Strong Terrible in Retribution.

ayahs.text: Verily We sent Moses with Our Signs and a clear authority
ayahs.translation: Verily We sent Moses with Our Signs and a clear authority

ayahs.text: to Pharaoh and Haman and Korah. They said:  (He is) a sorcerer an utter liar.
ayahs.translation: to Pharaoh and Haman and Korah. They said:  (He is) a sorcerer an utter liar.

ayahs.text: When Moses brought them the Truth from Us they said:  Kill the sons of all the believers who have joined him but spare the women. The guile of the unbelievers always ends in vain.
ayahs.translation: When Moses brought them the Truth from Us they said:  Kill the sons of all the believers who have joined him but spare the women. The guile of the unbelievers always ends in vain.

ayahs.text: One day Pharaoh said:  Let me go and kill Moses; then let him invoke his Lord. I fear that he will change your religion or cause disruption in the land.
ayahs.translation: One day Pharaoh said:  Let me go and kill Moses; then let him invoke his Lord. I fear that he will change your religion or cause disruption in the land.

ayahs.text: Moses said:  I have taken refuge with my Lord and your Lord from everyone who waxes arrogant and does not believe in the Day of Reckoning.
ayahs.translation: Moses said:  I have taken refuge with my Lord and your Lord from everyone who waxes arrogant and does not believe in the Day of Reckoning.

ayahs.text: Then a man endowed with faith from Pharaoh''s folk who had kept his faith hidden said:  Do you kill a person simply because he says: ''My Lord is Allah'' even though he brought to you clear Signs from your Lord? If he is a liar his lying will recoil upon him; but if he is truthful you will be smitten with some of the awesome consequences of which he warns you. Allah does not guide to the Right Way any who exceeds the limits and is an utter liar.
ayahs.translation: Then a man endowed with faith from Pharaoh''s folk who had kept his faith hidden said:  Do you kill a person simply because he says: ''My Lord is Allah'' even though he brought to you clear Signs from your Lord? If he is a liar his lying will recoil upon him; but if he is truthful you will be smitten with some of the awesome consequences of which he warns you. Allah does not guide to the Right Way any who exceeds the limits and is an utter liar.

ayahs.text: My people today the kingdom is yours and you are supreme in the land. But if Allah''s chastisement were to come upon you who will come to our help? Pharaoh said:  I only counsel what I consider right; I only direct you to the Path of Rectitude.
ayahs.translation: My people today the kingdom is yours and you are supreme in the land. But if Allah''s chastisement were to come upon you who will come to our help? Pharaoh said:  I only counsel what I consider right; I only direct you to the Path of Rectitude.

ayahs.text: He who had faith said:  My people I fear that you will confront a day like that which overtook many parties before you
ayahs.translation: He who had faith said:  My people I fear that you will confront a day like that which overtook many parties before you

ayahs.text: like the day that overtook the people of Noah and Ad and Thamud and those who came after them. Allah does not wish to subject His servants to any injustice.
ayahs.translation: like the day that overtook the people of Noah and Ad and Thamud and those who came after them. Allah does not wish to subject His servants to any injustice.

ayahs.text: My people I fear that you will encounter a day when there will be much wailing and you will cry out to one another for help
ayahs.translation: My people I fear that you will encounter a day when there will be much wailing and you will cry out to one another for help

ayahs.text: the day when you will turn around to retreat there will be none to protect you from Allah. He whom Allah lets go astray none will be able to show him the Right Way.
ayahs.translation: the day when you will turn around to retreat there will be none to protect you from Allah. He whom Allah lets go astray none will be able to show him the Right Way.

ayahs.text: Verily Joseph came to you with Clear Signs before yet you continued to doubt his Message. Thereafter when he died you said: ''Allah shall send no Messenger after him.'' Thus Allah leads astray those who transgress the limits and are given to much doubting;
ayahs.translation: Verily Joseph came to you with Clear Signs before yet you continued to doubt his Message. Thereafter when he died you said: ''Allah shall send no Messenger after him.'' Thus Allah leads astray those who transgress the limits and are given to much doubting;

ayahs.text: those who contend regarding Allah''s Signs without any evidence that might have come to them. That is exceedingly loathsome to Allah and to those that believe. Thus does Allah seal the heart of everyone who is proud and high-handed.
ayahs.translation: those who contend regarding Allah''s Signs without any evidence that might have come to them. That is exceedingly loathsome to Allah and to those that believe. Thus does Allah seal the heart of everyone who is proud and high-handed.

ayahs.text: Pharaoh said:  Haman build for me a lofty tower that I may scale the highways -
ayahs.translation: Pharaoh said:  Haman build for me a lofty tower that I may scale the highways -

ayahs.text: the highways to the heavens - and have a look at the God of Moses although I am certain that Moses is a liar. Thus Pharaoh''s evil deed was made to seem fair to him and he was barred from the Right Path. Pharaoh''s guile only led him to his own perdition.
ayahs.translation: the highways to the heavens - and have a look at the God of Moses although I am certain that Moses is a liar. Thus Pharaoh''s evil deed was made to seem fair to him and he was barred from the Right Path. Pharaoh''s guile only led him to his own perdition.

ayahs.text: The person endowed with faith said:  My people follow me; I shall direct you to the Path of Rectitude.
ayahs.translation: The person endowed with faith said:  My people follow me; I shall direct you to the Path of Rectitude.

ayahs.text: My people the life of this world is ephemeral whereas the Hereafter that is the permanent abode.
ayahs.translation: My people the life of this world is ephemeral whereas the Hereafter that is the permanent abode.

ayahs.text: Whosoever does an evil deed will be requited only with the like of it; and whosoever acts righteously and has attained to faith - be he a male or a female - they shall enter Paradise and be provided sustenance beyond all reckoning.
ayahs.translation: Whosoever does an evil deed will be requited only with the like of it; and whosoever acts righteously and has attained to faith - be he a male or a female - they shall enter Paradise and be provided sustenance beyond all reckoning.

ayahs.text: My people how is it that I call you to salvation while you call me to the Fire;
ayahs.translation: My people how is it that I call you to salvation while you call me to the Fire;

ayahs.text: you call me to deny Allah and to associate with Him as His partners those regarding whom I have no knowledge (that they are Allah''s partners in His Divinity) whereas I call you to the Most Mighty the Most Forgiving?
ayahs.translation: you call me to deny Allah and to associate with Him as His partners those regarding whom I have no knowledge (that they are Allah''s partners in His Divinity) whereas I call you to the Most Mighty the Most Forgiving?

ayahs.text: There is no doubt that those whom you call me to have no claim to be called upon in this world and in the Hereafter. Certainly to Allah shall be our return and those who exceed the limits are destined to the Fire.
ayahs.translation: There is no doubt that those whom you call me to have no claim to be called upon in this world and in the Hereafter. Certainly to Allah shall be our return and those who exceed the limits are destined to the Fire.

ayahs.text: Soon you shall remember what I say to you. I entrust my affairs to Allah. Surely Allah is watchful over His servants.
ayahs.translation: Soon you shall remember what I say to you. I entrust my affairs to Allah. Surely Allah is watchful over His servants.

ayahs.text: Eventually Allah saved the person endowed with faith from all the evils of their guile and a woeful chastisement encompassed the Pharaonites.
ayahs.translation: Eventually Allah saved the person endowed with faith from all the evils of their guile and a woeful chastisement encompassed the Pharaonites.

ayahs.text: They are exposed to the Fire every morning and evening; and when the Last Hour will come to pass a command shall be given:  Admit the Pharaonites to an even more severe chastisement.
ayahs.translation: They are exposed to the Fire every morning and evening; and when the Last Hour will come to pass a command shall be given:  Admit the Pharaonites to an even more severe chastisement.

ayahs.text: Just imagine when they will remonstrate with one another in Hell. The weak ones will say to those who waxed proud:  We were your followers. Will you then lighten for us a part of our suffering of the Fire?
ayahs.translation: Just imagine when they will remonstrate with one another in Hell. The weak ones will say to those who waxed proud:  We were your followers. Will you then lighten for us a part of our suffering of the Fire?

ayahs.text: Those who had waxed proud will reply:  All of us are in it. Allah has already passed His judgement among His servants.
ayahs.translation: Those who had waxed proud will reply:  All of us are in it. Allah has already passed His judgement among His servants.

ayahs.text: Those suffering in the Fire will say to the keepers of Hell:  Call upon your Lord to lighten the chastisement for us just for a day.
ayahs.translation: Those suffering in the Fire will say to the keepers of Hell:  Call upon your Lord to lighten the chastisement for us just for a day.

ayahs.text: The keepers of Hell will ask:  Did your Messengers not come to you with Clear Signs?  They will say:  Yes (they did).  The keepers of Hell will say:  Then you yourselves should call (upon the Lord). And the call of the unbelievers will end in vain.
ayahs.translation: The keepers of Hell will ask:  Did your Messengers not come to you with Clear Signs?  They will say:  Yes (they did).  The keepers of Hell will say:  Then you yourselves should call (upon the Lord). And the call of the unbelievers will end in vain.

ayahs.text: Surely We shall help Our Messengers and the believers in the life of this world and on the Day when witnesses will rise to testify
ayahs.translation: Surely We shall help Our Messengers and the believers in the life of this world and on the Day when witnesses will rise to testify

ayahs.text: the Day when the excuses offered by the wrong-doers shall not avail them. They shall be victims of the curse and a woeful abode.
ayahs.translation: the Day when the excuses offered by the wrong-doers shall not avail them. They shall be victims of the curse and a woeful abode.

ayahs.text: We surely guided Moses and made the Children of Israel the heirs of the Book
ayahs.translation: We surely guided Moses and made the Children of Israel the heirs of the Book

ayahs.text: which was a guidance and good counsel to people endowed with understanding and wisdom.
ayahs.translation: which was a guidance and good counsel to people endowed with understanding and wisdom.

ayahs.text: Be steadfast then (O Prophet) Allah''s promise is true.Seek forgiveness for your shortcomings and celebrate the praise of your Lord evening and morning.
ayahs.translation: Be steadfast then (O Prophet) Allah''s promise is true.Seek forgiveness for your shortcomings and celebrate the praise of your Lord evening and morning.

ayahs.text: Verily those who dispute regarding the Signs of Allah without any evidence that might have come to them nothing but vain pride fills their hearts. Yet they shall never be able to satisfy the pride with which they are puffed up. So seek refuge with Allah. Verily He is All-Hearing All-Seeing.
ayahs.translation: Verily those who dispute regarding the Signs of Allah without any evidence that might have come to them nothing but vain pride fills their hearts. Yet they shall never be able to satisfy the pride with which they are puffed up. So seek refuge with Allah. Verily He is All-Hearing All-Seeing.

ayahs.text: Surely the creation of the heavens and the earth is a greater act than the creation of human beings. But most people do not know.
ayahs.translation: Surely the creation of the heavens and the earth is a greater act than the creation of human beings. But most people do not know.

ayahs.text: Never can the blind and the seeing be equal; nor those that believe and act righteously and those that do evil. Little do you understand.
ayahs.translation: Never can the blind and the seeing be equal; nor those that believe and act righteously and those that do evil. Little do you understand.

ayahs.text: The Hour will indeed come; there is no doubt about that. Yet most people do not believe.
ayahs.translation: The Hour will indeed come; there is no doubt about that. Yet most people do not believe.

ayahs.text: Your Lord said:  Pray to Me and I will accept your prayers. Surely those who wax too proud to worship Me shall enter Hell utterly abased.
ayahs.translation: Your Lord said:  Pray to Me and I will accept your prayers. Surely those who wax too proud to worship Me shall enter Hell utterly abased.

ayahs.text: Allah it is Who made the night so that you may seek repose in it and made the day radiant. Surely Allah is Most Bounteous to people; but most people do not give thanks.
ayahs.translation: Allah it is Who made the night so that you may seek repose in it and made the day radiant. Surely Allah is Most Bounteous to people; but most people do not give thanks.

ayahs.text: Allah (Who bestowed all these favours upon you) is your Lord the Creator of everything. There is no god but He. Whence are you then being led astray?
ayahs.translation: Allah (Who bestowed all these favours upon you) is your Lord the Creator of everything. There is no god but He. Whence are you then being led astray?

ayahs.text: Thus it is only those who had denied Allah''s Signs that were led astray.
ayahs.translation: Thus it is only those who had denied Allah''s Signs that were led astray.

ayahs.text: Allah it is Who made the earth a dwelling place for you and made the sky a canopy Who shaped you - and shaped you exceedingly well - and gave you good things as sustenance. That is Allah your Lord; blessed be Allah the Lord of the Universe.
ayahs.translation: Allah it is Who made the earth a dwelling place for you and made the sky a canopy Who shaped you - and shaped you exceedingly well - and gave you good things as sustenance. That is Allah your Lord; blessed be Allah the Lord of the Universe.

ayahs.text: He is the Ever-Living: there is no god but He. So call upon Him consecrating to Him all your devotion. All praise and thanks be to Allah the Lord of the whole Universe.
ayahs.translation: He is the Ever-Living: there is no god but He. So call upon Him consecrating to Him all your devotion. All praise and thanks be to Allah the Lord of the whole Universe.

ayahs.text: Say (O Prophet):  I have been forbidden to worship those beside Allah whom you call upon. (How can I worship any beside Allah) when clear Signs have come to me from my Lord and I have been commanded to surrender to Allah the Lord of the Universe?
ayahs.translation: Say (O Prophet):  I have been forbidden to worship those beside Allah whom you call upon. (How can I worship any beside Allah) when clear Signs have come to me from my Lord and I have been commanded to surrender to Allah the Lord of the Universe?

ayahs.text: He it is Who created you from dust then from a sperm-drop then from a clot; then He brings you out as an infant then causes you to grow into full maturity and then causes you to grow further so that you may reach old age while some of you He recalls earlier. All this is in order that you may reach an appointed term and that you may understand (the Truth).
ayahs.translation: He it is Who created you from dust then from a sperm-drop then from a clot; then He brings you out as an infant then causes you to grow into full maturity and then causes you to grow further so that you may reach old age while some of you He recalls earlier. All this is in order that you may reach an appointed term and that you may understand (the Truth).

ayahs.text: He it is Who gives life and causes death. Whenever He decrees a thing He only commands to it  Be and it is.
ayahs.translation: He it is Who gives life and causes death. Whenever He decrees a thing He only commands to it  Be and it is.

ayahs.text: Did you not see those who dispute concerning Allah''s Signs? Whence are they then being turned astray?
ayahs.translation: Did you not see those who dispute concerning Allah''s Signs? Whence are they then being turned astray?

ayahs.text: Those who gave the lie to this Book and all the Books which We had sent with Our Messengers shall soon come to know the Truth
ayahs.translation: Those who gave the lie to this Book and all the Books which We had sent with Our Messengers shall soon come to know the Truth

ayahs.text: when fetters and chains shall be on their necks and they shall be dragged into
ayahs.translation: when fetters and chains shall be on their necks and they shall be dragged into

ayahs.text: boiling water and cast into the Fire.
ayahs.translation: boiling water and cast into the Fire.

ayahs.text: It will then be said to them:  Where are those whom you
ayahs.translation: It will then be said to them:  Where are those whom you

ayahs.text: associated with Allah in His Divinity? They will say:  We have lost them; rather we never used to call upon anyone before. Thus will Allah cause them to stumble in error.
ayahs.translation: associated with Allah in His Divinity? They will say:  We have lost them; rather we never used to call upon anyone before. Thus will Allah cause them to stumble in error.

ayahs.text: (They will be told):  This is because while you were on earth you took delight in untruth and exulted in it.
ayahs.translation: (They will be told):  This is because while you were on earth you took delight in untruth and exulted in it.

ayahs.text: Enter Hell now to abide in it. How woeful is the abode of those who wax proud!
ayahs.translation: Enter Hell now to abide in it. How woeful is the abode of those who wax proud!

ayahs.text: So be patient (O Prophet). Surely Allah''s promise is true. Whether We show them a part of the woeful consequences against which We warn them (while you are still in their midst) or We recall you (from this world) before that eventually it is to Us that they shall be brought back.
ayahs.translation: So be patient (O Prophet). Surely Allah''s promise is true. Whether We show them a part of the woeful consequences against which We warn them (while you are still in their midst) or We recall you (from this world) before that eventually it is to Us that they shall be brought back.

ayahs.text: Indeed We sent many Messengers before you: of them there are some whose account We have narrated to you and there are others whose account We have not narrated to you. It did not lie in any Messenger''s power to bring any Sign except with Allah''s leave. So when Allah''s decree came the matter was decided with justice and those steeped in error courted utter loss then and there.
ayahs.translation: Indeed We sent many Messengers before you: of them there are some whose account We have narrated to you and there are others whose account We have not narrated to you. It did not lie in any Messenger''s power to bring any Sign except with Allah''s leave. So when Allah''s decree came the matter was decided with justice and those steeped in error courted utter loss then and there.

ayahs.text: Allah it is Who has made cattle for you so that you ride some of them and from some of them you derive food.
ayahs.translation: Allah it is Who has made cattle for you so that you ride some of them and from some of them you derive food.

ayahs.text: In them there are also other benefits for you and through them you fulfil your heartfelt need (to reach places) and you are borne along upon them as upon the ships.
ayahs.translation: In them there are also other benefits for you and through them you fulfil your heartfelt need (to reach places) and you are borne along upon them as upon the ships.

ayahs.text: Allah shows His Signs to you; then which of Allah''s Signs will you deny?
ayahs.translation: Allah shows His Signs to you; then which of Allah''s Signs will you deny?

ayahs.text: Did they not journey in the land that they may behold the end of those who had gone before them? They were more numerous and greater in strength and left behind more splendid traces in the land. Yet their attainments did not avail them.
ayahs.translation: Did they not journey in the land that they may behold the end of those who had gone before them? They were more numerous and greater in strength and left behind more splendid traces in the land. Yet their attainments did not avail them.

ayahs.text: When their Messengers came to them with Clear Signs they arrogantly exulted in whatever knowledge they had. They were then encompassed by what they had mocked.
ayahs.translation: When their Messengers came to them with Clear Signs they arrogantly exulted in whatever knowledge they had. They were then encompassed by what they had mocked.

ayahs.text: When they saw Our chastisement they said:  We have come to believe in Allah the Only One and we reject all what we had associated (with Allah in His Divinity).
ayahs.translation: When they saw Our chastisement they said:  We have come to believe in Allah the Only One and we reject all what we had associated (with Allah in His Divinity).

ayahs.text: But their believing after they had seen Our chastisement did not avail them. That has been Allah''s Way concerning His servants. And the unbelievers courted utter loss then and there.
ayahs.translation: But their believing after they had seen Our chastisement did not avail them. That has been Allah''s Way concerning His servants. And the unbelievers courted utter loss then and there.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Ha''. Mim.
verses.translation: Ha''. Mim.

verses.text: This is a revelation from the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: This is a revelation from the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: a Book whose verses have been well-expounded; an Arabic Qur''an for those who have knowledge
verses.translation: a Book whose verses have been well-expounded; an Arabic Qur''an for those who have knowledge

verses.text: one bearing good news and warning. Yet most of them turned away and are not wont to give heed.
verses.translation: one bearing good news and warning. Yet most of them turned away and are not wont to give heed.

verses.text: They say:  Our hearts are securely wrapped up against what you call us to and in our ears is a heaviness and between you and us there is a veil. So act; we too are acting.
verses.translation: They say:  Our hearts are securely wrapped up against what you call us to and in our ears is a heaviness and between you and us there is a veil. So act; we too are acting.

verses.text: Tell them (O Prophet):  I am only a human being like you. It is revealed to me that your God is One God; so direct yourselves straight to Him and seek His forgiveness. Woe to those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity
verses.translation: Tell them (O Prophet):  I am only a human being like you. It is revealed to me that your God is One God; so direct yourselves straight to Him and seek His forgiveness. Woe to those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity

verses.text: who do not pay Zakah and who deny the Hereafter.
verses.translation: who do not pay Zakah and who deny the Hereafter.

verses.text: As to those who have faith and do good works surely theirs shall be a never-ending reward.
verses.translation: As to those who have faith and do good works surely theirs shall be a never-ending reward.

verses.text: Tell them (O Prophet):  Do you indeed disbelieve in Him and assign compeers to Him Who created the earth in two days? He is the Lord of all beings of the Universe.
verses.translation: Tell them (O Prophet):  Do you indeed disbelieve in Him and assign compeers to Him Who created the earth in two days? He is the Lord of all beings of the Universe.

verses.text: (After creating the earth) He set up firm mountains on it blessed it and provided it with sustenance in proportion to the needs of all who seek (sustenance). All this was done in four days.
verses.translation: (After creating the earth) He set up firm mountains on it blessed it and provided it with sustenance in proportion to the needs of all who seek (sustenance). All this was done in four days.

verses.text: Then He turned to the heaven while it was all smoke. He said to the heaven and the earth:  Come (into being) willingly or unwillingly.  They said:  Here we come (into being) in willing obeisance.
verses.translation: Then He turned to the heaven while it was all smoke. He said to the heaven and the earth:  Come (into being) willingly or unwillingly.  They said:  Here we come (into being) in willing obeisance.

verses.text: Then He made them seven heavens in two days and revealed to each heaven its law. And We adorned the lower heaven with lamps and firmly secured it. All this is the firm plan of the All-Mighty the All-Knowing.
verses.translation: Then He made them seven heavens in two days and revealed to each heaven its law. And We adorned the lower heaven with lamps and firmly secured it. All this is the firm plan of the All-Mighty the All-Knowing.

verses.text: But if they turn away tell them:  I warn you against a sudden scourge like that which struck Ad and Thamud.
verses.translation: But if they turn away tell them:  I warn you against a sudden scourge like that which struck Ad and Thamud.

verses.text: When the Messengers (of Allah) came to them from the front and from the rear saying:  Do not serve any but Allah ; they said:  Had our Lord so willed He would have sent down angels. So we deny the Message you have brought.
verses.translation: When the Messengers (of Allah) came to them from the front and from the rear saying:  Do not serve any but Allah ; they said:  Had our Lord so willed He would have sent down angels. So we deny the Message you have brought.

verses.text: As for Ad they waxed proud in the land without justification and said:  Who is greater than we in strength?  Did they not see that Allah Who created them is greater in strength than they? They continued to deny Our Signs
verses.translation: As for Ad they waxed proud in the land without justification and said:  Who is greater than we in strength?  Did they not see that Allah Who created them is greater in strength than they? They continued to deny Our Signs

verses.text: whereupon We sent upon them a fierce wind on inauspicious days that We might make them taste a degrading chastisement in the life of this world. And surely the chastisement of the Hereafter is even more degrading. There will be none to help them there.
verses.translation: whereupon We sent upon them a fierce wind on inauspicious days that We might make them taste a degrading chastisement in the life of this world. And surely the chastisement of the Hereafter is even more degrading. There will be none to help them there.

verses.text: As for Thamud We bestowed guidance upon them but they preferred to remain blind rather than be guided. At last a humiliating scourge overtook them on account of their misdeeds.
verses.translation: As for Thamud We bestowed guidance upon them but they preferred to remain blind rather than be guided. At last a humiliating scourge overtook them on account of their misdeeds.

verses.text: Yet We delivered those who believed and were God-fearing.
verses.translation: Yet We delivered those who believed and were God-fearing.

verses.text: Imagine the Day when Allah''s enemies will be mustered to the Fire and the people of the former times will be detained until the arrival of people of the later times
verses.translation: Imagine the Day when Allah''s enemies will be mustered to the Fire and the people of the former times will be detained until the arrival of people of the later times

verses.text: and when all have arrived their ears their eyes and their skins shall bear witness against them stating all that they had done in the life of the world.
verses.translation: and when all have arrived their ears their eyes and their skins shall bear witness against them stating all that they had done in the life of the world.

verses.text: They will ask their skins:  Why did you bear witness against us?  The skins will reply:  Allah gave us speech as He gave speech to all others. He it is Who created you for the first time and it is to Him that you will be sent back.
verses.translation: They will ask their skins:  Why did you bear witness against us?  The skins will reply:  Allah gave us speech as He gave speech to all others. He it is Who created you for the first time and it is to Him that you will be sent back.

verses.text: When you used to conceal yourselves (while committing misdeeds) you never thought that your ears or your eyes or your skins would ever bear witness against you; you rather fancied that Allah does not know a great deal of what you do.
verses.translation: When you used to conceal yourselves (while committing misdeeds) you never thought that your ears or your eyes or your skins would ever bear witness against you; you rather fancied that Allah does not know a great deal of what you do.

verses.text: This thought of yours about your Lord has led to your perdition and you have become among the losers.
verses.translation: This thought of yours about your Lord has led to your perdition and you have become among the losers.

verses.text: In this state whether they bear with patience (or not) Fire alone shall be their abode. And if they seek to make amends they will not be allowed to do so.
verses.translation: In this state whether they bear with patience (or not) Fire alone shall be their abode. And if they seek to make amends they will not be allowed to do so.

verses.text: We had assigned to them companions who embellished for them all that was before them and behind them. Thus the same decree (of chastisement) which had overtaken the previous generations of jinn and human beings (also) became due against them. Surely they became the losers.
verses.translation: We had assigned to them companions who embellished for them all that was before them and behind them. Thus the same decree (of chastisement) which had overtaken the previous generations of jinn and human beings (also) became due against them. Surely they became the losers.

verses.text: The deniers of the Truth say:  Do not give ear to the Qur''an and cause interruption when it is recited; thus perhaps you will gain the upper hand.
verses.translation: The deniers of the Truth say:  Do not give ear to the Qur''an and cause interruption when it is recited; thus perhaps you will gain the upper hand.

verses.text: We shall certainly make these unbelievers taste a terrible chastisement and shall fully requite them according to the worst deeds that they committed.
verses.translation: We shall certainly make these unbelievers taste a terrible chastisement and shall fully requite them according to the worst deeds that they committed.

verses.text: That is the recompense of the enemies of Allah - the Fire their abiding home. That will be the re-compense for their denying Our Signs.
verses.translation: That is the recompense of the enemies of Allah - the Fire their abiding home. That will be the re-compense for their denying Our Signs.

verses.text: There the unbelievers will say:  Our Lord show us those that led us astray both jinn and humans and we will trample them under our feet so that they are utterly degraded.
verses.translation: There the unbelievers will say:  Our Lord show us those that led us astray both jinn and humans and we will trample them under our feet so that they are utterly degraded.

verses.text: Those who say  Allah is our Lord  and then remain steadfast upon them descend angels (and say):  Do not fear nor grieve and receive good tidings of Paradise which you were promised.
verses.translation: Those who say  Allah is our Lord  and then remain steadfast upon them descend angels (and say):  Do not fear nor grieve and receive good tidings of Paradise which you were promised.

verses.text: We are your companions in this world and in the Hereafter. There you shall have all that you desire and all what you will ask for.
verses.translation: We are your companions in this world and in the Hereafter. There you shall have all that you desire and all what you will ask for.

verses.text: This is by way of hospitality from Him Who is Most Forgiving Most Merciful.
verses.translation: This is by way of hospitality from Him Who is Most Forgiving Most Merciful.

verses.text: And who is fairer in speech than he who calls to Allah and acts righteously and says:  I am a Muslim ?
verses.translation: And who is fairer in speech than he who calls to Allah and acts righteously and says:  I am a Muslim ?

verses.text: (O Prophet) good and evil are not equal. Repel (evil) with that which is good and you will see that he between whom and you there was enmity shall become as if he were a bosom friend (of yours).
verses.translation: (O Prophet) good and evil are not equal. Repel (evil) with that which is good and you will see that he between whom and you there was enmity shall become as if he were a bosom friend (of yours).

verses.text: But none attains to this except those who are steadfast; none attains to this except those endowed with mighty good fortune.
verses.translation: But none attains to this except those who are steadfast; none attains to this except those endowed with mighty good fortune.

verses.text: And if you are prompted by a provocation from Satan seek refuge with Allah. He and He alone is All-Hearing All- Knowing.
verses.translation: And if you are prompted by a provocation from Satan seek refuge with Allah. He and He alone is All-Hearing All- Knowing.

verses.text: And of His Signs are the night and the day and the sun and the moon. Do not prostrate yourselves before the sun nor before the moon but prostrate yourselves before Allah Who created them if it is Him that you serve.
verses.translation: And of His Signs are the night and the day and the sun and the moon. Do not prostrate yourselves before the sun nor before the moon but prostrate yourselves before Allah Who created them if it is Him that you serve.

verses.text: But if they wax proud (and persist in their attitude it does not matter for) the angels near-stationed to your Lord glorify Him night and day and never grow weary.
verses.translation: But if they wax proud (and persist in their attitude it does not matter for) the angels near-stationed to your Lord glorify Him night and day and never grow weary.

verses.text: And of His Signs is that you see the earth withered then We send down water upon it and lo! it quivers and swells. Surely He Who gives life to the dead earth will also give life to the dead. Surely He has power over everything.
verses.translation: And of His Signs is that you see the earth withered then We send down water upon it and lo! it quivers and swells. Surely He Who gives life to the dead earth will also give life to the dead. Surely He has power over everything.

verses.text: Those who pervert Our Signs are not hidden from Us. Is he who will be cast into the Fire better or he who comes secure on the Day of Resurrection? Do as you wish; He sees all what you do.
verses.translation: Those who pervert Our Signs are not hidden from Us. Is he who will be cast into the Fire better or he who comes secure on the Day of Resurrection? Do as you wish; He sees all what you do.

verses.text: These are the ones who rejected the Good Counsel when it came to them although it is certainly a Mighty Book.
verses.translation: These are the ones who rejected the Good Counsel when it came to them although it is certainly a Mighty Book.

verses.text: Falsehood may not enter it from the front or from the rear. It is a revelation that has been sent down from the Most Wise the Immensely Praiseworthy.
verses.translation: Falsehood may not enter it from the front or from the rear. It is a revelation that has been sent down from the Most Wise the Immensely Praiseworthy.

verses.text: (O Prophet) nothing is said to you but what was already said to the Messengers before you. Surely your Lord is the Lord of forgiveness and the Lord of grievous chastisement.
verses.translation: (O Prophet) nothing is said to you but what was already said to the Messengers before you. Surely your Lord is the Lord of forgiveness and the Lord of grievous chastisement.

verses.text: Had We revealed this as a non-Arabic Qur''an they would have said:  Why were its verses not clearly expounded? How strange a non-Arabic scripture and an Arab audience! Tell them:  It is a guidance and a healing to the believers. But to those who do not believe it serves as a plug in their ears and a covering over their eyes. It is as if they are being called from a place far away.
verses.translation: Had We revealed this as a non-Arabic Qur''an they would have said:  Why were its verses not clearly expounded? How strange a non-Arabic scripture and an Arab audience! Tell them:  It is a guidance and a healing to the believers. But to those who do not believe it serves as a plug in their ears and a covering over their eyes. It is as if they are being called from a place far away.

verses.text: And in the past We gave Moses the Book and yet it became an object of dispute. If your Lord''s decree had not gone forth before a decisive judgement would have been made among them once and for all. Surely they are in a disquieting doubt about it.
verses.translation: And in the past We gave Moses the Book and yet it became an object of dispute. If your Lord''s decree had not gone forth before a decisive judgement would have been made among them once and for all. Surely they are in a disquieting doubt about it.

verses.text: Whoever does good does so to his own benefit; and whoever does evil will suffer its evil consequence. Your Lord does no wrong to His servants.
verses.translation: Whoever does good does so to his own benefit; and whoever does evil will suffer its evil consequence. Your Lord does no wrong to His servants.

verses.text: The knowledge of the Hour rests solely with Him. Not a fruit comes forth from its sheath nor does any female conceive nor give birth to a child but it is in His knowledge. On that Day He will call out to them:  Where are those associates of Mine?  They will answer:  We have declared to You that none of us can bear witness to that.
verses.translation: The knowledge of the Hour rests solely with Him. Not a fruit comes forth from its sheath nor does any female conceive nor give birth to a child but it is in His knowledge. On that Day He will call out to them:  Where are those associates of Mine?  They will answer:  We have declared to You that none of us can bear witness to that.

verses.text: Then all those deities whom they once used to call upon shall vanish and they will come to know for sure that there is no escape for them.
verses.translation: Then all those deities whom they once used to call upon shall vanish and they will come to know for sure that there is no escape for them.

verses.text: Man wearies not of praying for good but when evil visits him he despairs and gives up all hope.
verses.translation: Man wearies not of praying for good but when evil visits him he despairs and gives up all hope.

verses.text: And if We bestow Our Mercy upon him after hardship he will surely say:  This is what I truly deserve and I do not believe that the Hour (of Resurrection) will ever come to pass; and if I am returned to my Lord there too I shall enjoy the best.  Surely We shall fully apprise the unbelievers of what they have done and We shall certainly make them taste a severe chastisement.
verses.translation: And if We bestow Our Mercy upon him after hardship he will surely say:  This is what I truly deserve and I do not believe that the Hour (of Resurrection) will ever come to pass; and if I am returned to my Lord there too I shall enjoy the best.  Surely We shall fully apprise the unbelievers of what they have done and We shall certainly make them taste a severe chastisement.

verses.text: When We bestow Our favour upon man he turns away and waxes proud; but when a misfortune touches him he is full of supplication.
verses.translation: When We bestow Our favour upon man he turns away and waxes proud; but when a misfortune touches him he is full of supplication.

verses.text: Tell them (O Prophet):  Did you ever consider: if this Qur''an is indeed from Allah and you still deny it who can be in greater error than he who goes far in fiercely opposing it?
verses.translation: Tell them (O Prophet):  Did you ever consider: if this Qur''an is indeed from Allah and you still deny it who can be in greater error than he who goes far in fiercely opposing it?

verses.text: Soon shall We show them Our Signs on the horizons and in their own beings until it becomes clear to them that it is the Truth. Is it not enough that your Lord is a witness over everything?
verses.translation: Soon shall We show them Our Signs on the horizons and in their own beings until it becomes clear to them that it is the Truth. Is it not enough that your Lord is a witness over everything?

verses.text: Lo they are in doubt concerning their meeting with their Lord. Surely He fully encompasses everything.
verses.translation: Lo they are in doubt concerning their meeting with their Lord. Surely He fully encompasses everything.

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: Ha''. Mim.
ayahs.translation: Ha''. Mim.

ayahs.text: This is a revelation from the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: This is a revelation from the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: a Book whose verses have been well-expounded; an Arabic Qur''an for those who have knowledge
ayahs.translation: a Book whose verses have been well-expounded; an Arabic Qur''an for those who have knowledge

ayahs.text: one bearing good news and warning. Yet most of them turned away and are not wont to give heed.
ayahs.translation: one bearing good news and warning. Yet most of them turned away and are not wont to give heed.

ayahs.text: They say:  Our hearts are securely wrapped up against what you call us to and in our ears is a heaviness and between you and us there is a veil. So act; we too are acting.
ayahs.translation: They say:  Our hearts are securely wrapped up against what you call us to and in our ears is a heaviness and between you and us there is a veil. So act; we too are acting.

ayahs.text: Tell them (O Prophet):  I am only a human being like you. It is revealed to me that your God is One God; so direct yourselves straight to Him and seek His forgiveness. Woe to those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity
ayahs.translation: Tell them (O Prophet):  I am only a human being like you. It is revealed to me that your God is One God; so direct yourselves straight to Him and seek His forgiveness. Woe to those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity

ayahs.text: who do not pay Zakah and who deny the Hereafter.
ayahs.translation: who do not pay Zakah and who deny the Hereafter.

ayahs.text: As to those who have faith and do good works surely theirs shall be a never-ending reward.
ayahs.translation: As to those who have faith and do good works surely theirs shall be a never-ending reward.

ayahs.text: Tell them (O Prophet):  Do you indeed disbelieve in Him and assign compeers to Him Who created the earth in two days? He is the Lord of all beings of the Universe.
ayahs.translation: Tell them (O Prophet):  Do you indeed disbelieve in Him and assign compeers to Him Who created the earth in two days? He is the Lord of all beings of the Universe.

ayahs.text: (After creating the earth) He set up firm mountains on it blessed it and provided it with sustenance in proportion to the needs of all who seek (sustenance). All this was done in four days.
ayahs.translation: (After creating the earth) He set up firm mountains on it blessed it and provided it with sustenance in proportion to the needs of all who seek (sustenance). All this was done in four days.

ayahs.text: Then He turned to the heaven while it was all smoke. He said to the heaven and the earth:  Come (into being) willingly or unwillingly.  They said:  Here we come (into being) in willing obeisance.
ayahs.translation: Then He turned to the heaven while it was all smoke. He said to the heaven and the earth:  Come (into being) willingly or unwillingly.  They said:  Here we come (into being) in willing obeisance.

ayahs.text: Then He made them seven heavens in two days and revealed to each heaven its law. And We adorned the lower heaven with lamps and firmly secured it. All this is the firm plan of the All-Mighty the All-Knowing.
ayahs.translation: Then He made them seven heavens in two days and revealed to each heaven its law. And We adorned the lower heaven with lamps and firmly secured it. All this is the firm plan of the All-Mighty the All-Knowing.

ayahs.text: But if they turn away tell them:  I warn you against a sudden scourge like that which struck Ad and Thamud.
ayahs.translation: But if they turn away tell them:  I warn you against a sudden scourge like that which struck Ad and Thamud.

ayahs.text: When the Messengers (of Allah) came to them from the front and from the rear saying:  Do not serve any but Allah ; they said:  Had our Lord so willed He would have sent down angels. So we deny the Message you have brought.
ayahs.translation: When the Messengers (of Allah) came to them from the front and from the rear saying:  Do not serve any but Allah ; they said:  Had our Lord so willed He would have sent down angels. So we deny the Message you have brought.

ayahs.text: As for Ad they waxed proud in the land without justification and said:  Who is greater than we in strength?  Did they not see that Allah Who created them is greater in strength than they? They continued to deny Our Signs
ayahs.translation: As for Ad they waxed proud in the land without justification and said:  Who is greater than we in strength?  Did they not see that Allah Who created them is greater in strength than they? They continued to deny Our Signs

ayahs.text: whereupon We sent upon them a fierce wind on inauspicious days that We might make them taste a degrading chastisement in the life of this world. And surely the chastisement of the Hereafter is even more degrading. There will be none to help them there.
ayahs.translation: whereupon We sent upon them a fierce wind on inauspicious days that We might make them taste a degrading chastisement in the life of this world. And surely the chastisement of the Hereafter is even more degrading. There will be none to help them there.

ayahs.text: As for Thamud We bestowed guidance upon them but they preferred to remain blind rather than be guided. At last a humiliating scourge overtook them on account of their misdeeds.
ayahs.translation: As for Thamud We bestowed guidance upon them but they preferred to remain blind rather than be guided. At last a humiliating scourge overtook them on account of their misdeeds.

ayahs.text: Yet We delivered those who believed and were God-fearing.
ayahs.translation: Yet We delivered those who believed and were God-fearing.

ayahs.text: Imagine the Day when Allah''s enemies will be mustered to the Fire and the people of the former times will be detained until the arrival of people of the later times
ayahs.translation: Imagine the Day when Allah''s enemies will be mustered to the Fire and the people of the former times will be detained until the arrival of people of the later times

ayahs.text: and when all have arrived their ears their eyes and their skins shall bear witness against them stating all that they had done in the life of the world.
ayahs.translation: and when all have arrived their ears their eyes and their skins shall bear witness against them stating all that they had done in the life of the world.

ayahs.text: They will ask their skins:  Why did you bear witness against us?  The skins will reply:  Allah gave us speech as He gave speech to all others. He it is Who created you for the first time and it is to Him that you will be sent back.
ayahs.translation: They will ask their skins:  Why did you bear witness against us?  The skins will reply:  Allah gave us speech as He gave speech to all others. He it is Who created you for the first time and it is to Him that you will be sent back.

ayahs.text: When you used to conceal yourselves (while committing misdeeds) you never thought that your ears or your eyes or your skins would ever bear witness against you; you rather fancied that Allah does not know a great deal of what you do.
ayahs.translation: When you used to conceal yourselves (while committing misdeeds) you never thought that your ears or your eyes or your skins would ever bear witness against you; you rather fancied that Allah does not know a great deal of what you do.

ayahs.text: This thought of yours about your Lord has led to your perdition and you have become among the losers.
ayahs.translation: This thought of yours about your Lord has led to your perdition and you have become among the losers.

ayahs.text: In this state whether they bear with patience (or not) Fire alone shall be their abode. And if they seek to make amends they will not be allowed to do so.
ayahs.translation: In this state whether they bear with patience (or not) Fire alone shall be their abode. And if they seek to make amends they will not be allowed to do so.

ayahs.text: We had assigned to them companions who embellished for them all that was before them and behind them. Thus the same decree (of chastisement) which had overtaken the previous generations of jinn and human beings (also) became due against them. Surely they became the losers.
ayahs.translation: We had assigned to them companions who embellished for them all that was before them and behind them. Thus the same decree (of chastisement) which had overtaken the previous generations of jinn and human beings (also) became due against them. Surely they became the losers.

ayahs.text: The deniers of the Truth say:  Do not give ear to the Qur''an and cause interruption when it is recited; thus perhaps you will gain the upper hand.
ayahs.translation: The deniers of the Truth say:  Do not give ear to the Qur''an and cause interruption when it is recited; thus perhaps you will gain the upper hand.

ayahs.text: We shall certainly make these unbelievers taste a terrible chastisement and shall fully requite them according to the worst deeds that they committed.
ayahs.translation: We shall certainly make these unbelievers taste a terrible chastisement and shall fully requite them according to the worst deeds that they committed.

ayahs.text: That is the recompense of the enemies of Allah - the Fire their abiding home. That will be the re-compense for their denying Our Signs.
ayahs.translation: That is the recompense of the enemies of Allah - the Fire their abiding home. That will be the re-compense for their denying Our Signs.

ayahs.text: There the unbelievers will say:  Our Lord show us those that led us astray both jinn and humans and we will trample them under our feet so that they are utterly degraded.
ayahs.translation: There the unbelievers will say:  Our Lord show us those that led us astray both jinn and humans and we will trample them under our feet so that they are utterly degraded.

ayahs.text: Those who say  Allah is our Lord  and then remain steadfast upon them descend angels (and say):  Do not fear nor grieve and receive good tidings of Paradise which you were promised.
ayahs.translation: Those who say  Allah is our Lord  and then remain steadfast upon them descend angels (and say):  Do not fear nor grieve and receive good tidings of Paradise which you were promised.

ayahs.text: We are your companions in this world and in the Hereafter. There you shall have all that you desire and all what you will ask for.
ayahs.translation: We are your companions in this world and in the Hereafter. There you shall have all that you desire and all what you will ask for.

ayahs.text: This is by way of hospitality from Him Who is Most Forgiving Most Merciful.
ayahs.translation: This is by way of hospitality from Him Who is Most Forgiving Most Merciful.

ayahs.text: And who is fairer in speech than he who calls to Allah and acts righteously and says:  I am a Muslim ?
ayahs.translation: And who is fairer in speech than he who calls to Allah and acts righteously and says:  I am a Muslim ?

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) good and evil are not equal. Repel (evil) with that which is good and you will see that he between whom and you there was enmity shall become as if he were a bosom friend (of yours).
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) good and evil are not equal. Repel (evil) with that which is good and you will see that he between whom and you there was enmity shall become as if he were a bosom friend (of yours).

ayahs.text: But none attains to this except those who are steadfast; none attains to this except those endowed with mighty good fortune.
ayahs.translation: But none attains to this except those who are steadfast; none attains to this except those endowed with mighty good fortune.

ayahs.text: And if you are prompted by a provocation from Satan seek refuge with Allah. He and He alone is All-Hearing All- Knowing.
ayahs.translation: And if you are prompted by a provocation from Satan seek refuge with Allah. He and He alone is All-Hearing All- Knowing.

ayahs.text: And of His Signs are the night and the day and the sun and the moon. Do not prostrate yourselves before the sun nor before the moon but prostrate yourselves before Allah Who created them if it is Him that you serve.
ayahs.translation: And of His Signs are the night and the day and the sun and the moon. Do not prostrate yourselves before the sun nor before the moon but prostrate yourselves before Allah Who created them if it is Him that you serve.

ayahs.text: But if they wax proud (and persist in their attitude it does not matter for) the angels near-stationed to your Lord glorify Him night and day and never grow weary.
ayahs.translation: But if they wax proud (and persist in their attitude it does not matter for) the angels near-stationed to your Lord glorify Him night and day and never grow weary.

ayahs.text: And of His Signs is that you see the earth withered then We send down water upon it and lo! it quivers and swells. Surely He Who gives life to the dead earth will also give life to the dead. Surely He has power over everything.
ayahs.translation: And of His Signs is that you see the earth withered then We send down water upon it and lo! it quivers and swells. Surely He Who gives life to the dead earth will also give life to the dead. Surely He has power over everything.

ayahs.text: Those who pervert Our Signs are not hidden from Us. Is he who will be cast into the Fire better or he who comes secure on the Day of Resurrection? Do as you wish; He sees all what you do.
ayahs.translation: Those who pervert Our Signs are not hidden from Us. Is he who will be cast into the Fire better or he who comes secure on the Day of Resurrection? Do as you wish; He sees all what you do.

ayahs.text: These are the ones who rejected the Good Counsel when it came to them although it is certainly a Mighty Book.
ayahs.translation: These are the ones who rejected the Good Counsel when it came to them although it is certainly a Mighty Book.

ayahs.text: Falsehood may not enter it from the front or from the rear. It is a revelation that has been sent down from the Most Wise the Immensely Praiseworthy.
ayahs.translation: Falsehood may not enter it from the front or from the rear. It is a revelation that has been sent down from the Most Wise the Immensely Praiseworthy.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) nothing is said to you but what was already said to the Messengers before you. Surely your Lord is the Lord of forgiveness and the Lord of grievous chastisement.
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) nothing is said to you but what was already said to the Messengers before you. Surely your Lord is the Lord of forgiveness and the Lord of grievous chastisement.

ayahs.text: Had We revealed this as a non-Arabic Qur''an they would have said:  Why were its verses not clearly expounded? How strange a non-Arabic scripture and an Arab audience! Tell them:  It is a guidance and a healing to the believers. But to those who do not believe it serves as a plug in their ears and a covering over their eyes. It is as if they are being called from a place far away.
ayahs.translation: Had We revealed this as a non-Arabic Qur''an they would have said:  Why were its verses not clearly expounded? How strange a non-Arabic scripture and an Arab audience! Tell them:  It is a guidance and a healing to the believers. But to those who do not believe it serves as a plug in their ears and a covering over their eyes. It is as if they are being called from a place far away.

ayahs.text: And in the past We gave Moses the Book and yet it became an object of dispute. If your Lord''s decree had not gone forth before a decisive judgement would have been made among them once and for all. Surely they are in a disquieting doubt about it.
ayahs.translation: And in the past We gave Moses the Book and yet it became an object of dispute. If your Lord''s decree had not gone forth before a decisive judgement would have been made among them once and for all. Surely they are in a disquieting doubt about it.

ayahs.text: Whoever does good does so to his own benefit; and whoever does evil will suffer its evil consequence. Your Lord does no wrong to His servants.
ayahs.translation: Whoever does good does so to his own benefit; and whoever does evil will suffer its evil consequence. Your Lord does no wrong to His servants.

ayahs.text: The knowledge of the Hour rests solely with Him. Not a fruit comes forth from its sheath nor does any female conceive nor give birth to a child but it is in His knowledge. On that Day He will call out to them:  Where are those associates of Mine?  They will answer:  We have declared to You that none of us can bear witness to that.
ayahs.translation: The knowledge of the Hour rests solely with Him. Not a fruit comes forth from its sheath nor does any female conceive nor give birth to a child but it is in His knowledge. On that Day He will call out to them:  Where are those associates of Mine?  They will answer:  We have declared to You that none of us can bear witness to that.

ayahs.text: Then all those deities whom they once used to call upon shall vanish and they will come to know for sure that there is no escape for them.
ayahs.translation: Then all those deities whom they once used to call upon shall vanish and they will come to know for sure that there is no escape for them.

ayahs.text: Man wearies not of praying for good but when evil visits him he despairs and gives up all hope.
ayahs.translation: Man wearies not of praying for good but when evil visits him he despairs and gives up all hope.

ayahs.text: And if We bestow Our Mercy upon him after hardship he will surely say:  This is what I truly deserve and I do not believe that the Hour (of Resurrection) will ever come to pass; and if I am returned to my Lord there too I shall enjoy the best.  Surely We shall fully apprise the unbelievers of what they have done and We shall certainly make them taste a severe chastisement.
ayahs.translation: And if We bestow Our Mercy upon him after hardship he will surely say:  This is what I truly deserve and I do not believe that the Hour (of Resurrection) will ever come to pass; and if I am returned to my Lord there too I shall enjoy the best.  Surely We shall fully apprise the unbelievers of what they have done and We shall certainly make them taste a severe chastisement.

ayahs.text: When We bestow Our favour upon man he turns away and waxes proud; but when a misfortune touches him he is full of supplication.
ayahs.translation: When We bestow Our favour upon man he turns away and waxes proud; but when a misfortune touches him he is full of supplication.

ayahs.text: Tell them (O Prophet):  Did you ever consider: if this Qur''an is indeed from Allah and you still deny it who can be in greater error than he who goes far in fiercely opposing it?
ayahs.translation: Tell them (O Prophet):  Did you ever consider: if this Qur''an is indeed from Allah and you still deny it who can be in greater error than he who goes far in fiercely opposing it?

ayahs.text: Soon shall We show them Our Signs on the horizons and in their own beings until it becomes clear to them that it is the Truth. Is it not enough that your Lord is a witness over everything?
ayahs.translation: Soon shall We show them Our Signs on the horizons and in their own beings until it becomes clear to them that it is the Truth. Is it not enough that your Lord is a witness over everything?

ayahs.text: Lo they are in doubt concerning their meeting with their Lord. Surely He fully encompasses everything.
ayahs.translation: Lo they are in doubt concerning their meeting with their Lord. Surely He fully encompasses everything.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Ha''. Mim.
verses.translation: Ha''. Mim.

verses.text: Ayn. Sin. Qaf.
verses.translation: Ayn. Sin. Qaf.

verses.text: Thus does Allah the Most Mighty the Most Wise reveal to you even as (He revealed) to those (Messengers) who preceded you.
verses.translation: Thus does Allah the Most Mighty the Most Wise reveal to you even as (He revealed) to those (Messengers) who preceded you.

verses.text: His is all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth; He is the Most High the All-Great.
verses.translation: His is all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth; He is the Most High the All-Great.

verses.text: The heavens may well nigh rend asunder from above while the angels proclaim the praise of their Lord and ask forgiveness for those on earth. Lo it is Allah and He alone Who is Most Forgiving Most Merciful.
verses.translation: The heavens may well nigh rend asunder from above while the angels proclaim the praise of their Lord and ask forgiveness for those on earth. Lo it is Allah and He alone Who is Most Forgiving Most Merciful.

verses.text: Those who have taken others than Him as their protectors beside Him it is Allah Who oversees them; you are no guardian over them.
verses.translation: Those who have taken others than Him as their protectors beside Him it is Allah Who oversees them; you are no guardian over them.

verses.text: And thus did We reveal this Arabic Qur''an to you that you may warn the people of the Mother of Cities (to wit Makkah) and those who dwell around it; and warn them of the Day of Gathering concerning which there is no doubt: whereon some will be in Paradise and some in the Blazing Fire.
verses.translation: And thus did We reveal this Arabic Qur''an to you that you may warn the people of the Mother of Cities (to wit Makkah) and those who dwell around it; and warn them of the Day of Gathering concerning which there is no doubt: whereon some will be in Paradise and some in the Blazing Fire.

verses.text: If Allah had so willed He could have made them all a single community. But He admits whomsoever He pleases into His Mercy. As to those given to wrong-doing they shall have none as protector or helper.
verses.translation: If Allah had so willed He could have made them all a single community. But He admits whomsoever He pleases into His Mercy. As to those given to wrong-doing they shall have none as protector or helper.

verses.text: (Are they so foolish that) they have chosen others rather than Allah as their protectors? Yet it is Allah Who is the Protector and Who resurrects the dead and Who has power over everything.
verses.translation: (Are they so foolish that) they have chosen others rather than Allah as their protectors? Yet it is Allah Who is the Protector and Who resurrects the dead and Who has power over everything.

verses.text: The judgement on whatever you differ rests with Allah. Such is Allah my Lord; in Him I have put all my trust and to Him I always turn in devotion.
verses.translation: The judgement on whatever you differ rests with Allah. Such is Allah my Lord; in Him I have put all my trust and to Him I always turn in devotion.

verses.text: The Originator of the heavens and the earth He has appointed for you pairs of your own kind and pairs also of cattle. Thus does He multiply you. Naught in the universe is like Him. He is All-Hearing All-Seeing.
verses.translation: The Originator of the heavens and the earth He has appointed for you pairs of your own kind and pairs also of cattle. Thus does He multiply you. Naught in the universe is like Him. He is All-Hearing All-Seeing.

verses.text: His are the keys of the heavens and the earth. He enlarges and straitens the sustenance of whomsoever He pleases. Surely He has knowledge of everything.
verses.translation: His are the keys of the heavens and the earth. He enlarges and straitens the sustenance of whomsoever He pleases. Surely He has knowledge of everything.

verses.text: He has prescribed for you the religion which He enjoined upon Noah and which We revealed to you (O Muhammad) and which We enjoined upon Abraham and Moses and Jesus commanding:  Establish this religion and do not split up regarding it. What you are calling to is very hard upon those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity. Allah chooses for Himself whomsoever He pleases and guides to Himself whoever penitently turns to Him.
verses.translation: He has prescribed for you the religion which He enjoined upon Noah and which We revealed to you (O Muhammad) and which We enjoined upon Abraham and Moses and Jesus commanding:  Establish this religion and do not split up regarding it. What you are calling to is very hard upon those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity. Allah chooses for Himself whomsoever He pleases and guides to Himself whoever penitently turns to Him.

verses.text: They did not split up except after knowledge had come to them and then only because they wished to commit excesses against each other. Had your Lord not already decreed that judgement would be made later at an appointed time the matter between them would surely have been decided once and for all. Indeed those who were later made the heirs of the Book are in disquieting doubt about it.
verses.translation: They did not split up except after knowledge had come to them and then only because they wished to commit excesses against each other. Had your Lord not already decreed that judgement would be made later at an appointed time the matter between them would surely have been decided once and for all. Indeed those who were later made the heirs of the Book are in disquieting doubt about it.

verses.text: (This being so O Muhammad) call people to the same religion and be steadfast about it as you were commanded and do not follow their desires and say (to them):  I believe in the Book Allah has sent down. I have been commanded to establish justice among you. Allah is our Lord and your Lord. We have our deeds and you have your deeds. There is no contention between us and you. Allah will bring us all together. To Him all are destined to return.
verses.translation: (This being so O Muhammad) call people to the same religion and be steadfast about it as you were commanded and do not follow their desires and say (to them):  I believe in the Book Allah has sent down. I have been commanded to establish justice among you. Allah is our Lord and your Lord. We have our deeds and you have your deeds. There is no contention between us and you. Allah will bring us all together. To Him all are destined to return.

verses.text: Those who contend concerning Allah(after His call has been responded to) their contention is absolutely void in the sight of their Lord. Allah''s wrath is upon them and a grievous chastisement awaits them.
verses.translation: Those who contend concerning Allah(after His call has been responded to) their contention is absolutely void in the sight of their Lord. Allah''s wrath is upon them and a grievous chastisement awaits them.

verses.text: Allah it is Who sent down this Book with the Truth and the Balance. And what would make you know that the Hour (of Judgement) has drawn near?
verses.translation: Allah it is Who sent down this Book with the Truth and the Balance. And what would make you know that the Hour (of Judgement) has drawn near?

verses.text: Those who do not believe in it seek to hasten its coming. But those who believe (in it) hold it in dread and know that the Hour (of Judgement) is bound to come. Lo those who dispute concerning the coming of the Hour are gone far in error.
verses.translation: Those who do not believe in it seek to hasten its coming. But those who believe (in it) hold it in dread and know that the Hour (of Judgement) is bound to come. Lo those who dispute concerning the coming of the Hour are gone far in error.

verses.text: Allah is Most Gentle to His servants and grants sustenance to whomsoever He pleases. He is All-Strong Most Mighty.
verses.translation: Allah is Most Gentle to His servants and grants sustenance to whomsoever He pleases. He is All-Strong Most Mighty.

verses.text: Whoever seeks the harvest of the Hereafter We shall increase for him his harvest and whoever seeks the harvest of this world We shall give him thereof; but he will have no share in the Hereafter.
verses.translation: Whoever seeks the harvest of the Hereafter We shall increase for him his harvest and whoever seeks the harvest of this world We shall give him thereof; but he will have no share in the Hereafter.

verses.text: Do they have any associates (of Allah) who have laid down for them a way pertaining to faith which Allah did not sanction? But for the fact that a decree had already been made the matter between them would have been decided once and for all. Surely a grievous chastisement awaits the wrong-doers.
verses.translation: Do they have any associates (of Allah) who have laid down for them a way pertaining to faith which Allah did not sanction? But for the fact that a decree had already been made the matter between them would have been decided once and for all. Surely a grievous chastisement awaits the wrong-doers.

verses.text: You will see the wrongdoers fearful of the consequence of their deeds which will certainly overtake them. But those who have faith and do good deeds will be in the meadows of the Gardens wherein they shall have whatever they desire from their Lord; that is the great Bounty.
verses.translation: You will see the wrongdoers fearful of the consequence of their deeds which will certainly overtake them. But those who have faith and do good deeds will be in the meadows of the Gardens wherein they shall have whatever they desire from their Lord; that is the great Bounty.

verses.text: That is the Bounty of which Allah gives tidings to His servants who have faith and do good deeds. Tell them (O Prophet):  I do not ask you for any recompense for my work except love towards kinsfolk. Whoever does a good deed We shall increase its merit for him. Surely Allah is Most Forgiving Most Appreciative.
verses.translation: That is the Bounty of which Allah gives tidings to His servants who have faith and do good deeds. Tell them (O Prophet):  I do not ask you for any recompense for my work except love towards kinsfolk. Whoever does a good deed We shall increase its merit for him. Surely Allah is Most Forgiving Most Appreciative.

verses.text: Do they say:  He has forged a lie against Allah? If Allah so wanted He could seal up your heart. Allah blots out falsehood and confirms the truth by His Words.He is well aware of all the secrets hidden in the breasts (of people).
verses.translation: Do they say:  He has forged a lie against Allah? If Allah so wanted He could seal up your heart. Allah blots out falsehood and confirms the truth by His Words.He is well aware of all the secrets hidden in the breasts (of people).

verses.text: He it is Who accepts repentance from His servants and forgives sins and knows all what you do
verses.translation: He it is Who accepts repentance from His servants and forgives sins and knows all what you do

verses.text: and answers the prayers of those who believe and do good deeds and bestows upon them even more out of His Bounty. As for those who deny (the Truth) a grievous chastisement awaits them.
verses.translation: and answers the prayers of those who believe and do good deeds and bestows upon them even more out of His Bounty. As for those who deny (the Truth) a grievous chastisement awaits them.

verses.text: If Allah were to grant ample sustenance to His servants they would go about transgressing in the land. But He sends down in due measure whatever (sustenance) He wills. Surely He is Well-Aware and All-Seeing concerning matters that relate to His servants.
verses.translation: If Allah were to grant ample sustenance to His servants they would go about transgressing in the land. But He sends down in due measure whatever (sustenance) He wills. Surely He is Well-Aware and All-Seeing concerning matters that relate to His servants.

verses.text: He it is Who sends down the rain after they despair of it spreading out His Mercy. He is the Protector the Immensely Praiseworthy.
verses.translation: He it is Who sends down the rain after they despair of it spreading out His Mercy. He is the Protector the Immensely Praiseworthy.

verses.text: And of His Signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the living creatures that He has spread out in them. He has the power to bring them together when He so wills.
verses.translation: And of His Signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the living creatures that He has spread out in them. He has the power to bring them together when He so wills.

verses.text: Whatever misfortune befalls you is a consequence of your own deeds. But much of it He forgives.
verses.translation: Whatever misfortune befalls you is a consequence of your own deeds. But much of it He forgives.

verses.text: You cannot frustrate Him in the earth; you have no protector nor helper against Allah.
verses.translation: You cannot frustrate Him in the earth; you have no protector nor helper against Allah.

verses.text: And of His Signs are the ships that sail in the sea like mountains.
verses.translation: And of His Signs are the ships that sail in the sea like mountains.

verses.text: If He so wills He can cause the winds to become still so that they will remain motionless on its surface. Surely there are many Signs in this for those who are wont to be steadfast and give thanks.
verses.translation: If He so wills He can cause the winds to become still so that they will remain motionless on its surface. Surely there are many Signs in this for those who are wont to be steadfast and give thanks.

verses.text: He may while forgiving much of the sins of those that ride these ships drown them on account of some of their misdeeds.
verses.translation: He may while forgiving much of the sins of those that ride these ships drown them on account of some of their misdeeds.

verses.text: Then those who wrangle about Our Signs will come to know that there is no escape for them.
verses.translation: Then those who wrangle about Our Signs will come to know that there is no escape for them.

verses.text: That which has been given to you is only the wherewithal of the transient life of this world. But that which is with Allah is better and more enduring for those who believe and put their trust in their Lord;
verses.translation: That which has been given to you is only the wherewithal of the transient life of this world. But that which is with Allah is better and more enduring for those who believe and put their trust in their Lord;

verses.text: who eschew grave sins and shameful deeds and whenever they are angry forgive;
verses.translation: who eschew grave sins and shameful deeds and whenever they are angry forgive;

verses.text: who obey their Lord and establish Prayer; who conduct their affairs by consultation and spend out of what We have bestowed upon them;
verses.translation: who obey their Lord and establish Prayer; who conduct their affairs by consultation and spend out of what We have bestowed upon them;

verses.text: who when a wrong is done to them seek its redress.
verses.translation: who when a wrong is done to them seek its redress.

verses.text: The recompense of evil is evil the like of it. But he who forgives and makes amends his reward lies with Allah. Surely He does not love the wrong-doers.
verses.translation: The recompense of evil is evil the like of it. But he who forgives and makes amends his reward lies with Allah. Surely He does not love the wrong-doers.

verses.text: There is no blame against him who avenges himself after he has been wronged.
verses.translation: There is no blame against him who avenges himself after he has been wronged.
