verses.text: Blame attaches only to those who subject people to wrong and commit excesses on earth. A painful chastisement awaits them.
verses.translation: Blame attaches only to those who subject people to wrong and commit excesses on earth. A painful chastisement awaits them.

verses.text: But he who patiently endures and forgives that is a conduct of great resolve.
verses.translation: But he who patiently endures and forgives that is a conduct of great resolve.

verses.text: He whom Allah lets go astray none after Him can be his protector. You will see that when the wrong-doers observe the chastisement they will exclaim:  Is there any way to go back?
verses.translation: He whom Allah lets go astray none after Him can be his protector. You will see that when the wrong-doers observe the chastisement they will exclaim:  Is there any way to go back?

verses.text: You shall see them as they are brought face to face with the chastisement in a state of abject humiliation looking with a furtive glance. But the believers will say:  Surely the true losers are they who lose themselves and their kindred on the Day of Resurrection.  Lo the wrong-doers will be in an enduring torment.
verses.translation: You shall see them as they are brought face to face with the chastisement in a state of abject humiliation looking with a furtive glance. But the believers will say:  Surely the true losers are they who lose themselves and their kindred on the Day of Resurrection.  Lo the wrong-doers will be in an enduring torment.

verses.text: They shall have no protectors to help them against Allah. For he whom Allah causes to go astray will have no way to save himself.
verses.translation: They shall have no protectors to help them against Allah. For he whom Allah causes to go astray will have no way to save himself.

verses.text: Accept the command of your Lord before there comes a Day from Allah that cannot be averted. On that Day there shall be no shelter for you and none may change your predicament.
verses.translation: Accept the command of your Lord before there comes a Day from Allah that cannot be averted. On that Day there shall be no shelter for you and none may change your predicament.

verses.text: (O Prophet) if they turn away from the Truth know that We did not send you to them as their overseer. Your task is only to convey (the Message). Indeed when We give man a taste of Our Mercy he exults in it. But if any misfortune afflicts them on account of their deeds man is utterly ungrateful.
verses.translation: (O Prophet) if they turn away from the Truth know that We did not send you to them as their overseer. Your task is only to convey (the Message). Indeed when We give man a taste of Our Mercy he exults in it. But if any misfortune afflicts them on account of their deeds man is utterly ungrateful.

verses.text: The dominion of the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah. He creates whatever He pleases. He grants females to whomever He pleases and males to whomever He pleases
verses.translation: The dominion of the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah. He creates whatever He pleases. He grants females to whomever He pleases and males to whomever He pleases

verses.text: or grants them a mix of males and females and causes whomever He pleases to be barren. He is All- Knowing All-Powerful.
verses.translation: or grants them a mix of males and females and causes whomever He pleases to be barren. He is All- Knowing All-Powerful.

verses.text: It is not given to any human being that Allah should speak to him except through revelation or from behind a veil or that a messenger (an angel) be sent to him who reveals to him by Allah''s leave whatever He wishes. He is All-High Most Wise.
verses.translation: It is not given to any human being that Allah should speak to him except through revelation or from behind a veil or that a messenger (an angel) be sent to him who reveals to him by Allah''s leave whatever He wishes. He is All-High Most Wise.

verses.text: Even so We revealed to you (O Prophet) a spirit by Our command. (Ere to that) you knew neither what the Book nor what the faith was. But We made that spirit a light whereby We guide those of Our servants whom We please to the Right Way. Surely you are directing people to the Right Way
verses.translation: Even so We revealed to you (O Prophet) a spirit by Our command. (Ere to that) you knew neither what the Book nor what the faith was. But We made that spirit a light whereby We guide those of Our servants whom We please to the Right Way. Surely you are directing people to the Right Way

verses.text: the Way of Allah to Whom belongs the dominion of all that is in the heavens and the earth. Lo it is to Allah that all things ultimately revert.
verses.translation: the Way of Allah to Whom belongs the dominion of all that is in the heavens and the earth. Lo it is to Allah that all things ultimately revert.

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: Ha''. Mim.
ayahs.translation: Ha''. Mim.

ayahs.text: Ayn. Sin. Qaf.
ayahs.translation: Ayn. Sin. Qaf.

ayahs.text: Thus does Allah the Most Mighty the Most Wise reveal to you even as (He revealed) to those (Messengers) who preceded you.
ayahs.translation: Thus does Allah the Most Mighty the Most Wise reveal to you even as (He revealed) to those (Messengers) who preceded you.

ayahs.text: His is all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth; He is the Most High the All-Great.
ayahs.translation: His is all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth; He is the Most High the All-Great.

ayahs.text: The heavens may well nigh rend asunder from above while the angels proclaim the praise of their Lord and ask forgiveness for those on earth. Lo it is Allah and He alone Who is Most Forgiving Most Merciful.
ayahs.translation: The heavens may well nigh rend asunder from above while the angels proclaim the praise of their Lord and ask forgiveness for those on earth. Lo it is Allah and He alone Who is Most Forgiving Most Merciful.

ayahs.text: Those who have taken others than Him as their protectors beside Him it is Allah Who oversees them; you are no guardian over them.
ayahs.translation: Those who have taken others than Him as their protectors beside Him it is Allah Who oversees them; you are no guardian over them.

ayahs.text: And thus did We reveal this Arabic Qur''an to you that you may warn the people of the Mother of Cities (to wit Makkah) and those who dwell around it; and warn them of the Day of Gathering concerning which there is no doubt: whereon some will be in Paradise and some in the Blazing Fire.
ayahs.translation: And thus did We reveal this Arabic Qur''an to you that you may warn the people of the Mother of Cities (to wit Makkah) and those who dwell around it; and warn them of the Day of Gathering concerning which there is no doubt: whereon some will be in Paradise and some in the Blazing Fire.

ayahs.text: If Allah had so willed He could have made them all a single community. But He admits whomsoever He pleases into His Mercy. As to those given to wrong-doing they shall have none as protector or helper.
ayahs.translation: If Allah had so willed He could have made them all a single community. But He admits whomsoever He pleases into His Mercy. As to those given to wrong-doing they shall have none as protector or helper.

ayahs.text: (Are they so foolish that) they have chosen others rather than Allah as their protectors? Yet it is Allah Who is the Protector and Who resurrects the dead and Who has power over everything.
ayahs.translation: (Are they so foolish that) they have chosen others rather than Allah as their protectors? Yet it is Allah Who is the Protector and Who resurrects the dead and Who has power over everything.

ayahs.text: The judgement on whatever you differ rests with Allah. Such is Allah my Lord; in Him I have put all my trust and to Him I always turn in devotion.
ayahs.translation: The judgement on whatever you differ rests with Allah. Such is Allah my Lord; in Him I have put all my trust and to Him I always turn in devotion.

ayahs.text: The Originator of the heavens and the earth He has appointed for you pairs of your own kind and pairs also of cattle. Thus does He multiply you. Naught in the universe is like Him. He is All-Hearing All-Seeing.
ayahs.translation: The Originator of the heavens and the earth He has appointed for you pairs of your own kind and pairs also of cattle. Thus does He multiply you. Naught in the universe is like Him. He is All-Hearing All-Seeing.

ayahs.text: His are the keys of the heavens and the earth. He enlarges and straitens the sustenance of whomsoever He pleases. Surely He has knowledge of everything.
ayahs.translation: His are the keys of the heavens and the earth. He enlarges and straitens the sustenance of whomsoever He pleases. Surely He has knowledge of everything.

ayahs.text: He has prescribed for you the religion which He enjoined upon Noah and which We revealed to you (O Muhammad) and which We enjoined upon Abraham and Moses and Jesus commanding:  Establish this religion and do not split up regarding it. What you are calling to is very hard upon those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity. Allah chooses for Himself whomsoever He pleases and guides to Himself whoever penitently turns to Him.
ayahs.translation: He has prescribed for you the religion which He enjoined upon Noah and which We revealed to you (O Muhammad) and which We enjoined upon Abraham and Moses and Jesus commanding:  Establish this religion and do not split up regarding it. What you are calling to is very hard upon those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity. Allah chooses for Himself whomsoever He pleases and guides to Himself whoever penitently turns to Him.

ayahs.text: They did not split up except after knowledge had come to them and then only because they wished to commit excesses against each other. Had your Lord not already decreed that judgement would be made later at an appointed time the matter between them would surely have been decided once and for all. Indeed those who were later made the heirs of the Book are in disquieting doubt about it.
ayahs.translation: They did not split up except after knowledge had come to them and then only because they wished to commit excesses against each other. Had your Lord not already decreed that judgement would be made later at an appointed time the matter between them would surely have been decided once and for all. Indeed those who were later made the heirs of the Book are in disquieting doubt about it.

ayahs.text: (This being so O Muhammad) call people to the same religion and be steadfast about it as you were commanded and do not follow their desires and say (to them):  I believe in the Book Allah has sent down. I have been commanded to establish justice among you. Allah is our Lord and your Lord. We have our deeds and you have your deeds. There is no contention between us and you. Allah will bring us all together. To Him all are destined to return.
ayahs.translation: (This being so O Muhammad) call people to the same religion and be steadfast about it as you were commanded and do not follow their desires and say (to them):  I believe in the Book Allah has sent down. I have been commanded to establish justice among you. Allah is our Lord and your Lord. We have our deeds and you have your deeds. There is no contention between us and you. Allah will bring us all together. To Him all are destined to return.

ayahs.text: Those who contend concerning Allah(after His call has been responded to) their contention is absolutely void in the sight of their Lord. Allah''s wrath is upon them and a grievous chastisement awaits them.
ayahs.translation: Those who contend concerning Allah(after His call has been responded to) their contention is absolutely void in the sight of their Lord. Allah''s wrath is upon them and a grievous chastisement awaits them.

ayahs.text: Allah it is Who sent down this Book with the Truth and the Balance. And what would make you know that the Hour (of Judgement) has drawn near?
ayahs.translation: Allah it is Who sent down this Book with the Truth and the Balance. And what would make you know that the Hour (of Judgement) has drawn near?

ayahs.text: Those who do not believe in it seek to hasten its coming. But those who believe (in it) hold it in dread and know that the Hour (of Judgement) is bound to come. Lo those who dispute concerning the coming of the Hour are gone far in error.
ayahs.translation: Those who do not believe in it seek to hasten its coming. But those who believe (in it) hold it in dread and know that the Hour (of Judgement) is bound to come. Lo those who dispute concerning the coming of the Hour are gone far in error.

ayahs.text: Allah is Most Gentle to His servants and grants sustenance to whomsoever He pleases. He is All-Strong Most Mighty.
ayahs.translation: Allah is Most Gentle to His servants and grants sustenance to whomsoever He pleases. He is All-Strong Most Mighty.

ayahs.text: Whoever seeks the harvest of the Hereafter We shall increase for him his harvest and whoever seeks the harvest of this world We shall give him thereof; but he will have no share in the Hereafter.
ayahs.translation: Whoever seeks the harvest of the Hereafter We shall increase for him his harvest and whoever seeks the harvest of this world We shall give him thereof; but he will have no share in the Hereafter.

ayahs.text: Do they have any associates (of Allah) who have laid down for them a way pertaining to faith which Allah did not sanction? But for the fact that a decree had already been made the matter between them would have been decided once and for all. Surely a grievous chastisement awaits the wrong-doers.
ayahs.translation: Do they have any associates (of Allah) who have laid down for them a way pertaining to faith which Allah did not sanction? But for the fact that a decree had already been made the matter between them would have been decided once and for all. Surely a grievous chastisement awaits the wrong-doers.

ayahs.text: You will see the wrongdoers fearful of the consequence of their deeds which will certainly overtake them. But those who have faith and do good deeds will be in the meadows of the Gardens wherein they shall have whatever they desire from their Lord; that is the great Bounty.
ayahs.translation: You will see the wrongdoers fearful of the consequence of their deeds which will certainly overtake them. But those who have faith and do good deeds will be in the meadows of the Gardens wherein they shall have whatever they desire from their Lord; that is the great Bounty.

ayahs.text: That is the Bounty of which Allah gives tidings to His servants who have faith and do good deeds. Tell them (O Prophet):  I do not ask you for any recompense for my work except love towards kinsfolk. Whoever does a good deed We shall increase its merit for him. Surely Allah is Most Forgiving Most Appreciative.
ayahs.translation: That is the Bounty of which Allah gives tidings to His servants who have faith and do good deeds. Tell them (O Prophet):  I do not ask you for any recompense for my work except love towards kinsfolk. Whoever does a good deed We shall increase its merit for him. Surely Allah is Most Forgiving Most Appreciative.

ayahs.text: Do they say:  He has forged a lie against Allah? If Allah so wanted He could seal up your heart. Allah blots out falsehood and confirms the truth by His Words.He is well aware of all the secrets hidden in the breasts (of people).
ayahs.translation: Do they say:  He has forged a lie against Allah? If Allah so wanted He could seal up your heart. Allah blots out falsehood and confirms the truth by His Words.He is well aware of all the secrets hidden in the breasts (of people).

ayahs.text: He it is Who accepts repentance from His servants and forgives sins and knows all what you do
ayahs.translation: He it is Who accepts repentance from His servants and forgives sins and knows all what you do

ayahs.text: and answers the prayers of those who believe and do good deeds and bestows upon them even more out of His Bounty. As for those who deny (the Truth) a grievous chastisement awaits them.
ayahs.translation: and answers the prayers of those who believe and do good deeds and bestows upon them even more out of His Bounty. As for those who deny (the Truth) a grievous chastisement awaits them.

ayahs.text: If Allah were to grant ample sustenance to His servants they would go about transgressing in the land. But He sends down in due measure whatever (sustenance) He wills. Surely He is Well-Aware and All-Seeing concerning matters that relate to His servants.
ayahs.translation: If Allah were to grant ample sustenance to His servants they would go about transgressing in the land. But He sends down in due measure whatever (sustenance) He wills. Surely He is Well-Aware and All-Seeing concerning matters that relate to His servants.

ayahs.text: He it is Who sends down the rain after they despair of it spreading out His Mercy. He is the Protector the Immensely Praiseworthy.
ayahs.translation: He it is Who sends down the rain after they despair of it spreading out His Mercy. He is the Protector the Immensely Praiseworthy.

ayahs.text: And of His Signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the living creatures that He has spread out in them. He has the power to bring them together when He so wills.
ayahs.translation: And of His Signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the living creatures that He has spread out in them. He has the power to bring them together when He so wills.

ayahs.text: Whatever misfortune befalls you is a consequence of your own deeds. But much of it He forgives.
ayahs.translation: Whatever misfortune befalls you is a consequence of your own deeds. But much of it He forgives.

ayahs.text: You cannot frustrate Him in the earth; you have no protector nor helper against Allah.
ayahs.translation: You cannot frustrate Him in the earth; you have no protector nor helper against Allah.

ayahs.text: And of His Signs are the ships that sail in the sea like mountains.
ayahs.translation: And of His Signs are the ships that sail in the sea like mountains.

ayahs.text: If He so wills He can cause the winds to become still so that they will remain motionless on its surface. Surely there are many Signs in this for those who are wont to be steadfast and give thanks.
ayahs.translation: If He so wills He can cause the winds to become still so that they will remain motionless on its surface. Surely there are many Signs in this for those who are wont to be steadfast and give thanks.

ayahs.text: He may while forgiving much of the sins of those that ride these ships drown them on account of some of their misdeeds.
ayahs.translation: He may while forgiving much of the sins of those that ride these ships drown them on account of some of their misdeeds.

ayahs.text: Then those who wrangle about Our Signs will come to know that there is no escape for them.
ayahs.translation: Then those who wrangle about Our Signs will come to know that there is no escape for them.

ayahs.text: That which has been given to you is only the wherewithal of the transient life of this world. But that which is with Allah is better and more enduring for those who believe and put their trust in their Lord;
ayahs.translation: That which has been given to you is only the wherewithal of the transient life of this world. But that which is with Allah is better and more enduring for those who believe and put their trust in their Lord;

ayahs.text: who eschew grave sins and shameful deeds and whenever they are angry forgive;
ayahs.translation: who eschew grave sins and shameful deeds and whenever they are angry forgive;

ayahs.text: who obey their Lord and establish Prayer; who conduct their affairs by consultation and spend out of what We have bestowed upon them;
ayahs.translation: who obey their Lord and establish Prayer; who conduct their affairs by consultation and spend out of what We have bestowed upon them;

ayahs.text: who when a wrong is done to them seek its redress.
ayahs.translation: who when a wrong is done to them seek its redress.

ayahs.text: The recompense of evil is evil the like of it. But he who forgives and makes amends his reward lies with Allah. Surely He does not love the wrong-doers.
ayahs.translation: The recompense of evil is evil the like of it. But he who forgives and makes amends his reward lies with Allah. Surely He does not love the wrong-doers.

ayahs.text: There is no blame against him who avenges himself after he has been wronged.
ayahs.translation: There is no blame against him who avenges himself after he has been wronged.

ayahs.text: Blame attaches only to those who subject people to wrong and commit excesses on earth. A painful chastisement awaits them.
ayahs.translation: Blame attaches only to those who subject people to wrong and commit excesses on earth. A painful chastisement awaits them.

ayahs.text: But he who patiently endures and forgives that is a conduct of great resolve.
ayahs.translation: But he who patiently endures and forgives that is a conduct of great resolve.

ayahs.translation: He whom Allah lets go astray none after Him can be his protector. You will see that when the wrong-doers observe the chastisement they will exclaim:  Is there any way to go back?

But the believers will say:  Surely the true losers are they who lose themselves and their kindred on the Day of Resurrection.  Lo the wrong-doers will be in an enduring torment.

But the believers will say:  Surely the true losers are they who lose themselves and their kindred on the Day of Resurrection.  Lo the wrong-doers will be in an enduring torment.

ayahs.translation: They shall have no protectors to help them against Allah. For he whom Allah causes to go astray will have no way to save himself.

ayahs.text: Accept the command of your Lord before there comes a Day from Allah that cannot be averted. On that Day there shall be no shelter for you and none may change your predicament.
ayahs.translation: Accept the command of your Lord before there comes a Day from Allah that cannot be averted. On that Day there shall be no shelter for you and none may change your predicament.

Indeed when We give man a taste of Our Mercy he exults in it. But if any misfortune afflicts them on account of their deeds man is utterly ungrateful.

ayahs.translation: The dominion of the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah. He creates whatever He pleases. He grants females to whomever He pleases and males to whomever He pleases

ayahs.text: or grants them a mix of males and females and causes whomever He pleases to be barren. He is All- Knowing All-Powerful.
ayahs.translation: or grants them a mix of males and females and causes whomever He pleases to be barren. He is All- Knowing All-Powerful.

ayahs.translation: It is not given to any human being that Allah should speak to him except through revelation or from behind a veil or that a messenger (an angel) be sent to him who reveals to him by Allah''s leave whatever He wishes. He is All-High Most Wise.

But We made that spirit a light whereby We guide those of Our servants whom We please to the Right Way. Surely you are directing people to the Right Way

ayahs.translation: the Way of Allah to Whom belongs the dominion of all that is in the heavens and the earth. Lo it is to Allah that all things ultimately revert.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Ha''. Mim.
verses.translation: Ha''. Mim.

verses.text: By the Clear Book;
verses.translation: By the Clear Book;

verses.text: verily We have made it an Arabic Qur''an that you may understand.
verses.translation: verily We have made it an Arabic Qur''an that you may understand.

verses.text: Indeed it is transcribed in the Original Book with Us; sublime and full of wisdom.
verses.translation: Indeed it is transcribed in the Original Book with Us; sublime and full of wisdom.

verses.text: Should We divert this Good Counsel from you because you are a people immersed in extravagance?
verses.translation: Should We divert this Good Counsel from you because you are a people immersed in extravagance?

verses.text: How many a Prophet did We send to the earlier peoples!
verses.translation: How many a Prophet did We send to the earlier peoples!

verses.text: Yet never did a Prophet come to them but they mocked him.
verses.translation: Yet never did a Prophet come to them but they mocked him.

verses.text: We utterly destroyed them although they were greater in might than these. The examples of ancient peoples have gone before.
verses.translation: We utterly destroyed them although they were greater in might than these. The examples of ancient peoples have gone before.

verses.text: Yet if you were to ask them:  Who created the heavens and the earth?  they will certainly say:  The All-Mighty the All-Knowing has created them.
verses.translation: Yet if you were to ask them:  Who created the heavens and the earth?  they will certainly say:  The All-Mighty the All-Knowing has created them.

verses.text: He it is Who made this earth for you a cradle and made in it pathways for you that you may find the way to your destination;
verses.translation: He it is Who made this earth for you a cradle and made in it pathways for you that you may find the way to your destination;

verses.text: He Who sent down water from the sky in a determined measure and thereby We revived a dead land: likewise will you be raised up (from the earth) -
verses.translation: He Who sent down water from the sky in a determined measure and thereby We revived a dead land: likewise will you be raised up (from the earth) -

verses.text: He Who created these pairs all of them and provided you ships and cattle on which you ride
verses.translation: He Who created these pairs all of them and provided you ships and cattle on which you ride

verses.text: so that when you are mounted upon them you may remember the bounty of your Lord and say:  Glory be to Him Who has subjected this to Us whereas we did not have the strength to subdue it.
verses.translation: so that when you are mounted upon them you may remember the bounty of your Lord and say:  Glory be to Him Who has subjected this to Us whereas we did not have the strength to subdue it.

verses.text: It is to our Lord that we shall eventually return.
verses.translation: It is to our Lord that we shall eventually return.

verses.text: Yet they have made some of His servants a part of Him. Indeed man is most evidently thankless.
verses.translation: Yet they have made some of His servants a part of Him. Indeed man is most evidently thankless.

verses.text: Has Allah taken for Himself daughters out of those whom He creates and has chosen you to have sons?
verses.translation: Has Allah taken for Himself daughters out of those whom He creates and has chosen you to have sons?

verses.text: (They believe so although when) any of them is given tidings of the birth of a female child the like of which he assigns to the Merciful One his countenance darkens and he is choked with grief.
verses.translation: (They believe so although when) any of them is given tidings of the birth of a female child the like of which he assigns to the Merciful One his countenance darkens and he is choked with grief.

verses.text: Do they assign to Allah one who grows up amidst ornaments and is not well-versed in the art of disputation?
verses.translation: Do they assign to Allah one who grows up amidst ornaments and is not well-versed in the art of disputation?

verses.text: They claim that angels who are Allah''s chosen servants are females. Did they witness how their bodies are constituted? Their testimony shall be written and they shall be called to account.
verses.translation: They claim that angels who are Allah''s chosen servants are females. Did they witness how their bodies are constituted? Their testimony shall be written and they shall be called to account.

verses.text: They say:  Had the Merciful One so willed we would never have worshipped these deities. But they have no knowledge of the matter and are simply conjecturing.
verses.translation: They say:  Had the Merciful One so willed we would never have worshipped these deities. But they have no knowledge of the matter and are simply conjecturing.

verses.text: Or did We bestow upon them a Book before on whose authority they are holding on (to angel-worship)?
verses.translation: Or did We bestow upon them a Book before on whose authority they are holding on (to angel-worship)?

verses.text: Nay; they simply claim:  We found our forefathers on a way and we continue to find guidance in their footsteps.
verses.translation: Nay; they simply claim:  We found our forefathers on a way and we continue to find guidance in their footsteps.

verses.text: And thus it is: whenever We sent any warner to a city its affluent ones said:  We found our forefathers on a way and we continue to follow in their footsteps.
verses.translation: And thus it is: whenever We sent any warner to a city its affluent ones said:  We found our forefathers on a way and we continue to follow in their footsteps.

verses.text: Each Prophet asked them:  Will you do so even if we were to show you a way better than the way of your forefathers?  They answered:  We disbelieve in the religion with which you have been sent.
verses.translation: Each Prophet asked them:  Will you do so even if we were to show you a way better than the way of your forefathers?  They answered:  We disbelieve in the religion with which you have been sent.

verses.text: Then We exacted retribution from them. So do consider the end of those who gave the lie (to the Prophets).
verses.translation: Then We exacted retribution from them. So do consider the end of those who gave the lie (to the Prophets).

verses.text: Call to mind when Abraham said to his father and his people: I totally disown all whom you serve
verses.translation: Call to mind when Abraham said to his father and his people: I totally disown all whom you serve

verses.text: except the One Who created me; and behold it is He Who will direct me to the Right Way.
verses.translation: except the One Who created me; and behold it is He Who will direct me to the Right Way.

verses.text: And Abraham left behind this word to endure among his posterity so that they may return to it.
verses.translation: And Abraham left behind this word to endure among his posterity so that they may return to it.

verses.text: (Even when they began worshipping others than Allah We did not destroy them) but bestowed sustenance on them and on their forefathers until there came to them the Truth and a Messenger who clearly expounded things to them.
verses.translation: (Even when they began worshipping others than Allah We did not destroy them) but bestowed sustenance on them and on their forefathers until there came to them the Truth and a Messenger who clearly expounded things to them.

verses.text: And when the Truth came to them they said:  This is just sorcery and we reject it.
verses.translation: And when the Truth came to them they said:  This is just sorcery and we reject it.

verses.text: They say:  Why was this Qur''an not sent down upon some great man from the two (main) cities?
verses.translation: They say:  Why was this Qur''an not sent down upon some great man from the two (main) cities?

verses.text: Is it they who distribute the Mercy of your Lord? It is We Who have distributed their livelihood among them in the life of this world and have raised some above others in rank that some of them may harness others to their service. Your Lord''s Mercy is better than all the treasures that they hoard.
verses.translation: Is it they who distribute the Mercy of your Lord? It is We Who have distributed their livelihood among them in the life of this world and have raised some above others in rank that some of them may harness others to their service. Your Lord''s Mercy is better than all the treasures that they hoard.

verses.text: Were it not that all mankind would become a single community (and follow the same way) We would have provided for all those who disbelieve in the Merciful One silver roofs for their houses and (silver) stairs on which to go up
verses.translation: Were it not that all mankind would become a single community (and follow the same way) We would have provided for all those who disbelieve in the Merciful One silver roofs for their houses and (silver) stairs on which to go up

verses.text: and (silver) doors to their houses and couches (of silver) upon which they would recline;
verses.translation: and (silver) doors to their houses and couches (of silver) upon which they would recline;

verses.text: or that they be made of gold. Surely all this is only the enjoyment of the life of the world. But (true prosperity) in the Hereafter with Your Lord is only for the God-fearing.
verses.translation: or that they be made of gold. Surely all this is only the enjoyment of the life of the world. But (true prosperity) in the Hereafter with Your Lord is only for the God-fearing.

verses.text: He who is negligent to remember the Merciful One to him We assign a satan as his boon companion
verses.translation: He who is negligent to remember the Merciful One to him We assign a satan as his boon companion

verses.text: and these satans hinder them from the Right Path while he still reckons himself to be rightly-guided.
verses.translation: and these satans hinder them from the Right Path while he still reckons himself to be rightly-guided.

verses.text: But when he comes to Us he will say (to his satan):  Would that there had been between me and you the distance as between the East and the West. How evil a companion you were!
verses.translation: But when he comes to Us he will say (to his satan):  Would that there had been between me and you the distance as between the East and the West. How evil a companion you were!

verses.text: (He will then be told):  Today it will not benefit you the least that after your wrong-doing you and your satans now share the chastisement.
verses.translation: (He will then be told):  Today it will not benefit you the least that after your wrong-doing you and your satans now share the chastisement.

verses.text: Can you (O Prophet) then make the deaf hear or direct to the Right Way the blind or one lost in manifest error?
verses.translation: Can you (O Prophet) then make the deaf hear or direct to the Right Way the blind or one lost in manifest error?

verses.text: We shall inflict retribution on them whether We take you away from the world (before We do that)
verses.translation: We shall inflict retribution on them whether We take you away from the world (before We do that)

verses.text: or make you see the end that We had promised them for We have full power over them.
verses.translation: or make you see the end that We had promised them for We have full power over them.

verses.text: So hold fast to what has been revealed to you. Surely you are on the Straight Way.
verses.translation: So hold fast to what has been revealed to you. Surely you are on the Straight Way.

verses.text: Verily it is a great source of eminence for you and your people and soon you will be called to account concerning that.
verses.translation: Verily it is a great source of eminence for you and your people and soon you will be called to account concerning that.

verses.text: Ask all Our Messengers whom We sent before you whether We had appointed any deities beside the Merciful One to be worshipped.
verses.translation: Ask all Our Messengers whom We sent before you whether We had appointed any deities beside the Merciful One to be worshipped.

verses.text: Indeed We sent Moses with Our Signs to Pharaoh and his nobles. He told them:  I am a Messenger of the Lord of the Universe.
verses.translation: Indeed We sent Moses with Our Signs to Pharaoh and his nobles. He told them:  I am a Messenger of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.text: Yet when he brought forth Clear Signs from Us then lo they burst into laughter.
verses.translation: Yet when he brought forth Clear Signs from Us then lo they burst into laughter.

verses.text: Every Sign that We showed them was greater than its predecessor; and then We seized them with Our chastisement so that they may return (to the Right Way).
verses.translation: Every Sign that We showed them was greater than its predecessor; and then We seized them with Our chastisement so that they may return (to the Right Way).

verses.text: (Whenever they faced an affliction) they would say:  O magician pray for us to your Lord according to your station with Him. We shall certainly be guided to the Right Way.
verses.translation: (Whenever they faced an affliction) they would say:  O magician pray for us to your Lord according to your station with Him. We shall certainly be guided to the Right Way.

verses.text: But lo each time We removed Our affliction from them they would go back on their word.
verses.translation: But lo each time We removed Our affliction from them they would go back on their word.

verses.text: And Pharaoh proclaimed among his people: My people do I not have dominion over Egypt and are these streams not flowing beneath me? Can''t you see?
verses.translation: And Pharaoh proclaimed among his people: My people do I not have dominion over Egypt and are these streams not flowing beneath me? Can''t you see?

verses.text: Am I better or this contemptible man who is scarcely able to express himself?
verses.translation: Am I better or this contemptible man who is scarcely able to express himself?

verses.text: Why were bracelets of gold not bestowed upon him? Why did a retinue of angels not accompany him as attendants?
verses.translation: Why were bracelets of gold not bestowed upon him? Why did a retinue of angels not accompany him as attendants?

verses.text: He incited his people to levity and they obeyed him. Surely they were an iniquitous people.
verses.translation: He incited his people to levity and they obeyed him. Surely they were an iniquitous people.

verses.text: So when they incurred Our wrath We exacted retribution from them and drowned them all
verses.translation: So when they incurred Our wrath We exacted retribution from them and drowned them all

verses.text: and made them a thing of the past and an example for those who would come after them.
verses.translation: and made them a thing of the past and an example for those who would come after them.

verses.text: No sooner the example of the son of Mary was mentioned than lo and behold your people raised a clamour
verses.translation: No sooner the example of the son of Mary was mentioned than lo and behold your people raised a clamour

verses.text: and said:  Who is better our deities or he? They said so only out of contentiousness. They are a disputatious people.
verses.translation: and said:  Who is better our deities or he? They said so only out of contentiousness. They are a disputatious people.

verses.text: He was no more than a servant (of Ours) one upon whom We bestowed Our favours and whom We made an example (of Our infinite power) for the Children of Israel.
verses.translation: He was no more than a servant (of Ours) one upon whom We bestowed Our favours and whom We made an example (of Our infinite power) for the Children of Israel.

verses.text: If We had so willed We could have made some of you into angels to become your successors on earth.
verses.translation: If We had so willed We could have made some of you into angels to become your successors on earth.

verses.text: Verily he [i.e. Jesus) is a portent of the Hour. So be in no doubt concerning it and follow Me. This is the Straight Way.
verses.translation: Verily he [i.e. Jesus) is a portent of the Hour. So be in no doubt concerning it and follow Me. This is the Straight Way.

verses.text: Let not Satan hinder you (from believing in the Hour) for surely he is your open enemy.
verses.translation: Let not Satan hinder you (from believing in the Hour) for surely he is your open enemy.

verses.text: When Jesus came with Clear Signs and said:  I have brought wisdom to you that I may make plain to you some of the things you differ about. So fear Allah and follow me.
verses.translation: When Jesus came with Clear Signs and said:  I have brought wisdom to you that I may make plain to you some of the things you differ about. So fear Allah and follow me.

verses.text: Allah is my Lord and your Lord; therefore serve Him. That is the Straight Way.
verses.translation: Allah is my Lord and your Lord; therefore serve Him. That is the Straight Way.

verses.text: Then the factions fell apart among themselves. So woe to the wrong-doers from the chastisement of a grievous Day.
verses.translation: Then the factions fell apart among themselves. So woe to the wrong-doers from the chastisement of a grievous Day.

verses.text: Are they awaiting anything other than the Last Hour that it should suddenly come upon them without their even perceiving it?
verses.translation: Are they awaiting anything other than the Last Hour that it should suddenly come upon them without their even perceiving it?

verses.text: On that Day even bosom friends shall become enemies to one another all except the God-fearing.
verses.translation: On that Day even bosom friends shall become enemies to one another all except the God-fearing.

verses.text: (It will be said to them):  My servants today you have nothing to fear or regret
verses.translation: (It will be said to them):  My servants today you have nothing to fear or regret

verses.text: you who believed in Our Signs and had surrendered yourselves (to Us)!
verses.translation: you who believed in Our Signs and had surrendered yourselves (to Us)!

verses.text: Enter Paradise joyfully both you and your spouses.
verses.translation: Enter Paradise joyfully both you and your spouses.

verses.text: Platters and cups of gold shall be passed around them and there shall be all that they might desire and all that their eyes might delight in. (They shall be told):  Herein shall you abide for ever.
verses.translation: Platters and cups of gold shall be passed around them and there shall be all that they might desire and all that their eyes might delight in. (They shall be told):  Herein shall you abide for ever.

verses.text: Such is the Paradise that you shall inherit by virtue of your good deeds in the life of the world.
verses.translation: Such is the Paradise that you shall inherit by virtue of your good deeds in the life of the world.

verses.text: Herein you will have abundant fruits of which you will eat.
verses.translation: Herein you will have abundant fruits of which you will eat.

verses.text: But the evil-doers shall abide in the torment of Hell.
verses.translation: But the evil-doers shall abide in the torment of Hell.

verses.text: Never will their torment be lightened for them. They shall remain in utter despair.
verses.translation: Never will their torment be lightened for them. They shall remain in utter despair.

verses.text: It is not We Who wronged them; rather it is they who wronged themselves.
verses.translation: It is not We Who wronged them; rather it is they who wronged themselves.

verses.text: They shall call out:  O Malik let your Lord put an end to us.  He will reply:  You must stay on in it.
verses.translation: They shall call out:  O Malik let your Lord put an end to us.  He will reply:  You must stay on in it.

verses.text: We brought you the Truth; but to the truth most of you were averse.
verses.translation: We brought you the Truth; but to the truth most of you were averse.

verses.text: Have they contrived some scheme? If so We too will contrive a scheme.
verses.translation: Have they contrived some scheme? If so We too will contrive a scheme.

verses.text: Or do they think that We do not hear their secret talks and their whispering counsels? Yes indeed We do and Our messengers [i.e. angels) are with them writing.
verses.translation: Or do they think that We do not hear their secret talks and their whispering counsels? Yes indeed We do and Our messengers [i.e. angels) are with them writing.

verses.text: Say:  If the Merciful One had a son I would have been the first one to worship him.
verses.translation: Say:  If the Merciful One had a son I would have been the first one to worship him.

verses.text: Exalted be the Lord of the heavens and the earth the Lord of the Throne above what they attribute to Him.
verses.translation: Exalted be the Lord of the heavens and the earth the Lord of the Throne above what they attribute to Him.

verses.text: So leave them alone to indulge in their vanities and to frolic about until they encounter that Day of theirs against which they have been warned.
verses.translation: So leave them alone to indulge in their vanities and to frolic about until they encounter that Day of theirs against which they have been warned.

verses.text: He it is Who is God in the heavens and the earth. He is the Most Wise the All-Knowing.
verses.translation: He it is Who is God in the heavens and the earth. He is the Most Wise the All-Knowing.

verses.text: Blessed is He Who has dominion over the heavens and the earth and all that is between them. With Him is the knowledge of the Hour; and to Him you shall all be sent back.
verses.translation: Blessed is He Who has dominion over the heavens and the earth and all that is between them. With Him is the knowledge of the Hour; and to Him you shall all be sent back.

verses.text: Those whom they call upon instead of Allah have no power of intercession except such that testify to the truth based on knowledge.
verses.translation: Those whom they call upon instead of Allah have no power of intercession except such that testify to the truth based on knowledge.

verses.text: If you were to ask them:  Who created them?  they will surely say:  Allah. Whence are they then being led astray?
verses.translation: If you were to ask them:  Who created them?  they will surely say:  Allah. Whence are they then being led astray?

verses.text: We call to witness the cry of the Messenger:  O Lord these are a people not wont to believe!
verses.translation: We call to witness the cry of the Messenger:  O Lord these are a people not wont to believe!

verses.text: Indulge them (O Prophet) and say to them:  Peace to you. For soon they shall come to know.
verses.translation: Indulge them (O Prophet) and say to them:  Peace to you. For soon they shall come to know.

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: Ha''. Mim.
ayahs.translation: Ha''. Mim.

ayahs.text: By the Clear Book;
ayahs.translation: By the Clear Book;

ayahs.text: verily We have made it an Arabic Qur''an that you may understand.
ayahs.translation: verily We have made it an Arabic Qur''an that you may understand.

ayahs.text: Indeed it is transcribed in the Original Book with Us; sublime and full of wisdom.
ayahs.translation: Indeed it is transcribed in the Original Book with Us; sublime and full of wisdom.

ayahs.text: Should We divert this Good Counsel from you because you are a people immersed in extravagance?
ayahs.translation: Should We divert this Good Counsel from you because you are a people immersed in extravagance?

ayahs.text: How many a Prophet did We send to the earlier peoples!
ayahs.translation: How many a Prophet did We send to the earlier peoples!

ayahs.text: Yet never did a Prophet come to them but they mocked him.
ayahs.translation: Yet never did a Prophet come to them but they mocked him.

ayahs.text: We utterly destroyed them although they were greater in might than these. The examples of ancient peoples have gone before.
ayahs.translation: We utterly destroyed them although they were greater in might than these. The examples of ancient peoples have gone before.

ayahs.text: Yet if you were to ask them:  Who created the heavens and the earth?  they will certainly say:  The All-Mighty the All-Knowing has created them.
ayahs.translation: Yet if you were to ask them:  Who created the heavens and the earth?  they will certainly say:  The All-Mighty the All-Knowing has created them.

ayahs.text: He it is Who made this earth for you a cradle and made in it pathways for you that you may find the way to your destination;
ayahs.translation: He it is Who made this earth for you a cradle and made in it pathways for you that you may find the way to your destination;

ayahs.text: He Who sent down water from the sky in a determined measure and thereby We revived a dead land: likewise will you be raised up (from the earth) -
ayahs.translation: He Who sent down water from the sky in a determined measure and thereby We revived a dead land: likewise will you be raised up (from the earth) -

ayahs.text: He Who created these pairs all of them and provided you ships and cattle on which you ride
ayahs.translation: He Who created these pairs all of them and provided you ships and cattle on which you ride

ayahs.text: so that when you are mounted upon them you may remember the bounty of your Lord and say:  Glory be to Him Who has subjected this to Us whereas we did not have the strength to subdue it.
ayahs.translation: so that when you are mounted upon them you may remember the bounty of your Lord and say:  Glory be to Him Who has subjected this to Us whereas we did not have the strength to subdue it.

ayahs.text: It is to our Lord that we shall eventually return.
ayahs.translation: It is to our Lord that we shall eventually return.

ayahs.text: Yet they have made some of His servants a part of Him. Indeed man is most evidently thankless.
ayahs.translation: Yet they have made some of His servants a part of Him. Indeed man is most evidently thankless.

ayahs.text: Has Allah taken for Himself daughters out of those whom He creates and has chosen you to have sons?
ayahs.translation: Has Allah taken for Himself daughters out of those whom He creates and has chosen you to have sons?

ayahs.text: (They believe so although when) any of them is given tidings of the birth of a female child the like of which he assigns to the Merciful One his countenance darkens and he is choked with grief.
ayahs.translation: (They believe so although when) any of them is given tidings of the birth of a female child the like of which he assigns to the Merciful One his countenance darkens and he is choked with grief.

ayahs.text: Do they assign to Allah one who grows up amidst ornaments and is not well-versed in the art of disputation?
ayahs.translation: Do they assign to Allah one who grows up amidst ornaments and is not well-versed in the art of disputation?

ayahs.text: They claim that angels who are Allah''s chosen servants are females. Did they witness how their bodies are constituted? Their testimony shall be written and they shall be called to account.
ayahs.translation: They claim that angels who are Allah''s chosen servants are females. Did they witness how their bodies are constituted? Their testimony shall be written and they shall be called to account.

ayahs.text: They say:  Had the Merciful One so willed we would never have worshipped these deities. But they have no knowledge of the matter and are simply conjecturing.
ayahs.translation: They say:  Had the Merciful One so willed we would never have worshipped these deities. But they have no knowledge of the matter and are simply conjecturing.

ayahs.text: Or did We bestow upon them a Book before on whose authority they are holding on (to angel-worship)?
ayahs.translation: Or did We bestow upon them a Book before on whose authority they are holding on (to angel-worship)?

ayahs.text: Nay; they simply claim:  We found our forefathers on a way and we continue to find guidance in their footsteps.
ayahs.translation: Nay; they simply claim:  We found our forefathers on a way and we continue to find guidance in their footsteps.

ayahs.text: And thus it is: whenever We sent any warner to a city its affluent ones said:  We found our forefathers on a way and we continue to follow in their footsteps.
ayahs.translation: And thus it is: whenever We sent any warner to a city its affluent ones said:  We found our forefathers on a way and we continue to follow in their footsteps.

ayahs.text: Each Prophet asked them:  Will you do so even if we were to show you a way better than the way of your forefathers?  They answered:  We disbelieve in the religion with which you have been sent.
ayahs.translation: Each Prophet asked them:  Will you do so even if we were to show you a way better than the way of your forefathers?  They answered:  We disbelieve in the religion with which you have been sent.

ayahs.text: Why were bracelets of gold not bestowed upon him? Why did a retinue of angels not accompany him as attendants?
ayahs.translation: Why were bracelets of gold not bestowed upon him? Why did a retinue of angels not accompany him as attendants?

ayahs.text: He incited his people to levity and they obeyed him. Surely they were an iniquitous people.
ayahs.translation: He incited his people to levity and they obeyed him. Surely they were an iniquitous people.

ayahs.text: So when they incurred Our wrath We exacted retribution from them and drowned them all
ayahs.translation: So when they incurred Our wrath We exacted retribution from them and drowned them all

ayahs.text: and made them a thing of the past and an example for those who would come after them.
ayahs.translation: and made them a thing of the past and an example for those who would come after them.

ayahs.text: No sooner the example of the son of Mary was mentioned than lo and behold your people raised a clamour
ayahs.translation: No sooner the example of the son of Mary was mentioned than lo and behold your people raised a clamour

ayahs.text: and said:  Who is better our deities or he? They said so only out of contentiousness. They are a disputatious people.
ayahs.translation: and said:  Who is better our deities or he? They said so only out of contentiousness. They are a disputatious people.

ayahs.text: He was no more than a servant (of Ours) one upon whom We bestowed Our favours and whom We made an example (of Our infinite power) for the Children of Israel.
ayahs.translation: He was no more than a servant (of Ours) one upon whom We bestowed Our favours and whom We made an example (of Our infinite power) for the Children of Israel.

ayahs.text: If We had so willed We could have made some of you into angels to become your successors on earth.
ayahs.translation: If We had so willed We could have made some of you into angels to become your successors on earth.

ayahs.text: Verily he [i.e. Jesus) is a portent of the Hour. So be in no doubt concerning it and follow Me. This is the Straight Way.
ayahs.translation: Verily he [i.e. Jesus) is a portent of the Hour. So be in no doubt concerning it and follow Me. This is the Straight Way.

ayahs.text: Let not Satan hinder you (from believing in the Hour) for surely he is your open enemy.
ayahs.translation: Let not Satan hinder you (from believing in the Hour) for surely he is your open enemy.

ayahs.text: When Jesus came with Clear Signs and said:  I have brought wisdom to you that I may make plain to you some of the things you differ about. So fear Allah and follow me.
ayahs.translation: When Jesus came with Clear Signs and said:  I have brought wisdom to you that I may make plain to you some of the things you differ about. So fear Allah and follow me.

ayahs.text: Allah is my Lord and your Lord; therefore serve Him. That is the Straight Way.
ayahs.translation: Allah is my Lord and your Lord; therefore serve Him. That is the Straight Way.

ayahs.text: Then the factions fell apart among themselves. So woe to the wrong-doers from the chastisement of a grievous Day.
ayahs.translation: Then the factions fell apart among themselves. So woe to the wrong-doers from the chastisement of a grievous Day.

ayahs.text: Are they awaiting anything other than the Last Hour that it should suddenly come upon them without their even perceiving it?
ayahs.translation: Are they awaiting anything other than the Last Hour that it should suddenly come upon them without their even perceiving it?

ayahs.text: On that Day even bosom friends shall become enemies to one another all except the God-fearing.
ayahs.translation: On that Day even bosom friends shall become enemies to one another all except the God-fearing.

ayahs.text: (It will be said to them):  My servants today you have nothing to fear or regret
ayahs.translation: (It will be said to them):  My servants today you have nothing to fear or regret

ayahs.text: you who believed in Our Signs and had surrendered yourselves (to Us)!
ayahs.translation: you who believed in Our Signs and had surrendered yourselves (to Us)!

ayahs.text: Enter Paradise joyfully both you and your spouses.
ayahs.translation: Enter Paradise joyfully both you and your spouses.

ayahs.text: Platters and cups of gold shall be passed around them and there shall be all that they might desire and all that their eyes might delight in. (They shall be told):  Herein shall you abide for ever.
ayahs.translation: Platters and cups of gold shall be passed around them and there shall be all that they might desire and all that their eyes might delight in. (They shall be told):  Herein shall you abide for ever.

ayahs.text: Such is the Paradise that you shall inherit by virtue of your good deeds in the life of the world.
ayahs.translation: Such is the Paradise that you shall inherit by virtue of your good deeds in the life of the world.

ayahs.text: Herein you will have abundant fruits of which you will eat.
ayahs.translation: Herein you will have abundant fruits of which you will eat.

ayahs.text: But the evil-doers shall abide in the torment of Hell.
ayahs.translation: But the evil-doers shall abide in the torment of Hell.

ayahs.text: Never will their torment be lightened for them. They shall remain in utter despair.
ayahs.translation: Never will their torment be lightened for them. They shall remain in utter despair.

ayahs.text: It is not We Who wronged them; rather it is they who wronged themselves.
ayahs.translation: It is not We Who wronged them; rather it is they who wronged themselves.

ayahs.text: They shall call out:  O Malik let your Lord put an end to us.  He will reply:  You must stay on in it.
ayahs.translation: They shall call out:  O Malik let your Lord put an end to us.  He will reply:  You must stay on in it.

ayahs.text: We brought you the Truth; but to the truth most of you were averse.
ayahs.translation: We brought you the Truth; but to the truth most of you were averse.

ayahs.text: Have they contrived some scheme? If so We too will contrive a scheme.
ayahs.translation: Have they contrived some scheme? If so We too will contrive a scheme.

ayahs.text: Or do they think that We do not hear their secret talks and their whispering counsels? Yes indeed We do and Our messengers [i.e. angels) are with them writing.
ayahs.translation: Or do they think that We do not hear their secret talks and their whispering counsels? Yes indeed We do and Our messengers [i.e. angels) are with them writing.

ayahs.text: Say:  If the Merciful One had a son I would have been the first one to worship him.
ayahs.translation: Say:  If the Merciful One had a son I would have been the first one to worship him.

ayahs.text: Exalted be the Lord of the heavens and the earth the Lord of the Throne above what they attribute to Him.
ayahs.translation: Exalted be the Lord of the heavens and the earth the Lord of the Throne above what they attribute to Him.

ayahs.text: So leave them alone to indulge in their vanities and to frolic about until they encounter that Day of theirs against which they have been warned.
ayahs.translation: So leave them alone to indulge in their vanities and to frolic about until they encounter that Day of theirs against which they have been warned.

ayahs.text: He it is Who is God in the heavens and the earth. He is the Most Wise the All-Knowing.
ayahs.translation: He it is Who is God in the heavens and the earth. He is the Most Wise the All-Knowing.

ayahs.text: Blessed is He Who has dominion over the heavens and the earth and all that is between them. With Him is the knowledge of the Hour; and to Him you shall all be sent back.
ayahs.translation: Blessed is He Who has dominion over the heavens and the earth and all that is between them. With Him is the knowledge of the Hour; and to Him you shall all be sent back.

ayahs.text: Those whom they call upon instead of Allah have no power of intercession except such that testify to the truth based on knowledge.
ayahs.translation: Those whom they call upon instead of Allah have no power of intercession except such that testify to the truth based on knowledge.

ayahs.text: If you were to ask them:  Who created them?  they will surely say:  Allah. Whence are they then being led astray?
ayahs.translation: If you were to ask them:  Who created them?  they will surely say:  Allah. Whence are they then being led astray?

ayahs.text: We call to witness the cry of the Messenger:  O Lord these are a people not wont to believe!
ayahs.translation: We call to witness the cry of the Messenger:  O Lord these are a people not wont to believe!

ayahs.text: Indulge them (O Prophet) and say to them:  Peace to you. For soon they shall come to know.
ayahs.translation: Indulge them (O Prophet) and say to them:  Peace to you. For soon they shall come to know.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Ha''. Mim.
verses.translation: Ha''. Mim.

verses.text: By the Clear Book.
verses.translation: By the Clear Book.

verses.text: We revealed it on a Blessed Night for We were intent on warning;
verses.translation: We revealed it on a Blessed Night for We were intent on warning;

verses.text: (We revealed it on the Night) wherein every matter is wisely determined
verses.translation: (We revealed it on the Night) wherein every matter is wisely determined

verses.text: by Our command. Verily We were set to send a Messenger
verses.translation: by Our command. Verily We were set to send a Messenger

verses.text: as a Mercy from your Lord. Surely He is All-Hearing All-Seeing
verses.translation: as a Mercy from your Lord. Surely He is All-Hearing All-Seeing

verses.text: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and of all that is between them: if you would only have sure faith.
verses.translation: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and of all that is between them: if you would only have sure faith.

verses.text: There is no god but He: He gives life and causes death. He is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers of yore.
verses.translation: There is no god but He: He gives life and causes death. He is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers of yore.

verses.text: (But the fact is they lack certainty) and frolic about in doubt.
verses.translation: (But the fact is they lack certainty) and frolic about in doubt.

verses.text: So watch for the Day when the sky will come down with a pall of smoke
verses.translation: So watch for the Day when the sky will come down with a pall of smoke

verses.text: enveloping people. That will be a grievous scourge.
verses.translation: enveloping people. That will be a grievous scourge.

verses.text: (People will then say):  Our Lord remove this scourge from us; we shall believe.
verses.translation: (People will then say):  Our Lord remove this scourge from us; we shall believe.

verses.text: But how will they take heed? Such are they that a Messenger came to them clearly expounding the Truth
verses.translation: But how will they take heed? Such are they that a Messenger came to them clearly expounding the Truth

verses.text: yet they turned away from him and said:  This is a well-tutored madman.
verses.translation: yet they turned away from him and said:  This is a well-tutored madman.

verses.text: Yet We will hold the scourge back for a while (but no sooner than We will do so) you will revert to your old ways.
verses.translation: Yet We will hold the scourge back for a while (but no sooner than We will do so) you will revert to your old ways.

verses.text: The Day when We shall seize them with a mighty seizing that will be the Day on which We shall inflict upon you full retribution.
verses.translation: The Day when We shall seize them with a mighty seizing that will be the Day on which We shall inflict upon you full retribution.

verses.text: Indeed before that We subjected the Pharaonites to the same test. A noble Messenger came to them
verses.translation: Indeed before that We subjected the Pharaonites to the same test. A noble Messenger came to them

verses.text: (and said): Deliver to me Allah''s servants. I am a trustworthy Messenger to you
verses.translation: (and said): Deliver to me Allah''s servants. I am a trustworthy Messenger to you

verses.text: and do not exalt yourselves in defiance of Allah. I have come to you with a clear authority (as a Messenger).
verses.translation: and do not exalt yourselves in defiance of Allah. I have come to you with a clear authority (as a Messenger).

verses.text: I have taken refuge with my Lord and your Lord lest you should attack me with stones.
verses.translation: I have taken refuge with my Lord and your Lord lest you should attack me with stones.

verses.text: But if you do not believe what I say leave me alone (and desist from laying hands on me).
verses.translation: But if you do not believe what I say leave me alone (and desist from laying hands on me).

verses.text: Then he called upon his Lord:  These are a criminal people.
verses.translation: Then he called upon his Lord:  These are a criminal people.

verses.text: (He was told):  Set out with My servants by night for you will certainly be pursued.
verses.translation: (He was told):  Set out with My servants by night for you will certainly be pursued.

verses.text: And leave the sea behind you as calm as ever. Surely they are an army that is doomed to be drowned.
verses.translation: And leave the sea behind you as calm as ever. Surely they are an army that is doomed to be drowned.

verses.text: How many gardens did they leave behind and how many fountains
verses.translation: How many gardens did they leave behind and how many fountains

verses.text: and sown fields and splendid mansions
verses.translation: and sown fields and splendid mansions

verses.text: and the life of ease in which they took delight!
verses.translation: and the life of ease in which they took delight!

verses.text: Thus it was; and We made another people inherit all that.
verses.translation: Thus it was; and We made another people inherit all that.

verses.text: Then neither the sky shed tears over them nor the earth. They were granted no respite.
verses.translation: Then neither the sky shed tears over them nor the earth. They were granted no respite.

verses.text: Thus did We deliver the Children of Israel from the humiliating chastisement
verses.translation: Thus did We deliver the Children of Israel from the humiliating chastisement

verses.text: from Pharaoh who was most prominent among the prodigals.
verses.translation: from Pharaoh who was most prominent among the prodigals.

verses.text: We knowingly exalted them (i.e. the Children of Israel) above other peoples of the world
verses.translation: We knowingly exalted them (i.e. the Children of Israel) above other peoples of the world

verses.text: and bestowed upon them the Signs wherein lay an evident test for them.
verses.translation: and bestowed upon them the Signs wherein lay an evident test for them.

verses.text: Indeed these people say:
verses.translation: Indeed these people say:

verses.text: This is our first and only death and we shall never be raised again.
verses.translation: This is our first and only death and we shall never be raised again.

verses.text: Bring back to us our fathers if you are truthful.
verses.translation: Bring back to us our fathers if you are truthful.

verses.text: Are these better or the people of Tubba and those who went before them? We destroyed them for they were a criminal people.
verses.translation: Are these better or the people of Tubba and those who went before them? We destroyed them for they were a criminal people.

verses.text: It was not in idle sport that We created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them.
verses.translation: It was not in idle sport that We created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them.

verses.text: We did not create them except in Truth. But most of them do not know.
verses.translation: We did not create them except in Truth. But most of them do not know.

verses.text: The Day of Final Decision is the appointed time for all;
verses.translation: The Day of Final Decision is the appointed time for all;

verses.text: the Day when a friend shall be of no avail to his friend nor shall they be helped
verses.translation: the Day when a friend shall be of no avail to his friend nor shall they be helped

verses.text: except those to whom Allah shows mercy. He is the Most Mighty the Most Compassionate.
verses.translation: except those to whom Allah shows mercy. He is the Most Mighty the Most Compassionate.

verses.text: The tree of al-Zaqqum
verses.translation: The tree of al-Zaqqum

verses.text: shall be the food of the sinful.
verses.translation: shall be the food of the sinful.

verses.text: Like dregs of oil it will boil in their bellies
verses.translation: Like dregs of oil it will boil in their bellies

verses.text: like boiling water.
verses.translation: like boiling water.

verses.text: Seize him and drag him to the middle of the Blazing Fire
verses.translation: Seize him and drag him to the middle of the Blazing Fire

verses.text: then pour boiling water over his head as chastisement.
verses.translation: then pour boiling water over his head as chastisement.

verses.text: Taste this you are a person mighty and noble!
verses.translation: Taste this you are a person mighty and noble!

verses.text: This is what you used to doubt.
verses.translation: This is what you used to doubt.

verses.text: Verily the God-fearing shall be in a secure place
verses.translation: Verily the God-fearing shall be in a secure place

verses.text: amidst gardens and springs.
verses.translation: amidst gardens and springs.

verses.text: Attired in silk and brocade they shall be arrayed face to face.
verses.translation: Attired in silk and brocade they shall be arrayed face to face.

verses.text: Thus shall it be: and We shall espouse them to fair wide-eyed maidens.
verses.translation: Thus shall it be: and We shall espouse them to fair wide-eyed maidens.

verses.text: While resting in security they shall call for all kinds of fruit.
verses.translation: While resting in security they shall call for all kinds of fruit.

verses.text: They shall not taste death except the death in this world. And Allah will save them from the chastisement of Hell
verses.translation: They shall not taste death except the death in this world. And Allah will save them from the chastisement of Hell

verses.text: as a favour from your Lord. That is the great triumph.
verses.translation: as a favour from your Lord. That is the great triumph.

verses.text: (O Prophet) We have made this Book easy in your tongue so that they may take heed.
verses.translation: (O Prophet) We have made this Book easy in your tongue so that they may take heed.

verses.text: Wait then; they too are waiting.
verses.translation: Wait then; they too are waiting.

verses.text: This Book is a revelation from the Most Mighty the Most Wise.
