verses.text: Behold for those who believe there are (myriad) Signs in the heavens and the earth
verses.translation: Behold for those who believe there are (myriad) Signs in the heavens and the earth

verses.text: and in your own creation; and in the animals which He spreads out over the earth too there are Signs for those endowed with sure faith;
verses.translation: and in your own creation; and in the animals which He spreads out over the earth too there are Signs for those endowed with sure faith;

verses.text: and in the succession of night and day and in the provision that Allah sends down from the sky wherewith He gives life to the earth after it had been lifeless and in the change of the winds: (in all these) there are Signs for people who use reason.
verses.translation: and in the succession of night and day and in the provision that Allah sends down from the sky wherewith He gives life to the earth after it had been lifeless and in the change of the winds: (in all these) there are Signs for people who use reason.

verses.text: These are Allah''s Signs that We rehearse to you in Truth. In what kind of discourse after Allah and His Signs will they then believe?
verses.translation: These are Allah''s Signs that We rehearse to you in Truth. In what kind of discourse after Allah and His Signs will they then believe?

verses.text: Woe to every guilty impostor
verses.translation: Woe to every guilty impostor

verses.text: who hears Allah''s Signs being rehearsed to him and yet persists in his pride as though he had not heard it. Announce to him then the tidings of a grievous chastisement.
verses.translation: who hears Allah''s Signs being rehearsed to him and yet persists in his pride as though he had not heard it. Announce to him then the tidings of a grievous chastisement.

verses.text: Whenever he comes to know anything of Our Signs he makes them an object of jest. For such there awaits a humiliating chastisement.
verses.translation: Whenever he comes to know anything of Our Signs he makes them an object of jest. For such there awaits a humiliating chastisement.

verses.text: Hell is behind them. Their worldly earnings shall not avail them nor those whom they took as protectors instead of Allah. An awesome chastisement lies in store for them.
verses.translation: Hell is behind them. Their worldly earnings shall not avail them nor those whom they took as protectors instead of Allah. An awesome chastisement lies in store for them.

verses.text: This (Qur''an) is the true guidance. Those who deny the Signs of their Lord shall suffer the torment of a woeful scourge.
verses.translation: This (Qur''an) is the true guidance. Those who deny the Signs of their Lord shall suffer the torment of a woeful scourge.

verses.text: Allah it is Who has subjected the sea to you so that ships may sail upon it at His bidding and you may seek of His Bounty and give thanks to Him.
verses.translation: Allah it is Who has subjected the sea to you so that ships may sail upon it at His bidding and you may seek of His Bounty and give thanks to Him.

verses.text: He has subjected to you all that is in the heavens and the earth all being from Him. Verily there are Signs in this for those who reflect.
verses.translation: He has subjected to you all that is in the heavens and the earth all being from Him. Verily there are Signs in this for those who reflect.

verses.text: (O Prophet) tell the believers to indulge those who have no fear of any evil days coming upon them from Allah so that Allah may Himself requite them for their deeds.
verses.translation: (O Prophet) tell the believers to indulge those who have no fear of any evil days coming upon them from Allah so that Allah may Himself requite them for their deeds.

verses.text: Whoever acts righteously does so to his own good; and whoever commits an evil will suffer its consequence. All of you will then be sent back to your Lord.
verses.translation: Whoever acts righteously does so to his own good; and whoever commits an evil will suffer its consequence. All of you will then be sent back to your Lord.

verses.text: Indeed We endowed the Children of Israel with the Book and Wisdom and Prophethood and provided them with good things as sustenance and exalted them above the peoples of the whole world.
verses.translation: Indeed We endowed the Children of Israel with the Book and Wisdom and Prophethood and provided them with good things as sustenance and exalted them above the peoples of the whole world.

verses.text: We gave them clear directions in matters pertaining to religion. Yet they differed among themselves (not out of ignorance but) after knowledge had come to them; and they did so out of the desire to commit excesses against one another. On the Day of Resurrection Allah will judge among them regarding what they had differed.
verses.translation: We gave them clear directions in matters pertaining to religion. Yet they differed among themselves (not out of ignorance but) after knowledge had come to them; and they did so out of the desire to commit excesses against one another. On the Day of Resurrection Allah will judge among them regarding what they had differed.

verses.text: And then We set you (O Prophet) on a clear high road in religious matters. So follow that and do not follow the desires of those who do not know.
verses.translation: And then We set you (O Prophet) on a clear high road in religious matters. So follow that and do not follow the desires of those who do not know.

verses.text: Surely they will be of no avail to you against Allah. Indeed the wrong-doers are friends of each other whereas Allah is the friend of the God-fearing.
verses.translation: Surely they will be of no avail to you against Allah. Indeed the wrong-doers are friends of each other whereas Allah is the friend of the God-fearing.

verses.text: These are the lights of discernment for people and guidance and mercy for those endowed with sure faith.
verses.translation: These are the lights of discernment for people and guidance and mercy for those endowed with sure faith.

verses.text: Do the evil-doers imagine that We shall make them equal to those who believe and do good making their lives and deaths alike? How vile is their judgement!
verses.translation: Do the evil-doers imagine that We shall make them equal to those who believe and do good making their lives and deaths alike? How vile is their judgement!

verses.text: Allah created the heavens and the earth in Truth that each person may be requited for his deeds. They shall not be wronged.
verses.translation: Allah created the heavens and the earth in Truth that each person may be requited for his deeds. They shall not be wronged.

verses.text: Did you ever consider the case of him who took his desire as his god and then Allah caused him to go astray despite knowledge and sealed his hearing and his heart and cast a veil over his sight? Who after Allah can direct him to the Right Way? Will you not take heed?
verses.translation: Did you ever consider the case of him who took his desire as his god and then Allah caused him to go astray despite knowledge and sealed his hearing and his heart and cast a veil over his sight? Who after Allah can direct him to the Right Way? Will you not take heed?

verses.text: They say:  There is no life other than our present worldly life: herein we live and we die and it is only (the passage of) time that destroys us. Yet the fact is that they know nothing about this and are only conjecturing.
verses.translation: They say:  There is no life other than our present worldly life: herein we live and we die and it is only (the passage of) time that destroys us. Yet the fact is that they know nothing about this and are only conjecturing.

verses.text: And when Our Clear Signs are rehearsed to them their only contention is:  Bring back to us our fathers if you are truthful.
verses.translation: And when Our Clear Signs are rehearsed to them their only contention is:  Bring back to us our fathers if you are truthful.

verses.text: Tell them (O Prophet):  It is Allah Who gives you life and then causes you to die and He it is Who will then bring all of you together on the Day of Resurrection a Day regarding which there can be no doubt. Yet most people do not know.
verses.translation: Tell them (O Prophet):  It is Allah Who gives you life and then causes you to die and He it is Who will then bring all of you together on the Day of Resurrection a Day regarding which there can be no doubt. Yet most people do not know.

verses.text: Allah''s is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and on the Day when the Hour (of Resurrection) shall come to pass the followers of falsehood shall be in utter loss.
verses.translation: Allah''s is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and on the Day when the Hour (of Resurrection) shall come to pass the followers of falsehood shall be in utter loss.

verses.text: On that Day you shall see every people fallen on their knees. Every people will be summoned to come forth and see its Record and will be told:  Today you shall be requited for your deeds.
verses.translation: On that Day you shall see every people fallen on their knees. Every people will be summoned to come forth and see its Record and will be told:  Today you shall be requited for your deeds.

verses.text: This is Our Record which bears witness against you with truth; We used to record all what you did.
verses.translation: This is Our Record which bears witness against you with truth; We used to record all what you did.

verses.text: As for those who believe and act righteously their Lord shall admit them to His Mercy. That indeed is the manifest triumph.
verses.translation: As for those who believe and act righteously their Lord shall admit them to His Mercy. That indeed is the manifest triumph.

verses.text: But those who denied the Truth they shall be told:  Were My Signs not rehearsed to you? But you waxed proud and became a guilty people.
verses.translation: But those who denied the Truth they shall be told:  Were My Signs not rehearsed to you? But you waxed proud and became a guilty people.

verses.text: And when it was said to them:  Surely Allah''s promise is true and there is no doubt regarding the Hour of Resurrection you were wont to say:  We do not know what the Hour (of Resurrection) is. We are simply making conjectures and are not at all certain.
verses.translation: And when it was said to them:  Surely Allah''s promise is true and there is no doubt regarding the Hour of Resurrection you were wont to say:  We do not know what the Hour (of Resurrection) is. We are simply making conjectures and are not at all certain.

verses.text: (On that Day) the evil of their deeds will become apparent to them and what they had mocked at will encompass them
verses.translation: (On that Day) the evil of their deeds will become apparent to them and what they had mocked at will encompass them

verses.text: and it will be said:  We will forget you today as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours. The Fire shall now be your abode and you shall have none to come to your aid.
verses.translation: and it will be said:  We will forget you today as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours. The Fire shall now be your abode and you shall have none to come to your aid.

verses.text: You reached this end because you made Allah''s Signs an object of jest and the life of the world deluded you.  So they shall not be taken out of the Fire nor shall they be asked to make amends (and thus please their Lord).
verses.translation: You reached this end because you made Allah''s Signs an object of jest and the life of the world deluded you.  So they shall not be taken out of the Fire nor shall they be asked to make amends (and thus please their Lord).

verses.text: So all praise be to Allah the Lord of the heavens the Lord of the earth the Lord of the whole Universe.
verses.translation: So all praise be to Allah the Lord of the heavens the Lord of the earth the Lord of the whole Universe.

verses.text: His is the glory in the heavens and the earth. He is the Most Mighty the Most Wise.
verses.translation: His is the glory in the heavens and the earth. He is the Most Mighty the Most Wise.

ayahs.text: Ha''. Mim.
ayahs.translation: Ha''. Mim.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Ha''. Mim.
verses.translation: Ha''. Mim.

verses.text: The revelation of this Book is from Allah the Most Mighty the Most Wise.
verses.translation: The revelation of this Book is from Allah the Most Mighty the Most Wise.

verses.text: We have created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in Truth and for an appointed term. But those who disbelieve have turned away from what they were warned against.
verses.translation: We have created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in Truth and for an appointed term. But those who disbelieve have turned away from what they were warned against.

verses.text: Tell them (O Prophet):  Did you consider those whom you call upon beside Allah? Show me which part of the earth they created? Or do they have any share in creating the heavens? Bring to me any Scripture earlier than this one or any vestige of knowledge (in support of your belief) if you are truthful.
verses.translation: Tell them (O Prophet):  Did you consider those whom you call upon beside Allah? Show me which part of the earth they created? Or do they have any share in creating the heavens? Bring to me any Scripture earlier than this one or any vestige of knowledge (in support of your belief) if you are truthful.

verses.text: Who is farther strayed from the Right Path than he who calls upon others than Allah that cannot answer his call till the Day of Resurrection the while they are not even conscious that callers are calling upon them?
verses.translation: Who is farther strayed from the Right Path than he who calls upon others than Allah that cannot answer his call till the Day of Resurrection the while they are not even conscious that callers are calling upon them?

verses.text: When all human beings will be gathered together those who had been called upon will become the enemies to their votaries and will disown their worship.
verses.translation: When all human beings will be gathered together those who had been called upon will become the enemies to their votaries and will disown their worship.

verses.text: When Our Clear Messages are rehearsed to them the unbelievers exclaim about the Truth when it came to them:  This is plain sorcery.
verses.translation: When Our Clear Messages are rehearsed to them the unbelievers exclaim about the Truth when it came to them:  This is plain sorcery.

verses.text: Do they claim that the Messenger himself has fabricated it? (If so) tell them:  If I have fabricated it then you have no power to protect me from Allah''s chastisement. He knows well the idle talk in which you indulge. He suffices as a witness between me and you. He is Most Forgiving Most Merciful.
verses.translation: Do they claim that the Messenger himself has fabricated it? (If so) tell them:  If I have fabricated it then you have no power to protect me from Allah''s chastisement. He knows well the idle talk in which you indulge. He suffices as a witness between me and you. He is Most Forgiving Most Merciful.

verses.text: Tell them:  I am not the first of the Messengers; and I do not know what shall be done with me or with you. I follow only what is revealed to me and I am nothing but a plain warner.
verses.translation: Tell them:  I am not the first of the Messengers; and I do not know what shall be done with me or with you. I follow only what is revealed to me and I am nothing but a plain warner.

verses.text: Tell them (O Prophet):  Did you consider (what would be your end) if this Qur''an were indeed from Allah and yet you rejected it? And this even though a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to the like of it. But he believed while you waxed arrogant. Verily Allah does not guide such wrong-doers to the Right Way.
verses.translation: Tell them (O Prophet):  Did you consider (what would be your end) if this Qur''an were indeed from Allah and yet you rejected it? And this even though a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to the like of it. But he believed while you waxed arrogant. Verily Allah does not guide such wrong-doers to the Right Way.

verses.text: The unbelievers say to the believers: If there was any good in this Book others would not have beaten us to its acceptance. But since they have not been guided to it they will certainly say:  This is an old fabrication.
verses.translation: The unbelievers say to the believers: If there was any good in this Book others would not have beaten us to its acceptance. But since they have not been guided to it they will certainly say:  This is an old fabrication.

verses.text: Yet before this the Book was revealed to Moses as a guide and a mercy. This Book which confirms it is in the Arabic tongue to warn the wrong-doers and to give good tidings to those who do good.
verses.translation: Yet before this the Book was revealed to Moses as a guide and a mercy. This Book which confirms it is in the Arabic tongue to warn the wrong-doers and to give good tidings to those who do good.

verses.text: Surely those who said:  Our Lord is Allah  and then remained steadfast shall have nothing to fear nor to grieve.
verses.translation: Surely those who said:  Our Lord is Allah  and then remained steadfast shall have nothing to fear nor to grieve.

verses.text: They are the people of Paradise. They shall remain in it forever as a reward for their deeds.
verses.translation: They are the people of Paradise. They shall remain in it forever as a reward for their deeds.

verses.text: We have enjoined man to be kind to his parents. In pain did his mother bear him and in pain did she give birth to him. The carrying of the child to his weaning is a period of thirty months. And when he is grown to full maturity and reaches the age of forty he prays:  My Lord dispose me that I may give thanks for the bounty that You have bestowed upon me and my parents and dispose me that I may do righteous deeds that would please You and also make my descendants righteous. I repent to You and I am one of those who surrender themselves to You.
verses.translation: We have enjoined man to be kind to his parents. In pain did his mother bear him and in pain did she give birth to him. The carrying of the child to his weaning is a period of thirty months. And when he is grown to full maturity and reaches the age of forty he prays:  My Lord dispose me that I may give thanks for the bounty that You have bestowed upon me and my parents and dispose me that I may do righteous deeds that would please You and also make my descendants righteous. I repent to You and I am one of those who surrender themselves to You.

verses.text: Such are those from whom We accept their best deeds and whose evil deeds We overlook. They will be among the people of Paradise in consonance with the true promise made to them.
verses.translation: Such are those from whom We accept their best deeds and whose evil deeds We overlook. They will be among the people of Paradise in consonance with the true promise made to them.

verses.text: But he who says to his parents:  Fie on you! Do you threaten me that I shall be resurrected although myriad generations have passed away before me (and not one of them was resurrected)?  The parents beseech Allah (and say to their child):  Woe to you have faith. Surely Allah''s promise is true.  But he says:  All this is nothing but fables of olden times.
verses.translation: But he who says to his parents:  Fie on you! Do you threaten me that I shall be resurrected although myriad generations have passed away before me (and not one of them was resurrected)?  The parents beseech Allah (and say to their child):  Woe to you have faith. Surely Allah''s promise is true.  But he says:  All this is nothing but fables of olden times.

verses.text: It is against such that Allah''s sentence (of punishment) has become due. They will join the communities of humans and jinn that have preceded them. Verily all of them will court utter loss.
verses.translation: It is against such that Allah''s sentence (of punishment) has become due. They will join the communities of humans and jinn that have preceded them. Verily all of them will court utter loss.

verses.text: Of these all have ranks according to their deeds so that Allah may fully recompense them for their deeds. They shall not be wronged.
verses.translation: Of these all have ranks according to their deeds so that Allah may fully recompense them for their deeds. They shall not be wronged.

verses.text: And on the Day when the unbelievers will be exposed to the Fire they will be told:  You have exhausted your share of the bounties in the life of the world and you took your fill of enjoyments. So degrading chastisement shall be yours on this Day for you waxed arrogant in the earth without justification and acted iniquitously.
verses.translation: And on the Day when the unbelievers will be exposed to the Fire they will be told:  You have exhausted your share of the bounties in the life of the world and you took your fill of enjoyments. So degrading chastisement shall be yours on this Day for you waxed arrogant in the earth without justification and acted iniquitously.

Verily I fear that the chastisement of an awesome day shall come upon you.

verses.translation: They said:  Have you come to us to turn us away from our gods? Then bring upon us the scourge that you threaten us with. Do so if you are truthful.

verses.text: So why did those whom they had set up as gods apart from Allah hoping that they would bring them nearer to Him not come to their aid? Instead they failed them. This was the end of the lie they had fabricated and the false beliefs they had invented.

When they reached the place (where you were reciting the Qur''an) they said to one another:  Be silent (and listen).  And when the recitation ended they went back to their people as warners.

verses.translation: They said:  Our people We have heard a Scripture revealed after Moses verifying the Scriptures revealed before it; it guides to the Truth and to the Straight Way.

verses.text: Our people respond to the call of him who calls you to Allah and believe in him. Allah will forgive your sins and will protect you from a grievous chastisement.
verses.translation: Our people respond to the call of him who calls you to Allah and believe in him. Allah will forgive your sins and will protect you from a grievous chastisement.

verses.text: And he who does not respond to the one who calls to Allah will not be able to frustrate Him on earth nor will they have anyone to protect them from Allah. Such people are in manifest error.
verses.translation: And he who does not respond to the one who calls to Allah will not be able to frustrate Him on earth nor will they have anyone to protect them from Allah. Such people are in manifest error.

verses.text: Do they not see that Allah Who created the heavens and the earth- and creating them did not wear Him out - has the power to bring the dead back to life? Why not! He certainly has the power over everything.
verses.translation: Do they not see that Allah Who created the heavens and the earth- and creating them did not wear Him out - has the power to bring the dead back to life? Why not! He certainly has the power over everything.

verses.text: On the Day when the unbelievers will be brought within sight of the Fire they will be asked:  Is this not the Truth?  and they will answer  Yes by Our Lord (this is the Truth).  Allah will say:  Then suffer the chastisement as a requital for your disbelieving.
verses.translation: On the Day when the unbelievers will be brought within sight of the Fire they will be asked:  Is this not the Truth?  and they will answer  Yes by Our Lord (this is the Truth).  Allah will say:  Then suffer the chastisement as a requital for your disbelieving.

verses.text: So bear with patience (O Prophet) even as the Messengers endowed with firmness of resolve (before you) bore with patience and do not be hasty in their regard. The Day when they see what they had been warned against they will feel as though they had remained in the world no more than an hour of a day. (The Truth has been conveyed.) Will any then suffer perdition except those who disobey?
verses.translation: So bear with patience (O Prophet) even as the Messengers endowed with firmness of resolve (before you) bore with patience and do not be hasty in their regard. Will any then suffer perdition except those who disobey?

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: Ha''. Mim.
ayahs.translation: Ha''. Mim.

ayahs.text: The revelation of this Book is from Allah the Most Mighty the Most Wise.
ayahs.translation: The revelation of this Book is from Allah the Most Mighty the Most Wise.

ayahs.text: We have created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in Truth and for an appointed term. But those who disbelieve have turned away from what they were warned against.
ayahs.translation: We have created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in Truth and for an appointed term. But those who disbelieve have turned away from what they were warned against.

ayahs.text: Tell them (O Prophet):  Did you consider those whom you call upon beside Allah? Show me which part of the earth they created? Or do they have any share in creating the heavens? Bring to me any Scripture earlier than this one or any vestige of knowledge (in support of your belief) if you are truthful.
ayahs.translation: Tell them (O Prophet):  Did you consider those whom you call upon beside Allah? Show me which part of the earth they created? Or do they have any share in creating the heavens? Bring to me any Scripture earlier than this one or any vestige of knowledge (in support of your belief) if you are truthful.

ayahs.text: Who is farther strayed from the Right Path than he who calls upon others than Allah that cannot answer his call till the Day of Resurrection the while they are not even conscious that callers are calling upon them?
ayahs.translation: Who is farther strayed from the Right Path than he who calls upon others than Allah that cannot answer his call till the Day of Resurrection the while they are not even conscious that callers are calling upon them?

ayahs.text: When all human beings will be gathered together those who had been called upon will become the enemies to their votaries and will disown their worship.
ayahs.translation: When all human beings will be gathered together those who had been called upon will become the enemies to their votaries and will disown their worship.

ayahs.text: When Our Clear Messages are rehearsed to them the unbelievers exclaim about the Truth when it came to them:  This is plain sorcery.
ayahs.translation: When Our Clear Messages are rehearsed to them the unbelievers exclaim about the Truth when it came to them:  This is plain sorcery.

ayahs.text: Do they claim that the Messenger himself has fabricated it? (If so) tell them:  If I have fabricated it then you have no power to protect me from Allah''s chastisement. He knows well the idle talk in which you indulge. He suffices as a witness between me and you. He is Most Forgiving Most Merciful.
ayahs.translation: Do they claim that the Messenger himself has fabricated it? (If so) tell them:  If I have fabricated it then you have no power to protect me from Allah''s chastisement. He knows well the idle talk in which you indulge. He suffices as a witness between me and you. He is Most Forgiving Most Merciful.

ayahs.text: Tell them:  I am not the first of the Messengers; and I do not know what shall be done with me or with you. I follow only what is revealed to me and I am nothing but a plain warner.
ayahs.translation: Tell them:  I am not the first of the Messengers; and I do not know what shall be done with me or with you. I follow only what is revealed to me and I am nothing but a plain warner.

ayahs.text: Tell them (O Prophet):  Did you consider (what would be your end) if this Qur''an were indeed from Allah and yet you rejected it? And this even though a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to the like of it. But he believed while you waxed arrogant. Verily Allah does not guide such wrong-doers to the Right Way.
ayahs.translation: Tell them (O Prophet):  Did you consider (what would be your end) if this Qur''an were indeed from Allah and yet you rejected it? And this even though a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to the like of it. But he believed while you waxed arrogant. Verily Allah does not guide such wrong-doers to the Right Way.

ayahs.text: The unbelievers say to the believers: If there was any good in this Book others would not have beaten us to its acceptance. But since they have not been guided to it they will certainly say:  This is an old fabrication.
ayahs.translation: The unbelievers say to the believers: If there was any good in this Book others would not have beaten us to its acceptance. But since they have not been guided to it they will certainly say:  This is an old fabrication.

ayahs.text: Yet before this the Book was revealed to Moses as a guide and a mercy. This Book which confirms it is in the Arabic tongue to warn the wrong-doers and to give good tidings to those who do good.
ayahs.translation: Yet before this the Book was revealed to Moses as a guide and a mercy. This Book which confirms it is in the Arabic tongue to warn the wrong-doers and to give good tidings to those who do good.

ayahs.text: Surely those who said:  Our Lord is Allah  and then remained steadfast shall have nothing to fear nor to grieve.
ayahs.translation: Surely those who said:  Our Lord is Allah  and then remained steadfast shall have nothing to fear nor to grieve.

ayahs.text: They are the people of Paradise. They shall remain in it forever as a reward for their deeds.
ayahs.translation: They are the people of Paradise. They shall remain in it forever as a reward for their deeds.

ayahs.text: We have enjoined man to be kind to his parents. In pain did his mother bear him and in pain did she give birth to him. The carrying of the child to his weaning is a period of thirty months. And when he is grown to full maturity and reaches the age of forty he prays:  My Lord dispose me that I may give thanks for the bounty that You have bestowed upon me and my parents and dispose me that I may do righteous deeds that would please You and also make my descendants righteous. I repent to You and I am one of those who surrender themselves to You.
ayahs.translation: We have enjoined man to be kind to his parents. In pain did his mother bear him and in pain did she give birth to him. The carrying of the child to his weaning is a period of thirty months. And when he is grown to full maturity and reaches the age of forty he prays:  My Lord dispose me that I may give thanks for the bounty that You have bestowed upon me and my parents and dispose me that I may do righteous deeds that would please You and also make my descendants righteous. I repent to You and I am one of those who surrender themselves to You.

ayahs.text: Such are those from whom We accept their best deeds and whose evil deeds We overlook. They will be among the people of Paradise in consonance with the true promise made to them.
ayahs.translation: Such are those from whom We accept their best deeds and whose evil deeds We overlook. They will be among the people of Paradise in consonance with the true promise made to them.

ayahs.text: But he who says to his parents:  Fie on you! Do you threaten me that I shall be resurrected although myriad generations have passed away before me (and not one of them was resurrected)?  The parents beseech Allah (and say to their child):  Woe to you have faith. Surely Allah''s promise is true.  But he says:  All this is nothing but fables of olden times.
