verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Allah has caused the works of those who disbelieve and hinder people from the way of Allah to go to waste.
verses.translation: Allah has caused the works of those who disbelieve and hinder people from the way of Allah to go to waste.

verses.text: As for those who attained to faith and did righteous works and believed in what was revealed to Muhammad - which indeed is the Truth from their Lord - Allah has remitted their evil deeds and has set their condition right.
verses.translation: As for those who attained to faith and did righteous works and believed in what was revealed to Muhammad - which indeed is the Truth from their Lord - Allah has remitted their evil deeds and has set their condition right.

verses.text: That is because those who disbelieved followed falsehood whereas those who believed followed the Truth that came to them from their Lord. Thus does Allah set forth to people parables showing their true state.
verses.translation: That is because those who disbelieved followed falsehood whereas those who believed followed the Truth that came to them from their Lord. Thus does Allah set forth to people parables showing their true state.

verses.text: When you meet the unbelievers (in battle) smite their necks until you have crushed them then bind your captives firmly; thereafter (you are entitled to) set them free either by an act of grace or against ransom until the war ends. That is for you to do. If Allah had so willed He would have Himself exacted retribution from them. (But He did not do so) that He may test some of you by means of others. As for those who are slain in the way of Allah He shall never let their works go to waste.
verses.translation: When you meet the unbelievers (in battle) smite their necks until you have crushed them then bind your captives firmly; thereafter (you are entitled to) set them free either by an act of grace or against ransom until the war ends. That is for you to do. If Allah had so willed He would have Himself exacted retribution from them. (But He did not do so) that He may test some of you by means of others. As for those who are slain in the way of Allah He shall never let their works go to waste.

verses.text: He will guide them and set their condition right
verses.translation: He will guide them and set their condition right

verses.text: and will admit them to Paradise with which He has acquainted them.
verses.translation: and will admit them to Paradise with which He has acquainted them.

verses.text: Believers if you aid Allah He will come to your aid and will plant your feet firmly.
verses.translation: Believers if you aid Allah He will come to your aid and will plant your feet firmly.

verses.text: As to those who disbelieve perdition lies in store for them and Allah has reduced their works to nought.
verses.translation: As to those who disbelieve perdition lies in store for them and Allah has reduced their works to nought.

verses.text: That was because they were averse to what Allah had revealed; so He let their works go to waste.
verses.translation: That was because they were averse to what Allah had revealed; so He let their works go to waste.

verses.text: Have they not journeyed through the land to see the end of those who went before them? Allah utterly destroyed them. These unbelievers are doomed to the same end.
verses.translation: Have they not journeyed through the land to see the end of those who went before them? Allah utterly destroyed them. These unbelievers are doomed to the same end.

verses.text: That is because Allah is the Protector of the believers whereas the unbelievers have none to protect them.
verses.translation: That is because Allah is the Protector of the believers whereas the unbelievers have none to protect them.

verses.text: Allah shall admit those who believe and do righteous works to the Gardens beneath which rivers flow. As for the unbelievers they enjoy the pleasures of this transient life and eat as cattle eat. The Fire shall be their resort.
verses.translation: Allah shall admit those who believe and do righteous works to the Gardens beneath which rivers flow. As for the unbelievers they enjoy the pleasures of this transient life and eat as cattle eat. The Fire shall be their resort.

verses.text: (O Prophet) how many are the cities that had greater power than your city that drove you out? We destroyed them and there was none to protect them.
verses.translation: (O Prophet) how many are the cities that had greater power than your city that drove you out? We destroyed them and there was none to protect them.

verses.text: Then can he who is on a Clear Guidance from His Lord be like him whose evil deeds have been embellished to him and who pursued their lusts?
verses.translation: Then can he who is on a Clear Guidance from His Lord be like him whose evil deeds have been embellished to him and who pursued their lusts?

verses.text: Here is the parable of Paradise which the God-fearing have been promised: in it shall be rivers of incorruptible water rivers of milk unchanging in taste and rivers of wine a delight to those that drink; and rivers of pure honey. In it they will have every kind of fruit as well as forgiveness from their Lord. Can such be like those who will abide in the Fire and will be given a boiling water to drink that will tear their bowels apart?
verses.translation: Here is the parable of Paradise which the God-fearing have been promised: in it shall be rivers of incorruptible water rivers of milk unchanging in taste and rivers of wine a delight to those that drink; and rivers of pure honey. In it they will have every kind of fruit as well as forgiveness from their Lord. Can such be like those who will abide in the Fire and will be given a boiling water to drink that will tear their bowels apart?

verses.text: Among them some give ear to you. But no sooner do they leave your presence than they ask those endowed with knowledge:  What is it that he said just now? Such are those whose hearts Allah has sealed and who pursue their lusts.
verses.translation: Among them some give ear to you. But no sooner do they leave your presence than they ask those endowed with knowledge:  What is it that he said just now? Such are those whose hearts Allah has sealed and who pursue their lusts.

verses.text: As for those who were led to the Guidance Allah increases them in their guidance and causes them to grow in God-fearing.
verses.translation: As for those who were led to the Guidance Allah increases them in their guidance and causes them to grow in God-fearing.

verses.text: Are they waiting then for anything else than the Last Hour to suddenly come upon them? Already some of its tokens have come. But when it does actually come upon them where will any time be left for them to take heed?
verses.translation: Are they waiting then for anything else than the Last Hour to suddenly come upon them? Already some of its tokens have come. But when it does actually come upon them where will any time be left for them to take heed?

verses.text: Know therefore (O Prophet) that there is no god but Allah and ask forgiveness for your shortcomings and also for (the shortcomings of) believing men and believing women. Allah knows the places where you move about and where you dwell.
verses.translation: Know therefore (O Prophet) that there is no god but Allah and ask forgiveness for your shortcomings and also for (the shortcomings of) believing men and believing women. Allah knows the places where you move about and where you dwell.

verses.text: The believers used to say:  Why is a surah (that would ordain fighting) not revealed?  But when a definitive surah was revealed wherein fighting was mentioned you saw that those in whose hearts there was a sickness looked at you as though they were about to faint at the approach of death. Pity on them!
verses.translation: The believers used to say:  Why is a surah (that would ordain fighting) not revealed?  But when a definitive surah was revealed wherein fighting was mentioned you saw that those in whose hearts there was a sickness looked at you as though they were about to faint at the approach of death. Pity on them!

verses.text: (They keep affirming their) obedience and saying good words. But when a course of action was clearly determined it would have been better for them if they had proved true to Allah.
verses.translation: (They keep affirming their) obedience and saying good words. But when a course of action was clearly determined it would have been better for them if they had proved true to Allah.

verses.text: Now if you were to turn away what else can be expected but that you will work corruption in the land and fly at each other''s throats?
verses.translation: Now if you were to turn away what else can be expected but that you will work corruption in the land and fly at each other''s throats?

verses.text: It is these upon whom Allah has laid His curse: so He made them deaf and deprived them of their sight.
verses.translation: It is these upon whom Allah has laid His curse: so He made them deaf and deprived them of their sight.

verses.text: Do they then not reflect on the Qur''an? Or are there locks on their hearts?
verses.translation: Do they then not reflect on the Qur''an? Or are there locks on their hearts?

verses.text: Certainly those who have turned their backs on the True Guidance after it became manifest to them Satan has embellished their ways for them and has buoyed them up with false hopes.
verses.translation: Certainly those who have turned their backs on the True Guidance after it became manifest to them Satan has embellished their ways for them and has buoyed them up with false hopes.

verses.text: This because they said to those who are averse to the faith that Allah has revealed:  In some matters we shall obey you. Allah has full knowledge of their secret parleys.
verses.translation: This because they said to those who are averse to the faith that Allah has revealed:  In some matters we shall obey you. Allah has full knowledge of their secret parleys.

verses.text: But how will they fare when angels will take their souls at death and will carry them striking their faces and backs?
verses.translation: But how will they fare when angels will take their souls at death and will carry them striking their faces and backs?

verses.text: That is because they have followed a way that angered Allah and have been averse to His good pleasure. So He reduced all their works to nought.
verses.translation: That is because they have followed a way that angered Allah and have been averse to His good pleasure. So He reduced all their works to nought.

verses.text: Or do they in whose hearts there is a sickness believe that Allah will not bring their failings to light?
verses.translation: Or do they in whose hearts there is a sickness believe that Allah will not bring their failings to light?

verses.text: If We were to so will We could have shown them to you so that you would recognise them by their faces and you would certainly know them by the manner of their speech. Allah knows all your deeds.
verses.translation: If We were to so will We could have shown them to you so that you would recognise them by their faces and you would certainly know them by the manner of their speech. Allah knows all your deeds.

verses.text: We shall certainly test you until We know those of you who truly strive and remain steadfast and will ascertain about you.
verses.translation: We shall certainly test you until We know those of you who truly strive and remain steadfast and will ascertain about you.

verses.text: Those who disbelieved and barred others from Allah''s Way and opposed the Messenger after the True Guidance had become manifest to them they shall not be able to cause Allah the least harm; rather Allah will reduce all their works to nought.
verses.translation: Those who disbelieved and barred others from Allah''s Way and opposed the Messenger after the True Guidance had become manifest to them they shall not be able to cause Allah the least harm; rather Allah will reduce all their works to nought.

verses.text: Believers obey Allah and obey the Messenger and do not cause your works to be nullified.
verses.translation: Believers obey Allah and obey the Messenger and do not cause your works to be nullified.

verses.text: Verily Allah shall not forgive those who disbelieved and barred others from Allah''s Way and clung to their unbelief until their death.
verses.translation: Verily Allah shall not forgive those who disbelieved and barred others from Allah''s Way and clung to their unbelief until their death.

verses.text: So be not faint-hearted and do not cry for peace. You shall prevail. Allah is with you and will not bring your works to nought.
verses.translation: So be not faint-hearted and do not cry for peace. You shall prevail. Allah is with you and will not bring your works to nought.

verses.text: The life of this world is but sport and amusement. If you believe and are God-fearing He will grant you your reward and will not ask you for your possessions.
verses.translation: The life of this world is but sport and amusement. If you believe and are God-fearing He will grant you your reward and will not ask you for your possessions.

verses.text: If He were to ask you for your possessions and press you (in that regard) you would have grown niggardly and Allah would have brought your failings to light.
verses.translation: If He were to ask you for your possessions and press you (in that regard) you would have grown niggardly and Allah would have brought your failings to light.

verses.text: Behold you are those who are called upon to spend in Allah''s Way but some of you are niggardly. Whoever is niggardly is in fact niggardly to himself. For Allah is All-Sufficient whereas it is you who are in need of Him. If you turn away He will replace you by a people other than you and they will not be like you.
verses.translation: Behold you are those who are called upon to spend in Allah''s Way but some of you are niggardly. Whoever is niggardly is in fact niggardly to himself. For Allah is All-Sufficient whereas it is you who are in need of Him. If you turn away He will replace you by a people other than you and they will not be like you.

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: Allah has caused the works of those who disbelieve and hinder people from the way of Allah to go to waste.
ayahs.translation: Allah has caused the works of those who disbelieve and hinder people from the way of Allah to go to waste.

ayahs.text: As for those who attained to faith and did righteous works and believed in what was revealed to Muhammad - which indeed is the Truth from their Lord - Allah has remitted their evil deeds and has set their condition right.
ayahs.translation: As for those who attained to faith and did righteous works and believed in what was revealed to Muhammad - which indeed is the Truth from their Lord - Allah has remitted their evil deeds and has set their condition right.

ayahs.text: That is because those who disbelieved followed falsehood whereas those who believed followed the Truth that came to them from their Lord. Thus does Allah set forth to people parables showing their true state.
ayahs.translation: That is because those who disbelieved followed falsehood whereas those who believed followed the Truth that came to them from their Lord. Thus does Allah set forth to people parables showing their true state.

ayahs.text: When you meet the unbelievers (in battle) smite their necks until you have crushed them then bind your captives firmly; thereafter (you are entitled to) set them free either by an act of grace or against ransom until the war ends. That is for you to do. If Allah had so willed He would have Himself exacted retribution from them. (But He did not do so) that He may test some of you by means of others. As for those who are slain in the way of Allah He shall never let their works go to waste.
ayahs.translation: When you meet the unbelievers (in battle) smite their necks until you have crushed them then bind your captives firmly; thereafter (you are entitled to) set them free either by an act of grace or against ransom until the war ends. That is for you to do. If Allah had so willed He would have Himself exacted retribution from them. (But He did not do so) that He may test some of you by means of others. As for those who are slain in the way of Allah He shall never let their works go to waste.

ayahs.text: He will guide them and set their condition right
ayahs.translation: He will guide them and set their condition right

ayahs.text: and will admit them to Paradise with which He has acquainted them.
ayahs.translation: and will admit them to Paradise with which He has acquainted them.

ayahs.text: Believers if you aid Allah He will come to your aid and will plant your feet firmly.
ayahs.translation: Believers if you aid Allah He will come to your aid and will plant your feet firmly.

ayahs.text: As to those who disbelieve perdition lies in store for them and Allah has reduced their works to nought.
ayahs.translation: As to those who disbelieve perdition lies in store for them and Allah has reduced their works to nought.

ayahs.text: That was because they were averse to what Allah had revealed; so He let their works go to waste.
ayahs.translation: That was because they were averse to what Allah had revealed; so He let their works go to waste.

ayahs.text: Have they not journeyed through the land to see the end of those who went before them? Allah utterly destroyed them. These unbelievers are doomed to the same end.
ayahs.translation: Have they not journeyed through the land to see the end of those who went before them? Allah utterly destroyed them. These unbelievers are doomed to the same end.

ayahs.text: That is because Allah is the Protector of the believers whereas the unbelievers have none to protect them.
ayahs.translation: That is because Allah is the Protector of the believers whereas the unbelievers have none to protect them.

ayahs.text: Allah shall admit those who believe and do righteous works to the Gardens beneath which rivers flow. As for the unbelievers they enjoy the pleasures of this transient life and eat as cattle eat. The Fire shall be their resort.
ayahs.translation: Allah shall admit those who believe and do righteous works to the Gardens beneath which rivers flow. As for the unbelievers they enjoy the pleasures of this transient life and eat as cattle eat. The Fire shall be their resort.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) how many are the cities that had greater power than your city that drove you out? We destroyed them and there was none to protect them.
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) how many are the cities that had greater power than your city that drove you out? We destroyed them and there was none to protect them.

ayahs.text: Then can he who is on a Clear Guidance from His Lord be like him whose evil deeds have been embellished to him and who pursued their lusts?
ayahs.translation: Then can he who is on a Clear Guidance from His Lord be like him whose evil deeds have been embellished to him and who pursued their lusts?

ayahs.text: Here is the parable of Paradise which the God-fearing have been promised: in it shall be rivers of incorruptible water rivers of milk unchanging in taste and rivers of wine a delight to those that drink; and rivers of pure honey. In it they will have every kind of fruit as well as forgiveness from their Lord. Can such be like those who will abide in the Fire and will be given a boiling water to drink that will tear their bowels apart?
ayahs.translation: Here is the parable of Paradise which the God-fearing have been promised: in it shall be rivers of incorruptible water rivers of milk unchanging in taste and rivers of wine a delight to those that drink; and rivers of pure honey. In it they will have every kind of fruit as well as forgiveness from their Lord. Can such be like those who will abide in the Fire and will be given a boiling water to drink that will tear their bowels apart?

ayahs.text: Among them some give ear to you. But no sooner do they leave your presence than they ask those endowed with knowledge:  What is it that he said just now? Such are those whose hearts Allah has sealed and who pursue their lusts.
ayahs.translation: Among them some give ear to you. But no sooner do they leave your presence than they ask those endowed with knowledge:  What is it that he said just now? Such are those whose hearts Allah has sealed and who pursue their lusts.

ayahs.text: As for those who were led to the Guidance Allah increases them in their guidance and causes them to grow in God-fearing.
ayahs.translation: As for those who were led to the Guidance Allah increases them in their guidance and causes them to grow in God-fearing.

ayahs.text: Are they waiting then for anything else than the Last Hour to suddenly come upon them? Already some of its tokens have come. But when it does actually come upon them where will any time be left for them to take heed?
ayahs.translation: Are they waiting then for anything else than the Last Hour to suddenly come upon them? Already some of its tokens have come. But when it does actually come upon them where will any time be left for them to take heed?

ayahs.text: Know therefore (O Prophet) that there is no god but Allah and ask forgiveness for your shortcomings and also for (the shortcomings of) believing men and believing women. Allah knows the places where you move about and where you dwell.
ayahs.translation: Know therefore (O Prophet) that there is no god but Allah and ask forgiveness for your shortcomings and also for (the shortcomings of) believing men and believing women. Allah knows the places where you move about and where you dwell.

ayahs.text: The believers used to say:  Why is a surah (that would ordain fighting) not revealed?  But when a definitive surah was revealed wherein fighting was mentioned you saw that those in whose hearts there was a sickness looked at you as though they were about to faint at the approach of death. Pity on them!
ayahs.translation: The believers used to say:  Why is a surah (that would ordain fighting) not revealed?  But when a definitive surah was revealed wherein fighting was mentioned you saw that those in whose hearts there was a sickness looked at you as though they were about to faint at the approach of death. Pity on them!

ayahs.text: (They keep affirming their) obedience and saying good words. But when a course of action was clearly determined it would have been better for them if they had proved true to Allah.
ayahs.translation: (They keep affirming their) obedience and saying good words. But when a course of action was clearly determined it would have been better for them if they had proved true to Allah.

ayahs.text: Now if you were to turn away what else can be expected but that you will work corruption in the land and fly at each other''s throats?
ayahs.translation: Now if you were to turn away what else can be expected but that you will work corruption in the land and fly at each other''s throats?

ayahs.text: It is these upon whom Allah has laid His curse: so He made them deaf and deprived them of their sight.
ayahs.translation: It is these upon whom Allah has laid His curse: so He made them deaf and deprived them of their sight.

ayahs.text: Do they then not reflect on the Qur''an? Or are there locks on their hearts?
ayahs.translation: Do they then not reflect on the Qur''an? Or are there locks on their hearts?

ayahs.text: Certainly those who have turned their backs on the True Guidance after it became manifest to them Satan has embellished their ways for them and has buoyed them up with false hopes.
ayahs.translation: Certainly those who have turned their backs on the True Guidance after it became manifest to them Satan has embellished their ways for them and has buoyed them up with false hopes.

ayahs.text: This because they said to those who are averse to the faith that Allah has revealed:  In some matters we shall obey you. Allah has full knowledge of their secret parleys.
ayahs.translation: This because they said to those who are averse to the faith that Allah has revealed:  In some matters we shall obey you. Allah has full knowledge of their secret parleys.

ayahs.text: But how will they fare when angels will take their souls at death and will carry them striking their faces and backs?
ayahs.translation: But how will they fare when angels will take their souls at death and will carry them striking their faces and backs?

ayahs.text: That is because they have followed a way that angered Allah and have been averse to His good pleasure. So He reduced all their works to nought.
ayahs.translation: That is because they have followed a way that angered Allah and have been averse to His good pleasure. So He reduced all their works to nought.

ayahs.text: Or do they in whose hearts there is a sickness believe that Allah will not bring their failings to light?
ayahs.translation: Or do they in whose hearts there is a sickness believe that Allah will not bring their failings to light?

ayahs.text: If We were to so will We could have shown them to you so that you would recognise them by their faces and you would certainly know them by the manner of their speech. Allah knows all your deeds.
ayahs.translation: If We were to so will We could have shown them to you so that you would recognise them by their faces and you would certainly know them by the manner of their speech. Allah knows all your deeds.

ayahs.text: We shall certainly test you until We know those of you who truly strive and remain steadfast and will ascertain about you.
ayahs.translation: We shall certainly test you until We know those of you who truly strive and remain steadfast and will ascertain about you.

ayahs.text: Those who disbelieved and barred others from Allah''s Way and opposed the Messenger after the True Guidance had become manifest to them they shall not be able to cause Allah the least harm; rather Allah will reduce all their works to nought.
ayahs.translation: Those who disbelieved and barred others from Allah''s Way and opposed the Messenger after the True Guidance had become manifest to them they shall not be able to cause Allah the least harm; rather Allah will reduce all their works to nought.

ayahs.text: Believers obey Allah and obey the Messenger and do not cause your works to be nullified.
ayahs.translation: Believers obey Allah and obey the Messenger and do not cause your works to be nullified.

ayahs.text: Verily Allah shall not forgive those who disbelieved and barred others from Allah''s Way and clung to their unbelief until their death.
ayahs.translation: Verily Allah shall not forgive those who disbelieved and barred others from Allah''s Way and clung to their unbelief until their death.

ayahs.text: So be not faint-hearted and do not cry for peace. You shall prevail. Allah is with you and will not bring your works to nought.
ayahs.translation: So be not faint-hearted and do not cry for peace. You shall prevail. Allah is with you and will not bring your works to nought.

ayahs.text: The life of this world is but sport and amusement. If you believe and are God-fearing He will grant you your reward and will not ask you for your possessions.
ayahs.translation: The life of this world is but sport and amusement. If you believe and are God-fearing He will grant you your reward and will not ask you for your possessions.

ayahs.text: If He were to ask you for your possessions and press you (in that regard) you would have grown niggardly and Allah would have brought your failings to light.
ayahs.translation: If He were to ask you for your possessions and press you (in that regard) you would have grown niggardly and Allah would have brought your failings to light.

ayahs.text: Behold you are those who are called upon to spend in Allah''s Way but some of you are niggardly. Whoever is niggardly is in fact niggardly to himself. For Allah is All-Sufficient whereas it is you who are in need of Him. If you turn away He will replace you by a people other than you and they will not be like you.
ayahs.translation: Behold you are those who are called upon to spend in Allah''s Way but some of you are niggardly. Whoever is niggardly is in fact niggardly to himself. For Allah is All-Sufficient whereas it is you who are in need of Him. If you turn away He will replace you by a people other than you and they will not be like you.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: (O Prophet) surely We have granted you a clear victory
verses.translation: (O Prophet) surely We have granted you a clear victory

verses.text: so that Allah may forgive you your shortcomings whether earlier or later and may complete His favours upon you and guide you to the Straight Way
verses.translation: so that Allah may forgive you your shortcomings whether earlier or later and may complete His favours upon you and guide you to the Straight Way

verses.text: and that Allah may bestow upon you a mighty help.
verses.translation: and that Allah may bestow upon you a mighty help.

verses.text: He it is Who bestowed inner peace on the hearts of the believers so that they may grow yet more firm in their faith. To Allah belong the legions of the heavens and the earth; Allah is All-Knowing Most Wise.
verses.translation: He it is Who bestowed inner peace on the hearts of the believers so that they may grow yet more firm in their faith. To Allah belong the legions of the heavens and the earth; Allah is All-Knowing Most Wise.

verses.text: (He did this) to admit the believers both men and women to Gardens beneath which rivers flow wherein they shall abide and to efface their evil deeds from them. That in Allah''s sight is the supreme triumph.
verses.translation: (He did this) to admit the believers both men and women to Gardens beneath which rivers flow wherein they shall abide and to efface their evil deeds from them. That in Allah''s sight is the supreme triumph.

verses.text: (He also did this) to chastise the hypocrites both men and women and those who associate others in His Divinity both men and women and who harbour evil thoughts about Allah. They shall be afflicted with misfortune Allah is wroth with them. He has laid His curse upon them and has prepared for them Hell. What an evil end!
verses.translation: (He also did this) to chastise the hypocrites both men and women and those who associate others in His Divinity both men and women and who harbour evil thoughts about Allah. They shall be afflicted with misfortune Allah is wroth with them. He has laid His curse upon them and has prepared for them Hell. What an evil end!

verses.text: To Allah belong the legions of the heavens and the earth. Allah is Most Mighty Most Wise.
verses.translation: To Allah belong the legions of the heavens and the earth. Allah is Most Mighty Most Wise.

verses.text: (O Prophet) We have sent you forth as a witness as a bearer of good news and as a warner
verses.translation: (O Prophet) We have sent you forth as a witness as a bearer of good news and as a warner

verses.text: so that (all of) you may all believe in Allah and His Messenger and support him and revere him and celebrate Allah''s glory morning and evening.
verses.translation: so that (all of) you may all believe in Allah and His Messenger and support him and revere him and celebrate Allah''s glory morning and evening.

verses.text: Those who swore fealty to you (O Prophet) in fact swore fealty to Allah. The Hand of Allah is above their hands. So whoever breaks his covenant breaks it to his own hurt; and whoever fulfils the covenant that he made with Allah He will bestow on him a great reward.
verses.translation: Those who swore fealty to you (O Prophet) in fact swore fealty to Allah. The Hand of Allah is above their hands. So whoever breaks his covenant breaks it to his own hurt; and whoever fulfils the covenant that he made with Allah He will bestow on him a great reward.

verses.text: (O Prophet) the bedouins who were left behind say to you: We were occupied with our goods and families. So ask forgiveness for us.  They say with their tongues what is not in their hearts. Say to them:  Who can be of any avail to you against Allah if He should intend to cause you any harm or confer upon you any benefit?  Allah is well aware of all that you do.
verses.translation: (O Prophet) the bedouins who were left behind say to you: We were occupied with our goods and families. So ask forgiveness for us.  They say with their tongues what is not in their hearts. Say to them:  Who can be of any avail to you against Allah if He should intend to cause you any harm or confer upon you any benefit?  Allah is well aware of all that you do.

verses.text: (But the truth is not what you say.) You had imagined that the Messenger and the believers would never return to their families and this notion was embellished in your hearts. You harboured an evil thought and you are an immensely evil people.
verses.translation: (But the truth is not what you say.) You had imagined that the Messenger and the believers would never return to their families and this notion was embellished in your hearts. You harboured an evil thought and you are an immensely evil people.

verses.text: As for those who do not believe in Allah and His Messenger for such unbelievers We have prepared a Blazing Fire.
verses.translation: As for those who do not believe in Allah and His Messenger for such unbelievers We have prepared a Blazing Fire.

verses.text: To Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whom He pleases and chastises whom He pleases. He is Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.
verses.translation: To Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whom He pleases and chastises whom He pleases. He is Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.

verses.text: When you press forth for the spoils those who were left behind will say:  Let us accompany you. They want to change the command of Allah. Say to them (in clear words):  You shall not accompany us. Thus has Allah already said. Then they will say:  Nay; but you are jealous of us.  The truth is that they understand little.
verses.translation: When you press forth for the spoils those who were left behind will say:  Let us accompany you. They want to change the command of Allah. Say to them (in clear words):  You shall not accompany us. Thus has Allah already said. Then they will say:  Nay; but you are jealous of us.  The truth is that they understand little.

verses.text: Say to the bedouins who were left behind:  You will be called against those who possess great might and be asked to fight against them unless they surrender. If you obey (the command to fight) Allah will bestow upon you a goodly reward. But if you turn away as you turned away before He shall inflict upon you a grievous chastisement.
verses.translation: Say to the bedouins who were left behind:  You will be called against those who possess great might and be asked to fight against them unless they surrender. If you obey (the command to fight) Allah will bestow upon you a goodly reward. But if you turn away as you turned away before He shall inflict upon you a grievous chastisement.

verses.text: There is no blame on the blind nor on the lame nor on the sick (if they do not go forth to fight). Allah will admit those who obey Allah and His Messenger to the Gardens beneath which rivers flow and will inflict a grievous chastisement on those who turn away.
verses.translation: There is no blame on the blind nor on the lame nor on the sick (if they do not go forth to fight). Allah will admit those who obey Allah and His Messenger to the Gardens beneath which rivers flow and will inflict a grievous chastisement on those who turn away.

verses.text: Allah was much pleased with the believers when they swore fealty to you under the tree. He knew what was in their hearts. So He bestowed inner peace upon them and rewarded them with a victory near at hand
verses.translation: Allah was much pleased with the believers when they swore fealty to you under the tree. He knew what was in their hearts. So He bestowed inner peace upon them and rewarded them with a victory near at hand

verses.text: and with abundant spoils which they shall acquire. Allah is Most Mighty Most Wise.
verses.translation: and with abundant spoils which they shall acquire. Allah is Most Mighty Most Wise.

verses.text: Allah has promised you abundant spoils which you shall acquire. He has instantly granted you this (victory) and has restrained the hands of people from you that it may be a Sign for the believers and He may guide you to a Straight Way.
verses.translation: Allah has promised you abundant spoils which you shall acquire. He has instantly granted you this (victory) and has restrained the hands of people from you that it may be a Sign for the believers and He may guide you to a Straight Way.

verses.text: He also promises you other spoils which you have not yet taken but Allah has encompassed them. Allah has power over everything.
verses.translation: He also promises you other spoils which you have not yet taken but Allah has encompassed them. Allah has power over everything.

verses.text: Had the unbelievers fought against you at that time they would have turned their backs (in flight) and would have found none to protect or help them.
verses.translation: Had the unbelievers fought against you at that time they would have turned their backs (in flight) and would have found none to protect or help them.

verses.text: Such is Allah''s Way that has come down from the past. Never shall you find any change in the Way of Allah.
verses.translation: Such is Allah''s Way that has come down from the past. Never shall you find any change in the Way of Allah.

verses.text: He it is Who restrained their hands from you and your hands from them in the valley of Makkah even though He had made you victorious against them. Allah was watching all that you did.
verses.translation: He it is Who restrained their hands from you and your hands from them in the valley of Makkah even though He had made you victorious against them. Allah was watching all that you did.

verses.text: They are the ones who disbelieved and barred you from the Inviolable Mosque and prevented the animals you had designated for sacrifice from reaching the place of their offering. If it had not been for the believing men and believing women (who lived in Makkah and) whom you did not know and had there not been the fear that you might trample on them and unwittingly incur blame on their account (then fighting would not have been put to a stop. It was stopped so that) Allah may admit to His Mercy whomsoever He pleases. Had those believers been separated from the rest We would certainly have inflicted a grievous chastisement on those of them [i.e. the Makkans) who disbelieved.
verses.translation: They are the ones who disbelieved and barred you from the Inviolable Mosque and prevented the animals you had designated for sacrifice from reaching the place of their offering. If it had not been for the believing men and believing women (who lived in Makkah and) whom you did not know and had there not been the fear that you might trample on them and unwittingly incur blame on their account (then fighting would not have been put to a stop. It was stopped so that) Allah may admit to His Mercy whomsoever He pleases. Had those believers been separated from the rest We would certainly have inflicted a grievous chastisement on those of them [i.e. the Makkans) who disbelieved.

verses.text: (This is why) when the unbelievers set in their hearts a fierce bigotry - the bigotry of ignorance - Allah bestowed inner peace upon His Messenger and upon the believers and made the word of piety binding on them. They were more deserving and worthier thereof. Allah has knowledge of everything.
verses.translation: (This is why) when the unbelievers set in their hearts a fierce bigotry - the bigotry of ignorance - Allah bestowed inner peace upon His Messenger and upon the believers and made the word of piety binding on them. They were more deserving and worthier thereof. Allah has knowledge of everything.

verses.text: Allah indeed showed His Messenger the true vision one fully in accord with reality. If Allah so wills you shall certainly enter the Inviolable Mosque in full security you will shave your heads and cut your hair short and do so without any fear. He knew what you did not know and He granted you a victory near at hand even before (the fulfilment of the vision).
verses.translation: Allah indeed showed His Messenger the true vision one fully in accord with reality. If Allah so wills you shall certainly enter the Inviolable Mosque in full security you will shave your heads and cut your hair short and do so without any fear. He knew what you did not know and He granted you a victory near at hand even before (the fulfilment of the vision).

verses.text: He it is Who sent His Messenger with the True Guidance and the Religion of Truth that He may make it prevail over every religion. Sufficient is Allah as a witness (to this).
verses.translation: He it is Who sent His Messenger with the True Guidance and the Religion of Truth that He may make it prevail over every religion. Sufficient is Allah as a witness (to this).

verses.text: Muhammad is Allah''s Messenger and those who are with him are firm with the unbelievers but compassionate with one another. You see them occupied in bowing and prostrating and in seeking Allah''s bounty and good pleasure. They are distinguished from others by the marks of prostration on their faces. Thus are they described in the Torah.And their parable in the Gospel is that of a tilth that puts forth its shoot then strengthens it so that it becomes stout and stands firmly on its stem. This is a sight pleasing to the sowers and one by which the unbelievers will be enraged. As for those who believe and do righteous deeds Allah has promised them forgiveness and a great reward.
verses.translation: Muhammad is Allah''s Messenger and those who are with him are firm with the unbelievers but compassionate with one another. You see them occupied in bowing and prostrating and in seeking Allah''s bounty and good pleasure. They are distinguished from others by the marks of prostration on their faces. Thus are they described in the Torah.And their parable in the Gospel is that of a tilth that puts forth its shoot then strengthens it so that it becomes stout and stands firmly on its stem. This is a sight pleasing to the sowers and one by which the unbelievers will be enraged. As for those who believe and do righteous deeds Allah has promised them forgiveness and a great reward.

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) surely We have granted you a clear victory
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) surely We have granted you a clear victory

ayahs.text: so that Allah may forgive you your shortcomings whether earlier or later and may complete His favours upon you and guide you to the Straight Way
ayahs.translation: so that Allah may forgive you your shortcomings whether earlier or later and may complete His favours upon you and guide you to the Straight Way

ayahs.text: and that Allah may bestow upon you a mighty help.
ayahs.translation: and that Allah may bestow upon you a mighty help.

ayahs.text: He it is Who bestowed inner peace on the hearts of the believers so that they may grow yet more firm in their faith. To Allah belong the legions of the heavens and the earth; Allah is All-Knowing Most Wise.
ayahs.translation: He it is Who bestowed inner peace on the hearts of the believers so that they may grow yet more firm in their faith. To Allah belong the legions of the heavens and the earth; Allah is All-Knowing Most Wise.

ayahs.text: (He did this) to admit the believers both men and women to Gardens beneath which rivers flow wherein they shall abide and to efface their evil deeds from them. That in Allah''s sight is the supreme triumph.
ayahs.translation: (He did this) to admit the believers both men and women to Gardens beneath which rivers flow wherein they shall abide and to efface their evil deeds from them. That in Allah''s sight is the supreme triumph.

ayahs.text: (He also did this) to chastise the hypocrites both men and women and those who associate others in His Divinity both men and women and who harbour evil thoughts about Allah. They shall be afflicted with misfortune Allah is wroth with them. He has laid His curse upon them and has prepared for them Hell. What an evil end!
ayahs.translation: (He also did this) to chastise the hypocrites both men and women and those who associate others in His Divinity both men and women and who harbour evil thoughts about Allah. They shall be afflicted with misfortune Allah is wroth with them. He has laid His curse upon them and has prepared for them Hell. What an evil end!

ayahs.text: To Allah belong the legions of the heavens and the earth. Allah is Most Mighty Most Wise.
ayahs.translation: To Allah belong the legions of the heavens and the earth. Allah is Most Mighty Most Wise.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) We have sent you forth as a witness as a bearer of good news and as a warner
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) We have sent you forth as a witness as a bearer of good news and as a warner

ayahs.text: so that (all of) you may all believe in Allah and His Messenger and support him and revere him and celebrate Allah''s glory morning and evening.
ayahs.translation: so that (all of) you may all believe in Allah and His Messenger and support him and revere him and celebrate Allah''s glory morning and evening.

ayahs.text: Those who swore fealty to you (O Prophet) in fact swore fealty to Allah. The Hand of Allah is above their hands. So whoever breaks his covenant breaks it to his own hurt; and whoever fulfils the covenant that he made with Allah He will bestow on him a great reward.
ayahs.translation: Those who swore fealty to you (O Prophet) in fact swore fealty to Allah. The Hand of Allah is above their hands. So whoever breaks his covenant breaks it to his own hurt; and whoever fulfils the covenant that he made with Allah He will bestow on him a great reward.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) the bedouins who were left behind say to you: We were occupied with our goods and families. So ask forgiveness for us.  They say with their tongues what is not in their hearts. Say to them:  Who can be of any avail to you against Allah if He should intend to cause you any harm or confer upon you any benefit?  Allah is well aware of all that you do.
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) the bedouins who were left behind say to you: We were occupied with our goods and families. So ask forgiveness for us.  They say with their tongues what is not in their hearts. Say to them:  Who can be of any avail to you against Allah if He should intend to cause you any harm or confer upon you any benefit?  Allah is well aware of all that you do.

ayahs.text: (But the truth is not what you say.) You had imagined that the Messenger and the believers would never return to their families and this notion was embellished in your hearts. You harboured an evil thought and you are an immensely evil people.
ayahs.translation: (But the truth is not what you say.) You had imagined that the Messenger and the believers would never return to their families and this notion was embellished in your hearts. You harboured an evil thought and you are an immensely evil people.

ayahs.text: As for those who do not believe in Allah and His Messenger for such unbelievers We have prepared a Blazing Fire.
ayahs.translation: As for those who do not believe in Allah and His Messenger for such unbelievers We have prepared a Blazing Fire.

ayahs.text: To Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whom He pleases and chastises whom He pleases. He is Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.
ayahs.translation: To Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whom He pleases and chastises whom He pleases. He is Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.

ayahs.text: When you press forth for the spoils those who were left behind will say:  Let us accompany you. They want to change the command of Allah. Say to them (in clear words):  You shall not accompany us. Thus has Allah already said. Then they will say:  Nay; but you are jealous of us.  The truth is that they understand little.
ayahs.translation: When you press forth for the spoils those who were left behind will say:  Let us accompany you. They want to change the command of Allah. Say to them (in clear words):  You shall not accompany us. Thus has Allah already said. Then they will say:  Nay; but you are jealous of us.  The truth is that they understand little.

ayahs.text: Say to the bedouins who were left behind:  You will be called against those who possess great might and be asked to fight against them unless they surrender. If you obey (the command to fight) Allah will bestow upon you a goodly reward. But if you turn away as you turned away before He shall inflict upon you a grievous chastisement.
ayahs.translation: Say to the bedouins who were left behind:  You will be called against those who possess great might and be asked to fight against them unless they surrender. If you obey (the command to fight) Allah will bestow upon you a goodly reward. But if you turn away as you turned away before He shall inflict upon you a grievous chastisement.

ayahs.text: There is no blame on the blind nor on the lame nor on the sick (if they do not go forth to fight). Allah will admit those who obey Allah and His Messenger to the Gardens beneath which rivers flow and will inflict a grievous chastisement on those who turn away.
ayahs.translation: There is no blame on the blind nor on the lame nor on the sick (if they do not go forth to fight). Allah will admit those who obey Allah and His Messenger to the Gardens beneath which rivers flow and will inflict a grievous chastisement on those who turn away.

ayahs.text: Allah was much pleased with the believers when they swore fealty to you under the tree. He knew what was in their hearts. So He bestowed inner peace upon them and rewarded them with a victory near at hand
ayahs.translation: Allah was much pleased with the believers when they swore fealty to you under the tree. He knew what was in their hearts. So He bestowed inner peace upon them and rewarded them with a victory near at hand

ayahs.text: and with abundant spoils which they shall acquire. Allah is Most Mighty Most Wise.
ayahs.translation: and with abundant spoils which they shall acquire. Allah is Most Mighty Most Wise.

ayahs.text: Allah has promised you abundant spoils which you shall acquire. He has instantly granted you this (victory) and has restrained the hands of people from you that it may be a Sign for the believers and He may guide you to a Straight Way.
ayahs.translation: Allah has promised you abundant spoils which you shall acquire. He has instantly granted you this (victory) and has restrained the hands of people from you that it may be a Sign for the believers and He may guide you to a Straight Way.

ayahs.text: He also promises you other spoils which you have not yet taken but Allah has encompassed them. Allah has power over everything.
ayahs.translation: He also promises you other spoils which you have not yet taken but Allah has encompassed them. Allah has power over everything.

ayahs.text: Had the unbelievers fought against you at that time they would have turned their backs (in flight) and would have found none to protect or help them.
ayahs.translation: Had the unbelievers fought against you at that time they would have turned their backs (in flight) and would have found none to protect or help them.

ayahs.text: Such is Allah''s Way that has come down from the past. Never shall you find any change in the Way of Allah.
ayahs.translation: Such is Allah''s Way that has come down from the past. Never shall you find any change in the Way of Allah.

ayahs.text: He it is Who restrained their hands from you and your hands from them in the valley of Makkah even though He had made you victorious against them. Allah was watching all that you did.
ayahs.translation: He it is Who restrained their hands from you and your hands from them in the valley of Makkah even though He had made you victorious against them. Allah was watching all that you did.

ayahs.text: They are the ones who disbelieved and barred you from the Inviolable Mosque and prevented the animals you had designated for sacrifice from reaching the place of their offering. If it had not been for the believing men and believing women (who lived in Makkah and) whom you did not know and had there not been the fear that you might trample on them and unwittingly incur blame on their account (then fighting would not have been put to a stop. It was stopped so that) Allah may admit to His Mercy whomsoever He pleases. Had those believers been separated from the rest We would certainly have inflicted a grievous chastisement on those of them [i.e. the Makkans) who disbelieved.
ayahs.translation: They are the ones who disbelieved and barred you from the Inviolable Mosque and prevented the animals you had designated for sacrifice from reaching the place of their offering. If it had not been for the believing men and believing women (who lived in Makkah and) whom you did not know and had there not been the fear that you might trample on them and unwittingly incur blame on their account (then fighting would not have been put to a stop. It was stopped so that) Allah may admit to His Mercy whomsoever He pleases. Had those believers been separated from the rest We would certainly have inflicted a grievous chastisement on those of them [i.e. the Makkans) who disbelieved.

ayahs.text: (This is why) when the unbelievers set in their hearts a fierce bigotry - the bigotry of ignorance - Allah bestowed inner peace upon His Messenger and upon the believers and made the word of piety binding on them. They were more deserving and worthier thereof. Allah has knowledge of everything.
ayahs.translation: (This is why) when the unbelievers set in their hearts a fierce bigotry - the bigotry of ignorance - Allah bestowed inner peace upon His Messenger and upon the believers and made the word of piety binding on them. They were more deserving and worthier thereof. Allah has knowledge of everything.

ayahs.text: Allah indeed showed His Messenger the true vision one fully in accord with reality. If Allah so wills you shall certainly enter the Inviolable Mosque in full security you will shave your heads and cut your hair short and do so without any fear. He knew what you did not know and He granted you a victory near at hand even before (the fulfilment of the vision).
ayahs.translation: Allah indeed showed His Messenger the true vision one fully in accord with reality. If Allah so wills you shall certainly enter the Inviolable Mosque in full security you will shave your heads and cut your hair short and do so without any fear. He knew what you did not know and He granted you a victory near at hand even before (the fulfilment of the vision).

ayahs.text: He it is Who sent His Messenger with the True Guidance and the Religion of Truth that He may make it prevail over every religion. Sufficient is Allah as a witness (to this).
ayahs.translation: He it is Who sent His Messenger with the True Guidance and the Religion of Truth that He may make it prevail over every religion. Sufficient is Allah as a witness (to this).

ayahs.text: Muhammad is Allah''s Messenger and those who are with him are firm with the unbelievers but compassionate with one another. You see them occupied in bowing and prostrating and in seeking Allah''s bounty and good pleasure. They are distinguished from others by the marks of prostration on their faces. Thus are they described in the Torah.And their parable in the Gospel is that of a tilth that puts forth its shoot then strengthens it so that it becomes stout and stands firmly on its stem. This is a sight pleasing to the sowers and one by which the unbelievers will be enraged. As for those who believe and do righteous deeds Allah has promised them forgiveness and a great reward.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Believers do not advance before Allah and His Messenger and fear Allah. Verily Allah is All-Hearing All-Knowing.
verses.translation: Believers do not advance before Allah and His Messenger and fear Allah. Verily Allah is All-Hearing All-Knowing.

verses.text: Believers do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet and when speaking to him do not speak aloud as you speak aloud to one another lest all your deeds are reduced to nothing without your even realising it.
verses.translation: Believers do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet and when speaking to him do not speak aloud as you speak aloud to one another lest all your deeds are reduced to nothing without your even realising it.

verses.text: The ones who lower their voices in the presence of the Messenger of Allah are those whose hearts Allah has tested for God-fearing. Theirs shall be forgiveness and a great reward.
verses.translation: The ones who lower their voices in the presence of the Messenger of Allah are those whose hearts Allah has tested for God-fearing. Theirs shall be forgiveness and a great reward.

verses.text: Surely most of those who call out to you (O Prophet) from behind the apartments are devoid of understanding.
verses.translation: Surely most of those who call out to you (O Prophet) from behind the apartments are devoid of understanding.

verses.text: If they were patient until you went out to them that would have been better for them. Allah is Most Forgiving Most Merciful.
verses.translation: If they were patient until you went out to them that would have been better for them. Allah is Most Forgiving Most Merciful.

verses.text: Believers when an ungodly person brings to you a piece of news carefully ascertain its truth lest you should hurt a people unwittingly and thereafter repent at what you did.
verses.translation: Believers when an ungodly person brings to you a piece of news carefully ascertain its truth lest you should hurt a people unwittingly and thereafter repent at what you did.

verses.text: Know that Allah''s Messenger is among you. Were he to follow you in many an affair you yourselves would suffer. But Allah has endeared faith to you and has embellished it in your hearts and has made unbelief and evil-doing and disobedience abhorrent to you. Such are those who are rightly guided
verses.translation: Know that Allah''s Messenger is among you. Were he to follow you in many an affair you yourselves would suffer. But Allah has endeared faith to you and has embellished it in your hearts and has made unbelief and evil-doing and disobedience abhorrent to you. Such are those who are rightly guided

verses.text: by Allah''s favour and bounty. Allah is All-Knowing All-Wise.
verses.translation: by Allah''s favour and bounty. Allah is All-Knowing All-Wise.

verses.text: If two parties of the believers happen to fight make peace between them. But then if one of them transgresses against the other fight the one that transgresses until it reverts to Allah''s command. And if it does revert make peace between them with justice and be equitable for Allah loves the equitable.
verses.translation: If two parties of the believers happen to fight make peace between them. But then if one of them transgresses against the other fight the one that transgresses until it reverts to Allah''s command. And if it does revert make peace between them with justice and be equitable for Allah loves the equitable.

verses.text: Surely the believers are none but brothers unto one another so set things right between your brothers and have fear of Allah that you may be shown mercy.
verses.translation: Surely the believers are none but brothers unto one another so set things right between your brothers and have fear of Allah that you may be shown mercy.

verses.text: Believers let not a group (of men) scoff at another group it may well be that the latter (at whom they scoff) are better than they; nor let a group of women scoff at another group it may well be that the latter are better than they. And do not taunt one another nor revile one another by nicknames. It is an evil thing to gain notoriety for ungodliness after belief. Those who do not repent are indeed the wrong-doers.
verses.translation: Believers let not a group (of men) scoff at another group it may well be that the latter (at whom they scoff) are better than they; nor let a group of women scoff at another group it may well be that the latter are better than they. And do not taunt one another nor revile one another by nicknames. It is an evil thing to gain notoriety for ungodliness after belief. Those who do not repent are indeed the wrong-doers.

verses.text: Believers avoid being excessively suspicious for some suspicion is a sin. Do not spy nor backbite one another. Would any of you like to eat the flesh of his dead brother? You would surely detest it. Have fear of Allah. Surely Allah is much prone to accept repentance is Most Compassionate.
verses.translation: Believers avoid being excessively suspicious for some suspicion is a sin. Do not spy nor backbite one another. Would any of you like to eat the flesh of his dead brother? You would surely detest it. Have fear of Allah. Surely Allah is much prone to accept repentance is Most Compassionate.

verses.text: Human beings We created you all from a male and a female and made you into nations and tribes so that you may know one another. Verily the noblest of you in the sight of Allah is the most God-fearing of you. Surely Allah is All-Knowing All-Aware.
verses.translation: Human beings We created you all from a male and a female and made you into nations and tribes so that you may know one another. Verily the noblest of you in the sight of Allah is the most God-fearing of you. Surely Allah is All-Knowing All-Aware.

verses.text: The Bedouins say:  We believe. (O Prophet) say to them:  You do not believe; you should rather say: ''We have submitted'' ; for belief has not yet entered your hearts. If you obey Allah and His Messenger He will not diminish anything from the reward of any of your deeds. Surely Allah is Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.
verses.translation: The Bedouins say:  We believe. (O Prophet) say to them:  You do not believe; you should rather say: ''We have submitted'' ; for belief has not yet entered your hearts. If you obey Allah and His Messenger He will not diminish anything from the reward of any of your deeds. Surely Allah is Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.

verses.text: Indeed the ones possessed of true faith are those who believed in Allah and His Messenger and then they did not entertain any doubt and strove hard in the Way of Allah with their lives and their possessions. These are the truthful ones.
verses.translation: Indeed the ones possessed of true faith are those who believed in Allah and His Messenger and then they did not entertain any doubt and strove hard in the Way of Allah with their lives and their possessions. These are the truthful ones.

verses.text: Say (O Prophet) (to these pretenders to faith):  Are you apprising Allah of your faith? Allah knows all that is in the heavens and the earth. Allah has full knowledge of everything.
verses.translation: Say (O Prophet) (to these pretenders to faith):  Are you apprising Allah of your faith? Allah knows all that is in the heavens and the earth. Allah has full knowledge of everything.

verses.text: They count it as a favour to you that they accepted Islam. Say:  Do not regard your (accepting) Islam as a favour to me; rather Allah has bestowed a favour on you by guiding you to faith if you are truthful (in your claim to be believers).
verses.translation: They count it as a favour to you that they accepted Islam. Say:  Do not regard your (accepting) Islam as a favour to me; rather Allah has bestowed a favour on you by guiding you to faith if you are truthful (in your claim to be believers).

verses.text: Surely Allah knows every hidden thing of the heavens and the earth. Allah sees all that you do.
verses.translation: Surely Allah knows every hidden thing of the heavens and the earth. Allah sees all that you do.

verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Qaf. By the glorious Qur''an.
verses.translation: Qaf. By the glorious Qur''an.

verses.text: Nay; they wondered that a warner should have come to them from among themselves. The unbelievers said:  This indeed is a strange thing.
verses.translation: Nay; they wondered that a warner should have come to them from among themselves. The unbelievers said:  This indeed is a strange thing.

verses.text: What! When we are dead and reduced to mere dust (shall we be raised to life)? Such a return is far-fetched.
verses.translation: What! When we are dead and reduced to mere dust (shall we be raised to life)? Such a return is far-fetched.

verses.text: (Thus do they imagine although) We know well what the earth takes away from them. With Us is a Record that preserves everything.
verses.translation: (Thus do they imagine although) We know well what the earth takes away from them. With Us is a Record that preserves everything.

verses.text: They gave the lie to the Truth when it came to them. So they are now in a state of great perplexity.
verses.translation: They gave the lie to the Truth when it came to them. So they are now in a state of great perplexity.

verses.text: Did they never observe the sky above them: how We built it and beautified it; and it has no cracks;
verses.translation: Did they never observe the sky above them: how We built it and beautified it; and it has no cracks;

verses.text: and We have spread out the earth and have set upon it firm mountains and have caused it to bring out plants of all beauteous kinds?
verses.translation: and We have spread out the earth and have set upon it firm mountains and have caused it to bring out plants of all beauteous kinds?

verses.text: All these are to serve as eye openers and as a lesson to every being who is prone to turn (to the Truth).
verses.translation: All these are to serve as eye openers and as a lesson to every being who is prone to turn (to the Truth).

verses.text: We also sent down blessed water from the heaven wherewith We caused gardens and harvest-grain to grow
verses.translation: We also sent down blessed water from the heaven wherewith We caused gardens and harvest-grain to grow

verses.text: and tall palm-trees with their thickly-clustered spathes;
verses.translation: and tall palm-trees with their thickly-clustered spathes;

verses.text: all this as sustenance for Our servants. And thus We do bring the dead land back to life with water. Such shall be the coming forth (of human beings from the earth).
verses.translation: all this as sustenance for Our servants. And thus We do bring the dead land back to life with water. Such shall be the coming forth (of human beings from the earth).

verses.text: In the past Noah''s people and the people of Rass and Thamud gave the lie (to Messengers)
verses.translation: In the past Noah''s people and the people of Rass and Thamud gave the lie (to Messengers)

verses.text: and so did ''Ad and Pharaoh and Lot''s brethren
verses.translation: and so did ''Ad and Pharaoh and Lot''s brethren

verses.text: and the people of Aykah and the people of Tubba''. They all gave the lie to the Messengers. Thereafter My threat of chastisement against them was fulfilled.
verses.translation: and the people of Aykah and the people of Tubba''. They all gave the lie to the Messengers. Thereafter My threat of chastisement against them was fulfilled.

verses.text: Did We then become worn out by the first creation? Not at all; but they are in doubt about a fresh creation.
verses.translation: Did We then become worn out by the first creation? Not at all; but they are in doubt about a fresh creation.

verses.text: Surely We have created man and We know the promptings of his heart and We are nearer to him than even his jugular vein.
verses.translation: Surely We have created man and We know the promptings of his heart and We are nearer to him than even his jugular vein.

verses.text: Moreover there are two scribes one each sitting on the right and the left recording everything.
verses.translation: Moreover there are two scribes one each sitting on the right and the left recording everything.

verses.text: He utters not a word but there is a vigilant watcher at hand.
verses.translation: He utters not a word but there is a vigilant watcher at hand.

verses.text: Lo the agony of death has indeed come with the Truth. That is what you had sought to avoid.
verses.translation: Lo the agony of death has indeed come with the Truth. That is what you had sought to avoid.

verses.text: And then the Trumpet was blown. This is the day of the promised chastisement.
verses.translation: And then the Trumpet was blown. This is the day of the promised chastisement.

verses.text: Everyone has come each attended by one who will drive him on and another who will bear witness.
verses.translation: Everyone has come each attended by one who will drive him on and another who will bear witness.

verses.text: You were heedless of this. Now We have removed your veil and so your vision today is sharp.
verses.translation: You were heedless of this. Now We have removed your veil and so your vision today is sharp.

verses.text: His companion said:  Here is he who was in my charge.
verses.translation: His companion said:  Here is he who was in my charge.

verses.text: The command was given:  Cast into Hell every hardened stubborn unbeliever
verses.translation: The command was given:  Cast into Hell every hardened stubborn unbeliever

verses.text: who hinders good exceeds the limits is immersed in doubts
verses.translation: who hinders good exceeds the limits is immersed in doubts

verses.text: and has set up another deity with Allah. Hurl him into the grievous torment.
verses.translation: and has set up another deity with Allah. Hurl him into the grievous torment.

verses.text: His companion said:  I did not incite him to rebel; he was far gone into error of his own accord.
verses.translation: His companion said:  I did not incite him to rebel; he was far gone into error of his own accord.

verses.text: (It was said):  Do not remonstrate in My presence. I had warned you.
verses.translation: (It was said):  Do not remonstrate in My presence. I had warned you.

verses.text: My Word is not changed; and never do I inflict the least wrong upon My servants.
verses.translation: My Word is not changed; and never do I inflict the least wrong upon My servants.

verses.text: On that Day We shall ask Hell:  Are you full?  And it will reply:  Are there any more?
verses.translation: On that Day We shall ask Hell:  Are you full?  And it will reply:  Are there any more?

verses.text: And when Paradise shall be brought close to the God-fearing and will no longer be far away
verses.translation: And when Paradise shall be brought close to the God-fearing and will no longer be far away

verses.text: it will be said:  This is what you were promised a promise made to everyone who turned much (to Allah) and was watchful of his conduct
verses.translation: it will be said:  This is what you were promised a promise made to everyone who turned much (to Allah) and was watchful of his conduct

verses.text: to everyone who feared the Merciful One though He is beyond the reach of perception to everyone who has come with a heart ever wont to turn (to Him).
verses.translation: to everyone who feared the Merciful One though He is beyond the reach of perception to everyone who has come with a heart ever wont to turn (to Him).

verses.text: Enter this Paradise in peace. That will be the Day of Eternity.
verses.translation: Enter this Paradise in peace. That will be the Day of Eternity.

verses.text: Therein they shall get whatever they desire; and with Us there is even more.
verses.translation: Therein they shall get whatever they desire; and with Us there is even more.

verses.text: How many a nation did We destroy before them that were stronger in prowess than these. They searched about the lands of the world. But could they find a refuge?
verses.translation: How many a nation did We destroy before them that were stronger in prowess than these. They searched about the lands of the world. But could they find a refuge?

verses.text: Verily there is a lesson in this for everyone who has a (sound) heart and who listens with an attentive mind.
verses.translation: Verily there is a lesson in this for everyone who has a (sound) heart and who listens with an attentive mind.

verses.text: We created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six days and weariness did not even touch Us.
verses.translation: We created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six days and weariness did not even touch Us.

verses.text: Hence bear with patience whatever they say and celebrate your Lord''s glory before the rising of the sun and before its setting;
verses.translation: Hence bear with patience whatever they say and celebrate your Lord''s glory before the rising of the sun and before its setting;

verses.text: and in the night too celebrate His glory in the wake of prostration.
verses.translation: and in the night too celebrate His glory in the wake of prostration.

verses.text: Hearken on the Day when the caller will call from a place nearby
verses.translation: Hearken on the Day when the caller will call from a place nearby

verses.text: the Day when they shall hear the Blast in truth. That will be the Day (for the dead) to come forth.
verses.translation: the Day when they shall hear the Blast in truth. That will be the Day (for the dead) to come forth.

verses.text: Surely it is We Who give life and cause death and to Us shall all return
verses.translation: Surely it is We Who give life and cause death and to Us shall all return

verses.text: on the Day when the earth will be rent asunder and people rising from it will hasten forth. To assemble them all will be easy for Us.
verses.translation: on the Day when the earth will be rent asunder and people rising from it will hasten forth. To assemble them all will be easy for Us.

verses.text: (O Prophet) We are well aware of what they say; and you are not required to force things on them. So exhort with the Qur''an all those who fear My warning.
verses.translation: (O Prophet) We are well aware of what they say; and you are not required to force things on them. So exhort with the Qur''an all those who fear My warning.

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: Qaf. By the glorious Qur''an.
ayahs.translation: Qaf. By the glorious Qur''an.
