verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: By the winds which scatter dust
verses.translation: By the winds which scatter dust

verses.text: which carry clouds laden with water
verses.translation: which carry clouds laden with water

verses.text: which then smoothly speed along
verses.translation: which then smoothly speed along

verses.text: and execute the great task of apportioning (rainfall):
verses.translation: and execute the great task of apportioning (rainfall):

verses.text: surely what you are being warned against is true
verses.translation: surely what you are being warned against is true

verses.text: and the Judgement shall doubtlessly take place.
verses.translation: and the Judgement shall doubtlessly take place.

verses.text: By the heaven with its numerous forms:
verses.translation: By the heaven with its numerous forms:

verses.text: surely you are at variance (about the Hereafter);
verses.translation: surely you are at variance (about the Hereafter);

verses.text: though only those who are averse to the Truth will turn away from (believing in it).
verses.translation: though only those who are averse to the Truth will turn away from (believing in it).

verses.text: Doomed are the conjecturers
verses.translation: Doomed are the conjecturers

verses.text: who are steeped in ignorance and heedlessness.
verses.translation: who are steeped in ignorance and heedlessness.

verses.text: They ask:  When will the Day of Judgement be?
verses.translation: They ask:  When will the Day of Judgement be?

verses.text: It will be the Day when they shall be scourged by the Fire
verses.translation: It will be the Day when they shall be scourged by the Fire

verses.text: (and be told):  Taste your ordeal! This is what you were seeking to hasten.
verses.translation: (and be told):  Taste your ordeal! This is what you were seeking to hasten.

verses.text: As for the God-fearing they shall be in the midst of gardens and fountains
verses.translation: As for the God-fearing they shall be in the midst of gardens and fountains

verses.text: joyously receiving what their Lord will have granted them. Verily they did good works before (the coming of this Day):
verses.translation: joyously receiving what their Lord will have granted them. Verily they did good works before (the coming of this Day):

verses.text: they used to sleep but little by night
verses.translation: they used to sleep but little by night

verses.text: and would ask for forgiveness at dawn
verses.translation: and would ask for forgiveness at dawn

verses.text: and in their wealth there was a rightful share for him who would ask and for the destitute.
verses.translation: and in their wealth there was a rightful share for him who would ask and for the destitute.

verses.text: There are many Signs on earth for those of sure faith
verses.translation: There are many Signs on earth for those of sure faith

verses.text: and also in your own selves. Do you not see?
verses.translation: and also in your own selves. Do you not see?

verses.text: And in heaven is your provision and also what you are being promised.
verses.translation: And in heaven is your provision and also what you are being promised.

verses.text: So by the Lord of the heaven and the earth this is certainly true as true as the fact of your speaking.
verses.translation: So by the Lord of the heaven and the earth this is certainly true as true as the fact of your speaking.

verses.text: (O Prophet) did the story of Abraham s honoured guests reach you?
verses.translation: (O Prophet) did the story of Abraham s honoured guests reach you?

verses.text: When they came to him they said:  Peace ; he said:  Peace also be to you; (you seem to be) a group of strangers.
verses.translation: When they came to him they said:  Peace ; he said:  Peace also be to you; (you seem to be) a group of strangers.

verses.text: Then he went back to his familyand brought a fat roasted calf
verses.translation: Then he went back to his familyand brought a fat roasted calf

verses.text: and laid it before them saying:  Will you not eat?
verses.translation: and laid it before them saying:  Will you not eat?

verses.text: Then he became afraid of them. They said:  Fear not and announced to him the good news of (the birth of) a boy endowed with knowledge.
verses.translation: Then he became afraid of them. They said:  Fear not and announced to him the good news of (the birth of) a boy endowed with knowledge.

verses.text: So hearing his wife went forth shouting. She struck her face and exclaimed:  A barren old woman am I.
verses.translation: So hearing his wife went forth shouting. She struck her face and exclaimed:  A barren old woman am I.

verses.text: They said:  So has your Lord said (that you shall have a boy). Surely He is Most Wise All-Knowing.
verses.translation: They said:  So has your Lord said (that you shall have a boy). Surely He is Most Wise All-Knowing.

verses.text: Abraham said:  Envoys (of Allah) what is your errand?
verses.translation: Abraham said:  Envoys (of Allah) what is your errand?

verses.text: They replied:  Behold we have been sent to a wicked people
verses.translation: They replied:  Behold we have been sent to a wicked people

verses.text: that we may unleash a shower of clay-stones
verses.translation: that we may unleash a shower of clay-stones

verses.text: marked by your Lord upon those who go beyond the limits.
verses.translation: marked by your Lord upon those who go beyond the limits.

verses.text: Then We evacuated there from all the believers
verses.translation: Then We evacuated there from all the believers

verses.text: and We did not find there any apart from a single house of Muslims
verses.translation: and We did not find there any apart from a single house of Muslims

verses.text: and We left therein a Sign for those who fear the grievous chastisement.
verses.translation: and We left therein a Sign for those who fear the grievous chastisement.

verses.text: There is also a Sign for you in the story of Moses when We sent him with a clear authority to Pharaoh.
verses.translation: There is also a Sign for you in the story of Moses when We sent him with a clear authority to Pharaoh.

verses.text: But Pharaoh turned away showing arrogance on account of his power and said (about Moses):  He is either a sorcerer or a madman.
verses.translation: But Pharaoh turned away showing arrogance on account of his power and said (about Moses):  He is either a sorcerer or a madman.

verses.text: So We seized him and his hosts and cast them into the sea. He became an object of much blame.
verses.translation: So We seized him and his hosts and cast them into the sea. He became an object of much blame.

verses.text: There is also a Sign for you in (the story of) Ad when We let loose upon them an ominous wind
verses.translation: There is also a Sign for you in (the story of) Ad when We let loose upon them an ominous wind

verses.text: that left nothing that it came upon without reducing it to rubble.
verses.translation: that left nothing that it came upon without reducing it to rubble.

verses.text: There is also a Sign for you in (the story of) Thamud. They were told:  Enjoy yourselves for a while.
verses.translation: There is also a Sign for you in (the story of) Thamud. They were told:  Enjoy yourselves for a while.

verses.text: But they brazenly disobeyed their Lord s command and then a sudden chastisement overtook them while they looked on.
verses.translation: But they brazenly disobeyed their Lord s command and then a sudden chastisement overtook them while they looked on.

verses.text: They were unable even to stand up or protect themselves.
verses.translation: They were unable even to stand up or protect themselves.

verses.text: Before all these We destroyed the people of Noah: they were a wicked people.
verses.translation: Before all these We destroyed the people of Noah: they were a wicked people.

verses.text: And heaven   We made it with Our Own Power and We have the Power to do so.
verses.translation: And heaven   We made it with Our Own Power and We have the Power to do so.

verses.text: And the earth   We spread it out and how well have We smoothed it!
verses.translation: And the earth   We spread it out and how well have We smoothed it!

verses.text: And of everything We have created pairs; perhaps you will take heed.
verses.translation: And of everything We have created pairs; perhaps you will take heed.

verses.text: Flee therefore to Allah. Surely I am a clear warner to you from Him;
verses.translation: Flee therefore to Allah. Surely I am a clear warner to you from Him;

verses.text: and do not set up any deity with Allah. Surely I am a clear warner to you from Him.
verses.translation: and do not set up any deity with Allah. Surely I am a clear warner to you from Him.

verses.text: Thus has it been (in the past): never did a Messenger come to the nations that preceded them but they said:  (He is) a sorcerer or a mad-man.
verses.translation: Thus has it been (in the past): never did a Messenger come to the nations that preceded them but they said:  (He is) a sorcerer or a mad-man.

verses.text: Have they arrived at a common understanding concerning this? No; but they are a people given to transgression.
verses.translation: Have they arrived at a common understanding concerning this? No; but they are a people given to transgression.

verses.text: So turn your attention away from them; you shall incur no blame.
verses.translation: So turn your attention away from them; you shall incur no blame.

verses.text: Do however keep exhorting them; for exhortation benefits those endowed with faith.
verses.translation: Do however keep exhorting them; for exhortation benefits those endowed with faith.

verses.text: I created the jinn and humans for nothing else but that they may serve Me;
verses.translation: I created the jinn and humans for nothing else but that they may serve Me;

verses.text: I desire from them no provision nor do I want them to feed Me.
verses.translation: I desire from them no provision nor do I want them to feed Me.

verses.text: Surely Allah is the Bestower of all provision the Lord of all power the Strong.
verses.translation: Surely Allah is the Bestower of all provision the Lord of all power the Strong.

verses.text: The wrong-doers shall receive a portion of the chastisements as their fellows (of yore). So let them not rush Me.
verses.translation: The wrong-doers shall receive a portion of the chastisements as their fellows (of yore). So let them not rush Me.

verses.text: Woe then betide those who disbelieved in that Day of theirs which they are being asked to hold in dread.
verses.translation: Woe then betide those who disbelieved in that Day of theirs which they are being asked to hold in dread.

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: By the winds which scatter dust
ayahs.translation: By the winds which scatter dust

ayahs.text: which carry clouds laden with water
ayahs.translation: which carry clouds laden with water

ayahs.text: which then smoothly speed along
ayahs.translation: which then smoothly speed along

ayahs.text: and execute the great task of apportioning (rainfall):
ayahs.translation: and execute the great task of apportioning (rainfall):

ayahs.text: surely what you are being warned against is true
ayahs.translation: surely what you are being warned against is true

ayahs.text: and the Judgement shall doubtlessly take place.
ayahs.translation: and the Judgement shall doubtlessly take place.

ayahs.text: By the heaven with its numerous forms:
ayahs.translation: By the heaven with its numerous forms:

ayahs.text: surely you are at variance (about the Hereafter);
ayahs.translation: surely you are at variance (about the Hereafter);

ayahs.text: though only those who are averse to the Truth will turn away from (believing in it).
ayahs.translation: though only those who are averse to the Truth will turn away from (believing in it).

ayahs.text: Doomed are the conjecturers
ayahs.translation: Doomed are the conjecturers

ayahs.text: who are steeped in ignorance and heedlessness.
ayahs.translation: who are steeped in ignorance and heedlessness.

ayahs.text: They ask:  When will the Day of Judgement be?
ayahs.translation: They ask:  When will the Day of Judgement be?

ayahs.text: It will be the Day when they shall be scourged by the Fire
ayahs.translation: It will be the Day when they shall be scourged by the Fire

ayahs.text: (and be told):  Taste your ordeal! This is what you were seeking to hasten.
ayahs.translation: (and be told):  Taste your ordeal! This is what you were seeking to hasten.

ayahs.text: As for the God-fearing they shall be in the midst of gardens and fountains
ayahs.translation: As for the God-fearing they shall be in the midst of gardens and fountains

ayahs.text: joyously receiving what their Lord will have granted them. Verily they did good works before (the coming of this Day):
ayahs.translation: joyously receiving what their Lord will have granted them. Verily they did good works before (the coming of this Day):

ayahs.text: they used to sleep but little by night
ayahs.translation: they used to sleep but little by night

ayahs.text: and would ask for forgiveness at dawn
ayahs.translation: and would ask for forgiveness at dawn

ayahs.text: and in their wealth there was a rightful share for him who would ask and for the destitute.
ayahs.translation: and in their wealth there was a rightful share for him who would ask and for the destitute.

ayahs.text: There are many Signs on earth for those of sure faith
ayahs.translation: There are many Signs on earth for those of sure faith

ayahs.text: and also in your own selves. Do you not see?
ayahs.translation: and also in your own selves. Do you not see?

ayahs.text: And in heaven is your provision and also what you are being promised.
ayahs.translation: And in heaven is your provision and also what you are being promised.

ayahs.text: So by the Lord of the heaven and the earth this is certainly true as true as the fact of your speaking.
ayahs.translation: So by the Lord of the heaven and the earth this is certainly true as true as the fact of your speaking.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) did the story of Abraham s honoured guests reach you?
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) did the story of Abraham s honoured guests reach you?

ayahs.text: When they came to him they said:  Peace ; he said:  Peace also be to you; (you seem to be) a group of strangers.
ayahs.translation: When they came to him they said:  Peace ; he said:  Peace also be to you; (you seem to be) a group of strangers.

ayahs.text: Then he went back to his familyand brought a fat roasted calf
ayahs.translation: Then he went back to his familyand brought a fat roasted calf

ayahs.text: and laid it before them saying:  Will you not eat?
ayahs.translation: and laid it before them saying:  Will you not eat?

ayahs.text: Then he became afraid of them. They said:  Fear not and announced to him the good news of (the birth of) a boy endowed with knowledge.
ayahs.translation: Then he became afraid of them. They said:  Fear not and announced to him the good news of (the birth of) a boy endowed with knowledge.

ayahs.text: So hearing his wife went forth shouting. She struck her face and exclaimed:  A barren old woman am I.
ayahs.translation: So hearing his wife went forth shouting. She struck her face and exclaimed:  A barren old woman am I.

ayahs.text: They said:  So has your Lord said (that you shall have a boy). Surely He is Most Wise All-Knowing.
ayahs.translation: They said:  So has your Lord said (that you shall have a boy). Surely He is Most Wise All-Knowing.

ayahs.text: Abraham said:  Envoys (of Allah) what is your errand?
ayahs.translation: Abraham said:  Envoys (of Allah) what is your errand?

ayahs.text: They replied:  Behold we have been sent to a wicked people
ayahs.translation: They replied:  Behold we have been sent to a wicked people

ayahs.text: that we may unleash a shower of clay-stones
ayahs.translation: that we may unleash a shower of clay-stones

ayahs.text: marked by your Lord upon those who go beyond the limits.
ayahs.translation: marked by your Lord upon those who go beyond the limits.

ayahs.text: Then We evacuated there from all the believers
ayahs.translation: Then We evacuated there from all the believers

ayahs.text: and We did not find there any apart from a single house of Muslims
ayahs.translation: and We did not find there any apart from a single house of Muslims

ayahs.text: and We left therein a Sign for those who fear the grievous chastisement.
ayahs.translation: and We left therein a Sign for those who fear the grievous chastisement.

ayahs.text: There is also a Sign for you in the story of Moses when We sent him with a clear authority to Pharaoh.
ayahs.translation: There is also a Sign for you in the story of Moses when We sent him with a clear authority to Pharaoh.

ayahs.text: But Pharaoh turned away showing arrogance on account of his power and said (about Moses):  He is either a sorcerer or a madman.
ayahs.translation: But Pharaoh turned away showing arrogance on account of his power and said (about Moses):  He is either a sorcerer or a madman.

ayahs.text: So We seized him and his hosts and cast them into the sea. He became an object of much blame.
ayahs.translation: So We seized him and his hosts and cast them into the sea. He became an object of much blame.

ayahs.text: There is also a Sign for you in (the story of) Ad when We let loose upon them an ominous wind
ayahs.translation: There is also a Sign for you in (the story of) Ad when We let loose upon them an ominous wind

ayahs.text: that left nothing that it came upon without reducing it to rubble.
ayahs.translation: that left nothing that it came upon without reducing it to rubble.

ayahs.text: There is also a Sign for you in (the story of) Thamud. They were told:  Enjoy yourselves for a while.
ayahs.translation: There is also a Sign for you in (the story of) Thamud. They were told:  Enjoy yourselves for a while.

ayahs.text: But they brazenly disobeyed their Lord s command and then a sudden chastisement overtook them while they looked on.
ayahs.translation: But they brazenly disobeyed their Lord s command and then a sudden chastisement overtook them while they looked on.

ayahs.text: They were unable even to stand up or protect themselves.
ayahs.translation: They were unable even to stand up or protect themselves.

ayahs.text: Before all these We destroyed the people of Noah: they were a wicked people.
ayahs.translation: Before all these We destroyed the people of Noah: they were a wicked people.

ayahs.text: And heaven   We made it with Our Own Power and We have the Power to do so.
ayahs.translation: And heaven   We made it with Our Own Power and We have the Power to do so.

ayahs.text: And the earth   We spread it out and how well have We smoothed it!
ayahs.translation: And the earth   We spread it out and how well have We smoothed it!

ayahs.text: And of everything We have created pairs; perhaps you will take heed.
ayahs.translation: And of everything We have created pairs; perhaps you will take heed.

ayahs.text: Flee therefore to Allah. Surely I am a clear warner to you from Him;
ayahs.translation: Flee therefore to Allah. Surely I am a clear warner to you from Him;

ayahs.text: and do not set up any deity with Allah. Surely I am a clear warner to you from Him.
ayahs.translation: and do not set up any deity with Allah. Surely I am a clear warner to you from Him.

ayahs.text: Thus has it been (in the past): never did a Messenger come to the nations that preceded them but they said:  (He is) a sorcerer or a mad-man.
ayahs.translation: Thus has it been (in the past): never did a Messenger come to the nations that preceded them but they said:  (He is) a sorcerer or a mad-man.

ayahs.text: Have they arrived at a common understanding concerning this? No; but they are a people given to transgression.
ayahs.translation: Have they arrived at a common understanding concerning this? No; but they are a people given to transgression.

ayahs.text: So turn your attention away from them; you shall incur no blame.
ayahs.translation: So turn your attention away from them; you shall incur no blame.

ayahs.text: Do however keep exhorting them; for exhortation benefits those endowed with faith.
ayahs.translation: Do however keep exhorting them; for exhortation benefits those endowed with faith.

ayahs.text: I created the jinn and humans for nothing else but that they may serve Me;
ayahs.translation: I created the jinn and humans for nothing else but that they may serve Me;

ayahs.text: I desire from them no provision nor do I want them to feed Me.
ayahs.translation: I desire from them no provision nor do I want them to feed Me.

ayahs.text: Surely Allah is the Bestower of all provision the Lord of all power the Strong.
ayahs.translation: Surely Allah is the Bestower of all provision the Lord of all power the Strong.

ayahs.text: The wrong-doers shall receive a portion of the chastisements as their fellows (of yore). So let them not rush Me.
ayahs.translation: The wrong-doers shall receive a portion of the chastisements as their fellows (of yore). So let them not rush Me.

ayahs.text: Woe then betide those who disbelieved in that Day of theirs which they are being asked to hold in dread.
ayahs.translation: Woe then betide those who disbelieved in that Day of theirs which they are being asked to hold in dread.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: By the Mount
verses.translation: By the Mount

verses.text: and the Book inscribed
verses.translation: and the Book inscribed

verses.text: on fine parchment;
verses.translation: on fine parchment;

verses.text: by the much-frequented House
verses.translation: by the much-frequented House

verses.text: by the elevated canopy;
verses.translation: by the elevated canopy;

verses.text: and by the swelling sea:
verses.translation: and by the swelling sea:

verses.text: verily your Lord''s chastisement shall come to pass
verses.translation: verily your Lord''s chastisement shall come to pass

verses.text: none can avert that.
verses.translation: none can avert that.

verses.text: (It shall come to pass) on the Day when the heaven will convulse in a great convulsion
verses.translation: (It shall come to pass) on the Day when the heaven will convulse in a great convulsion

verses.text: and the mountains shall violently fly about.
verses.translation: and the mountains shall violently fly about.

verses.text: Woe then on that Day to those who give the lie (to this Message)
verses.translation: Woe then on that Day to those who give the lie (to this Message)

verses.text: and amuse themselves with vain argumentation.
verses.translation: and amuse themselves with vain argumentation.

verses.text: On the Day when they shall be thrust into Hell with a violent thrust (and shall be told):
verses.translation: On the Day when they shall be thrust into Hell with a violent thrust (and shall be told):

verses.text: This is the Hell which you used to give the lie to.
verses.translation: This is the Hell which you used to give the lie to.

verses.text: Is this then any feat of magic or are you unable to see?
verses.translation: Is this then any feat of magic or are you unable to see?

verses.text: Go now and burn in it. It is all the same whether you bear it patiently or do not bear it with patience. You are only being recompensed for your deeds.
verses.translation: Go now and burn in it. It is all the same whether you bear it patiently or do not bear it with patience. You are only being recompensed for your deeds.

verses.text: Surely the God-fearing shall be in Gardens and bliss
verses.translation: Surely the God-fearing shall be in Gardens and bliss

verses.text: enjoying what Allah will have endowed them with; and their Lord will have saved them from the torment of the Blazing Fire.
verses.translation: enjoying what Allah will have endowed them with; and their Lord will have saved them from the torment of the Blazing Fire.

verses.text: (They will be told):  Eat and drink to your hearts'' content as a reward for your deeds.
verses.translation: (They will be told):  Eat and drink to your hearts'' content as a reward for your deeds.

verses.text: The God-fearing shall be reclining on couches facing each other and We shall wed them to maidens with large beautiful eyes.
verses.translation: The God-fearing shall be reclining on couches facing each other and We shall wed them to maidens with large beautiful eyes.

verses.text: We shall unite the believers with those descendants of theirs who followed them in their faith and shall not deny them any part of the reward for their good deeds. Every person is pledged to what he did.
verses.translation: We shall unite the believers with those descendants of theirs who followed them in their faith and shall not deny them any part of the reward for their good deeds. Every person is pledged to what he did.

verses.text: We shall provide them in abundance with all kinds of fruit and meat whatever they may desire.
verses.translation: We shall provide them in abundance with all kinds of fruit and meat whatever they may desire.

verses.text: They shall pass on to one another a cup that will incite neither levity nor sin.
verses.translation: They shall pass on to one another a cup that will incite neither levity nor sin.

verses.text: Youths as fair as hidden pearls will be set apart to wait upon them; they will be running to and fro to serve them.
verses.translation: Youths as fair as hidden pearls will be set apart to wait upon them; they will be running to and fro to serve them.

verses.text: They will turn to one another and ask (regarding the past events).
verses.translation: They will turn to one another and ask (regarding the past events).

verses.text: They will say:  When we were living before among our kinsfolk we lived in constant fear (of Allah''s displeasure).
verses.translation: They will say:  When we were living before among our kinsfolk we lived in constant fear (of Allah''s displeasure).

verses.text: Then Allah graced us with His favour and saved us from the chastisement of the scorching wind.
verses.translation: Then Allah graced us with His favour and saved us from the chastisement of the scorching wind.

verses.text: Formerly we had always prayed to Him. Surely He is Most Benign Most Compassionate.
verses.translation: Formerly we had always prayed to Him. Surely He is Most Benign Most Compassionate.

verses.text: So exhort (them O Prophet) for by your Lord''s Grace you are neither a soothsayer nor a madman.
verses.translation: So exhort (them O Prophet) for by your Lord''s Grace you are neither a soothsayer nor a madman.

verses.text: Or do they say:  He is a poet for whom we await an adverse turn of fortune.
verses.translation: Or do they say:  He is a poet for whom we await an adverse turn of fortune.

verses.text: Tell them:  Wait; I too am waiting with you.
verses.translation: Tell them:  Wait; I too am waiting with you.

verses.text: Do their minds prompt them to say such things or are they a people immersed in transgression?
verses.translation: Do their minds prompt them to say such things or are they a people immersed in transgression?

verses.text: Do they say:  He has himself fabricated the Qur''an?  No; the truth is that they are altogether averse to believing.
verses.translation: Do they say:  He has himself fabricated the Qur''an?  No; the truth is that they are altogether averse to believing.

verses.text: (If they are truthful in this) then let them produce a discourse of similar splendour.
verses.translation: (If they are truthful in this) then let them produce a discourse of similar splendour.

verses.text: Did they come into being without any creator? Or were they their own creators?
verses.translation: Did they come into being without any creator? Or were they their own creators?

verses.text: Or is it they who created the heavens and the earth? No; the truth is that they lack sure faith.
verses.translation: Or is it they who created the heavens and the earth? No; the truth is that they lack sure faith.

verses.text: Or do they have your Lord''s treasures in their keeping? Or have absolute authority over them?
verses.translation: Or do they have your Lord''s treasures in their keeping? Or have absolute authority over them?

verses.text: Or do they have a ladder whereon they can climb and attempt to listen (to what is transpiring in the Higher Realm)? Then let any of them who has listened to it produce a clear proof of it.
verses.translation: Or do they have a ladder whereon they can climb and attempt to listen (to what is transpiring in the Higher Realm)? Then let any of them who has listened to it produce a clear proof of it.

verses.text: Or does Allah have daughters whereas you have sons?
verses.translation: Or does Allah have daughters whereas you have sons?

verses.text: Or is it that you ask of them any recompense so that they should fear to be weighed down under the burden of debt?
verses.translation: Or is it that you ask of them any recompense so that they should fear to be weighed down under the burden of debt?

verses.text: Or is it that they have access to (the Truths in) the realm beyond sense-perception which they are writing down?
verses.translation: Or is it that they have access to (the Truths in) the realm beyond sense-perception which they are writing down?

verses.text: Or are they contriving a stratagem against you? If so that stratagem will rebound against the unbelievers.
verses.translation: Or are they contriving a stratagem against you? If so that stratagem will rebound against the unbelievers.

verses.text: Do they have any god other than Allah? Exalted be Allah above whatever they associate (with Him in His Divinity).
verses.translation: Do they have any god other than Allah? Exalted be Allah above whatever they associate (with Him in His Divinity).

verses.text: (So obstinate are they that) even if they were to see some fragments of the sky falling down they would still say:  It is only a mass of cloud.
verses.translation: (So obstinate are they that) even if they were to see some fragments of the sky falling down they would still say:  It is only a mass of cloud.

verses.text: So leave them alone until they encounter that Day of theirs when they shall be struck down
verses.translation: So leave them alone until they encounter that Day of theirs when they shall be struck down

verses.text: when their stratagem shall be of no avail to them nor shall they be succoured.
verses.translation: when their stratagem shall be of no avail to them nor shall they be succoured.

verses.text: Surely a chastisement awaits the wrong-doers even before the coming of that Day; but most of them do not know.
verses.translation: Surely a chastisement awaits the wrong-doers even before the coming of that Day; but most of them do not know.

verses.text: Be patient then (O Prophet) until the judgement of your Lord comes. For surely you are before Our eyes. And celebrate the praise of your Lord when you rise
verses.translation: Be patient then (O Prophet) until the judgement of your Lord comes. For surely you are before Our eyes. And celebrate the praise of your Lord when you rise

verses.text: and also celebrate His praise at night and at the retreat of the stars.
verses.translation: and also celebrate His praise at night and at the retreat of the stars.

ayahs.text: Or are they contriving a stratagem against you? If so that stratagem will rebound against the unbelievers.
ayahs.translation: Or are they contriving a stratagem against you? If so that stratagem will rebound against the unbelievers.

ayahs.text: Do they have any god other than Allah? Exalted be Allah above whatever they associate (with Him in His Divinity).
ayahs.translation: Do they have any god other than Allah? Exalted be Allah above whatever they associate (with Him in His Divinity).

ayahs.text: (So obstinate are they that) even if they were to see some fragments of the sky falling down they would still say:  It is only a mass of cloud.
ayahs.translation: (So obstinate are they that) even if they were to see some fragments of the sky falling down they would still say:  It is only a mass of cloud.

ayahs.text: So leave them alone until they encounter that Day of theirs when they shall be struck down
ayahs.translation: So leave them alone until they encounter that Day of theirs when they shall be struck down

ayahs.text: when their stratagem shall be of no avail to them nor shall they be succoured.
ayahs.translation: when their stratagem shall be of no avail to them nor shall they be succoured.

ayahs.text: Surely a chastisement awaits the wrong-doers even before the coming of that Day; but most of them do not know.
ayahs.translation: Surely a chastisement awaits the wrong-doers even before the coming of that Day; but most of them do not know.

ayahs.text: Be patient then (O Prophet) until the judgement of your Lord comes. For surely you are before Our eyes. And celebrate the praise of your Lord when you rise
ayahs.translation: Be patient then (O Prophet) until the judgement of your Lord comes. For surely you are before Our eyes. And celebrate the praise of your Lord when you rise

ayahs.text: and also celebrate His praise at night and at the retreat of the stars.
ayahs.translation: and also celebrate His praise at night and at the retreat of the stars.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: By the star when it sets:
verses.translation: By the star when it sets:

verses.text: your companion has neither strayed nor is he deluded;
verses.translation: your companion has neither strayed nor is he deluded;

verses.text: nor does he speak out of his desire.
verses.translation: nor does he speak out of his desire.

verses.text: This is nothing but a revelation that is conveyed to him
verses.translation: This is nothing but a revelation that is conveyed to him

verses.text: something that a very powerful one has imparted to him
verses.translation: something that a very powerful one has imparted to him

verses.text: one endowed with immense wisdom. He came forth and stood poised
verses.translation: one endowed with immense wisdom. He came forth and stood poised

verses.text: being on the higher horizon.
verses.translation: being on the higher horizon.

verses.text: Then he drew near and hung above suspended
verses.translation: Then he drew near and hung above suspended

verses.text: until he was two bows'' length away or nearer.
verses.translation: until he was two bows'' length away or nearer.

verses.text: Then he revealed to Allah''s servant whatever he had to reveal.
verses.translation: Then he revealed to Allah''s servant whatever he had to reveal.

verses.text: His heart added no untruth to what he saw.
verses.translation: His heart added no untruth to what he saw.

verses.text: Are you then going to contend with him regarding what he sees with his eyes?
verses.translation: Are you then going to contend with him regarding what he sees with his eyes?

verses.text: Indeed he saw him a second time
verses.translation: Indeed he saw him a second time

verses.text: by the lote-tree at the farthest boundary
verses.translation: by the lote-tree at the farthest boundary

verses.text: near which is the Garden of Abode.
verses.translation: near which is the Garden of Abode.

verses.text: (This was) when the lote-tree was covered with that which covered it.
verses.translation: (This was) when the lote-tree was covered with that which covered it.

verses.text: His eye did not waver nor did it stray
verses.translation: His eye did not waver nor did it stray

verses.text: and he certainly saw some of the greatest Signs of His Lord.
verses.translation: and he certainly saw some of the greatest Signs of His Lord.

verses.text: Have you ever thought about al-Lat and al-Uzza
verses.translation: Have you ever thought about al-Lat and al-Uzza

verses.text: and about the third deity al-Manat?
verses.translation: and about the third deity al-Manat?

verses.text: Shall you have the male issues and He the female issues?
verses.translation: Shall you have the male issues and He the female issues?

verses.text: That is indeed an unfair division!
verses.translation: That is indeed an unfair division!

verses.text: These are nothing but names that you and your forefathers have invented for which Allah has sent down no authority.They are merely following their conjectures and their carnal desires although guidance has come to them from their Lord.
verses.translation: These are nothing but names that you and your forefathers have invented for which Allah has sent down no authority.They are merely following their conjectures and their carnal desires although guidance has come to them from their Lord.

verses.text: Does man imagine that whatever he wishes for is right for him?
verses.translation: Does man imagine that whatever he wishes for is right for him?

verses.text: To Allah belong both the Next World and the present.
verses.translation: To Allah belong both the Next World and the present.

verses.text: Numerous are the angels in the heavens; yet their intercession shall be of no avail except in regard to those whom He grants the leave of intercession and whose plea He is pleased to accept.
verses.translation: Numerous are the angels in the heavens; yet their intercession shall be of no avail except in regard to those whom He grants the leave of intercession and whose plea He is pleased to accept.

verses.text: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter give angels the names of females
verses.translation: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter give angels the names of females

verses.text: although they have no knowledge regarding that. They only follow their conjecture and conjecture can never take the place of the Truth.
verses.translation: although they have no knowledge regarding that. They only follow their conjecture and conjecture can never take the place of the Truth.

verses.text: So leave alone those who turn away from the remembrance of Us and who seek nothing but the life of the world
verses.translation: So leave alone those who turn away from the remembrance of Us and who seek nothing but the life of the world

verses.text: that being the utmost of their knowledge. Surely your Lord fully knows those who have strayed away from His Path and He also fully knows those who are rightly guided.
verses.translation: that being the utmost of their knowledge. Surely your Lord fully knows those who have strayed away from His Path and He also fully knows those who are rightly guided.

verses.text: To Allah alone belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. He will requite the evil-doers for their deeds and bestow a goodly reward on those who have done good
verses.translation: To Allah alone belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. He will requite the evil-doers for their deeds and bestow a goodly reward on those who have done good

verses.text: on those who avoid grave sins and shameful deeds even if they may sometimes stumble into lesser offences. Surely your Lord is abounding in His Forgiveness. Very well is He aware of you since He produced you from the earth and while you were still in your mothers'' wombs and not yet born. So do not boastfully claim yourselves to be purified. He fully knows those that are truly Godfearing.

verses.translation: who gave a little and then stopped?

verses.text: Does he have any knowledge of the world beyond the ken of sense-perception and therefore clearly sees (the Truth)?

verses.text: Has he not been informed of what is in the Scrolls of Moses

verses.text: and of Abraham who lived up to the trust?

verses.text: That no bearer of a burden shall bear the burden of another

verses.text: and that the final end is with your Lord

verses.text: and that He it is Who causes people to laugh and to cry

verses.text: and that He it is Who causes death and grants life
verses.translation: and that He it is Who causes death and grants life

verses.text: and He it is Who created the two kinds the male and the female
verses.translation: and He it is Who created the two kinds the male and the female

verses.text: from a drop of sperm when it was emitted
verses.translation: from a drop of sperm when it was emitted

verses.text: and that it is for Him to grant the second life
verses.translation: and that it is for Him to grant the second life

verses.text: that He it is Who bestowed wealth and riches
verses.translation: that He it is Who bestowed wealth and riches

verses.text: that He is the Lord of Sirius
verses.translation: that He is the Lord of Sirius

verses.text: that He it is Who destroyed the ancient ''Ad
verses.translation: that He it is Who destroyed the ancient ''Ad

verses.text: and Thamud leaving no trace of them
verses.translation: and Thamud leaving no trace of them

verses.text: and that He it is Who destroyed the people of Noah before for they were much given to iniquity and transgression.
verses.translation: and that He it is Who destroyed the people of Noah before for they were much given to iniquity and transgression.

verses.text: And He brought perdition upon the subverted cities
verses.translation: And He brought perdition upon the subverted cities

verses.text: and caused them to be covered with that which He covered them with.
verses.translation: and caused them to be covered with that which He covered them with.

verses.text: So which of your Lord''s bounties will you doubt?
verses.translation: So which of your Lord''s bounties will you doubt?

verses.text: This is a warning among the warnings of yore.
verses.translation: This is a warning among the warnings of yore.

verses.text: The imminent Hour has drawn near
verses.translation: The imminent Hour has drawn near

verses.text: and none but Allah can avert it.
verses.translation: and none but Allah can avert it.

verses.text: Will you then wonder at this?
verses.translation: Will you then wonder at this?

verses.text: Will you laugh at it rather than weep?
verses.translation: Will you laugh at it rather than weep?

verses.text: Will you occupy yourselves simply in merriment?
verses.translation: Will you occupy yourselves simply in merriment?

verses.text: Prostrate yourselves before Allah and serve Him.

verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: The Hour of Resurrection drew near and the moon split asunder.
verses.translation: The Hour of Resurrection drew near and the moon split asunder.

verses.text: (Regardless of any Signs these people see) they turn away and say:  This is an ongoing sorcery.
verses.translation: (Regardless of any Signs these people see) they turn away and say:  This is an ongoing sorcery.

verses.text: They also gave the lie to (the splitting asunder of the moon) and only followed their desires. Yet everything is destined to reach an end.
verses.translation: They also gave the lie to (the splitting asunder of the moon) and only followed their desires. Yet everything is destined to reach an end.

verses.text: Surely there came to them narratives (of the ancient nations) that should suffice to deter (them from transgression)
verses.translation: Surely there came to them narratives (of the ancient nations) that should suffice to deter (them from transgression)

verses.text: narratives that are full of consummate wisdom. But warnings do not avail them.
verses.translation: narratives that are full of consummate wisdom. But warnings do not avail them.

verses.text: So turn away from them (O Prophet). On the Day when a caller shall call them to a thing most terrible
verses.translation: So turn away from them (O Prophet). On the Day when a caller shall call them to a thing most terrible

verses.text: with down-cast eyes they shall go forth from their graves as though they were scattered locusts.
verses.translation: with down-cast eyes they shall go forth from their graves as though they were scattered locusts.

verses.text: They shall be hurrying forth towards the caller and the unbelievers (who had once denied this Day) will say:  This is a woeful Day.
verses.translation: They shall be hurrying forth towards the caller and the unbelievers (who had once denied this Day) will say:  This is a woeful Day.

verses.text: Before them Noah''s people also gave the lie (to his Message). They rejected Our servant as a liar saying:  He is a madman ; and he was rebuffed.
verses.translation: Before them Noah''s people also gave the lie (to his Message). They rejected Our servant as a liar saying:  He is a madman ; and he was rebuffed.

verses.text: Then he called upon His Lord:  Verily I am vanquished; so come You to my aid.
verses.translation: Then he called upon His Lord:  Verily I am vanquished; so come You to my aid.

verses.text: Thereupon We opened the gates of the sky for water to pour down
verses.translation: Thereupon We opened the gates of the sky for water to pour down

verses.text: and We made the earth burst forth with springs and all this water converged to fulfil that which had been decreed.
verses.translation: and We made the earth burst forth with springs and all this water converged to fulfil that which had been decreed.

verses.text: And We bore Noah on the vessel built of planks and nails
verses.translation: And We bore Noah on the vessel built of planks and nails

verses.text: which sailed on under Our supervision: a reward for him who had been shown ingratitude.
verses.translation: which sailed on under Our supervision: a reward for him who had been shown ingratitude.

verses.text: And We left the Ark as a Sign. Is there then any who will take heed?
verses.translation: And We left the Ark as a Sign. Is there then any who will take heed?

verses.text: So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!
verses.translation: So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!

verses.text: We have made this Qur''an easy as a reminder. Is there then any who will take heed?
verses.translation: We have made this Qur''an easy as a reminder. Is there then any who will take heed?

verses.text: Ad also gave the lie (to Hud). So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!
verses.translation: Ad also gave the lie (to Hud). So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!

verses.text: We sent a tumultuous wind against them on a day of unremitting misfortune
verses.translation: We sent a tumultuous wind against them on a day of unremitting misfortune

verses.text: which tore people away and hurled them as though they were trunks of uprooted palm-trees.
verses.translation: which tore people away and hurled them as though they were trunks of uprooted palm-trees.

verses.text: So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!
verses.translation: So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!

verses.text: We have made the Qur''an easy to derive lessons from. Is there then any who will take heed?
verses.translation: We have made the Qur''an easy to derive lessons from. Is there then any who will take heed?

verses.text: Thamud gave the lie to the warnings
verses.translation: Thamud gave the lie to the warnings

verses.text: saying:  Are we to follow a single mortal one from among ourselves? If we do that we shall surely be in error and folly.
verses.translation: saying:  Are we to follow a single mortal one from among ourselves? If we do that we shall surely be in error and folly.

verses.text: Was there none but he to whom the Reminder could be vouchsafed excluding all others? Nay; he is an insolent liar.
verses.translation: Was there none but he to whom the Reminder could be vouchsafed excluding all others? Nay; he is an insolent liar.

verses.text: (We told Our Messenger):  Tomorrow they shall know who is the insolent liar.
verses.translation: (We told Our Messenger):  Tomorrow they shall know who is the insolent liar.

verses.text: We shall send the she-camel as a trial for them; so watch their end with patience.
verses.translation: We shall send the she-camel as a trial for them; so watch their end with patience.

verses.text: Let them know that the water should be divided between them and the she-camel each availing their turn.
verses.translation: Let them know that the water should be divided between them and the she-camel each availing their turn.

verses.text: Eventually they summoned their companion and he undertook the (outrageous) task and hamstrung the she-camel.
verses.translation: Eventually they summoned their companion and he undertook the (outrageous) task and hamstrung the she-camel.

verses.text: So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!
verses.translation: So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!

verses.text: Behold We sent a single Blast against them and they became like the trampled twigs of a sheep pen-builder.
verses.translation: Behold We sent a single Blast against them and they became like the trampled twigs of a sheep pen-builder.

verses.text: Surely We have made this Qur''an easy as a reminder. Is there then any who will take heed?
verses.translation: Surely We have made this Qur''an easy as a reminder. Is there then any who will take heed?

verses.text: Lot''s people also gave the lie to the warnings
verses.translation: Lot''s people also gave the lie to the warnings

verses.text: and behold We let loose upon them a tempest which rained stones upon them except upon Lot''s household whom We rescued in the last hours of the night
verses.translation: and behold We let loose upon them a tempest which rained stones upon them except upon Lot''s household whom We rescued in the last hours of the night

verses.text: as a favour from Us. Thus do We reward those who give thanks.
verses.translation: as a favour from Us. Thus do We reward those who give thanks.

verses.text: Surely Lot warned his people that We shall seize them (with Our chastisement) but they doubted the warnings.
verses.translation: Surely Lot warned his people that We shall seize them (with Our chastisement) but they doubted the warnings.

verses.text: Then they even solicited his guests from him whereupon We blotted out their eyes (telling them):  Now have a taste of My chastisement and My warnings.
verses.translation: Then they even solicited his guests from him whereupon We blotted out their eyes (telling them):  Now have a taste of My chastisement and My warnings.

verses.text: Indeed an abiding chastisement came upon them in the morning.
verses.translation: Indeed an abiding chastisement came upon them in the morning.

verses.text: So have a taste of My chastisement and My warnings.
verses.translation: So have a taste of My chastisement and My warnings.

verses.text: Surely We have made this Qur''an easy as a reminder. Is there then any who will take heed?
verses.translation: Surely We have made this Qur''an easy as a reminder. Is there then any who will take heed?

verses.text: Warnings also came to the Pharaonites
verses.translation: Warnings also came to the Pharaonites

verses.text: but they gave the lie to Our Signs to all of them. Thereupon We seized them with the seizing of the Most Mighty the Most Powerful.
verses.translation: but they gave the lie to Our Signs to all of them. Thereupon We seized them with the seizing of the Most Mighty the Most Powerful.

verses.text: Are your unbelievers (of Makkah) any better than they? Or have you been granted any immunity in the Scriptures?
verses.translation: Are your unbelievers (of Makkah) any better than they? Or have you been granted any immunity in the Scriptures?

verses.text: Or do they say:  We are a strong legion strong enough for victory?
verses.translation: Or do they say:  We are a strong legion strong enough for victory?

verses.text: Soon shall this legion be routed and shall turn their backs and flee.
verses.translation: Soon shall this legion be routed and shall turn their backs and flee.

verses.text: Nay; the Hour of Doom is their appointed time and the Hour shall be more calamitous and bitter.
verses.translation: Nay; the Hour of Doom is their appointed time and the Hour shall be more calamitous and bitter.

verses.text: The evil-doers are victims of error and madness.
verses.translation: The evil-doers are victims of error and madness.

verses.text: There shall come a Day when they will be dragged on their faces into the Fire and will be told:  Now taste the flame of Hell.
verses.translation: There shall come a Day when they will be dragged on their faces into the Fire and will be told:  Now taste the flame of Hell.

verses.text: We have created everything in a determined measure.
verses.translation: We have created everything in a determined measure.

verses.text: Our command consists of only one Word which is carried out in the twinkling of an eye.
verses.translation: Our command consists of only one Word which is carried out in the twinkling of an eye.

verses.text: We did indeed destroy many like you. Is there then any who will heed?
verses.translation: We did indeed destroy many like you. Is there then any who will heed?

verses.text: All their deeds are recorded in the Scrolls;
verses.translation: All their deeds are recorded in the Scrolls;

verses.text: everything large or small is duly inscribed.
verses.translation: everything large or small is duly inscribed.

verses.text: Surely those who shun disobedience will dwell amidst Gardens and running streams
verses.translation: Surely those who shun disobedience will dwell amidst Gardens and running streams

verses.text: where they will be honourably seated in the presence of a King Mighty in Power.
verses.translation: where they will be honourably seated in the presence of a King Mighty in Power.

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: The Hour of Resurrection drew near and the moon split asunder.
ayahs.translation: The Hour of Resurrection drew near and the moon split asunder.

ayahs.text: (Regardless of any Signs these people see) they turn away and say:  This is an ongoing sorcery.
ayahs.translation: (Regardless of any Signs these people see) they turn away and say:  This is an ongoing sorcery.

ayahs.text: They also gave the lie to (the splitting asunder of the moon) and only followed their desires. Yet everything is destined to reach an end.
ayahs.translation: They also gave the lie to (the splitting asunder of the moon) and only followed their desires. Yet everything is destined to reach an end.

ayahs.text: Surely there came to them narratives (of the ancient nations) that should suffice to deter (them from transgression)
ayahs.translation: Surely there came to them narratives (of the ancient nations) that should suffice to deter (them from transgression)

ayahs.text: narratives that are full of consummate wisdom. But warnings do not avail them.
ayahs.translation: narratives that are full of consummate wisdom. But warnings do not avail them.

ayahs.text: So turn away from them (O Prophet). On the Day when a caller shall call them to a thing most terrible
ayahs.translation: So turn away from them (O Prophet). On the Day when a caller shall call them to a thing most terrible

ayahs.text: with down-cast eyes they shall go forth from their graves as though they were scattered locusts.
ayahs.translation: with down-cast eyes they shall go forth from their graves as though they were scattered locusts.

ayahs.text: They shall be hurrying forth towards the caller and the unbelievers (who had once denied this Day) will say:  This is a woeful Day.
ayahs.translation: They shall be hurrying forth towards the caller and the unbelievers (who had once denied this Day) will say:  This is a woeful Day.

ayahs.text: Before them Noah''s people also gave the lie (to his Message). They rejected Our servant as a liar saying:  He is a madman ; and he was rebuffed.
ayahs.translation: Before them Noah''s people also gave the lie (to his Message). They rejected Our servant as a liar saying:  He is a madman ; and he was rebuffed.

ayahs.text: Then he called upon His Lord:  Verily I am vanquished; so come You to my aid.
ayahs.translation: Then he called upon His Lord:  Verily I am vanquished; so come You to my aid.

ayahs.text: Thereupon We opened the gates of the sky for water to pour down
ayahs.translation: Thereupon We opened the gates of the sky for water to pour down

ayahs.text: and We made the earth burst forth with springs and all this water converged to fulfil that which had been decreed.
ayahs.translation: and We made the earth burst forth with springs and all this water converged to fulfil that which had been decreed.

ayahs.text: And We bore Noah on the vessel built of planks and nails
ayahs.translation: And We bore Noah on the vessel built of planks and nails

ayahs.text: which sailed on under Our supervision: a reward for him who had been shown ingratitude.
ayahs.translation: which sailed on under Our supervision: a reward for him who had been shown ingratitude.

ayahs.text: And We left the Ark as a Sign. Is there then any who will take heed?
ayahs.translation: And We left the Ark as a Sign. Is there then any who will take heed?

ayahs.text: So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!
ayahs.translation: So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!

ayahs.text: We have made this Qur''an easy as a reminder. Is there then any who will take heed?
ayahs.translation: We have made this Qur''an easy as a reminder. Is there then any who will take heed?

ayahs.text: Ad also gave the lie (to Hud). So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!
ayahs.translation: Ad also gave the lie (to Hud). So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!

ayahs.text: We sent a tumultuous wind against them on a day of unremitting misfortune
ayahs.translation: We sent a tumultuous wind against them on a day of unremitting misfortune

ayahs.text: which tore people away and hurled them as though they were trunks of uprooted palm-trees.
ayahs.translation: which tore people away and hurled them as though they were trunks of uprooted palm-trees.

ayahs.text: So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!
ayahs.translation: So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!

ayahs.text: We have made the Qur''an easy to derive lessons from. Is there then any who will take heed?
ayahs.translation: We have made the Qur''an easy to derive lessons from. Is there then any who will take heed?

ayahs.text: Thamud gave the lie to the warnings
ayahs.translation: Thamud gave the lie to the warnings

ayahs.text: saying:  Are we to follow a single mortal one from among ourselves? If we do that we shall surely be in error and folly.
ayahs.translation: saying:  Are we to follow a single mortal one from among ourselves? If we do that we shall surely be in error and folly.

ayahs.text: Was there none but he to whom the Reminder could be vouchsafed excluding all others? Nay; he is an insolent liar.
ayahs.translation: Was there none but he to whom the Reminder could be vouchsafed excluding all others? Nay; he is an insolent liar.

ayahs.text: (We told Our Messenger):  Tomorrow they shall know who is the insolent liar.
ayahs.translation: (We told Our Messenger):  Tomorrow they shall know who is the insolent liar.

ayahs.text: We shall send the she-camel as a trial for them; so watch their end with patience.
ayahs.translation: We shall send the she-camel as a trial for them; so watch their end with patience.

ayahs.text: Let them know that the water should be divided between them and the she-camel each availing their turn.
ayahs.translation: Let them know that the water should be divided between them and the she-camel each availing their turn.

ayahs.text: Eventually they summoned their companion and he undertook the (outrageous) task and hamstrung the she-camel.
ayahs.translation: Eventually they summoned their companion and he undertook the (outrageous) task and hamstrung the she-camel.

ayahs.text: So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!
ayahs.translation: So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!

ayahs.text: Behold We sent a single Blast against them and they became like the trampled twigs of a sheep pen-builder.
ayahs.translation: Behold We sent a single Blast against them and they became like the trampled twigs of a sheep pen-builder.

ayahs.translation: Surely We have made this Qur''an easy as a reminder. Is there then any who will take heed?

ayahs.translation: Warnings also came to the Pharaonites

ayahs.translation: Surely those who shun disobedience will dwell amidst Gardens and running streams

ayahs.text: where they will be honourably seated in the presence of a King Mighty in Power.
ayahs.translation: where they will be honourably seated in the presence of a King Mighty in Power.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: The Merciful One
verses.translation: The Merciful One

verses.text: has taught the Qur''an
verses.translation: has taught the Qur''an

verses.text: has created man
verses.translation: has created man

verses.text: and has taught him articulate speech.
verses.translation: and has taught him articulate speech.

verses.text: The sun and the moon follow a reckoning
verses.translation: The sun and the moon follow a reckoning

verses.text: and the stars and the trees all prostrate themselves
verses.translation: and the stars and the trees all prostrate themselves

verses.text: and He has raised up the heaven and has set a balance
verses.translation: and He has raised up the heaven and has set a balance

verses.text: that you may not transgress in the balance
verses.translation: that you may not transgress in the balance

verses.text: but weigh things equitably and skimp not in the balance.
verses.translation: but weigh things equitably and skimp not in the balance.

verses.text: And He has set up the earth for all beings.
verses.translation: And He has set up the earth for all beings.

verses.text: Therein are fruit and palm-trees with their dates in sheaths
verses.translation: Therein are fruit and palm-trees with their dates in sheaths

verses.text: and a variety of corn with both husk and grain.
verses.translation: and a variety of corn with both husk and grain.

verses.text: Which of the bounties of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
verses.translation: Which of the bounties of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

verses.text: He has created man from dry rotten clay like the potter''s
verses.translation: He has created man from dry rotten clay like the potter''s

verses.text: and has created the jinn from the flame of fire.
verses.translation: and has created the jinn from the flame of fire.

verses.text: Which of the wonders of your Lord''s power will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
verses.translation: Which of the wonders of your Lord''s power will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

verses.text: Lord of the two easts and of the two wests is He.
verses.translation: Lord of the two easts and of the two wests is He.

verses.text: Which of the powers of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
verses.translation: Which of the powers of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

verses.text: He unleashed the two seas so that they merge together
verses.translation: He unleashed the two seas so that they merge together

verses.text: and yet there is a barrier between them which they may not overstep.
verses.translation: and yet there is a barrier between them which they may not overstep.

verses.text: Which of the wonders of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
verses.translation: Which of the wonders of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

verses.text: From these seas come forth pearls and coral.
verses.translation: From these seas come forth pearls and coral.

verses.text: Which of the wonders of your Lord''s power will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
verses.translation: Which of the wonders of your Lord''s power will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

verses.text: His are the ships towering on the sea like mountains.
verses.translation: His are the ships towering on the sea like mountains.

verses.text: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
verses.translation: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

verses.text: All that is on earth will perish
verses.translation: All that is on earth will perish

verses.text: only the Person of your Lord full of majesty and splendour will endure.
verses.translation: only the Person of your Lord full of majesty and splendour will endure.

verses.text: So which of the wonders of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
verses.translation: So which of the wonders of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

verses.text: All in the heavens and the earth entreat Him for their needs; a new mighty task engages Him each day.
verses.translation: All in the heavens and the earth entreat Him for their needs; a new mighty task engages Him each day.

verses.text: Which of your Lord''s laudable attributes will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
verses.translation: Which of your Lord''s laudable attributes will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

verses.text: O you twain who are a burden (on the earth) We shall attend to you and call you to account.
verses.translation: O you twain who are a burden (on the earth) We shall attend to you and call you to account.

verses.text: (We shall then see) which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
verses.translation: (We shall then see) which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

verses.text: O company of jinn and men if you have the power to go beyond the bounds of the heavens and the earth go beyond them! Yet you will be unable to go beyond them for that requires infinite power.
verses.translation: O company of jinn and men if you have the power to go beyond the bounds of the heavens and the earth go beyond them! Yet you will be unable to go beyond them for that requires infinite power.

verses.text: Which of your Lord''s powers will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
verses.translation: Which of your Lord''s powers will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

verses.text: (If you so venture) a flame of fire and smoke shall be lashed at you which you shall be unable to withstand.
verses.translation: (If you so venture) a flame of fire and smoke shall be lashed at you which you shall be unable to withstand.

verses.text: Which of your Lord''s powers will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
verses.translation: Which of your Lord''s powers will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

verses.text: (What will happen) when the heaven will be split asunder and will become crimson like leather?
verses.translation: (What will happen) when the heaven will be split asunder and will become crimson like leather?

verses.text: Which of your Lord''s powers will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
verses.translation: Which of your Lord''s powers will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

verses.text: On that Day there will be no need to ask either men or jinn about their sins.
verses.translation: On that Day there will be no need to ask either men or jinn about their sins.

verses.text: (We shall see) which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
verses.translation: (We shall see) which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

verses.text: The culprits shall be known by their marks and shall be seized by their forelocks and their feet.
verses.translation: The culprits shall be known by their marks and shall be seized by their forelocks and their feet.

verses.text: Which of the powers of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
verses.translation: Which of the powers of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

verses.text: (It will be said):  This is the Hell that the culprits had cried lies to.
verses.translation: (It will be said):  This is the Hell that the culprits had cried lies to.

verses.text: They will keep circling around between Hell and boiling water.
verses.translation: They will keep circling around between Hell and boiling water.

verses.text: Which of your Lord''s powers will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
verses.translation: Which of your Lord''s powers will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

verses.text: For any who fears to stand before his Lord are two Gardens.
verses.translation: For any who fears to stand before his Lord are two Gardens.

verses.text: Which of your Lord''s favours will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
verses.translation: Which of your Lord''s favours will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

verses.text: These Gardens will abound in green blooming branches.
verses.translation: These Gardens will abound in green blooming branches.

verses.text: Which of your Lord''s favours will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
verses.translation: Which of your Lord''s favours will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

verses.text: In each of the two Gardens are two flowing springs.
verses.translation: In each of the two Gardens are two flowing springs.

verses.text: Which of your Lord''s favours will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
verses.translation: Which of your Lord''s favours will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

verses.text: In both these is a pair of every fruit.
verses.translation: In both these is a pair of every fruit.

verses.text: Which of your Lord''s favours will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
verses.translation: Which of your Lord''s favours will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

verses.text: They shall recline on couches lined with brocade and within reach shall hang the fruits of the two Gardens.
verses.translation: They shall recline on couches lined with brocade and within reach shall hang the fruits of the two Gardens.

verses.text: Which of your Lord''s favours will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
verses.translation: Which of your Lord''s favours will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

verses.text: In the midst of these shall be maidens with modest restrained glances; maidens whom no man or jinn has ever touched before.
verses.translation: In the midst of these shall be maidens with modest restrained glances; maidens whom no man or jinn has ever touched before.

verses.text: Which of your Lord''s favours will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
verses.translation: Which of your Lord''s favours will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

verses.text: Lovely as rubies and pearls.
verses.translation: Lovely as rubies and pearls.

verses.text: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
verses.translation: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

verses.text: Can the reward of goodness be any other than goodness?
verses.translation: Can the reward of goodness be any other than goodness?

verses.text: Which of the laudable attributes of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
verses.translation: Which of the laudable attributes of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

verses.text: And besides these two there shall be two other Gardens.
verses.translation: And besides these two there shall be two other Gardens.

verses.text: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
verses.translation: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

verses.text: Two Gardens dark green and fresh.
verses.translation: Two Gardens dark green and fresh.

verses.text: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
verses.translation: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

verses.text: In them will be two gushing springs.
verses.translation: In them will be two gushing springs.

verses.text: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
verses.translation: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

verses.text: Therein will be fruits and dates and pomegranates.
verses.translation: Therein will be fruits and dates and pomegranates.

verses.text: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
verses.translation: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

verses.text: In the midst of these will be maidens good and comely.
verses.translation: In the midst of these will be maidens good and comely.

verses.text: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
verses.translation: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

verses.text: There shall be maidens sheltered in tents.
verses.translation: There shall be maidens sheltered in tents.

verses.text: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
verses.translation: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

verses.text: No man or jinn ever touched them before.
verses.translation: No man or jinn ever touched them before.

verses.text: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
verses.translation: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

verses.text: They shall be reclining on green cushions and splendid carpets.
verses.translation: They shall be reclining on green cushions and splendid carpets.

verses.text: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
verses.translation: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

verses.text: Blessed be the name of your Lord the Lord of Majesty and Glory.
verses.translation: Blessed be the name of your Lord the Lord of Majesty and Glory.

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: The Merciful One
ayahs.translation: The Merciful One

ayahs.text: has taught the Qur''an
ayahs.translation: has taught the Qur''an

ayahs.text: has created man
ayahs.translation: has created man

ayahs.text: and has taught him articulate speech.
ayahs.translation: and has taught him articulate speech.

ayahs.text: The sun and the moon follow a reckoning
ayahs.translation: The sun and the moon follow a reckoning

ayahs.text: and the stars and the trees all prostrate themselves
ayahs.translation: and the stars and the trees all prostrate themselves

ayahs.text: and He has raised up the heaven and has set a balance
ayahs.translation: and He has raised up the heaven and has set a balance

ayahs.text: that you may not transgress in the balance
ayahs.translation: that you may not transgress in the balance

ayahs.text: but weigh things equitably and skimp not in the balance.
ayahs.translation: but weigh things equitably and skimp not in the balance.

ayahs.text: And He has set up the earth for all beings.
ayahs.translation: And He has set up the earth for all beings.

ayahs.text: Therein are fruit and palm-trees with their dates in sheaths
ayahs.translation: Therein are fruit and palm-trees with their dates in sheaths

ayahs.text: and a variety of corn with both husk and grain.
ayahs.translation: and a variety of corn with both husk and grain.

ayahs.text: Which of the bounties of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
ayahs.translation: Which of the bounties of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

ayahs.text: He has created man from dry rotten clay like the potter''s
ayahs.translation: He has created man from dry rotten clay like the potter''s

ayahs.text: and has created the jinn from the flame of fire.
ayahs.translation: and has created the jinn from the flame of fire.

ayahs.text: Which of the wonders of your Lord''s power will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
ayahs.translation: Which of the wonders of your Lord''s power will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

ayahs.text: Lord of the two easts and of the two wests is He.
ayahs.translation: Lord of the two easts and of the two wests is He.

ayahs.text: Which of the powers of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
ayahs.translation: Which of the powers of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

ayahs.text: He unleashed the two seas so that they merge together
ayahs.translation: He unleashed the two seas so that they merge together

ayahs.text: and yet there is a barrier between them which they may not overstep.
ayahs.translation: and yet there is a barrier between them which they may not overstep.

ayahs.text: Which of the wonders of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
ayahs.translation: Which of the wonders of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

ayahs.text: From these seas come forth pearls and coral.
ayahs.translation: From these seas come forth pearls and coral.

ayahs.text: Which of the wonders of your Lord''s power will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
ayahs.translation: Which of the wonders of your Lord''s power will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

ayahs.text: His are the ships towering on the sea like mountains.
ayahs.translation: His are the ships towering on the sea like mountains.

ayahs.text: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
ayahs.translation: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

ayahs.text: All that is on earth will perish
ayahs.translation: All that is on earth will perish

ayahs.text: only the Person of your Lord full of majesty and splendour will endure.
ayahs.translation: only the Person of your Lord full of majesty and splendour will endure.

ayahs.text: So which of the wonders of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
ayahs.translation: So which of the wonders of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

ayahs.text: All in the heavens and the earth entreat Him for their needs; a new mighty task engages Him each day.
ayahs.translation: All in the heavens and the earth entreat Him for their needs; a new mighty task engages Him each day.

ayahs.text: Which of your Lord''s laudable attributes will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
ayahs.translation: Which of your Lord''s laudable attributes will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

ayahs.text: O you twain who are a burden (on the earth) We shall attend to you and call you to account.
