ayahs.translation: O you twain who are a burden (on the earth) We shall attend to you and call you to account.

ayahs.text: (We shall then see) which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
ayahs.translation: (We shall then see) which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

ayahs.text: O company of jinn and men if you have the power to go beyond the bounds of the heavens and the earth go beyond them! Yet you will be unable to go beyond them for that requires infinite power.
ayahs.translation: O company of jinn and men if you have the power to go beyond the bounds of the heavens and the earth go beyond them! Yet you will be unable to go beyond them for that requires infinite power.

ayahs.text: Which of your Lord''s powers will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
ayahs.translation: Which of your Lord''s powers will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

ayahs.text: (If you so venture) a flame of fire and smoke shall be lashed at you which you shall be unable to withstand.
ayahs.translation: (If you so venture) a flame of fire and smoke shall be lashed at you which you shall be unable to withstand.

ayahs.text: Which of your Lord''s powers will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
ayahs.translation: Which of your Lord''s powers will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

ayahs.text: (What will happen) when the heaven will be split asunder and will become crimson like leather?
ayahs.translation: (What will happen) when the heaven will be split asunder and will become crimson like leather?

ayahs.text: Which of your Lord''s powers will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
ayahs.translation: Which of your Lord''s powers will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

ayahs.text: On that Day there will be no need to ask either men or jinn about their sins.
ayahs.translation: On that Day there will be no need to ask either men or jinn about their sins.

ayahs.text: (We shall see) which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
ayahs.translation: (We shall see) which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

ayahs.text: The culprits shall be known by their marks and shall be seized by their forelocks and their feet.
ayahs.translation: The culprits shall be known by their marks and shall be seized by their forelocks and their feet.

ayahs.text: Which of the powers of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
ayahs.translation: Which of the powers of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

ayahs.text: (It will be said):  This is the Hell that the culprits had cried lies to.
ayahs.translation: (It will be said):  This is the Hell that the culprits had cried lies to.

ayahs.text: They will keep circling around between Hell and boiling water.
ayahs.translation: They will keep circling around between Hell and boiling water.

ayahs.text: Which of your Lord''s powers will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
ayahs.translation: Which of your Lord''s powers will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

ayahs.text: For any who fears to stand before his Lord are two Gardens.
ayahs.translation: For any who fears to stand before his Lord are two Gardens.

ayahs.text: Which of your Lord''s favours will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
ayahs.translation: Which of your Lord''s favours will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

ayahs.text: These Gardens will abound in green blooming branches.
ayahs.translation: These Gardens will abound in green blooming branches.

ayahs.text: Which of your Lord''s favours will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
ayahs.translation: Which of your Lord''s favours will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

ayahs.text: In each of the two Gardens are two flowing springs.
ayahs.translation: In each of the two Gardens are two flowing springs.

ayahs.text: Which of your Lord''s favours will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
ayahs.translation: Which of your Lord''s favours will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

ayahs.text: In both these is a pair of every fruit.
ayahs.translation: In both these is a pair of every fruit.

ayahs.text: Which of your Lord''s favours will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
ayahs.translation: Which of your Lord''s favours will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

ayahs.text: They shall recline on couches lined with brocade and within reach shall hang the fruits of the two Gardens.
ayahs.translation: They shall recline on couches lined with brocade and within reach shall hang the fruits of the two Gardens.

ayahs.text: Which of your Lord''s favours will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
ayahs.translation: Which of your Lord''s favours will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

ayahs.text: In the midst of these shall be maidens with modest restrained glances; maidens whom no man or jinn has ever touched before.
ayahs.translation: In the midst of these shall be maidens with modest restrained glances; maidens whom no man or jinn has ever touched before.

ayahs.text: Which of your Lord''s favours will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
ayahs.translation: Which of your Lord''s favours will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

ayahs.text: Lovely as rubies and pearls.
ayahs.translation: Lovely as rubies and pearls.

ayahs.text: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
ayahs.translation: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

ayahs.text: Can the reward of goodness be any other than goodness?
ayahs.translation: Can the reward of goodness be any other than goodness?

ayahs.text: Which of the laudable attributes of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
ayahs.translation: Which of the laudable attributes of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

ayahs.text: And besides these two there shall be two other Gardens.
ayahs.translation: And besides these two there shall be two other Gardens.

ayahs.text: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
ayahs.translation: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

ayahs.text: Two Gardens dark green and fresh.
ayahs.translation: Two Gardens dark green and fresh.

ayahs.text: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
ayahs.translation: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

ayahs.text: In them will be two gushing springs.
ayahs.translation: In them will be two gushing springs.

ayahs.text: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
ayahs.translation: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

ayahs.text: Therein will be fruits and dates and pomegranates.
ayahs.translation: Therein will be fruits and dates and pomegranates.

ayahs.text: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
ayahs.translation: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

ayahs.text: In the midst of these will be maidens good and comely.
ayahs.translation: In the midst of these will be maidens good and comely.

ayahs.text: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
ayahs.translation: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

ayahs.text: There shall be maidens sheltered in tents.
ayahs.translation: There shall be maidens sheltered in tents.

ayahs.text: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
ayahs.translation: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

ayahs.text: No man or jinn ever touched them before.
ayahs.translation: No man or jinn ever touched them before.

ayahs.text: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
ayahs.translation: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

ayahs.text: They shall be reclining on green cushions and splendid carpets.
ayahs.translation: They shall be reclining on green cushions and splendid carpets.

ayahs.text: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?
ayahs.translation: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain   you men and jinn   then deny?

ayahs.text: Blessed be the name of your Lord the Lord of Majesty and Glory.
ayahs.translation: Blessed be the name of your Lord the Lord of Majesty and Glory.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: When the Event will come to pass
verses.translation: When the Event will come to pass

verses.text: and then there will be no one to deny its occurrence
verses.translation: and then there will be no one to deny its occurrence

verses.text: (a calamitous Event) that shall turn things upside down:
verses.translation: (a calamitous Event) that shall turn things upside down:

verses.text: when the earth will suddenly shake with a terrible shaking
verses.translation: when the earth will suddenly shake with a terrible shaking

verses.text: and the mountains will crumble
verses.translation: and the mountains will crumble

verses.text: and will scatter abroad into fine dust.
verses.translation: and will scatter abroad into fine dust.

verses.text: You shall then become three groups.
verses.translation: You shall then become three groups.

verses.text: The People on the Right: and how fortunate will be the People on the Right!
verses.translation: The People on the Right: and how fortunate will be the People on the Right!

verses.text: And the People on the Left: and how miserable will be the People on the Left!
verses.translation: And the People on the Left: and how miserable will be the People on the Left!

verses.text: As for the Foremost they will be the foremost!
verses.translation: As for the Foremost they will be the foremost!

verses.text: They shall be near-stationed (to their Lord)
verses.translation: They shall be near-stationed (to their Lord)

verses.text: in the Gardens of Bliss.
verses.translation: in the Gardens of Bliss.

verses.text: A throng of the ancients
verses.translation: A throng of the ancients

verses.text: and a few from later times.
verses.translation: and a few from later times.

verses.text: They (will be seated) on gold-encrusted couches
verses.translation: They (will be seated) on gold-encrusted couches

verses.text: reclining on them arrayed face to face;
verses.translation: reclining on them arrayed face to face;

verses.text: immortal youths shall go about them
verses.translation: immortal youths shall go about them

verses.text: with goblets and ewers and a cup filled with a drink drawn from a running spring
verses.translation: with goblets and ewers and a cup filled with a drink drawn from a running spring

verses.text: a drink by which their minds will not be clouded nor will it cause drunkenness;
verses.translation: a drink by which their minds will not be clouded nor will it cause drunkenness;

verses.text: they will also go about them with the fruits of which they may choose
verses.translation: they will also go about them with the fruits of which they may choose

verses.text: and with the flesh of any fowl that they may desire to eat;
verses.translation: and with the flesh of any fowl that they may desire to eat;

verses.text: and there shall be wide-eyed maidens
verses.translation: and there shall be wide-eyed maidens

verses.text: beautiful as pearls hidden in their shells.
verses.translation: beautiful as pearls hidden in their shells.

verses.text: All this shall be theirs as a reward for their deeds.
verses.translation: All this shall be theirs as a reward for their deeds.

verses.text: There they shall hear no idle talk nor any sinful speech.
verses.translation: There they shall hear no idle talk nor any sinful speech.

verses.text: All talk will be sound and upright.
verses.translation: All talk will be sound and upright.

verses.text: As for the People on the Right how fortunate shall be the people on the Right!
verses.translation: As for the People on the Right how fortunate shall be the people on the Right!

verses.text: They shall be in the midst of thornless lote trees
verses.translation: They shall be in the midst of thornless lote trees

verses.text: and flower-clad acacias
verses.translation: and flower-clad acacias

verses.text: and extended shade
verses.translation: and extended shade

verses.text: and gushing water
verses.translation: and gushing water

verses.text: and abundant fruit
verses.translation: and abundant fruit

verses.text: never-ending and unforbidden.
verses.translation: never-ending and unforbidden.

verses.text: They shall be on upraised couches
verses.translation: They shall be on upraised couches

verses.text: and their spouses We shall have brought them into being afresh
verses.translation: and their spouses We shall have brought them into being afresh

verses.text: and shall have made them virgins
verses.translation: and shall have made them virgins

verses.text: intensely loving and of matching age.
verses.translation: intensely loving and of matching age.

verses.text: All this will be for the People on the Right;
verses.translation: All this will be for the People on the Right;

verses.text: a large throng from the ancients
verses.translation: a large throng from the ancients

verses.text: and also a large throng from those of later times.
verses.translation: and also a large throng from those of later times.

verses.text: As for the People on the Left: how miserable will be the People on the Left!
verses.translation: As for the People on the Left: how miserable will be the People on the Left!

verses.text: They will be in the midst of scorching wind and boiling water
verses.translation: They will be in the midst of scorching wind and boiling water

verses.text: and a shade of thick pitch-black smoke
verses.translation: and a shade of thick pitch-black smoke

verses.text: which will neither be cool nor soothing.
verses.translation: which will neither be cool nor soothing.

verses.text: Surely they had lived before in luxury
verses.translation: Surely they had lived before in luxury

verses.text: and had persisted in the Great Sin.
verses.translation: and had persisted in the Great Sin.

verses.text: They used to say:  What! Once we are dead and are reduced to dust and bones shall we still be raised to a new life from the dead?
verses.translation: They used to say:  What! Once we are dead and are reduced to dust and bones shall we still be raised to a new life from the dead?

verses.text: (We) and our fore-fathers of yore?
verses.translation: (We) and our fore-fathers of yore?

verses.text: Tell them (O Prophet):  The earlier ones and the later ones
verses.translation: Tell them (O Prophet):  The earlier ones and the later ones

verses.text: shall all be brought together on an appointed Day.
verses.translation: shall all be brought together on an appointed Day.

verses.text: Then you the erring ones and those that gave the lie to the Truth
verses.translation: Then you the erring ones and those that gave the lie to the Truth

verses.text: shall all eat from the Tree of al-Zaqqum
verses.translation: shall all eat from the Tree of al-Zaqqum

verses.text: filling your bellies with it;
verses.translation: filling your bellies with it;

verses.text: and thereupon you shall drink boiling water
verses.translation: and thereupon you shall drink boiling water

verses.text: drinking it as thirsty camels do.
verses.translation: drinking it as thirsty camels do.

verses.text: Thus shall they be entertained on the Day of Recompense.
verses.translation: Thus shall they be entertained on the Day of Recompense.

verses.text: We have created you then why would you not confirm it?
verses.translation: We have created you then why would you not confirm it?

verses.text: Did you ever consider the sperm that you emit?
verses.translation: Did you ever consider the sperm that you emit?

verses.text: Do you create a child out of it or are We its creators?
verses.translation: Do you create a child out of it or are We its creators?

verses.text: It is We Who ordained death upon you and We are not to be frustrated.
verses.translation: It is We Who ordained death upon you and We are not to be frustrated.

verses.text: Had We so wished nothing could have hindered Us from replacing you by others like yourselves or transforming you into beings you know nothing about.
verses.translation: Had We so wished nothing could have hindered Us from replacing you by others like yourselves or transforming you into beings you know nothing about.

verses.text: You are well aware of the first creation; then do you learn no lesson from it?
verses.translation: You are well aware of the first creation; then do you learn no lesson from it?

verses.text: Have you considered the seeds you till?
verses.translation: Have you considered the seeds you till?

verses.text: Is it you or We Who make them grow?
verses.translation: Is it you or We Who make them grow?

verses.text: If We so wished We could have reduced your harvest to rubble and you would have been left wonder-struck to exclaim:
verses.translation: If We so wished We could have reduced your harvest to rubble and you would have been left wonder-struck to exclaim:

verses.text: We have been penalised;
verses.translation: We have been penalised;

verses.text: nay; we have been undone!
verses.translation: nay; we have been undone!

verses.text: Did you cast a good look at the water that you drink?
verses.translation: Did you cast a good look at the water that you drink?

verses.text: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds or is it We Who brought it down?
verses.translation: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds or is it We Who brought it down?

verses.text: If We had so pleased We could have made it bitter. So why would you not give thanks?
verses.translation: If We had so pleased We could have made it bitter. So why would you not give thanks?

verses.text: Did you consider the fire which you kindle?
verses.translation: Did you consider the fire which you kindle?

verses.text: Did you make its tree grow or was it We Who made it grow?
verses.translation: Did you make its tree grow or was it We Who made it grow?

verses.text: We made it a reminder and a provision for the needy.
verses.translation: We made it a reminder and a provision for the needy.

verses.text: Glorify then (O Prophet) the name of your Great Lord.
verses.translation: Glorify then (O Prophet) the name of your Great Lord.

verses.text: No! I swear by the positions of the stars
verses.translation: No! I swear by the positions of the stars

verses.text: and this is indeed a mighty oath if only you knew
verses.translation: and this is indeed a mighty oath if only you knew

verses.text: that this indeed is a noble Qur''an
verses.translation: that this indeed is a noble Qur''an

verses.text: inscribed in a well-guarded Book
verses.translation: inscribed in a well-guarded Book

verses.text: which none but the pure may touch;
verses.translation: which none but the pure may touch;

verses.text: a revelation from the Lord of the Universe.
verses.translation: a revelation from the Lord of the Universe.

verses.text: Do you then take this discourse in light esteem
verses.translation: Do you then take this discourse in light esteem

verses.text: and your portion in it is simply that you denounce it as false?
verses.translation: and your portion in it is simply that you denounce it as false?

verses.text: Why then when the soul leaps up to the throat
verses.translation: Why then when the soul leaps up to the throat

verses.text: the while you are helplessly watching that he is on the verge of death
verses.translation: the while you are helplessly watching that he is on the verge of death

verses.text: at that moment when We are closer to him than you although you do not see (Us)
verses.translation: at that moment when We are closer to him than you although you do not see (Us)

verses.text: if you are not subject to anyone''s authority
verses.translation: if you are not subject to anyone''s authority

verses.text: why are you then not able to bring them back to life if you are truthful?
verses.translation: why are you then not able to bring them back to life if you are truthful?

verses.text: So if he is one of those who are near-stationed (to Allah)
verses.translation: So if he is one of those who are near-stationed (to Allah)

verses.text: then happiness and delight and Gardens of Bliss are his.
verses.translation: then happiness and delight and Gardens of Bliss are his.

verses.text: And if he is one of the People on the Right
verses.translation: And if he is one of the People on the Right

verses.text: he will be welcomed by the words:  Peace to you  from the People on the Right.
verses.translation: he will be welcomed by the words:  Peace to you  from the People on the Right.

verses.text: And if he is one of those who give the lie (to this Message) and go astray
verses.translation: And if he is one of those who give the lie (to this Message) and go astray

verses.text: then he will be served boiling water
verses.translation: then he will be served boiling water

verses.text: and will be scorched by the Fire.
verses.translation: and will be scorched by the Fire.

verses.text: That indeed is the absolute truth.
verses.translation: That indeed is the absolute truth.

verses.text: So glorify the name of your Great Lord.
verses.translation: So glorify the name of your Great Lord.

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: When the Event will come to pass
ayahs.translation: When the Event will come to pass

ayahs.text: and then there will be no one to deny its occurrence
ayahs.translation: and then there will be no one to deny its occurrence

ayahs.text: (a calamitous Event) that shall turn things upside down:
ayahs.translation: (a calamitous Event) that shall turn things upside down:

ayahs.text: when the earth will suddenly shake with a terrible shaking
ayahs.translation: when the earth will suddenly shake with a terrible shaking

ayahs.text: and the mountains will crumble
ayahs.translation: and the mountains will crumble

ayahs.text: and will scatter abroad into fine dust.
ayahs.translation: and will scatter abroad into fine dust.

ayahs.text: You shall then become three groups.
ayahs.translation: You shall then become three groups.

ayahs.text: The People on the Right: and how fortunate will be the People on the Right!
ayahs.translation: The People on the Right: and how fortunate will be the People on the Right!

ayahs.text: And the People on the Left: and how miserable will be the People on the Left!
ayahs.translation: And the People on the Left: and how miserable will be the People on the Left!

ayahs.text: As for the Foremost they will be the foremost!
ayahs.translation: As for the Foremost they will be the foremost!

ayahs.text: They shall be near-stationed (to their Lord)
ayahs.translation: They shall be near-stationed (to their Lord)

ayahs.text: in the Gardens of Bliss.
ayahs.translation: in the Gardens of Bliss.

ayahs.text: A throng of the ancients
ayahs.translation: A throng of the ancients

ayahs.text: and a few from later times.
ayahs.translation: and a few from later times.

ayahs.text: They (will be seated) on gold-encrusted couches
ayahs.translation: They (will be seated) on gold-encrusted couches

ayahs.text: reclining on them arrayed face to face;
ayahs.translation: reclining on them arrayed face to face;

ayahs.text: immortal youths shall go about them
ayahs.translation: immortal youths shall go about them

ayahs.text: with goblets and ewers and a cup filled with a drink drawn from a running spring
ayahs.translation: with goblets and ewers and a cup filled with a drink drawn from a running spring

ayahs.text: a drink by which their minds will not be clouded nor will it cause drunkenness;
ayahs.translation: a drink by which their minds will not be clouded nor will it cause drunkenness;

ayahs.text: they will also go about them with the fruits of which they may choose
ayahs.translation: they will also go about them with the fruits of which they may choose

ayahs.text: and with the flesh of any fowl that they may desire to eat;
ayahs.translation: and with the flesh of any fowl that they may desire to eat;

ayahs.text: and there shall be wide-eyed maidens
ayahs.translation: and there shall be wide-eyed maidens

ayahs.text: beautiful as pearls hidden in their shells.
ayahs.translation: beautiful as pearls hidden in their shells.

ayahs.text: All this shall be theirs as a reward for their deeds.
ayahs.translation: All this shall be theirs as a reward for their deeds.

ayahs.text: There they shall hear no idle talk nor any sinful speech.
ayahs.translation: There they shall hear no idle talk nor any sinful speech.

ayahs.text: All talk will be sound and upright.
ayahs.translation: All talk will be sound and upright.

ayahs.text: As for the People on the Right how fortunate shall be the people on the Right!
ayahs.translation: As for the People on the Right how fortunate shall be the people on the Right!

ayahs.text: They shall be in the midst of thornless lote trees
ayahs.translation: They shall be in the midst of thornless lote trees

ayahs.text: and flower-clad acacias
ayahs.translation: and flower-clad acacias

ayahs.text: and extended shade
ayahs.translation: and extended shade

ayahs.text: and gushing water
ayahs.translation: and gushing water

ayahs.text: and abundant fruit
ayahs.translation: and abundant fruit

ayahs.text: never-ending and unforbidden.
ayahs.translation: never-ending and unforbidden.

ayahs.text: They shall be on upraised couches
ayahs.translation: They shall be on upraised couches

ayahs.text: and their spouses We shall have brought them into being afresh
ayahs.translation: and their spouses We shall have brought them into being afresh

ayahs.text: and shall have made them virgins
ayahs.translation: and shall have made them virgins

ayahs.text: intensely loving and of matching age.
ayahs.translation: intensely loving and of matching age.

ayahs.text: All this will be for the People on the Right;
ayahs.translation: All this will be for the People on the Right;

ayahs.text: a large throng from the ancients
ayahs.translation: a large throng from the ancients

ayahs.text: and also a large throng from those of later times.
ayahs.translation: and also a large throng from those of later times.

ayahs.text: As for the People on the Left: how miserable will be the People on the Left!
ayahs.translation: As for the People on the Left: how miserable will be the People on the Left!

ayahs.text: They will be in the midst of scorching wind and boiling water
ayahs.translation: They will be in the midst of scorching wind and boiling water

ayahs.text: and a shade of thick pitch-black smoke
ayahs.translation: and a shade of thick pitch-black smoke

ayahs.text: which will neither be cool nor soothing.
ayahs.translation: which will neither be cool nor soothing.

ayahs.text: Surely they had lived before in luxury
ayahs.translation: Surely they had lived before in luxury

ayahs.text: and had persisted in the Great Sin.
ayahs.translation: and had persisted in the Great Sin.

ayahs.text: They used to say:  What! Once we are dead and are reduced to dust and bones shall we still be raised to a new life from the dead?
ayahs.translation: They used to say:  What! Once we are dead and are reduced to dust and bones shall we still be raised to a new life from the dead?

ayahs.text: (We) and our fore-fathers of yore?
ayahs.translation: (We) and our fore-fathers of yore?

ayahs.text: Tell them (O Prophet):  The earlier ones and the later ones
ayahs.translation: Tell them (O Prophet):  The earlier ones and the later ones

ayahs.text: shall all be brought together on an appointed Day.
ayahs.translation: shall all be brought together on an appointed Day.

ayahs.text: Then you the erring ones and those that gave the lie to the Truth
ayahs.translation: Then you the erring ones and those that gave the lie to the Truth

ayahs.text: shall all eat from the Tree of al-Zaqqum
ayahs.translation: shall all eat from the Tree of al-Zaqqum

ayahs.text: filling your bellies with it;
ayahs.translation: filling your bellies with it;

ayahs.text: and thereupon you shall drink boiling water
ayahs.translation: and thereupon you shall drink boiling water

ayahs.text: drinking it as thirsty camels do.
ayahs.translation: drinking it as thirsty camels do.

ayahs.text: Thus shall they be entertained on the Day of Recompense.
ayahs.translation: Thus shall they be entertained on the Day of Recompense.

ayahs.text: We have created you then why would you not confirm it?
ayahs.translation: We have created you then why would you not confirm it?

ayahs.text: Did you ever consider the sperm that you emit?
ayahs.translation: Did you ever consider the sperm that you emit?

ayahs.text: Do you create a child out of it or are We its creators?
ayahs.translation: Do you create a child out of it or are We its creators?

ayahs.text: It is We Who ordained death upon you and We are not to be frustrated.
ayahs.translation: It is We Who ordained death upon you and We are not to be frustrated.

ayahs.text: Had We so wished nothing could have hindered Us from replacing you by others like yourselves or transforming you into beings you know nothing about.
ayahs.translation: Had We so wished nothing could have hindered Us from replacing you by others like yourselves or transforming you into beings you know nothing about.

ayahs.text: You are well aware of the first creation; then do you learn no lesson from it?
ayahs.translation: You are well aware of the first creation; then do you learn no lesson from it?

ayahs.text: Have you considered the seeds you till?
ayahs.translation: Have you considered the seeds you till?

ayahs.text: Is it you or We Who make them grow?
ayahs.translation: Is it you or We Who make them grow?

ayahs.text: If We so wished We could have reduced your harvest to rubble and you would have been left wonder-struck to exclaim:
ayahs.translation: If We so wished We could have reduced your harvest to rubble and you would have been left wonder-struck to exclaim:

ayahs.text: We have been penalised;
ayahs.translation: We have been penalised;

ayahs.text: nay; we have been undone!
ayahs.translation: nay; we have been undone!

ayahs.text: Did you cast a good look at the water that you drink?
ayahs.translation: Did you cast a good look at the water that you drink?

ayahs.text: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds or is it We Who brought it down?
ayahs.translation: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds or is it We Who brought it down?

ayahs.text: If We had so pleased We could have made it bitter. So why would you not give thanks?
ayahs.translation: If We had so pleased We could have made it bitter. So why would you not give thanks?

ayahs.text: Did you consider the fire which you kindle?
ayahs.translation: Did you consider the fire which you kindle?

ayahs.text: Did you make its tree grow or was it We Who made it grow?
ayahs.translation: Did you make its tree grow or was it We Who made it grow?

ayahs.text: We made it a reminder and a provision for the needy.
ayahs.translation: We made it a reminder and a provision for the needy.

ayahs.text: Glorify then (O Prophet) the name of your Great Lord.
ayahs.translation: Glorify then (O Prophet) the name of your Great Lord.

ayahs.text: No! I swear by the positions of the stars
ayahs.translation: No! I swear by the positions of the stars

ayahs.text: and this is indeed a mighty oath if only you knew
ayahs.translation: and this is indeed a mighty oath if only you knew

ayahs.text: that this indeed is a noble Qur''an
ayahs.translation: that this indeed is a noble Qur''an

ayahs.text: inscribed in a well-guarded Book
ayahs.translation: inscribed in a well-guarded Book

ayahs.text: which none but the pure may touch;
ayahs.translation: which none but the pure may touch;

ayahs.text: a revelation from the Lord of the Universe.
ayahs.translation: a revelation from the Lord of the Universe.

ayahs.text: Do you then take this discourse in light esteem
ayahs.translation: Do you then take this discourse in light esteem

ayahs.text: and your portion in it is simply that you denounce it as false?
ayahs.translation: and your portion in it is simply that you denounce it as false?

ayahs.text: Why then when the soul leaps up to the throat
ayahs.translation: Why then when the soul leaps up to the throat

ayahs.text: the while you are helplessly watching that he is on the verge of death
ayahs.translation: the while you are helplessly watching that he is on the verge of death

ayahs.text: at that moment when We are closer to him than you although you do not see (Us)
ayahs.translation: at that moment when We are closer to him than you although you do not see (Us)

ayahs.text: if you are not subject to anyone''s authority
ayahs.translation: if you are not subject to anyone''s authority

ayahs.text: why are you then not able to bring them back to life if you are truthful?
ayahs.translation: why are you then not able to bring them back to life if you are truthful?

ayahs.text: So if he is one of those who are near-stationed (to Allah)
ayahs.translation: So if he is one of those who are near-stationed (to Allah)

ayahs.text: then happiness and delight and Gardens of Bliss are his.
ayahs.translation: then happiness and delight and Gardens of Bliss are his.

ayahs.text: And if he is one of the People on the Right
ayahs.translation: And if he is one of the People on the Right

ayahs.text: he will be welcomed by the words:  Peace to you  from the People on the Right.
ayahs.translation: he will be welcomed by the words:  Peace to you  from the People on the Right.

ayahs.text: And if he is one of those who give the lie (to this Message) and go astray
ayahs.translation: And if he is one of those who give the lie (to this Message) and go astray

ayahs.text: then he will be served boiling water
ayahs.translation: then he will be served boiling water

ayahs.text: and will be scorched by the Fire.
ayahs.translation: and will be scorched by the Fire.

ayahs.text: That indeed is the absolute truth.
ayahs.translation: That indeed is the absolute truth.

ayahs.text: So glorify the name of your Great Lord.
ayahs.translation: So glorify the name of your Great Lord.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: All that is in the heavens and the earth extols the glory of Allah. He is the Most Mighty the Most Wise.
verses.translation: All that is in the heavens and the earth extols the glory of Allah. He is the Most Mighty the Most Wise.

verses.text: His is the dominion of the heavens and the earth. He gives life and causes death and He has power over everything.
verses.translation: His is the dominion of the heavens and the earth. He gives life and causes death and He has power over everything.

verses.text: He is the First and the Last and the Manifest and the Hidden and He has knowledge of everything.
verses.translation: He is the First and the Last and the Manifest and the Hidden and He has knowledge of everything.

verses.text: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six days and then established Himself on the Throne. He knows all that enters the earth and all that comes forth from it and all that comes down from the heaven and all that goes up to it. He is with you wherever you are. Allah sees all that you do.
verses.translation: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six days and then established Himself on the Throne. He knows all that enters the earth and all that comes forth from it and all that comes down from the heaven and all that goes up to it. He is with you wherever you are. Allah sees all that you do.

verses.text: His is the dominion of the heavens and the earth and to Him are all matters referred (for judgement).
verses.translation: His is the dominion of the heavens and the earth and to Him are all matters referred (for judgement).

verses.text: He causes the night to pass into the day and causes the day to pass into the night and He fully knows all that is hidden in the breasts of people.
verses.translation: He causes the night to pass into the day and causes the day to pass into the night and He fully knows all that is hidden in the breasts of people.

verses.text: Believe in Allah and in His Messenger and expend of what He has entrusted to you. A great reward awaits those of you who believe and spend their wealth.
verses.translation: Believe in Allah and in His Messenger and expend of what He has entrusted to you. A great reward awaits those of you who believe and spend their wealth.

verses.text: How is it that you do not believe in Allah when the Messenger calls you to believe in your Lord and although he has taken a covenant from you if indeed you are believers?
verses.translation: How is it that you do not believe in Allah when the Messenger calls you to believe in your Lord and although he has taken a covenant from you if indeed you are believers?

verses.text: He it is Who sends down Clear Signs to His servant so as to bring you out from darkness into light. Surely Allah is Most Kind and Most Compassionate to you.
verses.translation: He it is Who sends down Clear Signs to His servant so as to bring you out from darkness into light. Surely Allah is Most Kind and Most Compassionate to you.

verses.text: How is it that you do not expend in the Way of Allah when to Allah belongs the inheritance of the heavens and the earth? Those who spent their wealth and took part in fighting before the Victory cannot be equated (with those who spent their wealth and took part in fighting afterwards). They are higher in rank than those who spent and fought afterwards. But to each Allah has promised a good reward. Allah is well aware of all that you do.
verses.translation: How is it that you do not expend in the Way of Allah when to Allah belongs the inheritance of the heavens and the earth? Those who spent their wealth and took part in fighting before the Victory cannot be equated (with those who spent their wealth and took part in fighting afterwards). They are higher in rank than those who spent and fought afterwards. But to each Allah has promised a good reward. Allah is well aware of all that you do.

verses.text: Who is it that will give Allah a beautiful loan? A loan that Allah will repay after increasing it many times and grant him a generous reward.
verses.translation: Who is it that will give Allah a beautiful loan? A loan that Allah will repay after increasing it many times and grant him a generous reward.

verses.text: On that Day you will see believing men and women that their light will be running before them and on their right hands. (They will be told):  A good tiding to you today.  There shall be Gardens beneath which rivers flow; therein they shall abide. That indeed is the great triumph.
verses.translation: On that Day you will see believing men and women that their light will be running before them and on their right hands. (They will be told):  A good tiding to you today.  There shall be Gardens beneath which rivers flow; therein they shall abide. That indeed is the great triumph.

verses.text: On that Day the hypocrites both men and women shall say to the believers:  Look at us that we may extract some light from your light. They will be told:  Go back and seek light for yourselves elsewhere.  Then a wall shall be erected between them with a door in it. On the inside of it there will be mercy and on the outside of it there will be chastisement.
verses.translation: On that Day the hypocrites both men and women shall say to the believers:  Look at us that we may extract some light from your light. They will be told:  Go back and seek light for yourselves elsewhere.  Then a wall shall be erected between them with a door in it. On the inside of it there will be mercy and on the outside of it there will be chastisement.

verses.text: The hypocrites will call out to the believers:  Were we not with you? The believers will reply:  Yes; but you allowed yourselves to succumb to temptations and you wavered and you remained in doubt and false expectations deluded you until Allah''s command came to pass and the Deluder deluded you concerning Allah.
verses.translation: The hypocrites will call out to the believers:  Were we not with you? The believers will reply:  Yes; but you allowed yourselves to succumb to temptations and you wavered and you remained in doubt and false expectations deluded you until Allah''s command came to pass and the Deluder deluded you concerning Allah.

verses.text: So no ransom shall be accepted from you today nor from those who disbelieved. You are destined for the Fire. That will be your guardian. And that indeed is a grievous destination.
verses.translation: So no ransom shall be accepted from you today nor from those who disbelieved. You are destined for the Fire. That will be your guardian. And that indeed is a grievous destination.

verses.text: Is the time not come that the hearts of the believers should be humbled to Allah''s remembrance and to the Truth that He has revealed and that they should not be like those who were vouchsafed the Book and then a long time elapsed so that their hearts were hardened? A great many of them are now evil-doers.
verses.translation: Is the time not come that the hearts of the believers should be humbled to Allah''s remembrance and to the Truth that He has revealed and that they should not be like those who were vouchsafed the Book and then a long time elapsed so that their hearts were hardened? A great many of them are now evil-doers.

verses.text: Know well that Allah revives the earth after it becomes lifeless. We have clearly shown Our Signs to you perchance you will use your reason.
verses.translation: Know well that Allah revives the earth after it becomes lifeless. We have clearly shown Our Signs to you perchance you will use your reason.

verses.text: Verily those who give alms be they men or women and give Allah a beautiful loan shall be repaid after increasing it many times; and theirs shall be a generous reward.
verses.translation: Verily those who give alms be they men or women and give Allah a beautiful loan shall be repaid after increasing it many times; and theirs shall be a generous reward.

verses.text: In Allah''s sight only those who truly believe in Allah and His Messengers are utterly truthful and true bearers of witness (for the sake of Allah). For them is their reward and their light. As for those who gave the lie to Our Signs they are the people of Hell.
verses.translation: In Allah''s sight only those who truly believe in Allah and His Messengers are utterly truthful and true bearers of witness (for the sake of Allah). For them is their reward and their light. As for those who gave the lie to Our Signs they are the people of Hell.

verses.text: Know well that the life of this world is merely sport and diversion and adornment and an object of your boasting with one another and a rivalry in the multiplication of riches and children. Its likeness is that of rain: when it produces vegetation it delights the tillers. But then it withers and you see it turn yellow and then it crumbles away. In the Hereafter there is (either) grievous chastisement (or) forgiveness from Allah and (His) good pleasure. The life of this world is nothing but delusion.
verses.translation: Know well that the life of this world is merely sport and diversion and adornment and an object of your boasting with one another and a rivalry in the multiplication of riches and children. Its likeness is that of rain: when it produces vegetation it delights the tillers. But then it withers and you see it turn yellow and then it crumbles away. In the Hereafter there is (either) grievous chastisement (or) forgiveness from Allah and (His) good pleasure. The life of this world is nothing but delusion.

verses.text: So vie with one another in seeking to attain your Lord''s forgiveness and a Garden whose width is as the width of the heaven and the earth one which has been prepared for those who believe in Allah and His Messengers. That is Allah''s bounty which He bestows upon those whom He pleases. Allah is the Lord of abounding bounty.
verses.translation: So vie with one another in seeking to attain your Lord''s forgiveness and a Garden whose width is as the width of the heaven and the earth one which has been prepared for those who believe in Allah and His Messengers. That is Allah''s bounty which He bestows upon those whom He pleases. Allah is the Lord of abounding bounty.

verses.text: No misfortune ever befalls on earth nor on yourselves but We have inscribed it in the Book before We make it manifest. Surely that is easy for Allah.
verses.translation: No misfortune ever befalls on earth nor on yourselves but We have inscribed it in the Book before We make it manifest. Surely that is easy for Allah.

verses.text: (We do so) that you may not grieve over the loss you suffer nor exult over what He gave you. Allah does not love the vainglorious the boastful
verses.translation: (We do so) that you may not grieve over the loss you suffer nor exult over what He gave you. Allah does not love the vainglorious the boastful

verses.text: those who are niggardly and bid others to be niggardly. And he who turns away (should know that) Allah is Self-Sufficient Immensely Praiseworthy.
verses.translation: those who are niggardly and bid others to be niggardly. And he who turns away (should know that) Allah is Self-Sufficient Immensely Praiseworthy.

verses.text: Indeed We sent Our Messengers with Clear Signs and sent down with them the Book and the Balance that people may uphold justice. And We sent down iron wherein there is awesome power and many benefits for people so that Allah may know who without even having seen Him helps Him and His Messengers. Surely Allah is Most Strong Most Mighty.
verses.translation: Indeed We sent Our Messengers with Clear Signs and sent down with them the Book and the Balance that people may uphold justice. And We sent down iron wherein there is awesome power and many benefits for people so that Allah may know who without even having seen Him helps Him and His Messengers. Surely Allah is Most Strong Most Mighty.

verses.text: Indeed We sent forth Noah and Abraham and established in their line Prophecy and the Book. Then some of them embraced the guidance and many of them are wicked.
verses.translation: Indeed We sent forth Noah and Abraham and established in their line Prophecy and the Book. Then some of them embraced the guidance and many of them are wicked.

verses.text: In their wake We sent a succession of Our Messengers and raised Jesus son of Mary after all of them and bestowed upon him the Evangel and We set tenderness and mercy in the hearts of those that followed him. As for monasticism it is they who invented it; We did not prescribe it for them. They themselves invented it in pursuit of Allah''s good pleasure and then they did not observe it as it ought to have been observed. So We gave their reward to those of them that believed. But many of them are wicked.
verses.translation: In their wake We sent a succession of Our Messengers and raised Jesus son of Mary after all of them and bestowed upon him the Evangel and We set tenderness and mercy in the hearts of those that followed him. As for monasticism it is they who invented it; We did not prescribe it for them. They themselves invented it in pursuit of Allah''s good pleasure and then they did not observe it as it ought to have been observed. So We gave their reward to those of them that believed. But many of them are wicked.

verses.text: Believers have fear of Allah and believe in His Messenger and He will grant you a two-fold portion of His Mercy and will appoint for you a light whereby you shall walk; and He will forgive you.Allah is Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.
verses.translation: Believers have fear of Allah and believe in His Messenger and He will grant you a two-fold portion of His Mercy and will appoint for you a light whereby you shall walk; and He will forgive you.Allah is Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.

verses.text: (You should do this) so that the People of the Book know that they have no control over Allah''s Bounty and that all bounty is in Allah''s Hand; He bestows it on whomsoever He pleases. Allah is the Lord of abounding bounty.
verses.translation: (You should do this) so that the People of the Book know that they have no control over Allah''s Bounty and that all bounty is in Allah''s Hand; He bestows it on whomsoever He pleases. Allah is the Lord of abounding bounty.

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: All that is in the heavens and the earth extols the glory of Allah. He is the Most Mighty the Most Wise.
ayahs.translation: All that is in the heavens and the earth extols the glory of Allah. He is the Most Mighty the Most Wise.

ayahs.text: His is the dominion of the heavens and the earth. He gives life and causes death and He has power over everything.
ayahs.translation: His is the dominion of the heavens and the earth. He gives life and causes death and He has power over everything.

ayahs.text: He is the First and the Last and the Manifest and the Hidden and He has knowledge of everything.
ayahs.translation: He is the First and the Last and the Manifest and the Hidden and He has knowledge of everything.

ayahs.text: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six days and then established Himself on the Throne. He knows all that enters the earth and all that comes forth from it and all that comes down from the heaven and all that goes up to it. He is with you wherever you are. Allah sees all that you do.
ayahs.translation: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six days and then established Himself on the Throne. He knows all that enters the earth and all that comes forth from it and all that comes down from the heaven and all that goes up to it. He is with you wherever you are. Allah sees all that you do.

ayahs.text: His is the dominion of the heavens and the earth and to Him are all matters referred (for judgement).
ayahs.translation: His is the dominion of the heavens and the earth and to Him are all matters referred (for judgement).

ayahs.text: He causes the night to pass into the day and causes the day to pass into the night and He fully knows all that is hidden in the breasts of people.
ayahs.translation: He causes the night to pass into the day and causes the day to pass into the night and He fully knows all that is hidden in the breasts of people.

ayahs.text: Believe in Allah and in His Messenger and expend of what He has entrusted to you. A great reward awaits those of you who believe and spend their wealth.
ayahs.translation: Believe in Allah and in His Messenger and expend of what He has entrusted to you. A great reward awaits those of you who believe and spend their wealth.

ayahs.text: How is it that you do not believe in Allah when the Messenger calls you to believe in your Lord and although he has taken a covenant from you if indeed you are believers?
ayahs.translation: How is it that you do not believe in Allah when the Messenger calls you to believe in your Lord and although he has taken a covenant from you if indeed you are believers?

ayahs.text: He it is Who sends down Clear Signs to His servant so as to bring you out from darkness into light. Surely Allah is Most Kind and Most Compassionate to you.
ayahs.translation: He it is Who sends down Clear Signs to His servant so as to bring you out from darkness into light. Surely Allah is Most Kind and Most Compassionate to you.

ayahs.text: How is it that you do not expend in the Way of Allah when to Allah belongs the inheritance of the heavens and the earth? Those who spent their wealth and took part in fighting before the Victory cannot be equated (with those who spent their wealth and took part in fighting afterwards). They are higher in rank than those who spent and fought afterwards. But to each Allah has promised a good reward. Allah is well aware of all that you do.
ayahs.translation: How is it that you do not expend in the Way of Allah when to Allah belongs the inheritance of the heavens and the earth? Those who spent their wealth and took part in fighting before the Victory cannot be equated (with those who spent their wealth and took part in fighting afterwards). They are higher in rank than those who spent and fought afterwards. But to each Allah has promised a good reward. Allah is well aware of all that you do.

ayahs.text: Who is it that will give Allah a beautiful loan? A loan that Allah will repay after increasing it many times and grant him a generous reward.
ayahs.translation: Who is it that will give Allah a beautiful loan? A loan that Allah will repay after increasing it many times and grant him a generous reward.

ayahs.text: On that Day you will see believing men and women that their light will be running before them and on their right hands. (They will be told):  A good tiding to you today.  There shall be Gardens beneath which rivers flow; therein they shall abide. That indeed is the great triumph.
ayahs.translation: On that Day you will see believing men and women that their light will be running before them and on their right hands. (They will be told):  A good tiding to you today.  There shall be Gardens beneath which rivers flow; therein they shall abide. That indeed is the great triumph.

ayahs.text: On that Day the hypocrites both men and women shall say to the believers:  Look at us that we may extract some light from your light. They will be told:  Go back and seek light for yourselves elsewhere.  Then a wall shall be erected between them with a door in it. On the inside of it there will be mercy and on the outside of it there will be chastisement.
ayahs.translation: On that Day the hypocrites both men and women shall say to the believers:  Look at us that we may extract some light from your light. They will be told:  Go back and seek light for yourselves elsewhere.  Then a wall shall be erected between them with a door in it. On the inside of it there will be mercy and on the outside of it there will be chastisement.

ayahs.text: The hypocrites will call out to the believers:  Were we not with you? The believers will reply:  Yes; but you allowed yourselves to succumb to temptations and you wavered and you remained in doubt and false expectations deluded you until Allah''s command came to pass and the Deluder deluded you concerning Allah.
ayahs.translation: The hypocrites will call out to the believers:  Were we not with you? The believers will reply:  Yes; but you allowed yourselves to succumb to temptations and you wavered and you remained in doubt and false expectations deluded you until Allah''s command came to pass and the Deluder deluded you concerning Allah.

ayahs.text: So no ransom shall be accepted from you today nor from those who disbelieved. You are destined for the Fire. That will be your guardian. And that indeed is a grievous destination.
ayahs.translation: So no ransom shall be accepted from you today nor from those who disbelieved. You are destined for the Fire. That will be your guardian. And that indeed is a grievous destination.

ayahs.text: Is the time not come that the hearts of the believers should be humbled to Allah''s remembrance and to the Truth that He has revealed and that they should not be like those who were vouchsafed the Book and then a long time elapsed so that their hearts were hardened? A great many of them are now evil-doers.
ayahs.translation: Is the time not come that the hearts of the believers should be humbled to Allah''s remembrance and to the Truth that He has revealed and that they should not be like those who were vouchsafed the Book and then a long time elapsed so that their hearts were hardened? A great many of them are now evil-doers.

ayahs.text: Know well that Allah revives the earth after it becomes lifeless. We have clearly shown Our Signs to you perchance you will use your reason.
ayahs.translation: Know well that Allah revives the earth after it becomes lifeless. We have clearly shown Our Signs to you perchance you will use your reason.

ayahs.text: Verily those who give alms be they men or women and give Allah a beautiful loan shall be repaid after increasing it many times; and theirs shall be a generous reward.
ayahs.translation: Verily those who give alms be they men or women and give Allah a beautiful loan shall be repaid after increasing it many times; and theirs shall be a generous reward.

ayahs.text: In Allah''s sight only those who truly believe in Allah and His Messengers are utterly truthful and true bearers of witness (for the sake of Allah). For them is their reward and their light. As for those who gave the lie to Our Signs they are the people of Hell.
ayahs.translation: In Allah''s sight only those who truly believe in Allah and His Messengers are utterly truthful and true bearers of witness (for the sake of Allah). For them is their reward and their light. As for those who gave the lie to Our Signs they are the people of Hell.

ayahs.text: Know well that the life of this world is merely sport and diversion and adornment and an object of your boasting with one another and a rivalry in the multiplication of riches and children. Its likeness is that of rain: when it produces vegetation it delights the tillers. But then it withers and you see it turn yellow and then it crumbles away. In the Hereafter there is (either) grievous chastisement (or) forgiveness from Allah and (His) good pleasure. The life of this world is nothing but delusion.
ayahs.translation: Know well that the life of this world is merely sport and diversion and adornment and an object of your boasting with one another and a rivalry in the multiplication of riches and children. Its likeness is that of rain: when it produces vegetation it delights the tillers. But then it withers and you see it turn yellow and then it crumbles away. In the Hereafter there is (either) grievous chastisement (or) forgiveness from Allah and (His) good pleasure. The life of this world is nothing but delusion.

ayahs.text: So vie with one another in seeking to attain your Lord''s forgiveness and a Garden whose width is as the width of the heaven and the earth one which has been prepared for those who believe in Allah and His Messengers. That is Allah''s bounty which He bestows upon those whom He pleases. Allah is the Lord of abounding bounty.
ayahs.translation: So vie with one another in seeking to attain your Lord''s forgiveness and a Garden whose width is as the width of the heaven and the earth one which has been prepared for those who believe in Allah and His Messengers. That is Allah''s bounty which He bestows upon those whom He pleases. Allah is the Lord of abounding bounty.

ayahs.text: No misfortune ever befalls on earth nor on yourselves but We have inscribed it in the Book before We make it manifest. Surely that is easy for Allah.
ayahs.translation: No misfortune ever befalls on earth nor on yourselves but We have inscribed it in the Book before We make it manifest. Surely that is easy for Allah.

ayahs.text: (We do so) that you may not grieve over the loss you suffer nor exult over what He gave you. Allah does not love the vainglorious the boastful
ayahs.translation: (We do so) that you may not grieve over the loss you suffer nor exult over what He gave you. Allah does not love the vainglorious the boastful

ayahs.text: those who are niggardly and bid others to be niggardly. And he who turns away (should know that) Allah is Self-Sufficient Immensely Praiseworthy.
ayahs.translation: those who are niggardly and bid others to be niggardly. And he who turns away (should know that) Allah is Self-Sufficient Immensely Praiseworthy.

ayahs.text: Indeed We sent Our Messengers with Clear Signs and sent down with them the Book and the Balance that people may uphold justice. And We sent down iron wherein there is awesome power and many benefits for people so that Allah may know who without even having seen Him helps Him and His Messengers. Surely Allah is Most Strong Most Mighty.
ayahs.translation: Indeed We sent Our Messengers with Clear Signs and sent down with them the Book and the Balance that people may uphold justice. And We sent down iron wherein there is awesome power and many benefits for people so that Allah may know who without even having seen Him helps Him and His Messengers. Surely Allah is Most Strong Most Mighty.

ayahs.text: Indeed We sent forth Noah and Abraham and established in their line Prophecy and the Book. Then some of them embraced the guidance and many of them are wicked.
ayahs.translation: Indeed We sent forth Noah and Abraham and established in their line Prophecy and the Book. Then some of them embraced the guidance and many of them are wicked.

ayahs.text: In their wake We sent a succession of Our Messengers and raised Jesus son of Mary after all of them and bestowed upon him the Evangel and We set tenderness and mercy in the hearts of those that followed him. As for monasticism it is they who invented it; We did not prescribe it for them. They themselves invented it in pursuit of Allah''s good pleasure and then they did not observe it as it ought to have been observed. So We gave their reward to those of them that believed. But many of them are wicked.
ayahs.translation: In their wake We sent a succession of Our Messengers and raised Jesus son of Mary after all of them and bestowed upon him the Evangel and We set tenderness and mercy in the hearts of those that followed him. As for monasticism it is they who invented it; We did not prescribe it for them. They themselves invented it in pursuit of Allah''s good pleasure and then they did not observe it as it ought to have been observed. So We gave their reward to those of them that believed. But many of them are wicked.

ayahs.text: Believers have fear of Allah and believe in His Messenger and He will grant you a two-fold portion of His Mercy and will appoint for you a light whereby you shall walk; and He will forgive you.Allah is Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.
ayahs.translation: Believers have fear of Allah and believe in His Messenger and He will grant you a two-fold portion of His Mercy and will appoint for you a light whereby you shall walk; and He will forgive you.Allah is Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.

ayahs.text: (You should do this) so that the People of the Book know that they have no control over Allah''s Bounty and that all bounty is in Allah''s Hand; He bestows it on whomsoever He pleases. Allah is the Lord of abounding bounty.
ayahs.translation: (You should do this) so that the People of the Book know that they have no control over Allah''s Bounty and that all bounty is in Allah''s Hand; He bestows it on whomsoever He pleases. Allah is the Lord of abounding bounty.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Allah has surely heard the words of her who contends with you concerning her husband and complains to Allah. Allah hears what both of you say. Verily Allah is All- Hearing All-Seeing.
verses.translation: Allah has surely heard the words of her who contends with you concerning her husband and complains to Allah. Allah hears what both of you say. Verily Allah is All- Hearing All-Seeing.

verses.text: Those among you who divorce their wives by declaring them to be their mothers such are not their mothers; none are their mothers except those who gave birth to them. Indeed what they say is highly contemptible and false. Verily Allah is Most Pardoning Most Forgiving.
verses.translation: Those among you who divorce their wives by declaring them to be their mothers such are not their mothers; none are their mothers except those who gave birth to them. Indeed what they say is highly contemptible and false. Verily Allah is Most Pardoning Most Forgiving.

verses.text: Those who declare their wives to be their mothers and thereafter go back on what they have said shall free a slave before they may touch each other. That is what you are exhorted to do. Allah is fully aware of all your deeds.
verses.translation: Those who declare their wives to be their mothers and thereafter go back on what they have said shall free a slave before they may touch each other. That is what you are exhorted to do. Allah is fully aware of all your deeds.

verses.text: And he who does not find a slave (to free) shall fast for two months consecutively before they may touch each other; and he who is unable to do so shall feed sixty needy people. All this is in order that you may truly believe in Allah and His Messenger. These are the bounds set by Allah; and a grievous chastisement awaits the unbelievers.
verses.translation: And he who does not find a slave (to free) shall fast for two months consecutively before they may touch each other; and he who is unable to do so shall feed sixty needy people. All this is in order that you may truly believe in Allah and His Messenger. These are the bounds set by Allah; and a grievous chastisement awaits the unbelievers.

verses.text: Verily those who oppose Allah and His Messenger shall be brought low even as those before them were brought low. Surely We have sent down Clear Signs; and a humiliating chastisement awaits the unbelievers;
verses.translation: Verily those who oppose Allah and His Messenger shall be brought low even as those before them were brought low. Surely We have sent down Clear Signs; and a humiliating chastisement awaits the unbelievers;

verses.text: a chastisement that shall come upon them on the Day when Allah will raise them all to a new life and will inform them of their deeds. Allah has recorded it all while they have forgotten it. Allah is a witness over everything.
verses.translation: a chastisement that shall come upon them on the Day when Allah will raise them all to a new life and will inform them of their deeds. Allah has recorded it all while they have forgotten it. Allah is a witness over everything.

verses.text: Are you not aware that Allah knows whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth? Never is there any whispering among three but He is their fourth; nor among five but He is their sixth; nor fewer nor more but He is with them wherever they may be.And then He will tell them on the Day of Judgement all that they have done. Surely Allah knows everything.
verses.translation: Are you not aware that Allah knows whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth? Never is there any whispering among three but He is their fourth; nor among five but He is their sixth; nor fewer nor more but He is with them wherever they may be.And then He will tell them on the Day of Judgement all that they have done. Surely Allah knows everything.

verses.text: Have you not seen those who were forbidden to whisper and yet they engaged in what they had been forbidden? They secretly converse among themselves concerning sin and transgression and disobedience to the Messenger. And when they come to you they greet you in a manner that Allah does not greet you and say to themselves:  Why does Allah not chastise us for these utterances of ours? Hell it is that shall suffice them and in it will they burn. How woeful is their destination!
verses.translation: Have you not seen those who were forbidden to whisper and yet they engaged in what they had been forbidden? They secretly converse among themselves concerning sin and transgression and disobedience to the Messenger. And when they come to you they greet you in a manner that Allah does not greet you and say to themselves:  Why does Allah not chastise us for these utterances of ours? Hell it is that shall suffice them and in it will they burn. How woeful is their destination!

verses.text: Believers when you converse in secrecy let that not be concerning sin and transgression and disobedience to the Messenger; rather converse concerning virtue and piety. And fear Allah to Whom all of you shall be mustered.
verses.translation: Believers when you converse in secrecy let that not be concerning sin and transgression and disobedience to the Messenger; rather converse concerning virtue and piety. And fear Allah to Whom all of you shall be mustered.

verses.text: Whispering is an act of Satan one that aims at causing grief to the believers; yet without Allah''s leave no harm can be caused to them. So in Allah should the believers put all their trust.
verses.translation: Whispering is an act of Satan one that aims at causing grief to the believers; yet without Allah''s leave no harm can be caused to them. So in Allah should the believers put all their trust.

verses.text: Believers when you are told:  Make room for one another in your assemblies then make room; Allah will bestow amplitude on you. And when it is said:  Rise up then rise up; Allah will raise to high ranks those of you who believe and are endowed with knowledge. Allah is well aware of all that you do.
verses.translation: Believers when you are told:  Make room for one another in your assemblies then make room; Allah will bestow amplitude on you. And when it is said:  Rise up then rise up; Allah will raise to high ranks those of you who believe and are endowed with knowledge. Allah is well aware of all that you do.

verses.text: Believers when you come to the Messenger for private consultation offer some charity before your consultation with him. That is better for you and more conducive to purity. But if you find nothing to offer in charity then know that Allah is Most Merciful Most Compassionate.
verses.translation: Believers when you come to the Messenger for private consultation offer some charity before your consultation with him. That is better for you and more conducive to purity. But if you find nothing to offer in charity then know that Allah is Most Merciful Most Compassionate.

verses.text: Are you afraid that you will have to offer charity when you hold private conversation with the Prophet? But if you are unable to do so and Allah pardons you then establish Prayer and pay Zakah and obey Allah and His Messenger. Allah is well aware of all that you do.
verses.translation: Are you afraid that you will have to offer charity when you hold private conversation with the Prophet? But if you are unable to do so and Allah pardons you then establish Prayer and pay Zakah and obey Allah and His Messenger. Allah is well aware of all that you do.

verses.text: Do you not see those who took for friends a people whom Allah is wroth with? They neither belong to you nor you to them. They swear to a falsehood and they do so knowingly.
verses.translation: Do you not see those who took for friends a people whom Allah is wroth with? They neither belong to you nor you to them. They swear to a falsehood and they do so knowingly.

verses.text: Allah has prepared for them a grievous chastisement. Indeed evil are the acts in which they are engaged.
verses.translation: Allah has prepared for them a grievous chastisement. Indeed evil are the acts in which they are engaged.

verses.text: They have taken their oaths as a shield by means of which they hinder people from the Way of Allah. Theirs shall be a humiliating chastisement.
verses.translation: They have taken their oaths as a shield by means of which they hinder people from the Way of Allah. Theirs shall be a humiliating chastisement.

verses.text: Neither their possessions nor their offspring will be of any avail to them against Allah. They are the people of the Fire; therein they shall abide.
verses.translation: Neither their possessions nor their offspring will be of any avail to them against Allah. They are the people of the Fire; therein they shall abide.

verses.text: On the Day when Allah will raise them all from the dead they will swear before Him as they swear before you today thinking that this will avail them. Behold they are utter liars.
verses.translation: On the Day when Allah will raise them all from the dead they will swear before Him as they swear before you today thinking that this will avail them. Behold they are utter liars.

verses.text: Satan has gained mastery over them and has made them neglect remembering Allah. They are the party of Satan. Behold the party of Satan will be the losers.
verses.translation: Satan has gained mastery over them and has made them neglect remembering Allah. They are the party of Satan. Behold the party of Satan will be the losers.

verses.text: Verily those who oppose Allah and His Messenger will be among the most abject beings.
verses.translation: Verily those who oppose Allah and His Messenger will be among the most abject beings.

verses.text: Allah has written:  Surely I will prevail; I and My Messengers. Verily Allah is Most Strong Most Mighty.
verses.translation: Allah has written:  Surely I will prevail; I and My Messengers. Verily Allah is Most Strong Most Mighty.

verses.text: You shall not find a people who believe in Allah and the Last Day befriending those who oppose Allah and His Messenger even though they be their fathers or their sons or their brothers or their kindred. He has inscribed faith in their hearts and has strengthened them with a spirit from Him and He shall make them enter Gardens beneath which rivers flow. Therein they shall abide. Allah is well-pleased with them and they are well-pleased with Him. They belong to Allah''s party. Verily Allah''s party shall prosper.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth extols Allah''s Glory: He is the Most Mighty the Most Wise.
verses.translation: All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth extols Allah''s Glory: He is the Most Mighty the Most Wise.

verses.text: He it is Who in the first assault drove forth the People of the Book that disbelieved from their homes at the first gathering of forces. You did not believe that they would leave; while they too thought that their fortresses would defend them against Allah.Then Allah came upon them from whence they did not even imagine casting such terror into their hearts that they destroyed their homes by their own hands and their destruction was also caused by the hands of the believers. So learn a lesson from this O you who have perceptive eyes!
verses.translation: He it is Who in the first assault drove forth the People of the Book that disbelieved from their homes at the first gathering of forces. You did not believe that they would leave; while they too thought that their fortresses would defend them against Allah.Then Allah came upon them from whence they did not even imagine casting such terror into their hearts that they destroyed their homes by their own hands and their destruction was also caused by the hands of the believers. So learn a lesson from this O you who have perceptive eyes!

verses.text: If Allah had not decreed banishment for them He would certainly have chastised them in this world. As for the Hereafter the chastisement of the Fire awaits them.
verses.translation: If Allah had not decreed banishment for them He would certainly have chastised them in this world. As for the Hereafter the chastisement of the Fire awaits them.

verses.text: That is because they set themselves against Allah and His Messenger; and whoever sets himself against Allah should know that Allah is surely Most Stern in retribution.
verses.translation: That is because they set themselves against Allah and His Messenger; and whoever sets himself against Allah should know that Allah is surely Most Stern in retribution.

verses.text: The palm-trees that you cut down or those that you left standing on their roots it was by Allah''s leave that you did so.(Allah granted you this leave) in order that He might humiliate the evil-doers.
verses.translation: The palm-trees that you cut down or those that you left standing on their roots it was by Allah''s leave that you did so.(Allah granted you this leave) in order that He might humiliate the evil-doers.

verses.text: Whatever Allah has taken away from them and bestowed (as spoils) on His Messenger for which you spurred neither horses nor camels; but Allah grants authority to His Messengers over whomsoever He pleases. Allah has power over everything.
verses.translation: Whatever Allah has taken away from them and bestowed (as spoils) on His Messenger for which you spurred neither horses nor camels; but Allah grants authority to His Messengers over whomsoever He pleases. Allah has power over everything.

verses.text: Whatever (from the possessions of the towns people) Allah has bestowed on His Messenger belongs to Allah and to the Messenger and to his kinsfolk and to the orphans and to the needy and to the wayfarer so that it may not merely circulate between the rich among you. So accept whatever the Messenger gives you and refrain from whatever he forbids you. And fear Allah: verily Allah is Most Stern in retribution.
verses.translation: Whatever (from the possessions of the towns people) Allah has bestowed on His Messenger belongs to Allah and to the Messenger and to his kinsfolk and to the orphans and to the needy and to the wayfarer so that it may not merely circulate between the rich among you. So accept whatever the Messenger gives you and refrain from whatever he forbids you. And fear Allah: verily Allah is Most Stern in retribution.

verses.text: It also belongs to the poor Emigrants who have been driven out of their homes and their possessions those who seek Allah''s favour and good pleasure and help Allah and His Messenger. Such are the truthful ones.
verses.translation: It also belongs to the poor Emigrants who have been driven out of their homes and their possessions those who seek Allah''s favour and good pleasure and help Allah and His Messenger. Such are the truthful ones.

verses.text: It also belongs to those who were already settled in this abode (of Hijrah) having come to faith before the (arrival of the) Muhajirun (Emigrants).They love those who have migrated to them and do not covet what has been given them; they even prefer them above themselves though poverty be their own lot. And whosoever are preserved from their own greed such are the ones that will prosper.

verses.text: (And it also belongs to) those who came after them and who pray:  Lord forgive us and our brethren who have preceded us in faith and do not put in our hearts any rancour towards those who believe. Lord You are the Most Tender the Most Compassionate.
