verses.text: Did you not see the hypocrites say to their brethren the unbelievers among the People of the Book:  If you are banished we too will go with you and will not listen to anyone concerning you; and if war is waged against you we will come to your aid.  But Allah bears witness that they are liars.

verses.text: To be sure if they are banished they will not go with them and if war is waged against them they will not aid them; and even if they provide any aid to them they will still turn their backs and thereafter no aid will be forthcoming to them.

verses.text: Surely they have greater dread for you in their hearts than for Allah. That is because they are a people who are devoid of understanding.

verses.text: They will never fight against you as a body (in an open battlefield); and if they fight against you they will fight only in fortified townships or from behind walls. Intense is their hostility to one another. You reckon them united while their hearts are divided. That is because they are a people devoid of reason.

verses.text: And be not like those who forgot Allah and so He made them oblivious of themselves. They are the wicked ones.

ayahs.text: He it is Who in the first assault drove forth the People of the Book that disbelieved from their homes at the first gathering of forces. You did not believe that they would leave; while they too thought that their fortresses would defend them against Allah.Then Allah came upon them from whence they did not even imagine casting such terror into their hearts that they destroyed their homes by their own hands and their destruction was also caused by the hands of the believers. So learn a lesson from this O you who have perceptive eyes!

english_meaning: She that is to be examined

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Believers if you have left (your homes and) have come forth to struggle in My Way and to seek My good pleasure do not make friends with My enemies and your enemies. You befriend them whereas they have spurned the Truth that has come to you; and (such is their enmity that) they expel the Messenger and yourselves for no other reason than that you believe in Allah your Lord. You send to them messages of friendship in secrecy although I know well whatever you do be it secretly or publicly. And whosoever of you does so has indeed strayed far away from the Straight Path.
verses.translation: Believers if you have left (your homes and) have come forth to struggle in My Way and to seek My good pleasure do not make friends with My enemies and your enemies. You befriend them whereas they have spurned the Truth that has come to you; and (such is their enmity that) they expel the Messenger and yourselves for no other reason than that you believe in Allah your Lord. You send to them messages of friendship in secrecy although I know well whatever you do be it secretly or publicly. And whosoever of you does so has indeed strayed far away from the Straight Path.

verses.text: If they could overcome you they would act as your foes and would hurt you by their hands and tongues and would love to see you become unbelievers.
verses.translation: If they could overcome you they would act as your foes and would hurt you by their hands and tongues and would love to see you become unbelievers.

verses.text: On the Day of Resurrection neither your blood-kindred nor your own offspring will avail you. (On that Day) He will separate you. Allah sees all that you do.
verses.translation: On the Day of Resurrection neither your blood-kindred nor your own offspring will avail you. (On that Day) He will separate you. Allah sees all that you do.

verses.text: You have a good example in Abraham and his companions: they said to their people:  We totally dissociate ourselves from you and from the deities that you worship instead of Allah. We renounce you and there has come to be enmity and hatred between us and you until you believe in Allah the One True God.  (But you may not emulate) Abraham''s saying to his father:  Certainly I will ask pardon for you although I have no power over Allah to obtain anything on your behalf. (And Abraham and his companions prayed):  Our Lord in You have we put our trust and to You have we turned and to You is our ultimate return.

We renounce you and there has come to be enmity and hatred between us and you until you believe in Allah the One True God.  (But you may not emulate) Abraham''s saying to his father:  Certainly I will ask pardon for you although I have no power over Allah to obtain anything on your behalf. (And Abraham and his companions prayed):  Our Lord in You have we put our trust and to You have we turned and to You is our ultimate return.

verses.text: Our Lord do not make us a test for the unbelievers and forgive us our Lord. Surely You are Most Mighty Most Wise.
verses.translation: Our Lord do not make us a test for the unbelievers and forgive us our Lord. Surely You are Most Mighty Most Wise.

verses.text: Indeed there is a good example for you in them; a good example for anyone who looks forward to Allah and the Last Day. As for him who turns away Allah is All-Sufficient Immensely Praiseworthy.
verses.translation: Indeed there is a good example for you in them; a good example for anyone who looks forward to Allah and the Last Day. As for him who turns away Allah is All-Sufficient Immensely Praiseworthy.

verses.text: It may well be that Allah will implant love between you and those with whom you have had enmity. Allah is Most Powerful; and Allah is Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.
verses.translation: It may well be that Allah will implant love between you and those with whom you have had enmity. Allah is Most Powerful; and Allah is Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.

verses.text: Allah does not forbid that you be kind and just to those who did not fight against you on account of religion nor drove you out of your homes. Surely Allah loves those who are equitable.
verses.translation: Allah does not forbid that you be kind and just to those who did not fight against you on account of religion nor drove you out of your homes. Surely Allah loves those who are equitable.

verses.text: Allah only forbids you to be friends with those who have fought against you on account of religion and who have driven you out of your homes and have abetted in your expulsion. And any who make friends with them they are the wrong-doers.
verses.translation: Allah only forbids you to be friends with those who have fought against you on account of religion and who have driven you out of your homes and have abetted in your expulsion. And any who make friends with them they are the wrong-doers.

verses.text: Believers when believing women come to you as Emigrants (in the cause of faith) examine them. Allah fully knows (the truth) concerning their faith. And when you have ascertained them to be believing women do not send them back to the unbelievers.Those women are no longer lawful to the unbelievers nor are those unbelievers lawful to those (believing) women. Give their unbelieving husbands whatever they have spent (as bridal-dues); and there is no offence for you to marry those women if you give them their bridal-dues. Do not hold on to your marriages with unbelieving women: ask for the return of the bridal-due you gave to your unbelieving wives and the unbelievers may ask for the return of the bridal-due they had given to their believing wives. Such is Allah''s command. He judges between you. Allah is All-Knowing Most Wise.
verses.translation: Believers when believing women come to you as Emigrants (in the cause of faith) examine them. Allah fully knows (the truth) concerning their faith. And when you have ascertained them to be believing women do not send them back to the unbelievers.Those women are no longer lawful to the unbelievers nor are those unbelievers lawful to those (believing) women. Give their unbelieving husbands whatever they have spent (as bridal-dues); and there is no offence for you to marry those women if you give them their bridal-dues. Do not hold on to your marriages with unbelieving women: ask for the return of the bridal-due you gave to your unbelieving wives and the unbelievers may ask for the return of the bridal-due they had given to their believing wives. Such is Allah''s command. He judges between you. Allah is All-Knowing Most Wise.

verses.text: And if you fail to receive from the unbelievers a part of the bridal-due of your disbelieving wives and then your turn comes pay to those who have been left on the other side an amount the like of the bridal-due that they have paid. And have fear of Allah in Whom you believe.
verses.translation: And if you fail to receive from the unbelievers a part of the bridal-due of your disbelieving wives and then your turn comes pay to those who have been left on the other side an amount the like of the bridal-due that they have paid. And have fear of Allah in Whom you believe.

verses.text: O Prophet when believing women come to you and pledge to you that they will not associate aught with Allah in His Divinity that they will not steal that they will not commit illicit sexual intercourse that they will not kill their children that they will not bring forth a calumny between their hands and feet and that they will not disobey you in anything known to be good then accept their allegiance and ask Allah to forgive them. Surely Allah is Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.

Surely Allah is Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.

verses.text: Believers do not make friends with those against whom Allah is wrathful and who are despaired of the Hereafter as despaired as are the unbelievers lying in their graves.
verses.translation: Believers do not make friends with those against whom Allah is wrathful and who are despaired of the Hereafter as despaired as are the unbelievers lying in their graves.

ayahs.text: Allah only forbids you to be friends with those who have fought against you on account of religion and who have driven you out of your homes and have abetted in your expulsion. And any who make friends with them they are the wrong-doers.
ayahs.translation: Allah only forbids you to be friends with those who have fought against you on account of religion and who have driven you out of your homes and have abetted in your expulsion. And any who make friends with them they are the wrong-doers.

ayahs.text: Believers when believing women come to you as Emigrants (in the cause of faith) examine them. Allah fully knows (the truth) concerning their faith. And when you have ascertained them to be believing women do not send them back to the unbelievers.Those women are no longer lawful to the unbelievers nor are those unbelievers lawful to those (believing) women. Give their unbelieving husbands whatever they have spent (as bridal-dues); and there is no offence for you to marry those women if you give them their bridal-dues. Do not hold on to your marriages with unbelieving women: ask for the return of the bridal-due you gave to your unbelieving wives and the unbelievers may ask for the return of the bridal-due they had given to their believing wives. Such is Allah''s command. He judges between you. Allah is All-Knowing Most Wise.
ayahs.translation: Believers when believing women come to you as Emigrants (in the cause of faith) examine them. Allah fully knows (the truth) concerning their faith. And when you have ascertained them to be believing women do not send them back to the unbelievers.Those women are no longer lawful to the unbelievers nor are those unbelievers lawful to those (believing) women. Give their unbelieving husbands whatever they have spent (as bridal-dues); and there is no offence for you to marry those women if you give them their bridal-dues. Do not hold on to your marriages with unbelieving women: ask for the return of the bridal-due you gave to your unbelieving wives and the unbelievers may ask for the return of the bridal-due they had given to their believing wives. Such is Allah''s command. He judges between you. Allah is All-Knowing Most Wise.

ayahs.text: And if you fail to receive from the unbelievers a part of the bridal-due of your disbelieving wives and then your turn comes pay to those who have been left on the other side an amount the like of the bridal-due that they have paid. And have fear of Allah in Whom you believe.
ayahs.translation: And if you fail to receive from the unbelievers a part of the bridal-due of your disbelieving wives and then your turn comes pay to those who have been left on the other side an amount the like of the bridal-due that they have paid. And have fear of Allah in Whom you believe.

ayahs.text: O Prophet when believing women come to you and pledge to you that they will not associate aught with Allah in His Divinity that they will not steal that they will not commit illicit sexual intercourse that they will not kill their children that they will not bring forth a calumny between their hands and feet and that they will not disobey you in anything known to be good then accept their allegiance and ask Allah to forgive them. Surely Allah is Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.
ayahs.translation: O Prophet when believing women come to you and pledge to you that they will not associate aught with Allah in His Divinity that they will not steal that they will not commit illicit sexual intercourse that they will not kill their children that they will not bring forth a calumny between their hands and feet and that they will not disobey you in anything known to be good then accept their allegiance and ask Allah to forgive them. Surely Allah is Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.

ayahs.text: Believers do not make friends with those against whom Allah is wrathful and who are despaired of the Hereafter as despaired as are the unbelievers lying in their graves.
ayahs.translation: Believers do not make friends with those against whom Allah is wrathful and who are despaired of the Hereafter as despaired as are the unbelievers lying in their graves.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: All that is in the heavens and all that is on earth extols Allah''s glory. He is the Most Mighty the Most Wise.
verses.translation: All that is in the heavens and all that is on earth extols Allah''s glory. He is the Most Mighty the Most Wise.

verses.text: Believers why do you profess that which you do not practise?
verses.translation: Believers why do you profess that which you do not practise?

verses.text: It is most loathsome in the sight of Allah that you should profess what you do not practise.
verses.translation: It is most loathsome in the sight of Allah that you should profess what you do not practise.

verses.text: Allah indeed loves those who fight in His Way as though they are a solid wall cemented with molten lead.
verses.translation: Allah indeed loves those who fight in His Way as though they are a solid wall cemented with molten lead.

verses.text: And call to mind when Moses said to his people:  O my people why do you torment me when you know well that I am Allah''s Messenger to you? So when they deviated Allah made their hearts deviant. Allah does not direct the evil-doers to the Right Way.
verses.translation: And call to mind when Moses said to his people:  O my people why do you torment me when you know well that I am Allah''s Messenger to you? So when they deviated Allah made their hearts deviant. Allah does not direct the evil-doers to the Right Way.

verses.text: And call to mind when Jesus son of Mary said:  O Children of Israel I am Allah''s Messenger to you I verify the Torah which has come before me and I give you the glad tiding of a Messenger who shall come after me his name being Ahmad. Yet when he came to them with Clear Signs they said:  This is sheer trickery.
verses.translation: And call to mind when Jesus son of Mary said:  O Children of Israel I am Allah''s Messenger to you I verify the Torah which has come before me and I give you the glad tiding of a Messenger who shall come after me his name being Ahmad. Yet when he came to them with Clear Signs they said:  This is sheer trickery.

verses.text: Who would be more unjust than he who invents a lie about Allah the while he is being called to Islam? Allah does not direct such evil-doing folk to the Right Way.
verses.translation: Who would be more unjust than he who invents a lie about Allah the while he is being called to Islam? Allah does not direct such evil-doing folk to the Right Way.

verses.text: They seek to extinguish Allah''s light (by blowing) with their mouths but Allah shall spread His light in all its fullness howsoever the unbelievers may abhor this.
verses.translation: They seek to extinguish Allah''s light (by blowing) with their mouths but Allah shall spread His light in all its fullness howsoever the unbelievers may abhor this.

verses.text: He it is Who has sent forth the Messenger with the Guidance and the True Religion that He may make it prevail over all religion however those that associate aught with Allah in His Divinity might dislike this.
verses.translation: He it is Who has sent forth the Messenger with the Guidance and the True Religion that He may make it prevail over all religion however those that associate aught with Allah in His Divinity might dislike this.

verses.text: Believers shall I direct you to a commerce that will deliver you from a grievous chastisement?
verses.translation: Believers shall I direct you to a commerce that will deliver you from a grievous chastisement?

verses.text: Have faith in Allah and His Messenger and strive in the Way of Allah with your possessions and your lives. That is better for you if you only knew.
verses.translation: Have faith in Allah and His Messenger and strive in the Way of Allah with your possessions and your lives. That is better for you if you only knew.

verses.text: He will forgive you your sins and will admit you to Gardens beneath which rivers flow. He will lodge you in excellent mansions in the Gardens of eternity. That is the supreme triumph.
verses.translation: He will forgive you your sins and will admit you to Gardens beneath which rivers flow. He will lodge you in excellent mansions in the Gardens of eternity. That is the supreme triumph.

verses.text: He will also grant you the other favour that you desire: help from Allah and a victory that will come soon. Give glad tidings of this to the believers.
verses.translation: He will also grant you the other favour that you desire: help from Allah and a victory that will come soon. Give glad tidings of this to the believers.

verses.text: Believers become Allah''s helpers as Jesus son of Mary said to the disciples: Who is my helper in (calling people) to Allah?  The disciples had responded by saying:  We are Allah''s helpers. Then a section of the Children of Israel believed and a section rejected the call. Thereafter We aided the believers against their enemies and they prevailed.
verses.translation: Believers become Allah''s helpers as Jesus son of Mary said to the disciples: Who is my helper in (calling people) to Allah?  The disciples had responded by saying:  We are Allah''s helpers. Then a section of the Children of Israel believed and a section rejected the call. Thereafter We aided the believers against their enemies and they prevailed.

verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth extols the glory of Allah the Sovereign the Holy the All-Mighty the All-Wise.
verses.translation: All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth extols the glory of Allah the Sovereign the Holy the All-Mighty the All-Wise.

verses.text: He it is Who has sent to the gentiles a Messenger from among themselves one who rehearses to them His verses purifies their lives and imparts to them the Book and the Wisdom although before that they were in utter error;
verses.translation: He it is Who has sent to the gentiles a Messenger from among themselves one who rehearses to them His verses purifies their lives and imparts to them the Book and the Wisdom although before that they were in utter error;

verses.text: and (He has also) sent him to those others who have not yet joined them. He is the Most Mighty the Most Wise.
verses.translation: and (He has also) sent him to those others who have not yet joined them. He is the Most Mighty the Most Wise.

verses.text: Such is Allah''s favour: He bestows it on whomsoever He pleases. Allah is the Lord of abounding favour.
verses.translation: Such is Allah''s favour: He bestows it on whomsoever He pleases. Allah is the Lord of abounding favour.

verses.text: The parable of those who were charged with the Torah and then they failed to live up to it is that of a donkey laden with books. Even more evil is the parable of the people who gave the lie to the Signs of Allah. Allah does not direct such wrong-doers to the Right Way.
verses.translation: The parable of those who were charged with the Torah and then they failed to live up to it is that of a donkey laden with books. Even more evil is the parable of the people who gave the lie to the Signs of Allah. Allah does not direct such wrong-doers to the Right Way.

verses.text: Tell them:  O you who have become Judaised if you arrogantly fancy that you are Allah''s favourites to the exclusion of all people then wish for death if you are truthful in your claim.
verses.translation: Tell them:  O you who have become Judaised if you arrogantly fancy that you are Allah''s favourites to the exclusion of all people then wish for death if you are truthful in your claim.

verses.text: But they shall never wish for death because of the (evil) deeds they have committed. Allah is well aware of these evil-doers.
verses.translation: But they shall never wish for death because of the (evil) deeds they have committed. Allah is well aware of these evil-doers.

verses.text: Tell them:  The death from which you flee will certainly overtake you. Then you will be returned to Him Who fully knows what is hidden and what is manifest. Thereupon He will let you know all that you used to do.
verses.translation: Tell them:  The death from which you flee will certainly overtake you. Then you will be returned to Him Who fully knows what is hidden and what is manifest. Thereupon He will let you know all that you used to do.

verses.text: Believers when the call for Prayer is made on Friday hasten to the remembrance of Allah and give up all trading. That is better for you if you only knew.
verses.translation: Believers when the call for Prayer is made on Friday hasten to the remembrance of Allah and give up all trading. That is better for you if you only knew.

verses.text: But when the Prayer is ended disperse in the land and seek Allah''s Bounty and remember Allah much so that you may prosper.
verses.translation: But when the Prayer is ended disperse in the land and seek Allah''s Bounty and remember Allah much so that you may prosper.

verses.text: Yet no sooner than they saw some trading or amusement they flocked to it and left you standing by yourself. Tell them:  That which is with Allah is far better than amusement and trading. Allah is the Best Provider of sustenance.
verses.translation: Yet no sooner than they saw some trading or amusement they flocked to it and left you standing by yourself. Tell them:  That which is with Allah is far better than amusement and trading. Allah is the Best Provider of sustenance.

verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: (O Prophet) when the hypocrites come to you they say:  We bear witness that you are certainly Allah''s Messenger.  Allah certainly knows that you are His Messenger. But Allah also bears witness that the hypocrites are utter liars!
verses.translation: (O Prophet) when the hypocrites come to you they say:  We bear witness that you are certainly Allah''s Messenger.  Allah certainly knows that you are His Messenger. But Allah also bears witness that the hypocrites are utter liars!

verses.text: They shelter behind their oath and thus hinder their own selves and others from the Path of Allah. Evil indeed is what they do.
verses.translation: They shelter behind their oath and thus hinder their own selves and others from the Path of Allah. Evil indeed is what they do.

verses.text: All that is because they first believed and then disbelieved and therefore a seal was set on their hearts; as a result they understand nothing.
verses.translation: All that is because they first believed and then disbelieved and therefore a seal was set on their hearts; as a result they understand nothing.

verses.text: When you look at them their persons are pleasing and when they speak you pay heed to what they say. But in truth they are (merely) beams of timber propped-up (against a wall). They consider every shout they hear to be directed against them. They are your utter enemies; guard against them. May Allah do away with them! How are they being turned away (from the Truth)?
verses.translation: When you look at them their persons are pleasing and when they speak you pay heed to what they say. But in truth they are (merely) beams of timber propped-up (against a wall). They consider every shout they hear to be directed against them. They are your utter enemies; guard against them. May Allah do away with them! How are they being turned away (from the Truth)?

verses.text: When it is said to them:  Come Allah''s Messenger will seek forgiveness for you they (contemptuously) shake their heads and you see them holding back in pride.
verses.translation: When it is said to them:  Come Allah''s Messenger will seek forgiveness for you they (contemptuously) shake their heads and you see them holding back in pride.

verses.text: It is all the same for them whether you ask forgiveness for them or not; for Allah shall never forgive them. Surely Allah does not direct the transgressing folk to the Right Way.
verses.translation: It is all the same for them whether you ask forgiveness for them or not; for Allah shall never forgive them. Surely Allah does not direct the transgressing folk to the Right Way.

verses.text: It is they who say:  Give nothing to those who are with the Messenger of Allah so that they may disperse.  (They say so although) the treasures of the heavens and the earth belong to Allah. But the hypocrites do not understand.
verses.translation: It is they who say:  Give nothing to those who are with the Messenger of Allah so that they may disperse.  (They say so although) the treasures of the heavens and the earth belong to Allah. But the hypocrites do not understand.

verses.text: They say:  When we return to Madinah the honourable ones will drive out from it those that are abject. In truth all honour belongs to Allah and to His Messenger and to the believers. But the hypocrites do not know.
verses.translation: They say:  When we return to Madinah the honourable ones will drive out from it those that are abject. In truth all honour belongs to Allah and to His Messenger and to the believers. But the hypocrites do not know.

verses.text: Believers let your possessions and your offspring not make you negligent of Allah''s remembrance. For whoso does that they will be the losers.
verses.translation: Believers let your possessions and your offspring not make you negligent of Allah''s remembrance. For whoso does that they will be the losers.

verses.text: And spend of what Allah has granted you by way of sustenance before death should come to any of you and he should say:  Lord why did You not defer my return for a while so that I might give alms and be among the righteous?
verses.translation: And spend of what Allah has granted you by way of sustenance before death should come to any of you and he should say:  Lord why did You not defer my return for a while so that I might give alms and be among the righteous?

verses.text: But when a person''s term comes to an end Allah never grants any respite. Allah is well aware of all that you do.
verses.translation: But when a person''s term comes to an end Allah never grants any respite. Allah is well aware of all that you do.

ayahs.translation: And spend of what Allah has granted you by way of sustenance before death should come to any of you and he should say:  Lord why did You not defer my return for a while so that I might give alms and be among the righteous?

ayahs.text: But when a person''s term comes to an end Allah never grants any respite. Allah is well aware of all that you do.
ayahs.translation: But when a person''s term comes to an end Allah never grants any respite. Allah is well aware of all that you do.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth extols Allah''s glory. His is the sovereignty and to Him is all praise due; He has power over everything.
verses.translation: All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth extols Allah''s glory. His is the sovereignty and to Him is all praise due; He has power over everything.

verses.text: He it is Who has created you: and among you are those that deny the Truth and among you are those that believe in it. Allah observes all that you do.
verses.translation: He it is Who has created you: and among you are those that deny the Truth and among you are those that believe in it. Allah observes all that you do.

verses.text: He created the heavens and the earth with Truth and shaped you giving you excellent shapes. And to Him is your ultimate return.
verses.translation: He created the heavens and the earth with Truth and shaped you giving you excellent shapes. And to Him is your ultimate return.

verses.text: He knows what is in the heavens and the earth and knows what you conceal and what you disclose. Allah even knows what lies hidden in the breasts of people.
verses.translation: He knows what is in the heavens and the earth and knows what you conceal and what you disclose. Allah even knows what lies hidden in the breasts of people.

verses.text: Has the news of the unbelievers of the past not reached you? (They disbelieved) and then tasted its evil consequence. A grievous chastisement awaits them.
verses.translation: Has the news of the unbelievers of the past not reached you? (They disbelieved) and then tasted its evil consequence. A grievous chastisement awaits them.

verses.text: This was because their Messengers would come to them with Clear Signs but they would say:  Shall mortals (like ourselves) guide us to the Right Way? They rejected the Truth and turned away. Thereupon Allah became unconcerned with them for Allah is Self-Sufficient Innately Praiseworthy.
verses.translation: This was because their Messengers would come to them with Clear Signs but they would say:  Shall mortals (like ourselves) guide us to the Right Way? They rejected the Truth and turned away. Thereupon Allah became unconcerned with them for Allah is Self-Sufficient Innately Praiseworthy.

verses.text: The unbelievers have vehemently contended that they shall not be raised to life. Say to them:  Yes by my Lord you shall surely be raised to life and you shall certainly be fully informed of all that you did. That is easy enough for Allah.
verses.translation: The unbelievers have vehemently contended that they shall not be raised to life. Say to them:  Yes by my Lord you shall surely be raised to life and you shall certainly be fully informed of all that you did. That is easy enough for Allah.

verses.text: So believe in Allah and in His Messenger and in the Light that We have sent down. Allah is fully aware of what you do.
verses.translation: So believe in Allah and in His Messenger and in the Light that We have sent down. Allah is fully aware of what you do.

verses.text: (You shall come to know that) when He will assemble you on the Day of Gathering. That shall be the Day (to determine) mutual gains and losses. Whoever believes in Allah and acts righteously Allah will have his evil deeds expunged and will admit him to Gardens beneath which rivers flow. Therein they shall abide forever. That is the supreme triumph.
verses.translation: (You shall come to know that) when He will assemble you on the Day of Gathering. That shall be the Day (to determine) mutual gains and losses. Whoever believes in Allah and acts righteously Allah will have his evil deeds expunged and will admit him to Gardens beneath which rivers flow. Therein they shall abide forever. That is the supreme triumph.

verses.text: As for those who disbelieved and gave the lie to Our Signs: they shall be the inmates of the Fire and will abide in it. That is a woeful resort!
verses.translation: As for those who disbelieved and gave the lie to Our Signs: they shall be the inmates of the Fire and will abide in it. That is a woeful resort!

verses.text: No misfortune ever befalls unless it be by Allah''s leave. And whosoever has faith in Allah Allah directs his heart along the Right Path. Allah has knowledge of everything.
verses.translation: No misfortune ever befalls unless it be by Allah''s leave. And whosoever has faith in Allah Allah directs his heart along the Right Path. Allah has knowledge of everything.

verses.text: Obey Allah and obey the Messenger. But if you turn away from obedience (then know that) Our Messenger has no other duty than to clearly convey the Truth.
verses.translation: Obey Allah and obey the Messenger. But if you turn away from obedience (then know that) Our Messenger has no other duty than to clearly convey the Truth.

verses.text: Allah there is no god but He; in Allah should the believers put all their trust.
verses.translation: Allah there is no god but He; in Allah should the believers put all their trust.

verses.text: Believers there are enemies to you from among your spouses and your offspring so beware of them. But if you forgive and overlook their offences and pardon them then surely Allah is Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.
verses.translation: Believers there are enemies to you from among your spouses and your offspring so beware of them. But if you forgive and overlook their offences and pardon them then surely Allah is Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.

verses.text: Your possessions and your offspring are nothing but a trial for you. And there awaits a great reward for you with Allah.
verses.translation: Your possessions and your offspring are nothing but a trial for you. And there awaits a great reward for you with Allah.

verses.text: So hold Allah in awe as much as you can and listen and obey and be charitable. This is for your own good. And whoever remains safe from his own greediness it is such that will prosper.
verses.translation: So hold Allah in awe as much as you can and listen and obey and be charitable. This is for your own good. And whoever remains safe from his own greediness it is such that will prosper.

verses.text: If you give Allah a goodly loan He will increase it for you several fold and will forgive you. Allah is Most Appreciative Most Forbearing.
verses.translation: If you give Allah a goodly loan He will increase it for you several fold and will forgive you. Allah is Most Appreciative Most Forbearing.

verses.text: He knows that which is beyond the ken of perception as well as that which can be perceived. He is the Most Mighty the Most Wise.
verses.translation: He knows that which is beyond the ken of perception as well as that which can be perceived. He is the Most Mighty the Most Wise.

ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: O Prophet when you divorce women divorce them for their waiting-period and compute the waiting period accurately and hold Allah your Lord in awe. Do not turn them out of their homes (during the waiting period)   nor should they go away (from their homes)  unless they have committed a manifestly evil deed. Such are the bounds set by Allah; and he who transgresses the bounds set by Allah commits a wrong against himself. You do not know: maybe Allah will cause something to happen to pave the way (for reconciliation).
verses.translation: O Prophet when you divorce women divorce them for their waiting-period and compute the waiting period accurately and hold Allah your Lord in awe. Do not turn them out of their homes (during the waiting period)   nor should they go away (from their homes)  unless they have committed a manifestly evil deed. Such are the bounds set by Allah; and he who transgresses the bounds set by Allah commits a wrong against himself. You do not know: maybe Allah will cause something to happen to pave the way (for reconciliation).

verses.text: And when they reach the end of their term (of waiting) then either honourably retain them (in the bond of wedlock) or honourably part with them and call two persons of known probity as witnesses from among yourselves and (let these witnesses) give upright testimony for the sake of Allah. That is to what all those that believe in Allah and the Last Day are exhorted. Allah will find a way out for him who fears Allah
verses.translation: And when they reach the end of their term (of waiting) then either honourably retain them (in the bond of wedlock) or honourably part with them and call two persons of known probity as witnesses from among yourselves and (let these witnesses) give upright testimony for the sake of Allah. That is to what all those that believe in Allah and the Last Day are exhorted. Allah will find a way out for him who fears Allah

verses.text: and will provide him sustenance from whence he never even imagined. Whoever puts his trust in Allah He shall suffice him. Surely Allah brings about what He decrees; Allah has set a measure for everything.
verses.translation: and will provide him sustenance from whence he never even imagined. Whoever puts his trust in Allah He shall suffice him. Surely Allah brings about what He decrees; Allah has set a measure for everything.

verses.text: The waiting period of those of your women who have lost all expectation of menstruation shall be three months in case you entertain any doubt; and the same shall apply to those who have not yet menstruated. As for pregnant women their waiting period shall be until the delivery of their burden. Allah will create ease for him who fears Allah.
verses.translation: The waiting period of those of your women who have lost all expectation of menstruation shall be three months in case you entertain any doubt; and the same shall apply to those who have not yet menstruated. As for pregnant women their waiting period shall be until the delivery of their burden. Allah will create ease for him who fears Allah.

verses.text: This is the commandment of Allah that He has revealed to you. Whoever fears Allah He will expunge his evil deeds and will richly reward him.
verses.translation: This is the commandment of Allah that He has revealed to you. Whoever fears Allah He will expunge his evil deeds and will richly reward him.

verses.text: (During the waiting period) lodge them according to your means wherever you dwell and do not harass them to make them miserable. And if they are pregnant provide for them maintenance until they have delivered their burden. And if they suckle your offspring whom they bore you then give them due recompense and graciously settle the question of compensation between yourselves by mutual understanding. But if you experience difficulty (in determining the compensation for suckling) then let another woman suckle the child.
verses.translation: (During the waiting period) lodge them according to your means wherever you dwell and do not harass them to make them miserable. And if they are pregnant provide for them maintenance until they have delivered their burden. And if they suckle your offspring whom they bore you then give them due recompense and graciously settle the question of compensation between yourselves by mutual understanding. But if you experience difficulty (in determining the compensation for suckling) then let another woman suckle the child.

verses.text: Whoever has abundant means let him spend according to his means; and he whose means are straitened let him spend out of what Allah has given him. Allah does not burden any human being beyond the means that He has bestowed upon him. Possibly Allah will grant ease after hardship.
verses.translation: Whoever has abundant means let him spend according to his means; and he whose means are straitened let him spend out of what Allah has given him. Allah does not burden any human being beyond the means that He has bestowed upon him. Possibly Allah will grant ease after hardship.

verses.text: How many towns rebelled against the commandment of their Lord and His Messengers. Then We called them to a stern accounting and subjected them to a harrowing chastisement.
verses.translation: How many towns rebelled against the commandment of their Lord and His Messengers. Then We called them to a stern accounting and subjected them to a harrowing chastisement.

verses.text: So they tasted the evil fruit of their deeds; and the fruit of their deeds was utter loss.
verses.translation: So they tasted the evil fruit of their deeds; and the fruit of their deeds was utter loss.

verses.text: Allah has laid in store for them a grievous chastisement. So fear Allah O people of understanding who have attained to faith. Allah has sent down to you an Exhortation
verses.translation: Allah has laid in store for them a grievous chastisement. So fear Allah O people of understanding who have attained to faith. Allah has sent down to you an Exhortation

verses.text: a Messenger who rehearses to you Allah''s verses that clearly expound the Guidance so that He may bring out those that believe and act righteously from every kind of darkness into light. He will admit whosoever believes in Allah and acts righteously to Gardens beneath which rivers flow. They shall abide in them forever. For such has Allah made an excellent provision.
verses.translation: a Messenger who rehearses to you Allah''s verses that clearly expound the Guidance so that He may bring out those that believe and act righteously from every kind of darkness into light. He will admit whosoever believes in Allah and acts righteously to Gardens beneath which rivers flow. They shall abide in them forever. For such has Allah made an excellent provision.

verses.text: Allah it is He Who created seven heavens and like them the earth. His commandment descends among them. (All this is being stated so that you know) that Allah has power over everything and that Allah encompasses all things in His knowledge.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: O Prophet why do you forbid what Allah has made lawful for you? Is it to please your wives? Allah is Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.
verses.translation: O Prophet why do you forbid what Allah has made lawful for you? Is it to please your wives? Allah is Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.

verses.text: Allah has prescribed for you a way for the absolution of your oaths. Allah is your Guardian. He is All-Knowing Most Wise.
verses.translation: Allah has prescribed for you a way for the absolution of your oaths. Allah is your Guardian. He is All-Knowing Most Wise.

verses.text: The Prophet confided something to one of his wives and then she disclosed it (to another); so after Allah revealed to the Prophet (that she had disclosed that secret) he made a part of it known to her and passed over a part of it. And when he told her about this (i.e. that she had disclosed the secret entrusted to her) she asked:  Who informed you of this?  He said:  I was told of it by He Who is All-Knowing All-Aware.
verses.translation: The Prophet confided something to one of his wives and then she disclosed it (to another); so after Allah revealed to the Prophet (that she had disclosed that secret) he made a part of it known to her and passed over a part of it. And when he told her about this (i.e. that she had disclosed the secret entrusted to her) she asked:  Who informed you of this?  He said:  I was told of it by He Who is All-Knowing All-Aware.

verses.text: If the two of you turn in repentance to Allah (that is better for you) for the hearts of both of you have swerved from the Straight Path. But if you support one another against the Prophet then surely Allah is his Protector; and after that Gabriel and all righteous believers and the angels are all his supporters.
verses.translation: If the two of you turn in repentance to Allah (that is better for you) for the hearts of both of you have swerved from the Straight Path. But if you support one another against the Prophet then surely Allah is his Protector; and after that Gabriel and all righteous believers and the angels are all his supporters.

verses.text: Maybe if he were to divorce you your Lord might grant him in exchange wives better than you  those who truly submit to Allah are full of faith obedient disposed to repentance and given to worship and fasting  both previously wedded ones and virgins.
verses.translation: Maybe if he were to divorce you your Lord might grant him in exchange wives better than you  those who truly submit to Allah are full of faith obedient disposed to repentance and given to worship and fasting  both previously wedded ones and virgins.

verses.text: Believers guard yourselves and your kindred against a Fire whose fuel is human beings and stones a Fire held in the charge of fierce and stern angels who never disobey what He has commanded them and always do what they are bidden.
verses.translation: Believers guard yourselves and your kindred against a Fire whose fuel is human beings and stones a Fire held in the charge of fierce and stern angels who never disobey what He has commanded them and always do what they are bidden.

verses.text: (It will then be said):  Unbelievers make no excuses today. You are being recompensed for nothing else but your deeds.
verses.translation: (It will then be said):  Unbelievers make no excuses today. You are being recompensed for nothing else but your deeds.

verses.text: Believers turn to Allah in sincere repentance; maybe your Lord will expunge your evil deeds and admit you to the Gardens beneath which rivers flow. This will be on the Day when Allah will not disgrace the Prophet and those who have embraced faith and are with him; their light will be running before them and on their right hands and they will say:  Our Lord perfect for us our light and forgive us. Surely You have power over everything.
verses.translation: Believers turn to Allah in sincere repentance; maybe your Lord will expunge your evil deeds and admit you to the Gardens beneath which rivers flow. This will be on the Day when Allah will not disgrace the Prophet and those who have embraced faith and are with him; their light will be running before them and on their right hands and they will say:  Our Lord perfect for us our light and forgive us. Surely You have power over everything.

verses.text: O Prophet strive against the unbelievers and the hypocrites and be severe with them. Hell shall be their resort. What a grievous end!
verses.translation: O Prophet strive against the unbelievers and the hypocrites and be severe with them. Hell shall be their resort. What a grievous end!

verses.text: Allah has set forth for the unbelievers the parable of the wives of Noah and Lot. They were wedded to two of Our righteous servants but each acted treacherously with her husband and their husbands could be of no avail to them against Allah. The two of them were told:  Enter the Fire with all the others who enter it.
verses.translation: Allah has set forth for the unbelievers the parable of the wives of Noah and Lot. They were wedded to two of Our righteous servants but each acted treacherously with her husband and their husbands could be of no avail to them against Allah. The two of them were told:  Enter the Fire with all the others who enter it.

verses.text: Allah has set forth for the believers the parable of Pharaoh''s wife. She prayed:  My Lord build for me a house with You in Paradise and deliver me from Pharaoh and his misdeeds; and deliver me from the iniquitous people.
verses.translation: Allah has set forth for the believers the parable of Pharaoh''s wife. She prayed:  My Lord build for me a house with You in Paradise and deliver me from Pharaoh and his misdeeds; and deliver me from the iniquitous people.

verses.text: Allah has also set forth the parable of Mary the daughter of Imran who guarded her chastity and into whom We breathed of Our Spirit and who testified to the words of her Lord and His Books. She was among the obedient.
verses.translation: Allah has also set forth the parable of Mary the daughter of Imran who guarded her chastity and into whom We breathed of Our Spirit and who testified to the words of her Lord and His Books. She was among the obedient.

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: O Prophet why do you forbid what Allah has made lawful for you? Is it to please your wives? Allah is Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.
ayahs.translation: O Prophet why do you forbid what Allah has made lawful for you? Is it to please your wives? Allah is Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.

ayahs.text: Allah has prescribed for you a way for the absolution of your oaths. Allah is your Guardian. He is All-Knowing Most Wise.
ayahs.translation: Allah has prescribed for you a way for the absolution of your oaths. Allah is your Guardian. He is All-Knowing Most Wise.

ayahs.text: The Prophet confided something to one of his wives and then she disclosed it (to another); so after Allah revealed to the Prophet (that she had disclosed that secret) he made a part of it known to her and passed over a part of it. And when he told her about this (i.e. that she had disclosed the secret entrusted to her) she asked:  Who informed you of this?  He said:  I was told of it by He Who is All-Knowing All-Aware.
ayahs.translation: The Prophet confided something to one of his wives and then she disclosed it (to another); so after Allah revealed to the Prophet (that she had disclosed that secret) he made a part of it known to her and passed over a part of it. And when he told her about this (i.e. that she had disclosed the secret entrusted to her) she asked:  Who informed you of this?  He said:  I was told of it by He Who is All-Knowing All-Aware.

ayahs.text: If the two of you turn in repentance to Allah (that is better for you) for the hearts of both of you have swerved from the Straight Path. But if you support one another against the Prophet then surely Allah is his Protector; and after that Gabriel and all righteous believers and the angels are all his supporters.
ayahs.translation: If the two of you turn in repentance to Allah (that is better for you) for the hearts of both of you have swerved from the Straight Path. But if you support one another against the Prophet then surely Allah is his Protector; and after that Gabriel and all righteous believers and the angels are all his supporters.

ayahs.text: Maybe if he were to divorce you your Lord might grant him in exchange wives better than you  those who truly submit to Allah are full of faith obedient disposed to repentance and given to worship and fasting  both previously wedded ones and virgins.
ayahs.translation: Maybe if he were to divorce you your Lord might grant him in exchange wives better than you  those who truly submit to Allah are full of faith obedient disposed to repentance and given to worship and fasting  both previously wedded ones and virgins.

ayahs.text: Believers guard yourselves and your kindred against a Fire whose fuel is human beings and stones a Fire held in the charge of fierce and stern angels who never disobey what He has commanded them and always do what they are bidden.
ayahs.translation: Believers guard yourselves and your kindred against a Fire whose fuel is human beings and stones a Fire held in the charge of fierce and stern angels who never disobey what He has commanded them and always do what they are bidden.

ayahs.text: (It will then be said):  Unbelievers make no excuses today. You are being recompensed for nothing else but your deeds.
ayahs.translation: (It will then be said):  Unbelievers make no excuses today. You are being recompensed for nothing else but your deeds.

ayahs.text: Believers turn to Allah in sincere repentance; maybe your Lord will expunge your evil deeds and admit you to the Gardens beneath which rivers flow. This will be on the Day when Allah will not disgrace the Prophet and those who have embraced faith and are with him; their light will be running before them and on their right hands and they will say:  Our Lord perfect for us our light and forgive us. Surely You have power over everything.
ayahs.translation: Believers turn to Allah in sincere repentance; maybe your Lord will expunge your evil deeds and admit you to the Gardens beneath which rivers flow. This will be on the Day when Allah will not disgrace the Prophet and those who have embraced faith and are with him; their light will be running before them and on their right hands and they will say:  Our Lord perfect for us our light and forgive us. Surely You have power over everything.

ayahs.text: O Prophet strive against the unbelievers and the hypocrites and be severe with them. Hell shall be their resort. What a grievous end!
ayahs.translation: O Prophet strive against the unbelievers and the hypocrites and be severe with them. Hell shall be their resort. What a grievous end!

ayahs.text: Allah has set forth for the unbelievers the parable of the wives of Noah and Lot. They were wedded to two of Our righteous servants but each acted treacherously with her husband and their husbands could be of no avail to them against Allah. The two of them were told:  Enter the Fire with all the others who enter it.
ayahs.translation: Allah has set forth for the unbelievers the parable of the wives of Noah and Lot. They were wedded to two of Our righteous servants but each acted treacherously with her husband and their husbands could be of no avail to them against Allah. The two of them were told:  Enter the Fire with all the others who enter it.

ayahs.translation: Allah has set forth for the believers the parable of Pharaoh''s wife. She prayed:  My Lord build for me a house with You in Paradise and deliver me from Pharaoh and his misdeeds; and deliver me from the iniquitous people.

ayahs.text: Allah has also set forth the parable of Mary the daughter of Imran who guarded her chastity and into whom We breathed of Our Spirit and who testified to the words of her Lord and His Books. She was among the obedient.
ayahs.translation: Allah has also set forth the parable of Mary the daughter of Imran who guarded her chastity and into whom We breathed of Our Spirit and who testified to the words of her Lord and His Books. She was among the obedient.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Blessed is He in Whose Hand is the dominion of the Universe and Who has power over everything;
verses.translation: Blessed is He in Whose Hand is the dominion of the Universe and Who has power over everything;

verses.text: Who created death and life that He might try you as to which of you is better in deed. He is the Most Mighty the Most Forgiving;
verses.translation: Who created death and life that He might try you as to which of you is better in deed. He is the Most Mighty the Most Forgiving;

verses.text: Who created the seven heavens one upon another. You will see no incongruity in the Merciful One''s creation. Turn your vision again can you see any flaw?
verses.translation: Who created the seven heavens one upon another. You will see no incongruity in the Merciful One''s creation. Turn your vision again can you see any flaw?

verses.text: Then turn your vision again and then again; in the end your vision will come back to you worn out and frustrated.
verses.translation: Then turn your vision again and then again; in the end your vision will come back to you worn out and frustrated.

verses.text: We have adorned the lower heaven with lamps and have made them a means to drive away the satans. We have prepared for them the chastisement of the Blazing Fire.
verses.translation: We have adorned the lower heaven with lamps and have made them a means to drive away the satans. We have prepared for them the chastisement of the Blazing Fire.

verses.text: The chastisement of Hell awaits those who disbelieve in their Lord. What a wretched destination!
verses.translation: The chastisement of Hell awaits those who disbelieve in their Lord. What a wretched destination!

verses.text: When they will be cast into it they will hear it roar as it boils
verses.translation: When they will be cast into it they will hear it roar as it boils

verses.text: as though it will burst with rage. Every time a multitude is cast into it its keepers will ask them:  Did no warner come to you?
verses.translation: as though it will burst with rage. Every time a multitude is cast into it its keepers will ask them:  Did no warner come to you?

verses.text: They will say:  Yes a warner came to us but we gave the lie to him and said: ''Allah has revealed nothing. You are surely in huge error.''
verses.translation: They will say:  Yes a warner came to us but we gave the lie to him and said: ''Allah has revealed nothing. You are surely in huge error.''

verses.text: They will say: ''If we had only listened and understood we would not be among the inmates of the Blazing Fire.''
verses.translation: They will say: ''If we had only listened and understood we would not be among the inmates of the Blazing Fire.''

verses.text: Thus will they confess their sins. Damned are these inmates of the Blazing Fire.
verses.translation: Thus will they confess their sins. Damned are these inmates of the Blazing Fire.

verses.text: Surely forgiveness and a mighty reward await those who fear Allah without seeing Him.
verses.translation: Surely forgiveness and a mighty reward await those who fear Allah without seeing Him.

verses.text: Whether you speak in secrecy or aloud (it is all the same to Allah). He even knows the secrets that lie hidden in the breasts of people.
verses.translation: Whether you speak in secrecy or aloud (it is all the same to Allah). He even knows the secrets that lie hidden in the breasts of people.

verses.text: Would He not know He Who has created when He is All-Subtle All-Aware?
verses.translation: Would He not know He Who has created when He is All-Subtle All-Aware?

verses.text: He it is Who made the earth subservient to you. So traverse in its tracks and partake of the sustenance He has provided. To Him will you be resurrected.
verses.translation: He it is Who made the earth subservient to you. So traverse in its tracks and partake of the sustenance He has provided. To Him will you be resurrected.

verses.text: Do you feel secure that He Who is in the heaven will not cause the earth to cave in with you and then suddenly it will begin to rock violently?
verses.translation: Do you feel secure that He Who is in the heaven will not cause the earth to cave in with you and then suddenly it will begin to rock violently?

verses.text: Do you feel secure that He Who is in the heaven will not let loose upon you a storm of stones? Then shall you know what My warning is like!
verses.translation: Do you feel secure that He Who is in the heaven will not let loose upon you a storm of stones? Then shall you know what My warning is like!

verses.text: Those who came before them also gave the lie (to the Messengers): then how awesome was My chastisement!
verses.translation: Those who came before them also gave the lie (to the Messengers): then how awesome was My chastisement!

verses.text: Have they not seen birds above them spreading and closing their wings with none holding them except the Merciful One? He oversees everything.
verses.translation: Have they not seen birds above them spreading and closing their wings with none holding them except the Merciful One? He oversees everything.

verses.text: Which is your army that will come to your aid against the Merciful Lord? But the unbelievers are in utter delusion.
verses.translation: Which is your army that will come to your aid against the Merciful Lord? But the unbelievers are in utter delusion.

verses.text: Who shall provide for you if He withholds His sustenance? Nay; but they persist in rebellion and aversion.
verses.translation: Who shall provide for you if He withholds His sustenance? Nay; but they persist in rebellion and aversion.

verses.text: Who is better guided: he who walks grovelling on his face or he who walks upright on a Straight Path?
verses.translation: Who is better guided: he who walks grovelling on his face or he who walks upright on a Straight Path?

verses.text: Say:  He it is Who has brought you into being and has given you hearing and sight and has given you hearts to think and understand. How seldom do you give thanks!
verses.translation: Say:  He it is Who has brought you into being and has given you hearing and sight and has given you hearts to think and understand. How seldom do you give thanks!

verses.text: Say:  Allah it is Who multiplied you in the earth and to Him you will be mustered.
verses.translation: Say:  Allah it is Who multiplied you in the earth and to Him you will be mustered.

verses.text: They say:  If you are truthful tell us when will this promise (of the Hereafter) be fulfilled?
verses.translation: They say:  If you are truthful tell us when will this promise (of the Hereafter) be fulfilled?

verses.text: Say:  Allah alone knows about that; and I am no more than a plain warner.
verses.translation: Say:  Allah alone knows about that; and I am no more than a plain warner.

verses.text: When they will see it near at hand the faces of all those who had denied it will be distraught and then they will be told:  This is the doom which you used to ask for.
verses.translation: When they will see it near at hand the faces of all those who had denied it will be distraught and then they will be told:  This is the doom which you used to ask for.

verses.text: Say to them:  Did you ever consider: whether Allah destroys me and those that are with me or shows mercy to us who can protect the unbelievers from a grievous chastisement?
verses.translation: Say to them:  Did you ever consider: whether Allah destroys me and those that are with me or shows mercy to us who can protect the unbelievers from a grievous chastisement?

verses.text: Say to them:  He is Merciful and it is in Him that we believe and it is in Him that we put all our trust. Soon will you know who is in manifest error.
verses.translation: Say to them:  He is Merciful and it is in Him that we believe and it is in Him that we put all our trust. Soon will you know who is in manifest error.

verses.text: Say to them:  Did you even consider: if all the water that you have (in the wells) were to sink down into the depths of the earth who will produce for you clear flowing water?
verses.translation: Say to them:  Did you even consider: if all the water that you have (in the wells) were to sink down into the depths of the earth who will produce for you clear flowing water?
