verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Nun. By the pen and what the scribes write.
verses.translation: Nun. By the pen and what the scribes write.

verses.text: By your Lord''s Grace you are not afflicted with madness
verses.translation: By your Lord''s Grace you are not afflicted with madness

verses.text: and surely yours shall be a never-ending reward
verses.translation: and surely yours shall be a never-ending reward

verses.text: and you are certainly on the most exalted standard of moral excellence.
verses.translation: and you are certainly on the most exalted standard of moral excellence.

verses.text: So you will soon see and they too will see
verses.translation: So you will soon see and they too will see

verses.text: which of you is afflicted with madness.
verses.translation: which of you is afflicted with madness.

verses.text: Surely your Lord knows well those who have strayed from His Way just as He knows well those who are on the Right Way.
verses.translation: Surely your Lord knows well those who have strayed from His Way just as He knows well those who are on the Right Way.

verses.text: Do not then yield to those who reject the Truth decrying it as false;
verses.translation: Do not then yield to those who reject the Truth decrying it as false;

verses.text: they would wish you to be pliant so that they too may be pliant.
verses.translation: they would wish you to be pliant so that they too may be pliant.

verses.text: And do not yield to any contemptible swearer
verses.translation: And do not yield to any contemptible swearer

verses.text: the fault-finder who goes around slandering
verses.translation: the fault-finder who goes around slandering

verses.text: the hinderer of good the transgressor the sinful;
verses.translation: the hinderer of good the transgressor the sinful;

verses.text: the coarse-grained and above all mean and ignoble;
verses.translation: the coarse-grained and above all mean and ignoble;

verses.text: (who so acts) simply because he has wealth and sons
verses.translation: (who so acts) simply because he has wealth and sons

verses.text: and whenever Our verses are rehearsed to him he says:  These are fairy-tales of times gone by.
verses.translation: and whenever Our verses are rehearsed to him he says:  These are fairy-tales of times gone by.

verses.text: Soon shall We brand him on his snout.
verses.translation: Soon shall We brand him on his snout.

verses.text: We have put them [i.e. the Makkans] to test even as We put to test the owners of the orchard when they vowed that they would gather the fruit of their orchard in the morning
verses.translation: We have put them [i.e. the Makkans] to test even as We put to test the owners of the orchard when they vowed that they would gather the fruit of their orchard in the morning

verses.text: without making any allowance (for the will of Allah).
verses.translation: without making any allowance (for the will of Allah).

verses.text: Thereupon a calamity from your Lord passed over it while they were asleep
verses.translation: Thereupon a calamity from your Lord passed over it while they were asleep

verses.text: and so by morning the orchard lay as though it had been fully harvested.
verses.translation: and so by morning the orchard lay as though it had been fully harvested.

verses.text: At daybreak they called out to one another:
verses.translation: At daybreak they called out to one another:

verses.text: Hurry to your orchard if you would gather its fruit.
verses.translation: Hurry to your orchard if you would gather its fruit.

verses.text: So off they went whispering to one another:
verses.translation: So off they went whispering to one another:

verses.text: No destitute person shall enter it today.
verses.translation: No destitute person shall enter it today.

verses.text: They went forth early believing that they had the power (to gather the fruit).
verses.translation: They went forth early believing that they had the power (to gather the fruit).

verses.text: But as soon as they beheld the orchard (they cried out):  We have certainly lost the way;
verses.translation: But as soon as they beheld the orchard (they cried out):  We have certainly lost the way;

verses.text: rather we are utterly ruined.
verses.translation: rather we are utterly ruined.

verses.text: The best among them said:  Did I not say to you: why do you not give glory to (your Lord)?
verses.translation: The best among them said:  Did I not say to you: why do you not give glory to (your Lord)?

verses.text: They cried out:  Glory be to our Lord! Certainly we were sinners.
verses.translation: They cried out:  Glory be to our Lord! Certainly we were sinners.

verses.text: Then they began to reproach one another.
verses.translation: Then they began to reproach one another.

verses.text: They said:  Woe to us! We had indeed transgressed.
verses.translation: They said:  Woe to us! We had indeed transgressed.

verses.text: Maybe our Lord will give us a better orchard in its place; to our Lord do we penitently turn.
verses.translation: Maybe our Lord will give us a better orchard in its place; to our Lord do we penitently turn.

verses.text: Such is the chastisement; and the chastisement of the Hereafter is assuredly even greater if only they knew.
verses.translation: Such is the chastisement; and the chastisement of the Hereafter is assuredly even greater if only they knew.

verses.text: Surely the God-fearing shall have Gardens of bliss with their Lord.
verses.translation: Surely the God-fearing shall have Gardens of bliss with their Lord.

verses.text: What! Shall We treat those who have submitted (to Our command) like those who have acted as criminals?
verses.translation: What! Shall We treat those who have submitted (to Our command) like those who have acted as criminals?

verses.text: What is the matter with you? How ill do you judge!
verses.translation: What is the matter with you? How ill do you judge!

verses.text: Or do you have a Book wherein you read
verses.translation: Or do you have a Book wherein you read

verses.text: that (in the Hereafter) you shall have all that you choose for yourselves?
verses.translation: that (in the Hereafter) you shall have all that you choose for yourselves?

verses.text: Or have We sworn a covenant with you which We are bound to keep till the Day of Resurrection (a covenant requiring that whatever you ordain for yourselves shall be yours)?
verses.translation: Or have We sworn a covenant with you which We are bound to keep till the Day of Resurrection (a covenant requiring that whatever you ordain for yourselves shall be yours)?

verses.text: Ask them:  Which of them can guarantee that?
verses.translation: Ask them:  Which of them can guarantee that?

verses.text: Or has something been guaranteed by any of those whom they associate with Allah in His Divinity?  If so let them bring forth their associates if they are truthful.
verses.translation: Or has something been guaranteed by any of those whom they associate with Allah in His Divinity?  If so let them bring forth their associates if they are truthful.

verses.text: On the Day when the dreadful calamity will unfold when people will be summoned to prostrate themselves and yet they will not be able to prostrate.
verses.translation: On the Day when the dreadful calamity will unfold when people will be summoned to prostrate themselves and yet they will not be able to prostrate.

verses.text: Their eyes shall be downcast and ignominy shall overwhelm them. For when they were safe and sound they were summoned to prostrate themselves (and they refused).
verses.translation: Their eyes shall be downcast and ignominy shall overwhelm them. For when they were safe and sound they were summoned to prostrate themselves (and they refused).

verses.text: So leave Me (O Prophet) to deal with him who gives the lie to this Discourse. We shall draw them little by little (to their undoing) in a way that they will not know.
verses.translation: So leave Me (O Prophet) to deal with him who gives the lie to this Discourse. We shall draw them little by little (to their undoing) in a way that they will not know.

verses.text: I am giving them a respite. Great is My scheme!
verses.translation: I am giving them a respite. Great is My scheme!

verses.text: Or are you asking them for some compensation so that they feel burdened with debt?
verses.translation: Or are you asking them for some compensation so that they feel burdened with debt?

verses.text: Or do they have any knowledge of the Unseen which they are now writing down?
verses.translation: Or do they have any knowledge of the Unseen which they are now writing down?

verses.text: So bear with patience until the Judgement of your Lord comes and do not be like the man in the fish (i.e. Jonah) who called out choking with grief:
verses.translation: So bear with patience until the Judgement of your Lord comes and do not be like the man in the fish (i.e. Jonah) who called out choking with grief:

verses.text: had his Lord not bestowed His favour upon him he would have been cast upon that barren shore (and would have remained there) in disgrace.
verses.translation: had his Lord not bestowed His favour upon him he would have been cast upon that barren shore (and would have remained there) in disgrace.

verses.text: But his Lord exalted him and included him among His righteous servants.
verses.translation: But his Lord exalted him and included him among His righteous servants.

verses.text: When the unbelievers hear this Exhortation they look at you as though they would knock you off your feet with their (hostile) glances. They say:  Surely he is afflicted with madness ;
verses.translation: When the unbelievers hear this Exhortation they look at you as though they would knock you off your feet with their (hostile) glances. They say:  Surely he is afflicted with madness ;

verses.text: although this is nothing but an Exhortation (to goodness) for everyone in the world.
verses.translation: although this is nothing but an Exhortation (to goodness) for everyone in the world.

ayahs.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: Nun. By the pen and what the scribes write.
ayahs.translation: Nun. By the pen and what the scribes write.

ayahs.text: By your Lord''s Grace you are not afflicted with madness
ayahs.translation: By your Lord''s Grace you are not afflicted with madness

ayahs.text: and surely yours shall be a never-ending reward
ayahs.translation: and surely yours shall be a never-ending reward

ayahs.text: and you are certainly on the most exalted standard of moral excellence.
ayahs.translation: and you are certainly on the most exalted standard of moral excellence.

ayahs.text: So you will soon see and they too will see
ayahs.translation: So you will soon see and they too will see

ayahs.text: which of you is afflicted with madness.
ayahs.translation: which of you is afflicted with madness.

ayahs.text: Surely your Lord knows well those who have strayed from His Way just as He knows well those who are on the Right Way.
ayahs.translation: Surely your Lord knows well those who have strayed from His Way just as He knows well those who are on the Right Way.

ayahs.text: Do not then yield to those who reject the Truth decrying it as false;
ayahs.translation: Do not then yield to those who reject the Truth decrying it as false;

ayahs.text: they would wish you to be pliant so that they too may be pliant.
ayahs.translation: they would wish you to be pliant so that they too may be pliant.

ayahs.text: And do not yield to any contemptible swearer
ayahs.translation: And do not yield to any contemptible swearer

ayahs.text: the fault-finder who goes around slandering
ayahs.translation: the fault-finder who goes around slandering

ayahs.text: the hinderer of good the transgressor the sinful;
ayahs.translation: the hinderer of good the transgressor the sinful;

ayahs.text: the coarse-grained and above all mean and ignoble;
ayahs.translation: the coarse-grained and above all mean and ignoble;

ayahs.text: (who so acts) simply because he has wealth and sons
ayahs.translation: (who so acts) simply because he has wealth and sons

ayahs.text: and whenever Our verses are rehearsed to him he says:  These are fairy-tales of times gone by.
ayahs.translation: and whenever Our verses are rehearsed to him he says:  These are fairy-tales of times gone by.

ayahs.text: Soon shall We brand him on his snout.
ayahs.translation: Soon shall We brand him on his snout.

ayahs.text: We have put them [i.e. the Makkans] to test even as We put to test the owners of the orchard when they vowed that they would gather the fruit of their orchard in the morning
ayahs.translation: We have put them [i.e. the Makkans] to test even as We put to test the owners of the orchard when they vowed that they would gather the fruit of their orchard in the morning

ayahs.text: without making any allowance (for the will of Allah).
ayahs.translation: without making any allowance (for the will of Allah).

ayahs.text: Thereupon a calamity from your Lord passed over it while they were asleep
ayahs.translation: Thereupon a calamity from your Lord passed over it while they were asleep

ayahs.text: and so by morning the orchard lay as though it had been fully harvested.
ayahs.translation: and so by morning the orchard lay as though it had been fully harvested.

ayahs.text: At daybreak they called out to one another:
ayahs.translation: At daybreak they called out to one another:

ayahs.text: Hurry to your orchard if you would gather its fruit.
ayahs.translation: Hurry to your orchard if you would gather its fruit.

ayahs.text: So off they went whispering to one another:
ayahs.translation: So off they went whispering to one another:

ayahs.text: No destitute person shall enter it today.
ayahs.translation: No destitute person shall enter it today.

ayahs.text: They went forth early believing that they had the power (to gather the fruit).
ayahs.translation: They went forth early believing that they had the power (to gather the fruit).

ayahs.text: But as soon as they beheld the orchard (they cried out):  We have certainly lost the way;
ayahs.translation: But as soon as they beheld the orchard (they cried out):  We have certainly lost the way;

ayahs.text: rather we are utterly ruined.
ayahs.translation: rather we are utterly ruined.

ayahs.text: The best among them said:  Did I not say to you: why do you not give glory to (your Lord)?
ayahs.translation: The best among them said:  Did I not say to you: why do you not give glory to (your Lord)?

ayahs.text: They cried out:  Glory be to our Lord! Certainly we were sinners.
ayahs.translation: They cried out:  Glory be to our Lord! Certainly we were sinners.

ayahs.text: Then they began to reproach one another.
ayahs.translation: Then they began to reproach one another.

ayahs.text: They said:  Woe to us! We had indeed transgressed.
ayahs.translation: They said:  Woe to us! We had indeed transgressed.

ayahs.text: Maybe our Lord will give us a better orchard in its place; to our Lord do we penitently turn.
ayahs.translation: Maybe our Lord will give us a better orchard in its place; to our Lord do we penitently turn.

ayahs.text: Such is the chastisement; and the chastisement of the Hereafter is assuredly even greater if only they knew.
ayahs.translation: Such is the chastisement; and the chastisement of the Hereafter is assuredly even greater if only they knew.

ayahs.text: Surely the God-fearing shall have Gardens of bliss with their Lord.
ayahs.translation: Surely the God-fearing shall have Gardens of bliss with their Lord.

ayahs.text: What! Shall We treat those who have submitted (to Our command) like those who have acted as criminals?
ayahs.translation: What! Shall We treat those who have submitted (to Our command) like those who have acted as criminals?

ayahs.text: What is the matter with you? How ill do you judge!
ayahs.translation: What is the matter with you? How ill do you judge!

ayahs.text: Or do you have a Book wherein you read
ayahs.translation: Or do you have a Book wherein you read

ayahs.text: that (in the Hereafter) you shall have all that you choose for yourselves?

verses.translation: And what is that indubitable event?

verses.translation: And what do you know what that indubitable event is?

verses.translation: The Thamud and the Ad denied the (possibility of a) sudden calamity calling it false.

verses.text: Then the Thamud were destroyed by an awesome upheaval;
verses.translation: Then the Thamud were destroyed by an awesome upheaval;

verses.text: and the Ad were destroyed by a furiously raging wind-storm
verses.translation: and the Ad were destroyed by a furiously raging wind-storm

verses.translation: which He let loose upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession; so that (if you had been there) you might have seen people lying prostrate as though they were uprooted trunks of hollowed palm trees.

verses.text: Pharaoh and those before him and the people of the overturned habitations all engaged in the same great sin.
verses.translation: Pharaoh and those before him and the people of the overturned habitations all engaged in the same great sin.

verses.translation: They did not follow the Messenger of their Lord and so He seized them with a severe grip.

verses.translation: Verily when the water rose to great heights We bore you upon a floating vessel (i.e. the Ark)

verses.text: so that We might make it an instructive event for you and retentive ears might preserve its memory.
verses.translation: so that We might make it an instructive event for you and retentive ears might preserve its memory.

verses.text: So when the Trumpet is blown with a single blast
verses.translation: So when the Trumpet is blown with a single blast

verses.text: and the earth and the mountains are carried aloft and are crushed to bits at one stroke
verses.translation: and the earth and the mountains are carried aloft and are crushed to bits at one stroke

verses.text: on that Day shall that indubitable event come to pass;
verses.translation: on that Day shall that indubitable event come to pass;

verses.text: when the sky will be rent asunder the grip holding it together having loosened on that Day
verses.translation: when the sky will be rent asunder the grip holding it together having loosened on that Day

verses.text: and the angels will stand on the sides with eight of them bearing aloft the Throne of your Lord on that Day.

verses.text: in a lofty Garden

verses.text: the clusters of whose fruit will be hanging low to be within reach (of the inmates of Paradise).

verses.translation: and had not known my account.

verses.text: Oh! Would that the death that came to me in the world had made an end of me!
verses.translation: Oh! Would that the death that came to me in the world had made an end of me!

verses.translation: My riches have not availed me

verses.text: (A command will be issued):  Seize him and shackle him
verses.translation: (A command will be issued):  Seize him and shackle him

verses.text: then cast him in the Fire
verses.translation: then cast him in the Fire

verses.text: then fasten him with a chain seventy cubits long.

verses.translation: He would not believe in Allah the Most Great;

verses.text: nor would he urge the feeding of the poor.
verses.translation: nor would he urge the feeding of the poor.

verses.text: Today he has been left here friendless;
verses.translation: Today he has been left here friendless;

verses.text: and has no food except the filth from the washing of wounds
verses.translation: and has no food except the filth from the washing of wounds

verses.text: which only the sinners will eat.
verses.translation: which only the sinners will eat.

verses.text: and by what you do not see

verses.text: that this is the speech of an honourable Messenger

verses.text: not the speech of a poet. Little do you believe!

verses.translation: And if he [i.e. the Prophets] had forged this Discourse and thereafter ascribed it to Us

ayahs.text: And if he [i.e. the Prophets] had forged this Discourse and thereafter ascribed it to Us
ayahs.translation: And if he [i.e. the Prophets] had forged this Discourse and thereafter ascribed it to Us

ayahs.text: We would surely have seized him by the right hand
ayahs.translation: We would surely have seized him by the right hand

ayahs.text: and then severed his life vein;
ayahs.translation: and then severed his life vein;

ayahs.text: and not one of you would have been able to withhold Us from doing so.
ayahs.translation: and not one of you would have been able to withhold Us from doing so.

ayahs.text: Surely it is a Good Counsel for the God-fearing.
ayahs.translation: Surely it is a Good Counsel for the God-fearing.

ayahs.text: We certainly know that some among you will give the lie to it
ayahs.translation: We certainly know that some among you will give the lie to it

ayahs.text: and surely it will be a cause of regret for the unbelievers.
ayahs.translation: and surely it will be a cause of regret for the unbelievers.

ayahs.text: Certainly it is a Truth of absolute certainty.
ayahs.translation: Certainly it is a Truth of absolute certainty.

ayahs.text: So glorify the name of your Lord Most Great.
ayahs.translation: So glorify the name of your Lord Most Great.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: A beseecher besought the visitation of chastisement
verses.translation: A beseecher besought the visitation of chastisement

verses.text: (a chastisement meant) for the unbelievers one which none can avert;
verses.translation: (a chastisement meant) for the unbelievers one which none can avert;

verses.text: a chastisement from Allah the Lord of the ascending steps
verses.translation: a chastisement from Allah the Lord of the ascending steps

verses.text: by which the angels and the Spirit ascend to Him in one Day the duration of which is fifty thousand years.
verses.translation: by which the angels and the Spirit ascend to Him in one Day the duration of which is fifty thousand years.

verses.text: So (O Prophet) persevere with gracious perseverance.
verses.translation: So (O Prophet) persevere with gracious perseverance.

verses.text: Verily they think that the chastisement is far off
verses.translation: Verily they think that the chastisement is far off

verses.text: while We think that it is near at hand.
verses.translation: while We think that it is near at hand.

verses.text: It shall befall on a Day whereon the sky will become like molten brass
verses.translation: It shall befall on a Day whereon the sky will become like molten brass

verses.text: and the mountains will become like dyed tufts of wool
verses.translation: and the mountains will become like dyed tufts of wool

verses.text: and no bosom friend will enquire about any of his bosom friends
verses.translation: and no bosom friend will enquire about any of his bosom friends

verses.text: although they shall be within sight of one another. The guilty one would fain ransom himself from the torment of that Day by offering his children
verses.translation: although they shall be within sight of one another. The guilty one would fain ransom himself from the torment of that Day by offering his children

verses.text: and his spouse and his brother
verses.translation: and his spouse and his brother

verses.text: and his kinsfolk who had stood by him
verses.translation: and his kinsfolk who had stood by him

verses.text: and all persons of the earth if only he could thus save himself.
verses.translation: and all persons of the earth if only he could thus save himself.

verses.text: By no means! It will be the fierce flame
verses.translation: By no means! It will be the fierce flame

verses.text: that will strip off the scalp.
verses.translation: that will strip off the scalp.

verses.text: It shall insistently summon him who turned his back and retreated
verses.translation: It shall insistently summon him who turned his back and retreated

verses.text: and amassed wealth and covetously hoarded it.
verses.translation: and amassed wealth and covetously hoarded it.

verses.text: Verily man is impatient by nature:
verses.translation: Verily man is impatient by nature:

verses.text: bewailing when evil befalls him
verses.translation: bewailing when evil befalls him

verses.text: and tight-fisted when good fortune visits him
verses.translation: and tight-fisted when good fortune visits him

verses.text: except those that pray
verses.translation: except those that pray

verses.text: and are constant in their Prayer;
verses.translation: and are constant in their Prayer;

verses.text: and those in whose wealth there is a known right
verses.translation: and those in whose wealth there is a known right

verses.text: for those that ask and those that are dispossessed
verses.translation: for those that ask and those that are dispossessed

verses.text: those who firmly believe in the Day of Recompense
verses.translation: those who firmly believe in the Day of Recompense

verses.text: and fear the chastisement of their Lord
verses.translation: and fear the chastisement of their Lord

verses.text: surely the chastisement of their Lord is a thing none can feel secure from
verses.translation: surely the chastisement of their Lord is a thing none can feel secure from

verses.text: and those who guard their private parts
verses.translation: and those who guard their private parts

verses.text: except in regard to their spouses and those whom their right hands possess for in regard to them they are not reproachable
verses.translation: except in regard to their spouses and those whom their right hands possess for in regard to them they are not reproachable

verses.text: but any who seeks to go beyond that it is indeed they who are the transgressors
verses.translation: but any who seeks to go beyond that it is indeed they who are the transgressors

verses.text: and those who fulfil their trusts and their covenants
verses.translation: and those who fulfil their trusts and their covenants

verses.text: and those who are upright in their testimonies;
verses.translation: and those who are upright in their testimonies;

verses.text: and who take due care of their Prayer:
verses.translation: and who take due care of their Prayer:

verses.text: all these shall live honourably in the Gardens.
verses.translation: all these shall live honourably in the Gardens.

verses.text: But what is the matter with the unbelievers who are hurrying towards you
verses.translation: But what is the matter with the unbelievers who are hurrying towards you

verses.text: in crowds both on the right and on the left?
verses.translation: in crowds both on the right and on the left?

verses.text: Does everyone of them wish to enter the Garden of Bliss?
verses.translation: Does everyone of them wish to enter the Garden of Bliss?

verses.text: By no means! They know that which We have created them from.
verses.translation: By no means! They know that which We have created them from.

verses.text: I swear by the Lord of the easts and the wests that We have the power
verses.translation: I swear by the Lord of the easts and the wests that We have the power

verses.text: to replace them by others who would be better than they; and We shall certainly not be overpowered.
verses.translation: to replace them by others who would be better than they; and We shall certainly not be overpowered.

verses.text: So leave them to engage in vain talk and to amuse themselves until they come face to face with the Day which they are promised
verses.translation: So leave them to engage in vain talk and to amuse themselves until they come face to face with the Day which they are promised

verses.text: the Day on which they will hastily come forth from their graves as though they were hurrying on to the altars of their deities.
verses.translation: the Day on which they will hastily come forth from their graves as though they were hurrying on to the altars of their deities.

verses.text: Their eyes will be downcast and disgrace will overwhelm them. Such is the Day that they were promised.
verses.translation: Their eyes will be downcast and disgrace will overwhelm them. Such is the Day that they were promised.

verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: We sent Noah to his people (and directed him):  Warn your people before a grievous chastisement comes upon them.
verses.translation: We sent Noah to his people (and directed him):  Warn your people before a grievous chastisement comes upon them.

verses.text: Noah said:  My people I have certainly been sent as a clear warner to you
verses.translation: Noah said:  My people I have certainly been sent as a clear warner to you

verses.text: that you serve Allah and fear Him and follow me;
verses.translation: that you serve Allah and fear Him and follow me;

verses.text: He will forgive your sins and will grant you respite until an appointed term. Indeed when Allah''s appointed term comes it cannot be deferred; if you only knew!
verses.translation: He will forgive your sins and will grant you respite until an appointed term. Indeed when Allah''s appointed term comes it cannot be deferred; if you only knew!

verses.text: He said: My Lord I called my people by night and by day
verses.translation: He said: My Lord I called my people by night and by day

verses.text: but the more I called the farther they fled.
verses.translation: but the more I called the farther they fled.

verses.text: And every time I called them so that You might forgive them they thrust their fingers into their ears and wrapped up their faces with their garments and obstinately clung to their attitude and waxed very proud.
verses.translation: And every time I called them so that You might forgive them they thrust their fingers into their ears and wrapped up their faces with their garments and obstinately clung to their attitude and waxed very proud.

verses.text: Then I summoned them openly
verses.translation: Then I summoned them openly

verses.text: and preached to them in public and also addressed them in secret.
verses.translation: and preached to them in public and also addressed them in secret.

verses.text: I said to them:  Ask forgiveness from your Lord; surely He is Most Forgiving.
verses.translation: I said to them:  Ask forgiveness from your Lord; surely He is Most Forgiving.

verses.text: He will shower upon you torrents from heaven
verses.translation: He will shower upon you torrents from heaven

verses.text: and will provide you with wealth and children and will bestow upon you gardens and rivers.
verses.translation: and will provide you with wealth and children and will bestow upon you gardens and rivers.

verses.text: What is amiss with you that you do not look forward to the majesty of Allah
verses.translation: What is amiss with you that you do not look forward to the majesty of Allah

verses.text: when He has created you in stages?
verses.translation: when He has created you in stages?

verses.text: Do you not see how Allah has created seven heavens one upon the other
verses.translation: Do you not see how Allah has created seven heavens one upon the other

verses.text: and has placed the moon in them as a light and the sun as a radiant lamp?
verses.translation: and has placed the moon in them as a light and the sun as a radiant lamp?

verses.text: And Allah has caused you to grow out of the earth so wondrously
verses.translation: And Allah has caused you to grow out of the earth so wondrously

verses.text: and He will later cause you to return to it and will then again bring you out of it.
verses.translation: and He will later cause you to return to it and will then again bring you out of it.

verses.text: Allah has made the earth a wide expanse for you
verses.translation: Allah has made the earth a wide expanse for you

verses.text: so that you may tread its spacious paths.
verses.translation: so that you may tread its spacious paths.

verses.text: Noah said:  My Lord they did not pay heed to what I said and followed those (nobles) whose possession of wealth and children has led them to an even greater loss.
verses.translation: Noah said:  My Lord they did not pay heed to what I said and followed those (nobles) whose possession of wealth and children has led them to an even greater loss.

verses.text: They contrived a plot of great magnitude.
verses.translation: They contrived a plot of great magnitude.

verses.text: They said:  Do not abandon your deities; do not abandon Wadd nor Suwa nor Yaghuth nor Yauq nor Nasr.
verses.translation: They said:  Do not abandon your deities; do not abandon Wadd nor Suwa nor Yaghuth nor Yauq nor Nasr.

verses.text: They have misled many. So do not enable these evil-doers to increase in anything except straying (from the Right Way).
verses.translation: They have misled many. So do not enable these evil-doers to increase in anything except straying (from the Right Way).

verses.text: And so they were drowned on account of their sins and then cast into the Fire and did not find any other than Allah to come forth to their help.
verses.translation: And so they were drowned on account of their sins and then cast into the Fire and did not find any other than Allah to come forth to their help.

verses.text: Noah said:  My Lord do not leave out of these unbelievers even a single dweller on earth
verses.translation: Noah said:  My Lord do not leave out of these unbelievers even a single dweller on earth

verses.text: for certainly if You should leave them (alive) they will mislead Your servants and will beget none but sinners and utter unbelievers.
verses.translation: for certainly if You should leave them (alive) they will mislead Your servants and will beget none but sinners and utter unbelievers.

verses.text: My Lord forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house as a believer and forgive all believers both men and women and do not increase the wrong-doers in anything except perdition.

verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Say (O Prophet) it was revealed to me that a band of jinn attentively listened to (the recitation of the Qur''an) and then (went back to their people) and said:
verses.translation: Say (O Prophet) it was revealed to me that a band of jinn attentively listened to (the recitation of the Qur''an) and then (went back to their people) and said:

verses.text: We have indeed heard a wonderful Qur''an which guides to the Right Way; so we have come to believe in it and we will not associate aught with Our Lord in His Divinity ;
verses.translation: We have indeed heard a wonderful Qur''an which guides to the Right Way; so we have come to believe in it and we will not associate aught with Our Lord in His Divinity ;

verses.text: and that  He   exalted be His Majesty   has not taken to Himself either a wife or a son ;
verses.translation: and that  He   exalted be His Majesty   has not taken to Himself either a wife or a son ;

verses.text: and that  the foolish among us have been wont to say outrageous things about Allah ;
verses.translation: and that  the foolish among us have been wont to say outrageous things about Allah ;

verses.text: and that  we had thought that men and jinn would never speak a lie about Allah
verses.translation: and that  we had thought that men and jinn would never speak a lie about Allah

verses.text: and that  some from among the humans used to seek protection of some among the jinn and thus they increased the arrogance of the jinn ;
verses.translation: and that  some from among the humans used to seek protection of some among the jinn and thus they increased the arrogance of the jinn ;

verses.text: and that  they thought even as you thought that Allah would never raise anyone (as a Messenger) ;
verses.translation: and that  they thought even as you thought that Allah would never raise anyone (as a Messenger) ;

verses.text: and that  we tried to pry (the secrets of) the heaven but we found it full of terrible guards and shooting meteors ;
verses.translation: and that  we tried to pry (the secrets of) the heaven but we found it full of terrible guards and shooting meteors ;

verses.text: and that  we would take up stations in the heaven to try to hear but anyone who now attempts to listen finds a shooting meteor in wait for him ;
verses.translation: and that  we would take up stations in the heaven to try to hear but anyone who now attempts to listen finds a shooting meteor in wait for him ;

verses.text: and that  we do not know whether evil is intended for those on the earth or whether their Lord intends to direct them to the Right Way ;
verses.translation: and that  we do not know whether evil is intended for those on the earth or whether their Lord intends to direct them to the Right Way ;

verses.text: and that  some of us are upright and some of us are otherwise for we follow widely divergent paths ;
verses.translation: and that  some of us are upright and some of us are otherwise for we follow widely divergent paths ;

verses.text: and that  we thought that we will neither be able to frustrate Allah on earth nor frustrate Him by flight ;

verses.translation: so that We might try them through this bounty. Whoso turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will cause him to suffer a grievous chastisement;

verses.text: and that  mosques belong to Allah so do not invoke anyone with Him ;

verses.text: Say:  Surely neither it is in my power to hurt you nor to bring you to the Right Way.

verses.text: Say:  None can protect me from Allah nor can I find a refuge apart from Him.
verses.translation: Say:  None can protect me from Allah nor can I find a refuge apart from Him.

verses.text: (They shall not change their ways) until they see that against which they had been warned and then they will know whose helpers are weaker and whose supporters are fewer in number.

ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

ayahs.text: Say (O Prophet) it was revealed to me that a band of jinn attentively listened to (the recitation of the Qur''an) and then (went back to their people) and said:
ayahs.translation: Say (O Prophet) it was revealed to me that a band of jinn attentively listened to (the recitation of the Qur''an) and then (went back to their people) and said:

ayahs.text: We have indeed heard a wonderful Qur''an which guides to the Right Way; so we have come to believe in it and we will not associate aught with Our Lord in His Divinity ;
ayahs.translation: We have indeed heard a wonderful Qur''an which guides to the Right Way; so we have come to believe in it and we will not associate aught with Our Lord in His Divinity ;

ayahs.text: and that  He   exalted be His Majesty   has not taken to Himself either a wife or a son ;
ayahs.translation: and that  He   exalted be His Majesty   has not taken to Himself either a wife or a son ;

ayahs.text: and that  the foolish among us have been wont to say outrageous things about Allah ;
ayahs.translation: and that  the foolish among us have been wont to say outrageous things about Allah ;

ayahs.text: and that  we had thought that men and jinn would never speak a lie about Allah
ayahs.translation: and that  we had thought that men and jinn would never speak a lie about Allah

ayahs.text: and that  some from among the humans used to seek protection of some among the jinn and thus they increased the arrogance of the jinn ;
ayahs.translation: and that  some from among the humans used to seek protection of some among the jinn and thus they increased the arrogance of the jinn ;

ayahs.text: and that  they thought even as you thought that Allah would never raise anyone (as a Messenger) ;
ayahs.translation: and that  they thought even as you thought that Allah would never raise anyone (as a Messenger) ;

ayahs.text: and that  we tried to pry (the secrets of) the heaven but we found it full of terrible guards and shooting meteors ;
ayahs.translation: and that  we tried to pry (the secrets of) the heaven but we found it full of terrible guards and shooting meteors ;

ayahs.text: and that  we would take up stations in the heaven to try to hear but anyone who now attempts to listen finds a shooting meteor in wait for him ;
ayahs.translation: and that  we would take up stations in the heaven to try to hear but anyone who now attempts to listen finds a shooting meteor in wait for him ;

ayahs.text: and that  we do not know whether evil is intended for those on the earth or whether their Lord intends to direct them to the Right Way ;

verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: O you the (sleeping) enwrapped one!
verses.translation: O you the (sleeping) enwrapped one!

verses.text: Stand up in Prayer by night all but a small part of it;
verses.translation: Stand up in Prayer by night all but a small part of it;

verses.text: half of it or reduce it a little;
verses.translation: half of it or reduce it a little;

verses.text: or add to it a little; and recite the Qur''an slowly and distinctly.
verses.translation: or add to it a little; and recite the Qur''an slowly and distinctly.

verses.text: Behold We shall cast upon you a Weighty Word.
verses.translation: Behold We shall cast upon you a Weighty Word.

verses.text: Surely getting up at night is the best means of subduing the self and is more suitable for uprightness in speech.
verses.translation: Surely getting up at night is the best means of subduing the self and is more suitable for uprightness in speech.

verses.text: You are indeed much occupied during the day with the affairs of the world.
verses.translation: You are indeed much occupied during the day with the affairs of the world.

verses.text: So remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with exclusive devotion.
verses.translation: So remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with exclusive devotion.

verses.text: He is the Lord of the East and the West; there is no god but He. So take Him alone for your Guardian
verses.translation: He is the Lord of the East and the West; there is no god but He. So take Him alone for your Guardian

verses.text: And bear patiently the vain things they utter and gracefully forsake them.
verses.translation: And bear patiently the vain things they utter and gracefully forsake them.

verses.text: Leave it to Me to deal with the affluent ones who give the lie (to the Truth) and bear with them for a while.
verses.translation: Leave it to Me to deal with the affluent ones who give the lie (to the Truth) and bear with them for a while.

verses.text: We have heavy fetters and a blazing Fire in store for them;
verses.translation: We have heavy fetters and a blazing Fire in store for them;

verses.text: and a food that chokes and a grievous chastisement.
verses.translation: and a food that chokes and a grievous chastisement.

verses.text: (They will come across all this) on the Day when the earth and the mountains shall tremble violently and the mountains shall crumble into heaps of scattered sand.
verses.translation: (They will come across all this) on the Day when the earth and the mountains shall tremble violently and the mountains shall crumble into heaps of scattered sand.

verses.text: Surely We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness over you just as We had sent a Messenger to Pharaoh.
verses.translation: Surely We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness over you just as We had sent a Messenger to Pharaoh.

verses.text: But Pharaoh disobeyed Our Messenger so We seized him with a terrible seizing.
verses.translation: But Pharaoh disobeyed Our Messenger so We seized him with a terrible seizing.

verses.text: If you persist in disbelieving how will you guard yourself against the (woe of the) Day that will turn children grey-haired
verses.translation: If you persist in disbelieving how will you guard yourself against the (woe of the) Day that will turn children grey-haired

verses.text: the Day whose severity shall cause the heaven to split asunder? Allah''s promise is ever bound to be fulfilled.
verses.translation: the Day whose severity shall cause the heaven to split asunder? Allah''s promise is ever bound to be fulfilled.

verses.text: Indeed this is nothing but a Good Counsel; so let him who will take a way leading to his Lord.
verses.translation: Indeed this is nothing but a Good Counsel; so let him who will take a way leading to his Lord.

verses.text: (O Prophet) your Lord knows that you sometimes stand up in Prayer nearly two-thirds of the night and sometimes half or one-third of it and so does a party of those with you; Allah measures the night and the day. He knows that you cannot keep an accurate count of it so He has shown mercy to you. So now recite as much of the Qur''an as you can. He knows that there are among you those who are sick and others who are journeying in the land in quest of Allah''s bounty and still others who are fighting in the cause of Allah. So recite as much of the Qur''an as you easily can and establish Prayer and pay Zakah and give Allah a goodly loan.Whatever good you send forth for yourselves you shall find it with Allah. That is better and its reward is greater. And ask for Allah''s forgiveness; surely He is Most Forgiving Most Compassionate.

verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: O you enveloped in your cloak!
verses.translation: O you enveloped in your cloak!

verses.text: Arise and warn
verses.translation: Arise and warn

verses.text: and magnify the glory of your Lord
verses.translation: and magnify the glory of your Lord

verses.text: and purify your robes
verses.translation: and purify your robes

verses.text: and shun uncleanness
verses.translation: and shun uncleanness

verses.text: and bestow not favour in order to seek from others a greater return
verses.translation: and bestow not favour in order to seek from others a greater return

verses.text: and persevere for your Lord''s sake.
verses.translation: and persevere for your Lord''s sake.

verses.text: When the Trumpet shall be sounded
verses.translation: When the Trumpet shall be sounded

verses.text: that will surely be a hard day
verses.translation: that will surely be a hard day

verses.text: not an easy day for the unbelievers.
verses.translation: not an easy day for the unbelievers.

verses.text: Leave Me with him whom I alone have created
verses.translation: Leave Me with him whom I alone have created

verses.text: whom I have endowed with abundant riches
verses.translation: whom I have endowed with abundant riches

verses.text: and sons ever present with him
verses.translation: and sons ever present with him

verses.text: and for whom I have smoothed the way (to power and riches)
verses.translation: and for whom I have smoothed the way (to power and riches)

verses.text: and who still greedily desires that I should bestow upon him more.
verses.translation: and who still greedily desires that I should bestow upon him more.

verses.text: By no means; he is stubbornly opposed to Our Signs.
verses.translation: By no means; he is stubbornly opposed to Our Signs.

verses.text: I shall soon constrain him to a hard ascent.
verses.translation: I shall soon constrain him to a hard ascent.

verses.text: He reflected and then hatched a scheme.
verses.translation: He reflected and then hatched a scheme.

verses.text: Ruin seize him how did he hatch a scheme?
verses.translation: Ruin seize him how did he hatch a scheme?

verses.text: Again ruin seize him how did he hatch a scheme?
verses.translation: Again ruin seize him how did he hatch a scheme?

verses.text: He looked (at others);
verses.translation: He looked (at others);

verses.text: then frowned and scowled;
verses.translation: then frowned and scowled;

verses.text: then he retreated and waxed proud
verses.translation: then he retreated and waxed proud

verses.text: and said:  This (Qur''an) is merely a sorcery of yore;
verses.translation: and said:  This (Qur''an) is merely a sorcery of yore;

verses.text: this is nothing but the word of a mere mortal!
verses.translation: this is nothing but the word of a mere mortal!

verses.text: Him shall I soon roast in Hell.
verses.translation: Him shall I soon roast in Hell.

verses.text: And what do you know what Hell is?
verses.translation: And what do you know what Hell is?

verses.text: It spares nothing; it leaves nothing intact;
verses.translation: It spares nothing; it leaves nothing intact;

verses.text: it scorches (even) the skin.
verses.translation: it scorches (even) the skin.

verses.text: Over it are nineteen keepers.
verses.translation: Over it are nineteen keepers.

verses.text: We have appointed none but angels as the keepers of the Fire and We have not made their number but as a trial for the unbelievers so that those who have been endowed with the Book will be convinced and the believers'' faith will increase and neither those who have been endowed with the Book nor the believers will fall into any doubt. As for those in whose hearts there is a sickness as well as the unbelievers they will say:  What did Allah aim at by this strange parable? Thus does Allah let whomsoever He pleases to go astray and directs whomsoever He pleases to the Right Way. And none knows the hosts of your Lord but He. (And Hell has only been mentioned here) that people may take heed.

(And Hell has only been mentioned here) that people may take heed.

verses.text: Nay by the moon
verses.translation: Nay by the moon

verses.text: and by the night when it recedes
verses.translation: and by the night when it recedes

verses.text: and by the day when it dawns (with its radiance)
verses.translation: and by the day when it dawns (with its radiance)

verses.text: surely (Hell) is one of the greatest Signs
verses.translation: surely (Hell) is one of the greatest Signs

verses.text: a warning to humankind
verses.translation: a warning to humankind

verses.text: a warning to everyone of you whether he would like to come forward or lag behind.
verses.translation: a warning to everyone of you whether he would like to come forward or lag behind.

verses.text: Each one is a hostage to one''s deeds
verses.translation: Each one is a hostage to one''s deeds

verses.text: save the People of the Right Hand
verses.translation: save the People of the Right Hand

verses.text: who shall be in the Gardens and shall ask
verses.translation: who shall be in the Gardens and shall ask

verses.text: about the guilty ones:
verses.translation: about the guilty ones:

verses.text: What drove you to Hell?
verses.translation: What drove you to Hell?

verses.text: They will answer:  We were not among those who observed Prayer
verses.translation: They will answer:  We were not among those who observed Prayer

verses.text: and we did not feed the poor
verses.translation: and we did not feed the poor

verses.text: and we indulged in vain talk with those who indulged in vain talk
verses.translation: and we indulged in vain talk with those who indulged in vain talk

verses.text: and we gave the lie to the Day of Judgement
verses.translation: and we gave the lie to the Day of Judgement

verses.text: until the inevitable event overtook us.
verses.translation: until the inevitable event overtook us.

verses.text: The intercession of the intercessors shall then be of no avail to them.
verses.translation: The intercession of the intercessors shall then be of no avail to them.

verses.text: What is the matter with people that they are turning away from this Exhortation
verses.translation: What is the matter with people that they are turning away from this Exhortation

verses.text: as though they were frightened wild asses
verses.translation: as though they were frightened wild asses

ayahs.translation: and who still greedily desires that I should bestow upon him more.

ayahs.translation: By no means; he is stubbornly opposed to Our Signs.

ayahs.translation: I shall soon constrain him to a hard ascent.

ayahs.translation: He reflected and then hatched a scheme.

ayahs.text: Ruin seize him how did he hatch a scheme?
ayahs.translation: Ruin seize him how did he hatch a scheme?

ayahs.text: Again ruin seize him how did he hatch a scheme?

ayahs.translation: He looked (at others);

ayahs.translation: then he retreated and waxed proud

ayahs.translation: and said:  This (Qur''an) is merely a sorcery of yore;

ayahs.text: this is nothing but the word of a mere mortal!
ayahs.translation: this is nothing but the word of a mere mortal!

ayahs.text: Him shall I soon roast in Hell.
ayahs.translation: Him shall I soon roast in Hell.

ayahs.text: And what do you know what Hell is?
ayahs.translation: And what do you know what Hell is?

ayahs.text: It spares nothing; it leaves nothing intact;
ayahs.translation: It spares nothing; it leaves nothing intact;

ayahs.text: it scorches (even) the skin.
ayahs.translation: it scorches (even) the skin.

ayahs.text: Over it are nineteen keepers.
ayahs.translation: Over it are nineteen keepers.

ayahs.text: We have appointed none but angels as the keepers of the Fire and We have not made their number but as a trial for the unbelievers so that those who have been endowed with the Book will be convinced and the believers'' faith will increase and neither those who have been endowed with the Book nor the believers will fall into any doubt. As for those in whose hearts there is a sickness as well as the unbelievers they will say:  What did Allah aim at by this strange parable? Thus does Allah let whomsoever He pleases to go astray and directs whomsoever He pleases to the Right Way. And none knows the hosts of your Lord but He. (And Hell has only been mentioned here) that people may take heed.

verses.text: This will be a gushing spring wherefrom Allah''s servants shall drink wine a spring from which they will take out channels wherever they wish.

verses.text: These will be the ones who fulfil their vows and dread the Day whose woe shall be spread far and wide;

verses.translation: (saying): We feed you only for Allah''s sake; we do not seek of you any recompense or thanks

verses.text: we fear from our Lord a Day that shall be long and distressful.

verses.text: and will reward them for their steadfastness with Paradise and robes of silk.
verses.translation: and will reward them for their steadfastness with Paradise and robes of silk.

verses.text: Whither to you look around you will see an abundance of bliss and the glories of a great kingdom.

ayahs.text: These will be the ones who fulfil their vows and dread the Day whose woe shall be spread far and wide;
ayahs.translation: These will be the ones who fulfil their vows and dread the Day whose woe shall be spread far and wide;

ayahs.text: those who for the love of Him feed the needy and the orphan and the captive
ayahs.translation: those who for the love of Him feed the needy and the orphan and the captive

ayahs.text: (saying): We feed you only for Allah''s sake; we do not seek of you any recompense or thanks
ayahs.translation: (saying): We feed you only for Allah''s sake; we do not seek of you any recompense or thanks

ayahs.text: we fear from our Lord a Day that shall be long and distressful.
ayahs.translation: we fear from our Lord a Day that shall be long and distressful.

ayahs.text: So Allah shall guard them against the woe of that Day and will procure them freshness and joy
ayahs.translation: So Allah shall guard them against the woe of that Day and will procure them freshness and joy

ayahs.text: and will reward them for their steadfastness with Paradise and robes of silk.
ayahs.translation: and will reward them for their steadfastness with Paradise and robes of silk.

ayahs.text: There they will recline on elevated couches and will be subjected neither to the burning heat of the sun nor to bitter cold.
ayahs.translation: There they will recline on elevated couches and will be subjected neither to the burning heat of the sun nor to bitter cold.

ayahs.text: The shades of Paradise will bend over them and its fruits will be brought within their easy reach;
ayahs.translation: The shades of Paradise will bend over them and its fruits will be brought within their easy reach;

ayahs.text: and there shall be passed around them vessels of silver and goblets of crystal
ayahs.translation: and there shall be passed around them vessels of silver and goblets of crystal

ayahs.text: goblets bright as crystal but made of silver filled to exact measure.
ayahs.translation: goblets bright as crystal but made of silver filled to exact measure.

ayahs.text: Therein they shall be served a cup flavoured with ginger
ayahs.translation: Therein they shall be served a cup flavoured with ginger

ayahs.text: drawn from a spring (in Paradise) called Salsabil.
ayahs.translation: drawn from a spring (in Paradise) called Salsabil.

ayahs.text: There boys of everlasting youth shall go about attending them: when you see them you would think that they are scattered pearls.
ayahs.translation: There boys of everlasting youth shall go about attending them: when you see them you would think that they are scattered pearls.

ayahs.text: Whither to you look around you will see an abundance of bliss and the glories of a great kingdom.
ayahs.translation: Whither to you look around you will see an abundance of bliss and the glories of a great kingdom.

ayahs.text: They [i.e. the virtuous] shall be attired in garments of fine green silk and rich brocade and will be adorned with bracelets of silver.Their Lord will give them a pure wine to drink.
ayahs.translation: They [i.e. the virtuous] shall be attired in garments of fine green silk and rich brocade and will be adorned with bracelets of silver.Their Lord will give them a pure wine to drink.

ayahs.text: Behold this is your recompense and your endeavour has been appreciated.
ayahs.translation: Behold this is your recompense and your endeavour has been appreciated.

ayahs.text: (O Prophet) indeed We have revealed the Qur''an to you in portions.
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet) indeed We have revealed the Qur''an to you in portions.

ayahs.text: So persevere with the command of your Lord and do not pay any heed to the wicked and the unbelieving
ayahs.translation: So persevere with the command of your Lord and do not pay any heed to the wicked and the unbelieving

ayahs.text: and remember the name of your Lord morning and evening;
ayahs.translation: and remember the name of your Lord morning and evening;

ayahs.text: and prostrate yourself before Him at night and extol His Glory during the long watches of the night.
ayahs.translation: and prostrate yourself before Him at night and extol His Glory during the long watches of the night.

ayahs.text: Verily they love (the good of this world) that is hastily obtainable and are oblivious of the burdensome Day ahead of them.
ayahs.translation: Verily they love (the good of this world) that is hastily obtainable and are oblivious of the burdensome Day ahead of them.

ayahs.text: We created them and strengthened their joints; and whenever We wish We can change their faces entirely.
ayahs.translation: We created them and strengthened their joints; and whenever We wish We can change their faces entirely.

ayahs.text: Verily this is an Exhortation; so let him who so will take a way to his Lord.
ayahs.translation: Verily this is an Exhortation; so let him who so will take a way to his Lord.

ayahs.text: But your willing shall be of no avail until Allah Himself so wills. Surely Allah is All-Knowing Most Wise.
ayahs.translation: But your willing shall be of no avail until Allah Himself so wills. Surely Allah is All-Knowing Most Wise.

ayahs.text: He admits to His Mercy whomsoever He pleases. As for the wrong-doers He has prepared for them a grievous chastisement.
ayahs.translation: He admits to His Mercy whomsoever He pleases. As for the wrong-doers He has prepared for them a grievous chastisement.

verses.text: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate
verses.translation: In the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate

verses.text: By the (winds) sent forth in quick succession
verses.translation: By the (winds) sent forth in quick succession

verses.text: which then blow tempestuously
verses.translation: which then blow tempestuously

verses.text: and raise (clouds) and scatter them around
verses.translation: and raise (clouds) and scatter them around

verses.text: then winnow them thoroughly
verses.translation: then winnow them thoroughly

verses.text: and then cast (Allah''s) remembrance (in people''s hearts)
verses.translation: and then cast (Allah''s) remembrance (in people''s hearts)

verses.text: to serve as an excuse or a warning.
verses.translation: to serve as an excuse or a warning.

verses.text: Surely what you are promised shall come to pass.
verses.translation: Surely what you are promised shall come to pass.

verses.text: So when the stars are extinguished
verses.translation: So when the stars are extinguished

verses.text: and the sky is rent asunder
verses.translation: and the sky is rent asunder

verses.text: and the mountains are blown away
verses.translation: and the mountains are blown away

verses.text: and the appointed time to bring the Messengers together arrives (then shall the promised event come to pass).
verses.translation: and the appointed time to bring the Messengers together arrives (then shall the promised event come to pass).

verses.text: To which Day has this task been deferred?
verses.translation: To which Day has this task been deferred?

verses.text: To the Day of Judgement.
verses.translation: To the Day of Judgement.

verses.text: What do you know what the Day of Judgement is?
verses.translation: What do you know what the Day of Judgement is?

verses.text: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
verses.translation: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!

verses.text: Did We not destroy many a nation of the earlier times?
verses.translation: Did We not destroy many a nation of the earlier times?

verses.text: And We shall cause those of later times to follow them.
verses.translation: And We shall cause those of later times to follow them.

verses.text: Thus do We deal with the guilty.
verses.translation: Thus do We deal with the guilty.

verses.text: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
verses.translation: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!

verses.text: Did We not create you of a mean fluid
verses.translation: Did We not create you of a mean fluid

verses.text: which We then placed in a secure repository
verses.translation: which We then placed in a secure repository

verses.text: until an appointed time?
verses.translation: until an appointed time?

verses.text: See that We had the power to do so. Great indeed is Our power to do what We will.
verses.translation: See that We had the power to do so. Great indeed is Our power to do what We will.

verses.text: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
verses.translation: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!

verses.text: Did We not make the earth a receptacle
verses.translation: Did We not make the earth a receptacle

verses.text: for the living and the dead
verses.translation: for the living and the dead

verses.text: and did We not firmly fix towering mountains on it and give you sweet water to drink?
verses.translation: and did We not firmly fix towering mountains on it and give you sweet water to drink?

verses.text: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
verses.translation: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!

verses.text: Proceed now towards that which you were wont to deny as false;
verses.translation: Proceed now towards that which you were wont to deny as false;

verses.text: proceed towards the three-pronged shadow
verses.translation: proceed towards the three-pronged shadow

verses.text: which neither provides (cooling) shade nor protection against the flames;
verses.translation: which neither provides (cooling) shade nor protection against the flames;

verses.text: it indeed throws up sparks like castles
verses.translation: it indeed throws up sparks like castles

verses.text: which seem as though they are yellow-coloured camels.
verses.translation: which seem as though they are yellow-coloured camels.

verses.text: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
verses.translation: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!

verses.text: That will be the Day on which they will not (be able to) utter a word
verses.translation: That will be the Day on which they will not (be able to) utter a word

verses.text: nor will they be allowed to proffer excuses.
verses.translation: nor will they be allowed to proffer excuses.

verses.text: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
verses.translation: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!

verses.text: That is the Day of Judgement on which We have assembled you as well as all those who went before you.
verses.translation: That is the Day of Judgement on which We have assembled you as well as all those who went before you.

verses.text: So if you have any ploy try it against Me!
verses.translation: So if you have any ploy try it against Me!

verses.text: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
verses.translation: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!

verses.text: Behold today the God-fearing will be amidst shades and springs
verses.translation: Behold today the God-fearing will be amidst shades and springs

verses.text: and the fruits that they desire (will be ready at hand).
verses.translation: and the fruits that they desire (will be ready at hand).

verses.text: Eat and drink and may every joy attend you as a reward for your deeds.
verses.translation: Eat and drink and may every joy attend you as a reward for your deeds.

verses.text: Thus do We reward those that do good.
verses.translation: Thus do We reward those that do good.

verses.translation: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!

verses.text: Eat and enjoy yourselves for a while.Surely you are evil-doers.
verses.translation: Eat and enjoy yourselves for a while.Surely you are evil-doers.

verses.translation: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!

verses.text: that they are in utter disagreement?

verses.text: No indeed; soon will they come to know;

verses.text: again no indeed; soon will they come to know.

verses.text: and fixed the mountains like pegs

verses.text: and created you in pairs (as men and women)

verses.text: and made your sleep a means of repose

verses.text: and made the night a covering

verses.text: and made the day to seek livelihood

verses.text: and built above you seven strong firmaments

verses.text: and placed therein a hot shining lamp

verses.text: and sent down abundant water from the clouds

verses.text: so that We may thereby bring forth grain and vegetation

verses.text: and gardens dense with foliage?

verses.text: Surely the Day of Judgement has an appointed time;

verses.text: the Day when the Trumpet shall be blown and you will come forth in multitudes;

verses.text: and when the sky shall be opened up and will become all doors;

verses.text: and the mountains will be set in motion and become a mirage.

verses.text: they shall taste in it no coolness nor any pleasant drink

verses.text: And everything have We recorded in a Book.

verses.text: So taste (the fruit of your deeds). We shall only increase your torment.
verses.translation: So taste (the fruit of your deeds). We shall only increase your torment.

verses.text: gardens and vineyards

verses.text: and youthful maidens of like age

verses.text: and an overflowing cup.

verses.text: Therein they shall hear no idle talk nor any falsehood;
verses.translation: Therein they shall hear no idle talk nor any falsehood;

verses.text: a recompense from your Lord and an ample reward
verses.translation: a recompense from your Lord and an ample reward

verses.text: from the Lord of the heavens and the earth and of that which is between them; the Most Merciful Lord before Whom none dare utter a word.

verses.text: The Day when the Spirit and the angels are ranged row on row. None shall speak save he whom the Merciful Lord will permit; and he too will speak what is right.
verses.translation: The Day when the Spirit and the angels are ranged row on row. None shall speak save he whom the Merciful Lord will permit; and he too will speak what is right.

verses.text: That Day is sure to come. So let him who will seek a resort with his Lord.
